name: Flappy Pro: Design Your Game
description:
Flappy Pro – Customize, Fly & Beat Your High Score!

Experience the classic flappy gameplay with a whole new level of personalization. Flappy Pro lets you create your own unique version of the game by customizing the bird, backgrounds, pipes, and sound effects using files from your device.

Tap to fly, avoid obstacles, beat your high score, and enjoy endless fun—whether you're online or offline.

 Features
 Fully Customizable Gameplay

Make the game truly yours by personalizing:
*  Bird appearance
*  Background images
* Pipe themes
* Jump sound
* Score sound
* Crash/Game Over sound

Choose images and audio files directly from your device using the built-in file picker. Your selected files remain on your device and are never uploaded.

 Classic Endless Arcade Fun

Enjoy the addictive tap-to-fly gameplay inspired by classic arcade games.

* Simple one-touch controls
* Endless gameplay
* Fast-paced action
* Easy to learn, challenging to master

 Dynamic Difficulty

As your score increases, the challenge grows.
* Faster gameplay
* More challenging obstacles
* Test your reflexes and improve your skills

Smooth Gaming Experience

Designed for responsive and enjoyable gameplay with:

* Modern user interface
* Smooth animations
* Visual hit effects
* Optimized performance
* Low-latency sound playback

 Play Anytime, Anywhere

* Works offline
* No account required
* Quick to start
* Lightweight and fast

Why You'll Love Flappy Pro

Unlike traditional flappy games, Flappy Pro allows you to customize the entire experience with your own images and sounds. Create a fun, unique game that reflects your personal style while enjoying endless arcade action.

Challenge yourself, beat your highest score, and see how far you can fly!

Download Flappy Pro today and create your own personalized flappy adventure.

name: Dunder City
description:
Biscuit is missing. Your first line of Python sends the search party to the street where he was last seen. By the end of the case, the night desk is running on software you wrote.

THE LOST DOG REGISTRY
Start with one witness card. Predict what your code will print, change the line, then try it on a new sighting. Across 12 scenes, you issue badges, reunite the right dog, and recover a damaged registry without losing the original.

THE GRIMOIRE
Take the night watch at a weather observatory. In 12 more scenes, turn cryptic weather reports into readings, track corrections across midnight, and assemble a dawn bulletin from functions you wrote yourself.

AFTER HOURS
Who gets the next patrol? Build a dispatch engine that ranks open reports, breaks ties, and never sends two teams to the same badge. A new shift brings different calls to test your decisions.

SIGNAL LAB
Turn a list of sightings into a glowing search route. Edit the Python, run it, and replay the drawing one mark at a time. Try a wind chart or design a registry seal, then share your source.

New to coding? Each scene has a worked example, hints, and a place to try your own input without changing your score. Already know Python? Head straight for the commissions.

All lessons run offline. Your code and case journal stay on this device. No sign-in or subscription.

name: Rifflefolio
description:
The gauge gives you a number. Your fieldbook tells you what that number felt like.

Rifflefolio pairs USGS river readings with your own trip notes. Open a familiar station, check the observation time and compare its flow with the last day you spent on that river.

FIND YOUR WATER
Search U.S. stream gauges by name or station number, or narrow the search by state. Bookmark a gauge to keep it close. See discharge and gauge height when the station reports them.

LOOK BEYOND THE LATEST READING
Inspect daily mean flows across seven days, a month, three months or a year. Tap a point to see the date and flow. A new reading and a daily average are different measurements; the chart distinguishes them.

REMEMBER THE RUN
Save the section you paddled, the date and what the water felt like. Add a flow, water-character tags and a note in your own words. Compare a reading with your nearest and most recent logged flows at the same gauge.

TAKE YOUR FIELDBOOK OFFLINE
Reopen cached readings and write trip notes without an account. Your journal is stored on the device where you create it. New gauge searches and fresh data require an internet connection.

Rifflefolio uses data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Coverage varies by station, and provisional readings can change. Comparisons describe your own records, not navigability or safety. Rifflefolio is independent of USGS.

name: Teleprompter Caleb
description:
Teleprompter Caleb convierte tu iPhone en un estudio de grabación portátil para leer tus guiones con fluidez natural mientras miras directo al lente.


  

CARACTERÍSTICAS PRINCIPALES:
• Lectura fluida a 60/120 Hz con control de velocidad y tamaño de letra.
• Guía visual alineada junto a la cámara frontal para contacto visual natural.
• Cámara en vivo a pantalla completa (frontal o trasera) en 1080p Full HD o 4K.
• Biblioteca de múltiples guiones con editor rápido, contador de palabras y tiempo estimado.
• Modo Espejo horizontal para teleprompters profesionales de cristal.
• Cuenta regresiva configurable (0s, 3s o 5s) y guardado directo en Fotos.


  

PRUEBA GRATUITA Y DESBLOQUEO ÚNICO:
• Lectura, edición de guiones y modo espejo siempre disponibles.
• Incluye 3 grabaciones de video gratuitas para que pruebes todas las funciones.
• Desbloqueo PRO de por vida con un único pago económico, sin suscripciones ni cobros mensuales.

name: The Corridor
description:
"There's no way out, Joseph. Not until you remember."

You wake on the floor of a condemned apartment building, your head pounding, a card on the floor beside you: "You let her out once, Mr. Keller. Not again." The lights are failing. The exit is chained shut. And in the kitchen, something inside a chained wardrobe is knocking, and begging to be let out.

Open it, and the night starts over. The same doors, the same rooms, but never quite the same. Each loop the building gives back a little more of what happened on 13 October 1985, and a little more of what you did.

The Corridor is a first-person psychological horror game about a place that keeps repeating, a doll that is never where you left her, and a tall man in a plague mask and top hat who walks the halls tapping his cane.

SIX LOOPS, EACH ITS OWN KIND OF FEAR
• The Wardrobe · The Call · Every Word · 13 October 1985 · Hold Your Breath · No
• A payphone that rings with calls from a year ago, word for word
• A building that goes dark, a garage beneath it, and a door that should never be opened

PUZZLES THAT LIVE IN THE WORLD
• Breaker panels, keypads, a caretaker's code book, numbers scratched into a wall, a car radio in the dark
• No arrows, no markers. Read the notes, listen to the calls, look closer

A TORCH AND NOTHING ELSE
• No weapons. Hide in wardrobes, keep to the dark and keep moving
• He hears you run. If he sees you, he comes for you

A STORY YOU PIECE TOGETHER
• Newspapers, drawings, photographs, phone calls, and the notes Mr. Hale leaves for you
• Every loop ends with a reveal

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
• Touch controls: a stick under your left thumb, drag to look, and a hand button that appears whenever there's something to use
• Fills the whole screen on iPhone. The game saves at the start of every loop, so Continue takes you back to the loop you reached
• Subtitles for every line, adjustable look speed, and options to reduce flashing and camera shake

Play with headphones, in the dark.

Content note: horror themes, a murder, blood, jump scares, flashing lights and loud sudden sounds. Recommended for ages 16 and up.

A game by Particles, with Sentinel Den.

name: OARVIKO: Rowing Race Game
description:
Row hard, time every stroke and race down the rapids. OARVIKO is a 3D arcade rowing game where you control each oar on its own.

Race the AI on five rivers, chase record times, then take the fight online against friends and other players.

FEATURES
• Control each oar separately and sync your strokes for speed
• Dodge obstacles and read currents and bends
• Five rivers with AI opponents, plus a tutorial guide
• Time trials with medals, multi-race cups and solo challenges
• Daily challenge with streaks and a weekly league to climb
• Quick online matches, or private rooms by code for up to 4 players, with rematches
• Earn shells to customize your boat, oars, paint, decals, outfits, hats, pennants, trails, celebrations and pets
• Track records, medals, cups, achievements and unlocks

OARVIKO is free to play. Optional shell packs are available as in-app purchases.

name: CineCam Studio
description:
CineCam – More Than Just a Camera.
Discover what your iPhone camera can do with CineCam!
CineCam is designed for those who want to get more out of their iPhone camera. It combines an easy-to-use camera interface with advanced photography and video recording capabilities in one single app.
Why CineCam?
More Possibilities in One App
Take photos, record videos, create slow-motion footage, time-lapse videos, or capture moments using other creative recording modes. There's no need to switch between different apps.
You're in Control of the Camera
Don't rely only on automatic settings! With manual controls, you can adjust your recordings according to your own preferences. Customize settings such as ISO, shutter speed, and white balance.
Professional Tools When You Need Them
Advanced camera features help you gain greater control over your recordings. Use various image analysis and monitoring tools for a more informed video recording experience.
A Clean and Intuitive Interface
CineCam is designed to remain easy to use while offering advanced capabilities. Access important settings quickly, allowing you to focus more on capturing the moment.
All Your CineCam Recordings in One Place
With your own CineCam Library, you can easily find the photos and videos captured with the app.
No Subscriptions, No In-App Purchases
Purchase CineCam once and enjoy its features without additional in-app purchases or recurring subscription fees. No hidden costs – just one purchase.
Your Privacy Matters
CineCam takes your privacy seriously. Your photos and videos stay on your own device. The app does not upload or transmit your recordings to external servers. Your personal recordings remain under your control.
Made for Those Who Want to Create More
Whether you're capturing everyday moments or creating creative videos, CineCam gives you more possibilities to bring your own ideas to life.
CineCam – Capture More. Create More.

name: Brain Playground: Gentle Games
description:
Brain Playground is a set of gentle brain games for older adults. Big text, big buttons and a kind voice make it easy to enjoy on your own or together with family.

■ 15 games
• Numbers – from counting pictures to adding, taking away, times tables and making change
• Matching Pairs – turn over two cards at a time to find all the pairs
• Watch and Tap – watch the friends light up, then tap them in the same order
• Shopping – remember a short shopping list, then pick those items from the shelf
• Odd One Out – spot the one picture that is different
• Tap in Order – tap the scattered numbers in order
• Read the Clock – choose the time the clock shows
• What day is it? – questions about today, like the day and the month
• Go Together – find what goes together, like rain and an umbrella
• Seasons – which season does it belong to?
• Name It – choose the right name for the picture
• Picture Puzzle – put the pieces of a picture back in place
• Memory Lane – a picture quiz and a memory album of things from days gone by, like a rotary phone or a record player
• Let's Move – clap along and follow gentle stretches in a chair
• Feelings – match a face or an everyday moment to how it feels

■ Six levels
Level 1 is the gentlest and Level 6 asks the most.
The level is only a starting point: go up if it feels easy, go down if it feels hard. After a very good game, the app offers to go up a level, and after a hard one, it offers a gentler level. Staying where you are is fine too.
Not sure where to start? "Find a level" asks a few easy questions and suggests a comfortable place to begin. It is not a test.
Next time you open the app, it goes straight to the games for the level played last.

■ Made with care
• A different animal friend guides each level by voice: Chirpy, Hoppy, Buddy, Teddy, Kitty and Bamboo
• Tap the speech bubble to hear it again
• Kind words only, never a scolding, and every game ends with a cheer
• No time limits for answering
• "Stop" asks before leaving a game, so a stray tap won't end it
• The layout still fits when your device's text size is set larger
• Turn the sound off with the speaker button at the top right
• Every game works without the internet
• Works on iPhone and iPad
• Play in English or Korean (the Korean version adds two Korean word games)
• The animal friends' voices were made with AI and are built into the app

■ Your privacy
No sign-up, no ads and no tracking.
The app collects no data and sends nothing on its own. It keeps only three settings on your device: the level played last, the sound setting and the language.
Nothing is shared unless you tap a share button. "Share this" (after a game) and "Share this app" open your device's share sheet, where you choose how to send it and who gets it. "Share this" includes a cheer card picture and a short note; "Share this app" includes a short note. Both come with a link to the app. Scores, levels and personal details are never shared.

■ Please note
Brain Playground is a set of games, made simply to be enjoyed. It is not a medical device, and it does not test or measure anyone's health or abilities.
For Let's Move, sit in a chair and go slowly. If anything hurts, stop right away.
If you are worried about memory, please talk to your doctor.

name: Mani - Caderno de Esmaltes
description:
Mani é o caderno de quem faz as próprias unhas em casa.

SUA COLEÇÃO EM UM LUGAR
• Fotografe o frasco e o Mani lê a cor do esmalte.
• Veja todos os seus esmaltes por cor e acabamento.
• Na hora de comprar, o Mani avisa se você já tem uma cor parecida.

O ESMALTE DA SEMANA
• Registre até 3 cores por semana, o número de camadas e o top coat.
• Marque o dia em que pintou e o dia em que lascou para saber quantos dias o esmalte dura.
• Guarde uma foto das unhas de cada semana. As fotos ficam só no seu aparelho.

TIMER DE SECAGEM
• O Mani sugere o tempo de secagem de acordo com as camadas e avisa quando o esmalte está seco.

AULAS AO VIVO
• Guias ensinam o passo a passo em aulas ao vivo. Quem assiste acompanha e comenta.
• As aulas mostram só as mãos.
• Você pode denunciar aulas e comentários e bloquear qualquer pessoa.

MANI+
A coleção, o registro da semana, o timer de secagem e as aulas ao vivo são sempre gratuitos. Com a assinatura Mani+, você assiste a todas as aulas gravadas, inclusive as exclusivas.

Assinatura mensal com renovação automática. A cobrança é feita na sua conta da App Store e renova todo mês, a menos que você cancele pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período. Você pode cancelar quando quiser nos Ajustes do iPhone.

O Mani é para pessoas com 18 anos ou mais.

name: GIFOX: GIF Keyboard & Stickers
description:
Your GIFs and stickers, one tap away in every chat.

GIFOX is a keyboard for iPhone that keeps the GIFs and stickers you love right where you type. Make your own, save the ones you find, and send the perfect reaction in Messages, WhatsApp, Instagram, Snapchat or any app with a text box.

MAKE YOUR OWN GIFS
• Turn any video into a GIF: trim it and pick the quality
• Import GIFs from Photos, Files, the share sheet or anything you copy
• GIFOX keeps one copy of each, so your library stays tidy

STICKERS IN ONE TAP
• Cut the subject out of a GIF and get a moving sticker with no box
• Use them in the keyboard or as an iMessage sticker pack

A REAL KEYBOARD
• Favorites, your GIFs, stickers and GIF search right above the keys
• Swipe typing, autocorrect, next-word suggestions and emoji search
• Numbers-only pad for codes and amounts
• Light, dark and themed looks

TRANSLATE AS YOU TYPE
• Write in your language and send it in theirs
• Translate a message you got with one tap
• Many languages work offline on your iPhone

CLIPBOARD HISTORY
• Everything you copy, text and images, in the keyboard
• Pin what you reuse; passwords are skipped

AI WRITING HELP
• Rewrite, fix grammar, make it friendlier or more formal
• Get reply ideas for a message you got, or check your tone
• Free with Apple Intelligence on iPhones that support it

GIFOX PLUS (OPTIONAL)
• ChatGPT writing help right in your keyboard, no API key needed
• 7 days free for new subscribers, then yearly or monthly
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your GIFs, stickers and clipboard stay on your iPhone
• The keyboard never sends what you type; text leaves your iPhone only when you use search, online translation or AI

GIF search is powered by KLIPY.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zeus1me.github.io/gifox/privacy.html

name: Hairpin Havoc
description:
Throw a tiny car sideways into a hairpin, hold the drift, and fire out of the corner with a boost. Hairpin Havoc is a top-down pixel-art racer built for quick, frantic races on your iPhone and iPad.

• RACE A FULL GRID: Take on nine rivals over three laps on ten tracks.
• DRIFT TO WIN: Longer slides charge bigger boosts. Chain them together and burn nitro on the straights.
• GRAB ITEMS: Hit item boxes for tricks like oil slicks and jammers, and spin out rivals to earn points.
• BUILD YOUR GARAGE: Earn credits to unlock 7 cars, install upgrades, pick paint jobs and equip gadgets.
• CHASE GHOSTS: In Time Trial, race your best lap, copy your ghost as a code and challenge friends to beat it.
• MADE FOR TOUCH: Point a joystick where you want to go, or switch to arrow buttons. Throttle is automatic.

No ads, no accounts, no internet connection required. Your progress stays on your device.

Grab the wheel and start drifting.

name: HBCW - CW - Code Morse
description:
Le Morse s'apprend avec les oreilles, pas en comptant. hbcw t'apprend la télégraphie (CW) comme une musique, avec la méthode des radioamateurs qui y arrivent vraiment.

DEUX LETTRES POUR COMMENCER
Tu démarres avec K et M. Une nouvelle lettre arrive seulement quand tu reconnais les autres à 90 %. C'est la méthode Koch, utilisée depuis les années 1930.

LES SIGNES À VRAIE VITESSE
Chaque signe est joué vite, à 20 mots par minute ou plus, pour que tu entendes sa mélodie au lieu de compter les points et les traits. Ce sont les silences qui s'allongent au début (espacement de Farnsworth).

LE RÉFLEXE AVANT TOUT
hbcw mesure ton temps de réaction sur chaque signe. Tant que tu hésites, il revient. Quand la réponse sort toute seule, il est acquis.

CINQ FAÇONS DE T'ENTRAÎNER
Station : ta séance du jour et ta prochaine lettre.
Oreille : réflexes, groupes de cinq façon examen, mots et abréviations radio.
Manip : tape le Morse toi-même, manipulateur droit ou iambique.
Bande : une bande radio simulée, des stations t'appellent par ton indicatif, tu fais de vrais QSO.
Défis : sprints, trophées et records.

LE DÉCODEUR
Pose ton téléphone près de ta radio : hbcw écoute par le micro et écrit le Morse reçu. Le son est analysé en direct sur le téléphone, rien n'est enregistré.

WIDGETS ET APPLE WATCH
Ta série et ta prochaine lettre sur l'écran d'accueil. Sur l'Apple Watch, de courtes séances au son ou au poignet, en vibrations.

SUR TOUS TES APPAREILS
Un compte facultatif garde ta progression et te permet de continuer sur ton iPad, un autre téléphone ou dans le navigateur. Sans compte, tout reste sur ton téléphone.

Aucune licence n'est nécessaire pour apprendre. Pas de publicité, aucun suivi.

hbcw est une app netVD, faite en Suisse. 73 et à bientôt sur l'air.

name: Rubble to Riches: Idle Tycoon
seller_name: THE FINE GROUP IC VE DIS TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Start in a small town with a single crew. Haggle with the landowner, win the neighbours over and raise the building floor by floor. Sell the flats, collect the rent and use what you earn to open the next lot. When the town is done, the big city is waiting, and after that, cities around the world.

WHAT YOU DO
• Haggle with landowners: you name the share, they come back with a counter-offer.
• Build floor by floor: you choose the materials, the facade and the quality.
• Sell and rent out flats. Rent keeps coming in and your crew keeps working while you are away.
• Renovate old buildings and transform the neighbourhood.
• Bid in tenders and win big projects such as schools, hospitals and stadiums.
• Compete with rival builders for the same lots.

COLLECT YOUR CRAFTSMEN
Craftsmen from journeyman to legend join your crew. Each has a trade and a strength: one works fast, one finishes renovations in half the time, one earns the building an extra star. They level up as they work, and the bigger your collection, the faster every site moves.

CITY AFTER CITY
Every city has 21 buildings, its own neighbourhoods and its own story. Finish a city and your holding grows, and the next city opens.

AT YOUR OWN PACE
• No account needed. Your game is saved on your phone.
• No forced ads. Ads play only when you choose to watch one for a reward.
• Play for a few minutes a day, or for hours.

The game is free to play and contains optional rewarded ads and in-app purchases.

Questions and suggestions: info@zavlongames.com

name: YADAHub
description:
YADAHub is the staff app for schools that use YADA. School directors, teachers and counselors get the whole school on their phone: who is slipping, how every class is doing, and the exams that show it.

KNOW WHO NEEDS HELP
• A risk score for every student that explains itself: engagement, weak chapters, trend and recency.
• Alerts flag students whose results or activity drop, so you can act early.
• Student 360: results, study plan, notes, cases and wellbeing in one profile.

FOLLOW EVERY CLASS
• Class average, pass rate, median and quartiles, compared with the previous weeks.
• Chapter view, weakest first, so you know what to reteach.
• Ready-made groups (reteach, practise, extension) you can save and assign work to.
• Trends, leaderboards, question analysis and syllabus progress.

MAKE EXAMS FAST
• Write an exam yourself, with maths and science formulas.
• Generate questions with AI from your own textbooks.
• Import printed pages, a PDF or a Word file.
• Reuse released exams and worksheets from your school's Exam Bank.
• Paper exams: print answer sheets, scan them with the camera and let YADAHub mark them.

RESULTS THE MOMENT THEY LAND
• Ranked results, per-question correct rates and chapter breakdowns for every exam.
• Choose when students see their scores.

AI COACH
• Ask about your school in plain English: who needs attention, which subjects are weakest, what went wrong on an exam. Answers use your school's data and show their sources.

BUILT FOR SCHOOLS
• Separate views for directors, teachers and counselors; teachers see only their own classes.
• Light and dark mode.

YADAHub needs a staff account issued by a school that uses YADA. Students use the YADA app.

name: Standiz – bureau de l'accueil
description:
Standiz est l’accueil de votre établissement, animé par Vérity : elle répond à vos clients jour et nuit, au téléphone et sur votre page d’accueil, prend leurs messages, leurs demandes de rappel et leurs rendez-vous.

L’application Standiz est votre bureau, dans la poche :
• Aujourd’hui : les rendez-vous du jour, ceux à confirmer et les messages urgents, en tête.
• Messages : chaque demande résumée par Vérity, l’appel et sa durée, et « Ce qui a été dit » pour relire l’échange.
• Appeler : rappelez un client d’un geste, depuis sa fiche.
• Traité, À rappeler, Rouvrir : votre liste reste à jour.
• Rendez-vous : confirmez, déplacez ou annulez ; le client est prévenu par e-mail quand il en a donné un.
• Questions sans réponse : répondez une fois, Vérity saura répondre la fois suivante.
• Réglages : horaires de rendez-vous, adresse courte de votre page d’accueil, badge du comptoir.
• Avis des nouveaux messages et des rendez-vous à confirmer, même application fermée, et pastille sur l’icône. Les avis ne montrent ni nom ni numéro.
• Protection par Face ID ou par le code de l’iPhone, si vous le souhaitez.
• Sans réseau, l’application l’indique clairement et rouvre votre bureau dès le retour du réseau.

Cette application est réservée aux établissements qui utilisent déjà Standiz : on ne peut ni s’inscrire ni rien acheter dans l’application. Ouvrez-la avec le lien de votre bureau, reçu par e-mail.
Les noms des captures sont des exemples.

name: 10ScienceQ – Daily Science
description:
10 questions. Every day. Science made fun.

Play a five-minute science challenge at your level, from plants, animals and the weather to magnets, circuits and the Moon, then on to cells, atoms, genetics, energy, stars and the story of the Earth. Miss a question? Get a tip and try again, then see the answer explained.

Everyone playing the same level gets the same daily questions, so families, classes and friends can play along and talk it over. Want another round? Each level has its own daily 10.

No account. No ads. No subscriptions.

10 LEVELS, FROM STARTER TO EARTH & SPACE
• Young scientists: alive or not, floats or sinks, the five senses, animal groups, solids, liquids and gases, seasons, food chains and life cycles, read aloud
• Growing scientists: planets, circuits, conductors, sound and light, adaptations, rocks, forces, mixtures and the phases of the Moon
• Teens and grown-ups: cells, the periodic table, atoms, energy, fair tests and graphs, DNA and genetics squares, evolution, density, electricity, waves, chemical equations, plate tectonics, stars and climate

SCIENCE YOU CAN TRUST
• More than 6,500 questions, each fact checked against trusted sources such as NASA, NOAA, USGS, NIH and OpenStax, listed in the app
• Diagrams drawn by the app: circuits, food chains, Moon phases, charts, genetics squares
• Mainstream science explained calmly, as taught in schools
• Questions test understanding, not sums
• Nothing to try at home with fire, chemicals or electricity

LEARN AS YOU GO
• A gentle tip after a miss, then one more try
• Harder questions have an optional hint
• Tap to hear a question read aloud
• A new set of 10 questions every day
• Study guides included with Levels 6–10

A HABIT, NOT HOMEWORK
• About five minutes a day
• A daily streak that never scolds: miss a day and it simply starts again
• Share your score as 10 little squares, without your name, age or level
• A cheer for every right answer

SAFE AND PRIVATE
• No tracking and no data collected: your progress stays on your device
• Any purchase is behind a grown-up check

FREE TO PLAY
Levels 1–5 are free every day. Levels 6–10 are free for 7 days; after that, Advanced Levels is a one-time purchase. Extra Practice is a separate one-time purchase that adds 10 more questions after the daily round, at any level you can play.

Made by I See, I Spell, I Learn, LLC, makers of 10MathQ, 10WordsQ, 10LogicQ, 10GeographyQ, Picture Sight Words and Picture Homophones.

name: 11:11 Arcade
description:
No ideas. No propaganda. No nothing. Just flow.

Every month the gnomes throw a masquerade. Everyone was invited, which was the mistake. The animals came. The vampires came for the punch and stayed to laugh at their own jokes. The zombie cyborgs came because nobody told them the last party was over, and they have not looked up since. Somebody is still waiting at a table for two. You are the only one who came without a mask, and nobody remembers inviting you either.

11:11 Arcade is 24 endless arcade games played with one touch:

LEAP - hold to orbit a light, let go to fly to the next.
FLIP - tap to cross between the walls as the spikes close in.
SWING - hold to hook and swing, let go to fly.
GRAZE - hold to rise, let go to fall, and fly as close to the cave wall as you dare.
BOUNCE - it bounces by itself; tap to slam down onto the next pad.
ECHO - cross the floor. Every crossing you make keeps replaying and becomes the traffic for the next one.
DROP - it flies over by itself; tap to let the parcel go, and allow for the wind.
VAULT - hold to wind up, let go to jump, before the ground gives way.
SHIFT - hold for pink, let go for blue, and match every gate.
CREEP - hold to climb, let go to stop, and slip between the sliders.
SWELL - hold to blow the bubble up, let go to bank it before anything touches it.
JUGGLE - tap when one is on the line. Each has its own rhythm, and more keep arriving.
RUSH - you cannot stop and you cannot jump. Hold to run, let go to walk.
SPIN - round the ring you go; tap to turn back before the darts arrive.
GUARD - hold to swing the shield one way, let go for the other.
SQUEEZE - let go to grow, hold to shrink; big scores, small fits.
MIRROR - two sparks on one string: when one rises the other falls. Thread both.
WHIRL - a ball on a chain goes round you; hold to let the chain out, let go to reel it in.
TWIST - hold to turn the bar, let go to leave it; it only turns one way.
TEETER - the pole wants to fall; hold to push right, let go to push left.
LAND - hold to burn; touch down gently, with as little fuel as you dare.
HUSH - you never stop climbing; hold and everything else stands still, for as long as the stillness lasts.
ZAP - the gun never stops turning; tap to fire when it points at something.
DIVE - hold to go down, let go to come up; bring the pearls home before the air runs out.

- Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum medals in every game
- An Elite score beyond Platinum: a costume to wear from every game, and unmasked guests dancing along behind you. Choose which eleven follow you.
- 24 original tracks, one to start every game
- A masquerade: cloaked guests in old Venetian masks drift through every game. Bump into one to see who it was, and fill the guest book with all fifteen to become the guest of honour.
- Unmask a vampire and a blood moon doubles every bonus. Unmask a zombie cyborg and its rotting clock drags the game into slow motion.
- Now and then someone turns up uninvited: a vampire hanging by his feet, a zombie cyborg who cannot put its phone down, a snowman who came anyway.
- A season for every month of the year, from New Year through Easter, Midsummer, a crayfish party and Halloween to Christmas, each with its own weather, things to bump into and things the gnomes should not be doing. Switch them off if you want the quiet version.
- At 11:11, morning and night, the wishing minute: eleven stars fall, the bells ring eleven times and every bonus counts double for sixty seconds. Play a game during the minute to earn its wish star.
- A golden goose that lays a golden egg every time you catch it, and a black swan whose egg nobody can predict: a windfall, a crash, or nothing much at all.
- No ads. No accounts. Plays offline.
- Something that should not exist is said to cross the screen now and then.

Every game is free to try. Unlock a single game, any six games of your own choosing, or all 24 at once. Bought a pack already? The rest costs less. You pay once: no subscriptions.

name: 13-Line Quran: IndoPak Tajweed
description:
100% FREE FOREVER • ZERO ADS • 100% OFFLINE • NO SUBSCRIPTIONS
Authentic 848-Page 13-Line Colour-Coded IndoPak Tajweed Mushaf with 13 Haramain & Tajweed Qaris, Spoken English & Urdu Audio, and Hifz Satar-Posh Memorization Shield across iPhone and iPad.

• 100% Offline 848-Page 13-Line IndoPak Colour-Coded Tajweed Mushaf: High-clarity South Asian calligraphy with instant 0ms Single-Page Portrait & Dual-Page Facing Book Spread across iPad and automatic landscape rotation on iPhone
• Daily Juz Default (1 Juz / Day): Save your preferred Full, Half, or Quarter Juz/Para profile once (Qari, playback speed, Ayah repeat count, Play 1x or Loop, and spoken English/Urdu/Phonetics) and switch Juz 1–30, all 114 Surahs (Yaseen, Al-Kahf, Al-Mulk, Ar-Rahman, Al-Waqiah), or 7 Manzils in one tap
• Hifz Memorization Suite: Satar-Posh Line-Masking Self-Test Shield (smooth drag & Ayah-by-Ayah stepping), Teacher Mistake Pins & Notes across facing pages, Page Side Looping, and Multi-Reciter Rotation
• 13 Renowned Haramain & Tajweed Master Reciters: Sheikh Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais, Sheikh Sa'ud ash-Shuraym, Sheikh Maher Al-Muaiqly, Sheikh Abu Bakr Ash-Shatri, Sheikh Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary (Muallim & Murattal), Dr. Ayman Rushdi Suwayd (Tajweed Master), Sheikh Muhammad Siddiq Al-Minshawi (Teacher & Murattal), Sheikh Ali Abdur-Rahman Al-Hudhaify, Sheikh Abdul Basit Abdus Samad, Sheikh Mishary Rashid Alafasy, and Sheikh Muhammad Ayyub, plus spoken Urdu & English translations
• Fine-Grained Pitch-Preserving Speed (0.75x–2.0x including 1.1x, 1.2x & 1.25x), Lock Screen & Control Center audio transport, and Eye-Comfort Paper Tints (Parchment, Warm Sepia, Masjid Sage & Night Tajweed)
• 100% Privacy-First: Zero ads, zero subscriptions, zero trackers, zero account sign-ups

Offered humbly as a perpetual Sadaqah Jariyah in loving honour of Haji Mohammed Sardar and Hajan Zainab Bibi. Please remember them generously in your sincere du'as.

Pas un réseau pro de plus. Un club.

25/35 réunit des entrepreneurs, dirigeants et profils ambitieux de 25 à 35 ans. Ici, on ne parle pas de chiffre d'affaires ni de levée de fonds. On parle de ce qu'on écoute, de ce qu'on lit, du dernier risque qu'on a pris. On découvre la personne derrière l'entrepreneur.

UNE QUESTION PAR JOUR
Elle tombe à une heure différente chaque jour, entre 11 h et 19 h. « Ta musique du jour ? » « Montre-nous ton bureau. » « Le conseil que tu aurais aimé recevoir à 20 ans ? » Répondez en texte, en photo ou en musique. Les réponses du club se dévoilent seulement une fois la vôtre publiée.

LE FIL
Un moment, une idée, une découverte. Un disque, un livre, une table, une expo. On commente, on réagit, mais sans compteur d'abonnés ni course aux likes.

LES MEMBRES
Des fiches qui racontent la personne avant le CV. Une réponse vous parle ? Écrivez directement à son auteur.

LES SOIRÉES
Le club ne vit pas que dans l'app. Un rendez-vous par saison : dîners, concerts privés, visites, rencontres. On s'inscrit en un geste, puis on retrouve les photos partagées par ceux qui y étaient.

SUR CANDIDATURE
25/35 est un club privé. Chaque candidature est lue par l'équipe, pour garder un club cohérent, où l'on a envie de se rencontrer.

Candidatez sur club2535.com.

name: 3726 MDPL : Sejalur
description:
Rangga and Andini set out for the summit of Mount Rinjani. Their trail branches, their supplies are limited, and each stop holds clues for the next leg of the climb.

Pack at Basecamp and choose between a forest trail and a riverside route. Clean trail markers, assemble a bridge, and pitch a tent. Read the wind on the savanna, sketch the ridgeline with a pencil, and choose your path to sunrise at the summit.

Use the route map, inventory, and journal to track what you discover. Keep an eye on supplies, water, and both hikers’ condition along the way. Story Mode lets you take the journey at a more relaxed pace.

A single-player 2D puzzle adventure with painterly illustrations and instrumental music. Choose Indonesian or English in Settings. Play in landscape with local saves, offline play, and no accounts, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: 3X Pray
description:
3X Pray helps you pray three times a day, morning, noon, and night, with a simple, private prayer list.

WRITE YOUR PRAYERS
Add the people and needs on your heart. Edit them, reorder them, and mark them answered when God moves.

CHECK THEM OFF
Morning, noon, and night each have their own checklist that starts fresh every day. Tap each prayer as you pray it.

PRAY MY LIST
Walk through your list one prayer at a time, at your own pace. If you recorded a prayer in your own voice, it plays as you pray.

RECORD YOUR VOICE (OPTIONAL)
Record a prayer in your own words, save it privately, and replay it any time.

REMINDERS
Get gentle reminders at the times you choose for morning, noon, and night prayer.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
See your daily completion, your streak, and your progress through a 7, 15, 30, 90, or 365-day prayer challenge. Share your progress with friends without sharing your prayers.

DAILY REFLECTION
Write a short reflection each day and look back on what God has done.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your prayers, reflections, and recordings are private to your account. No ads. Sign in with Apple, Google, or email, and delete your account any time from the Me tab.

"Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice." Psalm 55:17 (KJV)

name: 4Champz Chess
description:
4Champz Chess is the companion app for students of 4Champz chess classes.

• Join your live classes with your coach
• Follow your lessons step by step: chapters, slide shows and homework
• Solve puzzles and practise on an interactive board
• Explore Labs for openings, endgames and tactics
• See your rating, streak, badges and homework scores
• Parents can follow progress and upcoming classes

An account is created by 4Champz when a student joins a class.

name: 711 Metrics Laboratory
description:
Explore mathematics and data analysis through educational materials covering numerical patterns, data distributions, mathematical models, and statistical concepts. Learn how datasets are organized and discover relationships between different numerical variables.

Work with interactive tools to compare datasets, perform calculations, and explore mathematical relationships. Charts and visual comparisons help make complex information easier to understand. Save your work and revisit previous calculations whenever you want.

Develop your mathematical skills through interactive exercises. Identify unusual values in datasets, complete numerical matrices, and solve mathematical tasks. Review your answers, track your learning progress, and explore different methods of working with data.

The application combines educational resources, practical tools, and interactive exercises in a convenient environment designed to support mathematical learning and data exploration.

name: 7Drink: Thai Drink Mixes
description:
Make viral iced drinks from Thai convenience-store products in two minutes.

7Drink is a pocket guide for travellers in Thailand: grab a cup of ice at the counter, a few drinks from the fridge, and mix something amazing.

• 200+ recipes with real photos — layered sodas, jelly drinks, vitamin and electrolyte mixes, protein shakes, coffee, Thai tea and adult cocktails
• Exact products and prices in baht, so you know what to buy and how much it costs
• Mix builder: choose a cup, drop the ice in, pour drinks and watch the layers — shake the phone to mix
• Food sets, sandwiches, onigiri, burgers and ready meals, with a spicy / not spicy label on every dish
• Hangover helpers, sport and hydration drinks, low-sugar picks and kids' drinks
• Alcohol sale hours in Thailand and no-alcohol holidays
• 12 languages and local currency conversion
• Works offline

Prices are approximate and can differ by store. 7Drink is an independent guide and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by 7-Eleven or any brand shown. Drink responsibly; alcohol is sold in Thailand only to people aged 20+.

name: 99 Offline Games: No WiFi Fun
description:
Ninety-nine different games in one small app, and every one plays without internet.

Trending puzzles: ball sort, water sort, screw out, block fit, arrow out, hex stack, triple tiles and car jam. Classics: sudoku, mines, nonogram, 2048, slide 15, mazes and magic squares. Board games against the phone or a friend on the same screen: chess, checkers, reversi, four in a row, mancala, mill, hex and ludo. Cards: klondike, freecell, tripeaks, pyramid, go fish and crazy eights. Arcade: snake, brick breaker, pinball, bowling, air hockey, archery and more. Brain training: memory, reflex and focus games.

Browse 63 categories, keep favourites, pick up a saved game where you left it, and try the game of the day.

Easy, normal and hard levels. Light and dark look. Plays in 11 languages.

The app shows ads between games and offers one purchase that removes them.

name: Aboosto Taxi
description:
Aboosto brings the ways you move around and get things done into one simple app. Book a taxi across town, reserve your seat on an intercity bus, send a parcel, or order food from restaurants near you.

TAXI RIDES
* Set your pickup from GPS or drop a pin on the map, then choose where you're going
* See the route, distance, travel time and arrival time before you book
* Choose Standard, Comfort or Premium and see the fare upfront
* Compare offers from nearby drivers: name, rating, car, plate number and how far away they are. Then pick the one you want
* Track your driver live on the map and call them right from the app

BUS TICKETS
* Search intercity routes and departure times
* Choose your exact seat on a live seat map
* Get a digital e-ticket with a unique QR code, and download it as a PDF
* Keep all your bookings together in My Bookings

PARCEL DELIVERY
* Send parcels with pickup and drop-off details
* Track any parcel with its tracking code, including recipients who don't have an account
* Follow every stage of the delivery on a clear timeline

FOOD DELIVERY
* Browse restaurants that deliver near you
* Explore menus, add dishes to your cart and check out in a few taps
* Follow your order from the kitchen to your door

PAY YOUR WAY
* Pay in cash, or with telebirr or eBirr
* Prices are always shown in Ethiopian Birr (ETB), with no surprises
* For taxi rides, nothing is charged when you book. You settle the fare when the trip is over

MADE FOR YOU
* Notifications when your driver, ticket, parcel or order is updated
* Light and dark themes, or follow your device setting
* Manage your account, signed-in devices and settings, or delete your account at any time from within the app

Download Aboosto and move smarter, travel together.

name: Abraj System
description:
أبراج هو النظام الداخلي لشركة أبراج ومعاملها. التطبيق لموظفي الشركة فقط: لا يمكن إنشاء حساب من داخله، ومدير النظام هو من ينشئ حساب كل موظف ويوافق على هاتفه.

ما يفعله الموظف من هاتفه:
• القبان: تسجيل دخول الصهاريج وخروجها وأوزانها، وطباعة ورقة القبان.
• الاستلام والمبيعات: متابعة الصهاريج وأوامر التجهيز والكميات.
• الحسابات: حساب كل زبون وناقل، والمقبوض والمتبقي وأعمار الديون.
• القاصة: سندات الصرف والوارد مع صورة الوصل من كاميرا الهاتف، والرواتب والسلف.
• التدقيق والموافقات: المدقق يراجع ويعتمد، وتصل طلبات الموافقة بإشعار على الهاتف.
• صاحب المشروع: كل المعامل في شاشة واحدة.

الحماية: كل هاتف يُسجَّل بمفتاح داخل شريحة الأمان فيه، ولا يدخل النظام إلا بعد موافقة مدير النظام، والدخول ببصمة الوجه بلا كتابة كلمة المرور.

للاستفسار: abraj.sys@gmail.com

name: Abrar Charity
description:
Abrar Charity helps you share meals with families facing hunger, support orphans and help build mosques.

• Choose a cause and give once or every month, starting from one meal.
• Our registered local partners deliver the food where it is needed most.
• Get updates from the field and an email receipt for every donation.
• Optional donor account: keep your details, see all your donations and receipts.
• Available in 13 languages, including Arabic, German, French and Turkish.

Donations are made on the charity's secure Stripe payment page in Safari. Monthly gifts can be stopped at any time.

name: Abyssia: Sea Animal Explorer
description:
PHOTOGRAPH 106 REAL SEA ANIMALS
Clownfish, sea turtles, octopuses, manta rays, humpback whales, penguins, narwhals and anglerfish that glow in the dark. Swim close and tap to take a photo: closer photos earn more stars, and rare golden animals hide in every sea.

TRUE FACTS, READ ALOUD
Every animal in the Sea Guide has three true facts (the next ones unlock as you take better photos), its family, what it eats and its real size next to yours. Pip reads everything aloud, so children who can't read yet can play on their own. You can even listen to the calls of whales, dolphins, seals and more.

FIVE SEAS OF THE WORLD
Travel on the world map to:
- the Coral Sea: coral reefs, kelp forests and the dark twilight and midnight zones
- Antarctica: dive under the sea ice and meet Pip's penguin family
- the Mediterranean by Spain: seagrass meadows, octopuses and Roman amphorae on the sand
- the Arctic: belugas, narwhals, walruses and a polar bear paddling overhead
- Mangrove Bay in the Caribbean: mangrove roots full of baby fish, manatees and lemon shark pups

NIGHT DIVES
After a couple of expeditions the moon comes out: glowing plankton, fluorescent coral, coral spawning, parrotfish asleep in their bubbles, the northern lights over the ice and animals that only come out in the dark.

EXPEDITIONS THAT NEVER END
Every dive brings new goals: photograph an animal, bring a lost baby back to its family, free an animal from a lost fishing net, count a group of fish, plant baby corals, pick up litter, swim through bubble rings and open sunken treasure. New expeditions keep coming, for ever, in every sea.

HELP THE OCEAN
On Turtle beach, baby sea turtles hatch at night and need your help to reach the sea: switch off the bright lamps that confuse them, pick up the litter and fill in the holes. Pip explains why, just as it happens on real beaches.

MORE TO PLAY
- Pip's Ocean Quiz: who is bigger, who eats what, which sea of the world
- Who lives where?: sort animals into their homes
- Fish Lab: design your own fish and take it diving
- Pip's notebook: why the sea looks blue, why deep-sea animals glow, how whales breathe
- Badges to win and a present from Pip every day

UPGRADE YOUR SUB
Earn pearls on every dive and spend them in the Sub Dock: a stronger hull to dive deeper, brighter lights, a faster engine, sonar, a little buddy, new paint and 11 hats for Captain Pip.

NOBODY GETS STUCK
No lives and no losing. Goals are always within reach, Pip gives hints, and a friendly hand shows the youngest players what to do.

MADE FOR YOUNG EXPLORERS (AGES 5-9)
- English and Spanish (Spain), following the device language
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no chat
- Works offline: nothing is collected and nothing leaves the device
- Settings behind a grown-up gate: language, music, sounds, read aloud, and a progress page for parents
- Every animal, sound and song is made for the game

Privacy policy: https://www.denxiik.com/policies/kido-games/abyssia/

name: Academia da Venda
seller_name: UP VENDAS GESTAO DE PAGAMENTOS SA
description:
A Academia da Venda é a plataforma de aprendizado da UP Vendas para quem vende. Acesse aulas em vídeo, treinamentos e conteúdos práticos para melhorar seus resultados no dia a dia.

Aprenda no seu ritmo, onde estiver, e acompanhe a sua evolução.

O que você encontra:
* Aulas em vídeo, inclusive em formato curto e vertical
* Treinamentos organizados para quem trabalha com vendas
* Acompanhamento do tempo assistido de cada aula
* Acesso para revendedoras com mais de uma empresa, com troca de empresa dentro do app
* Compartilhamento de conteúdos com a sua equipe

Para quem é:
Revendedoras, vendedores e equipes que usam a UP Vendas e querem se desenvolver com conteúdo direto ao ponto.

Entre com o seu acesso e continue aprendendo.

name: Account Vault - Login Log
description:
Keep your work, personal, and spare accounts organized by app. Account Vault helps you find the right account when you need it.

• Start with a directory of apps for your region, or add your own.
• Save multiple accounts per app and organize them by category with notes.
• Search apps and accounts, and favorite the accounts you use most.
• Save a password if you wish. Viewing or copying it requires device authentication.
• Change the interface language or preset region while keeping the apps and accounts you've added.

Your records stay on your device. Open an app or website from Account Vault and sign in there.

name: Acessio Gestão
description:
O Acessio Gestão leva para o celular as decisões do controle de acesso da sua unidade. Os cadastros que chegam pelo autocadastro, os documentos enviados e os agendamentos pedidos esperam por você numa só lista, com aviso por notificação.

O QUE VOCÊ FAZ NO APP
• Aprovações: cadastros, documentos, pessoas pendentes e agendamentos, com todos os dados à vista antes de decidir
• Conferência completa: Aprovar e Recusar só aparecem depois que você passa por todo o conteúdo
• Documentos: CNH, ASO, NRs e CRLV com validade e situação, e o pedido do que falta
• Agenda: o dia da unidade, agendar pessoas e veículos, cancelar, encerrar período e agendar os aprovados
• Fila da unidade: quem espera, a posição de cada um e o Chamar
• Convites: links de autocadastro, direto ou completo, por link ou QR
• Busca por nome, placa ou código
• Tema claro ou escuro

SEGURANÇA
• O celular é pareado com a organização por um administrador, e cada pessoa entra com o próprio PIN ou com biometria
• Verificação de integridade do aparelho e conexão protegida
• Telas com dados pessoais não aceitam print
• A sessão se encerra sozinha depois de um tempo sem uso

ACESSO
O app é para organizações que usam o Acessio. O celular precisa ser pareado na web por quem administra o Acessio na sua organização. Para conhecer o Acessio, visite nuvem.net.

name: Acx Totality Lite
description:
ACX Totality Lite is a high-performance, enterprise-grade Real Estate CRM mobile client engineered specifically for property developers, sales managers, and real estate professionals. Designed to streamline lead management from initial enquiry to final unit booking, the app empowers sales teams to close deals faster and never miss a follow-up.

HOW ACX TOTALITY LITE WORKS:

1. Unified Lead Capture & Inflow:
Instantly receive leads from marketing campaigns, property portals, and channel partners in real-time. View source attribution, campaign performance, and initial enquiry requirements.

2. Visual Pipeline & Workflow Stages:
Organize prospects through an interactive Kanban board and customizable pipeline stages (New, Contacted, Site Visit Scheduled, Negotiation, Booked). Move leads with a single swipe and monitor stage conversion rates.

3. Site Visits & Scheduling:
Schedule and log property site visits directly from the field. Track visit statuses (Scheduled, Completed, Cancelled), add client feedback, and automatically trigger post-visit follow-up tasks.

4. Smart Follow-ups & Reminders:
Stay on top of calls, meetings, and WhatsApp follow-ups with automated agenda reminders and timely push notifications so no opportunity goes cold.

5. "Ask ACX" AI Workspace:
Experience next-generation conversational CRM. Ask questions in natural language to generate instant lead summaries, conversion stats, KPI breakdowns, and recommended next actions in real-time.

6. Executive Performance Dashboard:
Sales managers can monitor overall team metrics, lead inflows, inventory availability, booking trends, and communications in a unified dashboard.

KEY FEATURES:
• Visual Kanban & List Views for seamless pipeline management
• Real-time lead assignment and status updates
• Site visit scheduling with calendar reminders
• AI-powered CRM assistant ("Ask ACX") with streaming responses
• Push notifications for follow-ups, escalations, and hot leads
• Multi-theme support (Clean Light, Dark, and Gemini Aurora themes)
• Enterprise-grade data protection and encrypted sessions

WHO IS THIS APP FOR?
• Real Estate Developers & Project Heads
• Real Estate Sales Managers & Executives
• Channel Partners & Property Brokers

Note: ACX Totality Lite is an enterprise application. An active organizational account provisioned by your system administrator is required to access the platform.

name: ADB Fire Cleaner
description:
Take control of your Fire TV or Android TV from your iPhone or iPad. ADB Fire Cleaner helps you review supported preinstalled apps and turn off the ones you don’t use—without uninstalling them.

Connect to a TV on your Wi-Fi, browse its apps, and choose what to turn off. Use Quick Clean for a guided cleanup, or manage apps individually. Restore points and undo tools help you reverse changes, and you can turn everything back on whenever you need to.

Features

Find TVs on your Wi-Fi or connect by address
Review apps and turn off supported preinstalled apps
Check available storage and running apps
Save and manage multiple TVs
Use the remote, capture screenshots, and set a sleep timer with Pro
ADB debugging must be enabled on your TV. Your TV will ask you to approve the connection.

ADB Fire Cleaner Pro is available as a one-time in-app purchase. No subscription.

name: AdHoc – Planuri spontane
description:
AdHoc te ajută să transformi „ce facem diseară?” într-un plan concret, cu oameni din jur.

Vezi pe hartă ce se întâmplă aproape de tine — o partidă de șah, un meci de fotbal pe sintetic, o seară de board games, o degustare de vin sau o plimbare foto prin oraș — și cere să participi în câteva secunde.

CUM FUNCȚIONEAZĂ
• Descoperi: hartă și listă cu evenimentele din apropiere, filtre pe categorii și pe zile.
• Participi: intri direct sau îi trimiți gazdei o cerere, cu un mesaj scurt.
• Vorbești: chat de grup pentru fiecare eveniment și mesaje directe cu gazda.
• Organizezi: creezi un eveniment în două minute — loc, oră, număr minim și maxim de participanți, reguli, cost împărțit sau fix.

GAZDA ARE CONTROLUL
• Aprobi sau refuzi fiecare cerere și vezi profilul și evaluările celui care vrea să vină.
• Setezi un număr minim de participanți și un termen: dacă nu se strâng destui, evenimentul se anulează automat și toată lumea e anunțată.
• Adresa exactă poate rămâne ascunsă până accepți pe cineva.
• Evenimente care se repetă săptămânal sau o dată la două săptămâni.
• Copertă din galerie sau generată cu AI din titlu și descriere, marcată clar ca imagine AI.

SIGURANȚĂ
• Evaluări după fiecare eveniment, pentru gazde și pentru participanți.
• Poți raporta sau bloca orice persoană sau eveniment; rapoartele sunt verificate de echipa AdHoc.
• Evenimente doar pentru adulți sau doar pentru femei, când gazda alege asta.
• Îți poți șterge contul oricând, direct din aplicație.

AdHoc este gratuit. Costurile unui eveniment (teren, bilete, ingrediente) se stabilesc între participanți, în afara aplicației.

Termeni: https://adhoc-app.ro/termeni
Confidențialitate: https://adhoc-app.ro/confidentialitate

name: Ads Manager Marketing Suit
description:
Ads Manager Marketing Suit — Wholesale Quotes & Orders

Business Quote Flow is a practical business management application designed for small businesses, retailers, wholesalers, entrepreneurs, and marketing professionals.

Organize product information, prepare wholesale quotations, manage sales orders, track inventory, and review marketing activities through one structured workspace.

BUSINESS DASHBOARD

View important business information through a clear and organized dashboard.

- Review sales and quotation summaries.
- Monitor product inventory.
- Track open orders and business activities.
- Review recorded revenue and costs.
- Explore performance charts and business trends.

PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

Keep product information organized and accessible.

- Create and manage product records.
- Organize products by SKU and category.
- Manage product variants and prices.
- Review product availability.
- Track inventory movements.
- Monitor stock levels and replenishment needs.

WHOLESALE QUOTATIONS

Prepare and organize product quotations for business sales.

- Create quotations with multiple products.
- Configure quantity-based pricing.
- Apply discounts and calculate totals.
- Review quotation status and expiration dates.
- Maintain quotation revisions.
- Organize accepted and pending quotations.
- Convert accepted quotations into sales orders.

SALES ORDER MANAGEMENT

Manage business orders through structured records.

- Create and update sales orders.
- Add products and quantities.
- Calculate order totals and discounts.
- Review order processing status.
- Track inventory reservations.
- Maintain fulfillment and shipment records.
- Review sales history.

INVENTORY & PURCHASING

Organize stock and purchasing activities.

- Track product quantities.
- Review warehouse inventory.
- Record stock additions and reductions.
- Organize supplier information.
- Maintain purchase order records.
- Review incoming stock and goods receipts.

MARKETING CAMPAIGNS

Organize marketing plans and monitor manually recorded performance.

- Create marketing campaign records.
- Set advertising budgets and objectives.
- Track recorded spending and revenue.
- Record impressions, clicks, and conversions.
- Calculate CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, and ROAS.
- Compare campaign results and budget usage.

BUSINESS ANALYTICS & REPORTS

Review business activities using performance summaries.

- Explore sales revenue trends.
- Review quotation and order statistics.
- Compare product performance.
- Monitor inventory information.
- Analyze marketing campaign results.
- Review financial summaries.
- Generate reports from recorded business information.

SIMPLE BUSINESS WORKSPACE

Business Quote Flow helps users maintain organized business records and review operational performance.

The application does not require account registration or an external advertising account connection.

Business information is entered directly within the application and stored locally on the device.

Financial summaries and marketing metrics are calculated from the available records.

name: Ads Manager Offer Lap
description:
Plan product bundles, compare pricing options, and decide how to use shared stock with Ads Manager Offer Lap. Keep the assumptions behind each decision alongside the results you record later.

Create a local product catalog with unit costs and your own images. Combine products into offers, set quantities and selling prices, and enter packaging, shipping, payment fees, and advertising assumptions. Review estimated contribution per order against your chosen contribution floor.

Compare scenarios such as a discount, standard delivery, or customer pickup. Saved offer versions preserve their original terms, so you can revisit the assumptions behind a comparison as your catalog changes.

Plan several offers against the same available stock. Enter a planning window, availability, and order limits, then compare allocations and see shortages before activating a plan. Alternative allocations are evaluated separately. Saving a plan reserves planning capacity without changing physical stock quantities.

Use the decision journal to save your allocation, reasoning, and a frozen snapshot of its products, costs, quantities, and scenarios. Later product edits do not rewrite that snapshot. Create a linked revision when you want to reconsider a decision.

Record daily net product revenue, advertising spend, and completed purchases manually against a saved decision. Add a source note or local image or PDF evidence. Corrections retain an audit history, and voided results leave the totals while remaining available for review. Home summarizes recorded results for your selected date range, including revenue, spend, average cost per purchase, and return on ad spend. Future estimates stay separate from recorded performance.

Explore the included 12-product Demo, then switch to the separate My Business workspace for your own records. Export selected results or a saved decision as CSV or PDF. Export a complete workspace backup, including owned media, and validate it before restoring to a separate workspace or confirming a replacement.

Work offline without an account. Records and imported media are stored locally. The app includes no ad publishing, advertising-platform connection, cloud synchronization, tracking SDK, payments, subscriptions, or third-party ads. Its native interface adapts to iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo, with Dynamic Type and layouts that respond to the available space. The current interface is in English and monetary values use USD.

All planning estimates depend on the costs, prices, fees, availability, and demand limits you enter. Estimated contribution is not net profit or a guarantee of sales. Tax is excluded, and returns or overhead affect estimates only when included in your entered assumptions.

**Key Features**

- Product catalog with unit costs, optional reference retail prices, and local images.
- Offer composition with component quantities, selling terms, fees, and advertising assumptions.
- Scenario comparisons with estimated contribution and contribution-floor checks.
- Shared-stock planning with availability contexts, order limits, and conflict detection.
- Frozen decision snapshots, reasoning notes, and linked revisions.
- Manual daily outcomes with source evidence, audited corrections, and voiding.
- Date-filtered Home metrics calculated from recorded outcomes.
- Separate Demo and My Business stores, with a 12-product sample workspace.
- CSV/PDF reports and complete workspace backup and restore.
- Offline operation, native navigation, Dynamic Type, and adaptive iPhone/iPad/Duo layouts.

name: Ads Manager Tracker Suit
description:
Catalog Lead Tracker helps small sellers follow up on product inquiries and see which ones turn into orders.

Build a product catalog with list prices and see how many open inquiries each product has. Record a customer's name, the product they're interested in, and any contact details or notes you want to keep.

Qualify inquiries, record quoted amounts, and mark orders as won. Each lead has a timeline so you can see when the inquiry came in, when it was qualified, when you recorded a quote, and when the order was won.

Use Overview to track the inquiry-to-order funnel, total won order value, and orders by week. In Marketing, enter daily ad reports manually or import USD campaign data from a CSV file in Files. Link inquiries to a campaign to measure recorded ad spend per inquiry and per won order.

Catalog Lead Tracker works offline and stores your records on your device. It uses US English and USD. All features are free, with no account, subscription, or in-app purchases.

name: adsumCalendar
description:
adsumCalendar puts your iCloud, Fastmail and CalDAV calendars in one view, two-way, on iPhone and Android alike. Events with a place show when to leave and whether it will rain there.

When to leave
Open an event with a place and it says when to set off: “Leave by 11:52, 30 min by public transport”, from where you are or from the event before. Switch between public transport, driving, walking and cycling. The forecast for that place and time sits beside it, from adsumWeather, which compares several forecasts.

Every calendar, two-way
Connect iCloud, Fastmail or any CalDAV server, such as Nextcloud. Their events show beside your own, and changes you make here go back to them.

Type it as you’d say it
“Piano lesson with Mia Thu 4:30pm” fills in the day, the time and who it’s for, and offers to repeat it every Thursday. A clash is pointed out before you add it.

A calendar for the household
Share one household calendar between iPhones and Android phones. Add people who don’t have an account, such as a child or a parent you drive to appointments, mark who an event is for and who’s driving, and show one person’s events at a time. If the driver is busy then, the app says so.

Shift patterns
Pick a pattern such as 2 long days, 2 nights, 5 off, or type your own, and your shifts fill the calendar. You can also paste in a rota. The month shows Night or Off under each day.

Public and school holidays
Add the public holidays and school holidays for where you live. They never count as busy, and a repeating event such as the school run offers to skip the holiday dates.

Today and the views
Today is one scroll: what’s on now, what’s next and how long until it, free time, and the days after. Day, week, month and agenda views, and search across every calendar.

Invitations
Invite anyone by email. They answer from their own email, and the answer shows on your event. Invitations to you wait in Inbox, with any clash shown.

With or without an account
Without an account, events stay on your phone. With an Adsum account they sync to your other devices and to calendar.adsum.ai, and you can connect other calendars and share.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app. Dated tasks from adsumNotes show on your calendar and your events show in its Today; adsumRoute works out when to leave; adsumWeather gives the forecast; bookings from adsumBooking go on your calendar. Each link is off until you turn it on.

Privacy
No ads and no tracking. Events from calendars you connect are never used for advertising, never sold and never used to train AI. Leave by sends adsumRoute a place and a time, never the event’s title. Events aren’t end-to-end encrypted, because the server keeps connected calendars in sync and sends invitations.

adsumCalendar is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumCompany
description:
adsumCompany is for the owners and admins of a company on Adsum. Invite people, put them in groups, verify your domain and choose who can use each Adsum app. When someone leaves, hand over their mailbox, calendars and files from one screen.

People
Invite people one at a time, or import a CSV and check the dry run before anyone is added. Give each person a role: owner, admin or member. Search by name or email, and show only the invited, the admins, the suspended or the removed.

Suspend, hand over, remove
Suspend someone and their sign-in stops while their mail keeps arriving. When they leave, Hand over moves what they hold in each app to someone else in one step, then Remove takes them out of the company. Removing a person never erases the company’s data.

Groups
Groups for teams such as Design or Engineering. A group can have its own address, such as team@ your domain.

Apps
Turn each Adsum app on or off for the company: adsumMail, adsumCalendar, adsumDocs, adsumFinance, adsumNotes and adsumBooking. Choose whether everyone can use it or only chosen groups.

Resources and access
Shared mailboxes, shared drives, team calendars and company books on one screen, with who can use each. Who can do what shows every person’s access in every app, and where it comes from.

Domains
Add your company’s domain and verify it with one DNS record. The app shows each record as a checklist that ticks itself when DNS sees it.

Security
See who signs in with a passkey or two-step sign-in, and the recent sign-ins of the company’s accounts.

Activity
Every admin action and sign-in as a plain sentence, newest first. The log is kept for 13 months, each entry is chained to the one before so a change would show, and it exports as CSV.

Data
Storage used by each app and each person. Owners can archive the company, or erase it with 30 days to undo.

See an example
Not set up yet? Open the example studio and try every screen with made-up people. Nothing you do there is saved.

One sign-in for every app
Your Adsum account signs you in to adsumCompany and every other Adsum app. People in your company see which account they are in, Personal or the company, at the top of each app, and switch in one tap.

Privacy
No ads and no tracking. Admins see the company’s accounts and resources, never a person’s Personal account.

adsumCompany is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumDocs: documents and drive
description:
adsumDocs keeps every file in one drive and edits documents, spreadsheets and presentations in the same app. You get 15 GB for your files alone, not shared with your email or photos, and several people can edit a file at the same time.

Documents
Headings, lists, checklists, tables, images and equations. Comment on any words, and suggest changes for the author to accept or reject. Print, or download as Word.

Spreadsheets
Formulas, number formats, frozen rows, sorting, filters and charts: column, bar, line, area, pie, donut and scatter. Download as Excel or CSV.

Presentations
Slides with layouts, themes and speaker notes. Present full screen from your phone or laptop, or download as PowerPoint.

Edit together
Everyone in a file sees each other’s changes as they type, with their names. With no signal, your changes are saved on your device and sent when you’re back online.

Office files
Open Word, Excel and PowerPoint files to edit them, as a copy beside the original. Older Office files and OpenDocument files open too.

Drive
Folders, Starred, Shared with me, Trash and search. Preview PDFs and photos, and go back to an earlier version of a document, spreadsheet or presentation.

Sharing
Share a file or folder as viewer, commenter or editor, or turn on a link. A company or household gets shared drives that belong to it, not to one person.

Storage
15 GB for adsumDocs alone. A single file can be up to 10 GB.

Assistant
Type what you want changed, and the Assistant edits the part on screen as suggestions you accept or reject.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app. In adsumMail, attach files from adsumDocs and save attachments to it.

Privacy
Files are stored on Adsum’s servers and encrypted at rest. They aren’t end-to-end encrypted. Your files aren’t sold, used for advertising or used to train AI models. There are no ads or trackers.

adsumDocs is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumMeet
description:
adsumMeet makes video calls for up to 25 people. Guests join from the link in their browser, with no account and no app to install, and a call can run for 24 hours.

Start a call
New meeting › Start now opens the call at once. Schedule in adsumCalendar puts it in your calendar with its link, and Copy link for later gives you a link to send. In adsumMail, Video call › Start now in a conversation opens the call and a reply to everyone in it, with the link filled in.

Who gets in
People you invite come straight in from their link. Anyone else with the code asks to join, and you admit or deny them. Turn on Anyone with the link can join when you’d rather not be asked.

In the call
Everyone in a grid, or the person talking large when there are more than six. Chat, raised hands and a timer. Hosts can ask someone to mute, remove them, or end the call for everyone.

Data saver
Set Data saver to Always in Settings and calls bring in smaller video, so they use less of your mobile data. Your voice is never reduced. On any connection, video you can’t see on the screen isn’t downloaded.

Upcoming and Recent
Upcoming lists today’s and tomorrow’s calls from adsumCalendar, each with Join. Recent shows past calls, who came and for how long.

Notes after the call
When a call ends, Write notes opens a note in adsumNotes with the call’s title, date and who came.

Without an account
Start a test call, open to anyone with its link for 2 hours, or join a call with its code. An Adsum account is needed to start calls of your own.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to adsumMeet, adsumMail, adsumCalendar, adsumNotes and the other Adsum apps. Guests don’t need one.

Privacy
Calls aren’t recorded, transcribed or listened to, and adsumMeet has no AI features. Video and sound are encrypted on the way to and from Adsum’s call servers, which pass them on in memory; they aren’t end-to-end encrypted. What’s kept: who came, when and for how long; the chat, for 30 days; and a guest’s name as they typed it. No ads and no tracking.

adsumMeet is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumPassword
description:
adsumPassword is a password manager for your passwords, passkeys and two-step codes, with AutoFill in apps and Safari. Everything is encrypted on your iPhone or iPad with keys made from your vault password and a Secret Key that Adsum never has, so not even Adsum can open your vault.

AutoFill in apps and Safari
Turn on adsumPassword in AutoFill, and your logins appear above the keyboard in Safari and in apps. Choose one and unlock with Face ID or Touch ID. It fills only on the website the login belongs to, never on a look-alike address.

Passkeys
Save a passkey when a website or app offers one, and sign in with Face ID or Touch ID. Passkeys sync to your other devices with the rest of your vault.

Two-step codes
Add a website’s setup key to a login, and its authenticator code shows beside the password with a timer, ready to copy. On iOS 18 and later, AutoFill fills the code too.

Everything in one vault
Logins, passkeys, cards, identities, secure notes, SSH keys, API keys, Wi-Fi networks and documents, with tags and favourites.

Password generator
Random characters, memorable words or a PIN, at the length you choose.

Security report
See which passwords are weak, reused or found in a data breach. The checks run on your phone, and a breach check sends only the first 5 characters of a hash of the password.

Sharing
Share a login or a vault with people in your household or team. Choose Can edit, Can view or Fill only, which signs them in on the login’s website without showing them the password.

Moving in
Import from 1Password, Bitwarden, Chrome, Apple Passwords, LastPass or a CSV file. The file is read on your device and never uploaded.

Encryption
Your vault is encrypted and decrypted only on your devices. Its key comes from your vault password and your Secret Key, so a copy of our database can’t be opened without both. Adsum can’t read your vault or reset your vault password. Shared vaults are encrypted for each person’s own keys with a post-quantum method (X25519 with ML-KEM-768).

We carried out our own security audit of the encryption, our servers’ rules and the apps. The summary and the full report are in Settings and at password.adsum.ai/security/audit.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app. Your vault is also at password.adsum.ai in a browser. When you share, the people in your Adsum household or company are suggested.

Privacy
No tracking, and your data isn’t sold. adsumPassword uses iOS AutoFill only to offer your logins, passkeys and codes, and to save the passkeys you create. Nothing about what you fill is sent to us. Error reports leave out your vault and are deleted after 7 days.

adsumPassword is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumRoutine
description:
adsumRoutine shows each person the next step of their routine, with a picture, a timer and the step read aloud. Children share one iPad and tap their own face, and parents see every tick on their phones as it happens. At work, every check is kept with its time, its reading and who signed it.

One step at a time
A picture, a word and a disc that shrinks as the step’s time runs out, with Done, Skip and Undo. A child who doesn’t read yet sees the picture; one who reads sees the words too.

Finish by
Give a routine a time to be done by, such as 08:10 for school. A ring shows the time left, and steps marked “If there’s time” can be dropped when the morning runs late.

One iPad for the family
Each child taps their face on the shared iPad. A parent sets it up with a code from their phone, and the iPad’s Settings open only with a code shown on an adult’s phone.

Live on every phone
Ticks reach the parents’ phones as they happen. Remind makes the iPad say the child’s step aloud.

Read aloud by name
Steps are read aloud with the person’s name, in one of 10 studio voices.

Every step, with its time
The done log lists each step with the time and the device it was ticked on, so “did I lock the back door?” has an answer.

Routines to start from
School morning, Morning, Evening and Leaving the house at home; Café opening, Café closing, Fridge and display checks, Opening checks, Medication room checks and Cleaning round at work. Each step has a picture and its minutes, and a routine can run on chosen days or when you start it.

At work
Checks at set times, on a shared iPad or on staff iPhones. A reading has its limits: when one is out of range, the app asks what was done and sets a recheck. Each person signs off with their own 4-digit code, and staff need no account.

Records
Every check by site and day, with its readings and sign-offs, kept for 2 years and exported as CSV.

For yourself
Just me needs no account: your own mornings, evenings and leaving-the-house checks, kept on your iPhone.

For children
A child has a first name and a picture, not an account. Their screen always shows which adults can see their progress. There are no points, streaks or rewards.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app, and a household or organisation set up in one is the same in the others.

Privacy
No ads and no tracking. A home’s done log is kept for 90 days and a workplace’s records for 2 years. To read a step aloud, its words and the person’s name are sent as text to our voice service.

adsumRoutine is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumTrips
description:
adsumTrips turns your booking emails into one itinerary, day by day. Trains, flights, ferries, hotels, car hire and restaurant bookings each land on their day, with the forecast for where you’ll be and the time to leave for the station or airport.

Bookings from your mail
With adsumMail, Find bookings reads the next 12 months of confirmations and proposes each trip with its bookings, for you to tick and add. Turn on Bookings from your mail and new confirmations are filed into their trip by their dates as they arrive.

A forwarding address
Using another mail app? Forward a confirmation to your own adsumTrips address and it goes into the right trip, or into the Inbox when it could belong to more than one. Only addresses you’ve confirmed with a code can forward to it.

Changes and cancellations
A later email for the same booking updates it. A cancelled booking is marked as cancelled, not deleted, until you remove it. A confirmation that can’t be read with confidence waits in the Inbox for you to check, instead of landing in the wrong place.

Days in local time
Each day shows its date, where you are and its bookings in order, at the local time of each end. A travel day reads “Leeds → Edinburgh”. Your trips are kept on your phone as well as in your account, so they open with no signal.

When to leave
For a trip’s first departure, adsumTrips shows when to be at the station, airport or port, from the times you set or a ferry’s check-in close, and when to leave home, timed by adsumRoute.

Weather for each day
Each day in the next 10 days shows the forecast for the place you’ll be, from adsumWeather. Only the area goes to adsumWeather, never the trip or its bookings.

Packing lists
Make a packing list for a trip in adsumNotes. The trip shows how much is packed, such as “12 of 30”, and opens the list in one tap.

Sharing
In a household, everyone in it sees and edits the trip. Anyone else can have a view-only link, which leaves out booking references.

Add to calendar
