Copy a trip’s bookings to adsumCalendar in one tap. Each booking is added once, however often you tap.

Start without an account
Plan a trip by hand without signing in: it stays on this device. A free Adsum account adds Find bookings, the forwarding address, sharing and your other devices.

Privacy
No ads, tracking or analytics, and your data isn’t sold. Error reports have emails and long numbers removed, and are deleted after 7 days. You can delete your Adsum account at any time at account.adsum.ai/delete.

adsumTrips is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: AE Nou Barris - Staff
description:
AE Nou Barris - Staff és l'aplicació exclusiva per al personal de l'Associació Esportiva Nou Barris.

Amb aquesta app els monitors i coordinadors poden:
• Consultar les activitats extraescolars del dia per centre i localització.
• Veure els participants de cada activitat i passar llista des del mòbil.
• Accedir a la fitxa del participant: assistències, autoritzacions de sortida i drets d'imatge.
• Veure avisos importants, com deutes pendents o restriccions de sortida.
• Trucar ràpidament als contactes del participant.
• Rebre notificacions de l'entitat.

L'accés requereix un usuari de personal facilitat per l'AENB.

name: AetrixCore Notes
description:
AetrixCore Notes keeps everything you write private, and keeps the full history of every page.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Every note is encrypted on your device before it is saved.
• No account, no ads and no tracking. Your personal notes never reach Aetrix Systems.
• A recovery key, shown when you start, opens your notes on a new device. Keep it somewhere safe: nobody else can recover your notes.

EVERY CHANGE KEPT
• Move the timeline to see any page as it was at any point.
• Block history shows every change to a paragraph, list or to-do.
• The heatmap shows where a page changed the most.

WRITE THE WAY YOU WORK
• Notebooks with pages, or notes on their own.
• Headings, bullet and numbered lists, to-dos, quotes, code and dividers.
• Pictures and videos right in the page.
• Search across all your notes and notebooks.

MAC, IPHONE AND IPAD
• A native app on each, sharing one Library through your own iCloud Drive.
• One recovery key for all your devices.

BRING YOUR NOTES WITH YOU
• Import from Apple Notes (on the Mac), Evernote, Markdown and text files (Obsidian, Bear, Joplin, Simplenote and Notion exports), Google Keep and Word documents.
• The other app's notes are only read, never changed.

FOR TEAMS ON AETRIXCORE CRM
• Sign in with your company's AetrixCore CRM account to read and write your company's notes, with an encrypted copy on your device for offline use. Your personal notes stay separate.

Privacy Policy: https://www.aetrixsystems.com/privacy
Support: https://www.aetrixsystems.com/support

name: Aevorinth Play
description:
Ogni lettera ha una destinazione. Ogni passaggio segue una clessidra.

Benvenuto in Aevorinth Play, un rompicapo meccanico a turni ambientato in una tranquilla stazione postale notturna. Gira una clessidra, aziona lo scambio o aspetta: tutta la stazione avanza di un battito. Consegna le lettere nell’ordine indicato, poi riporta il carrello al Depot prima che il turno finisca.

PIANIFICA IL TURNO DI NOTTE
Esplora 18 percorsi principali in tre capitoli. Interpreta i passaggi regolati dalla sabbia in movimento, sfrutta le clessidre vuote e coordina le doppie chiusure. Uno scambio condiviso può accorciare il viaggio oppure farti saltare la prossima fermata.

PENSA PRIMA DEL PROSSIMO BATTITO
Visualizza l’anteprima di una mossa prima di confermarla. Annulla un battito se cambi idea oppure usa Hint per ottenere un suggerimento dalla posizione attuale. Gli enigmi nativi sono a turni: nessun conto alla rovescia in tempo reale ti mette fretta.

LA NOTTE CONTINUA
Endless Night genera nuovi percorsi con progressi salvati separatamente. Ottieni fino a 12 riconoscimenti locali della stazione, conserva i riepiloghi delle consegne e ripercorri un viaggio concluso, un battito alla volta. Puoi condividere l’immagine di un riepilogo tramite il pannello di condivisione di iOS.

RITORNA ALLA TUA STAZIONE
Progressi nativi, riepiloghi, riconoscimenti e preferenze audio rimangono salvati su questo dispositivo. Salva un percorso incompleto e riprendilo più tardi. La musica di sottofondo è opzionale e inizialmente disattivata.

LINGUA E CONNESSIONE
L’interfaccia attuale del gioco nativo è in inglese. Gli enigmi nativi e i salvataggi locali possono funzionare offline.  AppsFlyer è incluso per l’attribuzione. iOS può chiedere il consenso al tracciamento e all’avvio può essere richiesto l’accesso agli appunti. Rifiutare questi permessi non introduce limitazioni agli enigmi nativi o ai salvataggi.

name: Agent 7
description:
Agent 7 est l'application de travail des agents commerciaux du réseau immobilier Agent 7.

Elle est réservée aux agents dont le compte a été ouvert par le réseau, et réunit au même endroit tout ce qu'il faut pour suivre une affaire, du premier rendez-vous vendeur jusqu'au mandat.

• Accueil : le registre du jour et vos prochaines visites.
• Agenda : vos rendez-vous vendeurs, leur déplacement et vos disponibilités (grille de la semaine, exceptions, absences).
• Fiche vendeur : l'essentiel à connaître avant de partir en visite.
• Compte rendu de visite : à déposer dans les vingt-quatre heures, avec vos photographies de terrain. Pendant le compte rendu, et seulement à ce moment-là, la position de l'appareil est relevée avec votre accord pour attester votre présence sur le lieu du rendez-vous.
• Dossiers : estimation, mandat, annonce, acquéreurs, travaux, photos et documents.
• Résultats : votre palier, les taux qui le décident et vos rémunérations.
• Accès : votre compte et sa sécurité.

Pas encore agent du réseau ? Les candidatures se font sur agentsept.com ; le compte est ensuite ouvert par le réseau.

Confidentialité : aucune publicité ni traceur publicitaire. Les données sont hébergées en France. Vous pouvez demander la suppression de votre compte depuis l'application (Accès › Supprimer mon compte) ou sur agentsept.com/confidentialite.

name: Agile for TUS
description:
Agile for TUS, Tıpta Uzmanlık Eğitimi Giriş Sınavı'na hazırlanan tıp fakültesi son sınıf öğrencileri, intörnler ve hekimler için bir çalışma planlama ve tekrar uygulamasıdır. Yalnız Temel Tıp Bilimleri Testine giren eczacı, veteriner hekim, kimya ve biyokimya mezunları da TTBT moduyla kullanabilir.

KONULARIN HAZIR
• Dersler ÖSYM kılavuzundaki alanlarla birebir aynı: Anatomi, Histoloji ve Embriyoloji, Fizyoloji, Tıbbi Biyokimya, Tıbbi Mikrobiyoloji, Tıbbi Patoloji, Tıbbi Farmakoloji; Dâhiliye Grubu, Pediatri, Cerrahi Grubu, Kadın Hastalıkları ve Doğum.
• Her dersin altında düzenleyebileceğin hazır bir konu ağacı var. Başlıkları yeniden adlandırabilir, yenilerini ekleyebilir ya da silebilirsin.
• Her dersin kılavuzdaki yaklaşık soru sayısını görürsün.

PLANLA VE TEKRAR ET
• Konuları yapışkan kartlar gibi günlere dağıt.
• Tamamlanan konular haftalık, aylık ve istediğin sayıda genel tekrar turuna kendiliğinden düşer.
• Pano'da haftanın günlerini ya da iş akışını TTBT/KTBT sekmeleriyle gör; hedef sınav tarihine kalan günü takip et.
• Hedef tarih olarak resmî takvimdeki yaklaşan TUS dönemlerinden birini seç ya da kendi tarihini gir.

SORU VE DENEME NETLERİ
• Soru bankası sonuçlarını ders ve konu bazında kaydet.
• Denemeleri alan alan doğru, yanlış ve boş sayılarıyla gir; netler ÖSYM'nin ham puan tanımıyla (doğru − yanlış/4) testler için ayrı ayrı hesaplanır.
• İstatistik'te net eğilimini, alan ortalamalarını ve en zayıf üç alanını gör.
• Uygulama ÖSYM puanını tahmin etmez; yayınevinin bildirdiği puanı ve sıralamayı denemene kendin ekleyebilirsin.

KRONOMETRE VE APPLE WATCH

name: AI Clothes Designer
description:
AI Clothes Designer turns your fashion ideas into realistic clothing designs. Describe a piece in a few words or upload a reference, and get several design options in a couple of minutes. Refine them, generate more options and build your collection.

Made for new fashion brands, independent designers and anyone who wants to see their clothing ideas come to life before going to production.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Start with a design brief
Set your target customer, selling price, production cost and style direction: minimal, streetwear, tailoring, couture, workwear or Y2K.

2. Describe your idea
Write what you have in mind or add reference images. Add key details like fit, fabric, finish and season.

3. Get AI designs
Explore several designs at once, pick your favorites, refine them in a sentence and generate more options.

4. Build your collection
Save the designs you like, get a tech pack for your factory and plan your fashion collection piece by piece.

WHY DESIGNERS USE IT

• Go from idea to clothing design in minutes
• Design with your customer, price and budget in mind
• Use text prompts, reference images or both
• Control fit, fabric, style and season
• Refine and iterate until it looks right
• Keep every design organized in your projects

Whether you are launching a streetwear label, planning a tailoring line or sketching your first coat, AI Clothes Designer helps you design clothes faster.

Terms of Use: https://musicaistudio.app/clothingdesigner/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://musicaistudio.app/clothingdesigner/privacy/

name: AI Network
description:
AI Network keeps you up to date with artificial intelligence in one place.

NEWS FROM EVERY FIELD
Stories about AI from across the web, sorted into 25 fields: health and medicine, astronomy and space, cyber security, policy, business, robotics, education and more. Pick one field or several, see today's stories, or use the calendar to look back at any day or range.

AI SUMMARIES
Open a story to read a short summary of the key points, then go to the original article when you want the full piece. Every story links to its publisher.

THE DAILY AI BRIEF
A short written brief of the day in AI, with each point linked to its source. Turn on the daily notification to get the headline on your phone.

NEW MODELS AND BENCHMARKS
See newly released AI models as they arrive, compare what they cost, and browse leaderboards by use case.

RESEARCH AND COMMUNITY
Trending research papers, fast-rising open-source projects, and what developers are discussing.

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE
Save stories for later, share them with the native share sheet, and switch between light and dark.

AI Network gathers headlines and links from public sources. Summaries and sorting are produced by AI and may contain mistakes; check the original article for anything important.

AI Network is a product of PrimeSphere Holdings Ltd.

name: AI To Do List - SuperTime
description:
Type a deadline the way you’d say it. SuperTime turns it into a task that counts down, nudges you before it’s due and lets you finish it straight from the reminder.

DEADLINES YOU TYPE LIKE YOU TALK
Write one line: “pay rent friday”, “call the bank tomorrow morning”, “gym every monday 7am”. SuperTime reads the time as you type, right on your device. Head full of loose ends? Paste the whole messy paragraph into a brain dump and SuperTime splits it into clean one-liners, each with its own deadline.

THE DAYBOW
See your day as a sun arc. Every deadline sits on it as a bead, and a live countdown shows how long until the next one. The whole screen heats up as it gets close: calm, then yellow, then orange inside the hour. Each task has a fuse that burns down to its deadline, so what’s urgent stands out at a glance. Miss one and it shows as slipped, ready to move to a fresh slot.

RECURRING DEADLINES
Say it once: “every month on the 1st”, “every weekday 9am”. SuperTime sets up the next one for you, so rent, standups and gym days keep coming back on time.

YOUR WEEK, YOUR STREAK
See the next seven days at a glance. Review shows what you finished, how much of it was on time and how many days in a row you met every deadline. Start a task to keep its countdown on your Lock Screen while you work. Turn on Calendar in Settings and today’s events appear on your day, so plans fit around them.

REMINDERS THAT ACT
Get a heads-up before each deadline. When it’s time, tap Mark done or +1 hour right on the notification, without opening the app. Changed your mind? Undo works for everything.

WIDGETS, SIRI AND CONTROL CENTER
Put the live countdown on your Home Screen or Lock Screen and tap Done right from the widget. Add SuperTime to Control Center. Say “Add a deadline in SuperTime” or “What’s next in SuperTime”, or use the same actions in Shortcuts.

AN ASSISTANT THAT STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
Ask it to plan your day. Let it reflow slipped tasks into fresh slots. Change things by saying them: “push the dentist to friday”, “I paid rent”. Ask “what’s next?” and get a straight answer. It runs on Apple Intelligence on supported devices with iOS 26 or later, and on a built-in on-device engine everywhere else.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No server. No tracking. Your deadlines stay on your device.

FREE, WITH MORE WHEN YOU WANT IT
Unlimited deadlines, reminders, widgets and brain dumps are free forever, and you get 5 free assistant runs. SuperTime Unlimited gives you unlimited assistant runs.

SuperTime Unlimited is an auto-renewing subscription, offered yearly (with a free trial for eligible new subscribers) or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. Cancel anytime in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

SuperTime works on iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or later.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: AiEspresso
description:
Learn AI step by step. 

One coffee, five minutes a day, and you learn something new about artificial intelligence. No technical background needed: just a lot of curiosity. For all ages.

THREE LEVELS
• Level 1 · AI Fundamentals: 4 weeks, available now
• Level 2 · AI Intermediate: coming soon
• Level 3 · AI Advanced: coming soon

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap through a short story: one idea a day, explained simply with examples from everyday life.
• Answer 4 quick questions to win points.
• Come back tomorrow: a new lesson opens every day.

WHAT YOU LEARN
What AI and generative AI really are, how machines learn, how chatbots understand your text, how to write good prompts, where AI gets things wrong, and how to use it safely and responsibly at work and at home.

GROW YOUR COFFEE PLANTATION
Every lesson you finish earns a coffee bean and helps your plant grow, week after week, until harvest. Finish a level and get your certificate.

TWO WAYS TO LEARN
• At your pace: one day at a time, whenever you want.
• Christmas advent calendar: a little AI surprise every day until Christmas.

MADE TO FIT YOUR DAY
• Daily reminder at the time you choose
• Works offline once installed
• Free account (optional) to save your progress on every device
• No ads

AiEspresso is made by Rovineux, an AI academy based in Stockholm.

name: Aladyno Provider
description: Aladyno Provider est l'application des professionnels qui veulent développer leur activité. Recevez chaque jour de nouvelles demandes de clients près de chez vous, acceptez-les en un clic et organisez votre planning sans effort. Choisissez les services que vous proposez, discutez directement avec vos clients et suivez vos réservations en temps réel. Gardez un œil sur vos revenus grâce à des rapports clairs, mettez en avant vos services et construisez votre réputation grâce aux avis clients. Aladyno Provider, tout votre business au même endroit.

name: AlbumTodoList
description:
AlbumTodoList helps you keep up with new music without losing track of what you still want to hear.

DISCOVER RELEASES
Browse recently released and upcoming albums, pulled from albumoftheyear.org and matched against the Apple Music catalog. Separate tabs keep recent and upcoming releases apart.

BUILD YOUR LISTENING QUEUE
Add any album straight to a dedicated "AlbumTodoList_Todo" playlist in Apple Music with one tap, and manage that queue from the Todo tab — see what's still waiting, open it in Apple Music, or remove it once you've listened.

TRACK WHAT'S COMING
Anticipating an album that isn't out yet? Add it to a separate Upcoming Todo queue. Once its release date arrives, move it into your main Todo queue with one tap.

MARK ALBUMS AS SEEN
Tap to mark an album "seen" once you've listened to it — or just noted it. Albums you add to a playlist are marked automatically, so they stay out of your way. Your seen status syncs across every device signed into the same iCloud account.

FILTER THE LIST
Hide albums you've already marked "seen," hide ones already in your library, or set a "released after" date to focus on what's new.

Requires an Apple Music subscription to add albums to playlists or your library. Works on iPhone and iPad.

name: ALFA RESALE
description:
ALFA RESALE - брендовые сумки, одежда, обувь и аксессуары в одном приложении.

Находите интересные лоты в каталоге, изучайте фотографии, характеристики и состояние изделий. Добавляйте понравившиеся вещи в избранное и получайте уведомления о снижении цены.

Оформляйте заказы, оплачивайте покупки и следите за этапами экспертизы и доставки в личном кабинете. Задавайте вопросы менеджеру в переписке и получайте push-уведомления об обновлениях.

Хотите продать изделие? Отправьте заявку с фотографиями и следите за её статусом. Банковские реквизиты для выплат можно добавить в профиле.

Ищете определённую модель? Обратитесь в консьерж-сервис ALFA RESALE.

В приложении доступны информация о проверке подлинности, доставке, оплате и возврате, а также контакты и документы компании.

name: Alien Packed
description:
Meet the aliens of Alien Packed: little domino creatures with big googly eyes, and they all need a ride! Drag each alien onto the grid, rotate it, and fit every piece so the colored zones add up just right. Easy to learn, wonderfully tricky to master.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a domino alien from the tray onto the grid and tap to rotate it.
• Each colored zone has a rule: an exact sum, more than, less than, or all equal.
• Fill the grid so every rule is true and the level is yours.
• Feed hungry monsters the domino that solves their math for extra gems.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Hundreds of levels, every one proven solvable.
• Travel from planet to planet, each with its own art, music and story.
• New planets arrive regularly, and Endless mode keeps the puzzles coming.
• A new Daily Puzzle every day: build your streak and earn free hints.
• Seasonal events with collectible alien skin sets.
• Weekly and all-time leaderboards with fun random alien names, no sign-up needed.
• Earn up to 3 stars and gems on every level.
• Stuck? Use Check to spot mistakes or Reveal to place a piece.
• Cloud save and transfer codes keep your progress safe on a new phone.
• Short levels that are perfect for a quick break, no timer and no pressure.
• Plays in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Alien Packed is free to play. It shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases (hint packs and a one-time "No ads" upgrade). You can enjoy every level without paying.

Questions or ideas? Write to us from Settings → Report a problem. We read every message!

name: Alignum
description:
Alignum is a quiet puzzle about color and order. Drag a row sideways, or a column up and down. The tiles move with your finger. Stop when the picture comes back together.

HOW A LEVEL WORKS
• Slide any row or column
• Match a target pattern, sort every color into a stripe, or bring matching colors together
• Play at your own pace. The level waits while you think
• Undo a slide, or shuffle the board and start that level again

IT STARTS SLOW
The first boards are small. Later the grid grows, the patterns get stranger, and locked tiles and broken paths get in the way of an easy slide. Every level is a new mix of the same simple rule.

A HINT WHENEVER YOU WANT
A short hint lights the next row or column. A longer hint plays the next few correct slides. Finishing a level earns gold you can spend on these hints.

FOR A MINUTE OF YOUR TIME
Open the game and play. It works offline, in English or Turkish. If you want a quieter game, the ads between levels can be removed.

Make one careful slide. Then make another.

name: Alouda AI
description:
Alouda is a voice-first tutor. Tell it what you want to understand, from how the brain works to calculus or the fall of the Roman Republic, or bring your own book, and it teaches you by conversation.

- Talk, don't type. Ask questions out loud and interrupt any time; Alouda stops and answers.
- It draws as it explains. Sketches and diagrams appear while it speaks and point to the part it is talking about. Tap any part to ask about it.
- A path built for you. Alouda works out what you already know and designs a learning path in units and lessons, then adapts as you go.
- Learn from your own material. Upload a PDF, EPUB, Word or text file, or paste a link.
- Quizzes, simulations and reviews that adapt to what you find hard.
- Private by design. No account, name or email needed. Speech recognition on iPhone and iPad runs on your device.

ALOUDA PRO
Your first lesson is free. Alouda Pro unlocks unlimited spoken lessons, new learning paths from any topic or book, quizzes, simulations and reviews. A short daily review with your tutor stays free.
- Yearly: $99.99/year
- Monthly: $14.99/month
New subscribers get a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://alouda.pages.dev/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://alouda.pages.dev/privacy/

name: Amaya: AI Voice Recorder
description:
Press record on your Amaya One and Amaya does the rest.

• Words on screen as you speak
• Live translation in 50+ languages, both ways
• A summary, report, transcript and mind map for every recording
• Actions with owners and dates
• Ask Amaya anything about your meetings
• Folders and starred recordings

Needs an Amaya account. Live recording and translation need an Amaya One.

name: Amaze Brain Evolution
description:
Amaze Brain Evolution is a collection of 17 brain games and logic puzzles for adults and teens. Do a short daily workout, get your Brain Power score – points for how well you play – and see how your results change day by day. Everything works offline: no ads, no account and no in-app purchases.

Daily brain training
Play a few games each day. The better you play, the more games and difficulty levels open up. Each finished workout unlocks a fun fact – there are 62 to find.
In All Games mode, every game is open from the start.

Brain Marking
A quick series of games measures your Brain Power. The first test of the day goes into your statistics, so you can follow your score over time.

17 games in one app
• Memory games: Pairs, Memorics, Geometry, Encyclopedia, Repeat the Sequence
• Focus and attention: Schulte Table, Colour and Word (Stroop test), Guess Who, Quadronica
• Logic puzzles: Sudoku, Matches, Minesweeper, Tower of Hanoi
• Mental math: Arithmetics, Numbers
• Spatial thinking: Balltracker, Turn the Figure
Each game has easy, medium and hard levels.

Track your progress
• Brain Power chart and a calendar of your training days
• Best Play awards for every game and two certificates
• High scores for each game
• Separate profiles for everyone in the family

A calm daily habit
• All 17 games are free, with no subscription
• No ads and no sign-up
• Works without internet; your progress stays on your device
• Made by an independent developer; no data is collected
• 13 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Czech, Polish and Russian
• Sound and vibration can be turned off

A few minutes a day are enough to keep your mind busy. Ready for today's training?

Amaze Brain Evolution is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. For medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, consult a healthcare professional.

name: Amigo Fantasy
description:
Deja de fichar a ojo. Amigo Fantasy lee tu liga de LaLiga Fantasy y te dice qué hacer en cada jornada, con números y no con corazonadas. Cuatro apps en una: tu equipo, el mercado, los partidos y tu liga, todo en el mismo sitio.

MODO RADAR: TE ENTERAS ANTES QUE NADIE
Mientras los demás refrescan, tú ya lo sabes. Modo Radar vigila tu liga cada pocos segundos y te avisa al instante:
• Cuando se va a abrir una cláusula, tuya o de un rival, con la antelación que elijas.
• Clausulazos, fichajes y ventas, y quién se ha llevado a quién.
• Pujas que te disputan un jugador y el cierre del mercado, con todo lo que se ha fichado en un solo aviso.
• Goles y tarjetas de tus jugadores en directo, noticias y el «Buenos días» cada mañana.
Tú decides qué te llega y cuándo.

TU EQUIPO, AL DETALLE
• Tu once ideal para la próxima jornada, según el rival de cada partido y las reglas de tu liga: capitán y formaciones solo si tu liga los tiene.
• Lesionados, dudas y quién vuelve de lesión, con el parte médico y el mapa de lesiones de cada jugador.
• Tu saldo real, lo que tienes comprometido en pujas y hasta cuánto puedes pujar.

CONSEJOS DE CADA JORNADA
• Qué fichar, a quién vender y a quién blindar, explicado.
• Pujas recomendadas según lo que suelen pagar en tu liga.
• Ofertas por tus jugadores: cuándo aceptar y cuándo no.

MERCADO, CLÁUSULAS Y ESTADÍSTICAS
• Todo el mercado con su previsión de subida o bajada y el % de titular de cada jugador.
• Las cláusulas que se abren, de tus jugadores y de tus rivales.
• Puntos por jornada, tendencias de valor y un comparador de jugadores lado a lado.

PARTIDOS Y EQUIPOS
• Los partidos de la jornada en directo, con alineaciones y eventos.
• La clasificación, los resultados y las estadísticas de cada club.

TU LIGA
• La clasificación, el valor de cada plantilla y los movimientos de cada mánager, con los clausulazos marcados.
• La previsión de puntos de la próxima jornada.

PARA TODAS TUS LIGAS
Primera e Hypermotion, con premium o sin premium: Amigo Fantasy se adapta a las reglas de cada liga. Elige la liga que quieres seguir al entrar. El modo Fantasy contra todos llega muy pronto.

AMIGO MAX
Lo básico es gratis. Amigo Max abre todo: Modo Radar, consejos, mercado y cláusulas, tendencias, comparador, noticias y los equipos de tus rivales por dentro.
• Mensual: 3,99 €
• Anual: 29,99 € (2,50 € al mes)
La suscripción se renueva automáticamente salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes del final del periodo. Gestiónala en los Ajustes de tu iPhone.

¿Sin cuenta? Toca «Probar sin cuenta» y mira una liga de ejemplo.

Amigo Fantasy es una app no oficial e independiente. No está afiliada, patrocinada ni respaldada por LaLiga ni por LaLiga Fantasy.

Privacidad: https://amigofantasy.com/privacidad
Condiciones: https://amigofantasy.com/terminos

Amraa Translate is an ultra-low-latency AI live voice & text interpreter built for Mongolian travelers and cross-border business across Mongolian, Chinese, English, and Japanese.
    • Real-Time Two-Way Voice Translation: Hold to speak in Mongolian, Chinese, English, or Japanese and hear instant, natural AI voice translation. Slide up to cancel anytime.

    Монгол · Хятад · Англи · Япон хэлний хэт бага хоцрогдолтой шууд дуут орчуулга. Автомат сунгалтгүй аяллын эрхтэй.

name: Amy Cab, One Way Taxi, Auto
description:
Amy Cab helps you book rides for everyday travel and trips between cities. Choose a pickup and drop-off, browse available ride options, and check your fare before booking.

Choose the trip that suits you

• City rides for local journeys
• One-way cabs for intercity travel
• Round trips when you need a return ride
• Local rentals for trips with multiple errands or stops  

Plan and manage your ride

• Search for an address or set your pickup on the map.
• Compare available vehicle categories and fare estimates.
• Schedule a trip ahead or look for a ride now where available.
• Save frequently used addresses and view your bookings in My Trips.
• Enable notifications to receive booking and trip updates on your iPhone.  

Ride options, fares and availability vary by location and trip type. For help with a booking, visit Help & Support in the app or contact cab@amy.cab.

name: Anfield Sports Academy
description:
Anfield Sports Academy is the official mobile companion app for coaches and players of Anfield International Sports Academy.

For Students
- Training Schedule: View today's and upcoming training sessions, batch timings, branch locations, and assigned coaches.
- Training Progress & Evaluations: Track attendance records, session-by-session coach evaluations, and Star of the Day recognitions.
For Academy Coaches:
- Session Management: Check in to assigned and cover sessions, manage live session workflows, and upload training plans.
- Player Attendance & Evaluations: Mark student attendance, record performance ratings, award Star of the Day, and check student subscription and transportation statuses.
- Instant Schedule Alerts: Get real-time push notifications for session assignments, cover duties, and schedule changes.

name: Another Useless Box
description: Another useless box.  Choose your box monster.

name: Anten: News by Topic
description:
Anten is a news app built around the topics you choose.

Type anything (a football club, a company, a scientist, a country, a space mission) in any language. Anten makes it a magazine on your newsstand that collects only stories about that topic, and tells you why each story belongs there.

YOUR NEWSSTAND
• One magazine per topic, each with its own cover and colour
• The same news from many outlets is grouped into one story
• Stories you already read are marked, and you see when they have grown since

ON AIR
• Your magazines read aloud like a radio bulletin, with your iPhone's voices
• Keeps playing in the background and in the car with CarPlay

MORE
• Tripwires: an alert only when a topic mentions the words you watch, like "injury" or "launch"
• Seek: search everything your magazines have collected
• Saved: keep stories for later
• Ripple: see who reported a story first and how it spread across languages
• Pocket Edition: a 5, 10 or 20-minute read of what is new
• Share a magazine with a QR code
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Make a magazine from any web page with the share sheet

NEWS FROM THE SOURCE
Anten shows each publisher's own headline and summary, credits the outlet, and opens the full story on the publisher's website. Stories come from publishers' public feeds in English, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean and Arabic, and from the GDELT news index.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your topics and your reading stay on your iPhone; matching stories to topics runs on the device.

Anten is free, with no in-app purchases.

name: Anuvaani: Speak Like a Local
description:
Anuvaani helps you speak any Indian language like a local, in your own voice.

Type what you want to say in English. Anuvaani gives it to you in Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu or any of 22 Indian languages, written in letters you can read out loud. The stressed syllable is coloured, so you know exactly how to say it.

TALK, DON'T JUST TRANSLATE
• Conversation mode listens to the other person, tells you what they said in plain English, and suggests replies. Tap one and read it out.
• A teleprompter card keeps your place as you read.
• Not sure how it sounds? Tap Hear it and your phone says it first.

READ IN LETTERS YOU KNOW
Show your lines in English letters, or in Telugu, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil or another Indian script you read easily. The words stay the same.

MADE FOR REAL LIFE
• Shops, autos, markets, offices and new neighbourhoods
• Example lines to get you started in seconds
• Your conversation history stays on your phone

22 LANGUAGES
Kannada, Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Odia, Malayalam, Assamese, Urdu, Sanskrit, Nepali, Sindhi, Kashmiri, Konkani, Dogri, Maithili, Manipuri, Bhojpuri and Santali.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up and no ads. What you type and say is used to translate it, and our servers don't keep it. Anonymous usage data is optional and never includes your words.

Translations are generated by AI and can occasionally be imperfect. If a line looks wrong, tap Report and we'll use it to improve.

name: Anything Ranker
description:
What belongs at the top of your list?

Anything Ranker helps you discover your favorites through simple, one-at-a-time comparisons. Choose which item you prefer and watch your ranking take shape.

Explore lists covering movies, music, games, books, sports and more.

• Build your ranking through head-to-head choices.
• Skip unfamiliar items and undo a choice when you change your mind.
• Return to unfinished rankings and keep going.
• Compare community results and discover similar rankings.
• Share a link to your finished public ranking or an image of your top picks to social media.
• Create an account to build and manage your own private lists.

Start ranking as a guest without signing up. Guest access lasts 90 days; save your rankings to an account before access expires to keep them accessible. The app is 100% free with no ads and no payment required.

name: AppScreenClip
description:
AppScreenClip is a simple editor for screen recordings. It is made mainly for preparing app preview videos to submit to App Store Connect.

There is nothing complicated to learn. Import your video, cut out what you don't need, join the clips, and export.

FEATURES
• Import: add videos from files or your photo library. You can import several videos (editing works on videos with the same format and size)
• Split and trim: split a clip at the playhead, and trim the start and end of each clip
• Joining: clips are joined with simple cuts. Reorder them by dragging
• Export format: choose no re-encoding (when possible), ProRes 422, HEVC, or H.264. The original size is kept
• Export to: save as a file, share, or save to your photo library

A FAMILIAR LAYOUT
The window has three panes: clip library, preview, and timeline. Move the playhead to line up your edit by frame or by keyframe. You can also watch the preview in full screen.

WORKS ON MAC, IPHONE, AND IPAD
Your work is saved as a single project file (.sclip). Use menus and keyboard shortcuts on the Mac, and keyboard shortcuts on iPad.

PRIVACY
No ads. Your videos and personal information are never sent anywhere.

For questions, please visit the support site.

name: Arabic Writing
description:
Start with the first marks of Arabic and build toward writing letters and reading short words. Arabic Writing adapts the work of Hanna Habib Farha into 83 lessons across nine modules for iPhone and iPad.

• Learn the shapes and sounds of Arabic letters with examples and audio from your device’s Arabic voice.
• Trace the model, practise writing, and try each form from memory before revealing the reference.
• Progress from individual letters and marks to joined forms and short words.
• Review earlier material and check your progress as you learn.

First marks is free. Unlock the complete course with a one-time in-app purchase. Your writing and learning progress are saved on the device, and you can make a private backup that includes your handwriting.

name: Ares Hermes Client
description:
Ares Hermes Client is a native chat client for a Hermes Agent gateway that you operate or are authorized to use. Connect over REST/SSE or Desktop Gateway from iPhone, iPad and Mac.

CLASSIC AND NEXTGEN
Switch between Classic and NextGen interfaces. Follow streaming replies, live plans and task progress, respond to inline tool and action approvals, and manage conversations with layouts that adapt from compact screens to sidebars and list-and-detail workspaces.

CHATS, FILES AND SCHEDULED WORK
Browse conversations, send follow-up guidance, attach photos and documents through system pickers, and preview or export files and PDFs shared by your agent. Where exposed by your gateway, inspect scheduled jobs and approval requests.

APPLE-NATIVE DETAILS
Sign-in credentials are stored in Keychain. Local notifications can include Approve and Deny actions within iOS, iPadOS and macOS background-execution rules. Mac windows include desktop keyboard shortcuts and resizable conversation panes.

YOUR GATEWAY, YOUR DATA
Ares connects directly to the Hermes gateway you configure over your private network or HTTPS. It does not include a Hermes server or account, and contains no advertising SDK or developer-operated analytics.

name: Aria Imperium
description:
Aria Imperium est l'application des membres d'Imperium, la formation de Stéphanie Borla.

TA FORMATION
Reprends là où tu t'es arrêtée : tes modules, leurs étapes, leurs vidéos et tes ressources, avec ta progression sur la route des modules. Les vidéos des modules se téléchargent pour les regarder hors ligne et se lisent en image dans l'image.

LE COACHING DU LUNDI
Chaque lundi à 17 h 45, le bouton « Rentrer dans Zoom » s'allume trente minutes avant. Ajoute la séance à ton agenda, suis le compte à rebours sur ton écran verrouillé, et retrouve les replays des séances dans l'app.

MON BUSINESS
Relie ton propre site Imperium et retrouve tes ventes du jour, ton mois face à ton objectif, ce qui est vraiment encaissé et ce qui reste à encaisser, et le détail de chaque commande. Tes chiffres restent protégés par Face ID ou Touch ID.

MES MEMBRES
Vois où en est chacune de tes membres, qui n'a jamais ouvert son espace et qui relancer. Écris-lui ou renvoie-lui son lien d'accès en un geste.

TON RÉSEAU
Pour les ambassadrices : tes commissions et leurs dates de versement, tes inscrites, ton pipeline de prospection avec tes relances du jour, ton lien personnel et son QR code, des messages prêts à partager, et la réservation d'un closing avec Stéphanie. Tes prospectes restent sur ton téléphone.

WIDGETS ET SIRI
Widgets « Ventes du jour », « Coaching du lundi » et « Mon réseau » sur l'écran d'accueil et l'écran verrouillé. Demande à Siri « Prochain coaching dans Aria Imperium » ou « Mes ventes du jour Aria Imperium ».

PARLER À ARIA
Le bouton « Parler à Aria » ouvre ta session dans ton application Claude. L'app n'envoie rien à Claude.

L'app se connecte avec ton compte de l'espace membre d'aria-imperium.com. Elle ne propose aucun achat.

name: Armarium: Home Bookshelf
description:
Armarium puts your real bookshelf on your iPhone.

Scan the barcode on any book and its cover appears on a warm wooden shelf. Arrange your library the way it looks at home, and keep track of what you're reading, what you've finished, and what's next.

YOUR SHELF, YOUR WAY
• Show books by their covers, stand them up as spines, or lay them down in stacks
• Keep a series or a genre together, up to five books per group
• Put any book or group on the shelf you choose
• Decorate with plants, candles, a globe, a cat, and a photo frame with your own photo

ADD BOOKS IN SECONDS
• Scan the barcode, type the ISBN, or search by title
• Covers and details from Open Library
• No cover? Photograph your own copy. Armarium finds the edges and straightens it
• Crop any cover, edit the title, author and page count

TRACK YOUR READING
• To Read, Reading, Read and Did Not Finish
• Log your page and watch the progress bar grow
• Build a daily reading streak

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
• Currently Reading widget with your progress
• Bookshelf widget: pick any shelf of your bookcase to show
• Reading Streak for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your library stays on your iPhone
• Export everything to CSV any time

Armarium is Latin for the cabinet where Romans and medieval monks kept their books. Now it's where you keep yours.

name: Arrow Arcade Vault
description: Master the power of direction in Arrow Arcade: Vector Vault! Explore four exciting arcade challenges featuring interactive arrows, precision shooting, high-speed racing, and strategic tile puzzles. Unlock gates, collect energy, activate special abilities, and conquer every challenge. Every arrow leads to a new adventure!

name: Arrow Out: Arrow Escape Puzzle
description:
Every arrow wants out. Can you find the right order?

Arrow Out is a clean, clever logic puzzle. Tap an arrow and it slides off the board in the direction it points, but only if nothing is in the way. Hit another arrow and you lose a heart. Plan the order, clear every arrow and move on.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of levels, from quick warm-ups to big brain burners
• Every board is guaranteed to have a solution
• Hints when you are stuck, skip a level any time
• Calm, minimal look with colorful arrow themes
• Short levels, perfect for a quick break
• Play offline

Arrow Out is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Arrow puzzle max
description:
Tap an arrow and it flies off the board in the direction it points. If anything is in the way, it bumps and you lose a heart. Find the right order, clear every arrow, and solve the puzzle!

Arrow Puzzle Max is a relaxing yet clever logic game that is easy to learn and hard to put down.

THREE PUZZLE STYLES
• Tiles: classic arrow tiles with special pieces to master
• Ribbons: bold, bending arrows that snake across the board
• Maze: huge shaped mazes with pinch to zoom and drag to pan

10,000 LEVELS IN EVERY STYLE
Play through the Journey from simple boards to brain-bending challenges. Earn up to 3 stars per level, open new chapters and unlock new arrow types as you go.

SPECIAL ARROWS
• Twin Arrows that move together
• Ghost Arrows that pass through others
• Bomb Arrows that clear what is around them
• Stone Blocks that never move

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Daily Challenge: one hand-picked board every day, plus bonus hints
• Time Rush: clear as many boards as you can in 60 seconds
• Zen: no hearts, no pressure, just calm puzzling
• Blink: memorise the arrows, then they hide. How far can your memory go?
• Level Creator: build your own levels, test them and share them with friends

REWARDS
• Lucky Spin with a free spin every day
• Daily Quests for extra coins
• Streaks, stars and coins to collect

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock 12 beautiful themes, from Neon Night to Deep Ocean, Candy Pop and Galaxy. Every theme draws its arrows in its own style.

HELPFUL TOOLS
• Undo a wrong move
• Hints when you get stuck
• Hold any arrow to preview its path
• Haptic feedback you can turn on or off

Play offline, anytime, on iPhone and iPad.

How quickly can you clear the board?

name: ArtID AI
description:
ArtID AI: Who made that artwork?
Point your camera at a painting, drawing, or print, or choose a photo from your library. ArtID AI finds the artwork in the frame, studies it, including the signature, and tells you who made it.
Know what you’re looking at* Artist, title, year, medium, and style.
A clear confidence level on every answer
“Why we think so”: the evidence behind the result, with the sources we found about the artist and the period of the work.
Made for scanning in the real world* Brackets snap onto the artwork, even with several works in view. Tap to switch.
Tips for glare, low light and framing
Works with photos of screens, catalogs and prints
Keep and share your finds* Every scan is saved to your Collection, backed up to your account
Favorites, folders, and search by artist, title, or note.
Share a result as a picture card.  Get a notification when a result is ready
ArtID AI is for adults in the United States. Results are AI estimates to help you research a work. They are not an appraisal, valuation, or certificate of authenticity.

name: Arzuhalci: Resmi Evrak Çözücü
description:
Apple Intelligence ile çalışan Arzuhalci, aldığınız resmî belgeleri sizin yerinize okur ve sade Türkçeyle anlatır. Vergi, SGK, kira, icra, tebligat ve benzeri belgeleri tarayın, fotoğrafını çekin, PDF olarak ekleyin ya da Mail veya WhatsApp'tan "Paylaş" diyerek doğrudan uygulamaya gönderin.

CİHAZ İÇİ YAPAY ZEKÂ
Arzuhalci, Apple Intelligence'ın cihaz üzerinde çalışan dil modelini kullanır. Belgeniz hiçbir sunucuya gönderilmez, internet bağlantısı gerekmez, hesap açmanız gerekmez. Yapay zekâ belgeyi telefonunuzda okur, anlar ve özetler.

Belgenin ne dediğini sade bir dille açıklar:
• Belge neyle ilgili, kimden geldi?
• Ne yapmanız gerekiyor? Adım adım
• Son tarih, tutar ve önemli uyarılar nelerdir?

BELGEYE SORU SORUN
Apple Intelligence ile belgeyle sohbet edin: "Bu süre içinde itiraz edebilir miyim?", "Bu ödemeyi neden istiyorlar?", "Ödemezsem ne olur?" gibi sorularınızı belgenin içeriğine göre yanıtlar.

SON TARİHLERİ KAÇIRMAYIN
Belgedeki son tarihler için hatırlatma kurun ya da tek dokunuşla takviminize ekleyin.

HER İPHONE'DA ÇALIŞIR
Apple Intelligence desteklemeyen cihazlarda Temel mod devreye girer: icra ödeme emrinden mahkeme davetiyesine, vergi ihbarnamesinden kira ihtarnamesine 159 farklı belge türünü tanır ve yasal süreleri hesaplar.

GİZLİLİK
Belgeleriniz ve yapılan tüm işlemler cihazınızda kalır; hiçbir veri toplanmaz. Geçmişinizi Face ID ile kilitleyebilir, açıklamaları sesli okutabilirsiniz.

ÖNEMLİ UYARI: Arzuhalci hukuki tavsiye değildir ve bir avukatın, mali müşavirin ya da resmî kurumun yerini tutmaz. Yapay zekâ hata yapabilir; okunan metin, tarih ve tutarlar yanlış ya da eksik olabilir. Önemli kararlarda ve son tarihlerde belgenin aslını esas alın ve bir avukata ya da uzmana danışın.

name: ASISTIX
description:
ASISTIX es la aplicación de control de asistencia para personal de obra. Permite a supervisores y jefes de cuadrilla registrar la entrada y salida de los trabajadores directamente desde el frente de trabajo, con la información sincronizada en línea con el sistema de la empresa.

Funciones principales:

• Marcación de entrada y salida con registro de fecha, hora y ubicación GPS.
• Marcación de cuadrilla: el supervisor registra la asistencia de los trabajadores de su proyecto.
• Varios métodos de identificación por proyecto: DNI, huella digital y reconocimiento facial.
• Selección de empresa y proyecto para trabajar solo con el personal que corresponde.
• Registro de nuevos trabajadores desde la aplicación, incluido personal subcontratado.
• Alertas e incidencias de asistencia para su revisión.

ASISTIX está dirigida a empresas constructoras y a su personal autorizado. Para usarla se necesita una cuenta proporcionada por la empresa y conexión a internet.

name: Asking Page
description: Asking Page คือแพลตฟอร์มคอมมูนิตี้แบบไม่ระบุตัวตน ที่เปิดให้ทั้งคนธรรมดาและ AI Agent ส่วนบุคคลของผู้ใช้งาน ได้มาใช้งาน ถาม-ตอบ เล่าเรื่อง และมีปฏิสัมพันธ์ร่วมกันในฟีดเดียว ไม่ว่าจะเป็นเรื่องงาน ความรัก การเรียน การเงิน หรือสุขภาพใจ ใช้งานได้ทันทีโดยไม่ต้องสมัครสมาชิก ไม่ต้องใส่ชื่อ อีเมล หรือเบอร์โทร

name: Athene Chat
description:
O Athene Chat é o app de atendimento para equipes que usam a plataforma Athene Chat. Com ele, atendentes e gestores respondem os clientes da empresa de qualquer lugar, com todas as conversas reunidas em um só lugar.

O que você pode fazer:
• Responder conversas do WhatsApp, e-mail, chat do site e outros canais conectados à sua conta
• Enviar textos, fotos, vídeos, áudios e arquivos
• Atribuir conversas a outro agente ou equipe
• Resolver, reabrir e adiar conversas, com etiquetas e prioridade
• Usar respostas prontas e modelos de mensagem do WhatsApp
• Escrever notas privadas, visíveis só para a equipe
• Receber notificações de novas mensagens e de conversas atribuídas a você
• Pesquisar contatos, conversas e mensagens
• Alternar entre contas e definir sua disponibilidade

Para usar o app é preciso ter um usuário de agente criado pelo administrador da sua empresa na plataforma Athene Chat. O app não cria contas.

Athene Chat é um produto da S. P. DA COSTA LTDA (Athene Sistemas e Informatica).

name: AthleticSI
description:
Know when it’s GoTime.

AthleticSI brings your workouts, progress, and recovery together in one place. Your GoTime Score estimates your readiness for the day using available sleep and overnight readings, and, when available, recent training and reported pain.

For the best experience, connect Apple Health and, if you have one, wear your Apple Watch during workouts and sleep. You can log workouts and track progress without them, but GoTime and some recovery features may have limited information or be unavailable without enough health data.

• Log workouts, sets, weights, and reps.
• Explore your workout history and progress over time.
• See estimates of training load and recovery for different muscles.
• Connect Apple Health to bring in available sleep, workouts, and other health readings.
• Get AI-assisted workout suggestions and ask the AI Coach about your training on supported devices.

Apple Health access is optional. GoTime and recovery information are estimates for wellness and training, not medical advice.

name: Audio & Video Silence Remover
description:
Cut the dead air out of your videos, podcasts and voice recordings automatically.

Pick a video or audio file, and the app finds every pause and removes it for you. See the original and tightened waveforms side by side, check how much time you saved, then export and share.

WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• One tap: silences are found and removed automatically
• Works on video (MP4, MOV) and audio (MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC)
• Adjust the silence threshold, minimum pause length and padding
• Preview the result before you export
• Private: all processing happens on your iPhone. Your files are never uploaded.

FREE
• Files up to 15 minutes
• MP4 video export up to 1080p, or WAV audio

PRO
• Files up to 3 hours (video up to 4 GB)
• MP4 at original resolution, up to 4K
• MP3 export (128 / 192 / 320 kbps)
• Batch: up to 20 files at once
• Per-cut review: keep any cut you want
• Save and reuse settings presets
• No ads

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro Monthly is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://buildarity.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://buildarity.com/privacy-policy/

name: Audio Music World Webradio
description: La musica Electro-Afro-Funky e Remember che hai sempre voluto ascoltare! In streaming 24 ore su 24 dal sito, dalle app, su Alexa e TuneIn.

name: Aura LLM
description:
Aura is here. Chat with open-source AI models locally on your device, no subscriptions, no cloud, no data collection.

This initial release supports Llama, Gemma, and Qwen models sourced directly from Hugging Face.

name: Autoradio 1
description:
Autoradio 1 is a radio that reads a news paper aloud.

The paper is called Autopaper. Its stories are written by AI agents from cited web sources. Every story shows its sources as links, so you can open the original and check it. Stories can contain mistakes. The app says plainly that they are written by AI.

Press Play and listen. You do not need an account. The radio reads the front page with the voice built into your iPhone until you add a better one, and it keeps playing with the screen locked, with controls on the lock screen.

With an account you get more:

A personal edition. Choose the topics you care about, by tapping or by speaking. Tap more of this or less of this on any story and the radio adjusts.

Talk to it. Turn on Voice and ask about the story you are hearing, or tell the radio to skip, pause or play something next. Your speech is turned into text on your phone. The text of a request is sent to your account's Choir computer on our server and to outside AI models that write the answer. During the beta every account is on the free tier, and some of those companies may keep what is sent and use it to train their models. You agree to this when you create your account, and the screen says so above the button.

A reader. Read a story or a document, see its sources and its versions, and hear it read aloud.

Podcasts. Search for shows, subscribe, and listen. Episodes stream from the publisher.

Mail and files. Read and write mail, and keep files on your Choir computer.

Notebook. Keep notes that your Choir computer remembers.

Takes. Record a take of up to 60 seconds. It is shared with other listeners only if you press Publish, and you can delete it.

Your Choir computer. Each account has its own virtual machine on our server. It holds what you make and what you ask the radio to remember.

Sign in with a passkey. There are no passwords. A new account first checks your email address with a code we send, and you make the passkey on your phone. You can delete the account in the app, in Settings. Your access ends at once, and your account, your Choir computer and your data are permanently removed after 72 hours. You must be 16 or older.

What to know before you use it:

Stories are written by AI, not by reporters. The sources are cited and linked. Please check them for anything that matters.

Voice and takes use the microphone only when you turn them on. The iPhone shows its microphone indicator while it is on.

When you set up voice, the app recommends the speech and language models that fit your phone, shows their total size, and downloads them from Hugging Face only after you agree. In Settings, Voice and models, you can try, switch or remove models.

The news can include war, crime and other serious subjects.

Privacy policy: https://choir.news/privacy

name: AutoTribe.One
description:
AutoTribe.One — персональная страница вашей машины. Вся история обслуживания в одном месте, а не в бумажках из бардачка.

  ИСТОРИЯ ОБСЛУЖИВАНИЯ
  • Сфотографируйте заказ-наряд или чек из автосервиса — AutoTribe.One распознает документ и сам внесёт работы, запчасти, сумму и пробег.
  • Добавляйте записи вручную: ТО, ремонт, тюнинг, прочее.
  • Хроника по годам и календарь: видно, что и когда делали с машиной.
  • Документ прикрепляется к записи — запись становится доказательством, а не воспоминанием.

  DRIVEAI — ПОМОЩНИК ПО ВАШЕЙ МАШИНЕ
  • Знает марку, модель, год, пробег и историю обслуживания именно вашей машины.
  • Отвечает на вопросы: когда следующее ТО, какое масло подходит, что пора менять.
  • Сам напоминает о ТО, страховке и техосмотре и предупреждает о морозах и гололёде в вашем городе.
  • Пришлите фото одометра — запишет пробег. Пришлите заказ-наряд — сохранит его в историю.
  • Добавить машину можно прямо в чате: «добавь камри 2018».

  ПАСПОРТ МАШИНЫ
  • Год, двигатель, мощность, привод, КПП, госномер — всё на одной странице.
  • Описание вашей машины, составленное ИИ, и фото модели из каталога, пока вы не добавили своё.
  • История пробега: каждое показание с датой.

  УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ ПО ДЕЛУ
  Напоминания приходят пушем и только о вашей машине. Какие темы получать, выбираете в профиле.

  НА ДВУХ ЯЗЫКАХ
  Интерфейс на русском и казахском.

  ВАШИ ДАННЫЕ — ВАШИ
  Номер телефона, VIN и документы не видны другим людям. Аккаунт можно удалить в профиле в любой момент.

name: Auvyra
description:
Auvyra is one app for every internet radio station that runs Auvyra. Add your favourite stations by their website address and listen live, wherever you are.

• Listen live, with the song, the artist and the album art as they play, and controls on your lock screen while the app is in the background.
• See what's coming up: the station's schedule, its shows and presenters, in the station's own time zone.
• Read the station's news.
• Request a song from the station's library, and send a shoutout to the presenter, where the station allows it.
• Keep as many stations as you like, and switch between them in a tap.
• Choose how the app looks. Simple is one screen with a big play button and large text. Advanced adds saved songs, sharing, a sleep timer and a visualiser.

No accounts, no adverts and no tracking. The stations you add are kept on your phone. The app only talks to the stations you add.

Auvyra is open-source software for radio stations that use AzuraCast, made by SkyBlox Systems LTD. Try it with the demo station: add demo.auvyra.org.

name: AuxPass
description:
AuxPass turns your phone into the party speaker everyone gets a say in.

Start a room, and friends join with a 6-letter code or by scanning a QR code. They search for songs and send requests from their own phones, in the AuxPass app or straight from a web page with nothing to install. Requests land in your queue and play on your own Apple Music or Spotify Premium account.

THE ROOM DECIDES
• Thumbs up moves a song higher in the queue
• See how many people in the room like what's playing
• Not feeling it? When more than half the room votes to skip, it skips
• React with Fire, Haha, Wow and Love and watch the hype meter fill up

YOU STAY IN CHARGE
• Auto-approve requests, or approve each one
• Limit how many songs each guest can have waiting
• Reorder or remove requests, and block or remove a guest, at any time
• Play, pause and skip from the room screen

FOR CAR RIDES AND HOUSE PARTIES
• Car ride preset: just the queue, no games
• Friends nearby can join over Bluetooth with no internet
• On a Mac, full screen becomes a party display with a big Now Playing, the room code and the queue

PARTY GAMES (AUXPASS PLUS)
• Guess who picked it
• Name that tune
• Guess the year
• Music bingo
• Team mode and theme rounds

Votes, reactions, Top DJs, badges and the end-of-party recap are free. Free rooms hold up to 5 guests.

AUXPASS PLUS
Plus removes the guest limit and unlocks the game modes. Choose monthly or yearly, each with a 1-week free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings. Guests never pay.

HOW IT PLAYS
AuxPass never records, streams or sends audio. Songs play only through the host's own Apple Music or Spotify app, so the host needs an Apple Music subscription or Spotify Premium. Guests only send song info.

Terms of Use: https://auxpass-relay.asigurdsdev.workers.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://auxpass-relay.asigurdsdev.workers.dev/privacy

name: Ava Social
description:
Play CORDON 9, then switch to one-on-one chat, friends, feed, and profile.Ava brings CORDON 9 and its social spaces together. Start a full-screen run from the game card in Chat, then return to catch up with the people around the game.
- Play CORDON 9: Jump into a run directly from Chat and switch back to Ava when you’re done.
- Chat one-on-one: Open a conversation and pick up where you left off.
- Keep up with friends: Browse the Friends list and visit player profiles.
- Browse the Feed: See updates and activity from around your crew.
From the first tap on the game card to the conversations and updates between runs, Ava keeps CORDON 9 and its community in one place.

name: Avalio App
description:
O Avalio é o aplicativo de coleta de pesquisas e questionários para equipes de campo. Pesquisadores, avaliadores e entrevistadores cadastrados pela empresa contratante recebem seus questionários no celular, respondem com rapidez e enviam tudo de forma segura — com ou sem internet.

SEUS QUESTIONÁRIOS DO DIA NUM SÓ LUGAR
• Veja os questionários agendados para você, com horário e status de cada um.
• Acompanhe o progresso: quantas respostas já foram coletadas e sincronizadas.
• Rascunho salvo automaticamente: pare a qualquer momento e continue de onde parou.
• Receba notificações quando houver novos questionários ou lembretes.

RESPONDA EM POUCOS TOQUES
• Escalas de 0 a 10, múltipla escolha, caixas de seleção, textos, datas e muito mais.
• Fotos pela câmera ou galeria, quando o questionário pedir.
• Localização preenchida automaticamente nas perguntas que exigem.

ASSINATURA DIRETO NA TELA
• Colete termos de autorização e consentimento na hora, no próprio celular.
• Assinatura manual desenhada na tela pelo respondente.
• Assinatura com foto: validação do respondente com código enviado por e-mail, SMS ou WhatsApp e selfie, gerando um comprovante.
• O respondente pode receber uma cópia das próprias respostas por e-mail, SMS ou WhatsApp.

FUNCIONA ATÉ SEM INTERNET
• Baixe os questionários e responda em qualquer lugar, mesmo sem sinal.
• As respostas ficam guardadas com segurança no aparelho e são enviadas automaticamente quando a conexão voltar.
• Sincronize manualmente com um toque sempre que quiser.

SEU ACESSO, PROTEGIDO
• Login individual para cada pesquisador.
• Dados armazenados de forma criptografada no aparelho.
• Termos de uso e política de privacidade sempre à mão no seu perfil.

IMPORTANTE: o Avalio é de uso exclusivo de pesquisadores cadastrados por empresas clientes. O acesso é feito com o login fornecido pela sua empresa — não há cadastro aberto dentro do aplicativo.

name: Awail Al Fath
description:

name: Ayıp Ettin Komşu
description:
Türkiye haritası, 973 ilçe, gerçek oyuncular. Sınırın öbür yanında komşun askerlerini sayıyor; sen de boş durma.

Ayıp Ettin Komşu, Türkiye'nin ilçe haritasında geçen gerçek zamanlı, çok oyunculu bir strateji oyunu. Boş bir ilçeye muhtar olarak yerleş, askerini topla, komşu ilçelere dal ve haritayı kendi rengine boya.

NASIL OYNANIR
• Boş bir ilçe seç, muhtar ol. Başkentini iyi koru: düşerse bütün ilçelerin elden gider.
• Her saat askerini topla, nüfusundan asker al. Gece saldırı yoktur; askere alma yerine bekçi tutarsın.
• Kendi ilçene dokun, "Buradan dal"a bas, komşuna saldır. Ordun yola çıkar, varınca zarlar masaya atılır: 3 kırmızı zar, 2 beyaz zara karşı.
• Bir ilde en çok ilçeyi tutan vali olur, bir bölgenin hâkimi bölge ağası.
• İlçene saldırı gelince ekranın kenarı kırmızı yanıp söner: koş, takviye getir.

DOST MU, DÜŞMAN MI?
• Komşuna dostluk teklif et: dostlar birbirine saldırmaz, birbirine asker yollar.
• Ya da bir çay ısmarla, sözlü ateşkes yap. Ama çayı döken 24 saat "Güvenilmez" damgası yer; haritada da sohbette de herkes görür.
• Sohbette ittifak kur, pazarlık et, gerektiğinde hesap sor.

HER HAFTA YENİ SEZON
• Harita her hafta sıfırlanır, levelin ve unvanın kalır.
• Sezonun en çok puan toplayanı "Türkiye'nin Muhtarı" olur.
• Sezon sonunda Elmas, Altın, Gümüş ve Bronz ligleri dağıtılır; lig rozetin bir sonraki sezon boyunca adının yanında durur.
• Günlük ve haftalık görevler, seri bonusu, level atladıkça yeni unvanlar.

BU SEZON NELER VAR?
• Bölge ağalığı: bölgenin hâkimi her saat fazladan asker ve puan kazanır.
• Ganimet kartları: günün ilk fethi Çay, Simit ya da Lokum kartı getirir; üçlü seti askerle takas et.
• Gizli görev: her sezon yalnızca senin gördüğün tek bir hedef.
• Hafta sonu akşamları etkinlik: cumartesi bölge savaşı ve şans günü, pazar barış günü.

HABERİN OLSUN
• Bildirimler: ilçene saldırı gelince ya da askerlerin dolunca haber gelir. Hangi bildirimin geleceğini sen seçersin; gece bildirim gelmez.

HERKESE AÇIK, HERKESE EŞİT
• Misafir olarak hemen başla, hesap gerekmez. Sohbete yazmak için hesabını bağlaman yeter.
• Web'de ve telefonda aynı harita, aynı sezon: kaldığın yerden devam et.
• Telefonda ve tablette yatay ekranda oynanır.
• Reklam yok, oyunda avantaj satılmaz. Kazanmak için tek yol strateji.
• Sohbette küfür filtresi var; mesajı uzun basarak bildirebilir, oyuncuyu engelleyebilirsin. Bildirilen mesajları moderatörler inceler.

Gizlilik politikası: https://ayipettinkomsu.com/gizlilik
Kullanım koşulları: https://ayipettinkomsu.com/sartlar
Nasıl oynanır: https://ayipettinkomsu.com/nasil-oynanir

Hadi, komşu bekliyor. Ayıp etme.

name: Azure Admin Associate 2027
description:
Pass the Microsoft Azure Administrator exam with focused, realistic practice that fits your day.

AZ-104 Prep gives you 515 exam-style questions across all five AZ-104 skill areas, clear explanations for every answer, timed mock exams and a readiness score that tells you when you are ready to book the real thing. Everything works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

PRACTICE THAT ADAPTS
- 515 questions: single answer, multiple answer and scenario style
- Identity & governance, storage, compute, virtual networking, and monitor & maintain
- Smart practice targets the domains where you are weakest
- Missed questions come back until you get them right
- Bookmark any question to review later

MOCK EXAMS THAT FEEL REAL
- Full 40-question timed exam, weighted like the real domains
- Flag questions, move freely, review and submit
- Scaled score out of 1,000 with the 700 pass line
- Domain-by-domain breakdown and a full review of every miss
- Every attempt saved, so you can watch your score climb

LEARN WHY, NOT JUST WHAT
- Instant feedback with a clear explanation after each answer
- Questions reflect current Azure services and terminology: Entra ID, RBAC, Azure Policy, storage, VMs, scale sets, App Service, containers, virtual networks, load balancing, Azure Monitor, backup and recovery

BUILT FOR HABITS
- Streaks keep you moving
- Optional reminders at the time you choose, scheduled on your device
- Beautiful, fluid design with satisfying motion and haptics

FREE TO START
- About 20% of every domain is free (100+ questions)
- A free 20-question Lite mock exam, unlimited retakes
- Unlock everything with a single one-time purchase. No subscription, ever.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your progress stays on your device. No sign-up, no ads, no analytics, no data collected.

AZ-104 Prep is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft. Microsoft and Azure are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies. Practice questions are original and are not actual exam questions. Passing the real exam is not guaranteed.

name: Baby Nap Schedule & Bedtime
description:
Know when the next nap is, in about fifteen seconds: enter your baby's age in months and what time they woke up, and Sunny Naps shows the next nap time as one clear number.
Then the whole day is laid out: every nap, the time between them and a suggested bedtime, built from age-based wake windows. Tap when a nap really starts and ends, and everything after it moves to fit.
One gentle reminder before the next nap. No account, no chatbot, no long setup. Your baby's details stay on your device.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tell us your baby's age and today's wake-up time (and when the last nap ended, if there was one).
• See the next nap time right away.
• Get today's full plan: naps, awake stretches and bedtime, using a conservative wake-window range for each age from newborn to 3 years.
• Tap "Nap started" and "Nap ended" as the day goes. Running late or a short nap? The rest of the day recalculates.
• Pick a reminder 10, 15 or 20 minutes before the next nap so you can start winding down.

A CALM, SIMPLE DAY VIEW
A big next-nap card and a simple timeline show where you are in the day. Large type and big buttons work one-handed at 3 a.m. or 3 p.m., and the layout adapts to larger and folding iPhones.

GENERAL GUIDANCE, NOT MEDICAL ADVICE
Sunny Naps gives general timing guidance based on age. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose or treat anything. Every baby is different: follow your baby's sleepy cues. In the first months sleep varies a lot, so check with your pediatrician about your baby's sleep.

SUBSCRIPTION
Sunny Naps is a subscription app. You can try the next-nap calculation once, then choose a weekly, monthly or annual plan to unlock the full day schedule and reminders. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

Privacy policy and terms of use are linked inside the app.

name: BaghChal बाघचाल
description:
Four tigers hunt. Twenty goats defend.

BaghChal (बाघचाल) is the classic board game of Nepal, played on a hand-drawn 5×5 board in full 3D.

On a board of connected lines, one side controls four tigers, the other a herd of twenty goats. Tigers capture by leaping over a goat; eat five and the tigers win. The goats can't fight back alone, but together they are unstoppable: block every tiger's move and the goats win. A pure battle of aggression versus patience, with no luck involved.

• Play the computer — Easy, Medium and Hard, as tigers or goats, offline and with no account
• Play online — get matched with another player, climb 15 ranks from Beginner to Master, and compete on daily, weekly, monthly and all-time leaderboards
• Play a friend — create a private game and share a 6-character code
• Quick reactions — emoji and friendly phrases during online games
• Full 3D board with carved pieces, real shadows and a 30-second move clock
• Authentic rules, including the traditional rule against repeating positions
• Block and report players, and delete your account any time from your profile
• No ads, no in-app purchases

BaghChal (बाघचाल, "moving tigers") is one of South Asia's oldest strategy games, traditionally played on boards carved in stone or scratched into the earth.

Online play needs a free account (username, email and password). Playing the computer needs nothing.

name: Bakeworth: Cake Pricing
description:
Bakeworth tells you what to charge for your cakes, cupcakes and cookies.

Type in what you pay for flour, butter and eggs. Add your recipe. Bakeworth works out what one batch really costs, adds your time, your packaging and your profit, and gives you one clear price.

MADE FOR HOME BAKERS
• Cups, teaspoons, ounces, grams: use the units your recipe uses. Bakeworth converts between them, even cups of flour to pounds.
• Enter each ingredient's price once. When butter goes up, every recipe that uses it updates by itself.
• Use one recipe inside another: make buttercream once, add it to every cake.
• Double it or halve it and see the cost and the price for any batch size.

A PRICE YOU CAN EXPLAIN
• See where the money goes: ingredients, your time, packaging, overhead and profit.
• Set your hourly rate, overhead and profit once. Every recipe uses them.
• Round prices up to a tidy number.

SEND A QUOTE (PREMIUM)
• Turn any recipe into a short message for your customer, with the quantity and the price. Your costs stay with you.

YOURS, ON YOUR PHONE
• Works offline. No account, no sign-up.
• No ads.
• Save a backup file and bring your recipes to a new phone (Premium).
• 16 languages.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Bakeworth is free for up to 3 recipes, with every calculation included. Premium unlocks unlimited recipes, customer quotes and backups. Pay once and keep it forever, or pay by the year.

name: Bapsang Note
description:
Bapsang Note is a fast way to log Korean meals. Instead of adding rice, soup and each side dish one by one, the combinations you eat often are grouped into "sets" you can log in one tap.

■ One-tap Korean meal sets
When you log the same foods together in one meal twice or more, they're automatically grouped into a set. Tap a set to log the whole meal. Grouping happens on your device only — no server or AI.

■ Seasoning & oil adjustment
The same side dish can be saltier or oilier. Choose Less, Normal or More and fat and sodium are adjusted approximately.

■ Same as yesterday
Ate about the same as yesterday? Copy the previous day's meals with one button — and undo right away if you tapped by mistake.

■ Search, recent and custom
Search thousands of foods, re-log frequent foods from your recent list, or enter your own. See breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks with totals for calories, carbs, protein, fat and sodium. The food list follows your region: Korea, the US, the UK, France or Taiwan, each from that country's public food composition data.

■ Recipes
Korean recipes you can filter by cooking time, with servings you can log directly.

■ Suggestions for this meal
Get a combination for your next meal based on what you've eaten today and the calories you have left. It's calculated on your device only — no server or AI.

■ Look back
Log your weight once a day. With Pro, weekly and monthly nutrition reports show average calories, carbs, protein, fat, sodium and sugar for the days you logged, the share of each meal and your most frequent foods, and weight trends show a 7-day moving average and the gap to the goal you set yourself.

■ Home Screen widgets and Shortcuts
Check today's calories against your goal on Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets; tap to open logging. Start logging with Siri or Shortcuts.

■ Optional reminder
Turn on one reminder a day at a time you choose. Nothing is sent until you turn it on.

■ Appearance and accessibility
Light (default), Dark or System appearance, large text, landscape, and side-by-side layouts on iPad and large screens.

■ Privacy
No accounts, servers, ads or analytics. Everything stays on your device.

■ Nutrition sources
In Korea, based on the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (Korea) food composition and national food nutrient standard data (Public Data Portal) and the Rural Development Administration Korean Food Composition Database 10.4 (KOGL Type 1). Other regions use USDA FoodData Central (US), CoFID 2021 (UK, Open Government Licence v3.0), Ciqual 2025 (France, Licence Ouverte 2.0) and the Taiwan Food Nutrient Database (TFND). Full credits are in Settings > Nutrition Sources. All values are approximate references and not a substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment.

■ Pricing
Core features are included, with up to 3 sets shown. Bapsang Note Pro (monthly subscription, yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase) adds nutrition reports, weight trends, advanced meal suggestion settings and unlimited editable meal sets. No ads.
Subscriptions are charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renew automatically for the same period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. The lifetime purchase is charged once.

name: Batik Dip
description:
Batik Dip keeps each cloth on this iPhone.

Wax holds the color a patch already has. A bath only dyes when it is darker than the last one. Soga, then madder, then indigo. A lighter bath does nothing. A cloth that is waxed on every patch does nothing. Scrape the wax and that patch takes the next darker bath.

Boil removes every bit of wax. Three or more shades, counting white, come out patterned. Fewer shades come out flat. Boil before any dip and nothing changes. After the boil, wax, scrape, dip and boil do nothing. Only a cloth that has not been boiled can be deleted.

The cloth shows twelve patches. The layers page stacks each patch from white up to the shade it holds, with wax on top when it is still waxed.

You can name each cloth and find it by name. Share sends the name, how many baths it took, and whether it is patterned, flat, or not boiled. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Bauble Band: Christmas Carols
description:
Pick a carol and a band plays it. Bring a guitar, a ukulele, a recorder or just your voice, and play along.

82 carols and Christmas tunes, from Silent Night and Jingle Bells to Tchaikovsky’s Nutcracker dances and Handel’s Hallelujah Chorus.

A BAND THAT FOLLOWS YOU
Try three to seven styles per carol, including folk band, orchestral, jazz, ska, reggae, soul and medieval. Slow down while you learn it or change the key to suit your voice. Switch the drums, bass, keys, tune or sleigh bells on and off.

CHORDS AND THE TUNE
See the chord you’re on and the next one, with shapes for guitar, ukulele or piano. Pick trumpet, trombone, saxophone, clarinet, flute, recorder, violin or another instrument to see the tune written for it.

WORDS TO SING
Most carols have words on screen. A bouncing ball follows the syllable as the band plays. Open the words full screen for a room full of singers.

WINE GLASSES
Tap a wine glass to ring it or run a finger around its rim to make it sing. The glasses are tuned to the carol, and the band keeps playing.

Bauble Band is free and works without an account. Made by Magic Zebra Ltd.

name: Bazaar Sort: Cozy Shop Match
description:
A cozy neighbourhood bazaar, one puzzle at a time.

In Bazaar Sort, arrange the goods on the shelves and match identical triples. Every shelf has three slots, and some items are hidden behind the front ones. Put three identical items on one shelf to make a match, and they fly off to the customer waiting for that order.

Cats, bears, bunnies, foxes, pandas, owls, puppies and hedgehogs are all waiting for their orders. You decide which order to fill first. A level ends when every order is complete, not when the shelves run empty.

Highlights
• 5 shops: A new shop opens every 20 levels: Corner Shop, Bakery, Fruit Stand, Spice Bazaar and Toy Shop.
• 60-item collection: Every item is drawn in a hand-made style and saved to your collection.
• Daily Order: Everyone gets the same level. Earn medals based on your move count and share your result.
• Helpers: Every level gives you three free undos. Shuffle the items at the front or add an extra shelf when you need it.
• Streak and rewards: Play every day to grow your streak and complete the 7-day reward calendar.
• 11 languages: Play in your language.

No timer, no rush
There is no clock. Every level is solved at your own pace.

Your daily habit
A new Daily Order every day. Compare your results, keep your streak alive and collect the regular customers from each shop.

Few ads
No ads in the first 15 levels. After that, ads are rare and optional. You can also watch a short ad to use a helper.

Free to play. Contains ads. You can make a one-time in-app purchase to remove interstitial ads.

name: BDG Cleaning
description:
This app is exclusively for Bailey Development Group cleaning staff. Accounts are issued by the company. There is no public sign-up.

BDG Cleaning is the job app for Bailey Development Group's contracted cleaning crew. If you clean for BDG and need access, contact your manager.

• See your assigned cleanings with dates, checkout times and property details
• Get door, supply closet and Wi-Fi info for each property you're assigned
• Work through a room-by-room checklist so nothing gets missed
