name: Bee Hub: Client Portal
description:
Bee Hub is the client portal for businesses that run on Beemud. If you work with an agency, freelancer or studio that uses Beemud, this app keeps everything about your work with them in one place.

CHAT WITH YOUR TEAM
One chat with the people doing your work. Ask a question, share a thought, get an answer. Type @bee to ask Bee, the assistant, about your projects, tasks or invoices any time.

KNOW THE MOMENT SOMETHING NEEDS YOU
Get a notification when your team replies, when a task is waiting for your review, when they comment on your work, or when an invoice or proposal arrives. Tap it to open exactly that item.

YOUR TASKS
See what is waiting on you, approve work or ask for changes, and follow what the team is doing now.

INVOICES AND PROPOSALS
See what you owe and pay securely, read and sign proposals and contracts.

MORE
Start a new project request, see results, share logins safely in your Locker, choose which notifications you get, light or dark mode, and Face ID.

Bee Hub is free. You sign in with the email or mobile number your business already has for you; there is no account to create.

name: Beeyard: Beekeeping Log
description:
Keep a complete record of every hive, every season — in the yard, with gloves on, with no signal.

Beeyard is a beekeeping log built for the inspection itself, not for the paperwork afterwards. Open the hive, tap or speak what you see, close the app. Every record saves to your phone first and syncs when you're back in range, so a dead zone never costs you an inspection.


BUILT FOR THE APIARY, NOT THE DESK

• Field Mode — one question per screen, oversized targets, usable one-handed in a veil
• Voice logging — say "queen seen, eggs, eight frames, four mites" and Beeyard fills in the fields. Speech is transcribed on your device, so it works with no signal and nothing is sent away to be understood
• Offline first. No spinner, no waiting, no lost inspection


WHAT YOU CAN TRACK

• Inspections — queen, eggs, larvae, capped brood, queen cells, frames of bees, stores, space and temperament
• Varroa counts, measured against the treatment threshold
• Treatments, with a warning when you're about to repeat the same chemistry and breed resistance
• Feeding, by type, with guidance for the season
• Hive weight over time
• Splits and nucs, with lineage back to the parent colony
• Queen rearing — grafting through emergence to laying, on a calendar that counts the days for you
• Harvests, with a live yield estimate and a winter-stores verdict before you take the supers


HONEY, FROM FRAME TO CUSTOMER

• Bottling runs turn a harvest into jars
• Jar inventory that knows the difference between reserved and available, so the same jars are never promised twice
• Sales, with delivery and payment tracked separately
• Printable receipts carrying your own details


KNOW WHAT'S ACTUALLY HAPPENING

• Mite trends and hive strength charted across the season
• Year-on-year yield, hive by hive
• PDF hive reports — for your own records, a bee inspector, or a buyer
• CSV export, so your records are readable without this app
• Seasonal reminders tuned to your climate rather than a generic calendar
• Swarm-season alerts when a colony starts showing the signs

Hive tags can be scanned with NFC, so the right hive opens the moment you touch the phone to the box.


FREE AND PRO

Free includes one hive with unlimited inspections, treatments, feeding, tasks and harvests, plus CSV export of that hive's records.

Beeyard Pro adds:
• Unlimited hives and apiaries
• Mite trend and hive strength charts
• PDF reports and honey receipts
• Photos on hives and inspections
• Honey sales and jar inventory
• CSV export of every record

name: Begerig Shelf
description:
Begerig Shelf zamienia przepełnioną kosmetyczkę w uporządkowaną, przejrzystą półkę.

Zanim kupisz kolejny krem, sprawdź, co już masz.

Większość z nas trzyma w łazience trzy serum o podobnym składzie, a gdy jakieś jest naprawdę potrzebne, nie ma żadnego. Ten katalog powstał po to, żeby zauważyć to w porę.

Pielęgnacja skóry, makijaż i kosmetyki do włosów lądują w jednym miejscu. Każdy produkt ma swoje miejsce i swoją kategorię.

Aplikacja sama porządkuje produkty według działów. Nie musisz przewijać całej listy, żeby znaleźć jeden podkład.

Status mówi więcej, niż się wydaje.

Etykieta statusu pokazuje, na jakim etapie jest dany produkt. Od razu widzisz, co dopiero otwierasz, a co powoli się kończy.

Data otwarcia ma znaczenie.

Okres przydatności po otwarciu, oznaczany skrótem PAO, mówi, jak długo kosmetyk zachowuje swoje właściwości. Aplikacja zapisuje daty w jednolitym formacie, więc łatwo je porównać, niezależnie od tego, kto je wpisał.

Produkty, którym kończy się termin, nie giną w tłumie. Na bieżąco widzisz, co wymaga uwagi, zanim będzie za późno.

Ilość też się liczy.

Każdy produkt ma swoją jednostkę: mililitry, gramy albo sztuki. Dzięki temu dwa opakowania tej samej pomadki nie wyglądają w katalogu jak dwie różne rzeczy.

Grupy zamiast bałaganu.

Łącz produkty w grupy, które odpowiadają Twoim rytuałom. Poranna pielęgnacja, wieczorny demakijaż czy pielęgnacja włosów mogą mieć własne sekcje, a każda z nich pozostaje przejrzysta nawet przy dużej liczbie produktów.

Sprawdź duplikaty, zanim kupisz.

To serce całej aplikacji. Przed zakupem zaglądasz na swoją półkę i sprawdzasz, czy nie stoi tam już coś podobnego. Oszczędzasz pieniądze, miejsce w szafce i ten niezręczny moment, gdy okazuje się, że masz już dwa toniki.

Zapamiętaj, gdzie kupujesz.

Adres sklepu przypisany do produktu pozwala szybko wrócić po kolejne opakowanie bez przekopywania historii zamówień.

Czytelne linki i bezpieczny dostęp.

Każdy produkt dostaje krótki, czytelny link, który łatwo zapamiętać i komuś przesłać. Jeśli ustawisz hasło, aplikacja przechowuje wyłącznie jego skrót, a nie samo hasło.

Półka na dobry początek.

Aplikacja może przygotować startowy zestaw produktów, dzięki czemu już przy pierwszym uruchomieniu zobaczysz, jak wygląda uporządkowany katalog.

Dla kogo?

Dla osób, które kochają pielęgnację, ale nie chcą płacić dwa razy za to samo. Dla tych, którzy mają zapasy w kilku szufladach i nie są pewni, co zdąży się przeterminować.

Zacznij od jednego produktu. Półka będzie rosła, a z każdym wpisem lepiej poznasz to, czego naprawdę używasz.

name: Begrudged
description:
Begrudged is a workplace comedy about your actual problems.

Describe something that annoyed you today. The Office of Undue Concern, Department of Grievances & General Discontent, will open a file, book Conference Room B and convene four employees who take themselves far too seriously. They will discuss it at length. They will disagree about the agenda. Someone will propose a working group.

Then comes the paperwork: an official incident report, on the record until you say otherwise.

WHAT HAPPENS
- Report to Reception and file a grievance in your own words
- Watch the meeting unfold in Conference Room B, written fresh for every complaint
- Receive an incident report with findings, recommendations and no consequences
- Return to an office that remembers what you told it, and holds it against everyone

ACCIDENTAL PRODUCTIVITY
Fictional incompetence. Functional competence. If your grievance mentions a real appointment, deadline or errand, the staff may offer to put it on your calendar or in your reminders. Nothing is added unless you tap Approve. The Morning Memorandum lists what you approved, in case anyone asks.

NO ACCOUNT. NO ADS.
No sign-up, no login, no tracking. Your records stay on your phone, and you can delete everything from Settings whenever the office gets to be too much. Meetings are written by AI for each grievance.

Begrudged is fictional entertainment for adults. It is not therapy, advice or HR. No real organization, investigation or finding is implied.

A Half Ordinary Software production. Misery loves software.

name: BelegSafe – Quittungen
description:
Wo ist die Quittung der Waschmaschine? Wann läuft die Garantie des Handys ab? Mit BelegSafe hast du alle Kaufbelege und Garantien an einem Ort.

FOTOGRAFIEREN UND ABLEGEN
• Quittung mit der Kamera fotografieren oder aus der Galerie wählen
• Produkt, Marke, Laden, Kaufdatum, Preis, Modell- und Seriennummer erfassen
• Vorschläge für Schweizer Läden wie Migros, Coop, Interdiscount, MediaMarkt, Fust, Digitec Galaxus, Brack, Manor und IKEA
• Weitere Fotos speichern, z. B. Typenschild oder Bedienungsanleitung

GARANTIE IM BLICK
• Garantiedauer frei wählbar (12, 24, 36, 60 Monate oder eigene Angabe)
• Countdown bis zum Garantieende mit klarem Status: aktiv, läuft bald ab, abgelaufen
• Erinnerung 30 Tage vor Ablauf und am letzten Garantietag

GARANTIEANFRAGE IN SEKUNDEN
• Defekt beschreiben – BelegSafe erstellt ein fertiges Schreiben an den Händler
• Auf Deutsch, Französisch oder Albanisch
• Kopieren, per E-Mail senden oder teilen
• Ist die Garantie abgelaufen, wird automatisch eine Kulanzanfrage daraus

PRIVAT
• Alle Daten bleiben auf deinem Gerät
• Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking
• Export deiner Daten als JSON

App-Sprache: Deutsch, Französisch und Albanisch.

name: Belliney's
description:
Belliney's Ristorante & Bar, Italian restaurant, Ryde, now on your phone.

ORDER IN A FEW TAPS
Browse the full menu: wood-fired pizzas, handmade pasta, fresh seafood, mains, salads, kids' meals and desserts. Add extras, leave a note for the kitchen and choose pickup as soon as possible or at a time that suits you.

LOWER PRICES ONLINE
Every price in the app is lower than in the restaurant.

PAY YOUR WAY
Apple Pay, Google Pay, credit and debit cards, Afterpay and Belliney's gift cards, all processed securely by Square.

BELLINEY'S REWARDS
Earn 1 point for every $1 you spend, whether you dine in or order in the app. It's the same balance as at the counter. Every 100 points is $5 off, and you can use as many points as you have, in the app or in the restaurant.

REORDER IN SECONDS
Your details and past orders are saved on your phone, so your usual order is one tap away. Receipts are kept in the app too.

BOOK A TABLE
Send a booking request from the app and our team will call or email you to confirm.

Belliney's Ristorante & Bar
The Piazza, Shop 3040, Ground Level, 109 Blaxland Rd, Ryde NSW 2112

name: Benjamin Marc
description:
**Benjamin Marc — Web Design & Digital Marketing**

Discover the creative and digital marketing services offered by Benjamin Marc, a Long Island and New York City web design and marketing agency established in 2005.

Explore our portfolio, learn about our services, and connect directly with our team.

name: Bhumesh
description:
Bhumesh  by Bhumesh get you covered here! This software helps in executing your idea of managing the lead, Inventory, Associate and much more in addition with utmost accuracy and better sorting.

This Software is made especially for the real estate industry, keeping in mind their real hustles of lead generations/lead management for the plots occupied/unoccupied and other things

name: Bilan de mandat
description:
Le vendeur vous demande ce qui revient le plus souvent en visite ? Ouvrez le dossier du bien pour retrouver les visites réalisées, les freins cités et les actions à mener.

DU PREMIER RENDEZ-VOUS AU BILAN

• Créez le dossier dès le premier rendez-vous vendeur et ajoutez la référence de votre logiciel métier.
• Planifiez les visites et contre-visites, puis notez ce qui a plu, les freins et les suites à donner.
• Rassemblez les photos, vidéos, notes vocales et documents du bien ou d’une visite.
• Retrouvez dans « À traiter » les questions, pièces à envoyer et rappels.
• Suivez les offres reçues et les changements de prix, de photos ou d’annonce.

UN BILAN PRÊT POUR LE VENDEUR

Choisissez la période, vérifiez les chiffres, ajoutez vos décisions et sélectionnez les photos à inclure. Partagez le bilan en PDF. Les noms des acquéreurs et les notes internes restent dans le dossier.

UN DOSSIER COMPLET GRATUIT

Découvrez l’app avec un dossier fictif, puis suivez un bien gratuitement, export PDF compris. Un achat unique débloque les dossiers et archives illimités ainsi que la personnalisation des bilans au nom et à la couleur de votre agence.

Vos dossiers sont conservés sur votre appareil. Aucun compte à créer.

name: Bilgisayarcı: PC Dükkanı
description:
Mahalle dükkanından İstanbul'un en büyük bilgisayar mağazasına uzanan bir patronluk hikâyesi seni bekliyor!

Bilgisayarcı'da kendi PC dükkanını açıyorsun: toptancıdan ekran kartı, işlemci, RAM ve çevre birimleri alıyor, raflara diziyor, fiyatları belirliyor ve kapıdan giren her müşteriyi mutlu etmeye çalışıyorsun. Oyun gerçek zamanlı akar; sen yokken bile depo sorumlun rafları doldurur, kasa dolmaya devam eder.

◆ KENDİ DÜKKANINI KUR
• 3B mağazanda rafları sürükle, döndür, istediğin gibi diz
• Ekran kartı vitrininden oyuncu koltuğu alanına kadar 7 farklı raf
• Birinci şahıs kamerayla dükkanının içinde gez

◆ AL, DİZ, SAT
• 80'den fazla parça, onlarca kurgusal marka
• Toptan fiyatı, piyasa fiyatı ve kâr marjını sen yönet
• Parçaları seç, hazır sistem topla; tek tek satmaktan çok daha kârlı

◆ İSTANBUL'U FETHET
• 39 ilçenin her biri farklı: kira, müşteri profili, fiyat hassasiyeti ve rekabet
• İlk mağazanı istediğin ilçede aç, sonra diğer ilçelerde şubeler kur
• Mahalle dükkanından AVM mağazasına, oradan dev teknoloji merkezine büyü

◆ PAZARLAMA VE ETKİNLİKLER
• El ilanından TV reklamına kampanyalar
• YouTuber'larla iş birliği yap, LAN partisi ve espor turnuvası düzenle
• Piyasa haberlerini takip et: kripto patlaması, RAM krizi, kur dalgalanması…

◆ EKİP VE BÜYÜME
• Satış danışmanı, kasiyer, depo sorumlusu, teknisyen ve sosyal medya uzmanı işe al
• Seviye atladıkça yeni bölümler, daha pahalı ve kaliteli ürünler açılır
• Hedefleri tamamla, ödülleri topla

◆ SEN YOKKEN DE KAZAN
Oyun kapalıyken de mağazaların satış yapmaya devam eder. Geri döndüğünde seni "Sen yokken" raporu ve dolu bir kasa karşılar.

Bilgisayarcı ücretsizdir. İsteğe bağlı uygulama içi satın alımlar (elmas paketleri, Başlangıç Paketi) ve Patron Kartı aboneliği içerir. Oyunda yalnızca senin istediğinde açılan ödüllü reklamlar bulunur.

PATRON KARTI ABONELİĞİ
• Aylık, otomatik yenilenen abonelik
• Çevrimdışı kazanç süresi 4 saatten 12 saate, verim %100
• Her gün 60 elmas, günlük bonuslar ve tüm şubelerde +%10 müşteri
• Ödeme, satın alma onaylandığında Apple hesabından alınır. Dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse abonelik aynı fiyattan otomatik yenilenir. Aboneliğini App Store hesap ayarlarından yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsin.

Kullanım Koşulları: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Gizlilik Politikası: https://bilgisayarci.ugurkadirkarahan.online/gizlilik/

Oyundaki tüm marka ve ürün adları kurgusaldır; gerçek şirketlerle bir ilgisi yoktur.

name: birdtwo: Pixel Bird
description:
birdtwo is a one-tap, hand-made pixel-art arcade game.

Tap and fly: every tap is a flap. Glide through the pipes without touching them.
10 birds: from the gull to the legendary Sunbird, each one opens as you play. Some are surprises.
8 worlds: the city, the forest, the snowy peak, the sunset, the night meadow and surprises in the shadows.
6 badges: earned by the score you make in a single round.
World and country rankings: race players from around the world on Game Center.
11 languages: pick yours on the start screen.

name: Bisim: Dual SIM Calls
description:
Carry one phone in your hand and leave the other in your bag. Bisim brings the calls, texts, contacts and call history of your own Android phone to your iPhone, over an encrypted Bluetooth link.

CALLS
• Calls ring on the iPhone's own call screen
• Hold, mute, keypad and speaker
• Choose the line for each call when the phone has two SIMs

TEXTS
• Read, search and answer your conversations
• Answer from the notification
• One-time codes ready to copy, reactions shown on the message

ALWAYS HONEST ABOUT THE LINK
• See at a glance whether the two phones are connected
• Battery, signal and network of the other phone
• Widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Calls, texts and contacts go between your two phones, encrypted
• No account on the iPhone, no ads, no tracking

TRY IT FIRST
Tap "Try the demo" on the Link tab to use the whole app with made-up data, with no second phone.

YOU NEED
• Your own Android phone with a SIM, kept within Bluetooth range
• The free Bisim app on that phone, from bisim.org

Call sound depends on the Android model. Bisim is not a replacement for emergency calling.

name: BiteClub - Eat. Post. Earn
description:
EAT. POST. EARN.

Your next favorite bite could lead to your next reward. BiteClub connects food lovers with participating restaurants that reward original social content.

DISCOVER SOMETHING DELICIOUS
Explore participating restaurants, browse their locations, and see the rewards they offer.

CAPTURE YOUR FOOD MOMENTS
Take a fresh photo or video in BiteClub, then choose an available sharing destination. Finish publishing in your social app and return to submit your post for review.

EARN POINTS TOWARD REWARDS
Qualifying posts earn points after the required posting period and BiteClub approval. Track available and pending points, explore rewards, and redeem at eligible participating locations.

BUILD YOUR BADGE COLLECTION
Earn badges for approved original posts and exploring different cuisines, restaurant brands, and cities.

WORK YOUR WAY TO VIP FOODIE
Earn all seven other badges plus 1,000 lifetime points to unlock access to BiteClub’s VIP rewards. Reward availability and point costs vary.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose a participating restaurant and location.
• Capture a fresh photo or video.
• Share to an available social platform and finish publishing there.
• Return to BiteClub and submit for review.
• Redeem approved points toward eligible rewards.

Posting requirements vary by platform. Qualifying posts must remain public for the required period and include the specified restaurant mentions and hashtags. Sharing or submitting does not automatically award points. Pending points cannot be redeemed. Restaurant and location restrictions apply.

Discover your next bite with BiteClub.

name: BLACK HOLE – Space Survival
description:
Take control of your own Black Hole and devour the entire universe!

Start as a tiny singularity, swallow asteroids, moons, planets, and colossal stars — and outrun lethal rival Black Holes in silky-smooth 120 FPS.

FEATURES: 
• Endless Mode: Chase your high score, trigger 2× Fever Mode, and survive escalating apex hunters.
• Galactic Odyssey Story Mode: 50 handcrafted levels across 5 galaxies, 5 epic boss fights, 150 collectible stars & milestone chests.
• Boost, Shockwave & Wormholes: Blast away with Warp Boost, unleash your Gravity Shockwave, and jump through cosmic wormholes.
• 10 Unique Skins, 8 Galaxy Maps & Permanent Upgrades: Customize your Black Hole with live shader effects and trails.
• Daily Rewards & Missions: 7-day login streak and rotating daily challenges.
• Galaxy League & Apple Game Center: Climb the league ranks and compete globally or with friends.

Are you ready to devour the galaxy?

name: Blackleaf: Redact Word Docs
description:
Blackleaf helps you find and remove personal data from Word documents on your iPhone or iPad. Everything runs on the device. There is no account, and the app makes no network calls.

Open a .docx from Files, Mail or the Share sheet, or tap Try the sample document to use a built-in fictional tenancy reference. Blackleaf scans the parts a Word file can hide as well as the visible text: headers, footers, comments, notes, text boxes, links, fields, properties and more.

You review every finding before anything is changed. Accept or reject names, contact details, financial numbers, IDs and anything you mark yourself. Export stays unavailable until each item has a decision. Replacements can be consistent labels, such as [NAME 1], or fixed-width black bars.

When you export, Blackleaf writes a new file and leaves your original untouched. You can save a sanitized Word copy, or a PDF drawn from that cleaned copy. An optional Flatten setting turns each PDF page into an image so there is no text layer; it is off by default, and labels stay searchable if you leave it off. Blackleaf then re-reads the new file and blocks sharing if a redacted string is still found.

Always check the output before you share it.

What Blackleaf does not do
• It does not read text inside images or photos, and it tells you how many images were not checked.
• Embedded objects are listed and removed on export rather than redacted.
• It opens standard .docx files only, not .doc, password-protected, macro-enabled or Strict OOXML files, and it does not import PDFs.
• The PDF layout is a simplified rendering of the cleaned Word copy, not a pixel-perfect match for Microsoft Word.
• Detection can miss things. That is why review is required.

The app is free to download. Opening a document, scanning it and reviewing every finding are free. A single one-time in-app purchase unlocks export of the sanitized Word copy and the PDF. There is no subscription.

Blackleaf is a tool to help you find and remove personal data. It is not legal, privacy or compliance advice, and it does not claim GDPR, HIPAA or court-ready status.

name: Blade Toss: Spin & Throw
description:
Throw your blades into the spinning target, but never hit a blade that is already stuck in it!

Tap to throw. The target spins, speeds up, slows down and reverses, so timing is everything. Clear every stage to smash the target, hit apples for bonus coins, and face a boss every fifth stage: the Cheese Wheel, the Iron Shield, the Watermelon and the Giant Donut.

FEATURES
• Simple one-tap controls with tricky timing
• Endless stages with changing spin patterns
• Boss fights every five stages
• Collect blades: Kunai, Cleaver, Ruby, Jade and the Golden Sword
• Second chance when a throw goes wrong
• Play offline anywhere

Blade Toss is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Blame Tower
description:
Blame Tower is a single 3D tower shared by players all over the planet. Everyone adds one block. If the tower collapses on yours, your name goes straight onto the Wall of Shame for the whole world to see.

• ONE TOWER FOR EVERYONE: real physics and real tension with every block. How high can we go together?
• WALL OF SHAME: whoever knocks it down gets called out. Don't let it be you.
• SEASON GOALS: height targets with a deadline. If the world hits them, everyone wins.
• 45 COLLECTIBLE BLOCKS: unlock shapes, materials and rarities to leave your mark.
• PRIVATE TOWERS: build your own tower and challenge your friends to see who cracks first.
• CHAT BY COUNTRY: cheer, tease and blame your fellow players in real time.
• VIP: no ads, faster blocks and exclusive perks.

Place it, breathe… and don't be the one who drops it.

Terms of Use: https://agunapps.com/apps/blame-tower/terminos/

name: Blaze Along
description:
Blaze Along is the group trip planner with an AI travel buddy built in. Tell Blaze where you're going and it builds the plan, keeps your crew in sync, and tracks the details nobody wants to chase.

PLAN IN ONE CHAT
• Tell Blaze your dates, destination and wishlist. It drafts a day-by-day itinerary.
• Rename the trip, move plans around or add ideas by just asking.
• Share booking screenshots and PDFs. Blaze reads them and adds flights, stays and reservations to the trip.

A GROUP CHAT THAT KNOWS THE PLAN
• Invite friends with a trip code.
• Tag @Blaze in the group chat to ask about the weather, restaurants, concerts or what's next. Everyone sees the answer.
• Get notified when the plan changes or someone posts.

EVERY DAY, MAPPED OUT
• A calendar of the trip in local time, day by day.
• One-tap directions to every stop.
• Add plans to your phone's calendar.

KNOW WHAT'S LEFT TO BOOK
• Blaze turns the plan into a pre-trip checklist and shows how ready you are.
• On-trip lists keep the important stuff in one place.
• Blaze keeps an eye on the trip and gives you a heads-up when something needs attention.

SPLIT COSTS WITHOUT THE SPREADSHEET
• Log expenses by telling Blaze, snapping a receipt or adding them by hand.
• See who owes whom, with debts simplified to as few payments as possible.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your chat with Blaze is just you and Blaze. Every detail Blaze saves shows whether it's private or shared with the group.
• Report or block anyone from a long-press, and delete your account any time from Profile.

Blaze uses AI and can make mistakes. Always double-check important details like flight times, entry rules and opening hours with the official source.

name: Blind Marble
description:
No ads. No logins. No subscriptions. Zero data tracking. Just open the app and play.

Blind Marble is a minimalist physics puzzle built for pure, distraction-free play. Pull back anywhere on screen to launch a luminous ivory marble into the dark. Every wall is completely invisible until you hit it—lighting up briefly in soft pastel mint and lavender before fading back into memory.

Map the labyrinth through touch, sound, and ricochet until you guide the marble through the pale-gold doorway.

PURE & SIMPLE BY DESIGN
• Instant Play — No menus, no tutorials, no timers, and no pop-ups getting in your way.
• 100% Language-Free — Visual, intuitive, and playable by anyone in seconds.
• Completely Offline & Private — Plays anywhere with zero tracking and zero data collected.

EXPLORE, RICOCHET & COLLECT
• 20 Handcrafted Levels + Endless Mode — Progress from calm starter corridors to 45° angled prism ricochets and an infinite stream of unique, guaranteed-solvable mazes.
• 48 Hidden Symbols Across 3 Collections — Listen for subtle proximity sonar pulses in diamond levels to uncover Gold (Cosmos), Mint (Nature), and Lavender (Sound) relics.
• Constellation Journey Map — Tap the progress bar to trace your path through the stars and revisit every symbol you have discovered.
• Soothing Sound & Tactile Haptics — Procedurally generated harmonic chimes and crisp haptic feedback respond to every bounce, angle, and discovery.

Sit back, take a shot into the unknown, and unwind—one ricochet at a time.

name: BlinkClip: Batch Video Tools
description:
Edit without editing.

BlinkClip is a batch video processing app for iPhone and iPad. When you already know what needs to be changed, you don't need to open a timeline and edit every video individually.

Select your videos, configure an action, and process the entire batch.

**VIDEO TOOLS**

• Trim — remove unwanted beginnings and endings.
• Still Trim — automatically detect and trim frozen endings.
• Quick Crop — adjust video framing and aspect ratios.
• Convert — convert videos to MP4, MOV, or M4V.
• Compress — reduce video file sizes.
• Resolution — resize videos to your desired dimensions.
• Speed — adjust playback speed.
• Merge — combine multiple videos into one.

**ADD AND CUSTOMIZE**

• Add Intro — add an intro, outro, or both to multiple videos.
• Insert Clip — insert a video at a selected position.
• Overlay — add images or videos over your footage.
• Add Audio — add, mix, or replace audio tracks.
• Mute — remove audio from videos.
• Extract Audio — export audio as M4A (AAC or ALAC), WAV, AIFF, or CAF.

**WORKFLOW**

Combine multiple actions into a single workflow. Configure your process once and apply it across multiple videos.

**BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD**

Import videos from Photos or Files, or share them directly to BlinkClip using the system share menu. Enjoy an adaptive interface designed for different screen sizes.

**PRIVATE BY DESIGN**

Your videos are processed locally on your device. BlinkClip does not upload your media to its servers, and no account is required. Your original videos remain unchanged.

Device mockup credits and licenses: https://blinkclip.baproj.com/legal/

Do once. Apply to all.

BlinkClip — Edit without editing.

name: Blinkdoku
description:
Where does the next firefly go? In Blinkdoku, you solve logic puzzles and light up a forest at night. Your first few clearings teach you the rules as you play. As you progress, the grids get larger and the lantern clues get trickier.

Place exactly one firefly in each row and column. The number on each lantern tells you how many fireflies are directly above, below, to its left, or to its right. Tap once to cross out a square and double-tap to place a firefly.
- Fixed puzzles that get more challenging as you progress
- An interactive tutorial to help you get started
- Hints that show you the next move you can deduce
- Glowing animations and gentle sound effects
- Optional iCloud sync for your game progress
Extra hints are available as optional in-app purchases.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Block Flip: Tower
description:
Flip the tower. Line up three. Smash!

Block Flip: Tower is a fresh brick puzzle. Tap any bar and it flips, together with every bar above it. Put three bars of one colour side by side and they burst. Keep popping on every move to grow your combo up to ×5.

TWO-SIDED BRICKS
Some bars have a different colour on the back. Flip them and they turn over. Plan each flip and your tower falls into place.

GETS BETTER AS YOU DO
• No timer: think as long as you like.
• Every level makes your pops worth 10% more.
• From level 10 your well grows a row, up to 14.
• Fill the fever meter for a burst of easy pops.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Send a challenge link: your friend gets the exact same tower.
• When they play, your run plays right next to theirs, move for move.
• Climb the global leaderboard: all time, this week and today's tower.

EVERY DAY
• Today's Tower: the same tower for everyone, one official try.
• Three daily missions and a weekly chest.
• 13 brick skins to collect, plus the ultra-rare Holo and Liquid Foil skins you can only find by luck (and give to a friend).

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Plays offline.
• No account needed.
• 16 languages.
• Colour-blind friendly marks on every bar.
• Leave the game at any time: your run is saved.
• Plays on iPhone and iPad.

Optional rewarded ads give you a second chance or a few Gems, only when you choose to watch one. Your first save each day is free. Privacy policy: https://lat-thap.pages.dev/privacy

name: Block Mine: Puzzle RPG
description:
Every line you clear, Bori's hammer comes down on a golem.

Block Mine: Puzzle RPG takes the classic 8×8 block puzzle and adds an RPG. Place blocks to clear lines and Bori, an apprentice dwarf, strikes the golem in front of him — clear several lines at once for a bigger hit. The deeper you go, the tougher the golems get, and the deeper the story runs.

■ Block puzzle meets battle
· Clearing lines attacks; keep a combo going for more damage
· Armored golems, regenerating golems, treasure golems that run away — each needs a different approach
· Stuck? Use the hammer or a reroll to clean up the board

■ A 700-floor mine and a story that keeps going
· Why do the golems never stop working? Follow the secret down into the mine
· Four parts, plus six more stories from floor 401 to 700 — and the mine goes on after that
· Ten companions fight at your side: Lina the crossbow-for-hire, silent Torvin, Mira the scholar who grades everything…

■ Plenty to grow
· Merge the ore golems leave behind into 15 tiers of gems in the workshop
· Upgrade, evolve and awaken gear, socket gems, collect relics and cards
· Hit a wall? Rebirth for medals and permanent power, then go deeper
· Sweep through easy floors in one go; your companions keep the veins running while you're away

■ Made for you if you
· love block puzzles but want something to aim for
· like short sessions with a long story
· enjoy cute pixel art and a warm, funny tale

· Plays offline. Sign in to keep your progress across devices.
· Free to play with optional in-app purchases. Ads only when you choose to watch one for a reward.

name: Blockberry: Block Puzzle
description:
Blockberry is a juicy, relaxing block puzzle that's easy to learn and hard to put down.

Drag colorful jelly blocks onto the 8x8 board, fill complete rows or columns to clear them, and chain clears together for huge combos. No timer, no pressure – just you, the board and your next high score.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Satisfying combos – clear several lines at once and watch the board explode with sparkles
• Smart boosters – Smash, Blast and Refresh help you escape tough spots
• Second chance – keep your run going when the board gets stuck
• Daily missions, a daily gift calendar and a free lucky wheel every day
• Level up, earn berries and unlock juicy block skins
• Global and country leaderboards – daily, weekly and all-time
• Play offline, anytime – perfect for short breaks or long sessions
• Available in 9 languages

HOW TO PLAY
1. Drag blocks onto the board
2. Fill a full row or column to clear it
3. Clear several lines in a row for combo bonuses
4. The game ends when no block fits – try to beat your best!

Train your brain, relax and climb the ranking. How high can you go?

Blockberry is free to play and supported by ads. You can remove ads with a one-time purchase.

name: Bloom World: Orbit Hop
description:
Every planet starts as grey rock. Land on it and it bursts into colour: grass, flowers, trees and a little creature that hops and blinks.

Bloomworld is a one-tap space arcade game. Your ball orbits a planet; tap to jump to the next orbit. Time it right to hop from planet to planet, aim for the centre for a Full Bloom combo, and bloom as many worlds as you can.

At the end of every run, your bloomed planets merge into one big world, from Common to Legendary. Collect them all in your own galaxy.

FEATURES
• One-tap controls, easy for all ages
• Every planet looks different; no two worlds match
• New zones every 15 planets: drifting planets, shrinking rings, spin storms
• Dodge rockets and UFOs; grab hearts, magnets, fireballs and time freezes
• Daily challenge: the same planets for everyone, share your result with family
• Three art styles: Cartoon, Dreamy and Neon
• Unlock 10 ball skins with the stars you collect
• Plays offline

A quick space game for short breaks: hop through orbits, grow a galaxy of tiny planets, and beat your best.

Bloomworld is free to play with optional ads. A one-time purchase removes the ads between runs.

name: Bloomumma
description:
A village for every mom.

Motherhood is meant to be shared. Bloomumma brings together local moms, families, and community circles in one warm, welcoming space designed for real connection, everyday support, and shared experiences.

Whether you are new to the area, navigating early motherhood, or looking for meaningful friendships and family-friendly outings, Bloomumma helps you find people who get it—close to home.

What you can do on Bloomumma:
• Connect Locally: Meet nearby moms and families for casual coffee chats, park playdates, and neighborhood gatherings.
• Join Community Circles: Take part in dedicated groups, book clubs, wellness sessions, and intergenerational circles like Naani-Daadi Circle.
• Discover Events & Experiences: RSVP to local meetups, workshops, and community gatherings hosted across your area.
• Share & ReCircle: Exchange ideas, recommendations, and community-minded finds with fellow members.

Built under RiverNest LLC with a focus on genuine connection over noise, Bloomumma is your everyday space to belong, share, and grow alongside other moms.

name: BlurKeep: Face Blur Video
description:
Protect faces, license plates, QR codes, shipping labels, and location metadata before you share—100% offline on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Whether you are sharing family clips while keeping classmates private with cute Emoji stickers, posting dashcam or street footage, or smearing parcel labels and QR codes for marketplace listings, BlurKeep gives you fast, frame-accurate visual privacy without ever uploading a single pixel to the cloud.

WHY BLURKEEP
• Two-Pass Offline Face Recall & Per-Track Keep/Blur: Automatically detects scene cuts, scans twice on Apple Silicon to reduce turn-away flicker, ranks people by visual prominence, and defaults every detected track to Blurred (Fail-Safe Privacy). Simply tap "Keep" on yourself or your family member to leave them clear while bystanders stay redacted.
• Tracking Emoji Face Stickers, Coarse Mosaic, Blur & Solid: Choose dynamic coarse Pixelate (with adjustable Mosaic Coarseness), smooth Gaussian Blur, Solid blackout, or fun Emoji face stickers that follow heads automatically across the clip.
• 1-Tap Bidirectional Plate Tracker & Zero-Drift Fixed Masks: Drag one rectangle or oval to track moving license plates, badges, or side profiles forward and backward—or switch to "Fixed" to cover static dashcam timestamps and corner watermarks with zero drift. Pinch to zoom up to 4x on distant targets.
• Photo Freehand Brush & 1-Tap QR/Barcode Scanner: Swipe your finger with "Brush" to redact slanted addresses and chat screenshots in seconds, or tap "QR" / "Scan QR" to detect and cover shipping-label QR codes and barcodes automatically on-device.
• Free Automatic GPS & EXIF Metadata Stripping: Every exported Rec.709 H.264 MP4 video and JPEG/PNG photo strips GPS coordinates, camera EXIF, and device TIFF tags automatically at no cost.

HONEST ON-DEVICE SCOPE
All detection and tracking run locally using Apple's on-device Vision engine (zero facial identity recognition across clips, zero cloud servers). Extreme 90-degree edge-clipped profiles, heavy motion blur, and non-face targets such as license plates or text labels are covered in seconds using 1-tap manual tracking boxes, fixed masks, or the photo brush.

FREE PLAN VS. LIFETIME PRO (UNIVERSAL PURCHASE)
• Free Plan: Unlimited live preview, automatic person track detection with Keep/Blur toggles, starter Emoji stickers (Smile & Sunglasses), 1 manual tracking/QR box per project, unlimited freehand photo brush strokes, full-length 720p video export with a Made with BlurKeep watermark, your 1st watermark-free photo export (subsequent free photos export with a watermark), and free GPS/EXIF metadata stripping.
• BlurKeep Lifetime Pro: A single one-time Universal Purchase across iPhone, iPad, and Mac (no subscriptions). Unlocks original 1080p/4K full-resolution video exports without watermarks, all 8 family & kids tracking Emoji stickers, 2+ simultaneous manual/QR boxes per clip, and unlimited watermark-free photos plus offline Batch Auto-Redact.

Privacy Policy: https://blurkeep.unboundcove.com/privacy/
Support: https://blurkeep.unboundcove.com/
Terms of Use (Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Bnei Noah Quiz
description:
Bnei Noah Quiz brings together a Bible quiz and sixteen games made for the Bnei Noah (Noahides): non-Jews who hold to the one God and to the seven laws given to Noah.

A quiz in six themes:
• Torah: the five books of Moses, from Noah to Balaam
• Prophets and Writings: Jonah, Ruth, Naaman, Cyrus and others
• Second Temple: the intertestamental period, from the Persians to the Romans, the Maccabees, the Septuagint and the Dead Sea Scrolls
• Jewish festivals: Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Sukkot, Passover, Shavuot, Purim
• The seven laws: the Noahide laws and their sources in the Talmud and in Maimonides
• Biblical Hebrew: key words such as Bereshit, Shema, Emet and Tzedakah

Every answer is explained and comes with its source: a Bible verse, a Talmud tractate, Maimonides or Josephus.

Play by theme, or mix all the themes with 10 random questions. Questions come in three levels: easy, medium and expert. Missed questions come back in “Review my mistakes” until you get them right.

Sixteen games to learn in a different way:
• Who am I?: recognize a biblical character from three clues
• Timeline: put events back in order, from the flood to Maimonides
• The map: find Ur, Nineveh, Jerusalem or Qumran on two maps
• Mystery word: find a biblical word in six tries
• Memory: match Hebrew words with their meaning
• True or false: judge answers in sixty seconds
• The crossing: cross the sea, one step per right answer
• Letter path: link the letters of a grid to find a word
• Two by two: bring the animals into the ark before the waters rise
• The manna: gather in a basket the words that match the instruction
• The wall: raise the wall of Jerusalem and discover a Hebrew word on every row
• The dove: guide the dove through the right answer
• Counting in Hebrew: learn the numbers from 1 to 100
• Alef-Bet: recognize the Hebrew letters, their values and the final letters
• The menorah: relight the seven lamps in the right order
• Crossword: a new grid of Bible words every round

Build pictures as you play: every good round, in the quiz and in the games, places pieces on the ark, then on the rainbow, the Tablets of the Law, the menorah and Jerusalem. Each finished picture unlocks a new game. The “My progress” screen shows your successes, your best scores and what is left to review.

Daily challenge: five questions every day, one per theme, and a streak to keep going.

A glossary explains Hebrew words and Jewish terms, with their common names: Shavuot is Pentecost, Sukkot the Feast of Tabernacles. In the quiz, just tap an underlined word.

An interrupted game can be picked up later, right where you left off. Sign in with Apple or Google if you like, and your progress follows you to all your devices.

An illustrated “How to play” guide appears before your first game of each kind.

• Works without an Internet connection
• No ads
• Optional account: without signing in, everything stays on your device
• Light and dark mode
• In English and French, and you can switch between them at any time

Found a mistake, or have an idea for a question? Write to les.benei.noah@gmail.com.

name: Book Scan Split
description:
Turn a PDF of two-page book scans into a clean PDF of single pages, in the right reading order.

Scanned a book on a flatbed, or got a PDF where every page shows two facing pages? Book Scan Split cuts each spread into two readable pages, keeps covers and single pages whole, and gives you one PDF that reads page by page on a phone, tablet or e-reader.

ONE SPREAD. TWO READABLE PAGES.
• Choose a PDF from Files, up to 200 pages
• Mark which pages are spreads. Nothing is split until you say so, so covers and single pages stay whole
• See the two pages each spread becomes before you create anything
• The resulting page count is shown as you go (for example 10 pages with 8 spreads become 18)

CHOOSE WHERE PAGES SPLIT
• Drag the teal split line anywhere from 5% to 95% of the page width, for spines that aren't centered
• Fine-tune one page, or apply one page's split to every marked page
• Rotated pages and pages of different sizes are each handled on their own

KEEP YOUR READING ORDER
• Left Then Right for most books, Right Then Left for manga and right-to-left books
• Page order across the document never changes; only the two halves of each spread are ordered
• Preview the real PDF, with every page numbered and labeled with where it came from, before you save or share

SHARP, NOT SCREENSHOTS
• Each new page is the original page cropped to one half, so text and line art stay as sharp as the source
• Your original PDF is never changed

GOOD TO KNOW
• A split is a straight crop: curved or tilted scans aren't flattened or straightened
• Splitting isn't redaction. Text outside a crop can remain in the file
• Comments, links and form fields keep their look but don't stay interactive
• Password-protected or restricted PDFs aren't opened
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything happens on your iPhone

Selecting and previewing are always free, and your first export is free. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports. It isn't a subscription and never renews. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/book-scan-split/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/book-scan-split/terms

name: BookletMap
description: BookletMap calculates the print order for a folded booklet. Set a page count and binding edge to see the sheet count, blank pages, and left-to-right page order on each side. Save a layout locally and restore it when you are ready to print.

name: Bookworm Audio
description:
Bookworm Audio is the player for your own collection of audiobooks and audio dramas. Transfer your files to your iPhone once and listen anywhere: at home, on the go, in the car and on your Apple Watch. No internet needed.

PICK UP RIGHT WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Every audiobook remembers its own position. When you resume, the app can jump back a few seconds so you never lose the thread.

EASY TO GET ONTO YOUR IPHONE
• Over Wi-Fi from your Mac: just drag folders into a browser window, no cable needed
• From the Files app and iCloud Drive
• Via Share or AirDrop
• With a cable in the Finder
• For pros: straight from a web address or a network share (NAS)
Covers, titles and track order are read from the files automatically.

A CLEAR LIBRARY
• Grid, compact grid or list
• Group series into folders
• Progress at a glance
• Sort by title, recently played or recently added

APPLE WATCH
Put audiobooks on your watch, or let the one you’re listening to come along automatically, and listen with Bluetooth headphones, even without your iPhone nearby.

CARPLAY
Your library in the car, with large controls made for the road.

A THOUGHTFUL PLAYER
• Sleep timer for bedtime
• Adjustable playback speed
• Configurable skip intervals
• Control from the Lock Screen, headphones and Control Center
• Background colors that match the cover
• Light and dark mode, optionally by time of day

PRIVATE AND FAIR
No ads, no subscription, no account, no tracking. Your audiobooks stay on your devices. If you like the app, you can buy me a coffee, entirely voluntary.

Note: Bookworm Audio doesn’t include any audiobooks. It plays audio files you own (MP3, M4A, M4B, AAC, WAV, AIFF, FLAC).

name: Boomerang Flow: App Automation
description:
Boomerang Flow connects your business apps with no code.

• New lead from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok or Google? Send a WhatsApp, add a Google Sheets row and a task for your team.
• Calendar, Telegram, Monday, webhooks and more.
• Marlo, the AI helper, builds the automation for you from one sentence.

Same account as Boomerang Loop: everything stays in sync.

name: BoothWheel
description:
WORKS COMPLETELY OFFLINE. No wifi, no signal, no problem.

Convention center wifi fails? BoothWheel does not. Every feature except the one-time purchase runs in airplane mode, so a dead network never costs you a lead.

BoothWheel turns an iPad into a prize wheel that captures leads. An attendee enters their details, spins, and wins a prize you set up. You walk out with a list of new prospects!

BUILT FOR THE SHOW FLOOR

- Fully offline. The wheel, the lead form, duplicate checking and CSV export all work with no connection at all.
- The lead is saved BEFORE the wheel starts spinning. 
- Lock it down. Staff settings sit behind a PIN. Pair it with iPadOS Guided Access and the iPad does nothing but run your wheel all day.
- The screen stays awake, with no status bar and nothing to tap your way out of.

YOUR BRAND, NOT OURS

- Import your logo and set the branding colors. 
- Write your own headline, subheadline and thank-you message.
- Build your prize list with weighted odds, so the good prize comes up as rarely as you want.
- Cap any prize by quantity. When it runs out, the wheel stops offering it.

THE LEAD FORM, YOUR WAY

- Choose which fields appear: name, company, phone, job title. Email is always required.
- Ask one custom question of your own.
- Add a marketing opt-in checkbox when you need consent on record.
- The same email cannot enter twice at one event, so your list stays clean.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

- Leads are stored on your iPad and nowhere else. No cloud, no account, no sign-in, ever.
- Nothing is uploaded, shared or sold. We never see a single lead.
- Export a CSV whenever you like and send it where you want.

FREE, AND PRO

BoothWheel is free, and the free version captures and saves EVERY lead in full - it never stops collecting, no matter how busy the booth gets. Free events show the first 10 leads and cannot export.

BoothWheel Pro is a ONE-TIME purchase, not a subscription. It reveals every lead you have captured, including the ones taken while you were on the free tier, and unlocks CSV export. One purchase covers every iPad signed in to the same Apple Account.

RUN SEVERAL SHOWS

Keep a separate event per show, each with its own branding, prizes and leads. Duplicate last show's setup and edit it rather than starting over.

Made for exhibitors, trade shows, conferences, career fairs, open days and anywhere a spinning prize wheel gets people to stop walking.

name: Bootstrap Indonesian Grammar
description:
Turn the Indonesian words you know into sentences you can use. Ask how much two glasses of tea cost, make plans with a friend or find a polite way to ask for help. Try the first 10 lessons free, with all their audio and exercises.

Build sentences of your own
Start with just two words. Each of the 250 lessons adds one idea, explained in plain English. Put word tiles in order to try it yourself. As you progress, you’ll type the missing verb form, discover how a prefix changes the meaning and learn to choose words that suit the person you’re speaking to.

Train your ear with 4,046 spoken examples
Hear every Indonesian sentence and check its English meaning. If the words run together, use slower playback to hear where one ends and the next begins. Then play it again at normal speed and practise saying it aloud.

Remember what you learn with spaced repetition
Miss a phrase today and it comes back tomorrow. As you get it right, the time between reviews grows. Open Review and the app picks out what’s due, so you can spend your practice time on the phrases that still need work.

Take your Indonesian with you
Star the phrases you want to use and revisit them in your personal Study List. All lessons and recordings work offline on iPhone and iPad, even on the flight there.

Start with the 10 free lessons. When you’re ready for more, one purchase gives you lifetime access to all 250 topics, their exercises and audio.

name: Bounce Bricks: Ball Breaker
description:
Aim, release and break every brick before it reaches the floor!

Bounce Bricks is a satisfying aim-and-shoot game. Drag to aim, let go and a stream of balls bounces around the field. Each hit lowers the number on a brick. Collect +1 rings to grow your volley, and plan clever bank shots to clear the rows before they push down to the bottom.

FEATURES
• Simple drag-to-aim controls with a bounce guide
• Endless mode: beat your best score
• Collect extra balls and coins
• Fast-forward when the volley takes long
• Unlock ball styles: Aqua, Fire, Lime, Bubble and Gold
• Play offline

Bounce Bricks is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Bounce Club: Home Court
description:
Make basketball practice a game with Bounce Club. Stand your iPhone or iPad upright, use an orange indoor ball and turn a clear practice space into your home court.

• Play freely or aim for 10, 25 or 50 bounces.
• Try Crossovers and Side V ball-path challenges.
• Follow Daily Three, a guided three-minute workout with spoken cues and rests.
• Keep separate personal bests and practice progress for up to eight local players.
• Tap Selfie to capture your game face with your best score, then share through an app you choose.

A parent helps frame the full ball path, including its lowest point, with the front camera facing the player. Choose Free Play, Crossovers or Side V to start counting, or choose a 10, 25 or 50 Bounce Goal. The initial Free Play screen also offers a Play shortcut. There is no floor-calibration step. Keep the device steady. An orange ball, clear lighting and an uncluttered background help. Counts and ball-path reps are estimates; Bounce Club does not verify hand use or technique.

Practice video is processed on your device and is not recorded. No account, ads or subscription is included. Family boards stay on this device. Optional shared score cards are handled by your chosen destination app.

Requires an iPhone or iPad running iOS or iPadOS 26 or later and a stable device holder. Use a clear space and an indoor ball appropriate for the room.

name: Bow Rehair
description: BowRehair – це журнал майстер-класу для тих, хто відновлює начісування смичка. Смички для скрипки, альта, віолончелі та бас-гітари повертаються через місяці. На верстаті зберігається інформація про те, кому належить паличка, дерево та коли востаннє змінювалося начісування. У журналі перераховані смички від останнього візиту до найдавнішого. Відкрийте смичок, щоб побачити музиканта, дерево (пернамбуко, бразильське дерево або карбон), жабку, натяг та чи знаходиться смичок на верстаті чи вже з музикантом. Завершене відновлення позначено синьою ниткою. Коли ви реєструєте відновлення, запишіть, скільки волосся пішло на нього, скільки пасом і чи лядка рівно сиділа. Зверніть увагу, чи клин тугий, чи розтягування рівномірне, і чи вже випадає свіже волосся на жабці. Натяг після роботи залишається на тій самій картці. Під час передачі роботи запишіть, хто взяв смичок і що слід пам'ятати під час наступного візиту. Волосся на кінчику може бути густішим, рівномірнішим або світлішим. Поки смичок відсутній, журнал показує день, коли його потрібно шукати. Після вибраної вами кількості місяців буде позначено смичок, який потрібно обробити, і лава може надіслати нагадування. Пошук за музикантом або виробником. Звузьте список до смичками на лавці, смичками з синьою ниткою або смичками, які потрібно обробити. Ноти деревини та ноти натягу залишаються на паличці. Коротку ноту про передачу можна залишити, коли смичок повернеться додому.

name: BoxFit Carton Planner
description:
Check if an item will fit inside a carton with room for padding. Enter the item measurements, interior box dimensions, and padding per side. BoxFit checks all six right-angle orientations and shows clearance or shortfall for each axis.

Try a worked example, save your own results, and reopen or edit them when plans change. Share a readable summary through the iPhone share sheet. The core calculator and saved records are available locally without signing in.

name: Boxing Training: Ringwise
description:
Ringwise is your boxing training coach. Stand your iPhone up, step back and start the round. Ringwise sees your punches, counts them and shows what you threw, live.

PUNCH TRACKING ON YOUR IPHONE
• Jab, cross, hook and uppercut, counted and labeled as you throw them
• Punch speed in m/s, km/h or mph
• Body tracking runs on your iPhone. Live camera frames never leave the device

ROUND TIMER AND COMBO CALLS
• Pick your round length and rest, then train without touching your phone
• Voice call-outs tell you what to throw next and mix with your music
• Built for shadow boxing, heavy bag rounds, kickboxing and muay thai drills

AI VIDEO COACH
• Record a round or pick a clip from your library
• Get a report on your guard, pace and punch mix, with timestamps that jump to the moment
• Scout an opponent: break down a fight video before you spar

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Weekly rounds, punches, minutes and streak
• Every round saved with its stats
• Practice reminders on the days you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your rounds and videos stay on your iPhone. The video coach sends a few still frames only when you ask for a report, and you can switch it off.

Train safely: warm up, stay within your limits and stop if you feel pain.

Privacy Policy: https://clefy-frontend.vercel.app/ringwise/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://clefy-frontend.vercel.app/ringwise/terms/
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Boyfriend Quest
description:
Being a great boyfriend takes practice. Boyfriend Quest turns the little things into daily missions, so you never miss one.

HOW IT WORKS
Every day a new mission arrives between 9:00 and 21:00: get her flowers, plan something together, take care of her when she needs it most or send the message she isn't expecting. When you complete it in real life, mark it as done and earn XP.

LEVEL UP
Start as a Decent guy and work your way to the top. Seven levels, each with missions a little more special than the last.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Over 40 missions across gifts, time together, care and digital gestures
• One reminder a day so you never forget
• Your streak of days completing missions
• A history of everything you've done for her

TRULY PRIVATE
No accounts, no passwords and no ads. We don't collect any data: everything you enter stays on your phone.

name: Breathe: Quit Smoking
description:
Dejar de fumar es más fácil cuando ves que merece la pena. En Breathe, tus pulmones están en el centro: empiezan grises y castigados por el humo y, con cada día sin fumar, reverdecen, echan hojas y acaban llenos de flores.

TUS PULMONES, VIVOS
• Ocho etapas, de "Despertar" a "Plenitud", que evolucionan según el tiempo que llevas sin fumar.
• Pulmones en 3D que respiran contigo y puedes girar con el dedo.
• Un cielo que sigue la hora real: amanecer, día, atardecer y noche con luna y estrellas.

TU PROGRESO, CLARO
• Tiempo sin fumar al segundo, cigarrillos evitados y dinero ahorrado.
• Gráficas por semana, mes y año.
• Hitos de salud: de los primeros 20 minutos a los 15 años, con lo que tu cuerpo recupera en cada uno y cuánto falta para el siguiente.

AYUDA CUANDO APRIETA EL ANTOJO
• Respira: un minuto de respiración guiada (4‑4‑6).
• Muévete y relájate: sesiones cortas paso a paso.
• Distráete: un minijuego de 30 segundos.
• Hidrátate y motívate: tus motivos, frases y lo que podrías comprar con lo ahorrado.
• Registro de antojos superados.

RETOS Y LOGROS
• Cuatro retos diarios sencillos: hoy sin fumar, beber agua, caminar, escribir algo bueno…
• Logros por tiempo y por acciones, con nivel y experiencia.

RECORDATORIOS QUE ACOMPAÑAN
• Motivación por la mañana con tu progreso, revisión por la noche y aviso cuando tus pulmones cambian de etapa. Tú eliges las horas o los desactivas.

PRIVADO Y GRATIS
• Sin cuenta, sin anuncios y sin compras.
• Tus datos se guardan solo en tu teléfono.
• Funciona sin conexión.
• En español e inglés.

Breathe es una herramienta de apoyo. La información de salud se basa en estimaciones generales de la OMS, los CDC y el NHS, y no sustituye el consejo de un profesional sanitario.

name: BrickPop: Build & Play
description:
BrickPop is a toy-brick playground with 53 mini-games in one big world. Pick your avatar, jump into any game, and take it with you everywhere: your look, your coins and your gems follow you from game to game.

RACE
Street racers, open-wheel cars, karts, hover craft, light cycles, waterpark slides and gliders. Drift, boost and take down your rivals.

FIGHT
Knuckle Up is a one-on-one fighting game with 16 original fighters, light, heavy and special moves, combos and spectacular super finishes. Wizard duels, arena battles and monster battles are waiting too.

BUILD
Build anything you can imagine in the creative sandbox, dig and craft in survival, or race to guess what your friends are building.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Party royale, mini golf, prop hide and seek, co-op cooking and social deduction. Play online with friends or jump in with bots whenever you like.

RELAX AND COLLECT
Match-3 puzzles, farming, fishing, a life sim, creature collecting, merge and restore, dice boards and more. Short sessions or long evenings, it's up to you.

DRESS UP
Create your own character with outfits, hair, colours and poses, and show it off in every game.

Play as a guest right away, no sign-up needed. Create an account any time to keep your progress safe, add friends and play on more than one device.

In-app purchases are available for optional gem packs. Online chat is part of multiplayer games, and you can block other players.

Support: https://brickpop.gamesultans.com/legal/support.html
Privacy: https://brickpop.gamesultans.com/legal/privacy.html
Terms: https://brickpop.gamesultans.com/legal/terms.html
Delete Account: https://brickpop.gamesultans.com/legal/delete-account.html

name: Brightside Field Crew
description:
Brightside Field Crew is the internal field-operations app for Brightside Cleaning Restoration's employees and contracted technicians. It is not a consumer app and is not intended for the general public.

With Brightside Field Crew, technicians can:
- View assigned restoration claims and job details
- Clock in and out at job sites
- Document rooms, damage, and contents with photos
- Record room measurements and sketches
- Track inventory and packout items
- Complete job checklists and update job status
- Review and sign work authorization documents

Access requires a company-issued login.

name: Brújula by Beatriz Quintero
description:
BRÚJULA es la plataforma de Beatriz Quintero para empresarias veterinarias que quieren una clínica que funcione sin vivir dentro de ella.
  
   • Mis números: ingresos, gastos y margen de tu clínica mes a mes, con lecturas claras y comparativas del sector.
   • Mi libertad empresarial: cuánto depende hoy la clínica de ti y cómo avanzar.
   • Camino: objetivos, revisión semanal, logros y delegaciones a tu equipo.
   • Mentora y biblioteca: recursos y artículos para decidir con criterio.
   • Comunidad: comparte y aprende con otras empresarias veterinarias.
   • Protege tu cuenta con Face ID y recibe avisos de tus revisiones.

  Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta de BRÚJULA.

name: BrushRinse
description: BrushRinse kertoo maalarille, millä liuottimella, monellako huuhtelulla ja missä kuivausajassa sivellin pestään heti maalauksen jälkeen. Valitse kärjen muoto ja siihen jäänyt pigmentti, tee kolme huuhteluvaihetta hoitokortilla ja kirjaa pesu, jotta jokainen sivellin säilyttää oman kuntonsa ja pesuhistoriansa. Kuusitoista liuotinohjetta täyttää kortin uudelleen, kun karva tai maali vaihtuu. Liuotin ja tunnit ovat työskentelyhaarukoita — seuraa siveltimen ja maalin merkintöjä.

name: Brusio: Offline AI Voice Notes
description:
Brusio is a private, offline-first AI voice notes app built for people who think out loud. Hit record, speak naturally, and turn rambling thoughts into clean notes, actionable checklists, ready-to-send emails, and structured study summaries.

Unlike bloated subscription apps, Brusio keeps your recordings 100% private on your device and puts you in complete control—use free on-device speech transcription or connect your own AI API key (BYOK) with zero monthly subscriptions.

WHY BRUSIO?
• Think Out Loud, Stay Organized: Capture fleeting ideas, meeting notes, brain dumps, and daily to-dos in seconds without typing.
• Private & Offline by Design: Your audio recordings and transcripts stay locally on your iPhone. No cloud accounts, no tracking, and no data harvesting.
• Keep Your Authentic Voice: Clean up filler words ("um", "uh", "like") and fix punctuation without rewriting your personality into robotic corporate text.
• Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): Connect your own Google Gemini, Groq, or OpenAI API key for fast AI formatting, or use built-in on-device transcription completely free.
• Pay Once, Own Forever: Try Brusio free, then unlock Lifetime Pro with a single one-time purchase. No recurring monthly subscriptions.

SMART VOICE-TO-ACTION TOOLS
• Clean Note: Turn messy voice memos into crisp, readable paragraphs.
• Action Checklist: Automatically extract tasks and reminders into interactive checkboxes.
• Email & Message Drafts: Speak your thoughts and get a polite, ready-to-send email or message.
• Study & Meeting Summaries: Condense long lectures, voice notes, or imported audio files into clear bullet points.
• Ask Your Notes: Search and chat across your personal voice library to find past decisions and ideas instantly.

DESIGNED FOR FOCUS
• Instant Launch-to-Record option for capturing thoughts in under a second
• Background recording and playback with lock-screen controls
• Biometric Face ID / Touch ID lock to keep personal voice notes private
• One-tap export to Apple Notes, Markdown, email, and other apps

PERFECT FOR
• Founders, professionals, and creatives capturing ideas on the go
• Students turning recorded lectures and study sessions into structured notes
• Anyone tired of paying monthly subscriptions for basic voice-to-text tools

Download Brusio today and turn your voice into action—privately and effortlessly.
