Terms:   https://miracle101000.github.io/murmur-legal/terms.html

name: BTAQA Door
description:
BTAQA Door is the check-in app for door staff at events sold with BTAQA Events.

Scan a guest's ticket and see in a second who they are, which table they booked, and how many chairs are still to come in. Admit the whole group at once, or one person at a time as they arrive.

SCAN FAST
Point the camera at the ticket QR from Apple Wallet or the booking email. The app reads it instantly.

KNOW EVERY BOOKING
Each scan shows the guest's name, table, category, and the chairs already checked in, so a ticket can never be used twice.

COLLECT WHAT IS OWED
When the event collects the rest of the price at the door, the app shows the amount still to pay before you admit the guest.

FIND A GUEST WITHOUT A QR
Dead phone? Search by phone number or booking reference and check the guest in by hand.

STAY SIGNED IN FOR THE WHOLE SHIFT
Sign in once with the account your event planner invited you with. The app keeps you signed in, and the planner can switch your access off at any time.

BTAQA Door needs a staff account from a BTAQA Events planner. Planners invite their door team from the BTAQA Events dashboard at btaqa.events.

name: Bucktail: A&P Shop Toolkit
description:
Bucktail is a pocket shop reference for A&P mechanics, students and IAs. Type a part number, pick a size, and get the number you need, with the FAA source printed under it.

FREE
• Part decoder: AN3–AN20 bolts, AN310/315/316/320 nuts, MS20365 and MS20364 self-locking nuts, AN350 wing nuts, AN960 washers, and MS20470, MS20426 and AN solid rivets. See diameter, thread, length, material, head marking, drilled head or shank, drill size and the nuts and washers that go with it.
• Torque: every row of AC 43.13-1B Table 7-1, fine and coarse threads, tension and shear nuts, with friction drag added and the maximum allowable. Shows in-lb, ft-lb or N·m, and the minimum prevailing torque for reusing a self-locking nut.
• Safety wire and cotter pins: which wire diameter to use for the hole and spacing, emergency devices and seals, plus the AC 43.13-1B rules.
• Drills and fractions: the full number, letter and fractional drill chart, closest drill to any size, decimals and millimeters.

BUCKTAIL PRO — one-time purchase
• Rivet layout: minimum and preferred edge distance, pitch and row spacing for 1, 2 or 3 rows, a drawn layout, rivet count for a seam, length dash number from grip, drill sizes and shop-head dimensions.
• Bend and flat pattern: setback, bend allowance, flat lengths and total developed width for angles and channels, sight-line placement, and the AC 43.13-1B minimum bend radius for 13 aluminum alloys and tempers.
• Wire size: the smallest copper or aluminum wire that meets both the AC 43.13-1B voltage-drop limit and the bundle current rating, with every gauge checked side by side and conductor-temperature correction.
• Torque adapters: the wrench setting for a crowfoot or extension, using the AC 43.13-1B Figure 7-2 formula.
• Hardware index: search 547 AN, MS and NAS part numbers from AC 43.13-1B Tables 7-10 to 7-15.

BUILT FOR THE HANGAR
• Everything works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Large, high-contrast numbers set in B612, the typeface Airbus designed for cockpit displays.
• Light and dark mode.

WHERE THE NUMBERS COME FROM
FAA Advisory Circular 43.13-1B, the FAA Aviation Maintenance Technician Handbook — General (FAA-H-8083-30) and — Airframe (FAA-H-8083-31). Tables are transcribed from those documents and checked against the worked examples in them.

Bucktail is a reference. The aircraft or component manufacturer's maintenance data always comes first; the AC 43.13-1B values are for when the manufacturer gives none. Bucktail is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FAA.

name: Building Cleaning Scheduler
description:
Building Cleaning helps a volunteer coordinator keep a shared building clean without the spreadsheet, the paper list, and the scramble on Friday night.

Set up a month in seconds. Pick the day of the week and how many volunteers you want, and the app lays out every cleaning day with open slots.

Pass around a signup sheet. Print or share a ready-made sheet with your dates and start time, then tap to enter who signed up — one person, or a whole household together.

Remind without retyping. Send each volunteer a friendly reminder from your own Messages app with the day and time already filled in. Mark who confirmed and who can't make it, and see at a glance how many you can count on.

Know who showed up. Record attendance on the day, keep a history for each person, and send a thank-you to everyone who came.

Made for meetinghouse cleaning, useful anywhere. The wording, titles and messages are yours to edit, so it fits a ward, a parish, a school, a clubhouse or a community hall.

Private by design. There is no account and nothing to sign up for. Your volunteers' names and numbers stay on your devices and in your own iCloud. We collect nothing.

FEATURES
• Monthly schedules with your cleaning day, start time and number of slots
• Printable, shareable signup sheet (PDF)
• Assign individuals or whole households, including households with several adults
• One-tap reminder and thank-you texts with wording you can edit
• Track replies and attendance, with a history for each volunteer
• Add people by hand or from your contacts
• A nudge a few days before each cleaning so reminders go out on time
• Optional Face ID or passcode lock
• Sample data so you can try everything first
• Syncs across your own iPhone and iPad through iCloud

Building Cleaning is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

name: Bunny vs Snake
description:
Drop an apple. Dodge the chase. Turn the trap around.

Play as a quick-footed rabbit and lure snakes into biting their own bodies. Read each snake’s moves, time your dash, and escape with as many hearts as you can.

• Work through a 120-stage campaign with different snake types and boss fights.
• Unlock animal allies and discover their skills in the Field Guide.
• Try survival and one-heart challenges, or switch sides and hunt as a snake.

The first 5 campaign stages are free. A one-time purchase unlocks stages 6–120. Snake Hunt is a separate one-time purchase.

name: Bura Online
description:
Bura Online is the classic Central Asian card game on your phone: play real opponents, friends or bots.

• Quick game. Pick a stake and rules — the game finds an opponent with a rating close to yours.
• 1 on 1 and 2 on 2. House rules with 4–5 cards and penalty points, or Classic 31.
• Tables for friends. Open a private table and send the link.
• Lessons. Five short lessons with a coach: leading, tricks, discarding face down, Bura, the save.
• Play vs bots with no internet and no coins.
• Rating, weekly league, daily tasks, rewards and medals.
• Fair play: the server shuffles, a bot finishes for a player who leaves, reports and a block list are built in.
• Nine languages: Russian, English, Uzbek, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Tajik, Azerbaijani, Armenian, Georgian.
• Two table themes: Turquoise and Adras.

Terms of Use: https://bura.roloot.tech/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bura.roloot.tech/privacy

Coins are in-game currency: they are given in the game and are not sold. They cannot be withdrawn or exchanged for money or goods. The game does not offer real-money gambling or a chance to win real money or prizes. Success in the game does not imply success at real-money gambling. For ages 18 and over.

name: Butterfly: Bluesky & Mastodon
description:
Butterfly is a minimalist client for the Bluesky and Mastodon social networks. All your accounts live in one app, and you switch between them with a single tap.

READING
• Timeline, Bluesky custom feeds and Mastodon lists
• Threads, profiles, hashtags and search
• Notifications and direct messages
• Bookmarks, filters and moderation, including reporting and blocking

WRITING
• Posts with images, polls and image descriptions (ALT)
• Content warnings (CW) and visibility settings for Mastodon
• Drafts that never get lost
• Profile editing, including links

DESIGN
• Built for iPhone and iPad, with Liquid Glass on iOS 26
• Clean, ad-free design
• True-black dark mode, custom accent color and font size
• VoiceOver and Dynamic Type support

BUTTERFLY PLUS (subscription)
• Crossposting – one post to Bluesky and Mastodon at once
• More than 2 accounts
• Scheduled posts
3 days free, then €2.99 per month. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it. You can cancel any time in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions, at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

PRIVACY
Butterfly has no server of its own and collects nothing about you. Your sign-in is stored only on your device, in the Keychain, and the app talks directly to Bluesky and your Mastodon instances. No analytics, no tracking.

Terms of Use: https://butterflyapp.eu/#podminky
Privacy Policy: https://butterflyapp.eu/#soukromi

Butterfly is an independent app and is not affiliated with Bluesky Social PBC or Mastodon gGmbH.

name: Byblos FC
description: Stay connected with Byblos FC wherever you are. The official Byblos FC mobile app brings fans, players, and academy families closer to the club with fast access to fixtures, live match timelines, player profiles, official news, and seasonal training schedules—all in one place.

name: Cable Master: Desk Tidy
description:
Cable Master is a 3D cable-tidying puzzle where you untangle the cables on your clients' desks. Place the devices you're given, connect matching ports, and hide the cables with cable clips, cable ducts and cable ties for a clean desk.

■ How a job works
- Place: put devices such as a laptop, monitor, PC tower, router and speakers on the desk.
- Connect: plug power cables into the power strip, and connect devices through ports of the same type.
- Tidy: hold cables in place and hide them with cable clips, cable ducts and cable ties.
- Check: zero tangled cables, zero sagging cables and enough hidden cable clears the job. Your tidy score earns 1 to 3 stars.

■ It starts in a studio-apartment neighborhood
- Pick a building and a unit on the building miniature on the main screen. Finishing a building opens the next one.
- Finished units light up their windows.
- Right now there are 15 units in the three buildings of District 1, a neighborhood of studio apartments. More districts are planned for future updates.

■ A desk that feels real
- Turn and zoom a desk with realistic materials and lighting to follow the path of every cable.

■ Free Build
- Decorate and save your own desk in 8 rooms, including a studio corner, a living-room window, a workroom, a gaming room and a home studio.
- Everyone's Setups: view setups other players published in 3D, and leave stars and praise. Publish your own under an anonymous name.

■ Stuck? See the answer
- Watch an ad to the end to switch to the solution layout. With Remove Ads, it opens right away without an ad.
- Finishing with the answer earns 1 star; solve it again from the start for up to 3 stars.

■ Good to know
- Free, with ads. Remove Ads and room/object packs are available as in-app purchases.
- No sign-up. Your progress and setups are saved on this device; only setups you publish are visible to others.
- Publishing and rating require iCloud sign-in.
- Available in English, Korean and Japanese.

name: Cabosat +Net
seller_name: CABO SAT NET PROJETOS E INSTALACOES LTDA
description:
Nosso aplicativo foi criado pensando em oferecer a você uma experiência segura, eficiente e extremamente prática. Com ele, você pode gerenciar todos os aspectos da sua assinatura a partir do seu smartphone, acessando nossos serviços onde quer que esteja, a qualquer hora.

Serviços Disponíveis no Aplicativo:

- Pagamentos: Copie a chave PIX ou código de barras com rapidez e segurança.

- Consultar Débitos e Faturas: Consulte débitos futuros ou emita o recibo de débitos já pagos.

- Segunda Via de Boleto: Baixe ou imprima boletos com poucos toques.

- Teste de Velocidade: Monitore a velocidade da sua conexão em tempo real.

- Central de Atendimento: Tenha suporte imediato através do seu aplicativo de mensagens preferido.

- Assinatura de Planos: Escolha e assine o plano que melhor atende às suas necessidades.

- Configurações de Rede: Visualize o tipo de conexão de forma prática.

- Promessa de Pagamento: Desbloqueie temporariamente sua conexão até que o pagamento seja efetuado, caso necessário.

- Wifi Scanner: Monitore as dispositivos conectados na sua rede em tempo real.

- Consumo de Internet: Monitore o uso dos seus dados de internet em tempo real.

name: Cadet OPS
description:
No joystick. No test center. Just your phone.

Cadet Ops brings pilot aptitude and psychomotor training to your pocket. Every exercise is designed for touch controls, so you can practise reaction, memory, attention, spatial orientation and multi-tasking anywhere, anytime.

18 EXERCISES IN 6 SKILL AREAS
• Reaction & Speed – Simple Reaction, Choice Reaction
• Spatial Orientation – Spatial Arrow, Cube Rotation, Spatial Rocket
• Memory – Memory Test, Verbal Memory, Corridor Memory
• Attention & Perception – Sustained Focus, Vigilance I & II, Flight IQ and more
• Motor Control – Target Lock, Pursuit Tracking
• Problem Solving – Maze, Cognitive Agility

BUILT FOR FOCUSED PRACTICE
• Clear briefing before every exercise
• Easy, Normal, Hard and Exam difficulty levels
• Scores and personal records for every exercise
• Statistics to follow your progress
• Works offline

PAY ONCE, TRAIN FOREVER
One-time purchase. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases.

Cadet Ops is an independent practice app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any airline, flight school, armed forces, aviation authority or test provider. The exercises are original and are not official tests.

name: Cairo Coding School
description:
Class starts at 7. Was it Sunday or Thursday? Did it move this week? Where's the link? 

Cairo Coding keeps everything about your Cairo Coding School course in one app, so you always know when your next session is, how to join it, and how you're doing.

YOUR NEXT SESSION, FRONT AND CENTER
Open the app and see your next session: the day, the time, your instructor and a live countdown. When it's time, tap "Join meeting" and you're in class.

THE FULL SCHEDULE
Every upcoming session for your group, plus the ones you already attended. If a session is moved, cancelled, or an extra one is added, it's clearly marked, so you never show up at the wrong time.

A REMINDER BEFORE EVERY SESSION
Get a notification the day before and an hour before each session, with the time and your group. When a session is moved or cancelled, your reminders update too. Prefer no reminders? Turn them off in your Profile.

QUIZZES AFTER YOUR LESSONS
Take the quizzes your instructor publishes, some with a timer. See your score, your average and which quizzes are still open. The answers open for review once a quiz closes.

YOUR GROUP'S LEADERBOARD
See where you rank in your group, overall or quiz by quiz. Your first attempt is the one that counts, so it's fair for everyone.

WATCH IT AGAIN
Missed a session or want to review pointers one more time? Every recording is listed with its session number and date, and you can search by topic. Recordings open in YouTube or Google Drive.

NEWS FROM THE SCHOOL
Announcements from Cairo Coding School wait for you under the bell on the home screen.

YOUR PROFILE AND PROGRESS
Your diploma and group, your attendance rate, the share of session tasks you handed in, and your certificates, all in one place.

ARABIC OR ENGLISH, LIGHT OR DARK
Use the app in Arabic or English, with full right-to-left support. Pick light, dark, or follow your phone's theme.

MADE FOR ENROLLED STUDENTS
There's no sign-up. Cairo Coding School creates your account when you enroll, and you set your own password from the email you receive. You only ever see your own groups.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. Your schedule and recordings are only visible to the students of your group, and leaderboards show your name and score only to your group mates.

Enrolled at Cairo Coding School? Sign in with the email you registered with and see your next session.

name: Call Break, Hazari: Taash Adda
description:
Taash Adda brings the two card games of every Bangladeshi, Nepali and Indian adda to your phone: Call Bridge (Call Break) and Hazari.

CALL BRIDGE · CALL BREAK
Four players, thirteen tricks, spades are trump. Call your tricks, make them exactly (or one more) and don't get broken. Bangladesh rules by default, Nepal rules (+0.1 per extra trick) one tap away. Kaka keeps the khata round by round.

HAZARI
Arrange your 13 cards into three, three, three and four, reveal chal by chal and race to 1000 (or 500 for a quick game). Troy, colour runs, runs, colours and pairs, with the order guard so you never lose a hand by mistake.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Friends room: share a code, a QR or a link; empty seats fill with bots
• Quick match: real players in seconds, bots join after 20 seconds
• Same Wi-Fi table: play at one table with no internet at all
• Bots: Easy, Medium and Hard, ready any time, even offline
• Daily Hand: everyone gets the same 13 cards today — who scores best?
• Ajker Sajano: today's Hazari puzzle
• Ranked seasons: from Kagoj to Heera

MADE FOR YOUR ADDA
• Bangladesh, Nepal and India themes, each with its own rooftop, card back, table cloth and Kaka
• Play in Bangla or English, with your choice of digits (০১২ · 123 · १२३)
• Big, clear cards with four-colour suits and big index options
• Quick chat and stickers, no strangers' free text
• Friends, history with trick-by-trick review, achievements and leaderboards

COINS AND THE SHOP
Playing is free. Coins come from wins, daily gifts and events; you can also buy coin packs, the Adda Pass (no forced ads, every region's look) or join Adda Club (monthly coins). Adda Club renews monthly until you cancel in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

Terms: https://taashadda.com/terms · Privacy: https://taashadda.com/privacy

name: Callen
description:
Callen é a agenda online feita para profissionais autônomos: cabeleireiros, barbeiros, manicures, esteticistas, personal trainers, terapeutas e quem mais atende com hora marcada.

Seus clientes marcam sozinhos pelo seu link de agendamento, você acompanha tudo pelo app e para de perder tempo trocando mensagens para achar um horário.

AGENDA SEMPRE À MÃO • Veja seus próximos atendimentos em lista ou na visão de semana e de dia • Aprove ou recuse pedidos com um toque • Crie agendamentos para seus clientes em segundos, com um ou vários serviços • Marque folgas e horários de trabalho para não receber pedidos fora de hora

LINK DE AGENDAMENTO • Uma página só sua, para colocar na bio do Instagram ou mandar para quem pedir horário • O cliente escolhe o serviço, o dia e o horário livre — sem conflito com a sua agenda • Seja avisado por notificação assim que chegar um novo pedido

LEMBRETES E MENOS FALTAS • Envie lembretes e resumos do atendimento pelo WhatsApp a partir do agendamento • Lembretes automáticos antes de cada horário

CLIENTES ORGANIZADOS • Histórico de atendimentos, observações e aniversários de cada cliente • Busca por nome, telefone ou e-mail • Importe e exporte sua lista de clientes

CONTROLE FINANCEIRO • Saiba quanto recebeu e quanto ainda está pendente em cada período • Marque atendimentos como pagos e envie a cobrança pelo WhatsApp • Relatórios de agendamentos e receita

E MAIS • Agendamentos recorrentes para clientes fixos: semanal, quinzenal ou mensal • Fila de espera: quando um horário vaga, você já sabe quem chamar • Feito para iPhone e iPad, com barra lateral no iPad • Entre com e-mail ou com a Apple

O Callen funciona junto com a versão web em callen.app: o que você faz no app aparece no computador e vice-versa.

Dúvidas ou sugestões? Fale com a gente em contato@callen.app.

name: CalorieBreeze
description:
Plan your meal before you eat.

CalorieBreeze works the opposite way from most calorie trackers. You say how many calories (and how much protein) you want, pick the foods you like, and CalorieBreeze works out how much of each to measure. Cook, weigh, eat. No guessing while the food is on your plate.

BUILD MY MEAL
Pick your foods, set your calories, and get suggested amounts for each one. Change any amount and the totals update instantly.

FOOD MISSING? WE LOOK IT UP.
Other apps miss foods, especially home-cooked and cultural dishes. Type any food or a whole meal, like "jollof rice, plantain and oxtail" or a fast-food order, and CalorieBreeze looks it up and splits it into separate foods you can adjust. Results are estimates, clearly labelled.

BUILD MY WEEK
Choose your foods and your goal and get a full week of meals in exact amounts, plus a shopping list.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- No account needed. Your meals stay on your iPhone.
- Thousands of foods built in, and it works offline.
- Scan barcodes, or read a nutrition label with your camera. Photos are read on your phone and never uploaded.
- Track what you ate today, with a calm, uncluttered history.
- Works in grams or ounces.

CalorieBreeze gives estimates for general information and is not medical advice. Talk to a doctor or dietitian before changing how you eat.

name: Camp Christmas
description:
The official app for Pine Valley Camp Christmas, a walkthrough winter wonderland of lights, entertainment and holiday fun for the whole family in Pine Valley, California.

Keep your tickets, the park map and everything you need for your visit in one place, even where cell service is weak.

YOUR TICKETS, READY AT THE GATE
• Sign in with the email you used to buy. We send a link and a 6-digit code, so it works from any mail app.
• Your QR tickets are saved on your phone and open without a signal.
• The screen brightens automatically so the scanner reads your code fast.
• Add any ticket to Apple Wallet.

TONIGHT AT CAMP CHRISTMAS
• See whether we're open tonight, the hours, and when the next event night is.
• Get announcements from the Camp Christmas team.

PARK MAP
• Find attractions, food, restrooms, first aid, parking and photo spots.
• The map is saved on your phone, so it works once you're inside.

EXPLORE
• Browse featured attractions and everything else by category.
• Check food and drink menus before you go.

GUEST CAMERA
• Take or choose a photo from your night and send it to our photo team.

PLAN YOUR VISIT
• Directions with one tap to Apple Maps, plus parking instructions.
• Policies and FAQ, and a quick way to call or email us.
• Buy tickets on our secure website checkout.

Camp Christmas runs on select evenings in November and December. Tickets are for a specific night and can sell out, so buy early.

name: Camport: MP4 Video Converter
description:
Camport turns videos from old digital cameras and camcorders into MP4 files your iPhone can play, share and keep in Photos.

• Import from an SD card or USB drive with any USB-C or Lightning card reader. Pick the card once and Camport finds every video on it, including the folders camcorders tuck away.
• Or import from Files or Photos, or share a video to Camport.
• Converts AVI, MOV, MP4, MTS, M2TS, MOD and 3GP, and other common camera formats, to MP4 (H.264/AAC) at the original resolution.
• Keeps the original recording date when the camera saved one, so videos land in Photos on the day you filmed them.
• Widescreen camcorder clips keep their 16:9 shape.
• Everything happens on your iPhone. No upload, no account.
• If a file is damaged, Camport saves the parts that still play. Your original file is never changed.

Free: 3 videos a day, with a small Camport mark in the corner. Full version: one-time purchase, no daily limit, no mark.

Not every file with these extensions uses a codec Camport can read. Camport does not play discs, does not record from tapes and does not convert MKV files.

name: Can Seam
description:
Can Seam keeps each can on this iPhone.

The can starts empty. The end seats only when it reaches the chuck. After it is seated, press the first roll one notch and the hooks lock. Press that roll a second notch and the curl is crushed. A crushed can cannot be sealed. Press the iron roll before the hooks lock and the roll slips. The seam stays seated. After the hooks lock, press the iron roll one notch and the seam is sealed. After it is sealed, both rolls do nothing.

You can name the can. Delete only a can that is not sealed. Share sends the name and whether the seam is sealed, crushed, or not sealed. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Canal Village - Tile Puzzle
description:
Canal Village is a tile path puzzle board game. Each turn the dice give you four route tiles. Place them on the board to connect canals and roads from gate to gate and watch a village grow.

There is no timer. Take your time, think ahead and play offline anywhere.

HOW TO PLAY
- Each turn you get four dice tiles. Place them next to a gate or an existing route.
- Tap a placed tile to rotate it. Canals connect to canals, roads connect to roads.
- Dock and bridge tiles weave canals and roads together.
- Three landmark tiles per game connect in many directions and rescue dead ends.
- Every village has three goals. Each goal you complete earns a star.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 60 villages across 5 regions. Boards grow from 5x5 to 7x7 and gate layouts change.
- Goals vary: link gates, build a long canal or road, fill the plaza, leave few dead ends.
- A daily village with the same dice for everyone.
- Eight board themes to unlock with stars and daily streaks.
- A gallery that keeps every village you finish.
- Leave any time and resume from the same turn.

A game takes 3 to 5 minutes, perfect for a short break.

YOU WILL LIKE IT IF YOU ENJOY
- Path, pipe and connect puzzles
- Tile laying and roll and write board games
- Relaxing logic puzzles without time pressure
- A quick daily brain teaser

name: Cannon Grove
description:
Tap. Fire. SMASH!

Welcome to Cannon Grove, a bright and breezy physics game set on sunny Miami-style beaches. Aim your cheerful little cannon, fire, and watch towers of glass, wood and stone come crashing down into the sand. Every shot is a satisfying chain of crashes, cracks and tumbles.

TAP TO SMASH
Just tap the piece you want to hit and the cannon aims and fires for you. Prefer full control? Switch to Drag mode in Settings to aim and release by hand. Easy to pick up and hard to put down!

EPIC COMBOS
Knock one piece into the next and watch the combo counter climb. Bring a whole tower down at once for big scores, slow-motion smashes and showers of points.

GLASS, WOOD & STONE
Every material breaks its own way. Glass shatters into sparkling shards, wood splinters, sand crumbles, and tough stone and iron blocks take more than one hit. Watch out for bouncy beach balls and traffic cones too!

GIANT TOWERS
Each level is a new puzzle: stacked forts, sandcastles, piers, rafts and moving platforms. Special challenge levels (marked with a skull) bring the toughest towers of all.

10 BEACH SCENES
Play from Sunny Beach and Sunrise Pastel to Golden Sunset, Neon Night Pier, Art-Deco Ocean Drive, Island Lagoon, Coral Reef Bay, Palm Garden Park, Sailboat Marina and the Beach Fair.

THOUSANDS OF LEVELS
Hand-made opening levels lead into thousands more, each with a fresh tower to topple. Follow the winding beach map, earn up to 3 stars per level and replay any level to improve.

UPGRADE YOUR CANNON
Collect coins and spend them in the Cannon Shop: heavier shot, more impact, bigger balls and a longer aim guide. Keep progressing to unlock the Mark II Golden Cannon, the Mark III Royal Cannon and the Mark IV Diamond Cannon.

FEEL-GOOD BEACH VIBES
Bright cartoon 3D graphics, a sunny soundtrack and crunchy smash sounds make every session a mini holiday. Music and sound effects can be switched on or off any time.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a piece to fire at it, or drag to aim.
• Clear every piece before you run out of cannonballs.
• Have balls left over at the end to earn more stars and coins.
• Spend coins on cannon upgrades and take on bigger towers.

Cannon Grove is free to play and suitable for all ages. It is supported by ads.

Grab your cannon and start smashing!

name: Cannonball 2048

Aim the cannon and fire number cubes up into five columns. Matching numbers merge, and every merge can trigger the next one: 2+2, 4+4, 8+8… all the way to 2048 and beyond.

Armored boss blocks block the way. You can't hit them directly: only merges right next to a boss chip away its armor. Plan the chain, crack the boss, clear the level.

FEATURES
• One tap to play: aim and release
• 100 hand-tuned levels with 1–3 stars
• Boss blocks with armor that only combos can break
• Endless mode: chase your best score
• Duel: you vs a bot on the same board, 20 shots each
• Hammer and swap tools for tricky spots
• A second chance when you almost make it
• Daily gift and a 7-day streak
• Home-screen widget with your best score and streak
• English and Russian

Completely free. No ads, no purchases.

Made by Sudarev · sudarev.app
Privacy policy: https://sudarev.app/cannonball2048/privacy/

name: Capriolo
description:
Capriolo aplikacija je vaša digitalna kartica lojalnosti i najbrži put do ponuda u Capriolo prodavnicama – bicikli, oprema za lov i ribolov.

• Digitalna kartica – pokažite barkod na kasi i skupljajte pogodnosti pri svakoj kupovini.

• Akcije i katalog – aktuelne akcije i ponude uvek su vam pri ruci.

• Lokacije – pronađite najbližu Capriolo prodavnicu na mapi.
• Kupovine – pregled vaših kupovina i ostvarenih pogodnosti.
• Vesti i obaveštenja – budite prvi koji saznaju za nove akcije.

Prijava je jednostavna: e-mail adresom, Google ili Apple nalogom.

Capriolo – više od bicikla.

name: Car Parking Trainer
description:
Struggle with parking in real life? Car Parking Trainer is a calm, realistic practice ground that teaches you how to park — one manoeuvre at a time.

This is not a drift or racing game. Every level is a small, focused lot built around a real parking situation, and the game tells you exactly what went wrong so you can improve.

LEARN REAL TECHNIQUES
• Bay, perpendicular, angled and parallel parking
• Reverse into a space, use your mirrors and judge your turning radius
• Guide lines show the path you are about to take
• Clear feedback after every attempt: "Parked too crooked", "Front right wheel over the line"

50 LEVELS, 5 CHAPTERS
From a wide, empty car park to crowded lots, street parking and a logistics depot — difficulty grows gradually.

4 VEHICLES
• Sedan – compact and nimble
• SUV – wider, needs more care
• Delivery van – longer body, wider turns
• Articulated truck with trailer – the trailer swings the other way when reversing, just like in real life

CAMERAS THAT HELP YOU LEARN
Top-down view to judge the geometry, chase camera for the driving feel and a rear bumper camera for reversing.

CONTROLS THAT FIT YOU
Steering wheel, buttons, joystick or tilt. One-handed portrait mode, left-handed layout and automatic gear changes — press the other direction and the car stops, then reverses.

FAIR SCORING
Position, angle, collisions and time give you 1–3 stars. Bumping something costs points but never ends your attempt — correct it and keep going.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account and no data collection. Available in English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Italian.

name: Carloaded
description:
Carloaded is Nigeria's marketplace for buying and selling cars.

FIND YOUR NEXT CAR
• Browse thousands of foreign used, Nigerian used and brand new cars
• Search by make, model, year, price, body type, transmission, fuel type and location
• Narrow down by state and city, and sort by price, year or newest

TALK TO SELLERS

SELL YOUR CAR

STAY SAFE
• Safety tips on every listing
• Report suspicious listings, and block or report users in chat

Sign in with email, Apple, Google or Facebook. You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

name: Cartouche Of Dawn
description:
Six signs have lost their order, and the morning light no longer reaches the inner halls. Follow Tali, an apprentice scribe, through an Egyptian inspired archive. Rebuild its stone seals, recover the record left by Meret and discover what the small guardian Senu remembers about the closed doors.

Each seal has four to six numbered slots. Tap a sign, then choose its place on the stone strip. You can also drag stones, swap two placed signs or return one to the tray. Every sign belongs on the seal exactly once. The clues refer to positions and relationships, so no knowledge of real hieroglyphs is needed.

The Journey contains 32 chambers across four chapters. Begin with order and neighbours at the Reed Gate. The Measured Court introduces exact distances and stones that must stay apart. Six signs and reflected inscriptions wait in the Mirror Gallery. In the Dawn Vault, a statement can depend on another: if one condition is true, its consequence must follow. Every chamber has one complete arrangement that satisfies all its inscriptions.

Sun reads the physical row from left to right. Shadow describes the same stones from the side of a mirror. A sign that comes before another in the reflection can sit to its right on the actual seal. Changing the light does not rearrange your work. Both readings remain available, and any inscription can be opened for a larger diagram and an English explanation. A distance of two means two steps between positions, with one slot in between.

Keep possible signs, exclusions and pinned guesses in the notebook. These marks are your assumptions, not extra rules. Undo restores an earlier arrangement. Testing an incomplete seal tells you how many slots remain without counting a mistake. If a complete arrangement breaks a rule, the game points to one specific inscription and leaves the stones where you put them.

Help comes in three stages. First, Senu draws attention to a useful inscription. The next hint explains a deduction, and the last justifies a position for one sign. You can choose to study the full solution after a warning, but the game does not complete the room for you. You still place the stones and test the seal. Hints have no price or waiting period.

A restored seal earns a ray. Solve without hints for another, and avoid incorrect complete checks for the third. Studying the full solution limits that attempt to one ray. Any successful result opens the way forward, while replays keep your best score. Recover eight different relics, including a reed stylus and a bronze mirror. Short scenes are saved in the Findings journal even when you skip them. The final seal leads to a choice about the future of the archive.

The Daily Chamber offers one local puzzle for each UTC date. An unfinished seal keeps its original stones and clues when the date changes. Earlier daily rooms can be reviewed or replayed. At the practice table, choose an unlocked rule set and enter a seed to prepare a reproducible puzzle. A new room is made only when you request it.

Light with the warmth of honey falls across caramel shades in the stonework. Cream panels keep the board and inscriptions clear. Between the richer chapter illustrations, the puzzle surface stays quiet enough to read each position. Three guided lessons introduce placement, adjacency and reflection. Settings include larger text, reduced motion and optional haptics, and touch controls work without dragging.

Play offline, without an account, advertising or purchases. Progress, notebook marks and unfinished attempts are saved on the device. The interface, inscriptions and story are in English.

name: Carvoeiro Tennis & Padel
description:
The official app of Carvoeiro Tennis & Padel Club, in the Algarve.

MEMBERSHIP
• Join or renew your membership plan in the app and pay with MB WAY, card or your club wallet
• Your digital member card with QR code, always with you

name: CastArt: Editor de fotos IA
description:
CastArt es tu estudio creativo de bolsillo: edita tus fotos, dibuja con pinceles de efectos y crea fondos increíbles con inteligencia artificial.

INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL
• Quitar fondo: separa a la persona u objeto principal de tu foto con un toque.
• Crea escenas con IA: describe con tus palabras el fondo que imaginas ("una playa al atardecer con palmeras", "ciudad neón estilo anime") y CastArt lo genera.
• Mejorar a HD: duplica la resolución de tu foto y la hace más nítida.

PINCELES CON EFECTOS
Ocho pinceles, cada uno con su propio estilo: Neón, Láser, Fuego, Holográfico, Galaxia, Acuarela, Spray y Cromo. Además, borrador, difuminado y relleno de fondo, con el color y el grosor que quieras.

TEXTO
Escribe sobre tu foto con distintas fuentes y estilos. Muévelo, agrándalo y gíralo con dos dedos.

FILTROS
17 filtros para darle a tus fotos el ambiente perfecto: Clarendon, Juno, Valencia, Vintage, Cinematic, Cyberpunk y muchos más.

HERRAMIENTAS DE EDICIÓN
• Recorte libre o con proporciones (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9...).

• Deshacer y rehacer cualquier cambio.

GUARDA Y COMPARTE EN ALTA CALIDAD
Guarda tus creaciones en tu galería a la resolución de tu foto, o compártelas en tus redes favoritas.

ÚSALA COMO QUIERAS
Empieza como invitado y edita sin crear cuenta. Inicia sesión con Apple, Google o Facebook para usar las herramientas de IA.

CASTART PRO
La versión gratuita incluye anuncios y un límite diario de uso de IA. Con CastArt PRO tienes muchos más usos de IA al día y sin anuncios.
• PRO Semanal: suscripción de 1 semana.

name: Cat Pinball Dungeon
description:
Welcome to Cat Pinball Dungeon!

Join cute cats on a playful pinball adventure through the dungeon. Aim, launch and bounce your balls through waves of monsters, then pick new powers after every level.

FEATURES
- Easy one-finger aiming with satisfying pinball bounces
- Roguelike runs: choose new balls and accessories every level
- Evolve two balls into a stronger one
- Collect cat heroes and companions, each with their own skills
- Upgrade gear, relics and talents between runs
- Boss fights, challenge modes, daily dungeons and events

A little adventure. A lot of bouncing. Plenty of cats.

name: Cat Seafood Collect
description: The game features a relaxed and enjoyable gameplay, but it also contains some challenging elements. Control the direction of the cat's movement, plan sic bo the route, and eat all the fish in the scene. Anticipate the path, avoid obstacles, and help the cat collect all the fresh fish.

name: Catwise: Daily Cat Wisdom
description:
Catwise sends you one cat a day, and each one brings a little piece of wisdom.

Meet the four house cats:
• Sage, the wise one, with calm advice for a busy day
• Rumi, the loving one, who reminds you to be kind to yourself
• Nico, the naughty one, who tells you to break a rule or two
• Ziggy, the funny one, because some days need a laugh

HOW IT WORKS
Pick your cats, your name and the time you'd like your visit. Each day one of them turns up at the door. Tap the cat to read its quote. Then give it a pet, a biscuit, a bowl of milk or a fish, and feel it purr.

DON'T OVERFEED THEM
Every cat has a food bowl that holds 5 helpings and slowly empties over the day. Once a cat is full, it turns your treat down in its own words. A pet is always welcome, though.

KEEP THE GOOD ONES
Save the quotes you love and come back to them any time. Share one with a friend who needs it.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add the Catwise widget, small or medium, to see today's cat and the rest of the gang at a glance.

A GENTLE REMINDER
Choose a time and Catwise sends one friendly note a day, with your cat's face on it. "Good morning, Daniele. Sage is at the door."

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There's no account to make and nothing to sign up for. Your cats, your saved quotes and your settings stay on your iPhone. We don't collect any data.

120 quotes, 4 cats, 1 visit a day.

name: Caught Out: Imposter Game
description:
One phone. 3 to 8 friends. Someone is lying.

Caught Out is the pass-the-phone bluffing game for lunch tables, road trips, sleepovers, dorm rooms and family nights. Add your friends, everyone gets a colour, and Round 1 starts in seconds. No accounts, no Wi-Fi, no setup.

THREE WAYS TO CATCH THE IMPOSTER

Wrong Question
Everyone secretly reads the same question, except one player gets a different one and has no idea. Answer out loud on 3. When the real question drops, someone has a lot of explaining to do.

Undercover
Everyone gets the same secret word, except the imposter gets a close one (think Burger King instead of McDonald's) and doesn't know it. Give one-word clues and spot who is bluffing. Switch to Classic if you want the imposter to know their role and try a last-second guess.

Number Bluff
Everyone answers a 1 to 10 question at the same time, except one player got a different question. Reveal the real one and watch someone defend why they just said 2.

BUILT FOR A REAL TABLE
Hold to peek: press to see your secret, lift your finger and it hides, so nobody sneaks a look.
Your colour, your turn: the whole screen turns your colour when it's your go, so the phone always shows whose turn it is.
5 packs out of the box: Original, School, Late Night, Pop Culture and Family, with 380+ rounds and no repeats in a session.
A fair shuffle, so the same friend isn't the imposter every time.

THE ROUND RECEIPT
Every round ends with a receipt: the real prompt, the fake one, and who got caught out or got away. Send it to the group chat.

Plays fully offline. No account, no ads.

Privacy Policy: https://caughtout.pasora.dev/privacy

name: CDL Practice Test: Texas 2026
description:
Study for the Texas CDL written tests with questions that are right.

Every one of the 329 questions in this app was written from scratch and checked several times against the Texas Commercial Driver License Handbook (March 2026). After each answer you see why it is right and the handbook section it comes from, so you can look it up yourself.

ALL 9 WRITTEN TESTS
- General Knowledge (required for every CDL class)
- Air Brakes
- Combination Vehicles (Class A)
- Texas Commercial Rules
- HazMat, Tanker, Doubles/Triples, Passenger and School Bus endorsements

THREE WAYS TO STUDY
- Practice: answer at your own pace and see the explanation right away
- Mock exam: a full test scored like the real one, 80% to pass
- Review: go back over only the questions you missed

NO SURPRISES
- No ads
- No account or sign-up. Your progress stays on your phone
- No subscription and no trial that charges you later. Try General Knowledge free, then unlock everything with one payment of $19.99. It's yours for good.

This app is built for Texas. It is an independent study app and is not made by or connected to the Texas Department of Public Safety, FMCSA or any government agency. It can't promise you'll pass, so read the official handbook too.

name: ÇEMBER: Kinetic Arena
description:
Çember; zamanlama, hareket ve hızlı reflekslerin farkı yarattığı hızlı tempolu bir arcade oyunudur.

Arenaya gir, çubuğunu kontrol et ve topu oyunda tut. Ortada dönen Çember'i kullanarak topu sektir, kombolar yap ve rakibinin kalesini zorla. Farklı oyun modlarında kendini dene ve online maçlarda gerçek oyunculara meydan oku.

ONLINE KARŞILIKLI OYNA
Oda aç ya da kodla katıl, başka bir oyuncuyla gerçek zamanlı maç yap. iPhone ve Android oyuncuları aynı odada karşılaşabilir.

DÜNYA TURNUVASI
40 milli takım arasından ülkeni seç, bayrak renklerindeki çubuğunla 40 maçlık şampiyonluk yolunda ilerle.

MACERA MODU
Neon Siber'den Magma Çukuru'na, Kutup Kristali'ne kadar farklı temalı 30 bölüm. Her bölümü geçerek yeni arenaların kilidini aç ve rozetler topla.

ARENA MAĞAZASI
Maçlardan kazandığın yıldızlarla yeni çubuk kaplamaları, avantajlar ve engeller aç. Gerçek parayla satın alma yok.

5 ZORLUK SEVİYESİ
Easiest'tan Chaos'a kadar sana uygun temposu seç. SMASH ile ileri hızla vur, güçleri topla, sarı ve kırmızı kartlara dikkat et!

DOKUNMATİK VEYA JİROSKOP
Parmağınla sürükleyerek ya da telefonu eğerek oyna.

REKLAMSIZ, ÜCRETSİZ
Reklam yok, uygulama içi satın alma yok. Sadece oyun.

Çember, Özgür Söz tarafından tasarlandı.

name: Central Espírita
description:
O Central Espírita reúne os ensinos da Doutrina Espírita num só lugar: simples, acolhedor e gratuito. É um projeto do Centro Espírita Serapião Ribeiro, de Goiânia, sem fins lucrativos.

ESTUDE NO SEU RITMO
Jornadas de estudo guiadas pelas obras da codificação e de outros autores, para quem está começando e para quem quer aprofundar. Você continua de onde parou.

GOTAS DO EVANGELHO
Conte como você está se sentindo e receba um trecho escolhido para o seu momento. Se preferir, leia na sequência do livro ou deixe o Evangelho escolher por você. Em muitos trechos há uma versão em palavras simples, para facilitar a leitura.

CINCO MINUTOS
Textos curtos de reflexão, entregues aos poucos, para caber no seu dia.

CULTO DO EVANGELHO NO LAR
Um roteiro guiado, passo a passo, para fazer o culto em família: prece inicial, reflexão, leitura do Evangelho, comentários e prece final. Quem estiver junto pode acompanhar no próprio celular, lendo o QR Code, e o passo muda sozinho. Você também escolhe o dia e a hora, e o app lembra.

REFORMA ÍNTIMA
Faça o check-in da sua casa mental, escolha um defeito para vencer e uma virtude para cultivar, registre o seu dia e peça uma gota de leitura quando precisar.

TESTE DE NÍVEL
Um teste curto para sugerir por onde começar.

SEU JEITO
Escolha um tema de cores que muda ao longo do dia, ajuste o tamanho da letra e decida quais avisos quer receber.

name: Champignons Chasse - Cartes
description:
Champignon Chasse is a field map for mushroom picking, not a directory of spots. It overlays public French forest data from IGN onto a standard map background, so you can choose where to search: tree species, stand types, soil types and the age of the woodlands.

USEFUL MODES
• Mushrooms — pines and oaks, the species hosting most edible mycorrhizae
• Forests — the complete BD Forêt v2, in the official IGN rendering
• Soils — dominant soil types in France and their acidity: limestone or acid makes all the difference
• Age — woodlands continuously forested since the 19th century
• Chestnuts — pure chestnut stands, without intercropping

IN THE FIELD
Zoom in: the close view highlights stands, the wide view shows density. Tap an area to read its sheet — tree species, stand type, BD Forêt v2 code — then open the location in your navigation app with a single tap.

A WIKI OF TWENTY SPECIES
For each common species: habitat, soil, associated trees, temperature, humidity and season. Twenty fact sheets, and twenty safety reminders. An app is not a substitute for a mycologist: if in doubt, have your harvest checked.

OFFLINE
Tiles you have already viewed stay on your device. In the forest, without a network connection, the map remains readable where you have already been.

YOUR DATA
No account, no trackers, no advertising. Your location is only read when you tap "My location", and it never leaves your device.

OFFICIAL SOURCES
Map data comes from IGN (the French national institute for geographic and forest information), published by Géoplateforme under the Etalab 2.0 open licence:
• BD Forêt v2: https://geoservices.ign.fr/bdforet
• Plan IGN v2: https://geoservices.ign.fr/planign
• Géoplateforme: https://geoservices.ign.fr/
• Dominant soils (INRAE / GisSol): https://www.gissol.fr/
• Etalab 2.0 Open Licence: https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence/

DISCLAIMER
This app is a personal, independent project. It is not published, endorsed or sponsored by IGN, INRAE, or any French public administration or entity. It does not represent any government entity and provides no public service. Data is reused as published, under its open licence; any display or interpretation error is the app's alone.

name: Channelist: Video RSS Reader
description:
Channelist is a calm reader for the YouTube channels you choose. No recommendations and no endless feed: just new videos from your subscriptions, newest first, in an inbox you can actually finish.

YOUR INBOX, YOUR RULES
• New videos from the channels you follow, grouped by day
• Swipe to mark a video as watched or hide it, or mark a whole channel as watched at once
• Hide Shorts or live streams everywhere or just for one channel
• Continue Watching remembers where you stopped in every video
• Playback speed is remembered for each channel
• Unwatched counts for every channel at a glance

FIND AND KEEP
• Favorites for the videos worth keeping
• Search titles, descriptions and channel names on iPad and Mac
• Each channel keeps its videos, Shorts and live streams in separate tabs

EASY TO START
• No account or sign-in needed
• Paste a link to a channel or any of its videos
• Import your subscriptions from another RSS reader with OPML
• Made for iPhone, iPad and Mac

CHANNELIST PRO
Channelist Free keeps up to 10 channels active. Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription:
• Unlimited channels
• Categories to organize your subscriptions
• A queue for later, with continuous playback
• iCloud sync between your iPhone, iPad and Mac
Try Pro free for 14 days. When the trial ends, nothing is deleted. Pro works on all your devices and with Family Sharing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Channelist has no servers of its own and no analytics. Your library stays on your devices and, with Pro, in your private iCloud.

Videos play in the official YouTube player, with no downloads and no background playback. Channelist uses YouTube API Services and is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

Terms of Use: https://channelistapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://channelistapp.com/privacy

name: Chapman Security
description: Chapman Security in association with SS Tracking is a powerful GPS vehicle and fleet tracking solution designed to help businesses and individuals monitor, protect and recover vehicles and assets in real time. Access live tracking, route history, alerts and fleet viability from an easy-to-use mobile platform built for reliability, security and operational control.

name: CharisScan
description:
CharisScan turns paper into searchable PDFs on your iPhone or iPad. Scan a page with the camera or import photos, tidy it up, and save. The text is recognized on your device, so you can find any word later.

No account. No ads. No analytics. CharisScan never connects to a server, and your scans never leave your device unless you export them.

SCAN OR IMPORT
• Scan with the document camera, or import up to 50 photos at once
• Review every page before you save
• Pages become one PDF with a searchable text layer

CLEAN UP EVERY PAGE
• Choose Original, Color, Grayscale or Black & White for each page, or apply one filter to all
• Rotate pages and delete the ones you do not want
• Set the filter you use most as your default in Settings

TEXT RECOGNITION IN ENGLISH AND CHINESE
• Recognizes English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
• Runs entirely on your device with Apple's on-device text recognition
• Each scan gets a suggested name from its text, and you can rename it any time
• Read the recognized text of any page

FIND ANYTHING
• Search the text of every scan in one field
• See the matching line and page in the results
• Open a scan and the matches are highlighted on the page

YOU DECIDE WHAT LEAVES THE APP
• Scans stay in the app's protected storage until you export one
• Export a PDF copy to Files, or share it with AirDrop, Messages, Mail or another app
• A clear notice appears before any copy leaves the app
• Optionally remove EXIF, GPS and device details from exported copies
• Delete one scan, or all of them, whenever you like

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
CharisScan has no sign-in, no analytics and no tracking, and it does not use the network itself. Scans are stored with file protection, and you choose whether the library is included in device backups.

FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL TIP
Every feature is free. If CharisScan saves you time, you can leave a one-time tip from Settings. It unlocks nothing.

name: Chart107: Part 107 Test Prep
description:
Pass your FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Knowledge Test (UAG) on the first try — with interactive FAA sectional charts, live METAR/TAF decoding, airport sign drills, and a full 480-question practice bank. Pay once, no subscription, 100% offline.

WHY PILOTS CHOOSE CHART107
Sectional charts and airspace rules are the #1 reason drone pilots miss Part 107 questions. Most study apps give you tiny, unreadable screenshots or charge $20/month. Chart107 is built around real public-domain FAA-CT-8080-2H Testing Supplement figures you can pinch-zoom and tap directly.

INTERACTIVE FAA SECTIONAL CHART TRAINER
• 12 guided sectional chart lessons built on authentic FAA-CT-8080-2H figures
• Pinch-zoom high-resolution charts and tap airspace rings for instant floor, ceiling, LAANC, and frequency callouts
• 60-target Chart Gauntlet with Tap-to-Pinpoint and Read & Answer visual drills
• Instant Legend 1 reference overlay inside every lesson

INTERACTIVE FIELD TRAINERS (100% FREE)
• METAR & TAF Token Decoder: tap any token to decode wind, visibility, ceilings, and automatic 14 CFR §107.51(c) max drone altitude math — with offline drills plus optional live aviationweather.gov lookup
• Airport Signs & Runway Markings Trainer: master mandatory hold-short, location, direction, displaced threshold, and blast-pad chevron markings
• Load Factor & Density Altitude Physics Lab: interactive bank-angle G-load and stall speed calculator (FAA Figure 2)

REALISTIC FAA PART 107 EXAM PREP
• 480 original questions mapped to FAA-S-ACS-10B codes and 14 CFR Part 107 citations, including 89 figure questions
• Realistic 60-question, 2-hour timed PSI Knowledge Test Simulator with inline zoomable FAA figures
• Spaced repetition (SM-2) Smart Queue, FAA Top Traps, Missed Review, and ACS Readiness dashboard

HONEST FREE TIER + ONE-TIME PRO UNLOCK
Try 3 full sectional chart lessons, 15 Chart Gauntlet targets, all 3 visual trainers, 112 practice questions, 24 flashcards, and 1 complete 60-question mock exam free. Unlock everything permanently with a single one-time purchase — no recurring charges, no user account, works 100% offline.

Chart107 uses public-domain FAA materials sourced from faa.gov (FAA-CT-8080-2H, FAA-G-8082-22, FAA-S-ACS-10B, 14 CFR Part 107). Independent study aid; not affiliated with or endorsed by the Federal Aviation Administration.

name: CheckLot Log
description:
Keep sample checks organized from the first observation to a closed lot.

Define reusable criteria with instructions. Create a lot with a sample size and a maximum failed-item count. Each lot freezes its criteria, so later catalog edits do not rewrite its history.

Record Pass or Fail and a memo for each item and criterion. Saving the same pair updates its observation instead of adding a duplicate. Summary counts failed items once even when several criteria fail on the same item. A final Within limit or Over limit result appears only after every planned check is complete.

Close completed lots into searchable History and explicitly reopen them before changing observations. Share summaries, export local JSON or delete records with confirmation. Sample sizes range from1 to1000 with up to20 criteria. The limit is chosen by you; the app does not certify compliance with an industry or safety standard.

Core records stay locally on this iPhone. There is no app login, purchase, advertising or analytics SDK. More > Settings can export local JSON or delete this app's business data after confirmation. Copies already shared and system backups are managed separately.

Online destination: on launch and each return to the foreground, the app may read its dedicated public CloudKit configuration under a white cover. A valid enabled HTTPS destination opens automatically through the system. Disabled, missing, invalid, failed or timed-out reads (maximum2.5seconds), or an open failure, restore the local interface and existing edits. More > About provides status, Refresh configuration (no automatic opening) and Open website (manual, only for a valid current destination). The current initial configuration is disabled with an empty URL. No active business destination is configured. Local business records are not synchronized to CloudKit. External websites have their own data practices. All users, including reviewers, receive the same behavior.

name: Chispa: Cozy Virtual Pet
description:
Meet Chispa — a warm, cozy virtual pet companion crafted for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.

Start right away with Mochi, an adorable Shiba Inu puppy living in a sunlit illustrated room. Feed, bathe, tuck into bed under a glowing night lamp, pet, tickle, and play together as your pet levels up and evolves.

COLLECT & SWITCH BETWEEN 8 UNIQUE PETS
• Mochi (Shiba Inu), Pipo (King Frog), Boba (Red Panda), Yuki (Ghost Cat), Nori (Pink Axolotl), Bruma (Tea Dragon), Sora (3-Tail Kitsune), and Luno (Astral Owl).
• Open Mystery Capsules to discover new species and upgrade their stars (from 1 to 5 stars).
• Switch your active pet anytime right from your Wardrobe while keeping every pet's progress.

LIVING ILLUSTRATED ROOMS & CUSTOMIZATION
• Care for 4 cozy needs: Hunger, Mood, Rest, and Hygiene.
• Touch, rub, tickle, or gently shake for reactive physics, expressions, and custom sound effects.
• Unlock 5 animated rooms: Cozy Cottage, Sakura Garden, Matcha Café, Lunar Observatory, and Coral Island.
• Dress up your companions with charming accessories and 8 expressive eye styles.

STARFALL MINI-GAME, LEAGUES & SEASON PASS
• Catch falling stars and dodge grumpy clouds to earn coins, XP, and League trophies.
• Climb from Rookie to Legend League for gem promotion rewards.
• Claim 7-day Daily Gifts, idle piggy-bank coins, and Season Pass tiers.

FULL-SCREEN IMMERSIVE APPLE WATCH EXPERIENCE
• Your pet lives edge-to-edge on your Apple Watch with quick orbital care buttons around it and watch face complications.
• Seamless bidirectional sync between iPhone and Apple Watch.
• Optional Apple Watch HealthKit bonus: your daily steps, calories, exercise, stand hours, and sleep help care for your pet. Health data stays 100% private on your device.

Download Chispa free and carry a cozy pocket world on your phone and wrist!

name: Chop Chop: Fruit Slicer
description:
Swipe to slice the fruit flying across the board!

Chop Chop is a fast, juicy arcade game. Fruit is tossed into the air. Swipe through it to slice it in half and score. Cut several in one swipe for combo bonuses. Miss three fruits and the run is over, and never, ever slice a bomb.

FEATURES
• Pure swipe controls, easy to learn, hard to master
• Watermelons, oranges, apples, kiwis, coconuts and more
• Combos for big points
• Endless mode: beat your best score
• Unlock blade trails: Fire, Toxic, Royal, Candy and Gold
• Play offline

Chop Chop is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: CiCi Run: Endless Runner
description:
Get ready for a fast and fun running adventure with CiCi Run!

Cici never stops running. Your job is to dodge obstacles, jump at the right moment and keep running as long as you can to reach the highest score.

RUN AND SURVIVE
Guide Cici past rocks, thorny bushes, trees and buzzing bees.

MASTER YOUR TIMING
Tap to jump, jump up to three times in a row, or hold to slide under obstacles. As the speed increases, your reflexes matter more and more.

COLLECT STARS, UNLOCK CHARACTERS
Use the stars you collect to unlock Blue Robin, Cotton Bunny, Tabby Kitty, Bamboo Panda, Caramel Pup and many more cute characters.

EXPLORE NEW WORLDS
The further you go, the more worlds you discover, from Sunny Meadow and Sunset Canyon to Mystic Night and Candy Kingdom.

POWER-UPS
Grab magnets, shields and speed boosts to run even further.

BEAT YOUR OWN RECORD
Try to go further on every run and top your best score.

SIMPLE CONTROLS, FUN GAMEPLAY
Easy-to-learn controls let you start playing right away. No ads, no account and no internet connection needed.

Available in English and Turkish.

How far can you run with Cici?

name: Ciğerim: Quit Smoking
description:
Ciğerim is a free companion app that supports you every day on your way to a smoke-free life. You don't need an account; by default your data stays only on your phone.

Please note: the app's content is currently available in Turkish only.

SEE EVERY SMOKE-FREE MOMENT
• Live timer: the time since you quit, second by second
• Money saved and cigarettes not smoked, based on your own consumption and pack price
• Estimated life regained: an informational estimate based on the approximation in a study published in the BMJ in 2000
• Savings goal: pick something you want to buy with the money you save and watch how close you are

WHAT IS CHANGING IN YOUR BODY?
An 11-step health recovery timeline shows the changes commonly seen after quitting, from 20 minutes to 15 years. The information is based on material published by organizations such as the World Health Organization (WHO), CDC and NHS, and the source is shown under every step.

WHEN A CRAVING HITS
The "I have a craving, what should I do?" button opens a step-by-step guide: pick the trigger, rate how strong the urge is, follow your personal plan, calm down with a box breathing exercise and then check in on how you feel. If you need support, you can call ALO 171, Turkey's free quit-smoking helpline, with one tap.

ONE STEP EVERY DAY
• 90 days of motivation cards personalized to your reasons for quitting
• Optional illustrated motivation notification every morning
• Mood check-ins and a chart that shows how your mood changes over time
• Badges and a journey bar for the milestones you reach

LEARN
Clear, referenced articles on the harms of smoking, the benefits of quitting, the hard parts of withdrawal and common myths. Health information in the app is based on 30 verified sources, all listed inside the app.

MAKE IT YOURS
• 6 color themes, light and dark appearance
• 45 custom illustrations
• Backup and restore as a file

OPTIONAL ENCRYPTED SYNC
If you use more than one device, you can turn on sync with your explicit consent. Your progress is encrypted on your device before it is sent to the server. You link a new device with a QR code, and a support code identifies your account. Unless you turn on email recovery, the key that decrypts your data stays only on your devices. You can turn sync off at any time and delete your account and server data from inside the app.

IMPORTANT
Ciğerim is not a health service or a medical device. Its content is for general information and motivation only and is not a substitute for diagnosis, treatment or medical advice. Make decisions about nicotine replacement products or medication together with your doctor or pharmacist. In an emergency, call your local emergency number (112 in Turkey). Results vary from person to person.

Privacy policy: https://cigerim.balkay.net/gizlilik
Sources: https://cigerim.balkay.net/kaynaklar
Medical disclaimer: https://cigerim.balkay.net/sorumluluk-reddi

name: Cineflix Player Pro
description:
Cineflix Player Pro é um reprodutor de mídia para iPhone, iPad, Apple TV e Apple Vision Pro. Ele reproduz as listas que você já tem: não vende, não hospeda e não inclui canais, filmes, séries ou qualquer outro conteúdo.

Para usar, você precisa de uma lista própria (M3U ou Xtream Codes) de um provedor que tenha os direitos do conteúdo. Sem uma lista, o app não mostra conteúdo.

COMO ENTRAR
• Código de acesso
• Servidor, usuário e senha (Xtream Codes)
• Endereço ou arquivo de uma lista M3U
Os dados da lista ficam guardados com segurança neste aparelho (Keychain). Dá para guardar várias listas e trocar entre elas.

RECURSOS
• Canais ao vivo por categoria, com o programa de agora e o próximo quando a lista traz o guia (EPG)
• Guia de programação completo e, quando o servidor da lista oferece, programas que já passaram
• Filmes e séries por categoria, com temporadas, episódios, continuar de onde parou e próximo episódio
• Busca em canais, filmes e séries
• Favoritos, últimos canais e Continuar assistindo
• Minhas sequências: monte uma fila de títulos para assistir em seguida
• Escolha da faixa de áudio e da legenda quando o arquivo traz
• AirPlay, Picture in Picture e controles na tela bloqueada
• No iPad: barra lateral, várias janelas e atalhos de teclado
• Na Apple TV: tudo pelo controle Siri Remote, com o mesmo código de acesso
• No Apple Vision Pro: o player numa janela, o modo cinema e os seus vídeos 180° e 360°

FAMÍLIA
• Até 5 perfis, cada um com os próprios favoritos e histórico
• Perfil Infantil, com limite de tempo por dia e hora de dormir
• Controle parental: conteúdo adulto travado por PIN ou escondido

AJUDA
• Diagnóstico (internet, lista e último erro) e relato de problemas direto pelo app

Idiomas do app: português, inglês e espanhol.

Importante: o Cineflix Player Pro não fornece conteúdo e não tem vínculo com nenhum provedor de listas. Use apenas listas e conteúdos que você tem o direito de acessar.

name: CivTop Beam
description:
CivTop Beam is a beam calculator for setting up beam models and exploring how loads and supports affect structural response.

In the Design tab, set the beam length, choose pin, roller or fixed supports, and enter the elastic modulus and second moment of area. Apply point loads, uniform or linearly varying distributed loads, and applied moments. The beam diagram lets you check the model as you edit it.

In the Results tab, view shear force, bending moment and deflection diagrams. Select a position along the beam to read the result at that location. Check vertical reactions and support moments in the Support Reactions table.

CivTop Beam is designed for engineers and engineering students who need quick beam checks, want to compare load and support arrangements, or are learning how beams respond.

Use results alongside independent engineering checks and applicable design standards.

name: Clarinet Buddy
description:
Clarinet Buddy is the clarinet teacher that listens. Play a note and it hears you, lights up in that note's color, and tells you if you're right, in tune and holding it steady.

Made for kids around 8 to 12 who just got their first clarinet, and for grown-up beginners too.

A JOURNEY, ONE STOP AT A TIME
Follow a winding path from your very first squeak to crossing the break. Each stop is a short lesson: meet the parts of the clarinet, put it together, find your embouchure, then learn new notes and play real songs like Hot Cross Buns, Mary Had a Little Lamb and Twinkle, Twinkle.

IT LISTENS AS YOU PLAY
Clarinet Buddy hears the pitch of your note many times a second. Hold the note and watch the ring fill. If you're a little high or low, it tells you which way to adjust.

EVERY NOTE AND FINGERING
The Notes library shows every note on the staff with a clear fingering chart. Tap "Hear it" to listen first, then try it yourself.

FREE PLAY
Play anything and the whole screen turns the color of your note, with a tuning meter, the note on the staff and its fingering.

MADE FOR THE B-FLAT CLARINET
Notes are shown the way they're written in clarinet music. The app handles the transposition for you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sound is analyzed live on the device. Nothing is ever recorded or sent anywhere. No ads.

SAVE PROGRESS ACROSS DEVICES
A grown-up can make an optional free account so progress follows your musician between iPhone and iPad.

FREE TO START
The first three lessons, the Notes library and Free Play are free. A one-time purchase unlocks the full journey, including every lesson we add later. No subscription. Works with Family Sharing.

name: Clay Batch
description: Clay Batch calculates dry glaze ingredient weights from a target batch size. Separate base ingredients from additions, set scale precision and tolerances, record actual weights, and export a snapshot of the recipe and weighing results.

name: Clean Speaker Sound: Rivo
description:
Muffled playback after rain, splashes, steam, or pocket lint? Clean Speaker Sound: Rivo pairs real-time 48 kHz acoustic waveforms with synchronized Core Haptics to help push surface water droplets and loose dust from your iPhone speaker grille, with zero ads, no account, and full offline support.

Four focused audio tools in one clean app:
• Clean (Water, Deep, and Dust): Guided 6-phase cycles that alternate sub-bass sweeps, rhythmic air pulses, and octave bass pumps instead of a static hum. Includes 1 free 15-second Quick Clean and a post-run Speaker Sound Check track to try right away.
• Tone Generator (Free, 20 Hz–20 kHz): Logarithmic frequency dial with tactile ticks, quick presets (165 Hz Water Eject resonance, 250 Hz, 440 Hz, 1 kHz), ±1 Hz and ±10 Hz fine steps, and automatic soft gain reduction at 2,000 Hz and above.
• dB Meter (Free, Estimated SPL): Real-time ambient loudness on a 20–120 dB scale with MIN, AVG, and MAX readouts plus a 24-band spectrum. Microphone audio is analyzed in temporary device memory and is never recorded, saved, or transmitted. Readings are on-device estimates, not calibrated SPL measurements.
• Stereo Speaker Test (Free): Isolate Left or Right channels or turn on Auto Sweep (Both → Left → Right) to check balance between your top earpiece and bottom speaker.

Three 6-phase cleaning modes (Rivo Pro)
• Water Eject (60s · 48–340 Hz): Built for everyday splashes, rain, and shower steam across Sub Wake, Bass Sweep, Sub Pulses, Bass Pump, Deep Flush, and Dry & Clear.
• Deep Clean (90s · 42–420 Hz): Extended cycle with heavier sub-bass excursion and longer pumping stages for stubborn muffled sound.
• Dust Flush (45s · 150–680 Hz + Pink Noise): Combines pink noise, mid-bass mesh shakes, air pulses, and Core Haptics to help loosen dry pocket lint.

Built for safe, offline use
• 2-step Prep Guide before cleaning: reminds you to disconnect headphones, raise speaker volume, and place your iPhone face down so gravity assists each pulse.
• Headphone Safety (on by default): blocks cleaning cycles from starting into AirPods or wired/Bluetooth headphones and pauses immediately if headphones connect mid-cycle.
• 7-Day Speaker Care tracker: optional on-device streak on the Clean tab.
• Works in Airplane Mode: all waveforms, haptics, stereo checks, and microphone FFT spectrum math run locally on your iPhone. Internet access is only needed to start or restore a subscription through the App Store.

Important hardware & hearing note
Acoustic waves and device vibrations can help dislodge surface moisture and light dust from speaker openings, but software cannot repair blown speakers, corroded components, or internal liquid damage. Never hold the speaker grille against your ear during playback. After deep submersion or saltwater exposure, power off your device, let it dry, and contact Apple Support or an authorized service provider.

Rivo Pro subscription
• Tone Generator, dB Meter, Stereo Speaker Test, and 1 15-second Quick Clean are included free with zero ads.
• Rivo Pro unlocks unlimited full 60s Water, 90s Deep, and 45s Dust 6-phase cycles and post-clean Speaker Sound Check playback.
• Plans: Rivo Pro Yearly ($39.99/year with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) or Rivo Pro Weekly ($6.99/week), or local App Store equivalent.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or after the free trial ends, if eligible). Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period or trial in Settings > Manage or Cancel Plan or in iPhone Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://cleanspeakersound.app/privacy/
Terms of Use (incorporates Apple Standard EULA): https://cleanspeakersound.app/terms/
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Cleaner Nook
description:
When two shots look almost identical, bring them into the same frame. Cleaner Nook groups similar photos taken close together. Drag the divider to compare details, adjust your picks in the thumbnail strip, and review the selection before removing anything. At least one photo stays in each group.

Start at Desk to see how much space is available on your iPhone. Quick clean opens duplicate photos for review. Similar videos and screenshots have their own tools. You confirm what gets removed.

Have two contact cards for the same person? Review the phone numbers and email addresses before merging the cards. In Calendar cleanup, browse past events by year and remove a selected occurrence from an editable calendar.

Import photos or videos into Private pocket to keep separate copies on this device. Add a four-digit PIN if you like. Removing an original from Photos requires a separate confirmation.

The storage guide remembers which steps you’ve checked off. Add a storage or battery widget to your Home Screen to see the latest reading. No account is required to use the cleanup tools.

name: ClearedStops
description:
ClearedStops puts your snow route, ordered, on your phone — one check-off list, proof photos, and invoicing from the work itself. For 1–5 truck crews, billed in-season only.

Every stop on one check-off list — nothing lives in someone’s memory. The run screen works through low signal and offline: check-offs queue on the device and sync when signal returns.

Build an ordered route once, check off each stop as you clear it — with an optional proof photo — and roll the month’s closed runs into invoices. The route plan shows every stop pinned on the map, in run order, with turn-by-turn directions that follow the road.

Proof you were there. A text that it’s done. Attach a timestamped proof photo at the stop; once you’ve connected your own texting account and its registration clears, checking off a stop sends the customer a text that it’s done.

The month’s work, already written down. Your closed runs become the invoice — each cleared stop a line, with the date and the address.

name: CLF Legal Tools – Court Fees
description:
CLF Legal Tools – Court Fees brings the calculators and finders of centurylawfirm.in to your phone: court fees, time limits, Delhi court and police finders, company law and arbitration fees, succession shares, and a section-by-section comparison of the old and new criminal laws. Made by Century Law Firm, Delhi, for advocates, litigants and law students.

COURT FEES IN 30 STATES AND UNION TERRITORIES
Type the value of a civil suit, pick the State, and the ad valorem court fee appears at once, with the amount in words. It covers Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Delhi, Chandigarh, Goa, Gujarat, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Ladakh, Lakshadweep, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Manipur, Meghalaya, Odisha, Puducherry, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Tripura, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand and West Bengal. For Delhi, the app also tells you which court hears a civil suit of that value. Separate calculators give the fee for a succession certificate, probate or letters of administration in 14 States and Union territories, for an OA or SA before a Debts Recovery Tribunal, and for a consumer complaint.

TIME LIMITS
Count the days between two dates, find the last date of a limitation period, or pick one of 80 kinds of suits, appeals and applications to have the period filled in. The cheque bounce calculator works out each time limit under section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act from your own dates.

DELHI COURTS AND POLICE
Choose a police station in Delhi to see its ACP office, DCP office, CAW Cell and criminal court, with addresses, e-mail and directions. If you do not know your police station, search your colony or village, mark the spot on the map, or tap "Use my location". The civil court finder shows the district court for a civil suit about a place in Delhi, with the SDM and Sub-Registrar offices. You can also find the District Consumer Commission and the DRT for a police station.

IPC TO BNS, CRPC TO BNSS, IEA TO BSA
Find the new section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) or Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) for a section of the IPC, the CrPC or the Indian Evidence Act, and the other way round. Search by section number or subject, read what changed and the text of the new section, and save sections you use often. The BNS offence finder shows the punishment for an offence, whether it is cognizable and bailable, and the court that tries it.

COMPANY LAW AND ARBITRATION
Find the filing fee for 35 applications, petitions and appeals before the NCLT and NCLAT, and the NCLT Bench for each State and Union territory. Work out an arbitral tribunal's model fee under the Fourth Schedule to the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, and the fees and administrative cost at the Delhi International Arbitration Centre.

SUCCESSION
See the share of each Class I heir of a Hindu man, and of the husband and children of a Hindu woman, who died without a will.

ARTICLES
Read guides from the Century Law Firm blog. New articles appear by themselves, and those you have opened stay readable without internet.

MADE TO BE QUICK
The calculators, finders and law tables work without internet (the street map needs a connection). Copy or share any result with a link to its source, save sections and articles, search everything from one box, and choose light or dark mode.

PRIVACY
There is no account, no sign-in and no advertising. Your location is read only when you tap "Use my location", and it is not sent to us. The app counts which screens are opened, using Google Analytics for Firebase, without any advertising ID. The full privacy policy is in the app under More and at www.centurylawfirm.in/app-privacy-policy.php.

Fee scales, time limits and court lists change from time to time. The tools are a guide and not legal advice; please check the result against the current rules before you file.

Questions, corrections or suggestions: info@centurylawfirm.in

name: Clip Mint: Video Converter
description:
Clipmint turns videos that won't play, share or edit on your iPhone or iPad into files that just work. Open an MKV, WebM, AVI or almost any other video, pick a format, and Clipmint converts it on your device with Apple's own video encoders. Nothing is uploaded, and there's no account to make.

Convert to what you need
• Video: MP4, MOV, M4V or MKV, using H.264 or HEVC
• Sound only: M4A, MP3, WAV or FLAC
• Animated GIF: choose the start, length, size and smoothness
• Pick Small, Balanced or High quality and see the file size before you start

Opens files other apps can't
• MKV, WebM, AVI, MOV, MP4, FLV, WMV, MPEG-TS and more
• AV1, VP9, HEVC, H.264 and many older formats
• Open from the Files app or your photo library
• Send a video from another app, or drag one in on iPad

HDR, your way
• Keep HDR10 and HLG videos in HDR, using HEVC
• Or convert them to standard range so they look right on every screen

Made for long videos
• Pause a conversion and carry on later
• Leave the app and Clipmint pauses, then continues when you come back
• A warning before you run out of storage

Your Library
• Every conversion is kept in the Library, with the space it uses
• Play, share, save to Photos or delete, or select several at once
• Converted files also appear in Clipmint's folder in the Files app

Private by design
• Your videos, sound and GIFs never leave your device
• No account and no sign-in

For iPhone and iPad
• Works in portrait and landscape
• Dark, Light or match your device

name: Clock-Out Breakout
description:
The clock says 6:00. The office says you're staying. Grab the paper blaster and find a way out.

• Move with one thumb and fire automatically when enemies come in range. Keep moving through projectiles and boss attack warnings.
