• Pick a combat perk and build around it. Leave fire where enemies fall, slow a rush with ice, or chain lightning through a crowd.
• Earn coins and parts, equip the gear you find, and build up your weapons between fights.
• Follow the story across an interconnected office, then take on survival challenges or search the Warehouse Raid for loot you can extract.
• Play the core game offline. Optional rewarded videos and App Store purchases require a connection.

No Ads + Instant Rewards is a one-time purchase that lets you claim eligible video rewards instantly. It uses the same reward limits as free play.

name: Cloud Surge
description: Cloud Surge is a hexagonal honeycomb chain-flipping puzzle. Tap a hex tile to flip it, triggering a sequential surge that spreads to neighboring tiles. The propagation directions are determined by each tile’s current face. Plan your taps to transform the whole honeycomb into the target color pattern.

name: Cobox - Baies et racks serveur
description:
Cobox, la marque de LANDE SAS, conçoit et distribue des baies, racks et coffrets pour l'infrastructure informatique des entreprises.
L'application Cobox vous donne un accès direct à la boutique cobox.fr et à votre espace client, depuis votre téléphone.
AVEC L'APPLICATION COBOX
• Consultez tout le catalogue : baies serveur, baies insonorisées, baies climatisées, racks, coffrets muraux, coffrets étanches et accessoires.
• Connectez-vous à votre compte client et restez connecté.
• Retrouvez vos commandes et vos informations de compte.
• Passez commande comme sur le site, avec les mêmes prix et les mêmes conditions.
• Recevez des notifications sur les nouveautés, les offres et les informations produits.
NOS GAMMES
• SmartQube : baies serveur climatisées.
• Silence Zen et Silence Style : baies insonorisées pour bureaux et open spaces.
• SOHO : racks compacts pour petites structures.
• Coffrets IP55 : protection contre la poussière et les projections d'eau.
• Accessoires : tout le nécessaire pour équiper vos baies.
POUR QUI ?
L'application s'adresse aux professionnels : services informatiques, intégrateurs, installateurs et revendeurs qui équipent des salles serveur, des locaux techniques ou des bureaux.
BESOIN D'AIDE ?
Notre équipe vous répond depuis la page Contact de cobox.fr.
LANDE SAS — 3 rue des Bâtisseurs, 91350 Grigny, France.

name: CockpitView: In Flight PFD
description:
CockpitView gives you the pilots' view from your seat in the cabin. Your iPhone or iPad becomes the glass cockpit of an airliner and follows your flight on cockpit-style displays, in airplane mode and without Wi-Fi.

BEFORE YOU BOARD
• Enter your flight number, or pick the departure and arrival airports
• Download the flight: route, airports and terrain are stored on your device for use without internet
• Set it up like the crew does: choose the departure runway and the approach on the flight plan page, or add waypoints

IN FLIGHT
• Switch on airplane mode, keep GPS on, and the displays follow your aircraft from takeoff to landing
• Primary flight display: attitude indicator, speed and altitude tapes, vertical speed and heading
• Navigation display: moving map with your flight plan and waypoints, terrain coloured by height, distance and time to destination
• Vertical display: the ground below and ahead of you, and the climb and descent of your flight

TWO FLIGHT DECKS
Choose between two classic airliner cockpits. Everything is set up on a working flight computer (MCDU / CDU): type into the scratchpad and press the line-select keys, just like in the cockpit. Set speed, heading and altitude on the autopilot panel. Speed in km/h, mph or knots; vertical speed in m/s or ft/min.

Works in portrait and landscape, on iPhone and iPad, including Split View.

GOOD TO KNOW
• GPS is required: iPhone, or iPad with cellular. A window seat gives the best reception.
• The flight path is the planned route (from SimBrief, the flight number's airports, or waypoints you enter), so the route actually flown can differ.

CockpitView is for entertainment. It is not a navigation aid or a certified instrument, and not for flying an aircraft. Follow the crew's instructions on using devices on board.

Flight routes: adsbdb.com (Virtual Radar Server standing data, CC0) and hexdb.io. Flight tracks contain data from adsb.lol (ODbL 1.0). US procedures: FAA CIFP. Terrain: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles. Airports: OurAirports. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

name: Coda: Self-Hosted Music
description:
Coda plays the music on your Jellyfin server, and works the way you’d expect a music app on iPhone to. Artwork comes first, colors come from the covers, and the controls and gestures are the ones you already know.

YOUR MUSIC, THE WAY YOU WANT IT
• Synced lyrics that light up line by line, with a translation underneath when they’re in another language
• Gapless playback, so live albums and DJ mixes flow without a pause
• Lossless and Hi-Res Lossless: FLAC, ALAC, WAV and AIFF play untouched, and a badge says so. Your server converts the rest
• Sound Check plays every song at about the same volume
• Separate streaming quality for Wi-Fi and cellular

A HOME THAT KNOWS YOUR LIBRARY
Home digs through your server for what you just added, what you play most, and the albums you haven’t heard in years. Anniversaries brings back albums released on this day in earlier years.

TAKE IT WITH YOU
• Download songs, albums and playlists, lyrics included, as AAC or the original file
• One button downloads all your favorites, including the ones you star later
• Offline, your library still shows, and everything on your iPhone plays

EVERYTHING ELSE YOU’D LOOK FOR
• Create, rename and reorder playlists, and start a station from any song, album or artist
• Shuffle, Repeat, Autoplay and a sleep timer
• Favorites that stay in sync with your server
• Lock Screen and Control Center controls, AirPlay and AirPods
• Siri: ask for a song, an album, an artist, a playlist or a genre by name (needs iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence)
• Play counts and “last played” stay current on your server
• In English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Swedish, Japanese, Portuguese, Chinese, Russian, Greek, Thai, Korean, Dutch and Polish

NOTHING IN BETWEEN
Coda connects straight to your server. There’s no account with us, no tracking, and no server of ours in between. Sign in with your Jellyfin password or with Quick Connect.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A Jellyfin server, version 10.9 or later, with a music library
• A Jellyfin account on that server

Coda is an independent app and isn’t affiliated with the Jellyfin project.

name: CoDate
description:
Choose one of eight fictional companions and settle down to work or study alongside them. Each mate has a different setting, from a snowbound study to a city studio after dark.

Work together
Write down a task and start a 25- or 50-minute focus session. Try a one-minute session first, or pause and resume the timer as needed.

Take a meal break
Switch to your mate’s dining scene. Work and meal sessions appear separately in your records.

Offline video and ASMR
All character scenes and ambient sounds are included in the app. You can use the timer, play scenes and view your last 30 sessions offline. Optional local notifications let you know when a session ends. Audio may pause when the screen is locked or you leave the app.

Free to use, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Tasks and records are stored on your device. Supports English, Korean, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

name: CoinWorthy: Coin Identifier
description:
Is your coin worth anything? Point your camera at it. CoinWorthy tells you what the coin is, its grade as a range, and about what it sells for, right on the coin.
When we are not sure about a detail, we say so and ask you one quick question.

Found old coins in a drawer, a jar of change, or a collection someone left you? You do not need to know anything about coins. Hold your phone over a coin on a plain table. The photo takes itself when your phone is steady.

WHAT YOU SEE FOR EACH COIN
• The coin's name, country and year, and the mint mark when it can be read.
• How sure we are about each part.
• Its grade as a range, for example Very Fine, could be Fine to Extremely Fine.
• A price range from recent sales of the same coin, with the typical price in the middle. Some coins have too few sales for a price yet, and we tell you so.
• For silver and gold coins, what the metal alone is worth.
• A warning on valuable coins that are often faked, so you have them checked before you sell.

SCAN A PILE OF COINS
• Common coins show for a moment, then the camera is ready for the next one. Coins worth a closer look stop and wait for you.
• Flip a coin when asked and the back helps with the mint mark.
• You can also upload photos you already took.

YOUR COLLECTION
• Add any coin to your collection with one tap.
• Sort coins into folders and search them by name or year.
• Members see what the whole collection is worth, with a graph over time.

EXPLORE AND FILL YOUR SETS
• Browse sets like Morgan dollars, Lincoln wheat cents and state quarters.
• See which coins you have, which you still need, and the key dates to look for.

SELL ON EBAY
• Members can turn a coin into an eBay listing in a few taps, with the photos and details filled in.
• You check it, set the price and choose when it goes live. The sale happens on eBay, under eBay's rules and fees. You need your own eBay account.

WHICH COINS IT KNOWS
US coins are our strongest. It also knows many world coins, including coins from Canada, Mexico, Great Britain and Australia. If we do not know a coin yet, we usually say so instead of guessing. Paper money is not supported.

FREE AND MEMBERSHIP
• Your first scan is free and shows everything.
• After that, you get 10 free scans a day that show the coin, its grade and how sure we are.
• Membership adds the prices of your coins, your collection's value and scans with no daily limit.
• The yearly plan starts with a free week. You see the price in the app before you start. A monthly plan is also in the app. No ads.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account. With the free week, the first charge comes when the free week ends. Your membership renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
• If you cancel during the free week, it ends that day and you go back to the free plan.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Sign in with Apple or Google so your coins are saved to your account.
• Values are estimates from your photos and recent sales, not a guaranteed grade or price. For a valuable coin, have a coin shop or a grading service look at it before you sell.
• We remove location data from every photo.

Terms of Use: https://coingrader.app/coinworthy/terms
Privacy Policy: https://coingrader.app/coinworthy/privacy

name: Cold or Allergy
description:
Some days you wake up stuffy and wonder: is this a cold, or is it something in the air?

Cold or Allergy is a quiet record of how you feel, kept next to what was actually outside. Tap a face whenever you like. The app writes down the pollen, mold, air quality and weather around you, and over a few weeks your own patterns start to show.

• Tap a face to check in, as often as you like. Add symptoms, medication, time outdoors or a note if you want to.
• Pollen for trees, grasses and weeds, down to individual plants like oak, birch and ragweed.
• An estimated mold level from the weather: season, temperature, recent rain and humidity.
• U.S. EPA air quality and Apple Weather, recorded automatically for wherever you are.
• History and charts that put how you felt next to what was in the air.
• Ask Apple Intelligence about your own log, right on your device: "What triggers my bad days?" "Cold or allergies lately?"
• A weekly summary every Sunday.
• Widgets for your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Control Center. Log a face without opening the app.
• Export to a spreadsheet, JSON, or a summary ready to paste into an AI chat.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.

Private by design: no accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your log lives on your devices and in your private iCloud. Your location is rounded to about a kilometer before the app looks anything up.

Cold or Allergy helps you notice patterns. It isn't a medical device and doesn't give medical advice. Mold levels are estimated from the weather, not measured.

name: Colégio New Way
description:
O app oficial dos alunos do Colégio New Way.

Aqui você acompanha a sua rotina de estudos e tudo o que o colégio prepara para a sua turma, do primeiro dia de aula até o vestibular.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA

• Cronograma: o que estudar em cada semana, organizado por disciplina.
• Cursos e aulas: videoaulas e materiais da sua turma.
• Simulados e avaliações: provas do colégio, com resultado e correção.
• Questões: banco de questões de vestibulares com resolução comentada.
• Flashcards: revisão espaçada para fixar o conteúdo.
• Redação: envie o seu texto e receba a correção.
• Livro de Revisão: capítulos de revisão para a reta final.
• Boletim e desempenho: suas notas e a sua evolução por área.
• Agenda e calendário escolar: provas, eventos e compromissos.
• Assessoria e apoio socioemocional: acompanhamento da equipe do colégio.

PARA QUEM É

O acesso é exclusivo para alunos matriculados no Colégio New Way. O login é o mesmo que você recebeu do colégio. Não há cadastro pelo app.

Plataforma do Colégio New Way, operada pela MedWay.

name: Collapse Four Joy - Offline
description:
Collapse Four Joy is the classic four-in-a-row game with one unforgettable twist: every fifth move, the bottom row collapses and everything above it drops one row.

Plan ahead, because the countdown is always in sight. A threat on the bottom row can vanish before your opponent finishes it. A disc you drop at the wrong moment can disappear before it ever helps you. The floor is never safe, and neither is the lead.

WHAT YOU GET
• A quick, elegant game that is easy to learn and hard to put down
• Three difficulty levels, from a relaxed warm-up to a ruthless opponent
• An interactive tutorial that teaches the collapse step by step with small puzzles
• A hint button when you are stuck
• Local statistics and badges to chase
• Smooth, tactile animations and haptics (switch them off any time)
• Works completely offline. No account, no ads, no timers
• Available in 20 languages

HOW IT WORKS
Take turns dropping discs into a seven-column board. Line up four of your discs in a row, in any direction, to win. After every fifth move in total, the bottom row disappears. Use it: let the collapse wipe out your opponent's bottom-row plans, and keep your own threats above the floor.

PRIVACY
Collapse Four Joy never asks you to sign in. If you agree, the game sends anonymous usage statistics and crash reports to help us improve it. You can say no and the game works exactly the same, and you can change your choice in Settings at any time.

name: Color Block Resonance
description: Color Block Resonance is a logical resonance puzzle. Tap a block to trigger a wave that spreads to adjacent cells. The wave flips cells only when their state differs and stops when it meets a matching block. Plan your taps carefully to transform the starting grid into the target pattern.

name: Colorlunch: Color Reflex Game
description:
Eat the colors. A block appears in the middle of the screen, colored bands surround it. Hold your finger on the edge with the same color, and the color reaches out and gobbles the block up. Pressed the wrong one? Lift your finger before it hits and the color slides back.

Simple to learn, hard to master. Every 40 rounds a new level brings a new color, its own musical scale and new movement: colors slide around the edge, the center starts to drift and turn, blocks get layers, split in two or change color while you look.

FEATURES
• Three difficulty levels: Easy (more time, wide edges at first), Normal and Hard (less time, starts further in)
• Seven lives, streaks, multipliers and a party at 25 in a row
• Special moments: sparkling rainbow edges, glowing slow-motion blocks, a black hole that freezes the edge, grey blocks you must not eat
• Every correct answer plays the next note of a melody that rises and falls with your streak
• Haptics and sounds that respect your silent switch
• Your own Top 10 and statistics for each difficulty
• English and Finnish

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Levels 1–3 are free. A one-time purchase unlocks all levels, and the game continues straight from level 4 with your score, streak and lives intact. No subscription, no ads.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your scores stay on your device.

Colorlunch is part of Embody Apps: small apps made by Ossi Konttinen.

name: Complejos
description:
Complejos helps students master operations with complex numbers through fast, focused practice.

Each round gives you 10 multiple-choice questions on complex numbers in the form a + bi:
• Addition
• Subtraction
• Multiplication (including i² = −1)
• Division using the complex conjugate

Tap your answer and move on automatically to the next question. A green or red flash shows right away whether you were correct. At the end you get your score, your time, and a review of every question with the correct answer.

Every round uses new random numbers, so you can practice as many times as you want. Answer choices are built from common student mistakes, such as forgetting that i² = −1 or distributing the negative sign incorrectly, so the practice really builds understanding.

Features:
• 10 questions per round: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division
• New random questions every time
• Instant feedback and automatic next question
• Score out of 100, timer, and full review at the end
• Switch between English and Spanish with one tap
• Works offline, with no account, ads, or data collection

Created by a certified high school math teacher for Algebra 2 and Precalculus students. Aligned to Common Core and New Jersey Student Learning Standards (NJSLS) for complex numbers.

name: Composer Appointments
description:
Customers book a time with you, day or night. You run the day from your phone.

Composer Appointments is a booking app for any business that takes appointments: salons, spas, studios, repair shops, tutors, trainers, showrooms and more. Customers tap your booking link, pick a time and book. They do not need an account. You see each booking on your calendar.

WHO IT IS FOR
Owners and teams. Customers never need the app. They use a plain web page.

WHAT YOU CAN DO IN THE APP
- See today at a glance: who is next, who has checked in, and who is waiting for your yes.
- Check a customer in, call them or text them from the booking.
- Say yes or no to a booking before it is confirmed, if you turn on approval.
- Open your calendar by day, month or list. Drag an appointment to move it.
- Pick one person or everyone, so each person sees their own day.
- Search your customers by name, number or email. Keep private notes and photos on each one.
- Get an alert on your phone when a customer has not arrived for their time.

WHAT YOU SET UP ON YOUR BOOKING PAGE
- Your own booking link. Put it on your website, your social pages or in a message. Print the code for your counter.
- Services, hours and days off for you and for each person on your team.
- Rooms and equipment, so a time is offered only while what the service needs is free.
- More than one location. Each place has its own address, hours, people and link.
- Classes where several customers book the same time, up to a limit you set.
- A waiting list when a time is full.
- Several services in one visit, booked back to back.
- "Take turns" so visits go to the person who has had the fewest.
- Questions on the booking form, so you know what you need before the visit.
- Packages, memberships and gift cards for your customers.
- Deposits, tips and no-show fees, paid to your business's own Stripe account.
- Pages for events and booths, with a sign to print and an "I am here" button for walk-ups.
- Your Google or Outlook calendar blocks the times you are busy.
- Confirmation and reminder emails to your customers.
- Light or dark, to suit your eyes.

GOOD TO KNOW
- For Composer customers: sign in with your Composer account, the same one you use in other Composer apps.
- Alerts are optional. You choose whether to turn them on.

Questions or ideas? appointments@retailcomposer.com

name: Composer Media
description:
Show customers your photos and videos. Then send them home with a link.

A customer looks at a sofa in your showroom, loves it, and goes home to think. By dinner they cannot remember the color or the size. Composer Media keeps one tidy album for each thing you sell. You show it on your phone or iPad while the customer is with you. Then you send one short link, and they get exactly what they saw.

It is made for anyone who sells something people want to see first. If you can take a picture on your phone, you can use it. Customers never need an app.

A normal day: before you open, you add new photos to an album, like Corner Sofas or Patio Sets. A customer comes in, and you swipe through it together. They want to think it over, so you text or email a short link, or they scan the QR code on your phone. Later you see when they open it. That is your cue to follow up.

What you can do in the app
- Keep albums for everything you sell, with photos, videos and YouTube links in the order you show them.
- Add photos and videos right from your phone or iPad.
- Crop photos and trim videos in the app.
- Search every album to find the right one fast.
- Send a short link by text or email, or show a QR code the customer scans.
- See when each link was opened and what the customer watched.
- Get a notification when a customer comes back to a link.
- See which photos a customer liked, so you know what to talk about when you call.
- Put your card on every link: your photo, name and how to reach you.
- Pick a few photos and clips and make one short highlight video with your contact card at the end.
- Share one library with your team, so everyone shows the same current photos.

Good to know
- For Composer customers: sign in with your Composer account, using your password, a sign-in link or a passkey.
- Customers open your links in any browser with nothing to install.
- You can delete your account at account.retailcomposer.com/delete-account.

Composer Media is made by Retail Composer LLC.

name: composerSMS Chat
description:
Your team's text inbox, in your pocket.

A customer texts back about their delivery. The text lands on one phone, in one pocket. If that person is at lunch or off today, nobody answers. composerSMS Chat fixes that. Everyone on your team opens the same inbox, sees the same conversations and answers from the same shop number.

This app is for businesses that already use composerSMS. It shows your team's inbox. It does not read or send the texts on your own iPhone.

A normal day: a customer texts back, you see it in the app, and you answer from the inbox. Group texts and pictures work both ways. People who asked you to stop are left alone until they text START.

What you can do in the app
- Open one inbox for the whole team, with one conversation for each person or group.
- Read the full conversation and answer in a few taps.
- Start a new conversation with someone from your team's contact list.
- See which conversations are unread, and search your conversations by name.
- Change your mind: after you send, tap Undo for a few seconds and the text is held back.
- Get a notification for each new text, with the conversation name and the start of the message.
- Use it on an iPhone or an iPad, upright or sideways.

Good to know
- For Composer customers: sign in with your Composer account, using your password, a sign-in link or a passkey.
- Customers see the number your team already uses. They can call it too.
- Notifications are optional. You choose whether to turn them on.
- You can delete your account at account.retailcomposer.com/delete-account.

composerSMS Chat is made by Retail Composer LLC.

name: Compresso: Photo, Video, PDF
description:
Photos too big to email? A video that won’t send? A PDF rejected by an online form? Compresso shrinks and converts all your files in a tap.

ONE TAP
• For email: your photos under 2 MB
• WhatsApp, Instagram, Story: the right format, automatically
• Online forms: a PDF under 1 MB
• Private sharing: strip the GPS location from your photos

IMAGES
• Compress photos (JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC)
• HEIC → JPG: iPhone photos that open everywhere
• Resize: square, portrait, Story or custom
• Remove metadata: GPS location, device, date

VIDEO & AUDIO
• Compress videos to 720p, 1080p or 4K
• Trim a video to keep only what matters
• Video → animated GIF
• Video → MP3 and Audio → MP3 (voice memos, M4A, WAV…)

DOCUMENTS
• Compress PDFs
• Merge PDFs or extract pages
• Scan documents into PDFs with your camera
• Create and open ZIP archives

FREE UP SPACE
Compresso finds the heaviest videos in your library and slims them down, right on your phone.

HANDY
• Process up to 30 files at once
• Pick a target size: “under 2 MB” and you’re done
• Import from Photos, Files, a direct link, or share to Compresso from any app
• Conversion history and space saved

YOUR FILES STAY YOURS
Most tools run entirely on your iPhone: nothing is uploaded. Tools marked “Online” (MP3, GIF, trimming, PDF) delete your file from our server as soon as the conversion is done. No account, no ads, no tracking.

COMPRESSO PREMIUM
The free version handles one file at a time and includes 3 online conversions a day. Premium unlocks batch processing, target size, the gallery cleaner, maximum quality (4K, 320 kbps MP3, PNG, WebP) and unlimited online tools.

Monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://devexa.fr/compresso/en/politique-de-confidentialite/

name: Comunidad Cristiana de PZO
description:
Bienvenido a la App Oficial de la Comunidad Cristiana de Pinhalzinho

Nos alegra tenerte aquí. 

Esta es la App oficial de la Comunidad Cristiana de Pinhalzinho creada para acercarnos aún más como iglesia y facilitar la comunicación entre la iglesia sus miembros y visitantes.

A través de la App podrás

 Gestionar Grupos Pequeos Células Discipulados y Ministerios.

 Encontrar un Grupo Pequeo o Célula cerca de tu casa.
Si ya participas de un grupo también podrás

 Indicar nuevos participantes
 Registrar la asistencia y completar el informe del encuentro
 Consultar la dirección del próximo encuentro
 Enviar notificaciones a los participantes.

 Consultar y organizar eventos como Escuelas Bíblicas campamentos cursos de formación y otros encuentros de la iglesia.

 Mural de Recados mantente al día con las novedades de la iglesia y comunícate con otros miembros.

 Mi Perfil actualiza tus datos personales y la información registrada en la iglesia.

 Contenido accede a los audios y videos disponibles en la App.

 Pedidos de oración y visitas puedes enviar tus pedidos de oración solicitar una visita y mucho más.

 Agenda consulta el calendario de cultos eventos y actividades de la iglesia además de tu participación en los diferentes ministerios y departamentos.

 Discipulado si estás realizando un discipulado podrás consultar los encuentros y acompaar de manera más organizada todo el proceso.

 Queremos estar más cerca comunicarnos mejor y caminar juntos como iglesia.

Descarga ahora nuestra App Oficial y disfruta de todas sus funcionalidades

Es un gusto tenerte con nosotros. Somos una familia y queremos caminar juntos 

COMUNIDAD CRISTIANA DE PINHALZINHO

name: ConcreteYardage
description: ConcreteYardage kertoo, kuinka paljon betonia tilataan laatalle. Syötä pituus, leveys ja paksuus, valitse säkkejä kuutiojaardia kohti ja pieni hukkaprosentti — puhelin näyttää kuutiojaardit, 80 naulan säkkimäärän ja kuormat. Tallenna erä paikalliseen valukirjaan ja käytä samaa kokoa seuraavalla kerralla. Arvio on työmaan tilausapua, ei sideainesuunnitelmaa.

name: Contractfix: Contract Maker
description:
Need a rental agreement, a freelance contract or a car sale contract in another country? Contractfix builds it under that country's law, in the local language with an English or Russian translation side by side. No AI. Ready in minutes.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a country: Czech Republic, Spain, Germany, Poland, Portugal or International (US / UK)
• Pick a contract: freelance and services, residential lease, or private used-car sale
• Answer simple questions: parties, dates, rent or price, deposit, deadlines
• Get a PDF ready to print and sign
Available contract types vary by country.

TWO LANGUAGES, ONE CONTRACT
The text that counts is in the country's language. An English or Russian translation runs next to it, clause by clause, so both sides understand what they sign. Made for expats, foreign freelancers and landlords with international tenants.

BASED ON THE LAW, NOT ON AI
• Fixed templates written for each country, with references to the laws they follow: German BGB, Spain's LAU, the Czech, Polish and Portuguese Civil Codes and more
• The same answers always give the same text. Nothing is made up
• Notes in the questionnaire where the law sets limits, such as deposit caps

ADD YOUR OWN CLAUSES
A pet rule, a parking space, a special payment schedule? Add any clause you need in your own words.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, nothing uploaded
• Names, addresses and ID numbers stay on your device

FREE TO TRY
Fill in any contract and preview the PDF with a watermark for free.

CONTRACTFIX PRO
• Clean PDF without watermark
• Side-by-side translation
• Every country and contract type, unlimited contracts
Choose a weekly subscription (with a free trial where offered), a yearly subscription, or a one-time purchase that unlocks the PDF of a single contract.

NOT LEGAL ADVICE
Contractfix fills in standard templates. It is not a law firm and does not give legal advice, and no template fits every situation. Read the contract before you sign it and, for anything unusual, ask a lawyer.

Subscriptions: Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. The single-contract purchase is a one-time payment and does not renew.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://contractfix.app/privacy/

name: Converoom
seller_name: KARYATURK BELGELENDIRME VE EGITIM HIZMETLERI LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Converoom ile iki kişi QR kodu okutarak ya da 6 haneli bir numarayla saniyeler içinde aynı sohbete girer. Üyelik, telefon numarası veya e-posta gerekmez.

• Uçtan uca şifreli: Anahtarlar yalnızca iki cihazda üretilir; sunucu mesajları okuyamaz.
• Hiçbir şey saklanmaz: Mesajlar, fotoğraflar ve dosyalar hiçbir sunucuda tutulmaz.
• 10 saniyede silinir: Mesaj karşı tarafın ekranında göründükten 10 saniye sonra iki cihazdan da silinir.
• Ekran görüntüsü koruması: Ekran görüntüsü siyah çıkar ve karşı tarafa bildirilir; ekran kaydı sırasında mesajlar gizlenir.
• Fotoğraf, dosya, emoji ve titreşim gönderebilirsiniz; fotoğraflardaki konum bilgisi silinir.
• iPhone, Android ve web (app.converoom.com) birbiriyle konuşur.

Nasıl kullanılır?
Yan yanaysanız: Biri "QR göster"e dokunur, diğeri "QR okut" ile kameraya tutar.
Uzaktaysanız: Biri "Numara oluştur"a dokunur ve 6 haneli numarayı telefonda söyler, diğeri "Numara gir" ile yazar. Numara 2 dakika geçerlidir ve tek kullanımlıktır.
Bağlandığınızda konuşmaya başlayın.

Bir sohbette aynı anda en fazla 2 kişi konuşur. Kötüye kullanımı sohbetteki bayrak düğmesiyle anında sonlandırıp bildirebilirsiniz.

Converoom ücretsizdir ve 18 yaş ve üzeri kullanıcılar içindir.

name: Cookie Pair Party
description:
Spin a 5×5 grid of cookies in Cookie Reels, then flip smiling faces in Cookie Match.

Choose a Play Cost in virtual croookies and spin once or turn on Auto Spin. Sticky Cookies stay in the center row between spins at the same Play Cost. Fill the row to open Cookie Hold Bonus and see what lands in the remaining spaces.

In Cookie Match, flip two cookies at a time. Each pair in a streak raises your multiplier. Collect the current result after a match or keep flipping to clear the board. A mismatch uses one try, resets the multiplier, and turns the matched cookies face down again.

Start with a 3×3 board and unlock three larger layouts. Earn Reward Tickets through a calendar of seven daily rewards and 12 achievements. Spend tickets on boards or boosts for either mode. Track your balance over time, compare board multipliers, and check your longest streak. Adjust music, sound effects, and vibration separately.

Croookies, tickets, and rewards have no value outside the game and cannot be redeemed.

name: Cornerstone Family Worship
description:
This app will help you stay connected with the day-to-day life of Cornerstone Family Worship. With this app, you can watch or listen to past messages, stay updated with push notifications, read the Bible, and view our calendar.

Mobile app version: 6.24.8

name: CourtHype
description:
Your pickup game deserves a crowd.

CourtHype turns any court into a packed arena. Connect a Bluetooth speaker, press Start, and play. The building does the rest: a crowd that rises and falls, a cheer squad, a coach who never stops yelling, stomp-stomp-clap, drums, organ and a PA announcer.

FULL AUTO
Nobody has to touch the phone. Pick a pace and the arena runs itself.
• Chill: something happening every 15 seconds or so
• Normal: non-stop noise
• Get Loud: one big button for the big moments

ARENA MIX
Six channels, like a sound desk: Crowd, Chant, Squad, Coach, Music and PA. Drag to set a level, tap to mute. Don't want the announcer? Mute the PA.

GAME CLOCK
See how long you have been playing. Pause and reset whenever you like.

YOUR COLORS
Pick your team color and the whole arena lights up in it.

COURTHYPE PRO (one-time purchase)
• Courtside mode: call the game yourself. Made shot, three, block, miss, game winner, defense, cheer squad, coach, drums, organ and buzzer, one pad each.
• Playoffs pace: Game 7 intensity in Full Auto. The building never sits down.
• Get Loud with no waiting (the free version has a 20-second wait between presses).
• Try Courtside and Playoffs free for 5 minutes every day.

No account. No ads. No data collected.

For the best experience, use a loud Bluetooth speaker.

name: Cove Pop: Bubble Shooter
description:
Chapters 1 to 3 (60 levels), the daily pool and endless mode are free for good. Chapters 4 to 15 are free for 14 days, then a one-time purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account.

Cove Pop is a calm bubble shooter in a sunny rock pool, and every level is proven clearable with its own bubbles. Aim, bounce and pop your way through 300 levels along a coast of 15 coves, with a new daily pool every day and an endless mode for a relaxed score chase.

AIM, BOUNCE, POP
• Drag below the conch to aim and lift to fire; bubbles bounce off the rocks at the sides
• Three or more of a color pop, and everything left hanging drops into the pool
• The aim line is drawn by the same code that moves the bubble, so the path you see is the path it takes
• Pebbles, sandy bubbles, crabs to free and jelly bubbles arrive in chapters 2, 4, 6 and 8
• One starfish for meeting a level's goal, two or three for bubbles to spare

FAIR BY DESIGN
• Before a level ships, a solver finds a way to meet its goal with its own bubbles, using only shots a person can aim
• Each level's bubbles come in a fixed order: you always see the next one, and you can swap the two
• If a color leaves the pool, the bubbles you can see in that color change to one still there, so no shot is wasted
• Out of bubbles twice on a level? Watch it solved shows one way through with the same bubbles, then it's your turn
• No lives, no timers, no boosters, no coins and no gems. Nothing is for sale inside a level

DAILY POOL AND ENDLESS
• A new daily pool every day, the same for everyone and proven clearable too
• This week's shells fill in as you clear each day's pool
• Share your result as a line of text that gives nothing away
• Endless is a score chase, not a proven level: two new rows slide in after eight shots without a pop, and there's no clock
• Records keep your levels, starfish, daily pools and best endless score

MADE FOR EVERY PLAYER
• A symbol on every color, so you can tell bubbles apart by shape as well as color
• Large symbols and a high-contrast board, a tap away in Settings
• A long aim line that shows where each shot will land
• A left-handed layout that puts the next bubble on the left
• With Reduce Motion on, pops and drops fade in place
• No clock anywhere, endless mode included
• On iPhone and iPad, with bigger bubbles on the bigger screen
• Dark mode: the same pool by moonlight
• Sounds and haptics you can turn off
• Works offline, and every game is saved as you play

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPad or iPhone, and in your own iCloud or computer backups if you use them.

name: Cowboy Puzzles
description:
Discover the West in a jigsaw puzzle game for adults. Explore 110 original illustrations across ten regions, with rivers, trains, ranches, camps and landscapes to piece together at your own pace.

Each scene offers puzzles with 12, 24, 48, 80 and 120 pieces. Complete five different scenes at one difficulty to unlock the next. Within each scene, follow the challenges in order too. After completing a puzzle, tap Continue to get another eligible scene at random, at the same difficulty.

Earn a sheriff star for each difficulty you complete for the first time. Collect up to 550 stars and seven badges. Replaying the same challenge does not award another star.

Use hints and a reference image. Enjoy the original soundtrack and adjust the volume to suit your moment.

Progress saves automatically with every piece placed. The puzzles work offline, and no account is needed. Progress stays on this device.

Interface available in 18 languages.

Contains banner ads. Advertising and consent options may require an internet connection.

When your hints run out, you can choose to watch an ad to completion for one extra hint, if an ad is available.

Ads may also appear between completed puzzles, with limits on how often they appear.

TryX Studios · ChemistryX Unipessoal, Lda.

name: CP HUB
description:
Sıradaki yarışın hangisi?

İlk 10K yarışın, hayalini kurduğun maraton, dağlarda bir ultra maraton, uzun bir bisiklet yarışı ya da aylarca hazırlandığın bir triatlon... Hedefin ne olursa olsun, spor sezonunun kontrolü artık sende.

CP HUB (Checkpoint Hub), dayanıklılık sporcuları için geliştirilmiş kişiselleştirilebilir bir yarış takvimi, spor planlayıcısı ve kişisel yarış merkezidir.

YENİ YARIŞLAR. YENİ ROTALAR. YENİ HEDEFLER.

Farklı internet sitelerinde yarış tarihleri aramak ve sezon planını ayrı ayrı uygulamalarda tutmak zorunda kalma. Türkiye'deki dayanıklılık sporları organizasyonlarını tek bir uygulamada keşfet.

• Yol koşusu, 5K, 10K, yarı maraton ve maraton
• Patika koşusu ve ultra maraton
• Bisiklet yarışları ve Gran Fondo
• Yüzme yarışları
• Triatlon

Yarış tarihlerini, mesafelerini, lokasyonlarını, katılım koşullarını ve resmi organizasyon bağlantılarını incele. Sana uygun yarışları bul ve bir sonraki maceranı seç.

KENDİ SPOR SEZONUNU TASARLA

Her sporcunun hedefleri ve hazırlık süreci farklıdır. CP HUB'ı kendi spor hayatına göre kişiselleştir.

• Favori yarışlarını kaydet.
• Katılacağın organizasyonları belirle.
• Kendi yarış ve antrenman etkinliklerini ekle.
• Kişisel spor takvimini oluştur.
• Yarış öncesi ekipman kontrol listelerini hazırla.

BÜYÜK GÜNE GERİ SAY

Sezonunun en önemli yarışını ana hedefin olarak belirle. Yarış gününe ne kadar kaldığını anlık olarak takip et.

iPhone ana ekranına ekleyebileceğin CP HUB widget'ı ile hedefin her zaman gözünün önünde olsun.

Çünkü motivasyon bazen sadece kaç gün kaldığını görmekle başlar.

TEMPONU HESAPLA, YARIŞ STRATEJİNİ BELİRLE

Tempo hesaplayıcı ile mesafeni, hedef süreni ve yarış temponu hesapla. İster ilk yarışını tamamlamayı hedefle, ister kişisel rekorunu geliştirmek için hazırlan.

HER BİTİŞ ÇİZGİSİ BİR HİKAYEDİR

Tamamladığın yarışları, derecelerini ve kişisel başarılarını kendi yarış arşivinde sakla. Spor geçmişini tek bir noktadan yönet, gelişimini gör ve yeni hedefler belirle.

EKİPMAN VE SPOR TEKNOLOJİLERİNİ KEŞFET

Spor saatlerinden koşu ayakkabılarına, bisiklet ekipmanlarından spor kulaklıklarına kadar dayanıklılık sporlarına yönelik ürün incelemelerini ve karşılaştırmaları takip et.

NEDEN CP HUB?

• Beş farklı spor branşı, tek uygulama
• Kişiselleştirilebilir yarış ve antrenman takvimi
• Ana hedef geri sayımı ve iPhone widget desteği
• Tempo hesaplayıcı
• Kişisel yarış arşivi
• Ekipman kontrol listeleri
• Ürün ve teknoloji incelemeleri
• Türkçe ve İngilizce dil desteği
• Modern ve kullanıcı dostu tasarım
• Üyelik oluşturmadan kullanım

İster hafta sonları koşan bir sporcu, ister deneyimli bir ultra maratoncu, bisikletçi, yüzücü veya triatlet ol.

CP HUB senin yarışların, senin planların ve senin hedeflerin için var.

Her sporcu bir hedefle başlar.

KEŞFET. PLANLA. YARIŞ.

CP HUB | Checkpoint Hub

name: Craviooo Restaurant
description:
Cravioo Restaurant is designed for restaurant owners and staff to manage food orders and restaurant activities through the Cravioo platform.

The app helps restaurant partners handle incoming orders, manage menu items, and keep track of order progress in one convenient place.

Key Features

Order Management: View and manage incoming customer orders.

Menu Management: Add, edit, and manage food items and prices.

Order Status Updates: Update order progress as orders are prepared.

Restaurant Operations: Organize daily order-related activities.

Easy-to-Use Interface: Access essential restaurant management features conveniently.

Cravioo Restaurant helps restaurant partners manage their orders and streamline daily tasks so they can focus on preparing and serving delicious food.

Use Cravioo Restaurant to manage your restaurant's food orders with ease.

name: Cresnu
description:
Cresnu turns a family's daily routine into something a child can follow on their own.

A grown-up sets up the routines on the web or in the parent area of this app. On this app, a child sees what to do now, what is coming next, and what they have finished — with points that are worked out by the family's account, never by the phone.

WHAT A CHILD CAN DO
• See today's tasks, and start, finish or pass on one
• Send a photo when a task needs one, and hear back when a grown-up has looked
• Follow habits and goals, and collect badges
• Ask for a reward they have saved up for, and change their mind about it
• Read the messages the app has sent them

BUILT FOR FAMILIES
• Made for children under 13. No advertising, no third-party analytics, no tracking.
• A child's space is entered with a PIN on a shared family tablet, or by a grown-up on a phone.
• Signing out, switching child and anything else a parent owns is behind a grown-up check.
• Works without a connection: what a child finishes is saved and sent when the signal comes back.

A Cresnu account is required. A grown-up can create one in the app or on cresnu.com.

name: Crew Activity Dashboard
description:
Crew Activity Dashboard is an independent field and crew operations app built by Christopher DeBouck. It helps crews and supervisors coordinate work on jobsites. Companies and other crews can use it in their own workspace. It is not a consumer marketplace app.

With a workspace-approved account, you can:

• Read and post jobsite or workspace-wide announcements
• Browse and update material inventory, folders, and pick lists
• Track tools, scan tool QR codes, and process tool invoices
• Log inbound truck unloading and track truck trips, including bills of lading
• Submit and review daily reports, including work progress, manpower, delays, and photos (drafts can be saved on the device if you are offline)
• Organize site photos by jobsite and date
• Submit expense reports and receipts
• Use project management tools for work areas, equipment rentals, and manpower
• Upload spreadsheets for AI-assisted operational reports
• Build manpower and equipment quotes
• Submit a call-in when you will be absent or late, and review call-ins if you are a manager
• Receive optional push notifications, such as alerts when a new announcement is posted

You sign in with your account. New registrations stay pending until a workspace administrator approves them, and what you can see depends on your role, department, and assigned jobsite.

Crew Activity Dashboard is operated independently by Christopher DeBouck. For support, email chris.debouck@gmail.com.

name: Crew HQ – Leonida Guide
description:
Crew HQ is a companion app for players who run the new Leonida game with friends. Keep it on your phone next to the TV.

MAP
• Interactive map of Leonida. Mark what you've found; it syncs to your account and the website.
• Draw mode: sketch routes and plans right on the map.

GUIDES THAT ARE CHECKED
• Cheat codes, the 100% checklist, collectibles, missions and vehicles.
• Every entry shows whether it's Verified, Confirmed or Needs check, and when it was last checked.
• Nothing leaked or datamined, no exploits, no mod menus.

TODAY AND THE FEED
• Patch notes, newly confirmed cheats and news from the last 24 hours, each linked to its source.
• New clips, strats and guide entries in one stream.

YOUR CREW
• Crew roster with gamertags, invite links, crew chat and shared map pins.
• Sessions everyone can RSVP to, with one-tap calendar export.
• Strat Builder: numbered points, a route and steps drawn on the map. Keep it private, share a link, or post it.
• Save anything and send it to your crew. It lands in their Inbox.
• Share a clip or link from any app straight into Crew HQ.

MADE FOR IPHONE
• Push notifications for crew chat, sends and session reminders.
• Long-press the app icon to jump straight to the Map, Inbox, your crews or Search.
• Home Screen widget with your crew's next session, and a Lock Screen / Dynamic Island countdown when it's about to start.
• Haptic feedback, pull to refresh, swipe back, and an unread count on the app icon.
• Sign in with Apple.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Report and block on every post, comment and chat message, with a moderation queue reviewed within 24 hours.
• Delete your account any time from Edit profile.

CREW HQ PLUS
• Take a look first without an account: browse the map, guide lists and feed and open a few entries a day as a guest. A Crew HQ Plus subscription (monthly, first month free for new subscribers) unlocks everything. The price and trial are shown in the app before you buy.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ · Privacy: https://gtacrewhq.com/privacy

Crew HQ is an unofficial fan app. It is not made, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. All artwork in the app is original.

name: CrewSpeak: Cabin Crew English
description:
CrewSpeak teaches cabin crew and cabin crew candidates the English that is actually used on board. Not exam drills, but the language you speak every day with passengers, colleagues and the flight deck, from boarding to landing.

Written by a working cabin manager.

ONE SITUATION, THREE TONES
See every situation in Simple, Polite and Formal. Clear, firm phrases are marked separately for safety-related instructions. Learn how to speak to a passenger, a colleague or a senior.

7 MODULES, 350+ PHRASES
• Boarding: welcome, seats, bags, door closure
• Service: drinks and meals, special meals, sales
• Difficult passengers: complaints, rule breaking, calming tension
• Medical situations: unwell passengers, asking for help, crew communication
• Special assistance: wheelchair users, infants and pregnant passengers, blind and deaf passengers, service animals, unaccompanied minors, nervous flyers
• Crew communication: briefings, talking to the flight deck, handovers
• Interview: introducing yourself, motivation, scenario questions

REAL DIALOGUES
Voiced conversations with passengers, colleagues and the captain in every module. Listen line by line, then say it yourself.

LEARN BY LISTENING
Every phrase and dialogue is professionally voiced. Slow it down to 0.75x when you need to.

RECORD AND COMPARE
Say the sentence, compare your voice with the example and improve your pronunciation.

DAILY PRACTICE
Spaced-repetition cards help you remember: first the situation, then the English answer.

WORD GAMES
Three games with 100 aviation words: Match, Quick answer and Spell it. Beat your record and keep your streak going.

PHRASE OF THE DAY
A daily phrase notification turns practice into a habit.

WORKS IN FLIGHT
All content and audio are inside the app. No internet needed.

FREE AND PREMIUM
The full Boarding module, the first section and first dialogue of every other module, practice cards and word games are free. Premium unlocks every module.

Note: CrewSpeak is not affiliated with any airline. All content is general and original. Emergency and medical content is for language practice only and does not replace official training.

Terms of use: https://aimapro.co/crewspeak-terms
Privacy policy: https://aimapro.co/crewspeak-privacy

name: CRM Composer
description:
Never lose track of a customer again.

A customer says "let me think about it." You get busy, and they go somewhere else. CRM Composer keeps every customer in one list, shows you who is waiting on a reply, and reminds you when it is time to check back in.

It is made for people who sell face to face: showrooms, events, trade shows and small teams. If you would rather text a customer than email them, this app is for you.

The sale you lose is the one you forget. Most customers do not decide the first time you talk. They go home, measure the room, ask someone, and wait. The salesperson who checks back in gets the sale. CRM Composer is a list that remembers for you.

What you can do in the app
- Open Today and see who is waiting on a reply and which tasks are due.
- Get a notification the moment a customer replies.
- Open one page for each customer with their texts, calls, emails, notes and sales in the order they happened.
- Search by name, company or phone number, and filter your list.
- Set a follow-up. If you miss one, it reminds you again the next day.
- See your pipeline: who is new, who is thinking it over and who is ready to decide.
- Save the texts you send again and again, with spaces that fill in the customer's first name.
- Text a whole group from an event, one at a time. People who asked you to stop are skipped.
- Line up follow-ups that send themselves, and choose what stops them, like a reply or a sale.
- Connect your email and send from your own address. Every email lands on the customer's page next to the texts.
- Make a form for your website. Each person who fills it in becomes a contact.
- When the same person is in your list twice, see both side by side and join them into one.
- Hold up your phone so a customer can scan your digital business card, save your number and text you their name.

On a phone, the app opens to your texts, customers and tasks. On an iPad, it opens the full CRM with room to see a list and a customer side by side.

Good to know
- For Composer customers: sign in with your Composer account, using your password, a sign-in link or a passkey.
- Texting works through composerSMS. Replies come back into the customer's page.
- You can delete your account at account.retailcomposer.com/delete-account.

CRM Composer is made by Retail Composer LLC.

name: CroatiaStoryAtlas
description:
Otkrijte Hrvatsku kroz male priče, mirise i mjesta koja se ne vide na razglednici. Croatia Story Atlas okuplja odabrane destinacije, tematske rute i kratki dnevni kviz.

OPIS
Hrvatska je više od popisa poznatih pogleda.

Croatia Story Atlas mala je digitalna bilježnica za ljude koji vole putovati sa znatiželjom. Umjesto pretrpanih popisa donosi odabrane priče o gradovima, otocima, nacionalnim parkovima i okusima koji oblikuju svaki kraj.

ŠTO MOŽETE RADITI

• Otkrijte 12 odabranih mjesta od Istre i Dalmacije do Like i Slavonije.
• Istražite tematske rute prema moru, prirodi i lokalnoj kuhinji.
• Pregledajte sve lokacije na razigranoj karti Hrvatske.
• Sačuvajte mjesta koja vas zanimaju u osobni put.
• Provjerite znanje uz kratki dnevni kviz i otkrijte zanimljivost iza svakog odgovora.
• Pratite male oznake i vlastiti napredak.

KAKO JE NAPRAVLJEN

Croatia Story Atlas ima hrvatski kao glavni jezik. Sučelje je mirno, ali živo: ručno oblikovane ilustracije, bogata paleta i nježne animacije vode vas kroz sadržaj bez dodatne buke.

Svi uključeni opisi i mjesta dostupni su odmah, bez internetske veze. Aplikacija ne zahtijeva stvaranje računa.

name: CROPP Field Kit
seller_name: Cooperative Regions of Organic Producer Pools
description:
CROPP Field Kit is for Organic Valley and CROPP Cooperative staff and invited partners. It needs an account set up by CROPP. Without one there is nothing to do in the app.

Use it on farm visits to fill out audits and visit forms:

- Works with no signal. Fill out a form in the barn and it sends when you are back in range.
- Take photos and collect signatures as part of a form.
- Find the farm you are on, nearest first.
- Pick up tasks sent to you and follow up on corrective actions.
- Your work is saved on the device as you go.

name: Crossword City
description:
Every puzzle in Crossword City is shaped like the thing it builds. Solve a house-shaped crossword and a house pops into your town. Solve a skyscraper and watch it rise.

SOLVE
- Hand-shaped crosswords for houses, shops, stadiums, skyscrapers and more
- Clues mix classic crossword words with pop culture, sports, music, art, history and places
- Easy, Medium and Hard, with fresh puzzles every time
- 3 free hints every day

BUILD
- Place, move and rotate everything in a 3D-style town you can spin around
- Lay your own roads, buy land and plan neighborhoods
- Shops, malls, backyard pools, fountains and more
- Undo anything, as far back as you want

GROW
- Climb from Town to City to Metropolis, each with its own buildings
- Keep citizens happy: neighborhoods ask for a grocery store or a park nearby
- Found new towns, connect them with highways, name your capital
- Link three metropolises and found your own country, with your own flag

Free to play with ads. Optional in-app purchases: No Ads, hints, credit packs, the Holiday Pack and the Ultimate Pack.

name: Cubby's Journey
description:
Help Cubby roll home!

Cubby is a little red block who tumbled off a desk and into a world of floating puzzle islands. Roll, flip and stand Cubby up on tile after tile to reach the glowing goal, one clever move at a time.

PUZZLE YOUR WAY WORLD BY WORLD
Travel through four handcrafted worlds, each with its own music and its own tricks:
• The Meadow: glass tiles, toy blocks, sand and buttons
• The Canyon: conveyors, portals, switches and split rings
• The Ice Caves: slippery ice, stone pillars and cold engines
• The Night Sky: twin blocks and every trick at once

More than 75 story levels start gentle and grow into real brain-teasers. Solve a level in par moves to earn its star.

A LITTLE CUBE, A LONG WAY HOME
Short animated scenes tell Cubby's story as you travel from world to world. Cubby smiles, wobbles nervously near an edge and cheers when you win.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
The Daily Challenge brings a fresh board every day. Solve it in as few moves as you can and see how you compare on the Game Center leaderboard.

ENDLESS PUZZLES, YOUR DIFFICULTY
Endless mode builds new puzzles on the fly. Pick the world, the difficulty and the pieces you want, and keep rolling.

BUILD YOUR OWN LEVELS
Design your own boards with the map creator, test them, and share them with other players. Play and rate levels made by the community in Custom Creations. Every shared level is checked before it appears.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS IN GAME CENTER
Earn Game Center achievements as you master each world and its tricks.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Easy to learn, with plenty of depth for puzzle fans
• Undo and restart any time, and no timers in the story
• Plays offline
• Built for iPhone and iPad

Cubby's Journey is made by Morell Creations. We'd love to hear from you: feedback@morellcreations.com

name: Cube Builder – 3D Puzzle
description:
Fill the cube! A cube of 9 × 9 × 9 cells floats in front of the starry sky – empty, drawn only as a grid. You get three to nine metallic pieces that fit exactly, each with at least one bend. Rotate them around the X, Y and Z axes, tap an empty spot, and the piece snaps into place. Once the last piece is in, the finished cube spins freely in space.

Cube Builder is a calm 3D puzzle for kids and grown-ups: no timer, no pressure, just you and the cube. It playfully trains spatial reasoning and combinatorial thinking – rotating shapes in your head, spotting gaps, planning the order.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag to rotate the cube in any direction, pinch to zoom. Grid lines are white at the front and grey at the back, so you can see the depth.
• Select a piece and rotate it by 90 degrees with X, Y and Z. The preview shows the orientation exactly as the piece would sit in the cube.
• Tap an empty spot: the app finds the fitting position with the most contact faces. If it doesn't fit, it tells you.
• Tap a placed piece to take it out again.

HELP WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
• After every placement the app checks whether the rest can still be completed. If not, it warns you at once – take a piece out and try another position.
• The “Solution” button lets all pieces fly to their places. For learning, without scoring – then the level restarts.
• The built-in manual explains everything step by step.

500 LEVELS, 7 TIERS
• Levels 1–72 have three pieces; every band of 72 levels adds one more – up to nine pieces in the final levels.
• Every level is guaranteed solvable, and no piece is a plain box.
• Restart a level any time, pick levels freely and solve them at your own pace.

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Five languages: German, English, French, Italian, Spanish – switchable in the app at any time.
• Metallic pieces with reflections, a starry sky with the Milky Way that rotates with the cube.
• Fully offline. No ads, no account, no data collection.

BUY ONCE, PLAY FOREVER
25 free plays are included, freely chosen from levels 1–216. Unlock all 500 levels with one single purchase – no subscription, no extra purchases, Family Sharing included.

name: Curb - Skate
description:
Land it or eat it. Curb is the plaza where the attempt is the post. A photo splits into the part that worked and the part that did not, and other riders answer on that phase, not with a generic like. The trickbook is an index of what people are actually trying, matched to the riders still on it.

Build a line when the session has a shape. Leave it on your deck. Most tries are open to read. A few notes with the full breakdown take coins, once, for that account. Safety actions are labeled on the try and on the rider, up front, with icons you can name.

name: CurlS
description: CurlS turns your curl styling routine into steps you can repeat. Record what you used and what you changed, then check how your curls look and feel once fully dry and on Day 1. Try one adjustment, review both sessions side by side, and keep a version you want to repeat. Discover techniques in the Lookbook and share an English routine checklist as a PDF or text.

name: Custody Logs: Sealed Days
description:
When you're co-parenting through a dispute, everyone tells you to document everything. Then the notes sit in an app where anything can be edited, and the screenshots sink into your camera roll.

Sealed Days is a private custody journal built for that job. Writing an entry takes about 30 seconds with one hand. The moment you save it, the entry is fingerprinted with SHA-256, linked to the entry before it and time-stamped by an independent RFC 3161 authority. Of your entry, only the fingerprint leaves your phone. From then on, any later change to that entry is detectable, and the date it was written can be checked by anyone.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Log custody exchanges, missed visits, messages and how your child is doing, with photos, video, voice memos and files
• Keep parenting time and every handoff in one custody log
• Add the people involved, a category and, if you choose, your location
• Correct an entry with an amendment while the original stays untouched
• Verify the whole chain on your phone whenever you like
• Export one clear PDF for your attorney, or a full evidence package with the original files and signed timestamps
• Lock the app with its own passcode and Face ID
• Save an encrypted backup file to your own iCloud Drive

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account and no sign-in. There are no ads and no tracking. Your entries are stored on your phone and go nowhere unless you export them. The app counts anonymous usage events, which you can switch off in Settings.

HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT IS
Sealed Days helps you keep a record. It isn't a law firm and doesn't give legal advice. A seal shows when an entry was written and that it hasn't changed since. It can't show that what was written is true, and each court decides what it accepts.

SUBSCRIPTION
Sealed Days Plus is $17.99 a month or $179.99 a year, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. If you stop subscribing, everything you've sealed stays readable and you can still verify and export it.

Terms: https://sealeddays.pages.dev/terms
Privacy: https://sealeddays.pages.dev/privacy

name: Custody Schedule Builder
description:
Custody Schedule Builder keeps your parenting time in one place: who has the kids tonight, when the next handoff is, and how the year adds up.

CALENDAR
- Color-coded monthly custody calendar for Parent A and Parent B
- Built-in patterns: 2-2-3, 2-2-5-5, 7-7, 3-4-4-3, Every Other Weekend and the Texas Standard Possession Order weekends
- Holiday rotation for Spring Break, July 4, Thanksgiving and Winter Break, alternating each year
- Sync the exact schedule you built on custodyschedulebuilder.com with a sync code
- Next handoff card with a live countdown, time, place and direction, plus an optional reminder an hour before

OVERNIGHTS
- Annual overnight totals and percentage split for each parent
- Monthly breakdown and total exchanges for the year
- Record a swapped or missed night and see actual against scheduled
- Export the year as an .ics file for Apple, Google or Outlook Calendar, or share a read-only link

EVIDENCE BINDER
- Chronological log of missed exchanges, late pickups, schedule changes and notes, with photo attachments
- Every entry is stamped in UTC and sealed with a SHA-256 hash chained to the entry before it, so you can show it is unchanged since it was logged in the app
- Entries cannot be edited or deleted after saving
- Court-ready chronological exports: a PDF binder with exhibit IDs, timestamps, attachments and a hash verification appendix

EXPENSES
- Log shared child costs: medical, school, childcare, activities and clothing
- 50/50, 60/40 or custom splits, receipt photos, and a pending or reimbursed status for each item
- Monthly totals and a running balance between parents. Tracking only: the app never sends, holds or requests money.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Everything you enter stays on your phone. No account is needed. Nothing leaves the device unless you export or share it, or enter a sync code.

Informational scheduling and chronological recordkeeping tool. Not legal advice. Calendar output follows the schedule you enter; check your order with your court or an attorney.

name: Cutroom: Handpan Audio
description:
Cutroom was developed specifically to clean up handpan recordings. It helps reduce room noise, low rumble, and muddy bass while preserving the overtones that keep ringing after each strike.

Choose a video from your iPhone photo library. Once the cleaned audio is ready, switch between Original and Cleaned to hear the difference at the same point in your performance. Cutroom processes the audio on your iPhone.

Open Advanced to adjust noise reduction, protect ringing notes, set the output level, or add a touch of hall reverb. When you're happy with the sound, crop the frame if you like and export your performance as an MP4 or MOV video, or save just the audio as M4A.

name: Cycle by hicya
description:
Cycle by hicya is a private period tracker. Press "Period started" when your period begins, log how you feel, and see when your next period is likely, as a range of days from your own history.

Good apps, for good. Free, always. No ads. Made by a nonprofit.

Private by design:
• Everything you log stays on your phone. There is no account and no sign-in
• hicya runs no server for Cycle and holds none of your data
• Your phone's own backup (iCloud or Android backup) carries it to a new phone, or export a file and import it
• Optional lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your fingerprint
• Delete everything at any time from Settings

Simple every day:
• A ring shows your cycle day, period days and the days your next period is likely
• Log flow, how your body feels, your mood and a note for any day
• A calendar of past periods and logged days; tap any day to log it
• History with your average cycle and period length

Calm reminders, only if you want them:
• A reminder a day or two before your period is likely, and a daily reminder to log
• You write the reminder text; it never says "period" unless you do

Right where you are:
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Period started" and "Log today"
• Optional: save the flow you log to Apple Health

Predictions are estimates from your own logs. Cycle is not for birth control or getting pregnant, and it has no fertile window or ovulation features.

Light, Dark and AMOLED themes and Dynamic Type support.

name: Dabblings: Pixel Color Shooter
description:
Meet the Dabblings — round little paint critters with big eyes and a belly full of colour. Tap one and it hops onto the conveyor that loops around a pixel picture, flicking paint pellets at every pixel of its colour it can see. Pop! Pop! Pop! Clear the last pixel and the finished painting is revealed and hung in your own Gallery.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap the Dabbling at the front of a lane to send it onto the belt.
• On its lap it shoots the first pixel in each row and column — but only if that pixel is its colour.
• The number on its belly is its paint: one drop per pixel.
• Out of paint? It hops off happily. Paint left? It waits in the dock — tap it later to go round again.
• Don't let the dock overflow! Plan the order of your lanes and pop every pixel to finish the picture.

FEATURES
• 220 levels across eleven studio rooms — 112 hand-made pixel pictures (fruit, animals, toys, landscapes…) and colourful patterns. Every level is checked winnable by our solver.
• A Hard level every ten stages for a real challenge and bonus coins.
• New twists as you go: mystery Dabblings in a sack, shiny glazed pixels that need two hits, frozen lanes that thaw as you paint, and Dabblings that hold hands.
• Paint Bomb and Shuffle power-ups when you are stuck.
• Gallery — collect every finished painting and admire them full screen.
• Daily Canvas — a fresh picture every day with a streak to keep.
• Six studio looks to unlock: Dusk Studio, Mint Atelier, Night Gallery, Sunset Loft, Seaside Easel and Blossom Room.
• Juicy pops, paint splashes, a cheerful marimba soundtrack and haptics (all can be switched off).
• Colour-blind friendly: optional symbols on every colour.
• No timers, no energy. Plays offline; progress saves automatically.
• 14 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Indonesian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) and Vietnamese.

Dabblings is free to play with optional ads. Watching an ad is always your choice (continue, power-ups, double rewards). A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase turns off banners and interstitials.

name: Daily Goal Tracker - Goalsplit
description:
Goal Split turns big goals into small daily steps you log with a single tap. Drink 2 liters of water, read 20 pages, do 50 push-ups or stay under 2 coffees: set a daily or weekly target, then tap as you go.

No account, no setup. Your progress stays on your device.

FOUR WAYS TO TRACK
• Counter: tap to add a glass, a set or a page, in any unit you choose
• Timer: countdown or stopwatch sessions for focus, meditation, practice or study
• Checkmark: a simple done or not done for the day
• Checklist: multi-step routines such as a morning or bedtime routine

BUILD UP OR CUT DOWN
Every habit is one of three types:
• Good: something to do more of, with a goal to reach
• Limit: something to reduce, like cigarettes, coffee or phone checks, with a cap to stay under
• Neutral: just count it, no judgment

LOG WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
• Interactive Home Screen widgets: tap to log a habit directly from the widget
• Lock Screen widgets and Control Center controls
• Action button and Siri Shortcuts support
• Timer Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Day streaks and today's completion at a glance
• Daily completion charts and trends
• Calendar history for every habit

STAY MOTIVATED
• Reminders in the morning, afternoon, evening or at your own times
• A new motivational quote every day, also available as a widget
• Earn coins by completing goals and claiming daily rewards, then use them to unlock avatars and colour themes

80+ READY-MADE HABITS
Water, sleep, vitamins, medication, workouts, steps, cycling, meditation, gratitude, journaling, reading, new words, deep work, emails, chores, pet care, money saved, screen time and many more. A short setup suggests a starting set based on your answers, and you can change it any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your habits, history and profile are stored on your device. Export a JSON backup or a CSV file whenever you like.

GOAL SPLIT PRO
• Create fully custom habits and edit any preset
• Detailed stats for each habit
• Log or edit past days
• Reminders for every habit
• All avatars and colour themes
• No ads

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Goal Split Pro is available as an auto-renewing weekly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Plans, prices and any free trial are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://karthikraja-apps.blogspot.com
Website : https://karthikrajaapps.blogspot.com

name: Daily Inquiry: Self-Reflection
description:
The app is in Finnish.

One question a day. Nothing else.

Daily Inquiry gives you one carefully chosen question each day about self-worth, relationships, work and the deeper layers of life. Read it slowly, notice what moves in you and write a few words. Then let the question travel with you through the day.

THEN AND NOW
Questions come back. When you answer the same question again weeks or months later, Then and now puts your answers side by side so you can see what has changed and what has stayed.

YOUR WHEEL OF LIFE
Choose the areas your questions come from: Self at the centre, and Health, Growth, Family and friends, Love, Work, Money, Home and Leisure around it. 365 questions in all.

QUIET BY DESIGN
• The question fades in slowly on a calm, coloured page
• A gentle daily reminder at a random time between 9 am and 9 pm, with the day's question in the notification
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widget
• Your answers stay on your phone. No account, no ads, no tracking
• Backup file you can save and restore

FREE AND PRO
Free: the daily question from the Self area (45 questions), all your answers and Then and now.
Pro: all 8 life areas (365 questions), the changing question deck, the roulette and your own questions. Try Pro free for 7 days without a payment card, then choose a yearly subscription or a one-time purchase.

Daily Inquiry is a tool for self-reflection, not therapy or a medical device.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Daily Walk: Bible & Devotion
description:
Daily Walk is a quiet, private companion for your walk with God. Read the Bible, plan your devotions, write down what you hear on Sunday, and keep track of church events — all on your phone, all offline.

READ THE BIBLE ANYWHERE
• The complete World English Bible, built in — no internet needed
• Bookmark and highlight the verses that speak to you
• Search across the Bible and your own notes

DAILY DEVOTIONS
• Plan one or more devotion sessions each day
• Set up routines for your regular quiet time
• Write reflections and prayer points for each passage
• Alarms that ring at your devotion time and keep reminding you until you finish

SERMON & STUDY NOTES
• Capture Sunday service, sermon and Bible study notes
• Save the key verse, outline, lessons and prayer points
• Come back to them anytime

CHURCH EVENTS
• Keep a personal list of church events with dates, venues and links
• Get a reminder before each event starts

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Everything you write stays on your device
• Erase all your data anytime from Settings

Daily Walk is free. Start your day in the Word.

name: Daoxin: Idle Cultivation RPG
description:
Daoxin is an idle cultivation RPG in a hand-painted xianxia world. You start as a young sword cultivator at Qi Refining and climb ten realms toward immortality, one tap and one breakthrough at a time.

HOW IT PLAYS
Tap the demon beasts to strike them and gather tu vi. Spend it to cultivate your own strength and to train disciples, who fight beside you and keep fighting while you are away. Every fifteenth stage a Tribulation boss waits: beat it before the clock runs out to enter the next realm.

WHAT IS IN THE GAME
• Ten realms, from Qi Refining to Immortal Emperor, each with its own beasts and its own Tribulation boss.
• Thirty disciples to recruit: sword cultivators, archers, talisman casters and spirit beasts such as the fire qilin, the nine-tailed fox and the ancestral dragon. Each one breaks through at level milestones.
• Four techniques: Sword Rain, Thunder Seal, Golden Body and Spirit Vortex.
• Rebirth: start a new life with Dao Heart that makes every blow stronger for good. Realm bottlenecks open only to those with enough Dao Heart.
• Twenty treasures to obtain and refine with Dao Heart.
• Seclusion: your disciples gather tu vi while the game is closed.
• Cloud save with Sign in with Apple, so your cultivation follows you to a new phone.

FAIR TO PLAY
Every disciple, realm and treasure can be reached without paying. Rewarded ads are only ever watched when you choose to. Purchases buy time and convenience, never a realm: there are no loot boxes.

Nine languages: English, Tiếng Việt, Deutsch, Español, Français, 日本語, 한국어, Português, 中文.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://legal.lookbookai.app/daoxin/privacy.html

name: DateSpan Day Counter
description: DateSpan Day Counter shows calendar days and non-weekend days between two dates. Choose whether to include the end date, then save the range on your iPhone. Weekend rules follow your system calendar. Public holidays are included.

name: Dawcade Canvas
description:
Dawcade Canvas turns painting into music. Every brush is an instrument, every colour is a voice, and a light runs along each mark you make and plays it. Lines become melodies, shapes become rhythms, and a whole painting becomes a song you can hear grow as you paint.

PAINT
• Watercolor, ink, charcoal, chalk, oil, neon, spray and more, each with its own sound
• Synth brushes (Wave, Saw, FM, Analog, Morph, Spectral, Organ, Pad) plus Bow, Breath, Pluck, Chip, Bass and Kit
• Long-press any colour to choose its instrument from the sound rack
• Shapes, layers, selection and combine tools
• Turn a photo into a playing canvas

OBJECTS THAT PLAY
• Drops fall and play the marks they hit; Radar sweeps; Orbit circles; a Creature walks your lines
• Harp, Chimes, Seed and Band bring their own voices
• Prism, Portal, Mirror, Echo, Gate, Wind and Magnet bend and route the music
• Glass, crystal, chrome, brass, wood and more materials
• Tilt the iPad and the drops follow gravity

LIGHT THAT LISTENS
• Beam, Sand, Meter, Scope, Vine, Gem and React respond to the music in real time

SOUND
• Adjustments are visual and audio effects in one: blur becomes reverb, halo, swirl, echo trail and more
• 53 Dawcade engine effects
• Keys, scales and maqams, circle of fifths key wheel
• Perform mode: play marks with your finger

SHARE
• Export a time-lapse video of your painting with its song
• Templates and paint-along lessons to start in seconds

Free to try for 7 days. After that, one purchase unlocks everything for good. No subscription, no accounts, no ads, no tracking.

name: Dayloom
description:
Dayloom Lite 是专为 Apple TV 打造的家庭氛围信息台，将天气、时间、每日问候和家庭留言融入舒适的客厅画面。

你可以查看当前温度、日出日落与月相信息，切换多种动态氛围场景，并为家人留下提醒或问候。

• 当地天气与高低温
• 日出日落及月相信息
• 每日问候与家庭留言
• 动态场景与屏幕常亮设置

无需注册账号。家庭留言与显示偏好仅保存在当前 Apple TV，让客厅屏幕简单、实用又有温度。

name: DayPath: Daily Planner
description:
DayPath is a calm, offline-first daily planner built in monochrome Liquid Glass for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch — with no subscriptions, no accounts, and no clutter.

Your Day as a Timeline (iPhone & iPad)
- See your day at a glance with clear time slots, durations, and free-time gaps.
- Swipe left or right across days and jump via the week strip.
- Add tasks, subtasks, icons, repeating schedules, or all-day reminders.
- Optionally sync your Apple Calendar events alongside your DayPath tasks — and optionally write scheduled tasks back to a calendar you pick.

To-Do Lists That Flow Into Your Day
- Organize custom icon lists (To Do, Grocery, Work, Weekend, or anything you want).
- Pull down inside any list to add a new item right at the top.
- Schedule any to-do directly onto a day's timeline when you're ready to do it.

Open-Notebook Spread on iPad
- Designed from the ground up for iPad: your lists sit on the left page with spiral-bound depth and quick section tabs, facing today's timeline on the right.
- Drag any to-do across the spiral spine straight onto your timeline to schedule it.

Apple Watch Companion
- A clean, view-only reflection of your iPhone's day view and lists on your wrist.
- See what's on now, what's up next, and browse your lists anytime.
- Receive mirrored task-start notifications in a custom glass look.

Private & Pay-Once
