- All tasks, lists, and settings live privately on your device (synced directly between your iPhone and paired Apple Watch).
- Pay $4.99 once. No ads, no tracking, no subscriptions.

name: DayStar Mennonite Conference
description:
We Are DayStar Mennonite Conference

A community devoted to sharing the light of Christ through sound teaching and faithful living. We seek to guide hearts toward truth, nurture spiritual growth, and encourage obedience to God’s Word in every aspect of life. Through our messages and resources, we aim to inspire a steadfast walk of faith and devotion to Jesus Christ.

Discover easy access to valuable resources from DayStar Mennonite Conference. Explore sermons, an interactive map of church locations, our events calendar, and contact information, all designed to keep you connected. With real-time push notifications, you’ll stay inspired and always up-to-date.

name: DBB MEBİS
description:
Diyarbakır Büyükşehir Belediyesi Mezarlık Bilgi Sistemi.

Diyarbakır’daki mezarlıkları haritada görün. Ad veya soyad yazarak mezar arayın, mezarın yerini haritada açın ve yol tarifini alın.

Arama, harita ve mezar kartı aynı ekranda durur.

name: Deadstorey: Zombie Shelter
description:
The dead own the streets. You own a fenced yard, four tired survivors and a plan.

Deadstorey is a survival strategy game where you are the commander, not the soldier. Pick a team, send them to a building and watch them search, fight and come home - or not. Back at the shelter you decide what to build, who rests, who heals and who goes out again tomorrow.

EXPLORE A TOWN THAT FIGHTS BACK
- Sixteen districts full of houses, shops, clinics and gun stores to search
- Noise draws the dead: loud teams find more trouble
- Nests spawn hordes until you burn them out
- Weather, darkness and fatigue change every trip

BUILD A SHELTER WORTH DEFENDING
- Gardens, kitchens, infirmary, workshop, watchtower and more
- Barricades and night defence against growing hordes
- Food spoils, ammo runs out, people get hurt and tired

LEAD PEOPLE, NOT UNITS
- Every survivor has traits, skills and a specialisation
- Morning reports, hard choices and a community leader
- Allies, special operations and a way out of town

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Short sessions, the game saves itself
- Several start scenarios and bonuses to unlock with Insignia
- World and national leaderboards
- Back up your progress and continue on a new phone

The game is free to play. It shows optional reward videos and an occasional ad between runs, and offers optional purchases (No ads, Commander pack, Gold).

name: Deals Tracker: Switch
description:
Deals Tracker is a Nintendo eShop price tracker that shows every Nintendo Switch sale in your own currency, with price-drop alerts for the games you want.

Still reading? Here is what it does:

- All Nintendo Switch deals
Every game on sale in the Nintendo eShop, sorted by discount, price, end date, release or popularity. Switch and Switch 2 games, bundles and add-ons.

- Prices in your currency
See what a game really costs you in euros or any other currency: at your gift card rate, by bank card with your bank's fee, or compared with a download code.

- Price-drop alerts (Pro)
Add games to your wishlist and get a notification when they go on sale or drop below your target price.

- Price history (Pro)
A chart of every price change, so you can tell a real low from a usual sale.

- Find any game
Search the whole catalogue, with English titles for every game.

- Game pages
Screenshots, videos, description, release date and a direct link to the eShop.

- Wallet helper
Which gift cards to buy to cover a price with the least left over.

- Wishlist and library
Keep track of the games you want and the ones you already own.

- iPhone and Mac
One app for both, with your settings in sync.

-------

Deals Tracker Pro
One-time purchase, no subscription. Unlocks price-drop alerts and price history. Shared with your Family Sharing group.

No ads. No tracking. No affiliate links.

-------

Deals Tracker is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Nintendo. Nintendo, Nintendo Switch and Nintendo eShop are trademarks of Nintendo. Prices come from public sources and may differ from the store.

Privacy Policy: https://dealstracker-app.pages.dev/privacy

name: Deck Of Flavors Team
description:
Deck Of Flavors Team is the private work app for the staff and managers of Deck Of Flavors café in Winthrop Harbor, Illinois.

With it, our team can:
• See shift schedules and request time off or swaps
• Work through daily tasks and opening and closing checklists
• Keep the flavor board up to date, with a full change history
• Count inventory, log deliveries and record waste
• Read team announcements and messages
• Find training guides and café information

Sign-in uses your work email and a personal PIN, with Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices. Your account is created by the café; this app is only for Deck Of Flavors employees.

Questions or help: apps@deckofflavors.cafe

Designed and built by NerdArc.

name: Deen 365: Quran, Namaz, Duas
description:
Deen 365 is your all-in-one digital Islamic companion designed to enrich your daily spiritual journey with ease, elegance, and peace of mind. Completely ad-free, lightweight, and built with privacy in mind, Deen 365 works seamlessly offline so you can connect with your faith wherever you are.

KEY FEATURES:

THE HOLY QURAN (OFFLINE & BEAUTIFUL)
• Read the complete Quran with clear, authentic Arabic typography (Uthmani script).
• Verified translations in English and Urdu.
• Instant global search across Surahs and Ayahs with diacritic normalization.
• Bookmark your favorite verses and pick up right where you left off.

ACCURATE PRAYER TIMES & ADHAN ALERTS
• Precise Namaz timings calculated for your exact location (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha).
• Customizable prayer notifications with authentic Adhan audio or gentle chimes.
• Automatic countdown to the next prayer.

RECISION QIBLA COMPASS
• Instant, real-time magnetic compass pointing accurately toward the Holy Kaaba in Makkah.
• Calibration assistance and haptic feedback for pinpoint direction.

AUTHENTIC DUAS & AZKAR
• Curated collection of essential daily supplications from Hisnul Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim).
• Morning and evening Azkar, prayers for protection, forgiveness, health, and family.
• Arabic text with phonetic transliterations and clear translations.
• Add, manage, and customize your own personal Duas.

DIGITAL TASBEEH COUNTER
• Smooth, tactile digital counter with customizable vibration and haptic feedback.
• Preset daily Dhikr routines (SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, Astaghfirullah).
• Automatic cycle tracking, lap counts, and instant reset.

THE SIX KALMAS
• Complete Six Kalmas of Islam with Arabic text, Urdu, and English translations.
• Easy-to-read reference designed for learners of all ages.

100% PRIVACY FOCUSED & AD-FREE
• No intrusive ads, popups, or tracking.
• Location data is strictly used on-device to calculate prayer times and compass direction.
• No account registration or login required—everything is ready immediately.

Whether you are at home, traveling, or seeking daily remembrance, Deen 365 keeps you connected with your Deen 365 days a year.

name: Deercamp: Hunting Forecast
description:
Deercamp tells you which stand to hunt, and when.

Pick your stands on the map and Deercamp gives every one a Sit Score from 1 to 10 for every morning and evening this week. It weighs the wind against each stand's good wind directions, rising and falling pressure, temperature swings, rain, the rut and season dates for your state or province, and how hard you've been hunting that stand.

KNOW YOUR WIND BEFORE YOU WALK IN
• Hour-by-hour wind and temperature for the whole day
• Thermals: see when air is drifting downhill or rising off the terrain at your stand
• Sunrise, sunset and legal shooting light, drawn as a simple timeline

PLAN EVERY SIT
• Sit Score for every stand, 7 days out
• Alerts the night before a great sit
• Hunt log with conditions saved automatically, so you learn what works
• Live hunting session with a Lock Screen Live Activity

BLOOD TRAIL HELPER
• Log the shot, follow the recommended wait time and get an alert when it's time to track
• Mark blood as you track so you can see where the trail is heading

PUBLIC LAND
• U.S. public land and Canadian protected areas on the map
• Tap any spot to see who manages the land

HUNT AS A CREW
• Shared stands so nobody walks in on a buddy
• Sign out a stand for the morning or evening
• Check out and back in, and the crew is alerted if someone is overdue
• Crew feed for sightings, harvests and "need tracking help"

SHARE YOUR HARVEST
• Save harvest photos with the conditions you killed it in
• Make a clean share card for your crew or social

Works for whitetail, mule deer, elk, turkey and more, across U.S. states and Canadian provinces, with imperial or metric units.

DEERCAMP PRO
Sit Scores beyond today, night-before alerts, public land maps and creating a crew are part of Deercamp Pro:
• Yearly: $39.99 per year with a 3-day free trial
• Weekly: $9.99 per week
Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase (or when the free trial ends). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://deercampai.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://deercampai.com/privacy

Sit Scores, forecasts and legal light times are estimates. Always follow your local hunting regulations.

name: DefinedCare
description:
DefinedCare helps you build skincare and haircare routines around what is actually in your products, not marketing claims.

Instead of relying on subjective reviews, every product page shows its key ingredients and explains what they are generally used for and how a formula tends to feel in use. You stay in control: the app suggests, and you decide.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Explore a catalogue of skincare and haircare products, each broken down by ingredients
• Read plain-language formula tags and "What to expect" notes that explain, with caution, what the ingredients are likely to do
• Build a routine based on ingredients and your own preferences
• Filter by what you want to avoid, so you can focus on products that suit you
• Compare products by their ingredients to find similar options
• Track your skin progress over time and keep your own notes and ratings on products
• Save products to your basket to keep your shortlist together

HOW IT WORKS

DefinedCare uses consistent, rule-based logic rather than opinions. The same ingredients and the same rules give the same result every time, so you can see why a product is suggested.

YOUR ACCOUNT AND YOUR DATA

Create a free account with your email address to save your routines, notes and progress. You can delete your account and your data at any time in Settings. Our privacy policy is at definedcare.co.uk/privacy.html.

IMPORTANT

DefinedCare provides general information about cosmetic ingredients. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose or treat any condition. If you have a skin or scalp condition or allergies, or you are pregnant or breastfeeding, speak to a doctor, pharmacist or other qualified professional before changing your routine. Always patch test new products. You must be 16 or over to create an account.

DefinedCare is operated by SJS Innovations Ltd. Questions or feedback: sjsinnovationsltd@gmail.com

name: Defyne: Gym & Workout Tracker
description:
Defyne is de gym-app die van trainen een game maakt. Log elke set, word sterker met automatische progressive overload en klim in rank voor elke spiergroep en oefening.

WAT JE KRIJGT

• Slimme workout-tracking: log sets, kilo's en herhalingen in seconden. Met rusttimer, notities en je vorige prestaties altijd in beeld.
• Persoonlijk trainingsschema: op basis van je doel, ervaring, beschikbare dagen en materiaal. Voor de sportschool, thuis of calisthenics.
• Automatische progressive overload: Defyne rekent uit welk gewicht je de volgende keer pakt, zodat je blijft groeien.
• Ranks voor 700+ oefeningen: zie per spiergroep en per oefening hoe sterk je bent en waar je achterblijft.
• Streaks: blijf consistent met een trainingsreeks waarin ook je rustdagen meetellen.
• Voortgang en statistieken: grafieken per oefening, persoonlijke records en je geschatte 1RM.
• Techniek bij elke oefening: duidelijke uitleg en beelden voor de juiste uitvoering.
• Sociale feed: volg vrienden, geef respect, reageer en vergelijk je ranks.
• AI-trainingen: vertel je doel en krijg direct een training op maat.

DEFYNE PRO
Met Defyne Pro ontgrendel je onbeperkte schema's, AI-trainingen, automatische progressive overload en de slimme coach. Probeer het jaarabonnement 7 dagen gratis.

Abonnementen worden automatisch verlengd, tenzij je ten minste 24 uur voor het einde van de periode opzegt via je Apple ID-instellingen. De betaling wordt bij bevestiging van de aankoop via je Apple ID afgeschreven.

Gebruiksvoorwaarden: https://defyneapp.com/voorwaarden
Privacybeleid: https://defyneapp.com/privacy

name: DescargaTV
description:
La Descarga TV en vivo, directo en tu iPhone.

La aplicación oficial del canal La Descarga TV: abre la app y la señal en vivo comienza sola. Disfruta la programación del canal durante todo el día: programas de la mañana, noticias, deportes, películas y contenido dominicano.

Incluye:
• Señal en vivo del canal las 24 horas
• Pantalla completa y modo PiP (sigue viendo mientras usas otras apps)
• Notificaciones cuando tus programas están en vivo
• Avisos de ofertas y servicios (tú decides si los recibes)

Programas: La Mañana con Dary, Eco de la Mañana, Conexión al Día, Conexión Deportiva y Comentando la Actualidad.

La Descarga TV — la señal que te acompaña.

name: Descripted - AI Video Editor
description:
Descripted turns your video into text you can edit. Delete a word, an "um" or a long pause, and the video is cut with it. Then let AI find your best moments, frame them for Shorts, Reels and TikTok, and caption them, right on your iPhone or iPad.

EDIT VIDEO LIKE A DOC
• Fast, accurate transcripts with every word timed to the video.
• Tap a word to jump there; select and cut, restore, or move whole sentences.
• Remove filler words and shorten long pauses in one tap.
• AI finds retakes and false starts so only your best take stays.
• Fix a misheard word without touching the audio.
• Full undo and redo.

TURN ONE EPISODE INTO TEN CLIPS
• AI reads the whole episode and picks the moments people share.
• Every clip gets a score, the reason behind it, a hook title and hashtags.
• Ask for moments about a topic, and choose the length and how many.
• Clips are framed vertical around the speaker, with captions and a hook card ready to post.

CAPTIONS THAT GET WATCHED
• Six animated styles: Karaoke, Highlight, Pop, Box, Minimal and Neon.
• AI picks the key words to highlight and adds a fitting emoji.
• Translate captions into other languages; the timing still follows your voice.
• Export SRT, VTT or a plain transcript.

RECORD WITH A TELEPROMPTER
• Your script scrolls right over the camera.
• Voice follow scrolls as you speak and waits when you pause.
• Mirror mode for beam-splitter rigs and Bluetooth clicker support.
• AI writes or rewrites your script from a topic.

LOOK AND SOUND PRO
• Studio Sound removes room noise and hum and evens out your levels.
• Remove the background behind you, no green screen needed.
• 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9, with Fill or Fit and blurred or picture backgrounds.
• Background music that dips automatically when you speak.
• Audio-only podcasts become audiogram videos with captions.
• Thumbnail maker for YouTube and Shorts.

AI THAT DOES THE BORING PARTS
• Copilot: type "remove the ums and make it vertical with captions" and it's done.
• Write titles, YouTube descriptions, show notes, chapters, social posts, summaries and blog posts from your recording.

Export MP4 up to 4K, M4A audio, subtitles and transcripts. No account needed. Works on iPhone and iPad, with keyboard shortcuts on iPad.

name: Deulleum: Photo Trip Map
description:
Fill a map of Korea with the photos already on your phone.

Deulleum reads the location and date of your photos on your device, fills each city, county and district you have visited with your own picture, and groups your photos into trips.

Map
- Every district fills in with your photo
- See progress by province and what is still left to visit
- Keep a cover photo, a note, visit dates and a color label for each place

Trips
- Photos from days away from home become a trip automatically
- See each day's route and stops on a timeline
- Add a short note to any stop

Summary card
- Turn a trip into one card to share or save to Photos

Your photos stay yours
- Photos are read on your device. Only location and date are used, and nothing is sent to a server
- Small copies sync through your own iCloud
- No account, no ads, no tracking

Pro (one-time purchase)
- Unlimited trips, 20 photos per place, world map, more card layouts, editable labels

On the road, use Waykit for directions and planning.

name: Dhakarni
description:
Dhakarni – Toutes vos garanties, au même endroit.

Avez-vous déjà perdu une facture, oublié la date de fin d'une garantie ou cherché une preuve d'achat au moment où vous en aviez besoin ?

Dhakarni vous aide à centraliser et organiser vos garanties, vos preuves d'achat et vos documents importants, directement depuis votre smartphone.

QU'EST-CE QUE DHAKARNI ?

Dhakarni est une application mobile conçue pour simplifier la gestion de vos garanties et de vos produits.

Ajoutez vos appareils et vos produits, gardez leurs factures et leurs documents de garantie au même endroit, et recevez des rappels avant l'expiration de vos garanties.

Fini les recherches dans vos e-mails, vos dossiers ou vos photos pour retrouver une preuve d'achat : vos informations importantes restent accessibles depuis l'application.

GÉREZ VOS GARANTIES FACILEMENT

Avec Dhakarni, vous pouvez :

• Ajouter vos produits et appareils
• Enregistrer les informations de garantie
• Conserver vos preuves d'achat et documents importants
• Ajouter factures, tickets de caisse, contrats de garantie, PDF ou photos
• Consulter vos garanties à tout moment
• Recevoir des rappels avant l'expiration d'une garantie
• Recevoir des alertes pour les entretiens importants
• Transférer une garantie vers un autre compte Dhakarni, par exemple lorsque vous vendez ou offrez un produit

QUELS PRODUITS ?

Dhakarni s'utilise pour tous les produits disposant d'une preuve d'achat et/ou d'une garantie, notamment :

• Électroménager : machines à laver, réfrigérateurs, climatiseurs, etc.
• Électronique : téléviseurs, ordinateurs, smartphones, etc.
• Équipements et appareils de la maison
• Mobilier
• Panneaux solaires et autres équipements
• Et bien plus encore

NE PERDEZ PLUS VOS DOCUMENTS IMPORTANTS

Une facture ou un ticket de caisse peut être indispensable pour faire jouer une garantie.

Avec Dhakarni, vous stockez vos documents directement dans l'application et vous y accédez dès que vous en avez besoin.

LES BONS RAPPELS AU BON MOMENT

Une garantie peut expirer simplement parce que sa date a été oubliée.

Dhakarni vous aide à anticiper ces échéances grâce aux rappels et aux notifications. Vous pouvez aussi être alerté des entretiens importants pour mieux suivre vos produits et prolonger leur durée de vie.

UNE MEILLEURE GESTION DE VOS GARANTIES

Dhakarni ne sert pas seulement à stocker des documents. L'application vous aide à mieux suivre vos garanties et à garder les informations utiles sur vos produits.

Une meilleure organisation facilite aussi les échanges avec les vendeurs et le service après-vente, en vous permettant de retrouver rapidement les documents nécessaires.

COMMENT COMMENCER ?

1. Téléchargez Dhakarni.
2. Créez votre compte avec votre adresse e-mail et un mot de passe, ou connectez-vous avec Apple ou Google.
3. Ajoutez vos produits et leurs informations.
4. Ajoutez vos factures, tickets de caisse ou documents de garantie.
5. Laissez Dhakarni vous rappeler les échéances importantes.

Dhakarni : vos produits, vos documents et vos garanties, toujours à portée de main.

Pour en savoir plus, consultez notre politique de confidentialité :
https://dhakarni.com/politique-de-confidentialite/

name: Dhamma Share
description:
Dhamma Share brings the daily Pāli chanting, the Dhammapada and a meditation timer together in one calm, free app. The texts are on your phone, and their audio downloads by itself on Wi-Fi, or as you play each text, so from then on it all works with no connection. There are no ads, accounts or tracking.

CHANTING AND SUTTAS
• More than 40 chanting texts, from Vandanā, the Refuges and the Precepts to the Mettā Sutta, the Maṅgala Sutta and the parittas
• Suttas, and passages from the Abhidhamma
• Pāli with English, and Chinese in Traditional or Simplified characters
• Listen to the Pāli read aloud, passage by passage. It keeps playing with the screen locked, with controls on the lock screen

THE DHAMMAPADA
• All 423 verses in 26 chapters, in Pāli with Chinese
• Hear each chapter read aloud in Chinese
• More than 300 stories behind the verses, from the Dhammapada commentary, in Chinese
• A verse of the day on the home screen, ready to share

MEDITATION TIMER
• Sit for 5 to 60 minutes, with a bell to begin and to end
• The screen stays on while you sit, so the bell rings on time

UPOSATHA DAYS
• The coming Uposatha days and phases of the moon, and full-moon festivals such as Vesākha, in English or Chinese

MADE FOR READING
• Search in Pāli, English or Chinese
• Bookmark texts and stories to come back to
• Make the text larger or smaller, and choose a light or dark appearance
• Share or copy any verse

YOUR PRIVACY
There are no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking. Your bookmarks and settings stay on your device.

May you be well, happy and peaceful.

name: Dice Expedition: Dungeon RPG
description:
One roll of the dice and your adventure begins!
Dice Expedition is a 3D dungeon RPG where you roll two dice to move around the dungeon board, defeat monsters with the battle dice on your gear, and fight your way down 110 floors. One button to press, big text and big buttons. Jump right in, no tutorial reading required.

■ Every roll is a win
Roll the dice and move around the board. Every tile gives you a reward, and doubles let you roll again. Land on a glowing Bonus Tile and your reward grows ×2, ×4, up to ×8. In the Vault, pick chests to open and match three for extra loot.

■ Exciting 3D battles you can just watch
Step on a monster tile and a flashy 3D battle is over in seconds. Skills fire on their own when your mana is full.

■ A 110-floor expedition
From the Mossy Waterway down to the abyss of Demon Lord Morgas on floor 100, descend through ten dungeons one floor at a time. Collect three Seal Keys to open the stairway gate, and face a region boss every 10 floors. Defeat the Demon Lord to unlock the Frost Dragon's Vault on floors 101–110. Replay any cleared floor on Easy, Normal or Hard.

■ Four classes, up to four adventurers
· Warrior: high HP and tough defense
· Mage: fast mana and skills that hit every enemy
· Ninja: big attack faces land critical hits
· Archer: strong against elites and bosses, and can reroll movement dice
Level up to unlock new skills, passives and a second accessory slot. After level 40, XP turns into Renown. Raise one adventurer of each class, up to four.

■ Your gear is your battle dice
Every weapon, armor and accessory carries its own six-sided battle die. 190 items in four rarities: Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary. No complicated comparing: each item shows a single Power number, and one tap equips your best gear. Get a duplicate to add a star, and upgrade to power up your dice faces.

■ Raise a lion cub
Feed, pet and teach tricks to the lion cub who joins you from day one. With care it grows into a Teen Lion, then an Adult Lion who fights by your side.

■ Play with friends and cheer each other on
Form a party with friends and your adventurers cheer on each other's expeditions. No need to play at the same time, and level gaps are fine. Every time a party member wins, you earn a Party Share too. Don't know anyone? Join an open party with one tap.

■ Arena and daily tournaments
Challenge other adventurers in the Arena five times a day and climb the weekly ranking. The daily tournament changes its theme every day. Just roll to earn points, and place in the ranking for rewards.

■ Build your own tower and plunder the skyline
Spend the Gold you collect to raise your own tower floor by floor and add rooms like a Gold Mine, Forge and Training Ground. Your tower changes its look as it grows. Plunder towers across the skyline for even more Gold.

■ Short runs, every day
Roll the dice, follow the board and pick where to go next in a short adventure each day. A single run fits into any spare moment.

■ Big and easy
Big text and buttons, one thing per screen. Choose "Text: Extra large" in Settings to make it even bigger.

■ Start right away, no sign-up
Install and start playing as a guest. Link a login to keep your adventure when you change devices. No ads. Your progress is saved on our server, so an internet connection is required.

Contact: contact@breyes.net

name: DigiKinnect
description:
DESCRIPTION
Good experiences start with a little curiosity. DigiKinnect brings events, calendars, and community connections together, so you can find your next thing and keep your plans close.

DISCOVER SOMETHING NEW
Explore events, classes, workshops, music, theatre, and community activities from participating organizers.

MAKE TIME FOR MORE
Search by event, organizer, category, or place. Browse the calendar and find experiences that fit your day.

KEEP GOOD PLANS CLOSE
Save events for later, share them with others, and open registration with the organizer when you're ready.

YOUR COMPANIES, ONE PLACE
Sign in with your DigiPassport account and switch between companies you have permission to access.

STAY CONNECTED
Read saved-event announcements and open company or event chats available to your account. Enable notifications to receive supported event updates and new-message alerts.

Event availability and registration are managed by participating organizers. Company access and chat availability depend on your account permissions. Notifications require permission and availability. Registration and payment open with the event organizer.

name: Dinero-Tanda Grupal
description:
Organiza tu tanda sin libretas ni cuentas confusas.

Dinero-Tanda Grupal te ayuda a llevar el control de una tanda de ahorro: registra a los integrantes, define la cuota de cada periodo y marca quién ya pagó. La app calcula cuánto se ha reunido y qué integrante recibe en cada turno.

FUNCIONES
• Crea tandas con nombre, cuota, fecha de inicio y número de integrantes.
• Ordena los turnos de cada integrante.
• Marca pagos por periodo y consulta los pendientes.
• Consulta el total recaudado, lo que falta por cobrar y el avance.
• Cierra periodos y reabre el anterior si necesitas corregir.
• Todo se guarda en tu dispositivo: sin cuenta, sin internet y sin anuncios.

Ideal para tandas familiares, de oficina, del barrio o del gym.

PRIVACIDAD
No se recopilan datos personales. La información que escribes se queda en tu iPhone.

name: Direct TV
description:
Direct TV é um aplicativo de TV ao vivo destinado aos assinantes do serviço Direct TV.

O acesso é feito com o usuário e a senha fornecidos pelo provedor responsável. Após entrar, o assinante pode assistir no iPhone e no iPad à programação de televisão ao vivo disponibilizada em seu plano, usando sua conexão de internet.

Principais funcionalidades:
• Acesso à programação de TV ao vivo incluída no plano do assinante
• Conteúdo organizado por categorias
• Seleção e reprodução dos canais disponíveis
• Reprodução em tela cheia no iPhone e no iPad

O aplicativo não oferece acesso aberto nem vende assinaturas. Para contratar o serviço, obter as credenciais de acesso ou solicitar suporte, entre em contato com o provedor responsável.

name: Dist: Alarm
description:
Never miss your stop again.

Dist Alarm wakes you up when you get close to where you need to get off. Pick your stop, choose how far ahead it should ring, start the trip, and close your eyes. The alarm rings even when your phone is locked or on silent.

SET THE DISTANCE
• Search for your stop or tap the map to drop a pin.
• Choose how early to ring, anywhere from 100 m to 5 km before your stop.
• Not sure? Tap "Use recommended" and Dist Alarm picks a distance based on how fast your ride moves.

TUNED FOR YOUR RIDE
• Set the speed of each ride you take: train, subway, bus, tram or anything else.
• Choose how many minutes before your stop you want to wake up.

YOUR DAILY TRIP IN TWO TAPS
• Save stops as Home, Work or Other.
• Repeat on the days you commute.
• Pick alarm, notification or both, with your own sound and message.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed.
• Your stops stay on your phone.

TIP
iOS can notice that you have arrived up to a minute late, so give yourself a little extra distance on fast rides.

name: DK Carrier Survey
description:
iPhoneがつかんでいる携帯電波の強さ（RSRP）を、数値とグラフで見られるアプリです。引っ越し先や自宅・職場で「ここは電波が入るのか」を確かめるとき、キャリアの乗り換え前に手持ちの回線を比べるときに使えます。

■ 測り方（先にお読みください）
iOSのアプリは、電波の数値を直接読み取れません。このアプリは、iPhone標準の「フィールドテスト」画面を画面収録し、その録画から数値を読み取ります。
1. アプリで「計測を始める」を押す
2. 画面収録を始め、電話アプリでアプリが案内する番号を入力して、フィールドテスト画面を開く（電話はかかりません）
3. 数値が出ている画面を20〜30秒映し、録画を止める
4. アプリで録画を選ぶと、結果が出ます
1回の測定に1〜2分かかります。

■ できること（無料）
・電波の強さの平均と、「強い／やや強い／普通／弱い／とても弱い」の評価
・時間ごとの変化のグラフ（4G／5Gの区別つき）
・数値が映り始めてから最初の30秒・1回線分を読み取り
・RSRP、SINR、Bandなどの用語を、ふつうの言葉で説明

■ 有料版（買い切り）で使えること
・録画を最後まで読み取り（歩きながら撮った長い録画に）
・地図：測った場所を記録し、どこで電波が弱くなったかを表示
・2回線の比較：SIMが2つあるiPhoneで、手持ちの2回線を並べて比較
・履歴の一覧と、CSV・KML・GeoJSONでの書き出し

■ ご利用の前に
・iOS 17以降が必要です
・分かるのは電波の強さです。通信の速さは混み具合でも変わるため、強くても遅いことがあります
・比較できるのは、iPhoneに入っている回線だけです
・フィールドテスト画面の表示は、iOSのバージョンや機種によって変わることがあり、読み取れない場合があります

■ プライバシー
録画の読み取りは、すべてiPhoneの中で行います。録画や数値を外部に送信しません。録画の画像は保存せず、読み取った数値だけを端末内に保存します。

name: DM-Q Remote
description:
DM-Q Remote is a controller application for iPad and iPhone that remotely controls and synchronizes YAMAHA DM3 digital mixers and QLab 5 over the same local network (LAN).

Key Features:
- Bidirectional OSC / UDP communication with YAMAHA DM3 for fader control, CUE / ON switching, and channel link synchronization
- OSC integration with QLab 5 for workspace selection, cue list display, and transport controls such as GO and Panic
- Field-ready UI with layout switching (FLIP) between mixer control and QLab operation
- Fast, direct local-network communication design

Notes:
- This app requires your iPad or iPhone to be on the same local network (Wi-Fi / Ethernet) as the target mixer and QLab machine.
- Certain behaviors or synchronization states may vary depending on device firmware, network conditions, and configuration.

name: Dmacrocx
description: Dmacrocx Used for monthly review of personal expenses. After noting the USD amount, payment date, and account, the transaction history is automatically categorized into amount categories. View the amounts and number of transactions for two months side-by-side. Click on the category with the most significant changes to view details, average amount, and median by purpose or account. Modifying the dividing line will recalculate both time periods and mark the change in transaction history. Installment payments across months can be linked to the same item, and a single payment can be split by purpose. Refunds are included in net expenses based on the selected payment deadline. Frequently used categories and filters can be saved for the next month. At the end of the month, you can reconcile your bills with the original transaction history, record discrepancies, and compare your budget with actual expenses for each purpose.

name: DocVault: AI Document Vault
description:
DocVault is your secure personal document vault for storing, organizing, understanding, and keeping track of important documents in one place.

Store important documents such as passports, driving licenses, identity documents, insurance documents, financial records, work documents, travel documents, property documents, and more.

With DocVault, you can:

• Securely store your important documents
• Organize documents into categories
• Quickly search and filter your document collection
• View documents and their details in one place
• Use AI-powered document intelligence to understand key information
• Detect important dates and document details
• Track document expiry dates
• Set reminders before important documents expire
• Keep frequently needed documents easy to access
• Share documents when needed

AI Document Intelligence

DocVault can help you understand important information from your documents and identify useful details such as dates and key fields, making it easier to keep track of your documents.

Smart Expiry Reminders

Never forget an important expiry date. Set multiple reminders before a document expires, such as 90, 60, 30, 14, 7, or 1 day before expiration.

Simple Document Organization

Keep your documents organized across categories such as Identity, Insurance, Finance, Legal, Work, Travel, Property, and Other.

Search and Find

Quickly search your document vault by document name, type, or other available information.

DocVault is designed to make personal document management simple, organized, and easier to understand.

Store. Understand. Never Forget.

------------------------
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS

Monthly Plan: Monthly auto-renewing subscription
Yearly Plan: Yearly auto-renewing subscription

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://docvaultprivacy.blogspot.com/2026/11/privacy-policy-for-docvault.html
Terms of Use: https://docvaultprivacy.blogspot.com/2026/11/terms-and-conditions-end-user-license.html

name: Dodge Bomber
description:
You can't see the bomb behind the wall.
All you have is the hiss of the fuse, the click of a drop, and your memory.
Become a tin soldier and be the last one standing in a toy-box maze.

Dodge Bomber is a 3D bomb action game played at ground level. The camera stays at your soldier's eye height, so when someone drops a bomb behind a wall of toy blocks, you won't see it. Piece together the clues, feel the dread of turning a corner, and enjoy that "Called it!" moment when you dodge a blast you never saw.

- DEDUCE THE BOMBS YOU CAN'T SEE -
- You only see 110° ahead. Turn around, or your back stays a mystery.
- Hear the fuse of any bomb within about 5.5 tiles, even through walls.
- The moment anyone drops a bomb, its clockwork key goes click.
- A bomb you've seen leaves a "last seen" marker.
- The map only shows what you last saw yourself.
- CPU rivals play by the same rules: they read hidden bombs by sound and memory, too.

- 60-SECOND BATTLE ROYALE -
- Four players: you and three CPU rivals. Last one standing wins.
- When time runs out, Sudden Death begins and crates drop in from the edges.
- Once you're out, watch the rest from above and see which bomb got you.
- Short matches, made for quick breaks.

- 2 VS 2 (MEMBER PLAN) -
Team up with a CPU ally against two CPU rivals. Your teammate and their bombs show up on your map. Careful: your teammate's bombs can get you, too.

- STAGES -
- Block Maze: the classic maze, lined with unbreakable pillars.
- Open Field: no pillars, just packed breakable blocks. The more you break, the more you can see.

- CARDS -
Cards lie face up on the floor, so you know what you'll get.
- Fire+1, Speed+1 and Bomb+1 power you up.
- Kick: walk into a bomb to kick it away.
- Punch: throw the bomb ahead 3 tiles, or smash a block.
- Pierce: blasts go right through blocks.
- Purple "−1" cards are duds. Step around them.

- DRESS UP -
Repaint your tin soldier's jacket, pants, plume, hat badge and trim. Looks only: hitboxes and visibility stay the same for everyone.

- CONTROLS -
Drag on the left to move. Tap the turn buttons or swipe on the right to turn 45° at a time. Switch between third-person and first-person views.

- ALSO -
- Play against the CPU offline.
- Available in English and Japanese.

- PLANS -
- Free Plan: up to 5 solo matches a day (each match you start counts; resets at midnight on your device). Both stages and the basic Dress Up items are included.
- Member Plan (auto-renewing subscription): unlimited solo play, 2 vs 2, and every Dress Up item for your tin soldier. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription. Both start with a one-month free trial (once per Apple ID). Prices vary by country and region and are shown in the app before you buy.

ABOUT AUTO-RENEWING SUBSCRIPTIONS
- After the free trial, your Apple ID is charged for the plan you chose.
- Your subscription renews automatically for the same period and price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period.
- You can cancel or turn off auto-renewal anytime after purchase in Subscriptions in your App Store account settings.
- Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://dodgebomber.shinjo.dev/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://dodgebomber.shinjo.dev/en/privacy/

name: Dodos: Sleeps Countdown
description:
How many sleeps until Christmas? Until the holidays, the birthday, the big trip?

Dodos shows you at a glance: every night left is a little plush dodo. 13 sleeps is a small pile. 183 is a mountain. And every morning, there's one less.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE
• Count in sleeps: one night, one dodo, and the number in big type.
• A real pile that moves: tilt your iPhone and the dodos slide from edge to edge.
• The claw machine: slide the claw and grab a dodo, just for fun.
• The night before the big day, a giant dodo can't sit still. On the day itself, it's a party.
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• A wallpaper of the day, updated every morning with the Shortcuts app.
• A lovely image to share in a story or a message.

DODOS+ (one-time purchase, Family Sharing)
• Unlimited countdowns (3 without Dodos+).
• Repeating countdowns: birthdays, Christmas, shared custody every other week.
• Shared countdowns: a trip for two, the whole family. When one of you changes the date, the other follows. The person you invite doesn't need Dodos+.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your dates stay on your iPhone and in your iCloud.

For kids who ask "how many sleeps?", and for grown-ups who count too.

name: Dolu Masa
description:
Dolu Masa, arkadaşlarla, aileyle ya da kalabalık bir masada oynayabileceğin 20'den fazla parti oyununu tek uygulamada toplar. Telefonu ortaya koy, oyunu seç, eğlence başlasın!

PARTİ VE GRUP OYUNLARI
• Köylü Vampir – Gece olunca kim kimi seçti? Rolleri dağıt, vampiri bul.
• İmpostor – Herkes aynı kelimeyi biliyor, biri hariç. Sahtekârı yakala!
• Tabu – Yasaklı kelimeleri söylemeden anlat, takımınla puan topla.
• Sessiz Sinema – Türk ve yabancı film ve dizileri konuşmadan anlat.
• Bomba – Süre bitmeden kelimeyi bul, bomba elinde patlamasın.
• Ben Kimim? – Alnındaki ünlüyü sorularla tahmin et.
• 15'te 8 – 8 kelimeyi anlat, 15 sınırını aşma.
• Çiz Bil – Takımlı ve süreli çizim tahmin oyunu.

TANIŞMA VE SOHBET OYUNLARI
• Ben Hiç… – Yapanlar ceza puanı alır.
• Kim Daha Olası? – 3-2-1 de, herkes birini göstersin.
• Şişe Çevir: Doğruluk / Cesaret
• Ne Kadar Tanıyorsun? – Arkadaşını ya da sevgilini ne kadar tanıyorsun?
• İki Doğru Bir Yalan – Yalanı bulan puanı kapar.

KELİME OYUNLARI
• Alfabetik Kelimeler – A'dan Z'ye tanımlardan kelimeyi bul.
• Sütun Kelime – Her gün yeni kelime tahmini.
• Kelime Zinciri – Son harfle başlayan kelimeyi bul.
• Bardak Cezası

KLASİKLER VE ARAÇLAR
• Satranç ve Dama – Aynı telefonda iki kişilik.
• Karar Çarkı – Kendi seçeneklerini yaz, çarkı çevir.
• Parmak Seçici – Ekrana parmaklar, şanslı kişi seçilsin.

NEDEN DOLU MASA?
• İnternet gerekmez, her yerde çalışır.
• Reklam yok, üyelik yok, kişisel veri toplanmaz.
• Tamamen Türkçe, binlerce kelime ve soru.
• Tek telefonla bütün grup oynar.

Bir sonraki buluşmada masayı Dolu Masa ile şenlendir!

name: Domus Stays
description:
Domus Stays is the app for owners whose homes are managed by Domus Aedes.

Your home at a glance, wherever you are:

• Bookings: every stay with its dates and its booking total.
• Calendar: what is booked and what is free, month by month, with the nightly price.
• Your own nights: block the dates you want to keep for yourself in a few taps.
• Notifications: know at once when a booking comes in or is cancelled.
• In English, Spanish and French.

Signing in takes no password: enter the e-mail address we hold for you and we send you a link.

Domus Stays is for owners with a management agreement with Domus Aedes. To have your home managed by us, visit domusaedes.com.

name: Dont Panic by emma
description:
Type any idea. Dont Panic turns it into a plan, then helps you do it, one step at a time.

Want to build a cardboard castle for your cat? Plan a bake sale? Write a song about pizza? Tell the crew. A small team of friendly characters picks who should help, makes a short plan, and works through each step with you. They ask good questions, give you choices to tap, and never do the whole thing for you. The ideas stay yours.

MEET THE CREW
Data plans. Marvin dreams up odd "what if" ideas. Abe figures out how things could really work. Ford checks it all adds up. Scout, Analyst, Kram and Publisher help too, and you can make a crew mate of your own.

MADE FOR KIDS AND THE GROWN-UPS NEARBY
• Type, tap or talk: speech is turned into words on the device.
• Sketch it: draw a picture for any step, and the crew makes pictures with Image Playground.
• Badges and a night sky that fills up as you finish quests.
• A grown-ups area behind a simple lock.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. The crew thinks with Apple Intelligence, right on your iPhone or iPad, so your quests stay on your device.

Optional Big brain: a grown-up can turn it on for devices without Apple Intelligence. It sends the words of a quest, after a safety check, to our server and OpenAI to write the crew's replies. Nothing is kept. It is off until a grown-up turns it on.

Dont Panic works best with Apple Intelligence turned on.

name: Doom Scroll: Spot the Fake
description:
Your phone is full of liars. Can you catch them all before the shift ends?

Doom Scroll is a pixel-art detective game set on a retro phone. Every app on the home screen is a level, and every level puts you on a different moderation desk. Profiles, messages and payments keep coming. Swipe right on the real ones. For the fakes, tap every detail that doesn't add up, then swipe left.

SIX APPS, SIX DESKS
• Flamr: a dating app full of catfish. Does the age match the birth date? Is the star sign right? Is it even the same person in every photo?
• LinkdUp: "dream job" offers from recruiters. Check email domains, salary bands, office cities and impossible start dates.
• Pixgram: influencers with bought followers, fake brand deals and giveaway scams. Do the maths.
• Chirp: viral posts. Spot impostor accounts, fake quotes, recycled photos and wrong weekdays.
• Inbox: your own email. Phishing links, spoofed senders, dangerous attachments and accounts you never had.
• CashUp: the bank fraud desk. IBAN formats, bank codes, daily limits and classic gift-card cons.

PLAY DETECTIVE
• Cross-check everything against the rulebook: star sign dates, city distances, height conversions, company registers, calendars and more.
• New rules arrive mid-shift, so you never stop learning.
• Get it wrong and you get a citation that explains exactly what you missed. Three strikes and you're fired.
• Streaks, perfect calls and high scores. Hit the target score to unlock the next app.

Every profile is generated fresh, so no two shifts are the same, and every fake is guaranteed to break at least one rule. As a bonus, you'll get much better at spotting real-life scams.

No ads. No accounts. No data collected. Works offline.

All people, companies and content in the game are fictional.

name: DOPE: Click & Hold
description:
Know what to dial before you get behind the gun.
Mark where it hit, get the exact clicks, and save the number that put you on center.
Your DOPE, ready for the next distance.

DOPE: Click & Hold puts elevation and windage for your weapon and load in one place, in plain words: DIAL 37 CLICKS UP, HOLD 5.75 MOA RIGHT. From a practice day to a PRS or NRL stage to the field, spend less time working numbers and more time on the shot.

DIAL IT
• Pick a weapon and load, set the range, and read the instruction: how many clicks, which way.
• Turrets that look and turn like yours. Feel and hear each click.
• 0.1 MIL or 1/4 MOA clicks, set for each weapon.
• Zero stop: elevation never dials below your zero.

CORRECT IT
• Tap where the bullet hit on a reticle drawn in your scope's units, with your target (round, square or IPSC, any size) shown at true size for the range.
• Get the correction for both axes: 4 CLICKS DOWN, 5 CLICKS RIGHT.
• Apply it, shoot again, and save the hit when it's center.

WINDAGE YOUR WAY
• Hold it in the reticle or dial it on a windage turret, for each weapon or for all of them.
• Set the wind speed and clock direction; the app works out the hold or the clicks.
• Press and hold the windage number to see the hold drawn on a reticle.

SEE WHAT YOU HAVE PROVEN
Your DOPE card shows confirmed elevations in green and calculated ones in grey, with transonic distances flagged so you know where to confirm on steel.

A DOPE CARD FOR EVERY RANGE DAY
Every hit you save lands on that day's card with the day's temperature, humidity and pressure. Add a card for any date, copy in your paper notebook, and keep them all.

FIND YOUR TRUE DOPE
Analytics puts every range day for a weapon and load on one chart, corrects each day to today's air so hot July and cold October compare fairly, and gives you the true DOPE at each distance with how well your days agree. Bad hits are flagged and left out. If your hits say the load is faster or slower than the box, it shows the real muzzle velocity and applies it in one tap.

TAKE A PAPER CARD
Print or share your DOPE card as a full page, a 3 x 5 card, a scope card, or a flip-cap round in every common eyepiece size, each printed at true size. Use AirPrint, AirDrop it to your Mac, save it to Files or send it through Mail.

BUILD AROUND YOUR WEAPON
• Rifles, carbines, SBRs, PCCs and pistols, each with its own loads, zero, sight height and turret.
• Fill a load from factory ammunition or import a chronograph CSV for measured velocity.
• G7 ballistic solver with temperature, humidity and air pressure from your iPhone's barometer.

LEARN AS YOU GO
A Tips tab covers the things that trip shooters up: why adjustments are always up, where to zero and what each zero does on paper, MIL versus MOA, and reading the wind.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Works offline. No account, ads or tracking. Your data lives on your device and, if you use iCloud, syncs through your own private iCloud. We never see it.

Confirm calculated data on a safe range before relying on it. Conditions and equipment change; your confirmed range results matter.

name: DoricScan: Document Scanner
seller_name: Shanghai Wentong Cloud Software Dev. Co. Ltd.
description:
Turn paper documents into crisp, flat PDFs in seconds. Point your camera at a page to capture, turn to the next, and keep going—scanning, image enhancement, and editing all work offline on your iPhone, turning it into a pocket-sized replacement for a desktop flatbed scanner.

Built for the Apple ecosystem: seamlessly hand off captured pages or images via Universal Clipboard and paste them straight into macOS desktop apps—from everyday messaging tools like WhatsApp to productivity and coding workspaces like Codex and Cursor—so paper documents move effortlessly into your daily conversations and workflow.

Smart Capture & Page Enhancement

• Precision Edge & Page Flattening: Automatically detects document borders, lets you fine-tune corners manually, and straightens curled or warped pages for clean, scanner-grade results.
• Exposure & Contrast Tuning: Automatically balances lighting, restores shadows with smart exposure fill, and sharpens contrast so receipts, contracts, and notes stay easy to read.
• Hardware + AI Optimization: Built to take advantage of iPhone camera hardware and modern on-device AI models for fast, reliable document capture.

Organize, Sign & Share

• Multi-Page & Merging: Capture multi-page documents smoothly, reorder pages, and merge related scans into a single PDF or image export.
• Signatures & Watermarks: Add handwritten signatures or custom watermarks before sharing files with colleagues, clients, or accounting tools.
• Business Card Capture: Scan a business card, review the extracted contact details on your device, and save them to Contacts in a tap.

Optional Private Backup

• Keep your scans organized in your local library, or connect your own Google account anytime to back up scan pages directly to your personal Google Drive.

Feedback & Feature Requests

• Enjoying DoricScan? We'd love to hear what features you'd like to see next. Reach out anytime at support@docsintelligence.com.

name: DosePlate AI: GLP-1 & Protein
description:
Stay nourished, hydrated, and organized every week with DosePlate AI — your private protein-first companion built for GLP-1 lifestyles.

Low appetite makes hitting daily protein and fiber hard. DosePlate AI turns a quick meal photo into an instant protein, fiber, and calorie breakdown while keeping your weekly shot schedule, injection-site rotation, and wellness trends in one calm dashboard.

KEY FEATURES
• AI Meal Photo Scanner + 1-Tap Presets: Snap any plate for instant protein, fiber, and calorie estimates, plus curated Low-Appetite Mini Meals.
• Protein, Fiber & Hydration Rings: Designed specifically to help you protect lean muscle when portions are small.
• Weekly Shot Schedule & Site Rotation Log: Track your chosen days, rotate injection sites cleanly, and log gentle Shot-Day Prep checklists.
• Dual-Axis Weight & Wellness Trend Chart: Spot patterns between meal protein, hydration, and daily comfort.
• Doctor-Ready PDF Summary: Export a clean summary of your personal logs before check-ups.
• Local-First Privacy: Health logs stay on your device; strictly zero medical data is sent to analytics or ads. Guest-first with optional backup and 1-tap permanent account deletion.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
DosePlate AI Pro is offered as an auto-renewable Annual plan (with an eligible 3-day free trial) or Weekly plan. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.

Privacy Policy: https://barbarda.com/doseplate/privacy
Terms of Use: https://barbarda.com/doseplate/terms

Non-Medical Disclaimer: DosePlate AI is a personal nutrition and organizational wellness companion only. It does not prescribe medication, recommend doses, or replace advice from a licensed healthcare provider.

name: Dotglide: Braille by Touch
description:
Close your eyes and read braille with your finger.

Dotglide enlarges a single braille cell to fill the screen. Trace it with one finger: your phone vibrates only when your finger enters a raised dot. Find the dots without looking, then pick the letter.

A flat screen does not feel like embossed paper. Dotglide is for practicing the dot patterns by touch and recalling them without looking.

HOW IT WORKS
• One cell fills the screen, with six dot positions
• A short, crisp vibration when you touch a raised dot; nothing on flat positions
• Eyes-closed mode turns the screen dark
• Swipe up with two fingers (or tap the large button at the bottom) to answer from four choices
• Works with VoiceOver: the cell area accepts direct touch

A SENTENCE EVERY DAY
• A new short sentence each day: proverbs and sayings by authors long out of copyright, with the source shown
• Start with uncontracted (grade 1) braille, then move on to contractions

REVIEW
Signs you miss, or need a hint for, come back 1, 3, 7 and 14 days later, just before you forget them.

CHAPTERS AND CHARTS
• Unified English Braille (UEB): letters a–z (free), numbers and punctuation, grade 2 contractions and wordsigns
• Japanese braille: kana, voiced sounds, contracted sounds and numbers
• Quick-reference charts for UEB grade 1, grade 2 and Japanese braille

DOTGLIDE PREMIUM: monthly or yearly with the first week free, or pay once and keep it
• All chapters and charts
• Your full review list
• No ads

Three practice rounds a day are free. Watch an ad to the end for one more round, or to try a premium chapter once a day.

ALSO
• A morning reminder (once a day at 8:00)
• The menus speak 39 languages

Dotglide is not a medical device and does not test or diagnose vision.

A subscription renews on its own unless you turn it off 24 hours or more before the current period ends. To change or stop it, open Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://crelve-touch-braille.web.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://crelve-touch-braille.web.app/privacy.html

Close your eyes and find today's first dot.

name: Dough Temp
description:
Dough Temp keeps bakery water temperature on this iPhone.

Pick a mixer. Set the room and the flour. Water temperature is the factor times the dough target, minus room, flour, and friction. A preferment uses factor 4. Below tap water, ice is split by the melt. Below 0 °C or above 50 °C is held. Friction is written back only when the mix is within one minute of the standard length and the result is between 0 and 40 °C. The last mixer stays.

Temperatures stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: DoWeUp
description:
DoWeUp helps singles, couples, families and flatmates organise household chores without arguments or effort. Record what you did in a second, and everyone can see their own contribution and everyone else's: collaboration, not competition.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Home in order: a ring shows at a glance how the home is doing, room by room.
• I have 15 minutes: short on time? The app suggests the right chores to do right now.
• Quick activities: type a sentence and the activity is ready, with icon and duration.
• Calendar and events: recurring chores, deadlines and home events in one place.
• Us: see how much each person has contributed, fairly and without rankings.
• Sharing with iCloud: invite the people you live with and keep the home in sync on every iPhone.
• Notes, checklists, bills and parcels: everything the home needs, alongside your chores.
• Memory: keep the good moments you share at home.
• Siri and Shortcuts: mark a chore as done with your voice.
• Home Screen widgets (iOS 27 and later).
• Optional AI assistant: add your own Anthropic, OpenAI or Google key to get help creating activities.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your home's data stays in your iCloud and in that of the people you invite. The developer never sees it.

DoWeUp is available in English and Italian.

name: Drifting Fleet Joy - Offline
description:
Drifting Fleet Joy is a naval hunting game where nothing stands still. After every single shot, every ship on the sea drifts one square along its heading, yours and your enemy's. The squares you missed yesterday are empty water today.

Hit a ship twice and you can read its direction, because the damage moves with the hull. Then stop guessing and start predicting: fire where the ship will be, not where it was.

WHAT YOU GET
• A tense duel on an eight-by-eight sea with four ships per side
• Three difficulty levels, from a wandering gunner to a patient hunter that reasons about drift
• A sonar ping that scans an area once per game
• An interactive tutorial that teaches drifting, tracking and sonar step by step
• A hint that points out the most likely target
• Local statistics and badges to chase
• A calm animated sea, smooth effects and haptics (switch them off any time)
• Works completely offline. No account, no ads, no timers
• Available in 20 languages

HOW IT WORKS
Place your fleet by shuffling until you like the formation, then take turns firing one shot at the enemy sea. After each shot, all ships on both sides drift one square along their headings and bounce off the edges and each other. Sink all four enemy ships first to win. Misses fade as the sea moves on, hits travel with the ship, and your single sonar ping tells you how many ship parts hide in a three-by-three area.

PRIVACY
Drifting Fleet Joy never asks you to sign in. If you agree, the game sends anonymous usage statistics and crash reports to help us improve it. You can say no and the game works exactly the same, and you can change your choice in Settings at any time.

name: Drink the Ocean!
description: The World Ocean is 1,335,000,000 km³ of water. You have a straw. Get started. A first-person incremental game: sip, run to the toilet, hire helpers, upgrade your drinkware and watch the ocean actually go down. Yes, there is a bottom.

name: DripStamp Staff
description:
DripStamp Staff is the counter app for coffee shops that use DripStamp stamp cards. Customers keep their card in Apple Wallet, Google Wallet or the browser. Staff scan it, and the stamp shows up on the customer's card right away.

• Scan and stamp: point the camera at the customer's QR code and the stamp is added. Add more stamps for the same visit with one tap.
• Rewards: when a card has a reward ready, redeem it instead of a stamp.
• Undo: fix a mistake within two minutes.
• Type a code: if a QR won't scan, enter the code printed under it.
• Front or back camera: hold the phone, or stand it on the counter facing the customer.
• Recent activity: see the latest stamps and redeems at your shop, and which device made them.
• Themes: match the app to your shop's card.

Your shop needs a DripStamp account to use the app. Sign up at dripstamp.scytheengineering.com, then pair each staff phone from the dashboard by scanning its pairing QR code.

name: Dripzy: Water Reminder
description:
Dripzy is the chill hydration buddy that helps you drink enough water, one sip at a time.

Set a daily goal, choose your hours, and Dripzy sends gentle reminders while you go about your day. Log a drink with one tap, watch the ring fill up, and keep your streak going.

LOG IN ONE TAP
• Pick a cup size or type any amount
• Made a mistake? Undo your last sip
• See today's total and every sip at a glance

REMINDERS ON YOUR SCHEDULE
• Choose when your day starts and ends
• Get a reminder every 30 minutes up to every 4 hours
• Never at night, and you can turn them off anytime

STREAKS AND ACHIEVEMENTS
• Reach your goal day after day to grow your streak
• Unlock achievements as the habit builds

YOUR WEEK AT A GLANCE
• Weekly chart, total, daily average and best day
• Your goal, your units: litres or US fl oz, any goal from 0.25 to 6 L

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Hebrew, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, Italian, German, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese, with full right-to-left support for Hebrew and Arabic.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no signup
• Your drink log and settings stay on your iPhone
• No personalized ads and no tracking

DRIPZY PLUS
Dripzy is free to use. Dripzy Plus is a one-time purchase, not a subscription:
• No ads, ever
• 30-day history chart
• Restore it anytime with your Apple Account

Your daily goal is a personal choice, not medical advice. Talk to your doctor about what is right for you.

Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you at dripzy.app/support

name: Dropseam
description:
Create clothing mockups and illustrated tech packs on iPhone and iPad. Start with a garment template or a documented blank, set your measurements and size grading, then place your artwork on the front, back or fabric panel.

• Add multiple PNG or SVG artworks to the same side. Adjust their size and position and check how they sit on the garment.
• Save a size chart, record sample measurements and export what changed between samples.
• Share an illustrated PDF tech pack with dimensions, print placements and notes. Export a factory ZIP to send the original artwork alongside the spec.
• Keep drafts on your device and export a project backup when you want to move or protect your work.

Made for independent clothing brands and streetwear designers working towards a first or next sample. Previews are illustrative. Verify physical fit, print placement and measurements with a sample before production.

name: Drumigo
description:
At dusk, a little paper dragon sets out through a festival town. Slide whole streets to connect the ivory roads, then march one tile at a time. Pick up drummers, flutists, gong players, and bell ringers along the way. Each new musician makes your parade longer and adds a part to the music.

Every performer holds the street beneath them in place. Find a route for the whole band, then watch it march your solution in an encore you can skip.

Explore 24 untimed puzzles across Lantern Lane, Lotus Quay, and Moon Market. Use unlimited undo and restart, beat your best move count, or try the daily puzzle shared by players around the world. Progress stays on your device, and the game plays offline without accounts, ads, or purchases.

name: DSPStage – DSP Amp Control
description:
DSPStage lets you control your in-car DSP amplifier from your iPhone over Bluetooth.

• Volume and subwoofer: fine control with slim sliders or −/+
• Bass, mid, treble: tone controls on the main screen, back to flat with one tap
• 4 presets: switch instantly between P1–P4 and name each one
• Sound stage: move the stage to the driver, the front seat or the center with the joystick
• Lock screen card and widgets: control volume, sub and presets without opening the app
• CarPlay: widget on your car's display
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Connect", "Volume up", "Preset 3"; connect automatically when CarPlay connects
• Safe start: volume is lowered to your chosen level when connecting

Free download: try every screen in demo mode. Connecting to your amp requires the full version, a one-time purchase with no subscription.

Compatibility: in-car DSP amplifiers fitted with a compatible Bluetooth (BLE) control module.
No account, no ads, no tracking.

DSPStage is an independent app and is not affiliated with any amplifier manufacturer.

name: DTR: Love Test & Compatibility
description:
are u two 100% compatible?

DTR turns two birthdays into your love story, the way fanfic would write it: Soulmates, Enemies to Lovers, Friends to Lovers, Rivals to Lovers and more.

BASED ON THE KOREAN COMPATIBILITY TEST

In Korea, couples have checked their compatibility by birthday for centuries. It's called gunghap, and people still try it before a first date or even a wedding. DTR compares your birth year, month, day and (if you know it) hour with theirs, and explains every match and clash in plain words.

HOW TO USE DTR:

1) Enter your birthday and your person's birthday

2) Get your compatibility %, your love trope and your trope mix

3) Ask the Oracle anything about you two*

WHAT'S INSIDE

Your result: chemistry, communication, trust and drama, plus your top tropes.

Your matches: check your crush, your situationship, your ex or your best friend. Everyone you check lands in your matches, ranked.

The Oracle: ask "who's gonna text first?" or "does he like me back?" and get a thoughtful answer based on your result. Your first question is free.

Who really knows you?: make a quiz about yourself in a minute and send the link. Friends play in their browser, no app needed, and you see their scores.

Love tests: find your love language, attachment style and more.

PERFECT FOR

Anyone with a crush they can't stop thinking about.

Situationships that need a little clarity.

Couples who want to know their trope.

Best friends who want to test who knows who better.

Group chats that need something to talk about.

DTR PREMIUM

Your full story, chapter by chapter. As many matches as you want. 3 Oracle questions every month. The full breakdown of every test. More quizzes, including ones written fully in your own words.

Premium is available yearly (with a 7-day free trial) or monthly. Extra Oracle questions come in packs of 3, 6 or 12.

YOUR PRIVACY

No account needed. We only ask for your person's birthday, never their name, photo or contact. Signing in is optional and only saves your data across devices. No ads, no tracking.

If you have any ideas or questions, email us at hello@dtrlove.com.

NOTE: DTR is for entertainment. It's not a prediction or advice about your relationship. Be kind to each other.

*THE ORACLE USES AI. YOUR FIRST QUESTION IS FREE; MORE REQUIRE PREMIUM OR A QUESTION PACK.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://dtrlove.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://dtrlove.com/privacy

name: Dugout DJ - Baseball Walk-ups
description:
Dugout DJ is the game-day walk-up song manager built for baseball and softball coaches, team managers, and parents.

GAME-DAY WALK-UP PLAYBACK
• Manage your team's batting order with quick drag-and-drop reordering.
• Play walk-up clips from your Apple Music library, imported audio files, or YouTube links.
• Set custom start times and clip durations for every player so the best part of the song hits right as they step to the plate.
• Control playback effortlessly with Previous, Play/Pause, Stop, Replay, and Next transport controls.

EASY PARENT COLLABORATION & CLOUD SYNC
• Share a link with parents so they can submit or update their player's walk-up song from any browser—no app install required.

DUGOUT DJ PRO (ANNUAL SEASON PASS)
Upgrade to Dugout DJ Pro to unlock:
• AI Stadium Announcer: Custom pre-song batter introductions ("Now batting, #12…") cached for game day.
• Top 300 Walk-Up Songs Catalog: Browse and filter 300 pre-timed walk-up hits (with a Youth-Clean Lyrics filter) and apply cues in one tap.
• Extended 30-Second Clips (15 seconds on Free).
• Unlimited Teams for travel, rec, and tournament squads (1 team on Free).

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Dugout DJ Pro Season Pass is an auto-renewing annual subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://dugoutdj.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Duocarina
description:
An ocarina you play with your breath, just like the real one.

Blow into the mic to sound a note and cover the holes on screen to change it. Blow harder and it grows louder; stop and it fades away naturally.

• Breath playing: the mic listens to your breath, not to the notes it plays.
• Finger Guide: see which holes to cover for every note from C to high C.
• Made for your hands: drag the holes and ± keys where you like and keep two presets.
• Octaves: shift the range in Settings, or hold ± to play an octave up or down.
• Sound: choose a tone from ocarina to synth lead and add room, hall or plate reverb.
• Mic Sensitivity: pick Low, Default or High to suit where you play.
• Turn it around: drag to spin the instrument and pinch to look closer.

On iPhone Duo it fits both the folded and unfolded screens; on other iPhones it plays upright, aimed at the mic.

Mic sound is used only on your device and is never recorded or sent anywhere.

name: Duozo: 2 Player Games
description:
Two players. One screen. 48 quick duels.

Put your phone or iPad flat between you and play face to face: each player gets their own half of the screen, and you both play at the same time. No friend around? Every game has an AI with three levels.

SPORTS — Puck Clash, Flick Kick, Bullseye Slide, Keeper Duel, Swish, Putt Race, Pin Smash, Slalom, Sprint, Long Jump

BATTLE — Sumo Bump, Tank Tussle, Light Trails, Tug Rush, Knock Off, Spinner Clash, Bumper Cars, Hot Bomb, Mortar Duel, Snowball Fight, Paint Rush, Punch Out, Castle Crush

REFLEX — Quick Draw, Star Rain, Perfect Slice, Pop Rush, Mole Mash, Juicy Swipe, Time Stopper, Pump It, Beat Match, Fast Finger, Lane Dash, Target Gallery

BRAIN — Math Sprint, Color Clash, Echo Pads, Odd One, Dot Count, Big or Small, True or False, Arrow Rush, Next Number, Clock Time, Shape Count, Flash Grid, Mirror Match

EVERY GAME HAS
• A one-screen tutorial and a countdown
• Best-of-3 or best-of-5 matches, rematch in one tap
• Pause, sound and haptics toggles
• Names, colors and a head-to-head score for each pair of players

PLUS
• Random game button
• Tournament mode: several games in a row, one champion
• Works 100% offline
• English, French and Arabic

Free with a few ads between matches — never during play. Go Duozo for Life with one purchase: no ads and every game, forever. No subscription.

name: Durable - Longevity Exercises
description:
We all know we should be doing more for our mobility, but life is busy. You work, you take care of your family, and you hopefully find time to exercise. But our bodies eventually catch up with us: our backs get sore, injuries become more common, and life just keeps getting busier.

We built Durable to help you make a small investment in your mobility each day, so your older self will thank you.

• A 10-minute daily routine built around the areas you want to work on
• An expert-curated library of exercises chosen for longevity, with no fluff
• Video and voice guidance for every move
• A daily streak to keep you coming back

Because the best mobility routine is the one you'll actually do.

SUBSCRIPTION
Durable Pro unlocks your full routine. Start with a 7-day free trial, then choose monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm after the trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your iPhone's Settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://mfinch19.github.io/durable-site/privacy.html

Durable offers general fitness guidance, not medical advice. If you have an injury or a medical condition, check with a qualified professional before starting.

name: Duzzo
description:
Duzzo is a game of trust.

Every hand you say how many tricks you will take, and you score only if you take exactly that many: not one more, not one less. It is an Italian-style whist with 40 cards, for 2 to 8 players, made to be played with friends, even from afar.

HOW TO PLAY
• Open a room and send your friends its six-character code.
• One card each in the first hand, two in the second, up to the largest hand; then back down to one.
• Look at your cards and bid how many tricks you will take.
• You follow the suit of the first card if you can; trumps win the trick.
• Right on: 10 points plus 2 per trick. Wrong: 2 points off for every trick of difference.

THE RULE THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING
The last to bid can never make it add up: the bids never equal the tricks of the hand. Someone has to miss, and that is where the real game begins.

WHAT YOU FIND AT THE TABLE
• Private rooms: only those with the code take a seat.
• A minute per move: if someone drifts off, the table moves for them and the game never stops.
• Scores at hand: who is ahead, who bid what, and every hand already played.
• The room chat, with quick phrases: “Nice hand!”, “Your turn”, “Rematch?”. You can report a message and block its author.
• Four decks: Neapolitan, Piacentine, Duzzo and French cards. Everyone picks their own, even at the same table.
• The players’ standings, levels, daily streaks and ten medals to earn.

TOKENS
Every game costs one token. Every day at midnight, Italian time, you get 2 for free; more come as gifts with levels, streaks and medals, and they never expire.

GOOD TO KNOW
• You need an account to play: email, password and the name the others see at the table and in the standings.
• You play online with other people: an internet connection is required.
• In Italian and English.
• Duzzo is for players aged 14 and over.
• You can delete your account whenever you want from the settings, at once and for good.

Privacy policy: https://duzzo.it/en/privacy
Terms of use: https://duzzo.it/en/terms

name: Dye & Seek: Camouflage Game
description:
Paint yourself. Hide in plain sight. Don't get found.

Dye & Seek is a camouflage game and a hide and seek puzzle in one. You are a little jelly critter in a room full of color. Pick a paint, hop onto a spot that matches and blend in like a chameleon before the lights go out. Then a drone searches the room with its flashlight. If your camouflage is good enough, it flies right past you.

HOW TO PLAY
• Pick a paint tube. Some match the room, some are decoys.
• Tap a spot in the same color: a rug, a pillow, the floor.
• Watch the camo bar. Green means you are hidden.
• Press READY and stay still while the seeker looks for you.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 24 hiding levels in five kinds of rooms: living room, kitchen, kids' room, bathroom and bedroom
• Every room is checked so there are several fair places to hide
• Later levels give you less time and a sharper-eyed seeker
• Stars, coins, and hats that take on the color of your paint
• A find-me card: share a picture of your hiding spot and see if friends can find you
• Optional helpers: a hint, an eyedropper and a pattern brush
• Play offline, no account needed
• Settings for screen shake, flashes, sound and vibration

Dye & Seek is free to play. No full-screen ad interrupts a round. A one-time purchase removes the ads between levels and the banner; reward videos stay optional.

Contains ads. The first 3 levels have no banner and no ads between levels.

name: Dylematy: Decyzje i Rady
description:
Nie wiesz, co wybrać? Zapytaj obcych.

Dylematy to aplikacja, w której opisujesz swój dylemat w dwóch opcjach, A i B, a inni użytkownicy głosują i dorzucają krótkie rady. Ty widzisz wynik na żywo i podejmujesz decyzję po swojemu.

JAK TO DZIAŁA
• Opisz dylemat: zadaj pytanie i wpisz dwie opcje. Do każdej możesz dodać zdjęcie.
• Niech zagłosują inni: nieznajomi przesuwają kartę w lewo albo w prawo.
• Zobacz wynik: procenty rosną na żywo, a pod spodem czekają rady.

DLACZEGO DYLEMATY
• Anonimowo: bez konta, bez e-maila i bez numeru telefonu. Dostajesz losowy pseudonim.
• Nikt nie zobaczy, jak głosujesz.
• Przesuń i zdecyduj: głosowanie jednym gestem.
• Rady od ludzi: krótkie, życzliwe wskazówki. Oznacz te, które Ci pomogły.
• Dylemat dnia: codziennie nowe pytanie dla wszystkich.
• Iskry i seria: za głosy i rady zbierasz iskry i budujesz serię dni.

BEZPIECZEŃSTWO
• Każdy dylemat i każdą radę możesz zgłosić, a autora zablokować.
• Filtrujemy dane kontaktowe, linki i spam.
• Zdjęcia sprawdzamy ręcznie, zanim zobaczą je inni.
• W aplikacji znajdziesz numery do rozmowy z człowiekiem.
• Konto i wszystkie dane usuniesz w Ustawieniach.

Dylematy to pomoc w codziennych wyborach, a nie zastępstwo dla specjalisty. Dla osób od 16 roku życia.

Pytania: michal@rogalski.biz

name: DYNOMARK: Climbing Log
description:
DYNOMARK is a fast, focused logbook for indoor climbers. Log routes and boulders in a few taps, warm up with a plan built from your own sends, and watch your grades move across months and gyms.

LOG IN SECONDS
• Routes (YDS 5.5 to 5.15) and boulders (V0 to V12+)
• Flash, onsight, redpoint, project or repeat, with attempts, wall angle, hold colour and style
• Repeat-last and duplicate for laps
• Mark warm-ups so easy laps don't skew your stats

WARM UP SMARTER
• A warm-up ladder built from your recent working grade
• Tick the steps off as you go

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Grade progression with trend lines, volume and send rates
• Flash, onsight and redpoint rates, and attempts per send
• Consistency calendar and weekly streaks
• Personal records and first-time milestones
• Monthly reports and your year in climbing

CHASE PROJECTS
• Track your high point session by session
• An outlook based on your own progress, clearly labelled as an estimate
• A proper celebration when you send

TRAIN WITH PURPOSE
• Fingerboard, pull and core routines with a rest timer and your previous numbers
• Hangboard load calculator: added weight to % of body weight, and back

YOUR GYMS
• Pick your gym, keep favourites and see your history at each one
• Compare gyms using only your own logs, with optional soft or hard grade adjustments

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Everything stays on your phone; export your history as CSV any time
• Share cards for sessions, records and monthly recaps

DYNOMARK opens with a labelled demo account so you can explore. Start your own log from Profile whenever you're ready.

name: E.C.H. Property Renovations
description:
E.C.H. Property Renovations connects homeowners, landlords, and tenants with our property maintenance and renovation services in Visalia and California’s Central Valley.
Submit service requests, share project photos, message E.C.H., coordinate appointments, and follow project updates.
Available features depend on your account type. Service availability varies by location and scheduling.

name: Ear Training: Fifthwise
description:
Fifthwise plays two notes and you name the interval between them. Every interval you miss comes back the next day, more often, until you hear it right away.
Start with four real questions and see which interval your ear mixes up, like hearing a minor third as a major third.
Then train five minutes a day and watch your progress for each of the 12 intervals.

HOW IT WORKS
• Listen: Fifthwise plays two notes, rising, falling or together, from a soft built-in piano-like sound.
• Answer: tap the interval name. Replay as often as you like.
• Learn from the miss: when you get one wrong, hear the right interval and the one you picked back to back, so you know what the difference sounds like.
• Come back tomorrow: missed intervals return the next day and show up more often. Intervals you know well come back less often.
• Grow your set: start with the minor and major third, perfect fourth, perfect fifth and octave. New intervals are added once you know the current ones, up to all 12.
• See your progress: every interval has its own meter and recent accuracy.

MADE FOR PRACTICE
• A daily session takes about five minutes.
• Sound is made on your iPhone. No account, no internet needed, no microphone.
• Choose which directions to practice: rising, falling or played together.
• Sound plays even with the ring/silent switch on silent. Use headphones for the clearest notes.

GOOD FOR
Singers, guitar and piano players, choir and band members, music theory students and anyone who wants to play by ear.

SUBSCRIPTION
Fifthwise is a subscription app. After your four-question check, choose a weekly, monthly or annual plan to unlock daily training, all 12 intervals and your progress. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

Privacy policy and terms of use are linked inside the app.

name: Editcut: AI Video Editor
description:
