Film it messy. Post it clean.

Editcut cuts the retakes, pauses and dead air out of your talking videos, in seconds, right on your iPhone. Film the way you naturally talk. Say a line again if you slip. Editcut keeps your best take and removes the rest.

HOW IT WORKS
- Choose a video or record one in the app.
- Editcut listens on your phone and finds the retakes, false starts and long pauses.
- You see every sentence it kept and every one it cut. Tap one, or drag across several, to bring it back or cut it.
- Add captions, then save to Photos and post.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Nothing is hidden. Every cut is listed, you can play any sentence from your original video before you decide, and updating the video is free.

CAPTIONS THAT LOOK LIKE YOU
Choose Pop, Classic or Boxed, six fonts, your size, and top, middle or bottom. Captions are burned into your video.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your video and audio are processed on your iPhone and never uploaded. Only the words (a transcript) are sent to an AI service to choose the best takes, and we do not store them.

SPEAK YOUR EDITS
Say "cut" or "scratch that" after a slip and Editcut removes it. Say "B-roll" to mark a line where a photo should appear.

FREE TRIAL, THEN A SUBSCRIPTION
Start with a 14-day free trial. After the trial Editcut is a paid subscription (yearly or monthly) that renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in Settings, under your Apple Account, then Subscriptions. Fair-use limits apply.

Works on iPhone 11 and newer with iOS 26 or later. Videos up to 15 minutes.

Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: see the links below.

name: Efe Pizza
description:
Welkom bij de officiële app van Efe Pizza!

Zin in een krokante, versgebakken pizza, een smaakvolle döner kebab, een goedgevulde schotel of een heerlijke kapsalon? Via onze app bestel je jouw favoriete maaltijd sneller en makkelijker dan ooit. Kies voor snelle thuisbezorging in Olen en omgeving, of haal je bestelling op het gewenste moment bij ons af.

De voordelen van de Efe Pizza app:

Razendsnel bestellen: Bekijk ons complete menu en plaats je bestelling met slechts een paar klikken.

Altijd vers bereid: Wij werken dagelijks met dagverse ingrediënten voor de allerbeste smaak.

Veilig en flexibel betalen: Reken eenvoudig online af via Bancontact en andere betaalmethodes, of betaal contant bij levering of afhaling.

Exclusieve acties: Blijf direct op de hoogte van jouw bestelstatus en profiteer van speciale app-kortingen.

Download nu de Efe Pizza app, bestel direct en geniet van een heerlijke maaltijd.

Eet smakelijk!

name: Egg Belt: Color Sort Puzzle
description:
A crate holds a picture made of coloured eggs, and a belt runs all the way round it. Tap a basket to send it riding: it takes the nearest egg of its colour from every row and column it passes. A full basket flies away; one that comes back with room left waits in the rack.

Fill the crate's baskets in the right order before the rack's five slots run out. Every colour also has its own symbol, so the game reads without colour too.

24 hand-drawn pictures, hints when you are stuck, and offline play in 11 languages.

Egg Belt shows ads between levels and offers an optional purchase to remove them.

name: EggMonitor by Orka
description:
EggMonitor connects to the EggMonitor wireless impact sensor over Bluetooth and shows what it measures in real time.

Live impact chart and peak G values
Colour status matching the sensor light: yellow (still), green (moving), red (above your threshold)
Set your own threshold levels
Start and stop tests from the app or from the sensor
Download and review the saved test files on your phone
Export results as CSV files to share
Technician mode for calibration, with a Calibration Certificate you can save as a PDF
Simulate mode to explore the app without a sensor

A compatible EggMonitor sensor is needed to record real measurements.

name: EhAyeDog
description:
Bring your real-life best friend into the game!

EhAyeDog is the charming casual pet game where you can upload a photo of your very own dog and turn them into the star of the show. Frame your pup’s face and head out on fun adventures together.

Whether you're playing garden fetch, exploring the woods on walkies, or sprinting against rival pups, your faithful companion is by your side every step of the way!

FEATURES YOU’LL LOVE:

Star Your Own Pup
Snap or upload a photo of your dog, use the simple face-framer tool, and see your real pet running around in the 3D world.

Garden Fetch
Toss the tennis ball around the sunny back garden! Practise your throws, fetch streaks, and rack up bonus treats.

Lake Splash Fetch
Take your dog down to the water for a refreshing 60-second splash challenge. Retrieve floating tennis balls against the clock to earn extra bones!

Walkies Round the Neighbourhood & Woods
Clip on the lead and go for a relaxing stroll! Explore sunny suburban streets, a peaceful moonlit night walk, and winding woodland paths filled with nature and treats.

The Great Bone Race
Line up at the starting grid against three cheeky rival dogs! Dash and weave through the obstacle course to snatch 10 golden bones and take first place.

PRIVACY & PLAYER FIRST: • 100% Device-Local: Your dog's photo stays privately on your phone — it is never uploaded to any remote server or cloud account.
• No Accounts or Logins: Jump straight in and play immediately without needing an email address, password, or sign-up.
• No Real-Money Purchases: All cosmetic accessories and hats are unlocked purely by playing the games and earning bones.

Download EhAyeDog today, pop your pup into the game, and go on virtual walkies whenever you fancy!

name: EIDOLON: The Last Summoning
description:
A LAMP IN THE LAST LIT TOWN HANDS YOU A DEAD BINDER'S DECK.

EIDOLON is a complete story told through card duels. More than a hundred living cards, five realms, one long dusk, and three ways it can end.

A STORY FIRST
Seventeen duels across five realms, each with its own ruler, its own rule, and something to say to you. The original campaign features voiced characters. Your lantern-spirit Wisp stays at your side the whole way. Finish the story and two more chapters open: Memories of the Wheel and The Atlas of Six Worlds.

CARDS THAT FEEL ALIVE
• Call great spirits, and offer lesser ones to raise greater
• Veil cards face-down and spring them at the right moment
• Turn the Wheel between Dawn, Storm and Eclipse to change what every card can do
• Pair the right cards to wake a Bond
• Play a card often and it grows from Known to Mastered

MORE TO LOVE
• A new duel every day, the same for every player
• A trader with fresh offers daily, and card and deck codes to share with friends
• The Stilled Tower, an endless climb
• Built for touch on iPhone and iPad, with haptics
• Plays offline

FINISHED, AND YOURS
Start free: the prologue and the whole first realm. One purchase unlocks the complete original game, including the Tower, Memories of the Wheel and Atlas of Six Worlds. Optional cosmetic packs, a Collector’s Upgrade, the DJ Rhinox Listening Room and the new Echoes Beyond the Wheel chapter are separate one-time purchases. The Listening Room offers 20-second previews; full in-app track playback requires its unlock. Music during gameplay is always included. Echoes adds three written-dialogue encounters after the original finale.

Card packs are earned by playing. Nothing random is ever sold.

THE PAURAM PROMISE
Your game. Your achievements. Your privacy. No ads. No selling your data. Just pure play.

Designed by Pauram.

name: Ember Aloft: Focus Timer
description:
Set a focus timer and send Ember, a tiny dragon, across a hand-painted world. Your study time carries Ember through lantern-lit pines, past snowy mountains, and on to new destinations. Reach a new stop to collect a postcard and read Ember’s travel notes.

• Choose a countdown, a custom duration, or an open-ended stopwatch. Take a timed break after a session.
• Watch your journey grow across sessions and see your progress on the world map.
• Use focus labels or subjects and review your daily goal, study history, and calendar.
• Turn ambient flight music on or off. Use Strict Focus to pause the timer when you leave the app or lock your iPhone.
• Check the timer on the Lock Screen or in the Dynamic Island on supported iPhones.

All routes are free. No account is required. Focus records and journey progress are stored on your device. Available in English and Simplified Chinese.

name: Emberlit: AI Characters & Chat
description:
Emberlit is interactive stories with AI characters. The story unfolds as you text.

CHARACTERS WITH THEIR OWN LIVES
Every character has a username, a job, a world, a status and a day of their own. A spymaster whose ledger someone is copying. A rival architect snowed in at the same lodge. A café waitress whose rent just went up. They text like people do, in short bursts.

YOU DECIDE WHERE IT GOES
Each character starts with a situation. Where it goes is up to you: slice of life, mystery, adventure or romance.

MOMENTS
Swipe through what characters have been up to, then tap Message to step into their story.

MEMORY YOU CAN SEE
Characters remember what happens in the story and what you tell them. Every memory is listed. You can edit or delete any of it, or turn memory off.

GROUP CHATS
Put characters from the same world in one chat and watch them talk to each other.

MAKE YOUR OWN
Create a character in seven steps and keep it private, or publish it for others after review.

CLEAR PRICES
Up to 30 free messages a day across all characters. After that, messages cost Embers, and the price is shown in the message field before you send. Emberlit Plus gives unlimited messages with official characters. If no reply comes through, you aren't charged.

HONEST ABOUT AI, AND SAFE
- Every character is AI and has an AI badge. Ask one if it's an AI and it says yes.
- Characters don't guilt you about being away and don't ask you to spend.
- Report or block any character, person or message.
- Emberlit is not a crisis service. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number.

EMBERLIT PLUS SUBSCRIPTION
Emberlit Plus is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. In the US it is $12.99 a month or $79.99 a year; prices vary by country, and the price is shown in the app before you buy. New subscribers get a 7-day free trial, except in South Korea.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
- The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends.
- You can manage or cancel the subscription in your Apple Account Settings.
- Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://emberlit.chat/terms
Privacy Policy: https://emberlit.chat/privacy

name: Embers of Yesterday
description:
Only three people are left in the castle on the hill. Adan fights in the yard with a slingshot and a crowbar. Wren watches from the wall and throws him stones and food. Old Hank keeps the gate and the old mortar.

Every night wolves and bandits come up the slope. Bandits swing grappling hooks and climb the wall to grab Wren, so Adan has to get there first. Some nights the acid mist rolls in and nobody can see a thing, except Wren, who can hear. She draws the monsters she hears, and Hank fires his mortar at her drawings.

Every fifth night ends a chapter with a boss duel: the shielded Vulture, the Bonebreaker with its frost breath, the Sniffer Mother who tunnels under the field, the Mist King who hides in the fog, and the Iron Vulture Chief with his siege cart. And when the Chief falls, something chained inside the cart breaks free.

Adan grows with every level: a dash, a scatter shot, a ground slam, fire stones, a rallying cry, and two ultimates: the Whirlwind Kick at level 3 and the Dragon Fist at level 8. Each morning, pick one of three upgrades. Beat a boss and take its weapon as a trophy.

FEATURES
• 25 nights in 5 chapters, each with its own enemies
• 5 boss duels plus a final battle against a fire dragon
• Fog nights: aim the mortar by Wren's drawings
• Two ultimates: Whirlwind Kick and Dragon Fist
• 10 levels of skills and gear, morning upgrades, boss weapon trophies
• Simple touch controls: drag to move, buttons for the slingshot and skills, tap the field to fire the mortar
• Cartoon cut-out art
• English, Chinese and Spanish
• Chapter 1 is free; one purchase unlocks chapters 2 to 5 for good and lets you replay a lost night with your progress kept
• No ads, no account, plays offline

name: Embersand Arena
description:
Step into the firelit sands of Embersand Arena and fight wave after wave of monsters.

• Three heroes, three styles: the Ironvow Knight holds the line with shield and Whirlwind, the Verdant Ranger kites with arrows, and the Ember Mage burns crowds with spells.
• Every wave ends with a choice of blessings that reshapes your build for the rest of the run.
• Boss waves test everything you have built.
• Made for touch: on-screen stick and skill buttons, landscape play on iPhone and iPad.
• Fully offline: no account, no ads, no purchases, no data collection.
• Your run is checkpointed automatically, so you can pause, switch apps and pick up where you left off.
• English and Chinese, plus a low-quality mode for older devices.

name: EMS Reinigungsservice
description:
EMS Reinigungsservice is a business management application designed for cleaning companies.

The platform allows businesses to organize their employees, manage daily work assignments, and coordinate their teams through a simple and easy-to-use system.

Each company can create its own administrator account through the web management dashboard. Administrators can create employee accounts and provide their employees with login credentials to access the application.


The application is free to use and does not include in-app purchases, subscriptions, or payment processing.

name: En Comparsa
description:
Todas las fiestas de Moros y Cristianos, pueblo a pueblo.

En Comparsa reúne el calendario de las fiestas de Alicante, Valencia, Murcia y más, con el programa de cada pueblo, la hora de cada acto, dónde sale la Entrada y el orden en que desfilan las comparsas.

PARA TODOS LOS FESTEROS
• Calendario de más de 80 fiestas, con filtro por provincia
• Programa por días: dianas, entradas, embajadas, alardos, procesiones y castillos
• Si aún no ha salido el programa oficial, te enseñamos el previsto a partir del año anterior
• Orden de la Entrada con tu comparsa marcada
• Recordatorio antes de cada acto que sigas
• Aviso de los días con pólvora, si vas con niños o con perro
• Aviso al momento si la junta cambia una hora o un recorrido

LAS COMPARSAS DE CADA PUEBLO
• Más de 400 comparsas de los dos bandos, con su escudo
• Pide entrar en la tuya desde su ficha
• Si tu comparsa no está, la das de alta en un minuto

PARA TU COMPARSA O JUNTA
• Censo de miembros con cargos y papeles
• Solicitudes de acceso que la directiva acepta con un toque
• Comunicados que llegan como notificación
• Agenda de ensayos, cenas y reuniones, con confirmación de asistencia
• Control de cuotas: quién ha pagado y quién debe
• Las juntas verificadas publican el programa oficial y avisan de cualquier cambio

La app es gratis para todos los festeros, sin anuncios. La gestión de comparsas y juntas es un servicio para asociaciones festeras que se contrata aparte.

name: Encephala
description:
Encephala is a 100% offline interactive 3D human brain anatomy, white-matter tractography, and electrophysiology learning studio built for students, educators, and curious minds.

Explore five focused interactive stages directly on iPhone and iPad with zero account setup, zero telemetry, and zero internet connection required:

1. INTERACTIVE 3D HUMAN BRAIN ATLAS
• Rotate, zoom, and tap bilateral cortical lobes (Frontal, Parietal, Temporal, Occipital), deep Limbic & Insula structures, and the Cerebellum.
• Toggle Glass X-Ray Mode to inspect internal white-matter projection and commissural pathways alongside traveling action-potential particles.
• Cross-reference 13 Brodmann cytoarchitectonic areas with instant functional summaries.

2. WHITE-MATTER TRACTOGRAPHY & LARGE-SCALE NETWORKS
• Study the Tri-Network cognitive architecture: Default Mode Network (DMN), Central Executive Network (CEN), and Salience Network (SN).
• Inspect major white-matter fasciculi—Corpus Callosum, Arcuate Fasciculus, Corticospinal Tract, and Cingulum Bundle—with conduction velocity and fiber classifications.

3. SYNAPTIC CLEFT & ACTION POTENTIAL OSCILLOSCOPE
• Trigger a Hodgkin-Huxley style voltage sweep from -70 mV resting potential through -55 mV threshold, +40 mV Na+ depolarization, K+ repolarization, and -80 mV refractory undershoot.
• Compare Na+ and K+ ion channel conductance alongside five neurotransmitter pools (Glutamate, GABA, Dopamine, Serotonin, and Acetylcholine).

4. 5 NEURAL OSCILLATION FREQUENCY BANDS
• Tune across Delta (0.5–4 Hz), Theta (4–8 Hz), Alpha (8–12 Hz), Beta (13–30 Hz), and Gamma (30–100 Hz) with a live waveform visualizer and optional local acoustic reference tone (muted by default).

5. SELF-CHECK QUIZ & PRINTABLE STUDY SHEETS
• Test your understanding with instant explanation feedback, print formatted neuroanatomy study sheets via AirPrint / Save-to-PDF, or export plain-text summaries via the native iOS Share Sheet.

Educational Notice: Educational human brain anatomy, white-matter tractography, and electrophysiology reference studio for students and learners. Not a medical device, EEG/MRI diagnostic tool, or substitute for licensed neurological evaluation.

name: Endgame Archive
description:
Every position has a past. Endgame Archive gives you the final board and asks you to reconstruct the moves that led to it.

Open a case, read the evidence, and move each piece back to its previous square. Red moves along rows and columns, Blue moves diagonally, and Amber can step in any direction. Later cases ask you to restore captured pieces as you work backward.

• Solve 12 handcrafted cases on 4×4 and 5×5 boards.  
• Check starting positions, move order, and other evidence against your reconstruction.  
• Use layered hints, undo a move, or restart a case whenever you choose.  
• Verify your answer and step through the sequence in Forward Replay.  
• Play offline with no sign-in. Completed cases and unfinished attempts are saved on your device.

name: Endo - 力量训练记录
description:
Endo 是一款专注、安静的力量训练记录工具。选好今天要练的部位，记下每个动作的重量、次数与完成组数，再回看自己的训练积累。

【专注眼前这一组】
按胸、背、肩、腿、臀、手臂、核心快速开练，内置 530 个动作的肌群示意与中文做法要领。支持公斤（kg）与磅（lb）随时切换，自动带出上次训练重量作为参考。

【回看自己的积累】
通过每日达标圆环、动作力量进步曲线与下次加重建议，清晰掌握自己的训练节奏；所有历史记录均可随时回看、补记、修改或删除。

【记录每日蛋白摄入】
设定每日蛋白目标，随时记录或调整当天的蛋白摄入量，在首页与复盘页直观查看达标进度。

【本机保存，离线可用】
无需注册账号，无广告打扰。全部训练与蛋白记录均保存在你的 iPhone 本机，支持一键导出 Excel 表格供个人查看与留存（当前不支持将 Excel 导回 App，也无账号云同步；卸载 App 前请先导出留存）。

免责说明：Endo 仅用于个人训练与饮食日常记录，不构成医疗、康复或专业营养诊断建议。请根据自身身体状况合理安排训练。

name: EnGarantia: Warranty Tracker
description:
Scan the receipt when you buy, then stop worrying about the drawer full of paper. EnGarantia saves it as a PDF, works out when the warranty ends and reminds you a month before. If something breaks, the receipt, the manual and who to contact are one tap away.

SCAN THE RECEIPT, NEVER LOSE IT
• Document scanner with the camera: frame the paper and it crops and straightens it for you. Up to 3 pages per receipt.
• Live camera only, no importing from your photo library, so what you keep is the original receipt. The PDF carries the scan date and time and a digital fingerprint (SHA-256) of every page in its footer.
• The original photo is kept too, with zoom for the fine print.

AI FILLS IN THE DETAILS
• Artificial intelligence (Claude, by Anthropic) reads the store, purchase date, product, brand, model, price and country, and recognizes the type of product.
• It warns you if the receipt looks like a photo of a screen or an edited image.
• You check and correct everything before saving. Offline, you can fill it in by hand.

A REMINDER BEFORE IT RUNS OUT
• Works out the warranty end date from the years it suggests for the country of purchase (for example 3 in Spain and 2 in the rest of the EU; elsewhere it proposes 1 year). You can change them and add extra months.
• A notification one month before the warranty ends, at the time you choose.
• Periods are a guide: always check your receipt and the manufacturer's warranty.

ALL YOUR PURCHASES AT A GLANCE
• A grid with one icon per product by type: phone, TV, washer, laptop, headphones…
• Each icon shows how much warranty is left by color: green, amber, red or expired.

MANUAL AND CLAIM, ON HAND
• Finds the official user manual for your model, or the closest match, and tells you whether it's "official" or "approximate."
• Customer service phone, email and website for both the brand and the store, with buttons to call or send a ready-written email to make your warranty claim.
• Open the receipt PDF and share it by email or messaging, or export every PDF at once.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
• No account, no sign-up: warranties, PDFs and photos are stored on your iPhone, iPad or Mac.
• Photos only pass through our server to be read and are not kept.
• Reading the receipt and finding the manual need an internet connection.
• Works on iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs; on a Mac it scans with the computer's camera.

FREE AND PRO
• Free, with ads: a banner, a full-screen ad while the AI reads the receipt and, now and then, one when you open the app. Up to 20 AI receipt reads and 10 manual searches a day.
• EnGarantia Pro removes all ads and raises the limit to 60 reads and 30 manual searches a day. Monthly or yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial the first time; you see your local price in the app before paying.
• The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends, in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://cdpoma.github.io/engarantia/privacidad.html

Download EnGarantia and scan the receipt from your latest purchase today.

name: EnglishCall: İngilizce Öğren!
description:
İngilizceyi ezberleyerek değil, oynayarak öğren!

EnglishCall, İngilizceye yeni başlayanlar için hazırlanmış eğlenceli bir öğrenme oyunu. Sevimli rehberimiz Callie ile şehir şehir dolaşıyor, her durakta kısa ve keyifli derslerle yeni kelimeler ve cümleler öğreniyorsun.

Dil okulu EnglishCall Education'ın öğretmenleri tarafından hazırlanan dersler, sınıfta işe yarayan yöntemleri cebine taşıyor.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR?
• Her ünite kısa bir animasyonlu konu anlatımıyla başlar.
• Ardından dinleme, eşleştirme, cümle kurma ve sesli söyleme oyunlarıyla öğrendiklerini pekiştirirsin.
• Yanlış yaptığında Callie önce ipucu verir, sonra cevabın NEDEN doğru olduğunu kelime kelime açıklar.
• Zorlandığın sorular dersin sonunda yeniden karşına çıkar.

DOĞRU TELAFFUZ
• Her kelimeyi ve cümleyi anadili İngilizce gibi doğal bir sesle dinle.
• Yavaş dinle: zor cümleleri yavaşlatıp tane tane dinle.
• Sesli söyle: cümleyi Callie'den dinle, sesli tekrar et.

HER GÜN BİRAZ, HER GÜN İLERİ
• Callie Serisi: her gün çalışarak serini büyüt.
• Günlük görevler ve 7 günlük giriş takvimi ile her gün yeni ödüller.
• Haftalık lig: her hafta yarış, en çok ışığı toplayan sen ol!

CALLIE KARTLARI
• İki albüm, 130 koleksiyon kartı: "Callie Dünyayı Geziyor" ve "Callie Evreni".
• Paketleri yırt, kartları topla. Her kart yeni bir İngilizce kelime ve cümle öğretir.
• Sıradan, Nadir, Epik, Efsane… ve yalnızca 5 tane olan gizemli Mitik kartlar!
• Kart paketleri yalnızca oyun içinde kazanılır, asla gerçek parayla satılmaz.

CALLIE'Yİ GİYDİR
• Kazandığın ışıklarla Callie'ye astronot, ninja, korsan, büyücü ve daha fazla kostüm al.

GÜVENLİ VE ADİL
• Reklam yok.
• Uygulama içi satın alma yok.
• Konum, rehber, fotoğraf ya da mikrofon erişimi yok.
• Hesabını ve tüm verilerini uygulama içinden dilediğin an silebilirsin.

CANLI DERS
İngilizceyi bir öğretmenle konuşarak geliştirmek istersen, uygulamadaki Canlı Ders bölümünden bilgi bırak; EnglishCall Education eğitim danışmanları seni arasın.

Callie seni bekliyor. Hadi başlayalım!

name: Enigral: Puzzle Universe
description:
Remember the joy of opening the newspaper's puzzle page? Enigral brings it to your phone: 18 kinds of puzzles, 5,700 levels and a new daily puzzle that everyone solves on the same day.

18 PUZZLES, ONE GAME
• Number Fill-In
• Kakuro
• Nonogram
• Number Wheel
• Torn Paper
• Code
• Bridges
• Number Chain
• Tents
• Binary
• Skyscrapers
• Greater-Less
• Color Link
• Parking Jam
• Pipe Turn
• Light Path
• One Stroke
• Block Fit

Every level of every puzzle has exactly one solution. Each level is a little harder than the last.

NEW EVERY DAY
• The daily puzzle changes type every day; solve it and grow your streak.
• Sunday puzzle and the six-puzzle Enigral Times for slow weekends.
• Missed a day? Play it from the archive.

THE NEWSPAPER FEEL
• Take pencil notes and use hints only when you want.
• Every puzzle starts with a short tutorial, so you learn by playing.
• Finish chapters and collect stamps for your album.

WITH FRIENDS
• Add friends with an invite link and compare daily times.
• Send duels, start a club and race on the weekly leaderboard.
• Draw your own nonogram and share it with a link.

COMFORTABLE FOR EVERYONE
• Large text, colour-blind friendly colours and dark theme.
• Relaxed mode with no timer and no stamp penalty.
• Plays offline; your progress is saved to the cloud.

Five minutes a day, good for your mind. Download Enigral, your first puzzle is waiting.

name: ÉquiAllure-Équitation & Haras
description: ÉquiAllure est votre compagnon équestre complet conçu pour les cavaliers passionnés de dressage, de saut et de sorties en extérieur. Tenez votre carnet de selle personnel, suivez vos objectifs hebdomadaires et vérifiez votre liste de contrôle avant chaque séance. Explorez le plan interactif du manège, réglez la régularité du pas, du trot et du galop avec le métronome des allures et calculez facilement vos foulées entre deux obstacles. Consultez le suivi de maréchalerie, révisez vos fiches théoriques et découvrez des centres équestres en France pour progresser sereinement avec votre cheval au quotidien.

name: EraTap: Idle Dynasty & History
description:
Tap, build and lead one nation through 12,000 years of history.

EraTap is a calm, historical idle game. Every tap and every building moves your realm's calendar forward — from the carved pillars of Göbeklitepe to steam engines, railways and the Space Age. Real dynasties rise as you prosper, each with its own emblem and bonus.

FOURTEEN NATIONS, SEVEN ERAS
• Begin in your own heritage: Anatolian & Turkic, Egypt, Japan, Rome, China, Britain, Persia, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, Brazil, Korea or Indonesia
• Seven eras, from the Stone Age to the Information & Space Age
• 96 historical dynasties to earn as milestones

RULE WITH WISDOM
• The Royal Council brings 294 historical decisions — fund an observatory, host a harvest feast or barter obsidian for grain
• Research 22 technologies and hire 45 advisors from history
• Excavate 99 relics for your museum
• Catch the golden caravan, issue royal decrees and ride the fever

GROW, THEN BEGIN AGAIN
• Complete a nation's chronicle, then start a new one with Legacy points
• A 19-perk legacy tree makes every new nation faster
• Earn renown stars by completing nations again — 70 to collect
• Offline earnings keep your realm working while you are away

PLAYS FAIR
• No forced ads, no paywalls
• No subscriptions or energy timers
• Available in 14 languages

Your chronicle awaits.

name: Escapies: Arrow Puzzle Escape
description:
Can you free every arrow?

Escapies is a cozy brain teaser with one simple rule: every arrow flies the way it points. Tap an arrow with a clear path and watch it zoom off the board. Tap the wrong one and it bonks into a neighbor. Find the right order, clear the board and feel your brain light up.

Easy to learn, surprisingly deep and made for "just one more level".

◆ 200 LEVELS, 10 BEAUTIFUL WORLDS
Travel from Meadow Valley through the Stone Quarry, the Glacier, Night City, Coral Bay, the Volcano, the Cloud Kingdom, the Crystal Cave and the Desert Star all the way to Outer Space. Every world has its own scenery and its own relaxing soundtrack.

◆ CLIMB THE WORLD LEADERBOARD
Every star counts. Compete with players around the globe, see how you rank in your own country and challenge your friends to beat your score with one tap.

◆ NEW TWISTS AS YOU GO
Mirrors bend an arrow's path by 90°. Rocks never move. Frozen arrows stay stuck until a neighbor escapes. Hard levels give you fewer mistakes but double the rewards.

◆ A FRESH PUZZLE EVERY TRY
Restart a level and you get a brand-new layout with the same challenge, so every attempt feels new.

◆ SMART BOOSTERS
Hint shows a safe move, Hammer removes any arrow, Shield forgives a crash and the new Swap trades the places of two arrows. You get one free Swap in every level.

◆ STREAKS, CHESTS AND DAILY REWARDS
Win in a row to earn free boosters, fill your star chest and come back every day for login gifts and a new Daily Puzzle.

◆ CUTE CHARACTERS TO COLLECT
Dress your arrows in Classic, Neon, Candy and Gold looks.

◆ BEAT THE CLOCK
From level 11 every board has a time limit that matches its difficulty. Running out of time? Grab +30 seconds and keep going. Quick levels fit any break, and you can even play offline.

Escapies is free to play. It contains ads and offers optional in-app purchases. Escapies Pro removes ads between levels and gives you 5 lives instead of 3 that refill twice as fast.

Questions or ideas? Write to escapiesgame@gmail.com

name: Espacio Imagine SPA
description:
Espacio Imagine es un estudio de pilates con cuatro sedes en Santiago: Salvador y Batlle y Ordóñez en Ñuñoa, San Miguel y La Florida. Con esta app reservas tus clases en la sede que te quede más cerca, con un solo plan para todas.

Elige entre Pilates Reformer, Wall Unit, Barre & Chair, Matwork, TRX, Care Pilates y Pilates para embarazadas, o súmate a las clases online por Zoom cuando no alcances a llegar al estudio.

Revisa la grilla de cada sede por día, mira qué instructora dicta cada clase y cuántos cupos quedan, y reserva o cancela desde el teléfono. En tu perfil ves las clases que te quedan del plan y tus próximas reservas en Espacio Imagine.

name: EV Charge Timer: Charging Time
description:
Know exactly when your electric car will be charged, and get an alarm when it's ready.

EV Charge Timer works out how long home charging takes for your car, your outlet and your charger. Many cars, especially plug-in hybrids, can't stop at a chosen battery level, so the app tells you when to unplug.

TWO WAYS TO PLAN
• Find time: enter your charger amps (or kW) and see when charging will finish.
• Find amps: pick when you need the car, and get the lowest charger setting that gets you there in time. Gentler on your battery and your home wiring.

MADE FOR REAL HOMES
• Pick your car from a list of popular electric cars and plug-in hybrids, or enter the battery size.
• Choose your portable charger or wall box so suggestions match the settings it really has.
• Your outlet voltage (110–240 V), charging losses, cold weather and the slowdown near full are all included.
• Type the power your car's screen shows, and the app corrects for your real home voltage.

COUNTDOWN AND ALARM
• Live countdown with the estimated battery level.
• A loud alarm at the finish time, even when the app is closed.
• Pause if you unplug, and enter the real level during charging to re-plan the rest.

GETS MORE ACCURATE
• After each charge, two quick questions teach the app how your car really charges.
• Calibrate This Car (optional): one full charge, a tap each time the car shows the next 10%. The app finds your car's real speed and where it slows down.

ALSO
• Charging cost with your electricity price (average prices for many countries built in).
• Quick Calculator for energy, time, power and amps.
• Up to 4 cars in My Cars.
• English, Arabic, German, Spanish, French and Chinese.

BATTERY HEALTH
• Note the level and odometer before and after drives and charges; the time is recorded for you.
• A report estimates your battery's usable capacity, how it changes over the months, and how it compares with typical ageing for its age.

PRIVATE
No account, no tracking. Your data stays on your phone.

Estimates only, not a battery diagnosis. Always check your car's display, and never set more amps than your outlet, cable and circuit are rated for. Don't use the app while driving.

name: Every Salah: Prayer Times
description:
Every Salah shows the prayer times on a calm, simple screen, reminds you of the prayers you choose and puts the next prayer on your Home Screen with a widget.

PRAYER TIMES
• In Türkiye, the times of the Presidency of Religious Affairs (Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı) are used; the app finds the nearest Diyanet place, or you can pick it yourself.
• In other countries, the times are calculated on your phone with the method you choose.
• The source of the times is always shown. When Diyanet data is not available, times are labeled as calculated.
• When your location changes, the times update automatically; you can also pick your city by hand.

REMINDERS
• Reminders you can turn on for each prayer, before the prayer or when it begins.
• Optional suhoor and iftar reminders during Ramadan.
• Reminders are scheduled on your phone. Your iOS notification settings, Focus modes and notification summary can affect how they are shown.

WIDGETS
• The next prayer and the time remaining, on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.

MORE
• Qibla compass.
• Hijri calendar, religious days and a Ramadan timetable.
• Makruh times and the duha time.

OPTIONAL TRACKING
• If you want, log the prayers you pray; each prayer has its own streak.
• Logging is never required. A day without a record does not mean a prayer was missed.
• Pause excused days without breaking a streak.
• Share a milestone or week card only if you choose to.

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no analytics or tracking.
• Your location, settings and records stay on your phone.
• The only download is the Diyanet prayer-time file, the same for everyone; your location is not sent.

Every Salah is not an official app of the Presidency of Religious Affairs. Place names: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

Support: destek@everysalah.com

name: Everyday Ledger
description:
Everyday Ledger gives you a place to record income and expenses, choose a category, and add a note. Create categories with your own names and icons, look up entries by date, and see where your money goes in monthly charts. Export your records as a CSV.

On iPhone Duo, unfold the screen to choose a category alongside the keypad and keep editing when you fold it again. On a paired Apple Watch, record income or expenses and check your five most recent entries. Your watch keeps a draft until your iPhone is reachable.

Choose English or Simplified Chinese in Profile. Your 30-day free trial starts on first use. Buy Lifetime Membership once, at any time during or after your trial. The trial ends without an automatic charge.

name: Evolve Advanced Log
description:
Built for lifters who know the basics and want to keep progressing.

Evolve Advanced Log tracks intensity techniques the way you actually do them. Each technique has its own logging screen, so a Drop Set, a 50 R&P or a Wave is recorded properly, not squeezed into plain sets and reps.

INTENSITY TECHNIQUES
Rep Range, SCES, 10 Seconds Pause, FEP, 50 R&P, Drop Set, Partials, Superset, 21s, Splitter, Isometric Hold and Wave, each with a short "How it works." Add your own techniques and evolve them as you go.

THE EVOLVE SPLIT
A seven-day routine: four days of Chest/Tri, Back/Bi, Shoulders/Forearms and Legs with your chosen intensity technique, then three Rep Range days. Or build your own routines.

SMART STARTING WEIGHTS
Suggested weights for each technique, worked out from your own history.

EASY TO READ IN THE GYM
Big, clear numbers for weight and reps, a rest timer, and bench angles or machine settings that each keep their own record. Kilograms or pounds.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking.

ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Pay once. No subscription, ever.

From the Evolve book series by Brian Royce.

name: Evolve Inventory App
description: The Evolve Inventory app is a powerful tool that helps you manage your Odoo inventory. It allows you to track inventory levels, create and manage orders, manage purchase orders, internal transfers, stock in, stock out, inventory adjustments, and vendors. It is integrated with the Odoo barcode scanner, so you can quickly and easily scan barcodes to add items to your inventory. The app can help you improve your inventory accuracy, reduce your inventory costs, and increase customer satisfaction.

name: Experimo
description:
Experimo is built for learning science by experimenting, not just reading. It starts with physics, and more subjects are on the way. Every topic has two parts: a note full of live drawings and a workshop that runs on real physics calculations. What you see is not an animation; it is the calculated behavior of the setup you built.

NOTES
• Notes that flow on squared paper: drawings move on the page and experiments happen right inside it.
• "Ask yourself" cards, short stories from the history of science, common mistakes.
• Tap any part of the topic's scene to learn its name and job; at the end, test yourself on the scene.

WORKSHOPS
• Build circuits: put a battery, a bulb and a resistor on the board, measure current and voltage, see why a short circuit is dangerous.
• Forces and motion: push a cart, start a fan, switch friction on and off, measure acceleration, find F = m·a from your own data.
• Simple machines, balance and torque, pressure, floating and sinking, heat, waves, sound and music, light and color, magnets, fields, the atomic nucleus, quantum, relativity and more.
• More than 1,700 ready-made experiments: open one, press Start, change it and try again.
• Measure, record it in your notebook, read the graph: compare the value you calculated with the value you measured.

CONTENT
• 42 physics topics, 400 note chapters, more than 1,000 quiz questions.
• Big enough for a whole class on a tablet or a smart board; the same content on a phone.

FREE AND PRO
• Every note of all 42 topics is free to read, with its on-page experiments.
• Six workshops are free too: Measuring, Simple Machines, Energy, Light and Lenses, Electricity, From Atoms to the Universe. In the other workshops the first experiment is open.
• Experimo Pro opens every workshop, experiment set, challenge and test area.
• Plans: 3 months, 6 months or 1 year, each with a 14-day free trial for new subscribers. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel it in your store account settings.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

For ages 13 and up; matches middle and high school physics, open to anyone who is curious.

Privacy Policy: https://m2sahin.gitlab.io/experimo/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://m2sahin.gitlab.io/experimo/terms.html
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Exposure Therapy: Photo Culler
description:
Your camera roll is full of photos you'll never look at again: blurry shots, near-duplicates, screenshots from 2019. Exposure Therapy helps you finally let them go, one month at a time.

BREAK UP WITH OLD PHOTOS
Pick a month and review old photos. Swipe up to break up with a photo you don't want.

SEE THE WHOLE STORY
A filmstrip under each photo shows the shots taken just before and after it, so you can keep the best of a burst and let the rest go.

NOTHING IS DELETED UNTIL YOU SAY SO
When you're done, review your ex-photos one last time before finalizing the breakup. Tap any photo to take it back. Hit Breakup when you're ready, and iOS asks you to confirm. Deleted photos go to Recently Deleted, where you can recover them for 30 days.

MORE THAN KEEP OR DELETE
• Heart a photo to add it to your Favorites
• File a photo straight into an album
• Undo any decision, even after closing the app
• Change your mind about photos from earlier sessions

BUILD A HABIT
• Set a daily goal to review 25, 50 or 100 photos
• See how much storage you've freed and how much of your library you've reviewed
• An optional daily reminder
• Month-by-month progress so you always know where you left off

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no servers, no analytics, no ads. Your photos never leave your iPhone, and the app collects no data at all.

name: EXT Weather
description:
EXT is weather for exteriors: the apps a crew flips between all day — radar, lightning and sun tracking — plus the flight paths over your set, in one app built for production.

LIGHTNING, THE WAY SAFETY PLANS ARE WRITTEN
• Live strikes from NOAA's GOES lightning satellites, on the map within a minute or two (North and South America).
• The CSATF Safety Bulletin #38A rings — advise cast and crew at 20 miles, stop elevated work at 10, shelter at 6 — with the all-clear countdown that restarts on every new strike inside the ring. Your production sets the distances.
• Storm motion in minutes, not just miles: "at 10 mi in about 9 min."
• Alerts that reach your phone with the app closed, plus the all-clear.
• If the feed is behind or a place is outside satellite coverage, EXT says so. A quiet map is never called clear without a live feed.

A FORECAST YOU CAN CHECK
• Every major forecast model that covers your location — 11 over the US from 8 national agencies including NOAA, ECMWF and Environment Canada, up to 13 in Europe — blended by how well each one has actually done against real weather stations.
• The nearest weather station corrects the next 12 hours as the day goes.
• Where the models agree and where they don't, in plain English: "Rain likely from about 2p — 10 of 11 models agree."
• NOAA's severe-storm outlook for US locations.
• Live radar loop, labelled with its real age, with a short-range future view and storm motion.

THE SHOOT DAY
• Save your locations and set tomorrow's call, wrap and company moves; EXT follows the location and frames the day on your call-to-wrap hours.
• A paste-ready call-sheet weather block, and a weather card picture for the group text.
• Tides near the coast, from the nearest NOAA station.

LIGHT AND SOUND
• Golden hour countdown and how good the light will look, from the cloud layers.
• Sun Cam: the sun's path over your camera view and the real horizon.
• Flight paths: which airport approaches and departures cross your location, which way the wind has the runways running hour by hour, and roughly how loud each pass will be. Estimated from runways and airport weather reports, not live flight tracking.
• Wind for rigging: gust limits for overheads and lifts.

BUILT FOR SET
• High-contrast outdoor mode for direct sun.
• No account, no ads, no tracking.

EXT is a second pair of eyes, not your safety plan. Weather and lightning data come from public sources and can be delayed or incomplete; your production's safety department makes the call.

name: EXTRA 95.8 Corfu
description:
Corfu's Favorite Music Radio.

Listen live to EXTRA 95.8 from Corfu, see what's playing and which show is on air, and keep control from your lock screen, headphones or car. The stream keeps playing with the screen locked. Missed a show? Catch the last 14 days on demand, browse by programme or search by date.

What's inside:

Live radio
Now playing, the show on air, what's up next and the tracks that just played — with cover art and song info.

Schedule & On Demand
The weekly programme and the voices behind the mic. Replay full shows whenever you like.

News
Music, Corfu stories, cinema, tech and offbeat news.

What's on in Corfu
Going out, food and drink, cinema and theatre, concerts and the arts. Open an event for times, the venue map and directions.

KIIS2WIN
All the station's contests in one place. Enter from the app.

Corfu, at a glance
Weather now, hour by hour and for 7 days. Sea temperature, waves, wind and UV at the beaches of Corfu Town, Sidari, Paleokastritsa and Kavos. Name days, and useful local info: pharmacies on duty, emergency numbers, flights, ferries and buses.

Stay in touch
Send a message straight to the studio, call us, email us, or see our posts on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

The app is available in Greek and English, with a light or dark theme.

EXTRA 95.8 — Corfu's Favorite Music Radio

name: Facet: Focus Crystal Timer
description:
Facet is a gentle focus timer for people whose attention likes to wander. No pressure, no streaks to lose.

Pick a length, tap Start, and a one-of-a-kind crystal begins to grow on screen. The longer you focus, the more intricate it becomes. Stopping early is completely fine: the crystal simply stays as far as it grew, and it still counts.

• One-tap start with your last settings remembered
• Four crystal styles: Crystal, Bloom, Constellation, Lattice
• Lengths from a 2-minute try-it to 50 minutes
• A calm two-minute reset game for your breaks: sort soft shapes while you breathe
• Today view with every crystal you grew and a 7-day bar chart
• Save your crystal as an image or a short timelapse video to share
• Soft sounds you can switch off, and Reduce Motion is respected
• Private by design: no account, no ads, no trackers. Everything stays on your device.

Designed with ADHD brains in mind. Facet is a focus tool, not a medical product.

name: FactoryPlanet
description:
Начни с кирки и нескольких кусков руды. Построй первую печь, запусти конвейер и преврати небольшую базу в фабрику, которая работает сама.

ДОБЫВАЙ И ПРОИЗВОДИ
Исследуй карту, добывай ресурсы и перерабатывай их в детали. Соединяй печи, сборщики и склады конвейерами и манипуляторами. Когда производство вырастет, проложи железную дорогу и настрой маршруты поездов.

ПРОЕКТИРУЙ СВОЮ ФАБРИКУ
Выбирай, где разместить станки, как подвести электричество и куда направить материалы. Заглядывай в статистику производства, чтобы находить узкие места. Сохраняй удачные схемы в чертежах и используй их снова.

ГОТОВЬСЯ К ЗАПУСКУ
Открывай технологии, осваивай переработку нефти и собирай детали для ракеты. После запуска отправляйся на следующую планету и создавай новую фабрику с бонусом к скорости производства.

ИГРАЙ В СВОЁМ ТЕМПЕ
Подсказки помогут освоить первые производственные цепочки. Веди несколько игр с отдельными сохранениями и забирай накопленную продукцию после возвращения. Дополнительные бонусы можно получить за добровольный просмотр рекламы, когда она доступна.

name: Fahrschule B. Witte & Sohn
description: Die App der Fahrschule B. Witte & Sohn informiert über den Erste-Hilfe-Kurs in Cloppenburg. Sie zeigt Kursinhalte wie Reanimation, stabile Seitenlage und Wundversorgung sowie Angaben zu Abschluss, Gültigkeit und Zielgruppen. Telefonnummern und E-Mail-Adresse erleichtern die Kontaktaufnahme zur Anmeldung – auch ohne laufende Fahrausbildung.

name: Fair Slice!
description:
You cut it fair. So why are they fighting?

Cakes, pizzas, watermelons, steaks: find the one line that makes every picky sibling happy.

- Just swipe to cut. But the siblings have demands: strawberries for him, chocolate for her, don't cut the candles, the rose goes to her whole.
- Insight beats precision. "Any line through the middle splits it in half." "An L is two rectangles." Spot the trick and the hard ones fall apart. Every answer is checked to leave room for real fingers.
- Big Family mode: 3 to 13 people, many cuts. Pets get half a share. Some days there are two cakes.
- Daily Cake: one official try a day, timed, with an emoji result to share.
- Kids mode: Japanese hiragana with bar charts instead of percentages.

Free: the Cake pack, the first 6 Big Family stages (ending with the 5-way split), and the Daily Cake.
Unlock everything once for $2.99: every food pack, all Big Family stages, and Endless (101 puzzles plus Endless). No ads. Family Sharing supported.

name: Fairway Cup: Golf Tournaments
description:
Fairway Cup is the golf championship for you and your friends, with a real live leaderboard.

SET UP YOUR CHAMPIONSHIP IN A MINUTE
• A single round, or a season scored with points or best rounds.
• Gross or net leaderboard: handicap strokes come from each player's index, prorated to the holes played.
• Ties broken like in competition: last 9, 6, 3 holes, then the last hole.
• Find your club among the known courses, or create the scorecard in a minute.

EACH GROUP ENTERS ITS SCORES
• Send a link or a QR code: each marker picks their group and enters strokes hole by hole.
• No signal on the course? Scores are kept and sent when the network comes back.
• Optional: fairways, greens in regulation, putts, bunkers and penalties.

EVERYONE FOLLOWS LIVE
• Gross and net leaderboard updated after every hole, highlights (birdies, eagles), stats leaders.
• Each player's scorecard, shareable as an image.
• Notifications: round start, birdies and better, podium.

ORGANISE WITHOUT THE HASSLE
• The championship's player list with their usual handicap.
• Sign-up link: players register for a planned round or for the championship.
• Co-organisers, random draw of groups, results export as a spreadsheet.

YOUR OWN STATS
• Enter your own rounds too, official or casual, and track your progress over 30 days, 3 months or 12 months: scoring average, greens, fairways, putts, scrambling.
• Your records: best round, birdies, par streak, holes in one.
• Sign in with Apple, no password.

SHAPE WHAT COMES NEXT
Vote for upcoming features and suggest your own ideas.

Free: just sign in with Apple. Fairway Cup is available in 10 languages.

name: FaiSpazio: Free Up Storage
description:
FaiSpazio is Italian for "make room". That's the whole idea, with one rule: only count the room you really made.

Your phone is full and you don't know what to remove. FaiSpazio shows where your storage goes, helps you free it safely and tells you when it will be full again. Everything happens on your phone, with no account.

THE TANK
Your screen becomes a tank filled to the real percentage, in layers: photos, videos and the rest. Tilt the phone and the liquid moves. When you free space, the level drops. You see it at first launch, before granting any permission.

THE HONEST COUNTER
When you delete a photo on iPhone, it goes to Recently Deleted and still takes up space. FaiSpazio measures free space before and after, and keeps "really freed" apart from "still in the bin". Then it walks you through emptying it, if you want. Estimates always say "about".

THE FORECAST
"At this pace you'll be full in about 23 days." The forecast works from the first launch, because it rebuilds your growth from your library. It also tells you how many days the suggested actions buy you.

WHAT IT FINDS
• Exact duplicates and similar photos, with the best one already picked (change it with a tap)
• Bursts, old screenshots, screen recordings
• Large videos, to delete or to shrink
• Blurry, shaky or dark photos
• Live Photos to turn into stills
• "Good morning" greetings and memes from chats
• Photographed documents and receipts

SHRINK INSTEAD OF DELETE
A large video can stay, just lighter. FaiSpazio re-encodes it in HEVC with an estimate of the saving and a side-by-side preview. Date, place and favourite stay. The original goes to the bin only after the new video has been saved and checked again.

CAREFUL
• Nothing is deleted without your summary and the iOS confirmation
• Never preselected: favourites, edited photos, the best of each group, the last 7 days
• Everything goes through Recently Deleted: 30 days to change your mind
• Review by groups or one photo at a time in the deck, with undo always at hand

WHAT IT DOESN'T DO
FaiSpazio frees storage, nothing else. On iPhone no app can touch system data, messages or other apps' caches: in the tank that part is "not visible to apps", with no made-up numbers. The full list is at neurafit.it/faispazio/en.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no analytics. Analysis runs on your phone and your photos never leave it.

ALSO
• Widget with free space and forecast
• One optional alert, at most once a week, only below the threshold you choose
• A shareable report with the GB you freed and the greetings found, without any photo
• Dark and light themes, large text, reduced motion when you ask for it

FREE AND PRO
Free: tank, full scan with counts and GB, forecast, cleaning screenshots and exact duplicates, one deck session a day.
Pro: every category, Shrink, widget, report and unlimited deck. Monthly, yearly or once, for good. No weekly plan. You see the price after the scan, next to the GB you can free.

FaiSpazio is made in Italy by NEURAFIT.

Privacy: https://www.neurafit.it/faispazio/en/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: FaithActs
description:
Live out your Christian faith, one act at a time.

FaithActs is a calm place to put your faith into action. Each day it offers you one Faith Moment: a single act of faith you could do today. Pray for someone you have not prayed for in a long time. Forgive. Encourage. Serve. It is an invitation, never a task, and there is no score, no streak and no guilt on a day you leave it.

A FAITH MOMENT, EVERY DAY Open the app and there is one star, the words Faith Moment and a button to reveal it. Choose "I'll try this" or "Maybe another time". Say yes and a verse comes with it. Change how often you are invited in Settings, and switch the gentle reminder off in one tap.

A CALM HOME Your Faith Moment first. Then a verse to carry through the day, encouraging words from friends, friends' prayer requests (with a private "I'm praying"), and the events you are going to. Nothing on Home is counted, ranked or liked.

LITTLE SEEDS A short word to pass on to someone, every day, through your phone's own share sheet.

MY WALK: A PRIVATE RECORD OF YOUR LIFE WITH GOD A journal for reflections, prayers and lessons. Framed Moments for the memories you keep on purpose. Testimonies in your own words. A Vault to seal a letter to yourself until a day you choose. Quick notes, and a timeline of your whole story. Your journal, notes and Vault are private: not your friends, not your church, not FaithActs staff, unless you choose to send a copy of a note to a friend. My Walk is never a score.

PRAYER AND ENCOURAGEMENT, IN A SMALL CIRCLE Ask for prayer and share testimonies with the friends you choose. There are no public feeds, no likes, no advertising and no chat. You can also send a copy of a note, such as your sermon notes, to a connected friend.

YOUR CHURCH, IN YOUR POCKET Join your church in the app: see what is on, serve on teams and rotas, answer events, and give. Where your church has My Church Walk, you will find practical Church Acts, such as staying for a cup of tea or saying hello to someone new, to help you belong at your own pace. A church sees that you belong, not your faith life.

KINGDOM ACTS Find a church, events and people, and ways to take part in what God is doing beyond your own church.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT FaithActs never sells your information and shows no advertising. What you share, you choose. You can delete your account from inside the app whenever you like.

FaithActs is for people aged 13 and over.

name: Famistify Ebeveyn
description:
Famistify Ebeveyn, ailenin görev ve ödül düzenini telefondan yönettiğin ebeveyn panelidir. Çocuğunun telefonunda "Famistify" çocuk uygulaması olmalıdır; Ebeveyn uygulaması çocuk uygulamasıyla birlikte çalışır.

EBEVEYN OLARAK NELER YAPARSIN?
• Görev ve ödül tanımla: ev işleri, okul görevleri ve günlük rutinleri puanlı görevlere çevir; sinema gecesi, dondurma, ek oyun süresi gibi ödülleri çocuğunla birlikte belirle.
• Onay kuyruğu: çocuğunun tamamladığı görevleri tek ekranda gör, onayla ya da kibarca geri gönder.
• Kanıt fotoğrafları: görev kanıtı olarak çocuğunun gönderdiği fotoğrafları yalnızca sen görürsün.
• Haftalık yarışmalar ve aile hedefi: kardeşler ya da aile arasında dostça bir lig kur, ortak aile hedefine birlikte yaklaşın.
• Çocuk cihazını kodla bağla: çocuğunu ekle, aile kodunu çocuğunun telefonuna gir; eşleşme birkaç adımda tamamlanır.
• Ekran süresi kuralları: günlük süre ve kilit kurallarını belirle, çocuğun görev yaparak ek süre kazanmasına izin ver.
• Bildirimler: onay bekleyen görevlerden ve önemli gelişmelerden haberdar ol.

FAMISTIFY PLUS
Ücretsiz plan temel özelliklerin hepsini içerir. Famistify Plus ile daha fazla çocuk, ebeveyn ve yarışma ekleyebilirsin. Plus, Apple uygulama içi satın alma ile aylık ya da yıllık otomatik yenilenen abonelik olarak sunulur; ödeme Apple Kimliği hesabından alınır. Abonelik, dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmedikçe otomatik yenilenir. Aboneliğini Ayarlar > Apple Kimliği > Abonelikler bölümünden yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsin. Satın alımları Plus sayfasındaki "Satın alımları geri yükle" düğmesiyle geri yükleyebilirsin.

GİZLİLİK VE GÜVEN
• Reklam yok, izleyici yok.
• Çocuğun verisi satılmaz ve reklam amaçlı kullanılmaz.
• Famistify çocuğun mesajlarını, konumunu ya da neye baktığını görmez.
• KVKK'ya uygun tasarlandı; verilerin silinmesini panelden isteyebilirsin.
• Gizlilik politikası: famistify.fun/gizlilik
• Kullanım koşulları: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Famistify, aile içinde güven ve sorumluluk duygusunu büyütmek için tasarlandı: puanları çocuk kazanır, çocuk harcar; kurallar açık ve herkes tarafından bilinir.

Sorular ve destek için: famistify.fun

name: FARE METER
description:
FARE METER is an independent GPS fare estimator that uses the rates you set. Estimate the cost of a drive before you leave, then see how distance and elapsed time affect the total as you go.

Track your fare live
Start the meter to measure GPS distance and elapsed time, including time spent stopped in traffic. Pause and resume when needed, and add tolls or other extras to the trip total.

Set your own rates
Choose your currency and miles or kilometers. Enter a starting fare, a distance rate, a per-minute rate, and a minimum fare.

Estimate a trip before driving
Enter a destination to get a fare estimate based on Apple Maps driving distance and expected travel time. Open directions in Google Maps when you’re ready to go.

Save and share trip summaries
Review completed trips with their estimated fare, distance, and duration. Trip summaries are stored on your device and can be shared from the app.

Find nearby food stops with The Peach
Browse breakfast, lunch, dinner, and quick food options near you or in an area you choose. Get directions or use a food stop as your next fare estimate destination.

FARE METER provides estimates for planning and recordkeeping. It does not book rides or process payments.

name: Fast Cleaner - AI Scan
description:
Clean your Phone by talking to it.

Tap Ask and say what you want gone. Fast Cleaner turns your words into a scan, searches your photo library and shows what it found. No menus to dig through. You review the results, and iOS asks you to confirm before any photo or video is deleted.

TRY SAYING
• "Delete screenshots older than 6 months"
• "Find my blurry photos"
• "Show duplicate photos"
• "Videos over 500 MB"
• "Clean up my phone"

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap Ask and speak. It stops by itself when you finish.
2. The scan starts on its own, for the items, age and size you asked for.
3. Check the results and choose what to remove.

Prefer to type? The same requests work from the keyboard.

YOUR VOICE OPENS THE TOOLS TOO
• "Merge duplicate contacts" opens Contacts
• "Compress my videos" opens Compress Videos
• "Remove old calendar events" opens Calendar

MORE WAYS TO CLEAN
• Smart Clean: one tap to look for screenshots, similar shots, blurry photos and large videos
• Swipe Review: go month by month, left to delete, right to keep
• Compress Videos: keep a smaller copy
• Contacts: merge duplicates, with a backup saved first
• Calendar: remove old events that you select
• Secret Vault: private photos and videos behind Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
• Storage and battery widgets, plus a charging animation

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The microphone is on only while you speak a request
• Photos are checked on your iPhone and never uploaded
• Deleted photos and videos stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days
• No account, no ads, no tracking

GOOD TO KNOW
Speech becomes text with Apple's speech recognition, which may process audio on Apple's servers depending on your language and device. With Apple Intelligence, requests are understood on your iPhone. On other iPhones, use simple English words such as "screenshots" or "blurry photos".

FAST CLEANER PRO
Pro is available as a yearly or monthly subscription, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. The one-time purchase does not renew.

Terms of Use : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://fastcleaner-aiscan.pages.dev/privacy/

name: Fast o'Clock – Fasting Tracker
description:
Fast o'Clock is your simple companion for intermittent fasting. No account, no sign-up, no clutter: open the app, start your fast, done.

START YOUR FAST, SEE YOUR GOAL
• Pick a fasting goal like 16:8, 18:6 or 20:4, or set your own duration.
• The timer shows how long you have been fasting and how much is left.
• Forgot to start? Simply adjust the start time afterwards.

YOUR STREAK KEEPS YOU GOING
• See your current and your best streak at a glance.
• For custom durations you choose in the settings from how many hours a fast counts.

WEIGHT AND FASTING SIDE BY SIDE
• Fast o'Clock reads your weight from Apple Health and shows it in clear statistics.
• See how your fasting relates to your weight.

HOME SCREEN WIDGET
• Keep an eye on your timer without opening the app.

NO ACCOUNT, YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• All fasting data is stored only on your device.

AD-FREE
• Fast o'Clock is free and shows unobtrusive ads.
• Remove the ads for good with a one-time purchase.

Note: Fast o'Clock is not a medical app and does not replace medical advice. If you have health conditions, are pregnant or take medication, talk to your doctor before fasting.

name: FECG Miesau
description:
FECG Miesau – die App unserer Gemeinde.

Für alle Besucher:
• Unsere Gottesdienstzeiten am Sonntag auf einen Blick
• Ein Bibelvers zum Mitnehmen

Für Gemeindemitglieder nach der Anmeldung:
• Aufnahmen der Gottesdienste und Lieder anhören
• Termine und Wochenplan der Gemeinde
• Ankündigungen und Mitteilungen
• Support-Chat bei Fragen

Neue Mitglieder registrieren sich direkt in der App. Die Gemeindeleitung prüft den Antrag und schaltet das Konto frei.

name: Fernhum: Sleep & Focus
description:
Sound for sleep, focus and quiet moments.

Fernhum plays timed sound sessions that change as they go. Fall Asleep starts relaxed and slows down step by step. Deep Work eases you in, then holds steady through real focus blocks and breaks. Pick a session, choose how long, and press play.

SESSIONS WITH A GOAL
• Fall Asleep: slows down step by step as you drift off. Choose 20, 30 or 45 minutes.
• Power Nap: a short rest, then a gentle lift back up with birdsong and a chime.
• Deep Work: focus blocks with real breaks.
• Wind Down: leave the workday behind and move from alert to calm.
• Calm Before: a few minutes of paced breathing before an exam, interview or big meeting.
• Morning Wake-Up: starts soft and builds to bright, alert energy.
• Meditate: a soft drone and a slow, steady rhythm, with a bell to begin and end.

YOUR OWN MIX
Set the balance of tones, noise and backgrounds like rain, surf, a stream, wind, birdsong or a fire.

QUICK TONES
One steady tone for a minute: a simple listening break between sessions.

PLAN AHEAD
Schedule any session for later, like Fall Asleep at bedtime or Deep Work at 9.

PLAYS IN THE BACKGROUND
Sound keeps playing with the screen locked, and every session ends gently.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Everything stays on your phone. Works offline.

SUBSCRIPTION
Fernhum is a paid app. Choose a yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, or a monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your App Store account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your account settings.

Fernhum is for general wellness. It is not a medical device.

Terms of Use: https://altivia.fi/fernhum/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://altivia.fi/fernhum/privacy/

name: FernKoiGate
description:
Guide a glowing koi around a moonlit pond, swim through paper lanterns and dodge drifting lily pads – all with a single tap.

FernKoiGate is a calm-looking, quick-thinking arcade game set in a Japanese night garden. Your koi circles the moon-pond ring on its own. Tap anywhere to flip its direction, line up the next lantern gate and turn away before a lily pad or stone settles in your path. Every lantern quickens the current, so each run builds from peaceful to thrilling.

ONE TAP, ENDLESS FLOW
• Tap to reverse – that is the whole control scheme
• Paper lanterns give points, golden lanterns give bonus points and coins
• Lily pads and stones blink before they settle, so every splash is fair
• Speed and lantern count rise as your score grows

THREE WAYS TO SWIM
• Classic – an endless run that chases your best score
• 32 Pond Levels across four chapters, from Fern Shallows to Koi Shrine, each with a lantern goal and up to 3 stars for fast clears
• Daily Challenge – one hand-seeded pond for everyone, new every day at 00:00 UTC, with its own leaderboard

GOALS EVERY DAY
• 18 Missions with progress bars and coin rewards
• Moon Gifts – a 7-day calendar of daily coin rewards
• Pond Journal stats: runs, lanterns passed, golden lanterns, stars, time on the pond

COLLECT YOUR KOI
• 10 koi patterns in the Koi Locker – Kohaku, Bekko, Tancho, Sakura, Showa, Kujaku, Ogon, Asagi, Midnight and Moonlight
• Still Water boost for a calmer first 20 seconds
• Continue once after a splash

COMPETE QUIETLY
• Online leaderboards for Classic, Daily and Stars, all-time and today
• Anonymous pond nickname you can edit at any time, no account or login
• Cloud save keeps your progress safe

MAKE IT YOURS
• Set a Pond Keeper portrait with your camera or photo library
• Record a short victory cheer that plays on a new best
• Save a score card image to your Photos

A NIGHT GARDEN FOR YOUR EARS
Original water-droplet effects, koto-like plucked notes in a pentatonic scale and a soft wind-chime ambience – every sound was synthesized for this game.

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
No ads. Everything can be earned by playing: lanterns, missions, levels and daily gifts all give coins. Optional coin packs are available in the Shop for players who want to unlock koi sooner. Delete my data in Settings erases your progress on the device and on our server at any time.

name: FerrePOS Almacén
description:
FerrePOS Almacén ayuda a tu equipo a realizar operaciones de almacén desde un iPhone o iPad conectado a FerrePOS.

Registra entradas y salidas de mercancía, consulta órdenes y surte pedidos. Busca productos por código o usa la cámara para leer códigos compatibles.

Con FerrePOS Almacén puedes:

• Registrar entradas y salidas de productos con la cantidad y el motivo correspondiente.
• Consultar órdenes y registrar el surtido de sus productos.
• Acomodar mercancía en estantes y consultar productos pendientes de acomodo.
• Realizar y continuar conteos de inventario por ubicación.
• Leer códigos de productos y etiquetas de ubicación con la cámara o capturarlos mediante teclado.

Necesitas una cuenta de FerrePOS con acceso a una sucursal y permisos de almacén. La disponibilidad de las funciones depende del rol y de la configuración de tu negocio. Algunas operaciones requieren conexión a internet y los ajustes de inventario están sujetos a los permisos correspondientes.

name: Ferrolo: TCG Card Scanner
description:
Ferrolo reads a trading card with your camera, finds the exact print and shows its market price. Add it to your collection and your total value updates every day.

SCAN OR CHECK A PRICE
- Hold a card under the camera. Ferrolo reads the printed name and number on your iPhone
- Price check mode for the card shop or trade night: 10 seconds, no saving
- Add mode with a session tray, so you can sort a whole binder fast
- No camera? Search by name, or pick a photo
- Works with Pokemon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana and One Piece cards

THE EXACT PRINT, THE RIGHT PRICE
- Pick the printing (normal, holofoil, reverse holofoil, 1st edition) and the condition from NM to DMG
- See how far apart the prints are before you add
- Market prices in US dollars from free public card catalogs, with the source named on every price

YOUR COLLECTION
- Stash home: total value, change since yesterday, your biggest movers
- Binders, a wishlist, grid and list views, sort by value, set or name
- Graded cards, notes, and a value you set yourself
- Set progress: see how many cards you need to finish a set
- Home Screen widget with your collection value

TOOLS FOR COLLECTORS
- Pack log: scan what you pulled, see if the pack was worth it, share the result
- Trade check: add both sides of a trade and see the difference
- CSV import and export
- Add a custom item, like a sealed box, with your own value

FERROLO PRO (one time purchase, no subscription)
- Unlimited binders
- Full value history for your collection and each card
- Purchase price and profit on every card
- Trade check
Scanning, price checks, sets, pack log, CSV and the widget stay free.

Works offline: scans wait in a queue and get priced when you are back online. Your collection syncs through your private iCloud. No ads, no account, no tracking.

Prices are estimates from public data and may differ from what a buyer pays. Ferrolo is not affiliated with or endorsed by any card game publisher. All game names belong to their owners.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Ferry Tale: Boat Jam Puzzle
description:
Ferry Tale is a cozy boat jam puzzle and a voyage around the world.

Every harbour is packed with colourful boats. Tap a boat and it sails straight out along its arrow to a free berth. Little animal travellers walk along the pier and board the boat of their colour. Fill a boat and it sets off to sea. Plan your moves so the berths never fill up with the wrong colours!

• 1 000 levels across 100 ports, from the Aegean and the Caribbean to the Norwegian fjords, East Asia and the Pacific
• Tides that rise and fall every few moves, hiding and revealing sandbars
• Rocks, bridges, currents and more harbour surprises along the way
• Helpful boosters: Whistle, Tide Turn, Tug, Rewind and Spyglass
• Collect a postcard from every port and grow your Home Port
• Lantern festivals, a new harbour every day and daily gifts
• No timer, no rush: think it through and sail at your own pace
• Plays offline, in 16 languages

Every level can be solved without boosters. Can you clear the harbour?

name: Fever Memo - Temp & Meds Log
description:
For the days someone in your family has a fever. Log temperatures, medicines and symptoms for your family (including children) in seconds and see how things are going on a chart, in a soft, simple design. Made for parents and caregivers.

• Temperature in two taps
Tap "Temp", then tap the reading. The date and time are filled in for you and can be changed later.

• A chart of real readings
Every reading is plotted as measured — nothing is averaged. Fever reducers and other medicines appear as markers on the same timeline. Switch between 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days or "this illness".

• Your own fever threshold
Set the temperature you want to watch (for example 37.5°C / 99.5°F). The chart draws a line and highlights readings above it.

• Medicines and "next dose"
Log fever reducers, antibiotics and more with one tap. If you enter the interval your doctor or pharmacist gave you, the app shows when that interval ends. The app never suggests doses or intervals.

• Symptoms, notes and photos
Cough, runny nose, vomiting, rash and more — plus notes and photos.

• Visit summary (free)
Highest temperature, medicine times and symptoms together with the chart. Show it at the doctor's, or share it as an image or text.

• Messages for daycare, school and work
Drafts built from what you logged. Copy and send.

• One profile per family member
Pick a cute illustrated icon or a photo for each person (up to 2 in the free version).

• Night-friendly
Large text, dark mode and big buttons within thumb reach. No ads while you are logging or right after you save.

• Your data stays on your device
No account. Nothing is uploaded. Settings shows when you last backed up, and you can export a backup to iCloud Drive or Files.

• Fever Memo Pro (one-time purchase — never per record)
No ads, 3+ profiles, PDF export of the visit summary.

Important: This app is a notebook for parents and caregivers. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or advise on medication. If you are worried about someone's health, contact a medical professional.

name: FF Member
description: FF Member adalah aplikasi untuk member yang bisa digunakan untuk melihat jadwal sesi latihannya.

name: Fiafia: Truth or Dare Night
description:
Truth or Dare the way it's played at a real party: one phone passed around the room, your friends' names on the cards and a little bit of nerve.

HOW TO PLAY
• Add 2 to 16 players.
• On your turn, choose Dare, Truth or Random. The card flips over: read it out loud.
• Done? +1 point. Refuse? Do a light forfeit, or play one of your 2 jokers.
• Some dares come with a 30 or 60 second timer.
• At the end of the night, awards: The bravest, Open book and Joker king.

7 DECKS × 80 CARDS
• Classic, Icebreaker, Friends & secrets, Parties & send-offs.
• For adults (18+): Couples, Spicy and Extreme dares. Suggestive, never vulgar. They ask you to confirm your age and you can hide them in Settings.
• Every deck in English, Italian, Spanish, French and German, written for each language, not translated word for word.
• Cards don't repeat until the deck runs out.

PLAY NICE
• Every dare is done right there in the room: no messages or photos to people outside the game.
• Anyone can say no: that's what forfeits and jokers are for.

WORKS OFFLINE
No internet, no account, no ads.

TRY FIRST, THEN CHOOSE
• Play one trial game with no purchase: one round each, at least 10 cards from the Classic deck.
• Then unlock every deck with "Forever", a one-time payment: no subscription, nothing to cancel.
• Or choose "One night": a one-time payment for all decks for 48 hours. It doesn't renew.
• With "One night" still active you can upgrade to "Forever" and pay only the difference.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account. "Restore purchases" is on the purchase screen and in Settings.

Terms: https://www.fiafia.games/en/termini/
Privacy: https://www.fiafia.games/en/privacy/
Help: support@fiafia.games

name: Fid Bury
description:
Fid Bury keeps each rope tail on this iPhone.

Drag the fid across the strand. A fid that comes out the far side buries the tail, and the bury length is how far it came out. A fid that stops inside the strand does not change the bury. A tail that is already buried is not tucked again.

Only a rope that is not buried can be deleted. Only a buried rope can be renamed. Share sends the name, the bury length, and whether the tail is buried.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Field Kit: Event Prep
description:
Field Kit is a pocket plan for field marketers, sales teams and their leaders at trade shows and conferences. Open it before an event and you know who to meet, when, and what to say.

The first time you open Field Kit it loads a made-up demo plan (HealthTech Summit, a small team, a dozen accounts: 38 matched, 12 new, $1.4M in pipeline), so you can try every screen straight away. Signing in is optional. All names, companies and numbers in the demo are invented.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Events
See each event with its cost, passes, and a projected pipeline. Open the plan to change reach, meeting and opportunity rates and watch the numbers move. Share any guide as a PDF.

My day
Every meeting in time order, who is attending, a one-line brief, and a notes field. Mark a no-show or cancel a meeting, and restore it if plans change.

Accounts
Sort accounts into P1, P2 and P3 with a swipe. Open an account for a brief, check items marked "Check me", and see email drafts ready for you to edit.

Schedule
A grid of hosts by half-hour. Tap a meeting, tap a free slot, and it moves. Field Kit stops a move if someone on your side is already in another meeting then.

Sales guide
Each meeting gets a guide made of swipeable index cards: why now, talking points, objections and answers, who is in the room. Tap a card to flip it.

Voice
Tap the round mic in the tab bar and ask about your plan, such as who to meet first or what is left to confirm. Voice is on-device only, and there is no typing. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence turned on, Apple's on-device model helps write the answer. On every other iPhone, Field Kit answers with built-in rules.

Search
Find an event, account or meeting from the search next to your Profile initials.

Profile and roles
Add your name and company, then choose My role: Field marketer, Sales or Leader. Your role changes what shows first. Signing in with Apple is optional. From Profile you can also delete your account, send feedback, report a problem, request a change, and open Help.

Calendar and alerts
If you choose, Field Kit adds your meetings to Calendar, keeps them in step when a meeting moves, and checks busy times so you are not double-booked. It asks only when you tap the button. You can also turn on a reminder 15 minutes before each meeting.

A PERSON ALWAYS CLICKS SEND
Field Kit writes email drafts for you. It never sends one by itself. Tap Send, your Mail app opens, and you decide.

LIGHT AND DARK
Both are supported, with text sized for easy reading and support for larger Dynamic Type.

Field Kit is an independent app from Super Nupur. It is not made by, endorsed by or connected to any employer, event organizer or technology company named by its users.

Questions: https://supernupur.com/fieldkit/support/

name: Filedrivo: Site Photo Reports
description:
Document a site visit from the first equipment photo to the final handover. Keep photos, observations and corrective actions together by project. Annotate a detail, check recognized text from an equipment plate, and attach before-and-after evidence.

Choose a report template, review the pages and export a PDF for the client. Work offline on iPhone or use the wider project workspace on iPad. No separate account is required.

Free includes two active projects and three finalized reports. Monthly, annual and lifetime Pro options unlock the same paid features, including unlimited local projects and reports.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Film Stop: Exposure
description:
Shooting film and not sure what settings a frame was taken at? A digital camera writes shutter speed, aperture and ISO into the file. Film does not.
