When a lab sends scans in a folder, the frame alone doesn't tell you how it was metered. And if a roll was shot over several months, the conditions are almost impossible to reconstruct.

Film Stop saves the shooting settings right on the photo.

How it works

Choose a film from the catalogue of 34 stocks. ISO is filled in automatically.
Or take a quick exposure reading without choosing a film, when you just need the scene's EV.
Set shutter speed, aperture and ISO, and adjust exposure if needed.
Save the photo with a label showing the film name, ISO, shutter speed, aperture, date and time. The shot is saved to the app's gallery, and you can add it to Photos.
Open any saved shot to see its settings, even months later.
Why it's convenient

No notebooks or spreadsheets needed: the settings are already on the photo.
When the lab returns the scans, just find the frame with the label and all the data is at hand.
Choosing a film removes manual ISO entry and the mistakes that come with it.
The quick reading works without choosing a film, if it isn't loaded yet or you're not sure of the catalogue.
Everything is stored on your device.

name: Final Solution ERP
description:
تطبيق Final Solution ERP هو رفيق نظام الحسابات والمبيعات Final Solution ERP على الموبايل، لصاحب الشغل وللمناديب.

للمندوب:
• عربية المندوب: بيع من مخزن العربية مباشرة، والفاتورة بتتسجل فى النظام فورًا.
• العملاء: كشف الحساب، الرصيد، وتسجيل الزيارة بمكانها.
• التحصيل: استلام نقدية من العميل وإيصال على طول.
• طباعة الفاتورة على طابعة بلوتوث صغيرة.
• مسح باركود الأصناف بالكاميرا.
• تقارير المندوب: مبيعاتى، المبيعات حسب الصنف والعميل، التحصيلات، وأرصدة العملاء.

لصاحب الشغل:
• مبيعات اليوم والشهر لحظة بلحظة.
• أرصدة الخزن والبنوك.
• المخزون والأصناف اللى قرّبت تخلص.
• العملاء والموردين وأرصدتهم.
• تنبيهات بالفواتير المتأخرة والأحداث المهمة.

التطبيق محتاج حساب على Final Solution ERP: ادخل بكود شركتك واسم المستخدم وكلمة المرور اللى مدير الشركة عاملهالك.

name: Find & Sort It
description: sortsort it

name: Firehosy
description:
The world, right now.

See what’s happening around the corner—and a world away.

Firehosy brings you fresh photos and short videos from everyday life, shared by real people. Discover a different side of your neighborhood, drop into life somewhere new, and show the world what you’re seeing.

TAKE A LOOK AROUND

Switch to Nearby to discover moments shared around you. See familiar places from a new angle, from a local gathering to the little things you usually walk past.

LET THE WORLD SURPRISE YOU

Explore the Everyone feed for photos and short videos from different places. A new street. A different routine. A view you didn’t expect.

PUT YOUR MOMENT OUT THERE

Snap a photo or record a video up to 60 seconds. Add a caption and a place, then share it with the world. Your everyday could be someone else’s new perspective.

Open Firehosy. See a little more of the world. Share a little of yours.

Nearby uses location with your permission. You choose the location shown on your posts. Available moments depend on what people share.

name: FireTower: Build & Burn
description:
Build a tower out of wooden sticks - and keep it standing.

Every stick has weight. Squares fold, triangles hold. Watch the load bars: green is fine, red is about to snap. Brace the weak spots before they give way.

Then the fire starts. Sticks catch fire one by one and burn through. Replace them, brace around them, or turn them to gold — golden sticks never burn and are three times stronger. The higher you build, the stronger the wind.

• Real physics: weight, load and wind on every stick
• Fire that spreads as you build higher
• Golden sticks at 5 m and every 7 m after
• Score: 10 points per metre, plus a bonus for every fire survived
• Sandbox mode: no fire, no wind, unlimited sticks
• Short hands-on tutorial
• Works offline, no account needed

name: Fishivo: Fishing App & Spots
description:
Fishivo is a fishing log, map and angler community in one app.

LOG YOUR CATCHES
• Share catches with photo, species, length, weight, bait, technique and gear
• Build up your catch history on your profile and personal map

SPOTS AND MAPS
• Save fishing spots on the map and explore spots from the community
• Marine and lake layers, coordinate entry and location tools
• Anchor alarm for boats: alerts you if your anchor drags

WEATHER
• Wind, temperature, pressure trend, UV, moon phase and solunar periods
• Sunrise and sunset for your location or your saved spots

SPECIES CATALOG
• Thousands of fish species with habitat, size and conservation info
• Species found in your country come first
• Real catches from the community under every species and technique

COMMUNITY
• Follow, like, comment and share stories, also with close friends only
• Direct messages with other anglers
• Your feed is ranked by the country, species and techniques you choose

FISHIVO PRO
Pro unlocks:
• Fish species recognition from a photo
• Private spots and private catches
• Waypoints
• 3D terrain, satellite and globe views
• Advanced stats: 90-day analytics, CSV export, profile visitors

Fishivo Pro is offered as monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://fishivo.com/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://fishivo.com/en/privacy

name: Five Gardens Mahjong
description:
Five ways to play Mahjong, in one beautiful moonlit garden, watched over by a nine-tailed white fox.

FIVE GAMES, ONE APP
• Hong Kong Classic: flowers and seasons, faan scoring.
• Taiwanese 16 Tiles: five sets and a pair, tai scoring.
• Japanese Riichi: riichi, dora, yaku and full point calculation.
• American Style: jokers, the Charleston and our own original Garden Card with 44 hands.
• Mahjong Solitaire: eight original layouts and a new daily board. Every deal can be cleared.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Against the computer, no internet needed: Easy, Medium or Hard.
• Quick Match: play with people from anywhere. Computer players fill empty seats.
• Private rooms: share a code, invite your friends, write to each other and talk with voice chat.
• Watch the walls being dealt, then drag your tiles into any order or sort them with one tap.
• On iPhone, iPad and Mac. Upright or sideways, with mouse and keyboard on Mac.
• In English, Vietnamese, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.

MADE TO BE A PLEASURE
• Fourteen tile sets, two of them free, each with its own look, sounds and effects: Red Dragon, Galaxy, Cherry Blossom, the Five Elements and more. Cosmetic only. When one player at an online table has a special set, everyone enjoys it.
• Choose an avatar or use your own photo.
• Clear rules, a tile guide, hints, large symbols and VoiceOver names for every tile.
• Pick up an unfinished match whenever you like.

FRIENDLY AND FAIR
• Just points and placings. No ads.
• Chat and voice chat only in private rooms, voice off until the host allows it, microphones always start muted. Quick Match uses ready-made phrases.
• Silence, report or block anyone at any time.
• Play as a guest. Signing in with Apple or Google is optional; voice chat asks for it. Delete your online account any time.

American Style uses our own Garden Rules and original card, and is not affiliated with any league.

name: Five Sparks: Tidebound
description:
The storm is rising. The Great Beacon has gone dark. Five keepers stand separated across the strata of a towering sea spire.

Five Sparks: Tidebound is a wordless, 15-chapter atmospheric 2.5D puzzle-platformer built around butterfly-effect switching. Drain a flooded shaft as the Diver to open the Foundry for the Gearwright, lure spotlights with the Lantern Keeper so the Shadow Sneaker slips past, and bend time with the Chronomancer until all five paths converge at the summit.

FIVE KEEPERS, FIVE DISTINCT ABILITIES
• Lantern Keeper (Lower Wharf): Solidify shadow bridges and reveal hidden memories with focused amber light.
• Gearwright (The Gearworks): Rewire copper circuits and power lifts, pumps, and generators.
• Shadow Sneaker (Air Ducts): Cloak in darkness, crawl through vents, and outmaneuver sweeping searchlights.
• Diver (Flooded Cistern): Swim freely in 360 degrees, manage oxygen pockets, and shatter cracked bulkheads.
• Chronomancer (Bell Spire): Slow time to slip past swinging pendulums and synchronize cathedral gears.

BUILT FOR iPHONE & iPAD
• 15 handcrafted chapters across 4 Acts, painted cinematic Epilog, and a True Ending unlocked by collecting all 15 Hidden Memories.
• 6 optional Lantern Room mastery challenges, plus Speedrun and Memory Hunt replay modes.
• Seamless One-Finger controls (Tap, Drag, Hold), Classic Touch buttons, and hardware keyboard support.
• 6 languages (EN, TR, ES, DE, FR, 简体中文), colorblind-friendly shape coding, 3-tier Amber Hint system, and real-time layered procedural music.
• 100% offline, zero ads, zero tracking, zero accounts required.

name: FiveClose Weeks
description:
A life of 85 years is about 4,420 weeks. Seen one by one they look like a lot. Seen as a grid they fit on one screen.

Type the year you were born and see your life as a grid of weeks: the ones already lived, and the ones ahead.

• Adjust your week: sleep, work, getting there, chores, screens, and time with family and friends share 168 hours. See how much free time is left, and how many of your weeks go to the people who matter most.
• Drag the age slider to see the same life at another age: a grandchild, a parent, yourself in 20 years.
• Your people: add someone with a name, their age and how often you meet, and see about how many meet-ups are left until the first of you turns 85.
• Works offline. No account needed, and nothing you type leaves your phone.
• Sign up free to keep your people in FiveClose: a nudge before someone drifts, and they'll know you're OK. Signed in, Weeks opens your own Your weeks, with the meet-ups left with each person.

A reflection, not a countdown. Made by FiveClose, the app that helps you stay close to the five people you'd most regret losing touch with.

name: Flare HQ
description:
Flare HQ is the owner app for businesses whose website was built by Flare Studios. Everything your website does for you, in your pocket.

Today: see who's coming in, what orders are waiting and how the day is going, the second you open the app.

- Calendar: tap any appointment to text, call, mark done or no-show
- Orders: see new shop orders and mark them picked up
- Stock: mark items sold out and they come off your website right away
- Rewards: find a customer and give a stamp or a free reward
- Money & goals: set a monthly goal, watch the ring fill, unlock achievements
- Alerts the moment a customer books, moves, cancels or orders
- Your logo, your cover photo, your colors, light or dark mode

You only see what your business uses, so a salon sees its calendar and a shop sees its orders.

Your money is private. Flare Studios doesn't track your sales.

Sign in with your website address and your password. No new account, no setup.

name: FleetFolder
description:
FleetFolder – Inspect. Manage. Operate.

FleetFolder is a modern fleet management and inspection platform built for trucking companies, fleet managers, drivers, and equipment rental operations. It helps businesses replace paper-based processes with organized digital inspections, documentation, equipment records, and rental management.

DIGITAL PRE-TRIP INSPECTIONS

Give drivers a fast, simple way to complete daily vehicle and equipment inspections from their mobile device.

• Digital inspection checklists  
• Truck and trailer inspections  
• Photos and inspection notes  
• Video inspection documentation  
• Inspection history and timestamps  
• Driver and unit identification  
• Centralized inspection records  

Companies can configure inspection features based on their operational requirements.

VIDEO INSPECTIONS

Drivers can record inspection videos directly through FleetFolder. Videos are linked to the appropriate inspection and vehicle, giving fleet managers a visual record of equipment condition that can be reviewed when needed.

FLEET & EQUIPMENT MANAGEMENT

Keep trucks, trailers, and other commercial equipment organized in one centralized system.

Manage unit information, inspection history, condition documentation, and operational status without relying on paper forms, spreadsheets, or disconnected records.

RENTAL UNIT MANAGEMENT

Manage rented trucks, trailers, and other equipment throughout the rental lifecycle.

Track:

• Unit number  
• Customer  
• Rental start and end dates  
• Active or Returned status  
• Handover documentation  
• Return condition  
• Photos, videos, and inspection records  

CONDITION & DAMAGE REPORTING

Document equipment condition before, during, and after rentals or inspections. Use photos, videos, notes, and inspection records to create a clear history of the unit.

FleetFolder can help identify potentially visible issues such as dents, cracks, corrosion, damaged components, or missing parts. AI-assisted analysis can support your team, while final verification remains with the user.

REPORTS & DOCUMENTATION

Generate organized inspection and rental reports containing important vehicle, customer, rental, and condition information. Keep historical documentation available for future reference.

COMPANY & USER MANAGEMENT

FleetFolder is designed for multiple companies, with each organization having its own account, users, vehicles, equipment, inspections, and records.

Administrators can control which features are available to their company and adapt FleetFolder to their specific operational needs.

BUILT FOR MODERN FLEETS

FleetFolder helps reduce paperwork, improve accountability, and give fleet managers better visibility into their equipment.

Whether you operate a small fleet or manage hundreds of commercial vehicles, FleetFolder provides one centralized platform for inspections, documentation, rental equipment, and fleet operations.

FleetFolder — Inspect. Manage. Operate.

name: FlexDay: Smart AI Timetable
description:
Plans change, and that's completely okay. Whether you're a student managing busy class schedules or juggling daily tasks, FlexDay keeps life organized and stress-free.

【KEY FEATURES】

1. Easy Timetable Import & Auto-Expansion
• Import from Photo or PDF: Snap a syllabus photo or pick a PDF; FlexDay automatically recognizes courses, classrooms, and times.
• Odd / Even Weeks: Aligns with your semester calendar and seamlessly fills upcoming weeks.
• Clean, color-coded course cards for quick glances between classes.

2. Quick Voice Input & Actionable Steps
• Speak to schedule: Say times and tasks naturally to add them directly to your timeline.
• Break down daunting tasks: Turn complex projects into 5-minute actionable steps with easy checkboxes.

3. Flexible Rescheduling Without Conflicts
• Shift delayed items: Gently move remaining tasks into next open time slots without overlapping fixed calendar events.
• iOS Native Experience: Bi-directional Apple Calendar sync, Lock Screen & Home Screen widgets, and Live Activities on Dynamic Island.

4. Call It a Day & Fresh Mornings
• Call it a Day: Feeling overwhelmed? Tuck unfinished tasks safely away, clear tonight's schedule, and unwind without guilt.
• Fresh Morning Review: Wake up and choose what to bring forward into your day.

【PRIVACY & DATA SECURITY】
• Local-First: Core data stays securely on your device and syncs privately via personal Apple iCloud. We operate zero centralized servers collecting your private plans.
• Privacy Policy & Terms: https://equatorial-witch-fbe.notion.site/FlexDay-Terms-of-Service-Privacy-Policy-42198084167080e385d7cc4af7be33b0

name: FlexSched
description:
Το FlexSched είναι πλάνο γραμμής για δείγματα και μικρές παρτίδες. Βάζει τις επείγουσες εντολές στα πραγματικά λεπτά του σταθμού, χωρίς να κρύβει την αλλαγή τύπου.

ΠΩΣ ΝΑ ΤΟ ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΗΣΕΙΣ
1. Άνοιξε την εφαρμογή. Φορτώνει έτοιμο εργαστήριο. Χωρίς λογαριασμό.
2. Γραμμή — εμπρόθεσμα, επείγοντα, φόρτος. Ό,τι αλλάξεις, πάτα «Αναδιάταξη τώρα».
3. Εντολές — πελάτης, ποσότητα, οικογένεια, παράδοση, λεπτά, ύλη έτοιμη. Άλλαξε ύλη ή ολοκλήρωση· το πλάνο ξαναϋπολογίζεται.
4. Σχέδιο — έξυπνη χωροθέτηση. Γκρι = αλλαγή τύπου. Κόκκινο = υπερφόρτωση. Πάτα σχισμή για σημείωση.
5. Θέσεις — ημερήσια λεπτά, οικογένεια, λεπτά αλλαγής. Ανενεργός σταθμός μένει έξω.
6. Μονάδα — όνομα εργαστηρίου, προεπιλεγμένη αλλαγή, αντιγραφή περίληψης, ή επίδειξη από την αρχή.

Τα δεδομένα μένουν στη συσκευή. Σχόλια επάνω δεξιά στην αρχική οθόνη.

description: Flora Fine Foods Mobile Ordering Platform

name: Fluffy Merge
description:
Drop fluffy puffs into the jar, match two of a kind and watch them merge into something bigger and fluffier!

Fluffy Merge is a cozy physics puzzle with squishy, bouncy plush creatures. Every puff wobbles, blinks and reacts, so stacking them never gets old.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag to aim, release to drop.
• Two puffs of the same kind merge into the next one.
• Chain merges for combos and bonus points.
• Don't let the jar overflow past the dotted line!

FEATURES
• 12 adorable puffs to discover, from Tiny Puff to Rainbow Puff
• Satisfying real physics: puffs roll, squish and bounce
• Power-ups for tight spots: Sweep, Pop, Grow and Shake
• Daily challenges and a 7-day reward streak
• A collection book with every puff you've met
• Jar skins and storybook scenes to unlock with coins
• Original music and sound effects, plus gentle haptics
• Plays offline, with no account needed
• No ads
• Comfort options: reduced animations, and separate sound, music and haptics switches
• Made for iPhone and iPad

Your progress stays on your device. We collect no data.

Optional coin packs are available as in-app purchases. Everything in the game can also be earned by playing.

name: FluxoMove – Viagens e Entregas
description:
FluxoMove é o app de mobilidade urbana para viagens e entregas. Peça uma corrida, combine o valor e acompanhe o trajeto com tranquilidade.

Por que usar o FluxoMove?
• Ofereça sua tarifa e fique no controle do preço
• Categorias pra cada momento: comum, confort, moto e entrega
• Acompanhe a corrida ao vivo no mapa
• Compartilhe sua viagem com quem você confia
• Motoristas verificados e suporte durante o trajeto
• Pague do seu jeito: Pix, cartão ou dinheiro

Como funciona
1. Informe origem e destino
2. Escolha a categoria
3. Ofereça o valor da viagem
4. Aceite a proposta do motorista
5. Acompanhe o embarque e o trajeto em tempo real

Segurança em primeiro lugar
Ferramentas para compartilhar rota, acionar suporte e viajar com mais tranquilidade.

Baixe o FluxoMove e vá do seu jeito — rápido, justo e seguro.

name: Fold Diary
description:
When I got my iPhone Duo, I started wondering how many times a day I open it. Fold Diary is what I made to find out: it adds one each time the iPhone Duo opens.

Heads up: installing the app doesn't start the counting. You add one automation in the Shortcuts app, with the trigger "iPhone Is Opened" and the action "Log an Open". The app walks you through it on first launch (about a minute), then asks you to close and reopen your iPhone Duo to check it worked. After that, each open is logged without the app opening or anything popping up.

In the app:
• Today's count and a line about it, like "Business as usual." or, on a record day, "New record. Deepest crease yet."
• This week, this month, all time, daily average, best day and day streak
• This week day by day, and a list of every day before
• A Stamp Book of 13 stamps for total opens, busy days and streaks. The last one takes 20,000 opens.

Two Home Screen widgets: a simple one (small, medium) with today's count and how close the next stamp is, and Details (medium, large) with your week, month and all-time numbers. Both reset at midnight.

Missed one? Fix a Count lets you add or take away opens on today or any earlier day. Unfold the iPhone Duo and the app spreads out into two pages, with the Stamp Book on the right.

Free to download, with a 7-day free trial that you can start when you first open the app. Everything works during the trial. After that, a one-time purchase keeps new opens being logged. It's not a subscription, nothing renews, and nothing is charged when the trial ends. If you don't buy, everything you've already logged stays and you can still look through it. New opens just stop being logged, and the widget shows that the trial has ended. New phone or reinstall? Tap Restore Purchases.

No account, no ads. The app never sends your data anywhere, and your counts stay on your iPhone.

name: Folio: Student Notes & Planner
description:
Folio is a calm, beautifully designed study space for high school and university students. Your timetable, notes, deadlines and focus sessions live together — so you always know what's next and have everything you need for it.

YOUR DAY, ON ONE PAGE
Today shows your next class with its room and a live countdown, assignments due soon, how long you've studied, your water for the day, and your most recent notes. Tap a class to jump straight to that subject's latest note.

NOTES THAT THINK IN BLOCKS
• Headings, lists, checklists, quotes, callouts (Exam Tip, Formula, Warning), code and LaTeX equations
• Type "/" to add any block, or use Markdown shortcuts like "# " and "- "
• Toggle blocks for active recall — they become flashcards automatically
• Link pages with [[ and see what links back
• Organise by semester, subject and nested pages; favourites, archive and trash

WRITE AND DRAW WITH APPLE PENCIL
• Full-page canvases on blank, dotted, college-ruled or grid paper
• Sketch blocks inside your notes
• Handwriting is recognised on your device so you can search it

SCAN, RECORD, FIND
• Scan handouts and whiteboards; the text is read automatically and becomes searchable
• Record lectures with a live, on-device transcript and bookmarks
• Search titles, notes, scanned text and transcripts in one place

TIMETABLE IN SECONDS
Import from a calendar (.ics) file, the Calendar app, or a photo or screenshot of your timetable. Review everything before it's saved. Supports Week A / Week B schedules, or build your week by tapping and dragging on the grid.

DEADLINES AND GRADES
Track assignments and exams as a list, a Kanban board or a calendar, with countdowns and priorities. Add syllabus weightings and Folio works out your current grade, your GPA estimate, and exactly what you need on the final.

FLASHCARDS WITH SPACED REPETITION
Review the cards made from your notes with Again / Good / Easy. Folio schedules each card so you revise it just before you'd forget.

DEEP FOCUS
• Pomodoro sprints (25/5, 50/10, 90/15 or custom) linked to a subject or assignment
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island countdown — pause or skip from the Lock Screen
• Soft rain, brown noise or quiet library ambience
• Weekly study chart by subject

STAY HYDRATED, GENTLY
A quiet water tracker with +250 ml / +500 ml buttons and optional reminders that skip quiet hours, stop when you hit your goal, and — with Nudge on Break — wait until your focus sprint ends.

WIDGETS
Next Class, Due Soon, Water (log straight from the widget) and Start Focus, for the Home Screen and Lock Screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your notes, recordings and timetable stay on your device. Lock any page or subject with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode, and optionally lock the whole app.

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
Light "Warm Paper" and dark "Midnight Study" themes. A split-view workspace on iPad, and on iPhone Duo Folio moves between the outer screen and the full inner display without losing your place.

Export any page as a styled PDF, Markdown or an image card to share with classmates.

name: Food Roulette - Plan & Cook
description:
Tired of cooking the same few dishes? Food Roulette spins a varied week of meals for you, then helps you shop and cook it, on your own or with family or friends. Free, with no ads.

SPIN A WEEK OF MEALS
• Pick breakfast, lunch and dinner, then spin: one spin plans the whole week.
• Every meal shows its calories, and every day its energy, protein, fat and carbs.
• Set daily targets, and the roulette aims for them. Turn on snacks to add up to two a day, only on days that miss your targets.
• Filter by diet: vegetarian, pescatarian or vegan. Spin from all dishes, your own or your favorites, and let Something new mix in a few catalog dishes you haven't saved yet.
• Cook main dishes for one, two or three days at a time.
• Don't fancy a dish? Swap it for another one.

DISHES FROM AROUND THE WORLD
• 122 breakfasts, lunches and dinners from dozens of cuisines, each with nutrition per portion and a step-by-step cooking plan, plus 26 snacks.
• Star the dishes you love, and add your own dishes and ingredients.
• Tell the app how you cook a dish (talk, type or paste a video link) and it tidies it into steps.

SHOP AND COOK
• One shopping list for the whole week, sorted into sections like vegetables and herbs, ready to tick as you shop.
• Cook step by step, with each step's ingredients and time, and amounts that follow your portions.

TOGETHER
• Create a household to plan with the people you live with: one plan, one shopping list, and who cooks what.
• Share dishes and week plans with friends by link or code.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Serbian and Russian, dish names included. Choose the app's language in your profile; your other apps keep your phone's.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
• Start planning right away. Sign in with email, using a one-time code and no password, to keep your data safe, use it on other phones or join a household.
• No ads and no in-app purchases.

name: FoodChecker: Tủ lạnh, Nấu gì
description:
Tủ lạnh nhà bạn còn gì, món nào sắp hỏng, tối nay nấu gì? FoodChecker trả lời cả ba, để bữa cơm gọn hơn và bớt phải bỏ đồ ăn.

BIẾT NGAY MÓN NÀO SẮP HẾT HẠN
• Mỗi món có màu: Đỏ là dùng ngay, Vàng là sắp hết, Xanh là còn tốt.
• Chia theo Tủ lạnh, Ngăn đá, Kệ bếp; đồ sắp hết hạn luôn nằm trên cùng.
• Nhắc mỗi sáng những món cần dùng.

THÊM ĐỒ CHỈ VÀI GIÂY
• Chụp món: AI gợi ý tên, nhóm và hạn dùng; bạn bấm Áp dụng thì mới điền.
• Quét mã vạch đồ đóng gói, hoặc quét cả hoá đơn đi chợ.
• Chụp nhãn để đọc hạn sử dụng in trên hộp.
• Không có mạng vẫn dùng được: app gợi ý hạn theo bảng bảo quản cho hơn 100 loại đồ ăn quen thuộc.

HÔM NAY NẤU GÌ?
• Gợi ý mâm cơm từ đồ đang có, ưu tiên đồ sắp hết hạn.
• Gợi ý riêng cho bữa sáng, trưa, tối và cả ngày mai.

NẤU TỪNG BƯỚC, APP ĐỌC TO
• Chuẩn bị cho cả mâm: lấy bao nhiêu, trong tủ còn lại bao nhiêu.
• Chữ to, app đọc to từng bước, tự hẹn giờ; bấm micro rồi nói "Xong" để sang bước sau.
• Nấu xong, đánh dấu đồ đã dùng chỉ một chạm.

DANH SÁCH ĐI CHỢ TỰ LÊN
• Thiếu gì cho món nào, ghi sẵn theo từng món.

name: Forka Control
description:
Control your KEMPER PROFILER from your iPhone or iPad. Forka Control shows your current rig and signal chain in a landscape layout, so you can make adjustments while rehearsing or performing.

What you can do

• Switch rigs by bank and slot, and give slots custom names in the app.
• Turn effects on or off in the signal chain, or open a block to adjust its supported parameters.
• Adjust amp gain and supported amp and cabinet settings in the detail editor.
• Switch between Base and Morph and edit supported Morph values. The app also shows Morph changes triggered by the hardware footswitch.
• Open the tuner to see the note and how far sharp or flat it is as you play.

Getting connected

Join the hardware’s Wi-Fi network on your iPhone or iPad, open Forka Control, and allow Local Network access. No account is needed.

Compatibility

This version supports PROFILER Player. Compatible hardware is required for live control. Available banks and effects depend on your device’s level and settings.

Changes to the hardware, its firmware or communication protocol, or to iOS or iPadOS may limit or disable some controls. Before a performance, use your stage setup to check the connection, switch rigs, and test your effects.

Independent development and trademarks

GLASSHALF develops and publishes Forka Control independently of Kemper GmbH. Forka Control is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Kemper GmbH.

Forka Control lets you control a KEMPER PROFILER while you play. This version supports the PROFILER Player only. The app does not replace KEMPER Rig Manager, the manufacturer’s official software.

KEMPER, PROFILER, PROFILER Player, and KEMPER Rig Manager are trademarks of Kemper GmbH. These names identify compatible hardware and the manufacturer’s official software.

name: Forkscribe
description:
YOUR RECIPES. YOUR MEALS. YOUR DATA.

Forkscribe brings your favorite recipes, daily meal tracking, and nutrition information together in one simple iPhone app.

Organize your personal cookbook, track calories and macros, and connect with Apple Health—all while keeping your information under your control.

YOUR RECIPES, YOUR WAY

Keep the recipes you already love.

• Create, edit, organize, and search recipes.
• Open existing recipe folders from iCloud Drive or compatible Files providers.
• Automatically discover recipes across nested folders.
• Import and export recipes using the open Schema.org Recipe format.
• Browse ingredients, cooking instructions, preparation times, and nutrition information.
• Adjust recipes based on serving sizes.

No need to rebuild your cookbook or reorganize years of saved recipes.

SMART MEAL LOGGING

Record what you eat, your way.

• Log breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks.
• Select foods from your recipes or the built-in nutrition database.
• Track calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat.
• Adjust portions, including half and partial servings.
• Review and correct previous meal entries.
• See daily nutrition totals and history.

ON-DEVICE AI MEAL ASSISTANT

On compatible devices, Forkscribe uses Apple's on-device intelligence to help turn everyday meal descriptions into structured food entries.

• Type natural-language descriptions of your meals.
• Dictate what you ate using supported on-device speech recognition.
• Identify foods from photographs where supported.
• Recognize multiple foods and serving quantities.
• Review and correct AI suggestions before saving.

For example, describe "two scrambled eggs, toast, and a handful of nuts" and Forkscribe helps organize the foods into a meal entry.

AI features require a compatible device and supported Apple Intelligence configuration. Manual meal tracking remains available to everyone.

OFFLINE NUTRITION DATABASE

Forkscribe includes a built-in nutrition database based on USDA FoodData Central.

• Search foods without an internet connection.
• Find nutrition information for common ingredients and prepared dishes.
• Calculate calories and macronutrients using food quantities and serving sizes.
• Preserve nutrition information imported with recipes.
• Override nutrition values manually when needed.
• Review the sources of nutrition estimates.

Food searches and nutrition calculations are performed on your device without sending your meal descriptions to an external nutrition service.

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH

Bring your nutrition and weight information together.

• Record dietary calories and macronutrients.
• View authorized nutrition entries from other apps.
• Review body weight measurements and trends.
• Manually record weight measurements.
• Control Apple Health permissions.

Forkscribe only modifies Health records it creates.

SIRI AND APPLE SHORTCUTS

Use supported Siri commands and Apple Shortcuts to quickly access recipes, log meals, and review nutrition information.

Available actions depend on your device and iOS configuration.

YOUR FILES STAY YOURS

Forkscribe is built around open formats and user-controlled storage.

Keep recipes in iCloud Drive, on your iPhone, or in compatible Files locations. Your existing recipe collection stays in its original folder structure.

No required account. No proprietary recipe cloud. No developer-operated AI server.

BUILT FOR EVERYDAY USE

Whether you're saving a family recipe, logging lunch, or checking your daily calories, Forkscribe keeps things simple.

Your recipes. Your meals. Your data.

name: FortiKDS
description:
FortiKDS turns an iPad into a kitchen display screen (KDS) for restaurants.

Your point-of-sale system sends kitchen tickets to the iPad the same way it sends them to a kitchen printer. Set the iPad up as a network kitchen printer in your POS, and every ticket your staff fire appears on screen instantly, with modifiers, notes and order type, instead of on paper. Works with POS systems that print to network kitchen printers, such as Clover and Square.

FEATURES
• Tickets arrive straight from your POS over the restaurant's local network
• Clear ticket cards with quantities, modifiers and notes
• Order types at a glance, such as Dine-in, Pickup and Delivery
• Live ticket timers that change colour as orders wait
• Summary bar with the total of each item still to prepare
• Tap items to complete them, recall finished tickets, search and filter
• Ticket actions: table number, rush and print
• Voided items are taken off the ticket and shown on a VOID card
• Use several KDS together and pass items to the next station
• Customer screen mode shows Preparing and Ready order numbers

GETTING STARTED
A FortiKDS account is required. Add a KDS to your location on fortikds.com, then type its pairing code on the iPad. Keep the iPad on the same local network as your POS.

FortiKDS has no ads and no tracking. Tickets stay on your iPad.

name: FPL Circle

LIVE LEAGUE TABLE See every rival's points, rank changes and captain as matches play, with projected bonus and automatic subs. Switch to "If scores hold" to see where you'd finish.

MATCHES Every fixture with scorers, assists and bonus, and which rivals own which players.

THE CIRCLE Monthly winners, the race for this month, and season stats for your league.

name: Fractal Dimension Calculator
description:
Calculate the fractal dimension of the boundaries in your bitmap (BMP or PNG) images.

METHOD
The app uses the probability-measure nearest-neighbour scaling method. Edges are detected by colour-difference thresholding, the average distance to the k-th nearest neighbour is computed for each edge point, and the fractal dimension is the slope of the log(N/k) vs log(1/d) regression. The software is based on a Python implementation.

Note: the fractal dimension of any finite set of points is mathematically zero. Like the box-counting method, this app approximates the fractal dimension (mathematically comparable to the Hausdorff dimension) of a picture, which is a finite set of pixels.

WHAT CAN THIS BE USED FOR?
The fractal dimension estimates the "irregularity" of the boundary of the items in your image. This can be used to compare similar objects, for example aerial photos of different shorelines, rock samples, and more. Images of Julia sets are particularly suited to this application, whether they are "circle-like" or totally disconnected.

VERIFIED ACCURACY
The app has been tested against known dimensions: the Koch snowflake (true value 1.2619, measured 1.24955) and the Sierpinski triangle (true value 1.585, measured 1.57599) — both close to the true mathematical (Hausdorff) dimension.

MAIN FEATURES
• Simple screen to choose the picture and run the calculation. On iPhone, pick from your Photo Library or browse Files (BMP, PNG, JPG); on Android, use your file browser's "Browse" option to keep the original file name.
• Sliders to set the Colour Difference Factor (CDF), which adjusts the sensitivity of boundary edge detection, and the maximum image size.
• Progress bar showing calculation completion in percent.
• The result is a decimal number, usually between 1 and 2, representing an estimate of the "irregularity" of the boundaries in the picture.
• Number of edge points detected.
• Side-by-side comparison of the original image and the detected boundary edges.
• Graph showing the least-squares fit.
• Print option, including save as PDF.

Disclaimer: for research and educational use only — not a medical device and not a diagnostic tool. No responsibility for consequences arising out of the use of this software can be attributed to its creator or distributor.

name: FramePitch Layout
description:
Turn a wall measurement into a clear frame layout.

Create a wall project with frame dimensions, row and column counts, gaps and a hanger offset. FramePitch checks whether the grid fits and calculates equal margins on opposite sides. A numbered wall diagram shows the arrangement, while Coordinates lists every frame center and mounting point measured from the wall top-left.

Save reusable frame presets, copy them into new projects and keep each saved project independent. Search your project library, edit dimensions, share the complete coordinate plan or delete a project after confirmation. Metrics shows the size of your planning library.

All dimensions are in centimeters. Calculations use unrounded values; displayed coordinates use two decimal places. Supports 1–50 rows and columns. This is a spacing and measurement planner, not a structural, load-bearing or electrical safety assessment.

Core records stay locally on this iPhone. There is no app login, purchase, advertising or analytics SDK. More > Settings can export local JSON or delete this app's business data after confirmation. Copies already shared and system backups are managed separately.

Online destination: on launch and each return to the foreground, the app may read its dedicated public CloudKit configuration under a white cover. A valid enabled HTTPS destination opens automatically through the system. Disabled, missing, invalid, failed or timed-out reads (maximum2.5seconds), or an open failure, restore the local interface and existing edits. More > About provides status, Refresh configuration (no automatic opening) and Open website (manual, only for a valid current destination). The current initial configuration is disabled with an empty URL. No active business destination is configured. Local business records are not synchronized to CloudKit. External websites have their own data practices. All users, including reviewers, receive the same behavior.

name: Fretlist: Songbook & Setlists
description:
Fretlist keeps your songs and setlists in one place, ready to practice and ready to play.

Store every song with its chords and lyrics. Transpose to any key with one tap, or set a capo and read the shapes you play. Put songs in setlists for a rehearsal or a gig, and drag them into order.

MOVING FROM ONSONG OR SONGBOOKPRO?
Bring your whole library along in one go. Fretlist reads an OnSong backup and a SongbookPro backup: your songs come across with their keys, and your setlists in the same order. ChordPro files, PDFs, Word documents and Setlist Helper exports work too. Found a song on a chord site? Paste it in and it becomes a clean chord sheet.

PLAY MODE
- One song at a time, big and clear, readable from the music stand.
- Auto-scroll while you practice, at the speed you set
- Turn pages with a swipe or a Bluetooth page-turner pedal
- A metronome that clicks, or flashes when you play live
- Chord diagrams for guitar, ukulele, mandolin and banjo
- The screen stays on while you play

MARK UP YOUR SONGS
Write on your chord sheets with Apple Pencil or a finger. Circle a chord, highlight a line, stamp a Stop or a Rit. where the band needs it. Your marks stay with their words in Play Mode, and only you see them.

YOUR PDFS NEXT TO YOUR CHORDS
Keep the lead sheet, the sheet music or a photo from the music stand with its song. Read it in Play Mode, two pages side by side on a tablet. Or convert a sheet into a chart you can transpose.

WORKS WITHOUT INTERNET
Your whole library is on your device, files included. No signal on stage, or Wi-Fi that does not work? Your songs still open.

FOR BANDS AND WORSHIP TEAMS
Share one library with your band or worship team. Each player reads in their own key, capo and instrument, and singers can hide the chords to read only the lyrics. With Follow Me, the leader taps Play and every other device follows: same song, same spot. Charts from CCLI SongSelect come in as ChordPro files.

ALSO
- Write in ChordPro or chords over lyrics
- Chord grids for intros and instrumentals
- Folders and tags for a big library
- Print and export to PDF, Word and ChordPro
- Share a song or setlist by link
- Light and dark mode

Your library is the same on iPhone, iPad and in any browser, and stays in sync.

Made by one musician in the Netherlands. Questions or ideas? Mail support@fretlist.com and the person who builds Fretlist answers.

OnSong, SongbookPro, CCLI and SongSelect are trademarks of their owners. Fretlist is not affiliated with them.

name: From Here: Signpost
description:
From Here stands a signpost in front of you. Its arms point to cities, and to the places you care about, each with its distance. Turn around. The arms stay fixed to the world.

Cape Town. That way.

The Compass is free. The camera views need the From Here Monthly subscription, which starts with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers.

THE SIGNPOST
Look through the camera. A signpost stands on the ground ahead of you. Each arm points along the true shortest path over the Earth to a city, or to a place you saved and named. "Mom's house" can stand beside Tokyo.

YOUR SIGNPOSTS
Make more than one: for family, for a journey, for the places you have lived. Each has a name and up to eight places. Tap the name at the top of the screen to swap one for another.

HORIZON
A second camera view sets your places along the horizon, each in its true direction. Turn slowly and read the world around you.

THE COMPASS
A drawn compass does the same job without the camera, with a list of the places, each with its direction and distance.

THROUGH THE EARTH
The straight line to a far city runs through the planet. Turn this on, point your phone at the ground, and find the city there.

YOUR PLACES
Search for a city, a landmark, or an address. Type coordinates. Or drop a pin on a map. Then name it yourself.

THE DETAIL CARD
Tap any place. See its distance as the crow flies and its bearing (the compass direction). The card also shows the local time there and the path on a small globe. With the subscription it adds the angle through the Earth.

POSTCARDS
Take a photo of the scene with the signpost in it. It is stamped with where you stood and the date. Share it like any photo.

SIGN STYLES
Heritage Enamel. Park Timber. Alpine Rail. Night Brass.

COLLECTIONS
• World Cities (40)
• World Capitals (199)
• Landmarks and Wonders (42)
• Extremes (20)
• Lighthouses of the World (38), new

ACCURACY
Distance and direction are worked out on the WGS84 model of the Earth, with Karney's geodesic algorithm. The results are tested against reference values from GeographicLib. The math is precise. The compass in a phone is less so: it can be several degrees out, and more near metal. From Here shows how sure the compass is, and asks you to calibrate when it needs to.

ACCESSIBILITY
VoiceOver is supported. Point mode finds places by sound and touch.

PRIVACY
No account. No ads. No analytics. No tracking. Your location is never sent to us. Direction and distance are worked out on your device. Place searches go to Apple, as they do from Apple Maps.

FREE
Free forever: the Compass with forty world cities, the detail card, and your choice of kilometers, miles, or nautical miles.

THE SUBSCRIPTION
One plan: From Here Monthly. It adds:
• The camera views: Signpost and Horizon
• Through the Earth
• Search
• Signposts of your own
• As many saved places as you like, and every collection
• All four sign styles
• Postcards
• New collections and sign styles as they are added. We plan one about every month.

The first time you open From Here, you see the signpost once, free, before the offer is shown. If a subscription ends, your saved places are kept. They are never deleted.

7-day free trial for new subscribers, then $1.49 a month. The price is in US dollars and may differ in other countries. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free trial. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

name: Fruitful: Pregnancy by Week
description:
Fruitful shows how big your baby is this week, as a hand-painted fruit.

Enter the first day of your last period or your due date, and Fruitful works out your week the way doctors and midwives count it. From a tiny poppy seed to a big round watermelon, every week has its own fruit, its own colors, and your baby's typical length and weight, updated day by day.

WEEK BY WEEK
• Today's week and day at a glance
• The fruit your baby is about the size of, painted in gouache
• Typical length and weight for today, in centimeters and grams
• Days to go and your due date

5 THINGS ABOUT THIS WEEK
• Pull up the page for five short facts each week
• What's new for your baby, what you may notice, and what's good to know

YOUR BABY'S OWN CURVE
• Had an ultrasound? Add the length, the estimated weight, or both
• From that day on, the sizes follow your baby's own growth curve

SWIPE THROUGH YOUR PREGNANCY
• Swipe to any week from 4 to 42 and see what's ahead
• See every week at once in a colorful grid
• Back to today with one tap

SHARE THE MOMENT
• Turn this week into a photo for your partner, family or Instagram
• Post (4:5) or story (9:16) format
• Add your baby's nickname if you like

QUIET AND PRIVATE
• Free, with no account, no ads and no tracking
• Works offline; your dates never leave your iPhone
• In English and German

Sizes are typical averages; every baby grows at their own pace. Fruitful is a keepsake, not a medical app, and no substitute for your midwife or doctor.

name: FTScouter

FTC Scouter is the scouting companion for FIRST Tech Challenge teams. Browse events, teams and matches, record your own scouting at the field, and turn the data into smart decisions for your next match and for alliance selection.

SCOUT AT THE FIELD, EVEN WITHOUT WI-FI
• Match scouting forms with counters, toggles, ratings, lap timers and notes
• Pit scouting forms with photos of each robot

BROWSE EVENTS, TEAMS AND MATCHES

KNOW WHAT TO EXPECT

name: FunFest: Party Games
description:
FunFest is a box full of party games for one phone: open it, pick a game and pass the phone around. Eleven games inside, and every turn asks you to choose: bluff, read your friends, push your luck or pay your way out.

The standout is Who Said It?: Confessions, our own voice game. Everyone answers one personal question in secret, FunFest disguises every voice, and the room points at who said it.

Made for the Christmas party at home, the office holiday party and every game night after. Set the heat for each game: Family (kids at the table), Friends (crushes, embarrassing stories, what you think of each other) or Spicy (bolder, never rude). No drinking, ever. No internet or sign-up needed, and never an ad between rounds.

WHO SAID IT?: CONFESSIONS
• 3 to 8 players. One question, like "Say who your first crush was." Each player records up to 5 seconds in secret.
• Every take is disguised: robot, chipmunk, giant and more. On "3, 2, 1… point!" everyone points, and the speaker bluffs.
• Sure? Point with both hands to play your Double, once a game. A drum roll, then the real voice.
• Takes stay in the phone's memory for that game only.

TRUTH, DARE OR PAY (PRO)
• Pick Truth or Dare before you see the card. Don't like it? Pay: skip it and give 2 points to any player you choose. First to 10.

KNOW YOUR FRIEND (PRO)
• The hot seat secretly picks the true answer about themselves. Friends guess in turn, and can steal by calling the friend before them wrong.

MOST LIKELY TO
• "Who's most likely to…?" Everyone votes in secret and predicts who the room will pick. The crowned player confesses the story, or denies it and the room boos.

IMPOSTER (PRO)
• Everyone gets the same question but one. Answer out loud, then point. The imposter can call it any time by guessing the real question.

CHARADES
• Phone on your forehead while your team acts it out. Teams bid 3, 5 or 8 words first: hit the bid to score it, miss and score half.

MAJORITY RULES (PRO)
• Two choices. Pick a side in secret and call whether you're with the crowd or against it. The smaller side explains itself.

HOT POTATO (PRO)
• Say one thing in the category and pass before it pops. Play Reverse, Skip, Speed up or Shield. Caught? Take a letter, or answer a Truth.

CHICKEN (PRO)
• One finger each on the screen while the pot climbs. Lift to bank it. It bursts at a secret moment and anyone still holding gets nothing.

CHEER METER (PRO)
• Each team secretly picks a loudness target, then cheers. Closest without going over takes the round. Nothing is recorded.

BINGO
• A 75-ball caller: every ball spoken aloud and shown big, with a tap or every 5 to 30 seconds. Print cards as a PDF; type a card number and FunFest checks it.

WHAT PRO ADDS
Seven more games (Truth, Dare or Pay, Know Your Friend, Imposter, Majority Rules, Hot Potato, Chicken, Cheer Meter), every Friends and Spicy card, every voice disguise and twist rounds in Who Said It?, every Charades deck, more bingo patterns, calling only the letters a pattern needs, and up to 100 bingo cards.

Without Pro: Who Said It?, Most Likely To and Charades with all their Family cards and a sample of Friends, three voice disguises, and Bingo with unlimited calling, the classic patterns and cards for up to 10 players.

Pro comes as Monthly, Annual or Lifetime, and each one unlocks the same things. Purchases are charged to your Apple Account. Monthly and Annual renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings. Lifetime never renews.

name: Fusionista
description:
Fusionista brings two cuisines together in one dish, and walks you through it one step at a time.

Every recipe comes with:
• A clear ingredient list with quantities
• Step-by-step instructions you can follow at the stove
• A photo for each step, so you know what you're aiming for

COOK MODE
Open a recipe and tap Start cooking. One step fills the screen, with its photo, the instruction, the time it takes and the ingredients you need right now. Tap Next when you're ready.

FUSION, NOT CONFUSION
Think Kimchi Carbonara: recipes that borrow the best of two kitchens and stay easy enough for a weeknight. New recipes are added regularly.

YOUR FIRST RECIPE IS FREE

name: Galaxies: Symmetry Puzzle
description:
Draw walls along the grid lines to split the board into galaxies. Every galaxy holds exactly one dot, and it looks the same after a half turn around that dot.

Galaxies (also known as Tentai Show or Spiral Galaxies) is a classic Japanese logic puzzle with three clean rules and beautifully symmetric answers. Dots sit in cells, on edges or on corners; each one is the center of its own galaxy. Every level, daily puzzle and quick game has exactly one solution, reachable by pure logic.

12 SPACE STAGES, 360 LEVELS
• Journey from the Moon (5 × 5) to the edge of the Cosmos (15 × 15) across 12 stages
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; unlock new stages as you progress

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one shared 10 × 10 puzzle every day with a monthly calendar and streak
• Quick play: 5 × 5, 7 × 7, 10 × 10, 12 × 12 and 15 × 15 across four difficulties (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert)
• Import puzzle codes (compatible with the common dot-letter format) or copy and share your board

HELPFUL, NEVER INTRUSIVE
• Tap an edge to draw a wall, tap again for X, again to clear; drag along grid lines to draw long walls; hold an edge for X
• Wall / Mark X toolbar switch; optional grid, board coordinates and last-change highlight
• Finished galaxies light up in nebula colors and their dot turns into a star
• Live rule-break highlights (walled-off areas with no dot or that can't be symmetric) in red or color-blind blue
• 3 logical hints per game (watch an optional ad for more); every hint names the technique and explains why
• Solving tips: 7 logical techniques with before-and-after boards, plus an interactive tutorial
• Unlimited undo/redo; pinch to zoom and pan on large boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solve without hints and under the target time
• Statistics by board size and difficulty, plus 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Tailored dark layouts for iPhone, iPad, Android and Mac
• Mouse right-click for X and keyboard controls (Arrows, Shift+Arrow for a wall, Option+Arrow for X) on Mac and iPad
• English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account required
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads forever with a single one-time purchase — no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works completely offline; your progress stays on your device

name: Gamesona
description:
Gamesona brings your favorite brain games together in one app. Play word puzzles, test your knowledge, race through math, sharpen your mind, study with flashcards, and unlock real-world coupons - all in one place.

WHAT YOU CAN PLAY
• Word Search – Find hidden words in chapter-based puzzles that get harder as you go, plus a new Daily Puzzle every day.
• Trivia – Answer questions across many topics and see how much you really know.

• Community Voting – Vote "Yes" or "No" on coupons shared by others to help ensure everyone gets the best, working deals.
• Earn Coins – Collect coins just for playing your favorite games.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Keep your progress, scores, and streaks saved safely with your Gamesona account.
• Follow your daily challenges and try to beat your own records.
• Learn new words, practice math, and train your memory while having fun.

COMMUNITY & SAFETY
Flashcard decks and coupons are community-driven. You can report any deck, review, or code that breaks the rules. We actively review reports and take action to keep the platform safe and spam-free.

Gamesona Premium is optional and available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

name: GanaRed
description:
GanaRed es un mercado sencillo para comprar y vender ganado en Guatemala.

PARA COMPRAR
• Mira avisos sin crear cuenta.
• Cada aviso trae fotos, tipo de animal (vaca, toro, novilla o chivo), raza, cantidad, edad, peso aproximado, precio y departamento.

name: Gap Chain
description:
Gap Chain keeps a tolerance stack on this iPhone.

Add each part with its size, its plus-or-minus tolerance, and whether it opens or closes the gap. The nominal gap is the signed sum. The worst-case half-width is the sum of the tolerances. The RSS half-width is the square root of the sum of the squares. Both intervals inside the requirement pass. Only the RSS interval inside is RSS only. Otherwise the stack fails. Drag the largest contributor down and apply it when the stamp changes. The last chain stays.

Sizes stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: GarageBuddies: Garage Manager
description:
GarageBuddies keeps every bike, scooter and car in your garage on a digital job card, from drop-off to delivery. Customers follow the service on their own phone, so they stop calling to ask "is it ready?", and you know when each vehicle is due for its next service.

Made for two-wheeler service centres, car garages and workshops, at the garage and at the customer's door.

JOB CARDS BY VEHICLE NUMBER
• Type the vehicle number: a vehicle seen before fills in the owner, mobile, make and model
• Km reading and fuel level at drop-off, what was left with it (helmet, keys, RC copy…), its condition and up to 8 photos, so there are no arguments at delivery
• Complaint and work to do, estimate, advance, ready-by time and the mechanic on the job
• Print a job slip with a QR code on a receipt printer

SERVICE HISTORY
• Every vehicle keeps its history: each visit with its date, km reading, work done and bill
• Search by vehicle number, even by its last 4 digits, or by name, mobile or job number
• A customer with several vehicles picks one when their mobile number is typed

NEXT SERVICE REMINDERS
• Set the next service when you hand the vehicle over: a date and a km reading, whichever comes first
• It is suggested for you: every 3 months or 3,000 km for bikes and scooters, 6 months or 5,000 km for cars
• Customers who turn on notifications on their job page get a reminder before the date
• "Service due" lists the vehicles to call, with call and message buttons

CUSTOMERS SEE THE SERVICE LIVE
• Every job has its own page: status, expected ready time, bill and amount to pay
• Send the link with one tap; no app to install for the customer
• "Notify me when it's ready" on the customer's page
• Customers approve or decline extra work on your estimate before you start it

SAFE HANDOVER
• Every job has a 4-digit pickup code. The vehicle is handed over only with the code
• Too many wrong codes lock the job and the owner is told

SERVICE PACKAGES, BILLS AND GST
• Keep your fixed-price services ("General service") and add one to an estimate or bill in one tap
• Parts and labour, advance and payments by cash, UPI or card
• Print the bill or save it as a PDF, or send it to the customer
• GST tax invoices with CGST and SGST for garages with a GSTIN, numbered per financial year

DOORSTEP VISITS
• Book a visit with the address and time for a breakdown, a service at home or a pickup
• Each mechanic sees their own visits, with call and directions buttons
• The customer gives a visit code when the work is done

SPARE PARTS
• Keep a list of your parts (oil, filters, brake pads…) with stock at each branch
• Parts on a bill come off the stock by themselves, and you are warned when one runs low

BRANCHES, TEAM AND REPORTS
• Run several branches; staff only see the branches you give them
• See every branch on one screen: in the garage, ready, late and services due
• Reports: jobs in and out, money billed and collected, service time and work by mechanic

SIMPLE AND SECURE
• Log in with your mobile number and password, or with a one-time SMS code
• Works on iPhone and iPad, and in any web browser on a computer
• Customers' phone numbers and full vehicle numbers are never shown on public pages

GarageBuddies is made by CarryBuddies.
