name: Gates of Forge
description:
Step into the forge yard of the ancient Greek world. Gates of Forge is a hands-on bronze-metallurgy and monumental-gateway engineering workbench built for classics students, museum docents, blacksmithing hobbyists, and historical worldbuilders who want to understand how legendary gateways like the Lion Gate of Mycenae, the Propylaea of the Acropolis, and the gates of Tiryns were actually alloyed, forged, hinged, decorated, and worn by time.

Explore an illustrated Gate Atlas of 12+ real historic gates with cutaway diagrams, era, dimensions, materials, and inscriptions. Mix copper and tin on an alloy bench and watch hardness, color, and castability update in real time, matched against historical city-state recipes. Dial in forge temperatures on an interactive heat-color chart from dull cherry to white-hot, with a tap-hold hammer-strike timing interaction for authentic feedback.

Design pivot-and-socket door mechanisms by adjusting pivot-stone diameter and leaf weight to see swing-arc friction and long-term wear. Compose lintel and relief panels on a grid-snap canvas using a historically-grounded motif library — palmette, guilloche, meander key, lion, rosette — with symmetry tools. Stress-test a gate cross-section against wind gusts and battering-ram force, visualizing stress distribution and failure thresholds.

Scrub a decades-long patina timeline across coastal, dry inland, and humid climate presets to watch bronze shift from bright metal to brown oxide to green verdigris, complete with chemistry notes. Convert ancient units like pous, pechys, and orguia to metric, and search an illustrated glossary of architectural terms such as jamb, lintel, antae, and pivot.

Save unlimited alloy recipes and relief panel designs to a personal gallery for recall and side-by-side comparison. Gates of Forge is grounded in real metallurgy and archaeology, with zero ads, zero accounts, and zero notifications — just a focused sandbox for curious minds.

name: Gaudí Golf Club
description:
Gaudí Golf Club – Tu club de golf, siempre contigo

Descubre una nueva forma de disfrutar del golf con la aplicación oficial de Gaudí Golf Club, situado en Reus, Tarragona.

Con nuestra app tendrás tu club al alcance de la mano, de forma rápida, cómoda y sencilla. Organiza tus jornadas de golf, consulta la información del club y disfruta de una experiencia más completa desde tu dispositivo móvil.

Todo lo que necesitas para disfrutar del golf. Organiza tus próximas partidas de forma fácil e intuitiva; accede a las novedades y comunicaciones más importantes; y mantente informado sobre las competiciones y actividades del club. Disfruta de una conexión más directa con tu club desde cualquier lugar.

Tanto si eres socio como si visitas nuestras instalaciones, la app de Gaudí Golf Club está diseñada para hacer tu experiencia más cómoda y accesible.

Descarga la app oficial de Gaudí Golf Club y disfruta del golf en Reus como nunca antes.

name: GBIT Préstamos
description:
GBIT Préstamos es la herramienta de trabajo para los negocios de préstamos que usan el sistema de GBIT. Pone en el teléfono del dueño y de sus cobradores la ruta de cobro del día y deja constancia de cada peso que entra.

Qué puedes hacer:
• Ver a quién te toca cobrar hoy, con foto, monto y color: al día, vence hoy o atrasado.
• Registrar un cobro en segundos y ver cómo se reparte entre mora, interés y capital antes de confirmar.
• Imprimir el recibo en una impresora Bluetooth o compartirlo por WhatsApp.
• Trabajar sin señal: lo cobrado se guarda en el teléfono y sube solo cuando vuelve la conexión, sin duplicarse.
• Guardar fotos y documentos de cada cliente, préstamo y garantía.
• Marcar dónde queda la casa o el trabajo de cada cliente para llegar fácil.
• Llevar tu caja del día: lo cobrado, los gastos y el cierre.

Pensada para leerse de un vistazo en la calle: números grandes, colores claros y voz opcional que dice el monto.

El dueño administra todo desde la web: reportes, usuarios, rutas y los ajustes que se aplican en los teléfonos. Nada se borra: cada movimiento queda registrado con quién lo hizo y cuándo.

Para entrar necesitas el código de tu empresa y el usuario que ella te asigna. No hay registro abierto al público. Esta app no ofrece ni otorga préstamos: es una herramienta interna para el personal del negocio. La app sigue el modo claro u oscuro de tu teléfono.

name: GDMC: Goddess Mode Challenge
description:
GDMC is for people who want to keep a practice going without being pushed.

You choose a Path: seven days to begin, longer ones when you are ready. Each day gives you a few minutes of Body, Breath, Flow and Stillness, drawn to fit the Path you are on. The Goddess speaks at the start and the end, in her own words and never in a hurry.

HOW A PATH GOES
• Mercy Paths are free: seven and fourteen days, Gentle to Steady.
• A missed day stays on your Record, and nothing is taken from you for it.
• Grace days let a Path forgive a miss or two. After that it ends, and you can begin again at once.
• Homecoming is the lighter session that welcomes you back.

BEYOND THE PATH
• Moments: a single short practice, any time.
• Rituals: practices you choose to repeat, on the days you choose.
• A daily invitation, at most one a day, at the time you pick. It never mentions a missed day.
• Your Record and your level, kept on your account.

PAID ACCESS (OPTIONAL)
Arcadia and Elysium are longer, deeper Paths, thirty days each. They open with paid access. Paying never changes how a Path goes.
• A monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, at the price shown in the app.
• The same account also opens paid access in GMC.

BLESS SOMEONE
Give someone paid access as a gift. It asks nothing of them in return.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings in the App Store after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://goddessmodechallenge.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://goddessmodechallenge.com/terms

name: Geaphylax
description:
They came from beyond the Moon. One ship stands between them and home.

GEAPHYLAX is a cinematic 3D space shooter built for your phone. Defend Earth's orbit, then chase the invaders to the Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and the Sun-scorched skies of Mercury, across 70 handcrafted levels and colossal boss battles.

FREE TO START
The whole Earth Orbit campaign, 10 levels and its Mothership, is free. Unlock everything else once with Geaphylax Pro. No ads, no timers, no energy, nothing else to buy.

COLOSSAL BOSSES
Motherships, hive ships and six world bosses, each with its own attack patterns. Break through, fail, learn, and go again.

A NEW BUILD EVERY RUN
Choose power-ups that chain, ricochet and seek. Upgrade your ship in the hangar with salvage you earn in battle.

HOLD THE SHIELD EVERY DAY
Every alien you destroy charges Earth's shield. Fill it by midnight to earn bonus salvage. Let it fall, and tomorrow is a counter-attack.

DAILY AND WEEKLY CHALLENGES
A new level and a new twist every day, one shot that counts. Share your result.

AN ORIGINAL SCORE
Opening with "The Final Voyage", composed for Geaphylax, and a deep-space soundscape that puts you in the cockpit.

GEAPHYLAX PRO, ONE PAYMENT
• 60 more levels across six worlds, each with its own hazards and boss
• Endless mode and Veteran mode
• Two more ships, extra paint jobs, higher upgrade tiers and the Overdrive shockwave

Also: haptic feedback, game controller support, left-handed layout, colour assist, adjustable text size and a calm mode. Plays fully offline, with no account and no data collected.

name: GeniChat
description:
GeniChat é o chat de trabalho do Genezze: a conversa da sua equipe num lugar só, com a Geni, a assistente de IA do Genezze.

O QUE VOCÊ FAZ
• Conversas individuais, grupos e canais públicos ou privados.
• Responde, encaminha, reage, edita e apaga mensagens; vê quem leu.
• Manda fotos, PDFs, arquivos, áudios e figurinhas; galeria de mídias da conversa.
• Busca em todas as conversas.

COM A GENI
• Sugestão de resposta, ditado e correção do texto antes de enviar.

COMO ENTRAR
O app usa a sua conta do Genezze (usuário e senha). Ainda não tem? Crie a conta grátis na própria tela de entrada.

SUA CONTA E SEUS DADOS
Você pode excluir a sua conta dentro do app, no botão de conta no canto de cima da tela. Política de privacidade: genezze.com.br/privacidade.

name: GeniLousa
description:
Geni Lousa é o quadro branco infinito do Genezze, para pensar e desenhar com a sua equipe.

O QUE VOCÊ FAZ
• Desenha à mão, escreve, cria formas, setas e balões num quadro sem fim.
• Começa de um modelo e volta a qualquer versão do quadro.
• Desenha junto com a equipe, ao vivo, vendo o cursor de cada pessoa.
• Coloca cartões vivos das tarefas do Meu Gestor no quadro.
• Exporta em PDF ou compartilha um link só de leitura.

COM A GENI
• Peça e a Geni, a assistente de IA do Genezze, desenha diagramas, mapas de ideias e resumos no quadro, também por voz.

COMO ENTRAR
O app usa a sua conta do Genezze (usuário e senha). Ainda não tem? Crie a conta grátis na própria tela de entrada.

SUA CONTA E SEUS DADOS
Você pode excluir a sua conta dentro do app, no botão de conta no canto de cima da tela. Política de privacidade: genezze.com.br/privacidade.

name: GeniMail
description:
GeniMail é o e-mail do Genezze: suas caixas de trabalho e pessoais num só lugar, com a Geni, a assistente de IA do Genezze, ajudando a dar conta da caixa de entrada.

O QUE VOCÊ FAZ
• Lê, responde e organiza conversas, com pastas, categorias e regras.
• Conecta Gmail, Outlook ou qualquer caixa por IMAP/SMTP ou POP3 (o servidor é descoberto sozinho).
• Agenda envios, desfaz um envio e pede lembrete quando alguém não responde.
• «Porteiro»: remetente novo espera a sua decisão antes de entrar na caixa.
• Manda um boleto anexo para o Finanças ou um convite para a Agenda com um toque.

COM A GENI
• Resumo da conversa, sugestões de resposta e e-mail escrito a partir de um pedido seu.
• Lê dados de contas, boletos e eventos para você não digitar.

COMO ENTRAR
O app usa a sua conta do Genezze (usuário e senha). Ainda não tem? Crie a conta grátis na própria tela de entrada.

SUA CONTA E SEUS DADOS
Você pode excluir a sua conta dentro do app, no botão de conta no canto de cima da tela. Política de privacidade: genezze.com.br/privacidade.

name: GeniNotas
description:
GeniNotas guarda as suas ideias, listas e anotações de trabalho, e a Geni, a assistente de IA do Genezze, ajuda a organizar tudo.

O QUE VOCÊ FAZ
• Notas com formatação, cadernos, listas e lembretes.
• Dita a nota por voz e o texto aparece pronto.
• Histórico de versões: volte a qualquer versão da nota.
• Mural que aproxima notas parecidas.
• Importa do Google Keep, Evernote, Word/OneNote e Markdown; exporta em Markdown e PDF.
• Compartilha com a sua equipe e edita junto, ao vivo.
• A ata de cada reunião do Genezze vira nota sozinha.
• Ação no app Atalhos para guardar um link direto numa nota.

COM A GENI
• Resumir, organizar, tirar tarefas de uma nota e «Perguntar às notas».

COMO ENTRAR
O app usa a sua conta do Genezze (usuário e senha). Ainda não tem? Crie a conta grátis na própria tela de entrada.

SUA CONTA E SEUS DADOS
Você pode excluir a sua conta dentro do app, no botão de conta no canto de cima da tela. Política de privacidade: genezze.com.br/privacidade.

name: GenJ2: J2ME & iAppli Emulator
description:
Before there were app stores, there were jars, MIDlets and i-Applis.

GenJ2 brings that era back to your iPhone and iPad. It is an emulator for J2ME (Java ME) applications and for iAppli, the application format of Japan's feature phones, so you can play the games and apps that shaped the early days of mobile, on a modern screen.

RELIVE THE EARLY DAYS OF MOBILE
Tiny downloads, pixel art, soft keys and a numeric keypad. Import your own .jar files and play them the way they were meant to be played, with an on-screen keypad or d-pad and the soft keys right where you expect them.

J2ME AND iAPPLI
• Runs J2ME (MIDP) applications.
• Runs iAppli (i-appli) applications from the Japanese market. Import the .jar together with its .jam and .sp files, or as a folder.
• Import from Files, AirDrop or the share sheet. Zip archives work too.
• Browse your library as a grid or a list, with a size slider and sorting by name or date.

SAVE STATES
Save and load your game at any moment, in several slots, plus an autosave when you leave the app. Save states are a feature you won't find in any other J2ME emulator: stop in the middle of a fight, come back a week later and carry on.

GREAT COMPATIBILITY
GenJ2 runs a wide range of J2ME and iAppli titles, including 3D games. Every game has its own settings, so you can tune it:
• screen size, scaling, smoothing and frame rate
• sound volume, synthesizer, quality and buffer
• soft key codes (standard, Motorola, Siemens) and arrows that send 8 / 4 / 6 / 2

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO
GenJ2 uses both screens of iPhone Duo:
• Folded, with the game on one screen and the controls on the other, and a button to swap them
• Folded in portrait, DS-style
• Full-screen landscape
• The outer screen

CONTROLS YOUR WAY
A d-pad or a virtual stick, a full numeric keypad, soft keys, haptic feedback and adjustable opacity. Move the controls wherever your thumbs like them.

FOUR GAMES TO START WITH
GenJ2 comes with four original games made for it, so you can play right away: Gem Swap, Rainbow Hop, Void Wave and Star Catcher.

BRING YOUR OWN GAMES
GenJ2 does not include or download any third-party games. Import your own files that you have the right to use.

AVAILABLE IN
English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Spanish, German, French, Italian and Portuguese.

Questions? Ask on Discord!

Java is a trademark of Oracle and/or its affiliates. iAppli is a trademark of NTT DOCOMO, INC. GenJ2 is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

name: Genlar
description:
A galaxy of 4,000 stars, and every star hatches a round little creature like no other. Make friends with them, breed them with real genetics (dominant and recessive genes, rare mutations, a 1-in-200 super mutation) and fill your creature book.

• Explore eight regions of the galaxy; your friends' talents open the way.
• Plan your pairs: the gene lens shows the odds, and hidden genes can surprise you.
• Every day: a planet mission, the mystery of a lost friend, the visitor of the day.
• Found your own breeds, run in races, sing in a choir, decorate your Home planet.
• A weekly breeding challenge where everyone starts from the same friends.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your game stays on your phone, unless you choose to move it to a new one.

name: Genya's Block Breaker
description:
Genya is a black cat who wants to learn the words people use.
With a racket and a ball he found in the trash, he knocks down the letters of old poems and stories floating in the night sky. Every letter he breaks turns into a star and falls to him.

A simple block breaker: tap to hit the ball.

- Classic literature with cats in it becomes the stage itself
  Edgar Allan Poe, Lewis Carroll, Rudyard Kipling, Edward Lear, Basho, Issa and more
- 12 rounds, 72 stages, with a boss at the end of every round
- Spirals, mazes, block labyrinths, exploding red blocks, a glowing floor: every stage has its own trick
- Return the ball at the last moment and it turns yellow, then red, and hits harder
- Stop any time and pick up where you left off with CONTINUE
- Switch between Japanese and English

A game from the film "Genya the Black Cat" (written, directed and edited by Hirotaka Adachi; narration by Marika Hayase).

No ads. No in-app purchases. No internet connection needed.

name: Gesher: AI Translate Keyboard
description:
Write to them in your language.

Gesher is an AI keyboard that translates and rewrites your messages right where you type: in chats, email and any other app. No copying, no switching to a translation app. Type in your own language, pick theirs, and send a natural message that sounds like you wrote it.

Why Gesher:
• One tap to translate and rewrite, in dozens of languages.
• Rewrite in the same language too: turn a quick note into a formal or professional message.
• Swipe between tones: faithful, friendly, professional or formal. Gesher remembers your tone for each language.
• "How it sounds to them": a back-translation so you can check the meaning before you send.
• Received a message in another language? Paste it and understand it instantly.
• Cultural tip: a short note when there is something worth knowing about tone or etiquette.
• Automatic language detection, spelling and grammar fixes.

Privacy first:
• Your everyday typing stays on your device. Only text you choose to translate is sent, and only when you tap.
• We don't store your text.
• No sign-up, no email, no password.

Pricing:
• Free: 5 rewrites a day.
• Gesher Pro: up to 150 rewrites a day, monthly or yearly.

Subscriptions renew automatically and are charged to your Apple ID unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://gesher-api.noymil100.workers.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gesher-api.noymil100.workers.dev/privacy

name: Gestaltwer
description:
Gestaltwerk begleitet dich bei deinen Projekten rund um den FDM-3D-Druck. Du kannst passende Drucker, Materialien und Zubehör ansehen, Modelle suchen und vor dem Kauf die Kompatibilität prüfen.

Im Konfigurator stellst du deinen 3D-Drucker Modul für Modul zusammen. Wähle das passende Gerät sowie Optionen wie Düse und Druckplatte aus und sieh die Preise direkt ein. Zusätzlich steht dir ein Kostenrechner zur Verfügung, mit dem du Aufwendungen für Material, Strom und Abschreibung nachvollziehen und Berechnungen speichern kannst. Alle erstellten Einkaufspläne, Entwürfe und Bestellungen findest du übersichtlich im Bereich Pläne.

name: Gestor GC
description:
Gestor es la plataforma tecnológica No-Code que ayuda a organizaciones públicas y privadas a sistematizar sus procesos sin desarrollo de software a medida. Con más de 10 años de evolución y presencia consolidada en el sector salud público de Colombia (IVC Sanitario, Salud Ambiental, Vigilancia Epidemiológica y APS), Gestor parametriza formularios, flujos, usuarios y reportes de forma dinámica, adaptándose a cualquier sector que necesite gestionar información estructurada.

¿Qué puedes hacer con Gestor?

• Diseña formularios y encuestas dinámicos: crea entidades y encuestas a medida con reglas de visibilidad, validaciones y campos condicionales, sin escribir una sola línea de código.

• Captura información en campo: registra datos con geolocalización GPS, adjunta evidencias y guarda avances automáticamente aunque se interrumpa la conexión.

• Evalúa y puntúa resultados: aplica un motor de valoración configurable para calificar cumplimiento, calidad o desempeño de cada registro.

• Verifica registros por código QR: genera un QR por cada registro para que cualquier persona pueda consultar su información de forma pública y segura, sin exponer datos sensibles.

• Genera reportes y documentos: exporta a PDF con encabezado, pie de página y marca de agua personalizados, o a Excel para análisis externo.

• Visualiza relaciones entre datos: explora grafos de relación entre entidades y mapas geográficos para entender tu información de un vistazo.

• Organiza a tu equipo: define metas mensuales y anuales de captura por usuario, agenda actividades en un calendario colaborativo y recibe notificaciones y alertas.

• Administra múltiples clientes y aplicaciones: como plataforma multi-tenant, Gestor gestiona distintas organizaciones, aplicaciones y usuarios de forma independiente y segura, con auditoría completa de cada acción.

• Cuenta con un asistente de inteligencia artificial que te ayuda a navegar la plataforma, diligenciar formularios y consultar información mediante lenguaje natural.

Gestor nació para digitalizar procesos de vigilancia e inspección sanitaria en Colombia, pero su arquitectura flexible permite implementarlo en cualquier sector que necesite estandarizar la captura, evaluación y reporte de información: salud, ambiente, control territorial, calidad, auditoría y más.

Descarga Gestor y transforma la manera en que tu organización recopila, evalúa y reporta información.

name: Gland Crush
description: Name the packing box still under max crush with the highest crush percent. Drag max without rewriting heights.

name: Glasshour: Aligner Timer
description:
Clear aligners only work if you wear them 20–22 hours a day. Glasshour turns the roughly two hours you’re allowed to take them out into a simple countdown—and makes sure you put them back on time.

TAKE OUT, PUT BACK — ONE TAP
• Tap once when your aligners come out; the hourglass starts and today’s remaining out time counts down
• Tap again when they’re back in; worn time and your progress ring update instantly
• Works from the app, Dynamic Island, Lock Screen, Home Screen widgets, Control Center, the Action button, Siri and Apple Watch

AN ALARM THAT ACTUALLY GETS YOUR ATTENTION
• When today’s out time runs out, Glasshour rings like an alarm—even in Silent mode or a Focus
• Mark them as back in with one tap, or let it ring again in 10 minutes
• Gentle reminders too: time running low, “Still eating?”, a bedtime check, an optional chime while they’re out, and tray change reminders

RECORDS YOU CAN TRUST
• Every entry is based on start and end times, never a background timer
• Forgot to tap? Edit any entry or add one later; overlapping entries can be merged
• Undo mistakes with a tap
• Handles midnight snacks, time zones and daylight saving time automatically

YOUR TREATMENT AT A GLANCE
• Tray schedule with change days, expected finish date and checkups
• Postpone a change, switch early, go back a tray, or start refinements
• Calendar colored by goal met, close or missed; mark sick days as paused
• 7-day and 30-day averages and stats for every tray

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your data stays on your iPhone and, if you choose, in your own iCloud

Privacy Policy: https://franklioxygen.github.io/glasshour-app/privacy.html

Works with Invisalign® and other clear aligners. Glasshour is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Align Technology, Inc. Invisalign is a trademark of Align Technology, Inc.

Glasshour is not a medical device. Always follow your orthodontist’s instructions.

name: GlidePane
description:
用 iPhone 给 Mac 多一块屏幕。将两台设备连到同一局域网，在 iPhone 选中 Mac，再在 Mac 点「允许连接」。

• 选择「扩展桌面」，把 Mac 窗口拖到 iPhone 显示的第二块桌面。选择「镜像主屏」，查看 Mac 主显示器的内容。
• 用 iPhone 控制 Mac 指针、点击、拖动和滚动。使用手机输入法时，文字会实时送到 Mac 当前的编辑位置，显示区域随键盘调整。
• 在 iPhone Duo 半折叠时，上半屏显示 Mac 桌面，下半屏提供键盘和触控板。
• 短暂切到其他应用，返回后可继续原来的 Mac 会话。

需要 iOS 15 或更新版本、运行 macOS 14 或更新版本的 Mac、Mac 版 GlidePane 和可互通的局域网。半折叠自动布局适用于运行 iOS 27.1 或更新版本的 iPhone Duo。使用时无需注册。

name: GlobemX
description:
GlobemX helps business buyers source products and manage their purchasing workflow.

• Browse products and review product details.
• Submit sourcing requests for products you need.
• Place orders and follow their progress.
• Manage delivery information and your account.
• Contact our team for assistance with sourcing and orders.

Product availability, pricing, payment options, and delivery services may vary by destination. Refer to the information provided for your order or contact our team for details.

name: Goalie Tracker: Hockey Saves
description:
Goalie Tracker turns the stands into a stats booth. Built by a hockey parent for youth hockey goalies, it lets you log every shot as it happens and builds the season numbers for you.

LIVE TRACKING
• Tap the rink where a shot came from, then SAVE, GOAL or MISSED
• Big buttons that are easy to hit in a cold rink
• Period selector with overtime and shootout
• Your team's goals with one tap
• Undo, plus a play-by-play list to fix any mistake
• Goalie changes, backups and pulled goalies (empty-net goals don't count against your goalie)

STATS THAT MATTER
• Save %, goals against per game, shots per game, record and shutouts
• District (regular season) stats front and center
• Tournament stats, one row per tournament
• Home vs. away, by period, and by game type (official games vs. scrimmages)
• Season shot map showing where shots and goals come from
• Missed shot attempts tracked separately from saves
• Shootout record and stop rate

MULTIPLE GOALIES AND TEAMS
• Track as many goalies as you like
• Record which team they played for each game

SHARE AND SYNC
• Share a game recap image (score, goalie stats, periods and shot map) by text in one tap
• Sync across iPhone, iPad and Mac with iCloud
• Import or export games as a spreadsheet (CSV)

No accounts, no ads, and no data collection. Your stats stay on your devices and in your own iCloud.

name: Golden Nest
description:
Follow the markets, research stocks and ETFs. The app brings market news, investment research, and a paper trading portfolio together on your iPhone.

**See what’s moving the market**  
Follow major indices, see which U.S. stocks are gaining or losing ground, and track how different sectors are performing. Check the earnings calendar, build a personal watchlist, and bookmark articles to read later.

**Dig into stocks and ETFs**  
Search by company name or ticker and explore interactive price charts. Review company financial statements and earnings history when available. Compare stocks side by side and see how closely their returns have moved together over time.

**Practice investing with virtual cash**  
Place simulated buy and sell orders, build a practice portfolio, and track its allocation and performance over time. Review your trade history to see how your decisions played out.

**Explore financial scenarios and keep notes**  
See how recurring contributions and inflation affect long-term growth projections, estimate position size based on a risk budget, and convert currencies using reference exchange rates. Save receipts and trade notes on your device by entering them manually or scanning them with on-device text recognition.

name: Goldex for Jewellers
description:
Goldex is management software for jewellery shops in Algeria. This app is a companion to the Goldex web app: it puts the essentials of your shop in your pocket, in Arabic, French or English.

For Goldex customers only
The app only offers sign-in. Goldex creates the accounts, and each shop's owner adds their team from the web app. The app contains no in-app purchases and no subscriptions.

What's inside
• Home: today's sales, cash in the till, pieces in stock, today's gold rates and alerts (repairs ready or late, discounts awaiting approval).
• Sales: ring up a sale by scanning the label or searching for the piece, with customer, discount and payment (cash with change, CIB card, Edahabia, transfer, cheque), or collect it later. All sales by status, with each sale's details.
• Scan: scan the QR code on a Goldex label to open the piece, or type its code.
• Stock: search, filters, each piece's record, and adding a new piece with its photo, priced at the daily rate or a fixed price.
• Supplier purchases: record the pieces received from a supplier with their purchase rate; they go straight into stock.
• Repairs: follow each repair from drop-off to hand-back, collect the balance, and move it to the next stage.
• Customers: your customer list, each customer's details and one-tap calling.

Several shops
If you have access to more than one shop, switch between them from the top bar.

Everyone's permissions
Each team member sees what their permissions allow, as on the web. Till closing, treasury, reports, team and settings stay on the web app.

name: Good Arrows: Darts Games
description:
Good Arrows is the darts scorer for a night at the board. Tap what you hit and it does the maths: busts called, checkouts suggested, turns passed and every result kept.

TWELVE GAMES
• 301, 501 and 701, with optional double-out
• Count-Up
• Golf, over 9 or 18 holes, scored against par
• Cricket
• Killer
• Around the Clock
• Shanghai
• Halve-It
• Bob's 27
• Baseball
• Knockout
• Gotcha

UP TO SIX PLAYERS
Add everyone at the board. Good Arrows keeps the throwing order, lives, honours and who's armed, so nobody has to.

BUILT FOR THE OCHE
• Big keys you can hit with one thumb, dart still in hand
• Checkout routes for every finish from 170 down
• Undo for the dart you tapped wrong
• A colour-coded golf scorecard, editable after the fact
• Celebrations for the big moments, and a roast for the bad ones
• A running record of who actually wins

Every game explains its own rules before you start, so a new player can pick it up between throws.

FREE AND PRO
301, 501, 701 and Count-Up are free, with no ads. Good Arrows Pro unlocks the other ten games, monthly, yearly or once for life.

Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically until cancelled. Cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Good Bit
description:
Some words are worth carrying into the rest of your day. Good Bit offers one short reading from a published work or a collection of traditional sayings. Each reading shows its source so you can explore where it came from.

Read on iPhone or Apple Watch. Set a daily Watch reminder for a time that suits you, add the thought to a rectangular watch face slot, or revisit the past seven days.

Choose from 22 languages and 23 reading editions, including separate German-language collections for Austria and Germany. Each edition includes 365 readings you can enjoy offline.

name: GoSimple Auth
description:
GoSimple Auth keeps your two-step sign-in codes, passkeys and sign-in approvals in one calm, fast app. Everything is encrypted on your phone. No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

CODES THAT JUST WORK
• Time-based (TOTP) and counter (HOTP) codes, plus Steam Guard
• Scan a QR, pick one from a screenshot, paste a link or type the key
• Copy with a tap; the clipboard clears itself after 30 seconds
• See the next code during the last seconds, so you never type one that is about to expire
• Pin favourites, reorder, search

MOVE IN AND OUT FREELY
• Import Google Authenticator export QR codes in one go
• Import files from Aegis, 2FAS, Bitwarden, LastPass, Raivo, Ente, Proton Pass and 1Password
• Step-by-step help for apps that do not allow export
• Export to Google Authenticator QR codes, one QR per account, or a list of links — your codes are never locked in

PASSKEYS AND AUTOFILL
• Create and use passkeys on websites that support them
• Fill codes and passkeys in Safari and apps without opening GoSimple Auth

SIGN-IN APPROVALS (GoSimple Verify)
• Approve sign-ins to GoSimple services by picking the number shown on the website
• “It was not me” blocks new requests and warns the service

SECURITY YOU CAN SEE
• Face ID or a 6-digit PIN, auto-lock timer, optional erase after 10 wrong PINs
• Codes hidden in the app switcher and during screen recording
• Optional: hide codes until tapped
• Security log of unlocks, exports and sign-ins, kept only on the phone
• Time check warns if the phone clock is off

YOUR PHONES, YOUR KEY
• Optional sign-in with Apple or Google to sync between iPhone, iPad and Android
• The synced copy is encrypted with a password only you know; our servers (EU) never see your codes
• Encrypted backup file that opens on both iPhone and Android
• Widgets, Apple Watch and iPad layout

Privacy: https://auth.gosimple.agency/privacy
Terms: https://auth.gosimple.agency/terms

name: Grand Leonida Companion: GTA 6
description:
YOUR UNOFFICIAL GTA 6 COMPANION
The map, Where to find, 100% trackers, cheats, trophies and missions for GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) in one app, with spoiler controls so you only see what you choose.

▸ WHERE TO FIND
Stop searching. Open the map and go.
- 3,146 spots across Leonida, including 368 collectibles, 134 cars, 240 money spots, 64 weapons and 39 encounters, plus shops and activities.
- Filter by category, tick what you have collected and see your progress on each set.

▸ MAP OF LEONIDA
- 3,633 places from the community map at gtadb.org, with photos for many of them.
- Drop your own pins and name them.

▸ TRACKERS: GO FOR 100%
- A 100% tracker with 41 targets, each with its source.
- A Garage of 379 vehicles to tick Found or Owned, an encounter log, and reminders for missables before the mission that locks them out.
- 55 trophies and achievements to tick off, with completion stats.
- Ticks are kept per playthrough. The app cannot read your console or your saves.

▸ CHEATS
- 61 GTA 6 single-player cheats in five groups, with how each one unlocks and its warnings. Searchable.

▸ MISSIONS AND GUIDES
- A mission list from the GTA Wiki (23 main story and 2 side missions so far). Titles stay hidden until you reveal a chapter.
- 243 reference records on vehicles, weapons, characters, regions, buildings, wildlife and music, each labelled Official or Seen in trailer, with its sources.
- 39 news items linked to their sources.

▸ SPOILER-SAFE
A Zero / Light / Major switch decides how much story you see, and the app asks before it reveals more. The counts above include spots, targets and vehicles that only show at Light or Major.

▸ PLAY WITH YOUR CREW (optional, 18+)
- Pick a handle. No email or sign-in.
- Crews: share map pins and plans, and see each member's ticks.
- Finds: post what you have seen on the map, and confirm or dispute other players' finds. Player posts are labelled Player-reported: not official, not checked by Rockstar Games or by us.
- Routes: publish a plan and copy other players' routes.
- Text filter, report and block, and account deletion in Settings.

▸ YOUR OWN SPACE
Save references, write notes, build plans with checklists, keep a save-slot journal, run separate playthroughs, and back up to a file.

FREE AND AD-FREE
Every guide, news item, the map, Where to find and the cheats are free. No ads. No analytics or advertising SDK. No Rockstar login. The community uses an anonymous account (a random id, no email).

GRAND LEONIDA PRO (optional)
- Free keeps up to 25 saved items, 10 notes, 10 map pins, 2 plans, 2 playthroughs, 3 save slots and 3 missable reminders, and limits some community tools (for example 1 crew you create, 4 members per crew and 10 finds a day).
- Pro removes those limits, raises the community limits and adds the full completion stats dashboard, 3 colour themes and 3 alternate app icons.
- Monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription; the App Store shows the price when you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage it in your Apple ID settings. Restore purchases is on the Pro screen.

Terms of use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://shamrockai.ie/apps/grand-leonida/privacy

Grand Leonida Companion is an unofficial, independent fan app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and related names belong to their rights holders. Pictures from Rockstar Games are Rockstar Games' own, credited in the app under Content sources and credits. Information can be out of date; check the sources the app links to. Map and place data: gtadb.org (CC BY 4.0). Wiki text: GTA Wiki on Fandom (CC BY-SA 3.0).

name: Grandpa's Train: Rail Puzzle
description:
Forty years ago, Grandpa's first run started in a snowy mountain town. Now it's your turn.

Grandpa's Train is a cozy track-turning puzzle game. Tap a tile to turn its rail, join the line, press Depart and watch the little red train roll through tiny handcrafted dioramas.

FOUR SEASONS, FOUR LINES
• The Red Line: across the Swiss Alps and over the Landwasser Viaduct to Tirano
• The Eastern Line: from Istanbul under the Bosphorus to Kars
• The Northern Lights Line: from Stockholm to Narvik through the polar night
• The Four Seasons Line: from Tokyo's cherry blossoms to Hirosaki

A NEW IDEA AT EVERY STOP
Lifting bridges, level crossings full of cows and sheep, switches, fog and lamps, blizzards that freeze your rails, a night blast in a mine, northern lights that reveal the track, waves on the shore, mirror tiles, a train lift inside a mountain, and a festival with two trains at once.

COLLECT GRANDPA'S POSTCARDS
Every stop hides postcards along the track. Collect them to fill Grandpa's album and open each season's final.

• 36 handcrafted stops across 4 seasons
• Calm music and tactile sounds
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking
• Optional in-app purchases: tickets, extra moves and the Golden Ticket

name: Groma Timecard
description:
Groma Timecard is the time-tracking app for construction and field crews.

FOR THE CREW
• Clock in and out with GPS, checked against the job site
• Enter hours by job and cost code, or copy yesterday's in one tap
• See your schedule and today's assignment
• Request time off and log daily notes
• Works with a weak signal: entries save and sync when you're back online

FOR FOREMEN
• Enter hours for the whole crew at once
• See who's on the schedule and who's still missing hours
• Track equipment hours alongside labor

FOR THE OFFICE
• Approve or reject timecards in one tap
• Overtime worked out for you, including daily and California rules
• Reports by employee, job, cost code and pay period
• Payroll exports: CSV, PDF, and Foundation and QuickBooks add-ons

Groma Timecard is for companies with a Groma Studios account. Your employer sets up the company and invites you, and you sign in with the login they send.

name: GroundPulse
description:
GroundPulse for iPhone is the phone companion to your organization's GroundPulse account. It shows the alerts and the network map your team sees in the GroundPulse web app, so you can check them in the field.

GroundPulse measures ground movement along pipelines and at bridges from Sentinel-1 satellite radar, processed by Morton Analytics, and ties each measurement to the asset it affects.

In the app:
- Alerts: the alerts on your network, newest first, with severity, the asset, the rate the alert rule fired on and the confidence. Pull down to refresh, and acknowledge an alert from its detail.
- Map: your pipeline segments and bridges, each drawn by status: Moved beyond threshold, Watch, Stable, Preliminary screening or Not measurable. Not measurable is a result and is shown, never hidden. Tap a segment for its nearby ground rate with P50 and P90, or a bridge for its displacement rate and its NBI details.
- Your position on the map, if you allow location. It stays on the iPhone.
- Sign in with your GroundPulse email and password, with a two-factor code if your account uses one. Sign out in Settings removes everything the app stored on the iPhone.

An account is required: your GroundPulse administrator invites you from the GroundPulse web app. The app does not create accounts and has no purchases.

name: Groundrr
description:
Groundrr helps you find someone nearby to play with. Pick the sports you’re into, see who’s around, and send a Grounder: a quick invite with the sport, a time and a public place to meet.

Play the sports you actually play
Catch, skiing, snowboarding, pickleball, running, yoga, basketball, tennis, golf, soccer, volleyball, climbing, bowling, skating, darts, ping pong, weightlifting, Pilates, football, and even doggy playdates. Tick the ones you want to see in one simple checklist.

Ready now
Free right now? Turn on Ready now and you go to the top for anyone nearby who opens the app.

Built for safety
• For adults 18 and older
• Your exact location is never shared. Other members only see a rough distance.
• Meet in public places. Every invite asks for one.
• Report or block anyone from their profile or from chat. A person reviews every safety report.
• Delete your account anytime from Me.

Not a dating app
Groundrr is about the game: no swiping, no matching, no ratings of people. Just find someone to play with.

New in your area?
Groundrr is new. If nobody’s near you yet, look farther, turn on Ready now, or invite a friend. Every invite helps.

name: GS Academy
description: Explorez l'univers Grand Seiko, développez votre expertise et devenez un véritable ambassadeur de la Marque.

name: GT TRAININGEN
description:
LET OP: JE HEBT EEN GT TRAININGEN ACCOUNT NODIG OM IN TE LOGGEN IN DEZE APP. 

Sporten is nog leuker met onze GT TRAININGEN Fitness app. Gratis te gebruiken voor al onze leden! De ideale App voor een fit én gezond leven. Bereik je doelen en blijf gemotiveerd met de nieuwe GT TRAININGEN app. Houd je workouts en vooruitgang bij en laat ons je op weg helpen.

Met de GT TRAININGEN app kun je:
• De lesroosters en de openingstijden van jouw club bekijken
• Je dagelijkse fitnessactiviteiten bijhouden
• Je gewicht en andere statistieken invoeren en je voortgang bijhouden
• Duidelijke 3D demonstraties bekijken (er staan meer dan 2000 oefeningen in!)
• Vele kant-en-klare workouts gebruiken
• Zelf workouts samenstellen
• Meer dan 150 achievements verdienen

Kies de workout die bij jou past en start met jouw ideale training: in de sportschool of thuis. Houd je fitnessprestaties bij van conditie tot kracht, van afvallen tot groepsles: deze App is jouw eigen Personal Trainer en geeft je de motivatie die je nodig hebt! Upgrade naar de PRO-versie en je krijgt nog meer extra’s!

Je kunt deze app syncen met de Apple Gezondheid App. Wanneer je deze connectie activeert, worden je workouts in de Gezondheid app automatisch toegevoegd aan je activiteitenkalender.

name: GTA VI: Walkthrough
description:
The unofficial companion guide for GTA VI.

• Every main mission, side mission and story task, with clear step-by-step walkthroughs
• Spoiler-safe: hide spoilers until you're ready
• All discovered cheat codes for PS5 and Xbox, with the real D-pad inputs and how to unlock each one
• Easter eggs and secrets, with what's verified and what's still a rumour
• Interactive map of Leonida with mission locations, shops, gun shops, mod shops, safehouses, hotels, transport and landmarks
• Show any mission on the map in one tap

Free with ads. Remove all ads with a one-off purchase.

Map tiles and places data adapted from GTADB.org & the GTA VI Mapping Community, CC BY 4.0.

Unofficial fan guide. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and GTA are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.

Privacy Policy: https://chigz90.github.io/privacy/

name: Guard Condomínio
description:
O aplicativo oferece recursos e ferramentas voltadas a digitalização dos processos, além de possibilitar a interação dos
usuários com as tecnologias
utilizadas no local.
Funcionalidades do App:

- Cadastramento de Autorizados com foto
- Abertura de Portas e Portões
- Histórico de Acesso

- Convite autônomo via Chave Virtual

- Bilhetes para portaria

name: Günlük Çengel Bulmaca
description:
Gazete bulmacalarının keyfi şimdi cebinde. Her gün 7 yepyeni çengel bulmaca!

HER GÜN 7 BULMACA
Her gece yarısı 7 yeni bulmaca gelir: 2 kolay, 2 orta, 2 zor ve 1 usta. Aynı gün herkes aynı bulmacaları çözer. Son 14 günün bulmacaları da her zaman elinin altında.

KLASİK ÇENGEL DÜZENİ
İpuçları kutuların içinde, oklar kelimenin yönünü gösterir. Seçtiğin kelimenin ipucu ekranın üstünde büyük harflerle yazar; küçük ekranda bile rahatça okursun.

TÜRKÇE KLAVYE
Ç, Ğ, I, İ, Ö, Ş ve Ü harfleri tek dokunuşla. Kelime bitince sıradaki kelimeye kendiliğinden geçilir.

TAKILDIĞINDA İPUCU
Bir harf aç, bütün kelimeyi aç ya da yazdıklarını kontrol et. Her gün ücretsiz ipucu kazanırsın.

SERİNİ BÜYÜT
Her gün en az bir bulmaca çöz, serini büyüt. İstatistik ekranında en iyi serini, çözdüğün bulmacaları ve ortalama sürelerini gör.

İSTERSEN BÜYÜT
Izgarayı büyütüp kaydırarak oyna. iPhone ve iPad'de çalışır.

Hesap yok, kayıt yok. İlerlemen yalnızca cihazında saklanır. Bulmacalar ücretsizdir ve reklamlarla desteklenir.

name: Gurbani Home
description:
Gurbani Home brings the Guru's word into your day, simply and beautifully.

Daily Quote
Each day opens with a quote from Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji, shown in Gurmukhi with transliteration, a Punjabi meaning and an English meaning. Show or hide each part to suit how you read, and browse back through earlier days with a swipe or the calendar.

Today's Hukamnama
Read the daily Hukamnama from Sri Harmandir Sahib, Amritsar, as published by SGPC. Go back up to 30 days to read the ones you missed.

Share Gurbani
Share a quote as a beautiful image card or as plain text. Share the Hukamnama as separate cards for the Gurbani, the Punjabi meaning and the English translation.

Favorites
Save the quotes and Hukamnamas that move you, and find them again anytime in their own sections.

Made for comfortable reading
Adjust the text size for each part separately, switch between day and night mode with one tap, and choose from a set of peaceful backgrounds that change daily.

Private by design
No accounts, no ads and no data collected.

Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa, Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh.

name: GustGlyph
description:
Look at a runway and a reported wind. Which side is the wind coming from? How much of it is headwind? GustGlyph helps you practice that call before you see the answer.

WIND LAB
Set a runway heading, wind direction and speed. Switch between true and magnetic reference, adjust local variation, and watch the diagram resolve the wind into components. Turn on gusts or change the view from runway up to north up.

FOUR OFFLINE DRILL MODES
Practice crosswind and headwind estimates, true-to-magnetic conversion, simulated runway selection, and wind-triangle problems. Choose a difficulty and a session of 3, 5, 8 or 10 questions. After you answer, review the calculation and see how close your estimate was. Saved sessions make it easy to revisit your progress on the same device.

REAL REPORTS FOR STUDY
When connected, look up airport observations from the NOAA Aviation Weather Center and inspect their timestamps. No connection is needed for the lab or generated drills.

Designed for iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad and Mac. A one-time purchase with no account required. For educational use only. Not a flight-planning or navigation instrument.

name: Gym AMS
description:
PLEASE NOTE: YOU NEED A Gym AMS ACCOUNT TO ACCESS THIS APP. IF YOU'RE A MEMBER GET IT FOR FREE AT YOUR GYM!
 
Begin your journey to a healthier lifestyle and let Gym AMS help you along the way. Introducing  Gym AMS, most comprehensive fitness platform with:

• Check class schedules and opening hours
• Track your daily fitness activities
• Track your weight and other body metrics
• Over 2000+ exercises and activities
• Clear 3D exercise demonstrations
• Preset workouts and the option to create your own
• Over 150 badges to earn

Select workouts online and synchronize them with your app to workout at home or in the gym while keeping track of your progress. From strength to weight lifting, this app acts as your own personal trainer guiding and giving you the motivation you need.

You can sync this app with Apple Health App. If you enable this connection, any workout in the Health app with automatically be added to your Activity Calendar.

name: Hain! Filipino Diner Rush
description:
Run a busy Filipino karinderya with only one pair of hands.

You are Nena. Seat the guests, take their orders, cook every dish by hand at the stations, carry the plates out, collect the bill and clear the table, all before the next party runs out of patience. Fast, happy service builds a combo. A guest who walks out breaks it.

COOK EVERY DISH BY HAND
Each dish is a short recipe of real steps. Chop in rhythm, hold the pan and let go before it burns, tap to plate, and take the pot off the fire while it is ready. Adobo, Sinigang, Pancit, Kare-Kare, Crispy Pata, Halo-Halo and more: 42 dishes in all.

THREE VENUES, THIRTY DAYS
Start at the Corner Eatery, fire up the grills at the Seaside Grill, then feed whole fiestas at Fiesta Hall. Each day brings something new: impatient guests, big tippers, food critics, kids who leave a mess, rush hours, power flickers and surprise VIPs.

MAKE THE PLACE YOURS
Spend the day's earnings on faster stoves, a bigger tray, quick slippers, extra tables and new recipes. Move the tables and stations into the layout that works for you, and dress the place as a Bamboo Hut, a Fiesta or a Heritage House. The music corner, from a potted plant to an acoustic duo, keeps waiting guests patient.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- In landscape, on a phone or a tablet
- English or Filipino
- Fully offline: no account, no ads, no in-app purchases
- Colorblind palette, reduced motion and optional hints. Every meter has marks and icons, not only color.

Hain! means "serve the food" in Filipino. Come hungry.

name: Hairline: Tunnel Runner
description:
Cut it close. Risk it all.

Hairline is a fast 3D tunnel runner where the closer you fly, the more you score. Skim past walls, spinning saw blades and swinging pendulums to build your multiplier, and thread the tightest gaps for a Hairline pass worth more than double.

CAMPAIGN
Fly 15 levels across five worlds, from Skyline to Zenith, each ending at a finish line. Earn bronze, silver and gold medals, and take on each world's Overdrive level when you're ready for something harder.

ENDLESS
- Daily course: one tunnel a day, the same for every pilot. Learn it and climb the daily leaderboard.
- Random course: a brand-new tunnel every run. Nothing to memorize, only reflexes.

PHASE
Grazing charges Phase. Spend a charge to ghost through obstacles for half a second when you're boxed in.

HANGAR
Earn ships by playing, level each one up as you fly it, and unlock new colors, trails, finish celebrations and crash effects. Ships are looks only: every ship flies the same, so the leaderboard is pure skill.

PLAY ANYWHERE
No account needed. Sign in with Apple, Google or email to keep your progress on all your devices and at playhairline.com.

No ads.

name: HairUnion
description:
HairUnion er det sosiale nettverket for alle som jobber med hår i Norge: frisører, barberere, kolorister, lærlinger, salongeiere og leverandører.

VIS FREM ARBEIDET DITT
Del bilder og videoer av klipp, farger og styling. Bygg din faglige profil og bli sett av kolleger og salonger.

FØLG KOLLEGER
Følg frisører og barberere i hele landet og se hva de jobber med.

DEL TIPS OG STILL SPØRSMÅL
Få svar fra fagfolk og hjelp andre med din erfaring.

KURS OG MESSER
Få varsel om kurs, workshops og messer i bransjen.

KJØP OG SELG UTSTYR
Finn brukt og nytt utstyr, eller selg det du ikke trenger.

CHAT
Send meldinger direkte til andre i bransjen.

JOBB OG STOLLEIE
Finn ledige stillinger, lærlingplasser og stoler til leie – eller finn den rette personen til salongen din.

HairUnion er gratis for alle i hårbransjen.

name: Hakuma: Photo Borders
description:
Hakuma puts a border around your photos, arranges several on one canvas, and exports them at Instagram size or at the full resolution of your originals.

It is for photos you have already edited. There are no filters and no colour tools. What it does is the mat, the lines, the layout and the export.

BORDERS
Set the border with a slider, type an exact value, or drag the edges of the mat on the canvas. Adjust all four sides together or each side on its own, for a weighted bottom or an instant film shape. Every width is shown as a percentage and in pixels.
Choose the paper colour from neutrals, from colours taken out of your own photo, or from the colour picker. Round the corners if you want to.

KEY LINES
Add thin lines around each photo: a hairline black, then a band of white, then another line if you like. Set the width and colour of each, and drag them into order. A soft shadow is there for when a print should sit above the paper.

LAYOUTS
15 layouts: single, two, three and four stacked, side by side, strips, four up, six up, one over two, a large photo over three small ones, and three loose arrangements where prints overlap.
Drag the dividers to resize the frames. Hold a photo and drag it onto another to swap them. Pinch to zoom and drag to reposition inside a frame, or switch a frame to Fit to show the whole photo. Loose prints can be moved, resized and tilted.

TEMPLATES AND STYLES
31 templates in seven groups: Borders, Stacks, Grids, Film, Scrapbook, Editorial and Story. They include a film strip with sprocket holes, a contact sheet, and a layout that prints a row of colour swatches taken from the photo.
Eight styles are built in. Save your own border and line settings as a style and apply it to any project.

CAPTION
One line of text above or below the photos, in serif, italic, sans or mono.

SIZES
3:4, 4:5, 1:1, 9:16, 1.91:1 and 2:3. A guide shows the Story safe area on 9:16, and on wider canvases it shows what the 3:4 profile grid will hide.

EXPORT
Instagram size is 1080 pixels wide.
Original size grows the canvas until no photo is scaled down. Two 60 megapixel landscapes stacked on a 3:4 canvas export at more than 100 megapixels. The export screen shows the pixel size and megapixels before you save, and tells you if any photo is being enlarged.
Exports are JPEG, rendered from your original files and compressed once. Save to Photos or send through the share sheet.

WHAT IT LEAVES OUT
No account. No ads. No analytics. No subscription and no in-app purchases.
The app makes no network connections. Nothing is uploaded. Your photos and projects are stored on your device and nowhere else.

Projects save as you work, with undo and redo. Duplicate a project to try a second version.

Hakuma was made by a working photographer.

Hakuma is not affiliated with Instagram or Meta. Instagram is a trademark of Instagram, LLC.

name: Halftime : Bathroom Banter
description:
Halftime is a private group chat on a 15-minute timer.

Every other app is built so you never leave. Halftime gives you 15 minutes per visit, then the chat locks until your next bathroom break.

LOG IN WITH YOUR TOILET
Point your camera at your toilet and you're in. No joke, no password. The scan is checked on your phone and never uploaded, stored, or seen by anyone.

YOU GET 15 MINUTES
When the clock runs out, the room frosts over and your life resumes. Next time, you pick up right where you left off. The rules apply to everyone, so there's no FOMO.

ONE SHOT PER VISIT
Your best line gets framed for the room and rated by the group. The leader hangs at the top of the chat until somebody takes the crown. Standings reset every Sunday.

BUILT FOR YOUR GROUP
Private, invite-only rooms. No feed, no followers, no ads, no tracking. Just the people you'd actually text.

Free. Private. 15 minutes at a time.

name: Hamletry: Daily Town Puzzle
description:
Every day at 00:00 UTC, a new small isle rises from the sea. Every player in the world gets the same isle and the same cards in the same order. Place the buildings one by one, link neighbors into chains, and see how high you can score.

[How to play]
• Each card is a building. Tap an empty tile to preview the points, then tap again to build
• Buildings call their partners next door: a house calls a market, a market calls a square, a square calls a house
• The building you place moves first, then every partner it calls moves in turn. The 1st building scores 1 point, the 2nd scores 2, the 3rd scores 3, and so on
• A workshop starts chains, a garden next to a lake earns +2, and a belfry calls every neighbor (two tiles away when it stands on a hill)
• You can see the next 3 cards, so you can keep the right tile free for what comes next
• An isle takes about 3 to 5 minutes. Each isle has a target score. Reach 70% of it for bronze, 90% for silver, and the full target for gold

[A town every week]
• Monday to Sunday, seven isles form one map. Finish all seven to complete the week's town
• The next day, see where your score landed among all players and the average score
• Share an image of your isle or your week's town with friends

[More isles]
• Lessons: five short isles that teach each building
• Past isles: the last 3 days are free. Open older isles with bricks or with the Isle Archive
• Big Isles: 40 larger isles with about 30 cards each. The first 3 are free

[Bricks]
• Earn bricks by finishing today's isle, completing a week, or watching an optional video
• Spend bricks to swap the current and next card, undo a move, or open a past isle
• There are no random rewards. You see every price before you choose

[Premium and other purchases]
• Monthly and yearly plans: no ads, every past isle, all Big Isles, and 20 bricks every day. Both start with a 7-day free trial
• Lifetime: the same benefits with a one-time purchase
• Isle Archive and Big Isles: one-time purchases that unlock each set
• Brick packs in several sizes, and a one-time starter pack

No account or login is needed. The app is available in 39 languages.

[About subscriptions]
• Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically. At the end of the free trial or of each period, the price of the chosen plan is charged to your Apple ID
• A subscription renews at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• You can cancel in Subscriptions in your App Store account settings
• One-time purchases do not renew

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://crelve-ward-chain.web.app/privacy.html

name: Hamster Fling
description:
Load the slingshot, pull back and FLING!

Hamster Fling is a one-thumb arcade game you can play in a few minutes. Hold to dive down the hills, let go on the way up and watch your hamster soar. Every run earns seeds to upgrade your slingshot, drag, dive and rockets — so the next fling goes even farther.

• ONE-THUMB FUN — Hold to dive, release to fly. Easy to learn, satisfying to master.
• PERFECT LANDINGS & COMBOS — Land smoothly, fly through golden rings and chain combos into FEVER for 5× seeds.
• SIX WORLDS — Roll through Sunny Meadow, ride steam geysers in Dusty Canyon, slide across Frosty Glacier, catch tailwinds in Maple Woods, float on the low-gravity Candy Moon and brave the fiery Lava Peaks.
• DAILY CHALLENGE — A new course with a twist every day. Win bronze, silver and gold medals.
• THE SKY REALM — Late game, ride updrafts above the clouds, hop from cloud to cloud and collect stardust for constellation powers.
• COLLECT CRITTERS — Open capsules to find hamsters, hedgehogs, chinchillas and more, each with its own perk.
• TROPHIES & BALL SKINS — 38 big goals to chase, with 21 ball skins to earn or unlock.
• UPGRADE & GO FARTHER — Six upgrade tracks and rockets for that final push.
• DAILY GOALS — Fresh missions every day and a 7-day reward streak.
• FAIR BY DESIGN — Everything can be earned by playing. Videos are optional and give bonuses; ad breaks are rare and never interrupt a run.

Short sessions, big flights. How far can your hamster go?

name: Hangerly
description:
Stop buying things you won't wear. Match This before you buy.

Hangerly is your private digital wardrobe. See what you already own, put outfits together and make more informed decisions when shopping.

YOUR WARDROBE
Photograph your clothes and keep them together in one place. Hangerly uses AI to identify the category, colour and brand when visible, making it easier to catalogue your wardrobe.

MATCH THIS
Found something you like in a shop? Point your camera at it. Match This compares the garment with clothes you already own, helping you decide whether it belongs in your wardrobe before you buy.

BUILD OUTFITS
Put pieces from your wardrobe together and save your outfits.

KNOW WHAT YOU WEAR
Log your wears, track cost per wear and explore wardrobe insights, including your brand breakdown.

YOUR WARDROBE IS PRIVATE
Your wardrobe is personal to your account. Hangerly uses third-party AI processing to identify clothing and provide Match This results. There is no public feed or advertising.

HANGERLY PRO
Hangerly is free to download. Hangerly Pro is available through monthly and yearly auto-renewable subscriptions, each offering a 3-day free trial for eligible subscribers.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm a paid purchase or when your free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://hangerly.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://hangerly.app/terms

name: HANSA Recorder
description:
HANSA Recorder is an offline voice recorder that looks and feels like a portable cassette deck.

Tap REC to record, PLAY to play, and STOP to save. Recordings are saved automatically, with the date and time as the title. No account, no ads, and no data is collected. Everything stays on your device.

The tape reels turn as you record and play, and the tape winds from one reel to the other, just like a real cassette.

Free version:
- Record up to 30 minutes per recording.

One-time purchase (Full Version) unlocks:
- Unlimited recording time
- Folder management
- Export and sharing
- Waveform trimming
- Silence skip
- Lossless recording
- Markers
- Silence-cut saving

Find your recordings in the tape window list, search by title, rename, delete, or share them. Recordings are saved as files in the app, so you can also find them in the Files app.

name: Happy HSC
description:
Happy HSC is a study app for NSW HSC students. Practise unlimited exam-style questions, learn from worked solutions and lessons, and keep your whole HSC year on track with a small target each day.

PRACTISE LIKE THE REAL EXAM
• Thousands of practice questions across 20 subjects, all free, written for this app and inspired by past HSC exams
• Sit a full mock exam for a subject, or practise one syllabus topic at a time
• Multiple choice, written answers, diagrams, code and the online-exam formats
• Every question comes in several versions, so a second round isn't just remembering the answer
• Formula sheets, data sheets and the periodic table one tap away

UNDERSTAND EVERY ANSWER
• A worked solution for every question (part of the subscription after your first 10 days)
• Multiple-choice solutions explain why the right answer is right and why each wrong option is wrong
• Written answers are self-assessed against a sample answer: rate how many marks you think you earned, and weaker topics come back sooner

A LESSON FOR EVERY TOPIC
• Over 1,200 lessons, one set for each syllabus topic (lesson text is part of the subscription after your first 10 days; titles are always visible)
• Each lesson has a goal, clear explanations, worked examples, common mistakes, a quick check and a summary
• Jump from a lesson straight to its questions, or from a question back to the lesson

PLAN YOUR HSC YEAR
• Tell the app the year you sit the HSC and it works out a daily target from your subjects and the time left
• Today shows one suggested topic for each subject, with a line saying why
• Charts show your progress against the pace needed for the Trials and the HSC exams
• A weekly review of what you covered and what to revisit
• No streaks to lose and no red warnings if you miss a day

FREE, AND THE SUBSCRIPTION
• Every question is free, in every version
• Everything is open for your first 10 days
• After that, the daily plan, progress tracking and questions stay free. A subject subscription adds that subject's full worked solutions, its lesson text, and printing and sharing PDFs
• Each subject is its own subscription, A$5 a month (price shown in your currency in the App Store), so you only pay for the subjects you study. Subscribe to any 3 subjects and every subject unlocks (all subjects is A$15 a month)
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically every month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID subscription settings
• Terms of Use: https://toxgam.github.io/happyhsc/terms/
• Privacy Policy: https://toxgam.github.io/happyhsc/privacy/

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• No account and no ads
• Works offline
• Your progress is stored on your device

SUBJECTS
Mathematics Standard 1 and 2, Mathematics Advanced, Extension 1 and 2; English Standard, Advanced, EAL/D, Studies and Extension 1; Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Earth and Environmental Science, Investigating Science; Business Studies, Economics; Design and Technology, Software Engineering, Enterprise Computing.

Question and lesson depth varies by subject: English has fewer questions than the others, because most of its marks are for extended writing.

Happy HSC is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by NESA. Its questions are original and are not actual exam papers.

name: Hariprabodham Parivaar
description:
Hariprabodham Parivaar brings your local Hariprabodham mandal together in one simple, tap-first app.

The app is for members of a Hariprabodham satsang mandal, starting with Calgary. You sign up as a Yuvak or Yuvati, choose your group (Married, Single, Ambrish or Sahishnu), and an App Admin Karya-Karta of your mandal approves you before you can see anything inside.

MARYADA AND PRIVACY
- Bhai and Ben sections stay private from each other, as maryada asks.
- Your phone number stays hidden unless you choose to show it.
- No ads, no tracking, and your data is never sold.

SUNDAY SABHA AND PRASAD SEVA
- See the next sabha on Home with the time and place.
- Tap any Sunday on the calendar to book Prasad Seva for that sabha, for yourself or for a family member.
- Register for the sabha and ask for ride seva if you need a pickup.

HARIPRABODHAM CALENDAR
- A compact month calendar with sabhas, utsav, ekadashi and mandal events.
- Event pages with details, flyers and seva slots you can book with one tap.

STAY CONNECTED
- Notifications for sabha reminders, event changes, new events, seva bookings, birthdays, announcements, polls and approvals. Turn each category on or off in Settings.
- Birthday wishes and gunanuvad: see who has a birthday today and this week, and send a wish or a gunanuvad.
- Sabha photos, the member directory, and jobs and business notes from members.

FOR APP ADMIN KARYA-KARTA
- Approve or reject new members.
- Add events, calendar dates, seva slots, announcements, polls and photos.
- Remove content and manage members to keep the mandal safe.

You can report or block content you find objectionable, and you can delete your account at any time from Settings.

Hariprabodham Parivaar is free and is made by NC Pictures Ltd., Calgary.

name: HARMONIC MIDI VISUALIZER
description:
HARMONIC MIDI VISUALIZER di BjM Mario Bajardi.

Visualizzatore armonico MIDI a 11 voci, sintetizzatore polifonico legato in tempo reale ed esportatore di video musicali MP4 Full HD.

HARMONIC MIDI VISUALIZER trasforma qualsiasi progressione di accordi o file MIDI in una esperienza visiva e sonora minimalista che mette al centro il movimento delle voci, la purezza della intonazione e la creazione di video musicali verticali.

CARATTERISTICHE PRINCIPALI

Visualizzazione Voice Leading a 11 voci a 60 e 120 fotogrammi al secondo. Segui in tempo reale come una singola nota all unisono si apre in 11 voci armoniche indipendenti, disegnando curve di Bezier luminose su una tastiera di 56 tasti centrata e una griglia cromatica al neon.

Glissato legato continuo al 100 per cento senza riattacco. Il motore audio nativo Apple AVAudioEngine a 48 kHz Stereo integra la fase di 11 oscillatori continui: quando la progressione passa da un accordo al successivo, gli accordi non vengono ribattuti ma scivolano in puro legato lungo le curve con un respiro espressivo naturale e una coda di rilascio morbida.

Sistema Armonico Temperato con enarmonia intelligente. L applicazione analizza la tonalita tramite il Circolo delle Quinte e costruisce ogni accordo per terze diatoniche dalla fondamentale reale, mostrando accordi, gradi romani e note reali con tipografia editoriale Didot Serif.

12 Timbri Synth multi strato e Riverbero Hall editabile. Scegli tra 12 timbri polifonici ricchi tra cui Warm Analog Pad, SuperSaw, Cinematic Brass, Hybrid Celli, Analog Poly, Celestial Choir, Symphony Strings, Ambient Shimmer, Electric Piano, Rhodes, Cathedral Organ e Crystal Harp. Regola in tempo reale Tempo di Glide, Coda di Rilascio, Riverbero Hall Stereo, Filtro Cutoff e Volume Master.

Sfondo Video o Foto personalizzato e Rendering Finale Video MP4. Inserisci qualsiasi tuo video o foto come sfondo in loop regolando la velatura scura e genera direttamente dall app il file video MP4 finale in formato 1080 per 1920 Full HD con audio stereo 48 kHz legato pronto per la condivisione.

Funziona interamente offline, zero pubblicita e zero tracciamento dati.

name: Header Inspector
description: Header Inspector is a mobile workspace for sending HTTP requests and reading responses without leaving your phone. Pick a method, enter a URL, tune query parameters, headers, and body, then send and inspect status, timing, and payload in one flow. Save frequent calls into collections and favorites so you can reopen setups without auto-sending. Browse recent traffic in history, switch between plain text and formatted views, and validate URLs before you run. Sensitive header values can be redacted by default, and your history and collections stay on this device. Appearance settings, default timeouts, and export or import help you move setups between sessions when you need to. Built for API checks, webhook probes, header experiments, and quick network sanity tests when a laptop is not handy.

name: Heat Seekers: Card Collecting
description:
Heat Seekers is the card app built by a collector, for collectors. Scan a card and see what it's worth, keep your whole collection in one place, and see which cards are heating up.

SCAN AND PRICE
• Scan a raw card or a slab with your camera, or add one from a photo
• See every grade's value side by side: raw, PSA, BGS, CGC and more
• Prices come from price guides and recent sold values, each with a link to check it yourself

YOUR COLLECTION IN ONE PLACE
• Pokémon, One Piece, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana, sports cards and more
• Watch what your collection is worth, day by day
• Build binder pages, share them with a link or post them to your Story

HEAT INDEX
• See which cards are rising and falling, game by game

ASK ABOUT ANY CARD
• Ask how a card has done lately and see its sales on a chart

SEEKER
• Keep a list of the cards you're hunting and hear when a good price shows up

SELL AND TRADE
• Check a trade before you make it
• Write and post an eBay listing in a few taps
• Photo pre-grade: a read of centering, corners, edges and surface before you send a card in

FREE, WITH NO ADS
Heat Seekers is free and has no ads, ever. Some eBay links may earn us a small commission if you buy, at no extra cost to you. Heat Seekers Pro removes the monthly limits on scans, questions, pre-grades and listings, with a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel them in your Apple account settings.

Terms of Use: https://heat-seeker.dev/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://heat-seeker.dev/privacy.html

Heat Seekers is an independent app, not affiliated with The Pokémon Company, Bandai, Konami, Wizards of the Coast, Disney, Topps, Panini, PSA or any other card maker or grader.

name: HeicFix: HEIC to JPG, PNG, PDF
description:
Your iPhone saves photos as HEIC. Windows, Android, many websites and upload forms can't open them. HeicFix fixes that in one tap.

CONVERT IN ONE TAP
• HEIC → JPG that opens everywhere: Windows, Android, email, the web
• Choose JPG quality, or keep it lossless with PNG
• Your first photo is free

SHRINK TO ANY SIZE IN KB OR MB
Visa portals, job sites and government forms often reject big files. Pick 200 KB, 500 KB, 1, 2 or 5 MB — or type the exact limit the form asks for — and the app finds the best quality that fits.

PHOTOS TO PDF
Combine passport scans, receipts or documents into one PDF, one page per photo. Ready to email or upload.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Everything happens on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded
• Remove location and camera metadata before you share
• Works offline

CONVERT FROM ANYWHERE
• Batch convert many photos at once
• "Convert to JPG" right from the Photos share sheet
• Save to Photos, save to Files or share directly
• History keeps your converted files ready to share again

HEICFIX PRO
Unlimited photos, batch conversion, PNG, PDF, fit-under-size and share-sheet conversion without limits.

Subscriptions: Pro is available as a weekly subscription (with a free trial where offered) or a yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://heicfix.app/privacy

name: Heistbook: Tips for GTA 6
description:
Heistbook is a GTA 6 guide that works offline.

- All 61 cheats as PlayStation or Xbox button presses, with how each one unlocks. Spawn cheats link straight to the vehicle.
- Every mission with a step-by-step walkthrough, rewards, trophies and a checklist. Missable missions are flagged so you don't lose them.
- Safe codes, hidden stashes and easter eggs, with where to find them.
- Nearly 500 vehicles with stats, prices and resale value. Sort by speed, price or what a stolen car sells for.
- Weapons, characters, 245 animals for hunting and fishing, radio stations and gangs.
- A map you can filter to show missions, secrets, shops, gun stores and other places.
- Spoiler protection keeps story details hidden until you tap to see them.
- Progress syncs across your devices through iCloud.
- Guide updates download on their own, so fixes and new content arrive without an app update.
- Spot a mistake? Tap Report a problem on any item and it reaches us right away.
- The app is free with a small banner ad. One purchase removes the ads on all your devices.

Unofficial fan guide. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. GTA and Grand Theft Auto are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive.

name: Hej Herford
description:
HEJ Herford jetzt auch als digitale App-Variante

Ab sofort stehen im App-Store von Apple die aktuelle, und zukünftige Ausgaben zum Download bereit. Und nicht nur das. Diese Features bietet die neue, kostenlose App:

Integration von Bildergalerien, Videos und weiteren interaktiven Elementen für eine lebendige Berichterstattung
Intuitive Bedienung mit Zoom- und Suchfunktion, Lese- und Vorlesemodus
Kostenlose und einfache Zugänglichkeit auf verschiedenen Geräten (Smartphone, Tablet)
Alle Ausgaben jederzeit digital abrufbar – kein Papierchaos und immer griffbereit
Möglichkeit für Bürger, Kommentare zu hinterlassen
Offline-Verfügbarkeit für unterwegs
Drei Tage früher online als die Printvariante

Also: Jetzt die App herunterladen und dann immer etwas früher informiert sein.

name: Helldrop: Demon Ambush
description:
You command the demons. A lone marine is racing for the exit, and you decide where his next fight begins.

Start with seven bite-sized training encounters. Learn to summon out of sight, slam a door and time a barrel explosion. Then take on eight campaign maps and hunt for a ninth, secret map.

Tap Ambush to send a demon onto the marine’s route, or choose a floor yourself. Hidden summons arrive immediately and cost fewer souls. Watch where the marine turns for weapons and health, then use the souls you earn from damage to set up the next encounter.

Play offline on iPhone. Your progress and best clear times stay on your device.

name: Hen Pens: Daily Logic Puzzle
description:
Place one hen in every row, every column and every coloured pen, so that no two hens touch, not even at a corner. Every board has exactly one answer.

Tap once to mark a square, twice to place a hen, or slide a finger to mark many. Broken rules glow red, Undo is always there, and a hint shows one right hen.

A new 8×8 board every day keeps your streak going, and 50 levels grow from 5×5 to 9×9. Plays offline, in 11 languages.

Hen Pens shows ads between puzzles and offers an optional purchase to remove them.

name: HER Shape
description:
Download de HER shape app met de volgende functionaliteiten:

• Aanmelden bij ons
• Inplannen van trainingen
• Beheren van je boekingen
• Communiceren met ons
• Beheren van je profiel en voorkeuren
• Push notificaties over wijzigingen van de training
• Synchroniseren van de agenda

name: Herdbase360
description:
Herdbase360 is the farm record book for livestock farmers in Africa. Keep every animal, batch, treatment and sale in one place on your phone, and keep working when there is no network: records save on the phone and sync when you are back online.

FOR EVERY KIND OF HERD
Cattle, goats, sheep, poultry and fish. Register animals one by one or as batches, scan their QR tags with the camera, and see each animal's history at a glance.

RECORD THE DAY'S WORK IN SECONDS
• Weights and body condition, with growth over time
• Vaccinations, treatments and disease alerts, with reminders when something is due
• Breeding, heat, services and expected due dates
• Feed stock and feeding, milk and egg collection, hatchery and pond records
• Deaths and losses, with the reason

KNOW WHERE THE MONEY GOES
Record sales and expenses and see what each species is costing and earning.

RUN THE FARM AS A TEAM
Invite your farm workers with their own sign-in and choose what each person can see and do. Give out tasks and see what is overdue.

ASK ABOUT YOUR FARM
The assistant answers questions from your own records, such as "which animals are overdue for vaccination?" It asks for your permission before it sends anything to its AI service.

A Herdbase360 account works on the phone and on the web at app.herdbaseafrica.com.

name: HerHeavy: Period Workout Log
description:
Most workout trackers are built for men. HerHeavy is built for you.

Your strength isn't the same every week. It shifts with your menstrual cycle. Yet most gym logs treat a bad session in your luteal phase the same as a bad week, and compare you against a body that doesn't have a cycle. HerHeavy is a workout tracker made by a woman who lifts, for women who lift.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS BY CYCLE PHASE
Every workout is matched to your cycle phase automatically: menstrual, follicular, ovulation or luteal. Then compare like with like:
• Phase to phase: this luteal phase vs. your last luteal phase
• Every cycle: all your months side by side, with your strongest phase in each
• This month: how your current phases compare
• Mid-workout: see what you lifted in the same phase last cycle

SIMPLE GYM LOG
• Log weight, sets and reps. Nothing else.
• Follow your own workout plan, or log as you go
• A different weight for every set
• 200+ exercises, or add your own
• kg or lb

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your workouts and period data stay on your iPhone
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Export or delete your data any time

HERHEAVY PRO
Logging, your plan and the cycle calendar are free. HerHeavy Pro unlocks phase-by-phase progress comparisons and unlimited workouts in your plan.
