Start with 1 month free, then €4.99 a month or €29.99 a year. Prices vary by country. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

HerHeavy is a training tracker, not a medical device. It does not give medical advice and is not for contraception.

Terms of use: https://molinalabs.com/herheavy/terms
Privacy policy: https://molinalabs.com/herheavy/privacy

name: Héritage Musulman
description:
Comprends enfin ce que tu récites.

Héritage Musulman t'apprend le sens du Coran mot à mot, en jouant quelques minutes par jour.

• COMPRENDRE LE CORAN
Écoute chaque verset, touche un mot pour voir sa traduction, puis teste-toi. Ta jauge de compréhension monte à chaque mot appris.

• VERSET DU JOUR
Un nouveau verset chaque jour, le même pour toute la communauté. Joue chaque jour pour garder ta série.

• BLIND TEST CORAN
Écoute une récitation et devine la sourate.

• QUIZ ISLAMIQUES
Prophètes, piliers, histoire, compagnons, hadiths : trois niveaux de difficulté.

• RAPPEL QUOTIDIEN
Choisis ton heure : l'app te rappelle ta session du jour.

GRATUIT
Al-Fâtiha et Al-Ikhlâs jouables, et une partie par jour dans chaque activité.

HÉRITAGE PRO
Toutes les sourates, quiz et blind tests illimités.
• Annuel : 29,99 € par an
• Mensuel : 4,99 € par mois
(prix en France, ils peuvent varier selon le pays)

L'abonnement est payé via ton compte Apple et se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf résiliation au moins 24 h avant la fin de la période en cours. Tu le gères ou le résilies dans les réglages de ton compte Apple.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://heritage-musulman.com/#cgu
Confidentialité : https://heritage-musulman.com/#confidentialite

name: Heritage World
description:
Heritage World Stores is a marketplace designed to make discovering, buying, and selling products simple and convenient.

Browse products from different sellers, explore categories, search for items, view detailed product information, save products you like, and manage your shopping activity from one place.

You can explore the marketplace before creating an account and register when you are ready to access personalized shopping features.

SHOP AND DISCOVER

Explore a growing selection of products across different categories.

With Heritage World Stores, you can:

• Browse products from multiple sellers
• Search for products and categories
• View product images, descriptions, prices, and availability
• Explore seller stores
• Save products to your wishlist
• Add products to your shopping cart
• Place eligible orders through the marketplace
• View your purchases and order activity
• Contact sellers where supported

YOUR SHOPPING, IN ONE PLACE

Your account gives you convenient access to your shopping activity.

Keep track of purchases, saved products, product inquiries, account details, and other marketplace features from a simple and easy-to-use interface.

SELL ON HERITAGE WORLD STORES

Heritage World Stores also provides tools for people and businesses who want to sell online.

Sellers can:

• Create and manage a store
• Add product listings
• Upload product images
• Add product descriptions and pricing
• Manage available stock
• View and manage products
• Monitor customer orders
• Access seller tools from a dedicated dashboard

Products and seller information can be managed directly from the platform, making it easier to maintain an online storefront.

CONNECT BUYERS AND SELLERS

Heritage World Stores is built to help buyers discover products while giving sellers a simple way to showcase what they offer.

Whether you are browsing for something you need or building your own online store, Heritage World Stores brings shopping and selling together in one marketplace.

Some features may require an account and may vary depending on account type, availability, and location.

Download Heritage World Stores and discover a simpler way to browse, shop, and sell.

name: HideBee: Password Manager
description:
Busy life. Safe hive.

HideBee keeps your passwords locked on your own device before they are saved. We store only locked data, and we do not have the keys.

TAP. COPY. DONE.
Copy a username or password right from the list. A copied password is cleared from the clipboard after 30 seconds.

YOURS ALONE
- Every name, website, username, password and note is encrypted on your device
- Your Master Password and Secret Key never reach us
- Sign in with your password, your Secret Key and an authenticator code

EASY EVERY DAY
- Open with Face ID or Touch ID
- Make strong passwords
- Works without internet, and syncs with the web
- Website icons, asked straight from the website

IN CONTROL
- See your devices and sign any of them out
- Device stolen? Replace all your keys
- Import your passwords from other apps
- Encrypted backup, and delete your account any time

No ads. No tracking.

IMPORTANT: because we do not have your keys, we cannot reset them. Keep your Emergency Kit safe.

name: Highward
description:
In Highward you drop sliding blocks at just the right moment to raise your tower. But this tower is going somewhere: it starts at a sunset and climbs past the clouds, the northern lights and the International Space Station, on to the Moon, the planets and distant galaxies.

A REAL JOURNEY
• Celestial objects appear in their real order and at their real distances: the Moon, Mars, the asteroid belt, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, the Oort cloud, the Crab Nebula and the center of the Milky Way.
• Then come Hubble's and Webb's most famous galaxies, the Hubble Ultra Deep Field and the universe's first light.
• Reach the edge of the universe and a Big Bang begins a new cycle: the climb starts again from the sunset, and in the new universe you pass the planets' moons instead: Io, Europa, Titan, Enceladus, Triton and more. Each cycle is harder, with a golden tower.
• Every image is a real photograph from NASA, ESA/Hubble and ESA/Webb.
• What waits higher up stays hidden until you climb there.

SKY ATLAS
• Every stop you pass becomes a card in your atlas, with its real image and verified facts.
• Can you collect all 45?

TWO MODES
• Classic: how far can you go?
• Daily Climb: a new twist every day, the same for everyone. Windy days, lanternless nights, weightless blocks…

LANTERNS AND JOKERS
• Perfect placements light a lantern.
• A lantern saves you when you miss a block completely.
• After 5 perfects in a row, every perfect move widens your block again.
• Certain stops along the way give you a joker: slow motion, magnet, widen, and a shield against asteroids.
• Every stop earns stardust, which buys jokers to take on Classic runs. In the Daily Climb everyone starts equal.

EVERY ALTITUDE FEELS DIFFERENT
• Among the clouds, wind pushes your blocks around.
• In space, blocks drift weightlessly.
• In the asteroid belt, rocks knock into your tower.

WARM WOOD, LIVING MUSIC
• Your blocks change at every stop: from painted wood to Moon rock, Mars rock, ice and obsidian, galaxy glass and the universe's first light. 20 finishes in all.
• The music grows layer by layer as you rise, and every perfect move carries the melody on.
• Marimba, kalimba and electric piano sound themes.

GAME CENTER AND SHARING
• A Top 100 leaderboard for everyone, with your own rank always shown at the bottom.
• Restart from a stop you've reached by spending stardust.
• Achievements tied to real stops.
• When a run ends, your tower becomes a postcard in front of the farthest thing you reached.
• A home screen widget shows your farthest stop.

No ads. No data collected. No internet needed to play.

How high can you go? Start climbing.

name: Hippo Nexus
description:
Hippo Nexus puts your organization's helpdesk queue on your phone. Take tickets, reply to customers, and stay on top of what needs you, wherever you are.

For staff at organizations that use Nexus. Sign in with your existing Nexus account; there is no separate sign-up.

• See your queues: Mine, Unassigned, Breached, and more
• Take, assign, and update tickets: status, priority, and product
• Reply to customers or add internal notes, with saved answers
• Attach a photo or file to a reply
• Get notified about your tickets, on your schedule
• Locks when you leave; unlock with Face ID or Touch ID

name: HISA BSS
description:
Now you can easily check the photovoltaic power generation, household electricity consumption, and battery storage status.
Accurately assess the duration of your backup power availability in the event of a power grid outage.
The real-time status of all devices will be displayed in front of you, and your installer will also diagnose whether the device is faulty in the first place.
Through HISA BSS every kilowatt hour of electricity you use is more valuable.

name: Histalk: World History Study
description:
The complete story of world history, told in group chats.

From the first humans in Africa to the age of globalization, Histalk World covers world history as conversations between the people who made it. Read history the way you read your group chat, and the causes and consequences start to connect.

ANCIENT TO MODERN, NOTHING SKIPPED
Human origins, Mesopotamia and Egypt, Greece and Rome, classical India and China, the Islamic world, medieval Africa, the Americas, the Mongols, empires, revolutions, world wars, and the present day: 272 chat lessons across 95 units.

FEATURES
- In order, era by era: from human origins to today
- Key dates and terms, pinned: important dates, events, and terms are highlighted in the chat so you can come back to them
- Review with a summary: after each chat, a color-coded summary of dates, terms, and people
- Portraits: historical figures appear with portraits from Wikipedia

FOR AP® STUDENTS
The units from c. 1200 to the present are also designed for students preparing for the AP® World History: Modern exam. The Foundations sections (world history to c. 1200) go beyond the scope of the AP® exam and are provided for general world-history learning.

PRICING
All talks in Origins and Early Civilizations and the first talk of every unit are free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks every talk. No subscription, no ads.

ABOUT THIS APP
This app is an independently developed study aid, not an official textbook. While the content goes through our own verification process, you can report any errors via "Report an error" in the app — we review and fix reported issues.

AP® and Advanced Placement® are registered trademarks of the College Board, which was not involved in the production of, and does not endorse, this product.

The Foundations sections were developed with reference to "World History: Cultures, States, and Societies to 1500" (University System of Georgia, CC BY-SA 4.0) and Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0). All app text is independently written.

name: Hitosuji: Number Path Puzzle
description:
Draw one line through every cell, passing the numbers in order from 1. A new daily puzzle, the same for everyone, plus 300 stages to master.

DAILY PUZZLE
- A new puzzle at midnight, the same for every player
- Easy on Monday, toughest on Sunday
- Keep your streak and share your time

300 STAGES
- Grids grow from 4x4 to 9x9 as you go
- Walls appear along the way, and later stages give you only a few numbers
- Earn a ticket every 5 stages

FEELS GREAT
- A thick line with flowing colors and rising sparkles
- When you solve it, the line bursts into fizzy bubbles
- Haptics on every cell and bubbly sound effects (you can turn them off)

EASY TO PLAY
- Go back one cell to shrink the line, or tap the middle of the line to erase everything after it
- Stuck? A hint shows the correct path 3 cells ahead
- Your line is saved, so you can pick up where you left off
- iPhone and iPad, Dark Mode, English and Japanese

ABOUT STAMINA
Opening a puzzle uses 1 stamina (max 10, +1 every 15 minutes). Watch an ad or use a ticket to refill.

Free to play with ads. A one-time purchase removes ads and gives you unlimited stamina and hints.

name: Hizuke: Date Stamp Film Camera
description:
Hizuke is a camera that keeps the day in the photo: a film look and a date stamp, the moment you press the shutter.

FREE, NO LIMITS
- Unlimited photos, saved straight to Photos. No watermark, no ads.
- Three films (Sunlit, Blue Diary, Silver Afternoon), shown live in the viewfinder.
- Compare all eight films side by side on the same scene, paid ones included.
- Share a photo right after it's saved.
- A date stamp like an old film camera's: choose year-month-day, month-day-year or day-month-year, with or without the time.
- Flash, zoom, front and back cameras, and the volume buttons as a shutter.

ALL FILMS (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
- Five more films: Evening Glow, Neon Night, Spring Haze, Forest Shade and Old Album.
- Develop kept photos again with another film or date format, saved as new photos.
- Bring in photos from your library and develop them.
Try every paid film in the viewfinder before you buy. Not a subscription.

YOUR PHOTOS
Photos are developed on this iPhone, and Hizuke only adds to your library. A photo without a date never gets an invented one.

name: Hobbs Field Tools
description:
Hobbs Field Tools brings everyday hydronics and mechanical equipment resources together on your iPhone.

• Find equipment in the product catalog and review product details.
• Open and share equipment documents.
• Work through air separator selections and flow and pressure conversions.
• Ask Hobbs AI field questions and attach supporting photos or documents.
• Keep separate AI conversations with saved drafts and chat history.
• View project calendars and use the connected Hobbs project tools.

A Hobbs account with the appropriate access is required. Connected tools and AI require an internet connection. AI responses and preliminary selections should be checked against current manufacturer documentation and project requirements.

name: Học tiếng Đức A1–B2: Goethe
description:
Học tiếng Đức từ con số 0 đến trình độ B2, với giải thích hoàn toàn bằng tiếng Việt và chú ý đến những lỗi người Việt hay mắc.

LỘ TRÌNH THEO KHUNG CHÂU ÂU
• 4 cấp độ A1, A2, B1, B2, mỗi cấp chia thành các bài ngắn theo chủ đề đời sống: chào hỏi, gia đình, mua sắm, đi khám bệnh, công việc, thủ tục…
• Mở khoá bài tiếp theo khi bạn làm tốt bài trước.

LUYỆN ĐỦ 4 KỸ NĂNG
• Bảng chữ cái: 30 chữ kèm phiên âm, cách đọc và từ ví dụ.
• Ngữ pháp: 26 chủ đề, so sánh trực tiếp với tiếng Việt.
• Phát âm: 16 âm khó với người Việt (ä, ö, ü, ch, r…). Nghe mẫu, đọc theo và để máy chấm điểm.
• Nghe hiểu: câu ngắn và hội thoại, chỉnh được tốc độ đọc.
• Hội thoại tình huống: 20 tình huống nhập vai.
• Luyện viết: 14 đề viết thư, email, nêu ý kiến.

LUYỆN THI GOETHE
• 6 đề mô phỏng có bấm giờ theo cấu trúc 4 phần Hören, Lesen, Schreiben, Sprechen (nội dung do app biên soạn, không phải đề chính thức).

TỪ VỰNG & ÔN TẬP
• Từ vựng chuyên ngành: điều dưỡng, nhà hàng, visa, xin việc.
• Thẻ nhớ (flashcard) và ôn tập ngắt quãng: app nhắc lại đúng từ bạn sắp quên.
• Sổ từ để đánh dấu từ quan trọng.

GIỮ THÓI QUEN MỖI NGÀY
• Mục tiêu XP hằng ngày, chuỗi ngày học liên tiếp và thống kê tiến độ.
• Nhắc học hằng ngày theo giờ bạn chọn.
• Widget màn hình chính hiện một từ mới mỗi ngày.

ĐỒNG BỘ & QUYỀN RIÊNG TƯ
• Tiến độ lưu trên máy và tự sao lưu. Tạo tài khoản email để học tiếp trên máy khác.
• Không quảng cáo, không theo dõi. Có thể xoá tài khoản ngay trong app.

Phù hợp cho người chuẩn bị du học, đi làm, đoàn tụ gia đình hoặc học tiếng Đức vì sở thích.

name: Hollow Frontier: Sci-Fi RPG
description:
Past the last charted star lies the Frontier: dust worlds and neon towns the old empires left behind. Out here there is no law, only the Hollow, raiders in white skull masks who answer to a king no one has seen and lived.

Hollow Frontier is a sci-fi role-playing adventure you play alone or with up to five friends, each on their own phone. The game is your game master: it sets every scene, asks what you do, and the story changes with your choices.

BUILD YOUR HERO
Pick from seven races, from four-armed Tikkar tinkerers to night-flying Vesh, and shape nine attributes. Train between adventures, raise your stats and grow your hero your way.

CALL EVERY SHOT
Fights are turn-based. Choose your attack, your target, when to heal and when to throw a grenade. Enemies hit hard and bosses take a plan.

GEAR UP
Upgrade your weapons, socket power Cores, buy armor and supplies at shops across the Frontier, and hire mercenaries when your party is short.

PLAY TOGETHER
Start a party and share the code. Friends join with their own heroes, vote on the big decisions and fight side by side. Or play the whole story solo.

A NARRATOR AND VOICES
A narrator describes every place, and the people you meet talk back. Turn narration and voices on or off any time for a more immersive adventure.

FREE TO START
The opening of Campaign 1 is free. Unlock all six chapters with the Season, or get every campaign with the Frontier Pass.

FRONTIER PASS (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
Every campaign open, including each new one, 300 Tokens every month and 10% off everything bought with Tokens. Monthly or yearly.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm. The pass renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://hollow.titleshotgames.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://hollow.titleshotgames.com/privacy.html

Tokens and coins are game items only. They have no cash value and can't be exchanged for money.

name: HomeAdvin
description:
HomeAdvin is the notebook your smart home never came with. It sits beside Apple Home and keeps track of everything Apple Home has no room for. No account, no ads, no analytics.

OVERVIEW: YOUR HOME AT A GLANCE
• A health score from 0 to 100 with the reasons behind it: reachability, batteries and saved recovery codes. Measurements with no data are left out, never assumed healthy.
• Tap Rooms to see every room and the devices in it.
• "Needs attention" lists unreachable devices, low batteries and missing codes, each with its room.

DEVICES: AN INVENTORY OF EVERY ACCESSORY
• Pull your accessories in from Apple Home, or save a record for something that isn't in it. Add notes, purchase details, warranty dates and a support link.
• Add a new accessory to Apple Home by scanning its setup code with the same system sheet the Home app uses, or save an inventory record only. You choose each time.
• Search, sort, group and filter by room, missing code, low battery or unreachable. Removed accessories keep your notes, so nothing is lost when you re-pair.

VAULT: THE CODES APPLE HOME WON'T SHOW YOU
• Apple Home can't reveal the setup code of an accessory you've already paired. Store each code, or scan it from the label, so a factory reset isn't a long afternoon.
• Codes live in the iOS Keychain and open only with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. The vault locks itself when you leave the app.
• Codes are never written to a log, a search index or a plain-text export without a warning.

HEALTH & TOOLS
• Battery and reachability history, so you can see what's been quiet.
• Automation Inspector (read-only): scenes and automations, and the places they may overlap or conflict.
• Configuration History: snapshots of your home, with a diff of what changed.
• Network Diagnostics for HomeKit, Matter and Thread devices. It runs only when you start it.
• Maintenance reminders for battery changes and warranty dates.
• Reports, export, and an encrypted backup you can restore on a new phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything stays on your device. HomeAdvin has no servers and collects nothing.
• What Apple Home reports about your accessories is kept on your device only. It is never exported, backed up or synced.
• Pick your own app icon in Settings.

WHAT HOMEADVIN CAN'T DO
Apple doesn't let any app read the setup code of an accessory that's already paired, so HomeAdvin only stores codes you enter or scan. It can't restore a home or edit your scenes and automations. It tells you what it knows and says plainly when it doesn't. The health score is a tidy-home indicator, not a security guarantee.

HomeAdvin is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple. Apple, Apple Home, HomeKit, iPhone and iPad are trademarks of Apple Inc. Matter and Thread are trademarks of their respective owners.

Questions? https://homeadvin.app/support/ or hello@jerseycoder.com

name: Homebound: Photo Backup
description:
Homebound backs up your iPhone photos and videos to storage you own: a NAS or a shared folder on a PC or Mac at home. Your memories stay in your house, not in someone else's cloud, and there's no monthly fee.

SET IT UP ONCE
• Connect to any NAS or shared folder on your home Wi-Fi: Synology, QNAP, TrueNAS, Unraid, Windows, Mac or Linux
• Pick the folder you want to back up into
• Back up every photo on your phone, or only new ones from today forward

ONLY WHAT'S NEW
Homebound keeps track of everything it has backed up, so each backup copies only new photos and videos. Photos are filed into year and month folders with their original names, in full quality, including Live Photos and photos stored in iCloud.

BACKS UP ON ITS OWN
• Every time you open the app
• In the background when your iPhone allows it, including overnight while charging
• On a daily schedule you choose
• When you get home, using an iPhone Shortcuts automation
• Wi-Fi only, or over cellular too

SEE WHAT'S SAFE
Browse exactly what's on your backup location, month by month. A green check means a photo is backed up and there. View photos, play videos, and share or delete them. Anything you delete from the backup won't be backed up again.

FREE UP SPACE
Remove photos from your iPhone once they're safely backed up: everything, or just photos older than 30 days. Homebound checks each one on your backup location before anything is deleted.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photos go straight from your phone to your own storage, and nothing is sent to us.

AWAY FROM HOME?
Add an optional Tailscale address to reach your storage from anywhere.

name: HOMEpepper – Home Assistant
description:
HOMEpepper – Home Assistant Dashboard: Home Assistant endlich im modernen, cleanen Design, wie Sie es vom iPhone kennen. HOMEpepper steuert Ihr Zuhause mit einer ruhigen Oberfläche, direkt über Ihren eigenen Server, mit voller Funktion und leichtem Import Ihres Dashboards. Sie melden sich bei Ihrer vorhandenen Installation an, dann erscheinen Ihre Räume, Geräte, Szenen und Skripte. Es gibt keinen Server des Entwicklers: Ihre Daten gehen nur zwischen Ihrem Gerät und Ihrem Server.

VORAUSSETZUNG
Ein eigener, erreichbarer Server im Heimnetz oder über Ihre eigene Adresse (etwa Nabu Casa). Ohne ihn zeigt "Demo ausprobieren" ein Beispiel-Zuhause.

STARTSEITE
Die Startseite besteht aus Bausteinen (Status, Szenen, Favoriten, Räume, Routinen), die Sie ordnen, ein- oder ausschalten und benennen. Eigene Bereiche und Gruppen fassen Geräte zusammen, mit Hauptschalter. Neue Geräte aus Home Assistant bietet die App zum Hinzufügen an.

GERÄTE
Licht mit Helligkeit, Farbtemperatur und Farben, Schalter, Rollläden und Jalousien, Schlösser mit Face-ID-Bestätigung, Thermostat, Ventilatoren und Sensoren mit Live-Werten. Je Gerät wählen Sie Kachelgröße und Symbol, bei Werten auch die Anzeigeform (Zahl, Rundmesser, 24-Stunden-Verlauf).

KATEGORIEN, RÄUME, KAMERA
Kategorien wie Licht, Klima oder Sicherheit auf einen Blick. Jeder Raum hat eine eigene Seite mit 12 Hintergründen oder eigenem Foto (es bleibt auf Ihrem Gerät) und lässt sich ausblenden. Kamerabilder und Bewegungsmelder zeigt die App mit klarem Status, auch als Widget.

ROUTINEN UND AUTOMATIONEN
Starten Sie Skripte Ihres Servers als Routinen, schalten Sie Automationen ein und aus. Neue Automationen entstehen aus Vorlagen, etwa "Urlaubsmodus (Licht simulieren)" (Administrator-Zugang nötig).

DASHBOARD
Importieren Sie Ihr Dashboard mit wenigen Fingertipps als native Ansicht, samt Karten wie Mushroom.

ASSIST
Schreiben Sie mit dem Assistenten Ihres Servers, etwa "Mach das Licht im Wohnzimmer aus". Ein Befehl lässt sich auch über die Alexa-Integration Ihres Servers an ein Echo-Gerät schicken (Amazon-Konto nötig); die Antwort kommt dort.

WIDGETS UND STEUERZENTRALE
Widgets für Home- und Sperrbildschirm und Schalter für die Steuerzentrale. Verriegeln geht direkt, Entriegeln nur nach Bestätigung.

MELDUNGEN, TIMER, SICHERUNG
Nicht erreichbare Geräte erscheinen gedämpft. Der Timer schaltet Licht und Schalter nach Minuten oder Stunden; auf Wunsch läuft er in Home Assistant, auch bei geschlossener App (Administrator-Zugang nötig). Einstellungen sichern Sie automatisch in iCloud oder als Datei.

IPAD, RAUMTAFEL, IPHONE DUO
Das iPad nutzt Seitenleiste und Mehrspalten-Raster; der Raumtafel-Modus macht es zur Wandtafel (Schlösser nur mit Code). Auch für das iPhone Duo. Deutsch, Englisch, Chinesisch.

IHRE DATEN
Keine Analyse, keine Werbebanner, keine Drittanbieter; einzige Ausnahme: der gekennzeichnete Zubehör-Bereich.

KOSTENLOS UND PRO
Gratis: bis zu 7 Geräte und 2 Routinen, Widgets und Dashboard-Import inklusive. HOMEpepper Pro hebt die Grenzen auf, für 1,99 € pro Monat oder einmalig 14,99 € (mit Familienfreigabe). Endet Pro, wird nichts gelöscht, es wird nur gesperrt.

WICHTIGE HINWEISE
- Widgets aktualisieren sich nicht in Echtzeit (das System bestimmt es).
- Die App ersetzt keine Alarmanlage und keinen Rauchmelder.

ABONNEMENT
HOMEpepper Pro monatlich: 1,99 € pro Monat, Laufzeit 1 Monat. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch um einen Monat, wenn es nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf gekündigt wird. Abrechnung über Ihre Apple-ID; kündigen können Sie jederzeit in den Apple-ID-Einstellungen unter "Abonnements".
Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Datenschutz: https://chili-cooperation.com/homepepper/datenschutz

HOMEpepper ist eine eigenständige App und nicht mit der Open Home Foundation, Nabu Casa oder Amazon verbunden. Home Assistant und Alexa sind Marken der jeweiligen Inhaber. Eine App von Florian Higl Grafikdesign (Chili-App-Familie).

name: Hominin Chronicle
description:
45,000 years ago, in the last Ice Age.
With the sea far lower than today, the continental shelves lie bare, and six kinds of human share a wide, cold world. Choose one, lead your band between the mammoth steppe and the ice sheets, and open the door to the Neolithic.

Hominin Chronicle is a turn-based strategy game played on a map of the Ice Age Earth. There are no ads, no in-app purchases and no account. It plays from start to finish without an internet connection.

Please note: the game's text is in Korean only.

SIX HUMANS, SIX WAYS TO PLAY
- Homo sapiens: a broad diet and cheaper research. Unique unit: the Atlatl Hunter
- Neanderthals: tough close-combat fighters who shrug off the cold. Unique unit: the Cave Bear Hunter
- Denisovans: at home in hills and mountains. Unique unit: the Snow Stalker
- Homo erectus: cheap gatherers and a bigger band from the start. Unique unit: the Torch Warrior
- Homo floresiensis: a band that lives on little food, with rafts and nets from the first turn. Unique unit: the Shadow Hunter
- Homo naledi: cheap, sturdy buildings and a home cave twice as strong. Unique unit: the Cave Guardian

GATHER, BUILD, ADVANCE
Send gatherers to herds, woods and rock outcrops for food, wood, stone and flint. Raise huts, gathering camps, warriors' fires, hunters' lodges, stone workshops, watchtowers and painted caves, and move from the Lower Paleolithic through the Middle and Upper Paleolithic to the Neolithic. Eighteen linked technologies include control of fire, fur clothing, cooperative hunting, the Levallois technique, bow and arrow, cave painting, domestication, farming, pottery and the dugout canoe.

A WORLD THAT CHANGES
The ice sheets begin to melt around 19,000 years ago, and Beringia, Doggerland and the Yellow Sea plain sink as the sea rises. Tundra cold, fish in rivers and lakes, and herds gathering at salt lakes make every kind of land count. Build rafts to cross the Wallace Line to Sahul, or follow the edge of the ice along the coast to the Americas.

BEASTS AND RIVALS
Woolly mammoths, woolly rhinos, ground sloths and Diprotodon are big game; cave bears, cave lions and sabre-toothed cats attack first. Each rival species has its own temper. They gather war bands, remember who struck them, and fall back to rebuild after a heavy defeat. Three difficulty levels: easy, normal and hard.

THREE WAYS TO WIN
- Outlast every other human species
- Build the megalithic temple in the Neolithic and hold it for 20 turns
- Reach 5,000 years ago with the highest score

MADE FOR FINGERS
Tap a unit to select it, tap a bright tile to move and tap an enemy with a red outline to attack. Drag with one finger to pan and pinch to zoom; long-press any button to see its cost and what it does. A first-steps guide walks you through the opening. Designed for iPhone held sideways.

ALSO
- Automatic save every turn and when you leave the app, plus save and load at any time
- Ambient sound that follows the land on screen, with separate volume for effects and for music and ambience
- The rules are always at hand in the in-game guide

Six human species living side by side, and their abilities, are a game's take on prehistory. Coastlines are a simplified picture of the low Ice Age sea level.

name: Horalo: Price in Work Hours
description:
Point your camera at a price and Horalo shows it in minutes, hours or days of your own work. What it really costs, in time.

SCANNER
• Live camera: every price it reads gets its working time right away
• Tap a price to open its details
• Price in a foreign currency: converted with the European Central Bank reference rates
• Device without price reading, or camera access denied: type the price by hand

ANALYZE A PHOTO
• Pick a photo of a price tag, receipt or menu from your library: Horalo reads the prices in the image, without asking for access to your photo library
• An hours badge on every price it reads, with the list of prices below
• A blurry, strongly tilted or badly lit digit can be missed: the details sheet lets you check
• Numbers the reading does not recognize as prices are offered with a dotted outline: tap one to convert it
• Currency not read on the image: choose the one of the prices, and every time is recalculated

CALCULATOR AND PRICE DETAILS
• Type a price on the keyboard, in the currency you choose
• Working time in big type: minutes, hours, days, weeks or months depending on the amount
• Working days and share of your monthly income
• Optional item name, add to wishlist, share

SHAREABLE CARD
• A card in story or square format: working time in big type, with the item and the price if you choose
• Your income never appears on the card

WISHLIST
• Keep an item on hold for 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days before you buy
• A local reminder tells you when the wait is over, with no item name or amount on the lock screen
• "Bought" or "I'll pass": every item you pass on adds to your hours saved
• The working time of a wish is fixed when you add it

YOUR PROFILE
• Net income per hour, per month or per year, currency, hours and days worked per week, weeks worked per year
• "Count my commute" option: the commute of every working day is added to working time
• No default salary: you enter your own income
• Your income and your wishes stay on the device

ALSO
• Siri and Shortcuts: "How many hours does a price cost with Horalo?", and direct opening of Scanner, Calculator or Wishlist
• European Central Bank exchange rates, with the date of the rate shown; currency not quoted: conversion refused, never an invented rate
• No account, no developer server, no camera image kept or sent
• iPhone and iPad, interface in 45 languages

ADS AND SUBSCRIPTION
Horalo is supported by ads: a banner, an ad when the app opens and an optional short video that gives 6 hours without ads. The optional "Ad-Free" subscription (monthly or yearly, no trial period) removes all ads and reserves no feature: the scanner, photo analysis, calculator, wishlist and shareable card are the same for everyone. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, from your Apple account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Houd: Photo Backup & Storage
description:
Houd backs up the photos and videos from your iPhone to your own NAS, home server or computer over your home Wi-Fi. Files go straight to a shared folder on your Synology, QNAP or any SMB network drive, with no cloud in between.

SET UP IN A MINUTE
• Houd finds NAS drives and computers on your network automatically
• Browse the shared folders on the server and pick where backups go
• Back up your whole library or only the albums you choose
• Test the connection, then tap Sync

WORKS WITH YOUR STORAGE
• Synology, QNAP, WD My Cloud, TerraMaster, Asustor
• TrueNAS, Unraid, OpenMediaVault and other Samba servers
• Shared folders on Windows, macOS and Linux computers
• Any SMB network drive

BACK UP YOUR WAY
• Keep files in one folder, sort them by year and month, or split photos and videos
• Back up only while charging
• Free up iPhone storage: remove backed-up items from the phone after you confirm
• Several backup configurations for different servers or folders
• Files already on the server are skipped, so nothing is copied twice

RELIABLE IN THE BACKGROUND
• A backup you start keeps running after you leave the app
• Daily automatic backup on a schedule (Premium); iOS runs it in the background when the system allows
• Upload progress for every file and one-tap retry for failed files
• Free space check on the server before upload
• Notifications about backups that ran in the background
• A log of every session: uploaded, skipped and failed files with error details

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your photos travel directly from your iPhone to your storage over the local network
• No cloud storage and no upload to our servers
• Server passwords are kept in the iOS Keychain on your device

FREE AND PREMIUM
Manual backup with all of the settings above is free. Daily automatic backup requires Houd Premium, a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription; the yearly plan may start with a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Good for NAS and home server owners, photographers who keep a local archive, and families who want all their photos at home instead of in someone else's cloud.

Terms of Use: https://houd.mondoapps.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://houd.mondoapps.app/privacy

name: Hour Line: Zone Compass
description:
Hour Line is a compass for time zones. It points to every time zone next to you and tells you how far away it is.

Hold up your phone and the dial turns with you. Each arrow is a time zone you'd reach heading straight that way, labeled with how far ahead or behind it is and the distance to its border. Turn around and your phone clicks each time you point exactly at one.

• Every adjacent zone, including the half-hour and 45-minute ones, and the time zones out at sea
• The local time in each zone, and how many hours ahead or behind it is
• Tap a zone for a driving route to just across its border
• Daylight saving time is handled automatically, so arrows appear and disappear when the clocks change
• Works offline: all the boundaries are built in

HOUR LINE PRO
A one-time purchase, shared with your family. No subscription, no ads.
• See every adjacent zone, not just the nearest two
• Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets, and Apple Watch complications
• Alerts when you're approaching or crossing into a new time zone, with a Live Activity that counts down the distance on your Lock Screen

APPLE WATCH
A full compass on your wrist, no iPhone needed.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your location is used on your device and never leaves it. No accounts, no analytics, no tracking.

Time zone boundaries © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via timezone-boundary-builder.

name: Hue Atlas
description:
Hue Atlas is a calm, clever logic puzzle. Color every region of a map with four inks so that no two neighboring regions share the same ink. Every map has exactly one solution, so you never need to guess: just look, think and ink.

Each map you solve charts one region of an island. Finish an island and your ship sails through the fog to a new land, and your world keeps growing.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Journey: Chart the World. An endless voyage across islands, with up to 3 stars per map for solving it, using no hints and making no mistakes.
• Daily Challenge. A fresh map every day, the same for every player. Build your streak, earn Gold, Silver and Bronze stamps in your Passport, and collect Monthly Seals. Missed a day? Past Dailies stay free to play.
• Classic. Endless quick play from Easy to Expert. Every map has a short code you can share, so friends can play the exact same map.

ORIGINAL ATLAS RULES
• Twin Territories: two regions with the same crest must share an ink.
• Disputed Lands: a region marked with two inks may only take one of them.
These twists add fresh logic to the four-color idea without ever making a map unfair.

LEARN AS YOU GO
Short lessons teach real solving techniques (Last Ink, Locked Pair, Locked Trio and What-If), and hints explain why a move works instead of just giving the answer.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Seven ink sets, from Atlas Classic and Pastel Chart to Neon Night and Botanical
• Four map styles, including Blueprint, Terrain and the dark Nightfall
• 24 badges and detailed stats: best times, perfect solves, streaks and more
• Light and dark themes, gentle music and satisfying sound and haptics

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Plays fully offline, with no account and no sign-up
• Numbers and Patterns modes and a Clear Sight ink set, so you never rely on color alone
• Reduced motion, left-handed controls, bold borders and larger text support
• Optional daily reminders, never at night
• Available in 13 languages

Hue Atlas is free to play with ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banner and full-screen ads and makes every hint free. Optional Gold coin packs are also available. Coins are earned all the time just by playing.

name: Hue Match - Color Palette
description:
Pick one color and see which colors go with it. Hue Match is a simple color palette app for iPhone.

◆ Four ways to pick a color
• Tap the color wheel
• Point the camera at something and pick its color
• Pick from a photo
• Type a color code (#RRGGBB)

◆ See what matches
Choose a harmony pattern — complementary, analogous, split-complementary or triad — and the matching colors appear on the wheel. In Free mode, add any colors you like and the matching range is highlighted. Each pattern comes with a short note on when to use it.

◆ Check how it looks in use
Show text in your colors and check its readability (contrast ratio). Apply the palette to a sample app screen to see the overall feel.

◆ Save and share
Save a palette with one tap. Copy or share the color codes.

For design, illustration, slides, interiors and outfits.

Free with ads. "Remove Ads" (one-time purchase) turns off all ads.

name: Hull Circuit
description:
Restore power to a damaged spaceship, one bay at a time.

Rotate connectors to route power through three-dimensional circuits. Get close to a stubborn joint, pull back to see the whole board, and follow the illuminated lines through service corridors. When a circuit reaches its receiver, the next bay opens.

Start with 35 free bays in Main Distribution. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the remaining 65 bays in Life Support and Flight Control, which open as you progress. Give a stuck circuit another look with hints, undo, and an overhead view.

Play offline and pick up where you left off on the same device. Buying or restoring the chapter unlock requires an internet connection. Hull Circuit supports iPhone and iPad in English and Simplified Chinese.

name: hushme
description:
Hush is a private, invite-only messenger for you and the people you trust.

No public sign-ups, no strangers, no ads. Every member is invited and approved by the administrator, so your conversations stay inside a small, trusted circle.

Features • Private messaging: fast, simple one-on-one chats with typing indicators and read receipts. • Encrypted messages and media: message text, photos, videos and files are encrypted before they are stored. • Audio and video calls: clear calls over Wi-Fi or cellular data, with a split-screen video view and a camera flip button. • Instant camera: tap the shutter to take a selfie or a regular photo right inside a chat. • Reply and edit: swipe left on a message to reply, or tap your own message to edit it. • Clear chats: remove all messages from your view with one tap. • Notifications: a badge shows how many new messages you have. • Your style: choose light or dark mode, pick a color theme, and set your read-receipt color.

Simple by design Hush leaves out feeds, stories and clutter. You just talk.

name: Huvida
description:
Huvida ist dein persönlicher Tages-Brief: Du öffnest die App und siehst sofort, was heute wichtig ist – Wetter, Schlaf, Bewegung, Termine und die Nachrichten, die du selbst gewählt hast.

Morgens zeigt Huvida, wie du geschlafen hast und wie der Tag wird. Abends blickt der Brief schon auf morgen voraus.

WAS DRIN IST
• Wetter: aktuelle Temperatur, Verlauf über den Tag, 5-Tage-Vorschau, Regen, Wind und UV-Index für deinen Standort, dazu Pollenflug in Europa und Unwetterwarnungen für Deutschland
• Schritte: dein Tagesziel, Verlauf in Zwei-Stunden-Blöcken, Strecke und Etagen
• Health: Ruhepuls, Herzfrequenz-Verlauf, HRV, aktive Kalorien und Trainingsminuten aus Apple Health
• Schlaf: Dauer, Schlafphasen (Kern, Tief, REM), Wachzeiten, Einschlafzeit und der Vergleich mit deinen letzten Nächten
• Kalender und Erinnerungen: Termine für heute bzw. morgen und deine offenen Aufgaben
• Nachrichten: Trage die RSS-Feeds ein, die du lesen möchtest – Huvida zeigt dir die Schlagzeilen mit Bild

SCHLAF-TEXT
Jeden Morgen fasst ein kurzer Text zusammen, wie deine Nacht war – mit Apple Intelligence direkt auf deinem iPhone oder, wenn du magst, über deinen eigenen Home Assistant. Ohne KI siehst du feste Sätze. Auf Wunsch gibst du ihm einen eigenen Ton, zum Beispiel wie ein Sportreporter.

SCHLAFDATEN ABWARTEN
Dein Schlaf ist noch nicht in Health angekommen? Mit einem Kurzbefehl oder per Siri benachrichtigt dich Huvida, sobald die Daten da sind.

DEIN BRIEF, DEINE REGELN
• Jede Kachel lässt sich einzeln ein- und ausschalten. Berechtigungen werden erst gefragt, wenn eine Kachel sie braucht.
• Ziele für Schritte und Schlaf stellst du selbst ein.
• Deutsch und Englisch.

PRIVAT
Huvida hat kein Konto, keine Werbung und kein Tracking. Deine Gesundheits-, Kalender- und Erinnerungsdaten bleiben auf deinem iPhone und werden nur dort ausgewertet. Für das Wetter wird dein Standort nur ungefähr (auf etwa einen Kilometer) an die Wetterdienste gesendet. Nachrichten lädt die App direkt von den Quellen, die du selbst eingetragen hast.

Hinweis: Huvida zeigt Daten an und stellt keine medizinischen Aussagen oder Diagnosen. Der Schlaf-Score ist ein eigener Richtwert und ersetzt keine ärztliche Beratung. Wetterdaten: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), Unwetterwarnungen: DWD über Bright Sky.

name: Hwatu Matching - Big Text Game
description:
A card-matching game with Korean hwatu flower-card pictures. Tap cards to flip them; when two pictures are the same month, they stay as a pair. No sign-up needed. Nothing is bet or won - it is a relaxed card game of remembering pictures and finding pairs.

■ What you can do
- 3 levels: level 1 has 12 cards (6 pairs), level 2 has 16 (8 pairs), level 3 has 24 (12 pairs). Pick any level from the start
- Twelve months of hwatu pictures: pine and crane, plum and warbler, cherry blossoms, orchid, peony and butterfly, chrysanthemum, maple and deer, and more
- Star records: you earn 1 to 3 stars from the number of flips and the time. Your best stars, fewest flips and shortest time are kept for each level
- Hint: briefly shows the cards you have not matched yet. One hint per game is available without an ad; for more, watch a short ad to the end
- Resume: an unfinished game is saved on this phone and picks up where you left off after you close the app. The clock pauses while you are away
- Sound: short sounds when you flip, match and finish. You can turn them off any time
- Large text: bigger letters and buttons. The app asks once on first launch and also follows your phone's text size.
- Share: send your result by message or any chat app
- Nine languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Spanish, Portuguese, German and French

■ How it works
- Tap two cards one after the other. Same picture: they stay up. Different: they turn back after a moment
- The top shows flips, time and pairs left. The clock starts at your first flip
- Three stars are earned by finishing within the flip count and time set for each level
- It works without internet (only ads need a connection)

■ Ads
- There is a banner ad at the bottom. After you finish a game, an ad may sometimes appear when you leave the result screen (every few games, with a daily limit). While you play, no ad covers the screen on its own
- After the free hint, watch a short ad to the end to get another hint. You can also play without using hints
- Ads are provided by Google AdMob

■ Privacy
No sign-up. Your game in progress, records and settings stay on this phone and are not collected. The app does not use notifications. An advertising ID may be used for ads and can be turned off in your phone settings.

■ Other apps by FILLUS
Building Register Lookup · Subscription and Rental Notices · Government Benefits Finder · Tide Table

name: Hyrth
description:
A Wi-Fi password might need to be handy anywhere. A recovery code can have a different rule. In Hyrth, you choose which entries open normally and which ask for an extra phrase when you’re away from a place you trust.

Make a place a hearth

A hearth is a place you choose, such as your home or office. Mark it while you’re there, give it a name if you like, and choose how large an area it covers. You can save up to five hearths. The Vault tells you when Hyrth has confirmed a saved place and when it considers you away.

Choose what needs the extra step

Turn on Hearth-only for a record you want to protect. At a confirmed hearth, you can open it after unlocking the vault. When you’re away, an away phrase lets you reveal or copy the protected credentials. Ordinary entries stay available after you unlock, including when location access is off.

Hyrth can generate a six-word away phrase on your device, or you can choose your own. Keep a copy somewhere safe and accessible outside the app. If you forget the phrase, you can change it in Settings after returning to a confirmed hearth and authenticating with your device credentials.

Keep the details you actually look up

Save a website, username, password and private note together. Search by the details you remember when you need to find a record again. When you make a new login, use the password generator and choose the length, digits and symbols. Set an auto-lock interval that suits how you use the vault.

Your places and passwords stay on this device

Unlock Hyrth with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode. Location is optional for the vault and used for the hearths you choose to save. Hyrth checks it on the device and keeps no location history. The vault has no account or cloud sync. You can delete individual records or erase your local vault and hearths from Settings.

name: I Am President: Simulator 3D
description:
What really happens behind the doors of the president’s office?

Step into the role of the president in an immersive first-person simulator where the fate of an entire nation is in your hands.

Experience the daily life of a president, sign executive orders, approve or reject proposals, meet government officials, and make tough decisions. Every choice can have unexpected consequences.

But running a country is just the beginning.

BECOME THE PRESIDENT

Take control of the presidential office. Review documents, interact with visitors, sign executive orders, and decide what is best for your country.

MAKE YOUR OWN DECISIONS

Approve or reject government proposals. Deal with political challenges, manage national security, and face difficult choices that could change the future of your country.

FACE GLOBAL CRISES

A zombie outbreak threatens national security. International tensions bring humanity to the brink of nuclear war. An unknown alien civilization makes first contact with Earth.

How you respond is entirely up to you.

EXPERIENCE THE CONSEQUENCES

Your decisions shape the future of your nation. Will you become a respected leader, save humanity from disaster, or turn your presidency into complete chaos?

GAME FEATURES

Immersive first-person president simulator

Interactive presidential office

Executive orders and political decisions

Unexpected events and global emergencies

Zombie apocalypse and nuclear threats

First contact with an alien civilization

Political satire, absurd situations, and unexpected consequences

The power is in your hands. The responsibility is yours.

Can you handle being the president when the world is falling apart?

name: I'm Telling
description:
I'm Telling is the anonymous crime-tip app. You saw it — say it, without your name on it.

Witnesses stay silent for two reasons: they don't know which door a tip belongs at, and they don't want their name on it. I'm Telling removes both. Pick the state, pick what kind of thing it was, write what you know — and the app routes you to the right authority's own official channel: the FBI, ATF, DEA, ICE/HSI, the U.S. Marshals, the FTC fraud door, the national trafficking hotline, your state police tip door, or your state Crime Stoppers program.

Anonymous by architecture, not by promise:
• No account. No name. No sign-up — ever.
• No GPS. You type the place; the app never tracks it.
• No analytics, no trackers. The app makes no network calls of its own.
• Your tip is composed on your phone and handed off only through the official channel YOU tap — their number, their form. The app itself never transmits or keeps your tip.
• You get a Tip ID and a private lifecycle log that live only on your device — and erase in two taps.

Inside:
• Report a Crime — a guided three-step flow (where, what kind, what you know) that ends at the right door, with a nationwide FBI fallback on every route.
• Cold Cases — a shelf of unsolved cases (the cases in this build are labeled samples; the live shelf is supplied by agencies). A memory does not expire.
• My Tips — your Tip IDs and where each one stands, on this device only.
• For Agencies — how departments license the front door their community already understands. Users never pay; agencies license the layer on top, off-app.

Crime happening now? The app's first screen says what every screen says: call 911 first. I'm Telling is where you tell it — 911 is for right now.

False reports waste investigators' time and can be a crime; the app says so before you compose, and means it.

I'm Telling is a crime-reporting tool for the general public. It is not affiliated with any child-safety organization or program, and it is not a social network — there is no feed, nobody gets named on a wall, and nothing you write is posted anywhere. Your words go to the authority, through the authority's own door, chosen by you.

name: iAgent.Plus
description:
iAgent.Plus is a workspace where AI agents do the work.

Instead of opening one more chat box and explaining everything from scratch, you pick an agent that already knows the job — writing, research, translation, document reading, customer replies — and give it a brief.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Chat with agents
Talk to an agent the way you talk to a colleague. It keeps the context of the conversation, so you can refine the result step by step instead of starting over.

• Bring people and agents into one group
Create a group, add teammates and agents, and let them work in the same thread. The agent reads the conversation and answers where it is needed, so handovers stop getting lost in DMs.

• Choose from ready-made agents
Start from a preset agent built for a specific job — writing, research, summarising, customer replies and more — or create your own with your own instructions.

• Work with documents
Upload PDF, Word or Excel files and ask questions about them. The agent reads the document and answers from its content.

• Generate images and video
Describe what you need and get a poster, banner, product image or a short clip, in the style you ask for.

• Schedule recurring work
Set an agent to run on a schedule — a morning brief, a weekly report, a reminder at a fixed time — and it keeps running without you.

• One account, every screen
Open it on desktop or mobile browser and keep the same conversations and agents. Nothing is stored only on one device.

• Extend what agents can do
Add skills to an agent to extend its reach beyond chat — web search, data lookup, file handling and other tools.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Sign in and pick an agent, or create one.
2. Describe the task in plain language.
3. Review the result, ask for changes, and keep the thread for next time.

WHO IT IS FOR

People who use AI for real work every day: writing and editing, research and summaries, customer support, internal reporting, and anyone who wants an assistant that remembers the context instead of a blank page every morning.

ABOUT AI RESULTS

Agents generate content automatically. Output can be incomplete or wrong, so review anything important before you rely on it or send it out. You stay responsible for the final result.

ABOUT YOUR ACCOUNT

You need an account to use the app. You can delete your account and its data at any time from the app or from our website.

Support: contact@zytech.hk
Terms: https://www.iagent.plus/terms
Privacy: https://www.iagent.plus/privacy

name: IBV VELOSO
description:
Olá seja bem-vindo este é App da Igreja.
O APP permite o relacionamento entre a Igreja e seus membros ou visitantes. 
Através do App você pode realizar várias atividades para se relacionar com a Igreja como 

 Fazer o gerenciamento de seus Pequenos Grupos/Células Discipulados Ministérios
 Encontre um Pg/Célula próximo a sua casa. E se já participa de um PG/Célula perfeito Você poderá fazer o gerenciamento completo do seu grupo
 Se inscreva e acompanhe Eventos de todo tipo como Escolas Bíblicas Acampamentos e cursos de Formação
 Através do Mural de Recados poderá ficar por dentro de todas novidades da Igreja e também se comunicar com outras pessoas.

 No item Meu Perfil é possível conferir todos seus dados cadastrais na Igreja
 Acompanhe os conteúdos de música mensagens e outros disponibilizados pela Igreja
 Faça Pedidos de Oração Visitas etc
 Agenda Veja o calendário completo de Celebrações Eventos sua Escala em Ministérios/Departamentos da Igreja 
 Está fazendo discipulado Aqui você poderá visualizar os encontros e ter maior controle de seus discipulados.

Não deixe de instalar agora o nosso App Oficial e ter acesso completo a todas funcionalidades. É muito bom ter você aqui conosco

name: Icto Metronome
description:
Icto is a modern, precise metronome for iPhone.

It keeps exact time and adds the tools you need for practice and for the stage.

PRECISE
• Every click is placed on the audio clock with sample accuracy.
• 20 to 300 BPM, by the scale, by tapping, or typed exactly.
• Keeps playing with the screen locked.
• Plays over your music or video without pausing it.

CLEAR
• A clean screen that shows the bar and the tempo, and nothing else.
• Stage Mode for gigs: a dark screen that stays awake.
• Lock Controls, so a stray touch changes nothing.

MORE FOR PRACTICE
• Songs: lay out a tune as sections, with a count-in and a spoken cue one bar before each section.
• Silence: the click drops out for a few bars and comes back, so you find out whether you kept time alone.
• Layers: up to two more pulses across the same bar, such as three against four, and any layer can become the new beat for a metric modulation.
• An accent level for every beat, subdivisions, six sound kits, and beat haptics.

ALWAYS AT HAND
• The tempo shows in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen while the metronome plays.

PRIVATE
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Icto collects no data.

All feedback is sincerely appreciated.

name: iDrive.al
description:
Description – English
iDrive.al keeps your documents, photos, music and videos safe in the cloud – encrypted, in sync, and open on your iPhone, iPad, computer and in the browser. And it is more than storage: you edit Word and Excel documents, back up your photos and play your media right in the app.

WORD, EXCEL AND POWERPOINT – IN THE APP
• Edit .docx, .xlsx and .pptx files on your iPhone and iPad with iDrive Office
• Formatting, tables, formulas, charts and several sheets
• Changes save to iDrive.al by themselves – earlier versions kept for 30 days
• Older .doc, .xls and .ppt files and OpenDocument too

AUTOMATIC PHOTO BACKUP
• Camera Upload saves new photos and videos by itself – even with the screen locked
• iPhone HEIC photos and 4K videos included, with previews
• Choose Wi‑Fi only and whether to include videos
• Your library sorted by month

PLAY, VIEW AND EDIT – RIGHT IN THE APP
• Music player with album covers, next song, speed and repeat
• Video player for MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI and more, with gestures and full screen
• Text editor for notes and web files
• PDFs, photos, SVG and ZIP/RAR archives

ALL YOUR FILES, YOUR WAY
• List or grid with previews
• Recent, Favorites, Search and a 30-day Trash
• Earlier versions of a file, ready to restore
• Share links with a password, an expiry date and uploads from others
• Several accounts in one app
• In English and Albanian

SECURITY
• Every file and every file name stored encrypted with AES‑256
• New devices are confirmed with a code by email
• Forgot your password? A code by email gets you back, with all your files
• Prefer maximum privacy? Choose “Recovery key only”
• Two-step sign-in with an authenticator app
• Encrypted connections (HTTPS) everywhere

ON EVERY DEVICE
iPhone, iPad, Android, Windows, Mac and the web – one account, the same files.

LOCAL SUPPORT
iDrive.al is a service by iHost.al, with support in Albanian and English.

An iDrive.al account is required. Plans are available at idrive.al.

name: Ìe Bắc Âu
description: Ìe Bắc Âu giúp bạn tập thở theo hướng dẫn bằng âm thanh, hoạt động hoàn toàn offline. Tùy chỉnh số hiệp, thời gian nín thở và giữ hơi phục hồi; ghi lại thời gian nín thở, xem lịch sử và thống kê luyện tập. Dữ liệu lưu trên thiết bị, hỗ trợ xuất và nhập file để chuyển máy. Ứng dụng yêu cầu mã mời để sử dụng. Hãy tập ở nơi an toàn, không tập dưới nước hoặc khi lái xe, và thở lại bình thường ngay khi cần.

name: Ijego Rider
description:
Ijego is a Nigerian ride-hailing app that connects you with verified local drivers. Built in Nigeria, built for Nigeria, and shaped by the drivers who use it.

CLEAR PRICES BEFORE YOU BOOK
Enter where you are going and see the full price, including the service fee, before you confirm. No surprises at the end of the trip.

VERIFIED DRIVERS
Every driver's identity, driver's licence and vehicle are checked before they can drive with Ijego. You see your driver's name, photo, car and plate number before pickup.

SAFETY BUILT IN
Share your trip live with family or friends, save trusted contacts and use the SOS button if you ever need help.

EASY PAYMENT
Pay securely by card or bank transfer in the app through Paystack.

FAIR FOR EVERYONE
Five minutes of free waiting when your driver arrives, and free cancellation within two minutes of booking. Want a faster pickup? Offer your driver a little more than the recommended fare.

INVITE FRIENDS
Share your invite code and earn ride credit when friends join and ride.

Ijego is a product of Nesta Connect Limited, a company registered in Nigeria. Rides are available in Nigeria only. Travelling to Nigeria? Download Ijego and sign up before you arrive, so you are ready to book from the airport.

Questions? info@nestaconnectltd.com

name: iMakka
description:
iMakka is your daily companion for prayer and spiritual focus: a high-precision Qibla compass pointing toward the Kaaba, accurate geolocated prayer times worldwide, progress tracking, 24/7 Makkah Live audio streaming, and customizable reminders 5 minutes before every Salah.

• Precision Qibla compass with alignment feedback and distance to Makkah
• Automatic worldwide prayer times tailored to your location and regional calculation methods
• 24/7 live audio streaming (Makkah Live, Quran Radio, and Al-Haramain) with background playback and Lock Screen controls
• Local prayer notifications 5 minutes before each Salah in 10 languages
• Daily prayer tracker, monthly calendar, streak badges, and daily Quran verses
• Complete privacy: your GPS location and prayer history remain strictly on your device

name: IMEI TJ: проверка телефона
description:
IMEI TJ помогает проверить регистрацию телефона и узнать стоимость его растаможки в Таджикистане по данным сервиса imei.tj. Введите IMEI или найдите устройство по модели — регистрация в приложении не требуется.

ПРОВЕРКА IMEI
Проверяйте один или два IMEI телефона в одном запросе приложения. Каждый IMEI проверяется отдельно, а результат показывает зарегистрированные, незарегистрированные, ограниченные или заблокированные устройства согласно ответу сервиса. Если сервис не отвечает, приложение не выдаёт ошибку связи за отсутствие регистрации. В карточке результата IMEI маскируется.

СТОИМОСТЬ РАСТАМОЖКИ
Находите стоимость по IMEI или названию модели. Если найдено несколько вариантов, выберите нужное устройство. В результате сохраняются модель, состав платежей, итог и пояснения источника. Текст можно скопировать, а первоисточник — открыть в браузере.

ПЕРЕСЧЁТ В СОМОНИ
При доступности официального курса Национального банка Таджикистана приложение дополнительно показывает ориентировочную сумму в сомони и дату курса. Если курс недоступен, исходная стоимость сервиса остаётся доступной.

ПРОВЕРКИ И РЕКЛАМА
В каждом из двух разделов доступны 3 успешные проверки. Суточный лимит восстанавливается через 24 часа после первой успешной проверки этого раздела. После исчерпания можно дождаться таймера или добровольно посмотреть рекламу и получить ещё 3 проверки. Просмотр восстанавливает лимит только выбранного раздела; текущий срок суточного восстановления не переносится. Неполученные ответы сервиса не расходуют проверки.

УДОБНЫЙ ИНТЕРФЕЙС
Светлая и тёмная темы следуют настройке устройства. Поддерживаются системный размер текста, вставка IMEI и отдельная проверка второго IMEI. Приложение не сохраняет историю проверок; лимиты хранятся на устройстве.

ИСТОЧНИКИ И ВАЖНАЯ ИНФОРМАЦИЯ

Приложение не принимает оплату и не выполняет регистрацию или таможенное оформление телефона. Статус регистрации IMEI сам по себе не подтверждает факт таможенного оформления.
