name: immemoris: Remember Together
description:
Some memories are yours alone. Others are spread across several people — you hold one piece, someone else holds another. immemoris helps you gather what's there and weave it into a written memory fuller than the one in your head.

START WITH WHAT YOU REMEMBER
A wedding, a road trip, an evening you'd like to hold onto. Begin with a few sentences, a photo, or a voice recording. Even one detail is enough to begin.

REMEMBER MORE, WITH HELP
Guided recollection asks you questions based on what's already been shared — about the time, the place, the people, and the small details. Answer the ones that spark something and skip the rest.

INVITE OTHERS
Invite anyone who holds part of the memory. Each person adds what they remember, in text, photos, or audio. You're notified when someone contributes, and you decide what goes into the memory's narrative.

DIFFERENT VERSIONS CAN COEXIST
People remember the same event differently. immemoris doesn't force a single agreed-upon version or decide who's right — differing recollections can stay side by side.

A NARRATIVE FOR EACH MEMORY
immemoris weaves the recollections and photos into a written narrative. Choose its tone and perspective, edit it in your own words, rearrange paragraphs and photos, and listen to it read aloud.

YOUR LIFE STORY, MEMORY BY MEMORY
Sketch the milestones of your life — birth, school, family, work, moves — and turn each into a full memory over time. Your memories take their place on a timeline, and The Whole Story brings their narratives together into one life story.

ON YOUR OWN, OVER TIME
You don't need anyone else to use immemoris. Memories rarely come back all at once — return weeks or months later and add what has surfaced. Think of it as a collaboration with your future self.

AI IS YOUR CHOICE
Guided questions, narratives, transcription and narration use AI services. You decide whether to turn them on, and you can still write memories, add photos and invite others without them.

Available in English and Hebrew.

name: Imposter: Pass the Phone Game
description:
Everyone knows the secret word. Except one of you.

Imposter is the pass-one-phone word party game for iPhone and iPad. The phone deals the words, so nobody has to sit out to run it.

HOLD TO SEE
Pass the phone around. Each player holds the card to see the secret word, and it hides the moment they let go. The imposter sees "You're the imposter" and, if you like, a hint.

ONE WORD EACH
Go round the circle and say one word about the secret word. Too obvious and the imposter catches on. Too vague and everyone looks at you.

TALK, THEN POINT
Argue about who was bluffing, then point on three. Catch the imposter and the crew wins, unless the imposter can guess the word.

MAKE IT YOURS
- 3 to 15 players, with optional names, and up to 3 imposters
- 140 built-in words in 14 categories; turn any off
- A hint for the imposter, or nothing at all
- No timer by default, or a 1 to 5 minute discussion timer
- On iPad, lay it flat: prompts and the vote read from both sides of the table

FREE AND PRIVATE
Every word and option is included. No ads, no accounts, nothing sent anywhere. If it makes your night, there's an optional tip jar in Settings; tips don't unlock anything.

name: İmsakiye - Namaz Vakitleri
description:
İmsakiye - Namaz Vakitleri; Kuran, Meal, Kaza Namazı Takibi, Hatim Takibi ve Yapay Zeka destekli İslami asistan bir arada.

Türkiye'nin en kapsamlı İslami rehber uygulaması şimdi iPhone'da! Namaz vakitleri, ezan bildirimleri, Kuran okuma, kıble pusulası, kaza namazı takibi, dini hikayeler ve yapay zeka destekli İslami asistan ile manevi yolculuğunuzu bir üst seviyeye taşıyın.

NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ – DİYANET UYUMLU
Türkiye'nin tüm il ve ilçeleri için doğru namaz vakitleri. Konuma göre otomatik tespit, canlı geri sayım ve aylık imsakiye takvimi.

EZAN BİLDİRİMLERİ
Her vakit için ezan sesli bildirim; Mekke, Medine ve kısa ezan seçenekleri.

YAPAY ZEKA DESTEKLİ İSLAMİ ASİSTAN
Namaz, oruç, zekat gibi ibadet sorularına anında cevap; Kuran ayetleri ve hadisler hakkında bilgi.

KURAN-I KERİM
114 surenin tamamı orijinal hat ve mealiyle. Sayfa sayfa ilerleme, yer imi ve hatim takibi.

KAZA NAMAZI & ORUÇ TAKİBİ
Geçmiş namaz ve oruç borçlarınızı hesaplayın, "Kıldım" butonu ile hızlıca kaydedin, istatistiklerle ilerlemenizi görün.

DİNİ HİKAYELER VE KISSALAR
Peygamberlerin hayatı, sahabe kıssaları ve ibretlik hikayeler.

DİNİ GÜNLER VE GECELER
Kandil, bayram ve mübarek gecelere geri sayım ve hatırlatmalar.

ZİKİRMATİK VE TESBİHAT
Gelişmiş zikir sayacı, hedef belirleme ve hazır zikirler.

KIBLE PUSULASI
Konum destekli hassas kıble yönü ve derece bilgisi.

DUALAR
Arapça metin, Türkçe okunuş ve mealleriyle günlük dualar; favorilere ekleme ve paylaşma.

İSLAMİ DUVAR KAĞITLARI
Yüksek çözünürlüklü görselleri Fotoğraflar'a kaydedin.

PREMIUM
Tek seferlik satın alma ile reklamsız, kesintisiz deneyim.

GİZLİLİK
Verileriniz cihazınızda saklanır, kişisel bilgileriniz satılmaz. Çoğu özellik çevrimdışı çalışır.

İmsakiye ile manevi yolculuğunuza değer katın. Beğendiyseniz 5 yıldız vererek bize destek olun!

name: In Between Sets: Gym Language
description:
Log your set. Your rest timer starts, and a new phrase appears right under it.
In Between Sets turns the minutes you already spend resting into language practice: Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Portuguese or Vietnamese.
No extra time, no new habit. Just the gym you already go to.

THE REST YOU'RE ALREADY TAKING
A typical session has 15 to 20 rest breaks, often 20 minutes or more that usually go to scrolling. Here, every break brings one short lesson or quiz, sized to finish before your timer does. Then you're back under the bar.

REAL PHRASES YOU'LL USE
• 1,600+ phrases across 7 languages
• 11 topics per language: Essentials, Introductions, Everyday Chat, Daily Life, Getting Around, Travel & Hotels, Food & Drinks, Shopping & Money, Problems & Help, Friends, Dating
• Hear every phrase spoken, and tap any part of it to hear that part on its own
• See each phrase broken down word by word, with notes on when to use it

QUIZZES THAT ONLY TEST WHAT YOU'VE LEARNED
• Six quiz types, including listening and build-the-phrase
• New phrases start easy, and harder questions unlock as you get them right
• Miss one and it comes back a few cards later
• Browse any topic anytime in the Practice tab

A WORKOUT LOG BUILT FOR SPEED
• Build routines from a library of common exercises
• Log weight and reps on a big number pad, with last time's numbers right there
• Rest timer on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with an alert when rest is up
• Workout summary, weekly volume, and full history
• Export your history to CSV anytime
• kg or lb

THE REST OF YOUR GYM KIT
• Saves workouts to Apple Health (optional)
• Play Apple Music without leaving the app (Apple Music subscription required)
• Keep your gym's membership card or QR code one tap away
• Pick your accent color and app icon

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads. Your workouts and progress stay on your iPhone.

PRICE
In Between Sets is free. There are no subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

Pick a language, start your next workout, and learn your first phrase before your first set is done.

name: In Spirit & Truth Kaneohe HI
description:
In Spirit & Truth is the teaching ministry of Calvary Chapel Kaneohe with Pastor J.D. Farag, located on the Windward side of Oahu, Hawaii. It is our desire that each listener, here in Hawaii and beyond, would drink deeply from the water of God's Word, and in so doing quench their spiritual thirst with God's Word of truth.

With this app you can:
- Listen to and watch messages and Bible teaching on demand
- Join live services when the ministry is on air
- Read the Bible with the built-in reader
- Share messages with family and friends
- Get notified when the ministry goes live

name: Inbox Era: Fame Story
description:
Inbox Era is a game. All followers, fans, haters, creators and brands in the app are fictional, and their messages are generated by AI. No real person messages you, and nothing in the game is posted to social media. For entertainment only.

Inbox Era is a story game where you get 7 days to handle sudden fame, one message at a time.

You just went viral. Your inbox explodes with fans, rivals, brands and a few haters. Every reply is a choice, and every choice moves your stats: Followers, Hype, Brand $ and Drama. At the end of the week, your choices decide who you became.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Pick your niche: Gaming, Fashion, Comedy, Music, Fitness or Food.
• Each in-game day brings new messages, a brand deal, a hater and a cliffhanger.
• Choose your replies and watch your stats react in real time.
• Pick the viral moment of the day and shape where your story goes.
• Come back tomorrow for the next day, or skip ahead.

STORYLINES THAT CHANGE WITH YOU
• A rival who can't stop talking about you. Collab or clap back?
• A brand deal that looks too good to be true. Take the bag or protect the vibe?
• A superfan who knows every one of your posts.
• A mysterious collab invite that changes everything later in the week.

YOUR VIRAL WEEK RECAP
After 7 days you get a 5-slide recap: your follower graph, your biggest fan, your best clap-back, your biggest (fictional) brand deal and your final archetype, like Chaotic Icon, Brand Machine or Drama Magnet, with how rare it is. Save it or share it, then start a new season in a new niche.

INBOX ERA VIP (optional)
• Write your own replies
• Play the next day instantly, no waiting
• VIP DMs from fictional mega creators
• Animated video recap

Coins are optional consumable in-app purchases, used to skip ahead or unlock extras. They have no real-world value.

KEEPING IT FUN
Haters in Inbox Era joke about content and taste only, never about looks or identity. You can report an AI message from Settings.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
• Inbox Era VIP is an auto-renewable subscription, available weekly or yearly. The current price and period and any free trial offered are shown in the app before you buy and may vary by country.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends.
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings.
• Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://garagelab.tech/inboxera/terms
Privacy Policy: https://garagelab.tech/inboxera/privacy

name: Independence: Off-Grid Life
description:
You have a small house, a laptop, a dog called Buddy, and a bill for everything: electricity, water, food, coffee, clothes.

Independence is a cosy life simulator about getting rid of those bills one at a time. Whatever you make yourself, you no longer have to buy. Then you build things that earn while you sleep. The goal is not to get rich. It is to be able to stop working and have the place carry on without you.

MAKE IT YOURSELF
• Solar panels, batteries and bigger inverters: the sun runs the house, and later the whole farm
• A greenhouse with beds to plant, a tilapia pond, a borehole, an orchard
• Hens for eggs, coffee bushes and a roastery, beehives for honey
• Sheep, a sewing workshop and your own clothing line with an online store
• Apps you build on the laptop that pay every day, and a developer to build more

EVERYTHING HELPS SOMETHING ELSE
The pond cuts the water the beds drink. Trimmings from the beds feed the hens. Manure feeds the beds. Bees pollinate the beds and the orchard. Power runs the pumps. You see where every dollar comes from and goes, every morning.

NINE SIDE GAMES
A quick game for a little extra, once a day each: chop firewood, win the delivery run away from the lights, fish your own pond, pick coffee cherries, catch the eggs, herd the hens home with Buddy, shear a sheep, fly a bee to the flowers, and set down the floors of a forty-floor tower in town that pays you rent for good.

THREE HOLIDAYS
When the place can carry it, take thirty days off and watch it run without you. Then ninety. Then a whole year of your own.

PICTURE CARDS
The first time you build each thing, a picture card explains in plain words how it works: what a battery does, why a bigger inverter matters, how one part of a farm feeds another.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No adverts, no account, nothing to sign up for
• Plays without an internet connection
• The clock stops when you put the phone down: the place waits for you
• iPhone and iPad, upright or on its side
• Free to start. One purchase unlocks the full game: the two longer holidays and the tower above the tenth floor. No other purchases.

Made by Rubik Solutions, a small studio in South Africa.

name: Indus AI Academy
description:
Indus AI Academy is where you learn AI by doing. Our courses teach practical AI for work, study and your own business: prompting, AI tools, automations, agents and more, taught by people who build AI systems for a living. Every course is hands-on, so each session ends with something you have built.

This app is your classroom for the courses you have joined.

Your courses
- All your courses in one place, with what to do next in each.
- Watch lessons and pick up where you left off, on your phone or on the web.
- Take quizzes to check what you have learned.

Classes with your batch
- See your batch's schedule and get a reminder before each class.
- Join classes from your phone, ask questions, and take part in polls and quizzes.
- Follow along in English, Hindi or seven other Indian languages with live translation: Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi and Gujarati.
- Missed a class? Watch the recording and read the class notes.
- Change batch when your plans change.

Certificates
- Every certificate you earn, ready to share, each with its own verification link.

Use the app in English or Hindi. Sign in with the email or mobile number you used for your course. We send you a 6-digit code, so there is no password to remember.

The app is for learners already enrolled in an Indus AI Academy course. To find out more, visit indusai.academy.

name: infoKerkyra
description:
infoKerkyra is the tourist guide of Corfu on your phone. All of Corfu… here: places, beaches, villages, routes, history and what is on tonight on the island.

What to see
Hundreds of places in categories: beaches, museums, villages, churches and monasteries, archaeological sites, buildings and monuments, parks, nature and hiking. Every place has photos, a description, its position on the map and directions.

Map and Near me
Every place on the island map. With Near me you see what is around you. Your location is used only on your device.

Routes
Themed routes with stops, distance and duration: archaeological sites, the buildings and monuments of Corfu Town, the Corfu of famous people, film locations and more.

What's on tonight
Corfu's events calendar by day: cinema and theatre, arts, concerts, going out. Time and venue on the map.

Getting around
KTEL buses, ferries to and from Igoumenitsa and Lefkimmi, airport arrivals and departures, and a point-to-point journey planner.

Useful
Pharmacies on duty, emergency and useful phone numbers, the weather, local businesses.

Corfiot tradition
History, Saint Spyridon, the philharmonic bands, cuisine, a Corfiot lexicon, films and series shot on the island, famous people. And a quiz: how well do you know Corfu?

Also
Favourite places saved on your device, search, and EXTRA 95.8 live radio from Corfu.

The app is in Greek and English and needs no account.

name: Inkplaten
description:
The same letters can feel monumental, playful or urgent. Look closely at how six WPA posters use shape and spacing, from the wide capitals of Grand Canyon National Park to the narrow lettering of Brookfield Zoo.

EXPLORE THE ORIGINALS
Open a poster from the Library of Congress collection. Toggle guides and composition columns, select a lettering annotation, and compare the headline with its supporting type. Keep bookmarks and study notes on your device.

MAKE A PRACTICE SHEET
Trace original lettering cropped from the poster, then try a typeset warm-up phrase of your own. Adjust the cap height, slant and nib width and preview the ruled page as you work. Export a US Letter or A4 PDF for printing, or a high-resolution PNG for your preferred drawing app.

TAKE THE STUDIO OFFLINE
The collection and sheet tools are bundled with the app. Each study credits its source and links to the original record. Checking the latest library metadata requires internet access.

Designed for iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad and Mac.

name: Instince
description:
Instince is a welcoming space for people who love the simple pleasure of picnics. Whether you're planning a relaxing afternoon outdoors, looking for fresh food pairing ideas, or capturing the little moments under an open sky, there's always something inspiring to discover.

A lovely picnic often begins with a little imagination. Plan your next outing, explore delightful food combinations, and find new ideas to make every outdoor gathering feel special. From a quiet weekend lunch to a spontaneous afternoon in the sunshine, let each plan become a new memory.

Some of the best picnic ideas come from sharing. Ask questions, exchange practical tips, and learn from the experiences of fellow picnic lovers. Whether you're choosing picnic essentials, preparing a menu, or looking for inspiration for your next outing, there's always something new to learn.

Share your own picnic moments, photographs, and creative ideas with others. Celebrate the little details, discover different ways to enjoy the outdoors, and be inspired by the experiences of a community that loves picnics as much as you do.

Pack your favorite treats, gather your favorite people, and make room for a little more sunshine.

name: Intercambio: White Elephant
description:
The white elephant, Yankee swap or Dirty Santa at your holiday party, run from one phone. No more arguing about whose turn it is or how many times that blanket was stolen.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add the players and pick your rules
• The app shuffles the turn order, fairly
• Each turn: open a new gift, or steal one
• Steals chain: whoever was robbed goes next
• Gifts lock after the steal limit
• No stealing straight back
• The first player gets a final swap
• Undo any mistake

YOUR RULES
• White Elephant, Yankee Swap or Dirty Santa / Robo presets
• Change the steal limit, steals per turn, final swap and turn timer

FOR THE WHOLE ROOM
• Big-screen view on the phone or iPad, with every gift, who has it and how many times it was stolen
• At the end: who went home with what, and the most wanted gift

FAIR AND PRIVATE
The turn order is fixed by a random seed you can check after the game. No account, no ads, no data collected: everything stays on your phone.

INTERCAMBIO PRO (one-time purchase)
• More than 12 players (up to 60), for office parties and big families
• Saved groups for next year
• Gift photos
• The game on your TV with AirPlay or a cable

In English and Spanish.

name: Interpurr
description:
Interpurr listens to a call, a meeting or a video and shows what is said in your language, sentence by sentence, as it is said.

On a Mac it hears two sides apart: the sound your Mac plays is the other person, your microphone is you. On iPhone and iPad it listens through the microphone.

ON YOUR DEVICE
Speech is turned into text and translated by Apple's on-device speech recognition and translation. No account, no server, no cloud. What you say and hear stays on your device.

A WORD BOOK FOR NAMES AND TERMS
Ready-made packs for crypto, AI and software, startups and investing. Make your own pack with the AI assistant you already use: Interpurr writes the request, you paste the answer. Packs keep growing as you add words.

EVERY SESSION IS A FILE
Each conversation is saved as a plain Markdown file. Name it, add a note, search it later, or hand it to your own AI assistant for a summary or coaching in one tap.

SMALL WHEN YOU NEED IT
On a Mac the window shrinks to a strip or a pill that floats over your call.

YOUR VOICE
Record 20 seconds of your voice. On iPhone and iPad it tells your words from the other person's, so no one taps whose turn it is. On a Mac, other voices near your microphone are not written down as yours.

NINE LANGUAGES
English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Italian, in any pair Apple's on-device translation supports.

PAY ONCE
Free for 5 minutes a day. One purchase removes the limit on every device signed in to your Apple account. No subscription.

Interpurr is a helper, not a certified interpreter. Check anything that matters, and tell the people you record.

name: Into It: Daily Word Puzzles
description:
Into It turns the daily word puzzle into something about you. Pick what you're into (dogs, cats, your team, the Bible, Christmas, movies, New York, and 170 themes in all) and every game that day is built from that world's words, names and trivia.

Every day, in your theme:
• Hunch: guess the five-letter word in six tries, with a clue if you need one
• Huddle: sort sixteen tiles into four groups of four before you run out of tries
• Hideout: find the hidden words in a letter grid, across, down and diagonal
• Haywire: unscramble five words, shortest first, with clues

Play with friends. Send one invite link and you'll see each other's results every day, never the answers.

Keep your streak. A morning reminder when the new puzzles are ready and an evening one before your streak breaks, at the times you choose.

Free. No account. No ads.

Sports themes are unofficial fan puzzles and aren't affiliated with any team or league. Faith themes aren't affiliated with any religious organization.

name: Invoice Generator | Estimate
description:
With Invoice Generator | Estimate, you can finish a job, write up the invoice on your iPhone and send it to your client while the details are still fresh. When a payment comes in, open the same invoice to record it and check how much is left to pay.

Start with your business details and choose the client you’re billing. You can charge a flat fee for a project, bill by the hour or list individual products with their quantities and prices. If a job includes both labor and materials, give each its own line so your client can see how you arrived at the total. Add tax or a discount where it applies, choose the currency and set a due date.

Choose a PDF template and add your logo. There’s room for the details clients often ask for, like a purchase order number, a note about the work or instructions for a bank transfer. Preview the invoice as your client will see it, then send the PDF or save a copy for your records.

If a client pays a deposit up front and the rest when the job is done, you can record both payments against the same invoice. The payment history shows when each amount came in and how it was paid. If your client calls to check the balance, you’ll have the original total, the payments you’ve received and the amount still due in front of you.

When it’s time to follow up, the invoice overview shows how much you’re owed and how much of that is overdue. Search for a particular invoice or filter the list to see which bills are past due. Each entry shows the client’s name, amount and payment status, so you can decide who to contact first.

name: ITEMs: Weekly To-Do List
description:
ITEMs is the weekly to-do list built around the seven days in front of you. Drop a task on a day, check it off, move on. No ads, no tracking, no account — just your week on one clean board.

YOUR WEEK, ONE BOARD
• See Monday to Sunday at a glance and know exactly what today and tomorrow hold
• Add a task straight onto any day in one tap
• Finished tasks stay visible but out of the way — or hide them completely
• All Tasks view to see everything across every week
• On iPad, the board and your task details sit side by side

ORGANIZE WITHOUT THE CLUTTER
• Checklists — break a task into steps and tick them off one by one
• Priority — mark what matters with !, !! or !!!
• Tags — group tasks like #work, #kids or #groceries and filter in a second
• Search — find any task across every week instantly

SYNC & SHARE
• iCloud sync keeps your lists up to date on iPhone and iPad
• Share lists with family, roommates or teammates you invite

SCAN TO TASKS (PLUS)
Snap or pick a photo of a handwritten note, a whiteboard or a printed list. ITEMs reads the text on your device and turns it into a task with checklist items — nothing is uploaded.

EXPORT ANYWHERE (PLUS)
Export a day, a week or everything as PDF, PNG, CSV, JSON, Markdown or a calendar file (.ics). Print a weekly planner, drop tasks into a spreadsheet or bring them into your calendar — your data is never locked in.

NEARBY TRANSFER & CHAT (PRO)
Send lists to an iPhone or iPad right next to you and talk them through in a quick chat. Works device to device — no account, no sign-up.

PERFECT FOR
• Weekly planning and Sunday reset routines
• Groceries, chores and family errands
• School runs, appointments and bills
• Work tasks, side projects and study plans

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
ITEMs has no ads, no analytics and no account of its own. Your tasks are stored on your device and, if you turn on iCloud, in your own private iCloud database.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
ITEMs is free to use with the weekly board, checklists, tags, priority and search. Plus (Scan, Export) and Pro (everything in Plus, plus Chat and Transfer) are optional auto-renewable subscriptions, billed monthly or yearly. Yearly plans start with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://thanhhaikhong.pages.dev/privacy/#items
Questions or ideas? khongthanhhai@gmail.com

name: Ivy: Seamless Pattern Design
description:
Ivy is a drawing app made for one job: designing patterns that repeat.

The artboard IS the tile. Draw across its edge and your mark comes back on the other side, in place, as you draw. There is no "make seamless" step afterwards and no surprise at the join. Zoom out and the repeat is all around you.

One purchase. No subscription, no account, no ads.


WHAT YOU GET
• Live seamless repeats: grid, half drop, brick, mirrored, turned and border
• 163 brushes: watercolor, gouache, oil, ink, marker, pastel, stipple and more
• 800+ shapes, and a Shape Builder for the ones nobody has
• Colorways without repainting
• 40 photographed mockups, or a photo of your own
• Print-ready tiles, layered PSD and time-lapse video
• 17 built-in walkthroughs

EVERY REPEAT, LIVE
Grid, half drop and brick, with offsets from ¼ to ¾. Mirrored and turned repeats that make one motif read as a trellis, a damask or a pinwheel. Border repeats for ribbons and trims. Change the repeat after you have drawn; your tile stays as you drew it. Live symmetry — mirror, quadrant and radial — that still wraps correctly at the seam.

PAINT THAT BEHAVES LIKE PAINT
163 brushes built on photographed marks, not procedural circles: watercolor, gouache, oil, impasto, ink, markers, chalk and pastel, crayon, spray paint, stipple and halftone. Colors mix the way pigments mix — blue and yellow make green, not gray. A watercolor wash pools and dries as you lay it, a loaded brush runs out, and a blender pushes wet paint around. Set how firmly you press once, and every brush follows.

BRUSHES MADE FROM YOUR OWN ART
Turn a motif into a brush and draw with it: florals, ribbons, garlands, charms on a chain, every piece sitting right along the stroke. Multicolor brushes lay several colors in one pass. Edit any brush, or build one from a mark you made.

BUILD MOTIFS, DON'T HUNT FOR THEM
More than 800 shapes to start from, and a Shape Builder that overlaps shapes and lines and carves away what you do not want — so you can make a silhouette that is in nobody's library. Cut a subject out of a photograph and pattern with it. Composition guides lay out ditsy, trailing, flowing, clustered and open-space designs for you to draw into.

COLORWAYS WITHOUT REPAINTING
Recolor finished artwork into a new palette and keep the drawing. Keep the versions you like side by side and file the set as a collection in one move. Pull a palette out of a photo, or import .ase, .swatches and .gpl palettes. Split a design into one layer per color for screen printing.

SEE IT ON SOMETHING REAL
Put your repeat on 40 photographed mockups — wallpaper, a mug, gift wrap, a dress, a tote, a van — or on a photo of your own. The print follows the folds of the cloth. Render one design on a whole set in one go.

THE FILES PEOPLE ASK FOR
A seamless tile at true size for print-on-demand. A repeat sheet for showing work in context. A print sheet at real physical scale with bleed and crop marks. PNG, JPG, PDF, and layered PSD for clients and studios who want the layers.

SHOW HOW IT WAS MADE
Ivy records a time-lapse of each project as you draw. Export it as a video sized for social, ending on the finished repeat.

NEVER MADE A REPEAT BEFORE?
Seventeen step-by-step walkthroughs and a plain-English glossary are built in, covering what each tool is for and where to find it.

BUILT FOR IPAD AND APPLE PENCIL
Pressure, tilt and the barrel double-tap. Layers with blend modes, alpha lock and clipping masks. Text with 26 typefaces. More than 30 filters, from watercolor and gouache to ink and linocut. Autosave, with undo and redo wherever you are.

YOUR WORK IS YOURS
Nothing you draw leaves your iPad unless you export it. Ivy makes no network connections at all, collects nothing, and everything works offline. You own what you make and may sell it without limit.

name: Jacquaire – Camino on foot
description:
Jacquaire plans your Camino de Santiago day by day, and redoes the plan while you walk.

A PLAN THAT FOLLOWS YOUR WALK
You walk more slowly than planned, you set off again from another town, you change variant or date: the plan redoes the following days at once, with a bed every night. It is computed on your phone. In the evening, tell us where you sleep: we redo the rest of the journey from there.

A BED EVERY NIGHT
The plan stops where you can sleep, at your own pace, with the places to stay at each stage and their contact details. You choose your kilometres per day and your variants, and your start and finish freely, in either direction: towards Santiago, or from Santiago back home.

WHILE YOU WALK
• Where you are on the Way, what is left until evening and your expected arrival time.
• A warning if you leave the Way, even with the phone in your pocket if you ask for it.
• The walking route to a place ("Go there") and what is around you.
• The trip's maps downloaded, to walk without a network.
• Report a closed bed, a dry fountain or missing waymarks, or suggest a place (with an account).

EVERY DAY
• Water and table: the day's fountains, the cafés along the way, the evening meal, and the longest stretch without a known water point.
• The day's elevation profile, ascent and descent.
• The day's heritage: churches, bridges, monasteries, and their history.
• The waymarking of the section and who looks after it.
• Stories of the Way: the places the Codex speaks of, the legends, the miracles.
• The weather for the next seven days on a dated trip.
• An estimated budget, for the day and for the whole journey.

28 ROUTES
In France, Switzerland, Spain and Portugal: Voie du Puy, Voie de Tours, Voie de Vézelay, Voie d'Arles, Via Aurelia, Voie du Littoral, Via Gebennensis, ViaJacobi, Piémont pyrénéen, Chemin d'Alsace, Chemin de Lorraine, Camino Francés, Camino del Norte, Camino Primitivo, Camino del Salvador, Camino Inglés, Camino Portugués, Caminho Português Interior, Vía de la Plata, Camino de Madrid, Camino Mozárabe, Camino de Levante, Camino del Ebro, Camino Baztanés, Camino Vasco del Interior, Camino Lebaniego, Camino de Invierno, Camí de Sant Jaume.

THE PASS CHEMIN
The plan, the days, the weather and the budget are free. The Pass Chemin adds, for 12 months: Walk (your position on the Way, the off-route warning, "Go there"), "Sleep here" and the rest of the trip recomputed, offline maps, the journal and the printable route book (PDF). Paid once, no subscription, no renewal. Your first walking day is free. It is bought with a Jacquaire account and follows you on your devices.

WHAT WE KNOW ABOUT YOU
Almost nothing. Without an account, your plan stays on your phone. No ads and no audience measurement in the app. An account is optional: an e-mail address and a code are enough, to find your trips on another device. Your position leaves the phone only to compute a walking route, with no identifier, or if you attach it to a report.

In English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Catalan, Basque, Galician and Dutch.

name: Jam Line: Idle Jam Factory
description:
Lulu runs a jam works, and it runs by itself… as long as you draw the belts right! Trace conveyor belts with one finger, place the machines, and watch the fruit roll to the jars and on to the customers.

• 13 handmade workshops in 2 quarters: the mill and the market
• Three stars per workshop: deliver, be clever with few belts, and be quick
• Bridges, an eraser, spare machines, golden fruit and surprise customers
• Over 150 fruit rolling on screen at once, without slowing down
• A free workshop to build the biggest jam works of all
• The honey sold only buys fixed-price decorations and outfits: nothing random
• No energy, no subscription, no paid draws

Available in French and English.

name: JapsPos Delivery
description:
JapsPos Delivery Apps helps delivery drivers run today’s route, navigate stops, and mark deliveries from their phone.

Connect your company’s JapsPos server, sign in with your driver account, and work with live data — or explore with demo stops when the API is offline.

KEY FEATURES

• Home — today’s progress, KPIs, and next stop
• Route — map, start route, arrive / delivered / failed actions
• Assigned — stops assigned to you by date range
• All — all invoices / stops for your range
• Delivered — delivery history (delivered and failed)
• Live location sharing while a route is in progress (for your store’s admin map)

WHO IT’S FOR

Delivery drivers and staff of a JapsPos wholesale / retail store. Customers should use the Customer app.

GETTING STARTED

1. Enter your company name and server address
2. Activate the API connection
3. Sign in with your driver username and password

Support: contact your store administrator or JapsPos support.

name: JetCarTV: Own Media Player
description:
JetCarTV is a clean, native iPhone player for media you already own or are allowed to use. It comes empty: JetCarTV provides no channels, playlists, streams or videos. You add your own sources – nothing else.

YOUR SOURCES
• Video files from the Files app, played offline
• Your own M3U/M3U8 playlists, from a file or a web address – with groups, favorites, search and a playlist check that explains problems
• Your own XMLTV program guide for now/next information
• Direct links to a video or stream you may use
• Your own Jellyfin media server (sign-in stored in the iOS Keychain)
• Import an address by scanning a QR code – always shown in full for you to confirm

A PLAYER THAT FEELS AT HOME ON iPHONE
• Native iOS video player with Picture in Picture and AirPlay
• Continue watching where you left off
• Audio keeps playing in the background
• Embedded audio tracks and subtitles via the system player controls
• Dark and light appearance, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no tracking, no ads, no analytics
• Your library is stored on your iPhone and can be included in your iCloud or device backup; there are no JetCarTV servers
• Private in-app browser with a watchlist; cookies are deleted when you close the app
• Password-protected, encrypted backup and "Delete all data" in Settings

RESPONSIBLE BY DESIGN
• Downloads only for direct files you added, after you confirm you may download them
• No downloads from YouTube or streaming platforms, no copy-protection (DRM) circumvention

IN THE CAR
JetCarTV has no CarPlay app of its own and shows no videos in the CarPlay menu. Audio plays through your car like any other iPhone audio (CarPlay, Bluetooth or cable). With AirPlay, you can send videos to other screens, such as rear-seat displays, and to a car display if iOS and the car support it while parked. Before every video in a possible driving situation, a notice appears: as the driver, only watch when the car is stopped and the engine is off – traffic jams and red lights count as driving.

ALL FEATURES FREE
No in-app purchases, no subscription: every feature is free – including unlimited sources, the program guide, authorized downloads and your own collections.

Only add content you own or are authorized to use. Formats depend on what iOS can play.
Terms of use: https://www.delalo.de/jetcartv/en/terms/  ·  Privacy policy: https://www.delalo.de/jetcartv/en/privacy/

name: Jetlagged: Jet Lag Planner
description:
Fresh as a daisy, any time zone.

Jetlagged builds you a day-by-day plan to beat jet lag. It tells you when to get bright light, when to put sunglasses on, when coffee is fine and when to stop, and when to sleep, from two days before you fly until your body clock catches up with your destination.

ANY FLIGHT, EVEN PRIVATE
• Type a flight number and the airports fill in, with usual flight times when they're known.
• Flying private or charter? No flight number needed: pick the airports (thousands of airfields, or any time zone) and your times.
• Add connecting flights. Multi-stop flight numbers ask which leg you're on.

A PLAN FOR EVERY DAY
• A simple timeline for each day: wake up, get outside, sunglasses on, last coffee, lights out.
• On the plane: when to sleep, when to open the shade, and when to set your watch.
• See how far your body clock has come, and what time your body thinks it is.

NUDGES, NOT HOMEWORK
• Optional reminders tell you what to do as the day goes.
• Real wake-up alarms for the mornings the plan moves.

FREE AND PRIVATE
• No subscription, no ads, no account.
• Your trips stay on your iPhone.
• Light and dark mode.

How it works: your body clock is set mostly by light. Bright light at the right hours moves it toward your destination; at the wrong hours it pushes the wrong way. Jetlagged works out those hours for every day of your trip.

Plans are general guidance based on body-clock science, not medical advice.

Usual flight times are built from adsb.lol open data (ODbL 1.0).

name: Joule Jar: Kids Chore Chart
description:
Joule Jar™ turns your kids' daily routine into something they look forward to.

Your child works through their list: brush teeth, get dressed, homework, whatever you choose. When the day is done, they tap their picture, play a quick game and pick a glowing mystery orb. Inside is a real-life prize you've already approved, like an extra bedtime story, a donut run or Silly Sock Day.

Every finished day earns a joule. Five joules in a school week fills the jar, and on Full Jar day your child picks a Legendary prize.

MEET JOULES
Joules is the friendly glow who cheers your kids on and reads everything aloud, so even kids who can't read yet can follow their list on their own.

BUILT FOR REAL FAMILIES
• Picture lists made for each child, from little ones to big kids
• Or keep your own chart and use Joule Jar just for the reward
• Three quick games: Catch the Glow, Match Pairs and Shake the Jar
• You pick every prize. Nothing appears that you haven't approved
• A "Prizes waiting" board so you never forget what you owe
• Missed a day? Catch it up later in the week, or OK it yourself
• Optional weekend bonus lists and prizes
• Optional reminders so the routine doesn't slip
• The Joule Room (Plus): a shelf of every jar your child has filled, plus badges to earn
• Share a picture of your child's week with family
• Up to 6 kids with Plus
• Works on iPhone and iPad

PARENTS IN CHARGE
The Grown-ups area is locked behind a parent PIN or a grown-up math question. Kids can't change their lists, prizes or settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up
• No ads
• No tracking or analytics
• Your family's names, lists and prizes stay on your device

FOR EVERY KID
VoiceOver support, captions for every spoken line, Reduce Motion, and larger text sizes.

TRY IT FREE, THEN PAY ONCE
Everything is free for 7 days. After that, pay once: Joule Jar for one child, or Joule Jar Plus for up to six children, Progress and the Joule Room. No subscription, and nothing is charged automatically.

Made by Joule Kids, a small family company. We do the work, so your family doesn't have to.

Questions? support@joulekids.com

Joule Jar™ is a trademark of Joule Kids LLC.

name: Joymate:One Second a Day
description:
Joymate keeps one second of every day. At the end of the month, or the year, it stitches those seconds into a single film you can actually sit and watch.

That's the whole idea. No feed, no streak badges, no one else looking at it.

HOW IT WORKS

Open Joymate and tap record — your iPhone's own camera opens. Shoot a moment, trim the second you want, and save it. The clip lands in your diary with the date stamped onto the frame.

Already have the shot? Pull any video in from your library, or turn a single photo into a short clip instead.

When you're ready, pick a date range — this month, this year, the last 90 days, or any span you like — and Joymate compiles every clip in it into one continuous video, in date order, with the stamps still on the frames.

YOUR DIARY

A calendar sits at the top, marking every day you kept. Tap a day and its clips appear below on a timeline, in the order you shot them. Tap a clip to play it back inside the app.

Save more than one clip in a day if the day deserves it. Nothing gets overwritten.

MAKE IT YOURS

- Portrait (9:16) or landscape (16:9)
- Burn the date into each clip as numbers or written out, in a colour you pick, with an optional outline so it stays readable over bright footage
- Attach a line of subtitles to any clip as a real subtitle track, editable later
- Add a location by hand, or let Joymate fill in the place name for you
- Pick a name from your contacts for a clip's subtitle instead of typing it
- Keep separate diaries with profiles — one for the year, one for a trip, one for your kid — each with its own orientation and its own folder
- Light and dark themes
- Colour-blind friendly calendar option
- 12 languages: English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português, Русский, 中文, Čeština, Català, Magyar, Indonesia, Беларуская

WHERE YOUR CLIPS LIVE

Your clips and films are written to Joymate's own private app folder. No other app can read them, and nothing is uploaded. Deleting Joymate deletes them with it, so keep your own copy of anything you want to survive the phone.

There is no account to create and nothing to log in to. There are no ads.

PERMISSIONS, AND WHY

Joymate asks for each of these only when you use the feature behind it, and every one works the same if you say no — you just lose that one shortcut.

- Camera and Microphone: to record the clip
- Photos: to pick an existing video or photo as an entry
- Contacts: to pick a name for a clip's subtitle instead of typing it
- Location: to fill in the place name on a clip, once, when you ask

Your year is yours. Go record a second of it.

name: JoyPlus Driver
description:
JoyPlus Driver is the official app for chauffeurs working with JoyPlus Chauffeur Service.

Everything you need for a premium ride – in one app:

• Your trips at a glance – see your next job with time, pickup and destination
• Step-by-step trip flow – start trip, arrived at pickup, passenger on board, finish trip
• Live map – route, remaining time and arrival time in real time
• Passenger chat – send quick messages like "I have arrived" with one tap
• Name sign – show the passenger's name on your screen at the meeting point
• Flight and traffic info – stay on time even when plans change
• Receipts and photos – upload parking or toll receipts directly from the trip
• Push notifications – get informed about new trips and changes instantly
• English and German – switch the language anytime

During a trip, your live location is shared with the passenger and JoyPlus dispatch so everyone knows exactly when you arrive. Location is only used while a trip is running – never outside of trips.

This app is for chauffeurs of JoyPlus partner companies. You receive your login from your company or from JoyPlus.

JoyPlus Chauffeur Service – premium transfers in Austria, Germany, across Europe and worldwide.

name: JPC Thermostat
description:
JPC Thermostat is the setup app for JPC thermostats and HVAC relay boxes.
With your phone next to the device, the app finds it over Bluetooth and lets you:
• Connect the thermostat or relay box to your home Wi-Fi, including hidden networks
• Pair a thermostat with the relay box that drives your furnace, boiler or air conditioner, and pick which relay output it controls
• See each device's model, serial number, hardware revision and firmware version
• Check a relay box's outputs: what each one can drive, which thermostat holds it, and what it is calling for right now
Temperature and mode stay on the thermostat's own screen and in Apple Home. Firmware updates install automatically, so there is nothing to manage in the app.
The app needs a JPC thermostat or relay box to do anything useful. It collects no personal data and has no account or sign-in.

name: JPG Connect
description:
JPG Connect turns your iPhone or iPad into a live photo delivery station. Plug your camera in with a USB-C cable, start shooting, and every new photo uploads to your JPG Connect gallery automatically. Your clients, the couple, the event team or the brand watch the photos appear in real time on their own phones.

BUILT FOR WORKING PHOTOGRAPHERS
• Weddings, concerts, corporate events, sports and studio sessions
• Solo shooters and teams with many cameras feeding one gallery
• Each photographer can get their own client link

CABLE TETHERING THAT JUST WORKS
• Sony (PC Remote), Canon EOS and Leica over USB-C
• Uploads over Wi-Fi or 5G, so you are not stuck with venue internet
• No signal? Photos wait on the device and upload the moment you are back online
• Send JPG only for speed, or JPG + RAW for the team
• Add photos from the Photos app or Files any time

GALLERY FOR THE WHOLE TEAM
• View-only Gallery tab: every photographer can browse the job, filter by shooter and see photos full screen
• Share with clients on the spot: copy or send the link, or show a big QR code to scan
• Select one, many or all photos and save them to Photos or Files
• The Studio tab is locked with a 4-digit admin PIN, so only you can change settings

YOUR WHOLE STUDIO IN ONE APP
• Live gallery sorted by capture time, newest shots on top
• Client favorites and star ratings
• AI Cull to pick the best frames and hide blinks and duplicates
• AI retouch, color presets and watermarks applied as photos arrive
• Client links with expiry dates and download controls

A JPG Connect account is required.

name: JPrado
description:
O aplicativo da JPrado foi criado para facilitar sua rotina com a contabilidade.
Com ele, você pode:

- Enviar e acessar documentos de forma segura
- Acompanhar obrigações fiscais e contábeis
- Receber notificações de prazos importantes
- Falar diretamente com nossa equipe
- Consultar informações da sua empresa sempre que precisar

Baixe agora e tenha sua contabilidade na palma da mão!

name: Jubilee Revival AG Church
description:
We have a city to touch, a nation to reach, and a world to change.

What you can do in the app

- Watch the latest message and browse the church's videos and playlists.
- See upcoming events and services, with dates, times and places, and add an event to your calendar.
- Read sermon notes: the topic, speaker, date, service and key message.
- Ask JR Bot about service times, events, pastors, location, contact details and giving. It answers from the church's own information.
- Send a prayer request or share a testimony. You do not need an account for this.
- Find the church on the map with one tap.
- Give through your own UPI app or bank, using the details the church provides.
- Meet the pastors and read about the church.
- Create a member account to join your church family. A church administrator approves new members.
- Set reminders for services and events on your phone.

Your privacy

Registration asks for your name, email address and mobile number. Your information stays with your church and the service providers that run the app. We do not sell it and we do not use it for advertising. You can delete your account and personal data yourself at any time, inside the app (Profile, then Delete my account) or on the web page https://churchconnect-6a48a.web.app/jubilee-revival-ag/delete-account

Questions? contactjubileerevival@gmail.com

Jubilee Revival AG Church uses the Church Connect app.

name: k10AirDrop
description:
k10AirDrop is a simple, fast way to share anything from your iPhone. One clean screen, four buttons, and the iOS Share Sheet, with no clutter and no learning curve.

Share anything
• Photos and videos from your library
• Files from the Files app
• Any text you type. The keyboard opens right away.
• Whatever you last copied to the clipboard

Once you choose an item, a Share button appears right below it. Tap it to open the native iOS Share Sheet and send it with AirDrop, Messages, Mail, or any app you use.

Smart clipboard detection
When you open the app, it checks whether you've copied something. If so, a small alert offers to paste it with one tap. Tap anywhere outside the alert to dismiss it.

Your history, saved on your device
Everything you share is saved automatically in the app. Open Saved Items to:
• Browse your previous shares
• Copy or share any item again
• Select several items and delete them
• Delete everything at once

Make it yours
Choose the app's accent color: Orange, Blue, or Dark Green.

Simple and private
• No account and no sign-up
• No ads and no third-party libraries
• Your saved items stay on your device

Download k10AirDrop and share in a single tap.

name: Kachi Kachi Catch
description:
「カチカチキャッチ（Kachi Kachi Catch）」は、ウサギの「ウサギロー」と協力して、逃げ回るタヌキの「ポコ丸」を追い詰める新感覚の5×5詰みパズルゲームです！

■ ルールはかんたん、奥は深い！
・木のマスをタップすると、そのマスと上下左右の「十字」が裏返ります（木 ↔ 網）。
・ポコ丸が動けるマス（逃げ場）をすべて網や岩・切り株でふさげばクリア！
・ポコ丸は1手ごとに「逃げ場がいちばん多いマス」へ賢く逃げます。先を読んで1手詰・3手詰・5手詰・7手詰を決めよう！

■ たっぷり遊べるモード
・通常ステージ全50問（初級10問＋中級15問の計25問が無料！）
・毎日日替わりで挑戦できる「今日の1問」（120問収録・無料）
・ウサギロー＆ポコ丸の可愛いボイス掛け合い（日本語・英語対応）
・効果音、BGM、バイブレーション、文字サイズ変更、12言語対応

■ Kachi Kachi Catch PRO（¥300・買い切り）
・上級（5手詰）・激ムズ（7手詰）を含む全50問を解放
・タイムアタック（60秒／120秒／180秒）を解放
・ヒント回数が無制限に！
※広告なし・追加課金なしの完全買い切りです。

name: Kaiju Rumble: City Destruction
description:
You are the giant monster. The city is your toy box.

Pick a kaiju, stomp into town and smash the city until nothing is left standing. Crush buildings, send cars flying, blast the army and grow bigger with every block you wreck. Then the boss kaiju arrives.

SMASH THE CITY
• Pure city destruction: every building cracks, tips over and falls
• Start small, grow into a mega kaiju
• Easy touch controls: walk into it, smash it, charge your special attack

MONSTER RAMPAGE AROUND THE WORLD
• 24 stages in 8 worlds: a beach island, mountain towns, neon streets, desert pyramids, frozen cities and more
• Police, tanks, helicopters and jets try to stop you
• Earn three stars on every stage

KAIJU BOSS FIGHTS
• Every world ends in a boss fight, kaiju against kaiju
• Beat the boss and you can add it to your team

COLLECT 12 KAIJU
• A dragon, a gorilla, a robot, a shark, a moth, a two-headed beast and more, each with its own attack and special move
• Three secret kaiju to find
• 96 toy styles: gold, jelly, lava, neon and other collectibles from mystery style boxes, opened with coins you earn by playing

PLAY AS THE ARMY
• Switch sides in Kaiju Hunt: drive a police car, tank, helicopter or jet and take the monster down
• Endless mode: how long can your rampage last?

PLAY OFFLINE
• Short stages for a quick break
• No wifi needed to play

Ready to rumble?

Privacy Policy: https://www.nophigames.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.nophigames.com/terms-of-service.html

name: KaldbakSolberg
description: KaldbakSolberg provides guidance on monitoring the dew point of compressed air and the condition of the dryer for workshop use.

name: KamCal: AI Calorie Scan
description:
How many calories? Don't guess. Snap it.
KamCal counts the calories in your meal from a single photo. Point your camera at your plate and in seconds you see the calories, protein, carbs and fat.

Why KamCal?
• Knows Saudi and Gulf food: kabsa, mandi, madhbi, jareesh, qursan, marqooq, mutabbaq, sambosa, Arabic coffee and dates.
• Your daily calories, made for you: answer 6 simple questions and we calculate your daily calories and protein.
• Ate more? Adjust the portion in one tap: half a plate, one plate, one and a half.
• See how many calories you have left today, with all your meals in one place.
• Comfortable dark design.

Eat what you love. Just know the calories.

Subscription:
• Free to download; photo calorie scanning requires a subscription.
• 3-day free trial, then the subscription (weekly, monthly or yearly) renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your Apple ID settings.
• Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
• Privacy: https://kamcal-api.alameeenhis.workers.dev/privacy

Note: calories are estimates. KamCal is not a substitute for a doctor or a dietitian.

name: Karate Live Croatia
description:
Karate Live Croatia na jednom mjestu okuplja karate turnire u Hrvatskoj: prijave, raspored, ždrijebove, pobjednike susreta i postolja, s pretragom koja ističe tvog natjecatelja ili tvoj klub.

ZA NATJECATELJE, OBITELJI I KLUBOVE
• Turniri u Hrvatskoj: prijave po kategorijama, raspored, ždrijeb i pobjednik svakog susreta, osvježeno tijekom natjecanja.
• Prvenstva i kupovi HKS-a s cjelovitim poretkom svake kategorije.
• Profil svakog natjecatelja i kluba s njegovim rezultatima i medaljama.
• Favoriti i obavijesti na mobitelu.
• WKF događaji: svjetska prvenstva, Karate 1 i kontinentalna prvenstva, s rezultatima i tablicom medalja.
• Za trenere i klubove: Moj klub i sezona kluba u Excelu.
• Slike medalja za dijeljenje na društvenim mrežama.

PLANOVI

name: Karos Farm
description:
Mère Colette's eggs are everywhere - on planks, at the top of ladders and on the other side of wide gaps. Help Karo gather every egg on the farm before the time runs out!

Run along the planks, climb the ladders, leap over gaps and ride the hay lift - but jump off before it reaches the roof. The geese patrol the farm and must not be touched, and from round 9 the crow breaks out of its cage and chases Karo everywhere.

- 8 farm layouts that come back faster and harder every round
- Eggs, corn that stops the clock, hay lifts, geese and a crow that hunts you
- Simple touch buttons: walk, climb and a big JUMP button

name: Karos Groceries

Karos Groceries is a simple shopping list that remembers for you - and a recipe box that fills itself from your favourite food websites.

Shopping lists

Recipes

name: Kartiko: Animal Kart Racing
description:
Grab your kart and race! Drift round bends, fly off ramps, pull off tricks and leave your rivals in the dust. Then drive out into the city, where breaking the rules brings the police!

Kartiko is a colorful animal kart racing game for the whole family. It's easy to start, with plenty to master.

RACE WITH STYLE

 - 12 animal racers, from Kiko the fox to Tembo the elephant, each with their own strengths
 - 8 tracks: sunny savanna, neon streets, icy mountains, volcanoes, jungle, beach, crystal caves and stormy peaks
 - Drift for boosts, catch slipstreams and find hidden shortcuts
 - Hit the ramps, do tricks in the air and land for extra speed
 - 8 wild items: roll a coconut, send a buzzing bee or charge ahead on Rhino Rush

MANY WAYS TO PLAY

 - Race: eight racers, one winner
 - Grand Prix: four races, one golden cup
 - Knockout: the last places are out after every lap
 - Best Race: beat a see-through copy of your own best run
 - Mirror: every track flipped for a new challenge
 - Friends: up to 8 players race together nearby

EXPLORE THE CITY

 - Drive to famous places by day or night
 - Choose your own route on the map
 - Take on coin rushes and deliveries
 - Watch the signals and the speed cameras, or outrun the police!

MAKE IT YOURS

 - Decorate your kart with paint, wheels, stickers, trails, hats and outfits
 - Level up every racer to earn a horn, a signature outfit and a victory dance
 - Garage items change looks only, so races stay fair

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY

 - Open a daily gift
 - Complete quests and open the chest
 - Take on the daily challenge and build your streak
 - Hunt for 34 golden foxes hidden across the tracks and the city

EASY FOR EVERYONE

 - Auto-gas and Smart steer help new drivers
 - A quick practice lap teaches you the basics
 - Play sideways with two thumbs or upright with one
 - Tilt to steer, or use a game controller or keyboard
 - Three speeds: Chill, Pro and Wild
 - Play offline, anywhere
 - No ads

Your progress can be saved in your own iCloud, so your stars, coins and karts are ready on your other devices.

Start your engine and take the Kartiko crown!

name: KataKeep
description:
Know which part to buy when it is time for a replacement.

KataKeep keeps the details of household replacement parts in one place, from water filter cartridges to air purifier filters and vacuum bags. Save a name and part number now, and find them when you need them again.

KEEP THE DETAILS TOGETHER
Use a name that makes sense to you, such as “Kitchen water filter.” Add a part number, label photo, purchase link, and notes. Search by name or part number, copy a part number, or open a saved purchase link.

READ PART NUMBERS FROM LABEL PHOTOS
Take a photo or choose one from your library to find possible part numbers. Compare the suggestions with the label and select the right one, or enter the number yourself. Text recognition takes place on your device.

SYNC WITH ICLOUD
Sync part details, photos, reminder settings, and replacement history across devices using the same Apple Account. Save and view parts offline. iCloud sync requires an internet connection and an iCloud account.

PLAN REPLACEMENTS WITH KATAKEEP PLUS
• Save unlimited parts
• Choose a replacement date and notification time
• Set an optional replacement interval
• View upcoming replacements and recent history

Mark a part as replaced to record the date. If an interval is set, KataKeep calculates the next replacement from the date you record. Without an interval, you receive a one-time reminder at the selected date and time. Notifications require permission in your device settings.

START WITH UP TO FIVE PARTS FOR FREE
The free plan lets you save up to five parts. KataKeep Plus unlocks unlimited parts, replacement reminders, the schedule, and replacement history.

KataKeep Plus is an annual, auto-renewing subscription. See the purchase screen for pricing and renewal terms. Manage or cancel your subscription through the App Store.

Everything you want to read, watch and try, in a jar. And every day, one of them comes back to you.

A JAR FOR EVERYTHING

A NOTE EVERY DAY

SEE HOW FAR YOU'VE COME

name: KEcomBot
description:
os clients vous écrivent sur WhatsApp à toute heure : une question sur un prix, une photo à voir, une commande à passer. Chaque message sans réponse rapide est une vente qui part chez un concurrent. KEcomBot répond à votre place, vend vos produits et vous laisse piloter votre boutique depuis votre téléphone.

UN VENDEUR SUR WHATSAPP, 24 H SUR 24
KEcomBot branche un agent intelligent sur le numéro WhatsApp de votre boutique. Il accueille chaque client, comprend ce qu'il cherche, même formulé avec ses propres mots, et lui propose les bons produits de votre catalogue. Il envoie la fiche du produit avec sa photo et des boutons « Ajouter au panier » ou « Chercher autre chose », puis prend la commande : quantité, quartier, adresse et point de repère. Le client reçoit aussitôt le récapitulatif et le numéro de sa commande.

DES RÉPONSES JUSTES, PAS DES PROMESSES
Les prix, le stock, les frais de livraison et les totaux viennent toujours de votre catalogue, jamais d'une estimation. Un article est réservé dès qu'il entre dans un panier : vous ne vendez pas deux fois le même produit. Rien n'est ajouté au panier sans l'accord du client.

VOUS GARDEZ LA MAIN
L'application vous montre toutes les conversations en direct. Une question délicate, un client important ? Touchez « Reprendre la main », répondez vous-même depuis l'application, puis rendez la conversation à l'agent. Les conversations qui attendent un humain sont signalées sur l'accueil et par une notification.

TOUTE VOTRE ACTIVITÉ EN UN COUP D'ŒIL
• Commandes du jour, chiffre d'affaires du jour, commandes à préparer
• Graphique des commandes sur la semaine, le mois ou l'année
• Liste des clients classés par chiffre d'affaires, avec leurs coordonnées
• Une alerte à chaque nouvelle commande ; un appui ouvre directement la commande

DES COMMANDES SUIVIES JUSQU'À LA LIVRAISON
Chaque commande affiche ses articles, son total, le client, son adresse et sa position quand il l'a partagée. Faites-la avancer en un geste : confirmée, préparée, en livraison, livrée. Choisissez le livreur : son nom et son numéro sont envoyés au client, qui est prévenu à chaque étape. Le paiement se fait à la livraison.

LES RELANCES QUI RÉCUPÈRENT DES VENTES
Un client a rempli son panier puis s'est tu ? Il a regardé un produit sans le commander ? KEcomBot le relance au bon moment, avec un message adapté, jusqu'à quatre fois selon le calendrier que vous choisissez. La relance s'arrête dès que le client répond ou commande, et respecte les règles de WhatsApp sur les messages envoyés après 24 heures.

VOTRE CATALOGUE DANS LA POCHE
Ajoutez un produit en photographiant l'article, fixez son prix et son stock, rangez-le dans une catégorie. Définissez vos zones de livraison et leurs frais : l'agent les applique tout seul. Toute modification est prise en compte immédiatement dans les réponses aux clients.

UNE ÉQUIPE ORGANISÉE
Le propriétaire règle la boutique, les relances et la consigne donnée à l'agent (ton, informations à transmettre), et crée les comptes de ses agents. Les agents traitent les commandes et les conversations. Chaque boutique ne voit que ses propres données.

POUR QUI ?
Électroménager, informatique, mobilier, mode, beauté, téléphonie… KEcomBot convient à toute boutique qui vend déjà, ou veut vendre, par WhatsApp et livrer ses clients.

SIMPLE ET SÛR
Connexion sécurisée, mots de passe chiffrés, mode clair ou sombre. L'application reprend les mêmes données que le backoffice web : vous passez de l'ordinateur au téléphone sans rien perdre.

À SAVOIR
L'application est réservée aux boutiques inscrites au service KEcomBot ; vos identifiants vous sont remis à l'ouverture de votre boutique.

WhatsApp est une marque de Meta Platforms, Inc. KEcomBot est un service indépendant, non affilié à Meta.

name: Keep Scór
description:
Underage matches are high scoring and hard to follow. Three points, a goal, another point — and suddenly nobody on the line is sure who's ahead, or how long is left.

Keep Scór is for that. Big buttons, one hand, in the rain.

Scoring
Tap a goal, a point or a two-pointer for either side. Hold a button for a free, a '45, a mark, a sideline or a penalty. Tap Wide when it goes wide. Undo as many times as you need.

The clock
Halves, half time, full time, and how long is left — so you're not guessing.

All four codes, with the right rules
Football, hurling, camogie and ladies' football each have their own rules, and the app uses the right ones. Hurling has '65s, not '45s. A '45 in ladies' football is worth two points. Two-pointers count where they count.

After the whistle
The full breakdown in proper notation, every score with the time it went over, and the result shared to a WhatsApp group in one tap.

Over a season
Your results, where your scores come from, how your shooting is going, and your record against every club you've played.

Any match, not just your own
Watching a game you're not in? Score it without it touching your own season.

Every club in Ireland
All 1,618 of them, with their counties, so two clubs with the same name in different counties don't get mixed up.

What it doesn't do
No account. No sign-up. No ads. Nothing is sent anywhere — it all stays on your phone. It's free, and there's nothing to buy.

Keep Scór is an independent app, not affiliated with the GAA, the LGFA or the Camogie Association.

name: Kelime Avı: Harf Bulmaca
description:
Kelime Avı, Türkçe için baştan tasarlanmış sakin ve bağımlılık yapıcı bir harf bulmaca ve kelime oyunu. Izgaradaki harflerin arasına saklanmış kelimeleri bul, gizli kelimeyi aç, resmini albümüne ekle.

KELİME BULMACA NASIL OYNANIR?
• Harfe dokun, parmağını sürükle, bırak: kelimeler soldan sağa, yukarıdan aşağıya ya da çapraz yönde saklanır.
• Ters yazılmış kelime yok: her kelime okunduğu yönde, bulması adil ve keyifli.
• Kelimenin yerini ipucundan tahmin et. Bulduğun her kelime, ekranın üstündeki gizli kelimeden bir harf açar. Hepsini bulunca gizli kelime ortaya çıkar.
• Takıldığında ipucu kullan: bir harf aç ya da kelimenin yerini göster.

NEDEN KELİME AVI?
• 10 kategori, 400 seviye: şehirler, ülkeler, yemekler, hayvanlar, spor, meslekler, meyveler, sebzeler, doğa ve müzik.
• Her gün yeni bir günlük bulmaca ve günlük görevler. Seri takvimin ve seri kalkanınla serini koru.
• Sonsuz mod: üç canla, tur tur zorlaşan bulmacalar. Rekorunu kır.
• Her gizli kelimenin bir resmi var. Kelimeyi bulunca resim ortaya çıkar ve 161 resimlik albümüne eklenir.
• Her 5. seviyede küçük bir çeşni: altın harf, süre yarışı ya da kusursuz bonusu. Kaçırınca ceza yok.
• Bulduğun kelimeler ipuçlarıyla birlikte sözlüğünde toplanır.
• Altınla açılan görünüm temaları: Orman, Gün batımı, Lavanta ve Kömür.
• Günlük sonucunu arkadaşlarınla paylaş; paylaşılan kart gizli kelimeyi ele vermez.
• İsteğe bağlı günlük hatırlatma: istersen Ayarlar'dan aç, istediğin saati seç.

ZEKA OYUNU, BEYİN EGZERSİZİ
Seviyeler yavaş yavaş zorlaşır: 5×5'ten 9×9'a, düz yönlerden çaprazlara. İlk açılışta kısa bir öğretici seni oyuna alıştırır. Acele yok, süre baskısı yok: sözcük dağarcığını geliştirirken keyifli vakit geçir.

KEYİFLİ VE KOLAY
• Bulduğun kelimeler taş gibi yerine oturur; sesler ve titreşimle her bulgu tatmin edici hissettirir.
• Açık ve koyu mod, telefon ve tablet için uyumlu ekran.
• Hesap gerekmez. Çevrimdışı oynanır.
• Oynamak için satın alma gerekmez: altın oynayarak ya da isteğe bağlı reklam izleyerek kazanılır. İstersen altın paketi alabilir ya da reklamları kalıcı olarak kaldırabilirsin.
• Reklamlar seyrek ve oyun sırasında asla çıkmaz; ödüllü reklam izlemek tamamen isteğe bağlıdır.

Şehirleri, hayvanları, yemekleri ve daha fazlasını ara; bulmacayı çöz, gizli kelimeyi bul. İyi avlar!

name: Khmer Keyboard Smart
description:
Type Khmer the easy way. Khmer Smart Key turns the way a word sounds into real Khmer, so you can write Khmer fast without learning a new layout.

TYPE HOW IT SOUNDS
Type "sousdey" and get the Khmer word for "hello". Type "khnhom" and get the Khmer word for "I". Khmer words appear above the keys as you type. Tap one, flick down on a key, or slide on the space bar to pick it. English words still work normally, with spelling suggestions.

FULL KHMER KEYBOARD
Prefer typing in Khmer script? Switch to the Khmer (KorKhor) keyboard with one tap, or swipe up on the space bar. Every key shows its second character: swipe down or hold to type it. Common misspellings are fixed for you, like a vowel typed before a subscript consonant.

SMART PREDICTIONS
After each word, Khmer Smart suggests the next one, learned from real Khmer text. It also remembers the words you pick, so suggestions get better the more you type.

MORE
• Glide typing: draw across the letters to type a whole word
• All numbers and symbols, Khmer and English, on one page
• Optional number row: swipe up or down with three fingers
• Key sounds and vibration you can switch on or off
• Light and dark mode, iPhone and iPad

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Khmer Smart works fully offline and has no internet code, so nothing you type ever leaves your phone. No account, no ads, no tracking. "Allow Full Access" is optional and only needed for vibration and the keyboard's own click sounds.
