name: Kitty Focus
description:
Meet Miso, a fluffy little cat who keeps you company while you focus.
Start a timer and Miso walks along beside you. On your break, Miso curls up for a nap. Finish a session and Miso celebrates with you.
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your focus history stays on your iPhone.

Kitty Focus is a simple, gentle timer built around the Pomodoro rhythm: focus for a while, rest a little, repeat. It is made for studying, working, writing, practicing or any task that deserves your full attention.

A COMPANION, NOT A TASKMASTER
• Miso sits and waits for you, walks while you focus, naps on breaks and cheers when you finish.
• Stop early and Miso is understanding, never cross. No penalties, and the time you did focus stays in your Journey.
• Tap Miso for a wave, a giggle or a pair of heart eyes.
• Rename your cat whatever you like.

FOCUS YOUR WAY
• Quick picks for 5, 25, 45 or 60 minutes, or set anything from 5 to 120 minutes in Settings.
• Short breaks, plus a longer break after every fourth session.
• Pause and resume whenever life interrupts.
• A gentle notification when your session ends, if you want one.
• Optional completion sound and haptics.

SEE YOUR RHYTHM
• A daily goal that fills up as you go.
• Journey: a day-by-day timeline of your sessions, with notes on what you worked on.
• Tags such as Deep work, Study, Create and Move, plus your own.
• Insights: charts for the last 7 or 30 days, your day streak and where your time went.

GROW TOGETHER
• Every completed minute of focus adds to your cat's level.
• Visit the Cat Room to choose your cat and an accessory.
• Four cats at launch: Ginger to start, then Tuxedo, Mist and Calico as you focus.
• A bow tie, a star and a crown to unlock along the way.
• More cat friends are on the way. Peek at them in the Cat Room, marked Coming soon.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign-up and no account.
• No ads, no analytics and no tracking.
• Your sessions, notes and settings stay on your device.
• Export your focus history as a JSON file, or erase everything from Settings.

Kitty Focus is free, with no in-app purchases.

Find a comfy spot, pick a time and let Miso keep you company.

name: Klaar – Urenregistratie
description:
Klaar is de urenregistratie voor schoonmaakbedrijven. Medewerkers klokken in en uit per klus, zien hun rooster en melden zich ziek of vragen verlof aan, allemaal vanaf hun telefoon. Kantoor ziet direct wat er gebeurt.

Je account krijg je van je werkgever. Je kunt je niet zelf registreren.

VOOR MEDEWERKERS
• In- en uitklokken per klus met één veeg. De pauze gaat er automatisch af.
• Een live balk laat zien hoeveel tijd er nog is binnen de norm van de klus.
• Ga je over de norm? Dan kies je kort een reden, zodat kantoor weet waarom.
• Je weekkaart met al je diensten en gewerkte uren. Klopt er iets niet, dan vraag je een correctie aan.
• Verlof aanvragen en je ziek en beter melden.
• Een dienst overnemen die kantoor aanbiedt.
• Materiaal aanvragen voor je locatie en werkinstructies per locatie bekijken.
• In het Nederlands of Engels.

VOOR KANTOOR
• Planning maken en publiceren; medewerkers krijgen direct een bericht.
• Uren tegen de norm per week en per klant.
• Meldingen bij overschrijding, te laat of ziek.
• Uren corrigeren en goedkeuren, en exporteren voor de salarisadministratie.
• Kantoor werkt in hetzelfde portaal op de computer en in de app.

PRIVACY
Klaar vraagt alleen wat nodig is voor je uren: geen locatie, geen camera, geen contacten en geen advertenties of trackers. Je gegevens staan in de EU.

name: Klexerei
description:
Klexerei ist ein Malatelier fürs iPad, das mit deinem Kind mitwächst. Kreide mit körniger Spur, Pinsel mit Borsten, Filzstifte, die beim Übermalen dunkler werden – und eine Oberfläche, die schon Dreijährige ganz ohne Lesen verstehen.

EINE APP, DREI ALTERSSTUFEN
• 3–4 Jahre: große Symbole, kein Text, 8 kräftige Farben, Wachsmalstift
• 4–6 Jahre: Kreide, Pinsel und Filzstift, 16 Farben, mehr Stempel
• 6–10 Jahre: bis zu 4 Ebenen, 24 Stifte plus 48 Farbtöne, Spiegelmalen
Ihr stellt die Stufe im Elternbereich ein. Beim Wechsel geht kein Bild verloren.

MALEN WIE AUF ECHTEM PAPIER
• Apple Pencil mit Druckempfindlichkeit – oder einfach mit dem Finger
• Regenbogenstift, Glitzerstift und Farbeimer zum Ausfüllen
• Radiergummi, Rückgängig und Wiederholen
• Löschen nur durch langes Drücken – kein Bild verschwindet aus Versehen
• 7 Papierfarben, sanfte Geräusche und Vibration (abschaltbar)

AUSMALBILDER UND STEMPEL
• Ausmalbilder zu Tieren, Fahrzeugen, Essen, Dinos, Natur, Jahreszeiten, Festen und Mandalas
• Die Linien bleiben immer sichtbar – Kinder malen darunter und übermalen nichts
• Eigene Fotos oder PDFs als Ausmalbild
• Nachspur-Seiten mit Buchstaben, Zahlen und Linien
• Stempel nehmen die Farbe des Stifts an und lassen sich verschieben, drehen und vergrößern

MEINE BILDER
• Bis zu 6 Kinder mit eigener Galerie, Altersstufe und Papierfarbe
• Alles wird automatisch gespeichert, lokal auf dem iPad
• Bilder mit einem Tipp ins Fotoalbum sichern

FÜR ELTERN
• Pausen-Timer, der nur die echte Malzeit zählt, 2 Minuten vorher Bescheid gibt und dann eine Pause einlegt – auch wenn die App zwischendurch geschlossen wird
• Elternbereich mit Elternprüfung, damit Kinder keine Einstellungen ändern
• Wochenübersicht der Malzeit für jedes Kind
• Bebilderte Anleitung für den Geführten Zugriff, damit euer Kind in der App bleibt
• Keine Werbung, keine In-App-Käufe, keine Datensammlung, kein Konto – funktioniert auch ohne Internet

Klexerei – weil die schönsten Bilder dort entstehen, wo ein bisschen gekleckst werden darf.

name: Knobelbox
description:
NO ADS. NO SUBSCRIPTION. FULLY OFFLINE.
No video after the level, no coins, no timer. Just puzzles that keep getting harder.

SIX GAMES
• One Line: draw a line through every cell without crossing it. Every dead end costs a heart.
• Connect: join matching dots and fill the whole board. Box yourself in and you have to clear a line.
• Light Beam: turn mirrors until the beam hits every target. From level 5 the beam is invisible, three shots.
• Boxes: drag boxes onto their cells. Never pull, and a box in a corner is lost.
• Roller: swipe, the ball rolls until it hits a wall. Colour everything in as few moves as possible.
• Lights Out: every tap flips a cell and its neighbours. Darken the board in as few taps as possible.

IT REALLY GETS HARDER
Every level is generated on your device and checked by a solver: guaranteed solvable, no mirrored copies, no plateau. The curve climbs well past level 50, with breathers in between and new variants once a game hits its maximum.

THREE CHALLENGES EVERY DAY
Medium, Hard and Extreme, the same puzzle for every player. With a streak that forgives one missed day a week.

MORE
• 29 badges, plus looks you unlock with them
• Game Center leaderboards
• Progress synced through iCloud
• Hints as a stock: topped up daily, every three-star level adds one, never behind an ad
• Shapes inside dots and boxes for anyone who finds colours hard to tell apart
• Pinch to zoom on big boards
• English and German

No account, no tracking, no purchases. Only an anonymous counter of which game gets played. Just puzzles.

name: Knot Free: Untangle Ropes
description:
Untangle the ropes so that none of them cross!

Knot Free is a calm, satisfying puzzle about one simple idea: every rope connects two pins, and your job is to drag the pins until no two ropes cross. Red ropes are still tangled, gold ropes are free. Watch the crossings counter drop to zero and the whole knot lights up.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of hand-checked levels that get smarter as you go
• One-finger controls: just drag a pin
• Every level is guaranteed to be solvable
• Hints when you are stuck, skip a level any time
• Unlock rope styles: Mint, Candy, Ocean, Lava, Royal
• No timers, no pressure: play offline, at your own pace
• Small download, smooth on every iPhone

Knot Free is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Knot Pilot: Knot Tying in 3D
description:
Learn a knot by watching it tied, not by squinting at a drawing.

Knot Pilot ties each knot in 3D right in front of you, one move at a time. Slow it down, step back, turn the rope to any side and see exactly where the end goes.

WHAT YOU GET
• Knots for sailing, climbing, camping, fishing, tree work, rescue and jobs around the house
• Every step in plain words: what to do and what to watch for
• A path hint that shows where the working end goes next
• Any angle: the camera follows the knot, or turn it with a finger
• Your pace: from a quarter speed to double, one step at a time
• Find a knot by its name or by the job: "tarp", "join two ropes", "boat"
• Star the knots you use most and keep them close
• Works without a connection: on a boat, at the crag, deep in the woods

ROPE SANDBOX
Drag a rope with your finger, drape it over a rail or a post, pin a point and pull the ends. Tie any knot your own way, save your scenes and come back to them later.

START HERE
Not sure where to begin? Six knots cover most everyday jobs: the figure-eight, bowline, clove hitch, reef knot, sheet bend and round turn with two half hitches. Learn those and you're ready for almost anything.

name: Koinonia Messenger
description:
Koinonia Messenger keeps your church family connected in one simple, private app.

MESSAGES
• Group chats for every ministry, small group and team
• Private messages between members
• Voice messages, photos, polls and reactions
• Choose your own alert tone for each chat

CALENDAR AND EVENTS
• Every service, meeting and event in one calendar
• RSVP with one tap and see who's coming
• Meeting notes, schedules and volunteer roles

GROUPS
• Join open groups or be added by a leader
• Each group has its own chat and calendar
• Leaders can share checklists and notices

YOUR CHURCH
• Service times, address, pastor and contacts
• Announcements and devotionals from your pastor
• Photo albums from church events

SAFE AND PRIVATE
• Only people in your church can see your church's chats
• Block anyone and report any message
• Parents approve children under 16
• No ads, no tracking, and your information is never sold

Your church needs a Koinonia Messenger account to use the app. Church leaders can apply at koinoniamessenger.com.

name: Koinonia Pre-Alert
description:
Koinonia Pre-Alert gives volunteer firefighters and EMS responders in Lancaster County, PA an early heads-up when a call comes in, taken from the public county incident list.

Pick what you want to hear about: • First-due areas: calls inside the areas you tick • Stations and units: whenever your station or a unit is dispatched, even when added later • Townships: the call types you pick in the townships you pick • Countywide: call types anywhere in the county, like working building fires

Each alert has its own tone, so you can tell them apart by sound. Loud alerts can get through Do Not Disturb, and the call is read out loud after the tone. Quiet alerts just show in your notifications. Night mode lets you quiet some alerts overnight.

Sign in with your email and your alerts are saved to your account, so they come right back on a new phone. Ready-made station profiles get a new member set up in a minute.

PRE-ALERT ONLY. Koinonia Pre-Alert is a privately run pre-alert tool. It is not a public safety service, not an official dispatch or paging system, and is not affiliated with any 911 center, Lancaster County or any fire company. Alerts may be delayed or missed. Do not depend on it for dispatch. Always rely on your department's official pager or radio.

name: Koppi: Family Chores & Meals
description:
Koppi turns a spare iPad into your family's chore board, and your phone into the place you run the week.

FOR KIDS: WALK UP AND GO
Put an iPad on the wall or the kitchen counter. A kid walks up, Koppi recognizes their face, and their own list for today opens. No typing, no logging in, no peeking at a sibling's list. Every list can also be opened with a PIN.

• Big, friendly mission cards a young kid can use without reading help
• Stars for every finished chore, with a different check animation for each kid
• Wrapped surprise gifts you choose, opened when they hit the goal
• A puppy companion each kid can earn and name
• A little island that grows as the week fills in
• Chores can be read out loud for kids who are still learning to read
• Nothing ever punishes a missed day

FOR PARENTS: THE WHOLE WEEK IN ONE PLACE
• Today at a glance: what's next, meals, and how each kid's chores are going
• Chores on any schedule: every day, certain weekdays, weekly, monthly, or one time with a due date
• "Needs my OK" chores: get a notification, then approve or send it back with a note
• Family calendar for events, appointments and meals, with reminders for the people you pick
• See the family calendar in your phone's own calendar app
• Your own to-do list, on your phone or by walking up to the iPad

MEALS, COOKBOOK AND GROCERIES
• Plan each meal with one dish or several
• Save recipes from websites and social posts with Share, then Koppi
• Type in your own recipe, or take a picture of a recipe card
• A cookbook sorted into Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks and Desserts
• A grocery list built from the meals you planned, grouped by store section, for one week or several
• Tick off what you already have at home, then switch to a shopping list that shows only what's left
• Let a kid make dinner: it goes on their list with the recipe one tap away

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Face recognition happens on your iPad. Face data never leaves it.
• No ads and no tracking
• No email address or password needed. Parents' phones join with a short invite code.

Koppi works on iPhone and iPad. Use one iPad as the family board and add each parent's phone.

name: Korike Merchant
description:
Korike Merchant turns your shop into a delivery business. List what you sell, take orders from customers nearby, hand each one to a Korike rider, and get paid on a fixed schedule - without running a delivery fleet of your own.

SET UP YOUR SHOP

Register in five guided steps: shop name, address, photos and documents. Once you are verified, your shop appears to customers browsing Korike near you.

MANAGE YOUR INVENTORY

Add items with a photo, price and category. Edit a price in seconds, mark something out of stock the moment it runs out, and search the whole catalogue as it grows.

TAKE ORDERS

New orders arrive with the customer, the items and the total already on the card. Follow each one through Active and Picked Up. When a rider comes to collect, they give you a 4-digit pickup PIN that you verify in the app, so nothing leaves your counter with the wrong person.

LET RIDERS DELIVER

No drivers, no vehicles, no delivery staff to manage. Korike's rider network collects from your shop and takes the order to the customer, who follows it live on a map the whole way.

GET PAID

Your wallet shows the current balance and every transaction behind it. Balances are paid out automatically on the 1st and the 16th - no invoices to raise, nobody to chase.

SET YOUR HOURS

Choose your opening and closing times and the days you are closed. Customers see your shop as open only when you are actually trading.

WHO IT IS FOR

Grocery stores, pharmacies, bakeries, restaurants and any local shop that wants to sell past its walk-in customers.

Korike Merchant is the app for shop owners. Customers order in the Korike app, and riders work in Korike Partner.

Questions or feedback? Write to us from Help and Support in the app.

name: KOTA – Billets & Réservations
description:
KOTA, c'est une seule porte pour tout ce qui se vit.

Un match, un concert, un culte, une conférence, une séance de cinéma : avec KOTA, tu prends ton billet, tu réserves ta place gratuite ou tu t'inscris en quelques secondes. Le jour J, tu entres avec un seul QR code.

CE QUE TU PEUX FAIRE
• Découvrir les événements près de chez toi : sport, concerts, églises et cultes, conférences, cinéma, loisirs.
• Réserver une place gratuite pour un culte, une veillée ou une conférence.
• T'inscrire aux formations, ateliers et concours avec un formulaire simple.
• Choisir ta place quand la salle est numérotée.
• Retrouver tous tes billets dans l'app, même sans connexion.
• Libérer ta place si tu ne peux plus venir, pour qu'elle profite à quelqu'un d'autre.

POUR LES ORGANISATEURS
Les agents à l'entrée scannent les billets avec KOTA : un QR, une seule entrée, aucun double passage.

KOTA est un service de LIROYEN SASU (Kinshasa, RD Congo).
Kota. Vis l'expérience.

name: KweekPeil
description:
KweekPeil is een kweekboek dat in de hand past. Het noteert de stand van de maatbeker op een bepaald moment: hoeveel erin ging, wat u aflas, welke blik ontbrak, en welk totaal nog te berekenen viel. Wie op de vensterbank kweekt, microgroenten oogst of een opkweekpartij begeleidt, laat zo het bewijs van dezelfde pot, dezelfde schaal en dezelfde lichting op zijn plaats. Verandert een voorwaarde, dan blijft het oude besluit bij de oorspronkelijke waarde staan, klaar om de volgende keer punt voor punt na te rekenen.

Voor potafvoer staan zes proeven apart open. De klok start zodra het vaste gietvolume erin zit. Water uit de potgaten en water over de rand worden apart opgevangen. Een interval mag met een nieuwe of geleegde beker, of met een beker die blijft staan. Van een staande beker telt alleen de toename. Giet u 200 mL en leest u achtereenvolgens 40, 90 en 110 mL, dan staan cumulatief en percentage meteen klaar: het laatste interval is 110 min 90, het totaal 55 procent. Mist u precies de meting op 5 minuten, dan blijft het totaal controleerbaar en wordt dat ene interval onbekend.

Voor en na het vrijmaken van de gaten, met of zonder drainagelaag, vlak of een centimeter scheef, vers of een seizoen gebruikt substraat, lege of gevulde schotel: alles volgt dezelfde afspraak. Ontbreken herhalingen, wijkt een tijdstip te ver af of zijn de omstandigheden niet vergelijkbaar, dan meldt de vergelijking onvoldoende bewijs en blijven de oorspronkelijke waarden staan, klaar voor een aanvulling of een hermeting op dezelfde voet. Is het bewijs rond, dan kiest u zelf: behouden, aanpassen of stoppen.

Microgroenten en opkweek lopen per partij. Zaaidichtheid, de overgang van stapel naar licht, spoelen en uitlekken, het oogstvenster, isolatie en koelvoorraad, en ook precisiezaai, temperatuur, opkomst en een latere controle in het veld, legt u vast vanaf de stap die nu aan de beurt is. Wat nog niet gebeurd is, mag leeg blijven. Plan en werkelijkheid blijven gescheiden, eerdere versies zijn terug te lezen, en een geïsoleerde partij licht apart op de werkbank op.

Dossiers, concepten, foto’s en revisies blijven op dit apparaat. Zonder account, en ook zonder netwerk, kunt u blijven meten. Wilt u iets meenemen, dan bekijkt u eerst het PDF- of CSV-voorbeeld, controleert u kop, eenheid en datum, en bewaart u het bestand zelf via het deelvenster. Foto maken, één beeld uit de bibliotheek kiezen en een lokale herinnering staan alleen aan als u dat wilt. Zonder die rechten blijft een meting met de hand volledig.

De getallen liggen open. De keuze blijft van u.

name: L my Ex Items
description:
That ball in the closet deserves a game. L my ex items looks at the sports gear you already own and suggests what to play — then helps you get people together.

FIND A GAME
• Add photos of your gear with the camera or from your library: a ball, a racket, sneakers, a frisbee.
• Tell the app what you enjoy and choose tags like Outdoors, Team, Chill or Competitive.
• Get your top 3 matches out of 8 sports, with the reason for each one and what you'd still need.

GEAR & PLAYERS
• Keep your collection in one place: photo, name, description and the sport each item is good for.
• Build a list of friends for each sport and mark who you've invited.
• Tap Invite to copy a ready-made message and paste it into any chat.

YOUR OWN GAME
• Invent a game: name, the idea, rules, number of players, date and a cover photo.
• Save it and the invite with all the rules is copied for you.
• After you play, record how it went: did it happen, how many people came, and a rating.

ANALYTICS
• See how many people signed up, which games worked out and your average rating.
• Charts by day of the week show the best days to play.
• No games yet? Turn on sample data to see how the charts work.

PROFILE
• Your name, photo, date of birth and a few words about you.
• Counts of items saved, games played, games created and people invited.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Everything you add stays on your device, the app works offline, and you can delete all your data in one tap.

Made for iPhone and iPad, with a gold-on-black design.

name: La mia Patata
description:
- Scoprire il menu: esplora tutte le nostre specialità, dai fritti alle patate al forno, dagli gnocchi alle barchette e molto altro.
- Conoscere le nostre proposte: lasciati conquistare da ricette originali e abbinamenti sorprendenti.
- Ordinare facilmente: consulta le nostre proposte e accedi al servizio di ordinazione.
- Restare aggiornato: scopri novità, specialità e iniziative del nostro locale.
- Contattarci: trova tutte le informazioni utili per raggiungerci e vivere la tua esperienza La Mia Patata.

name: La petite parisienne
description: Bienvenue dans l’application La Petite Parisienne, votre boutique de mode féminine au style chic et intemporel, inspirée de l’élégance parisienne. Manteaux, robes, pulls, accessoires… Retrouvez toutes nos collections en quelques clics et composez des looks raffinés pour chaque saison.

name: La Route des Belles
description:
La Route des Belles suit chaque jour le stock des maisons qui vendent des voitures d'exception en France : ce qui arrive, ce qui part, et ce qui change de prix.

MOUVEMENTS — les entrées, les sorties, les baisses et les hausses de prix, jour par jour, avec la photo, le prix et l'écart.

VOITURES — tout le stock suivi, et l'historique des prix de chaque voiture.

MAISONS — les fiches des maisons suivies : où elles sont, ce qu'elles ont en stock, à quel prix.

ANALYSES — les lettres et les analyses du marché publiées par La Route des Belles.

NOTIFICATIONS — au choix, une par jour au plus : entrées, sorties, baisses ou hausses de prix.

Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucun traceur. Les notifications ne demandent qu'un jeton d'appareil, effacé quand on les coupe.

name: La Route des Belles Course
description:
La Route des Belles Course suit en direct les serveurs de course en ligne de La Route des Belles.

SERVEURS — qui roule, sur quel circuit, dans quelle session, et combien de places restent.

DIRECT — classement, écarts, meilleurs tours et secteurs, relus toutes les deux secondes pendant une session.

RECORDS — le record de chaque circuit, le tour idéal fait des meilleurs secteurs, le classement des pilotes, et un comparateur secteur par secteur.

PALMARÈS — les dernières courses et leurs podiums.

NOTIFICATIONS — au choix : quand une course d'au moins deux pilotes prend le départ, quand un record de piste tombe.

WIDGET — « En piste » sur l'écran d'accueil : qui roule en ce moment.

Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucun traceur. Les notifications ne demandent qu'un jeton d'appareil, effacé quand on les coupe.

name: Label It - QR Labels
description:
Label It – QR Labels

Keep your belongings organized with Label It, a simple QR label management app.

Create QR labels for your boxes, containers, storage spaces, and personal belongings. Add item lists to each label, generate a unique QR code, and scan it whenever you need to check what's inside.

No accounts. No subscriptions. No internet connection required for everyday use.

KEY FEATURES

Create QR Labels
Create unique QR labels for your boxes, containers, and other belongings.

Organize Your Items
Add multiple items to each label so you always know what's stored inside.

Scan and View Instantly
Scan a QR code to quickly retrieve its associated item list.

Edit Anytime
Update your labels and item lists whenever your storage needs change.

Print Your Labels
Print QR labels using AirPrint and attach them to your belongings.

Backup and Restore
Export your label data as a JSON backup and restore it whenever needed.

Privacy-Focused and Offline
Your labels and item data are stored locally on your device. No account registration is required.

STAY ORGANIZED

Whether you're organizing storage boxes, office supplies, household items, or personal belongings, Label It makes tracking what's inside simple.

Create it. Label it. Scan it.

---

Developed by Andromedevs.

name: LabelGrid
description:
Calculate how many rectangular labels fit on one sheet. Enter sheet and label dimensions, margins and spacing. Compare both orientations using a uniform grid.

Save results by name, reopen them to make changes, or share a summary through the system share sheet. Core calculations and saved records work offline.

name: Lagari LGS: 5–8. Sınıf
description:
Lagari LGS, 5, 6, 7 ve 8. sınıf öğrencileri için hazırlanmış bir ders çalışma uygulaması. 8. sınıftaysan LGS'ye hazırlanırsın; 5, 6 ya da 7. sınıftaysan okulda gördüğün dersleri pekiştirirsin. Roket yavrusu Lagi her gün yanında: ne çalışacağını gösterir, doğru cevabında seninle sevinir, takıldığında birlikte bakar.

DERSLER
• Matematik, Fen Bilimleri, Türkçe, İngilizce, Din Kültürü ve Ahlak Bilgisi
• 8. sınıfta T.C. İnkılap Tarihi ve Atatürkçülük, 5–7. sınıfta Sosyal Bilgiler
• 5–8. sınıf, toplam 168 ünite

HER ÜNİTEDE
• Konu özeti: madde madde ders notu, formüller, şekiller ve örnek çözümler
• 24 bilgi kartı: aralıklı tekrar, unutmak üzere olduğun bilgiyi geri getirir
• Testler ve uzman testleri: her sorunun adım adım çözümü var
• 3B laboratuvar: döndür, yakınlaştır, değişkenleri değiştir
• Kısa oyunlar: boş on dakikanda hızlı tekrar

SAYILARLA
• 20.600'den fazla soru
• 4.000'den fazla bilgi kartı
• 400 deneme
• 153 etkileşimli 3B laboratuvar
• 72 oyun

8. SINIF: LGS HAZIRLIĞI
• Tam LGS denemesi: Sözel (50 soru, 75 dakika) ve Sayısal (40 soru, 80 dakika) oturumları, gerçek sürelerle
• Branş denemeleri, Sayısal ve Sözel oturum denemeleri, ders ve soru sayısını senin seçtiğin karma denemeler
• Net, LGS kuralıyla hesaplanır: 3 yanlış 1 doğruyu götürür
• Ders ders net tahmini ve 500 puan üzerinden tahmini LGS puanı

5, 6 VE 7. SINIF
• Sınıfına göre üniteler, testler, branş ve karma denemeler
• Yanlış cevap doğruyu götürmez; sonucunu yüzde olarak görürsün

TEKRAR DEFTERİ
• Yanlış yaptığın sorular kendiliğinden deftere eklenir
• 1, 3, 7, 14 ve 30 gün sonra yeniden karşına çıkar; bildikçe bir sonraki istasyona geçer

İLERLEMEN
• Günlük hedef, Seri, Seri Kalkanı ve Yakıt
• Günlük çalışma süresi, doğruluk eğilimi ve zorlandığın konular
• Rozetler ve gezegen seviyeleri

SAKİN VE GÜVENLİ
• İnternetsiz çalışır, reklam yok
• Hesap açman gerekmez; çalışma verilerin cihazında kalır
• Yanlış cevaplar kırmızı çarpıyla değil, "tekrar" olarak gösterilir; can sistemi yok
• Denemelerde sakin mod: soluk renkler, efekt sesi yok
• Ekrana göre değişen sakin müzikler; istersen kapatırsın

ÜCRETSİZ VE PRO
Konu özetleri, bilgi kartları, oyunlar ve her ünitenin ilk testi ücretsizdir; her dersin ilk denemeleri ve ilk 3B laboratuvarları da açıktır. Lagari Pro ile tüm testler, uzman testleri, denemeler ve 3B laboratuvarlar açılır.
• Lagari Pro, yıllık ve otomatik yenilenen bir aboneliktir. İlk abonelikte 7 gün ücretsiz deneme sunulur.
• Ücret, satın almayı onayladığında mağaza hesabından alınır. Dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal etmezsen abonelik otomatik yenilenir. Deneme süresinde iptal edersen ücret alınmaz.
• Aboneliğini mağaza hesabının abonelik ayarlarından yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsin.

name: Lam Kieu Balicka
seller_name: A2D SOLUTIONS SP Z O O
description: Lam Kieu Bar Orientalny w Krakowie oferuje szeroki wybór dań kuchni wietnamskiej i tajskiej. Sprawdź nasze menu, w tym rybę słodko-kwaśną, makaron chiński z kurczakiem i warzywami oraz sajgonki z mięsem. Zamów na odbiór i śledź status swojego zamówienia. Zapłać online lub gotówką przy odbiorze.

name: Lamplight Relay
description:
A letter is waiting at the junction. Tap the brass switch to send it to the diner. Soon you’ll be watching two envelopes at once and working out which one needs the next turn.

Play 90 free delivery puzzles across First Post, Harbour Post and Night Lines. Three routes are open when you arrive. Keep delivering to open the next one, or come back for the day’s featured route. Earlier deliveries stay in your route book.

Each delivery earns a postmark for your album. Revisit a favorite route and try to earn gold in the fewest moves. If a junction has you stumped, tap Hint for your next move.

Take a free first trip through Night Market, Alpine Express or Grand Canal Atlas. Each district is available as a separate, one-time purchase.

name: Lanco Wash N Shine
description:
Welcome to Lanco Wash N Shine – your convenient way to keep your vehicle clean and shining.

The Lanco Wash N Shine app makes it easy to manage your car wash experience right from your phone.

• Wash Access – Conveniently access your wash services and manage your wash activity.

• Transaction History – Keep track of your previous wash transactions and account activity.

• Account Management – Manage your profile and account settings with ease.

• Convenient Experience – Access your car wash account anytime, directly from your mobile device.

Download the Lanco Wash N Shine app and enjoy a more convenient way to manage your car wash experience.

Thank you for choosing Lanco Wash N Shine!

name: Lapmi: Watch Interval Timer
description:
Lapmi is an interval tracker you drive from your watch.

Plan your workout order on your phone, start it on your watch, and tap once whenever a segment ends. Run 1 km, SkiErg 1000 m, sled push 50 m — Lapmi keeps the time of every exercise, separately.

■ Just your watch
• Leave your phone in the locker. Your watch records the whole session on its own and syncs later.
• Tapped by mistake? Undo instantly, or turn the crown to trim the segment you just finished.
• Heart rate is kept per segment as average and max (if you allow it).

■ Where to improve, before the charts
• Lapmi tells you in one sentence, like "You lose the most on Run 1 km."
• See a target time for your next session and your "potential best" built from your best segments.
• A fatigue curve shows which repeat you start slowing down on, and which station wrecks your next run.
• Compare every segment with your last session, your last-5 average, and your best.

■ Any workout as a routine
• Start right away with presets: Hybrid Race 8+8, Tabata, EMOM and more.
• Build blocks and rounds from 60+ exercises, or add your own.
• Set distance, reps, weight or time targets per segment.

■ With friends (optional)
• Sign in to cheer friends' sessions, see a weekly ranking, and compare the same routine.
• Share routines with a code.
• Without signing in, all records and stats stay on your device.

Recording segments requires an Apple Watch (watchOS 10 or later).

name: Lapworks
description: Build and test RC car setups for different virtual tracks. Adjust gearing, weight, tires, suspension, and center of gravity to change how the car behaves. Run virtual laps and observe acceleration, braking, grip, stability, and cornering performance. Analyze problem sections to understand which setup variables caused them. Compare configurations on the same track and measure the effect of every adjustment. Save experiments and return to previous setups to test alternative strategies. Find the tradeoffs that make each car configuration behave differently on each track.

name: Larut SleepCall
description:
Larut adalah layanan teman bicara lewat telepon suara: kamu memilih pendengar (talent), meneleponnya langsung dari aplikasi, dan membayar per menit dari saldo untuk waktu bicara langsung dengan orang sungguhan. Bukan aplikasi kencan, bukan cari jodoh — talent kami mendengarkan ceritamu sampai pikiranmu tenang, termasuk saat susah tidur.

• Pilih dari katalog: dengarkan contoh suaranya dulu, lihat rating dan ulasan.
• Tiga layanan: Sleep Call, Ngobrol Call, dan Curhat Call.
• Panggilan suara jernih di dalam aplikasi — nomor telepon tidak pernah bertukar.
• Pilih durasi sendiri; panggilan berakhir tepat di menit yang dipesan dan bisa diperpanjang tanpa terputus.
• Booking jam tertentu — pesan slot, talent menyetujui, kamu yang menelepon pada jamnya.
• Isi saldo lewat pembelian dalam aplikasi.
• Masuk dengan Apple atau Google.
• Privasi dua arah: identitas aslimu dan talent sama-sama dijaga.
• Moderasi aktif: laporkan percakapan yang tidak pantas, panggilan tertentu direkam untuk moderasi (dengan pemberitahuan), talent dan pengguna bisa saling blokir.

BATAS YANG JELAS
Larut adalah layanan mendengarkan dan teman ngobrol — bukan konsultasi psikologi, bukan layanan medis, dan bukan layanan kencan. Hanya untuk pengguna berusia 18 tahun ke atas. Jika kamu sedang menghadapi krisis kesehatan mental, hubungi tenaga profesional atau layanan darurat.

Kebijakan Privasi: https://ugcindonesia.com/privasi.php

name: LB Zone: Local Egyptian Brands
description:
LB Zone brings Egypt's homegrown brands together in one app. Discover local fashion, shoes, caps and perfumes, follow the brands you love, and order with cash on delivery.

WHY LB ZONE
• Local brands only: every piece comes from an Egyptian brand.
• Cash on delivery: no cards, no online payment. You pay when your order arrives.
• Real deals: discounts, bundles like "Buy 2, get 1 free" and free delivery, applied in your cart automatically.
• Track every order: from confirmed to packed, shipped and delivered.

DISCOVER
• Browse by category: clothing, shoes, caps, perfumes and more.
• Filter by men or women, and sort by popular, newest, top rated or price.
• Search brands and products in Arabic or English.
• See trending pieces and the latest special offers on the home page.

FOLLOW YOUR FAVOURITE BRANDS
• Every brand has its own page with its full collection, story and reviews.
• Follow a brand to hear about its new pieces and offers first.

SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE
• Clear photos, colours, sizes and a size guide on every product.
• Ratings and reviews from customers who received their order.
• Save pieces to your wishlist and come back later.
• Cancel before the brand packs your order, and request a return within 14 days of delivery.

MADE FOR YOU
• Full Arabic and English support.
• Light and dark mode.
• Order updates by notification.
• Sign in with email, Google or Apple.
• Help from our team and the brand, inside the app.

Are you a local brand? Apply to sell on LB Zone at lbzoneeg.com.

Questions? Email lbzone.eg@gmail.com.

name: Learn Salah: Adults & Kids
description:
Learn the Muslim prayer as a family, one clear step at a time.

Learn Salah teaches the Sunni prayer in the four schools: Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki and Hanbali. Choose your family's school once, and every step follows it. Not sure? See the common way, with notes where the schools differ. Men's and women's postures are shown for each person.

FOR GROWN-UPS
- A learn path, step by step: a clear picture, what to do, and what to say in Arabic, with transliteration and meaning.
- Listen to every word, with the Quran recited by Sheikh Muhammad Ayyoub. Aloud or silent, and how many times.
- Spoken instructions in English and Arabic.
- Pray-along: pick a prayer and the app leads each step, counting the rak'ahs. Slow, normal, or tap to move on. Practise with the app, then pray without it.
- Memorise Al-Fatiha, short surahs, the tashahhud and the salawat, with repeat and a transliteration switch.
- A daily review of a few minutes that brings back what you have learned.
- Praying together: where each person stands, and who leads.

FOR CHILDREN
- Kids' mode, with a cartoon boy or girl, big buttons and short sentences.
- Copy me, What comes next? and Listen and say.
- A sticker chart for the five daily prayers, ticked when a grown-up confirms.
- A certificate when the path is done.
- No ads, no purchases, no links inside kids' mode. A grown-up's check guards the way out.

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
- Up to six people on one phone, each with their own progress.
- English and Arabic.
- Works offline. No accounts.

Free: wudu, how a prayer is built, the lessons of all five daily prayers and the Fajr pray-along. The family plan opens a pray-along for every prayer, memorising, the daily review, kids' practice, the sticker chart, the certificate, extra profiles and the lessons beyond the five (Witr, the adhkar after prayer, Jumu'ah, sujud al-sahw and praying together), for everyone in the family, and Family Sharing shares it with your family's own devices.

Family plan: $3.99 a month or $29.99 a year in the US (prices vary by country). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.kiducate.eu/learn-salah/privacy/

Every step names its source. The Arabic of the Quran is the Tanzil Quran Text (tanzil.net), and its English meanings are Saheeh International's, from QuranEnc.com.

name: LeasingBoard
description:
LeasingBoard turns every property in your portfolio into a presentation. On iPad, you present a property across the table, one full-screen section at a time. On iPhone, the same sections in the same order make one page, for looking things up between meetings. Everything comes straight from your company’s LeasingBoard, so there’s nothing to sync and nothing goes out of date.

PRESENT
• Full-screen sections in your company’s order and look: its logo, fonts and colors.
• The bars slide away while you talk, and the screen stays on.
• Photo galleries, key facts, the leasing team, retailers and the tenant mix.
• Aerial tours and videos play straight away, with nothing to download.

LEASE
• Site plans that show what’s available now and what’s coming available in 3, 6 or 12 months.
• Tap a space for its size, details, plans and photos, then step through the rest.
• Filter spaces by when they’re available, their size and their use or type. The plan shows only what fits.
• Office buildings floor by floor, suite by suite.

KNOW THE AREA
• Maps with radius rings and the demographics within each ring.
• Nearby schools, employers, hotels and shops, and a search for any place around the property.
• The driving distance and time from the property to anything nearby.

SHARE
• Send prospects a link to a page of the properties, spaces and documents you pick, protected by a password. They can download it as a PDF.
• See when your links are opened, extend them, or turn one off at any time.
• Every document as a large thumbnail that opens full screen.

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Search your whole portfolio by name, city, tenant or leasing agent, as cards, a list or a map.
• Keep properties and spaces in saved lists, one per client or tour.
• Save a property to the device, with its photos, plans and documents, for places without Wi-Fi.
• Confidential documents stay hidden until you unlock the app with your password.
• In English, and in Spanish for companies that use it.

LeasingBoard is for the leasing teams of companies that use REOL’s LeasingBoard. Sign in with the account your company gives you. To see LeasingBoard with your own properties, or for a demo, contact REOL at leasingboard.com.

name: Leitstelle Wien – U-Bahn-Spiel
description:
Wien wächst – und du sitzt in der Leitstelle.

Bau Wiens U-Bahn in der echten Stadt: Stationen setzen, Gleise legen, Linien mit dem Finger ziehen und Züge losschicken. Dann zeigt sich, ob dein Netz hält. Zur Stoßzeit drängen sich die Leute am Bahnsteig, Züge fallen aus, ein Gleis wird gesperrt, und das Budget will auch noch stimmen.

ECHTES WIEN
98 echte Stationsorte, dazu Gebäude, Straßen und Hügel aus offenen Daten. Die Nachfrage kommt aus echten Wohn- und Arbeitsorten: Wo viele wohnen und arbeiten, wollen viele fahren.

DREI ARTEN ZU SPIELEN
• Echtes Wien: Starte mit einer kleinen Innenstadtlinie und bau das Netz Station für Station aus.
• Dein Wien: Fang bei null an und bau deine eigene U-Bahn.
• Kampagnen: Ringschluss, Über die Donau und Sanierungsjahr – Aufträge mit klaren Zielen.

DIE LEITSTELLE
• Die Nachfragekarte zeigt, wohin Wien will.
• Die Bahnsteige zeigen, wo die Leute warten und wo sie aufgeben.
• „Nächster Schritt“ zeigt das dringendste Problem, mit einem Knopf, der es behebt.
• Störungen, Stadtereignisse, Tagesberichte und eine Karriere vom Praktikum bis zur Betriebsdirektion.
• Der Wiener Ticker kommentiert dein Netz – mit dem nötigen Grant.
• Ein leiser Wiener Walzer begleitet den Betrieb und wird nachts ruhiger.

OHNE ALLES
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking, kein Internet. Dein Spielstand bleibt auf deinem iPhone.

Ein inoffizielles Fan-Spiel. Nicht verbunden mit den Wiener Linien oder der Stadt Wien. Karten © OpenStreetMap-Mitwirkende (ODbL). Daten: Stadt Wien – data.wien.gv.at und data.gv.at (CC BY 4.0).

name: Leo Contigo: leer y escribir
description:
Leo Contigo helps children learn to read and write in Spanish with cards, step by step. It is designed especially for autistic children and to be used with an adult beside them. The app is in Spanish.

READ
• Three levels: one word (“gato”), two words (“gato blanco”) and three words (“el gato blanco”).
• 400 words in 10 stages, from easiest to hardest. Add your own words too: the child’s name, favourite topics…
• The adult taps “read” or “again”. A mistake is never shown as an error: the word is said aloud and comes back soon.
• Four letter styles: lowercase, UPPERCASE, joined-up and gothic.

WRITE
• Dictation: the app says a word or phrase and the child writes it with a finger or Apple Pencil. The app checks it and the adult can correct it.

MOTIVATION AND PROGRESS
• Rewards for completing each stage.
• Reading and writing speed, practice days and time, monthly tables.
• PDF report and CSV data to share with anyone you choose.

PRIVACY
No accounts, no ads, no analytics and no internet. Everything stays on the device.

name: Lexichain: Word Chain Puzzle
description:
Lexichain is a word game with one rule: Every word must link to the last.

Trace a word across the letter grid, then reuse at least one of its tiles in your next word. Every play sets up, or ruins, the one after it. Plan ahead, keep the chain alive, and chase the highest score.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag or tap through neighboring letters to spell a word of three letters or more.
• Your next word has to share a tile with the one before.
• Special tiles change the board as you go: wilds, multipliers, bombs, stone blocks, and more.
• Reach the Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum score targets.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• The Daily Challenge gives everyone the same board and ten moves.
• Daily 5×5 offers a bigger board with the same ten moves.
• Afterwards, see the words you missed and tap any of them for its meaning.
• Share your result as a card that hides the letters, so nothing is spoiled.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: the original, with no clock and no pressure.
• Time Attack: chain as many words as you can in 60 seconds.
• Zen: relaxed play with hints and undo.
• Survival: fight through waves and bosses, build combos, and protect your lives.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Board skins that restyle the tiles, the frame, and the whole screen.
• A trophy case with 23 trophies to earn.
• Personal bests for every mode.
• Light and dark themes that follow your device.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE
• Color-vision modes and a high-contrast mode.
• Tiles are told apart by shape as well as color.
• Reduced-motion support.

NO ADS, NO PURCHASES
Lexichain has no ads and no in-app purchases. You can play every mode without an account. Create one only if you want to appear on leaderboards and keep your results across devices, and delete it whenever you like from My Account.

name: LIA ai
description:
Meet LIA Mobile, your intelligent AI-powered business assistant, designed exclusively for Leapsurge customers.

Experience a smarter way to access business information, get instant answers, and simplify your everyday business interactions. With LIA, you can communicate naturally through an intuitive chat interface and receive intelligent, relevant responses whenever you need assistance.

Whether you're looking for business insights, quick information, or support with your business-related queries, LIA makes accessing information easier and faster.

Built to enhance productivity and improve the customer experience, LIA brings the power of conversational AI directly to your mobile device.

Smarter conversations. Faster answers. Better business experiences.

Download LIA Mobile and discover a smarter way to connect with Leapsurge.

name: Librodoro – Corfu
description:
Libro d'Oro (librodoro.gr) is the city portal of Corfu (Kerkyra), all in one app.

What's on tonight in Corfu? Libro d'Oro shows you every event in town and around the island, lets you listen live to EXTRA 95.8 and gives you the useful local info you need, all in one place.

WHAT'S ON TONIGHT
• All of today's events at a glance: concerts, theatre, cinema, exhibitions, parties, food and nights out.
• Day-by-day agenda for the coming weeks.
• Categories: Food & Drink, Concerts, Cinema & Theatre, Arts & More.
• Every event has its own page with time, venue, map and "Take me there" directions.
• Event venues and picks from the Libro d'Oro team.

EXTRA 95.8 LIVE
• Listen to EXTRA 95.8 inside the app, with the song that's playing now.

FAVOURITES & NEAR ME
• Save the events and picks you like in "Favourites".
• "Near me tonight": tonight's events on a map, with the distance from you or from the Liston.

CORFU & USEFUL INFO
• Weather, pharmacies, buses (KTEL), airport and useful information about the town and the island.
• KIIS2WIN: contests with prizes.

CORFU BUSINESS GUIDE
• The Corfu business directory: businesses and services by category across the island, with phone numbers, map, social links and a contact form.

AND MORE
• Greek and English.
• No account, no sign-up.

Libro d'Oro – librodoro.gr. Corfu, every day, on your phone.

name: LicenseCoach
description:
LicenseCoach is two apps in one: a California real estate study coach while you work toward your salesperson license, and an on-device business toolkit once you're out in the field. Listen, practice, run the numbers, rehearse the conversation, and keep your day on track from your iPhone or iPad.

LEARN BY LISTENING
• 60 recorded lessons narrated by Ava, with synced on-screen transcripts you can follow along with
• Lessons, audio, and transcripts are free, with no account needed

PRACTICE AND REVIEW
• More than 1,200 original practice questions on California and national topics, including scenario and math items
• A California mock exam built to the salesperson blueprint: 150 questions, 3 hours, 70% to pass, with flag and review
• 500+ vocabulary flashcards with spaced review
• Drag-and-drop matching sets, an adaptive quiz, and a timed lightning round
• A study plan, daily goal, reminders, and a streak that counts any day you study

RUN YOUR BUSINESS WITH THE AGENT TOOLKIT
• Today: daily goals, follow-ups due, and upcoming closings at a glance
• Pipeline and deal tracking, with documents, contacts, and reminders
• Calculators: closing estimator, commission, seller net sheet, CMA, cash to close, payment, and affordability
• Coaching: role-play practice with record-and-compare, plus scripts and listing and buyer checklists
• Showings and an open-house sign-in kiosk, with a passcode to exit guest mode
• A digital business card with photo, logo, vCard, and QR code

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. There is no LicenseCoach server. Study progress, reminders, deal notes, recordings, and open-house leads stay on your iPhone or iPad. You can optionally lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode; that authentication stays on the device and is never collected. The App Store privacy label is Data Not Collected.

WHAT IS FREE, AND WHAT IS PAID
The download is free, and all lessons, recorded audio, and transcripts are included.

Exam Pass is a $34.99 one-time, non-renewing In-App Purchase. It unlocks practice questions, mock exams, flashcards, and the other study modes for 90 days.

Agent Pro is an auto-renewing subscription at $9.99 per month or $59.99 per year. Each plan includes a one-week (7-day) free trial for eligible new subscribers. Agent Pro unlocks the Agent Toolkit and all study modes.

IMPORTANT
California is the study state available in this version. LicenseCoach is not a state-approved pre-licensing course and does not award course hours or credit. It is not affiliated with, approved by, or endorsed by the California Department of Real Estate (DRE), Pearson VUE, PSI, or any other real estate commission, department, or testing vendor. Practice items and audio lessons are original study content, not official exam questions. LicenseCoach does not promise that you will pass the exam.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel a subscription in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/licensecoach-privacy

name: LiDARPlans
description:
Scan a home with an iPhone or iPad Pro and get, in minutes, everything you need to prepare building work: a dimensioned floor plan, room-by-room quantities and a staircase design.

SCAN A WHOLE FLOOR
• Walk through the rooms: walls, doors, windows and furniture are measured with the LiDAR sensor.
• Rooms are recognised and named automatically (living room, bedroom, bathroom, balcony…).
• See the home in 3D and fix the plan with a finger: walls, openings, furniture, railings.

AN ARCHITECT'S PLAN, DIMENSIONED IN MILLIMETRES
• Plan to scale at 1:50, 1:100 or 1:200, on A4 or A3, as a PDF.
• Running dimensions along every façade, the length of every wall, door and window sizes with sill heights, and the area and ceiling height of every room.
• Correct a length with your laser measure: the wall stretches as in CAD and the measured dimension shows in green.
• DXF export for AutoCAD, ArchiCAD and other drawing software.

QUANTITIES FOR EVERY ROOM
• Floor area, flooring to buy with an allowance for cuts, skirting, walls to paint less the openings, ceiling and litres of paint.
• Add your unit prices to cost the materials.
• CSV export for your spreadsheet.

DESIGN THE STAIRCASE
• Straight, L-shaped, U-shaped, winder or spiral, worked out from the measured height.
• Checked against the rules of your country (UK, US, France): riser, going, headroom, guarding…
• Timber stringers or steel beams, tread thickness, floor finishes still to lay.
• See it at full scale in augmented reality, with the steps traced on the wall.
• Fabrication sheet as a PDF: setting-out table, parts list, cuts.

A FILE TO SEND
• The whole project in one PDF: quantities, dimensioned plans and staircase sheets.
• Notes pinned on the plan ("move this socket", "crack").
• Back up or send the whole project as one file that opens on another iPhone or iPad.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no server: scans, plans and photos stay on your device and only leave it when you share them.

LIDARPLANS PRO
Scanning, plans, 3D, editing, the staircase calculator and AR are free. LiDARPlans Pro adds dimensioned plans, quantities and costing, the project file, the staircase fabrication sheet and the PDF, DXF, USDZ and JSON exports. Monthly subscription with a one-week free trial, or a one-time purchase. Everything is unlocked on the sample project, so you can try it first.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically each month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://nextstarsystems.com/lidarplans/privacy/

Scanning needs an iPhone or iPad with a LiDAR sensor (Pro models). Dimensions come from the scan and are accurate to about 2 cm: check them on site before making anything. Staircase checks are guidance taken from professional guides and do not replace a professional's advice.

name: Life in the UK: Practice
description:
Prepare for the Life in the UK Test with Life in the UK: Practice — an independent study companion designed to support your journey towards British citizenship or settlement in the United Kingdom.

Practise questions, explore study topics, take timed mock tests and track your learning progress, all in one easy-to-use app.

KEY FEATURES

• Practice Questions
Test your knowledge with multiple-choice questions, instant feedback and answer explanations.

• Timed Mock Tests
Challenge yourself with 24 questions and a 45-minute countdown.

• Study by Topic
Explore eight study categories covering British history, geography, government, culture, traditions and everyday life.

• Review Missed Questions
Revisit incorrectly answered questions and focus on areas where you need more practice.

• Progress & Statistics
Track your correct and incorrect answers, completed mock tests and best scores.

• Offline Learning
Study anytime, anywhere, without an internet connection.

• Simple and Accessible Design
Enjoy a clean, intuitive interface designed for a comfortable learning experience.

• No Account Required
Start practising immediately. Your learning progress is stored locally on your device.

WHO IS THIS APP FOR?

- British citizenship applicants
- Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR) applicants
- Anyone preparing for the Life in the UK Test
- Anyone interested in learning about British history, culture and society

Prepare. Practise.

name: Life Pilot: Focus & Habits
description:
Life Pilot shows every part of your life as a health bar, so one glance tells you what needs you this week.

Pick the areas you care about: Study, Work, Family, Myself. Add the things you actually do in each one. Then just show up. Each bar fades a little every day you leave it alone, and logging brings it back.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pillars are the areas of your life. Each one has a single health bar.
• Projects are what you do inside a pillar: deep work, a workout, calling your parents.
• Track a project with a focus timer, or with a one-tap check-in.
• Targets are weekly. Miss a day and nothing breaks; make it up on another.

FOCUS TIMER
• Stopwatch or Pomodoro sprints.
• The timer keeps running on your lock screen and survives closing the app.
• Take a five-minute break between sprints. Rest is never counted as work.

BUILT TO BE FORGIVING
• No streaks to lose. A bad week lowers a bar; a good day raises it again.
• You decide where "healthy" and "needs attention" begin for each pillar.
• Undo any check-in within five seconds.

name: Lighter – Swipe Photo Cleaner
description:
Lighter clears your camera roll the quick way: swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep.

ONE GESTURE
Pick an album and swipe through your photos one at a time. Left marks a photo for deletion, right keeps it. Prefer buttons? Delete, Undo and Keep are always on screen. Undo takes you back, as far as the first photo. You can also open a grid and select many photos at once.

CHECK BEFORE ANYTHING GOES
Nothing is deleted while you swipe. Review shows every photo you marked, and you can tap one to unmark it. Then iOS asks you once to confirm. Deleted photos stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days, so you can still change your mind.

SEE WHAT YOU CLEARED
When you finish, Lighter shows how much space you cleared and how many photos you reviewed, kept and deleted. Settings keeps a running total.

ALL YOUR ALBUMS
All Photos, Screenshots, Videos, Selfies, Favourites and your own albums, each with a cover and a count. Videos play with sound, and iCloud photos can be kept or deleted too.

CALM BY DESIGN
A quiet glass look in Light and Dark, with a serif wordmark and no alarms about your phone being full. Works with Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion and Reduce Transparency.

PRIVATE
Your photos never leave your iPhone. No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.

FREE, OR PAID ONCE
Swiping, keeping and reviewing are always unlimited. The free plan deletes up to 50 photos a day. Lighter Pro is a single one-time purchase that removes that daily limit. No subscription. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

Deleted photos stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days, so the space comes back when that album is emptied.

name: LINDE: Puzle de lógica
description:
LINDE convierte cada frontera en una pregunta de lógica. Coloca una pieza en cada fila, columna y región, sabiendo que dos piezas nunca pueden tocarse. En la variante Enlaces, cada pareja señalada debe contener exactamente una pieza.

La descarga incluye 20 niveles de campaña y el reto diario. Una única compra desbloquea los otros 80 niveles de campaña. No hay suscripciones.

name: Lindsome
description:
Lindsome is a feed of short, narrated true stories about how things came to be: the inventions, mistakes, experiments and odd decisions behind everyday life.

Each story runs three to four minutes. Swipe to the next one when you are done.

What is inside
- More than 180 stories in four categories: Work & business, Mind & body, Science & tech, and History & words. New stories are added without an app update.
- Every story lists its sources, with links, so you can check it yourself.
- Every story ends with three practical takeaways.
- Captions on every scene, and a speed control.
- Pick a category on the first card to see only the stories you care about.
- The eight free stories are stored in the app and play without a connection. The others are loaded over the internet when you open them.

How it is made
The illustrations and the narration voice are AI-generated. The scripts are written from published sources, which are listed with each story.

Membership
Eight stories are free. A Lindsome Membership unlocks every story in the app.
- Lindsome Membership: $4.99 per month (US price; other regions vary).
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription renews automatically each month until it is cancelled.
- Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

LinkCharge

name: LinksHQ
description:
LinksHQ finds indoor golf near you: simulator bays, sim lounges and practice studios across the US, with 4,000+ venues listed.

FIND A BAY
• Search near you or by city, state or venue name
• See hours, simulator brand, number of bays, amenities and leagues
• Tap Book to go straight to the venue's own booking page

LIVE OPEN TIMES
At venues that connect their booking system, LinksHQ shows today's open bay times so you can see what's free before you call.

OPEN-BAY ALERTS
Pick a venue and the days and times you want to play. When a bay opens in that window, we tell you, with a link to book it on the venue's site.
• Free: 1 alert by email
• LinksHQ Pro: up to 10 alerts, plus phone notifications

LinksHQ never takes bookings or payments. You always book with the venue directly. No ads, and we don't sell your data.

LINKSHQ PRO
LinksHQ Pro is an optional yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm (or when the trial ends) and renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the period ends in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

name: Litedesk
description:
Litedesk — бесплатная тикет-система (help desk) для поддержки клиентов. Обращения из Telegram-бота, бота MAX, почты, формы на сайте, API и кабинета вашего сервиса собираются в одном месте, а сотрудники отвечают клиентам прямо из приложения. Аккаунт тот же, что в кабинете на litedesk.ru.

Обращения
• Список обращений с фильтрами: в работе или закрытые, назначенные на вас или без назначения, по каналу (Telegram, MAX, почта, форма, API), и поиск по номеру, имени, адресу или теме
• Переписка с клиентом: видно, откуда пришло сообщение, и какие ответы отправлены через API или ИИ-ассистента (MCP)
• Ответ текстом и файлами: снимок с камеры, фото из галереи или любой файл
• Вложения клиентов: картинки открываются в приложении, файлы можно сохранить или переслать
• Статус обращения, назначение на себя или коллегу, удаление обращения владельцем проекта

Проекты и команда
• Все ваши проекты со счётчиками обращений
• Лимиты бесплатного тарифа: хранилище и отправленные за сутки ответы
• Участники проекта и приглашения: принять или отклонить приглашение в проект

Уведомления
• Push о новом обращении, новом сообщении клиента, назначении на вас, ответе поддержки Litedesk и приглашении в проект
• Каждый вид уведомлений включается и выключается в профиле

Поддержка Litedesk
• Вопрос о сервисе можно задать в разделе «Поддержка»: обращение, переписка и файлы

Удобно и безопасно
• Вход и регистрация одной формой, без пароля: код из письма
• Блокировка приложения Face ID, Touch ID или кодом-паролем
• Светлая и тёмная тема — по настройке телефона; раскладка для планшетов
• «Выйти на всех устройствах» и удаление аккаунта прямо в приложении

Бесплатно, с лимитами на проект
Платных тарифов нет. У каждого проекта — хранилище файлов 1 ГБ и до 100 ответов клиентам в сутки (сброс в 00:00 по Москве), до 5 своих проектов на аккаунт. Число сотрудников, каналов и входящих обращений не ограничено.

Подключение каналов (Telegram, MAX, почта IMAP/SMTP, форма, API), вебхуки и API-ключи настраиваются в кабинете на litedesk.ru — из приложения он открывается в браузере.

Нужны iOS 15 или новее и подключение к интернету.

name: Little Dings: Routine Alarms
description:
Fewer battles, more "yay!". Little Dings turns everyday changes into a friendly moment.

Pick an alarm: Potty time, Brush teeth, Bath time, Bedtime and 12 more. Each one has its own little friend and tune. Your child taps the big Stop button, and a golden star pops with confetti.

SET IT AND FORGET IT
Reminders nudge you at the right time. Tap the notification and the right alarm opens, ready to ring. Repeat every day, on weekdays or on chosen days, or every couple of hours (great for potty training).

MAKE YOUR OWN
Shoes on? Teeth again? Make your own alarm in any color, with its own sound.

MADE FOR LITTLE HANDS AND BUSY GROWN-UPS
• Plays even with the Silent switch on, once the app is open
• Starts gently and fades up, never blasts
• Dark mode by default, light mode if you prefer
• No account, no ads, no tracking

SUBSCRIPTION
Try every alarm free for 7 days, then a yearly subscription. Cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions, at least 24 hours before the trial ends. Works for your whole family with Family Sharing.

name: LittlePetling
description:
Meet Biscuit, a Labrador puppy filmed for real, who lives on your phone, tablet and laptop.

He comes when you call, asks for his dinner, naps when he is tired and sulks a little if he is ignored. Feed him, give him water, play with him, and ask for his tricks: sit, lie down, paw the screen, speak, turn round and more. Say his name and a word he knows, and he listens.

• He learns your routine, such as when you usually feed him

Liveclip is simple: add yourself or your favorite streamer, and it does the rest.

Add your own channel or any streamer on Twitch, Kick or YouTube Live. Liveclip watches every stream while it's live, finds the most viral moments, like a clutch play, a funny moment or a huge reaction, edits them into vertical clips with captions, and posts them automatically to your TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.

• Add a source: add your own channel, follow a live streamer, paste a video link, or upload a video from Photos or Files.

GTA 6, Fortnite, Apex Legends, Call of Duty (Warzone, Modern Warfare 4 and Black Ops 7) and Rocket League, with more on the way.

Start free.

name: Long Screenshot to PDF
description:
Turn one long screenshot into a multi-page PDF you can actually read.

A long screenshot squeezed onto a single page turns into tiny, unreadable text. Long Screenshot to PDF keeps the image at a readable width and spreads it across as many US Letter or A4 pages as it needs, at the same scale on every page.

ONE LONG SCREENSHOT. READABLE PAGES.
• Choose one PNG, JPEG or HEIC image from Photos or Files
• The image fills the page width inside 0.5-inch margins, proportions kept
• Every page uses the same scale; no page is shrunk to squeeze in more
• Every part of the image appears exactly once, in order, nothing cropped
• A short image simply becomes one page

ADJUST WHERE PAGES BREAK
• See the whole image as one strip with a purple line at every page break
• Drag a break, or nudge it up or down, to place it above or below a line of text
• Moving a break earlier leaves white space at the bottom of that page and the following pages adjust
• Breaks can't be placed where a page would have to shrink; the app tells you how far a break can go
• Optional repeated context: repeat up to 5% of a page at the top of the next page
• Breaks are placed at full pages automatically and don't read the text, so check them before you export

SAVE A PRINTABLE PDF
• Tap Create PDF and preview the real pages before exporting
• See the page count and file size
• Save PDF to Files, or Share PDF to Mail, Messages, AirDrop or Print
• Optional small page numbers in the bottom margin, outside the image

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Uses the system photo picker or Files: no photo-library, camera or screen-recording permission
• Everything is processed on your iPhone; there's no account or server
• Your original image is never changed
• The PDF doesn't include the file name, location or camera details
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics

Limits: up to 100 pages per PDF and up to 50 megapixels per image. Larger images are explained, never cut off silently.

Selecting and previewing are always free, and your first export is free. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports. It isn't a subscription and never renews. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

name: Long Table: Family Cookbook
description:
Long Table keeps your family's recipes together, from the handwritten cards in the kitchen drawer to the video you saved last night.

GET RECIPES IN FAST
- Take a photo of a recipe card or cookbook page and Long Table reads it for you, handwriting included.
- Add a whole stack of pages at once.
- Paste a link from a recipe website, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or YouTube.
- Or type one in yourself.

COOK FROM IT
- Cook mode shows one step at a time in large type, with timers built in.

- Recipes you have opened are there even with no signal.

SHARE WITH FAMILY
- Invite family to a cookbook with a link or a short code.
- Everyone can add recipes, leave notes and post a photo when they make something.
- The original card is kept beside the recipe, so Mom's handwriting is never lost.

PLAN THE WEEK
- Plan meals on a simple weekly calendar.
- Send ingredients to a grocery list that groups itself and remembers what is already in your pantry.
- Save favorites and build your own collections.

Long Table is free. Your cookbooks are private to you and the people you invite.

name: Loop Bookings: Appointments
description:
Online booking for your business.

name: Lost Legend Tapes
description:
History, but make it a detective case.

Lost Legend Tapes is a fast history trivia game narrated by George, with a twist: Glitch in Time. Every scene from the past hides 5 objects that could not exist yet. A shopping cart in ancient Rome? A guitar pick in a 1700 violin workshop? Find them before you run out of misses.

• 110 tapes across 6 eras, from the First Empires to 1969: 5-question quizzes, Glitch in Time scenes and bosses against the clock
• An evidence board for every era: each tape you clear pins a clue. Collect them all, then catch the era's Most Wanted in 60 seconds
• Raid his stash: after every catch, sort the stolen relics back into their cases and fill your Museum
• A free Daily every day: the same quiz, Glitch scene and heist for everyone, plus a streak to keep
• Learn something every round: each answer comes with a short, true fact

New tapes and fixes arrive without app updates.

name: Loutsa PRO

Loutsa PRO est l'application de commande des clients professionnels de Loutsa Torréfacteur : hôtels, restaurants, coffee-shops, bureaux, revendeurs.

Votre catalogue, à vos tarifs. Retrouvez les cafés, capsules, thés, chocolats, machines et accessoires que Loutsa vous propose, au prix négocié de votre entreprise, affiché hors taxe avec la TVA réelle de chaque produit.

name: Love, Dad
description:
Love, Dad is a private place where dads keep their child's childhood, in their own words, and hand it over when they turn 18.

ONE QUESTION A WEEK
Every week there's a new question about your child. Two minutes is enough: write an answer, record a voice note or film a short video.

LETTERS FOR THE MOMENTS THAT MATTER
Write "open when" letters for the hard days and the big ones. You choose when each one opens: on a birthday, on a date you pick, when the moment's right, or at 18. Birthday letters wait for 18, so they open one from every year at once.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
Memories, firsts, the funny things they say, photos, videos and voice notes, sorted by age, so nothing gets lost in your camera roll.

HEAR THEM GROW UP
Ask the same birthday questions every year and play their answers back, year by year, side by side.

THEIRS AT 18
On their 18th birthday, everything you kept is handed over as a keepsake they own forever. It opens on any computer, with no app or account needed.

FAMILY CAN HELP
Invite their mum, grandparents and others to add memories and photos for the children you choose. Your weekly answers and letters stay private to you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Only you and the people you invite can see what you keep. We never sell your information, never show adverts and never use what you keep to train AI. Download everything as a keepsake whenever you like.

SUBSCRIPTION
Start with a 30-day free trial, no card needed. After that, keep adding for £49 a year or £5.99 a month (or the same in your local currency). If you stop, everything stays safe for you to see and download.

Payment is taken from your Apple ID when you subscribe. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your iPhone's Settings: tap your name, then Subscriptions.

name: Lovely Thoughts
description:
Lovely Thoughts is a quiet place to keep the good things in your life, big and small.

Got out of bed on a hard morning? Finished something you'd been putting off? A stranger said something kind? Save it in a few seconds, and it's there when you need a reminder of how much good there really is.

SIX KINDS OF GOOD
• Successes: big or small. Mark a big one and watch the gold stars.
• Miracles: the little surprises and lucky moments.
• Good things: anything that made the day better.
• Happy thoughts: something that made you smile.
• Kind words: what someone said to you, and who said it.
• I learned: something new you want to remember.

LIFT ME UP
On a day you need it, tap Lift me up to see your favourites and kind words one at a time, full screen.

LOOK BACK
A calendar shows a dot for each kind of good thing you saved, plus the month's totals and big successes.

PHOTOS
Add a photo to any entry. You choose each one with your phone's photo picker, so the app never sees the rest of your library.

A GENTLE DAILY REMINDER
Pick a time and Lovely Thoughts will nudge you, only on days you haven't added anything yet.

SEARCH AND FAVOURITES
Find any entry by a word or a name, and heart the ones you want to come back to.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or sign-up
• No ads, analytics or tracking
• Everything stays on your device
• Back up your entries and photos to a file whenever you like

Questions or ideas? Email info@bluedanubestudio.com.

Lovely Thoughts is made by Blue Danube Studio.

name: Lucid Dream Journal - Reonir
description:
Reonir is a dream journal and a lucid dreaming trainer in one. Write your dream down in the morning before it fades, and spend the evening getting ready for the night you realize you're dreaming.

DREAM JOURNAL
• Two quick steps: the story first, then mood, vividness and whether the dream was lucid.
• Tags, favorites and full-text search across every dream.
• A wall of dreams with filters and a view of your last 30 nights.

LUCID DREAMING
• MILD, WBTB, SSILD, WILD and FILD step by step, with what the research says about each.
• Reality checks with daytime reminders, classic or your own.
• Tonight's intention: an evening ritual with an affirmation you choose or write yourself.

A CALM EVENING
• Guided breathing with light, sound and haptics: 4-7-8, extended exhale, box breathing and more.
• Relaxing sounds for falling asleep: rain, waves, stream, forest, campfire, and pink and brown noise.
• Dream guides: what lucid dreaming is, staying safe, sleep paralysis.

PRIVACY

• Lock your dreams with Face ID or a code.

REONIR PRO

name: Ludo: Party with Friends
description:
The classic board game, now on your iPhone and more fun than ever!

PLAY ONLINE WITH FRIENDS

Who will make it home first? Roll the dice and find out!

name: LullaTap: Baby Sleep Sounds
description:
Bring familiar sounds into your baby's bedtime routine with LullaTap. Record a voice, choose a gentle nature sound, and start playback when you need it.

• Record your voice or import audio, and keep it on your device.
• Download nature sounds and white noise to listen offline.
• Set a 15, 30 or 60-minute timer, with optional fade in and fade out.
• Continue listening with your screen locked or use the playback controls on supported devices.
• Add LullaTap controls to Control Center, the Lock Screen or the Action button on compatible iPhones.

Start free with 12 sounds, up to three personal sounds and one sound at a time. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks all 40 current nature and white noise tracks, more personal sounds and mixing up to three tracks. No subscription.
