LullaTap is a comfort tool and does not replace a caregiver. Keep the device outside the cot, avoid headphones for your baby, and check the actual volume.

name: LumaCam
description:
LumaCam transforme votre iPhone en caméra 4K à faible latence pour OBS Studio, et en webcam pour vos visios grâce à l’app LumaCam pour Mac (Zoom, Teams, Meet, FaceTime…).

SE CONNECTER EN UN INSTANT
• Branchez l’iPhone en USB : aucun réglage.
• Sans fil : tapez une seule fois dans OBS le code à 4 chiffres affiché dans l’app, sur le même Wi-Fi ou avec le partage de connexion de l’iPhone.
• Ensuite, OBS retrouve votre iPhone tout seul.

UNE IMAGE DE QUALITÉ
• Jusqu’en 4K et 60 images par seconde, en HEVC ou H.264.
• Objectifs 0,5×, 1×, téléobjectif et caméra avant.
• Styles de prise de vue : Naturel, Cinéma (flou de mouvement à 180°), Faible lumière, Action.
• Rendus couleur Vif, Chaud, Froid, Cinéma et Noir et blanc, appliqués par la carte graphique de l’ordinateur.
• Pincez pour zoomer, touchez pour faire la mise au point.

TOUT SE RÈGLE DEPUIS OBS
Zoom, mise au point, exposition, ISO, vitesse d’obturation, balance des blancs et lampe se règlent directement dans la source OBS.

PENSÉ POUR LES LONGS DIRECTS
• Mode studio : pendant le direct, l’écran se met en veille pour garder l’iPhone au frais.
• La qualité s’adapte automatiquement si le téléphone chauffe.

PRIVÉ PAR CONCEPTION
La vidéo va directement de votre iPhone à votre ordinateur, sans passer par Internet. Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucune donnée collectée.

À utiliser avec le plugin LumaCam pour OBS Studio ou l’app LumaCam pour Mac, gratuits sur lumacam-pi.vercel.app.

name: Lumaq
description:
Το Lumaq είναι ένα διαγνωστικό εργαλείο σε επίπεδο σειράς για τους μηχανικούς λειτουργίας και συντήρησης φωτοβολταϊκής ενέργειας και όχι μια επισκόπηση του σταθμού. Διαβάζει μόνο μία σειρά τη φορά, μιλώντας σύμφωνα με το πεδίο IV.
Πώς να το χρησιμοποιήσετε;
Ανοίξτε το αρχείο κατασκευής σταθμού ηλεκτρικής ενέργειας για να ελέγξετε την ονομασία των εξαρτημάτων, τον συντελεστή θερμοκρασίας και την τοπολογία σειράς. Για πρώτη φορά υπάρχουν παραδείγματα σταθμών πεδίου, μπορούν να αλλάξουν άμεσα.
Στην αρχική σελίδα, κάντε κλικ στο "Νέο τεστ" ή κάντε κλικ σε μια σειρά από το "Ομάδα νησιών".
Γεμίστε ακτινοβολία G, θερμοκρασία μονάδας, Voc、Isc、Vmp、Imp。 Η ηλεκτρική ενέργεια μπορεί να είναι κενή. Κάντε κλικ στο "Βάλτε αυτό το στυλό".
Δείτε την αναμενόμενη/μετρήσιμη ισχύ, PR、 Η αποδοτικότητα της σειράς η, ο παράγοντας γέμισης, η απομάκρυνση απώλειας και οι ρίζες με δράση στο πεδίο.
Επιλέξτε μια ρίζα για να ξεκινήσετε τον κύκλο επισκευής. Μετά την έναρξη των εργασιών στο πεδίο, σημειώστε «ο άνθρωπος είναι ήδη στο πεδίο» και επανεξετάστε την ίδια σειρά, συγκρίνοντας ΔPR και ΔP.
 «Κλείστε αυτόν τον γύρο». Δείτε πίσω ή μοιραστείτε αναφορές απλού κειμένου στο Αρχείο κύκλων.

name: LumeAir
description:
See the air you live in.

Most of what affects the air at home is invisible. Searing dinner sends fine particles through the kitchen. A closed bedroom builds up CO₂ overnight. Paint, cleaners and new furniture give off VOCs. LumeAir shows you all of it, and tells you in plain words when the air needs attention.

LumeAir is the companion app for the LumeAir home air quality monitor. Pair your monitor over Wi-Fi to see live readings from every room.

PLAIN ANSWERS, NOT JUST NUMBERS
Each room gets a clear rating at a glance, from Good to Poor, with a short summary of what's going on and what to do next, like ventilating or running an air purifier.

SEVEN READINGS IN ONE
• Particles: PM1.0, PM2.5, PM4 and PM10
• CO₂, measured directly with a photoacoustic NDIR sensor rather than estimated
• VOC index and NOx index
• Temperature and humidity
• Barometric pressure

KNOW WHAT EACH NUMBER MEANS
Tap any reading for the full picture: where it sits on a color-coded scale, what counts as good, whether it's rising or falling, and what the measurement actually is. Particle bands follow the US EPA Air Quality Index.

HISTORY AND TRENDS
See how the air changed over the last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days or a custom range, with the low, average and high for each period. Spot what happens when you cook, close the door or open a window.

ALERTS
Get notified when the air in a room needs attention, so you know when to crack a window or turn on the hood fan.

EVERY ROOM
Add a monitor for the kitchen, bedroom, office or nursery, and swipe between rooms.

LIGHT AND DARK
A calm, easy-to-read design in both light and dark mode.

REQUIRES A LUMEAIR MONITOR
This app works with the LumeAir home air quality monitor, sold separately. LumeAir is not a medical device and isn't meant to diagnose or treat any condition.

name: Lumi - Meditation & Vision
description:
Lumi is a guided meditation written just for you, about the life you want to create.

How it works:
• Chat with Lumi's gentle guide about your vision, goals and dreams: what you want, why it matters and how it will feel when it comes true.
• Lumi writes a personal meditation in your language (English or Hebrew) using the details you shared, and turns it into calm spoken audio.
• Get a personal vision board: images created for your goals.
• Choose when you practise: morning, before sleep or a custom time, and get a gentle daily reminder. Tapping it opens today's session.
• Goals changed? Go back to the chat, update them, and create a new meditation and vision board.

No sign-up and no account. You stay in control: before your first chat, a consent screen shows exactly what is sent to the AI service, and you can delete all your data anytime in Settings.

Lumi is a wellbeing and self-reflection tool and is not a substitute for medical or psychological advice.

name: Lumina: 4K Wallpapers
description:
Make your phone feel new again. Lumina is a clean, fast collection of hand-picked 4K wallpapers, from deep AMOLED blacks to sunsets, space, flowers, cars and more.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Hundreds of curated 4K wallpapers, with new ones added regularly
• Browse by category: AMOLED, Nature, Space, Cars, Abstract, Animals, Dark Aesthetic and more
• Search by name or tag, and filter by what you like
• Save any wallpaper to Photos in high quality, then set it as your Home or Lock screen
• Favorites: tap the heart to keep what you love
• Light and dark appearance
• Wallpapers you've seen stay available on a slow connection

FREE, WITH EXTRAS
Most wallpapers are free. Some are unlocked by watching a short ad, or by spending coins you earn from daily check-ins, the lucky spin and rewards. A few exclusive wallpapers are Premium.

LUMINA PREMIUM
• No ads, anywhere in the app
• Every premium 4K wallpaper unlocked
Choose weekly, yearly or lifetime. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.

Note: iOS doesn't let apps change your wallpaper directly, so Lumina saves the image to Photos and shows you how to apply it in two taps.

Terms of Use: https://lumina-api.hudatiapps.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lumina-api.hudatiapps.com/privacy

name: Lune: Star Map & Stargazing
description:
Lune is a planetarium for your iPhone, made with care in Melbourne. Hold it up and the sky on the screen lines up with the sky in front of you: tens of thousands of stars, every planet and all 88 constellations, with the best known stars named. It is patient with beginners and honest about what you can really see.

WHAT'S THAT BRIGHT ONE?
Tap one button and Lune finds the brightest light in view, rings it, and says what it is and why it looks the way it does: "Jupiter, a planet. Planets shine steadily; stars twinkle." It names the runner up too, and if nothing that bright is on the chart, it tells you what a moving light usually is.

WINDOW MODE
Pinch to the Window stop and your screen becomes a window at true scale. Held at arm's length, about 57 cm, the Moon on the glass matches the size of the Moon behind it.

THE SOUTHERN CROSS AND TRUE SOUTH
Southern Skies, Lune's guide to the southern sky, helps you find the Southern Cross and tell it from the False Cross. Follow the Pointers, and watch the lines that lead you to the south celestial pole. Meet the Jewel Box, the Coalsack, Omega Centauri and the Magellanic Clouds, and see why the Moon looks upside down from Australia. The same trick finds Polaris in the north.

METEOR WATCH
When a shower is on, start a watch and tap anywhere to count each meteor. Lune keeps ten minute tallies, keeps the screen awake, and shows how many you can honestly expect from your own sky, then sums up your night.

TRUE DARK
One switch turns all of Lune red on black, every screen and sheet, and dims the display while you observe. A ring counts your dark adaptation up to 30 minutes.

WHY CAN'T I SEE IT?
When something is out of reach, Lune says why in plain words: below the horizon until 9:40 pm, lost in the twilight, too faint for a city sky, or too close to the Sun.

FIRST LIGHT
Each day Lune opens with a one second lesson: a star figure, the Moon or a planet that is really up where you are, drawn and then turned to its true place in the sky.

THE SKY
About 45,000 stars down to magnitude 8, in their true colors, more than 300 of them named, and the Milky Way. 88 constellations with their lines, and 22 hand engraved figures from Urania's Mirror, a star atlas of 1824. The Sun, the Moon in its real phase, all eight planets, and 125 galaxies, clusters and nebulae, among them all 110 Messier objects. Pinch in to a 5 degree field, slide time a week either way, and search for anything to glide straight to it.

TONIGHT
One line tells you when the sky gets properly dark and what the Moon is doing. A twilight timeline, a 3D Moon lit the way it hangs tonight, and every planet's rise and set times for your place.

EVENTS
Meteor showers rated for your own sky and Moon, solar and lunar eclipses through 2030 with where each one can be seen, oppositions, close pairings, equinoxes and solstices. Tap the bell for a reminder.

SOLAR SYSTEM
The planets in 3D at their real positions around the Sun. Orbit, zoom, fly to Saturn's rings, and run time forward or back.

EXPLORE
A field guide to the constellations, the brightest stars, the Messier objects and the planets, each with what it is, whether it is up tonight, and a Show in Sky button.

WIDGETS AND SIRI
Moon Phase and Tonight widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen, and "Moon phase in Lune" for Siri.

PRIVATE, AND READY FOR A DARK FIELD
Lune is free, with no ads, no subscription and no account, and it collects nothing. Everything is computed on your iPhone, so it works far from any signal. Location is optional: you can choose from about 7,900 cities instead.

Every catalog, image and data source is credited in Settings.

name: Lysekil
description:
Lysekil i fickan: vad som är öppet just nu, vad som händer i helgen, var du kan bada och hur du tar dig dit.

PÅ GÅNG
Alla evenemang i Lysekil, Skaftö och Brastad, med dagar, plats och arrangörens egen text. Tryck Påminn mig, så säger telefonen till dagen innan.

HITTA SNABBT
Restauranger, caféer, butiker, bad, vandringsleder, toaletter, vård och apotek. Öppettiderna är kontrollerade, och läget just nu står på varje ställe.

BAD OCH HAV
Badplatserna med senaste vattenprovet och vattnets temperatur.

KARTA OCH PARKERING
Allt på en karta. Parkeringarna visar det som står på kommunens parkeringskarta, och skylten förklaras på ditt språk.

PÅ DITT SPRÅK
Svenska och 14 språk till, för dig som bor här och för dig som är på besök.

Ingen inloggning och ingen reklam. Det du sparar stannar i telefonen.

Appen är byggd av Infrakust, av en Lysekilsbo. Den är inte en tjänst från Lysekils kommun eller någon annan myndighet. Källor: Google, Turistrådet Västsverige (CC BY-SA 4.0), Havs- och vattenmyndigheten, SMHI, OpenStreetMap och Lysekils kommuns parkeringskarta. Källan står vid varje uppgift i appen.

name: m00d: visual references
description:
m00d is a visual reference board for people who make things.

Save from anywhere: share a photo or video from any app (your gallery, the browser, social apps) straight into m00d, or upload from your phone.

• Add a note about what caught your eye
• Sort references into folders
• Find them again by searching your notes
• Open any reference full screen, play videos and swipe between them

Your board is the same everywhere: on your phone, at m00d.art and in the m00d extension for Chrome.

Private by default: your references are visible only to you. m00d doesn't show your content to anyone and doesn't use it to train AI.

Light on your phone: images and videos are compressed on your device before upload.

Free plan with 500 MB of space.

name: MACK DMS
seller_name: SVM SOLUTIONS AND TECHNOLOGIES PTE. LTD
description:
MACK DMS is a powerful and reliable Document Management System designed specifically for ship crew members, supervisors, and maritime professionals to view and manage essential documents—both online and offline.
Whether you're navigating the high seas or docked at port, MACK DMS ensures that important files are always at your fingertips. With robust offline capabilities and seamless API server integration, this app is purpose-built to support your daily operations, audits, and compliance routines—anytime, anywhere.

-Key Features-
Centralized Access to Maritime Documents:
 - Quickly view and read all mapped documents through a clean, organized interface.
Online & Offline Functionality:
 - Access files even in low or no connectivity zones—perfect for remote operations at sea.
Role-Based Document Mapping:
 - Ship crew and supervisors can access only what they need, ensuring security and compliance.
Multi-Format File Support:
 - View documents in formats like PDF, PNG, XLS, and even browse content inside ZIP files.
API Server Integration:
 - Automatically sync documents from a central server when online, and continue working uninterrupted when offline.
Intuitive User Interface: 
 - Fast, responsive design makes it easy to navigate through templates, folders, and checklists.

name: Madhurang Studio
description:
No more sifting through endless photos let AI do the heavy lifting.

Photos capture the magic of our favorite moments whether it’s a wedding, vacation, birthday, or a big event. But sharing those memories with everyone involved? That’s where it usually gets messy.

Meet Madhurang Studio App the intelligent photo sharing app that takes the hassle out of sorting, tagging, and sending images. Powered by smart facial recognition, BlinkPic makes sure every photo reaches the right person fast, automatically, and in full quality.

What Madhurang Studio App does for you:

• Seamlessly share high-res images with guests, friends, or family
• Quickly identify who’s in which photo and send it their way
• Instantly match faces, tag people, and send notifications
• Upload from your gallery, Google Drive, or cloud storage
• See how your photos are performing with insights like views and downloads
• Easily spot and save pictures shared within your group

All the joy of your photos none of the busywork.

Privacy policy: https://blinkpic.in/privacy-policy

name: Mafidi Rides
description:
Mafidi Rides is a ride-hailing app for Harare where you and your driver agree the fare before the trip starts. You name your price, nearby drivers accept it or send their own offer, and you choose who picks you up.

FOR RIDERS

• You set the fare. The app suggests a fair price for your trip. Keep it or change it to suit your budget.
• Compare offers. See each driver's price, rating, vehicle and distance before you accept.
• No surprises. The fare you agree is the fare you pay. No surge multipliers.
• Add up to three stops, and say how many people are riding so only cars with enough seats respond.
• Follow your driver on the map from pickup to drop-off.
• Share your trip. Send a live link so family or friends can follow your ride.
• Chat with or call your driver about the pickup while the trip is active.
• Pay your driver the agreed fare in cash.
• Rate every trip, report a problem, and block anyone you would rather not ride with again.

FOR DRIVERS

• Keep your fares. There is no commission on your trips.
• Accept a rider's offer or counter with your own price.
• See where demand is with a live map of ride requests.
• Go online and offline whenever you like.
• Track your earnings in the app and export them when you need a record.

SAFETY

• Drivers submit their ID, driver's licence, vehicle registration and insurance, and are reviewed before they can accept a trip.
• Phone numbers are only visible to the other person while a trip is in progress.
• In-app support is available on every trip.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Enter your pickup point and destination.
2. Propose your fare.
3. Choose from the drivers who respond.
4. Ride, then pay the agreed fare.

Mafidi Rides currently operates in Harare, Zimbabwe. You need a mobile number to sign in, and the app needs your location to find rides and drivers. Continued use of location in the background while you are online as a driver can decrease battery life.

name: Magieschule
description:
You go to school like everyone else – but secretly you're an apprentice at a hidden magic school in the middle of a real city.

EXPLORE REAL CITIES
Walk through Luxembourg or Lisbon, rebuilt from real street maps. Discover legends, customs and true stories at real places, visit the bakery, café and ice cream shop and try local food.

MAGIC IN WORDS AND MOVEMENT
Draw circles with your finger to charge a spell, then swipe toward your opponent. Fire, Water, Earth, Air and Quintessence: every element has attack, defense and helper spells – and each one is strong against another.

DUELS AND MONSTERS
Practice with your classmates, fight monsters together and free haunted houses before the monsters spread through town. If you like, let the AI fight for you.

THE SCHOOL LIBRARY
Every school book hides a spell somewhere. But careful: flip too fast and it evaporates. Read closely – the seal asks you a question about the text.

A TOWN THAT LIVES
People go about their day, magic students go to school, chat with you and remember your hobbies. In the evening a silly school ghost haunts the hallways.

• Buy once, play everything – no ads, no account
• English and German
• Your name stays on your device
• AI texts by Claude (Anthropic), with a report button for inappropriate content

name: Mahj Edge Play
description:
Sit down at a real American Mahjong table, any time you like.

Mahj Edge Play is a complete game of American Mahjong against three computer opponents, on a 3D table you can see from your seat. Build the wall, pass the Charleston, call tiles, swap Jokers and declare Mahjong, all by the standard American rules.

A FULL GAME, START TO FINISH
• The Charleston, with blind passes, the vote on a second Charleston and the courtesy pass
• Call discards for a pung, kong or quint, or for Mahjong
• Swap your tile for a Joker in anyone's exposure
• Concealed hands, Singles and Pairs, self-drawn and jokerless wins
• Payments worked out for every win, with a running score across games

OPPONENTS THAT PLAY TO WIN
Give each of your three opponents a name and a level: Easy, Medium or Strong. Strong opponents weigh every discard and exposure, and try not to throw the tile you are waiting for.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
The house card shows the hands you're closest to and the tiles you still need. Open the full card at any time to see every hand and what it's worth.

PLAY BY YOUR OWN CARD
Enter the hands from a card you own, or photograph the card and let Mahj Edge Play read it. You check and correct every hand before it's added. During a game by your own card, Mahj Edge Play checks your Mahjong and the opponents play by your hands, but the card itself is never shown. Photos are read on your device and never uploaded or kept.

MAKE THE TABLE YOURS
Green Baize and Classic Ivory tiles are included. Three more tables and four more tile sets, including Large Print, are available as optional purchases.

TRY IT FREE
Your first 3 complete games are free. One purchase unlocks the full game for good, with Family Sharing:
• Unlimited games, by the house card or your own
• No ads, no subscription, no account
• Works completely offline

Mahj Edge Play's house card is an original card made for this game. Mahj Edge Play doesn't include the National Mah Jongg League card and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by the National Mah Jongg League.

name: Mahjong Solitaire: Old Street
description:
Old Street Mahjong is a calm mahjong solitaire game with big, clear tiles and no timer. Every board you clear helps rebuild a real old street in Asia, one shophouse at a time.

HOW IT PLAYS
Tap a bright tile and it waits in your letter rack. Tap its twin and the pair is posted. The rack holds four tiles, so think a step ahead. Dark tiles are held in place by their neighbors: free one side and they light up.

CALM BY DESIGN
- No timers, no lives, no energy to wait for
- 10 free undos on every board, plus 3 hints and 2 shuffles
- Every board is dealt so it can be cleared without helpers
- Big tiles and big words, with settings for bigger text, bigger tiles and darker blocked tiles
- Tea time: relaxed boards with no stars and no failing

SIX OLD STREETS
Restore Joo Chiat in Singapore, Armenian Street in Penang, Sham Shui Po in Hong Kong, Dihua Street in Taipei, the old town of Hoi An and Senado Square in Macau. Each street has its own houses, music and tiles drawn from its crafts and food. May, the new postwoman, has found a lost postbag: every house you mend sends a letter home.

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
- 1,200 boards across the six streets, then a road that keeps going
- A daily postcard board, picked to suit the way you play
- Seven more games: Three of a kind, Kopitiam orders, Kueh sort, Memory lane, Trishaw out, Lantern courtyard and Tea time
- Festivals on the street on their real dates: Lunar New Year, Hari Raya, Mid-Autumn, Deepavali and Christmas. The keepsakes stay yours
- A tile album with the true story behind each tile, a passport of heritage facts, and a shophouse home to furnish
- A log book with a new page for each day you play

SHARE WITH FAMILY
Send today's postcard as a short code. Your family types it in and plays the very same board. No account needed.

HONEST, ALWAYS
- No fake opponents, no leagues full of bots, no made-up numbers. Your statistics show your own boards only
- Plays without internet; your progress is kept on your phone
- Free to play, with ads. From board 8, a small banner sits below the buttons, and a short ad may show between games, never in the middle of a board
- Turn the ads off for good with one purchase, or buy helpers if you like. Stars are never sold, and every board can be played without paying

Play in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese or Malay.

name: Mancala - Offline Board Game
seller_name: Guangzhou Xingfeng Information Technology Co., Ltd
description: Discover Congklak, the traditional Indonesian board game, in a polished offline experience. Play classic Congklak or quick Mancala matches, learn the rules with a guided tutorial, explore island-inspired journeys, and collect beautiful boards and seeds. No account or internet connection is required.

name: Mancia – Tip Tracker
description:
Mancia is the simple tip tracker for everyone in hospitality: servers, bartenders, valets, doormen, cloakroom staff.

QUICK TO LOG
Type the amount, pick your shift, save – done. Big buttons, easy with one hand after a long night. Several tips on the same day? "+ Add amount" adds them up. Typo? Tap "Undo" or "Edit".

LATE SHIFT? NO PROBLEM
Until 4 a.m. the previous day still counts – your late shift lands on the right day.

YOUR STATS
• Tips per week, month and all time
• Average per shift and per weekday
• Best shift, best day, record
• Fair comparison with last week and last month – up to the same day

PRIVATE
On the main screen your amounts are hidden (€•••) – coworkers and your boss can't see what you earn. Tap the eye to show them.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO TRACKING
All data stays on your iPhone. Mancia never sends anything over the internet.

Available in English, German and Italian.

name: MandarinGo: Learn Mandarin
description:
Learning Mandarin for Taipei or Beijing/Shanghai? Wondering whether to learn Taiwan's Traditional characters with Zhuyin Fuhao (Bopomofo) or Mainland China's Simplified characters with Hanyu Pinyin?
They share the exact same spoken Mandarin—MandarinGo explains why and gives you both in one clean portrait app, switching every lesson, phonetic chart, writing canvas, flashcard, and dialogue with a single tap.

FIVE CORE PILLARS

1. Instant Switch: Taiwan Mandarin (Traditional + Zhuyin) ⇄ Mainland Mandarin (Simplified + Pinyin)
- Learn authentic Taiwan usage (MRT, EasyCard, Boba shops with Zhuyin Bopomofo and zh-TW pronunciation) or Mainland usage (Metro, QR Pay with Hanyu Pinyin and zh-CN pronunciation)—or compare both side by side.
- Every word and example includes Zhuyin, Pinyin, IPA, and standard + 0.7x slow native speech.

2. All 37 Zhuyin (Bopomofo) & Pinyin Symbols + Stroke Writing + 24 Tone & Ear Drills
- Tap any of the 21 Initials or 16 Finals for side-by-side Zhuyin and Pinyin breakdowns, mouth placement guides, and interactive stroke writing right on screen.
- Train your ear with 24 blind minimal-pair drills covering the 4 Mandarin tones (媽/麻/馬/罵), retroflex vs. flat sibilants (zh/ch/sh vs. z/c/s), aspirated vs. unaspirated stops, and -n vs. -ng finals.

3. 100 HD Taiwan Mandarin (zh-TW) Video Dialogues + Offline Studio Audio
- Watch and practice 100 real-world HD video scenarios (Boba & Dining, Night Markets, Airport/MRT/High-Speed Rail, Hotels & Sightseeing, Pharmacy & Emergencies) with synchronized Zhuyin/Pinyin, regional scripts, cultural tips, and studio-grade offline pronunciation across both zh-TW and zh-CN.

4. 12 Guided Speaking Missions · 160 SM-2 Flashcards · 18 Grammar Drills
- Practice 3-round boba, hotpot, transit, hotel check-in, and pharmacy missions where staff speak first and helpful Zhuyin/Pinyin hints stay visible while you reply.
- Review 160 essential cards with spaced repetition (SM-2) plus 18 grammar drills covering 了/過, 把-sentences, 比-comparisons, and measure words (個/杯/碗/張).

5. Instant 2-Way Live Voice Interpreter (Rightmost Tab)
- Speak or type in English / 日本語 / 한국어 / Español ⇄ Mandarin (Taiwan or Mainland) for fast two-way voice translation and fullscreen display cards.

PRIVACY FIRST
- No sign-up, no ads, no third-party tracking. Your study progress stays privately on your device.

name: MangaPedia
description:
Get to know a manga through its details.

MangaPedia helps you discover manga, search title information and keep works you want to revisit in local favorites.

DISCOVER AND SEARCH
Browse lists supplied by the data source, or open search at the top of Discover to search titles and explore additional pages of results. List order and available information come from the data source and may change.

EXPLORE TITLE DETAILS
View titles, authors, descriptions, existing ratings and volume reference information where available. Information varies by title, and some fields may be missing.

KEEP LOCAL FAVORITES
Save titles to favorites on your device for another look. An undo prompt lets you reverse a removal. Favorites do not include cloud sync or a separate backup service.

THREE INTERFACE LANGUAGES
Use the app in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese or English. The app follows your system's light or dark appearance. Interface languages do not guarantee translated metadata for every title.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN
MangaPedia is a manga reference and discovery app. It does not provide manga pages for reading, book downloads or translation. New information usually requires an internet connection. Offline access is limited to some previously cached metadata that has not expired; not every title will be available.

When you open an eligible saved title's details from local favorites, an external source link may appear if a valid source URL is available for that title. External websites have their own content, terms and privacy policies.

Developed by TFF Technology Limited.

name: Manila Bay: Pixel Harbor
description:
Set sail in Manila Bay, a handcrafted 16-bit pixel maritime trading and stock strategy board game for 3–5 players!

GAMEPLAY HIGHLIGHTS
• Harbormaster Auctions & Fleet Planning: Bid to become Harbormaster, purchase cargo shares, and choose which three cargo ships (Nutmeg, Silk, Ginseng, Jade) launch each voyage.

name: Mantrify: Daily Affirmations
description:
Start your day in the right mindset, and keep it past breakfast.

Mantrify is a daily affirmations app you use with your voice. You say your affirmations out loud each morning, and a few minutes later you walk into the day having told yourself, in your own voice, who you are and what you're building.

Words that stay with you

Words you say out loud stay with you longer than words you read in silence (MacLeod and colleagues, University of Waterloo, 2010). An affirmation you scrolled past is easy to forget. One you said seven times is much harder to lose.

A clearer head on a hard day

In one study, a short self-affirmation helped people under stress solve problems (Creswell and colleagues, Carnegie Mellon University, 2013). A minute or two with your own words before the meeting, the exam or the difficult call is a good trade.

Nothing you have to fake

"I am enough, exactly as I am" is hard to say when it doesn't feel true yet, and bold words can backfire when you don't believe them (Wood and colleagues, University of Waterloo, 2009). So each of the 64 affirmations in Mantrify is written three ways. You start with words you can say with a straight face, like "I'm learning that I'm enough", and move up when you're ready.

You know you did it

Each word lights up as you say it, and a glass sphere fills with a little more light on every repetition. When it glows full, you are done for the day, and you can see it.

A habit that holds

A daily habit takes about 66 days to feel automatic, and missing one day barely matters (Lally and colleagues, University College London, 2010). You choose how many times to say each affirmation, from 3 to 21, and a morning reminder and a streak goal keep you coming back.

How a practice goes

1. A calm recorded voice reads your affirmation once.
2. Your turn. Say it, and the words light up one by one in time with your voice.
3. Finish the phrase and the count goes up. Say it again until you reach your number.

Lock your phone if you like. The affirmation and your count stay on the Lock Screen, so you can keep going with your eyes closed.

The affirmations cover eight parts of life: self-worth, confidence, love, money, calm, health, purpose and gratitude. A few questions at the start pick your first ones. You can also write your own.

Questions people ask

Is Mantrify free?
Yes. This version is free, without purchases, subscriptions or ads.

Do I need an account?
No. You open the app and start.

Does it record my voice?
No. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone. Your voice is not recorded and does not leave the phone.

Can I use my own affirmations?
Yes. If you want the recorded voice to read one of them aloud, the app asks first, because those words are sent to a voice service to be turned into a recording.

What language is it in?
Affirmations and speech recognition are in English.

name: Mapea
description:
Mapea is a map for the places you love and the friends you'd send them to.

Pin a place, drop it in a list, and you have your own map: Thai spots, coffee, bars, Paris 2024. Each list gets its own color, so one glance tells you what's what.

No more texting your recommendations to friends one name at a time, or juggling a group chat, a reviews tab and a maps app just to pick a place for dinner. Send the whole list instead. It opens as a clean map on your friend's phone, with or without the app, showing how far each place is from where they are standing, the Google rating, and your own rating and note.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Pin any place and add your own rating and a one-line note
• Keep places in color-coded lists, and group lists into folders
• Show or hide lists on the map with a tap
• See a list sorted from closest to farthest
• Send a list in Messages; your friend opens it instantly, no account needed

MADE TO BE SIMPLE
No feed, no followers, no rankings. Just your map, and an easy way to hand a piece of it to someone.

You can use Mapea without an account. Signing in with Apple is only needed when you share a list, so friends can see who it's from.

name: Mapeleven: Maps & Directions

description:

SEARCH

OFFLINE MAPS

WHEN GPS IS DOWN
Set your position by hand by tapping a landmark you can see. The compass then points to any place you pick. The app warns you when your GPS position jumps somewhere a real trip could not reach. You can also open a printable paper map of any area.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save places you visit often and share any place as a link.

IMPROVE THE MAP

A clean map in light or dark mode, with labels in Arabic or English.

Detailed maps, search and directions currently cover Jordan, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman and Yemen. More countries are coming.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Mappe: Resume & Cover Letter

COVER PAGE

COVER LETTER

ATTACHMENTS
• Scan certificates, transcripts and references with the camera, or add them from Files and Photos

• With Pro: cover page, cover letter, resume and attachments in one single PDF

COUNTRY FORMATS

• “Why?”: every rule names its source and the date it was last checked. You decide whether to apply it

PRIVACY

• The free version shows ads; the ad service never gets the contents of your documents. Pro has no ads

MAPPE PRO
Free (with ads): create your documents and see them in the live preview, country formats with “Why?”, signature, ATS check and all phrase blocks – plus a free trial: export one complete application as a PDF once.
Pro unlocks: unlimited PDF exports, unlimited folders, up to 3 profiles, every template and cover page, one PDF for the whole application, a copy of a folder for each company – and no ads.

name: Marble Bloom: Ball Sort Puzzle
description:
Marble Bloom is a relaxing ball sort puzzle among flowers, with marbles and tubes that look and sound like real glass. Marbles clink as they land, a full tube rings softly, and every level is one you can solve.

RELAX AND UNWIND
• A relaxing game for a few mindful minutes: no timer, no lives, no rush.
• A zen puzzle with a meditation-like focus: one calm move at a time.
• Soft sounds of glass and nature, and peaceful painted worlds to rest your eyes on.
• A quiet moment of stress relief in a busy day, also offline.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a tube to lift its top marble, then tap another tube to drop it there.
• A marble goes onto the same color or into an empty tube.
• A tube filled with one color gets a cork.
• Sort every color to finish the level.

A BALL SORT THAT PLAYS FAIR
• Every level can be solved without an extra tube. A solver checks each one before it goes into the game.
• Undo and restart are free and unlimited.
• A hint shows the next good move, and tells you when to go back a few steps first.
• No timer and no lives: play at your own pace.
• Works offline. No connection needed.

EIGHT WORLDS IN BLOOM
• Start in a sunroom full of flowers and travel on to a garden, a lagoon, an observatory, cherry blossom, winter, the desert and a forest.
• Each world returns in four moods: clear, golden hour, rain and night.
• Painted scenes, soft light and the clink of glass make this a zen color sort to unwind with.

A CALMER BALL SORT
• No ads in the first levels, and never an ad after every level.
• No banners over the board.
• A video is always your own choice: for a hint, an extra tube or triple coins.
• One small purchase removes the ads between levels for good.

MORE TO DISCOVER
• 1,000 levels that grow gently from relaxing to truly tricky, with a breather after every hard one. After that, new puzzles keep coming.
• Hidden colors, frozen tubes and taller tubes keep the sort puzzle fresh.
• A new daily puzzle every day.
• Marble sets to collect: glass, pearl, candy, gem, chrome and aurora.
• Symbols on every ball for color-blind players, and a setting for less motion.
• Replay any level for three stars.
• Available in 32 languages.

Sort, breathe, and watch it bloom.

name: Marine ETO
description:
Marine ETO is a complete study suite for ships' Electro-Technical Officers — for ETO CoC preparation and daily reference on board.

NEW COURSE — READING ELECTRICAL DRAWINGS, ZERO TO HERO
Start not knowing a single symbol and finish reading DOL, star-delta and autotransformer starter drawings on your own. Nine chapters build up one idea at a time: what a drawing is for, the symbol alphabet, reference designations, power versus control, the ladder, then the three starters read line by line with faults you diagnose from the drawing itself. 56 hands-on steps you tap and change rather than read, 52 symbols, and a test at the end of every chapter. Chapters 1 to 3 are free.

INTERACTIVE SIMULATORS — 75+ modules
• Basic electricity & electronics labs: DC networks, RLC resonance, power factor, diodes, transistors, op-amps
• Component testing with a virtual multimeter — probe placement, polarity traps, fault finding
• Electrical safety: IEC 60479 shock zones, touch voltage, 30 mA RCD
• IP ratings & insulation classes with animated ingress tests
• Switchboards, alternators, AVRs, paralleling, motor starters, VFDs
• Switchgear: MCB/MCCB trip curves, RCD core balance, contactors
• High-voltage plant, insulation testing, earth faults, discrimination
• Instrumentation: 4–20 mA loops, transducers, calibration bench, pneumatic controllers, control valves, cascade and split-range control
• Hydraulics: power packs, directional valves, meter-in vs meter-out
• Power management: preference tripping, bus-tie interlock, blackout recovery; fire and smoke detection; salinity, viscosity and level
• Crankcase oil mist detection, steering control and stabilisers, deck machinery, reefer electrics, ICCP/MGPS, navigation lights, radar, PLC basics, MARPOL discharge decisions and more

EXAM BANK — 1,400+ QUESTIONS
Spaced repetition (Leitner), weak-question drills and per-module mastery tracking.

LECTURES
Full bilingual lecture notes across marine electro-technology — from basic electricity and electronics to propulsion drives and troubleshooting.

WORKS FULLY OFFLINE
Everything is bundled in the app — study at sea with no internet. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Bilingual throughout: English and Burmese (Myanmar language).

The basic modules, a quiz preview and the introductory lecture units are free. Marine ETO Pro unlocks the full suite with a single one-time in-app purchase — no subscription. Buy it once and it works on every iPhone and iPad signed in to the same Apple Account; tap Restore Purchases on a new device.

name: Matching Couple Wallpapers
description:
Turn a favorite photo into two matching Lock Screen wallpapers. Keep your half and send the other to your partner with steps to set it up on their iPhone.

Give each face its own frame
Start with a photo from your library or try a built-in design. Use Shared crop to carry one scene across both screens. If a close-up selfie cuts someone out, switch to Two portraits. When the editor finds two faces, Frame the faces suggests a crop for each person. Drag or pinch either portrait to refine it.

Fit both iPhones
Choose an iPhone model for each side. Swap sides to decide which half is yours. Preview both screens together or one at a time, with or without a clock overlay. iOS may adjust the crop when you set the wallpaper.

Save one half and send the other
Create two separate JPEGs sized for your chosen models. Save your half to Photos or Files and send the other through the iOS share sheet. If your messaging app accepts only the image, copy the setup steps and paste them alongside it. Your partner can use the picture without installing the app. Each of you sets your own wallpaper in iPhone Settings.

Pick up where you left off
Save a draft and return to it from the home screen. Find finished pairs in My wallpapers to send them again or adjust a crop and save a new version.

name: Matelda
description:
Find anything you've ever kept, from a few words.

Describe a photo, a moment in a video, or something a friend once wrote you. Matelda looks through your photos, videos, voice notes, chats, files and email at once, and every search happens on your iPhone.

YOU REMEMBER WHAT IT WAS ABOUT. THAT'S ENOUGH.
• Photos, by what's in them: describe the scene, the people or the place, even for a photo taken years ago. No captions or tags needed.
• The moment, not the whole video: results start playing right where your words match.
• Voice notes, found by ear: Matelda listens to the recording itself and finds the one you describe.
• Words on pictures: the exact words on a sign, a receipt or a screenshot, marked where they are.
• Files and PDFs: leases, invoices, tickets and slides are found by what they say, with the matching page shown first.
• Your WhatsApp chats: bring a chat in with WhatsApp's own Export Chat. Its messages, photos and voice notes become searchable.
• Email and cloud drives: sign in to Gmail, Outlook, Google Drive or OneDrive, and their mail and documents join the same search.

SET IT UP ONCE. ASK IT ANYTHING.
1. Choose what to include: your photo library, folders, chats and accounts, and how far back to go.
2. Matelda gets to know it, on your iPhone. It only takes long once; after that, just what's new. It keeps going in the background and is fastest with your iPhone plugged in.
3. Describe what you remember, the way you'd say it to a friend. The best matches of every kind come first.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Matelda has no server and no account. Your library is understood by a model that runs on the iPhone itself.
• Searching works in airplane mode.
• Nothing you keep or search for is ever sent to us.
• Email and drives are read straight from Google or Microsoft, with read-only access you can remove at any time.

FREE FOR YOUR FIRST WEEK
Everything is free for 7 days from the first time you open Matelda. After that, search needs a membership: monthly or yearly. Settings, your sources and getting your library ready keep working without one, so nothing is lost while you decide.

Memberships renew automatically at the price shown in the app until you cancel, at least 24 hours before the period ends, in Settings › your name › Subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account.

name: Mavoryx Spellworld Pro
description:
Mavoryx Spellworld Pro brings three original card challenges together in a single hand-illustrated fantasy world. Each game reinvents what you can do with a single deck and asks you to think several moves ahead.

Reef Current is a tide-lane puzzle. Three ocean currents each display a target number, and you steer cards from your hand into them, trying to land the total exactly on the tide mark. Go over and you wipe out, losing precious Air. Court cards bend the rules: Jacks pull a card back out, Queens mirror the last value played, and Kings trigger a Tsunami that can close a lane instantly. Chain crests without wiping out and the Tide multiplier climbs to four times, rewarding risk and precision equally.

Rune Siege is a one-on-one tug-of-war. You and an AI rival each draw from half the deck and clash cards simultaneously. A four-suit power cycle adds a rock-paper-scissors edge, the Sapper rule lets a lowly 2 topple an Ace, and Royal Guards absorb incoming damage when your face card loses. Three difficulty tiers, from the loose Squire to the calculating Warlord, keep the tension scaling. A Spyglass reveals one rival card each round so you can plan your counterplay.

Neon Circuit is a stream-drafting engine builder. Cards scroll along a six-slot conveyor; picking one costs energy equal to its position, while skipped cards accumulate charge you collect later. Every five cards you route compile into one of ten circuit patterns, from a basic Twin Link up to the legendary Crown Sequence, each returning points and energy that fuel the next cycle. A purge timer steadily removes the leftmost card, forcing you to balance patience against urgency.

All three games sit inside a storybook meadow backdrop with ornate parchment frames, animated butterflies, and per-game ambient scenes: rising bubbles for the ocean, drifting embers for the siege, and a neon perspective grid for the circuit. Twelve achievements track milestones across the trio, and a Daily Tide mode in Reef Current gives you one seeded deal per day to chase your personal best. Haptics, sound effects, and built-in tutorials round out the experience.

name: Mawja: Direct Calls
description:
Mawja is a simple voice calling app: your voice travels straight from your phone to the other person's phone.

No sign-up
No phone number, no email, no password. Open the app and start.

Direct
Audio goes directly between the two devices, encrypted, and never passes through our servers. Our server only delivers the invitation and helps the call get started.

Simple
Send your invite link with any messaging app, or show your QR code. Your friend taps the link and you are both added to each other. After that, calling takes one tap.

How it works
1. Tap (+) and send your invite link.
2. Your friend taps the link, then “Add”.
3. Tap their name to call. Their phone rings like any other call, even when the app is closed.

Privacy first
• We do not collect your number, your email, or your phone's contacts.
• Calls are never recorded, and we cannot listen to them.
• Your contacts and call history stay on your phone.
• You can delete your data from the server at any time, from inside the app.
• You can block anyone you do not want to hear from.

Please note
Mawja relies on a direct connection between the two devices, with no relay server for audio. Some restricted networks block this kind of connection. If that happens, try another Wi‑Fi network or mobile data.

The app is available in Arabic and English, and you can switch with one button.

name: MCLDelux
description: MCLDelux This system is designed for tracking personal bills. It displays both the amount confirmed as settled by the payee and the actual net outflow from your account. If a payment fails, you can re-process it using a different account while linking it to the original bill, allowing you to see exactly which transaction ultimately settled the balance. When a refund is received, you can allocate the incoming funds to cover the original payment and any associated processing fees, with any remaining unrefunded balance tracked as pending. By reconciling account statements against the actual month of entry, you can review the outstanding balance and net expenditure for a single bill across different dates. You can also set up installment or recurring bills, log refund commitments along with follow-up verification dates, and review any unmatched transactions at the end of each month.

name: MCQ Scanner: OMR Test Grader
description:
MCQ Scanner turns your phone or tablet into an OMR grader for multiple-choice tests. Print an answer sheet, let students fill in the bubbles, then point the camera at each sheet. The app reads the student ID, the test version and every answer, scores the sheet on the spot and saves the result. No scanner, no special paper, no account.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick an answer sheet and print it at 100% scale.
2. Create a test and enter the answer key: type it, scan a filled-in sheet, import it from Excel, or scan a QR code shared by a colleague.
3. Hold the camera over each sheet so the corner marks are in view. The sheet is graded and saved automatically, and the app waits for the next one.
4. Check the results, correct anything by hand, then export or send the scores.

ANSWER SHEETS FOR 40 COUNTRIES
• 70 ready-made sheets in the styles teachers use in 40 countries, from short quizzes to 200-question exams
• Design your own sheet: number of questions and columns, 2 to 10 choices per question, true/false and short-answer sections, student ID and test version digits, score boxes for essay questions
• Also reads several store-bought forms: 882-E, 883-E and 815-E machine forms, NEET practice OMR sheets, Taiwan answer cards, Poland's CKE exam cards and Vietnam's official 2025 answer sheet
• Beta: learn a sheet your school already prints from a photo or a PDF
• Download any sheet as a PDF, blank or with each student's name printed and ID filled in

FAST, CAREFUL GRADING
• Grade with the live camera, or a whole stack at once from a scanned PDF or photos
• Several versions per test: the right key is chosen from the version code on the sheet
• Copes with erased and crossed-out bubbles, and flags blank or double-marked questions
• Points per question or per section, penalties for wrong answers, and questions you can drop after the test
• Essay questions: type the marks in, or have them read from score boxes on the sheet
• Every result keeps a picture of the sheet with the marking drawn on it, so you can check it and fix a misread answer

CLASSES, RESULTS AND ANALYSIS
• Class lists from any Excel or CSV file, or brought in from Google Classroom, Canvas or Moodle
• Statistics for each test, item analysis for each question, and a list of sheets that need a second look
• Score scales and grade bands used in different countries
• Export to Excel, CSV and PDF, including gradebook files that Canvas and Moodle import; post scores to Google Classroom
• Send each student or parent their score by email, SMS or WhatsApp
• Search your tests, sheets and papers

TEST PAPERS
• Write a test in the app, shuffle questions and answer options into several versions, and export the papers with their keys as PDF

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• No account. Tests, class lists and results are stored only on your device, with backup to a file
• Works without an internet connection
• Phones and tablets

COUNTRIES WITH THEIR OWN SHEETS
Argentina, Australia, Bangladesh, Brazil, Chile, China, Colombia, Egypt, France, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Iran, Italy, Japan, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Malaysia, Mexico, Nepal, Netherlands, Nigeria, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Taiwan, Thailand, Türkiye, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States, Vietnam. Anywhere else, use any sheet or design your own.

FREE AND PRO
The free version shows ads and grades up to 30 sheets a day; watch a short ad whenever you like to get more for that day. Pro is a monthly auto-renewing subscription that removes the daily limit and the ads. You can cancel at any time in your Google Play subscriptions.

IT'S IN YOUR CALENDAR
Connect Google Calendar and your me time shows up next to everything else, planned around your appointments.

SEE YOUR WEEK

EASE IN AND EASE OUT
When a session ends, me time reminds you to put things away, so the next thing starts easy. Turn on check-in and wind-down time for gentler transitions.

A HEADS-UP BEFORE IT'S DUE
Gentle nudges 3 days and 1 day before a deadline, so nothing sneaks up on you.

FOCUS WHEN YOU NEED IT
Start a step and settle in with a timer, notes and calm focus music.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Widgets show what's next, so you can start without opening the app.

BUILT ADHD FIRST
me time is designed around how ADHD brains work, with small steps, gentle nudges and help moving from one thing to the next. It works for anyone who finds it hard to make time for themselves. Calm, simple and on your side.

YOUR PRIVACY

Try all of me time free for 7 days, no card needed. Subscribe whenever you like for £59.99 a year (about £5 a month) or £9.99 a month, with a free week first. Or keep going free after your 7 days with up to 5 admin actions and 2 activities. Payment is taken by your Apple ID and renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.

name: Mendbook: Maintenance Tracker
description:

Every item you own gets its own card: photos, category, brand, model, serial number, purchase date and price, warranty term and notes. Cars, bikes, computers, home appliances, tools - anything worth keeping track of.

Spending stats cover this month, this year, the last 12 months or all time, split by item category and type of work, month by month, with the most expensive items on top.

Selling the car or filing a warranty claim? Export the full history of one item or all of them as a clean report to share, or as a spreadsheet.
