Counts distinct pets received by QR in the month; re-sending the same record adds nothing.

EXPORT AND PRINT:
PDF of any record to share or print.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY:
Records are stored encrypted on your device and travel encrypted through iCloud. MentePrima does not operate pet-data servers.

BILINGUAL:
Spanish and English.

LEGAL NOTICE: MentePrima Veterinario organizes and displays information entered by the owner. It does not diagnose or replace a veterinarian's judgment. MentePrima records your license details as they appear on the document and does not verify them with any authority.

SUBSCRIPTION: MentePrima Veterinario is free to download and offers a 2-week trial, followed by a $29.99 monthly auto-renewing subscription. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, from Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions on your device. Privacy Policy: https://privacidad.menteprima.com · Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Mentiroso: Liar's Dice
description:
The bluffing dice game, the way it's played at the table. Everyone rolls five dice under a cup and sees only their own. Bid on how many dice on the whole table show a face, and when someone's bid is too good to be true, call them a liar.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Bid "four 5s", "six 2s"… every bid must go up
• Ones are wild, with the classic switching rules
• Call Liar! and everyone's dice are counted: the loser gives up a die
• Calzo: call a bid exactly right to win a die back
• Lose all your dice and you're out; the last player with dice wins

PLAY THE COMPUTER
Up to three computer players (five with Pro) that see only their own dice and the bids, like a person. They play the odds, read the table and bluff now and then. Easy or Standard, at the speed you like.

PASS THE PHONE
Playing with family? Set more than one player to "person" and pass one phone around. Before each turn the app hides everything until the right person taps to see their own dice.

FAIR DICE
Every round's dice come from a random seed. Its fingerprint is shown while you bid and the seed when the cups lift, so every roll can be checked. Nothing can change the dice after the fingerprint is shown.

• The whole game is free for up to 4 players
• In English and Spanish
• No ads, no account, no data collected

MENTIROSO PRO (one-time purchase)
• Up to 6 players
• House rules: ones not wild, or no calzo

name: Meow Color
description:
Meow Color is a cozy sorting puzzle. Six cat breeds are mixed up in wicker baskets. Move them until every basket holds a single breed.

HOW TO PLAY
Tap a basket to pick up its top cats, then tap another to drop them. Or drag them over. Cats only stack on their own breed or in an empty basket.

WHAT YOU GET
- Endless numbered levels in a repeating Easy, Medium and Hard cycle
- Every puzzle is checked to be solvable before you see it
- Six breeds: Orange Tabby, Siamese, Black Cat, Russian Blue, Calico and Maine Coon
- Cats with moods: they blink, look surprised, get grumpy and smile
- Undo, Restart and New puzzle when you get stuck
- Win levels to earn bills, a play money you spend in the in-game store on more Undos, Restarts and New puzzles
- Points for every win: solve fast and in few moves to score more, and watch your total score grow
- Gentle sound effects, a cozy music track and haptics, each with its own switch
- Respects the silent switch, other apps' music and Reduce Motion

NO STRINGS
No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. Bills are play money only, and the game works offline. Your progress is saved on your iPhone, and you can erase it anytime in Settings.

name: Meowcard
description:
Draw cute animated greeting cards with pixel cats and send them to the people you love!

Meow Card brings together greeting cards, cat stickers, fancy text and a cat planner, so every message feels special.

ANIMATED GREETING CARDS
• Cards for birthdays, Christmas, New Year, Mother's Day, graduation and more
• Featured animated pixel cards that keep playing after you send them
• Neon, rainbow, star and spray brushes
• Add text, handwriting and cat stickers

SURPRISE WAYS TO SEND
• Animated cards with an optional envelope-opening intro
• Voice cards: record your voice and send it with the card
• Scratch cards: friends watch the surprise being revealed
• Photo cards with layouts and photo animation
• Friends don't need the app — they can watch it right in WhatsApp, LINE or Messenger

CAT STICKERS
• 100+ pixel stickers: Tabby, Froggy Cat, Strawberry Cat and more
• Add whole packs to WhatsApp in one tap, or send stickers one by one to LINE and Messenger
• Cat text stickers: add fancy or handwritten text to any cat

FANCY TEXT & KEYBOARD
• 14 fancy text styles and cute kaomoji
• Meow Card keyboard: type fancy text in any app

MEOW PLANNER
• Schedule, to-dos, alarms and cat reminders
• Monthly income and expense totals
• Habit tracker, birthday and anniversary countdowns
• Daily vlog diary with Pixel Cat, Neon, Shonen Manga, Retro DV, Film and more filters — compile a whole month in one tap
• Year in review and Home Screen widget

MEOW CARD PRO
• Unlock all featured cards, surprise send modes, animated stickers, fancy text, cat text stickers and Meow Planner
• Export without watermarks
• Monthly, yearly (3-day free trial) or one-time lifetime purchase

Subscription details:
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• After the free trial, the subscription renews and you will be charged. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase another plan
• Manage or cancel anytime in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pixelcraftgames59.github.io/meowcard/privacy.html

name: Mercies: Daily Bible Verse
description:
Busy mornings, full days, no time to sit down with a Bible app? Mercies brings God’s word to you. You don’t have to remember to open anything: each morning, at the time you choose, a verse arrives like a gentle alarm and is read aloud to you, with a short thought and a prayer. It takes two minutes, and it keeps you close to God even on your busiest day.

GOD’S WORD COMES TO YOU
• A verse each morning at your time, even when your phone is on silent
• Read aloud in a calm voice: just press Listen, or listen on the go
• A short thought for the day and a one-line prayer
• Missed it? It comes again 15 minutes later
• A short word through the day, at the times you choose
• Special verses for Christmas, Easter, Good Friday, Pentecost and more

BE STILL: CHRISTIAN MEDITATION
• Peace, right now: one minute of breathing with Jesus’ words when everything is too much
• Today’s word, slowly: sit with the morning’s verse and let one word find you
• Breath prayers from Psalm 46 and the ancient Jesus Prayer
• Psalm 23 one line at a time, Cast your cares, Count your blessings
• Sleep in peace: let go of the day with Psalms 4 and 121
• A calm voice, a breathing circle, soft rain and a closing bell, in 3, 5 or 10 minutes

EVERY DAY’S WORD, KEPT FOR YOU
• Verses: every verse each day has brought you, day by day
• Hear any of them again, share one as a beautiful image or a link
• Count every morning you spend with God; miss a day and nothing is lost

AND WHEN YOU HAVE MORE TIME
• Read the Bible like a book, page by page, in the King James Version or the World English Bible
• Listen to whole chapters read aloud
• Highlight, bookmark and write your own notes

MADE TO BE GENTLE
• A Home Screen widget with today’s verse
• Siri shortcuts, dark mode and larger text
• Free. No ads, no account, no subscription. Mercies collects no data at all.

name: Mesalo - Waiter & Kitchen App
description:
Mesalo is a waiter and kitchen app for places where the internet is weak or missing: beach bars, mountain huts, club festivals, pop-ups and small cafés.

NO HARDWARE TO BUY
Bring your own devices: Mesalo runs on the iPhones and iPads your team already has. No POS terminals, no kitchen printers, no server.

WHAT IT SOLVES
Orders get from the table to the kitchen without paper slips and without running back and forth. Everyone sees which order is new, which one is being cooked and which one is ready to serve, so no dish waits unseen at the pass.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set up your venue, menu (also via CSV) and floor plan with tables in a few minutes.
• Invite your team's devices with a QR code, or send an invitation by message protected with a 6-digit code.
• Waiters take orders at the table, the kitchen sees them instantly and marks them ready.
• The devices sync directly with each other over a local Wi-Fi or hotspot. No internet, no server, no cloud account.
• If a device loses the connection, it catches up automatically when it is back in range, and Mesalo shows which devices are up to date.

FOR SERVICE
• Floor plan with table status: free, guests seated, ready, to clean, plus how long guests have been there.
• Pickup list: every dish that is ready, filtered to your tables, so one person can take the order and another can serve.
• Move guests to another table, hand a table over to a colleague, see a table's history.
• Undo by long press when you tapped the wrong thing.
• Bill overview per table with an even split and partial payments, for your till, not instead of it.

FOR THE KITCHEN AND BAR
• Kitchen display with new, cooking and ready orders, waiting times and undo.
• Takeaway: a counter role takes orders without a table, and a pickup display shows guests when their number is ready.

FOR THE OWNER
• Day report with service times and export of the day's orders as CSV.
• Roles for service, kitchen, counter and admin. Remove a lost device and the others get a new key.
• Recovery file: if the admin device is lost, a new device can take over.

SECURE BY DESIGN
Connections between devices are encrypted with your venue's key, every entry is signed by the device that made it, and invitations expire after 24 hours.

WHAT MESALO IS NOT
Mesalo is not a cash register. It does not take payments or print receipts. Your till stays as it is.

YOUR DATA
Menus, orders and tables stay on your devices. Mesalo only sends anonymous crash reports, if you allow them, so we can fix errors. You can switch them off in the app.

FREE
Mesalo is free to use for small setups. The iPhone and iPad version has no purchases.

Mesalo is in early testing. Feedback is very welcome: write to hello@mesalo.ch.

name: Meterveil
description:
Meterveil is a rhythm runner that turns the beat into your next move. Jump over gaps, slide under hazards, and dash through violet veils as the Hush closes in. Land moves on the beat to build Resonance, then ride a Crescendo for double points.

START IN GLIMMERWOOD
Play the complete Glimmerwood course for free as Tala. Learn the controls as you encounter them and replay the course whenever you like.

UNLOCK THE FULL GAME
One optional in-app purchase opens every course, Endless mode, Daily Runs, and the full progression system. Earn medals, unlock runners and flames, and try different loadouts and upgrades. There’s no subscription.

EIGHT REGIONS, ONE BEAT
Run through firefly woods, aurora-lit peaks, and the flooded halls of the Drowned Choir. Each region has its own music and hazards. Endless runs build a new route as you play, and Daily Runs give you a fresh route keyed to the date. The full game stores your best scores on your device.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Adjust audio timing, swap the touch controls, or turn down flashes and screen shake. There are no ads and no Meterveil account to create.

name: Meto: Your  Introduction
description:
Creează videoclipuri scurte în care te prezinți natural, clar și pe ritmul tău. Meto te ajută să înregistrezi răspunsuri pe fragmente, să le organizezi ușor și să obții un video final bine structurat, gata de salvat sau trimis mai departe.

Ce poți face
- Alegi un scenariu gata făcut sau îți creezi propriul scenariu - pornești rapid și rămâi autentic.
- Înregistrezi fiecare fragment separat cu indicații pe ecran - vorbești relaxat, fără să uiți ideile importante.
- Rearanjezi, tai, înlocuiești și ștergi fragmente - controlezi complet felul în care arată povestea ta.
- Adaugi fotografii și inserții text - faci video-ul mai expresiv și mai personal.
- Alegi copertă, titlu, font și culoare - obții un rezultat curat și plăcut vizual.
- Salvezi proiectul pe dispozitiv și revii oricând la el - continui editarea fără să pierzi nimic.

Potrivit pentru
- Prezentări personale și primele impresii.
- Răspunsuri video pentru întâlniri, comunități sau colaborări.
- Oameni care vor să spună cine sunt, ce iubesc și ce îi inspiră.
- Conținut creativ pentru profiluri, portofolii sau mesaje video.

De ce să alegi Meto
Meto combină scenarii gata pregătite, editare simplă și un flux de lucru gândit pentru video-uri personale. Ai la dispoziție teme pentru cunoaștere, interese, istorii, impresii și conversație, plus un editor de scenarii cu teme personalizate. Poți salva proiecte, crea copii, refolosi scenarii și exporta videoclipul final direct pe dispozitiv. Totul funcționează offline, iar datele rămân pe telefon.

Interfața este modernă, curată și rapidă, cu accent pe imaginea camerei și pe montaj. Ai controale clare pentru cameră, microfon, numărătoare inversă, previzualizare și ordinele fragmentelor, astfel încât să te concentrezi pe mesaj, nu pe tehnică.

Începe acum și transformă o simplă prezentare într-un video memorabil.

name: Mi-Pass
description:
Mi-Pass is a free app that helps you say what you need, without having to explain it from scratch every time.

Create your own simple pass — the things you find difficult and the small changes that help — and share it, in your own words and your own control, with a teacher, an employer, or anyone who needs to understand you.

Why people use Mi-Pass:
• Say it once — share your pass in seconds, instead of explaining again and again.
• In your words — you choose what to include.
• In your control — you decide who sees it, and you can delete everything at any time.
• For everyone — children, young people and adults, with or without a diagnosis.

What you can do:
• Build a pass with your name, photo and communication needs
• Add your own notes, in your own words
• Share your pass by message or email
• Delete your account and all your data whenever you want

Mi-Pass was built by parents with lived experience of the SEND system, to help people be understood and supported — at school, at work, at appointments, and anywhere new.

Mi-Pass is a communication tool. It is not medical, educational or legal advice.

Made by Mi-SEN Group Ltd · misengroup.co.uk

name: Migraine Diary: Attack Records
description:
Log an attack in seconds. Bring a clear report to your visit. Your records stay on this iPhone.

Migraine Diary is a local diary: capture the details as they happen, look back when you can, and export a report for your doctor.

◆ WHEN AN ATTACK HITS
• Long-press + to log severity and location in one screen, or tap + for a 4-step guide covering symptoms, triggers, medication and notes.
• Five emoji pain cards and a head map - no hard choices while you hurt.

◆ ANSWERS TO THE DOCTOR'S QUESTIONS
• How many headache days this month? How bad on average? Mornings or evenings? The calendar and stats show it at a glance.
• Review by time of day, trigger, symptom and location - just your own records, organized.

◆ DON'T SPEND YOUR VISIT REMEMBERING
• Members can export PDF or CSV for any date range: overview, headache calendar, pain mix, charts, medication and details, plus a fillable visit handoff sheet.

◆ ONLY YOUR IPHONE KNOWS
• No account, no analytics, no ads. Everything stays on your device by default; iCloud sync only applies after you turn it on.
• No notifications or streaks. Light, dark and system themes; Chinese and English.

◆ NOTE
For personal logging only. Not a substitute for professional medical advice.

name: MiLink 遠端
description:
MiLink 讓你用手機遠端操作自己家裡的電腦。

・電腦裝 MiLink 電腦端，手機輸入 6 位數配對碼就能連上
・即時看模擬器畫面：點擊、滑動、打字、傳檔、剪貼簿互通
・多台模擬器同時開、一鍵同步操作
・整台電腦桌面遠端操作，支援鍵盤滑鼠
・分組管理多台電腦，開機／關機一鍵完成
・分享給朋友「只能看」或「一起操作」

只能連到你自己配對過的電腦；畫面直接從你的電腦傳到手機。
電腦端下載：miworks.app/milink

name: Millavo
description:
Welcome to our app! We’ve designed simple and intuitive pages to provide a smooth and complete user experience. Our focus is on making everything easy to use while offering you the most convenient features. We value your feedback and are committed to continuously improving based on your needs. Download the app and enjoy — and feel free to share your suggestions and ideas with us!

**Inspect every detail. Calibrate with confidence. Keep your grinder performing at its best.**

Millavo is a professional coffee grinder calibration and maintenance app designed for coffee enthusiasts, baristas, and equipment technicians.

From inspecting burr conditions and managing grind settings to measuring coffee retention and tracking maintenance, Millavo brings essential grinder care tools together in one intuitive iOS workspace.

### Burr Inspection

Explore grinder burrs through an interactive inspection map. Record contact observations, identify wear patterns, attach photos, and track changes across different inspection sessions.

### Grind Dial Calibration

Manage grind adjustment settings with an interactive dial editor. Record zero references, configure adjustment steps, track grind positions, and compare calibration profiles.

### Dose & Retention Testing

Record coffee bean input and ground coffee output weights to calculate apparent mass differences. Compare repeated tests, review measurement trends, and evaluate results before and after maintenance.

### Grinder Maintenance

Organize cleaning routines, burr inspections, component replacements, and maintenance tasks. Track completed steps, document adjustments, and schedule follow-up checks.

### History & Reports

Keep a searchable history of inspections, calibration settings, dose tests, and maintenance activities. Compare before-and-after results and export structured reports for future reference.

### Key Features

- Interactive burr inspection maps
- Burr contact and wear records
- Grind dial calibration profiles
- Zero reference and grind setting tracking
- Coffee input and output measurements
- Mass difference calculations
- Repeated dose test comparisons
- Cleaning and maintenance workflows
- Burr replacement history
- Post-maintenance retesting
- PDF reports and data export
- Offline functionality and local data storage

### Built for Grinder Care

Millavo combines practical inspection tools, precise measurement records, and organized maintenance workflows to help you better understand and maintain your coffee grinder.

Whether you're checking burr conditions, refining grind settings, measuring output differences, or documenting routine maintenance, Millavo keeps every detail organized and accessible.

Measurements are based on user-provided readings and observations. Millavo does not automatically measure burr alignment, control grinder hardware, or diagnose mechanical faults.

**Inspect. Calibrate. Measure. Maintain.**

name: MimicSpanish: Spanish Speaking
description:
MimicSpanish helps you speak Spanish the way kids learn a language: listen to native speakers, then repeat them out loud.

SHADOWING WITH REAL CONVERSATIONS
• Short video conversations set in everyday places — cafés, taco stands, the office, the neighborhood.
• Each line plays on its own while the words light up, so you always know what you're hearing.
• Tap the mic, repeat the line, and get an instant score with every word marked right or wrong.
• Slow it down, loop a line, and see the English translation whenever you need it.

DICTATION — TRAIN YOUR EAR
• 840 listening lessons across 40 topics, from A1 to C1.
• Hear a sentence, type what you hear, and see exactly which words you missed.
• Words you mishear come back later in quick review sessions.

SAY IT — THINK IN SPANISH
• See a sentence in your language and say it in Spanish out loud.
• Hints when you're stuck, a streak counter when you're on a roll.

VOCABULARY THAT STICKS
• Thousands of words organized by level and topic, each with native audio and example sentences.
• Flashcards, listening and typing drills, and spaced-repetition review that brings each word back right before you forget it.

GRAMMAR, CLEARLY EXPLAINED
• A step-by-step path through 86 grammar points, with formulas, examples and common mistakes.
• Practice every point by shadowing, dictation and Say It, then take a short test.
• Full conjugation tables for 778 verbs — irregular forms highlighted, every form with audio.

STAY MOTIVATED
• Daily streaks, XP and levels, plus streak shields that save your streak if you miss a day.
• Your progress syncs with mimicspanish.com — practice on your phone or computer.

PREMIUM
Practice free every day, or go Premium for unlimited practice across every feature. Premium is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel anytime in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://mimicspanish.com/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mimicspanish.com/en/privacy

name: Mind Support: Daily Practice
description:
When so much is happening in the world at once, it helps me to take a quiet moment to look at something and try it for myself. Maybe you feel the same. I spent several months, on and off, making Mind Support. Now I’d like to give it to you.

How do you show something that you can only feel from the inside? Looking for an answer, I made my own images and animations. In Window of Tolerance, a bright frame shows the room you have to feel, think and choose how to respond. A wave rising above it pictures a moment when everything inside you is on alert. In The Downward Spiral, things pile up in a kitchen. The scene shows how “I’ll do it later” can bring relief today and make it harder to begin tomorrow.

I also wanted to share exercises that fit into everyday life. If you have just a moment, follow the fan of light for one breath. In Body Scan, a voice guides your attention through your body. In Muscle Relaxation, gently close your hands, open them again and notice the difference. If a conversation keeps replaying in your mind, When Thoughts Keep Circling invites you to look at one small detail, like the bright edge of a book. In Safe Place, you can picture somewhere you’d like to be right now.

You can start wherever you like and stay for as long as feels right. Natural-sounding, digitally generated voices guide you in English, German, Spanish, French and Italian. Mind Support is free and has no ads. All exercises work offline, without an account.

If an image comes back to you in the middle of an ordinary day and you find a use for it, making this app was worth it to me.

Dr. Stephan Gillmeier

Mind Support is my personal way of exploring these topics. It is not a clinically recognized therapy app and does not replace medical care or psychotherapy.

name: Mini Terminal: SSH & SFTP
description:
Mini Terminal is an SSH and SFTP client for iPhone and iPad. Open a shell on your own servers, run full-screen tools like vim, htop and tmux, and move files over SFTP, all from one app.

TERMINAL
• A real xterm-256color terminal with scrollback
• Long-press to select and copy; paste from the key bar or with ⌘V
• Copies from tmux and vim (OSC 52) land on your clipboard
• Pinch to change the font size
• Themes: Default, Solarized Dark and Light, Gruvbox Dark, High Contrast, with a block, underline or bar cursor

SERVERS AND SESSIONS
• Connect to several servers at once and switch between open sessions
• Keepalive every 30 seconds, and one automatic reconnect when you return to the app
• Saved commands you can send with one tap or edit before running

FILES
• Upload from the Files app, then download, rename and delete over SFTP
• On iPad, the terminal and files sit side by side

SECURITY
• Log in with a password or an OpenSSH Ed25519 or RSA key, with or without a passphrase
• Create Ed25519 keys on the device; private keys stay in the device's secure storage
• The server's SHA-256 fingerprint is checked before you log in
• Optional Face ID or Touch ID app lock

MINI TERMINAL PRO (one-time purchase)
• iCloud sync for servers, saved commands and trusted hosts (passwords and private keys are never synced)
• Jump host (bastion) connections
• Local port forwarding
• SSH agent forwarding, with approval for every signature

Hardware keyboard shortcuts: ⌘N new server, ⌘⇧F show or hide files (iPad), ⌘R reconnect, ⌘+ ⌘− ⌘0 font size, ⌘[ ⌘] previous and next session.

No ads and no account. Passwords and private keys never leave your device.

name: Minutopia
description:
Minutopia helps youth soccer coaches keep playing time fair.

Watch every player's minutes live on a field view. Set a fair-share minimum, get even-time substitution suggestions you approve or decline, and share a private report with one parent — with no other kids' data.

All of your data stays on your iPhone. Minutopia is free, with no ads, no accounts, and no tracking.

LIVE MINUTES ON THE FIELD
Start the clock and see each player's time on a visual pitch. Track minutes by position, keep score, and pause or end the game when you need to. Works in portrait and landscape.

FAIR-SHARE MINIMUM
Set a league floor as a percent of the game, for example 50% of 60 minutes. Each player's minimum is that percent times the minutes they are actually at the game, so a late arrival or early leaver is prorated automatically.

EVEN-TIME AUTO SUBS
Turn on Auto Subs and Minutopia plans even playing time and suggests substitutions — it never makes a change unless you approve. Approve one pair, approve all, or decline to snooze for five minutes. The suggestion sheet appears on any tab while the clock is running, and optional lock-screen notifications let you approve or decline without unlocking. You can cap how many substitutions are allowed in a game, or leave them unlimited.

See a sub plan before kickoff: who starts, who comes on and off and when, and each player's predicted minutes. During the game, a Next sub card counts down to the next window. The plan updates if a sub is missed, skipped, or declined, if a player leaves or is injured, or if someone arrives late.

MANUAL SUBS AND ATTENDANCE
Make a substitution in either order: tap a field player then a bench player, or a bench player then a field player, and confirm. Swap two players already on the field, or place a bench player in an empty spot. Mark who is here before kickoff, and adjust mid-game for late arrivals, early leavers, or injuries. A late arrival goes to the bench; a player who leaves comes off at once and their clock stops.

FORMATIONS FOR EVERY AGE GROUP
Choose 11v11 (4-3-3, 4-4-2, 4-2-3-1, 3-5-2, 3-4-3) or small-sided 4v4, 7v7, and 9v9. Auto-assign a lineup, save lineups, or reuse last game's lineup. Minutopia is soccer-first; basketball, volleyball, lacrosse, hockey, baseball, and a custom sport use a simpler on-court grid.

STATS, REPORTS, AND A PRIVATE PARENT SHARE
See season stats with a fairness percentage and a red-to-green view of who is on target for their minimum, plus minutes by position. After a game, or for the season, share a full team report as a CSV or PDF. Or share one child's report with a parent: a PDF of only that child's minutes, positions, and on/off times, with no other kids' names or data. An optional setting counts goalkeeper time separately from outfield time for fairness.

FOR THE WHOLE CLUB
Manage multiple teams in one app, each with its own roster, schedule, and history. Add optional player photos and a team logo — they stay on your iPhone. Settings includes Help & FAQ if you want a walkthrough.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
There is no account to create and nothing is uploaded. Minutopia does not collect data, show ads, or include analytics. Notifications are local only. Requires iOS 17 or later.

name: Mion
description:
Mion is an independent iPhone remote for supported Michi devices on your local network.

START FOR FREE
Turn your device on or put it in standby, and adjust volume where supported. Try the full demo without a purchase or physical amplifier.

UNLOCK ONCE
A single in-app purchase unlocks all other supported controls. No subscription. Restore your purchase using the same Apple Account.

• Select inputs and use the names reported by your device.
• Adjust supported tone, balance, USB and display options.
• Control playback on compatible sources and the Q5.
• View device, network and available channel-temperature readings.
• Select display presets on supported X5, M8 and S5 firmware, or record menu sequences where network menu control is available.
• Switch quickly between saved devices.
• Add Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, plus Control Center controls on iOS 18 or later. Power and volume are free; Mute requires the full version.

PROFILES
X3, X3 Series 2, X5, X5 Series 2, X430, P5, P5 Series 2, Q5, M8 and S5. Available controls depend on model and firmware. Power amplifiers do not provide volume or tone controls. X3 and X3 Series 2 does not offer network menu navigation or remote display presets.

REQUIREMENTS
An iPhone with iOS 17 or later and a compatible device reachable on the same local network. Power-on from standby requires the amplifier’s network interface to remain available, usually through Network Standby. Some advanced settings and menu sequences may be unavailable or behave differently across firmware versions.

Mion is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rotel or Michi. Product names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

name: MiPlay 手機玩
description:
MiPlay 把你自己電腦上的 PC 遊戲畫面串流到手機，躺在床上、出門在外也能玩。

・專為手機設計的操作版面：虛擬搖桿、選目標、互動、跳躍、一直跑
・技能按鈕對齊遊戲畫面，點了就放
・任務清單、背包、地圖一鍵打開，視窗開著時按鈕自動讓開

使用方式：在自己的電腦安裝 MiPlay 電腦端（miworks.app/miplay），手機輸入配對碼即可連線。
MiPlay 只是遠端操作你自己的電腦，不提供、不販售任何遊戲本身。

name: Mixly: Recipes & Kitchen
description:
Mixly writes recipes for the kitchen you actually have.

Say what you feel like, in your own words: "something cosy with squash", "dinner for 4 in 30 minutes", "my grandma's lasagne, but in the Thermomix". Mixly writes a recipe for your appliances, your diet and the people at the table, then cooks it with you, one step at a time.

ASK IN YOUR OWN WORDS
• Get a full recipe with ingredients, steps, times and portions
• Nothing is saved until you say so

BRING YOUR OWN RECIPES
• Snap a cookbook page or a handwritten card, even over several pages, or paste the text
• Keep it as written, or make it Thermomix-friendly for your kitchen, your diet and your units
• Your photos are only used to read the recipe, never kept

MADE FOR YOUR KITCHEN
• Tell Mixly your Thermomix model (TM7, TM6 or TM5), your accessories (Varoma, Blade Cover & Peeler, Cutter, Sensor…) and your other appliances: oven, hob, air fryer, microwave and more
• Time, temperature and speed for every Thermomix step
• Grams or cups, °C or °F: amounts convert and scale with the servings
• Recipes work on every Thermomix model that can make them, so friends with another model can cook them too
• Missing something a recipe needs? Adapt it to your kitchen in a tap, or keep it as is

COOK STEP BY STEP
• One step at a time, in big, clear text, read aloud if you like
• Tick off each ingredient as it goes in
• Timers that start from the step, with a gentle chime even on silent
• Your step and timers on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• The screen stays on, and Mixly remembers where you stopped

YOUR RECIPE BOOK
• All your recipes in one place, sorted into categories: browse by what you're in the mood for
• Several photos per recipe, and photos on any step
• Change the servings and get a shopping list
• Rate what you cooked, and find it again in your Cooked history

CHANGE ANY RECIPE
• Edit it by hand, or ask Mixly: "make it vegetarian", "for 6 people", "no oven"
• You see exactly what changes before anything is applied

SHARE WITH YOUR PEOPLE
• Mixly is private: you only see the friends you're connected with
• Add friends with your link, a QR code or a friend request by email
• Share a recipe with all your friends or just one
• Send a recipe link to anyone: on iPhone it opens instantly, no download needed, and they can cook it right away, then join you in a tap
• Comments, ratings and favourites, between friends only
• Report or block anyone, at any time

THERMOMIX OWNERS
• Guided Thermomix settings in every recipe
• Send any recipe to your Cookidoo account in one tap, photo included

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• A layout made for iPad with a landscape cook mode, dark mode, and six languages

FREE, WITH MIXLY PLUS FOR MORE AI
• Mixly is free to download and use: sign up with email, Apple or Google
• Everything works for free; the AI has a free allowance: 12 messages a day, 30 a month and 3 AI recipes a month
• Mixly Plus ($9.99 a month or $99 a year in the US) gives you 40 AI messages a day and 60 AI recipes a month
• Each friend who joins from the app with your link gives you a free month of Mixly Plus

Mixly Plus is an auto-renewable subscription, charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy: https://getmixly.com/privacy

Mixly is independent and not affiliated with Vorwerk, Thermomix or Cookidoo. Always check temperatures, cooking times and allergens.

name: MixShift
description:
Your overall return rate fell. Did every category improve?

A changing order mix can make the total move in the opposite direction from every category. MixShift gives small shops and brands a hands-on workbench to compare the original counts, hold the mix fixed and explore different order shares.

Follow your data from first entry to a saved, explainable scenario.

1. Enter or import two periods
Enter order counts and returned-order counts side by side, or import UTF-8 CSV. Checks flag missing, negative or noninteger counts and returns above orders. Review column mapping, duplicate rows and category IDs before confirming matches. Record order dates, return-observation cutoffs, counting units and inclusion rules so each comparison retains its basis.

2. Inspect the actual results
Compare overall rates, category rates, order shares and percentage-point changes. Chart width represents order share, height represents return rate, and area represents weighted contribution. Tap a bar or use the category index to inspect source counts and proportions.

3. Explain a surprising total
With complete, comparable categories, see when every category rate rises but the total falls, or the reverse. Inspect category-by-category contributions in a disclosed rates-first, mix-second breakdown. The two steps reconcile with the actual total change. For incomplete category sets, choose a common-category scope and review excluded orders.

4. Compare under one fixed mix
Choose previous-period, current-period, pooled-order or custom reference weights. Recalculate both periods under the same structure while retaining the actual results for comparison. Inspect the category rates and reference shares behind the totals.

5. Move the assumptions yourself
Hold one period's category rates fixed. Drag a boundary between neighboring unlocked categories, or adjust one category with a slider, buttons or exact percentage or fraction input. Lock shares you want to retain; the other unlocked shares redistribute proportionally. Original counts stay in their data version.

6. Find a target's crossover
Enter a target overall rate, or use the previous actual total. Explore the interactive curve, locate the crossover share and see which side lies above or below the target. Apply the crossover in one step. If no crossing is possible under the current constraints, inspect the attainable minimum and maximum.

7. Save the scenario and its evidence
Save a named snapshot with its data version, rate source, weights, locks and target. Restore it to continue, duplicate it, or compare two scenarios from the same project. Corrected counts create a new data version; historical scenarios retain their original basis and can be recalculated separately with new data.

8. Preview, share and organize
Preview a comparison image or CSV table before opening the system share sheet. Outputs distinguish actual data from hypothetical shares. Search, duplicate and archive projects, recover input drafts, and export or restore a complete local backup.

Start with three clearly marked examples covering opposing total/category trends, hidden improvement, and new or zero-order categories. In the first case, both category rates rise while the total falls from 11% to 4.8%. With the previous 50/50 mix, the current result becomes 12%.

Calculations and storage stay on your iPhone. No account or internet connection is needed. No ads, analytics SDKs or in-app subscriptions. English and Simplified Chinese are included. Feedback supports local drafts and optional system sharing.

Blank counts remain missing. Zero-order category rates are undefined, and missing rates are never treated as zero for positive scenario weights. Scenarios compare explicit assumptions; they are not forecasts or proof of a business cause.

name: Mizu Family Color Sort
description:
Mizu Family Color Sort is a water sort puzzle: pour the colored water between test tubes until each color is gathered in its own tube. Play at your own pace, together with Mizu and his family.

Tap a tube, then tap another tube to pour. Only the top color moves. Fill one tube with a single color to clear the stage - simple rules, but the later stages ask you to think several moves ahead.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap a tube to pick it up, then tap the tube you want to pour into
- You can pour onto the same color, or into an empty tube
- Sort every color into its own tube to clear the stage

FEATURES
- 100 stages on a single path - clear one to unlock the next
- Each stage attempt uses one heart. Hearts come back over time and on first clears, and you can also recover one by watching a short ad
- Earn coins from the daily bonus and from first clears, and trade them for a full heart refill
- A once-a-day Droplet Darts mini-game with coin and item prizes
- A spare-tube item for when you get stuck
- Mizu and his family appear on the title screen

No timers and no rushing - a stage takes just a few minutes. Free to play.

name: MMA STARS - Fighter Career
description:
MMA STARS is a mixed martial arts game built on mind games: both fighters choose a move at the same time.

- Mind-game fights
On the feet, Strike, Takedown and Counter beat each other like rock-paper-scissors. Take it to the ground and the top and bottom fighters each have three moves of their own. Read your opponent's habits and win by KO, submission or decision. Your once-per-fight All-Out and Guard Up cards can swing the fight.

- Career mode
Pick a background (wrestling, judo, karate, boxing or jiu-jitsu) and a build, then start your career at 18. Train every month, cut weight, face the press, sign sponsors, switch gyms and change weight classes as you rise from the amateurs to regional promotions, Japan's biggest stage, and finally the world's top promotion, ULTIMA. Age catches up with everyone - you only get one career.

- Fight with your own fighters
Retired fighters stay as registered fighters you can use in Free Match or Friend Match (two players on one device).

- Customize your look
Collect walkout effects, victory poses, trunks, gloves, robes, emblems and titles.

All promotions and fighters are fictional.

name: MobiSolitaire
description:
Klondike solitaire with cards you can actually read.

MobiSolitaire has a Large Print deck with oversized numbers and one big suit symbol on every card, in strong black and red on plain white. When cards overlap, the numbers stay in view. The move counter and timer are big too.

Prefer a traditional look? Switch decks with one tap, even in the middle of a game.

THREE CARD STYLES
• Large Print: big numbers, one symbol, high contrast
• Classic: traditional cards with illustrated kings, queens and jacks
• Glass: a bright, modern take on the classic deck

THREE TABLE LAYOUTS
• Deck at the top left
• Deck at the top right
• Deck and foundations at the bottom, closer to your thumb

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Draw 1 or Draw 3
• Tap a card to move it, or drag it where you want it
• Undo up to 100 moves
• Finish the game automatically once the deck is empty and every card is face up
• Your game is saved, so you can pick up where you left off

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• No account
• Works offline
• Collects no data

name: Mochi Ball
description:
Mochi Ball — your ADHD fidget pal!

Hands that won't stay still? A mind that won't slow down? Always reaching for something to touch, poke, or squish?

Meet Mochi Ball: a soft, soothing little mochi you'll never get tired of playing with. Between tasks, on a study break, when you feel restless, or when you just want to zone out, pull it out and give it a poke, a squish, or a fling.

[ PLAY ANY WAY YOU LIKE ]
Tap it and it hops. Drag it, fling it, or tilt your phone and it rolls along. It squashes when it hits the walls and makes cute faces: happy, shy, surprised, or a little dizzy.
No missions, no scores, no pressure. Just simple fun at your fingertips.

[ FIND THE FEEL THAT SOOTHES YOU ]
Five different physics feels for different sensory tastes:
- Mochi: soft and squishy, and it sticks to the walls
- Taffy: super sticky, and it hates to let go
- Jelly: soft and bouncy, you'll keep poking it
- Rubber: soft but springy, pops right back into shape
- Bouncy: crisp and lively, for the joy of a good bounce

[ MAKE IT YOUR OWN ]
A bow, party hat, cat ears, glasses, little crown, or sprout, plus six colors and a dark or light background. Make your Mochi Ball one of a kind!

[ LET MOCHI BALL KEEP YOU COMPANY ]
- On ADHD days when your hands can't stay still
- During little breaks from work or study
- When you feel irritated, tense, or restless
- When you're bored, waiting, or just want to let your mind go blank

Carry a little calm in your pocket, and poke your way to a relaxing moment anytime, anywhere.

name: ModelRocket
description:
ModelRocket is the field companion for the first launch, built around the safety code that ships with every model rocket kit in the United States. Before the pad goes up, it answers the question that decides the day: does this motor, this model and this field belong together? Choose the motor class, the weight of the finished model and the shortest side of the field you actually measured, and the app returns the clear area the class requires, the distance your spectators need to keep, the recovery that suits the wind, and a plain go or no-go call with the numbers behind it.

The logbook turns a season of launches into evidence. Each flight records the date, the field, the wind, the motor designation and batch, the apogee you saw and how the model came back, so the next decision is based on what happened at your field rather than on a guess. Charts draw the altitude trace across recent flights, the monthly cadence, the recovery mix and the motor classes you have actually flown.

For teachers and club leaders there is a planning sheet: kit counts for a class of twenty-four, four crew roles that rotate through the session, a ninety minute plan, and the supervision points that matter around an ignition system, eye protection and fire risk.

The reference section quotes the eleven rules of the NAR Model Rocket Safety Code in full, with a short field note under each one, and lays out the launch site table from 1/4A through 2 × G. Everything is written for someone standing in a park with a rocket in one hand and a controller in the other, wondering whether the field is big enough.

ModelRocket covers model rockets only. It does not explain motor modification, propellant mixing or high power assembly, and it does not replace the safety code, the motor instructions or your local authority. Airspace and local ordinances vary by jurisdiction, so confirm with the land manager before every launch.

name: Modune
description:
Modune brings the things you check throughout the day into one orbit on iPhone.

• Tap Water to log a glass. Open Calendar and Tasks to see your day. Below the orbit, find year progress, the lunar date, the Moon phase and upcoming dates from both calendars.
• Tap the Sun or Moon to capture something. Type a sentence, review what Modune found, and save it as an event, task or note. Hold the Sun or Moon to see it up close. Swipe horizontally to spin it.
• Modune Pro unlocks weather, reference prices for gold, fuel and crypto, Apple Health integration, capture by voice, camera, photo or paste, customizable cards and orbit items, and personal dates in Coming up.

Core features are free. Modune Pro is an auto-renewing yearly subscription. The App Store shows the price and any eligible free trial before purchase. Manage subscriptions in iPhone Settings and restore purchases in Modune.

Privacy policy: https://modune.escbase.xyz/en/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Moja SOŠPT Šaca
seller_name: Skola vo vrecku s. r. o.
description:
Spoločnosť Škola vo vrecku s. r. o. vám prináša aplikáciu plnú potrebných pomôcok a vymožeností ohľadom SOŠ PT v Šaci.

Môžete byť záujemca o štúdium, žiak, rodič žiaka na škole, či pedagóg alebo kľudne aj riaditeľ. Naša aplikácia vám otvorí dvierka do sveta SOŠPT v Šaci a uľahčí vám váš každodenný život na škole.

Veľa vymožeností, ktoré na školách chýbajú, sú nahradzované touto aplikáciou. Príkladom môže byť:
- navigácia po škole,
- učitelia a kabinety,
- 360° prehliadka školy,
- generácia priemyselnej prvej technickej strany v zošite s rozmermi,
- interaktívny výpočet priemeru známok, porovnaný s priemerom krajiny.

Aplikáciu a jej development vedie Filip Karab, zo spoločnosti Škola vo vrecku s. r. o.

name: Mojimori: Kanji Drop Puzzle
description:
Drop ink stones into a paper jar. When the right parts touch, they fuse into kanji.
木 + 木 makes 林, a grove. One more 木 and it becomes 森, a forest.
A calm physics puzzle in sumi ink, with a new kanji in every chain.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap to drop a part. Parts that belong together fuse when they touch.
• Chain fusions for a bigger score before the jar overflows.
• Recipes, not matching: 亻 and 木 make 休, 日 and 月 make 明, 女 and 子 make 好.

THREE JARS
• Forest Jar: trees, groves and forests. Free.
• Sun & Moon Jar: kanji of light and time.
• People Jar: kanji of people and words.

DAILY JAR
One jar a day, the same for everyone. Free.

THE BOOK
Every kanji you make goes into your Book, with its reading and meaning. Collect all 41.

PAY ONCE
The Forest Jar, the Daily Jar and the Book are free to play. Mojimori Full is a one-time purchase that opens the Sun & Moon and People jars. No subscription, no ads, no account. Family Sharing is supported.

name: Moltura: Fresh Milled Baking
description:
Fresh milled whole grain flour soaks up more water than bagged flour and needs time to hydrate. Moltura converts any recipe for your grain: wheat, spelt, rye, emmer, einkorn or oats, fine, medium or coarse. You see before and after side by side – and why. Plus our own recipes written for fresh milled flour, a baking journal and your grain pantry. Grams and °C, or cups and °F.

• Millstone converter: turn grain and grind, see water and rest
• Before and after side by side, with the reason
• Our own recipes for fresh milled flour, with baker’s percentages
• Grain library: six grains and how they behave
• Dough timer with steps and a notification when a step is done
• Baking journal for milling and baking days with notes
• Grain pantry in jars: goes down when you mill
• Bring in a recipe from a book with Live Text

Without a subscription: 3 conversions a month, 10 basic recipes, the grain library and the dough timer. Moltura Plus is a monthly or yearly subscription (trial on the yearly plan): unlimited conversions, all recipes and new seasonal collections, the journal without limit and the grain pantry. It renews automatically and can be cancelled in your Apple ID settings. No ads, no account; your data stays on your iPhone.

Moltura is an independent tool. A conversion is a starting value from our own test table; every grain and every mill is a little different. No health claims.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://baytechbv.github.io/privacy/moltura-eu/

name: Moment Puzzle: Photo Slide
description:
Every photo holds a moment. Moment Puzzle lets you take it apart and put it back together, one piece at a time.

Choose any photo from your library, pick a size, and the picture is cut into tiles and shuffled. Slide the tiles back into place until the moment is whole again.

• Your own photos — a trip, your family, your pet, a quiet afternoon
• Three sizes: 3×3, 4×4 and 5×5
• Tap a tile, or swipe on the board, to slide pieces into the empty space
• Hold to peek at the original photo whenever you need a hint
• Optional tile numbers for tricky puzzles
• Best moves and time saved for each size
• Works on iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
• A calm, paper-like design with no ads and no accounts

Your privacy is simple: the photo you choose stays on your device. Nothing is uploaded, collected or tracked.

Take a breath, pick a memory, and slide it back into place.

name: Montreal Casino Cabaret Nights
description:
Choose the night by what catches your attention first: the artist, the date, the style, or simply the feeling of the show. Browse upcoming performances, open detailed event pages, compare several shows side by side, and discover which one feels right for your plans.

Once the performance is picked, the rest of the visit becomes easier to shape. Explore available venue services, browse menu items, save favorites, review selected dishes and their total, and keep a personal loyalty code close at hand. Reward points and available benefits make every visit more engaging and convenient.

Useful information is never buried behind complicated menus. A dedicated Q&A area brings together answers about performances, tickets, venue services, dining, rewards, and practical visit details, helping you plan with less searching and more confidence.

name: Moodpuff: Mood Tracker & Diary
description:
Moodpuff is a calm, private mood diary. Each day, pick one of five little puffs — Awful, Low, Okay, Good or Amazing — and in a few seconds you've captured how today felt.

Want more? Tag what you did, who you were with, how you slept and what the weather was like. Add a short note and a photo. Over weeks and months, Moodpuff shows you what lifts your mood and what weighs it down.

TRACK YOUR MOOD IN SECONDS
• Five friendly moods, one tap each
• Tag feelings, people, hobbies, health, sleep, weather and life events
• Add a note and a photo to remember the day
• Fix or fill in past days any time

SEE YOUR PATTERNS
• Monthly calendar full of mood puffs
• Mood flow chart and mood mix for every month
• Weekday patterns: find your best and hardest days
• Which activities show up on good days vs hard days
• Your whole year in moods, plus month-by-month averages

YOUR DIARY
• A timeline of every day you've logged
• Search notes and activities, filter by mood
• Gentle daily reminder at the time you choose
• Light and dark appearance

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No servers, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Everything you write is stored only on your iPhone — even the developer can't see it.

MOODPUFF PLUS (OPTIONAL)
Everything above is free. Moodpuff Plus adds:
• App lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
• CSV import — bring your history from another app or a spreadsheet
• CSV export — open your diary in Numbers, Excel or Google Sheets

Plus is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in your Apple ID account settings.

Moodpuff is a personal journal, not a medical device, and doesn't diagnose or treat any condition. If you're struggling, please reach out to someone you trust or a local support line.

Made by one independent developer. Questions or ideas? imranli@vusal.me

Terms of Use: https://vusal.me/moodpuff/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://vusal.me/moodpuff/privacy/

name: MOONRAVEL
description:
You do not move the hero. You move the Moon.

Every tree, column and statue casts a shadow, and in this world a shadow is cloth. Lay it over a chasm and it holds Knot, a small creature made of silver thread, all the way across.

Drag the Moon left or right and the shadows swing. Lower it and they stretch. One Moon lights everything, so placing one shadow moves all the others.

Pin a shadow with a stitch and it stays where it is while you turn the Moon again. But the thread comes from the Moon itself: each stitch makes it thinner and every loose shadow shorter.

Where two shadows cross, they twist into a knot you can climb. Stitch the shadow of a stone wolf, owl or bear and its spirit wakes, runs, flies or pushes to open the way.

- 36 hand-made puzzles across three worlds: Whispering Grove, Broken Ruins and the Hall of Spirits
- A silver moth hidden on most levels for those who look further
- Unlimited undo and restart, no timers, no lives
- Gentle hints on the first levels, no text tutorials
- Embroidered art, calm and quiet

name: Mop: Phone Cleaner
description:
Mop is a storage cleaner for iPhone. It finds duplicate photos, similar shots, large videos, screenshots and other clutter, and you pay once to clear it. No subscription.

WHAT MOP FINDS
• Exact duplicate photos and videos, with the best copy kept
• Similar photos and bursts, grouped for you to choose from
• Large videos and large photos, biggest first
• Screenshots, screen recordings, blurry photos and Live Photos
• Duplicate contacts, old calendar events and completed reminders

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan your photo library for free and see everything Mop found.
2. Review each set side by side, or swipe through one at a time.
3. Confirm. Deleted photos and videos go to Recently Deleted, where iOS keeps them for up to 30 days.

You can also compress large photos and videos instead of deleting them, keep Live Photos as stills, and move private photos into a vault behind Face ID. Home and Lock Screen widgets show storage and battery.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Mop works on your iPhone and does not upload your photos. No account, no ads, no tracking.

ONE PAYMENT
Scanning is free. A single purchase unlocks cleaning and the vault for life. No subscription, and no trial that renews.

GOOD TO KNOW
Only exact copies are selected for you. Similar photos are never selected automatically. Mop cannot clear System Data or other apps' caches; no App Store app can.

Help: team@embelabs.xyz

name: More About: Post Everywhere
description:
More About posts your photos and short videos to all your social accounts at once. Pick a reel or up to 10 photos from your phone, turn photos into a collage, a seamless panorama or a slideshow video, write one caption, choose where it goes, and post it now or schedule it for later.

ONE POST, EVERY PLATFORM
Send the same photo or vertical video to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, X and Threads in one go. The caption counter knows each platform's limit, and platforms that can't take what you picked (YouTube Shorts is video only) step aside on their own.

POST NOW OR LATER
Schedule a week of posts in a few minutes. Times follow your own time zone, and the queue shows what goes out today, tomorrow and later, with each platform's result as it lands.

CUT FROM A LONGER VIDEO?
Name the YouTube video a reel came from and each caption gets a "Full video" line: a link where links work, the video's title where they don't. Once the Short is up, one tap opens YouTube Studio to make it the Short's Related video.

DRAFTS FROM YOUR AI ASSISTANT
Assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Cursor can stage posts for you through More About. They wait as drafts until you approve them here.

SEVERAL BRANDS, ONE ACCOUNT
Run a page for each business or brand and switch between them. Each page has its own connected accounts and queue.

YOUR LINK-IN-BIO PAGE
Every account comes with a moreabout.us page for your links, music, videos and gallery, edited on the website.

Scheduling to social accounts is part of the Gold and Diamond plans.

Questions? support@moreabout.us

name: Mournvale
description:
Three hundred years ago the Sundering Bell rang, and Mournvale has lived in dusk ever since. Now eight factions ride for the Bell Crown forged from that bell. Lead one of them.

Mournvale is a turn-based strategy game of heroes, towns and hex battles, painted in ink and candlelight and built for a phone: a turn takes minutes, and nothing is hidden from you.

RIDE THE DUSK
Explore a painted country of gallows roads, barrows, mines and drowned chapels. Tap a square to see the path, the cost and what waits there, down to the guard's exact count and a forecast of the fight. Claim mines, lift relics from behind their guards, and stop at wayside sites where a blind seer, a relic pedlar or a plague cart offers you a choice with a price.

BUILD A TOWN THAT MEANS SOMETHING
One structure a day. Walk the painted town and choose between works that shut each other out: the Sawpit or the Stoneyard, the Muster Yard or the Counting House. Raise creatures at each week's vigil, hire a second hero at the tavern, and brace for the Long Night, when the barrows swell.

BATTLES WITH EVERY NUMBER ON THE CARD
Fight on an eleven-by-nine hex field. Before you commit, the card shows the damage, the kills and the blow coming back. Flank a stack for extra damage, spend each unit's feat at the right moment, and use cover, fog and consecrated ground. Auto-resolve shows the exact losses before you accept.

DREAD, NOT DICE
Every army carries dread in place of morale and luck. It rises with losses and falls at shrines. Too much, and your soldiers break and flee, or frenzy and strike twice. The dead and the clockwork feel none of it.

EIGHT FACTIONS
The Vigil, the Hollowed, Ashwold, the Foundry Guilds, the Pestilent, the Masquerade, the Drowned and the Kindled, each with its own creatures, spells and town. Heroes level along a lattice of skills and swear one oath in their lives.

PLAY YOUR WAY
New Game against one to five rivals, each with its own temper. A fresh chapter every week. Hot-seat for two or more on one device. Every move can be undone until the day ends.

FREE, AND YOURS
The whole game is free: no ads, no in-app purchases, no energy timers, no account. Mournvale plays offline and saves your war as you go.

name: Mouvra
description:
Το Mouvra είναι ένας πιο ήσυχος τρόπος να μάθεις κίνηση.

Γνώρισε έμπιστους τοπικούς δασκάλους για δια ζώσης μαθήματα και συνέχισε τη δουλειά έξω από την αίθουσα με ένα χρονόμετρο πρακτικής και ένα ιδιωτικό ημερολόγιο που θυμάται τι ανακαλύπτει το σώμα σου.

ΒΡΕΣ ΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΛΛΗΛΗ ΑΙΘΟΥΣΑ
• Εξερεύνησε μια επιμελημένη ομάδα μεντόρων της Αθήνας σε σύγχρονο χορό, τάνγκο, καποέιρα, τζαζ, πολεμική ροή και street.
• Σύγκρινε την προσέγγιση κάθε μέντορα, το στούντιο, την εμπειρία, το κόστος και τη διαθεσιμότητα.
• Διάλεξε μέρα, ώρα, στόχο και ένταση και κράτησε τη συνεδρία στο προσωπικό σου πλάνο.
• Δες τον χάρτη του στούντιο και τις πρακτικές οδηγίες άφιξης πριν ξεκινήσεις.

ΕΞΑΣΚΗΣΟΥ ΜΕ ΚΑΘΑΡΗ ΠΡΟΘΕΣΗ
• Προσάρμοσε δουλειά, ξεκούραση και γύρους ώστε το χρονόμετρο να ταιριάζει στη δεξιότητα.
• Ξεκίνα από έτοιμες πρακτικές για footwork, αργή ροή, συνδυασμούς ή επαναφορά ανάσας.
• Δες με μια ματιά τη φάση, τον γύρο και τη συνολική πρόοδο της συνεδρίας.
• Ακολούθησε απαλές οδηγίες κίνησης και νιώσε κάθε αλλαγή φάσης με προαιρετική δόνηση και ήχο.
• Οι ολοκληρωμένες και οι μερικές συνεδρίες αποθηκεύονται με διάρκεια, γύρους και ένταση, κάνοντας την πρόοδο ορατή.

ΕΝΑ ΗΜΕΡΟΛΟΓΙΟ ΠΟΥ ΑΝΟΙΓΕΙΣ ΜΟΝΟ ΕΣΥ
• Κατέγραψε συνδυασμούς, απορίες, έμπνευση, διάθεση και την κατεύθυνση που θέλεις να εξερευνήσεις.
• Βρες σημειώσεις γρήγορα με αναζήτηση, φίλτρα προόδου, ετικέτες και καρφιτσώματα.
• Οι σημειώσεις κρυπτογραφούνται με AES-256 στο iPhone σου. Το κλειδί κρυπτογράφησης φυλάσσεται στο Keychain του iOS.
• Άνοιξε το ημερολόγιο με τον ιδιωτικό σου κωδικό ή το Face ID. Το Mouvra το κλειδώνει ξανά όταν η εφαρμογή φεύγει από τα χέρια σου.

ΙΔΙΩΤΙΚΟ ΑΠΟ ΣΧΕΔΙΑΣΜΟ
• Δεν χρειάζεται λογαριασμός.
• Χωρίς SDK διαφημίσεων.
• Χωρίς παρακολούθηση μεταξύ εφαρμογών.
• Κρατήσεις, ιστορικό πρακτικής, σημειώσεις και προτιμήσεις μένουν στη συσκευή σου.
• Σαφείς πληροφορίες απορρήτου μέσα στην εφαρμογή και επαναφορά τοπικών δεδομένων με ένα βήμα.

Είτε επιστρέφεις στην κίνηση είτε βελτιώνεις μια φράση που ξέρεις χρόνια, το Mouvra κρατά το επόμενο μικρό βήμα κοντά σου.

name: MovPlayer - 軽量動画プレイヤー
description:
MovPlayer は、iPhone・iPad に保存した動画を軽快に再生する動画プレイヤーです。
ファイルアプリの動画を「常にこのアプリケーションで開く」に設定すれば、タップするだけで起動して再生。前回の続きから、そのまま見られます。

■ 主な機能
・続きから再生
再生位置を自動で記憶。次に開いたときは少し戻ったところから再生します。最後まで見た動画は最初から再生されます。

・最近見た動画
サムネイルと進み具合のバー付きで一覧表示。見ていた場面がひと目でわかり、見たい動画にすぐ戻れます。

・お気に入りと連続再生
動画をお気に入りボタンで登録。お気に入りは追加順に連続再生でき、合計時間も表示されます。前の動画・次の動画への移動は、ロック画面やコントロールセンターからも操作できます。

・片手で操作しやすいジェスチャ
画面の左右をダブルタップで10秒戻し・10秒送り。長押しの間だけ2倍速になり、離すと元の速度に戻ります。

・再生速度とループ
0.5倍から2倍の再生速度を切り替えられます（音程はそのまま）。1本のループ再生にも対応。

・画面表示の切り替え
動画全体を表示する「全体」と、画面いっぱいに表示する「いっぱい」をワンタップで切り替え。

・ピクチャ・イン・ピクチャとバックグラウンド再生
他のアプリを使いながら再生を続けられます。AirPlay、字幕・音声トラックの切り替えにも対応。

・iCloud Drive の動画にも対応
iCloud にある未ダウンロードの動画も、開くと自動でダウンロードして再生します。

■ こんな方に
・ファイルアプリに保存した動画を、ストレスなく見たい
・長い動画を、いつでも続きから見たい
・お気に入りの動画を、続けて流しっぱなしにしたい

動画の再生は端末内で行われ、アカウント登録は不要です。
対応形式: mov / mp4 / m4v など、iOS が標準で再生できる動画

name: Mox: Countdown Widget
description:
Mox puts the days until the trip, the birthday or the big day right on your Home Screen, in big, beautiful numbers.

No ads. No account. Nothing to sign up for. Your countdowns stay on your iPhone.

A WIDGET FOR EVERY COUNTDOWN
• Add Mox from the widget gallery on your Home Screen. Mox shows you how, step by step.
• Each widget follows whatever comes next, or holds one countdown: touch and hold it, tap Edit Widget and pick.
• Small, medium and large sizes. The large one shows a countdown and the next three after it.
• Widgets update on their own, and Mox itself follows your iPhone's light or dark mode.

MADE TO BE LOOKED AT
• Give each countdown an emoji and a colour.
• Dress the widget in a solid colour, a gradient, your own photo, or one of sixteen backgrounds drawn for Mox: snow nights, sunset seas, aurora, confetti and more.
• Choose the number font, text colour and where the number sits. Mox warns you when text gets hard to read on a busy photo, and offers a fix.

COUNTS YOUR WAY
• Days, weeks, months, years, workdays, or down to the minute.
• Call them "sleeps" if that's what they are.
• Repeat every year, month or week, or every few days, for birthdays, anniversaries and paydays.
• Keep counting up after the day, if you like.

REMINDERS THAT ARRIVE
• A reminder on the day itself.
• Reminders minutes, hours, days or weeks ahead, so you can actually get the gift.
• Reminders are scheduled on your iPhone. Nothing is sent from a server.

QUICK TO SET UP
• Add a countdown in seconds, with a live preview of the widget as you type.
• Quick add for the holidays coming up in Canada or the US.
• Import events from your calendar. Mox reads it only when you ask, and never changes it.

SHARE IT AS A PICTURE
• Turn any countdown into an image and send it to whoever's counting with you. No link, no sign-up.

FREE, AND PRO ONCE
Mox is free to use for up to 3 countdowns, with the small widget, emoji and colours, holiday quick add, sharing, and a reminder on the day.

Mox Pro is one payment, not a subscription. It unlocks:
• Unlimited countdowns
• Medium and large widgets
• Photos, gradients and the background gallery
• Number fonts, text colour, number position and your own labels
• Weeks, months, years, workdays and exact time
• Repeating countdowns, and counting up after the day
• Reminders ahead of the day
• Import from your calendar

The price is shown in your currency before you buy. Pro restores on any iPhone signed in to the same Apple Account. If Pro is ever refunded, nothing you made is deleted; it goes back to the free look.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Mox has no ads, no analytics and no account. Your countdowns, photos and calendar never leave your iPhone. The app sends only anonymous crash reports, so we can fix bugs, and an anonymous check of whether you've bought Pro. Read the privacy policy at getmox.app/privacy.

Made in Canada by Longarm Software Inc. Questions or ideas: support@longarmsoftware.com

name: Mr G's Uno
description:
Mr G's Uno is a vibrant, inclusive, and completely screen-reader-friendly Uno card game built for everyone.

KEY FEATURES:
• Play Solo vs Computer Bots: Add up to 9 computer bots (up to 10 players total) with randomized names, or remove bots anytime before dealing.
• Online Multiplayer: Host public rooms or password-protected private games for 2 to 10 players. Search open lobbies, add friends by gamer name or location, and invite players via in-app notifications or your device's share sheet.
• Built for VoiceOver & Accessibility: High-contrast colourblind-friendly cards with clear symbols and labels, live announcements for turns and action cards, and 2-finger double-tap (Magic Tap) to call UNO—with zero competing extra TTS.
• Rich Sound Effects & Action Voices: Animated card shuffling and dealing with realistic card sounds and announcer callouts for Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, Wild Draw Four, and UNO.
• Persistent Login & Resume: Stay signed in across launches and resume open games anytime.

name: Mū Tōrere
description:
Mū Tōrere is a traditional strategy game of the Māori, the Indigenous people of New Zealand. You can learn the rules in a minute; mastering them takes patience.

The board is an eight-pointed star: eight points and a centre. Each player has four pieces and only one point is ever empty. On your turn, move a piece into that empty point. Leave your opponent with no legal move and you win.

FEATURES
• Three computer levels: Easy, Medium and Hard. Hard plays perfectly. Can you hold a draw?
• Two-player games on one phone.
• Daily challenge: everyone plays the same opponent from the same position each day. Match par, collect stars and keep your streak going.
• The last 30 challenges in the archive.
• Statistics and 14 achievements.
• Six board themes unlocked through achievements.
• English and Turkish.

No ads, no accounts, no internet needed. Your progress stays on your phone.

name: Mùa Lúa Chín: Village Farm
description:
Head back to the countryside! Plant rice, raise water buffalo, dry the harvest in the sun, wrap Tết rice cakes and build up your village in Mùa Lúa Chín ("Ripe Rice Season"), a relaxing farm game full of the charm of rural northern Vietnam.

PADDIES, GARDENS AND FISH PONDS
- Grow rice, sticky rice, fragrant rice and black sticky rice; water spinach, corn, sweet potato, peanuts, sugarcane, watermelon, tea, turmeric, sedge…
- Orchards of banana, mango, coconut, pomelo, lychee, longan, persimmon, orange, jackfruit and areca.
- Raise chickens, ducks, pigs, buffalo, cows, goats, bees and silkworms; dig ponds for tilapia, carp, river prawns and eels.
- Swipe across a row of fields to harvest or sow them all at once, or use Harvest all and Replant for the whole farm.
- Everything keeps growing while the game is closed, with a reminder when it is ripe.

A REAL LUNAR CALENDAR
- The game follows the Vietnamese lunar calendar: 24 solar terms, each with a farmer's proverb.
- Spring, summer, main and winter crop seasons: in-season crops grow faster.
- Changing weather: rain speeds up crops, a dry spell needs the pump station or the village well.
- Moonlit nights: the village darkens with your clock and the moon follows the real lunar calendar.

DRY THE RICE BEFORE IT RAINS
- Spread the harvested rice on the brick yard to dry for a bonus.
- Dark clouds coming? Pull the tarp over it before the rain soaks it!

FESTIVALS ALL YEAR
- Lunar New Year, the first full moon, the spring village festival, Đoan Ngọ, the seventh-month full moon, Mid-Autumn and the New Rice festival arrive on their real lunar dates.
- Each brings festival orders and decorations you can't buy anywhere: a Tết pole, a star lantern, a bamboo swing, a rice mortar…
- Weekly events: a new theme every week, 5 reward milestones and a weekly leaderboard with prizes for the top 30.

RIVER FISHING
- Tap the river, watch the float and strike.
- Fishing race: harder fish score more, with a new leaderboard every week.

CRAFTS AND THE VILLAGE MARKET
- Mill rice, wrap bánh chưng, bake rice crackers, make peanut candy, fish sauce, tofu, roasted tea and dried persimmons, reel silk and weave sedge mats.
- Fill villagers' orders and daily specials; sell spare goods to other players at the market.

BUILD A NEW VILLAGE
- Upgrade from a thatched hut to a garden villa, and build homes for your grown-up children.
- Build the village well, gate, concrete road, pump station, kindergarten, clinic, market and communal house, each with a lasting bonus.
- Buy more land, up to 36 plots, and decorate with bamboo fences, brick paths, bougainvillea, lotus ponds and apricot blossoms.

NEIGHBOURS
- Visit other players' farms on the region map and help them harvest for a reward.
- Or sneak a few vegetables, but watch out for the scarecrow and the guard dog!
- World chat with farmers everywhere, with report and block.
- Leaderboards, achievements and titles.

VILLAGE MEMORIES
- Every milestone opens a painted memory: the first harvest, the rice cakes on New Year's Eve, the village market, a letter from a child in the city…

A LIVELY VILLAGE
- Villagers carry baskets on shoulder poles, cycle with flowers, a boy rides a buffalo playing his flute and a duck herder drives his flock down the road.
- Farmers plant rice and hoe the beds; hens lead their chicks, ducks swim on the lotus lake and boats sail the river.

Plays offline. Optional Sign in with Apple or Google saves your farm to the cloud and lets you meet neighbours.

SHOP (OPTIONAL)
- Starter Pack: coins, +50 storage, 10 Instant Finish tickets, a lotus pot and a lantern arbor.
- Laterite Cellar: its own building with +250 storage, upgradable with coins up to 3000.
- 30-day Farmer Card: 5 free Instant Finishes a day, +20% coins on orders, doubled login gifts.
- Remove Ads: turns off interstitial ads.

Free to play, fully playable without paying. Contains ads; many are optional and give rewards.

The game is in Vietnamese.

Support: trungsmail@gmail.com

name: Můj Basketball
description:
Můj Basketball je aplikace pro hráče, rodiče, trenéry i fanoušky českého basketbalu. Najdete v ní rozpisy, výsledky a tabulky všech soutěží České basketbalové federace – celostátních i krajských, od dospělých až po nejmladší minižactvo.

SLEDUJTE SVÉ TÝMY
• Označte hvězdičkou týmy, které vás zajímají – klidně z různých klubů a kategorií.
• Kalendář ukáže všechny jejich zápasy na jednom místě: datum, čas, hala a výsledek.
• Úvodní obrazovka připomene nejbližší zápas vašeho týmu.

VŠECHNY SOUTĚŽE ČBF
• Celá ČR i všechny kraje, muži i ženy, dospělí a mládež U19 až U10.
• Výsledky po kolech, program zápasů a aktuální tabulky.
• Play-off zobrazené jako pavouk.

HLEDÁNÍ KLUBU
• Napište název klubu nebo města a uvidíte všechny jeho týmy napříč kategoriemi.

ZÁPASY A STATISTIKY
• Detail zápasu s výsledky po čtvrtinách.
• U soutěží se statistikami FIBA LiveStats i statistiky týmů a hráčů.

DALŠÍ
• Světlý a tmavý vzhled (podle systému).
• Volitelně novinky z RSS kanálu vašeho klubu.
• Bez registrace, nesbírá žádná osobní data.

Data pochází z veřejných dat České basketbalové federace (cz.basketball). Aplikace není oficiální aplikací ČBF.

name: MUMUKO
seller_name: ACARKENT FEN BILIMLERI MERKEZI EGITIM HIZMETLERI LTD STI
description:
MUMUKO World is an AI interactive story app for adults. Pick a story, step in as the lead, and write what you do next. The AI writes the scene that follows, with narration and characters who answer back.

PLAY THE LEAD
Every story opens with a scene and a cast of characters. Type your next move, an action or a line of dialogue, and the story continues from there. If a passage is not what you wanted, have it rewritten.

DISCOVER STORIES
Browse the stories on the Discover tab. Open one to read its introduction and meet its characters, then begin. Come back later to continue where you left off, or restart from the beginning.

CREATE YOUR OWN
Build a story with a cover, a name, an introduction, a background and an opening passage, and add your own characters. Creating a story is free. Once it passes review, it is published for other readers to play.

REPORT AND BLOCK
Stories are checked against our Community Guidelines. You can report any passage or story, and block any author so their stories no longer appear for you.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Stories are written by AI. Characters and events are fictional.
- MUMUKO World is for adults aged 18 and over.
- You sign in with an email address and a one-time code.
- Each AI reply uses crystals, the in-app currency. Crystal packs are sold as in-app purchases.

Terms of Service: https://mumuko.world/terms.html
Privacy Notice: https://mumuko.world/privacy.html

name: Muqeem – Prayer Times & Adhan
description:
Muqeem is a prayer-times app named after Prophet Ibrahim's dua: "My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer."

• Accurate times calculated on your phone from your location, elevation and your country's method.
• The full adhan on time, even on silent or Do Not Disturb: the Madinah adhan, a spoken announcement, the Muqeem tone, or vibrate only.
• A one-minute countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island before the adhan; stop it with one tap.
• A reminder 3 minutes before iqama, with official Jordan iqama times you can adjust.
• Fridays: Jumu'ah reminder 45 minutes before, and Surat Al-Kahf. In Ramadan: suhoor and imsak reminders.
• Qibla compass with a gentle buzz when you're aligned.
• Morning, evening, sleep and after-prayer adhkar from Hisn al-Muslim with a counter, plus a tasbeeh.
• Progress: track prayers, daily Quran pages and your khatma, with a small daily habit.
• Your own alerts, before or after any prayer or at set times.
• Nearby mosques with directions.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: next prayer, today's prayers, your day, adhkar, tasbeeh and your alerts.
• Arabic & English, light and dark themes.

Private by design: no accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your phone.

Muqeem Pro (optional): every colour, world city times, unlimited alerts, night prayer and weekly & monthly stats. A monthly or yearly subscription that renews automatically, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://nedalab.github.io/muqeem-privacy/

name: Music Shapes
description:
Music Shapes turns shapes into rhythms.

Every shape goes round once per bar and plays its sound at each corner. A triangle plays three evenly spaced hits, a square four, a pentagon five. Put shapes together and they play rhythms against each other: three against four, five against three, and anything else you can build. It's an easy way to make polyrhythms, and to see them.

MAKE A BEAT
• Shapes with 2 to 16 sides, each with its own sound and colour
• Rotate a shape to move its hits off the beat
• Mute any corner, or change its volume or pitch
• Tune each shape, and set the tempo from 60 to 200 BPM

66 SOUNDS
• Recorded drums and percussion
• Electronic drums, basses, keys, bells and effects
• Record your own with the microphone, or import audio files

MIX
• Volume, pan, mute and solo for every shape
• EQ, compressor, delay and reverb on every shape

SHARE
• Bounce up to 8 bars to a WAV file
• Or to a square video of your shapes playing

FREE
Every feature is free. No ads, no account and no subscription, and Music Shapes collects no data.

name: Mussio Media Player
description:
Play your local audio and video on iPhone. Import files once, then browse the collection by media type and play it offline.

On iPhone Duo, the compact display presents a single list. Open the wider inner display to browse in two columns. The mini player stays within reach while you browse.

Build playlists from songs and videos, drag items into order, and choose whether playback advances automatically. Adjust playback speed, skip interval and library sorting in Settings.

name: Must Be Cleaner: All Places
description: Love the feeling of a clean, fresh home, but don’t want to spend your entire weekend on chores? Build your own comfortable cleaning rhythm the app automatically shows when a quick room refresh is enough and when it’s time for a deeper clean or a load of laundry. With no complicated schedules or extra stress, you always have simple, clear steps for today, keep your cleaning supplies stocked, and enjoy a cozy, tidy home every single day.

name: Müteahhit Temelden Zirveye
description:
Bir arsa, küçük bir ekip ve büyük bir hayalle başla. Temelden zirveye bir inşaat ve holding imparatorluğu kur.

**İNŞAAT**
- Arsa al, proje tasarla, ruhsat çıkar, temelden çatıya inşaatı yönet.
- Şantiyeyi 3D izle: gerçek aşamalar, hava durumu, ekip ve makineler.
- Daireleri sat ya da kiraya ver; alıcılarla pazarlık et.

**ŞİRKET**
- Yönetim Merkezi: genel müdür, yönetim kurulu, yıllık hedefler ve departmanlar.
- Satın alma ve tedarik: tedarikçiler, pazarlık, sözleşme, depo ve stok.
- Makine parkı, operatörler, ikinci el pazarı ve kiralama.

**GAYRİMENKUL VE HOLDİNG**
- Portföy kur: kiracılar, depozito, bakım ve yenileme.
- Otel, AVM, restoran, tatil köyü ve site yönetimi işlet.
- Güneş, rüzgâr ve depolama ile enerji şirketi kur.
- Rakip şirketlere ortak ol, devral, iştiraklerini konsolide bilançoda yönet.

**İNŞAAT YARIŞI**
- Altyapı ihaleleri, rakip müteahhitler, ekonomik krizler ve fırsatlar.

Çevrimdışı oynanır, hesap gerektirmez. Tamamen ücretsiz, reklamsız ve uygulama içi satın almasızdır.

name: My BGD Wing
description:
My BGD Wing is the official companion app for BGD paragliders.

Add your wing by typing its serial number or scanning the QR code on its label, and the app finds the exact model, size and colour. From there, everything you need is one tap away.

YOUR WING
• Model details, specifications and the official manuals and line-length files
• Upgrades and spare parts from the BGD eshop
• Email BGD about your wing with its details already filled in

SERVICE
• Reminders before your next inspection, by date or by flight hours
• A service history with photos of your inspection sheets and repairs (with a free account)
• Approved BGD service centres and dealers near you

GLIDERS AND CLOTHING
• Browse the full BGD range of paragliders and flying clothing

ASK BGD
• Ask anything about your wing, from line care to trim. Answers come from BGD's own documents, and you can always reach a person.

SHARE YOUR FLYING
