• Send your best flying photos and videos straight to the BGD team

The app works without an account. A free account keeps your wings and service history safe across devices, and you can delete it at any time from the app.

name: My Codex
description:
A small robot. A world waiting to wake up.

Meet Codex, a little robot exploring a world reclaimed by nature. Among quiet ruins and forgotten machines, there are still people to help, stories to discover, and places worth bringing back to life.

Build a place to belong
Turn a struggling camp into a home. Gather supplies, build and upgrade facilities, manage food and water, and help survivors find their place. Every repaired building makes the camp a little more alive.

Follow the railway
Leave the camp and explore abandoned workshops, old railway carriages, overgrown buildings, and hidden corners of the city. Clear obstacles, search for useful materials, and uncover traces of the world that came before.

Bring old machines back to life
Solve circuit puzzles, fit electronic components, restore power, and open the way forward. Look closely at your surroundings: a forgotten device or a small clue can lead to the next discovery.

Meet the people behind the ruins
Help Aurora and the other survivors, welcome new residents, and get to know the travellers who visit your camp. Find moments of warmth and humour in a world learning to begin again.

Make every supply count
Collect materials, craft useful items, and improve Codex with modules. Decide what your camp needs next and prepare for the next journey beyond its gates.

My Codex combines story-driven exploration, camp construction and management, and hands-on puzzles in a detailed isometric world. Tap to interact, explore at your own pace, and help a small robot make a difference.

This is a single-player adventure. Progress is saved on your device.

name: My Home Booklet
description:
My Home Booklet keeps everything about your home in one place, so you're never digging through emails and drawers again.

WARRANTIES THAT REMIND YOU
Add your closing date and we fill in typical builder warranty dates (1, 2 and 10 years), then remind you before each one ends.

ISSUES WITH DATED PHOTOS
Log anything that needs fixing with dated photos, track it from reported to fixed, and send a ready-made report to your builder, warranty company, insurance or HOA.

YOUR HOME'S RECORDS
• Upgrades with photos and costs
• Contacts for your builder, warranty, insurance, HOA and pros
• Tests and inspections, like radon and mold
• A private records vault for reports, receipts and manuals
• Home facts: shutoffs, systems, paint colors and appliances

YOUR AGENT, ONE TAP AWAY
Found a home you like on Zillow, Realtor.com or a yard sign? Paste the link or type the address, pick a few times, and your agent sets up a private showing. You can also ask for a free home value report anytime.

SELLING?
Hand the buyer their own copy of the warranty details, home facts and upgrades you choose.

Your information is private to you, protected by a security code, and backed up every day.

name: My Sahn
description:
My Sahn connects you to your own masjid's prayer times, news and announcements — no account, no sign-up. Just enter the code your masjid shares with you (or scan its QR code) and the app becomes theirs: their name, their logo, their colours.

FEATURES

• Prayer timetable — Adhan and Iqama times for every prayer, browsable by day, with the next prayer always front and centre.
• Adhan reminders — an alert at each prayer time, with per-prayer toggles (e.g. Fajr and Maghrib only) and an Adhan-or-Iqama choice.
• News & announcements — stay up to date with what's happening at your masjid, with optional notifications.
• Qibla compass — find the direction of the Kaaba from wherever you are.
• Multiple masjids — pray at more than one place, or moved house? Connect to as many masjids as you like and switch between them.
• Choose your app icon — pick from 20 colours for the home-screen icon.
• Donate — a quick link to your masjid's own donation page, when they've set one up.

PRIVACY

My Sahn doesn't ask for your name, email or any personal details. See the full privacy policy at ilm-innovations.co.uk/pages/privacy-policy.

Is your masjid on Sahn but you don't have a code? Ask your masjid's admin — it's on their dashboard under "My Sahn App".

name: My Sunnah: Prayer, Quran & Dua
description:
My Sunnah is a daily Islamic companion: accurate prayer times, the Quran with translation and recitation, duas and dhikr, hadith and seerah, Qibla and nearby mosques, and gentle habit tracking. It is free, has no ads, needs no account, and keeps your data on your iPhone.

PRAYER TIMES
• Accurate times calculated on your device, with established methods (including Umm al-Qura, ISNA, Karachi, JAKIM, Kemenag and Diyanet) chosen for your country, or set manually
• Hanafi or Shafi'i Asr, and high-latitude rules for places where the sun sets late
• Start and end times for every prayer, plus Tahajjud, Ishraq and Duha, and the times when prayer is disliked
• Your mosque's Jamaat and Jumu'ah times, with a reminder of when to leave
• Prayer alerts with Adhan and other sounds, early reminders, and Time Sensitive delivery so they get through when it matters
• Focus Mode: a prayer-time alert that opens a calm full-screen pause

QURAN
• Read with translation beside each verse, or page by page in the IndoPak Mushaf
• Word-by-word meanings, tafsir notes and tajweed colours
• Listen to many reciters, keep playing in the background and on the Lock Screen, and download surahs for offline listening
• Hifz mode for memorisation, bookmarks, notes, and a khatm plan
• Pick up exactly where you stopped

DUAS AND DHIKR
• Duas organised by occasion, from Hisnul Muslim and more
• Morning and evening adhkar with reminders you choose
• Tasbih counter with targets, sound and vibration
• Ruqyah verses and the 99 Names of Allah with their meanings

LEARN
• Hadith collections with search, in Arabic with meaning and explanation
• The Seerah of the Prophet (peace be upon him) in organised chapters
• Hajj and Umrah guide, step by step

FIND AND EXPLORE
• Qibla compass
• Nearby mosques, sorted by distance, with directions in Maps
• Hijri calendar with Islamic observances

HABITS AND ROUTINES
• Track your five daily prayers and Sunnah habits, with streaks and a clear view of your day
• Daily, weekly, monthly and Hijri-date routines with reminders, plus ready-made templates
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: next prayer, countdown and the day's timeline

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics or tracking
• Your settings, progress and notes stay on your iPhone
• Location is used only to calculate prayer times and the Qibla; you can also set it by hand
• Password-protected backup file that you keep

EIGHT LANGUAGES
English, Bangla, Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, Turkish, Indonesian and Malay, with full right-to-left support.

May Allah make it a means of benefit for you.

name: MyDoughnut
description:
Are your daily choices helping you live well without costing the planet? MyDoughnut shows you, in one simple picture.

Inspired by the ideas of Doughnut Economics, MyDoughnut tracks 12 areas of your life. The inner ring covers your Life Needs: physical health, mental wellbeing, education, income, housing and community. The outer ring covers your Planet Impact: carbon footprint, energy, transport, waste, water and sustainable purchases. Stay in the green "safe and just space" between them: no shortfalls inside, no overshoot outside.

ONE-MINUTE DAILY CHECK-IN
Rate the areas that matter today from 1 to 5, and skip the rest. Your doughnut updates instantly. Red wedges show exactly where you're falling short or overshooting, and tapping any area gives you tips and ideas.

HABITS AND WEEKLY CHALLENGES
Build streaks with simple daily habits, and take on four new challenges every week, from walking instead of driving to buying local, cutting food waste or volunteering in your community.

IMPACT BUDGET
Log what you buy and see the cost and the estimated carbon side by side. Track your weekly budget, your carbon budget and how much of your spending goes to local, second-hand or eco-friendly choices.

LEVELS AND BADGES
Earn XP and grow from Seedling to Ecosystem. Unlock badges like Climate Champion, Waste Warrior, Community Builder and Healthy Human. Your progress is never lost.

APPLE HEALTH AND APPLE WATCH (OPTIONAL)
Connect Apple Health to fill in your scores automatically. Steps, exercise, stand hours, sleep, mindful minutes, time in daylight and walking or cycling distance all count, including data from your Apple Watch. Resting heart rate and heart rate variability are shown as gentle weekly trends for your awareness only. MyDoughnut only reads Health data and never shares it.

WIDGETS AND REMINDERS
See your doughnut on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, and tick off habits right from the widget. Optional reminders nudge you to check in, protect a streak or finish a challenge.

TRENDS
See how your weeks compare: your balance, Life Needs and Planet Impact over time, plus a good-week streak.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking, and your data is never sold.

MYDOUGHNUT PREMIUM
The full core app is free. Premium unlocks:
- Trends for 12 weeks, 6 months and 1 year
- Your best and worst area each month
- Personal goals: your own target for every area, plus step, exercise, sleep and active-travel goals

Premium is an auto-renewable subscription at £4.99 per month (or the equivalent in your local currency), with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Carbon figures are estimates to help you compare choices. MyDoughnut is not a medical device and doesn't provide medical, financial or legal advice. MyDoughnut is an independent app and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Kate Raworth or Doughnut Economics Action Lab.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy:https://github.com/adnanaltimeemy/MyDoughnutApp/blob/main/privacy.html

name: Myrmidons Vengeance
description:
Achilles is dead, and the dead will not lie still. As the last of his Myrmidons, descend through the dungeons, forests, and cliffs of Greek and Egyptian myth — from the shore of Troy and the Labyrinth of Knossos to the halls of Hades, the sands of Egypt, and the Twelve Hours of the Night.

• Survive relentless mythic hordes: your weapons strike automatically while you move, dodge, cast spells, and choose blessings from the gods.
• Grow stronger every run: wield spears, phalanx shields, lightning bolts, forged weapons, evolutions, active spells and techniques, and summon mythic companions to fight beside you.
• Face legendary bosses across 26 story stages and 2 secret stages: Hector, the Minotaur, the Hydra, Cerberus, the Sphinx, Apep, Typhon, and more.
• Unlock 29 playable heroes — from the Spartan Hoplite, Atalanta, Odysseus, and Heracles to Horus, Anubis, Bastet, Ra, Zeus, and Osiris — each with their own starting kit and growth.
• Play the Funeral Games between stages: march the host against bronze Talos, test your aim in first-person archery, and storm the ramparts of Tiryns.
• New procedural layouts, floor mysteries, hidden chests, and forge recipes every run.
• Plays completely offline in 20 languages. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.

The first six stages are free. Optional one-time purchases unlock the Full Saga (Acts I & II) as well as Act III and Act IV (Acts III and IV can also be earned through play by clearing the preceding act on Heroic difficulty).

name: Mystic Wish Solitaire
description:
Make a wish and see what the cards reveal!

Wish Cards is a mystical solitaire card game built around the 52-card cycle of destiny. Before each round, hold a wish in your mind and shuffle the deck. Draw cards in threes and guide every card into its rightful place across 8 destiny foundations. When all 52 cards find their home, your wish is granted!

HOW TO PLAY
• Make a wish and shuffle the 52-card deck to begin.
• Eight foundation slots sit on the table—two for each suit (Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades): one builds down from King (K), and the other builds up from Ace (A).
• Draw cards from the deck three at a time; playable cards glide smoothly into their matching foundations.
• Complete all 52 cards to unlock destiny—if a full cycle passes without a single move, destiny locks for this wish.

KEY FEATURES
• Mystical Table Atmosphere: Rotating astral geometry, floating stardust, and smooth 3D card animations.
• 8 Distinct Themes: Switch between Original, Classic, Summer, Winter, Ocean, Fun, Noir, and Chess—transforming both the table and card designs.
• Tactile Audio Feedback: Synthesized card shuffling, drawing, and placement chimes.
• Multi-Language Support: Play in English, Turkish, and many other supported languages.
• Universal Layout: Tailored for both portrait and landscape play on iPhone and iPad.

Shuffle the deck, trust your intuition, and discover what fate has in store for you!

name: Nacrehunt
description: Hunt target sea creatures on the reef. Play timed difficulty levels or endless mode; correct taps score, wrong taps cost points. Collect ten creatures in the album and unlock awards as you play. Scores are saved on a local leaderboard so you can review your best runs. Casual puzzle play, ready anytime.

name: Nanbaa Konte
description:
A 1 and a 3 are waiting around a corner. Can you land the 2 between them?

Rotate a falling piece to connect at least three numbers that go up or down one at a time. The path can turn corners and run in any of the four directions. When the blocks disappear, the ones above drop, giving you another chance to chain.

Race the clock in 90-Second Attack, where clearing blocks on three consecutive moves earns 150 bonus points. Or play Endless and take your time setting up a longer chain. Rainbow blocks can fill a missing number, and a bomb in a matching sequence clears the surrounding blocks.

An angel cheers you on and a little devil gives you warnings. You can preview both voices in the guide and toggle them on the title screen.

The game interface and character voices are in Japanese.
Character voices: VOICEVOX:雨晴はう and VOICEVOX:四国めたん.

name: Narrately: Text to Speech PDF
description:
Two ways to listen. Hear every word of a PDF, article, book or photo of a page, highlighted as it's read. Or hear just the gist first: a short brief made by Apple Intelligence right on your device.

Everything happens on your device. Your documents and the AI never leave it, there is no account, and listening is never limited. Your library syncs only through your own private iCloud.

LISTEN TO ANYTHING
• PDFs, EPUB books, Word files, text, Markdown, RTF and web pages
• Scan a page with the camera, then choose: listen now or summarize first
• Share any article from Safari or other apps, or paste text
• Skips page numbers, headers, footers and footnote marks for you

OR HEAR THE GIST
• Briefs in five lengths, from a quick take to a detailed summary
• Styles for papers, contracts, meetings, articles, book chapters and more
• Skim: a one-line gist for every chapter, then jump in where you like
• Listen to any brief with the same voices as the full text

ASK, AND HEAR THE ANSWER
• Ask a document a question and get an answer with the passages it came from
• Answers can be read aloud; tap a source to see it in the text
• Study tools: action items, quizzes, flashcards, key terms and questions to think about

HEAR IT IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• Translate and listen: read a document side by side in another language and hear the translation
• Translation runs on your device with Apple's translation languages

180+ VOICES, ABOUT 40 LANGUAGES
• Works with the voices built into your device, including Premium and Enhanced voices you download in Settings
• Read in your own Personal Voice, if you've made one
• A voice per language or per document, previews for every voice

STUDIO
• One place to make briefs, chapter gists, quizzes, flashcards and chats from your documents
• Everything you made, ready to open or listen to again
• Save a document or a chapter as an audio file for your own listening

READ ALONG
• Word-by-word highlighting; tap any word to start there
• Speed from 0.5× to 4×, with an optional gentle speed-up as you listen
• Focus sounds (soft rain, brown, pink or white noise) under the voice
• Outline, bookmarks, highlights, reading themes and an easy-reading layout

LISTEN ANYWHERE
• Keeps playing with the screen locked; Lock Screen, Control Center and AirPods controls
• Sleep timer and a listening queue
• Widgets, a Control Center control and Shortcuts
• On Mac: a full Mac app with menus, keyboard shortcuts and the Reader in its own window

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Documents and AI stay on your device; sync only through your own iCloud
• Face ID app lock

Briefs, Ask, Skim and study tools need a device that supports Apple Intelligence, with Apple Intelligence turned on, and a supported language. Without it, you still get the outline, keyword search inside documents and every listening feature. Translation is not available on Apple Vision Pro.

Read Aloud does not open DRM-protected books.
Privacy policy: https://adhavpavan.github.io/app-privacy-policy/readitaloud/

name: Narration Desk: Teleprompter
description:
Narration Desk is a teleprompter and voice recorder for speech practice, audiobook narration, cue cards, and presentation rehearsal.

Paste or upload a script and read it while you record audio. You set the scroll speed yourself. The script does not follow your voice, and the app does not add captions or a camera mirror.

Recording is 48 kHz, 24-bit WAV, saved on this device. While you record, the screen can stay clear, with just a timer and a level meter. Tap Mark clean when a section is done; the app keeps recording and transcribes that part in the background. Finish the take to get the rest of the transcript. You can retake a pass and, in Takes, stitch the versions you want to keep into one file.

Use it as a voice memo, a chapter recorder, or a place to rehearse. After a take, open the transcript, edit it if you need to, and use it as a script on the teleprompter.

Visual Story adds a voiceover on photos or short videos (up to three minutes) and exports a vertical 1080 by 1920 reel. While you talk, the original sound is muted so your voice is clear, and you do not need headphones. Pause and resume whenever you want. Let video play when you want the clip to run at full original volume while you stay quiet, then start talking again.

Recordings, transcripts, and reels stay on your iPhone or iPad unless you share them or save a reel to Photos. There is no account to create.

What this 1.0 version does not do: it does not scroll the script by listening to you, it does not burn in captions, and it does not include a teleprompter mirror or a green screen.

name: Nautica Fuorigiri Marine
description:
Porta Nautica Fuorigiri sempre con te. Consulta barche nuove e usate, motori, piedi poppieri e accessori, scopri le caratteristiche di ogni modello e richiedi informazioni al cantiere.

Se hai un’imbarcazione affidata a Nautica Fuorigiri, dopo il collegamento della tua scheda da parte del cantiere potrai consultare le tue barche, lo storico degli interventi, fotografie, documenti e aggiornamenti sui lavori. Puoi inviare richieste di intervento con foto, caricare documenti e gestire le informazioni e le scadenze disponibili nella tua area.

Anche chi non ha ancora una barca associata può registrarsi, esplorare la vetrina e richiedere un preventivo. I dati delle imbarcazioni sono riservati ai rispettivi clienti autorizzati.

Per informazioni e assistenza contatta Nautica Fuorigiri.

name: Navstar Workspace
description:
Navstar Workspace is de interne werkapp van Navstar B.V., voor medewerkers en genodigden van Navstar.

• Vandaag: je werk van vandaag in één overzicht.
• Mijn werk: al je taken met datum en prioriteit. Afhandelen met één tik.
• Taken maken voor jezelf of voor een collega.
• Chat, meldingen en alle andere onderdelen van de Werkplek, in de huisstijl van Navstar.
• Veilig: inloggen met je Navstar-account en daarna openen met Face ID.

Je hebt een account van Navstar nodig om de app te gebruiken.

name: Navtex Online
description:
Navtex Online brings NAVTEX maritime safety messages to your iPhone and iPad: navigational warnings, gale warnings, ice reports and search and rescue alerts, from coast stations around the world.

- Your sea area: choose one or more NAVAREAs on a map, or let your position pick the one you are in.
- Easy to read: every message in plain language, next to the original broadcast, with its positions on a map.
- Near you: show only the warnings within the distance you choose.
- Notifications: get a notification when a new warning for your area is broadcast.
- What is still in force: cancelled and withdrawn warnings are marked.
- No account, no ads, no tracking.

The messages come from navtex.online, which collects NAVTEX broadcasts from receivers around the world.

Not for navigation. Navtex Online is an aid: always check the official broadcast and your own NAVTEX receiver.

name: Neckwake: Posture Reminder
description:
Works only with AirPods Pro, AirPods Max, AirPods (3rd generation) and AirPods 4. Other headphones and 1st and 2nd generation AirPods don't report head movement.

Neckwake uses the motion sensors in your AirPods and reminds you when your head hangs forward for too long, at your desk and while walking. No looking at your phone, no camera: you hear a soft two-note chime, a short voice prompt or get a silent notification, and straighten up.

HOW IT WORKS
• Calibrate once: stand against a wall for ten seconds, done.
• Put in your AirPods and work as usual. If your head stays beyond the limit for longer than you set, the app reminds you, and keeps reminding you until you are upright.
• Works with the screen locked and while music plays. Music only dips briefly.
• Two modes: Desk reacts quickly and suggests a walking break after 50 minutes, Walking measures more calmly so your steps don't get in the way.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• A ring shows what percentage of your measured time you were upright.
• The day strip shows every quarter hour: upright, tilted or not measured.
• History shows the week and the month and compares with the period before.

YOUR CHARACTER
A giraffe, a shrimp, a rooster or a person shows your posture live: the giraffe lets its neck droop when you slouch.

YOUR PACE
You set how fast the reminder comes, from how many degrees of tilt it counts, and how often it repeats.

PRIVATE
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your measurements stay on your iPhone.

FAIR
Try Neckwake for free: 3 hours during which your AirPods are connected and the app measures your posture. After that, unlock it once, no subscription, with Family Sharing.

Note: Neckwake is not a medical device and does not replace medical advice. If you have pain, talk to a doctor. If you have neck or spine problems or an injury, talk to a doctor before using the app and stop if you feel pain or dizziness. Always pay attention to your surroundings when walking.

name: Neon Pawn: Totally Legit
description:
Welcome to Station K-09, the shadowy orbital crossroads where megacorporations, rebel insurgencies, crime syndicates, and cybernetic outlaws collide. In the neon-drenched alleys of the underground black market, you have just acquired a pawn shop counter. Your official motto? "Everything is totally legit." 

Your reality? Nothing here is ever quite what it seems.

Neon Pawn: Totally Legit is an immersive cyberpunk pawn shop and appraisal simulation. Step behind the counter to inspect exotic sci-fi tech, haggle with eccentric orbital denizens, detect counterfeit devices, sweep for hidden cyber-chips, expose rogue AI mimics disguised as human customers, and stash hot contraband into a lead safe before Security police break down your door!

100% AD-FREE & FULLY OFFLINE:
No annoying popups, no banner ads, no forced commercial breaks, and no constant internet connection required. Pure, uninterrupted retro cyberpunk management right in your hands!

KEY GAMEPLAY FEATURES

4 DISTINCT SPECIALIZATION PATHS
Choose your background when starting your shop, each granting specialized appraisal perks, unique starting gear, and strategic market advantages:
• Hawkeye Appraiser: Sharp instincts that highlight suspicious weight, altered serials, and hidden internal capsules.
• Hacker Forger: Master of counterfeit tech who can alter stolen serials, forge authentic manufacturer holograms, and re-engineer chips.
• Water Baron: Corner the vital liquid market in a polluted orbit, refining contaminated coolant into liquid gold.
• Gunrunner: Weapon modification specialist dealing in heavy servos, pulse rifles, and custom military hardware for rebel operatives.

HIGH-PRECISION FORENSIC INSPECTION TOOLS
Every item brought to your counter carries a secret history:
• Visual Appraisal: Study 32-bit handcrafted retro pixel art for subtle aesthetic anomalies.
• UV Fluorescence Scanner: Sweep ultraviolet beams over item chassis to reveal glowing "STOLEN" serial stamps filed off by thieves.
• Spectrum Probe: Charge and analyze internal circuitry waveforms to detect counterfeit knockoffs or uncover hidden high-value military chips.

ROGUE AI DETECTION & ALARM SYSTEM
Customers are not always human! In an era of android infiltration:
• Sweep your UV scanner across the eyes of suspicious customers.
• Catch the glowing red ocular glitch code [0xDEAD] indicating an illegal Rogue AI Mimic!
• Slam the Emergency Alarm to notify Security forces, collect hefty government bounties, and clean the station!

NIGHT WORKSHOP PROGRESSION
Close the shutters at night to run your backroom laboratory:
• Crafting & Smelting: Combine raw industrial scrap, rare ingots, and cyber eyes into coveted high-tier merchandise.
• Laundering & Polishing: Cleanse dirty serial numbers, polish scuffed relics, and forge legit authenticity certificates.
• Underground Wholesale: Buy surplus crates from mysterious night couriers to stock up for tomorrow's clientele.
• Debt Management: Pay off your crippling loan to the loan sharks before time runs out.

7 MULTIPLE ENDINGS & VIP FATE EPILOGUES
Your reputation with the Security Department, Megacorporations, and Rebel Resistance directly shapes the fate of K-09:
• Will you rise as a legit corporate tycoon, lead a cybernetic revolution, vanish into deep space, or end up locked away in an orbital penitentiary?
• Unlock permanent codex archives, rare item compendiums, and rich post-game story epilogues for all key characters.

MOBILE-FIRST DESIGN & FULL SCREEN ADAPTATION
• Specially tailored for iOS landscape touch controls with zero clutter.
• Full display safe-area support for Notch, Dynamic Island, and Home Indicator on all iPhone & iPad models.
• Lightweight, responsive, and battery-friendly 60 FPS gameplay.

Will you run an honest business or become the premier tech fence of the orbital underworld? The counter is open—take your seat!

name: Nest Guard: Idle Tower Defense
description:
A hen's nest stands in the middle of the meadow, and waves of foxes, crows, boars and a weasel boss come in from every side. Your hen shoots by herself; you choose the upgrades.

Spend corn during a run on damage, fire rate, range, health and regen. When the critters finally get in, the waves you reached pay coins for Workshop upgrades that stay for every run. Coins keep building up while you are away, for up to 8 hours.

Plays fully offline, in 11 languages. Play together, 2 to 4 players, on the same Wi-Fi or a hotspot, no internet needed. Research labs keep working while you are away.

Nest Guard shows ads between runs, offers videos for double coins, and sells optional purchases: Remove ads, a Coin doubler and a Starter pack.

name: NET
description:
NET är en lugn och minimalistisk logg för din dag. Ingen rörig app med tusen funktioner – bara tre symboler och en sida per dag.

– Notes: tankar, idéer och sådant du vill minnas
□ Events: möten och saker som händer vid en viss tid
○ Todos: det du ska göra

N, E, T. Därav namnet.

LOGGA PÅ SEKUNDER
Skriv, tryck retur, skriv nästa rad. Tryck på symbolen för att byta mellan anteckning, händelse och att göra – eller börja raden med "- ", "o " eller "[] ". Händelser får klockslag och längd med ett tryck.

FLYTTA ELLER STRYK
Det du inte hinner med markeras med >. Nästa dag bestämmer du: flytta det vidare eller stryk det. Vill du ha lite extra motstånd kan du kräva att uppgiften skrivs om innan den flyttas – ett enkelt sätt att fråga sig om den verkligen är värd att göra.

SYMBOLER SOM BERÄTTAR
○ blir ● när något är gjort. Händelser fylls i när de har varit. Det du har strukit syns som genomstruket. Du ser hela dagen med en blick.

DIN KALENDER, DIREKT I DAGEN
Koppla kalendern på din iPhone – iCloud, Google eller Outlook – och se dina möten direkt bland dagens rader. Händelser du skapar i NET kan sparas i kalendern.

PÅMINNELSER SOM HJÄLPER
• Planera dagen – en notis på morgonen
• Avsluta dagen – gå igenom det du inte hann på kvällen
• Innan händelser – välj hur långt innan du vill bli påmind

LUGN DESIGN
Svartvit, ren och byggd med iOS flytande glas. Fungerar lika bra i ljust som mörkt läge.

PRIVAT
Allt sparas lokalt på din iPhone. Inget konto, ingen spårning, ingen reklam.

name: NETCA Cano Partner
description:
NETCA Cano Partner là công cụ làm việc dành cho đối tác cano đã ký hợp tác với Nhà Bè Khánh Hào (Rạch Vẹm, Phú Quốc), dùng để báo đoàn khách đi cano cho Nhà Bè.

Đăng nhập bằng tài khoản do Nhà Bè cấp. App không có chức năng tự đăng ký.

Chức năng:
• Ghi một đoàn lên cano: tên đoàn, số khách, giá chuyến.
• Chụp hoặc chọn ảnh khách đi cano gửi kèm (không bắt buộc, tối đa 4 ảnh).
• Theo dõi từng đoàn trong ngày: chờ đi, đang đi, đã về.
• Nhắn trao đổi với Thu ngân và Tài công của Nhà Bè theo từng đoàn.
• Chốt quyết toán cuối ngày: số chuyến, số khách, tiền chuyến.

App không có quảng cáo và không theo dõi người dùng.

Chưa có tài khoản: liên hệ Nhà Bè Khánh Hào, 0774 029 983.
Vận hành bởi CÔNG TY TNHH NETCA.

name: Neural Oversight
description:
Neural Oversight is a daily newspaper for artificial intelligence. Every morning it reads dozens of trusted sources, picks the stories that matter, scores each one for risk from 1 to 10, and sets them out as a front page you can read in five minutes.

THE DAILY EDITION
• One edition each morning, numbered and dated like a paper.
• The lead story explained: what happened, why it matters and what to watch next.
• Stop press: the highest-risk story of the day, called out at the top.
• Headline size follows risk, so the page itself shows you where to look first.
• A risk outlook chart of the whole day at a glance.

THE WIRE
Every article the edition was built from, newest first. Filter by safety, ethics, regulation, research, tools or news, and search headlines.

CLIPPINGS
Keep the stories you want to come back to. They sync with your account on the web.

NEURAL OVERSIGHT PLUS
An optional monthly subscription that adds:
• Ask: put a question to the day's news and get an answer with its sources named.
• Watchlist alerts: follow companies, people and topics, and hear the morning one is in the edition.
• The archive: every edition, back to the first.
• The weekly edition: the week in one read.
• Trends, who's in the news and a regulation tracker.
• Your edition: the sections you choose lead your front page.
• Export any edition as a PDF.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.

MORNING NOTIFICATION
One notification when the edition is ready. Nothing else.

IPHONE DUO
Open the phone and the edition becomes a broadsheet, set in columns. Close it and you keep your place.

Every story links to the original article at its source. Summaries and risk scores are written by AI and can be wrong, so treat them as a guide to what to read, not a replacement for reading it.

ANY AGENT, ON YOUR SERVER

HOLD TO TALK

A KEYBOARD MADE FOR THE COMMAND LINE

TABS, FILES AND GIT CHANGES
Scroll the tab strip, long-press to reorder tabs, and swipe a pane sideways to switch. Browse the server's files and review git changes without leaving the app.

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
Nex is MIT licensed, with no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking. The same GPU-accelerated terminal runs on macOS, Linux, Windows and Android: jramirez-codes.github.io/nex

name: Norku
description:
Norku is a shoreline heritage guide for readers who want a coast to feel inhabited: its waterfront, its customs, and the flavor that comes off the sea. It is a calm atlas you can browse slowly, from a first look at a shore to the longer tale behind it, and then to a short path of three halts you choose yourself.

The Index opens onto coasts across the Mediterranean, the Caribbean, the Indian Ocean, the Pacific Rim, Southeast Asia, Atlantic Europe, the Middle East and North Africa, and the Americas. Amalfi, Bodrum, the Côte d’Azur, Dubrovnik, Ibiza, Barbados, Curaçao, Grenada, the Maldives, Mauritius, the Seychelles, Goa, Bora Bora, Okinawa, Palawan, Bali, Da Nang, Koh Samui, the Algarve, Cornwall, San Sebastián, Muscat, Essaouira, Acapulco, and Big Sur all sit in that same reading atlas. Each one carries a coast character of its own. You will meet lagoon ledges, coral rims, bluff inlets, port curves, and estuary gates, and you can narrow the Index to a single family of waters or keep every shore in view.

Shores gathers those families into wide sets, so the Mediterranean can be read beside the Caribbean, or a Pacific rim can be opened on its own. Step into a family and the locales are listed together, each with its country and its kind of coast. The pictures, names, and short portraits are there to help you recognize a place before you decide to read further.

Every destination holds two stories. Heritage follows the lived waterfront: ancient port custom, bazaar and song, seafaring handwork, isle caretaking, and the modest habits that make a shore feel occupied. Cuisine follows the flavor of the locale, from citrus conserve and cured haul to brine and shell work, spiced bazaar loaf, and woven shore cloth. On a coast you can open Heritage for the everyday tempo of the port and the people who tie the sea to handwork and hospitality, or open Cuisine for the ingredient, the hands that keep it, and the plate it becomes. The short portrait stays on the destination, and the longer reading stays one tap away, so you can move between a glance and a tale without losing the shore you started from.

Find is ready when a name, a custom, or a flavor is already in mind. Search looks across place names, shore families, coast characters, heritage, and specialties. Try a coast such as Amalfi, a word such as bazaar, or a custom you remember, and Norku returns the shores that fit. If nothing matches, the guide says so plainly and leaves you free to try another word.

When several coasts begin to belong together, sketch a shore path. A Shore Note holds three different halts, so the path stays short enough to remember. From a destination you can add that coast to the note, and on Plot you can see the three stops fill in, add another halt from the full atlas, or lift one out while the note is still open. Keep the Shore Note when the three stops feel right. Kept collects those paths. Open one later and the halts appear in order, with the culture and specialty that made each stop worth saving. In Norku a path is joined by meaning. If a note no longer belongs, the kept Shore Notes can be erased, and a new three-halt path can be sketched from the beginning.

You can also leave a name and a picture with the guide. Capture a photo, choose one from your photo library, or pick a shore picture already offered in Norku, then keep the identity you want to see on a later visit. Options holds a short introduction to the guide, help for writing to support@norku.app, a data notice, and the usage terms, so the practical reading sits beside the coasts instead of in a separate chore.

Norku is for unhurried attention. Study a shoreline, savor a locale, sketch three halts, and keep a Shore Note whose meaning is still there the next time you open the atlas.

name: NorziumElite
description: NorziumEliteUse this tool to record payments and scheduled refund dates, allowing you to track the total amount held at any given time on a timeline. Once a refund is processed, a single payment can be allocated across multiple deposits; if funds are withheld, they can be recorded as expenses upon confirmation. Stay on top of upcoming deadlines using a closing checklist and a refund calendar, while maintaining records of installment refund agreements, communication history, and supporting documentation. You can reconcile bank statements line by line—matching payments and refunds, identifying discrepancies, and saving the reconciliation results. Financial reports provide insights into held funds and turnover on a monthly or quarterly basis; you can also compare multiple deposits or forecast the peak capital commitment under various payment arrangements.

name: NostalgiaNes
description:
NostalgiaNes is a fast, accurate 8-bit console emulator with rewind, save states, cheats and a fully customizable on-screen controller. Three free homebrew games are included, and you can add your own game files.

FEATURES
- Rewind: lost a life? Rewind the game a few seconds and try again.
- Save states: 8 slots with screenshots plus autosave, so you continue where you left off.
- Fast forward with adjustable speed.
- Cheats: Game Genie codes and raw memory codes.
- Turbo A/B and A+B buttons.
- Light gun (Zapper) emulation by tapping the screen.
- PAL and NTSC video modes.
- Disk System (.fds) games with disk side switching (BIOS file required).
- Game controllers (MFi, Xbox, PlayStation) for 2 players, and hardware keyboards.
- Customizable on-screen controller: size and position of every button, separately for portrait and landscape, and a dynamic D-pad.
- Import games from the Files app, folders and ZIP archives (.nes, .unf, .fds).
- Export and import battery saves (.sav) and share save states.
- Screenshots to your photo library.
- Favorites, search, recently played and most played lists.

NO GAMES INCLUDED
Apart from the three included homebrew games, NostalgiaNes does not include or download any games. Play only games you own.

NOSTALGIANES PRO
The app is free with a small ad banner in the game list (never during gameplay). NostalgiaNes Pro removes ads and unlocks quick save, sound volume, smooth scaling, opacity and auto-hide of the on-screen controller, and unlimited fast forward and dynamic D-pad. Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://nostalgiaemu.app/lite_privacy.html

name: Notched Music
description:
Notched Music turns the songs you already love into "notched" music: music with a narrow band of sound removed around the pitch of your tinnitus.

Listening regularly to notched music is an approach that researchers have studied for tonal (ringing or whistling) tinnitus. The idea is simple: by leaving a gap at your tinnitus pitch while the music around it plays normally, the parts of your hearing next to that pitch keep getting exercised.

HOW IT WORKS
• Find your pitch: a guided five-minute listening test with headphones. You compare tones, narrow down the match, and confirm it across three rounds, with a check for the common octave mix-up.
• Notch your music: add songs from the Files app. Each one is processed on your iPhone with a one-octave notch centred on your pitch.
• Listen every day: a simple player with background playback, lock-screen and AirPods controls, folders, shuffle and repeat. One tap on Home picks up where you left off.
• Track your listening: daily minutes, a streak, and a 30-day chart against a goal you choose.
• Retest any time: if your pitch changes, your library can be re-notched to match.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There's no account and no sign-in, and nothing is uploaded. Your pitch results, listening history and music stay on your iPhone.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Works with music files you own (MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF and more). Apple Music and other streaming songs are copy-protected and can't be used.
• Headphones are recommended for both the pitch test and listening.
• Research on notched music is promising but mixed. The app includes plain-language summaries of the key studies.

Notched Music is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or cure any condition. Talk to a doctor or audiologist about your tinnitus, especially if it is new, in one ear only, or changing.

name: NoteMarker
description:
NoteMarker is a fast, distraction-free Markdown notebook built around a real native Git engine. Keep a full working copy of your notes on your iPhone, iPad, or desktop, edit completely offline, and sync cleanly whenever you're back online.

No proprietary cloud. No monthly sync subscription. Just plain Markdown files in a Git repository you own.

KEY FEATURES
- True Offline-First Git Sync: Powered by an embedded native libgit2 engine (not a fragile web wrapper). Commit offline on flights or trails, then pull, merge, and push when you reconnect.
- Works With Any Git Host: Connect via HTTPS to GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo, Gitea, or your own self-hosted Git server. Credentials are stored securely in the device Keychain.
- One-Tap 3-Way Auto-Merge: Edited the same note on two devices? NoteMarker merges disjoint edits automatically and offers a clean Auto-Merge preview for same-file conflicts, plus Keep Mine, Keep Theirs, and manual editing.
- Built for Real Writing: Clean editorial Light and Dark Ink themes, four bundled open-license writing fonts (JetBrains Mono, Inter, Literata, IBM Plex Mono), adjustable font size, Markdown formatting toolbar, and side-by-side Split View on iPad.
- Interactive Checklists: Tap Markdown checkboxes right in Preview to check off tasks and auto-save.
- Obsidian-Style Image Embedding: Insert images straight into an attachments/ folder with relative Markdown links, inline preview, and automatic cleanup of unused images when links or notes are deleted.
- Fast Title-First Search & Quick Capture: Jump straight to any note with relevance-ranked search or drop quick thoughts into your configured inbox folder.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
NoteMarker has no backend, no analytics, no ads, and no tracking. Your notes stay on your device and talk only to the Git repository you configure.

Built by Trailmarker Studios.

name: NotenGlow – Noten im Blick
description:
NotenGlow ist deine Notenübersicht für die Schule – schnell, übersichtlich und im leuchtenden Neon-Look. Du trägst deine Noten ein, NotenGlow rechnet deinen Schnitt aus. Alles bleibt nur auf deinem Handy.

DEINE NOTEN IMMER IM BLICK
• Gesamtschnitt und Schnitt je Fach auf einen Blick
• Verlauf als Grafik: Wirst du besser oder schlechter?
• Schriftlich und mündlich getrennt, mit Gewichtung

SO WIE AN DEINER SCHULE
• Notenpunkte (0–15), Noten mit Tendenzen (2+, 2−), Viertelnoten (1–2, 2,5) oder Dezimalnoten (2,4)
• Gewichtung als Verhältnis (z. B. 2 : 1) oder in Prozent
• Fertige Vorlagen: schriftlich + mündlich, Klassenarbeiten + Tests + mündlich, Sport Praxis + Theorie, nur Praxis und mehr
• Oder selbst gestalten: eigene Bereiche und Unterbereiche mit eigener Gewichtung

ZIEL-MODUS
• Lege fest, welche Note du im Zeugnis haben willst
• NotenGlow zeigt dir, was du in der nächsten Arbeit dafür brauchst

ALLES ZU EINER NOTE AN EINEM ORT
• Notiz zu jeder Note, z. B. „Klausur Nr. 1“ oder „2. mündliche Note“
• Gespräch & Rückmeldung: Was hat die Lehrkraft gesagt?
• Kopie der Arbeit: Foto scannen oder PDF hinzufügen

EINFACH SCHÖN
• Neon-Glow oder helle Ansicht
• Dezente Töne und kurzes Vibrieren beim Eintragen
• Beispieldaten zum Ausprobieren

DEINE DATEN GEHÖREN DIR
Kein Konto, keine Cloud, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Deine Noten, Fotos und Notizen werden nur auf deinem Gerät gespeichert.

HINWEIS ZU KI
Beim Programmieren der App wurde KI (Claude von Anthropic) als Hilfe genutzt. In der App selbst wird keine KI verwendet.

Entwickelt von Christian Henzler, Mathelehrer.

Fehler gefunden oder einen Wunsch? Schreib uns über henzler.cc/apps – wir antworten schnell.

name: NTP-STAG SeaWide Expo 2027
description: Expo brings together RV and marine customers, supplier partners, and NTP-STAG/SeaWide team members for education, certification, product discovery, and networking opportunities designed to strengthen businesses and support professional growth.

name: Nuke Keyboard
description:
Nuke Keyboard is a keyboard built for speed and accuracy.

A little more precision. A lot less work.

FAST
• Generous key reach, built for your thumbs, so more of your taps land where you meant them
• Haptic and sound feedback you can tune
• Quick Text: save the phrases you type all the time and drop them in with one tap
• A full emoji panel with skin tones, and a number pad

ACCURATE
• Smart autocorrect that learns the way you type
• Next-word predictions as you go
• Fix grammar, then review each change word by word
• Rewrite a sentence shorter, friendlier or more formal

DICTATION
• Hold to dictate and your words are turned into text on your iPhone
• The microphone is only on while you are dictating

PRIVATE
• Typing, autocorrect and dictation run on your iPhone
• Cloud proofreading is optional. Connect your own model and key, and nothing is sent anywhere until you do

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose the keyboard font, size and weight
• Choose your top row
• Try everything out in the app before you switch

SET UP
1. Open Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard and choose Nuke Keyboard.
2. Hold the globe key to switch to it.
3. Allow Full Access if you want the optional features that need it, such as your own cloud key.

name: Number Link - Connect Dots
description:
Connect each pair of matching numbers with a single line.
Just drag with your finger. Nothing complicated.

What you get

- No time limit. Think as long as you like
- Large squares and large numbers, easy to tap
- 175 puzzles across 7 levels, from a gentle 5x5 to a demanding 9x9
- Every puzzle has exactly one solution. You never have to guess
- No internet needed. Play anywhere
- No sign-up

How to play

1. Join each pair of matching numbers with one line
2. Lines never cross and never branch
3. The puzzle is solved when every square is covered

Stuck? A hint reveals one line at a time.
Undo works as many times as you need, so feel free to experiment.

name: numerology.life
description:
numerology.life — приложение для учеников школы астронумерологии.

• Видеоуроки и аудио в удобном плеере
• Материалы к урокам: методички PDF, таблицы

• Уведомления: задание проверено, открыт новый урок

name: Nut Madness: Color Sort Puzzle
description:
Nut Madness is a relaxing nut sort puzzle where you unscrew bolts, match colors and clear every board in smooth 3D. If you love color sort games, screw puzzles and nuts and bolts brain teasers, this is your next favorite puzzle game!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a nut to lift it, then drop it onto the bolt that matches its color.
• Sort every colorful nut onto the right bolt to complete the level.
• Plan each move carefully - one wrong nut sort can jam the board!

Easy to learn, hard to put down. Nut Madness blends the best of color sorting games and screw sort puzzles into one satisfying nuts and bolts challenge for puzzle fans of all ages.

GAME FEATURES
• Hundreds of Color Sort Levels: Every stage brings a fresh color match challenge, with difficulty that ramps up at a comfortable pace.
• Satisfying 3D Nuts and Bolts: Clean 3D visuals and smooth animations make every twist, tap and sort feel great.
• Powerful Boosters: Stuck on a tough level? Use Undo, Shuffle, Magic Wand or Key boosters to get unstuck and keep sorting.
• Skip Tricky Levels: Hit a wall? Watch a short ad to skip the level and keep your puzzle streak going.
• Fresh Themes: Unlock vibrant new backgrounds and settings as you climb the levels - every world sorts a little differently.
• Simple One-Tap Controls: Perfect for casual puzzle fans, quick breaks and relaxing sessions.
• Relaxing Puzzle Loop: A calming brain teaser, ideal for unwinding after a long day.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE NUT MADNESS
Whether you enjoy nut sort puzzles, screw sort games, bolt puzzles or classic color matching games, Nut Madness gives you a fresh take on the sorting genre. Twist, sort and solve your way through hundreds of nut and bolt puzzle levels, train your logic and planning skills, and enjoy that perfectly satisfying moment when every color finds its place.

Download Nut Madness now and become the ultimate nut sort and color sort puzzle master!

name: Nutrinaro: AI Calorie Diary
description:
Take a photo or type a meal name. Nutrinaro uses AI to estimate the portion, energy and nutrients and fills in the diary entry. Edit the estimates before saving or add details to a photo to refine them.

Follow your daily nutrition and hydration, set goals, optionally track caffeine, and see 7- or 30-day reports offline. AI estimates are approximate, require internet and a subscription, and are limited to 50 per day and 1,000 per calendar month. The manual diary is free.

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Objection: Sales Practice
description:
Practice the hardest part of sales out loud. Objection puts you on a live voice call with an AI prospect who pushes back with the objections you actually hear: too expensive, we already have a vendor, send me an email, now isn't a good time.

You talk. They answer in real time. They don't cave because you're friendly. They soften only when you handle it well: acknowledge the concern, find out what's really behind it, answer with something specific, and ask for a next step.

After every call you get a scored debrief:
- A score out of 100
- Whether you acknowledged, dug deeper, answered and asked for the next step
- Your weakest moment, and the exact line that would have worked better
- Filler words and how much of the call you did the talking

Built around your job. Tell Objection your role, your industry, what you sell, who you sell to and the objections that trip you up. Your prospects are built from that, so every rep is practice for a real call.

Short, daily reps. A call takes about three minutes. Track your scores and streak over time, and set a daily reminder if you want one.

Good for SDRs, BDRs, account executives, founders, recruiters and anyone who sells on the phone.

The prospect is an AI. Your voice is sent to ElevenLabs and the conversation is processed by Anthropic's Claude to play the prospect and score your call. Audio is not recorded. You can delete your transcripts anytime in Profile.

Subscription required. Objection Pro is $6.99 per week or $39.99 per year and unlocks unlimited practice calls and debriefs. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://objection-site.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://objection-site.vercel.app/privacy

name: Obsidianer 筆記學院
description:
本 App 為非官方學習資源，與 Obsidian（Dynalist Inc.）無隸屬關係。

想用 Obsidian 做筆記，卻不知道從哪裡開始？
Obsidianer 筆記學院用「滑卡片」的方式，帶你輕鬆認識 Obsidian 的每一個功能。每張卡片 30 秒看懂一個概念，有興趣就點進去，跟著互動課程一步步學會。

【滑卡探索】
像滑短影音一樣上下滑動，19 張功能卡片帶你快速認識 Obsidian：雙向連結、嵌入、標籤、屬性、關係圖譜、白板、每日筆記……每張卡片都有即時預覽，一看就懂。看到有興趣的，按愛心收藏起來慢慢學。

【循序漸進的課程】
6 個章節、19 堂小課，每課只要 5 分鐘：
• 認識 Obsidian：Vault、介面、命令面板
• Markdown 基本功：標題、粗體、清單、待辦、表格、Callout
• 連結的力量：雙向連結、反向連結、嵌入與區塊連結
• 整理你的知識：資料夾、標籤、屬性、進階搜尋
• 視覺化與效率：關係圖譜、Canvas 白板、每日筆記與範本
• 進階與工作流：外掛、同步與備份、PARA、卡片盒筆記法、MOC

【邊學邊練習】
課程內建 Markdown 編輯器，左邊打字、右邊即時預覽，支援雙向連結、嵌入、標籤、Callout 提示框與屬性。完成練習目標會自動打勾，學過的語法馬上就會用。

【小測驗】
每堂課都有小測驗與詳細解說，答對才算完成，學得更扎實。

【互動關係圖譜】
親手拖曳、縮放知識網路，完成的課程會亮起紫光，體驗 Obsidian 最迷人的視覺化功能。

【Markdown 練習場】
自由練習所有語法，寫好的內容可以下載成 .md 檔，直接放進你的 Obsidian 筆記庫。

【徽章與成就】
累積 XP、提升等級、記錄連續學習天數，收集 11 枚徽章，讓學習變成好習慣。

【快捷鍵速查】
常用快捷鍵一次整理，Windows / Mac 一鍵切換。

【適合誰？】
• 剛下載 Obsidian，不知道怎麼開始的新手
• 想整理課堂筆記、讀書心得的學生
• 想做好會議紀錄、專案管理的上班族
• 想打造「第二大腦」、建立個人知識管理系統的人

【隱私與離線】
• 不需要註冊帳號
• 所有課程內容都在 App 內，沒有網路也能學
• 學習進度只儲存在你的裝置上，不蒐集、不上傳任何資料
• 沒有廣告

Obsidian 是 Dynalist Inc. 的商標。

name: Oculario Bench
description: OcularBench è il manuale di lavoro per un oculista che dipinge a mano un occhio protesico. I clienti tornano raramente e il disegno dell'iride, i vasi sanguigni e la dimensione della pupilla devono essere riadattati. L'occhio reale e la protesi dipinta rimangono su uno sfondo nero. Solo le discrepanze vengono segnalate in blu, in modo che la seduta successiva inizi dall'ultimo disegno anziché da una pagina bianca. La sezione "Oggi" mostra la coda: l'iride ancora disponibile e la riga libera per la prossima visita. Cerca un nome o mantieni l'elenco per visualizzare le sedute aperte, le protesi abbinate o l'occhio sinistro o destro. Apri una seduta per posizionare l'occhio reale accanto alla protesi dipinta. Tocca con un segno blu un vaso sanguigno, il limbus, la pupilla o un colore che si è spostato. La dimensione della pupilla in millimetri viene riportata dall'ultima volta. La pittura rimane in ordine: base, fibre e limbus, ognuno con la relativa nota di miscelazione. Sposta uno strato verso l'alto o verso il basso quando il disegno cambia, oppure aggiungine un altro. Chiudi la visita quando il cliente se ne va. Registra se l'occhio è stato accettato. Se non lo era, lascia l'unica cosa da sistemare prima del loro ritorno. Le visite precedenti rimangono sulla conchiglia, dalla più recente alla meno recente. Ogni scheda persona conserva ogni conchiglia. Il tabellone di abbinamento totalizza le conchiglie aperte, i segni blu e la pupilla media.

name: Oddly Cozy
description:
Oddly Cozy opens straight into Gate Grid, a sliding-block puzzle for the few minutes you have to yourself. All 100 levels play offline after you download the app. No ads, no timers, no sign-in.

Slide each block along its track and out through the gate that matches its color. The first board takes a single slide. By the fourth, a lime-green block is waiting for a turquoise one to budge. Can you clear a path for both?

Pick any level and take your time. Undo the last move, start the board again, or leave it halfway through. Your iPhone remembers where the pieces were. On Hard and Super Hard boards, tap Hint for one move from your current position. Hints work offline, too.

Try the bright colors of Royal Pop or the wood grain of Wood Workshop. Switch looks in the middle of a puzzle and every piece stays put. Listen for the soft slide of a block and the swoosh as it slips through its gate, or tap the speaker to mute both.

Gate Grid is our first game. We plan to bring thousands of levels to Oddly Cozy over time.

Terms of use: https://oddlycozystudio.com/terms

name: OF Photo Diary
description:
OF Photo Diary is a private diary made of one photo a day. OF stands for One Frame.

ONE FRAME
Take today's photo with the camera or choose it from your library, crop it square and write a few lines. Add a mood and a place if you like, and star the days you want to find again.

LOCKED
A six-digit passcode with Face ID or Touch ID. The diary locks itself when you leave the app, and the app switcher shows a plain blue cover instead of your photos. Wrong passcodes lead to longer and longer pauses.

ON YOUR DEVICE
No account, no server, no ads, no analytics. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Every photo and word stays on your iPhone or iPad.

LOOK BACK
Watch the calendar fill in one square at a time. Scroll back through every frame, search your captions and places, filter by mood or favourites, and see what this day looked like a week, a month or a year ago.

YOURS TO KEEP
Save a single frame as an image with a date strip, a whole month as one calendar sheet, or the complete diary as a backup file whenever you choose. Restore a backup by filling empty days or by replacing the diary.

A QUIET REMINDER
If you want one, a reminder can appear at the time you pick, only on days when today's frame is still open. It never shows a photo or a caption.

Made for iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape.

name: OffDays: PTO & Leave Tracker
description:
OffDays is the private PTO ledger that knows your future.

Your HR system shows today's balance. OffDays shows whether July-you can actually take that trip.

LOOK AHEAD
Pick any future dates on the calendar. OffDays skips weekends and your company holidays, adds every pay-period accrual, respects your caps — and tells you exactly what's left when you land. Short by 6.5 hours? You'll know before you book.

NEVER LOSE A DAY
Use-it-or-lose-it expiry and accrual caps, tracked together. See the exact count at risk and get reminders 60/30/14 days before days vanish.

2027 PTO MAXXING
Built-in 2026–2028 US federal calendars with weekend observed rules. One tap turns bridge days into planned trips: 1 PTO day into a 4-day weekend, 4 days into a 10-day break.

PAYSTUB-PROOF MATH
Reconcile to your paystub anytime. OffDays projects from your latest real number, so rounding drift never stacks up. Biweekly, semi-monthly, monthly, weekly or lump-sum accrual — including 27-payday years.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No cloud. No ads. No tracking. Everything stays on your device, with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.

Free: one bucket, automatic accrual, 30-day look-ahead.
Pro (one-time): unlimited buckets, 12-month curve, unlimited projection, expiry alerts, bridge import, CSV export, all widgets.

Pay once. Keep forever.

name: Offlio Converter: PDF & Photo
description:
Offlio Converter converts, compresses and scans your files entirely on your phone. Nothing is uploaded — not to us, not to anyone. No account, no ads, no tracking. It even works in airplane mode.

EXACT-KB COMPRESSION FOR OFFICIAL PORTALS
Government and visa portals reject files that are even a few KB too big. Offlio hits the limit exactly: the result is always at or under the size you choose, at the best quality that fits.
• Passport / ID photo: under 50 KB
• Visa / government PDF: under 200 KB
• KYC / tax documents: under 500 KB
• Email / Slack: under 2 MB

CONVERT IN BATCHES
• HEIC, WebP, PNG and more → JPG or PNG
• Photos and PDFs → one merged PDF
• PDF → JPG pages
• Video → MP4, including a "Social & Messaging Ready (under 16 MB)" option
• Video or audio → MP3
• Location and camera data (EXIF) removed from photos by default

SCAN PAPER TO PDF OR WORD
Scan documents with your camera — edges are found and straightened automatically — then save them as a PDF, shrink them to an exact size, or turn them into an editable Word (.docx) document. Split an open book into separate pages, or put both sides of an ID card on one A4 page at true size. Print straight from the app, or lock a PDF with a password (AES-256). Text recognition runs on your device and reads up to 24 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic and more, plus Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Gujarati, Malayalam and Punjabi on Android.

COPY, EDIT AND SHARE TEXT
Image to Text reads the words in any photo, scan or PDF on your device. Copy one page or everything, fix any word, then share it as plain text or save it as a .txt file — all free. Saving an editable Word (.docx) file is part of Pro. Offlio itself is available in 24 languages, including Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Every conversion runs on your phone
• Files leave the app only when you tap Share or Save
• Recent exports stay in private storage you can clear any time
• No sign-up, no advertising, no analytics

POPULAR USES
HEIC to JPG · Compress PDF to 200 KB · Passport photo under 50 KB · Image to text (OCR) · PDF scanner · Merge and split PDF · Photos to PDF · Video to MP3

FREE AND PRO
The free plan includes 3 conversions a day (up to 3 files at once) for photos and PDFs with the built-in size presets — and no watermarks, ever.

Offlio Pro unlocks batches of up to 50 files with no daily limit, video and audio conversion, custom size targets from 20 KB to 5 MB, and Word export. Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription; the yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed or cancelled in your account settings.

Internet is needed only to buy or restore Offlio Pro. Your files are never uploaded.

Privacy Policy: https://edshreemknowledge.com/offlio/privacy
Terms of Use: https://edshreemknowledge.com/offlio/terms

Offlio is made by EDSHREEM KNOWLEDGE (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED.

name: Ohimennen: a small act a day
description:
In a long relationship, everyday life easily takes over. Ohimennen gives you one small act on the days you choose, a way to bring some warmth back: notice something, ask better questions, share the everyday load more fairly, be close, come up with something fun, or mend a small rift the same day.

The acts are short and concrete. On weekdays they take a few minutes; at the weekend you can do a longer one. Each one tells you what to do, what it can do for you both, what to do if it won’t work today, and how to take a “no” lightly.

WHAT YOU GET
• 82 acts in six themes: Noticing, Talk, Close, Together, Everyday and Making up
• An act on the days you choose, and the week’s longer act at the weekend
• A widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen: the day’s act at a glance
• Browse every act by theme, and do any of them today
• “Not for us” swaps an act for another, and the star saves the ones that work for you two
• Light and dark mode, 24 languages

DISCREET
The acts are yours: your partner doesn’t need to install anything. Your Home Screen just says Ohimennen. You don’t log anything, the app never asks whether you did an act, and there are no points, streaks or reminders.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription. Everything works offline, and nothing leaves your phone.

Small acts won’t fix everything, and the app isn’t therapy. If there is violence, fear or control in your relationship, these acts are not the right help.

name: OJ Gyms
description:
Download the OJ Gyms app to easily book classes and manage your fitness experience - anytime, anywhere. Make a reservation, get added to a wait list, check your profile and membership status, and more – all from your device.

Visit https://ojgyms.co.uk/ to learn more.

name: Olfa
description:
Olfa est l'application des amoureux du parfum : votre collection, les parfumeries près de chez vous et une communauté de passionnés, au même endroit.

MA COLLECTION
• Rangez vos flacons en trois listes : possédés, testés, envies.
• Plus de 300 parfums au catalogue, et ajout libre de ceux qui n'y sont pas encore.
• Notez chaque parfum et gardez vos impressions : tenue, sillage, occasions.

BOUTIQUES
• Carte et liste de parfumeries de niche, maisons et grands magasins.
• Triez par distance et partagez votre avis sur chaque boutique.

COMMUNAUTÉ
• Partagez votre parfum du jour, une découverte, une question, avec photo.
• Aimez et commentez les publications des autres membres.
• Signalez ou bloquez en un geste : les contenus offensants sont retirés.

Olfa est gratuite, sans publicité et sans abonnement.

name: Omok - Offline AI & 2P
description:
Enjoy classic 2D Omok (Gomoku / Five in a Row) anywhere—100% offline.
Works seamlessly even in Airplane Mode with no account, no login, and no external servers required.

[Key Features]

• 4-Tier Offline AI
  - Beginner: Relaxed play ideal for newcomers
  - Intermediate: Balanced offense and defense against 3 & 4 threats
  - Advanced: Reads broken patterns and 4-3 tactical traps
  - Expert: Deep tactical search with Victory by Continuous Fours (VCF)
  - Choose Black (1st), White (2nd), or Random; per-difficulty win/loss stats saved locally

• Authentic Renju & Freestyle Rules
  - Renju: Real-time X markers highlight Black's forbidden 3-3, 4-4, and overline (6+) points; Black wins with exact 5 only
  - Freestyle: No forbidden moves for either side; 5 or more in a row wins

• Customizable Match Rules
  - Per-turn countdown timer: Adjustable from 1s to 100s (applies equally to human and AI players)
  - Undo limit: Unlimited, 3x, 1x, or Off
  - Auto-save and Resume for unfinished AI matches

• Two-Player Modes (Local & Nearby)
  - Local 2P: Pass-and-play on a single iPhone or iPad
  - Nearby 2P: Direct peer-to-peer matches over the same Wi-Fi or Personal Hotspot (iOS & Android) with zero servers required

• Thoughtful 2D Board & Comfort
  - 2-step move confirmation (preview + confirm) prevents mis-taps on compact screens
  - Pinch-to-zoom, algebraic coordinates (A-O, 1-15), and move sequence numbers
  - AI Hint during play and step-by-step post-game Replay
  - Offline sound effects and haptic feedback
  - Tailored portrait layout on iPhone and portrait/landscape responsive layout on iPad

name: On the Nose: Party Game
description:
Thirteen quick games. One room. Closest to perfect survives.

On the Nose is a party game for up to 10 people, each on their own phone. One person hosts, everyone joins with a four-letter code or by pointing a camera at the screen, and the room takes turns at the same simple challenge. While you wait, you watch the turn live on your own phone, and often you can see things the player can't.

THE GAMES
- Stop the clock at exactly 7.00, with the numbers hidden
- Draw a perfect circle
- Flick a paper football through the posts
- Blow up the balloon and let go before it pops
- Slide the puck so it stops on the bullseye
- Keep the beat after the music stops
- Quick draw: wait for "Now"
- Remember the spot and pin it
- Spin the phone exactly once around
- Keep a steady hand with your eyes closed
- Hold one note on the line
- Turn one full circle, eyes shut
- Pour to the line and stop

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
Knockout: the lowest score takes a strike and the last one in wins. Everybody plays: every game once, nobody goes out, most points wins.

READ THE ROOM
Answer a few questions in secret, then guess how many of you picked each answer. Closest guess scores. Then see who said what.

Try any game on your own first. No ads, no accounts, nothing to buy.

Playing in a room needs an internet connection on each phone.

name: ON WAY – اطلبلي
description:
ON WAY — طلبك على الطريق.

اطلب من أفضل المطاعم والكافيهات وحلويات ومشروبات، وتابع طلبك لحظة بلحظة لحد ما يوصلك.
- تصفح المطاعم والأقسام القريبة منك.
- شوف المنيو بالأسعار والصور.
- حدد عنوانك على الخريطة.
- تابع حالة الطلب: قبول، تجهيز، استلام، توصيل.
- كودات خصم وعروض.
- محفظة ON WAY وأكواد شحن الرصيد.
- دعم مباشر من داخل التطبيق.
- الدفع عند الاستلام.

ON WAY — توصيل أكل سريع وسهل.

name: One More Set: Gym Tracker
description:
Train for strength with a plan that progresses with you: One More Set tells you what to lift today, which muscles have recovered, and shows every exercise in 3D. No account, no ads, works offline.

PROGRESS ON AUTOPILOT
- Next-weight suggestion: the next weight and reps for every exercise, with the reason.
- Weekly sets per muscle based on your goal and experience, against your personal range.
- Recovery map: which muscles are ready, recovering or freshly trained.
- Review my workout and plateau check: why a lift stopped improving and what to change.
- Records, estimated 1RM, charts, monthly summary and achievements.

LEARN EVERY EXERCISE
- 171 exercises with 3D animations you can rotate, technique cues, common mistakes and studies.
- Camera (experimental): on selected exercises it counts reps and times holds. Everything is analyzed on your iPhone and you confirm the count.
- Create your own exercises, even from your own video.

LOG IN SECONDS
- Every set in one tap: weight, reps and RIR (reps in reserve).
- Starter routines, 8 plan templates and a simple mode for your first days.
- Automatic rest timer, also on the Lock Screen (Live Activity), widgets and Apple Health.
- Cardio, timed and one-side exercises. Edit past workouts.
- Import your history from other workout apps (CSV file).
- 2 profiles on the same iPhone. Kilos or pounds. English and Spanish.

PRIVACY
No account needed. No ads, no tracking. Your workouts are stored on your iPhone, with an automatic copy in Files and, if iCloud Drive is on, in your own iCloud. Camera videos are analyzed on your iPhone and are never sent to us or to any server.

NOTICE
One More Set provides general training information, not medical advice. Check with a doctor before starting if you have an injury or health condition.

Terms of use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://borja25.github.io/onemoreset/privacy.html

name: Oneda Pass - Acesso Condomínio
description:
O Oneda Pass e o aplicativo oficial de controle de acesso e gestao inteligente para os condominios da Oneda Construtora. Desenvolvido para oferecer maxima seguranca, comodidade e tecnologia na palma da sua mao.

Com o Oneda Pass, a rotina do seu condominio se torna muito mais agil e segura, eliminando burocracias e filas na portaria para moradores, familiares e visitantes.

PRINCIPAIS RECURSOS:

ACESSO INTELIGENTE E FACE ID
- Libere portas, portões e catracas com rapidez e segurança utilizando Face ID ou autenticação biométrica nativa do iPhone.
- Validação de proximidade física para acionamento de portões automáticos.

CONVITES COM QR CODE DINÂMICO
- Gere convites individuais ou listas para festas e eventos em poucos segundos.
- Emissão de QR Codes seguros com atualização dinâmica (TOTP), que podem ser compartilhados diretamente pelo WhatsApp.
- Receba notificações push no momento em que seu convidado for identificado na portaria.

CÂMERAS AO VIVO
- Visualize as câmeras de segurança das áreas comuns e acessos do condomínio em tempo real, com alta definição e estabilidade.

ENCOMENDAS E CORRESPONDÊNCIAS
- Receba avisos instantâneos assim que uma encomenda for recebida pela portaria.
- Histórico completo e controle de retirada de pacotes.

RESERVA DE ESPAÇOS COMUNS
- Consulte a disponibilidade e faça reservas de salão de festas, churrasqueiras, quiosques e espaços gourmet diretamente pelo aplicativo.
- Acompanhe regras e status de aprovação de cada ambiente.

COMUNICADOS E OCORRÊNCIAS
- Fique por dentro de todos os avisos e circulares importantes enviados pelo síndico e pela administração.
- Registre chamados e ocorrências com facilidade e acompanhe a resolução em tempo real.

GESTÃO DA SUA UNIDADE
- Cadastro de dependentes, familiares e veículos com placas para acesso às garagens.
- Identificação dos animais de estimação da residência.

SEGURANÇA E PRIVACIDADE (LGPD)
O Oneda Pass adota rigorosos protocolos de criptografia e proteção de dados em conformidade com a LGPD e as diretrizes da Apple. O morador possui controle total e pode gerenciar ou revogar seus acessos a qualquer momento.

COMO ACESSAR:

O aplicativo é de uso exclusivo para moradores, proprietários e colaboradores dos condomínios atendidos pela Oneda Construtora. Para obter seu acesso, solicite o cadastro à administração ou portaria do seu condomínio.

name: OneSteper
description:
Hold to draw a trail. Release at just the right moment. Can you land exactly on gold?

OneSteper is a cozy timing puzzle set on floating islands. Each path grows as you hold. Release too early and your companion stops short. Hold too long and they walk past the goal. Land on the gold tile to keep your streak going.

Find your rhythm. Watch for tiles that speed up or slow down your path. On some trails, ice lights up in a repeating rhythm. On others, you’ll have to remember which marker is the real goal.

Meet companions with their own challenges. Start with Snowdrop Snowman in snowy Frost Valley. Hop across lily pads with Sprout, remember the real goal with Rose Dusk, or help Gingerbread Buddy repair a broken bridge. Try a companion’s first stage before unlocking its full challenge.

Pick a trail for today. Take on a new five-stage Daily Trail, or see how far you can go in Endless mode. Earn Trail points through play, check-ins, and daily goals, then spend them to unlock companions or get another chance on a run.

Keep a record of your journey. Track your best streak, revisit your top runs, earn growth badges, and share a journey card when you finish.

Optional in-app purchases are available for Paid point packs

name: OneXEOS Stall Terminal
description:
OneXEOS Stall Terminal là ứng dụng thu tiền cho từng quầy hàng trong khu ẩm thực, trung tâm vui chơi hoặc sự kiện dùng thẻ trả trước của OneXEOS.

Nhân viên quầy có thể:
- Nhập số tiền và thu từ thẻ của khách: chạm thẻ NFC, dùng đầu đọc thẻ, quét mã trên thẻ bằng camera, hoặc gõ mã thẻ.
- Xem số dư còn lại của thẻ ngay sau khi thu.
- Hoàn một giao dịch vừa thu nhầm.
- Xem danh sách và tổng tiền các giao dịch trong ngày của quầy mình.

Ứng dụng dành cho nhân viên của doanh nghiệp đang dùng OneXEOS. Cần tài khoản do doanh nghiệp cấp; không đăng ký được trong ứng dụng.

name: OnMarkaz Student
description:
OnMarkaz Student is the pocket companion for students of learning centres that use the OnMarkaz system. Enter the 6-digit code your centre gave you once, then sign in with your phone number and password.

What's inside:
• Lessons — your next lesson, timetable, attendance, and a page for each of your groups.
• Learning path — progress and dates for every unit, growth by skill.
• Homework — vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, writing and speaking tasks; results right away, voice answers go to your teacher or to the pronunciation check.
• Word games — a Leitner system brings words back on the right day; "Build the word" and "Quick choice" games, missed words come back at the end of the round.
• Coins and achievements — coins for activity, medals and a skills radar (if your centre turns them on).
• Balance and payments — see what you owe first and pay your centre with Payme or Click.
• Lesson reminders — the phone reminds you before a lesson starts.
• In Uzbek, Russian and English.

Your account is opened by your learning centre; the app is only for students of centres that use OnMarkaz.

name: OnSite FM
description:
OnSite FM is the app for employees, building technicians and security staff at companies that use OnSite-Soft facility management. Report faults, complete work orders, document inspections and call for help in an emergency, right from your iPhone or iPad.

You need an account from your company at OnSite-Soft. What you see in the app depends on your role.

REPORT A FAULT
• In one minute, with up to three photos
• Scan the QR code on a room or asset: site, location and asset are filled in for you
• Follow your own reports and their progress

WORK ORDERS FOR TECHNICIANS
• Assigned and open work orders, change status, add comments
• Mark up and label photos, schedule jobs with technicians and materials
• Collect a signature on site, assign a contractor

INSPECTIONS AND AUDITS
• Checklists item by item, defects with notes and photos, sign-off with signature
• Assets, fire safety and first aid equipment, meter readings, inventory

SECURITY
• Guard tours with NFC checkpoints
• Lone worker protection: regular check-ins, otherwise an alarm is raised automatically
• SOS button: the on-call staff from your company's alarm plan receive an emergency call in the app, with a spoken message of the site and the reason

WORKS OFFLINE
• The app shows the last loaded data and keeps reports, comments, photos and meter readings until the connection is back

BUILT-IN ASSISTANT
• Questions like "What is overdue?" or "My tasks" are answered by an assistant inside OnSite, without third-party AI services

PRIVACY
• Developed and operated in Germany, data hosted in the EU; a US data region is available on request
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics SDKs
• No location tracking

Costs, budgets and administration stay in the web portal; the app is made for work on site.

name: OpalSketch: Photo Editor
description:
Give a favorite photo a film-inspired look, turn a weekend’s worth of snapshots into a collage, or design a postcard from scratch. OpalSketch brings photo editing, collage layouts, and creative templates together on your iPhone.

Find your look
Try film-inspired filters, adjust their strength, and compare your edit with the original. Fine-tune light and color with RGB curves, levels, and hue controls. Crop, straighten, or correct perspective to get the framing you want.

Make a collage
Arrange up to 20 photos in grids, photo strips, or freeform layouts. Crop each photo independently and customize the spacing, borders, and background.

Make your subject stand out
Soften the background, touch up a portrait, or brush away small distractions. Cut out a subject to give it a new background or save it as a transparent PNG.

Create postcards and posters
Start with a template and add your own titles, captions, paper stickers, and drawings. Keep elements on separate layers so you can move and edit them anytime.

Save and share
Reopen an editable draft whenever you like. Export as JPEG, PNG, or HEIC, then save to Photos or Files or share from your iPhone.

Photo editing and drafts stay on your device. You can start editing without an account.

Terms of Use
https://www.opalsketch.xyz/terms.html

End User License Agreement (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Ora: Design Your Day
description:
Ora isn't another calendar. It's a better way to design your day.

Your calendar shows what's booked. It never asks what matters. Ora does. Every day becomes a simple loop of three moments, so you always know what to do next and you end the day with the thing that mattered actually done.

1 · PLAN
Pick the one thing that makes today a win. See at a glance the time that's still yours, between the meetings you already have. Place your to-dos in open time with one tap, or fill a free slot. Give each task a length, or none.

2 · TODAY
One clear card tells you what to do right now. Start the one thing in one tap and focus on it. Tick things off as you go, and watch a thin line show how much of your active day is left.

3 · REVIEW
Close the day in a minute. Mark the one thing done, move what's left to tomorrow or keep it for later, and choose tomorrow's one thing tonight. When you wake up, the plan is ready.

MADE FOR YOUR REAL DAY
• Works with the calendars and reminders already on your iPhone and Mac: iCloud, Google, Exchange.
• Your events stay in your calendar; your to-dos stay in Reminders.
• Ora's own day plan syncs through your iCloud between iPhone and Mac.
• Light and dark, Liquid Glass, large text support.
• On iPhone: widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen. On Mac: a menu bar dial and ⌥⌘K from anywhere.
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

Design your day. Get more done.

Made by Restaino Lab.

name: Orakel: Card Prophecy
description:
