Orakel is a classic trick-taking card game of prophecy. Each round you look at your hand and predict exactly how many tricks you will take. Hit your prophecy and you score; miss it by even one trick and you lose points.

The deck has 60 cards: four suits (Sun, Moon, Star and Comet), four mighty Oracles that win any trick, and four Fools that never do. Every round deals one card more, and a turned-up card decides the trump suit. Reading your hand is half the game; outwitting the table is the other half.

FEATURES
• 3 to 6 players: you against 2 to 5 computer opponents
• Four opponent strengths, from friendly Apprentice to the cunning Archmage
• Play together: invite friends with a five-letter room code, join a random room, or play on the same Wi-Fi. Computer players fill the empty seats
• Quick game of 10 rounds or the full game
• Optional rule: the bids may not add up to the number of tricks
• Two tables to choose from: a mystic Observatory and a cosy Tavern
• Beautiful 3D cards, hand-painted Oracles and Fools, calm music
• Your game is saved automatically
• Available in 13 languages

Your first quick game is free. One purchase unlocks everything: unlimited games, the full game length and hosting rooms. Joining a friend's room is always free. No ads, no subscriptions, no tracking.

name: Orbay: Car Rental Marrakech
description:
Rent a car in Marrakech from licensed local agencies.

Choose your dates and a car, and send a request. The agency accepts or declines it; if it accepts, you pay the agency when you collect the car. Nothing is paid in the app.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose your dates and a car. Each car shows its price per day, its deposit, the driver's minimum age and the agency's rental conditions. You can look around without an account.
• Send a request. Enter the driver's details and send it. The agency accepts or declines within 12 hours at most, less when pick-up is sooner. We e-mail you its answer; if it does not answer in time, the request closes by itself.
• Collect the car, pay the agency. Collect it at the agency or at Menara Airport. When the agency delivers, it can also bring the car to your hotel, riad or home, for the fee shown.

WHY ORBAY
• Agencies checked before they join: only licensed car rental agencies are accepted, after we check their commercial register, their car rental licence and their insurance.
• Prices shown before you send a request: the total covers the rental, the options and the delivery. Each car's page shows its deposit and the agency's conditions.
• Reviews only from renters: only people who rented through Orbay can rate their rental, once, after it is over.
• Talk in the app: write to the agency once you have sent a request. Phone numbers stay hidden on both sides until the booking is confirmed.

FOR AGENCIES
Licensed car rental agencies in Marrakech can list their cars from Profile › List your agency on Orbay. You set your prices, your fees, how far you deliver, your options and your rental conditions, and you accept or decline each request. During the pilot, Orbay takes no commission.

Orbay speaks English, Arabic and French.

name: orbit32: dial puzzle
description:
Slip a 2 between another 2 and a 4. The two 2s make a 4, which meets the 4 next door. You’ve made an 8 in a single move.

There are sixteen slots on the dial. Give it a turn and watch the numbers light up to show which ones will merge. When you spot a combination you like, tap the center. Each tile that reaches 32 disappears. Clear the whole dial to win.

You can already see the next piece. If it’s a ×2, that 16 might be worth keeping. On your next turn you can double it and clear its slot.

Play at your own pace, offline and ad-free. On iPhone Duo, start on the outer screen and unfold it to keep playing. On Apple Watch, you can also tap a slot to bring it straight to the top.

name: Orbivolt Arcade
description: Pilot a ship through a neon arena full of charged orbs. Match their polarity, split them into smaller targets and chain reflected shots. Play 500 campaign levels, try a fresh daily challenge or chase your high score in Endless mode. Move with your left thumb and fire or switch polarity with your right. Track personal records and unlock achievements across eight categories. The optional Ship Color Pack unlocks 10 cosmetic ship colors together.

name: Orderat IQ
description:
Orderat lets you shop from stores abroad and have your order delivered to your door in Iraq.

How it works
1. Pick a store from our list: Turkey, Europe, the USA, Dubai or China. It opens in your browser.
2. Copy the product link and paste it into your Orderat box. Choose the size and color.
3. Send your box. Products from many stores travel together as one order.
4. We send you the full price: product, shipping, customs and service fee.
5. Approve it and we buy, ship and deliver. Pay cash on delivery.

Why Orderat
• Stores from many countries in one list, from fashion and shoes to electronics and home
• One box for many stores
• Clear price before you approve
• Follow every order step by step, from purchase to your door
• English, Arabic and Kurdish (Badini and Sorani)

Orderat is an independent shopping and delivery service and is not affiliated with the stores listed in the app.

Questions? Write to orderatcompany@gmail.com

name: OrderUp EG
description:
OrderUp replaces the buzzer at the restaurant counter.

Scan the restaurant's code, enter your order number, and go find a seat. OrderUp follows your order from the kitchen and tells you the moment it's ready to collect.

FOLLOW EVERY STAGE
• See your order go from Placed to Preparing to Ready to Collected.
• A Live Activity keeps your order on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, so you don't need to open anything.
• See how long the restaurant usually takes.

NEVER MISS YOUR ORDER
• A notification arrives the moment the kitchen marks your order ready, and comes through Focus.
• If you step away, staff can send the alert again.

NOTHING TO SIGN UP FOR
• No account, no password, no menu to learn.
• On iPhone it opens as an App Clip straight from the restaurant's code, so you don't even need to install the app.

IN THE RESTAURANT'S OWN STYLE
Every screen shows the logo and colours of the restaurant you're ordering from.

OrderUp only works at restaurants that use it: look for the OrderUp code at the counter.

name: Ordo: Today in the Church
description:
Ordo follows the official U.S. Catholic liturgical calendar. Each day it shows what the Church in the United States celebrates, the solemnity or feast, the Sunday or season with its Gospel, or the saint's memorial, with a great painting.

• Made for the U.S. calendar: the feasts, memorials and holy days as they are kept in the United States. Outside the U.S., some days may differ from your local calendar.
• Every day: the name of the day, a short Gospel passage or the story of the saint, and a note about the painting. Swipe back two weeks or ahead a full year.
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen that change by themselves at midnight.
• Your Lock Screen: set it up once, and each night the new day's painting appears on your Lock Screen.
• Great art: paintings, icons, mosaics and engravings from the public domain, each with its artist and where it hangs.
• Private: no account, no ads, no tracking. Ordo collects nothing.

Scripture quotations are from the Revised Standard Version of the Bible, Second Catholic Edition, copyright © 2006 National Council of the Churches of Christ in the United States of America. Used by permission. All rights reserved.

name: OVA: Period, Ovulation Tracker
description:
Track your period, fertile days, and ovulation with complete privacy.

OVA is a calm, private period and ovulation tracker built so your personal health data stays strictly on your iPhone. There is no sign-up, no account, no cloud upload, and no ads.

WHAT YOU GET FOR FREE
• Accurate Period & Ovulation Predictions: Know when your next period, fertile window, and ovulation day are expected based on your own cycle rhythm.
• Fast Daily Logging: Log flow intensity, moods, cramps, symptoms, discharge, sleep, and water in seconds.
• Gentle & Discreet Reminders: Get notified before your period, fertile window, ovulation, daily check-ins, water, or medicine. Turn on Discreet Mode so notifications never mention periods.
• Soothe Kit & Misty Companion: Calming relief tools and gentle poses for period comfort, alongside Misty your cozy companion.
• Privacy Vault: Lock OVA with a secure PIN and erase all data anytime with one tap.
• 32 Languages & Dark Mode: Built to feel comfortable day or night in your preferred language.

OVA PLUS (OPTIONAL UPGRADE)
• Full Cycle History: Look back beyond your last 3 cycles and spot long-term shifts.
• Pattern Insights: See which symptoms and moods tend to appear in each phase of your cycle.
• Doctor-Ready Report: Export or copy a clean cycle and symptom summary for appointments.

SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING
OVA Plus offers Monthly ($3.99/month) and Yearly ($24.99/year with a 7-day free trial) auto-renewing subscriptions, plus a Lifetime one-time purchase ($59.99). Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Predictions, insights, and tips in OVA are estimates for general wellness only. OVA is not a medical device and should not be used as contraception or to diagnose, treat, or prevent any medical condition. Consult a healthcare professional for medical advice.

name: Over Here: Find Friends Nearby
description:
Lost your friends in a crowd? Over Here shows you exactly where they are.

At concerts, festivals, airports, theme parks, or anywhere you could lose each other, Over Here shows how far away each friend is and points an arrow straight at them. No signal, no internet, no account needed.

FIND EACH OTHER
• Exact distance and a live arrow pointing to your friend (iPhone 11 or later)
• Distance to everyone else in your group via Bluetooth
• Out of range? Friends can still be located through someone else in the group
• "Getting warmer / colder" hints guide you step by step

GET THEIR ATTENTION
• Ping: one tap and your friend knows you're looking for them
• Beacon: shake your phone and the screen lights up in your colour, easy to spot above a crowd
• Meet up: set a place and time, everyone sees a countdown and gets a reminder

CHAT WITHOUT SIGNAL
• Group chat and private messages, with photos
• Messages travel phone to phone, no internet or mobile data needed
• End-to-end encrypted

PRIVATE GROUPS IN SECONDS
• Invite friends standing next to you, both phones show the same safety code
• Or share your group's QR code
• Only people you invite can join

OPTIONAL GPS MODE
Too far for Bluetooth? Turn on GPS mode to see your group on a map. It's off by default, runs only while the app is open, and your position is shared encrypted with your group only.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no phone number
• No servers, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Your location and messages stay on your group's phones. We never see them.

Over Here is for finding friends who agreed to be found. Please don't use it to track anyone without their consent, and don't rely on it in emergencies.

name: OwlRemote
description:
OwlRemote turns your iPhone into a fast, glass styled remote for the TV on your home WiFi. No ads, no account, and every remote button is free.

MADE FOR YOUR THUMB
A big touch surface you swipe to move and tap to select, a thin volume rail on its edge, and Home, Play and Pause, Back and channel buttons right where your thumb rests. It fits small phones like iPhone SE and iPhone 12 mini without scrolling.

TYPE WITH YOUR PHONE
When the TV shows a search box, the iPhone keyboard pops up and your words appear on the TV as you type. No more spelling with arrow keys.

ASK YOUR TV
Type what you want, like "open mrbeast video" or "space documentary". OwlRemote opens the TV's search and types it for you. Quick match works for everyone; Pro adds smart search that understands what you mean.

APPS IN ONE TAP
Open Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+ and more from the remote, using the apps installed on your TV.

WHAT'S ON (PRO)
Open IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes for the show you are watching, and paste a YouTube link to like it, comment, or join the live chat from your phone.

WORKS WITH
Hisense VIDAA TVs, plus Google TV and Android TV, Roku, Samsung, LG and Fire TV. Your iPhone and TV must be on the same WiFi.

OWLREMOTE PRO
One payment, no subscription, Family Sharing included: smart search, What's on, YouTube actions, more than one TV, and iPhone side buttons for TV volume.

Privacy: the remote talks to your TV on your home network. Smart search sends only the words you type to OwlRemote's server to understand them. Details at the privacy link.

OwlRemote is not affiliated with Hisense, Google, Roku, Samsung, LG, Amazon, Netflix or YouTube.

name: Oyako Marker - School Prints
description:
School and cram-school handouts, shared with the whole family.

Oyako Marker lets parents snap a photo (or pick an image / PDF) of school handouts and share them with family members to view anytime.

No more hunting through cloud-storage folders. Your child can open the latest handout on their own phone or tablet whenever they need it.

FEATURES
- Upload by taking a photo, or by choosing an image / PDF (JPG, PNG, PDF)
- Organize with subjects (Math, Language Arts, Science, Social Studies, Foreign Language, Other) and tags, with quick filter chips
- Choose which children each print is shared with — or share with the whole family
- Kids sign in with a simple login code issued by a parent. No email or password for kids
- Other parents and grandparents can join the family group via QR code or invite link
- Unread prints show a dot and a tab badge, so nothing gets missed
- Hide answers with red markers and tap to reveal — great for memorization practice
- Four color themes, with Japanese and English interfaces

HOW IT WORKS
1. A parent takes a photo of a handout, or picks a file
2. Add a subject, tags, and the children to share with
3. Children sign in with their code and view the prints

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
- Prints are visible only to members of your own family group — never public
- Accounts can be deleted in the app at any time (deleting a parent's account removes the family's data)

GOOD TO KNOW
- Free to use, with no in-app purchases
- Print uploads are limited to 2 per family per week
- An internet connection is required

name: PackBack: Return Packing
description:
Before you head home, check the things you brought.

Make a list before you leave and tick each item as you pack. For the trip home, PackBack shows those items so you can mark them Packed or Leave behind. Choose To check to see what you haven’t checked yet.

Type or paste one item per line. You can add items, rename them or remove them during the trip. Preview the return checklist to share a text file or save it through the iOS share sheet.

For your next trip, keep the items and clear the checks.

Switch between English and Simplified Chinese in the app. Your device stores the list and checks; you don’t need an account. Each list holds up to 100 items, with 120 characters per item.

Sharing sends the exported checklist to the destination you choose.

name: PackSwift - Smart Packing List
description:
Pack smarter for every flight, road trip, and weekend getaway - completely offline.

PackSwift replaces messy notes with structured, reusable travel luggage cards and master templates. Check off essentials with satisfying progress rings and see what is left to pack right from your Home Screen.

KEY FEATURES
- Boarding-Pass Style Trip Cards: Track packing completion for every upcoming trip at a glance.
- Reusable Master Templates: Build go-to kits for business travel, beach holidays, international flights, or camping and spin up a new trip in one tap.
- Category Grouping and Quantities: Organize clothes, tech chargers, documents, and toiletries cleanly with item counts.
- Home Screen Widgets: Check remaining items without even opening the app.
- 100% Offline and Private: Works on airplanes with zero signal, zero accounts, and zero subscriptions.

HONEST PRICING
Create active trips and core checklists free forever. Unlock unlimited master templates and trip archives with a single $5.99 lifetime purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/packswift/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/packswift/support.html

name: PadaPudu
seller_name: POLENTE KOZMETIK SANAYI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Pudu Galaksisi'ne hoş geldin.

Pudu, içinde yıldızlar dönen küçük bir galaksi. Galaksinin her köşesinde bir oyuncak yaşar: Afacan Aslan, Fıstık Fil, Pofuduk Ayılar ve daha nicesi. Her birinin kendi sesi, kendi hareketi ve kendi masalı var. PadaPudu, bu masalları çocuğunla birlikte okuman, dinlemen ve oynaman için hazırlandı.

48 MASAL, GÜNDÜZ VE GECE
Masallar iki rafta: gündüz için oyunlu, kıpır kıpır masallar; gece için yavaşlayan, uykuya hazırlayan masallar. Masal sayfa sayfa açılır, her sayfada kocaman bir düğme vardır. Düğmeye dokununca aslan kükrer, kuşlar cıvıldar, yağmur yağar. Yazıyı büyütebilir, satır aralığını açabilir, gece ışığını kısabilirsin.

HER MASALA KENDİ MÜZİĞİ
48 masalın her biri için ayrı bestelenmiş müzik: marimba, kalimba, arp, okarina, müzik kutusu, çelesta, klarnet, akordeon ve daha fazlası. Müzik masalın arkasında usulca çalar, masal sesi gelince kısılır. Müzikler bölümünde hepsini tek tek dinleyebilir, uyku zamanlayıcısını kurup ışığı kapatabilirsin.

OYUNCAKLARIN DÜNYASI
Kahramanlar bölümünde 24 oyuncak kahraman seni bekler. Birine dokun: canlanır, sesini çıkarır, hareketini yapar. "Dinle, bul" oyununda sesi dinle, kimin olduğunu bul. Kahramanın hangi masallarda olduğunu, masal dostlarını gör; evindeki oyuncağı işaretle, masallarda seni beklesin.

VELİLER İÇİN
Reklam yok, takip yok. Çocuğun adı ve ayarlar yalnız bu cihazda kalır.
Masalların, müziklerin ve oyunların hepsi ücretsiz.
İnternet olmadan da çalışır: masallar, sesler ve müzikler uygulamanın içinde.
Mağaza, ödeme ve ayarlar ebeveyn kapısının arkasında.
Apple ile giriş: tek dokunuşla gir, ödeme sayfasında e-postan hazır gelsin.
PadaPudu oyuncakları padapudu.com'dakiyle aynı mağazadan, aynı ödeme sayfasıyla satın alınır.

Pudu Galaksisi büyümeye devam ediyor. Yeni masal gelince haber vermemizi istersen, bildirimleri açman yeter.

name: Paddle Wear Diagnostic
description:
Your paddle is changing every time you play. Paddle Wear Diagnostic helps you see how — using just your phone.

Photograph each face of your paddle and the app maps its surface wear. Then tap through a guided 35-point pattern while the app listens, building two core maps for each side:

• Ring Pitch — a lamination check that listens for changes in the paddle's ring
• Deep Tone — a core check that listens for changes in its deep response

Each side finishes with a Sweet Spot summary: one clear percentage for how much of the face is still playing like it should, drawn on a paddle outline with your results. Save the full report as a PDF and keep it for your records.

No account. No uploads. Every photo and recording is analyzed on your phone and never leaves it.

From AJ Penn and @mnapickleball — built by players, for players.

name: Page Robin
description:
When a page is hard to follow, change the page. Page Robin gives you more control over how books and documents look and feel on your iPhone or iPad.

Follow the text
Move your finger along the words with Finger Reading, or use Underline to mark the line you’re on. Switch between turning pages and scrolling through one continuous view.

Make the page yours
Informed by research on digital readability, Page Robin lets you choose a typeface, adjust the text size and line spacing, and pick a page colour that suits you. Use the tools you want and leave the rest off.

Bring your own reading
Try the built-in reading sample or import an EPUB, a PDF with selectable text, or a text file from Files. Use bookmarks and saved reading positions to pick up where you left off.

Page Robin is for anyone who finds dense pages hard to follow, including readers with ADHD, autistic readers (autism spectrum disorder, or ASD), and readers with dyslexia. No account is needed. Your reading is processed on your device. Page Robin is a reading tool, not a diagnostic or treatment app.

name: Paint Roll: Maze Painter
description:
Swipe to roll the ball and paint every tile of the maze!

The ball rolls until it hits a wall, painting every tile it passes. Plan your swipes to cover the whole maze. Simple to start, surprisingly clever later on, and wonderfully satisfying to watch.

FEATURES
• Swipe controls made for one hand
• Hundreds of mazes, each one checked to be solvable
• Hints show your next move when you are stuck
• Skip any level
• Unlock paint colors, including Rainbow
• No timers, play offline at your own pace

Paint Roll is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Pairing Cups
description:
Pairing Cups is an offline brew comparison instrument. Two cups side by side, so you can brew it again.

Pin your best cup on the left, and change only the next one on the right — dose, grind, temperature, time, and taste on the same dials.

• The home screen is a two-cup comparison deck, not a brew diary list
• Dose, grind, temperature, time, and taste stay visible together
• Pin a best cup as the reference, and log the next brew on the other side
• Works fully offline; your notes stay on this device
• A one-time Pairing Saucer unlock, with no subscription

The free tier keeps 8 slips. Pairing Saucer is a one-time Non-Consumable unlock for unlimited slips and unrestricted history comparison.

No account. No ads. No custom server.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are linked in Settings.

name: Pairs Apart: A Spacing Puzzle
description:
Every piece has a match, and every match needs exactly the right amount of room.

Pairs Apart is a calm logic puzzle about spacing. Each piece wears a number badge that tells you how many empty spaces belong between it and its twin. Place every pair along a winding path so each one is exactly the right distance apart. It sounds simple, until the pairs start competing for the same spaces.

HOW IT WORKS
• Count along the path, around every turn, the way the arrows point.
• A 2 badge means two spaces between the matching pieces. A 0 means they sit side by side.
• Padlocked pieces are already in the right place. Use them as clues.
• Place every piece, blanks included, to solve the puzzle.

THE STARTER COLLECTION
Five themed packs, each with its own twist:
• The Garden: one winding path, the classic rules.
• The Railway: two separate tracks. A pair must share one track.
• The Mountains: rocks count as spaces, but nothing can sit on them.
• The Museum: roped-off displays fill spaces you can't use.
• The Night Sky: a circular orbit with no start or end.

THE TRIOS COLLECTION
Every piece comes in threes, spaced evenly apart. Unlocked as you progress through The Garden, its five packs (The Orchard, The Canals, The Glacier, The Library and The Carousel) give the same twists a new challenge.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Five levels per pack, from Beginner to Expert, with 14 stages each.
• A new Daily Puzzle every day, with streaks and a calendar of your results.
• Short guided lessons teach each collection's rules before you begin.
• Stuck? Free hints come with most stages, and each one locks a correct piece in place.

CALM BY DESIGN
• No ads. Ever.
• Plays fully offline, so puzzles go wherever you do.
• No timers. Take as long as you like.

FREE TO START
The Garden's Beginner, Easy and Medium levels and The Orchard's Beginner level are free. Unlock the rest of the Starter or Trios Collection with a one-time in-app purchase. Extra hint packs are available as optional in-app purchases.

name: Palmastra: Kundli & Palmistry
description:
Palmastra is a Kundli and palm reading app in one. It reads your birth chart and your palm (hast rekha), then shows you where the two agree. Now in English and Hindi.

Most apps read your stars or your hand. Palmastra reads both and lines them up. Each mount on your palm is named after a planet, so Palmastra compares your hand with your chart and marks where they agree, partly agree or differ, with a confidence level for each.

FREE KUNDLI AND KUNDLI PDF
A full Vedic Kundli in North or South Indian style with degrees, D1, D9 Navamsa, Chalit and Moon charts. Every planet with its nakshatra, KP star and sub lords, avastha and dignity. Vimshottari and Ashtottari dasha, house by house summary, Avakhada and Ghatak chakras, yogas, Manglik, Kaal Sarp and your Sade Sati dates. Download it all as a free Kundli PDF, made on your phone.

KUNDLI MILAN FOR MARRIAGE
Match two Kundlis with all eight kootas of Guna Milan out of 36, the 10 poruthams and the Manglik check, explained in plain words. See your marriage timing windows from your dasha and Jupiter's transit, and your career and job change timing too.

PALM READING, HAST REKHA, LINE BY LINE
Take a photo with the on-screen guide. Palmastra checks the light and focus, finds your heart, head, life, fate and sun lines, and draws them on your own hand. Your photo is deleted after analysis unless you choose to keep it.

DAILY PANCHANG AND MUHURAT
Today's Panchang for your city with tithi, nakshatra, Rahu Kaal, Abhijit Muhurat and Choghadiya. A festival and vrat calendar, daily rashifal, a small upay or Vastu tip each morning, and Mercury retrograde and full Moon alerts. Find a good muhurat for a wedding, griha pravesh, vehicle or new start.

MORE FROM YOUR CHART
Lal Kitab chart with debts and simple remedies, a Vastu compass for your home, numerology, baby names by nakshatra, your year ahead, and Prashna: ask one question and get an answer from the chart of that moment. A Western chart wheel with Placidus or Whole Sign houses is there too.

A BIRTH CHART YOU CAN TRUST
Planet positions are calculated in the app to within seconds of arc with the Lahiri ayanamsa and checked against professional reference charts. Historical time zones and daylight saving are handled for you. No birth time? You still get a chart, and Palmastra tells you clearly what changes.

READINGS THAT SHOW THEIR WORKING
Daily, natal, palm and combined readings each name the transit, placement, dasha or palm line they come from. Ask Palmastra questions in your own words and get answers from your real chart and palm data.

FREE TO START
Free: both charts, the full Kundli and PDF, Panchang, a short daily reading, one palm reading and 5 questions.
Premium: full Vedic and combined readings, palm scans for everyone you add, weekly readings, 30 questions a month and a monthly Chart Compatibility. Premium Plus: 75 questions a month and up to 10 people. Family: 75 questions, 20 readings and up to 10 people.
One-off reports: buy a Hand and Stars report for one person or a Kundli match for one couple without subscribing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. Palm photos deleted by default. Export or delete all your data from inside the app.

Palmastra is for self-reflection and entertainment, not medical, legal or financial advice. It never predicts lifespan or death, and it does not give stock or lottery picks. Palmastra is for adults aged 18 and over.

Subscription terms: payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. A free trial turns into a paid subscription when it ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://palmastra.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://palmastra.com/privacy
Support: https://palmastra.com/support

name: PANA Algebra Play
description:
PANA Algebra Play is a free learning game for everyone. Travel a bright adventure map from the basics all the way to Linear Algebra, one short level at a time.

• 41 worlds and 211 skills in 9 regions: Basics, Algebra 1, Algebra 2, College Algebra, Precalculus, Calculus 1, 2 and 3, and Linear Algebra
• Short levels with worked examples, visual hints, graphs and stars
• A boss at the end of every world to prove what you've learned
• "Review today" uses spaced review to help you remember, and daily streaks keep you coming back
• An optional placement quiz finds the right place to start
• A skill tree and a cheat sheet for every world
• Fair grading: any correct form of an answer counts
• In English, Spanish and French
• Works fully offline on iPhone and iPad, because the whole game is built into the app

No ads. No accounts or sign-in. No tracking. No in-app purchases. Your progress stays on your device.

Made by PANA Green LLC.

name: Panelborn Heroes Triple Clash
description:
Three tiles. One heroic comeback.

Panelborn Heroes Triple Clash turns a layered tile puzzle into a comic-book battle. Pick uncovered hero tiles, collect three of a kind, and unleash a powerful attack.

MATCH WITH A PLAN
Look beneath overlapping tiles and choose your next move carefully. Your tray has seven slots, so every pick matters. Clear every tile and defeat the enemy to win the stage.

BRING TEN HERO POWERS TO THE FIGHT
Send shields flying, fire energy beams, call down lightning, and crash into battle with a wave. Each triple match brings a different hero attack to life.

BREAK THROUGH THE ARMOR
Each stage highlights two armor-breaking hero types. Find their matches to deal full armor damage, then keep matching to take down the enemy's health.

MAKE ROOM FOR A COMEBACK
Use Undo to take back a move, Move Out to free up to three tray slots, or Shuffle to change the board. Spend earned coins on boosters when you need a hand.

TAKE THE BATTLE ACROSS SIX SCENES
From neighborhood streets to a reactor showdown, discover new backdrops and increasingly layered puzzles, all in a colorful comic-book style.

CLAIM YOUR HERO MOMENT
Finish a stage to earn victory coins and return for daily sign-in rewards. Plan the match, feel the impact, and make your next move count.

Play in portrait on iPhone and iPad.

name: Pangu Spacing
description:
Pangu Spacing (Unofficial) automatically inserts crisp whitespace ("Pangu's White" / 盘古之白) between CJK characters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) and half-width Latin letters, digits, and symbols on web pages in Safari.

This is an unofficial cross-browser Safari Web Extension built on Vinta's pangu.js (MIT License) and is not affiliated with the original author. Released as free and open-source software under GPL-3.0.

Key Features:
- Automatic spacing on page load, or manual one-tap spacing from the Safari extension popup
- Customizable site Blocklist and Allowlist with wildcard (*) URL matching
- Single-page application (SPA) navigation support
- Optional "Zen Spacing" powered by native CSS text-autospace for purely visual spacing without altering copied text
- Optional sound effects and off-state toolbar icon on excluded sites
- Built-in UI language selector (English / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese)
- 100% local execution inside Safari — no data collection, no analytics, and no external network requests

How to Enable:
1. Open Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions (or Safari > Settings > Extensions on Mac)
2. Turn on Pangu Spacing and grant website access
3. Visit any page with mixed Chinese/CJK and English text to see automatic spacing in action

name: Paper Football: Fourth Period
description:
Fold it, flick it, hang it over the edge.

Paper Football is the game you played at the lunch table, on a school desk you can almost smell. Flick the paper triangle up the desk. If it hangs over the far edge without falling, that's a touchdown. Then line up the kick and put it through the finger goalposts.

HOW IT PLAYS
• One finger. Swipe to flick, or pull back like a slingshot.
• Touchdowns are 6. Extra points are 1.
• Stop right at the edge for a cliffhanger, and the extra point is worth 2.
• Last flick and too far out? Kick the field goal for 3, or go for it.
• Off the desk and you lose the ball.

WAYS TO PLAY
• Six classmates, each with their own style. Beat one to reach the next.
• Daily five: three hangs and two kicks, the same five shots for everyone that day. One try each.
• Pass and play: lay the phone flat between two people and play across the desk.

EARN
• Five footballs, from loose leaf to gum wrapper, and three desks. All earned by playing.

No ads. No purchases. No accounts. Plays offline.

name: Papertray: Document Scanner
description:
Papertray turns paper into clean, searchable documents and Markdown files, privately, on your iPhone and iPad.

Scan a stack of pages in one go. Papertray straightens and cleans each page, recognizes its text, and keeps the structure of what you scanned: titles, articles, numbered clauses and tables stay as printed. Everything happens on your device. There's no account, no internet connection and no data collection.

SCAN
• Scan many pages at once, with automatic edge detection
• Clean black-and-white, grayscale or color pages
• Add pages to a document later, or rescan one

TEXT YOU CAN USE
• On-device text recognition turns every scanned page into editable text
• Contracts keep their titles, articles and numbered clauses
• Tables become real tables you can export as CSV
• With Apple Intelligence, paragraphs are tidied on your device, without dropping a word or a number
• Correct a scanned page's text yourself
• Export a whole scanned document as one Markdown (.md) file, ready for any notes app or text editor

ORGANIZE AND FIND
• Folders and colored tags
• Search the text of every scanned page, not just the titles

IMPORT
• Bring in PDFs and photos as page images to mark up, sign and export as PDF; photos of pages are straightened automatically
• Open PDFs and images from Mail, Files or any app's share sheet

MARK UP AND SIGN
• Add text, dates, highlights, notes and freehand ink, with Apple Pencil on iPad
• Save your signature by drawing it, or by photographing it on paper
• Place it on any page in seconds, and lock your signatures with Face ID or Touch ID
• Markup never changes the scanned page underneath

EXPORT
• PDF with your markup and signatures drawn in, in standard or high quality
• Markdown (.md): the text of a whole scanned document in one file, with headings, clauses and tables kept
• Tables as CSV, ready for Numbers or Excel

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works fully offline, even in Airplane Mode
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your documents stay on your device; we never see them

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• A sidebar for your folders and tags on iPad
• Apple Pencil, keyboard shortcuts and Dark Mode

name: Papiyo: Digital Junk Journal
description:
Papiyo is your quiet, tactile digital junk journal and scrapbook atelier—built for café receipts, train tickets, pressed flowers, handwritten fragments, and layered collage spreads.

Unlike sterile note-taking apps or heavy flyer editors, Papiyo feels like opening a real 48-page bound notebook on an artisan wooden desk.

BIND BESPOKE 48-PAGE JOURNALS
• Design custom covers across Woven Linen, Full-Grain Leather, Raw Kraft, and Velvet Cloth.
• Stamp gold-foil titles and choose from 6 satin ribbon bookmarks.
• Browse your collection on an interactive 3D bookshelf—saved privately on your device with offline access.

3-MODE ZERO-JUMP STUDIO (WRITE · DRAW · COLLAGE)
• Write: Type or reflect across 4 curated typefaces (Manrope, Fraunces Serif, Caveat Script, Typewriter) on 10 textured papers including Parchment, Kraft Paper, Hobonichi 4mm, Dot Grid, Coffee Stained, Sheet Music, Watercolor Wash, and Starry Night—with optional distressed sepia edges.
• Draw: Sketch smoothly with our 60fps pure-vector ink engine featuring Fineliner, Mildliner, Watercolor, Pastel Chalk, Stitch Line, Eraser, 12 archival inks, and Behind/Front layering.
• Collage: Drag, rotate, scale, and layer scraps with 30-step Undo/Redo and 3-preset Magic Arrange auto-layout.

29 VECTOR EPHEMERA & MAGIC SCRAP CUTOUTS
• Customize 29 crisp SVG ephemera: café receipts, cinema/train/concert tickets, 3D wax seals, postage stamps, postmarks, apothecary labels, lace doilies, tarot cards, pressed botanicals, Dymo label tape, and 8 washi tape patterns in 6 colorways.
• Magic Scrap Cutout: Snap or import real photos, receipts, and ticket stubs (4:5 crop) inside 8 tactile frames (Torn Paper, 35mm Film, Postage Stamp, Arch, Cameo Oval, Taped Polaroid, Clipped Print, Polaroid).
• Start in seconds with 5 pre-arranged Starter Spreads or explore 5 curated Collection Packs (Parisian Café, Kyoto Autumn, Botanical Herbarium, Dark Academia, Coastal Summer).

EXPORT VIRAL 9:16 STORIES & REELS
• Frame any journal page over 4 atelier desk backdrops (Warm Linen, Walnut Desk, Atelier Sage, Midnight Velvet), preview animated layered playback, and export high-resolution 9:16 PNGs for Instagram Stories, TikTok, and Pinterest.

PRIVATE & LOCAL-FIRST
• Your writing, sketches, and photos live directly on your device. Export a full JSON archive anytime from Atelier Settings.
• Available in 8 languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, and Portuguese.

Studio Pass unlocks unlimited 48-page notebooks, all 10 papers, all 5 brushes, all 5 Collection Packs (60 curated treasures), unlimited cutouts, and clean watermark-free 9:16 exports.

name: Parhelion Docket
description:
Parhelion Docket is a calm day planner that lays your whole day out on one vertical timeline. Instead of an endless to-do list, every meeting, task, commute and break becomes a block with a start time and a length, so you can see at a glance where the day is full, where it overlaps and where it is still open.

The Today timeline shows blocks at their real times, with height proportional to duration and a gold Now line that moves through the day. Overlapping blocks sit side by side with a dashed outline and an "Overlaps with" note, and every gap of 30 minutes or more appears as a free window you can tap to plan into. Swipe a block right to mark it done or left to delete it with undo, drag its handle to shift it in 5-minute steps, or open it to see the lane, reminder, repeat rule, note and an attached photo such as an invitation, a ticket or a whiteboard.

When you plan a block, the editor checks it as you type: titles up to 60 characters, durations from 5 minutes to 12 hours, nothing past midnight, and a live mini timeline that highlights clashes before you save. Blocks can repeat daily, on weekdays or weekly, and carry an in-app reminder at the start or 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60 minutes before. Chimes slides a banner in with Done, Snooze 10 and Open, and lists what is up next and what you missed. Focus turns the current block into a full-screen countdown ring with a +5 min option.

Horizon shows the week as seven day bars with total load per day, and lets you move a block to another day. Blueprints keep reusable days, starting with Workday and Slow Sunday, and apply them to any date in Merge or Replace mode, or save the current day as a new blueprint. Daylight compares planned and done time over 7 or 30 days, by lane and by weekday. Lanes let you keep up to 12 colour-coded categories, and the whole plan exports and imports as a JSON file.

Parhelion Docket is built for freelancers, students, parents and anyone whose day is made of windows and appointments. No account, no subscription and no internet connection required: your plan stays on your device.

name: Parked: Locate Your Car
description:
Never wonder where you parked again.

Parked saves your spot in seconds: the level, section, spot number, a photo and a map pin. When you're ready to leave, it walks you right back to your car. A gentle reminder and a Lock Screen countdown keep an eye on the meter for you.

No account. No ads. No tracking.

SAVE YOUR SPOT IN TWO TAPS
Start with Any Building, Airport Parking or one of your saved places. Tap your level and section, then add a spot number, a note or as many photos as you need. Parked saves automatically 30 seconds after your last change, or tap Save to finish right away. Your details save even when there's no signal or location underground.

WALK RIGHT BACK TO YOUR CAR
See everything you saved at a glance: the blue pillar, the elevator, the garage entrance. If you saved a map pin, open walking directions in Apple Maps with one tap.

NEVER RUN OUT OF METER TIME
Set a parking timer with a quick preset or a specific date and time. You'll get a reminder 15 minutes before your time runs out and again at the end. A Live Activity keeps the countdown on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, so you can check it without opening the app.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN AND HOME SCREEN
Add a Home Screen or Lock Screen widget to see your current spot and time left. Save parking and Find my car are also available as controls in Control Center, on the Lock Screen and on the Action button, and as Siri and Shortcuts actions.

PERFECT FOR AIRPORTS, MALLS AND STADIUMS
Your spot stays saved until you finish parking, so it's still there after a long trip. Keep more than one active spot when you need to.

YOUR USUAL GARAGES, REMEMBERED
Save the places you park most and set the levels, sections and defaults you want ready next time. When you're near a saved place, Parked can suggest it.

EVERY VISIT, IN ONE PLACE
Look back through past visits, search your details, share a spot or export your parking history as a CSV file.

ON ALL YOUR IPHONES
iCloud sync keeps your spots, places and reminders in step across your iPhones, using your own private iCloud. There's no Parked account and no developer server. Turn sync off in Settings to keep everything on this iPhone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your parking details and photos stay on your iPhone and in your private iCloud, which we can't see. Nothing is shared unless you choose to share it, and you can delete your data at any time in Settings.

CALM AND EASY TO USE
Soft colors, clear type, large controls and a thoughtful dark appearance. Parked follows your preferred text size, and you can turn haptics off.

Location, camera and notifications are optional and requested only when you use a feature. GPS can be approximate in garages, so your level, notes and photos are there for indoor guidance. Reminders depend on your notification and Focus settings. Maps and walking directions use Apple's services.

name: Partner Orders
description:
Partner Orders is the ordering app for dealers and sales reps of brands on the partnermarketing.io platform.

For sales reps
• Open a customer and build an order from the full catalogue, with product photos
• Scan a barcode with the camera to add a product in seconds
• Download the catalogue and photos to work completely offline: orders wait in the outbox and are sent automatically once you are back online
• See your customers and their order history in one place

For dealers
• Order from your brand's own shop, in its own look and with your own prices
• Scan products in your store to reorder quickly

Every brand gets its own environment: after signing in you only see your own company's catalogue, prices and customers.

Partner Orders requires an account. Your brand or account manager sends you an invitation.

name: Partvoya
description:
Partvoya is the AI procurement desk for ship spares, built for ship owners, ship managers and superintendents.

Send a requisition the way you have it: a PDF, an Excel export, an email or a photo of a handwritten list taken on board. Partvoya reads every line, our desk checks it, and only the suppliers that carry the part are asked to quote. You approve one clear comparison on total delivered cost.

What you can do in the app
• Photograph a requisition, a data plate or a delivery note and send it in seconds
• Get a notification when quotes are in and when your approval is needed
• Compare offers on the cost on board, not only the part price
• Approve within your limit, or ask a colleague to approve
• Follow each order from the supplier to the vessel
• Keep the Material Declarations and SDoCs for your Inventory of Hazardous Materials, by vessel

For suppliers
• Receive requests for quotation and quote from your phone
• See every order you win and keep the buyer updated

Buyers and suppliers each have their own free company account. Choose "I buy for vessels" or "I supply" when you open the app.

name: Passa Quatro Clube
description:
Passa Quatro Clube de Campo – Seu clube na palma da mão!

O aplicativo do Passa Quatro Clube de Campo foi desenvolvido para aproximar ainda mais os associados e dependentes da rotina do clube, oferecendo praticidade, comodidade e facilidade de acesso aos principais serviços e informações, tudo diretamente pelo celular. O acesso é destinado a quem já possui credencial emitida pelo clube; não há inscrição pelo aplicativo.

Com uma estrutura completa voltada ao lazer, esporte e convivência familiar, o Passa Quatro Clube de Campo oferece diversas opções para aproveitar os melhores momentos. São piscinas para toda a família, saunas seca e a vapor, quadras esportivas, campo de futebol, academia, parquinho infantil e espaços especialmente preparados para confraternizações e eventos.

Entre as opções disponíveis no clube, você encontra:

Lazer e relaxamento: uma piscina grande, duas piscinas menores, sauna seca e sauna a vapor.
Esportes e atividades físicas: duas quadras de tênis, quadra de futsal, basquete, quadra de areia, campo de futebol e academia.
Convivência e gastronomia: dois quiosques com churrasqueiras, espaço gourmet para festas, lanchonete e espaço de sinuca.
Eventos e celebrações: salão amplo para eventos e uma charmosa área com pergolado, ideal para celebrações especiais, como casamentos.
Diversão para crianças: parquinho infantil, proporcionando momentos de lazer para os pequenos.
Pelo aplicativo, os associados poderão acessar diversos serviços e funcionalidades, como:

Carteirinha digital para identificação e acesso ao clube;
Consulta financeira e acompanhamento de mensalidades;
Reservas de espaços e estruturas disponíveis;
Consulta de atividades e serviços do clube;
Atualização de dados cadastrais;
Acesso a notícias, comunicados e informações importantes.
Tudo isso em um ambiente digital prático e intuitivo, pensado para facilitar o dia a dia dos associados e proporcionar uma experiência ainda melhor. Use o aplicativo do Passa Quatro Clube de Campo e tenha o seu clube sempre ao alcance das mãos.

name: Passage Guild Captain
description:
Set sail from Coralhaven in an original offline strategy adventure. Carry more cargo, protect your hull, rescue the crew or follow the glimmer below the tide.

- Three charter types: spice delivery, lighthouse rescue and tidal surveys.
- Three crew specialists with distinct sailing advantages.
- Five branching legs with visible wind directions and provision costs.
- Salvage, storms, markets, rescues and relics with clear consequences.
- Permanent hull, sail and hold upgrades.
- Eight illustrated relics with stories and a voyage ledger.
- Daily charts, local best rewards and automatic saving.

No account or internet connection required. Progress stays on your device. No advertising or in-app purchases.

name: PassRelax
description:
PassRelax helps you prepare for the state certificate exam in Polish as a foreign language at level B1. Enter your exam date and the app builds a daily plan of about 15 minutes, counting down the days for you.

What you can do in the app

• Daily plan: three short tasks a day (grammar, listening, reading), a countdown to your exam date, a streak and an optional daily reminder.
• All five exam parts: listening, reading, grammar, writing and speaking, with tasks in the style of the exam. Exercises are always in Polish, like the real exam.
• Explanations: after each answer you see why it is right or wrong, with key words. Mistakes are collected so you can repeat them, and flashcards bring words back for review.
• Writing: write an email or a letter and get an AI estimate of your score by the exam criteria, a corrected version of your text with changes marked, and a model answer. Letter templates give you steps and ready phrases.
• Speaking: record your answer or type it, get an AI estimate by the criteria, and compare with a model answer.
• Mock exam: a full run through all five parts with a time limit, a total score out of 160 points and a result for each part. You pass with at least 50% in every part, and the app shows which part is below that line.
• Progress: see your results in every part against the 50% pass mark, and a rough range of your chances based on your own results.
• Extras for Ukrainian speakers: false friends and calques from Ukrainian and Russian in short mini-lessons.
• Exam dates: optional reminders to check registration for upcoming exam sessions with an exam centre.
• Languages: the app interface is in English, Polish and Ukrainian. You can switch at any time.

Good to know

• AI feedback is an estimate and not an official score. To rate writing and speaking, the text you submit is sent for assessment, only after you agree in the app.
• AI rating requires an account (sign in with your e-mail) and access to the app. A free writing check is available without an account.
• PassRelax is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with the organisation that runs the exam. It does not guarantee a result.

name: PATH – Internships
description:
PATH – Your Next Opportunity Starts Here

Finding the right internship shouldn't be complicated.

PATH is a mobile platform connecting students and aspiring professionals with internship opportunities while helping companies discover and manage emerging talent.

Whether you're looking to gain practical experience or searching for your next intern, PATH brings the process together in one simple experience.

FOR STUDENTS & INTERNS

Discover Opportunities
Explore internship listings, view company information, and find opportunities aligned with your skills, interests, and career goals.

Build Your Professional Profile
Showcase your education, technical skills, and experience. Upload your CV and create a profile that helps companies understand your background.

Explore Skill Matches
See how your skills align with internship requirements and identify opportunities that suit your profile.

Apply with Ease
Submit internship applications directly through PATH.

Track Your Applications
Keep your applications organized and follow their progress, including updates when companies review or decide on your applications.

FOR COMPANIES

Publish Internship Opportunities
Create and manage internship listings with role descriptions, requirements, and application details.

Discover Emerging Talent
Review applications and explore candidate profiles, qualifications, and relevant skills.

Manage Recruitment
Organize applicants, track recruitment stages, and manage application decisions from one workspace.

Structured Candidate Screening
Use configurable screening criteria and evidence-based reports to support application reviews while keeping hiring decisions under human control.

WHY PATH?

• A dedicated platform for internships
• Personalized skill-based opportunity matching
• Professional student and company profiles
• Easy internship applications and status tracking
• Organized recruitment tools for companies
• A mobile experience for interns and recruiters

START YOUR JOURNEY WITH PATH

Build your profile, explore opportunities, and take the next step toward valuable professional experience.

For companies, PATH provides a convenient way to connect with emerging talent and manage internship recruitment.

Your future starts with PATH.

name: Patili Garson: Restoran Oyunu
description:
Çocukluğumuzun garson oyunlarını hatırlıyor musun? Şimdi sıra Patili'de!

Patili, paten kayan turuncu bir kedi garson. Müşterileri masalara oturt, siparişleri al, mutfaktan tabakları kap ve sıcak sıcak servis et. Ne kadar hızlı ve dikkatli olursan bahşişler o kadar büyür!

REKLAM YOK, SATIN ALMA YOK, İNTERNET GEREKMEZ

Patili Garson tamamen ücretsiz. Oyunun ortasında reklam çıkmaz, ilerlemek için para istenmez, hiçbir veri toplanmaz. İnternet olmadan her yerde oynanır; çocuğunuza gönül rahatlığıyla verebilirsiniz.

NASIL OYNANIR?
• Kapıdaki müşterileri boş bir masaya oturt
• Hazır olduklarında siparişlerini al
• Yemek tezgâha gelince tabakları kap
• Doğru masaya götür, kalkınca parayı ve bahşişi topla
Yanlış masaya tabak götürürsen ya da müşteriyi fazla bekletirsen kalpleri düşer!

KENDİ RESTORANINI KUR
• Restoranına adını ver, tabelanı kendin tasarla: ahşap, kara tahta, emaye, denizci ya da neon
• Sahil Kafe'den başla, sonra İskele Lokantası'nı ve Teras Restoran'ı satın al
• Masaları, tezgâhı, aşçıyı ve dekoru geliştir
• Teras'ı bitirince Sonsuz Mod açılır: her gün daha kalabalık!

PATİLİ'Yİ GİYDİR
• Önlükler, papyonlar, aşçı şapkası, denizci kepi, gözlük, hatta bir taç
• Rengârenk patenler: her biri kayarken kendi izini bırakır. Baloncuk, kalp, neon ışık, simli pırıltı...
• Cepli Önlük ve Sipariş Defteri gibi işini kolaylaştıran eşyalar

HER GÜN YENİ BİR GÖREV
Kimseyi kaçırmadan günü bitir, kalabalık grupları ağırla, bahşiş rekoru kır. Günü yıldızlarla kapat; yıldızlar yeni tabela stillerini ve giysileri açar.

KİMLER İÇİN?
• Eski garson ve restoran oyunlarını özleyenler
• Kedi oyunlarını sevenler
• Çocuğuna reklamsız, güvenli bir oyun arayan anne babalar
• Kısa molalarda tatlı bir oyun arayanlar

Sakin bir menü müziği ve kıpır kıpır bir servis ritmi seni bekliyor. Önlüğünü bağla, patenlerini giy: Patili Garson'da servis başlıyor!

name: PatiVerse
description:
PatiVerse, kedi, köpek, kuş ve diğer evcil dostlarının günlük bakımını, beslenmesini ve sağlık kayıtlarını tek bir modern ve sakin alanda yönetmen için tasarlanmış kişisel evcil hayvan bakım asistanıdır.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER:
• Çoklu Dost Yönetimi: Her dostun için ayrı profil, fotoğraf, yaş, kilo, alerji ve mikroçip bilgisi.
• Günlük Mama Takibi: Özelleştirilebilir gramaj hedefleri, tek dokunuşla sabah/akşam öğün ekleme ve haftalık tüketim grafikleri.
• Su Tüketimi Takibi: Ölçülen ve tahmini su ayrımı, su kabı kısayolu ve ortak su kabı desteği.
• Türüne Özel Günlük Bakım: Kedi ve köpeklere özel günlük rutinler, özel görev oluşturma ve hatırlatmalar.
• Sağlık Kayıtları & Dijital Pasaport: Kilo takibi grafiği, kronolojik sağlık zaman çizelgesi, aşı karnesi/rapor fotoğrafı ekleme ve dijital kimlik kartı.
• Dinamik Aşı Takvimi: Takvim ve liste görünümü ile yaklaşan aşı takibi ve hatırlatmalar.
• PatiVerse AI Asistan: Dostunun profiline, alerjilerine ve günlük tüketimine duyarlı eğitici bakım rehberi (açık kullanıcı onayı ile çalışır; veteriner hekim yerine geçmez).
• Türkçe ve İngilizce Dil Desteği, Açık ve Koyu Tema, Misafir Modu veya Apple/E-posta ile Bulut Yedekleme.

Not: PatiVerse ve PatiVerse AI yalnızca eğitici takip ve bakım rehberliği sunar; tıbbi teşhis veya tedavi yerine geçmez. Sağlık sorunlarında mutlaka veteriner hekiminize danışınız.

name: Pawfolio: Dog & Cat Health
description:
Your dog and cat health tracker, private on your phone.

Pawfolio keeps every vaccine date, vet visit, medicine and weight for your pets in one place, with reminders so the important things don't slip.

PET VACCINE TRACKER
Record each vaccine and the next due date your vet gave you. See what's overdue or due soon at a glance, and get a reminder on the day.

PILL & MEDICATION REMINDERS
Add medicines, flea and worming treatments, teeth brushing and other care. Get reminders once, daily, on chosen days, every few days or monthly. Enter instructions exactly as your vet wrote them.

VET VISITS & HEALTH TIMELINE
Notes, photos, vet visits, symptoms and grooming, sorted by date for each animal.

WEIGHT TRACKER
Log your dog's or cat's weight in kg or lb and see it on a chart over time. Great for puppies, kittens and senior pets.

HEALTH REPORT FOR YOUR VET
Make a tidy PDF health record (choose the pet, dates and sections) to share with your vet, pet sitter or boarding kennel.

BACKUP & NEW PHONE
Save a complete backup to Files or iCloud Drive and restore it on a new phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Pawfolio does not upload your records. Your phone's own backups may include them.

2 pets are free with every feature. A one-time purchase unlocks unlimited pets. No subscription.

Pawfolio stores records you enter. It does not give veterinary advice, suggest vaccine schedules or calculate doses. Always follow your vet's advice.

name: Paws Sort: Color Puzzle
description:
Match colors. Bring pets home.

Paws Sort is a cozy sorting puzzle with lovable cats and dogs. Move groups of pets between ropes, join matching pets, and fill a home with its matching group.

• Sort pets with distinctive natural coat colors and patterns
• Plan each move and make room on empty ropes
• Enjoy a warm, uncluttered puzzle board

Take your time and help every pet find a cozy home.

name: PAZOOLE
description:
動物を選んでマスを塗り、同じ広さの縄張りをつくろう。

空きマスをすべて埋めて、各色に動物を1匹ずつ。どの縄張りも同じマス数で、上下左右がつながればクリアです。盤面の動物やパレットから色を選び、タップやドラッグで塗れます。

・全500ステージ。小さな4×4から、手ごたえのある12×12まで。
・色選び、塗り方、塗り直しを試せるチュートリアル。
・クリアするたび次のステージが解放され、6面ごとに園の展示が増えます。
・途中の盤面とクリア記録は端末に保存され、いつでも続きから遊べます。

name: PDF Monster: Scanner & Editor
description:
PDF Monster turns paper into clean PDFs and handles the PDF tasks of everyday life. No ads, no watermarks and no account.

SCAN
• Scan documents with the camera, edges are found and straightened
• Several pages in one PDF; reorder, retake or delete pages
• Filters: Document, Enhanced color, Light, Grayscale, Black & white, also per page
• Quality guard: a hint for blurry or too dark pages
• Text recognition: the PDF becomes searchable and text can be copied
• Scan ID cards: front and back on one page, at original size
• Name from the text: "Invoice" plus sender becomes the file name
• Scan more pages, photos and screenshots to PDF, custom paper size

PDF TOOLS (no subscription needed)
• Merge, split, rotate, delete, reorder and extract pages
• Compress with a preview of the new size before saving
• Sign with your finger, plus date and text
• Fill in forms, highlight and comment
• Redact: the parts are really removed, not just covered
• PDF pages as images, add and remove a password
• Open in PDF Monster: edit PDFs straight from Mail, WhatsApp or Files

PDF MONSTER PRO (7-day free trial)
• Automatic sorting: invoices, contracts and IDs go into the right folder
• Deadline reminder: "payable by …" is found, you are reminded the day before
• Batch scan: every page becomes its own PDF, named from its text
• Automatic redaction: finds IBANs, e-mail addresses and phone numbers
Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription (each with a 7-day free trial) or as a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Cancel any time in the app under Settings › Pro or in your Apple ID settings.

YOUR FILES STAY WITH YOU
Everything happens on your iPhone, offline too. No upload, no account, no ads. Deleted PDFs stay in the trash for 30 days. The original is kept with every edit.

Note: the signature is a simple electronic signature and does not replace a qualified electronic signature.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://roxapps.com/en/pdf-monster/privacy/

name: PDF本棚
description:
PDF本棚は、たくさんのPDFを「本棚」と「ファイル」で整理し、開いて書き込み、必要なページを集めて一冊にまとめるためのアプリです。図面・手順書・マニュアルなど、現場や仕事で何度も開く資料に向いています。

■ 本棚とファイル
・PDFを本として本棚に並べます。表紙は1ページ目、タイトルはいつも見えます
・関連する本を、背ラベルと色の付いたファイルにまとめられます
・分類（図面・手順書・マニュアルなど）を自分で作れます
・追加順・名前順・ファイルサイズ順・分類順・手動順で並べ替え、名前で検索できます
・棚の表示と一覧の表示を切り替えられます

■ 読む・書き込む
・ページ移動、拡大縮小、サムネイル、PDF内の文字の検索
・前に見ていたページから再開します
・ペンで書き込み（色・太さ・消しゴム・取り消し）
・好きな場所にテキストを置けます
・iPadではApple Pencilで書き、指で移動・拡大できます。iPhoneでは指で書けます
・書き込みは自動で保存します。元のPDFは書き換えません

■ しおり
・見ているページに、ワンタップでしおりを付けられます。名前とメモを付けられます
・本ごと、ファイルごと、本棚全体でしおりを一覧できます
・しおりを押すと、そのページを直接開きます

■ 別冊を作る
・1冊または複数のPDFから必要なページを選び、並べ替え・回転して新しい一冊にまとめます
・結合、抽出、分割ができます
・書き込みとしおりを引き継げます
・元のPDFはそのまま残ります

■ 共有
・PDFそのもの、または書き込み付きのPDFを共有できます
・書き込み付きのPDFは、ほかのPDFビューアでも書き込みが見えます。元の文字は検索でき、図面は拡大しても線のままです

■ PDFは端末の中に
・取り込んだPDFと書き込みは端末の中に保存し、外へ送りません。通信がなくても読めます
・アカウントの登録はいりません

■ 広告と「広告を消す」
・本棚と読む画面の下に広告が出ます
・「広告を消す」（買い切り）を購入すると、広告が出なくなります。機種変更のときは「購入を復元」で戻せます

name: PDF编辑器 - 扫描格式转换助手
description:
用 iPhone 把纸质资料扫描成 PDF，给合同加上手写签名，或从多页文档中提取需要的几页。页简让你在手机上完成扫描、编辑、整理和分享。

• 拍照扫描　拍摄合同、票据或讲义，将单页或多页内容保存为 PDF。也可以从相册导入图片，在保存前预览、旋转或补拍。
• 编辑与批注　在 PDF 页面添加文本框、插入图片，或用画笔圈出重点。支持调整文字样式，并撤销或重做编辑操作。
• 签名与水印　直接在文档上手写签名，也可以从照片中提取签名并留作下次使用。支持为整份 PDF 添加文字水印，调整颜色、透明度和平铺样式。
• 整理 PDF 页面　合并多份 PDF，按页拆分文档，或将选中的页面提取为独立文件。支持拖拽排序、添加和删除页面。
• 管理与分享　用文件夹归类资料，按文件名快速搜索，从「最近删除」恢复误删文件。整理完毕后，可导出、分享或打印 PDF。

name: PEARL WHISPER
description:
Dive into PEARL WHISPER, a soothing observation puzzle set beneath the waves.

Shells open on the ocean floor. Inside each one rests a unique pearl—different in color, size, shape, pattern, and sheen. Read the clue, look carefully, and tap the pearl that truly matches.

Every level sharpens your eye. Early tides teach simple colors. Deeper chapters ask you to combine details—find the large pink pearl, the blue teardrop, the gold pearl with star sparkles. Near-misses will try to fool you. Only one answer is correct.

Explore six ocean chapters across 60 levels: Coral Bay, Shell Garden, Pearl Reef, Luster Depths, Starlit Trench, and Whisper Abyss. Collect pearls, unlock shells, earn stars for clean clears, and follow the journey map as the sea reveals more of its secrets.

Soft visuals, gentle motion, and a quiet focus on noticing what others overlook.

Open the shell.
Observe the pearl.
Discover the whisper.

name: PedometerX: Step Counter
description:
PedometerX is the step counter that talks. Head out with your iPhone in your pocket and, as you close in on your goal, it tells you out loud how many steps you’ve taken.

Voice alerts, right when they help most: on the way to your goal and when you reach it. You hear them with your iPhone locked, through the speaker or your headphones, without taking it out or looking at the screen. Prefer quiet? Get notifications instead.

And when you want to look, it’s a complete pedometer:
- Today: a ring that closes with your steps, your distance and your floors.
- History by week, month and year, with your records. It reads what’s already in Health, so you start with your whole history.
- Streaks with rest days and pause: a cold or a trip won’t break them.
- Medals for steps, distance, floors and streaks, and a new challenge every month.
- Walk, hike and run workouts with your route on the map, plus treadmill. Saved to Health.
- Twenty widgets: twelve for the Home Screen, eight for the Lock Screen.
- On Apple Watch: today’s steps on your wrist, and five complications for your watch face.
- Twelve color themes, light and dark. Kilometers or miles.

Simple on purpose: pick your goal and go.

No subscriptions. No ads. No accounts. Your data stays on your iPhone, your Apple Watch and in Health.

name: Pegloop Driver
description:
Pegloop Driver is the app for drivers at laundries that pick up and deliver with Pegloop. Your laundry adds you to its team; you sign in with your email and a one-time code, and your day is ready.

YOUR DAY, IN ORDER
See today's pickups and returns in the order the shop has planned, with the pickup window, address and customer notes on each stop. Check tomorrow with one tap.

ONE TAP PER STEP
Start driving, I've arrived, Picked up or Delivered. Each tap updates the shop straight away, and the customer can be told you're on your way. Tapped the wrong thing? Undo it within 5 seconds.

PROOF AT THE DOOR
Take a photo of the bags or the door, count the bags, and add a note. If no one's home, say so with a photo or a note and the shop knows right away.

GET PAID AT THE DOOR
When a customer still owes money, the stop shows how much. Mark it paid by cash or card as you hand over the clothes.

NAVIGATE AND CALL
Open directions in Maps, and call or text the customer, or call the shop when the laundry keeps customer numbers private.

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
Lifts, basements and dead spots don't stop you. Taps and photos are saved on your phone and sent as soon as you're back online.

JOB ALERTS
Turn on alerts to hear when the shop gives you a stop or changes a time. Tap the alert to open that stop.

LOCATION, ONLY WHILE YOU WORK
While you have stops left today, the shop sees where you are, and a customer sees how far away you are only while you're on your way to them. Location runs in the background only while you're driving to a stop, and you can pause sharing at any time. We keep only your latest position, never your route.

You need an account from a laundry that uses Pegloop. Laundry owners can find out more at pegloop.com.

name: Pegote
description: Plan a flower arrangement before cutting. Position stems and use their measured lengths to estimate each trim.

name: Pendi
description:
Viste un flyer en Instagram, TikTok o WhatsApp y dijiste "a esto voy"… y se te olvidó. Con Pendi ya no.

Guárdalo en Pendi: comparte la captura, la publicación o una foto del cartel, y Pendi lee los datos del evento por ti: nombre, fecha, hora, lugar, precio y preventa. Tú solo revisas y guardas.

Te avisamos en el momento justo
• Cuando abre la preventa, con el link de boletos listo.
• Un día antes, para que no se te cruce con otro plan.
• A qué hora salir para llegar a tiempo.
• Un resumen semanal con lo que tienes en la semana.

Todos tus planes en un solo lugar
• Tu próximo plan y la cuenta regresiva en la pantalla de inicio.
• Calendario del mes con tus días ocupados.
• Historial de lo que fuiste.
• Marca "Voy", "Tal vez" o "No".

Invita a tus amigos con un link
Comparte un plan y tus amigos ven el flyer, la fecha y el lugar, y lo pueden agregar a su calendario aunque no tengan la app.

Privado por diseño
Solo tú ves tus planes y tus flyers. No vendemos tus datos ni mostramos anuncios. Puedes borrar tu cuenta y todos tus datos desde la app.

Hecho en la Ciudad de México para conciertos, fiestas, talleres, mercados, teatro, deporte y todo lo que se anuncia con un flyer.

name: Perfectly Surrendered
description:
Perfectly Surrendered is a 30-day walk from Why? to Who.

For the woman who is angry, weary or ashamed about where her life is, and who keeps asking God "why?" This study doesn't ask you to clean it up first. It walks you, one day at a time, from honest lament to real surrender.

EACH DAY
• A passage to open in your own Bible, with a link to read it online
• One verse to sit with
• "Walk with me," a short, honest guide
• A heart check-in: angry, weary, ashamed, numb, anxious, hopeful or grateful
• Three reflection questions to write through
• "Today, Lord, I surrender…" and a closing prayer

THE WALK
Week 1 · Bring God your why
Week 2 · When it's my fault
Week 3 · I surrender all
Week 4 · Trust in the waiting
Finale · From why to Who

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your journal saves as you type and only you can read it. No ads, and your words are never sold or used to train AI.

Gentle daily reminders say "It's time to walk" at the hour you choose. Your map of 30 days fills in with your heart color as you go, and your surrender wall collects everything you've laid down.

From Melissa Blevins and Perfection Hangover.

Scripture quotations are from the Christian Standard Bible®, Copyright © 2017 by Holman Bible Publishers. Used by permission.

name: Perky Bean Clock
description:
Does drinking coffee in the afternoon affect your sleep tonight? With Perky Bean, you can see how much caffeine is still in your body and when to stop drinking for a better night's rest.

Simply record what you drink, and Perky Bean will estimate the increase and decrease in caffeine over time. You can track your current caffeine intake, see your bedtime forecast, and know the latest time you can have another drink while staying below your sleep-friendly caffeine threshold.

The app supports many popular drinks such as espresso, brewed coffee, cold brew, latte, tea, matcha, soft drinks, energy drinks, and even dark chocolate. Default servings are adjustable, and you can record drinks consumed, add a previous drink, or plan for a future one.

Each morning, record your sleep quality, the time you fell asleep, and the number of times you woke up during the night. Over time, you can see how your caffeine habits relate to your own sleep assessments. Perky Bean also provides statistics on your daily caffeine intake, when you usually drink it, and your favorite types of beverages.

You can customize your sleep time, wake-up time, daily caffeine limit, and caffeine elimination rate to suit you. Reminders for when to stop drinking and morning sleep tracking also help you maintain a consistent routine.

All data is stored on your device; no account creation is required. You can also export your history as a CSV file at any time.

Enjoy your favorite cup of coffee, but don't let caffeine make bedtime unpredictable.

name: Personality Test & Match
description:
Discover yourself, understand others, and build meaningful connections with Personality Test & Match.

Explore your personality through a 50-question assessment based on the Big Five personality model (OCEAN).

KEY FEATURES

• Big Five Personality Test
• Personalised personality results
• Detailed personality trait insights
• Personality matching and compatibility
• Profile sharing via QR code
• Personal growth insights
• Career suggestions
• Personality exploration

Understand your five core personality traits: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism.

Compare your personality with friends, partners, and family members to explore your similarities and differences.

Whether you are interested in self-discovery, relationships, psychology, or personal development, Personality Test & Match helps you better understand yourself and others.

Start your journey of self-discovery today.

Disclaimer: This app is intended for educational and informational purposes only. It does not provide medical diagnoses or professional psychological advice. Compatibility results do not guarantee relationship outcomes.

name: PestShift: Pest Control AI CRM
description:
PestShift is the business app for pest control companies. Run your day from your phone: see today's visits, add photos and chemical records on site, send invoices and keep every customer in one place.

FOR OWNERS AND OFFICE STAFF
• Calendar and daily schedule for the whole team
• Customer records with service history, notes and agreements
• Estimates and service agreements customers can accept and sign
• Invoices with a secure link so customers can pay online
• Ask PestShift: an AI assistant that answers questions about your schedule, customers and invoices

FOR TECHNICIANS
• "My day" shows only your own visits
• Add photos from the camera or your library straight to the visit
• Record products and chemical applications for each service
• Visit notes and chemical records save without signal and sync when you're back online

NOTIFICATIONS YOU CONTROL
Get notified about new online bookings, signed agreements, paid invoices, failed payments, changes to today's visits, tomorrow's summary, new customer messages, missing chemical records and expiring licenses. Turn each one on or off in Settings, with quiet hours at night.

PRIVATE AND SECURE
Lock the app with Face ID or your passcode. Notifications never show customer details on the lock screen. You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

PestShift is for pest control businesses with a PestShift account. Sign in with email, Google or Apple.

name: Pet&Love - Nana
description:
Nana — walks are better with company.

Nana is the social app for dog people. Find walking buddies nearby, share every walk, go live from the park, and keep the conversation going with chat and video calls — unlocked once you both follow each other.

• Discover walkers and dogs around you
• Post photos and clips from every walk
• Go live and send gifts to your favourite hosts
• Chat, call and plan the next walk together
• Block or report anyone in two taps

Built for people who would rather walk with company.

name: Phone Autopsy: Detective Game
description:
Someone died. The police closed the case. Their phone is in your hands.

Phone Autopsy is a detective game where every case is a real-feeling smartphone: messages, photos, deleted pictures, voicemails, notes, health data, door logs and calendar. The truth is hidden in the gaps between the apps.

HOW IT WORKS
• Crack the passcode with a clue the client sends you
• Dig through the victim's phone like it's real — because it feels real
• Pin anything suspicious as evidence 
• Don't type answers: SHOW the evidence. No more "I typed the right answer and it said no"
• Catch the contradiction: a message sent at 02:14 by someone whose heart stopped at 01:58
• Rebuild the night on a timeline and accuse the killer with proof

WHY DETECTIVES LOVE IT
• Hand-crafted murder mystery cases with real twists, red herrings and fair clues
• Every character texts differently — typos, emoji, silence — and that is a clue too
• Evidence board with red strings, suspect statuses and a luminol reveal
• Grades (S/A/B/C), XP, detective ranks and badges
• Hints when you're stuck ("Insight"), never a dead end
• A new case every Monday

FAIR BY DESIGN
The first half of every case is free. Halfway, you choose: unlock that single case once, get the Case Pass for every case, or wait for the forensic report and continue for free. No surprise paywalls.

Crime, investigation, murder mystery, whodunit, true-crime style story games and detective puzzles — all on one locked phone.

All people, phones and events are fictional.

Case Pass is an optional auto-renewing subscription (weekly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://phone-autopsy.web.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://phone-autopsy.web.app/privacy.html

name: Photo Editor: AI Retouch Tools
description:
Photo Editor: AI Retouch Tools

Make every photo look the way you imagined. Clean up distracting objects, change the background and refine details with a simple photo-editing workflow.

• REMOVE UNWANTED OBJECTS — Brush over distractions and tidy up your shots.
• CHANGE THE BACKGROUND — Isolate the subject and replace or simplify the scene.
• RETOUCH PORTRAITS — Refine small blemishes and adjust how photos look.
• EDIT WITH CONFIDENCE — Crop, adjust and fine-tune your favorite images.
• CREATE YOUR LOOK — Use filters and visual adjustments to bring your style together.

From everyday selfies and travel pictures to product photos and content for social media, keep attention on what matters in the frame. Review each edit and choose the result you want to save. Different tools suit different photos, so explore the available options and build your own editing routine.

HOW TO GET STARTED
Choose a photo, pick the edit you need, and adjust the result until the subject looks right. For object cleanup, focus on the distracting area. For backgrounds, start with the subject and choose the backdrop that fits your image. For portraits, use subtle adjustments rather than over-editing.

WHAT YOU CAN MAKE
A tidier vacation photo, a cleaner profile picture, a product image with less clutter, or an image for your next social post. Keep your original creative intent and use the tools that help the photo communicate it.

A more focused photo editing experience for images you want to share, keep or use in creative projects.

Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_V7hXCxYhzWbnToydbvZ3tSIoosXYgb1AO1hJ0arieo/edit?usp=sharing
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: photoBanana: AI Photo Editor
description:
Turn one selfie into a whole photoshoot.

photoBanana restyles your photo with AI into film looks, flash snaps and dreamy scenes, and keeps it looking like you. No sign-up, no editing skills, no complicated sliders. Pick a look, add a selfie, tap Create.

LOOKS
Change the mood of your photo in one tap:
• Honey Hour: warm last-hour-of-sun glow
• Red Room: bold red-light flash with club-night energy
• Golden Grain: warm everyday film with gentle grain
• After Dark: hard flash against a city night
• Digicam Era: that early-2000s pocket-camera glow
• Dewy Glow, Sparkle Haze, Film Still, Noir, Frost, Sun Leak and more

SCENES
Put yourself somewhere new:
• Neon Crossing: a neon city crossing at dusk
• Euro Summer: a sunlit old European street
• Cover Star: an editorial fashion shoot
• Amalfi Lunch, Jumbotron, Last Call, Matcha Date, Highway Nights, Make a Wish and more

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a look or scene
2. Take a selfie or choose a photo
3. Tap Create photo, and your new photo is ready in about 30 seconds

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Looks like you: built to keep your face, hair and features recognisable
• Before and after: slide to compare, pinch to zoom in on the detail
• Save in high resolution or share straight to your stories
• Your own gallery of every photo you make, kept on your phone
• New looks and scenes added every week
• No account needed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Your photo is used only to create your result and isn't kept on our servers. Your finished photos stay on your phone.

PLANS
Creating photos needs a weekly subscription:
• Plus: 5 photos every day
• Gold: 10 photos every day
Credits refill every day. If a photo fails, the credit comes back automatically. New subscribers may get a lower price for their first week.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Your subscription renews automatically each week at the price shown in the app unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current week. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://photobanana-api.photobanana-api.workers.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://photobanana-api.photobanana-api.workers.dev/privacy

name: PhotoCanvas Grid
description:
写真と動画を選ぶだけで、自由なグリッドレイアウトを作成できる画像・動画編集アプリです。

主な機能
・1〜9、16、25、36枚の写真や動画に対応
・写真を追加しながらレイアウトを確認
・仕切りをドラッグして枠サイズを調整
・各素材を移動、拡大・縮小、回転
・動画のループ再生、長押し停止、音声オン／オフ
・複数動画を含むレイアウトを動画として保存
・枠幅や表示スタイルを調整
・編集画面で写真や動画を交換

素材は端末内で編集されます。Instagramなどへ投稿できる画像・動画を簡単に作成できます。

name: PhotoPeya: Photo Editing Tools
description:
PhotoPeya is a photo editor and a set of tools for preparing pictures to post, send or save. Open an image from Photos, adjust its look, add your own words and export a separate copy. Your original photo stays unchanged.

Start with the background. Remove it to isolate a person or object, then keep the space transparent or choose a solid color. Background removal happens on your iPhone, and results depend on the subject and image.

Build the frame around what matters. Crop away distractions, rotate or flip the image and choose a frame that fits. Preview a filter and adjust its intensity, or fine-tune brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, hue, temperature, tint and fade yourself.

Make the image say something. Add text, choose a font and color, set its alignment or add a background, then move, resize and rotate it. Point out a detail with a brush, arrow, line or shape.
