Use local blur or pixelation on an area, soften the whole photo, or add an emoji. Undo and redo help you work through changes as you edit.

Choose PNG, JPEG or WebP when exporting. PNG and WebP retain transparency; JPEG fills transparent areas with white. Pick a size preset or enter your own width and height, with the option to keep the aspect ratio. Adjust JPEG quality and see the prepared file’s dimensions and size before saving to Photos or sharing. Images are prepared at up to 2560 pixels on the longest edge; custom export can resize beyond that working size.

Explore more tools from the home screen:

• Carousel Split: turn a photo into 2–5 square or portrait JPEG slides and share the slides or export them as a ZIP.
• File Size Target: create a JPEG to fit a size limit, reducing dimensions if needed.
• Color Palette: extract colors from a photo, copy HEX codes and save a palette or a palette image.
• Color Picker: sample pixels, copy HEX codes and build a palette to save for later.

PhotoPeya processes photos on your device. There is no account to create or subscription to manage. Save or share your edited image before closing the app: unfinished editing sessions are not restored. Saved palettes remain available separately.

name: Picenti: Church Management
description:
Picenti is the parish app for Coptic Orthodox churches. It keeps your church's members, services and records together in one secure place, and puts them in your pocket.

Your church needs a Picenti account to use the app. Members join by creating an account and asking their church for access, which a church administrator approves.

FOR PRIESTS, SERVANTS AND THE PARISH OFFICE
• Members and families: find anyone in the parish by name, email or phone, open their record, and call, message or get directions in one tap.
• Attendance: show a QR code at the door so people check themselves in, or keep the register by hand. Marks made without a signal are kept and sent when you are back online.
• Sacraments and certificates: the parish register of baptisms, chrismations, marriages and more.
• Pastoral care: plan visits, schedule follow-ups and see which families have not been visited for a while.
• Groups and ministries: rosters, leaders, events and the service rota for youth, choir, deacons and Sunday School.
• Announcements and calendar: tell the parish what is happening, and keep every liturgy, meeting and class on one calendar.
• Giving: record donations and issue receipts for the parish's books. The app takes no payments.
• Reports and birthdays: attendance and membership figures, and the birthdays coming up.

FOR MEMBERS AND FAMILIES
• Your church's calendar, events and announcements, and replies to invitations.
• Your own records: sacraments, attendance, documents and giving, and those of your children.
• Prayer requests that only your priests read, answered personally.
• Sunday School lessons children can follow at home, collecting stars as they go.
• Chat with the groups and ministries you belong to.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Each church's data is kept apart, and what you see depends on your role.
• Built for the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). You can delete your account in the app at any time.
• Optional app lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode.
• In English, German and Arabic.

Picenti is made by Mudita Solutions UG (haftungsbeschränkt) in Germany. To bring Picenti to your church, visit typikon.church.

name: Picks: AI Soccer Predictions
seller_name: All Stars Sports Media Pte. Ltd.
description:
Picks gives you AI soccer predictions and tips for every match in the top leagues: who we think wins, how likely each result is, and why.

EVERY PICK IS ON THE RECORD
Every pick is counted in our public record, right or wrong. You can see how often our picks came in, how they did at each confidence level, and every recent result. Picks are locked at kick-off and cannot change afterwards. Results from earlier this season, before the app launched, were worked out afterwards by the same model from what was known before each match, and the record says so.

WHAT YOU GET
• A pick for each match: home win, draw or away win
• Win, draw and loss chances as percentages
• Match analysis behind every pick: form, home and away record, head-to-head and team news
• Soccer stats that matter, in plain words
• Champions League, Premier League, La Liga, Serie A and Bundesliga
• Today, tomorrow and the days ahead, grouped by league

HOW THE PREDICTIONS ARE MADE
A statistical model rates every team from its past results and updates after each match; it alone decides the pick and the percentages. An AI then writes the analysis from our match data and from team news reported by football sites. Picks are refreshed through the day and again shortly before kick-off.

FREE AND PRO
Two matches a day are free, every pick opens to everyone at kick-off, and the record is always open. Picks Pro opens every pick before kick-off.

Picks Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your store account and renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your store account settings.

IMPORTANT
Predictions are estimates for information only and can be wrong. Picks offers no betting, takes no stakes and has no links to bookmakers. For ages 18 and over.

Privacy policy: https://picks.tocs.com/privacy
Terms of use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Pierloop
description:
Pierloop is a seaside rail yard you build by hand.

Turn the heading, lay a rail, and lift or lower the tail. Drag the yard to look around the pier in 3D. When the line reaches the flag, press Go. The cart rolls the path you built. Every seated guest has a comfort band. Some want a hill that comes back down, some want the splash lane, some want a crest loop, and some just want a smooth ride home.

Sixteen berths sit on four piers: Quiet Jetty, Buoy Bend, Crest Pier, and Gale Loop. A new pier opens after you clear three berths on the one before it. Dawn Tide is a fresh local ride each day, and only this device keeps the best. Open Slip is a free yard with no coins and no guests to please.

Grades are dock slips, not stars. Finish the ride and stay at the tidy piece count for a Legend slip. A little over par is Keen. A ride that still arrives is a Berth. Coins come only from improving a slip. Spend them on a plank, steel, or bobber kit, or on a pennant, buoy paint, and extra palms. Nothing is sold for real money.

Wind changes how sharp a bend you can take. Climb before a fast corner so the cart does not spill. Chain lifts help the cart up a hill. A spill ends that run, and you can lay the rail again.

name: PIESAP
description:
PIE SAP is an all-in-one Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) application designed specifically for manufacturing, production, and industrial business operations.

Streamline your complete day-to-day workflow with intelligent tracking, real-time reporting, and centralized management.

Key Features:
• Production & Manufacturing: Monitor work orders, job cards, machines, and production stages in real time.
• Inventory & Stock Control: Keep accurate track of raw materials, finished goods, stock transfers, and warehouse movements.
• Sales & Order Management: Manage customer orders, quotations, dispatch status, and invoicing seamlessly.
• Purchases & Vendors: Organize vendor orders, material requisitions, and purchase receipts with ease.
• Quality Control (QC): Ensure high manufacturing standards with built-in inspection checkpoints.
• Financials & Billing: Keep track of receivables, payables, and account summaries.
• Reports & Analytics: Gain actionable insights into your business performance with comprehensive data charts and reports.
• Secure & Real-Time Sync: Cloud-backed secure data synchronization across your devices.

Empower your business with PIE SAP to boost productivity, eliminate manual errors, and scale your operations effortlessly.

name: Pinnacle ONE
description:
Pinnacle ONE is a staff-only app for people who work at a dealership that uses the Pinnacle ONE dealer management system. It is not a shopper app, and you can't create an account from the App Store. Your dealership sets up your staff login.

Sign in with your dealership account. Sign-in opens a secure page that asks for a code from your authenticator app. You can then unlock the app with Face ID; Face ID data stays on the device.

What you see depends on what your dealership turns on and the access it gives you:
• Inventory: search, scan a VIN or HIN, add units, and add photos and video
• Parts: search and scan part barcodes
• Service: book, change and cancel appointments, create and work repair orders, notes and technician clock
• Sales: build quotes, take deposits and record cash, check or ACH payments, with voids and refunds on the same screen
• Accounting: read-only reports and key numbers
• Payroll: managers approve timesheets and pay runs
• Approvals and customer search

The app does not read or store card numbers. Everything is saved to your dealership's Pinnacle ONE account at www.pinnacleonedms.com; the app keeps no separate copy, and changes aren't queued offline.

The camera scans VINs, HINs and barcodes and takes photos and video. The microphone is used only to record sound with a video you choose to record; if you say no, video records without sound.

No ads, no tracking, nothing sold.

To delete your account, ask your dealership administrator or email info@pinnacleonedms.com with the subject "Account deletion request".

Support: support@pinnacleonedms.com or 304-250-1911
Privacy policy: https://www.pinnacleonedms.com/privacy/

name: Pinned: Parking Timer & Spot
description:
The mall gives you 2 hours free. At 2 hours and 5 minutes, you pay.

Pinned makes sure you never do.

TAP ONCE WHEN YOU PARK
Pinned saves where your car is, with the street address. Add a note ("Level -2, B14") or a photo of the pillar.

COUNT DOWN THE FREE TIME
Choose "Free time" and how long the car park gives you: 1 hour, 2 hours, 3 hours. The countdown sits on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while you shop. No need to open the app.

A REMINDER BEFORE IT COSTS YOU
10 minutes before the free time ends, Pinned tells you to head back. Another alert when it runs out.

PAID PARKING TOO
Paid for an hour at the meter? Set a "Paid" timer and add 15 minutes with one tap when you extend.

NOTICES WHEN YOU PARK
Turn on "Detect Parking" and Pinned saves your spot by itself when you stop driving and start walking. Or add the "Park Here" shortcut to your CarPlay or Bluetooth automation.

WALK BACK TO YOUR CAR
"Take Me There" opens walking directions in Apple Maps.

SAME MALL, ONE TAP
Pinned remembers your last timer at each place, so next time at your usual mall it's one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. Your location never leaves your iPhone.

In 25 languages.

name: Pipe Oval
description: Name the ring still under scrap with the highest ovality percent. Drag scrap without rewriting diameters.

name: PitchTime: fair match time
description:
PitchTime is a pocket assistant for youth-football coaches. It runs the clock, tracks every minute on the pitch and suggests the next substitution, so giving everyone a fair share of the game becomes easy, even on a busy Saturday morning.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add your squad: first names are enough. You can even read it from a photo of the team sheet.
• Set up the match: who is available, how many play at once, how many periods and how long.
• Follow the suggested changes: PitchTime tells you who comes off and who goes on. One tap to confirm.

DURING THE MATCH
• Reliable stopwatch, even with the screen locked.
• Change one player at a time or several together; players can come back on with no limits.
• A gentle alert when a player risks falling behind on minutes.
• "Work out the perfect rotation": the full substitution plan before kick-off.
• "Changes only at the break" option and a minimum time on the pitch, so you don't swap every two minutes.
• Score, including period by period.
• Mark a player unavailable during the match (injury, coach's choice) and bring them back whenever you like.
• The match on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

BEFORE AND AFTER
• Call-up sheet as a PDF to send to parents, even on your club's letterhead (up to 3 templates).
• End-of-match PDF summary, ready to share.
• Season statistics: minutes and appearances for every player, with details and export.
• Match calendar and a quick timer for training.
• Multiple teams, staff, crest and colours.
• Light or dark theme and your choice of app colour.

PRIVACY FIRST
• No account, no server: squad and matches stay on your iPhone.
• First names are enough; surname, number and photo are optional.
• No third-party ads, no tracking.
• Backup to a file you save wherever you like.

In English and Italian. Works on iPhone with iOS 17 or later, including iPhone Duo.

PitchTime is free. A G13.it project.

name: Pivotwayfit
description: Pivotwayfit is a clearance checker for bulky furniture and appliances. You record the way into a home as a path of doorways, hall corners, stair flights, landings and lifts, then enter a piece's sizes. It shows, for each point on the path, whether the piece passes, how much room is left, and which way to hold it.

name: Plain Vim Practice
description:
Plain Vim Practice is a pocket reference and quiz app for learning the Vim commands you use every day. Read how a command works, try it in a built-in emulator, then test yourself.

LEARN 67 COMMON COMMANDS
• Nine categories: modes and inserting, moving around, deleting and changing, copy and paste, text objects, search and replace, visual mode, undo and repeat, and saving and quitting
• From i, w, dd and yy to iw, :%s and :wq
• Each command has a summary, its syntax and worked examples, most showing the text before and after, with tips for many
• Copy any example to the clipboard
• Mark commands as learned

TRY THEM IN THE EMULATOR
• A small Vim-style editor built into the app, for trying commands on practice text
• The practice text is held in memory and cleared when the app closes; the emulator does not open or save files on your device

SOLVE EMULATOR CHALLENGES
• 14 challenges: turn one text into another, such as Fix the Typo, Inside the Quotes, and Cats to Dogs
• Your key count is compared against par, and your best count is kept
• The first three challenges are free

PRACTICE WITH QUIZZES
• Multiple choice, or type the command yourself (equivalent keys count)
• 5 to 30 questions per quiz (fewer for a small category)
• Quiz on every command, the ones you have not learned, the ones that need review, or a single category

PRACTICE KEY COMBOS
• Pick the Keys: choose the keys that do an editing task
• Build the Keys: tap pieces into order, with one decoy to leave out
• 20 exercises; choose 1 to 20 questions per round, and the app remembers your choice

READ THE GUIDES
• Six short guides: modes, operators and motions, counts and repeating, text objects, search and replace, and saving and quitting

FREE AND FULL ACCESS
Everything in the app is free except the challenges after the first three: the commands, guides, quizzes, key combos, emulator and three challenges. Full Access, an optional one-time In-App Purchase, opens all 14 challenges. It is not a subscription, it stays with your Apple Account, and it works offline. Restore Purchases is on the Full Access screen.

LOCAL AND SIMPLE
No account, advertising, or analytics, and the app asks for no permissions. Its only network use is Apple's App Store, for the optional purchase. Answers are checked on your device. Works on iPhone and iPad.

Your learned commands, quiz answer counts, and best challenge key counts stay on your device. The app has no iCloud sync, but this data can be included in iCloud Backup or a computer backup, if you have backups turned on. Reset All Progress, under Docs > Guides > About, clears it.

Found a bug or want a feature? Send feedback from the Home tab or the Docs tab.

Vim is free software by Bram Moolenaar and the Vim contributors. Plain Vim Practice is an independent study aid by Plain Text Office LLC and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Vim project. Its emulator was written for this app and contains no Vim code.

name: Plain: To-Do List & Notes
description:
Plain is a simple, distraction-free to-do list. Tasks, notes and plans live together in one list, and any line can hold more lines.

It's the to-do app, simplified: everything you need to plan a day or a project, none of the clutter. No boards, no labels to manage, no settings to learn. Just a list.

With Plain you can:
• Write things down the moment you think of them
• Put lists inside lists, as deep as you like
• Tap the dot beside any item to focus on it alone
• Check off tasks, and keep notes right under them
• Add #tags and @dates as you type: #home, @friday
• See what's due today and coming up, from anywhere in your list
• Find anything by a word in it
• Star the lists you come back to
• Write on the paper you like: ruled, dot grid, graph, legal pad or kraft
• Take everything with you as Markdown

Your list stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Feature highlights:
• Infinitely nested lists
• Tasks, notes and headings in one list
• Zoom into any item; breadcrumbs take you back
• Swipe right to nest, left to bring a line back out
• A keyboard bar for indent, move, task and undo
• #Tags, @dates and one-tap filters
• Search across everything
• Today and Upcoming, gathered from the whole list
• Stars and recent items
• Papers for day and night, set in a serif that reads like paper
• A companion in the corner: a fox, cat, dog, elephant or squirrel
• Recently deleted, with Restore
• Markdown import and export

Plain is a subscription, yearly (starting with a free week) or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free week ends. A subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings. If a subscription ends, your list stays on your iPhone to read and export.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://getplainapp.com/privacy

name: Planet Defense: Asteroid Game
description:
Defend your planet from an endless storm of asteroids! Planet Defense is a fast tap-to-shoot asteroid shooter: aim anywhere, blast meteors before they hit, survive the hordes and take down the boss. A space shooter and asteroid defense game that is easy to learn, hard to put down and playable offline.

TAP, SHOOT, SURVIVE
Tap the screen and your planet fires toward your finger. Small asteroids are fast, big ones take several hits and break into smaller rocks. Every phase sends waves of hordes that get faster and denser. Clear them all to earn stars and coins.

13 ASTEROID TYPES
Red, blue and green asteroids in three sizes, plus special enemies: Splitters that burst into three shards, Zigzag rocks that are hard to aim at, and Ghost asteroids that fade in and out of sight.

BOSS FIGHTS
A boss orbits your planet and fires back. As its health drops it changes tactics: fan-shaped volleys, summoned asteroids and a temporary shield. Face a mini-boss at phase 5 and a new boss every 10 phases.

ENDLESS MODE + WEEKLY LEADERBOARD
Clear phase 3 to unlock Endless mode: waves that never stop, a boss every 5 waves and a weekly ranking to see how long you can hold the line against other players.

9 WEAPONS
Simple Bomb, Missile, Shotgun, Homing Missiles, Laser, Plasma, Railgun, Plasma Beam (hold and drag) and Orbital Drones that fire on their own. Upgrade each weapon to level 5 for more damage, faster fire and piercing shots.

5 SKILLS + SYNERGIES
Supernova, Time Bubble, Shield, Attack Aura and Extra HP, each with its own cooldown and upgrades. Combine them to trigger synergies: Time Bubble + Supernova = SHATTER, Shield + Attack Aura = THORNS.

COMBOS & POWER-UPS
Chain hits to build a combo multiplier for bonus points. Shoot the items that drop from destroyed asteroids: Triple Shot, Coin Magnet and Slow Motion.

DAILY REWARDS, MISSIONS & BATTLE PASS
• 7-day login streak with rewards that grow every day
• 3 daily and 3 weekly missions
• Monthly Battle Pass with 30 tiers, a free track and a premium track
• A star chest for every 12 stars you collect

SKINS
Unlock 11 skins for your planet and your shot trails, like Lava, Ice, Toxic, Aurora, Golden and Void. Skins are cosmetic only and never change game balance.

ACHIEVEMENTS & RANKINGS
20 achievements to unlock, plus global rankings by score and by highest phase.

PLAY OFFLINE
The core game works without internet: play on a flight, on the subway or anywhere. Connect only for rankings, cloud save and purchases.

BUILT FOR QUICK SESSIONS
• Pause menu with resume and restart
• Revive to keep a run going
• Interactive tutorial you can replay any time
• Music, sound effect and vibration settings
• Save progress across devices with Apple, Google or email sign-in
• 12 languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish, Russian, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Thai

Planet Defense is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases (coin packs, a starter pack, Remove Ads and the premium Battle Pass).

Become the planet defender your world needs. Tap, shoot and defend the planet: how many waves can you survive?

name: Planet Drop: Space Merge
description:
Drop the planets, merge two of a kind and grow them all the way into the Sun!

Planet Drop is a cozy physics puzzle. Aim, release, and watch the cute little planets tumble into the jar. When two identical planets touch, they merge into the next one: Asteroid, Moon, Mercury, Mars, Venus, Earth, Neptune, Uranus, Saturn, Jupiter... and finally the Sun. Keep the jar from overflowing and chase your best score.

FEATURES
• Satisfying real physics: planets roll, stack and bounce
• 11 adorable planets with happy faces
• Bomb power-up to blast a planet out of the way
• Second chance when the jar is full
• Unlock space themes: Nebula, Aurora, Red Giant, Galaxy, Eclipse
• Quick games, endless replay, play offline

Planet Drop is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Planklub
description:
Planklub helps you plan an event with other people without getting lost in group chats.

You create the event and send a link. Your guests answer in seconds, with no app to install and no account to create.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• An invitation with your own poster: photo, colours, title style
• Who's coming: yes, maybe, no, with plus-ones
• Dates: suggest several, everyone votes, you pick the best one
• Polls: the place, the activity, the menu, anything
• Money: shared expenses, who owes what, a pot with a payment link
• Prepare: who brings what, tasks, shopping
• Rides and rooms: who drives, who sleeps where
• Surprise mode: what you hide stays invisible to the guest of honour
• Gift draw, where each person only sees their own match
• A recap after the event, with ratings and awards
• Photo album: everyone adds their photos, everyone finds them

FOR EVERY KIND OF EVENT
Party, birthday, dinner, weekend, holiday, Christmas, group gift, bachelor and bachelorette parties, weddings among guests, festival, road trip.

FOR GROUPS THAT MEET OFTEN
Create a community for your family, your club or your team: its members, calendar, polls and funds in one place. You can also make an event or a community public, and join the ones open near you.

SIMPLE AND RESPECTFUL
• Free, no ads
• No account required: a first and last name are enough
• An optional account (Apple, Google or email) to find your events on another phone
• Planklub never holds money: payments go through the apps you already use
• In English, French, Spanish and Portuguese

Questions? contact@planklub.com

name: Planning Permission App
description:
Planning Permission App is the official app of NI Planning Permission, UK Planning Permission and Ireland Planning. Use it to send a planning enquiry about a property in Northern Ireland, the rest of the UK, or Ireland.

Take photographs of the land or building, drop a pin on the map, and tell us what you want to do. Your enquiry goes straight to the planning consultancy team covering that property.

You can use the app to ask about:

• House extensions and alterations
• New homes and rural dwellings
• Change of use
• Commercial projects
• Certificates of lawfulness
• Retrospective or retention applications
• Planning appeals and enforcement
• Buying a site or property and wanting a planning check first

You can also view an optional AI-generated visual preview of a house extension or new dwelling on your photo — illustrative only, not a design or planning drawing — and use our quick permission checker for indicative guidance.

On a LiDAR iPhone you can optionally scan a room so we can see its approximate size. Photos are optional and are resized on your device before they are sent.

You can also open links to planning application searches for Northern Ireland, Ireland and Great Britain, and to land, environmental and water map services. These are external websites, independent of our consultancy; they open in Safari after a short confirmation.

There is no account to create. You send an enquiry as a guest, with your name, email and telephone number, and a short description of the project.

Your enquiry goes to the planning team that covers the property:

• Northern Ireland — NI Planning Permission
• Rest of the UK — UK Planning Permission
• Ireland — Ireland Planning

This app does not decide whether planning permission will be granted, and it does not replace a formal application to the planning authority.

If your enquiry is urgent, call the telephone number shown after you send it.

name: Plant & Grass -Scan & Care
description:
Not sure what that plant is, or why its leaves are turning yellow? Take a photo and find out!

Plant & Grass is a plant identifier and plant care app for home gardeners, plant parents, and anyone curious about nature. Scan a plant, flower, tree, or grass to learn its name, check for common diseases, and get simple care guidance, all in one place.

IDENTIFY PLANTS FROM A PHOTO

- Point your camera at a plant or upload a picture from your gallery.
- Identify houseplants, garden plants, flowers, trees, and grasses.
- Learn the plant's name and key details about it.

PLANT DISEASE IDENTIFIER

- Scan a leaf to check for common problems like spots, yellowing, or wilting.
- Get a likely diagnosis and suggested treatment steps.
- Catch problems early before they spread.

PLANT CARE GUIDES

- Get clear tips on watering, sunlight, and fertilizing.
- Find home-care advice for indoor and outdoor plants.
- Enjoy guidance that is easy for beginners and useful for experienced gardeners.

FIND NEARBY PLANT STORES

- Explore plant shops and nurseries near you.
- Find soil, fertilizer, and treatments your plants need.

SCAN HISTORY

- Every identification is saved automatically.
- Look back at past scans and follow up on plants you are treating.

SUBSCRIPTION PLANS

Choose a plan that suits your plant care needs.

- Free: Access the free plan.
- Monthly: 200
- Yearly - Basic: 700
- Yearly - Standard: 1200
- Yearly - Premium: 2000

Subscription prices are displayed in the applicable currency in the app. Available features and subscription benefits may vary by plan.

WHO IT'S FOR

- Plant parents caring for houseplants and balcony gardens.
- Home gardeners looking after flowers, vegetables, and lawns.
- Students learning botany and nature lovers exploring the outdoors.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Open the app and scan or upload a plant photo.
2. Discover the plant's name and check for signs of disease.
3. Follow the recommended care and treatment tips.

TIP: For the clearest results, photograph one plant at a time in good lighting, with the leaves or flowers in focus.

PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. Read our Privacy Policy to learn how your information is handled:

https://plantandgrass.canws.com/privacy-policy/

Download Plant & Grass and get to know the plants around you!

name: Plant Ward
description: Plant Ward is an offline observation journal for individual plants. Log visible changes with photos and voice notes, compare visits side by side, and browse a built-in leaf atlas. The atlas is a visual reference, not a diagnostic tool.

name: Planyski : ski entre amis
description:
Planyski organise vos sorties ski entre amis, en club ou en BDE.

Créez un séjour, invitez votre groupe par code ou QR code, et suivez la préparation : station, trajet, logement, forfaits.

Stations : météo sur 7 jours, neige en haut et en bas, bulletin avalanche (BERA) pour la France, état des pistes signalé par le groupe.
Trajet : meilleure heure de départ selon le trafic prévu, covoiturage avec places et passagers.
Logement : recherches pré-remplies, propositions et votes du groupe.
Forfaits : tarifs publics et combinaison la moins chère pour chacun.
Frais partagés : qui doit quoi, avec le minimum de virements.
Sondages, chat, photos et vidéos du séjour.
Calendrier des séjours de vos groupes et notifications.
Seul, Planyski prépare aussi vos séjours personnels.

name: PlateLog: AI Food Photo Log
description:
PlateLog turns a photo of your meal into a food log. On-device AI estimates the dish, each item, portion sizes, calories and macros (protein, fat and carbs).

SNAP TO LOG
- Take a photo or pick one from your library and the AI starts right away
- Check the portions, calories and macros for each item and edit them before saving
- Prefer typing? Add meals without a photo, too

LOOK BACK
- Daily totals for calories and macros, with progress toward your daily goal
- A 7-day bar chart and your daily average

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- The AI runs on your device. Your photos and meal records never leave your phone
- No account needed
- Download the AI model once (about 0.7-2 GB), then it works offline

PLEASE NOTE
Calories and macros are estimates from a photo and may not be accurate. PlateLog does not provide medical or dietary advice. If you need to manage your diet for health reasons, consult a doctor or dietitian.

Free to use with ads. Watch a short video to hide ads for 24 hours.

name: playfeed
description:
Run it back.

Prop your phone up courtside, tap each hoop and play. When you stop, playfeed goes through the game on your phone and picks out the shots and makes, so you can jump straight to every bucket.

• No tripod needed: a bench or a ledge will do. The setup screen shows what you'll get before you press record.
• Finding the plays happens on your phone, not in the cloud.
• Free: your games are shared with us to help make playfeed better, and each one of 30 minutes or more enters our £50 monthly draw (Great Britain, 18+, full rules in the app).
• playfeed Private (£4.99 a month): your video never leaves your phone.

playfeed is for adult games: everyone in shot must be 18 or over and happy to be filmed.

Blocks, steals and assists are on the way.

Apple is not a sponsor of, and is not involved in, the monthly draw.

name: Plopp Blocks: Block Puzzle
description:
Free. No ads. No purchases. Plays offline.

Plopp Blocks is a calm, clear placing puzzle: every puzzle gives you a board and exactly the pieces that fill it. Place all the pieces so no square stays empty. Tap a piece to rotate it, drag to place it. Every piece has a face, and when everything fits, they hop with joy.

TRULY FREE
All 200 puzzles are free. No ads, no purchases, no account, no data collected.

FOUR LEVELS
Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert, 50 puzzles each. Bigger boards, more pieces, new shapes. From Medium on the pieces come rotated, and you turn them to fit.

AGAINST THE CLOCK, WITHOUT PRESSURE
A big clock runs along. Be quick and get three stars. A hint shows where a piece belongs and costs 20 seconds. No lives, no waiting.

PUZZLE OF THE DAY AND STICKER ALBUM
A new puzzle every day, the same for everyone, no streaks, no pressure. Special moments become stickers in your album.

DUEL AGAINST THE CLOCK
Two players, one device, the same puzzle. The faster one wins.

PLAY ANYWHERE
Plopp Blocks needs no internet: on a plane, on the train, in a dead zone.

FOR KIDS AND GROWN-UPS
Clear design without glitter and flashing, with sound and haptic feedback. Easy to learn, hard to put down. From the makers of Plopp Match.

name: Plume: Work in Progress
description:
Plume is a studio community for the middle of a creative project. Share the piece you are working on, ask the question that is holding it up, and hear how other makers see it.

Discover works in progress in the feed, open a study and join its discussion. Published studies centre on an open question. Some existing works also offer directions to choose between, giving their maker another view of the next step.

Start with a photograph from your library or camera, inspect the details, and shape a question and caption. Keep drafts on this device while you work on them. A voice note can be kept with a draft and submitted through its separate voice-post action when you want to explain an idea aloud.

Save studies you want to revisit, follow makers, and use Discuss for direct conversations. Studio keeps your own work and drafts together. Conversation controls provide reporting and blocking, while Settings provides profile, account and privacy controls.

You can browse public work without signing in; an account is required to publish or participate. A connection is needed for shared content and messages. Camera, photo-library and microphone access are requested only for the corresponding creation action. Account details, published work, responses and messages are stored by the service; unpublished drafts are kept on the device.

name: PlumeLog
seller_name: Ming Heung Tea Import & Export Company Limited
description:
PlumeLog är en fältdagbok för fågelskådning, gjord för att användas utomhus utan nät.

Registrera en observation på en minut: välj bland 14 vanliga fågelarter och ange antal och tid. Lägg till plats, livsmiljö, väder, beteende eller en egen anteckning på upp till 500 tecken. Fälten kontrolleras direkt – du kan inte spara utan art, och orimliga värden förklaras i klartext.

Dagboken grupperar observationerna per dag och visar art, antal, tid, plats och taggar. Filtrera på allt, den här månaden eller det här året. Öppna en observation för att ändra eller ta bort den; artlistan och statistiken räknas om direkt.

Fälthandboken innehåller 14 arter med kinesiska, engelska och vetenskapliga namn, familj, kroppslängd, säsong, tre kännetecken och en kort beskrivning av läten. Sök på namn eller filtrera efter livsmiljö. På en artsida ser du hur ofta du har antecknat arten och kan starta en ny observation med arten förvald.

I artlistan ser du när och var du först såg en art samt antal observationer och fåglar. Statistiken visar antal arter, observationer och fåglar, månadens observationer, vanligaste art, fördelning mellan livsmiljöer, utveckling över sex månader och en rangordning per art.

Appen fungerar helt offline: inga nätverksanrop, inga behörigheter, inget konto, inga annonser, ingen analys och inga SDK:er från tredje part. Observationer och inställningar sparas som JSON på din iPhone och kan exporteras när du vill. Gränssnittet finns på engelska och förenklad kinesiska, och appen är gjord för iPhone i stående läge. Artbeskrivningarna är allmän referens och inte en auktoritativ artbestämning; fågelbilderna är tecknade silhuetter, inte fotografier.

name: PlumJarBloom
description:
Glowing fruit-orbs tumble from a blossom branch, and every one of them belongs in a jar. Drag, flick and sort your way through a hand-drawn storybook orchard where each full jar bursts into bloom.

SORT, FLICK, BLOOM
Plum, peach, mint-berry and lemon orbs fall at their own pace. Catch one with your finger, toss it toward the jar with the matching color and mark, and listen to it land with a soft glassy chime. Five orbs fill a jar, and a full jar blooms in a shower of petals, pays a big bonus and empties for more.

MIND THE CRACKS
Drop an orb in the wrong jar and the glass cracks. Three cracks end the run, unless you spend a few coins to mend one and keep going.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- Classic Orchard: endless sorting that speeds up every 8 orbs and adds new fruit as you go, with a fourth jar from speed 5.
- Orchard Path: 36 levels across three chapters (Blossom Lane, Honey Hollow and Moonlit Grove), each with its own goal and up to 3 stars.
- Daily Orchard: one shuffled orchard shared by every player, with a fresh one at 00:00 UTC.

GOALS AND REWARDS
- 18 missions with coin rewards and progress bars
- A 7-day Daily Basket of coins
- Lifetime stats for every orb you have sorted and every jar you have bloomed
- Leaderboards for Classic, Daily and Levels, all-time and today

COLLECT JARS
Fill your Jar Locker with 10 jar styles, from Mason Glass and Honey Pot to Paper Lantern and Beehive Skep. Each one changes how your jars look in every game.

HELPFUL BOOSTS
Frost freezes every falling orb for six seconds. Sweep sorts everything on screen in one swoop. Mend fixes a crack.

MAKE IT YOURS
Take or choose a Gardener portrait, record a three-second victory cheer, and save a score card of your best harvest to your photos.

A CALM, COZY LOOK
Cream paper, pastel fruit, ink outlines and a warm ambient pad, with sound, music and haptics you can switch on or off.

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
There are no ads. Everything in the game can be earned by playing, and the coin packs are optional extras for anyone who wants to collect faster. A short tutorial shows you how to play on your first run, and you can delete all your data at any time in Settings.

name: PlungePulse: Cold Plunge Log
description:
Plunge Pulse is a timer and logbook for people who cold plunge or take ice baths, built for the moment you are standing beside the tub. Unlike a plain countdown timer, it reads your own log back to you: whether the same effort now takes more cold, and when to go colder or longer.

ONE TAP AT THE TUB
A huge, high-contrast timer you can read through a waterproof pouch or from across the room. Start it with one tap, or with a 10-second countdown so the phone can be put down first. A gold line rises toward your goal, and the clock keeps true time even if the screen locks or the app closes.

EVERY PLUNGE, LOGGED
Tap Out and the session is saved at once — duration, time and your usual water temperature. Add how hard it felt, how you rewarmed and a note once you are warm, or leave it for later. Edit, backdate or delete any session. Your whole history is free, with no limit.

THE COLD LINE
Is "hard" starting to take more cold? The Cold Line puts your own effort ratings against the Cold Load you actually took — water temperature and minutes together — and shows how each word has moved since your first fortnight. The formula is shown in the app.

A LADDER THAT READS YOUR LOG
A 30-day ladder moves one thing at a time — a little colder or a little longer, never both — and checks the sessions you actually logged before it says advance, hold or step back.

THE WEEK AT A GLANCE
Weekly cold minutes toward a widely used 11-minute target, a run that respects your own routine so a planned rest day never breaks it, records, milestones and CSV export.

SAFETY FIRST
Before your first plunge, Plunge Pulse explains the gasp response, getting out, afterdrop and why breathing exercises never belong near water. Plunge Pulse is a timer and a logbook: it gives no medical advice and measures nothing about your body. Talk to a doctor before starting cold-water immersion.

Works without an account. Create one any time to keep your log if you change phones.

PLUNGE PULSE PRO
Pro adds the Cold Line, your Cold Load trend, comparisons from your own log and ladder weeks 2–4. Monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription; eligible new subscribers get a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation and renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy Policy: https://yovlzyk2n4.accountnotify.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://yovlzyk2n4.accountnotify.app/terms

name: Pocket Investigator
description:
Sirens on your street. A post in the group chat. Everyone has a different story.

Pocket Investigator finds out what actually happened. Describe an incident in your own words, and it gathers news reports and public posts about it, puts them in order by date, and writes a plain summary of what's known so far.

FOLLOW THE STORY, NOT THE RUMOURS

 • A clear summary of what's confirmed
 • A "Still unclear" list, so you know what hasn't been verified yet
 • A dated timeline, with every entry linked to its original source
 • Unconfirmed posts are clearly marked as unverified

KNOW WHAT'S HAPPENING AROUND YOU

 Tap Near me to see recent local news on a map. Open any story as a case file with one tap. It works in any town, in any country. Pocket Investigator works out where each story is happening and searches that country's news for you.

KNOW THE MOMENT IT CHANGES

 Pocket Investigator checks your open cases for new reports and sends you a notification when something new comes in. Cases with updates show a "new" badge, so you can catch up in seconds.

LISTEN ON THE GO 

Tap Listen to have any summary read aloud.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

 No account and no sign-up. Your case files stay on your device. On supported devices, summaries are written by Apple's built-in on-device AI, so your searches aren't sent to an AI service.

Pocket Investigator brings together public reporting to help you understand events. Always check the original sources before sharing, and contact local emergency services if you're in danger.
On-device AI summaries need iOS or iPadOS 26 on a device that supports Apple Intelligence. On other devices, the timeline is built straight from matching reports.

name: PocketMirror!
description:
PocketMirror turns your phone into a wireless display for your computer. Mirror your screen, or extend your desktop onto the phone in your pocket, using the Screen Mirroring already built into your computer. There is nothing to install on the computer, no account to create and no cable to carry.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open PocketMirror and put your phone on the same Wi-Fi network as your computer.
2. On your computer, open Control Center and click Screen Mirroring.
3. Choose PocketMirror. To use it as an extra display, choose Extended Display.

A DISPLAY THAT FITS YOUR SCREEN
PocketMirror tells your computer the exact shape of the screen you are holding, so the picture fills it edge to edge. Hold your phone upright for a tall display for documents and chat, or turn it sideways for a wide one. On a foldable phone, fold or unfold before connecting to get a display that matches either screen.

SHARP AND SMOOTH
• Choose Larger text for comfortable reading on a small screen, Sharpest to use every pixel, or Balanced in between.
• Up to 60 frames per second for smooth scrolling and cursor movement.
• HEVC support lets newer computers send more than 1080 lines, for full detail on large screens.
• Hardware video decoding keeps latency low.

SOUND INCLUDED
PocketMirror can play the audio that streams with your mirrored screen. Turn it off in Settings when you only want the picture.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Video and sound travel directly from your computer to your phone over your local network. PocketMirror has no account, no analytics and no ads, and it never stores or uploads what you mirror.

MORE
• Rename your receiver so it is easy to find in the Screen Mirroring menu.
• Tap the screen while mirroring to see the resolution, frame rate and bit rate, or to disconnect.
• Works on phones and tablets.

PocketMirror works with computers that offer Screen Mirroring in Control Center. Both devices need to be on the same network.

name: PokerGlyph
description:
PokerGlyph is a precision Texas Hold'em probability calculator and quantitative study workstation built for players who make decisions backed by math. Combining an ultra-fast native bitwise 7-card evaluator with an obsidian-and-gold interface, PokerGlyph delivers instant equity, clean outs, pot odds, EV curves, and 13x13 GTO hand range analysis completely offline.

KEY FEATURES

1. Multi-Way Equity Calculator (2–9 Players)
• Evaluate exact hand-vs-hand matchups or assign villains to Random (Any Two) and Top % ranges (5%–40%).
• Automatic 100% exact combinatorial enumeration on the Turn and heads-up Flop, paired with high-speed Monte Carlo simulation for preflop and multi-way pots.
• Live Hero equity arc gauge, Win / Tie / Lose telemetry, multi-player equity distribution bar, and projected river showdown hand-strength breakdown.
• Rapid 4x13 card picker with locked dealt cards and optional auto-advance across hole and board slots.

2. Odds & EV Decision Studio
• Real-time Pot Odds, Implied Odds, Expected Value (EV), Stack-to-Pot Ratio (SPR), Minimum Defense Frequency (MDF), and bluff break-even calculator.
• Interactive EV Expectation Curve visualizing your break-even threshold, edge, and +EV / -EV zones.
• One-tap sync pulls your live Hero equity directly from the Equity Table into the EV Studio.

3. Live Flop & Turn Outs Analyzer
• Automatically scans every remaining unseen card to identify deduplicated clean outs by target hand category.
• Side-by-side comparison of exact combinatorial hit probabilities versus the classic Rule of 4 & 2 shortcut, plus automatic backdoor flush and straight draw detection.

4. Interactive 13x13 GTO Range Matrix
• Tap or drag-paint across all 169 starting hands with instant combo counting (out of 1,326 total combos) split by pairs, suited, and offsuit hands.

MEINE WELT UND LERNPROFIL
Wörter und Redewendungen für dein Leben – Begrüßen, Einkaufen, Arzt, Arbeit, Reisen und mehr. Erzähl dem Maskottchen Lumo von dir, dann kommen deine Themen zuerst.

HINWEIS ZU KI
Beispielsätze und Übersetzungen wurden mit KI erstellt, die Aussprache ist eine KI-Stimme (OpenAI). Beides ist in der App als „KI-generiert“ gekennzeichnet. KI kann Fehler machen – findest du einen, schreib uns.

name: Poof: Swipe Cleaner
description:
A thousand screenshots of delivery codes, twenty identical sunsets and one video of your pocket. Sound familiar?

Poof! helps you dig out. Swipe left and a photo joins the delete pile. Swipe right and it stays. A few minutes in a coffee queue and you've got space back.

DUPLICATES AND SIMILAR SHOTS
Poof finds copies and near-identical bursts for you, right on your iPhone, with Apple Vision. Duplicates: one tap and a single copy stays. Similar shots: flip through each set, see every shot's size, and pick what to keep and what to delete. Tap a photo to see it full screen. Picked wrong? Hit Undo. And the list of sets you've sorted lets you reopen any of them and change your mind.

NOTHING VANISHES BY ACCIDENT
Everything you swipe left waits in a Final check first, with duplicates, similar shots and your own picks in their own sections. See them all in a grid or one by one. Changed your mind? Tap the photo and it stays. Poof only deletes after you say yes, and for 30 more days the deleted items sit in Recently Deleted in Photos, just in case.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
Poof has no servers, no account and no tracking. Finding duplicates, similar shots and searching all happen on the phone itself. We collect no data, mostly because we have nowhere to put it.
No internet needed either. The one exception is a photo that lives only in iCloud: iOS fetches it from your own iCloud.

SEARCH BY A WORD
"Beach", "dog", "receipt". Poof finds photos by what's in them, and even by the words written on them. Found it? Start swiping.

PICK YOUR STARTING POINT
Shuffle if you like surprises. On this day if you're feeling nostalgic. Old photos when it's finally time to sort the archive. There's also Recent, Favorites, Albums, By month and By dates. For a proper spring clean: Screenshots, Videos, Live Photos, Selfies, Bursts and Screen recordings. Each video shows its size right on the card, so the big ones can't hide.

ALBUMS
Fill an album by swiping: right, and the photo's in. Albums you'd rather leave alone can be excluded, and Poof keeps them out of your decks.

KEEP FOREVER
Photo from grandma's birthday? Pin it and Poof will never ask about it again. Photos you simply kept come back to your decks after a year, in case you feel differently by then. Change the time or turn it off.

LITTLE THINGS
Pinch to zoom in on the details. Pick one of 6 themes: Stone, Titanium, Midnight, Pine, Burgundy or Glacier, each in light and dark.

NUMBERS AND TIPS
Poof counts how much space you've freed and how many days you've kept your streak going. The Tips tab has a few more hiding spots for gigabytes: Telegram cache, WhatsApp media and apps you haven't opened in ages.

FREE. SERIOUSLY.
No ads, no subscription, every feature and every theme free. If Poof wins you over, you can leave an optional tip through the App Store.

name: PostmarkFile
description:
A postmark is a small piece of evidence. It says a letter was handled at a particular place on a particular day, and it quietly outlives almost everything else about that place. PostmarkFile is built for the question that follows: is that post office still there?

Search a town, a county, or a ZIP code and the app opens the office behind the mark — what kind of facility it was, which years the record actually covers, what the building looked like when a member last photographed it, and whether anything since then suggests it has closed. Where the file is silent, the app says so plainly. A missing office is not proof that a place had no post office, and this app is careful never to pretend otherwise.

The legend teaches you to read the mark itself. Hand devices, machine cancels, four-bar killers, Doane numerals, duplex frames, flag killers, pictorials, and the spray printers that cancel most mail today are drawn out one by one, with the details that separate them, and a comparison view that puts any two side by side. It is the difference between knowing a cover is old and knowing why.

For the covers you own, there is a shelf. Record the office, the style of the postmark, the date on the dater, and where the cover came from, and PostmarkFile checks the office against that date — inside the documented window, after the last observation, or after the office had already closed. The same covers become a map, one pin per town, so a collection that lives in a shoebox can be seen as a journey.

Genealogists tend to arrive with a different question: why can't I find the address my grandmother wrote on this envelope? The address desk answers it with postal history rather than guesswork — stations and branches that vanished without notice, contract units that kept a place name alive after the office closed, rural delivery that folded small towns into larger ones, and the year ZIP codes arrived and changed how every address was written.

The records come from the Post Mark Collectors Club's public post office photograph collection, compiled state by state by members over decades. PostmarkFile reads that published collection, credits it, and shows its gaps instead of filling them. It is an independent field reader, not an official publication, and it is meant to be used the way a collector uses a catalogue: with a pencil, a doubt, and a second source.
