name: Presenze SGS
description:
Presenze è l'app per gli addetti delle aziende che usano i sistemi SGS: serve per registrare l'inizio e la fine del turno e degli interventi, direttamente dal telefono.

COME FUNZIONA
Accedi con il codice azienda, il nome utente e la password che ti ha dato la tua azienda. Per timbrare inquadra il QR del foglio presenze del luogo di lavoro: l'app registra l'orario e, dove richiesto dall'azienda, verifica che tu ti trovi nel posto giusto.

COSA PUOI FARE
• Iniziare e terminare il turno con un tocco e il QR del luogo di lavoro
• Vedere il tempo trascorso in turno e i dati dell'ultimo turno
• Consultare l'agenda degli interventi assegnati, giorno per giorno (scorri a destra e sinistra per cambiare giorno)
• Aprire il dettaglio di un intervento: orario, descrizione, indirizzo, squadra e attività da svolgere
• Iniziare e terminare un intervento con la scansione del QR, e registrare interventi extra
• Vedere sulla mappa i luoghi di lavoro e gli interventi del giorno, e aprire il percorso nell'app di navigazione del telefono
• Mostrare il tuo QR personale (My ID)

PERMESSI
• Fotocamera: per leggere i QR delle timbrature
• Posizione: per verificare la distanza dal luogo di lavoro quando la tua azienda lo richiede, e per mostrarti sulla mappa

NOTE
• L'app è riservata agli addetti delle aziende clienti: serve un account fornito dalla propria azienda.
• Serve una connessione a internet.
• Le funzioni disponibili (per esempio gli interventi o il controllo della posizione) dipendono da come la tua azienda ha configurato il tuo profilo.

Per assistenza contatta il referente della tua azienda o SGS Software.

name: Prestino TV
description: Watch streams from your own playlists. Import an M3U or M3U8 file or enter an HTTPS playlist URL. Find channels, save favorites, and add an optional XMLTV guide. A built-in demo is included. Try full playback for 7 days, then unlock it with a one-time purchase. No automatic charge. Prestino TV is a player for compatible streams and does not provide channels or subscriptions.

name: PrincessSafa
description:
Step into an enchanted 3D fairytale palace and meet your child's new royal friend, Princess Safa.

Designed especially for toddlers and young children, Princess Safa creates a warm, magical world where children can talk, laugh, play dress-up, and listen to soothing bedtime stories.

WHAT MAKES PRINCESS SAFA SPECIAL

TALK AND CHAT WITH THE PRINCESS
Children can speak directly with Princess Safa. Using advanced on-device voice technology, Princess Safa listens, responds warmly, and remembers her little friend's favourite games and colours.

ROYAL PALACE AND 3D WARDROBE
Enter the grand royal hall through majestic swinging golden gates. Help Princess Safa pick royal dresses, sparkling tiaras, crowns, and slippers with magical sparkles.

ENCHANTING ACTIVITIES AND GAMES
Host a royal tea party, discover musical moments, play sweet dress-up games, and take keepsake royal photos to save in your family photo album.

GENTLE MORNING AND BEDTIME ROUTINES
Princess Safa follows the time of day. In the evening, she gently changes into her nightgown, says sweet goodnights, and tells calming bedtime stories to help little ones drift off to sleep.

SAFE, PRIVATE AND AD-FREE
We believe children deserve a safe, private space to play:
- Zero Advertisements
- Zero In-App Purchases or Subscriptions
- Zero Tracking or Data Collection
- 100 percent On-Device Technology: Voice processing stays strictly on your device and is never sent to the internet or recorded.
- Adult-Locked Parental Gate on all settings.

WORKS 100 PERCENT OFFLINE
No internet, Wi-Fi, or cellular connection is required. Perfect for car trips, flights, and quiet moments anywhere.

Bring home the wonder of royalty and imaginative friendship with Princess Safa today.

name: Promislate
description:
Still waiting for a refund, repair or promised callback? Promislate keeps the details together so you can follow up with confidence.

Create a case for each issue. Record the company, reference number, what happened and what was promised. Add dated updates, photos or files, then set a follow-up date and an optional reminder.

When it is time to contact the company again, prepare a case summary, copy it or export a PDF. Mark cases resolved when they are finished, and reopen them if you need to. Search your records and keep a backup you control.

Your cases stay on your device. No account is required, and there are no ads. You choose when to export or share your information. Device backups may also include app data according to your Apple settings.

FREE TO USE
Keep up to five active cases with notes, evidence, follow-up dates, optional local reminders, summaries, PDF exports and backups. Resolved cases remain accessible.

OPTIONAL PLUS UPGRADE
Unlock unlimited active cases with a one-time in-app purchase. No subscription. Restore Purchases is available in Settings.

Promislate helps you organise your records and follow-ups. It does not contact companies on your behalf or provide legal advice.

name: PromptCam
description:
Graba videos mientras lees tu guion en la misma pantalla. PromptCam combina un teleprompter ajustable con la cámara de tu iPhone o iPad. El guion se muestra sobre la vista previa y queda fuera del video final.

• Ajusta la velocidad, el tamaño de letra, el fondo y la posición del guion. También puedes avanzar con la voz o mover el texto con el dedo.
• Graba en vertical u horizontal con la cámara frontal o trasera, en hasta 4K según tu dispositivo. Usa una cuenta regresiva de 3, 5 o 10 segundos y revisa el resultado antes de guardarlo en Fotos o compartirlo.
• Crea y edita varios guiones. Al pegar texto, PromptCam puede ordenar los párrafos y te deja deshacer el cambio.
• Selecciona un micrófono compatible y comprueba el nivel de audio en pantalla.

PromptCam funciona sin crear una cuenta. El modo Seguir mi voz procesa el audio en el dispositivo por defecto. Si activas el reconocimiento en la nube y el reconocimiento local no está disponible, Apple puede procesar el audio.

Disponible en español e inglés.

name: PromZ Media
description:
PromZ Media is de app van PromZ Vak, het vakblad voor promotionele producten en werkkleding.
Lees het magazine, volg het vaknieuws, luister naar de podcast en vind je weg op de beurs PromZ Product Première.

Lezen en luisteren
- Magazines: blader in de kiosk door de nummers en lees ze pagina voor pagina. Met Inhoud en Zoeken vind je snel een artikel. Bewaar een nummer en lees het zonder internet.
- NewZ: het vaknieuws van promzvak.nl.
- Podcast: de PromZ Promo Podcast en The Next Generation. Spring 15 seconden terug of 30 vooruit, kies de snelheid en luister door met het scherm uit. Download een aflevering en luister offline; de app onthoudt waar je was.
- Beursagenda: de vakbeurzen op een rij.

Op PromZ Product Première
- Plattegrond: zoek op exposant, product of standnummer en markeer je favorieten. Werkt ook zonder internet, met de laatst bewaarde versie.
- Looproute door de gangpaden, naar één stand of langs al je favorieten.
- Waar sta ik? Scan de QR-code bij een stand en de kaart laat zien waar je bent.
- Beursnieuws, en als je wilt op de beursdag een herinnering met je route langs je favorieten.

Voor exposanten
Leads scannen (KeepTrack) is de badgescanner voor exposanten. Je hebt een token van de beursorganisator nodig. Scan de badges van bezoekers, ook offline, zet een notitie bij elke lead en exporteer je lijst als CSV.

Taal en editie
Kies in het menu de Nederlandse (promzvak.nl), Duitse (promz.de) of Zweedse editie (promz.se), of zet de menu's in het Engels.

name: ProOffice Lumora
description:
Lumora ist die App zu deinem Lumora-System von ProOffice Digital. Du siehst dein Haus als 3D-Modell und steuerst Licht, Heizung, Rollos und Musik, zu Hause auf dem Handy oder als Wandtablet.

DEIN HAUS IN 3D
• Das Gebäude als fotorealistisches 3D-Modell, von oben oder frei gedreht
• Beschriftet ist nur, was gerade an oder offen ist
• Lampen und Lautsprecher direkt im Modell antippen

ALLES AUF EINEN BLICK
• Übersicht mit Begrüßung, Innentemperatur und dem letzten Ereignis
• Hinweise auf offene Fenster und Türen, Rauch oder Wasser
• Szenen mit einem Tipp, „Alle Lichter aus“ für das ganze Haus
• Räume als Karten: Temperatur und wie viele Lichter an sind

LICHT
• Schalten und dimmen direkt in der Kachel
• Weißtöne und Farben für Lampen, die das können
• Farbmischung für Leuchten mit mehreren Kanälen, z. B. Weiß, Rot und Blau

HEIZUNG UND MEHR
• Thermostate mit Ist- und Zieltemperatur, Ziel in halben Grad einstellen
• Rollos öffnen, schließen und anhalten
• Saugroboter starten und zurückschicken

MUSIK
• Lautsprecher wählen, Pause, Weiter und Lautstärke
• Titel, Künstler, Alben, Playlists und Radio suchen und abspielen
• Favoriten mit einem Tipp starten

LIVE UND SICHER
• Änderungen erscheinen sofort, auch wenn jemand den Wandschalter benutzt
• Verlauf: wer wann was geschaltet hat
• Die App spricht nur mit deinem Lumora-Server im eigenen Netz. Er prüft jeden Befehl, bevor etwas geschaltet wird.
• Keine Werbung, kein Konto, keine Datensammlung durch die App

FÜR HANDY UND TABLET
• Eigenes Layout für Tablets, ideal als Bedienfeld an der Wand
• Dunkle Oberfläche mit Glas-Optik

VORAUSSETZUNG
Lumora braucht ein eingerichtetes Lumora-System von ProOffice Digital (Lumora-Server in deinem Haus). Ohne diesen Server lässt sich die App nicht nutzen. Mehr dazu unter https://lumora-store.pro-office.net

name: PROtv Streaming
description:
PROtv is a free streaming home for independent film and stories with their own point of view.

Watch films and series from independent creators, plus PROtv LIVE, a free channel that plays around the clock with an on-screen program guide.

Sign in with your free PROtv account to keep My List and Continue Watching in sync across your iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and watchprotv.com.

PROtv is free to watch.

name: Pruitts Daily Motivations
description:
Pruitts Daily Motivations is built around one simple mission: helping people find hope, connection and encouragement through life’s toughest moments.

Created by Mitchell Pruitt, a passionate mental health advocate, this app is designed to remind people that their lives matter and that asking for support is a sign of courage.

name: Pryeth
description:
A quiet record of the books made by hand.

Pryeth is a private binding journal for the bench. Record each book with its paper, stitch, cover, place, minutes, signatures and pages, then watch a year of small bindings gather into something worth keeping.

THE BENCH
Open to the last book, the papers in hand and the bindings that came before. Add a book in a few taps, or step back into the yearbook.

BOOKS, KEPT
Keep the minutes, signatures and pages for every binding. Add the cover material, the place, a mood and one honest note. Search the log by title, paper, stitch, place or phrase, and filter by the mood of the day.

THE PAPER SHELF
Catalog sheets across wove, laid, coated, handmade, recycled and vellum papers. Note the maker, finish, size and weight, and track full, in-use, low and out states with a manual sheet count.

THE STITCH LIBRARY
Keep the structures you actually use: Coptic, case, limp, accordion, pamphlet and long stitch. Note the thread, the papers that suit them and the books that came from each.

THE YEARBOOK
Read the shape of a year: books made, pages gathered, signatures folded, time under weight, binding days, favorite papers and stitches, month bars, the best day, papers out and the longest binding.

YOUR BENCH STAYS YOURS
No account. No cloud sync. No advertising. No analytics. No streak or score. The journal is a JSON file in the app's local Documents folder, and you can export a backup or a CSV whenever you choose.

DELIBERATE LIMITS
Pryeth is a bench notebook, not a shop or a course. There are no prices, affiliate links or material recommendations. It does not impose pages, scan a finished book or turn your practice into a number to beat.

Made for two hands, a quiet bench and the book under weight.

name: PsiStoria
description:
PsiStoria to Twoja półka z audiobookami. Zaloguj się danymi istniejącego konta PsiStorii, aby słuchać historii dostępnych na swoim koncie.

Wróć do opowieści o Leosiu, Bodziu lub Rózi i zacznij od miejsca, w którym skończył się ostatni odsłuch. Przewijaj o 15 sekund, zmień tempo albo wybierz następną historię. Możesz też włączyć powtarzanie lub automatyczne przejście do kolejnej bajki.

Kopia odtwarzanej historii zapisuje się w tle. Gdy na półce pojawi się oznaczenie „Pobrana”, możesz jej słuchać także bez internetu. Aplikacja zapamiętuje miejsce odsłuchu i pozwala zarządzać zapisanymi kopiami.

Słuchaj z wygaszonym ekranem. Do pierwszego logowania i przygotowania kopii offline potrzebne jest połączenie z internetem.

name: Pufi: Live Rooms & Chat
description:
Good people. Great energy. All live.

Pufi is where you find your people. Drop into a live voice room, take a seat and talk, or go live on video and bring friends on screen with you.

VOICE ROOMS
Rooms with 9 to 20 seats. Ask for a seat, chat with the room, or just listen in.

GO LIVE ON VIDEO
Start a live stream in seconds, invite guests to join you and keep the chat going.

FEED
Share photos and thoughts, browse topics, like and comment on posts from the people you follow.

MESSAGES
Keep talking after the room ends with private chats.

YOUR PROFILE
Photos, a short bio, levels, medals and titles that grow as you take part.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Report or block anyone in one tap. Room hosts and moderators keep rooms friendly, and our support team is one tap away inside the app.

Pufi is for adults 18 and over.

Questions? hello@pufi.social

name: PunchCard: TimeClock
description:
PunchCard is a simple personal time clock. Tap once to clock in, tap again to clock out, and always know exactly how many hours you worked.

Made for anyone who wants their own record of their hours: to check a paycheck, compare with an employer's time clock, or track time spent on a project, a hobby or volunteer work.

CLOCK IN AND OUT • One big button: Clock In turns into Clock Out • Live timer while you're on the clock • Today's and this week's hours at a glance

WEEKLY TIMESHEET • Every clock-in and clock-out time, week by week • Hours per punch, per day and for the whole week • Forgot to clock out? Tap the punch and fix the time • Missed a punch? Add it to any day in seconds • Add notes to any punch

REPORTS • Hours per day, week or month • Quick picks: This Week, Last Week, This Month, Last Month, This Year • Or choose any date range you like • Totals in hours:minutes and decimal hours

PRINT, EMAIL AND SHARE • Print your report or timesheet, or save it as a PDF • Email it with a spreadsheet (CSV) attached • Share with any app: Messages, Mail, Files and more

PRIVATE BY DESIGN • No account, no sign-in • No ads, no tracking, no analytics • Your hours never leave your iPhone unless you choose to share them

name: Pure Cam: Natural Beauty
description:
Pure Cam is a camera that makes you look naturally good, right as you shoot.

NATURAL RETOUCH
Smooths skin and gently refines your face line, while keeping eyes, brows and lips crisp. Turn face shaping on or off with one tap.

PEOPLE AND SCENERY
People mode retouches faces. Scenery mode adjusts color only.

PHOTO AND VIDEO
The same look in both.

SIMPLE CONTROLS
- Aspect ratios: 4:3, 16:9, 1:1, plus landscape framing while holding the phone upright
- Timer: 3, 5 or 10 seconds
- Night mode
- Tap to focus, swipe to adjust brightness
- Browse your photo library from the camera

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos and videos stay on your iPhone. Face detection runs on the device.

REMOVE ADS (MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION)
Pure Cam is free with ads. The Remove Ads subscription removes all ads and unlocks the highest photo resolution.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically every month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://itteee.github.io/pure-cam/privacy.html

name: PureScan: Seed Oil Scanner
description:
Shop with total label clarity in every grocery aisle. PureScan scans any food barcode in milliseconds to highlight industrial seed oils, ultra-processed additives, NOVA processing class, and cleaner swaps.

Unlike rigid black-box scores that penalize butter, olive oil, or avocados for calories, PureScan's Whole Natural Fats transparency badge distinguishes minimally processed whole foods from refined industrial oils.

KEY FEATURES
• Instant Seed Oil & Additive Detection: Spot canola, soybean, corn, cottonseed, sunflower, safflower, dyes, emulsifiers, and hidden sugars.
• 6 Live Scoring Lenses: Toggle Seed-Oil Strict, NOVA Score, Protein Ratio, Clean Additives, Low Sugar, and Whole Natural Fats.
• Aisle Compare (A vs B): Compare two products side-by-side before putting one in your cart.
• Interactive Science Drawer: Understand why each ingredient was flagged with clear, transparent explanations.
• Offline Cache & Safe Cart: Previously scanned items and curated staples load instantly even in zero-signal grocery aisles.
• Guest-First Privacy: Zero forced login, zero ads, optional backup, and 1-tap permanent account deletion.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
PureScan Pro is offered as an auto-renewable Annual plan (with an eligible 3-day free trial) or Weekly plan. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.

Privacy Policy: https://barbarda.com/purescan/privacy
Terms of Use: https://barbarda.com/purescan/terms

Informational Notice: Ingredient analyses are based on public OpenFoodFacts and manufacturer records; always check the physical package label, especially for allergies.

name: PurrCalm: Pet & Calm
description:
When everything feels like too much, PurrCalm gives your hands something gentle to do. Stroke a soft, purring friend on your screen, feel the purr in your fingertips, and breathe a little slower — one small moment at a time.

STAY WITH ME
One tap, from the heart in the middle of the tab bar, the Action button, Siri or a widget, opens a calm, guided flow with no choices to make. Your friend leans in to one place at a time — under the chin, behind the ears — and a calm voice walks you through it. Then a few slow breaths along their back, a 5-4-3-2-1 grounding exercise if you need it, and a check-in at the end. Leaving is always one tap.

FEEL A REAL PURR
The purr is a real recording of a real cat, matched to soft vibrations you can feel under your fingers while you stroke. Fur moves with your touch, and every friend has their own weight, texture and sound.

13 FRIENDS TO PET
Patik the tuxedo cat and Snowball the white cat are free to pet, as long as you like. With Plus, meet all thirteen — a golden retriever, a red panda, a lop-eared rabbit, a capybara, a lamb and more — in sunny rooms, gardens, rainy windows and quiet evenings. Name them, and choose who sits on your Home Screen.

SMALL RITUALS FOR HARD DAYS
• A one-minute pause
• Breathing together, at your own pace — never a forced hold
• Grounding with your senses
• A softer evening to turn the day down
• Four soothing little games, from a rainy window to a ball of yarn

SET YOUR WORRIES DOWN
Write what's on your mind and put it in the worry box. Notes are encrypted on your iPhone, can be locked with Face ID, and you can pause or close them when they're done with you.

ALWAYS NEAR
Widgets, a friend on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island after a hard moment, and gentle reminders when you want them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account is needed. If you choose to sign in with Apple or Google, your space is backed up and comes with you to a new iPhone — and your notes stay end-to-end encrypted, so only your own devices can read them.

Available in English and Turkish.

PURRCALM PLUS
Free: petting Patik and Snowball, the rainy window, and "Stay with me" once. PurrCalm Plus unlocks all 13 friends and every place, unlimited "Stay with me", all games, rituals, notes and widgets. Plus is available as an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription; the yearly plan includes a free trial for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://purrcalm.antaaistudio.com/privacy

PurrCalm is a wellbeing tool for everyday stress. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or replace care from a professional. If you are in danger or crisis, please contact your local emergency number.

name: Purrletter: Letter & Envelope
description:
Some words deserve more than a text message.

Purrletter helps you write a real letter to someone you love — a thank-you to a friend, a few warm words for your mom, a birthday wish for grandma — and send it in a beautiful envelope.

Write on paper, in a handwriting font. Pick the paper and ink, a pattern or your own photo. Seal the envelope with wax and a stamp. Then send it through any app: as pictures of the envelope and every sheet, or as a short video in which the envelope is opened and your letter comes out, with soft paper sounds.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Paper that feels real: the text lies on the sheet like handwriting and continues on the next sheets
• Over 30 fonts — handwritten, classic, typewriter — and your own fonts
• Paper, ink and envelope colors, and any color you like
• Patterns: paw prints, a sleeping cat, hearts, a garden, grid, letterhead and more
• Your photo as a polaroid sticker, a header or a soft background
• Postage stamps and wax seals in any color — with a cat, a paw, a swallow, a heart or your initial
• Holiday sets in one tap: Christmas, New Year, Lunar New Year, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Halloween, birthdays and weddings
• "Where to start?" — gentle questions and opening lines for a blank page
• Your own date on the letter and on the postmark
• Folders and favorites; drafts are saved automatically
• Gentle reminders before holidays and about unfinished letters — only if you want them
• iPhone and iPad, light and dark mode, 35 languages, right-to-left writing

FREE AND PRO
Your first 3 letters are free, with everything from Pro. After that, sending letters needs Purrletter Pro: every font, color, pattern, stamp and seal, your own photos and fonts, high-quality pictures without the Purrletter mark, video letters with sound, folders and favorites. Try anything while writing — you decide only when you send.
Purrletter Pro is a yearly subscription or a one-time purchase forever. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your letters stay on your device. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vandaq.github.io/purrletter-site/privacy/

name: Puzzle Pocket: Logic Puzzles
description:
Puzzle Pocket is a collection of clean, relaxing logic puzzles. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, so you never have to guess: just think it through.

FOUR PUZZLES IN ONE APP
• Route: draw one path from 1 through every number in order, filling every cell. Walls, one-way arrows and closed cells join along the way.
• Mini Sudoku: fill a 6×6 grid so each row, column and box holds 1 to 6 once. Harder levels add odd and even cells.
• Balance: fill the grid with dots and rings, three of each per row and column, never three in a row.
• Blocks: split the grid into rectangles, each holding one number equal to its size.

A NEW DAILY PUZZLE FOR EVERY MODE
• One daily puzzle per mode, the same for every player.
• Easy at the start of the week, harder on the weekend.
• Keep your streak going and share your result card with friends.

PACE RUNS
• Solve 3, 5 or 10 puzzles back to back on one clock.
• Your pace is your average time per puzzle; each hint adds 30 seconds.
• Every run has a short code, so friends can play the same puzzles and compare.

LEADERBOARDS AND STATS
• Optional leaderboards for daily puzzles and runs. No account needed: you get a random player name, and you can delete your leaderboard data at any time in Settings.
• Stats show your levels, daily streak, play time and best pace for every mode, ready to share.

1,400 LEVELS
• 500 Route levels across 5 worlds, plus 300 levels each for Mini Sudoku, Balance and Blocks.
• Difficulty rises gently from easy to hard.
• Stuck? Use a hint to reveal the next correct move.

DESIGNED TO RELAX
• No lives, no energy, no waiting.
• Light and dark themes.
• Levels and daily puzzles play offline.

Puzzle Pocket is free and supported by ads. A one-time purchase removes full-screen ads, and hint packs are available in the shop.

name: Q for Quran - Quran and Prayer
description:
Q For Quran is a complete Islamic companion — one beautiful app for the
Quran, your daily prayers and everything around them.

THE QURAN
• Read the full Quran with clear Arabic and verse-by-verse translations in English, Urdu and more
• Mushaf mode with real page layout — just like a printed Quran
• Listen to recitations from world-renowned reciters (Mishary Alafasy, Abdul Basit, As-Sudais, Minshawi, Husary and more)
• Verse audio with repeat, bookmarks, reading progress (Hifz Academy) and daily goals
• Noorani Qaida and step-by-step Arabic learning for beginners
• Kids section: Islamic stories, quizzes and fun learning

PRAYER & WORSHIP
• Accurate prayer times for your location with azan reminders and beautiful azan voices
• Qibla compass — find the direction of the Kaaba instantly, anywhere
• Learn Salah with step-by-step guides
• Tasbeeh counter, Duas & Ruqyah collection, 99 Names of Allah, Names of Muhammad (peace be upon him)
• Worship planner, fasting tracker and Jumu'ah resources
• Hijri Islamic calendar with important dates

LEARN & GROW
• Authentic hadith collections (Bukhari, Muslim and more)
• Seerah of the Prophet (peace be upon him) in chapters
• Islamic quiz to test your knowledge
• Zakat calculator, inheritance (Mirath) guide and sadaqah resources
• Personal spiritual journal

MORE
• Watch Makkah TV, Quran TV and more — LIVE 24/7 from the Haramain
• Shops & Deals — real discounts from trusted Islamic shops near you
• Mosque finder with directions
• Multiple app languages, light & dark themes
• Offline friendly: a clean reconnect screen if your internet drops, and it automatically resumes when you are back online

No ads. No tracking. Your reading stays private.

Q For Quran — Light for your heart.

name: QR Code Monkey: QR Generator
description:
Make a code worth keeping. QRcove is a native QR design studio for your phone, with local generation, original styling and real files you can use anywhere.

CREATE OFFLINE
Create QR codes for websites, plain text, Wi-Fi, contacts (vCard 3.0), email and phone numbers. Your content is encoded on your device, without a generation service or account. QRcove does not upload your links, Wi-Fi passwords, contact details or logos.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose a clear color palette, square or soft-corner pixels, and an optional logo from your device. High error correction, protective spacing and contrast checks help you create readable codes. Always test your code before printing.

REAL EXPORTS
Export an actual 1024 x 1024 PNG for free, with no watermark. Use the native share sheet to save to Files or share through another app. Pro adds genuine SVG vector geometry, a 100 x 100 mm print PDF and 2048px PNG.

SAVE AND REUSE
Save one design locally for free. Reopen, edit and export it later. Pro unlocks unlimited saved designs and duplicates, extra palettes, dot-shaped pixels and custom colors. Wi-Fi passwords are omitted from saved designs; re-enter them when reopening a protected network code.

LIFETIME PRO
One non-consumable purchase, USD $6.99 US base. Your store shows the actual localized price before purchase. No subscription, trial, ads, credits or renewal. Restore Purchases is available for the same store account. Apple and Google purchases are separate.

YOUR CONTENT, YOUR DEVICE

name: Question the Chart
description:
Învață să citești și să corectezi desenele de pe grafic prin exerciții ghidate, clare și practice. Question the Chart te ajută să identifici rapid liniile greșite, zonele inutile, măsurile plasate incorect și alte elemente de analiză tehnică, direct pe grafice pregătite în avans.

Secțiunea principală
- Situații de învățare gata pregătite - exersezi pe scenarii reale, cu obiectiv clar și verificare imediată
- Grafic cu rozare și editare directă - muți linii, margini de zonă, puncte de măsurare și adaugi note
- Explicații după fiecare răspuns - afli ce este corect, ce trebuie schimbat și de ce
- Mod de lucru offline - poți învăța fără internet, fără cont și fără pași inutili
- Seturi variate de exerciții - găsești linii orizontale, zone de preț, măsurări, marcaje pe lumânări și scenarii mixte
- Practică liberă - creezi și salvezi propria rozare, apoi revii oricând la ea

Potrivit pentru
- cei care vor să înțeleagă mai bine instrumentele de pe grafic
- utilizatori care învață analiza tehnică pas cu pas
- exerciții rapide de verificare și corectare a unei analize existente
- antrenament pentru linii, zone, măsurători și note pe grafic

De ce să alegi această aplicație
Question the Chart pune accent pe învățare practică, nu doar pe teorie. Fiecare situație are un obiectiv, o verificare precisă și o explicație scurtă, astfel încât să înveți cum funcționează fiecare instrument și cum îl folosești corect. Interfața este concepută pentru lucru comod pe ecran tactil, iar punctele de prindere sunt suficient de mari pentru ajustări precise. Progresul, setările și lucrările salvate rămân pe dispozitivul tău.

Începe acum și testează-ți cunoștințele pe grafice pregătite pentru antrenament, corectare și practică liberă.

name: Quick Focus: 1-Min Brain Gym
description:
Stop warming up your brain with endless scrolling before studying or deep work.
Quick Focus is a minimalist, offline cognitive utility designed to sharpen your focus and visual perception in just 60 seconds.

• Zero Ads: No banners or pop-ups interrupting your focus.
• No Subscriptions: Pay once and own it forever with no recurring fees.

1. Schulte Table (3×3, 5×5, 6×6)
Tap numbers in ascending order as quickly as possible to train peripheral vision and speed. Includes an optional Center Focus Dot for speed-reading practice.

Choose the ink color rather than the word meaning to train cognitive control and focus.

3. Reflex Timer

Inizia subito il tuo primo test in 5 secondi, senza registrazione obbligatoria, con banca dati aggiornata alle ultime riforme normative e funzionamento 100% offline.

5 MATERIE UFFICIALI DEI BANDI DI POLIZIA LOCALE
• Codice della Strada e Infortunistica (D.Lgs. 285/1992): aggiornato alla riforma L. 177/2024 (art. 186 ebbrezza, nuovo art. 187 stupefacenti, sospensione breve patente art. 218-ter, monopattini elettrici, patente a punti, termini artt. 201-204-bis, sequestri e rilievi sinistri).

• Diritto Amministrativo e TUEL (L. 241/1990, D.Lgs. 267/2000, L. 65/1986): procedimento, SCIA, accesso documentale e FOIA, organi del Comune, ordinanze sindacali artt. 50 e 54 TUEL, ordinamento Polizia Municipale e qualifica PS.
• Sistema Sanzionatorio Amministrativo (L. 689/1981): legalità, minori, concorso e solidarietà, contestazione/notificazione (90 gg), pagamento in misura ridotta, scritti difensivi (30 gg), ordinanza-ingiunzione, opposizioni, sequestro/confisca e prescrizione (5 anni).
• Polizia Commerciale, Edilizia, Ambientale e Pubblica Sicurezza: TULPS (R.D. 773/1931 artt. 16, 68, 80, 100, 109), commercio D.Lgs. 114/1998, vigilanza edilizia D.P.R. 380/2001, reati ambientali D.Lgs. 152/2006 (incluso nuovo art. 255 L. 137/2023), DASPO urbano e TSO/ASO.

FUNZIONALITÀ AVANZATE
• Risposte e Banca Dati: sfoglia tutti i quesiti con risposta esatta evidenziata, ricerca istantanea per parola chiave o norma, filtri Mai viste, Sbagliate e Preferite e spiegazioni normative dettagliate.
• PDF Engine integrato: stampa o condividi dispense studio/errori e Simulazioni Cartacee con spazio Nome/Cognome/Data, caselle A/B/C/D e Foglio Soluzioni staccato sull'ultima pagina.
• Ripasso Intelligente Errori (2x): ripete gli errori finché non indovini 2 volte consecutive.
• Simulazione Pesata da Bando: timer reale, criteri +1 / -0,25 / 0 ed esito Idoneo / Non Idoneo.
• Probabilità Superamento, Grafico Radar/Barre, Streak, Dark Mode e dimensione font regolabile.

DISCLAIMER LEGALE E FONTI PUBBLICHE
Questa app è uno strumento didattico indipendente sviluppato da GA-Soft e NON è affiliata, autorizzata né collegata ad alcun Comune, Corpo di Polizia Locale, Prefettura, Ministero dell'Interno o Dipartimento della Funzione Pubblica. Fonti pubbliche: inPA (https://www.inpa.gov.it), Normattiva (https://www.normattiva.it), Gazzetta Ufficiale Concorsi (https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/30giorni/concorsi).

name: Race Sim Engineer
description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a race engineer's pit wall. Race Sim Engineer listens for your console's live telemetry over your home Wi-Fi and gives you a real-time Voice Race Engineer, a Telemetry Auto-Tuner, and a full session library — all running 100% on-device.

LIVE DASH & MAP
Glanceable speed, gear, RPM, tyre temperatures and fuel while you drive, plus a live map that traces your line lap after lap.

VOICE RACE ENGINEER
Spoken callouts for tyre overheating, suspension bottoming out, personal bests and fuel warnings — timed so they never talk over each other.

TELEMETRY AUTO-TUNER
After just a minute of driving, Race Sim Engineer analyses suspension travel, wheelspin, tyre temperatures and gearing, and turns them into plain-English setup recommendations: which spring to stiffen, which differential setting to soften, which gear ratio to shorten.

LAP COACH
Compare any two laps corner by corner. See exactly where you braked too early, where your minimum speed dropped, and how much time each corner cost you — resampled onto a uniform distance grid so the comparison lines up even when your pace changes.

CREATOR STUDIO
Export a transparent telemetry overlay — speed, gear, pedal inputs, tyre temperatures — to drop straight on top of your own capture in CapCut, Final Cut or Premiere. No account, no watermark.

Compatible with Forza Horizon 6, Forza Horizon 5, Forza Horizon 4, Forza Motorsport and F1 25. Try Demo Drive from onboarding to see everything working before connecting a console.

PRIVACY FIRST
All telemetry decoding, voice coaching and tuning analysis happens on your device. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

Race Sim Engineer is an independent companion app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft, Turn 10 Studios, Playground Games, Sony, Polyphony Digital or EA Sports.

name: RackPivot: Gym Workout Log

TRAIN WITHOUT RETYPING
Start from a full-body, upper-body or lower-body routine, or build a workout from the exercise library. Log sets in pounds or kilograms and reuse the numbers from a previous set.

SWAP AROUND A BUSY GYM

KEEP THE SETS YOU’VE DONE

RAD Weather puts the official warnings near you on one map, with the weather and the surf alongside.

WARNINGS — FREE FOR EVERYONE
• Bushfire, flood, storm, cyclone, earthquake, tsunami, evacuation and more, from official government agencies in Australia, the Americas, Europe and Asia.

FORECASTS, SURF AND RADAR — RAD WEATHER YEARLY

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

name: RadioCabinet
description:
Radio Cabinet is the notebook you take to a flea market when a wooden set with no back plate catches your eye. Instead of guessing, you describe what you can actually see: the name on the dial, the shape of the cabinet, the number of valves glowing behind the back panel. The app compares that description with the public records of Le Grand Livre de la TSF and narrows thousands of models down to the handful that could plausibly be sitting in front of you.

Every record it opens is a real page from that archive: the year, the cabinet material, the wavebands, the valve complement, the service documents that survive. You can put the candidate beside the photographs and the schematic, notice a missing knob or a mains transformer that was added later, and decide whether the set is worth carrying home. The vocabulary of those pages is French and often sixty years old, so the app keeps a glossary beside you, with the English equivalent of each term.

What you keep afterwards is the part that matters. A machine enters your workshop with its photographs, and every intervention is written down: the capacitors you changed, the valves you swapped, the alignment you performed, the result you measured. Months later, the record still tells you what was done, in what order, and what is still waiting. Grouped by decade and by style, the collection becomes a wall of periods rather than a list of purchases.

Nothing here asks you to trust a live chassis. The app repeats the rule of the archive it draws from: an old receiver is never plugged in before it has been inspected, and no measurement is taken with the mains connected. The guidance it offers is about unplugging, discharging and knowing when to hand the set to someone qualified.

name: RadixRail Integer Lab
description:
Convert signed integers between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal. Inspect explicit-width unsigned bit operations and keep exact named results on your iPhone.

• Signed 64-bit conversion in four bases
• Unsigned 8, 16 and 32-bit AND, OR, XOR and NOT
• Logical left and right shifts with explicit width
• Uppercase hex and binary-grouping preferences
• Named immutable result snapshots with search
• Share results or export your actual local JSON

Negative conversions use a minus sign, not a two’s-complement encoding. Bit operands use whole decimal values. No code execution, hardware connection, account, ads or analytics. Works offline.

name: Railweaver
description:
Railweaver is a metro game for an invented city that grows every day.

Drag from one station to another to lay a line. Each passenger carries the symbol of the place they're heading to (a house, an office, a fair) and boards whichever train brings them closer; when it helps, they change lines. To extend a line, drag the ring at either end. If a station stays packed for too long, the network collapses and the game is over.

RUSH HOUR
In the morning people leave home for the office and the university; in the evening they head back. The load on the network flips twice a day, and the line that ran empty in the morning is packed by the evening.

A CITY THAT GROWS
• A day lasts one minute. Each night more of the city opens up, and new stations appear at any hour.
• As the days go by, the hospital, the university and the stadium arrive. There is only one of each, and the whole city has to be able to reach it.
• Each night you get a spare train and choose one of two upgrades: a new line, a carriage, two tunnels or an interchange, which holds twice as many waiting passengers.
• Crossing water uses up a tunnel, and tunnels are scarce.

THREE MAPS
• River City: a river cuts across it.
• Harbour: between the sea and a bay.
• Two Rivers: three arms of water meet in the middle.
Reach day 5 on one map to unlock the next. Each map keeps your record in days and passengers.

OFFLINE
No account or internet needed. The game collects no data: your records are saved only on your device. Available in English and Spanish.

FREE, NO ADS
River City is free to play, in full and with no time limit. The one-off “Full game” purchase adds Harbour and Two Rivers: pay once and it works on all your devices. No ads, no subscriptions.

name: Rambler Auction Co
description: This dynamic app allows you to (1) stay informed about our upcoming equipment auctions; (2) view items that interest you; (3) get notifications when you’ve been outbid; (4) bid no matter where you are located (or set and forget your maximum bid to let our platform automatically bid the lowest possible winning bid for you). This is the go-to-source for up-to-the-minute information on all of our auctions.

name: Random Page
description:
[Optimized for iPhone Duo] Random Page was made to be played on iPhone Duo. It works on any iPhone, but on iPhone Duo, unfolding your phone opens the book with it, and that is the experience this app was built for.

Remember opening a book at random and betting on the page number? Random Page brings that old game to your iPhone.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Pick a book from the shelf.
2. Open it. On iPhone Duo, just unfold your phone and the book opens with it. On other iPhones, tap Open.
3. Play the page you land on! Highest last digit, biggest sum of both pages, most people in the picture — you make the rules.

LUCK OR SKILL?
Open right away and you land on a random page.
Tap the cover's corner and the pages riffle from the back to the cover, just like flipping a book under your thumb. As they go, the stack under your thumb gets thinner. Open while it's thick for a page near the back, or wait until it's thin for one near the front. Time it right and catch the page you want.
The page isn't a random number — it's set by the exact moment you stop.

FIVE BOOKS, EACH ITS OWN THICKNESS
• From a 72-page notebook to a 1,280-page dictionary
• Thicker books take longer to riffle and land on more different pages
• Two picture magazines are full of people, animals, and objects, so you can play "most people wins"
• The book pages are in Korean; the shelf and instructions appear in your language

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
The folded outer screen is the cover. The unfolded inner screen is the pages. Unfolding your phone is opening the book: as you open it wider, the shadow in the spine fades and light falls on the paper.
On other iPhones, tap Open to play the same way, or turn your phone sideways to see both pages.

GREAT FOR
• Deciding who goes first or who takes the dare
• Quick bets with friends
• Number games with kids

Buy once and it's yours. No subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases.

name: Rappid Todo
description:
Rappid To-Do is a simple, fast to-do list.

• Add a task in seconds
• Tap any task to edit it
• Swipe to delete when it's done

Your tasks are stored only on your device. There are no accounts, no ads, and no tracking.

name: RapportPro
description:
RapportPro verwandelt eine Sprachaufnahme in einen klaren Arbeitsrapport – für Handwerk, Service und Installation.

So funktioniert's
1. Tippen Sie auf „Rapport sprechen“ und erlauben Sie das Mikrofon.
2. Erzählen Sie den Einsatz: Kunde, Adresse, Gerät, erledigte Arbeit, Material, Zeiten, Probleme, offene Punkte und den nächsten Termin. Bis zu 15 Minuten.
3. RapportPro transkribiert die Aufnahme vollständig und ordnet die Angaben in die Felder des Rapports. Sie können jedes Feld und das vollständige Notizen/Transkript prüfen und anpassen. Preise werden nicht erfunden.
4. Teilen Sie den Rapport als PDF, als Kundennachricht oder als Offerte. Optional erinnert Sie die App an den Folgetermin.

Die ersten drei gespeicherten Rapporte sind kostenlos. Danach können Sie RapportPro Plus abonnieren: wöchentlich für CHF 6.90 oder jährlich für CHF 99.00. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch über den App Store. Zahlung, Verlängerung und Kündigung laufen über Ihr Apple-Konto.

Datenschutz
Die Aufnahme wird zur Transkription an den Server von RapportPro und von dort an OpenAI gesendet. Der Server speichert die Aufnahme nicht. Rapporte und Firmendaten bleiben auf diesem Gerät. Es gibt kein Benutzerkonto und kein Tracking.

Support: info@ajkune-professional.ch
Datenschutz: https://rapportpro-api.vercel.app/privacy/

name: Ratchess Toll
description:
The more machines you build in the valley, the slower each one runs. Ratchess Toll is built around this paradox: the valley has only one stream and one wind, and everything you connect to them takes its share of power.

A waterwheel in the stream and windmill blades on the hill generate power, while gears, shafts, and pulleys carry it across the field to millstones, drying racks, screw presses, and oak barrels. Grain becomes bags of flour, seeds turn into bottles of golden oil, and apples become a drink that slowly matures in oak. But every new component changes the balance for everything else, so each placement demands the thought of a chess move. Then the day begins, and the weather puts your design to the test.

Key Features

- Power has two properties: torque and speed. Millstones need slow, powerful rotation, while conveyor belts need fast, light movement.
- When demand exceeds 100%, the machine farthest from the power source is the first to stop after a warning.
- Disconnect any machine with a tap to redistribute its share of power to the others, even before sunrise.
- Overloaded components begin to crack, then shed dust, shake, and eventually break, stopping everything connected downstream.
- Ice can freeze the stream in the middle of the day, forcing you to shift the load from water to wind in advance.
- At night, millstones won’t turn in the dark until a nearby lantern is lit.
- Spilled grain attracts hens, and a bird perched on a conveyor belt can block the entire production line.

Every level fits on a single 7×9 grid, where every cell matters. Twelve valleys take you from sunny meadows through autumn foliage to a night shift by the river, where a sudden surge of water, shifting winds, and the first frost arrive all at once. You can earn three stars on every level without a single upgrade, and a special reward awaits those who manage it. Complete the final valley to unlock an empty meadow, unlimited access to every component, and weather conditions of your choice. There’s still only one stream and one wind, but the temptation to build more machines never ends. See if you can power them all without letting a single one grind to a halt.

name: Ration Square
description:
Ration Square keeps a feed protein mix on this iPhone.

Two feeds sit on a square. Drag the target. The square subtracts the premix, then splits the rest by the two proteins. The adjusted target has to sit strictly between the feeds. Mixer fill over 100 percent splits into equal batches. A batch under 30 percent cannot be saved. Saving does not change the feed list. The last feed stays.

Weights stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: readywhen
description:
readywhen is the personal assistant for hands-on business owners. Available 24/7.

You're running the business and doing the work. The admin piles up in between. readywhen takes it off your plate.

Talk to it like a PA
Call it, message it or send a voice note between jobs. Tell it what needs doing and it gets on with it.

Know who's waiting on you
Ask what's outstanding and it tells you: the quote you promised, the client you owe a reply, the invoice that hasn't come in.

Replies written for you
Ask for the follow-up and it drafts it from the real conversation. You read it, tap to approve, and it goes.

Hand over the fiddly bits
Send a photo of a receipt or a PDF, or ask it to check something online. It sorts it.

Works with what you already use
Gmail, Outlook, your calendar and 1,400+ other tools.

You stay in control
Nothing sends without your tap. We don't train on your data.

name: Realtaro
description:
A Realtaro Magyarország első videóközpontú ingatlanplatformja. Az eladó és kiadó ingatlanokat nem fényképgalériákon, hanem lakásbejáró videókon ismered meg: úgy, mintha ott járnál.

MIÉRT MÁS?
Az ingatlankeresés ma többet kíván a hagyományos hirdetéseknél. A Realtaro görgethető videós felületén néhány perc alatt sok ingatlant fedezhetsz fel, valósághűbb képet kapsz a terekről és a hangulatról, és célzottabban választod ki, melyiket nézed meg személyesen.

MIT TUDSZ AZ APPBAN?
• Videós feed: pörgesd a hirdetéseket, minden ingatlanhoz videó, ár és a legfontosabb adatok tartoznak.
• Keresés és szűrők: eladó vagy kiadó, ár, alapterület, szobaszám, állapot, fűtés, parkolás és még sok más.
• Térképes nézet: lásd, hol van az ingatlan.
• Kedvencek és mentett keresések.
• Érdeklődés egy gombbal, aztán chat a hirdetővel az appon belül; értesítést kapsz, ha válasz érkezik.
• Élő lakásbejárás: nézz körbe élőben, kérdezz a tulajdonostól vagy az ingatlanostól.
• Körök: oszd meg a kiszemelt ingatlanokat a családdal és a barátokkal, ők kommentben és szavazattal mondják el a véleményüket, egy helyen, képernyőfotók küldözgetése nélkül.
• Megtekintés-foglalás és naptár az egyeztetett időpontokhoz.

HIRDETŐKNEK
Tulajdonosként vagy ingatlanosként videóval tűnhetsz ki a hagyományos hirdetések közül. A hirdetésed az appból is feladhatod, követheted az érdeklődőket, a megtekintéseket és a statisztikáidat, és élő bejárást indíthatsz.

BELÉPÉS
Böngészni bejelentkezés nélkül is lehet. Az érdeklődéshez, a chathez és a hirdetésfeladáshoz e-mail-címmel, Apple- vagy Google-fiókkal léphetsz be.

A Realtaro webes felülete: realtaro.hu. Kérdésed van? hello@realtaro.hu

name: Redline Mode
description:
Your EV is fast. Now make it sound like it.

Redline Mode plays a real V8 through your car's speakers and makes it react to how you drive. Press the pedal and it revs. Lift off and it crackles. It shifts up as you pick up speed and blips down as you slow. No cables, no add-ons: just your iPhone and your car's Bluetooth or CarPlay.

HOW IT WORKS
Your iPhone already knows how you're driving. Redline Mode reads its motion sensors and GPS, works out your speed and how hard you're pushing, and runs a full engine simulation in real time: six-speed gearbox, rev-matching downshifts, torque dip on upshifts, overrun pops, rev limiter. Put the phone in any mount, at any angle. It figures out which way is forward on its own.

THREE STEPS. THEN JUST DRIVE.
1. Connect your phone to your car.
2. Tap Start.
3. Drive.

It idles quietly until you pull away, goes silent when you park, and wakes up the moment you drive off.

BUILT FOR THE ROAD
• Plays only through your car's audio, never your phone speaker
• Keeps going with the screen locked, with RPM and gear on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Start and stop it hands-free with Shortcuts when your car connects or disconnects
• Navigation prompts and music still come through
• Predicts a split second ahead to hide Bluetooth delay

YOUR SOUND, YOUR WAY
Set the maximum volume, how much louder it gets with speed, and where it shifts.

TRY IT FREE
Get 5 minutes of driving with the engine on. The clock only runs while you can hear it. Then unlock Redline Mode with a single purchase. No subscription. Family Sharing included.

Keep your eyes on the road. Set everything up before you drive and obey local laws on in-car sound.

name: RedPen
description:
RedPen reads your manuscript aloud while you mark it up. Listen the way a reader would, catch what your eyes skip, and capture every edit the moment you hear it.

LISTEN
• Import a PDF, Word, RTF, HTML, text or Markdown file, or paste your text in.
• Hear it read aloud with the natural-sounding voices already on your iPhone or iPad, with the current sentence highlighted as you go.
• Change the reading speed, skip back or forward a few seconds, or jump by chapter.
• Keep listening with the screen locked.
• Try it right away with the included sample book, narrated and ready to play.

MARK IT UP
• Tap to flag a passage as something to cut or rewrite, with or without a note.
• Highlight text and add a written note.
• Dictate a voice note without taking your eyes off the page.
• See every edit in one list, and mark each one done as you work through it.

READ COMFORTABLY
• Paper, Sepia and system themes, adjustable text size and line spacing.
• Paragraphs laid out the way they were in your document, not as a wall of text.
• Search inside a manuscript.

SEND YOUR NOTES ANYWHERE
• Export your notes as a plain text file that names the chapter and paragraph for each one.
• Export your manuscript to PDF with your notes as annotations in the margin.
• Export to Word with your notes as comments, ready to send to an author, editor or co-writer.
• Back up your whole library and restore it on another device.

YOUR WORK STAYS YOURS
• Your manuscripts are stored on your device. RedPen doesn't need an account.

OPTIONAL: YOUR OWN AI VOICES
If you already have an account with OpenAI, Amazon Polly or Microsoft, you can add your own key in Settings to use their voices. This is optional, and those providers bill you directly. When you use one, the passages being read are sent to that provider to be turned into speech.

Made for novelists, editors, proofreaders, screenwriters and anyone who needs to hear their words to fix them.

name: RemoHop
description:
RemoHop lets you operate your own computers from an iPhone or iPad. It is the controller app for RemoHop, an open-source remote control project.

On the computer you run the RemoHop host (the "remohop" command-line program, for Linux, macOS and Windows). It shows a 9-digit ID and a temporary password. In the app you enter the ID, or the computer's address, and the password. After pairing once, you connect without a password.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Remote desktop: see and control the computer's screen, with full screen, quality presets and a monitor switch.
• Terminal: persistent shell sessions that keep running on the computer when you disconnect, with helper keys for Esc, Tab, Ctrl and arrows.
• Files: browse, upload, download, rename and delete; upload photos from your library or camera.
• Clipboard: send text between the phone and the computer.
• System information and screenshots.

HOW IT CONNECTS
• Sessions are end-to-end encrypted (QUIC with TLS 1.3) and go directly between your phone and your computer whenever the network allows it.
• Login is a password-authenticated key exchange. The password is never sent over the network.
• The computer's identity key is pinned on first login, and the app refuses a different key later.
• No RemoHop account is needed, and the app has no sign-up.

YOUR DATA
• The app contains no analytics, ads or tracking.
• Your identity key, pairings and settings stay in the app's private storage on your device.
• RemoHop has no built-in server. To find a computer by its ID, you enter the address of a rendezvous server that you or your organisation run. On the same network you can connect by address with no server at all.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A computer running the RemoHop host. See the website for how to get and run it.
• For remote desktop, the computer needs ffmpeg with an H.264 or AV1 encoder.

GOOD TO KNOW
• This app is a controller. It cannot make your iPhone or iPad controllable.
• The app must stay in the foreground during a session.
• The app is available in English and Simplified Chinese; choose the language in Settings.

Support: support@remohop.com · Telegram: t.me/remohop

name: Rental Master
description:
Rental Master is a point-of-sale app for businesses that rent things out by the hour: beach benches and chairs, boats, bikes, lockers and cloakrooms.

Staff see every unit on one screen, take payment for the hours up front, print a slip, and see at a glance which rentals are running and which are overdue.

EVERY UNIT ON ONE SCREEN
One tile per bench, boat or locker: free, in use or overdue, with the time left, said in words as well as colour. Tap a free unit to rent it out. Tap one in use to take it back.

THE HOURS PAID FIRST
A rental starts with its hours paid for. The price is worked out by the service from your own prices and is never typed in. The slip says when the paid time ends.

MORE HOURS AT ANY TIME
A running rental is extended from its unit. The extra hours are priced by the service and paid for, and a new slip shows the new end time.

DEPOSITS KEPT APART
A cash deposit, or a note that an ID is held, is recorded apart from income. It is then given back, or kept with a reason.

HANDED BACK BY SLIP
A rental is ended against the number on its slip, typed or scanned, or without the slip with a reason that a manager can see.

KEEPS WORKING OFFLINE
The unit screen, new rentals, extra hours and returns keep working without a network. Their records are sent when the connection is back. A deposit needs a connection.

SLIPS ON THE SPOT
Slips print on a Bluetooth receipt printer. Each names the unit and the time paid for.

SHIFTS AND REPORTS
Each cashier opens a cash shift and closes it against the expected cash. Owners and managers read the daily figures and a report per unit: times rented, time in use, money, and how busy it was.

THE OWNER'S WEB PORTAL
An owner or manager signs in on the web to add units, a numbered range at a time, to set prices, and to read the reports.

STAFF AND ROLES
Every member of staff has their own sign-in. A role decides what each one can do: an owner, a manager, a cashier who takes money, or a gate operator who does not.

ENGLISH AND BANGLA
The whole app, and every slip, in English or Bangla.

WHO IT IS FOR
Rental Master is for businesses. To use it you create a company, or your employer gives you a sign-in. A customer renting a bench does not need the app.

PRIVACY
No advertising, no analytics and no tracking. The app asks for Bluetooth only when you look for a printer. It asks for no camera, contacts or phone identifiers.
Privacy policy: https://rentalmaster.app/privacy/

Questions: support@rentalmaster.app

name: Retrace :: Track Back
description:
Retrace shows the walks, runs and rides you did before on the map, next to your live position. See where you've already been, pick up an old route again, or find out how fast you did that one stretch last time.

TRACKS NEARBY
Search the part of the map you're looking at, or look up a town or street. You see right away which of your tracks pass there, with date, distance and duration.

EACH IN ITS OWN COLOUR
Put a few tracks on the map at once. Every track gets its own colour, with arrows showing the direction, and the same colour in the list.

MEASURE A STRETCH
Tap two points on a track and see the distance, how long it took you and your pace. On a loop it also works across the start.

THE FIGURES FROM YOUR WATCH
Speed, elevation gain, heart rate, steps, cadence, calories, training effect and more, as you know them from Garmin Connect.

FILTERS
Filter by type (walking, running, cycling), distance, duration and period, and choose a search radius.

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
The tracks you put on the map are kept on your phone, so they keep working in the woods or the mountains.

BRING IN YOUR TRACKS
• Connect Garmin Connect with your own personal API key. New activities come in by themselves.
• Or import GPX files exported from Garmin Connect, Strava, Komoot and other apps.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no selling of data. Your location stays on your phone. You can delete your account and all your data in the app at any time.

Available in English, Dutch and French.

Garmin and Garmin Connect are trademarks of Garmin Ltd. or its subsidiaries. Retrace is not affiliated with Garmin.

Terms of use: https://retrace.eighty1.be/terms

name: Retro Rockets
description:
Dirige tu propio programa espacial con la estética de los planos de los años 60.

Construye cohetes pieza a pieza en el hangar: morros, cápsulas, tanques, motores, desacopladores y módulos de carga, montados en etapas y en racimo. Cada pieza cuesta dinero, pesa y consume combustible, así que cada diseño es una decisión de presupuesto.

Acepta contratos de agencias y empresas, cobra el adelanto y vuela:
• Cohetes sonda y el salto a la Línea de Kármán
• Vuelos suborbitales con aterrizaje propulsado y recuperación con paracaídas
• Satélites, astronautas en órbita y encuentros con la ISS
• Impactadores, orbitadores y alunizajes, con tripulación y con carga
• Viajes a Venus, Marte, Mercurio y Júpiter

Cinco fases de campaña: cada contrato cumplido desbloquea piezas nuevas. Los premios están calibrados con el coste real de un cohete capaz de cumplirlos, y los encargos repetibles te permiten reunir fondos.

Pilota con una cabina de época: palanca de empuje, giro, separación de etapas, paracaídas manual, telemetría de órbita, minimapa Tierra-Luna y tiempo acelerado para las travesías largas. La física es real: gravedad de la Tierra y la Luna, rozamiento atmosférico y consumo según el impulso específico de cada motor.

Versión completa de pago para iPhone y iPad: sin anuncios, sin compras integradas y sin registro. Disponible en 8 idiomas (español, inglés, francés, portugués, indonesio, hindi, bengalí y árabe). Tu progreso se guarda localmente en tu dispositivo.

name: REVEAL – Word Guess Game
description:
One clue. A hidden word. Every few seconds a new letter is revealed. The sooner you guess, the more you score, but a wrong guess costs points.
DAILY PLAY: 10 new words every day, the same for everyone. One try. Climb the daily leaderboard and keep your streak alive.

SOLO: play at your own pace with Easy, Medium or Hard words and a 20, 30 or 45 second timer.

PLAY TOGETHER: one phone hosts a private room. Friends and family join with a code or QR and see the ranking after every word.

RANKED (Beta): online Battle Royale. Wrong answer, no answer or slowest correct answer and you are out. Last one standing wins.

Play in English or Bahasa Melayu. No ads. No account needed to play; sign in only for ranked and to keep your records.

name: Ricochet - Watch Game
description:
One swipe sends the orb sliding across the board. Can you make it stop on the violet goal?

Ricochet is a sliding logic game for Apple Watch. The orb keeps moving until it hits a wall or reaches the edge. Use those stops to line up your next swipe, and look out for turn tiles that change your direction mid-slide.

• Play the first 100 Apple Watch levels for free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks all 1,000 levels.
• Match the fewest possible moves to earn a star, or replay a level to improve your best score.
• Undo a move or restart the puzzle whenever you want to try another route.

On iPhone, try an interactive practice puzzle and learn how to get started on Apple Watch. The numbered campaign is played on Apple Watch.

name: RiffDrop: Multitrack Recorder
description:
Record music together, from anywhere. RiffDrop is a multitrack studio on your iPhone that you share with a link: send it to your bandmates and they add their parts from their phones or any browser at riffdrop.io. Joining needs no account.

RECORD
• Multitrack audio recording with a count-in, metronome and loop region
• A latency test measures your iPhone, headphones or audio interface, so every take lands in time
• Punch in while the song plays, and keep every take
• A tuner for guitar, bass and voice
• See your take's waveform, or the notes you play, appear as you record

PLAY
• Riff Synth: keys, basses, pads, leads and plucks, with dozens of presets
• Drop Kit: a drum machine with 16 pads you play with your fingers
• Plug in a MIDI keyboard or pad controller: velocity, pitch bend, mod wheel and sustain
• A piano roll to draw, edit and quantize notes

MIX AND EDIT
• Volume, pan, mute and solo on every track
• Insert effects: EQ, filter, compressor, multiband compressor, limiter, distortion, chorus, delay, reverb, pitch shifter and stereo width
• Split, trim, fade, copy and paste clips, with undo
• Audio quantize tightens a strummed or picked part to the grid without changing its pitch
• Stretch clips or change their pitch

COLLABORATE
• Share a Drop with a link: everyone hears the same arrangement and adds takes from a phone or browser
• Comments on tracks, and a shared notepad for lyrics, chords and ideas
• A shared Drop's audio lives in its owner's own Google Drive
• The same Drops open in any browser at riffdrop.io, on a PC or Mac, with nothing to install

TAKE IT FURTHER
• Export a WAV or FLAC mixdown, stems that line up at bar 1, or MIDI
• Export whole projects for Reaper, Ableton Live 11.3 or later, and DAWproject (Studio One, Cubase, Bitwig), with every clip in place

A short tutorial shows the first steps, and a light appearance (white, with red waveforms) is one tap away in Settings.

Free, with every feature. No ads, no subscription.

name: Riftdive
description:
Dive into the rift, survive fifteen minutes of monsters, and come back stronger.

Riftdive is a one-finger action roguelite. You move — your hunter attacks on its own. Every level-up offers a choice of charms, and every choice changes how the run plays out.

THREE HUNTERS
A Warrior, an Archer and a Mage, each with their own weapons and their own class charms. Find the build that fits how you play.

FIFTEEN-MINUTE RUNS
Swarms grow, elites hunt you down, and a mid boss and a final boss wait at the end. Short enough for a break, deep enough to keep you coming back.

THREE RIFTS × TEN FLOORS
Each floor brings new monsters and a new twist. Clear it and the difficulty keeps rising — with mutations that change the rules, not just bigger health bars.

GEAR THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Upgrade your hunter's gear between runs with gold and stones earned in battle. Reach +5 and +10 to unlock new looks.

WEEKLY LEADERBOARD
Climb the ranking of each rift every week. Sign in with Apple to put your name on the board — or just play offline.

COMMUNITY ROOMS
Chat with real players — not AI — in rooms shared with our other games. Report or block anyone in a tap.

FAIR TO PLAY
Riftdive is free. Video ads are optional and only appear when you choose to watch one for a reward. Optional purchases: turn packs, No Ads (get rewards without watching), a monthly Premium that refills turns faster, and a seasonal Battle Pass with exclusive skins. Upgrade stones are never sold for real money — you earn them by playing. Out of turns? Keep playing in Practice.

SIXTEEN LANGUAGES
English, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski, Bahasa Indonesia, Türkçe, Русский, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文 and ไทย.

Questions or feedback: hamhansamu@proton.me

Privacy Policy: https://riftdive.privyzone.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://riftdive.privyzone.com/terms

name: Rig and Reel
description:
Rig and Reel is the tackle room companion for anglers. Photograph every rod, reel and lure, and give each lure an exact storage address in your boxes. Search by name, color or weight and the app highlights the right compartment in seconds. Keep a full line history for every reel, and see at a glance when it's time to change line or lubricate a reel. 

Planning a trip? Pick your fishing style and target fish, and Rig and Reel builds a packing list from your own arsenal, then checks it for you: right sinker and feeder weights, spare leaders, fresh line, serviced reels, enough groundbait. Missing something? Add it to your shopping list in one tap. After the trip, log lost lures and used supplies so your stock stays accurate, and see what you spent and lost over the season. 

Learn and practice with 16 essential fishing knots, each with a step-by-step animation, strength ranges and practical tips. Train against the clock and track your best times. Browse 19 rig diagrams for feeder, carp, float, spinning, ice and fly fishing, use the float shotting calculator, and save your own rigs built from the gear you own.

name: RightFitTrade: Tradie Quiz
description:
Not sure which trade might fit you? RightFitTrade is a 17-question quiz for Australian school leavers aged 16 and over, built to help you compare five trades: electrician, plumber, carpenter, air conditioning and refrigeration, and motor mechanic.

Answer short questions about your work preferences, your background, and what the day-to-day work involves. You'll see the trade that comes out as your closest match on a simple set of rules, shown in full straight away.

THE FIVE TRADES
• Electrician: electrical wiring and equipment in homes, shops and buildings
• Plumber: pipes, drains and fixtures moving water and waste
• Carpenter: building and fitting timber and building parts on site
• Air conditioning and refrigeration: air conditioners, cool rooms and heat-moving equipment
• Motor mechanic: servicing and repairing light vehicles in a workshop (not diesel or heavy vehicles)

WHAT'S FREE
• All 17 questions across work style, background and day-to-day reality, saved on your device
• Your closest-match trade shown in full, with the reasons it came first and any mismatches to weigh up
• The names of the other four trades in your short list
• A short preview of each of the five trades, with a summary and a photo
• One sample training provider for your chosen Australian state or territory
• No RightFitTrade account or email address is needed to take the quiz or see your closest match

WHAT UNLOCKING ADDS
With an optional one-time in-app purchase through the App Store (Full result unlock, no subscription), unlock:
• The reasons for the other trades in your short list, not just your closest match
• The full trade pages for all five trades, covering what a typical day and the physical work involve
• The rest of the training provider and employer list for your chosen Australian state or territory (ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, SA, TAS, VIC and WA), including group training organisations where listed
• A PDF of your unlocked result, to save or share

Unlocking works again on the same device if you retake the questions, and a Restore purchases button on the unlock screen lets you sync an existing purchase on your Apple ID.

WHO IT'S FOR
If you're weighing up an apprenticeship and want to see which tradie path might suit you, RightFitTrade is made for Australian school leavers aged 16 and over. There's no account to create, and your quiz answers stay on your device and are not sent to our servers.

WORTH KNOWING
This is guidance from your answers and simple rules. It is not a validated psychometric test and has not been checked for accuracy, so treat it as a starting point to think about, not a result. It is not careers advice, a job offer, or a guarantee of an apprenticeship, pay or hours. Before you decide anything, check with a training organisation, an employer, or your school careers adviser.

RightFitTrade is made by Origae, Melbourne VIC.

name: Ringlock: Tap the Gap
description:
One tap. One ring. One gap to hit.

A ring spins around a glowing core. Tap to lock it, but its gap has to line up with the gap of the ring below. Whatever misses gets sealed off, so every sloppy tap makes the next one harder.

Nail a PERFECT and the gap opens back up. String perfects together and every lock plays a higher note, until the whole tunnel is singing.

• Simple to learn, hard to master: just tap
• Every ring you lock sinks into an endless, color-shifting tunnel
• A rising melody and haptics reward every perfect combo
• The game gets faster, and some rings speed up and slow down as they spin
• Restart instantly with one tap
• Play offline, with no account and no data collection

Can you beat your best?

name: Ringward
description:
Three rings of wards circle the Core. Turn them to meet each wave, read where the next attack comes from, and push one wave further every run.

AIM BY TURNING
Nothing in Ringward fires in every direction. Each ward acts only inside its own arc, so you drag a ring to bring the right wards round to the side under attack. Warnings at the edge of the arena show where the next enemies will strike. Tap the Core to set off its Burst.

A DIFFERENT DEFENSE EVERY RUN
After key waves, pick one of three boons. Boons belong to families, and the right pair completes a combo. Bosses can drop trophies, which you keep and collect in the Codex.

GROW BETWEEN RUNS
Every run ends when the Core falls, and every run pays. Spend coins in the Forge, start timed Research, unlock new wards and rings, and climb through harder Orbits for bigger rewards.

PLAYS WHILE YOU ARE AWAY
Once you research it, Autopilot aims for you, and the Core keeps earning coins while you are away. Daily missions, a day streak, a first-week gift and a weekly challenge give every visit a goal.

FAIR BY DESIGN
- Ads only when you choose to watch one for a reward. No banners, no ads that interrupt the game.
- Everything in the Shop is optional; the whole game can be played for free.
- No account and no sign-in. Plays offline.
- In English, German and Turkish.

name: RinseRhythm: Shower & Hair
description:
Keep track of showers and hair care, at your own pace.

RinseRhythm gives your personal care moments a calm place to live. Tap “Showered” or “Showered + Hair” to save a moment in a second. Add the date, time, product categories or a note whenever you feel like it.

TWO RHYTHMS. YOUR CHOICE.
Set separate, flexible calendar-day windows for body and hair – or decide later. RinseRhythm doesn't prescribe a schedule, and a day without an entry is simply a day without a record.

A SMALL WORLD THAT GROWS WITH YOU
When a moment matches a window you chose, you collect wave light and your Wave Atelier grows scene by scene. Weeks with a saved moment count, too. Twelve badges celebrate real care moments. No daily streaks, no rewards for washing more often – and what you have reached stays yours.

THOUGHTFUL LITTLE ESSENTIALS
• Save a shower or a shower plus hair wash in one tap
• Add hair-only care and past moments
• Note shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, soap, scrub, mask and more
• See your history as a list or calendar, filtered by body or hair
• Insights for the last 7 and 30 days
• Export your entries as CSV

FREE
Every feature is free. No subscription, no ads.

YOUR RECORDS ARE YOURS
No account, no cloud: your entries, notes and rhythms stay on your iPhone. An anonymous usage counter without any device identifier can be turned off in Settings at any time.

No diagnosis or health claims. Just a welcoming place for your personal routine.

name: Rishtay Wali Aunty
description:
Rishtay Wali Aunty is a marriage matchmaking app where every single profile is verified by a real person before anyone can see it. No fake profiles, no endless scrolling through strangers nobody has spoken to.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create your profile: family, faith, education, profession and what you're looking for in a partner.
2. Book a 10-minute verification call: our team calls you to confirm you're real and your details are true.
3. See verified matches: only people our team has spoken to, ranked by how well you fit each other.
4. Unlock the family contact: use a credit to see a match's family contact number and, if they agreed, their photos. Then talk directly.

VERIFIED BY A REAL PERSON
Every member has a short audio call with our team before their profile goes live. If someone changes important details later, we check them again.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your contact number is never shown in listings. Only members who unlock your verified profile can see it.
- Photos stay blurred until someone unlocks you, and only if you choose to share them.
- Pause your profile any time, or delete your account and data from the app.

EVERY FAITH IS WELCOME
Muslim, Hindu, Sikh, Christian and more. Set your preferences to match within your community, or beyond it.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
- Profiles cover what families care about: family background, education, profession, residency status, marital status and more.
- "About me" prompts help you get to know the real person.
- A match score shows why two people fit, in plain words.
- Browse in swipe mode or as a list, with filters for age, faith, country, education and residency status.
- Notifications when you're verified and when new matches arrive.

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
- Report or block anyone from their profile.
- Our team reviews reports and removes anyone who breaks our rules.
- Strictly for adults aged 18 and over.

PAY ONLY FOR WHAT YOU USE
Creating a profile and getting verified is free. Unlock matches with credits bought in the app: one at a time or in a pack. No subscription.

Rishtay Wali Aunty is based in Vancouver, Canada.
Questions? Email rishtaywaliaunty@outlook.com
Privacy Policy: https://app.rishtaywaliaunty.workers.dev/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://app.rishtaywaliaunty.workers.dev/terms/

name: Riva Bowling
description:
Riva Bowling is a polished 3D arcade bowling game featuring satisfying physics, elegant retro styling, and easy-to-learn controls. Step into a warm, vintage bowling venue and test your skill as you aim for strikes and spares across every frame.

Key Features:

- Realistic 3D bowling physics and responsive pin movement
- A growing collection of visually unique bowling balls to unlock and equip
- Clean, intuitive touch controls perfect for quick play sessions
- Classic ten-pin bowling rules for authentic gameplay
- Rich retro-inspired art style and immersive lane environments
- Track your personal best score as you master your technique

Description:
Enjoy timeless bowling fun with Riva Bowling. Roll your ball down the wooden lane, line up your shot, and chase that perfect 300 game. Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to practice your bowling strategy, this game delivers accessible, relaxing arcade entertainment for players of all skill levels.

Take your shot and aim for the next strike.

name: Rivet Set
description:
Rivet Set keeps each strap on this iPhone.

Punch a hole, then set the rivet in that hole. Setting an empty hole bends the rivet and scraps the whole strap. A second punch on the same hole does nothing. Three set rivets hold the strap and lock it. A locked strap cannot be renamed or deleted.

The strap shows six holes. The section page draws the rivet in the hole you pick. The tally counts how many rivets are set.

You can name each strap and find it by name. Share sends the name, whether it is open, holding, or scrap, and how many rivets are set. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Rivnello: Bike Click Log
description:
Intermittent bicycle clicks are hard to explain when they disappear at the shop. Rivnello helps you keep the evidence together.

Record the noise under two conditions, with separate Heard, Quiet, or Untested outcomes. Investigate whether it changes while pedaling or coasting, seated or standing, and riding under load or on a stand. Keep a dated list of changes tried and what happened afterward. Then copy a concise handoff for your mechanic.

Your comparisons stay on your device and work without an account. Search and correct saved entries whenever you need to. Rivnello offers clues to discuss with a professional; it does not diagnose a failed part or replace a safety inspection.

Create and investigate comparisons for seven days with a free App Store trial. The trial does not renew or charge automatically. Buy permanent access once, including during the trial, from Settings. Saved comparisons remain readable and copyable after the trial ends.

name: RizeDijital
description:
RizeDijital – Rize'nin Dijital Dünyası

Rize'yi keşfetmek, şehirdeki gelişmeleri takip etmek ve günlük hayatı kolaylaştıran hizmetlere ulaşmak artık çok daha pratik!

RizeDijital; haberleri, şehir rehberini, ulaşımı, sağlık hizmetlerini, sosyal içerikleri ve dijital eğlenceyi tek uygulamada buluşturan kapsamlı bir şehir platformudur.

RİZE'DEN HABERDAR OLUN
• Rize gündemini ve yerel haberleri takip edin.
• Güncel hava durumunu görüntüleyin.
• Etkinlikleri ve şehirdeki gelişmeleri keşfedin.
