GÜNLÜK ŞEHİR HİZMETLERİ
• Nöbetçi eczanelere ve hastane bilgilerine ulaşın.
• Dolmuş saatlerini ve ulaşım seçeneklerini inceleyin.
• Akaryakıt ve çay fiyatlarını takip edin.
• Otopark, taksi ve belediye hizmetlerine hızlı erişin.

RİZE'Yİ KEŞFEDİN
• Yerel işletmeleri, restoranları ve konaklama seçeneklerini bulun.
• Rize'nin yaylalarını, doğal güzelliklerini ve tarihi yerlerini keşfedin.
• İlanları, fotoğrafları ve videoları görüntüleyin.

SOSYALLEŞİN VE EĞLENİN
• Sosyal akışta içerikleri keşfedin.
• Oyun merkezinde eğlenceli oyunları deneyin.
• RizePuan görevlerini ve dijital avantajları keşfedin.

AKILLI VE KİŞİSELLEŞTİRİLMİŞ DENEYİM
• Seçtiğiniz konuma göre ilgili şehir hizmetlerini görüntüleyin.
• RizeDijital Asistan ile bilgiye daha kolay ulaşın.
• Bildirimlerle ilgilendiğiniz gelişmeleri takip edin.

Rize'de yaşıyor, Rize'yi ziyaret ediyor veya memleketinizdeki gelişmeleri takip etmek istiyorsanız RizeDijital ile şehrin dijital dünyası her an yanınızda!

RizeDijital – Rize'ye dair her şey, tek uygulamada.

name: Roadframe:CarPlay Photo Widget
description:
Roadframe puts your favorite photos on your car screen with a CarPlay widget.

CHOOSE YOUR PHOTOS
• Up to 10 photos, picked one by one. Roadframe never asks for your whole library.
• Frame each photo your way: drag, pinch, fill the frame, or show the whole photo.
• See the saved result before you leave.

ON YOUR CAR SCREEN
• Photo 1 widget, with a small date you can turn off.
• Slideshow on or off. iPhone decides exactly when widgets update, so timing can vary.
• A step-by-step guide for adding the widget in CarPlay settings, plus a 42-second video.
• A guide for using the iPhone's own Weather or Stocks widget in the second box.

PREMIUM
A one-time purchase, no subscription. It unlocks Photo 2, so two different photos can appear on screens that show two widget boxes.

PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Your photos stay on your iPhone.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Requires iOS 26 or later and a vehicle that supports CarPlay widgets.
• Roadframe appears as a widget. It doesn't replace CarPlay, and it can't choose the size or position of widgets; iPhone and your car screen decide that.
• Set everything up while parked.

CarPlay is a trademark of Apple Inc.

name: Roll Call: Camera Roll Cleaner
description:
Your camera roll, finally under control.

Roll Call takes you through your library one month at a time. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep. When a month is done, review your picks and free up space in one tap.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE IT
• Month by month: small, satisfying sessions instead of one endless scroll
• Swipe to decide: fast, fun and impossible to get wrong
• Videos play right on the card, so you know what you're deleting
• Calendar, grid, list or cards: see your library the way you like
• Real sizes: see exactly how much space you'll free
• Undo anytime, and deleted photos stay 30 days in Recently Deleted

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos never leave your iPhone. No account, no uploads, no tracking.

Available in 25 languages.

name: Rollcue - Video Player
description:
Rollcue is a local video player for iPhone and iPad, built for finding and revisiting the moments that matter. Open a video from Photos or Files and swipe across the picture to move through it.

Move through video with a swipe
• Swipe horizontally in the upper half to move farther, or in the lower half for fine adjustments.
• On iPad, use two-finger horizontal scrolling with a compatible trackpad.
• Choose from playback speeds from 0.25× to 2×.

Save moments as chapters
• Mark a moment, give the chapter a name, and jump straight back to it.
• Move to the previous or next chapter from the playback controls.

Come back to your videos
• Save a video as a project to keep its chapters and playback position.
• Open a saved project and choose to resume or start from the beginning.
• See duration, progress, and when you last played a project. The capture date is shown when available.

Standard video playback and up to three saved projects are free. Try swipe scrubbing free for 7 days, with no automatic charge when the trial ends. A one-time purchase of Rollcue Pro unlocks swipe scrubbing and unlimited project saves.

name: Rollo Cam: Party Camera
description:
Rollo Cam turns your party into one shared disposable camera. Guests scan a QR code or type a 6-letter code and start shooting straight away, with no sign-up. Nobody sees the photos during the party: everyone's shots develop together at the reveal.

HOW IT WORKS
• Host an event in seconds: name it, choose how long the camera stays open (3 hours to 3 days) and when the roll develops.
• Share the QR code or join code. Guests join with just a name.
• Everyone gets a limited roll, so every shot counts.
• No peeking: photos stay sealed until the reveal.
• At the reveal, the whole roll lands in a private gallery for everyone at the event, with a reveal card to share.

VEGAS MODE
What happens at the party stays at the party. Photos are encrypted on the phone before they upload, so only people with the invite link can open them, and they are deleted automatically after 7 or 30 days.

FREE TASTER
• Up to 10 guests plus you, up to 10 shots each
• One free event open at a time

PARTY PACK: £4.99 PER EVENT
A one-time purchase for one event, not a subscription. Anyone at the party can unlock it for everyone:
• No 10-guest limit
• Up to 36 shots each
• A clean reveal card, without our mark

ROLLO PASS: FOR HOSTS
Every event you host gets the Party Pack. £39.99 a year, or £99.99 once for lifetime. It covers the events you host, not other people's.

Prices are UK prices and vary by country.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Rollo Pass Yearly is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically each year at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Rollo Pass Lifetime and the Party Pack are one-time purchases.

YOUR PRIVACY
No ads and no tracking. Guests don't need an account, and you can delete your account in the app.

Terms of Use: https://rsvs.dev/terms/#rollocam
Privacy Policy: https://rsvs.dev/apps/rollocam/privacy.html

name: RoomCoat
description:
Turn wall measurements into a practical paint purchase. Enter total wall area, subtract windows and other exclusions, then use the product coverage, number of coats, and a reserve to calculate liters and whole cans.

Try a worked example, save your own results, and reopen or edit them when plans change. Share a readable summary through the iPhone share sheet. The core calculator and saved records are available locally without signing in.

name: ROOTS: Your Time Travel
description:
ROOTS: Your Time Travel is an offline golden atlas of world civilizations and archaeology. Tap a region on the world map and discover the civilizations that shaped human history — from Anatolia to Mesopotamia, from the Nile to the Andes.

• Interactive golden world map with 141 verified civilizations & ancient sites across 8 regions
• Two structured views for every entry: History and Ancient Cities
• Established scholarly consensus shown separately from ongoing excavations & research
• Visitor guides, UNESCO World Heritage information, and academic references
• Rulers and key figures; legends presented separately and clearly labelled as non-historical
• 213 real Wikimedia Commons photographs with full photographer & license credits in-app
• 8 languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Russian, Arabic
• Works completely offline — no ads, no account, no personal data collected

Free for 3 days from first launch, then continue with a monthly auto-renewable subscription managed via Apple StoreKit. Cancel anytime in App Store settings.

name: Rotado: Padel Americano
description:
Rotado runs your padel night. Type the names, pick the courts and play: the app draws fair rounds, keeps the scores and shows a live leaderboard. One phone runs the whole session.

FAIR ROUNDS, MEASURED
• With 8, 12, 16 players and every multiple of four up to 40, everyone partners everyone exactly once and faces everyone exactly twice.
• Any number from 4 to 40 players works, on 1 to 10 courts.
• When the group is not a multiple of four, rest rounds rotate: nobody sits out more than one round more than anyone else.

FOUR FORMATS
• Americano: a new partner every round, points for yourself.
• Mixed Americano: one man and one woman in every pair.
• Team Americano: fixed pairs, every pair meets every other pair.
• Mexicano: each round is drawn from the leaderboard, so the matches get closer all night.

SCORES IN TWO TAPS
• Play to 16, 21, 24 or 32 points, or against the clock.
• Tap one side's points and the other side fills in.
• Clear tie-break rules written under the leaderboard: total points, then head to head, point difference and wins. Reorder them to match your club.

MADE FOR REAL LIFE
• Someone arrives late or has to leave? Add or remove them: only the rounds not yet played are redrawn.
• Wrong score? Correct it at any time.
• A court opens or closes? Change the number in the middle of the session.

SHOW IT, SHARE IT
• TV mode: a full-screen leaderboard and court assignments for the club screen or an iPad.
• Send the leaderboard or the full schedule to the group chat as an image or a PDF.

PLAYERS, GROUPS AND SEASONS
• Save your players and groups and start a session in seconds.
• A season leaderboard across sessions: average points, win rate, sessions won.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no sign-up. Your sessions, players and scores stay on your phone.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Rotasmart
description:
Rotasmart helps managers at pubs, restaurants and other shift-based businesses organise their staff rotas. Build the week’s schedule, assign shifts and publish the rota when it’s ready.

• Create and edit weekly rotas
• Assign shifts to team members
• Publish rotas and manage shift swaps
• See how many shifts and hours are scheduled each week
• Estimate your weekly wage bill using scheduled hours and pay rates
• Keep team documents and upcoming events in one place

name: RoundSpark
description:
RoundSpark는 친구나 가족과 iPhone 또는 iPad 한 대를 함께 보며 즐기는 오프라인 파티 게임 모음입니다. 로그인 없이 게임을 골라 바로 시작할 수 있어요.

8가지 미니게임

탭 룰렛
화면을 함께 누르고 카운트다운을 기다려요. 마지막까지 남은 색이 선택됩니다.

복불복 룰렛
원하는 결과를 입력하고 돌려 다음 순서나 결과를 정해요.

주사위
기기를 흔들어 주사위를 굴려요.

트럼프 카드
카드를 한 장씩 넘겨 다음 카드를 공개해요.

밸런스 게임
기기를 기울여 보드 위 공이 떨어지지 않게 버텨요.

용암 칵테일
차례로 용암을 더하며 넘치는 순간을 피해요.

종이 뽑기
당첨 칸 수를 정하고 뽑기판을 한 칸씩 열어요.

악어 이빨
차례로 이빨을 누르고 숨은 아픈 이빨을 피해요.

핵심 게임은 인터넷 연결 없이 플레이할 수 있습니다. 게임에 따라 화면 터치나 기기 움직임을 사용합니다. 한국어와 영어를 지원합니다.

name: Rowfern: Knitting Row Counter
description:
Rowfern keeps your place in your knitting pattern. Open your PDF, and the row you're on stays marked while you count with one tap. Pattern, row counter, reminders and notes live together, so you can put the needles down and pick up exactly where you left off.

Rowfern is a knitting app and crochet app in one: row counter, stitch counter and PDF pattern reader together. Count rows, rounds and repeats, whether you knit or crochet.

NEVER LOSE YOUR PLACE
• Open PDF patterns or photos of a printed pattern
• A reading guide highlights your current row and moves on when you finish it
• One big button to finish a row, and Undo for every step
• Count rows by voice, hands-free. Speech is recognised on your device

A ROW COUNTER THAT FOLLOWS THE PATTERN
• A counter for each part: back, front, left sleeve, right sleeve
• Repeats counted for you: "work rows 1 to 8 five times"
• Reminders show up the row before a decrease, increase or buttonhole
• Extra stitch and repeat counters, linked to your rows if you like
• Increase or decrease evenly across a row, worked out for you

CHARTS, ROW BY ROW
• Set up a knitting or crochet chart once, then follow cables, lace and colorwork one chart row at a time
• Pin the chart key or any part of the page so it stays in view

FROGGED? SET IT RIGHT
• Rip back rows and the count goes back with you, without losing your history

COUNT FROM YOUR WRIST
• Rowfern for Apple Watch counts rows on your watch and keeps your iPhone in sync
• Hand counting to the watch and back. If your iPhone is out of reach, the watch keeps counting and catches up later

NOTES AND TIME
• Notes on the pattern page, and a timer for each knitting session with progress and time

YOUR PROJECTS STAY YOURS
• Everything is saved on your device, with no account
• Back up one project or all of them to a file wherever you choose, and restore any time
• Made for iPhone and iPad, in light and dark

IMPORT PATTERNS FROM YOUR RAVELRY LIBRARY
• Sign in to Ravelry to bring in PDF patterns you own. Rowfern reads your library read-only and copies only the patterns you choose to your device
• Or import any PDF from Files

TRY IT FIRST
Your first project is free, along with the practice pattern. A one-time unlock adds as many projects as you like and counting on Apple Watch. No subscription.

Rowfern is made by Glintside, not by Ravelry, and is not endorsed by or affiliated with Ravelry. Ravelry is a trademark of Ravelry, LLC.

name: RPE-Reel Power Electric
description:
The RPE app is for Reel Power Electric employees and partners. You need an RPE account to sign in. The company creates the accounts; there is no sign-up in the app.

Clock in and out
• Clock in on your job with one tap. The app checks you are at the job site when you punch.
• No signal? The punch is saved on the phone and sent when you are back online.
• See your hours for the week.

Receipts
• Take a photo of a company card or PO receipt and send it to Accounting.
• The app reads the store, total and date from the photo for you. Check them and send.
• See when Accounting approves it, or why it came back.

For foremen
• See who is clocked in on your jobs right now.

Also
• Messages and tasks from the office.
• English and Spanish.
• Face ID each time the app opens, so only you can use your account.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.

name: RR9: Counterpoise
description:
Take the controls of a small copper hoist. Move its carriage, feed the rope and guide an amber load through narrow openings. Momentum travels down the line, so a smooth arrival takes more than a quick tap.

Use two hands to work the rail and winch together. Shift the counterweight to bias the load and hold the damper to quiet its swing. Let the damper cool, plan your next crossing and settle gently into the berth.

- Thirty work orders across three sectors
- Ten open challenges with changing loads and crosswinds
- Three hands-on lessons
- A live tuning bench and a local route foundry
- Six earned cargo finishes
- A private journal with recorded motion traces

name: Rullino Pulito
description:
Rullino Pulito helps you free up space by reviewing your photos one at a time.

Swipe left to put a photo in the trash, right to keep it. Swipe up to make it a favorite, down to see it again at the end of the month. Nothing is deleted until you confirm: at the end of a session you review the trash and iOS asks you to confirm just once.

ONE MONTH A DAY
Every day the app suggests the oldest month you haven't finished. A few minutes a day and your camera roll is back in order, with your streak to keep you going. If you like, a reminder will nudge you.

HANDY FILTERS
• Screenshots only: clear out the ones you no longer need.
• Largest videos: the videos that take up the most space, first.

ALWAYS IN CONTROL
• Undo for every choice.
• Date, type (Live, Burst, Video), length and size of each photo.
• Deleted photos stay in "Recently Deleted" for 30 days.
• Works even if you give access to only some photos.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY YOURS
Your photos never leave your phone: the app looks at them and deletes them right there.

FREE, NO SUBSCRIPTIONS
Rullino Pulito is free with a few ads, never between photos. One single purchase removes them forever.

In English, Italian, Spanish, French and German, on iPhone and iPad.

name: Run Walk Coach
description:
Run Walk Coach is a simple interval timer for run/walk training. Set how long you run, how long you walk, and how many rounds. Then put your phone in your pocket. A voice tells you when to run and when to walk, so you never have to look at the screen.

KEEPS COACHING WITH THE SCREEN LOCKED
Start a workout, lock your phone and keep your music playing. At every switch the coach says "Run! Round 2 of 8" or "Walk fast" over your music.

CHANGE INTERVALS MID-WORKOUT
Feeling strong? Add 15 seconds to your run while you're running. Need a breather? Lengthen the walk. The interval you're in adjusts right away.

CLEAR CUES, YOUR WAY
• Spoken calls for every interval, with the round number
• Distinct tones: three rising beeps mean run, two low tones mean walk
• Optional halfway call and a 3-2-1 countdown beep
• Turn the voice off and go by tones only
• Optional warm-up, and the choice to start with a run or a walk

CALORIES, INTERVAL BY INTERVAL
Enter your weight and your run and walk pace, and Run Walk Coach estimates the calories you burn. A bar chart fills in interval by interval as you go.

WORKOUT HISTORY
Every workout is saved automatically: date, time, rounds, minutes and calories. See your last 7 days at a glance with a calorie chart, your total minutes and your current streak.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Your settings and workout history stay on your phone.

Calorie numbers are estimates based on standard exercise values for your weight and pace. Run Walk Coach is a training timer, not a medical device.

name: Runaway Lion
description:
One run from the forest to the Bosphorus, with a nosy news crew right behind you!

Runaway Lion is a three-lane endless runner. Start on a forest trail, race downhill past an Ottoman fountain and reach the Bosphorus shore with its ferries, seagulls and wooden mansions, then on into city streets with trams. Swipe left or right to change lanes, up to jump and down to duck.

LIVE ON AIR
A comedic TV news crew is on your tail. Small mistakes fill the LIVE meter at the top of the screen; clean running empties it. If it fills up, the reporter catches up and you pose for the camera.

WHY RUNAWAY LION?
• Route forks: take the narrow, coin-rich path or the wide road.
• 6 big cats: Sarıyer Lioness, White Lioness, Ash Lioness, Caracal, Kara Yele and Anatolian Leopard.
• Power-ups: Magnet, Bounty, Evil Eye Bead and Gull Wing. Upgrade each up to level 6 with coins.
• Something new every day: 3 daily missions and a 7-day login reward. Miss a day and your streak waits instead of resetting.
• 300+ achievements, plus the Longest Escape leaderboard and achievements on Game Center.
• Cosmetics: dress any big cat with scarves, hats, sunglasses and trail effects.
• iCloud: your progress follows your Apple Account across devices.
• Fair progress: no energy system, no loot boxes, no subscriptions. Every pack shows its contents before you buy.
• Second chance: crashed? Once per run, watch an optional ad or spend Gold Paws to continue.
• Double your coins with an optional ad on the results screen.
• English and Turkish.

FREE TO PLAY
Runaway Lion is free and contains ads and optional in-app purchases:
• Starter Pack: Kara Yele, 3,000 coins and removal of interstitial ads.
• Remove Interstitial Ads: removes interstitial ads only. Rewarded ads stay optional.
• Permanent Coin x2: every coin you collect in a run counts double.
• Characters: Kara Yele and Anatolian Leopard.
• Coin and Gold Paws packs, plus a weekend offer.
• Pati Pass Season 1: a one-time purchase (not a subscription) that unlocks the premium reward track.
• Istanbul Bundle: a cosmetics set and 20 Gold Paws.

Restore permanent purchases on the same Apple Account with "Restore purchases" in the Shop. Coins and Gold Paws are consumable and are not restored.

All characters and events are fictional.

Privacy Policy: https://brick-bloom.github.io/kacakaslan/privacy/#en
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Runaway Office Chair
description:
Your shift is over. Your office chair has other plans.

Accelerate automatically and drag left or right anywhere in the free play area to steer with one hand. Launch whole furniture out of the way or slip through gaps. Chain destruction and close escapes to build a clock-out rush that really accelerates your chair.

• 180 courses across 21 chapters, four hidden routes and four optional bonus courses
• Offices, rooftops, stations and streets, followed by a car wash, TV studio, airport, container port, hot-spring inn, supermarket and moving-day apartments
• Moving brushes, cargo machines, swinging loads and gates released by real destruction
• Launched furniture that knocks pursuers down, burst pipes, rain, gusts and jumps between buildings
• Upgrade speed, power or handling independently, up to level 100 on each axis
• Start with one chair; unlock 23 more with blueprints and eight with stars, for 32 in total
• Choose chairs and eight wing styles independently to create your own combination
• Three stars per campaign or hidden course, 552 in total, plus score and time records
• Clear courses in order and earn at least 75% of each chapter’s stars to enter the next chapter
• Bonus courses pay extra coins on the first clear only; replays earn the normal coin reward
• After repeated failures, get driving and upgrade tips matched to what stopped you

Chairs and wings are cosmetic: they do not change collision shapes or upgrade performance. Failed runs still keep earned coins and collected blueprints.

Return from pause with a three-second countdown. Earn 12 stars in total to unlock an optional checkpoint retry after failure, once per run.

Play in Japanese, English, Korean, Traditional Chinese, German, French or Spanish. Change language in Help.

Offline play. No ads, in-app purchases or account registration. Progress is stored on your device; the game does not provide cloud sync. Opening support pages requires an internet connection.

name: RunCheck: Walk & Run Stats
description:
RunCheck turns the steps and workouts already in Apple Health into clear walk, jog and run stats. No account, no internet, no ads: your data stays on your iPhone.

SEE YOUR DAY, WEEK AND MONTH
• Today: steps against your daily goal, distance, energy and active time
• Week: Sunday to Saturday, swipe between weeks and tap any day
• Month: monthly totals with a tile for each week

WALK, JOG OR RUN, SORTED FOR YOU
• Movement is sorted by speed into walks, jogs and runs
• Real sessions are listed, not pacing around the house or office
• Open a session to see its speed, pace, tempo and a speed graph

MAKE IT YOURS
• Daily step goal, kilometres or miles
• Your own jog and run speed thresholds
• Minimum session length and how short breaks are joined

WORKS WITH WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE
RunCheck uses the steps your iPhone counts, workouts from Apple Watch, and walks and runs that other apps save to Apple Health.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
RunCheck only reads Apple Health and never writes to it. Your health data never leaves your iPhone, isn't stored in iCloud and is never used for advertising.

RunCheck shows activity stats only. It isn't a medical device and doesn't give medical advice.

name: Rune Sync
description: Align spinning rune wheels for stable phase resonance. A calm time-driven math puzzle. Tune phases, hold sync, trigger luminous harmony.

name: Rush Hills
description:
RUSH HILLS, la course de collines où chaque saut compte !

Prends le volant et franchis des collines, des ravins et des rampes sans retourner ta voiture. Gère ton carburant, ramasse les pièces et les jerrycans, enchaîne les sauts et les saltos pour battre ton record de distance.

100 VOITURES À DÉBLOQUER
De la petite citadine à l'hypercar de 1 000 ch : 100 modèles 3D tous différents, classés de la moins puissante à la plus puissante. Chaque voiture a ses propres performances : vitesse, accélération, freinage, maniabilité.

8 CIRCUITS
Campagne, désert, montagne enneigée, ville de nuit, forêt d'automne, plage au coucher du soleil, volcan et lune : chaque décor change la météo, l'adhérence et la difficulté.

GARAGE SHOWROOM
Admire tes voitures en 3D, change la peinture, les jantes et le décor, améliore le moteur, la suspension, les pneus et le réservoir.

PRISE EN MAIN IMMÉDIATE
Deux pédales, c'est tout : accélère, freine, et contrôle ta voiture en l'air pour réussir des atterrissages parfaits.

PIÈCES ET RÉCOMPENSES
Gagne des pièces en jouant. Tu peux aussi regarder une publicité pour continuer une course après un accident, doubler tes gains ou obtenir une voiture offerte. Des paquets de pièces et des voitures premium sont disponibles via des achats intégrés (facultatifs).

Le jeu est gratuit, fonctionne hors ligne et ne demande aucun compte.
Les noms de voitures et de marques sont fictifs.

name: RZ Deals: Best Sellers
description:
Find what everyone is buying, fast.

RZ Deals puts Amazon's Best Sellers from 33 departments in one clean app, so you can see the top-ranked products at a glance instead of digging through endless pages.

WHAT YOU GET
• Home: hand-built shelves like Holiday Gift Picks, Best Sellers Under $25 and the #1 product in every department
• Top 100 in every department: Electronics, Home & Kitchen, Beauty, Toys & Games, Video Games, Pet Supplies, Sports & Outdoors and more
• Rank badges: see at a glance what's #1, #2 and #3
• Sort by best selling or by price
• Search more than 3,000 best sellers
• Save favorites with one tap and come back to them later
• Share any product with friends
• One tap to view the product on Amazon

Prices are shown as of the time the list was last updated and may change; the price on Amazon at the time of purchase applies.

No account, no sign-up, no tracking. Saved items stay on your device.

As an Amazon Associate, RZ Deals earns from qualifying purchases. Amazon and the Amazon logo are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. RZ Deals is not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.

name: Saccuman Air Strings
description:
Air Strings turns the air in front of your phone into an instrument: you draw strings with your hands and pluck them by sweeping your finger across, as if they were real.

Draw the strings
• Pinch thumb and index finger, move your hand and open: the string stays fixed in the air
• Pinch with both hands to stretch a string between them
• Shorter string = higher note, locked to the scale and key you choose

Play
• Sweep your index fingertip across a string: faster is louder
• Closed fist to mute every string, open hand held still to delete one
• You can also pluck with your finger on the screen

Sounds
• Harp, guitar, koto and bass, synthesised like real strings
• Synth Pad, Lead, Pluck and Bass with Delay
• Drum machine: every string is a pad, from Kick to Hi-hat

Light and recording
• Gold and ivory bolts, sparks and glows at every pluck
• Record the sound only (WAV) or a video with sound (MP4) and share it

Create and Play
• Two modes: Create to draw strings, Play to pluck them (thumbs up to switch)
• Ready-made strings: harp, keyboard, guitar, arc and drums, already tuned
• Each string can have its own instrument: harp, bass and drums together
• Archive: save your strings with a name and find all your recordings

Privacy
• Hands are recognised on the phone: no internet, no data collected, no ads

name: SADRAAA: events, places, plans
description:
SADRAAA shows what's on in Tbilisi, Kutaisi and Batumi, the places worth going to, and is where you plan the evening with your friends.

WHAT'S ON
Concerts, clubs, theatre, exhibitions, festivals, talks and more, in one list for each city. We gather events from organisers' and venues' own pages, with the time, the place and the price as the organiser wrote them, and a link to where the ticket is.
- Choose a day, a time of day and a kind of event, each in its own colour.
- Save what you like. Saved events leave the list on their own once they are over.
- Follow your places and see their events in My week.
- Open plans: events people make for everyone to join.

PLACES
Restaurants, cafés, bars, clubs, theatres, galleries and more, ordered by the reviews of the people who go.
- A score and the reviews behind it. Write your own.
- Each place's page: photos, the menu, opening hours, the address on the map, what's on there and today's news from the place.
- Offers from places, in their own row. Ads are always marked as ads.

PLANS WITH FRIENDS
A birthday, a supra at home, a night out or a film night: make a plan in a minute and send one link.
- Your friends answer in one tap: I'm in, we'll see, or can't make it. You see who's in.
- Who brings what: a list everyone can take a line from.
- Comments, photos and an album after the night.
- Add it to your calendar. A reminder comes the day before.
- Groups of friends you invite with one tap.

FOR HOSTS
- A ticket for every guest, and a scanner at the door.
- One message to everyone invited, or only to those going.
- Co-hosts, a guest limit and approval of guests.

Safe by design: report or block anyone, and every report is read by our team. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

The app is in English and Georgian; switch the language anytime in Settings.

Terms of use: https://sadraaa.com/terms
Privacy: https://sadraaa.com/privacy

name: SafetyPro HSE
description:
SafetyPro HSE is the field app of the SafetyPro health, safety and environment platform. It puts your site's safety work in your pocket: report what you see, follow up what is assigned to you, and keep every record in the same system your HSE team uses on the web.

Note: SafetyPro is a business platform. You sign in with the account your company created for you in SafetyPro.

WHAT YOU CAN DO ON SITE
• Observations and hazards: report an unsafe act or condition in seconds, with photos, location, risk level and the person responsible.
• Inspections: run inspections with checklists, photos and signatures, and share the PDF report.
• Toolbox talks: record the topics, attendees and signatures, or attach a photo or PDF of the paper attendance sheet.
• Permits to work: view and prepare permits, with the work party and its signatures.
• Actions: see the corrective actions assigned to you, overdue first, and close them with evidence.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• A Summary screen shows open and late items for your project and a "Needs you" list of what is waiting for you.
• Push notifications when something is assigned to you or needs your review.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Keeps working with a weak signal: reports wait on the phone and send when you are back online.
• Voice notes and photos straight from the camera.
• English, Arabic and Urdu, with full right-to-left layout.

SECURE BY DESIGN
• Each company and each project only sees its own data.
• Photos and documents are stored privately and opened with short-lived links.
• What you can see and do follows the role your company gave you.

SafetyPro HSE is made for HSE officers, supervisors, engineers and site teams in construction, oil and gas, industry and infrastructure.

Website: https://www.safetypro24.com

name: Sailing Simulator: Regatta 3D
description:
Sailing Simulator is a realistic sailing game for iPhone and iPad. Free to play, no ads, no subscription, offline. Learn to sail, then race. Physics based on published tank tests of an Olympic dinghy.

Not just steering: you trim the sail yourself. Too loose and it flaps, too tight and it stalls, too near the wind and you stop. 12 lessons teach the points of sail, the no-go zone, tacking, gybing and starts, in steps you can't fail, while the wind drawn on the water fades until you read it yourself. Then race 17 rivals in New York Harbor, San Francisco Bay and Cascais.

Best for beginners before their first course, sailors staying sharp over winter and club racers. No pay-to-win: every boat and race is earned by sailing. And yes, you can race in a clown wig.

Learn to sail
• Basics: your first sail, the mainsheet, the points of sail, the no-go zone
• Manoeuvres: tacking, beating, running and gybing, a strong wind
• Racing: rounding marks, the start, upwind in a breeze, a graduation race
• You learn by sailing, not by reading: a new word is explained once, in a line, and the boat shows the rest
• Each lesson is a few guided steps, then one timed exercise graded bronze, silver or gold
• The wind is drawn on the water in the first lessons and fades lesson by lesson, until you read it from the water and the sail as sailors do
• When the sail flaps or stalls, the mainsheet slider shows where to trim it

Race
• 7 series, a daily challenge and free sailing
• 17 named rivals, each sailing at their own level
• Windward-leeward, triangle, Olympic, trapezoid, reaching and speed courses
• Timed starts with a gun, marks to round and a podium for the top three
• Three dinghies: the Tern club dinghy, the Kestrel race dinghy and the Osprey performance dinghy

Where you sail
• New York Harbor, between the Statue of Liberty and Governors Island
• San Francisco Bay, off Crissy Field by the Golden Gate
• Cascais, Portugal, outside the marina breakwaters
• Lake Ventalba, a lake in the Italian hills
• The three real venues are built from survey maps and elevation data
• Day and night, rain showers and a sea breeze that builds through the afternoon

A boat that sails like a boat
• Speed and heel come from a force model checked against published towing-tank, wind-tunnel and on-the-water measurements
• Gusts travel down the course; heel too far and you capsize
• Six telltales on every sail stream, hang or flutter with the airflow
• Your sailor sits and hikes as measured dinghy racers do

Your sailor, your boat
• A suit and tie, a Hawaiian shirt, a pirate hat, a Santa hat, a clown wig, a mohawk and more
• 66 sails, from plain colours to printed designs, and hull colours to match
• Your boat's name lettered on her hull

Good to know
• Free to play, with no ads and no subscription
• Every boat, venue and series can be earned by sailing; coin packs only get you there sooner
• Stars open the harder series, and they can only be won on the water
• No account and no internet needed
• Progress is saved in iCloud, so a new device or a reinstall starts where you left off
• A head start for learning to sail, not a replacement for an instructor on the water

Privacy Policy: https://guivr.github.io/sailing-simulator-legal/privacy.html

name: Sale in Bahrain
description:
Sale in Bahrain is the easy way to buy and sell in the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Find great deals on cars, property for rent and sale, mobile phones, electronics, furniture, jobs and much more, posted by people and businesses across Manama, Riffa, Muharraq, Isa Town, Hamad Town and every governorate.

BUY
• Browse the latest ads and featured listings
• Search by keyword, category, location and price
• See photos, details and the seller's phone number
• Call or WhatsApp sellers directly
• Save ads you like and come back to them later

SELL
• Post a free ad in under a minute
• Add photos straight from your camera or gallery
• Manage and delete your ads from My ads

SAFE AND SIMPLE
• English and Arabic
• Report suspicious ads and block sellers
• Delete your account at any time from the app

Read our safety tips before you meet a buyer or seller: https://www.saleinbahrain.com/safetyrules-p42

name: Salon Moles
description:
Aplicación oficial de Salón Moles, en L'Hospitalet de Llobregat. Reserva fácilmente tu servicio en 3 sencillos pasos. Ahorra tiempo y gestiona tus citas en tiempo real.

Con la app puedes:
• Reservar peluquería, depilación, maquillaje, masajes y servicios a domicilio.
• Elegir el día, la hora y tu profesional.
• Consultar y cancelar tus citas cuando lo necesites.
• Recibir recordatorios para no olvidar tu cita.
• Añadir tus citas al calendario del iPhone.
• Ver la dirección y los datos de contacto del salón.

Salón Moles · Carrer del Doctor Martí i Julià, 30, 08903 L'Hospitalet de Llobregat.

name: SAM.AI CRM
description:
SAM.AI puts your CRM in your pocket.

Built for reps who work away from a desk, it opens on the things that need you today and gets out of the way.

MY DAY
Everything due today in one place: tasks, appointments, call reminders, email replies and notifications. Each card opens its own screen, so you can clear the day without hunting through menus.

CALL READY
The people worth phoning today, gathered from your campaign call lists and the lead folders you choose. Each row shows why they are on the list and their engagement score, and dials straight from your phone with one tap.

RECORDS
Leads, deals, clients, partners, contacts and companies. Search across them, filter by folder, and open any record to see who it is, where the deal stands, and what has happened so far.

PIPELINE
Every stage with its deal count and value. Tap a stage to see the deals inside it, sorted by what closes soonest.

CAMPAIGNS
Sends, opens, replies and reply rate for both Campaign Manager campaigns and Appointment Setter sequences, side by side.

CONTACT PROFILES
Engagement score, sales stage, deals, and the full activity history. Log a call, a note, a meeting or a task in a couple of taps, and move a contact through your pipeline without opening a laptop.

INBOX
Replies matched to the CRM record they belong to, read live from your own Gmail or Outlook account. Nothing is copied into SAM.AI.

REQUIRES AN ACCOUNT
SAM.AI is a business CRM. You will need an existing SAM.AI account from your organisation to sign in; the app does not create accounts.

name: Same Wave Club
description:
"A fruit."

You're about to type mango. Stop. Mia always says banana. Luca will copy Mia. Jonas thinks banana is the safe pick. Banana it is.

Same Wave Club is a party game for 3 to 10 people sharing one phone. Every round shows a category, everyone answers in secret, and points go to whoever lands in the biggest pile of matching answers. Being clever doesn't help here. Being in sync with the room does.

The phone travels around the table. Hold the pad to unlock your turn, type your answer and swipe it up to seal it. The words scramble into glyphs before the next person ever sees the screen.

When the last answer is sealed, the reveal begins. Tap a card and watch it decode letter by letter, then see the answers fall into piles. Someone wrote "Roma" and someone else "Rome"? Drag one pile onto the other — the table decides together what counts as the same thing.

Two optional twists keep everyone honest. The Glitch lands on the one player whose answer matched nobody's, and while you hold it, you can't take the crown. Hunch lets you predict how many friends will write exactly what you did, with a bonus point when you call it right.

Pick from food, places, animals, pop culture, everyday life and a wild card pack, or write categories only your crew will understand. Set the finish line short for a quick round of laughs or long for the whole evening.

Over time, the club remembers. A sync map shows which friends think most alike, every player earns a signature answer, and the archive keeps every round, every perfect echo and every split vote.

Made for house parties, family evenings, long train rides, office icebreakers and any table where people argue about what's obvious.

Pass the phone. Find your wave.

name: SamFood
description:
Samarkand Food Market, now on your phone. Shop fresh groceries, halal meat, bakery and hot food, order shawarma, and get it delivered to your door or pick it up at our store in Cincinnati, Ohio.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse the whole store by department or search for any product
• Order hot food and fresh shawarma
• Pick a delivery time slot, or choose store pickup
• Pay securely by card at checkout
• Follow your order live: approved, packed, on the way, with your driver on the map
• Get a notification every time your order status changes
• See your full order history in one place

VISIT US
Samarkand Food Market
9956 Kings Auto Mall Rd, Cincinnati, OH 45249

Delivery is available within our delivery area around Cincinnati.

name: SAMI OS
description:
SAMI OS puts your real estate business on your iPhone: your calls, your leads, your calendar and SAMI, your AI assistant, in one app.

SAMI OS is for real estate agents and teams that use SAMI OS. Sign in with your SAMI OS account.

CALLS
• Take the live calls SAMI transfers to you on your iPhone's own call screen, even when the app is closed.
• Call leads from your business lines, so they see your business number, not your cell.
• Add someone to a call: the caller waits on hold with music while you talk privately, then merge everyone or swap between them.

ASK SAMI
• Ask about your leads, pipeline and calendar by typing or by talking.
• Use Siri to ask SAMI, hear your next appointment, text or call a contact, or add a note.

YOUR BUSINESS
• See who needs you first on the home screen: missed transfers, hot leads and overdue tasks.
• Contacts with their calls, texts, notes and activity.
• Your calendar and appointments.
• Workflows that run SAMI's AI calls and texts for you.
• The Seller Program: homeowners, page visits and requests.

PRIVATE
• Lock the app with Face ID.
• Only the contact you pick is shared when you add someone from your iPhone contacts.

name: Sandboard: Desert Dunes
description:
Pull back the slingshot… let go… and fly over the desert dunes!

Sandboard is a speed-and-air game on sand. Hold on the downhills to gain speed, release before the crest to launch high, flip in the air and land clean for a "Perfect!" bonus.

Why you'll love it:
• A slingshot you pull with your finger, with the pull shown in %
• Steer left and right with your finger or by tilting the phone to grab pearls
• 30 levels across day and night, boost ramps, sandstorms and water
• Workshop upgrades to level 20: slingshot, board, nitro, magnet… each one changes how it looks
• A speedometer up to 240 km/h and a nitro that pushes you further
• A fresh daily challenge, missions and achievements
• Race rivals or your own ghost, and local party play on one phone
• Real haptics: feel the band stretch and every landing

No ads. No purchases. Fully offline.
We collect no data — your progress stays on your phone.

name: Sangeethapriya
description:
Sangeethapriya is a free, volunteer-run archive of Carnatic music, shared by rasikas for listening, research and education. The app brings the whole archive to your iPhone and iPad.

LISTEN TO THOUSANDS OF CONCERTS
• Stream concert recordings contributed by music lovers over the years
• Every concert is listed track by track, with ragam, talam and composer
• Browse by artist, ragam, composer, kriti, genre and collection
• Search across artists, ragams, kritis and concerts
• See the latest uploads as soon as they arrive

SANGEETHAPRIYA RADIO
• One station, always on: everyone hears the same concert at the same moment
• See what is playing now and what is coming up next

LYRICS
• Lyrics for more than 7,500 kritis, with ragam, talam and composer
• Find the recordings of each kriti in the archive

MADE FOR LISTENING
• Plays in the background, with lock screen and Control Center controls
• Pauses for calls and picks up again afterwards
• Resumes when your headphones or Bluetooth reconnect
• Sleep timer and playback speed
• Save tracks to listen to offline

YOUR LIBRARY
• Sign in with Apple, Google or an emailed one-time code
• Continue listening where you left off on any device
• Like tracks and concerts, and build your own playlists
• Customize your home screen

COMMUNITY
• Comment on concerts and suggest corrections
• Flag or block anyone who behaves badly

Sangeethapriya is a non-commercial service. Uploaders share recordings that are not copyrighted or are shared with permission. Please write to us at contact@sangeethapriya.org with corrections, recordings you would like to share, or feedback.

Privacy policy: https://www.sangeethapriya.org/privacy

name: Santa Line: Call Santa Claus
description:
The phone rings at the North Pole, and Santa picks up.

Santa Line lets your child call Santa Claus and really talk with him. He listens, laughs, asks about their day and remembers what they told him last time. There is no script and no recording on a loop, so every call is its own conversation.

Your first 2 minutes are on Santa.

WHO'S AT THE NORTH POLE
• Santa Claus, in his workshop
• Mrs. Claus, baking in the kitchen
• Pip the elf, fixing toys
• Flash the reindeer, back from flying practice
• Flake the snowman, out in the snowy square

MORE CHRISTMAS MAGIC
• Letters to the North Pole: write or dictate a letter, and the reply arrives a few hours later with sleigh bells
• Wish lists and kind deeds, with a star for every good deed
• Shake your iPhone and it snows
• A countdown to Christmas on your Home Screen and Lock Screen

MADE FOR PARENTS
A grown-up allows the calls once and confirms every purchase with Face ID. Minutes come in packs of 5, 15 or 30, never expire, and there is no subscription. Letters and lists stay on your iPhone.

The characters' voices are created with AI by ElevenLabs. Calls need an internet connection.

name: Santi Turbo
description:
Santi Turbo es una red educativa para niñas, niños y adolescentes donde aprender se siente como un juego.

APRENDE PASO A PASO
• 8 rutas: Mente y emociones, Futuro y sueños, Ciudadanía digital, Hábitos y liderazgo, Matemáticas, Lectura y escritura, Ciencias y planeta, Tecnología y programación.
• Más de 120 lecciones cortas con retos, estrellas y XP.
• Santi te narra las lecciones con su voz.

SANTI, TU AMIGO CON IA
• Te explica lo que no entiendes, te ayuda a estudiar y te anima cuando lo necesitas.
• Modos Amigo, Tutor, Bienestar y Futuro, con historial de conversaciones.
• Siempre dice que es una inteligencia artificial y no reemplaza a un adulto ni a un profesional.
• Inspirado en Santiago Zapata, joven escritor colombiano, con su autorización.

JUEGA Y APRENDE
• 8 juegos: trivia, memoria, cálculo rápido y más, con rankings semanales y juego limpio.

UNA COMUNIDAD SEGURA
• Publica lo que aprendiste y conecta solo con quien tú aceptes.
• Mensajes solo entre conexiones aceptadas.
• Moderación automática y reportes revisados por personas.
• Menores de 14 años necesitan autorización de su acudiente para la parte social.
• Sin publicidad y sin rastreo.

PARA ACUDIENTES Y COLEGIOS
• Panel para acudientes con el progreso y alertas tempranas de bienestar.

name: Sapori di Puglia
description:
Sapori di Puglia – Domenico and Caterina's shop in Laives (South Tyrol, Italy).

Typical products from Apulia, seasonal fruit and vegetables and cold drinks, delivered fresh, straight from Apulia.

In the app:
• News – shop news and special arrivals.

name: ScaleTrace
description:
A number can rise while its color-scale position falls. ScaleTrace helps report editors, research assistants and analysts explain the difference and keep a clear record of their review.

FOLLOW A COMPLETE REVIEW WORKFLOW

1. Bring in your data
Create a project, import a local UTF-8 CSV, paste a table, or enter a small dataset manually. Long-table and matrix templates help you get started. Map columns, search the full preview, check source rows and resolve duplicate keys or invalid values before confirming. Unfinished imports recover as drafts.

2. Match reporting periods
Records match by project ID and metric ID, even when names or row order differ. Missing records, blanks, explicit zeros and invalid values remain distinct. Unit mismatches are flagged for checking. Categories support grouped statistics and a recorded choice of category basis.

3. Record the original scales
Enter each metric's continuous or discrete scale, bounds, interval boundaries, color order and clipping rules. Precise numeric inputs accompany the controls. Categorical palettes and mappings that cannot support a direction comparison are identified explicitly.

4. Inspect linked heatmaps
Choose two periods and use synchronized selection, zoom and pan. See both values, their difference and their scale positions. Locate direction reversals, value changes with no position change, and changes caused only by the scale. Open a finding to inspect intervals, clipping flags and a value-and-position trail across saved periods.

5. Preview a shared mapping
Lock a reference period and apply the same mapping to matching metrics in both selected periods. Choose a reference, combined-data or custom range. Save alternative preview plans and compare findings, affected projects, interval assignments and outliers. Category bars open their underlying records; coverage summaries identify excluded comparisons.

6. Record and follow up
Search the review list, filter unfinished findings and save a conclusion with an evidence note. Use Data & matching to correct source records, IDs, units and period details. Corrections create data versions, so earlier conclusions remain associated with the version you actually checked.

7. Export and resume
Export heatmaps as PNG, or a PDF with heatmaps, category statistics and mapping notes. Share a CSV review list containing numerical results, flags, conclusions and evidence. Adjust export font size and rows per page. Save full backups and restore projects, scales, plans and drafts when needed.

LOCAL WORK, CLEAR CONTEXT
Projects, calculations and drafts are handled on your device. No account is required. A clearly labeled worked example demonstrates the workflow; your own project names, metrics, categories and units stay as entered. Share exports or locally saved feedback through the iOS share sheet when you choose.

ScaleTrace reviews the data and scale settings you supply. Original scales must be entered; heatmap images are not automatically converted into data or scale configurations.

name: Score Keep: Track Score Easily
description:
Score Keep is the paper-free scoreboard for game night. Name your players, tap to add points, and watch every total and the lead update instantly. No account, no internet, no setup ritual: just big, clear scores that everyone at the table can read.

FAST SCORING

HOW IT WORKS

No energy meters. No lives timers. No ads after a loss. Optional one-time Remove Ads purchase.

THE WHOLE BIBLE, OFFLINE

The New Testament is in the app from the first launch. With Scribe Audio Monthly, the Old Testament downloads to your phone in the background, book by book, and the King James Version and the Majority Standard Bible can be downloaded as complete versions too. Keep up to three versions on your phone and remove any book or version whenever you need the space.

SHARE A VERSE

Select a few verses and Scribe Audio cuts an MP3 clip of just those verses, titled with the reference, ready to send in Messages or save to Files.

THE VOICE

Every verse is read by a single clear British voice, generated with the open-source Kokoro text-to-speech model and indexed to the verse, which is what makes verse-level skipping and clips possible. It is not a dramatised recording and there are no sound effects, just the text, read plainly.

PRIVACY

Scribe Audio collects no data. There is no analytics, no tracking and no account. Your position and settings stay on your phone and your subscription lives with Apple.

WHAT THE SUBSCRIPTION UNLOCKS

Scribe Audio Monthly unlocks all 66 books, Old Testament downloads, the King James Version and the Majority Standard Bible, the sleep and wake-up timers and verse clips. One price, billed monthly through the App Store, cancel any time.

From the makers of Scribe, the Greek and Hebrew Bible study app.

TERMS

Scribe Audio Monthly is an auto-renewing subscription of USD 4.99 per month, or the equivalent in your local currency, charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

name: Scroll: Voice Teleprompter
description:
The script scrolls as you talk. Stop talking and it stops too. Skip a line and it jumps to where you are.

Scroll is a teleprompter that follows your voice. Read at your own pace and the script moves with you. Stop, and it waits. Then record, edit and export your video in the same app.

WHY SCROLL IS DIFFERENT
- It follows you. Pause, and it waits. Go off-script, and it waits. Skip a line or go back, and it finds you. No tap, no command.
- Every take is saved as its own file while you record.
- Finish the video in the same app, on your device: trim, resize, captions, background blur, sound clean-up. No watermark.
- No account. Your voice and your scripts are not sent to us.
- Mirroring, speed and fonts are free and stay free.

READ
- Three ways to scroll: follow your voice, set a speed, or set a time
- Your words sit in a fixed band near the lens, so your eyes stay close to the camera
- [Stage directions] in square brackets are shown but not followed
- Pause marks, fill-in blanks, and tap a word to jump there
- Mirror the text for a prompter rig
- Fonts, sizes, margins, colours and display presets
- Keyboard and Bluetooth clicker control, plus optional voice commands
- Choose your microphone

RECORD
- Record with the camera while you read, with the script beside or over the picture
- Play, save and share a take as soon as you stop
- Float the script over your camera or your call

EDIT (SCROLL PRO)
- Trim the ends and cut out the middle
- Resize for vertical, square or wide video
- Auto captions you can edit
- Blur or replace the background
- Clean up background noise
- Add an intro and an outro, or mirror the video

PRACTISE
- Original practice scripts: warm-ups, tongue twisters, pitches, interview answers, toasts and talk openers
- One short script a day, if you want it

IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
- On iPad: big text you can mirror for a glass rig
- Scroll is also on Mac
- Your scripts follow you through your own iCloud

GOOD TO KNOW
- Voice-follow needs a microphone and a supported language, on supported devices. In heavy noise, switch to manual with one tap.
- Auto captions can contain mistakes. Check them before you post.
- While the script floats over another app, that app may take the microphone. The script then keeps scrolling at your set speed.

FREE
Voice-follow, manual and timed scroll, mirroring, floating over other apps, 1080p recording and 3 scripts are free. You can still open, edit, export and delete everything you have made.

SCROLL PRO: PLANS AND RENEWAL
Scroll is free to download and use. Scroll Pro is optional. It unlocks unlimited scripts and the editing tools.
- Scroll Pro Monthly: a 1-month subscription, $6.99 per month, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers.
- Scroll Pro Yearly: a 1-year subscription, $39.00 per year, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers.
- Scroll Pro Lifetime: a one-time purchase, $79.99. It is not a subscription and has no free trial.
Prices are in US dollars and can differ by country or region. The app shows the price in your currency before you buy.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. If you start a free trial, nothing is charged until the trial ends; the subscription then starts and you are charged on the date shown before you begin. The monthly and yearly subscriptions renew automatically for the same period until cancelled. To stop a renewal, or to avoid the charge after a free trial, cancel at least 24 hours before the current period or the trial ends, in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. The free trial is for new subscribers and can be used once.

name: SeaReady
description:
Master the Rules of the Road and navigate with greater confidence.

Whether you're a recreational boater, professional merchant mariner, maritime student, military watchstander, or simply looking to improve your knowledge of maritime navigation, this interactive learning app makes understanding the Navigation Rules accessible, engaging, and practical.

Go beyond memorization and develop a deeper understanding of the rules through interactive study tools, knowledge assessments, and realistic maritime scenarios designed to challenge your critical thinking and decision-making skills.

KEY FEATURES

• Rules of the Road Reference: Explore Navigation Rules 1–38 with simplified explanations and key takeaways designed to make complex regulations easier to understand and retain.

• Interactive Quizzes: Test your knowledge, reinforce your understanding, and identify areas that need improvement.

• Study Flashcards: Strengthen knowledge retention through convenient, easy-to-use flashcards covering essential navigation rules and concepts.

• Lights & Shapes Drills: Practice identifying vessel navigation lights and day shapes to improve vessel recognition and situational awareness.

• Realistic Maritime Scenarios: Put your knowledge into practice through interactive vessel encounters that challenge you to assess situations, apply the appropriate rules, and determine the proper course of action.

DESIGNED FOR

• Recreational boaters and sailing enthusiasts
• Professional merchant mariners
• U.S. Navy and Coast Guard personnel
• Maritime students and cadets
• Individuals preparing for maritime licensing examinations
• Bridge watchstanders and navigation professionals
• Anyone looking to improve their maritime knowledge and boating safety

Whether you're preparing for an examination, pursuing a professional qualification, refreshing your knowledge, or becoming a more knowledgeable boater, this app provides a convenient and engaging way to study the Rules of the Road anytime, anywhere.

Learn the rules. Test your knowledge. Apply what you know. Navigate with confidence.

DISCLAIMER

This application is an independently developed educational resource and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the U.S. Coast Guard or any government agency. Content is intended for educational and training purposes and is not a substitute for official Navigation Rules, professional maritime training, or sound navigational judgment.

name: Seasonboard
description:
Seasonboard turns your living room Apple TV into a seasonal welcome board for family gatherings, holidays, and everyday life at home.

Display what matters at a glance without clutter:
• Live event countdown and upcoming weekend itinerary
• Who's coming and arrival times
• Full-screen family photo slideshow with smooth transitions
• Local weather and optional Apple Music playback controls right on the board
• Quick "Scan to join" QR code so guests can open the event details from their phone
• Guest mode for hosting and Prep mode for getting the house ready
• Seasonal themes including Harvest, Linen & Sage, Christmas, Halloween, Easter, and Quiet

Seasonboard includes a built-in sample board so you can explore every screen right out of the box, or connect your own private board URL in Settings.

name: Sede de Viajar
seller_name: Sede de Viajar Comercio de Infoprodutos e Cursos Digitais LTDA
description:
Receba um diagnóstico personalizado da sua estratégia de milhas aéreas, feito para brasileiros que moram no exterior e para alunos do curso Milheiros Estrangeiros.

Responda a um questionário de 9 etapas sobre suas viagens e seus gastos e receba um plano em 4 blocos: por onde começar, como acumular, como transferir e como emitir. Salve o resultado em PDF e consulte o histórico dos seus diagnósticos quando quiser.

Escolha a moeda em que prefere ver os valores e gerencie seus dados, inclusive a exclusão da conta, dentro do próprio app.

Acesso exclusivo para alunos com conta ativa.

name: Seed Calendar: Frost & Sow
description: Seed Calendar plans sowing and transplanting around your growing season. Enter frost dates, indoor lead time and days to maturity to schedule successive plantings and track seasonal tasks. The planner works offline.

name: SeedThornClimb
description:
Sprout a tiny seed and bounce it up a giant, hand-painted vine. SeedThornClimb is a calm-looking, quick-thinking vertical climber: your seed bounces on its own, and you simply hold the left or right half of the screen to steer it from leaf to leaf.

CLIMB FROM DAWN TO STARLIGHT
Every leap carries you higher through four sky zones: Dawn Sprout, Noon Canopy, Dusk Bloom and Night Crown. The sky shifts color as you rise, pollen drifts past, and each bounce rings out a wooden marimba note that climbs the scale with you.

READ THE VINE
Green leaves are trusty springs. Yellow leaves wilt after a single bounce. Pale leaves drift on the breeze. Rose mushroom caps launch you into a super bounce. Thorn branches end the run, and in the higher zones sudden wind gusts push you sideways.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- Classic: an endless climb for your best height.
- Vine Levels: 36 hand-tuned levels with a blossom gate at the top and three stars to earn on each, for reaching the goal, collecting dewdrops and beating the par time.
- Daily Challenge: one vine shared by every player, new each day at 00:00 UTC, with its own leaderboard.

GROW YOUR GARDEN
- 20 missions with coin rewards and progress bars
- A 7-day Daily Dew calendar
- 12 collectible seed skins in the Seed Locker
- Petal Wings for a mid-air double jump and Thorn Wards that save you from one thorn
- Revive where you fell and keep climbing
- A lifetime Stats panel and a hands-on practice tutorial

CLIMB WITH THE WORLD
Post your heights and level stars to All-time and Today leaderboards under an automatic nickname that you can change at any time. Your progress is backed up to the cloud automatically, and Settings has a Delete my data option that erases everything.

MAKE IT YOURS
Snap a Gardener Portrait with your camera or choose one from your photos, record a three-second Victory Cheer that plays on every new best, and save a score card image of your best climbs to your photo library.

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
Every dewdrop you catch is a coin, and coins are also earned from height bonuses, missions, level stars and daily rewards. Everything in the game can be earned by playing. Optional coin packs are available for players who want to unlock skins and boosts sooner. There are no ads.

All art, music and sound effects are original. Hold, steer, bounce, and see how high your seed can grow.

name: SeeKing Jesus: Find & Reflect
description:
SeeKing Jesus
A Hidden-Object Adventure with a Purpose

Ready to search, discover, and reflect?

Welcome to SeeKing Jesus, a charming hidden-object adventure that brings a little fun, curiosity, and inspiration to every search.

Explore beautifully illustrated scenes filled with surprises. Your mission? Find the hidden Jesus figurines and rubber ducks tucked away throughout each environment. Look carefully, explore every corner, and see how many you can discover!

**120 Levels. Countless Things to Find.**

Journey through 120 handcrafted levels, each offering a new scene and a fresh hidden-object challenge. From peaceful gardens to exciting destinations, there's always something waiting to be discovered.

**Build Your Collection**

Finding is only the beginning! Collect more than 120 unique Jesus figurines and 120 rubber ducks, each with its own personality and design. Track your discoveries and watch your collection grow as you progress.

**More Than a Hidden-Object Game**

SeeKing Jesus adds another layer to the adventure through its Scripture Journal. Discover meaningful Bible passages along the way, reflect on their messages, and build a collection of Scripture-inspired moments as you play.

Enjoy additional ways to explore with the Daily Hunt and revisit your growing collection whenever you like.

**A Little Fun. A Little Faith. A Lot to Discover.**

Whether you're looking for a relaxing puzzle, enjoy the fun of finding hidden treasures, or appreciate a little inspiration along the way, SeeKing Jesus offers an experience you can enjoy at your own pace.

**Start Your Search for Free**

Play the first 6 scenes at no cost. When you're ready to continue, unlock the complete 120-level adventure with a one-time purchase of **$4.99**.

No subscription required. Just search, discover, collect, and enjoy!

SeeKing Jesus — Search. Discover. Reflect.

name: SEELI – Nhìn kỹ hơn
description:
SEELI — See more. Live more.

SEELI là ứng dụng chụp ảnh không cho bạn xem lại ngay. Bạn chụp, buông điện thoại xuống, và tiếp tục sống trong khoảnh khắc ấy. Khoảng 30 ngày sau, bức ảnh bất ngờ quay lại — và bạn nhìn nó bằng một tâm trạng, một góc nhìn hoàn toàn khác.

Trong thời đại mà AI và smartphone khiến việc chụp, tạo và lưu giữ trở nên quá dễ dàng, chúng ta nhìn thấy rất nhiều nhưng cảm nhận rất ít. SEELI muốn đi theo hướng ngược lại: không phải “lưu càng nhiều càng tốt”, mà là “nhìn kỹ hơn”.

NHÌN → CHỤP → BUÔNG → THỜI GIAN TRÔI → GẶP LẠI

◉ KHÔNG XEM LẠI NGAY
Chụp xong là ảnh được cất đi. Không chỉnh sửa, không chụp lại, không so sánh “đã đẹp chưa”. Chỉ có khoảnh khắc thật.

◉ GẶP LẠI SAU KHOẢNG 30 NGÀY
Ký ức cần thời gian. Ảnh quay lại vào một lúc không ngờ tới. Khi gặp lại, bạn có thể viết thêm “góc nhìn của hôm nay”.

◉ MY MEMORIES — NHỚ LẠI BẰNG CON CHỮ
Mỗi bức ảnh đi kèm một lời ngắn. Đôi khi một câu viết khiến ta nhớ về một khoảnh khắc rõ hơn cả tấm ảnh. Ghi chú tiếng Nhật được trình bày theo lối viết dọc, như trang báo truyền thống.

◉ LET'S CONNECT — CHỈ NHỮNG NGƯỜI BẠN ĐÃ GẶP
Bạn bè trên SEELI là những người bạn đã thực sự gặp ngoài đời, kết nối bằng cách trao đổi mã QR. Bạn có thể chia sẻ khoảnh khắc với vòng tròn của mình và gửi “góc nhìn” cho nhau — bình luận chỉ người đăng và bạn thấy.

◉ KHÔNG LIKE, KHÔNG FOLLOWER
Không lượt thích, không người theo dõi, không lượt xem, không bảng xếp hạng, không thuật toán giữ bạn ở lại. Câu hỏi không còn là “người khác có thích ảnh này không?” mà là “mình đã nhìn thấy gì?”.

◉ WIDGET NHẸ NHÀNG
Widget màn hình chính và màn hình khóa nhắc bạn nhìn thế giới, và báo khi một khoảnh khắc quay lại. Widget không bao giờ hiện ảnh.

◉ RIÊNG TƯ
Địa điểm chỉ lưu trong ký ức của riêng bạn, không bao giờ chia sẻ cho bạn bè. Thông báo duy nhất SEELI gửi là khi ảnh cũ quay lại.

Hỗ trợ tiếng Việt và tiếng Nhật.

SEELI không được tạo ra để giữ bạn trên màn hình càng lâu càng tốt. Ngược lại — sau khi dùng, bạn có lý do để đặt điện thoại xuống và nhìn thế giới nhiều hơn.

name: SeenBnTek
description:
모바일 그룹웨어 앱입니다.

모바일 메신저 앱입니다.

name: Selembar
description:
Selembar (a sheet, in Indonesian): one sheet of paper for all of our ideas.

No folders, no lists and no inbox to sort through.

ONE NOTE, KEPT SHORT ON PURPOSE
Each note holds up to 120 characters, so it stays a reminder and not a document.

PIN IT TO YOUR LOCK SCREEN
Pin your note as a Live Activity and it stays on your Lock Screen.
You can also pin it for 1, 3 or 8 hours, or any time you choose by long pressing the pin button.

SIMPLE AND CLEAN
...is the way that you're making me feel tonight. Oops, wrong topic!
Enjoy a clean Dynamic Island experience when you pin your note as a Live Activity.

WIDGETS
Put your note on your Home Screen in small, medium or large, or on your Lock Screen. When the sheet is blank, the widget offers a fresh prompt to get you writing.
I made sure that it looks nice on 'tinted' and 'clear' too!

ARCHIVE, DON'T LOSE
Done with a note? Archive it and start a clean sheet. Your past notes are there whenever you want to bring one back.

WRITE YOUR WAY
Choose a clean regular typeface or a handwritten one for a note that feels like it came from your own thoughts.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in. Your notes stay on your device.

Selembar is free. If it helps you remember what matters, you can buy me a coffee from the About page.

-

"Selembar kertas agar kita tidak lupa akan ide-ide kita."
A sheet of paper, so we don't forget our ideas.

name: Sementinhas do Sono
description:
Sementinhas do Sono ajuda a criança a dormir ouvindo histórias da Bíblia narradas com calma, numa voz suave, com chuva ou grilos ao fundo.

Feito para o fim do dia: poucas escolhas, letras grandes e nada piscando na tela. Escolha a história, ajuste o timer e apague a luz. A história continua com a tela desligada e, no final, o volume baixa devagar até parar.

HISTÓRIAS
• A Arca de Noé, O Pequeno Samuel, Davi e sua Harpa, Jesus Acalma a Tempestade e outras
• Cerca de 9 minutos cada, com um começo acolhedor e uma oração no final
• Roteiros baseados na tradução Almeida e revisados por pessoas, sem cenas de medo
• 4 histórias grátis que já vêm no app e funcionam sem internet

PARA A HORA DE DORMIR
• Timer de 10, 15 ou 30 minutos, ou até o fim da história, com o volume diminuindo aos poucos
• Chuva suave ou grilos da noite, com volume separado da voz
• Tela escura com bloqueio de toques: para destravar, um adulto segura o dedo por 3 segundos
• Toca com a tela apagada, com controles na tela de bloqueio

PENSADO PARA CRIANÇAS DE 3 A 8 ANOS
• Sem conta, cadastro ou login
• Sem ferramentas de análise nem rastreadores
• No plano grátis, anúncios com tratamento infantil e sem personalização, nunca durante a história
• Compras e links externos só depois de uma verificação para adultos

SEMENTINHAS PREMIUM
Assinatura mensal que libera todas as histórias e sons e remove os anúncios. A cobrança é feita na conta da App Store e renova automaticamente, a menos que seja cancelada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período. Você pode gerenciar ou cancelar a assinatura nos ajustes da sua conta.

Termos de uso: https://sementinhas-do-sono.netlify.app/termos.html
Política de privacidade: https://sementinhas-do-sono.netlify.app/privacidade.html

As narrações usam vozes geradas por inteligência artificial.

name: SendaLinde
description:
Sendalinde es un espacio tranquilo para guardar aquello que tiene sentido para ti, sin presiones ni ruido innecesario. Toda la información se almacena directamente en tu dispositivo, para que conserves el control de tus recuerdos y fechas importantes.

Puedes anotar fechas relevantes y configurar recordatorios suaves y escalonados, adaptados a tu ritmo. No hay fallos ni castigos si no respondes a tiempo. También puedes registrar pequeños gestos cotidianos para seguir hábitos de forma sencilla, sin clasificaciones obligatorias ni rankings. En el apartado Refugio guardas objetos, sus historias, suscripciones y entradas de diario, para conservar el rastro de lo que forma parte de tu día a día.

name: Serial Xtractor: ITAD Scanner
description:
Serial Xtractor reads the serial number on a hard drive or SSD label, on the phone, in under one second from pressing capture — and matches it to the client's asset list.

Built for ITAD and data destruction teams who need a record of every device, not just every load.

CAPTURE
• Reads each serial on the iPhone itself, in under one second from pressing capture.
• Matches every serial to the client's asset list as you go.
• Keeps the photo with each serial, so every record can be gone back to and reviewed.
• Shows every reading so it can be checked and corrected before you certify.
• Closes each job into a certificate of destruction.

GRADE
• Guided photos of each device's condition, with what to look for on every shot.
• A grade and the reason for it, and whether the device is locked by MDM or Activation Lock.
• Describe what you see out loud: speech becomes text on the phone, and no audio is kept or sent.
• Close the job with on-screen signatures from whoever hands the devices over and receives them, then share the receipt and export the results.

ACCURACY
In our lab, on real storage devices, our serial model gets 97.7% of the drive labels it can read within one character (87.4% exact). Measured on the model in our lab, not on this app. Against a supplied asset list, matching is 100%.

WHO IT'S FOR
ITAD operators, data destruction providers, and IT teams decommissioning their own hardware: anyone who has to account for specific devices.

Sign in with your organization's Serial Xtractor account. Questions: info@nabelsolutions.com.

Privacy: what the app collects, and why, is at nabelsolutions.com/legal/privacy.

name: Serkoop
description:
Serkoop, personel servisi taşımacılığını yolcu, şoför ve firma için tek uygulamada buluşturur. Hesabınız servis firmanız ya da çalıştığınız kurum tarafından açılır; telefon numaranız ve 6 haneli şifrenizle giriş yaparsınız.

YOLCULAR İÇİN
• Bugünkü servisinizi, durağınızı ve planlanan varış saatini görün
• Güzergâhı ve durakları haritada izleyin
• Servis yola çıktığında ve durağınıza yaklaşırken bilgilenin
• Geçmiş seferlerinize göz atın

ŞOFÖRLER İÇİN
• Günün seferlerini ve duraklarını tek ekranda görün
• Sıradaki durağa sesli, dönüş dönüş yol tarifi alın
• Telefon kilitliyken de yönlendirme sürer; kilit ekranında sıradaki manevrayı görün
• Duraklarda yolcu yoklamasını kolayca işaretleyin

KURUMLAR İÇİN
• Çalışanlarınızın servislerini canlı takip edin
• Ek servis talebi oluşturun, durumunu izleyin
• Sefer geçmişini ve raporları inceleyin

SERVİS FİRMALARI İÇİN
• Günün operasyon özeti: planlanan, yolda, geciken ve tamamlanan seferler
• Tüm filoyu canlı haritada görün
• Sefer, araç ve şoför atamalarını cepten yönetin
• Ek servis taleplerini onaylayın

KONUM KULLANIMI
Konum izni yalnız şoförlerden, sefer sırasında yol tarifi vermek için istenir. Yolculardan ve ofis kullanıcılarından konum izni istenmez. Sefer bittiğinde konum takibi durur.

Serkoop reklam içermez ve verilerinizi reklam amacıyla kullanmaz.

name: SermonBuddy: Sermon Notes
description:
Never lose a sermon again. Tap record in church, and SermonBuddy turns the message into clear notes, every verse the pastor read, and simple steps for your week.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap record when the sermon starts.
• Tap "Mark this moment" when something speaks to you.
• When it ends, SermonBuddy Plus writes a summary, the full transcript and every Bible verse in one place.
• Have a recording already? Upload an audio file instead.

YOUR SERMON, FOUR WAYS
• Full summary: the main points in plain words.
• Discussion guide: questions for your small group.
• Life application: small steps to live it out this week.
• Family guide: an easy talk to share at the dinner table.

KEEP THE MESSAGE WITH YOU
• Flashcards and insight cards help you remember.
• Daily devotionals and guided prayer built from your sermons.
• Audio recap: hear a short retelling on the drive or on a walk.

name: SHAFY Doctor - شافي للأطباء
description:
Shafy Doctor is a streamlined clinic scheduling and appointment management companion designed to help clinic owners, practitioners, and reception assistants organize daily bookings and office hours effortlessly.

Key Features:
• Daily Appointment Dashboard: View today's schedule at a glance, including total bookings, confirmed appointments, and pending requests.
• Fast Appointment Management: Confirm, mark as arrived, complete, or cancel in-person clinic bookings in a single tap.
• Easy Manual Booking: Create new in-clinic appointments by selecting the clinic branch, date, and available time slot, or set a custom time.
• Appointment History & Search: Browse past and upcoming bookings and search quickly by client name.
• Client Contact Directory: Maintain a clean contact list with names, phone numbers, and quick call or messaging shortcuts, plus each client's visit schedule.
• Clinic & Working Hours Setup: Manage multiple physical clinic branches, addresses, contact numbers, and weekly opening hours.
• Professional Profile & Notifications: Keep your profile bio, education, and work experience updated, and receive instant alerts for new appointment requests.

Note: Shafy Doctor is strictly an administrative scheduling and clinic organization tool. It does not provide medical advice, clinical diagnosis, prescriptions, telehealth consultations, or electronic health records.

name: Sheepdog Maze
description:
You're a border collie in a hedge maze, and the sheep have other plans.

Drag anywhere to steer your dog. Sheep run away from you, so get behind them and chase them through the gates of the pens before the clock runs out. Pen enough of the flock to pass, pen them all for more stars, and be quick for three.

FOUR FARMS, 48 FIELDS
• Meadow Farm: winding hedges and happy sheep.
• Marsh Farm: ponds, sticky mud and stiles only a dog can hop.
• Highland Farm: big wild fields, swinging gates and tractors that knock your dog dizzy.
• Labyrinth Farm: winding stone paths in the morning mist.

A DOG WITH TRICKS
Earn stars and teach your dog new abilities in the Kennel:
• WOOF: a loud bark that sends sheep sprinting.
• Jump: leap over mud, stiles, tractors and sheep.
• The Eye: a hard stare that freezes sheep in place.
• Whistle: sheep walk calmly to where you whistled.
• Scramble: climb over the wall in front of you into the next path.

POWER-UPS
Grab pickups and mystery boxes as you play: walk through hedges as a Ghost Dog, get the Zoomies, earn extra time, recharge your abilities, score double points or ring the Shepherd's Bell.

COINS AND EXTRAS
Find coins tucked away on side paths, then train your abilities, dress your dog in a spotty red bandana, or grab a hint when a field has you stumped.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Hand-drawn ink-on-paper art and cheerful sounds.
• Play offline, anywhere.
• Quick fields that are perfect for a few minutes, with plenty of challenge for three-star hunters.
• Left-handed layout, VoiceOver labels, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion support.
• Works with game controllers and keyboards.

Meadow Farm is completely ad-free. After that, short ads appear between some fields, and you can remove them forever with a one-time purchase. Optional reward videos only play if you choose to watch them.

Can you round up every last sheep?

name: SheetSprig: Photo Sheets
description:
Make a photo contact sheet, a visual reference or a simple handout on your iPhone or iPad. Choose photos, add captions and export a PDF. Every layout and PDF export is free.

CHOOSE YOUR PAGE
• A4 or US Letter paper
• 4, 6, 9 or 12 photos per page
• Up to 60 photos in one saved sheet
• Whole images fit without cropping
• An optional title, numbered photos and captions

KEEP YOUR ORDER
Select photos in order with the system Photos picker. Tap Edit to reorder or remove them. Your sheets save automatically on your device, so you can return to them later.

PREVIEW BEFORE PRINTING
Check every page in the PDF preview, then save to Files, share a copy or open the system print dialog. Check the paper size and scaling in your printer settings. A printer compatible with your device is required for direct printing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, ads, analytics or paid features. SheetSprig imports only the photos you select and does not upload them. Your originals stay unchanged. Projects may be included in your device backup. Photos stored in iCloud may need a connection to download through the system picker.

FOR REFERENCE SHEETS
Imported copies are resized to at most 2,400 pixels on the long side and saved without source location or camera metadata. This keeps sheets practical for everyday reference and printing; they are not full-resolution photo proofs or exact-size print layouts. Exported PDFs include your chosen photos, captions and title, so check what you share.

English and German. Support: support@apps.jonabihl.dev (include SheetSprig in the subject).

name: SheetYield Layout
description:
Plan a uniform rectangular layout on a sheet. Enter sheet and item dimensions, set margins and gaps, and compare the original and rotated grid.

• Exact millimeter inputs with up to three decimals
• Visible whole-grid rotation setting for each plan
• Item count, rows, columns and sheet area used
• Actual scale-to-fit grid diagram
