This is a uniform-grid estimate, not globally optimal mixed-orientation nesting. It does not control a printer or cutting machine. Drawing and coordinate display show up to 200 items; sharing includes all planned coordinates. No account, ads or analytics.

name: Shift Runner: Shape run
description:
Run for your life – and shift to survive!

A hungry lion is right behind you. Race down the track, dodge obstacles and collect coins. When the world changes, change with it:

• HUMAN – run, jump and slide along the path
• FISH – dive into rivers and swim past sharks and piranhas
• BIRD – fly over deep canyons and through golden rings
• TIGER – power through the wild jungle

Shift at the right moment or you're caught!

THREE WORLDS
• Savanna – escape the lion through rivers, canyons and jungle
• Ice World – outrun the polar bear on snow and ice, and ride a log down the mountain
• Shipwreck Beach – survive a shipwreck while an eagle hunts you from the sky

MINI GAMES
Sky Rings, Lion Fight, Log Slide, Boss Fight, Fish Feast and Flying Fish.

MORE TO PLAY
• Play as Boy, Girl or the Classic runner, with outfits to collect
• Vortex Run takes you through every world in one run
• Weekly leaderboard with gold, silver and bronze chests
• Power-ups, upgrades and daily gifts

Ads are optional: you only watch one when you choose to, for a reward.

How far can you run?

name: Shipping Label to 4x6
description:
Got your shipping label as a full A4 or Letter page? Crop just the label and save a printer-ready 4 × 6 PDF.

Import the label PDF, pick the page it's on, drag the orange frame around the label and preview the real PDF before you save it. Then open it in your label printer's own app and print.

CROP ONLY WHAT YOU NEED
• Import a PDF from Files (up to 50 pages) or one image from your photos
• Page thumbnails show every page, so you choose the right one
• Drag the corners and edges of the crop frame; zoom in to place it exactly
• Rotate 90° when the label sits sideways on the sheet
• The exact page and area that will be used is always shown

READY FOR 4 × 6
• Choose 4 × 6 in (288 × 432 points) or 100 × 150 mm (283.46 × 425.20 points). They are different sizes, and the app never mixes them up
• The crop is fitted onto one page and centered, never stretched or cut. Where the shapes differ, the rest stays white and the app tells you, so you can tighten the crop or rotate instead
• PDF text and lines stay sharp: the page is drawn into the new PDF, not photographed
• Barcodes are left exactly as they are: nothing is moved, changed or "enhanced"

SAVE YOUR PRINTER-READY PDF
• Preview the actual PDF, then Save to Files or Share
• Print at Actual Size (100%) on matching label paper from your printer's app
• Generic file name ("Label 4x6 in.pdf") and minimal PDF details

GOOD TO KNOW
• Include the whole label and the blank space around barcodes in your crop
• This app doesn't buy postage, connect to shipping accounts or printers, or check labels. Barcode scanning and printer compatibility aren't guaranteed
• Cropping is a layout step, not redaction: parts of the page outside the crop may remain in the PDF
• Password-protected or restricted PDFs aren't opened
• Your original file is never changed. Working copies stay on your iPhone and are temporary. No account, no ads, no tracking

Selecting and previewing are always free, and your first export is free. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports. It isn't a subscription and never renews. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

name: Shitly
description:
Shitly keeps the shift you were scheduled, the hours you actually worked, and the pay stub you received in one place. It is for hourly jobs you work alongside each other, each with its own payday.
Open the app and see the next shift, this week’s rota, and the pay period you are in now: estimated gross so far, payday, and how close you are to weekly overtime. After a shift, log the start, the end, unpaid breaks, and tips. A missing end, or a day with no wage on file, does not invent a paycheck.
Each role keeps its own hourly rate, currency, week start, time zone, and pay cadence: weekly, every two weeks, twice a month, monthly, or a span you set. A raise starts a new rate. Older shifts stay on the rate that applied that day. Planned hours and worked hours stay separate, so a late finish does not rewrite the rota.
Overtime, double time, a holiday you mark yourself, and a night or weekend add-on follow the rules you enter for that job. One minute is paid once. Shitly does not decide whether a rule matches local law.
Tips stay itemized: cash, card, pool, and tip-out. Cash you kept is part of your own estimate and stays off the stub comparison unless you say it was paid through payroll. Service charge and tronc stay in their own column.
When the stub arrives, enter the gross, the deductions, and the amount that landed as separate figures. Shitly compares estimated gross with stub gross. It does not treat take-home pay as the gross, and it does not build a gross out of the net alone. A difference is two records that do not match. You can note it, explain it, or mark it settled. It is not a finding that you were underpaid.
Insights show hours, roles, and tips over a week, a month, or a range you choose. Roles in different currencies are not added together unless you type an estimate rate. Export a CSV, or save a backup, when you want a copy of your own records.

name: Shizuka Filter - Quiet Feeds

One purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac on the same Apple Account. Choose Restore Purchases on the Pro tab when setting up another device.

To get started, enable the extension in Safari and allow access to the supported sites you choose. Setup includes steps for a grayed-out extension switch. Filters apply to websites in Safari and do not change other apps.

Filtering happens on your device. Shizuka Filter does not collect your browsing history or search terms. No account is required.

name: SHOOT STATS
description:
今日の25得点、効率はどうだった？

SHOOT STATSは、試合や練習のシュート記録から、成功率と得点効率をすぐに確認できるバスケットボール計算機です。
2P・3P・FTの成功数と試投数を入力すると、得点と5つの指標が自動で更新されます。

■ ひとつの入力から、まとめて計算
・総得点
・FG%（フィールドゴール成功率）
・3P%（3ポイント成功率）
・FT%（フリースロー成功率）
・eFG%（3Pの価値を反映したシュート効率）
・TS%（フリースローを含めた得点効率の目安）

■ 数字の意味まで確認
各指標のカードをタップすると、意味と計算式を確認できます。難しい計算式を覚えずに、スコアシートの振り返りに使えます。

■ すぐに使える
アカウント登録は不要。シュートの計算は通信なしで利用できます。「サンプルを試す」で入力例も確認できます。

■ 広い画面でも使いやすく
iPhone Duoの広い画面では結果と入力を左右に並べて表示。記録を入力しながら結果を確認できます。

【ご利用について】
・試合記録の保存・共有・同期機能はありません。アプリを終了すると入力した記録は失われます。
・試投数が0など計算できない場合は「—」と表示します。
・eFG%とTS%は100%を超えることがあります。TS%の0.44は推定係数です。
・数値は相手の守備、役割、シュートの難しさと合わせて振り返ってください。

name: SiamStays

SiamStays is a curated collection of holiday stays in Thailand — pool villas, condos, family homes and more in Phuket and Hua Hin — with the details you need to choose with confidence.

name: Sideline Film: Sports Memories
description:
Every game, a film worth keeping.

You filmed the whole game from the sideline. Sideline Film turns it into a short film in a minute: it listens for the cheers, watches for the action, picks the best plays and cuts them together with titles, slow motion and a look you choose. Everything happens on your iPhone. Your videos are never uploaded.

ONE LONG TAKE OR LOTS OF CLIPS
Pick a single tripod video or forty little clips from the camera roll, or files from your action camera. Sideline sorts them by time and finds the plays.

SPOTLIGHT YOUR KID
Tap your player once. Sideline looks for them in the best plays, moves their moments up, and keeps them in frame in vertical films. Only boxes over time are kept for that game. No faces, no profiles, nothing remembered across games.

STYLES WITH A FEEL
- Chill: slow dissolves, soft words, a little slow motion.
- Snapshot: every play as an instant print.
- Camcorder: REC dot, date stamp, the home video look.
- Home Reel: warm film, sprocket edges.
- Cinematic: letterbox calm, serif titles.
- Highlights: fast cuts, bold labels, best play last.
Pair them with looks like Sunday, Golden Hour, Floodlight and Home Movie.

THE SEASON, IN ONE FILM
Games gather by season. With Pro, cut them all into a Season Film, chapter by chapter, with the date and opponent on each one.

MADE FOR SHARING, YOUR WAY
Save 9:16 for Reels, TikTok and Stories or 16:9 for the TV. Turn the game sound off to add your own song in the app you post to. Films save straight to Photos.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Videos are analyzed on the device and stay there.

SIDELINE PRO
Free: your first film, then one film every week, in the Chill and Snapshot styles, with a small credit on the last card.

name: Sidewalk Assess
description:
See a cracked, lifted, or broken sidewalk? Report it in about 30 seconds.

Sidewalk Assess is a free app from American Sidewalks LLC that lets anyone photograph a sidewalk problem and send it to the town's repair list. No account, no sign-up, no ads.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap Report a Sidewalk Issue and take a photo.
2. Tap what you see: cracks, a raised edge (trip hazard), a broken or missing curb ramp, standing water, something blocking the path, and more.
3. Tap Upload. The app adds the GPS location and street name so your town knows exactly where it is.

WHY IT MATTERS
- The sidewalk in front of your home is your town's responsibility, and often yours too. A clear photo with an exact location helps it get on the repair list faster.
- Every report gets a priority score, so the most dangerous trip hazards and accessibility problems get looked at first.
- Towns often pay consultants to survey their sidewalks. Reports from residents help build that list for a fraction of the cost, which saves tax dollars.

BUILT FOR REAL STREETS
- Works without signal. Reports are saved on your phone and upload by themselves when you're back online.
- See every report you've made on a map, color-coded by priority.
- Track each report: Waiting, Uploading, or Sent.
- Delete any report from your phone at any time.

PRIVACY
Sidewalk Assess only uses your camera when you take a report photo, and your location only while the app is open, to place the report on the right street. We don't track you, sell your data, or show ads. Read the full privacy policy at the link below.

FOR TOWNS AND PUBLIC WORKS
American Sidewalks LLC turns resident reports into a private, prioritized repair spreadsheet and map for each town, with photos, GPS pins, and a daily crew list. Contact us to set up your town.

name: Sign & Scan PDF Pro
description:
Scan, sign and edit PDFs right on your iPhone. No account to create, no server for your documents: everything happens on the device.

FREE, NO WATERMARK
• Scan in one tap: edge detection, cropping, multiple pages. Import from Files, Photos or the share sheet.
• Offline text recognition (OCR), 3 per month, and search across all your documents.
• Signature: draw it once, place it anywhere. Every signature is sealed with a certificate created on your iPhone and a certified timestamp; the Proof screen shows the document hasn’t changed since.
• Annotations: highlight, write, draw, add text.

PRO
• Real text editing: the PDF’s text is actually replaced, not hidden under a white box.
• Smart forms: fields detected even on a scan and filled from your encrypted profile; official French Cerfa forms pre-filled.
• On-device AI assistant: summary, questions about the document, translation. Nothing is sent.
• Unlimited OCR and export to Word or text.
• Send for signature: your signer gets a link by email, signs in their browser, and the signed PDF comes back to the app.
• Redaction, PDF password, initials on every page.

EVERYWHERE ON YOUR IPHONE

• “Save to Sign & Scan”: the document is saved, read by OCR and filed automatically.
• Widgets: Scan button and recent documents (never those in the vault).
• iPhone, iPad and foldable iPhone: on a large screen, the list and the document side by side.

YOUR PRIVACY
Your documents stay on your iPhone. Two exceptions, only when you use them: the timestamp service only receives the document’s fingerprint, never its content; “Send for signature” transmits the encrypted document for your signer, then deletes it. No ads, no trackers.

PRO PLANS
Monthly or yearly, each with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time purchase for lifetime access. Prices in your currency are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

name: Signature to PNG
description:
Turn your signature into a clean, transparent PNG with no white rectangle behind it.

Draw it with your finger, or import a photo of it signed on paper. Signature to PNG keeps only the ink and saves a real PNG with transparency, ready to place on a letterhead, an email footer or a document you're preparing.

DRAW YOUR SIGNATURE
• A smooth canvas with Undo, Redo and Clear
• Black or blue ink

• Accidental taps are shown in gray and left out, unless you turn on Keep Dots for an i-dot or a period

IMPORT A PHOTO OF IT

• Keep the ink color, or switch it to black or blue

SAVE A TRANSPARENT PNG

• See its real pixel size and file size

• Save PNG to Files, or Share PNG as a file

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your signature is processed on your iPhone and kept only for the current session, in protected temporary storage that isn't backed up
• No signature library, no sync, no account, no uploads, no ads, no tracking, no analytics
• The app hides its preview in the app switcher (it can't block screenshots)
• Clear Current Signature removes your working copy at any time

Signature to PNG makes an image of your signature. It doesn't sign documents, verify identity or make a signature legally valid. Only use a signature you're allowed to use.

Selecting and previewing are always free, and your first export is free. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports. It isn't a subscription and never renews. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

name: Silver Six: Bullet Recall
description:
You have exactly six silver rounds. Every shot stays where it lands: lodged in a ghoul, on the stones, behind a coffin. Whistle and all six fly back to your hand, tearing through every monster on the way home.

Silver Six is a top-down action roguelite about those six rounds. Count them, place them, then call them home at the right moment from the right spot, and steer your step so the returning silver crosses the whole pack. Hunt alone, or bring a friend: the whole chapter plays as free online co-op for two.

HUNT TOGETHER (FREE ONLINE CO-OP)
• Two hunters, one hunt, each with their own six rounds. Invite a friend with a room code or a link by message, or find a partner who is waiting.
• Whistle together: where your returning rounds meet your partner's, they burst into silver sparks that hit every monster close by.
• Go down and your partner can pull you back up. Drop out and a bot keeps your hunter running until you reconnect.
• After each room you both see the same three cards and each take your own, on a 20-second timer.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Two thumbs: run with the left, fire, recall and dash with the right.
• Every enemy attack is telegraphed for at least half a second. Dodge, then punish.
• Shots plant rounds; recalls do the real damage. A plain hit is a setup, a recall through three monsters is a kill.
• Thieves steal rounds off the ground and run for the fence. Catch them or pay the ransom.

A CHAPTER OF THE GRAVEYARD
• Eight rooms and a boss: the Gravedigger, who only bleeds when silver comes home through his back.
• Seven monsters, each asking something different of your six rounds: ghouls, bat swarms, werewolves, coffin bearers, thieves, witches and wraiths.
• After each room, choose a gate: a plain fight, an elite room with marked monsters, a well, a forge or a strange candle-lit meeting.
• Engrave your rounds (Pierce, Bounce, Burst, Hook, Heavy, Magnet, Deep) and fuse two marks into named double marks.
• Contracts, silver scrap, charms, ransom and a forge between rooms.

KEEP HUNTING
• Four hunters, each calling rounds home in their own way: a whistle, a magnet glove, a chain, a lever rifle.
• Seven nights of rising danger, then the Blood Moon: stack your own conditions for a higher moon.
• A daily hunt with the same seed for everyone, a hunting journal and 24 oaths that open new charms and events.

No ads. No tracking. The chapter, the first hunter, the daily hunt and co-op are free. One optional purchase, Full Hunt, opens every hunter and every night at once; all of it can also be earned by playing.

Available in English, Español, Português (Brasil), Français, Deutsch, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어 and Tiếng Việt.

name: Sine Stack
description:
Sine Stack keeps a sine-bar gauge stack on this iPhone.

Pick a bar. Drag the angle. Height is the center distance times the sine, rounded to 0.001 mm. The thousandths, hundredths, tenths, and units digits each take one block. What remains must be one tens block in the set. Above 45 degrees is too steep. Below the smallest block, or a missing block, does not light a stack. A check sweep does not change the height. The last set stays.

Sizes stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Sintonia: Focus Music
description:
Instrumental music for coding, studying and deep work, composed live on your device. No lyrics and no looping playlist: a new piece every few minutes, for as long as you work.

Put your headphones on and pick a place. Night Terminal plays a precise sequence over a quiet bassline and the clicks of a machine left running. Paper Study has unhurried chords, a few piano notes and pages turning. Corner Café has warm electric piano and the clink of cups. Whether you are writing code, studying for an exam or finishing a paper, two hours later it is still playing, and you have not heard the same piece twice.

BUILT FOR LONG SESSIONS
- No lyrics, no ads and nothing that interrupts you
- Steady tempos from 47 to 112 BPM, from floating to rhythmic
- Each piece lasts three to eight minutes and crossfades into the next, so a session never loops back to the start
- A Coding category: Night Terminal, Night Laboratory and Beneath the Neon
- Keeps playing in the background and with the screen locked, with controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center
- Works offline, with no account

37 PLACES TO WORK IN
Each scene has its own key, tempo, lead instrument and field recording. You hear felt piano, electric piano, nylon and Spanish guitar, harp, celesta, music box, kalimba, oud, lute, flute, analog synthesizer, singing bowls and gong, over rain on a gutter, surf, pages turning, crackling embers, frogs, whale song or village bells heard from far away.

Filter by what you are doing: Focus, Coding, Calm, Meditation, Energy and Winter. When the work is done, the Calm and Meditation scenes slow everything down: Dawn Singing Bowls, Frozen Lake, Lighthouse in the Fog. Winter brings Lantern Tower, Toy Workshop, Sleigh Among the Firs and Vigil Bells.

FOCUS NOISE
Steady Noise is for the moments when you want no melody at all. Choose white, pink, brown or green noise, then set the level and how much it slowly varies.

SHAPE THE MIX
Every musical scene has five live controls: Drift for the harmony, Keys for the lead instrument, Pulse for the pattern of short notes, Beats for bass and soft percussion, and a fifth for the sounds of the place itself. Move them while the music plays and it follows, with no restart. Another Variation writes a new piece with the same mix.

Sintonia writes each piece on the device from a key, a tempo and a bank of chord progressions. Nothing is streamed.

WHAT IS INCLUDED
Included: 5 scenes and Steady Noise, with every control enabled. The scenes are Lighthouse in the Fog, Paper Study, Corner Café, Orange Blossom Patio and Dawn Singing Bowls. Every other scene plays a one-minute live preview, so you can hear it before deciding.

SINTONIA COMPLETE (ONE-TIME IN-APP PURCHASE)
- Every scene, including the ones added in the future
- Favorites: save a piece together with its exact mix and return to it
- Export any piece as M4A (30 or 60 minutes), royalty-free for your videos, livestreams and podcasts, with no credit needed
- One payment, no subscription, no ads
- Family Sharing is supported
- One purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account

PRIVACY
No account, no sign-up, no ads and no tracking. The music is composed on the device. The only thing the app sends is anonymous play counts (how many minutes each scene plays, with nothing that identifies you), and you can turn that off in Settings.

Support: hello@sintoniamusic.app
Privacy Policy: https://sintoniamusic.app/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sistolog: Blood Pressure Log
description:
Sistolog is a diary for your blood pressure readings. You read the values from your own blood pressure monitor and enter them in a few taps. The app does not judge your values. It keeps what you enter and lays it out clearly for your next doctor's appointment.

WHAT YOU CAN LOG
- Blood pressure: upper value (systolic), lower value (diastolic) and pulse
- Blood sugar in mg/dL or mmol/L, with the timing if you like: fasting, before a meal, after a meal, before bed
- Weight
- Circumstances and notes, for example "After getting up", "After coffee" or "Dizziness"

HISTORY
All entries by date, the average of the last 7 and 30 days, and a chart of your recent entries.

MEDICATION AND REMINDERS
Note the name, dose and times of your medication as prescribed, and tick off each dose you take. If you wish, the app reminds you every day to make your entry and at your medication times.

REPORT FOR YOUR DOCTOR
With one tap you create a PDF report for the last 30 or 90 days. It is laid out like the familiar paper blood pressure charts: each day with morning and evening values, followed by the average, the lowest and highest value, and every single entry. Blood sugar, weight and medication are included too. Print it, email it or show it on your phone at the appointment.

SEVERAL PEOPLE
Keep separate diaries on one phone, for example for your partner or your parents.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
All health data stays on your phone. There is no account, no sign-in and no server. Your entries are not sent to us and are never used for advertising.

EASY TO READ
Large text, large buttons, light and dark mode. Languages: English, German, Arabic and Turkish.

ADS AND SUBSCRIPTION
Sistolog is free and shows ads. The "Ad-free" subscription, monthly or yearly, removes the ads. Every feature of the app works without the subscription. The price is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically for one month or one year, depending on the option chosen, unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel at any time in your iPhone's Settings under your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bozbayajans.com/sistolog/en/privacy.html

IMPORTANT
Sistolog is not a medical device and does not take measurements. It only records the values you enter. It does not diagnose and does not recommend treatment. Talk to your doctor before making any decision about your health or changing your medication. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

name: SiteSign
description:
SiteSign is a daily log and safety paperwork app built for NYC construction sites.

Superintendents and foremen record what happened on site, then sign and lock the day's log so it cannot be changed later.

DAILY LOGS
- Add the companies and workers on site, with hours
- Write notes, safety observations and QC observations
- Add photos with the in-app camera or from your gallery, to a company, a note or a survey question
- Answer your company's daily survey questions
- Sign the log. Signed logs are locked and kept as a record
- Open the log as a PDF

SAFETY PAPERWORK
- Toolbox talks and pre-shift safety meetings
- Incident reports and safety observations
- Worker orientations

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
- Works with spotty reception: photos wait on the phone and send when you are back online
- Roll over the companies from yesterday's log with one tap, without copying old work descriptions
- English and Spanish

Accounts are created by your company's administrator. If you do not have a login, ask your office.

name: SınavPusulası: Ehliyet 2026
description:
2026 MEB Ehliyet e-Sınavına hazırlanmanın en akıllı ve en pratik yolu!

SınavPusulası, Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı (MEB) Motorlu Taşıt Sürücü Adayları Sınavı (MTSK) müfredatına %100 tam uyumlu olarak hazırlanmış kapsamlı bir hazırlık ve deneme simülatörüdür.

Sınavda çıkabilecek tüm güncel soruları çözün, eksik olduğunuz konuları pratik "Hap Notlar" ile pekiştirin ve gerçek sınav ortamını aratmayan 50 soruluk 45 dakikalık MEB simülasyonlarıyla kendinizi test edin.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER:

• 2026 GÜNCEL MEB MÜFREDATI
İlk Yardım Bilgisi, Trafik ve Çevre Bilgisi, Araç Tekniği (Motor) ve Trafik Adabı derslerine ait tüm konular ve çıkmış soru kalıpları.

• GERÇEK e-SINAV SİMÜLASYONU
MEB elektronik sınav formatında 50 soru, 45 dakika sayaç, soru işaretleme ve bayrak koyma özellikleri. Sınav sonunda anında baraj puanı (70 Puan) kontrolü ve detaylı sonuç karnesi.

• SINAVDA AKLINDA KALSIN (HAP NOTLAR)
Uzun kitap sayfaları arasında kaybolmayın! Sınavda en çok puan getiren kritik kurallar, renkli hap bilgiler ve özet maddeler.

• YANLIŞLARIM HAVUZU (AKILLI TEKRAR)
Çözdüğünüz testlerde yanlış yaptığınız veya boş bıraktığınız sorular otomatik olarak "Yanlışlarım Havuzu"na eklenir. Böylece aynı hataları gerçek sınavda tekrarlamazsınız.

• GELİŞMİŞ BAŞARI İSTATİSTİKLERİ
Hangi derste ne kadar başarılısınız? Net oranlarınız, genel müfredat ilerlemeniz ve konu bazlı eksikleriniz anlık grafiklerle elinizin altında.

• HEDEF SINAV SAYACI
Sınav tarihinizi belirleyin, kalan gün sayınızı ve günlük çözmeniz gereken soru hedefini takip edin.

• İNTERNETSİZ ÇALIŞMA DESTEĞİ
Metroda, otobüste veya yolda; internet bağlantınız olmasa bile soru çözmeye ve konu çalışmaya kesintisiz devam edin.

SınavPusulası ile ilk girişte ehliyetinizi cebinize koyun!

name: Skin Cleaner
description:
Explore endless skin in Skin Cleaner, a tactile pimple popping simulation for iPhone. Pan with one finger and squeeze with two to clear different spots at your own pace.

Discover soft bumps, dense plugs and ingrown hairs. Bring two fingers together around a spot and repeat the squeeze when a pocket remains.

Drag a needle, tweezers, loop, spoon or strip from your tool kit to work on different spots. Wipe away residue with gauze, then return to exploring.

Keep playing without levels. Progress is saved on your device. Sound and vibration can be adjusted independently.

Skin Cleaner is a fictional simulation made for entertainment.

name: Skrano
description:
Skrano turns your iPad or iPhone into a screen for your business: offers, prices, opening hours, weather and news. Connect it with one code and manage everything from your phone or computer.

Requires a Skrano account. Want to try it first? Tap Demo code and enter DEMO-1234.

name: SKsk - Free To Glide
description:
SKsk — Freestyle roller skating, together

SKsk is a community app for quad and inline skaters. It combines video feeds, skill courses, live skating sessions, and fellow skaters all in one space.

Access
No email verification required. Enter a display name and password, then tap Continue. If the account does not exist, it will be created instantly; if the account already exists, you will log in directly. Internet access is required for live sessions, video feeds, one-on-one chats, and credit balance checks.

Feed and discovery
The home page features a timeline for today’s activities, ongoing live sessions, skill courses, and recent clips shared by skaters from Barcelona, Berlin, Lisbon, Melbourne and Chicago. Tap any clip to watch it in full screen and leave comments. The Explore page sorts skaters by location. You can follow other skaters, accept friend requests, or block users.

Courses
Four course tracks — Urban Basics, Edge Control, City Freestyle and Night Riding — break down stance, edge work, crossovers and night‑riding skills into short lessons. All lessons stream directly from the library; no pre‑download is needed.

Live sessions
Live session cards open a live skating room with a side chat panel. Say hi, ask about their gear setup, and join in the skating vibe.

Messages and calls
Chat one‑on‑one with skaters you follow. Incoming calls ring for 30 seconds. If unanswered, the call automatically ends and returns you to the chat thread.

AI Coach
Ask questions about stance, turns, or how to plan your weekly practice, and receive simple, easy‑to‑understand guidance. The first three AI conversations are free; additional conversations require credits.

Credits
Credits can be purchased inside the app in small bundles. Region‑specific pricing will be displayed before purchase confirmation, and your credit balance is visible on your profile.

Your profile
Set your display name, city, skill level and bio. Your uploaded clips are shown in a grid layout. All your posts, likes, follows and messages are tied to your account and will sync when you log in on a new device.

Good to know

• An account is mandatory; guest or anonymous browsing is not supported.

• Video content, live sessions and chat functions require an internet connection.

• You may delete your account anytime from Settings. Account deletion permanently removes your profile, clips, comments, messages and follow data from our servers.

• SKsk is an inclusive community for skaters of all skill levels. Please be respectful, give credit to creators you feature, and always skate with protective gear.

name: Sky Stack: Tap Tower Stacker
description:
Tap to drop the sliding block and stack your tower as high as you can!

Every block slides across the top of your tower. Tap to drop it: whatever hangs over the edge is sliced off, so the tower gets narrower with every miss. Land a PERFECT drop and nothing is lost; chain perfects and the block grows back. Climb through the clouds and up into outer space.

FEATURES
• Pure one-tap gameplay, easy to learn, hard to master
• Perfect combos that rebuild your tower
• Sky changes as you climb: from daylight to the stars
• Colorful tower themes: Candy, Sunset, Mint, Neon, Gold
• Revive once per run
• Short runs, perfect for a quick break, play offline

Sky Stack is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Skyloop
description:
Skyloop is a flying game you play with one finger. Hold anywhere to open the throttle and pull the nose up. Let go and your biplane dives. Keep holding and you go up and over into a loop. It takes seconds to learn and a long time to master.

FLY FROM HANGAR TO HANGAR
Start in Flight School, then take on six areas: Meadow, Canyon, Crystal Caverns, Stormy Coast, Ocean and Snow Peaks. That's 121 levels in all. Each area has its own weather, music and tricks, from narrow canyon slots and pitch-dark cave tunnels to storm clouds you can't touch and icy peaks you have to climb over.

LAND TO KEEP YOUR PLACE
Touch down on a runway along the way and pay a coin to make it your checkpoint. Crash and you carry on from there. Out at sea, some of those runways are aircraft carriers.

HUNT FOR HIDDEN STARS
Every level hides three stars off the main route: up near the storm, down by the water, or tucked away in a secret passage. Stars you find stay found, and collecting enough of them opens the next area.

FIVE PLANES, FIVE WAYS TO FLY
Bank the coins you collect and spend them in the hangar. Sparrow turns on a dime, Comet is the fastest thing in the sky, Pelican sticks to the runway and Zephyr practically floats. Find the one that suits you, or switch planes for a tricky level.

POWER-UPS
Grab a Magnet from the shop to pull in coins, Double Coins to earn twice as fast, a Shield that rewinds you out of a crash, or Slow-Mo to give yourself time to think.

ENDLESS MODE
One life. How far can you fly? The scenery changes every 2 km and it keeps getting harder. Every 5 km there's a runway: land on it and pick a free power-up. Beat your own top 10.

19 ACHIEVEMENTS
Fly a level without crashing, beat the par time, chain back flips, land on a carrier, pull off a butter-smooth landing, fill the hangar and more. Each one pays out coins.

MADE FOR ANY WAY YOU HOLD IT
Play in landscape or portrait, with the screen filling edge to edge. On iPhone Duo, open it up for the big screen.

NO ADS. NO ACCOUNTS. NO TRACKING.
Skyloop plays fully offline, has no in-app purchases and collects no data. Your progress stays on your phone.

Hand-drawn 16-bit pixel art and a chiptune soundtrack for every area. Grab your goggles and take to the sky.

name: Skysteady: Turbulence Forecast
description:
Your next flight is going to feel different.

It's the surprise that scares you. Not the bump. Skysteady takes the surprise away: before you board, you see where the air is likely to be smooth and where it is likely to be bumpy, in plain words.

SEE THE BUMPS BEFORE YOU BOARD
Your whole flight, mapped minute by minute. When to expect bumps, how strong, and how long they are likely to last. No maps to decode. No pilot codes.

KNOW WHAT COMES NEXT, IN THE AIR
Tap "We just took off" and Skysteady stays with you: what the air is doing now, when the next bumpy stretch starts, and how long until you land. It works with no signal.

CALM ON DEMAND, AT 38,000 FEET
Breathing you can follow, things to do in your seat, and a live meter that shows how small the movement really is. All of it works offline.

EVERY NOISE AND SHAKE, EXPLAINED
The thump after take-off. The engines going quiet. Sixteen sounds and sensations of an ordinary flight, in the order they happen, so you know what that was. And why it's normal.

TAKE-OFF, LANDING AND THE WIND
The weather at both airports in local time, and whether the wind is behind you or against you on the way.

FLIGHTS YOU LOOK FORWARD TO
Save every trip. Each one gets its own forecast, checked again as the day gets close, with a quiet reminder to take a look.

ANYWHERE YOU FLY
More than 3,000 airports, on every continent. Search by city, name or code.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-in. No ads, no trackers. Your forecast is worked out on your iPhone, so your route never leaves it.

SUBSCRIPTION
Skysteady is a subscription app. Choose a yearly or weekly plan; the price is shown in the app before you pay. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

IMPORTANT
Skysteady gives an estimate for passengers, made from public weather forecasts (the Global Forecast System of the US National Weather Service). It is not an aviation weather product and must not be used to plan or fly a flight. The real route, height and timing of your flight will differ, and the weather can change. Your crew has better information: always follow their instructions and keep your seat belt fastened when seated. Skysteady is not medical care and is not a treatment for fear of flying. Skysteady is not connected to or endorsed by NOAA, the FAA or any airline.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://maarrccss.github.io/skysteady/privacy.html

name: Slant: Logic Puzzle
description:
Draw one diagonal line in every cell. A number on a corner tells how many lines touch that corner, and the lines must never form a closed loop.

Slant is a classic logic puzzle with two simple rules and surprisingly deep deductions. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

12 STAGES, 360 LEVELS
• An origami journey from a 5 × 5 blank sheet to a 15 × 15 paper dragon
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each stage unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone, with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 5 × 5 to 15 × 15, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Tap a cell for \, tap again for /; drag to draw many cells at once
• A \ / / switch chooses what the first tap draws
• Hold a line to light up every line joined to it
• Numbers that can no longer be met and lines that close a loop are marked (in red, or blue if you prefer); finished numbers dim
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong lines; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: seven techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: SledRush: Slingshot Sled Ride
description:
Pull back the sling, let go and fly down the slope on your sled! SledRush is a one-handed sled game played in portrait. Every run takes you a little further: spend the gold you earn to power up your sled, then beat your best on the next try.

No energy. No waiting. No run limits. Play as much as you like.

8 WORLDS, 60 HAND-MADE MAPS
• Alpine valleys and a snowy city
• A mountain airport and a red canyon
• A frozen harbor and a neon metropolis
• A ski valley with a giant ski jump, and a moon base
Every map is built by hand, with its own route, ramps and surprises.

LAUNCH, STEER, FLY
• Pull the sling, set your power, release
• Steer with one finger and catch the speed lanes
• Jump kicker ramps and swipe in the air for backflips and 360s
• Grab coins and dodge the traffic

UPGRADE AND PROGRESS
• Between runs, spend gold to upgrade your sling, sled, income and jet
• Earn 3 stars on every map and open world chests
• Climb the Explorer Rank with missions
• Win extra rewards from distance chests and the camp gift
• The 7-day login calendar never resets: miss a day and simply carry on where you left off

COLLECTION
• Collect sleds, slings, riders and snow trails
• See exactly what you get before you spend tokens

YOUR PROGRESS FOLLOWS YOU
• Your save is copied to your own iCloud, so a new iPhone picks up where you left off
• No account and no sign-in

FAIR PLAY
• Rewarded videos are always your choice: 3x gold, 2x chest rewards or a revive. A short ad may appear between runs now and then, never during a run; the No Ads pack or the Sled Club removes them.
• Nothing random is ever sold. You always see what you get before you buy.

SLED CLUB (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
• Rewards without videos and no ads between runs
• 60 tokens and 1 coupon every day (they save up for up to 7 days)
• An exclusive snow trail every month, yours to keep
• A free revive every run and +25% gold
• The yearly plan adds a golden snow trail
Monthly and yearly plans are available. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings; your benefits continue until the end of the period you paid for.

GOOD TO KNOW
• SledRush is free to download and play. It offers optional items that cost real money (token packs, a starter pack, ad-free rewards and more) and a subscription. You can turn off in-app purchases in Screen Time settings.
• Contains ads: optional rewarded videos and occasional ads between runs.
• Privacy Policy: https://ozapplab.com/sledrush/privacy-policy
• Terms of Use: https://ozapplab.com/sledrush/terms
• Support: https://ozapplab.com/sledrush/support

SledRush is made by OzAppLab, an independent studio.

name: Slideturtleshome
description:
Tervetuloa TideNestiin, rannikon pulmapeliin, jossa kärsivällisyys ohjaa vuoroveden kulkua.

Liu'uta värikkäitä kilpikonnia hiekkarannan ruudukolla. Ne liikkuvat suoraan eteenpäin, kunnes kivi tai riutta pysäyttää ne. Jokaisen kilpikonnan on löydettävä oma pesänsä ennen kuin siirtoraja tulee vastaan.

Pelissä pääset itse suunnittelemaan reitit: liu'uta pyöristettyjä riuttoja niitä varten tarkoitetuilla urilla ja luo väliaikaisia pysähdyspaikkoja, avaa vapaita kulkureittejä sekä suunnittele turvallisia paluumatkoja. Väärin ajoitettu pysähdys voi jättää toisen kilpikonnan tielle, mutta huolellisesti suunniteltu liike auttaa koko joukon takaisin kotiin.

Tutustu kolmeen rannikkolukuun, jotka etenevät rauhallisista ensimatkoista vilkkaisiin kolmen lahden loppuhaasteisiin. Siirtojen peruminen ja uudelleen tekeminen sekä vaiheittaiset vihjeet auttavat hahmottamaan jokaisen reitin. Siirtoloki puolestaan tallentaa, miten kukin vuoro muuttaa pelilautaa.

Nauti lämpimän hiekan ja laguunin sävyistä, kuuntele lempeitä rannikon ääniä ja koe uudelleen hyvin ajoitetun liu'un tuoma onnistumisen ilo.

name: Smart Cleaner - Photo Sweep
description:
Keep the photos you love and clear out the rest with Smart Cleaner.

Browse groups of similar photos, duplicate photos, screenshots, and similar videos. Review each item and select what you want to delete. See how many files are in a group and how much space they use, with duplicate group sizes displayed to two decimal places.

For a more personal way to tidy up, swipe through your photos month by month. Keep a photo or move it to Trash, and follow your progress as you go. Each month shows how many photos you’ve reviewed and how many are waiting in Trash. Once you’ve finished a month, it’s marked complete so you can focus on what’s next.

You choose what stays and what gets deleted.

name: Smart Host by Ask Vera
description:
Smart Host brings your Ask Vera villa owner tools together in one place.

Manage your property photos, keep your availability calendar up to date and stay in touch with guests. Switch between your approved properties without mixing their details.

With Smart Host you can:
• Edit your villa listing and manage its photos.
• Update your availability calendar.
• Read and reply to guest messages.
• Use Smart Chat with signed-in guests when enabled for your villa.
• Reply to guest reviews.
• Plan cleaning, pool care and property-team visits.
• Watch finished Vera review videos and villa tours attached to your property.

Smart Host is for existing Ask Vera property owners. Sign in with your owner account to access your approved listings.

An internet connection is required.

name: Snack Munch
description:
Tilt the bucket and pour colorful snacks down a peg board to fill your hungry pet's bowl.

Snack Munch is a physics pour puzzle built for quick breaks. Aim each pour through pegs, angled chutes, bumpers, and x2 spots to clear every piece on the board.

How to play
- Tap or drag a bucket to aim and pour matching snacks.
- Bounce pieces off pegs and pass through x2 spots to double your treats.
- Fill the top bar to trigger Snack Rush and sweep golden balls across the board.
- Use Magnet, Mega Bomb, and Smart Shuffle boosters when a board gets tight.

What is inside
- 300 puzzle stages with changing board shapes, boss tactical boosts, and obstacles.
- 30 animal friends including rabbit, corgi, quokka, shiba, red panda, polar bear, and alpaca, with a Pet Album and bond perks.
- Daily Missions, 7-day gift calendar, and offline play anytime.

name: SneakPlay – Party Game
description:
One phone, one round, no sign-up: SneakPlay is the pass-around game for parties and game nights with friends and family – and just as much for lessons, cover lessons and class trips. Pick a mode, enter names or teams, pass the phone around and play.

TWO AREAS: FREE TIME AND SCHOOL
Switch at the top of the home screen: free time brings words from everyday life, food, animals, music, sport and more. School brings maths cards by school year plus classroom-friendly topics and missions. Each area remembers its own selection.

FOUR GAME MODES

Imposter
Everyone gets the same secret word – except the imposter. Going round the circle, everyone says one matching word. Who is bluffing? If the imposter is caught, they get one last guess: hit the word and they steal the win. Three variants: the imposter sees the category, a similar word (and may not even know they’re the imposter) or nothing at all. Optionally with two imposters and a “clueless” player.

Explain it!
Explain words without saying the four forbidden ones – in 2 to 4 teams against the clock. Guessed, forbidden or skip with one tap; mistakes can be corrected after every turn.

Secret Missions
You chat about a casual topic – and almost everyone has a hidden task: slip in a certain word, answer with a question … One player has no mission at all and is only bluffing. Find them!

Word Bomb
The app shows a task like “An animal” or “A prime number”. Say a word, pass the phone! The bomb ticks faster and faster, and nobody knows when it will go off. Individually or in teams.

FOR THE CLASSROOM
• Maths cards by topic area: number, measures, shape & space, algebra & graphs, data & probability – with levels from Year 5 to Year 10
• Number imposter: everyone has the same value in a different form (½, 0.5, 50%) – who has one that isn’t equivalent? Also with algebraic expressions
• “To revise”: after every Explain it! game the tricky words are listed – one tap saves them for the next lesson
• Class workshop: groups create cards on their phones, the teacher collects them by QR code into one shared list
• Whole classes play in teams
• Create your own cards with forbidden words – the class can make them too – and pass them to other devices by QR code or text, without any server or account
• School mode with PIN: locks the app to the School area – no purchase buttons, rating or “Delete everything”

HOW IT WORKS
• Secret reveal: hold your finger on the card – let go and it is hidden again straight away
• Vote together or in secret
• Awards after every round such as “Master bluffer”, “Poker face” or “Rescue genius”, plus a scoreboard for the whole evening

CONTENT
More than 180 words in nine free-time categories, more than 180 explain cards with four forbidden words each (over 100 of them from maths), 40 chat topics, 70 missions and more than 90 bomb tasks.

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Imposter is free for good – with all categories, including school and maths. Own cards, QR sharing, teams and school mode are free too. Secret Missions, Explain it! and Word Bomb can each be tried twice and played without limits with the full version (one-time in-app purchase, no subscription).

PRIVACY
• Works completely offline
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collection
• Names, scores and your own cards stay on your device

For 2 to 16 players or whole classes in teams. In English and German, in light and dark mode.

name: SnipShelf: Code Snippets
description:
SnipShelf keeps the code you reuse in one tidy place. You can find it again in seconds on your Mac, iPad and iPhone.

Save a command you always forget, a SQL query from last month's report or the SwiftUI view you copy into every project. SnipShelf detects the language as you type or paste, highlights it, and keeps it in sync through your own iCloud.

ORGANIZE
• Nested folders with custom icons, plus colored tags
• Favorites, Uncategorized, Untagged and Trash views
• Drag a snippet onto a folder or tag to file it
• Full-text search across titles, code, notes, tags and languages

WRITE AND READ CODE
• Native editor with syntax highlighting for 25 languages, including Swift, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP, Shell, SQL, HTML, CSS, JSON, YAML and Markdown
• Xcode, GitHub, Solarized and Monokai themes in light and dark
• A full-size editor that hides the side columns
• An optional coding symbol bar above the iPhone and iPad keyboard
• Markdown preview with headings, checklists, tables, quotes and highlighted code blocks

SECURE VAULT
• Keep API keys, tokens, passwords and secure notes out of your snippets
• Encrypted on device with AES-256. Even item titles are encrypted
• Unlock with your password, or with Face ID or Touch ID
• Forgot your password? Use your recovery key or Face ID / Touch ID to set a new one
• Copied secrets are removed from the clipboard after a minute
• Locks automatically when you leave the app

APPLE INTELLIGENCE (on supported devices)
• Explain code, find issues, or ask a question about it
• Add comments, improve code, or convert it to another language
• Generate code from a description
• Suggest a title, tags and language
Everything runs on device. Your code is never uploaded.

FREE TO TRY, PAY ONCE
• Free includes 20 snippets and 3 vault items, with every feature
• SnipShelf Pro removes the limits with a single purchase that works on iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscription

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking
• Works fully offline
• Optional iCloud sync through your private iCloud database, or keep everything on one device
• Export and import your whole library as JSON at any time

Available in English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Español and Português.

name: Snook Toy Boxes
description:
Sort toys from moving trolleys, pack matching boxes and beat the clock across 50 worlds. Trade a keepsake for extra time when a round goes down to the wire.

Description
The trolleys are rolling and the clock is ticking. Help Snook sort the toys into matching boxes before time runs out in a fast-paced sorting game across 50 worlds.

SORT, PACK AND PLAN AHEAD

Pick toys from moving trolleys and fill each box with three matching toys. As you clear a trolley, more toys are revealed. Use the spare spots to set toys aside until a matching box is ready.

KEEP IT OR TRADE IT

Collect a keepsake in each world. If time runs out, trade a keepsake for extra seconds to finish packing. Make it to the end with the keepsake and it adds bonus points to your score.

FOLLOW THE TRACKS

Follow the railway map through 50 themed worlds, from First Finds to Clockwork Tower. See how many seconds you had left when you packed the last box, then replay a world to beat your best score.

name: SnoreClip - Snore & Sleep Talk
description:
Understand your night with 100% on-device privacy. SnoreClip never uploads your audio to any server and requires no login or account.

KEY FEATURES:
• Private Overnight Acoustic Monitoring: Runs quietly in the background while your screen is locked or placed face-down, filtering out room noise and phone handling bumps.
• Interactive Blackbox Timeline: Wake up to a Snore Index (0–100), sleep phase distribution, intensity breakdown, and clickable color-coded bars for light snoring, loud snoring, sleep talk, coughs, and silent-pause + gasp markers.
• 15-Second Shareable Waveform Videos: Export sleek vertical MP4 clips with live dB meters to share with your partner.
• Lifestyle Factor Attribution: Tag factors like alcohol, nasal congestion, back sleeping, side pillow, or nasal strips before bed to measure how habits affect your snoring index over time.
• Custom A4 PDF Reports: Filter date ranges, exclude short tests, and export clean multi-night summaries to share with your physician.

SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING INFO:
SnoreClip offers free overnight tracking, morning score overview, and playback of the top 2 loudest clips per night. Upgrade to SnoreClip Pro via Weekly ($4.99/week), Annual ($24.99/year with a 7-day free trial), or Lifetime one-time purchase ($39.99).
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in iPhone Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

WELLNESS DISCLAIMER:
SnoreClip is designed strictly for personal audio journaling and general wellness tracking. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent sleep apnea or any medical condition.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://crazyspark2025.github.io/snoreclip-legal/

name: Snowbound: The Road Home
description:
Start with your hands. Find your way home.

A winter storm has buried the neighborhood. In Snowbound: The Road Home, every scoop reveals a little more of the world—and brings you closer to the lights waiting at home.

CLEAR SOMETHING REAL
Move your character, hold the work button, and watch deep snow turn into paths, driveways, and open roads. Carry your snow to a hopper for coins and experience.

BUILD YOUR OWN WAY
Earn shovels, storage, and powered equipment through play. Choose from 39 connected skills to improve clearing, carrying, unloading, and more. Better equipment opens new possibilities while your choices still matter.

BRING THE NEIGHBORHOOD BACK
Help neighbors, uncover hidden keepsakes, restore landmarks, and explore branching streets. Restore a generator to charge your character's phone and use its in-game GPS. Salt exposed roads to stop ice from slowing you down.

SETTLE INTO A SNOW DAY
Relaxing music, snow underfoot, and a camera you can rotate and pinch to zoom. Play in portrait or landscape, with graphics and sound options to suit your device.

TRY THE OPENING FREE
Play the starter block for free. One optional Full Journey purchase unlocks the rest of the adventure. Equipment and skills are earned through play—there are no paid boosts or subscriptions. Your existing progress stays with you when you unlock.

Your journey is saved on this device. Restore Purchases restores the permanent unlock on your Apple Account; it does not transfer journey progress between devices. Gameplay works offline after installation. An internet connection is needed to buy or restore the Full Journey unlock.

name: SO SWEET — World Desserts
description:
SO SWEET — World Desserts is a global pastry encyclopedia and interactive recipe companion covering 617 verified traditional and modern desserts across 116 countries.

• Interactive World Dessert Map with 116 countries across 5 continents
• 617 verified recipes with real licensed Wikimedia Commons photography and attribution
• Live portion scaling and instant Metric ↔ Imperial unit & oven temperature converter
• Transparent prep, baking, and chill/rest timing breakdown
• Interactive step-by-step checklists, verified YouTube recipe video previews, and allergen exclusion filters
• Offline PDF recipe cards, Favorites, and smart Shopping List
• 8 full languages (English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic RTL, Chinese)
• No ads, no account required, no personal data collected

Start with a 3-day free trial, then continue with a monthly or annual auto-renewable subscription managed through Apple StoreKit. Cancel anytime in your App Store settings.

name: Social Trail SOS
description:
Social Trail SOS is the safety app for trail runners, mountaineers and hikers. Ask for help in seconds, keep your medical card at hand and share your exact position with the people you choose.

SOS WITH A COUNTDOWN
• Press and hold the SOS button: a countdown starts that you can cancel if it was a mistake.
• The app gets your GPS position and opens an SMS to your emergency contacts with your location, coordinates and a map link. You tap Send.
• Then it opens the dialler with 112 (or your country's number). You confirm the call.
• It tells you honestly what has been done: it never claims something was sent unless it can confirm it.

YOUR MEDICAL CARD
• Blood type, allergies, conditions, medication, ongoing pregnancy with due date and organ donor status.
• An emergency view designed for medics and rescuers.
• Export your card as a PDF and protect it with Face ID or Touch ID if you wish.
• Optional sports federation licence, shown in the emergency view.

RACE OR TREK MODE
• Save the race, your bib number and the organiser and safety phone numbers.
• Call the organisers with one tap and send your location to the right people.
• Temporary race contacts that can delete themselves when the race is over.

LOCATION
• Coordinates, UTM, altitude and a map of your current position.
• Share your location without starting an emergency.
• GPS works without mobile data.

WIDGETS
• SOS on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.
• Quick actions, medical card and race or trek widgets.

WORKS OFFLINE
Your card, your contacts, emergency numbers by country, the first aid guide and your coordinates are available without internet. Sending SMS and calling require mobile coverage.

PRIVACY
No account, no sign-up. Your data is stored encrypted on your phone only and never leaves it unless you send an alert or export your card.

SIMULATION MODE
Practise the whole SOS without calling or sending anything.

Social Trail SOS helps you ask for help, but it does not replace emergency services. In a serious emergency, call 112.

name: SocialClip Studio
description:
SocialClip Studio turns your long videos into short, captioned vertical clips for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and Facebook.

Paste a YouTube, Twitch, Kick or Facebook link to a video you own or have rights to, or upload a video from your phone. We watch the whole video, pick the moments most likely to hold attention, and cut them into ready-to-post 9:16 clips.

WHAT YOU GET
- The best moments picked for you, each with a title and description
- Captions timed to every word, in many styles
- Smart Reframe that keeps the speaker in frame, with layouts for 1, 2 or 3 people and gaming facecams
- Silence and filler-word removal, auto-zoom and background music (Starter and Pro)
- A full editor to trim, change captions and restyle any clip
- Download clips straight to your Photos, or post and schedule them to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X
- Uploads keep going in the background, and we notify you when your clips are ready

BUILT FOR
Podcasters, streamers, coaches, churches and anyone with long videos who wants more short-form content without editing for hours.

PLANS
Start on the Free plan (3 videos a month). Starter and Pro remove the watermark and unlock more videos and features. Pro is unlimited, with no credits.

Privacy: https://socialclipstudio.com/privacy.html
Terms: https://socialclipstudio.com/terms.html

name: Sofra: Recipe Saver & Planner
description:
All your recipes in one place — and actually cooked.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE
• Recipe websites: paste or share a link and Sofra reads the recipe exactly as written.
• Videos and social posts: Sofra reads the post's caption. If the recipe is only spoken or shown, add a few screenshots.
• Photos of cookbooks and handwritten recipes, in any language.
• Nothing is invented: every ingredient and step must appear in the source. Anything we can't find in it is shown separately for you to check — never saved silently.

COOK
• Change servings and every amount follows.
• Your units: as written, metric (flour and sugar in grams) or US cups. Local measures like çay bardağı or katori convert at their real size.
• Cook mode: big steps, screen stays on, tap a time in a step to start a timer.

SHOP
• One shopping list for all your recipes, merged and grouped by aisle. Send it on WhatsApp.

SHARE WITH YOUR HOUSEHOLD
• Start a household and invite your family: one shared recipe book and shopping list. No account or email needed.
• Translate any recipe for your helper — Tagalog, Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Sinhala, Indonesian and more — with amounts checked so no number changes.

YOUR CHOICES
• An optional note when a recipe contains pork or alcohol (on by default in some countries; it never claims anything is halal).
• In English, Arabic, Turkish, Indonesian and Urdu.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Saving from websites and captions, cook mode and the shopping list are free, always. Free includes 10 AI reads and 3 translations a month. Premium (monthly, yearly with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase) gives up to 300 AI reads and 100 translations a month and lets you start a household — the people you invite join free. We remind you 2 days before a trial ends. No ads, ever.

Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your App Store settings.

name: Sokety: EV Charging
description:
Sokety is the simplest way to charge your electric car. Find a station, start charging, follow it on your phone and pay when it's done.

FREE SOCKETS ON THE MAP
See nearby stations on a live map with power, price per kWh and how many sockets are free right now. Filter for your car, fast DC or available now with one tap.

KNOW BEFORE YOU GO
Socket types (CCS2, Type 2), power, unit price, opening hours, amenities and directions on one page.

START CHARGING
Pick a socket or scan the QR code on the charger. Choose your target charge level; the estimated cost and time are shown before you start.

LIVE ON THE LOCK SCREEN
Charge level, energy delivered, power and cost on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Get notified when you reach your target and before the free waiting time ends.

RECEIPTS, INVOICES, HISTORY
Summary, receipt and invoice in the app when charging ends. Manage your vehicles, cards, promo codes and full charging history in one place.

Sokety works with stations on charging networks that run Sokety software. The app is in Turkish.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: SOME Magic-The Workshop
description:
Stage magic & illusion — not a card game.

Not all the magic. Just some.

SOME Magic is a museum and workshop of stage magic — how the classics work, when never to do them, and where the art began. Every file teaches or tells the truth about a trick, because in this app knowing it's a trick is the point. This is honest deception: the performer deceives the eye, never the person. No fraud, no fake powers, no gambling cons.

EVERY FILE, FOUR QUESTIONS
What is it? — The effect as the audience sees it, and the principle underneath: misdirection, sleight, gimmick, mathematics, psychology.
How do you do it? — The method, taught plainly for public-domain classics and historical material, with the practice path: what to drill, in what order.
When should you NOT do it? — The Code: never to defraud, never to cheat at gambling, never claiming real powers, never teaching a working professional's original material.
When did it start? — The lineage: who first performed it, when, and how it traveled to the modern repertoire.

THE SHELVES
The Classics — Cups and Balls, the French Drop, Cut and Restored Rope, the Linking Rings.
Cards — the Ambitious Card, the Svengali Deck, Card to Pocket, the Invisible Deck.
Coins & Close-Up — the Thumb Tip Vanish, Professor's Nightmare, Miser's Dream.
Mentalism — the Book Test and the séance, exposed: method and psychology, never powers.
The Stage — Pepper's Ghost, Sawing a Woman in Half, Houdini's Metamorphosis and Water Torture Cell.
The Code — the ethics of the art, and the con games (Three-Card Monte, the Shell Game) taught so you can spot them, never run them.
The Timeline — the history of the art, from an Egyptian tomb painting to the close-up era.

FREE IN THE WORKSHOP
Eight complete trick files are taught in full, free — and the Code is free forever, never paywalled. The What, When NOT, and When did it start sections of all 20 files are free on every file.

SOME MAGIC PREMIUM — THE WORKSHOP VAULT
Premium opens the full method and practice files for all 20 classics, the practice regimens, the Stage deep files, and the Document Shelf of public-domain sources — Scot, Robert-Houdin, Hoffmann, Maskelyne & Devant, Houdini.

Premium is an auto-renewable subscription: $6.99/month, or $59/year ($4.92/month) with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan. Founding offer: during the launch window, the first year of the annual plan is $39; it renews at the standard $59.

name: SOME Spells
description:
Not all the spells. Just some.

SOME Spells is a museum of spellcraft as world folklore — a multi-tradition reference work holding what the world's traditions actually wrote down: where each spell came from, how its tradition practices it, and the safety law that travels with it, kept in one place and told straight.

Every working in these halls is presented as its tradition teaches it — attributed to its culture and its sources, documented, and never asserted by this app as fact. The app documents belief; it does not promise outcomes, and it aims nothing at anyone.

EVERY FILE, FOUR QUESTIONS
What is it? — the spell as its tradition understands it: its purpose inside that culture, its words, its materials, its moment.
How do you do it? — the practice as documented in the historical or traditional source, attributed and framed: what practitioners do, in the record's own terms.
When should you NOT do it? — the Safety Law, printed on every file: nothing is ever ingested, fire safety for every candle and burning rite, no working aimed at a named living person, no spell standing in for medicine, law, or money counsel, and closed traditions presented as history, not extraction.
When did it start? — the provenance: the oldest surviving source, who wrote it down, and how the working traveled — tablet to papyrus to grimoire to grandmother to phone.

THE SEVEN SHELVES
The Ancient World — Egyptian charms, Greek and Roman curse tablets, the Greek Magical Papyri.
Charms of the North & Fields — the Nine Herbs Charm, Æcerbot the field remedy, Icelandic staves, bind runes.
The Grimoires — the Key of Solomon, the Picatrix, the Hygromanteia.
Folk Magic of America — the honey jar, the mojo hand, psalm magic, the Long Lost Friend.
Charms of Europe & the Mediterranean — lifting the evil eye, Aradia and the strega tradition, the whispered zagovory.
Charms of Asia — ofuda and omamori, Japan's inscribed protections.
The Modern Craft — the Gardnerian Book of Shadows and the 20th-century revival, honestly dated.

FREE IN THE MUSEUM
Eight files are free and complete, and the What, Safety, and When-it-started sections of all 20 files are always free. The Safety Law is free in full, forever — safety is never paywalled.

SOME SPELLS PREMIUM — THE GRIMOIRE VAULT
Premium opens every file in full: all 20 files complete with the documented practice, source-by-source provenance, and the Record on every one; the Document Shelf of tablets, papyri, and manuscript pages (public-domain heritage); new tradition drops; offline reading; and bookmarks.

name: Sonify Sound
description:
Sonify masks the noise in your room. The Sonify base station's pods stick to the wall, window, ceiling or floor the noise comes through, and play a masking sound that blends traffic, footsteps and voices into the background.

Set up in minutes
• Plug in your base station and hold its button. The app finds it over Bluetooth, installs its latest software and connects it to your home Wi-Fi.
• A short guided setup asks about your room and the surfaces the noise comes through, shows where Sonify and its pods go, and tests each pod before you stick it down.

Three masking sounds
• Deep Masking for low noise: footsteps, bass and rumble.
• Full Range Masking for everyday noise: traffic, voices and TV.
• Pitched Masking for higher sounds.
Soft hum, pink, brown and more are there too.

Everyday control
• Turn masking on and off, and set its level with one dial.
• A lamp you can dim and color.
• Wake light: a sunrise on the lamp at the times and days you choose, and a wind down at night.
• More than one base station? Switch between them from the top of the screen and see what each one is doing.

Private by design
The app talks only to your base station, on your home Wi-Fi. No account, no sign-in, and no data collected.

Requires a Sonify base station. Learn more at trysonify.com.

name: Sort Animals Story
description:
Help Pokke the hedgehog lend a hand in a little woodland town. Sort Animals Story is a cozy sorting puzzle where you match three items on a plate and uncover the next part of an illustrated animal story.

MEET POKKE AND HIS NEIGHBORS
As the bakery opens and the post office starts its rounds, Pokke sets out to see his friends. Lulu the rabbit is getting ready for a drawing party, but her paper and colored pencils haven't arrived. On another day, a little squirrel's backpack strap breaks on the way to share snacks at the square. Follow Pokke's conversations to find out how you can help.

SORT ITEMS AND MAKE A TRIPLE MATCH
Move items from plate to plate and put three identical items on one plate to make a match. Use the open spots to organize the board and make room for your next move. It's easy to get started, and choosing which items to sort first makes each puzzle a little different. If you enjoy sorting games and casual match-3 puzzles, the rules will feel familiar from the first round.

FIVE PUZZLES, ONE STORY
Each chapter gives Pokke a different problem to solve. The story tells you what your animal friends need, from drawing paper to a tape measure at the repair shop. Clear the next puzzle to see what happens when Pokke brings them what they need. The fifth puzzle leads to the chapter's ending, followed by an illustration and Pokke's stamp in an open storybook.

TAKE A BREAK IN A STORYBOOK TOWN
Play a quick matching puzzle when you have a moment, or follow Pokke from the post office to the forest square and finish a whole chapter. It's a relaxing puzzle game for anyone who enjoys cute animal characters and cozy everyday stories.

name: Sortlicious
description:
Sortlicious'a hoş geldin! Rengârenk tatlıları raflara diz, aynı üç tatlıyı yan yana getir ve rafları boşalt.

• 14 dünyada 140 bölüm: Pastane Sokağı'ndan Kış Pastanesi'ne, Lokum Çarşısı'ndan Kristal Mağara'ya.
