name: Soul Experience
description:
Soul Experience is Michael Armstrong's members app for past life healing and soul growth.

INSIDERS
Hear from Michael directly. He shares audio messages, videos, thoughts, polls and questions, grouped by day like a private channel. Turn on alerts to know the moment something new is posted. Vote in polls, answer Michael's questions privately, and join the conversation when comments are open.

YOUR LIBRARY
Everything you have with Soul Experience, in one place:
• Regressions: guided past life journeys
• Soul Awakening: your monthly course
• Happenings: upcoming live events and replays
• My Reports: your readings and reports
• My Library: your courses, journeys and audio bundles

MADE FOR LISTENING
Regressions and audio messages keep playing in the background and can be controlled from your lock screen or headphones.

Sign in with your Soul Experience account to get started.

name: SoundRefine
description:
SoundRefine is a recording and editing studio for singers and instrumentalists. Record a vocal warm-up, a violin étude or a piano rehearsal, or bring in a performance video you already have. Recording, pitch correction, editing and export all run on your device. No account is required.

Record and compare takes
Record an original take for unaccompanied singing or a fast instrumental passage, then open the pitch editor to fine-tune it. For a slower, single-note instrumental performance, you can also record with live pitch correction. Set your A4 reference and correction strength before you play. In live correction mode, SoundRefine keeps both the original and the corrected take so you can listen to each and choose which to edit.

Shape a singing voice
Start with the vocal settings in One-Tap Sound Refinement, then listen as you adjust them. Soften sharp S sounds, reduce low-frequency microphone pops and bring quiet phrases closer in level to louder ones. Use vocal-priority reverb to give a held note room to ring while keeping the next lyric clear.

Work on individual notes
Open the pitch graph to see how a solo melody moves within each note. Compare the original and corrected sound, adjust individual notes and choose whether to straighten pitch drift on selected sustained notes. For a fast instrumental passage, use the original take and run note analysis to look more closely at short notes. Pitch correction is designed for an unaccompanied solo voice or an instrument playing one note at a time.

Choose the tone and the room
For bowed strings, soften bow noise or tame a harsh upper register. For piano, reduce low-mid buildup and bring out the attack. Shape the balance with EQ and compression, then blend the direct sound, early reflections and reverb tail. Compare the result with the original as you listen.

Change key or practice tempo
Transpose in semitone steps. Slow down a difficult phrase or fit a performance to a specific duration using the speed slider or target time. Turn on pitch preservation to practice in the original key. For video, choose whether the picture follows the tempo change.

Edit and export
Trim a count-in or a long pause, cut a section on the waveform, or insert a new recording at the cursor. Edits to a video soundtrack can follow through to the picture. Export the original or processed audio as WAV, FLAC, M4A or MP3, or save a video with its edited soundtrack.

On iPhone Duo, switch effects on the outer display, then unfold to see the preview and playback controls alongside the effect settings.

name: Souq Tycoon
description:
Start with a tiny corner shop and grow it into a supermarket empire.

Shoppers drive in, fill their baskets and queue at your tills. Every sale pays for the next upgrade: open new departments, hire staff, add checkouts and watch the money roll in, even while you are away.

BUILD YOUR STORE
• 11 departments, from Fresh Produce and Bakery to Frozen Foods, Snacks and Health & Beauty
• Up to 8 checkouts to keep the queues moving
• A bigger car park brings more shoppers through the door

WATCH IT GROW
• Your shop changes as you earn stars: corner shop, neighbourhood market, supermarket, hypermarket and finally a marble-floored flagship
• Put your own name on the sign out front

RUN IT YOUR WAY
• Hire staff and speed up every aisle
• Unload delivery trucks, welcome VIP shoppers and bus tours
• Complete goals for coins and gems
• Earn while you are offline, then collect when you return

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Plays fully offline
• No ads
• Available in English, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish and Traditional Chinese

Souq Tycoon is free to play. Optional in-app purchases are available.

name: Sourdough Starter: Bake Timer
description:
Sourdough timing that follows your kitchen, not a generic recipe clock.

Answer a short quiz to get a personal plan, then go from the first feed to a loaf out of the oven.

WHAT YOU GET
• A day-by-day plan to build a new starter or keep an active one
• Feed log at 1:1:1, 1:2:2 or 1:5:5 with peak notes, several starters and fridge mode
• Hydration calculator in baker's percentages that counts the water in your starter (100% or 50%), for 1 to 6 loaves
• Bake Day timeline: feed, autolyse, bulk, shape, cold proof and bake, timed from your dough temperature
• Optional local reminders
• Bake journal with a photo and a guided crumb checklist with fixes for your next bake

GOOD TO KNOW
Timings are estimates that depend on your kitchen temperature and flour. Judge your dough by how it looks, not by the clock alone. No account needed. Your starter log, recipes, journal photos and notes stay on your device, and the app works offline. The app is available in English, Arabic and Spanish.

SUBSCRIPTION
Sourdough Starter needs a subscription: weekly with a 3-day free trial, or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID account settings.

LEGAL
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://sourdough.reworked.dev/terms
• Privacy Policy: https://sourdough.reworked.dev/privacy
• Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Southern City Plus
description:
Southern City Plus is the home of Southern City Studios on iPhone: every music video and song in one place, made for members.

WATCH AND LISTEN
Music videos in full quality, or switch to audio only with one tap. Playback keeps going in the background and on the Lock Screen, with Control Centre controls and AirPlay. Picture in Picture keeps the video with you while you use other apps.

SYNCED LYRICS
Sing along with lyrics that follow the song line by line, on the Now Playing screen or full screen.

BROWSE YOUR WAY
A home screen of new releases, featured videos and collections, quick search, and browse by type: music videos, songs, ambient, seasonal and more.

YOUR LIBRARY
Sort by recent, newest or title, filter by type and jump back into what you played recently.

QUEUE, SHUFFLE AND REPEAT
Build a queue, shuffle a collection or put a favourite on repeat. Songs play on automatically.

JOIN THE CONVERSATION
Leave comments on releases and see what other members think. Report or block anyone, any time.

ALWAYS FRESH
New releases from Southern City Studios appear automatically, with no app update needed.

Sign in with your existing Southern City Studios account. No ads and no tracking.

name: SoveliaNarmuk
description: Air classifier calculator: airflow, rotor, cut, capacity and costs.

name: Spaltenwerk
description:
Plan your day, organize projects with Kanban, and see what you need at each store. Spaltenwerk brings it all together in one iPhone app.

My Day
Capture tasks in your inbox and choose what you want to do today. Due tasks and suggestions from yesterday appear in My Day. Use checklists, reminders, and repeats to keep track of recurring work.

Projects and files
Switch between a list and a Kanban board, create your own columns, and move tasks by dragging them. Store PDFs, photos, and documents in a project and link the same file to multiple tasks or checklist items.

Shop by store
Add items with quantities and stores. Filter your list while you shop and check off what’s in the cart. Add a frequently purchased item again with its last quantity and store. Use Siri or Shortcuts to capture tasks and shopping items on the go.

Work together
Share selected projects and shopping lists through Apple iCloud. Assign tasks and open Assigned to Me to see what you’re responsible for. Your My Day selections and personal reminders stay private.

Works offline, optional iCloud
Use Spaltenwerk offline, without ads, tracking, or a separate account. You can choose to sync private content across your Apple devices through iCloud. Export or restore private projects, tasks, and project files with a JSON backup.

name: Spare Sheet: Bowling Tracker
description:
Find the spares that are costing you pins.

Built for league bowlers: your average lives and dies on spares. Spare Sheet shows you which ones, and helps you fix them.

Tap the pins left standing after each ball. Spare Sheet keeps the official score and remembers every leave you faced: the 10 pin, the 3-6-10, the 7-10. Over a few league nights you'll see exactly where your pins are going.

SCORE A GAME IN SECONDS
• A big ten-pin deck you can tap, laid out the way you see it from the approach.
• One tap for a strike or a spare. Tap the leftover pins for anything else.
• A traditional scoresheet with running totals, tenth-frame bonus balls, and splits circled.
• Undo the last ball any time, and pick up an unfinished game later.
• Tag each game League, Practice, or Open play.

SPARE REPORT
• Conversion rates for all spares, single pins, multi-pin leaves, and splits.
• Every leave you've faced, most frequent first, with how often you made it.
• Last 10 games, last 30, or your whole history, for league games, practice, or everything.
• Average, high game, and strike rate at a glance.

SPARE DRILL
• Spare Sheet picks the leaves that cost you the most pins in real games.
• At practice, throw at a full rack along the spare line for that leave and tap Made or Missed.
• See this session's result and your all-time drill rate for each leave.

ONE PRICE, NO LIMITS
No subscription, no game limit, no ads, and no account. Your games stay on your iPhone, and the app works even with no signal inside the bowling center.

Splits follow the USBC definition: the head pin is down and a gap separates the pins left standing.

name: Speed Reading: Readgauge
description:
Read a short passage, answer one question, and Readgauge shows your reading speed in words per minute and how much you understood.
Then train with short RSVP sessions: words appear one at a time in the same spot, starting at the pace you measured.
Your pace moves up a little each day only when your comprehension answer is right, and every session lands on one simple graph.

HOW IT WORKS
• Check your speed: read a 100-word passage at your normal pace, tap Done, then answer one question about it. You see your words per minute and your comprehension result.
• Daily session: one built-in passage shown word by word (RSVP) with a focus letter that keeps your eyes still. Pause any time.
• One question at the end of every session. A right answer moves tomorrow's pace up by a small step. Two misses in a row bring it back down.
• Your 4-week plan shows the target pace for each week, recalculated from where you are today.
• The history graph shows every session: pace, and whether you got the question right.
• Pace range from 60 to 900 words per minute, so you can start slowly.

READ WITHOUT IMPORTS
Every passage is built in: short original pieces on science, history, nature and everyday life, written for the app. Nothing to upload, no files, no account.

GOOD TO KNOW
Readgauge is a reading practice tool. Results depend on the person and the text; the plan shows target paces, not promised results. Everything stays on your iPhone: no account, no servers, no tracking.

SUBSCRIPTION
Readgauge is a subscription app. After your speed check, you choose a weekly, monthly or annual plan to unlock daily RSVP sessions, the 4-week plan and your history graph. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

Privacy policy and terms of use are linked inside the app.

name: Spell Ready: Spelling Practice
description:
Spell Ready helps children practise the spelling words every primary school in England teaches in Years 3 to 6.

Each word is read aloud, then used in a sentence, then read again, just like a spelling test at school. Your child types the word, checks it, and learns from any mistakes.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Both statutory word lists: Years 3 and 4, and Years 5 and 6
• Every word read aloud with an example sentence
• Look, cover, try again: see the right spelling, then have another go
• Words to try again: brings back the ones your child got wrong
• Choose 5, 10, 15 or 20 words each go
• Pick a voice: female or male, or a fun robot, mouse or giant
• Normal or slow speed
• Autocorrect is switched off, so the keyboard can't do the spelling for them

FOR GROWN-UPS
• See progress through each word list at a glance
• A list of the words to practise
• Clear progress at any time

NO ADS. NO ACCOUNT. NO TRACKING.
Spell Ready collects no data at all. Progress stays on your phone. One price, everything included.

Word lists from the National Curriculum in England, used under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Spell Ready is not made by or linked to the Department for Education.

Made in the UK by Coffeehouse Productions.
Questions or ideas? support@coffeehouseproductions.co.uk

name: Spiro Rhythm
description:
Four seconds in. Six seconds out. With Spiro, you can hear when to breathe and leave the screen behind.

Pick a rhythm for calm, focus, balance or bedtime. See how long it takes, try it once, then save it to one of ten slots. Build your own pattern with separate timings for each inhale, exhale, hold and recovery.

Listen your way. Choose a guide voice or a few musical notes, add an ambient track, and lock your phone. The session keeps playing offline. Prefer a visual cue? The color lamp changes as each phase unfolds.

For dry apnea practice, explore progressive holds, CO₂ and O₂ tables, warm-ups and recovery intervals. Preview every round before you start. Practice seated or lying down on land, and breathe whenever you need to.

Your log remembers the rhythm, rounds and listening time. Revisit a session, use its settings again or export your history. On iPad, turn the screen sideways for the timer and controls side by side.

Find shared exercises on the recipe Board. Open a recipe to inspect its timing, save it, or send a friend the same rhythm with a link or QR code.

Every exercise is free. An optional coffee supports development.

name: Sportcentrum Putten
description:
PLEASE NOTE: YOU NEED A Sportcentrum Putten ACCOUNT TO ACCESS THIS APP. IF YOU'RE A MEMBER GET IT FOR FREE AT YOUR GYM!
 
Begin your journey to a healthier lifestyle and let Sportcentrum Putten help you along the way. Introducing  Sportcentrum Putten, most comprehensive fitness platform with:

• Check class schedules and opening hours
• Track your daily fitness activities
• Track your weight and other body metrics
• Over 2000+ exercises and activities
• Clear 3D exercise demonstrations
• Preset workouts and the option to create your own
• Over 150 badges to earn

Select workouts online and synchronize them with your app to workout at home or in the gym while keeping track of your progress. From strength to weight lifting, this app acts as your own personal trainer guiding and giving you the motivation you need.

You can sync this app with Apple Health App. If you enable this connection, any workout in the Health app with automatically be added to your Activity Calendar.

name: Spoutsong: Looper & Recorder
description:
Spoutsong turns your phone into a looper for practice. Play or sing a phrase into the microphone, and it repeats in a tight loop on the beat. Add a bass line, chords, a beatbox groove or a harmony on top, one layer at a time, then play or sing over the whole thing.

LOOPS THAT STAY ON THE BEAT
- Every layer lands exactly on the bar, with no gap where the loop starts again
- Count-in and a big beat light, so you know when to start
- Delay compensation set for your phone, with an optional click test and a manual fine-tune
- Tempo mode (set BPM, meter and bars) or Open mode (your first layer sets the length)
- New layers can be 1x, 2x or 4x as long as the first one

RECORD WITHOUT FUSS
- Start on sound: Open mode waits until you play
- A Bluetooth page-turner pedal or keyboard can start a layer, undo and stop
- Up to 3 passes per layer: keep the best take
- Input meter with a clip warning

SHAPE THE MIX
- Level, pan, mute and solo for each layer
- Undo the last pass, trim an open loop, nudge a layer by milliseconds
- Practice speed from 50% to 100% without changing pitch

KEEP PRACTISING
- Journal with your practice minutes for the week and an optional weekly goal
- A Jam Card each day with a tempo, meter and idea to build a loop around
- Optional practice reminder

SHARE IT
- Export the mix as M4A to Files or any app

SPOUTSONG PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
- 8 layers instead of 4
- Master effects: 3-band EQ, delay and reverb
- WAV 24-bit export and separate stems for each layer

Spoutsong records live microphone audio. Your recordings stay on your device. No account, no ads.
Wired headphones or the built-in speaker give the tightest timing. Bluetooth headphones work for listening; the iPhone microphone records.

name: Sprossen
description:
Sprossen ist dein liebevoll gezeichnetes Tagebuch für Sprossen und Microgreens – im Glas, in der Schale oder in Erde. Die App sagt dir, wann du spülen, ans Licht stellen und ernten musst – und die kleinen Gläser freuen sich mit dir.

NIE WIEDER VERGESSEN ZU SPÜLEN
• Erinnerungen genau zu deinen Spülzeiten – mehrere Gläser in einer Mitteilung
• Mit „Gespült“ direkt in der Mitteilung abhaken, auch auf der Apple Watch
• Hinweise, wenn das Einweichen fertig ist, es ans Licht geht und die Ernte reif ist

46 SORTEN IM LEXIKON
Von Mungbohne über Brokkoli und Alfalfa bis Rucola, Linsen und Sonnenblume: Für jede Sorte gibt es Einweichzeit, Spülrhythmus, Dunkelphase, Erntefenster, Geschmack, Inhaltsstoffe, Küchentipps und wichtige Hinweise – zum Beispiel, welche Sprossen du besser blanchierst.

ANSETZEN IN VIER SCHRITTEN
Ausrüstung wählen, Sorte oder Mischung aussuchen, Gefäß festlegen, los geht’s. Keimglas, Keimschale, Sieb, Tonschale oder Erdschale für Microgreens – die App passt Pflege und Erinnerungen daran an.

EIGENE MISCHUNGEN
Stell dir deine Lieblingsmischung zusammen. Sprossen prüft, ob die Sorten zusammen keimen können, und schlägt passende Partner vor. Sechs fertige Rezepte zum Übernehmen sind schon dabei.

SCHIMMEL ODER WURZELHAARE?
27 bebilderte Artikel erklären alles rund ums Keimen: Grundlagen, Hygiene, Licht und Dunkel, Ernten und Aufbewahren. Der Problemlöser hilft mit wenigen Fragen, wenn etwas komisch aussieht oder riecht.

TAGEBUCH & SAMMELALBUM
Halte jede Ernte mit Foto, Sternen und Notiz fest. Für jede geerntete Sorte klebt ein Sticker in dein Sammelalbum, dazu gibt es Abzeichen zu entdecken. Und bei der Ernte gibt es ein kleines Fest.

MIT HERZ GEZEICHNET
Jedes Glas wächst mit: Im Dunkeln trägt es eine Schlafmütze, nach dem Spülen jubelt es, und wenn es Durst hat, siehst du es ihm an.

PRIVAT VON ANFANG AN
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Deine Daten bleiben auf deinem Gerät.

SPROSSEN PRO – EINMAL ZAHLEN, FÜR IMMER
Kostenlos kannst du zwei Ansätze gleichzeitig ziehen und alle Sorten, Erinnerungen, Tagebuch und Sammelalbum nutzen. Mit Sprossen Pro bekommst du einmalig und ohne Abo:
• unbegrenzt viele Ansätze
• eigene Mischungen
• alle Wissensartikel und den Problemlöser
• Statistik im Tagebuch
• Widget für den Homescreen
• Abgleich über dein privates iCloud

Die Angaben sind Richtwerte für die Anzucht zu Hause und ersetzen keine ärztliche Beratung.

name: SPTQuest: SPT-N & Liquefaction
description:
SPTQuest is an all-in-one, offline-first geotechnical engineering and subsurface investigation suite built for field geologists, geotechnical engineers, structural engineers, and civil engineering teams.

Instead of switching between separate borehole loggers, spreadsheets, and desktop calculators, SPTQuest unifies the entire field-to-report workflow inside a single project—from raw SPT blow counts at the drill rig to seismic liquefaction curves, foundation bearing capacity, settlement checks, retaining wall stability, and client-ready PDF/AGS 4.1 deliverables.

4-STEP FIELD-TO-REPORT WORKFLOW:

1. PROJECT & BOREHOLE LOGGING (SK-1, SK-2...)
• Multi-project and multi-borehole management saved automatically offline on your device
• One-tap GPS coordinates (latitude/longitude) and parcel/site metadata
• Depth-based stratigraphy with USCS soil classifications (GW, GP, GM, GC, SW, SP, SM, SC, ML, CL, MH, CH) and built-in USCS reference guide
• Unit weights (gamma, gamma_sat), Fines Content (FC%), Plasticity Index (PI), and Groundwater Table (WT) tracking
• Real-time Graphic Borehole Log displaying USCS soil columns, water table line, raw SPT-N, and corrected (N1)60cs depth profiles

2. COMPLETE SPT-N CORRECTION ENGINE (ASTM D1586)
• Enter N15, N30, N45 blow counts and compute raw N = N30 + N45 automatically
• Full correction factors:
  - CN (Overburden Stress Correction: Idriss & Boulanger 2008 iterative or Liao & Whitman)
  - CE (Hammer Energy Ratio: Donut, Safety, Automatic, or Custom)
  - CB (Borehole Diameter), CR (Rod Length), CS (Sampler Liner)
• Instant outputs: total & effective vertical stress (sigma_v, sigma'_v), N60, (N1)60, clean-sand equivalent (N1)60cs, Relative Density (Dr%), Effective Friction Angle (phi'), and Undrained Shear Strength (cu)

3. SEISMIC LIQUEFACTION ANALYSIS (IDRISS & BOULANGER 2008)
• Interactive Earthquake Magnitude (Mw) and Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) controls
• Depth-by-depth computation of rd, Cyclic Stress Ratio (CSR), Magnitude Scaling Factor (MSF), K_sigma, CRR7.5, adjusted CRR, and Factor of Safety (FS_liq = CRR / CSR)
• Automatic non-liquefiable screening for cohesive soils (PI >= 7) and dense strata above water table
• Iwasaki Liquefaction Potential Index (LPI) with color-coded risk classification (Very Low / Low / High / Very High)
• Side-by-side CSR vs CRR and FS_liq = 1.0 threshold depth charts

4. FOUNDATION, SETTLEMENT & RETAINING WALL SUITE
• Auto-Fill from Active Borehole: transfer representative phi', cu, gamma, water table, and Es from your borehole in one tap
• Bearing Capacity: Terzaghi (1943), Meyerhof (1963), and Vesic (1973) for strip, square, rectangular, and circular footings with water table, eccentricity, and inclination effects (qu, qa, ks)
• Settlement Analysis: Elastic immediate settlement (Boussinesq & Schmertmann 1978) + 1D Primary Consolidation (Cc, Cr, e0, sigma'_p) with automatic SAFE / RISKY limit verification
• Retaining Wall & Slope Stability: Rankine Ka/Kp, Mononobe-Okabe seismic active thrust (Kae), sliding & overturning FoS, and Infinite Slope FoS with parallel seepage option

5. PROFESSIONAL PDF REPORTS & DESKTOP ROUND-TRIP
• One-tap multi-page PDF Geotechnical Report with custom company logo, summary tables, and vector FS_liq depth plots
• Industry-standard AGS 4.1 (PROJ, LOCA, GEOL, ISPT), CSV, and JSON export AND import—start a project on desktop software, continue logging in the field, and export back seamlessly
• 100% offline-first, 32 languages, Metric (SI) and Imperial (US) units, Light & Dark field modes

name: Star Route EV
description:
Star Route EV plans your electric car trips. Choose your vehicle, origin, destination and current charge, and the app calculates the route, charging stops, total time, estimated cost and the battery you arrive with.

WHAT IT DOES
- Trip plan with charging stops that match your car's connector and charging power.
- Estimated battery on arrival at each stop and at your destination, including route weather and elevation.
- Charging cost with your own rates, compared with a gasoline car.
- Charger map from OpenStreetMap with connector and power filters, plus community reports.
- Send the route to Google Maps, Apple Maps or Waze before you leave.
- Vehicle catalog with reference figures, manual entry or AI entry from a spec sheet.
- Assistant that explains your plan, by text or voice (dictation is done by your phone).
- Save trips and export them as GPX or CSV.
- 11 languages, light and dark mode, two-step verification.

HONEST DATA
Chargers come from open sources with partial coverage and no live status from operators: always check before you leave and keep a battery margin. If there is no safe plan, the app tells you and never makes up stops.

PREMIUM
Star Route EV Premium gives you unlimited plans, AI vehicle entry, charging log, fleet mode, trip sharing, offline plan and real consumption with calibration. Monthly and yearly plans are available, with 3 months free for new subscribers. The price is shown in your local currency before you confirm. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and the subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period; you can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

You can delete your account at any time from Settings.

Terms of Use: https://starrouteev.starapps.app/terminos
Privacy Policy: https://starrouteev.starapps.app/privacidad

name: Star Voyaging
description: Star Voyaging is a constrained viewport navigation puzzle. A fixed circular porthole masks the vast star map. Rotate the starfield to guide the target star to the center crosshair, while ensuring the flight path avoids hazardous reefs. You only see the partial view inside the window and must deduce the whole layout.

name: Starquilt: Star Battle Puzzle
description:
Starquilt is a calm Star Battle logic puzzle. Place stars so that every row, every column and every outlined patch of the quilt holds the same number of stars, and no two stars touch, not even diagonally.

Every puzzle in Starquilt has exactly one solution, proven by an exhaustive solver, and can be finished by deduction alone: you never have to guess.

FREE
• A new daily puzzle every day
• The first 10 puzzles of every size and difficulty band

STARQUILT PRO (one-time purchase)
• The rest of the library: 1,894 puzzles in all, from 6×6 to 10×10, with one-star and two-star grids, in up to five difficulty bands
• The daily archive: play any past daily

MADE TO BE PLAYED
• Tap to cycle a cell between empty, a dot and a star; drag to mark a whole row with dots
• Unlimited, instant undo and redo
• Six short lessons teach every technique the puzzles need, each on a moment from a real puzzle
• Hints that start from your own grid and explain the next logical step
• Your progress is saved on every move, so leaving the app never loses a puzzle
• Streaks counted from the puzzles you actually solved

FOR EVERY PLAYER
• Patches are told apart by pattern and border, not color alone
• VoiceOver labels on every cell, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion and dark mode

No ads. No account. No tracking. Works offline.

A Softlatch game.

name: Startblock
description:
O Startblock liga o iPhone a um bloco de partida instrumentado, por Bluetooth, e regista a força que o atleta aplica no bloco durante a saída.

Foi desenvolvido para o LaBioCoM, Laboratório de Biomecânica e Controle Motor, como ferramenta de apoio à investigação e ao treino de partidas de velocidade.

O QUE PODE FAZER
• Ligar ao bloco de partida por Bluetooth, sem cabos.
• Definir a duração da coleta, entre 10 e 50 segundos, e iniciá-la a partir do telemóvel.
• Acompanhar o estado do bloco e o progresso da coleta em tempo real.
• Ver o gráfico da força ao longo do tempo e tocar em qualquer ponto para ler o valor nesse instante.
• Consultar o pico de força e o instante em que ocorreu, o mínimo, a média e o desvio padrão.
• Guardar cada coleta num ficheiro CSV, acessível na app Ficheiros, para análise noutros programas.
• Gerir as coletas guardadas e eliminá-las quando já não forem precisas.

COMO FUNCIONA
O bloco mede a força com uma célula de carga, 80 vezes por segundo. No fim da coleta envia os dados para o iPhone, que os guarda e mostra em gráfico.

REQUISITOS
Esta app precisa do bloco de partida instrumentado do projeto Startblock. Sem o equipamento não é possível fazer coletas; continua a ser possível consultar coletas já guardadas no dispositivo.

Os dados ficam no seu dispositivo. A app não exige conta nem início de sessão.

name: Steel Frontline WW2
description:
STEEL FRONTLINE WW2 is a real-time tank tactics game set in the North African desert, 1941–1943. Take command of the German Afrika Korps, build your own battlegroup and fight from the sands of Libya to the passes of Tunisia, on iPhone and iPad.

NO ADS. NO IN-APP PURCHASES. PAY ONCE, PLAY EVERYTHING.

THE BATTLEGROUP SYSTEM
Before every battle you design your own battlegroup, a deck of up to 40 points built from real units of the Afrika Korps. Every card sits in a slot, and every slot has a price.
• Phases A, B and C: a battle is fought in three phases. Cards placed in Phase A are available from the first minute. Cards placed in Phase B or C arrive later, but you can field more copies of them. Strike early with a few units, or wait and bring up a massive late force. You decide the timing of the whole battle.
• Eight categories: Recon, Infantry, Tank, Support, Anti-Tank, Anti-Air, Artillery and Air. Build a fast armoured fist, a defensive gun line, or a balanced force.
• Start from a ready-made battlegroup such as Panzergruppe Afrika (Armoured Fist) or Festung Afrika (Fortified Defence), or design your own from scratch.

THE TANKS
• Light tanks: Panzer II F, the quick scout that opens the battle.
• Medium tanks: Panzer III J, L and N, and Panzer IV F2 and G, the long-barrelled workhorses of the desert war and much many more!
• Assault guns: StuG III G, a low, tough and deadly ambusher.
• Heavy armour: the mighty Tiger I, which dominates the battlefield, but costs a lot.
• Armoured cars and half-tracks: Sd.Kfz. 222 and 232 recon cars, plus Panzergrenadiers riding into battle.
Armour thickness, gun penetration, range, cover and crew morale all matter. A well-placed anti-tank gun can stop a column of tanks, and a flanking Panzer can win the day.

FIGHT THE WHOLE WAR
• Support your tanks with the PaK 38 anti-tank gun, the legendary 88 mm FlaK, howitzers, mortars and machine-gun teams.
• Call in Stuka dive bombers and Bf 109 fighter patrols, and keep your own anti-aircraft ready, because the RAF owns the sky.
• Manage your hangar, send aircraft to your target, recall them, and watch them land and refuel.

GAME MODES
• Campaign: historical missions through the desert war, with real battle briefings. Earn bronze, silver and gold trophies for winning on Medium, Hard and Very Hard.
• Custom Battle: defend, assault or fight a meeting engagement with your own battlegroup against the AI.
• Co-op multiplayer: team up with a friend on the same Wi-Fi.
• Training: Feldwebel Brandt teaches you everything, step by step.

BUILT FOR TOUCH
• Tap, drag and pinch to command your forces on a large tactical map, with groups, orders and a minimap.
• Pause, normal, fast and very fast speed.
• Graphics from Low to Ultra with an Auto mode, built to run smoothly on your device.
• Atmospheric battle music, with three tracks to choose from.

Rommel is waiting for your orders, Commander.

name: Stenora
description:
Η Stenora είναι εργαλείο πάγκου για γραμμές παραγωγής: υπολογίζει το τάκτ του πελάτη, βρίσκει το στενωπό και δείχνει αν η βάρδια βγάζει τα προγραμματισμένα τεμάχια.

Για ποιον είναι
Μηχανικούς γραμμής, συμβούλους lean και υπεύθυνους βάρδιας που μετράνε κύκλο, setup και απόδοση — χωρίς Excel στην τσέπη.

Τι σου δίνει
• Τάκτ πελάτη = διαθέσιμα λεπτά βάρδιας ÷ ζήτηση
• Ενεργός κύκλος ανά σταθμό (κύκλος, setup, παράλληλοι, απόδοση)
• Στενωπό, ισορροπία γραμμής, τεμάχια/ώρα και έλλειμμα βάρδιας
• Υγεία γραμμής 0–100 και κινήσεις kaizen με μετρήσιμο κέρδος
• What-if: δοκίμασε κύκλο, setup, απόδοση ή παράλληλο πόστο πριν το γράψεις
• Ιστορικό στιγμιοτύπων, σύγκριση και αναφορά για την ομάδα

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς
1. Φτιάξε έργο: όνομα, λεπτά βάρδιας, τεμάχια ανά βάρδια.
2. Πρόσθεσε σταθμούς με κύκλο, setup, παράλληλα πόστα και απόδοση καλών.
3. Δες στη Ροή το στενωπό, το Yamazumi και αν η βάρδια καλύπτει τη ζήτηση.
4. Τρέξε What-if ή πάτα μια πρόταση kaizen. Αν στέκει, γράψ’ το στη γραμμή.
5. Καταγραφή για ιστορικό, μοίρασε την αναφορά από τα Άλλα.

Τα δεδομένα μένουν στη συσκευή. Χωρίς λογαριασμό, χωρίς δίκτυο, χωρίς παρακολούθηση. iOS 15 και νεότερα.

name: Stepladder: Daily Step Goal
description:
A step counter with a daily step goal that rises a little every day.

Stepladder raises your daily step goal by a fixed amount you choose. Start at 6,000, add 100 a day, and tomorrow is 6,100, then 6,200, then 6,300. It never looks at an average of your steps, so your goal never quietly drops after an easy day. Tomorrow's goal is always on the Today screen.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a start goal and a daily step: +25, +50, +100, +250 or your own number
• Hit your goal and the rung is painted. Tomorrow's goal rises by exactly that step
• Set a summit to stop at, such as 10,000 steps, or climb with no limit
• Choose what a missed day does: Hold the goal, or Keep climbing
• Rest days and days with no step data are never counted as a miss

WHAT YOU GET
• Today: live steps, how many to go, and tomorrow's goal if you hit and if you don't
• Your climb: a chart of every goal and every day, with the date you reach your summit
• Days: a history of each day's goal and steps, with rest days marked
• Steps come from Apple Health (read only) or from the iPhone motion sensor
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking. Your steps never leave your phone

FREE AND PRO
Free: the whole ladder (start goal, daily step, summit), Hold and Keep climbing, tomorrow's goal, streaks, 2 rest days a month and the last 14 days of history.
Pro adds Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, the Step back rule, unlimited rest days and Pause, your full history and a target-by-date planner.

STEPLADDER PRO (auto-renewing subscription): Monthly or Yearly (3-day free trial on Yearly for new subscribers), or Lifetime as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Stepladder is a goal-setting tool, not a medical device, and gives no medical advice.

Privacy Policy: https://jigsawlab.com/apps/stepladder/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://jigsawlab.com/apps/stepladder/terms.html

name: Steps Performing Arts School
description:
The official app of Steps Performing Arts School in Zouk Mosbeh, Lebanon.

See the week's classes, book your spot in a tap and keep track of your pack, for you and for your kids.

BOOK IN SECONDS
• The full timetable: ballet, jazz, contemporary, tap, hip-hop, commercial heels, tango, musical theatre, singing, acting, pole, aerial hoop and silks, gymnastics, and classes for the little ones.
• Book your spot, or join the waitlist when a class is full.
• Book the same class for the weeks ahead in one go.
• Plans changed? Cancel from your phone.

ONE ACCOUNT FOR THE FAMILY
• Add your kids and book for each of them from your own phone.
• See everyone's classes and packs in one place.
• Both parents can see and book for the same kids.

YOUR PACK, ALWAYS UP TO DATE
• See the classes you have left and when your pack ends.
• Get a reminder before class.
• Add your bookings to your phone's calendar, if you want them there.

AT THE DOOR
• Show your check-in code at the front desk. One scan checks you in for today's classes.

NEWS FROM STEPS
• Schedule changes, shows and announcements, straight to your phone.

WONDERSIP
• See the menu of the café at Steps, reserve what you like and pick it up at the studio.

Signing in takes a moment: use your Apple or Google account, or a code sent to your email. There is no password to remember.

New to Steps? Come by the studio at Al-Centro, Zouk Mosbeh, or message the front desk. We will help you pick a class and the right level.

name: Stereogram Camera
description:
Stereogram Camera turns whatever your iPhone sees into a live Magic Eye style picture.

Point the camera at a person, a pet or a room and the app uses the depth sensor to hide the scene inside a field of random dots. Relax your eyes, look through the screen, and the scene pops out in 3D.

THREE WAYS TO SEE
- Camera: the normal picture.
- Depth map: see how far away everything is, near to far.
- Stereogram: a live random-dot autostereogram of the scene in front of you.

FLOATING TEXT
Type a word or a short message and it floats in front of the scene as a hidden 3D layer. Only people who know how to look will be able to read it.

RECORD AND SHARE
Record video with sound of exactly what is on screen and switch modes in the middle of a take. Videos are saved to your photo library, ready to share.

MAKE IT YOURS
Adjust the dot size, strip width and depth strength to make the 3D effect easier to see or more dramatic.

Works with the back camera (LiDAR or dual camera) and the front TrueDepth camera. A device with a depth-capable camera is required.

Everything is processed on your device. Nothing is uploaded and no account is needed.

name: Stivra: Habit Chain Tracker
description:
Most habit apps reset you to zero after a single missed day, and that's exactly where most people quit. Stivra is built to forgive: pick a habit, tick it off with one tap, and don't lose your chain to one bad day.

SIMPLE
No account, no sign-in, no forms. Open the app and today's habits are right there; checking one off is a single tap. Setup takes 30 seconds.

FEWER HABITS, KEPT
The free plan holds 3 habits, on purpose. People who start small are the ones who keep going.

ONE MISSED DAY DOESN'T END IT
If you missed yesterday, Stivra tells you, and a streak freeze saves the day. You get 1 free freeze every month.

FORGOT TO TAP? FIX IT
Did it but forgot to check it off? Tap any of the last 7 days and your chain is right again. No freeze spent.

X TIMES A WEEK
Not every habit is daily. Set "work out 3× a week"; any days count, and the chain carries on once the week is done.

TOOK A BREAK? THAT'S FINE
Away for a few days? Stivra doesn't guilt you. When you come back it suggests a small fresh start with the habit you kept best.

REMINDERS
Pick a time for each habit. Tap "Complete" right from the notification.

SHARE YOUR CHAIN
Hit a milestone and share your chain as a clean image card.

READY-MADE CHALLENGES
Test yourself with First Week, the 21-Day Reset, the 30-Day Sprint and the 90-day Season.

PRIVACY FIRST
No ads, no tracking. All your data stays on your phone and the app works offline. Export a backup file and restore it whenever you like.

STIVRA PREMIUM
• Streak freezes: rescue 3 missed days a month (free: 1)
• Evening last call: one heads-up before midnight when a streak is about to break
• Unlimited habits (3 on the free plan)
• A heat map of your whole year

Premium is optional. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel them in your store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://adnanyagmur.github.io/stivra-site/privacy.html

name: StoneAI Minions
description:
O StoneAI Minions reúne ajudantes de IA, os minions, que executam tarefas de trabalho por você.

Converse com um minion como num chat: peça uma pesquisa, um rascunho, uma conferência ou uma rotina que se repete. Ele trabalha em segundo plano, numa máquina separada só sua, e você acompanha o andamento.

O QUE VOCÊ FAZ
• Conversar com vários minions, cada um com a sua função.
• Receber um aviso no celular quando uma tarefa termina ou precisa de você.
• Compartilhar um texto de outro aplicativo direto para um minion.
• Agendar rotinas que se repetem.
• Guardar anotações e conhecimento que os minions usam depois.

CONTROLE E SEGURANÇA
• Acesso por convite, com login por e-mail, sem senha para decorar.
• Ações sensíveis ficam retidas até você aprovar.
• Você pode usar a sua própria chave de IA, guardada cifrada.
• Sem anúncios e sem rastreamento.

O acesso ao StoneAI Minions é por convite do administrador do serviço.

name: StretchShift: Desk Breaks
description:
Long stretches at your desk can make it easy to miss a chance to move or remember a glass of water. hareketh brings short exercise breaks and water reminders into your workday. Pick a movement, set your hours, and build a routine you can come back to.

TAKE A SHORT MOVEMENT BREAK

Start with a guided stretch for your neck, shoulders, or back, or choose a movement that gets you out of your chair. Browse the exercise library for stretching, strength, cardio, and walking ideas. You can choose quiet exercises without jumping when you share a workspace. Follow the on-screen steps and use the timer or rep count to keep your place. Save the moves you like in a routine for another day.

SET REMINDERS AROUND YOUR SCHEDULE

Choose your workdays, start and end times, and lunch break so reminders fit the hours you actually work. When a movement reminder arrives, mark the move as done, snooze it, or skip it. If you have a meeting or need uninterrupted time, turn on Focus to pause reminders for a while. When you're done for the day, close it to keep reminders quiet until tomorrow.

BUILD A WATER HABIT

Set a daily water goal and log a glass with one tap. The Today screen shows how much you've had and how much is left. You can use water reminders on their own or alongside movement reminders. Both work without an account.

SEE YOUR SMALL BREAKS ADD UP

The daily movement score and recent history show what you've done. Track which days you took breaks, keep a streak going, and earn badges along the way. If you give permission, hareketh can include your step count from Apple Health in your movement score.

FIND A BREAK PARTNER

People is an optional feature for ages 18 and over. After a movement break, you can get suggestions for people who moved around the same time. If you both wave, you can chat and invite each other to a shared break. An account is required for matching and chat.

WHAT'S INCLUDED WITH PREMIUM

Movement and water reminders are free. Premium adds extra exercise packs, more match suggestions, flexible movement reminder intervals, and reminders for meals, medication, and eye breaks. You also get a detailed weekly report and access to the full history calendar.

Premium is available as a weekly or monthly subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use https://hareketh-destek.merdoderdo55.chatgpt.site/terms#english

name: Studio Elaine Kiss
description:
O STUDIO ELAINE KISS é um aplicativo desenvolvido para quem valoriza criatividade, praticidade e identidade visual na comunicação digital.

Com milhares de figurinhas, você encontra recursos visuais para expressar ideias, personalizar seus conteúdos e tornar seus Stories ainda mais interessantes.

 Mais de 17 mil figurinhas: um amplo acervo para explorar diferentes estilos, temas e ocasiões.

 Busca inteligente: encontre figurinhas com facilidade usando a pesquisa por palavras.

 Seus favoritos: salve suas figurinhas preferidas na área de favoritos do aplicativo e encontre-as novamente sempre que precisar.

 Copie e cole: utilize as figurinhas sem precisar salvar cada imagem na galeria do celular.

 Liberdade criativa: explore novas possibilidades para compartilhar momentos, expressar sua personalidade e produzir conteúdos para seu negócio.

STUDIO ELAINE KISS

name: Study Pal: Snap, Solve & Write
description:
Stuck on a question and can't work out why? Read the foreign-language material three times and still have no idea what it says? Halfway through a report and unsure what to do next?
At moments like these, having someone to ask at any time makes everything easier. This AI assistant is designed for learning, languages and creativity. Whether you're a student, a parent, or a working professional who regularly reads, writes and produces content, it helps you turn "I don't get it" into "Oh, I see", and then turn "Oh, I see" into work of your own.

SNAP & SOLVE
Come across a maths, science or language question? Take a photo, or choose an image from your photo library, and you'll see a step-by-step explanation straight away. The aim isn't to copy answers, but to help you understand why each step is taken, so you can solve it yourself next time.
VIDEO CREATION
Some ideas come across better as video. Whether it's the opening of a class presentation, a visual explanation of a complex concept, homemade revision material, or a creative clip to share with friends, simply describe in words what you'd like to show and a video is generated for you. Alongside your studies, it brings your ideas to life.
ASK FOLLOW-UPS ANYTIME
Still stuck on one step? Just ask again. You can ask for a simpler explanation, another example, or a different method of solving it. Type or use voice input, and keep asking until it makes sense.
LEARN FROM WHAT YOU SEE
Snap a chart, a textbook page, a plant, a landmark, a menu or a line of foreign text, and find out straight away what it is and what it means. Everyday curiosity becomes a mini lesson in no time.
TRANSLATION & LANGUAGE LEARNING
Translate between Chinese, English, Japanese and many other languages. Along with the translation, you'll get notes on how word choices differ, whether the tone sounds natural, and how people would normally say it. It's handy for reading foreign-language sources, preparing for language exams, or writing to a friend overseas.
WRITING COACH
From drafting outlines and organising your arguments to polishing sentences and adjusting tone, you can turn to it for help with essays, reports, presentations, CVs and emails. It offers suggestions, but the writing stays yours, and so does the style.
KEY POINT SUMMARIES
Article too long to read in time? Paste in the text or snap your notes, and quickly pick out the key points in a clear bulleted summary, making reading and revision more efficient.
WHO IT'S FOR
Students racing to finish homework or preparing for exams
Parents who want to explain questions to their children more clearly
Anyone learning a foreign language who needs instant translation and usage notes
Working professionals who regularly write documents, emails and presentations
People who enjoy learning by asking questions and want to turn their ideas into videos and creative projects

















































SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
All features of this app require a subscription. You can choose the plan that suits you and check the price and duration before purchasing. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your purchase. Your subscription renews automatically at the same price unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal at any time in your device's Settings. For details, please see the Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service.

name: Stumari
description:
Stumari is the guest app for restaurants, cafés and bars that use Stumari.

Scan the QR code on your table to open the venue's live menu, with photos, prices and dietary tags, in your language.

• Browse the full menu and see what's available right now
• Order from your table; the order goes straight to the kitchen or bar
• Call a waiter or ask for the bill with one tap
• Pay the whole bill, or split it by dish or into equal parts
• Keep your receipts and collect points at venues that offer them
• Get notified when your order is ready or the waiter is on the way

You don't need an account to open a menu. Stumari works at venues that use Stumari.

name: Stumari Kitchen
description:
Stumari Kitchen turns a tablet into the kitchen or bar display for venues that use Stumari. Pair it once by scanning the QR code shown in your Stumari dashboard.

• New orders appear as soon as a waiter or guest sends them
• Each ticket shows its table, notes and modifiers
• Mark dishes as ready and the waiter is told right away
• Bar mode shows only drinks
• A sound and a notification for every new ticket, even when the app is in the background
• Built for landscape tablets, with a compact layout for phones

name: STYLEKOREAN JAPAN
description:
Get exclusive special offers on the mobile app!

Use the mobile app to enjoy features optimized for mobile devices and access exclusive special offers.



Main features:

Enjoy exclusive coupons and discounts

Use automatic login

Check and track your orders

Manage your shopping cart and shipping info

Receive store notifications

Access social media channels

Contact Customer Service

name: Stylo PDA
description:
Stylo PDA brings back the handheld organizer, the calm and focused kind, and connects it to your iPhone.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
- Today desktop with your next appointment, tasks, memos and contacts
- Stylo AI highlights your day on the device: what's next, what's due, when you're free
- Minimize any window to the taskbar and bring it back with a tap

AGENDA
- Day and month views in a classic PDA style; edit any appointment
- Add emoji and colour to appointments; use event types like Birthday or Travel, or make your own
- Works with your iPhone Calendar, both ways
- Reminders before appointments, with Snooze

TASKS, MEMOS, ADDRESS
- Tasks sync both ways with iPhone Reminders
- Memos with on-device summaries
- Address book that works with iPhone Contacts

WRITE YOUR WAY
- On-screen keyboard, handwriting pad (letters and whole words), or the iPhone keyboard

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Everything stays on your iPhone unless you turn on sync
- Stylo AI runs on the device
- No ads, no tracking

SYNC YOUR DEVICES
- Sign in with Apple to sync up to 5 of your iPhones (optional)

MORE
- Seven looks: Desktop, Penguin (Linux-style desktop), reflective LCD, backlit glow, colour TFT, Terminal and Tactical (night-ops HUD)
- Classic 90s wallpapers, or turn one of your photos into a retro desktop picture
- A Lock Screen card with your next appointment and tasks, plus Home Screen and StandBy widgets
- Lock with Face ID

Try every feature for 3 days, then unlock Stylo PDA with a single purchase. Lifetime upgrades included, no subscription.

name: SUI Next
description: SUI Next is a companion for a compatible SUI Next server. Connect to a server you manage to view its dashboard, configuration inventory, usage and logs. The app requires an existing server and account to manage real data.

name: Suit Shuffle: Match 3 Puzzle
description:
Think match 3 is all fruit and jewels? Time to shuffle the deck.

Suit Shuffle is a fast match 3 puzzle game with playing card suits. Swap hearts, diamonds, spades and clubs to match 3 or more, hit your target counts, and beat the 60-second clock across 1000+ timed levels.

Every level gives you a fresh target, so it's not just about matching fast — it's about matching smart. Chain combos and set off row, column, blast and colour specials to clear hard levels and earn 3 stars.

HOW TO PLAY
 • Swap adjacent card suits to match three or more
 • Collect the target number of each suit before time runs out
 • Chain combos to trigger powerful blast specials
 • Earn up to 3 stars per level and climb the leaderboard

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
 • A fresh card-suit twist on the classic match 3 puzzle game
 • Quick 60-second rounds — a complete brain game in every break
 • 1000+ levels with rising difficulty, from relaxed to brutal
 • Hearts, spades, diamonds and clubs in a clean card match design
 • 100% offline gameplay — play anywhere with zero data required
 • Free puzzle game, easy to pick up at any age

Built for match 3 and puzzle games fans: if you search for a card game with real targets, a blast-filled card puzzle, or a free puzzle game with 1000+ stages, Suit Shuffle fits short sessions and long grinds alike.

Download Suit Shuffle now and see if you've got what it takes to clear the deck — your next 60-second card puzzle starts today.

name: SuitBadge
description:
SuitBadge is the app for the SuitBadge pocket pin: a pin with your logo, your name and an NFC tag. Anyone who taps it with a phone opens what you chose, without installing anything.

PAIR YOUR PIN
Hold your iPhone near the pin: the app recognises it, links it to your account and writes the link. You can lock it so no one else can rewrite it.

CHOOSE WHAT IT OPENS
One of your links (website, LinkedIn, portfolio) or your SuitBadge page. Change it whenever you like from the app, without touching the pin: your price list at a trade show, your profile in a meeting.

BUILD YOUR PAGE
Your own page at name.suitbadge.com, built from blocks: intro, buttons, social profiles, save contact, photos and galleries, video, contact forms, polls, discount codes, offers, booking links, PDF documents, address, FAQ, testimonials, countdown. Pick a theme and a colour, see how others see you and publish.

DIFFERENT VERSIONS
Prepare up to five versions of your page (for example one for a trade show) and put the one you need online.

CONTACTS AND STATS
Form replies arrive in the app, with your notes, and export to Excel or CSV. Stats count taps, visits and clicks day by day, with no personal data about visitors.

EVEN WITHOUT A PIN
You can create your page and share it with its QR code before you have the pin.

PRIVACY
No ads and no tracking. Data is stored in the European Union, form replies are encrypted, and you can export or delete everything from the app.

Writing the pin requires an iPhone with NFC.

name: Suncoast Gymnastics
description:
The official app for Suncoast Gymnastics families.

Everything about your gymnast's time at Suncoast, in one place: classes, schedule, billing, events and news from the gym.

YOUR WEEK AT A GLANCE
• See every class for every child: day, time, room and coach
• Know what's next, with a countdown to class day
• Report an absence and book a make-up class

FIND AND BOOK CLASSES
• Browse classes by program, age and level
• See open spots instantly and book a trial
• Add another child to the family in seconds

CAMPS, PARTIES AND EVENTS
• Sign up for camps, open gyms and special events
• Book a birthday party right from your phone
• Private lessons, when your gym offers them

BILLING MADE EASY
• See your balance and upcoming charges
• Pay by card or bank account in a tap
• Turn on autopay and never miss a payment

STAY IN THE LOOP
• Push notifications for schedule changes, open spots and payment reminders
• Messages and closures straight from the gym

EVERY LOCATION, ONE APP
Odessa, Trinity and Wesley Chapel families all sign in here. Pick your location, enter the code we send you, and you're in. No password to remember.

Questions? Contact the front desk at your Suncoast location.

name: Sunscar
description:
The sun flares every fourteen days and the world ends. Then it starts again, and so do you.

Sunscar is a 2D online action sandbox with one goal: get stronger. You wake with nothing, in a world full of people who are stronger than you, and every one of them is a way to grow.

GROW YOUR POWER
- Train, meditate, and spar with people stronger than you to catch up fast.
- Watch one number climb from a hundred into the thousands, and feel the difference in every fight.
- Unlock transformations, flight, and a third eye.

FIGHT YOUR WAY
- Fast combos, blocks, perfect parries, dashes, blasts and charged beams.
- Fighting styles to learn from teachers across the world.
- Five masters in five places, each teaching different techniques.
- Six peoples to play, each with its own home, mentor and rules: living flame that pays for power with its health, giants who never stop growing, and a hungry thing that can only grow by absorbing whoever it beats.

A WORLD THAT ENDS
- Ten factions, each with its own answer to a sun that keeps killing everyone, and daily work to do for them.
- Light the Vanes to bring the end sooner, or damp them to hold it off. Everyone lives with the result.
- Bounties, outlaws, jail, raids on giant bosses, a tournament at noon, and a solar city that dances until the fire comes.

MAKE IT YOURS
- Outfits, aura colours, aura styles, titles and knockout effects, earned by playing.

PLAY TOGETHER OR ALONE
- One shared online world, or the whole game offline.
- Parties, hired sellswords, and bases you build in the wilds.
- No ads. No sign-up needed.

name: Susumu - JLPT Kanji Learning
description:
Susumu (進む) means "to move forward". It takes you from your first hiragana to JLPT N4, one short lesson at a time.

EVERYTHING FOR JLPT N5 AND N4
• 1,290+ Japanese vocabulary words, each with an example sentence
• 284 kanji with stroke order, readings and the words that use them
• 194 grammar points explained in plain English, with three examples each
• Hiragana and katakana from zero
• Reading passages written for each level

LEARN, THEN REMEMBER
Each lesson teaches a handful of words, up to two kanji and a grammar point. Susumu then brings every item back just before you would forget it, so a few minutes a day is enough.

PRACTICE LIKE THE REAL TEST
• Six full mock exams in the JLPT format
• Kanji reading, orthography, vocabulary in context, paraphrase, usage, grammar and sentence order questions
• A clear explanation for every answer
• Review your mistakes after each exam

READ JAPANESE WITH CONFIDENCE
Turn furigana on while you learn, hide it for kanji you already know.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Daily streak, study calendar and how much of each level you have covered.

Susumu is an independent study app and is not affiliated with the organizers of the Japanese-Language Proficiency Test.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://trysusumu.app/privacy

name: SWAPT: Style Your Pins
description:
Your Pinterest board is full of outfits you love. Your closet is full of clothes. SWAPT puts them together.

Film your closet once, bring the outfits you've saved, and SWAPT styles every look from clothes you already own. When one piece is missing, it finds it for you.

FILM YOUR CLOSET ONCE
• One quick, messy video. Just talk while you film ("my favorite blazer, runs small").
• SWAPT finds every piece, even folded stacks, and turns each one into a clean product photo.
• Fix any piece by typing what to change.

BRING YOUR INSPIRATION
• Add pins by link or screenshot.
• Follow the fashion creators you love on Instagram. Their outfits land in your feed, ready to style.
• Every look is sorted into vibes: old money, coastal, boho, goth, western and more.

STYLE ANY PIN FROM YOUR CLOSET
• Tap a pin and SWAPT rebuilds it with your own pieces, then shows what's missing.
• Style one piece three ways in your favorite vibes.
• Accessorize any look, save it, and rate it so SWAPT learns your taste.

SHOP ONLY WHAT'S MISSING
• Your sizes and fit notes (like inseam or high-waisted) guide every suggestion.
• Send the missing pieces to your Amazon cart in a few taps.

MADE FOR YOU
• Women's, men's or both.
• App skins that match your vibe, plus a disco-ball drop every time a new look lands.

SUBSCRIPTION
Start with a 3-day free trial, then choose SWAPT Monthly ($14.99/month, style up to 5 pins a day) or SWAPT Plus ($19.99/month, style up to 15 pins a day). Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm your purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.getswapt.com/privacy

name: Swell: Ride the Wave
description:
Hold your finger on the water and the wave builds. Your cargo rides it and keeps getting faster. Then the lip curls and the edge turns white: release now! The closer to the break, the farther you fly.

Swell is a one-finger arcade game: understood in seconds, mastered over a long time. There's no luck in the timing – practice pays off.

HOW SWELL PLAYS
• Hold: the wave grows and carries you.
• Ride: the longer you ride, the more boost you get.
• Release: perfectly just before the break – too late, and the breaker catches you.
• Hold again in the air: the next wave catches you. Hold just before landing and it becomes a ramp.

COMBOS AND TRICKS
Perfect releases, ramps, rings and jumps over rocks, buoys and counter-waves build your combo. Every combo adds boost, and every ten patch up your hull. One mistake – and it's gone.

SIX CARGOS, SIX FEELS
From the rubber duck that always bounces back, through the message in a bottle, surfboard, rowboat and sailing yacht, to the cruise ship that's nearly impossible to stop. Every cargo handles differently and has its own medals.

FROM MORNING TO NIGHT
The sea changes as you go: rocks, sandbars, buoys and counter-waves get denser, the sun sinks, and eventually you're riding under the stars.

LEADERBOARDS
Weekly top 10 and all-time top 100 for every cargo through Game Center – with your real rank, even if you're not at the top (yet).

FAIR AND CALM
No ads, no subscription, no pop-ups. In the shipyard you'll find life rings that let you continue a run once – one is ready for free every day – and paint jobs that only change the looks.

Sound and haptics let you feel every release. Playable without an account.

name: SwimVibe
description:
SwimVibe gives you a complete pool workout in seconds, sized to your session.

YOUR DISTANCE OR YOUR TIME
Choose the meters you want to swim, or the minutes you have before you need to leave the pool. SwimVibe finds the workout closest to your distance, or the longest one that fits in your time.

A COMPLETE PLAN
Every workout comes with a warm-up, a main set and a cool-down, written the way swimmers read them: 2x200 medley, 300 kick, 200 backstroke… Filter by difficulty (beginner, intermediate or advanced), and tap "Generate another" if you fancy something different.

LOG IT AND SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Tap "Finish & Log" when you are done.
• Set a weekly goal in meters and watch the bar fill up.
• See your last 8 weeks, your streak, your totals and this month against last month.
• Workouts you swam in the last 14 days are avoided, so your training stays varied.
• Star the workouts you love to find them again.
• Share a workout with your training partner.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Your history, goal and favorites are stored only on your iPhone. Export a backup file whenever you want, and import it on a new phone.

In English, Spanish and Catalan.

The workouts are general suggestions, not medical advice. Swim at your own level and check with a doctor if you have a health condition.

name: SwipeAndSwap
description:
SwipeAndSwap is a marketplace for anything. Swipe through furniture, phones, clothes, games, tools, bikes, and whatever else people near you are selling. Swipe right on what you want. When someone wants something of yours too, it's a Trade Match, and you can build an offer in a few taps.

Trade, buy, or both
Offer one item or several, add cash to even it out, or just buy it outright. Every offer shows the listed value on both sides, so you know a deal is fair before you send it.

Meet up or ship
Meet at a public safe spot near you, check in when you arrive, and confirm the swap in the app. Or ship with a prepaid label and take three days to check what arrived before the trade completes.

Protected from start to finish
Both traders put a small refundable hold on their card when an offer is accepted. If someone doesn't show up or doesn't ship, their hold goes to you. Cash purchases include Buyer Protection, so you're refunded in full if the item doesn't arrive or isn't as described. A person reviews every problem within 48 hours.

Built for regulars
Keep a Grail List and get an alert when one shows up nearby. Follow stores you like, see who wants your stuff, and pick up where you left off with New Since You Left. Keep a swap streak going if you like, with freezes for the days you're busy.

Free to list, free to swipe
Listing, swiping, messaging, and offers are free. Local meetup trades are free. Shipped trades have a small protection fee, and sellers keep everything they earn minus card processing.

SwipeAndSwap is for people 18 and older.

name: SwipeThru
description:
SwipeThru makes clearing out your photo library quick, and even a little fun.

Swipe right to keep a photo or video. Swipe left to set it aside for deleting. That's it.

PICK A PILE
Go through everything, or one part of your library at a time: recent photos, On This Day, videos (biggest first), screenshots, screen recordings, selfies, Live Photos, panoramas, bursts, any month, or any album.

NOTHING GOES WITHOUT A SECOND LOOK
Photos you swipe left wait in a To Delete list. Look them over, tap anything you want to keep, then delete the rest in one go. Deleted photos stay in Recently Deleted in Photos for 30 days, so you can always change your mind.

SEE EVERY DETAIL
Tap a photo to see it full size, with when and where it was taken, the camera and lens, the file size, and a map. Videos play right in the pile.

MAKE IT A HABIT
Set a daily goal, watch the ring fill up as you swipe, and keep your streak going. Turn on a reminder at a time that suits you. It only comes on days you haven't reached your goal.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking, nothing to sign up for. Your photos never leave your device, and your progress stays on it too.

Made for iPhone and iPad, with layouts for iPhone Duo open and closed.

name: Swoop Card Game - With Friends
description:
Swoop is a fast, friendly card game about getting rid of your cards before anyone else.

Play a card equal to or lower than the top of the pile. Can't? Pick up the whole pile. Drop a 10 or a Joker, or land four of a kind, and you swoop: the pile is swept away and you go again.

Everyone also has four face-up cards on the table, with a face-down card hidden under each. Clear the face-up card to unlock the one underneath, or flip it blind and hope it fits. When someone goes out, every card you're still holding counts against you, and the hidden ones are revealed one by one. A buried 10 or Joker costs 50 points.

WAYS TO PLAY
• Solo against computer players, Easy, Medium or Hard, with up to five opponents. Works offline.
• Pass and play: share one phone with up to six people. The table hides between turns.
• Online with friends: start a private table and send an invite link, or jump into a game with other players.

MADE TO BE EASY TO PICK UP
• A short guided lesson teaches every rule as you play.
• Choose a game of 100, 300 or 500 points.
• Pause between rounds and pick up where you left off.
• Two color themes, gentle sounds and haptics.

Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases. Play as a guest or sign in with Apple. Report and block are built in for online play.

name: Syntrix
description:
Syntrix is an HR system that brings attendance, leave, payroll and approvals together in one place, and the mobile app lets you handle your everyday HR tasks from anywhere.

With the Syntrix app you can:
- Check in and out and see your hours so far today
- Submit leave, punch-correction and remote-work requests
- See your leave balance and where each request stands
- Approve or reject your team's requests
- View your payslip
- Raise IT support requests and see the devices assigned to you
- Manage employee files and file leave on employees' behalf (for HR teams)
- Receive announcements and instant notifications
- Sign in with Face ID or your work account

Using the app requires a Syntrix account from your employer.

name: Tail Circle.
description:
Welcome to Tail Circle, your one-stop destination for pet care and everyday pet needs. Explore a range of services designed to keep your furry companions happy, healthy, and well cared for.

Key Features

Grooming & Spa
Discover pet grooming and salon services to help your pets look and feel their best.

Daycare & Boarding
Explore daycare and boarding options for your pets while you're busy or away.

Shop for Pets
Browse pet essentials, toys, treats, and other products for your furry friends.

Find Veterinarians
Discover veterinary services and explore appointment booking options for your pet's healthcare needs.

Pet Events
Explore pet-friendly events, parties, and activities to create memorable moments with your companions.

Healthy Pet Meals
Discover meal options designed to support your pet's everyday nutritional needs.

Everything Your Pet Needs in One Place

Tail Circle makes it easier to explore pet care services, discover useful products, and find convenient options for your pet's daily needs.

Download Tail Circle and make caring for your furry family members easier!

name: Tail Scribe
description:
Tail Scribe keeps each dovetail on this iPhone.

A joint starts as bare boards. Cut the pin first. Only then can the tail be scribed from it. With no pin, there is no line to copy. After the tail is scribed, saw on the line and the joint pulls tight. Saw past the line and the tail is loose, and it stays loose. Saw before the tail is scribed and the tail is scrap. The pin stays. A tight or scrap joint does not change again.

The board end shows the pin, the scribe line and the tail. Under it, Pin, Scribe and Saw light up in the order they happened. The order page lays the three steps out, so a saw that came before the scribe stands out.

You can name each joint and find it by name. Delete only a joint that is not tight. Share sends the name and whether it is tight, loose, scrap or not sawed. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: TankTap: Film Dev Timer
description:
TankTap turns your Apple Watch into a darkroom timer you can feel.

Pick a recipe, set the developer temperature with the Digital Crown and tap Start. Then lower your wrist and keep your eyes on the tank. TankTap taps your wrist for every agitation and every pour, and walks you through develop, stop, fix, wash and wetting agent on its own.

ON YOUR WRIST
• A tap for each agitation, each pour-out and each new stage
• Taps are scheduled up front, so they arrive on time even with your wrist down
• Time Sensitive alerts get through most Focus modes
• Colors you can read at a glance: red means agitate, black means rest, amber means pour out
• No tapping with wet hands: the next stage starts on its own after the pour

TIMES TO START FROM
• 144 starting points from Ilford, Kentmere, Kodak and Foma datasheets, including push times
• Temperature compensation fitted to the manufacturers' time–temperature charts
• Warnings outside 18–24 °C and below 5 minutes
• Ilford, Kodak and Foma agitation patterns, plus stand development

ON YOUR IPHONE
• Build and edit your own recipes: film, EI, developer, dilution, time and every stage
• Send a recipe to your watch with one tap
• A development log with temperature, the times actually used, results and notes, synced from your watch
• °C or °F

No account. No ads. No tracking. Your recipes and log stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch.

Always check the datasheets for your film and chemistry before developing.

name: Tapstorm: Angry Chef Rush
seller_name: AL TITI ESTABLISHMENT FOR SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY
description:
Tapstorm is a two-minute cooking rush with the angriest chef in town.

Customers shout their orders. You grab bread, grill the shawarma, fry the potatoes, add garlic and pickles, and serve before their patience runs out. The chef roasts you the whole time (no swearing, just a lot of shouting).

WATCH OUT FOR FOOD CRIMES
Someone wants ketchup on shawarma? Mayonnaise on falafel? Hit Cancel and kick them out. Cook it and the chef will never forgive you.

PLAY YOUR FAVOURITE SHOP
Scan the QR code on a shop's table card and Tapstorm turns into that shop's game: its name, colours and menu. Add as many shops as you like under My stores, switch between them, and remove the ones you no longer visit. No QR code? Play the Grill Corner kitchen for free.

FEATURES
• Quick shifts that fit in a coffee break
• Kids, Normal and Hard levels
• Combos, stars, daily streaks and a leaderboard on your phone
• Real voices in Jordanian Arabic, with English and Arabic menus
• Discount codes when a shop runs rewards for top scores
• No account, no ads, no tracking

Run a shop? Get your own game at tapstorm.app/offer.

name: Task King - Smart Tasks
description:
Take charge of your day with Task King, a focused task planner built for quick capture and dependable follow-through.

• Add tasks with due dates and optional times
• Schedule local phone reminders
• Repeat tasks daily, on weekdays, weekly, or monthly
• View your work in a clear calendar
• Mark tasks complete and keep your day organized
• Send tasks to your phone calendar when you choose

Task King keeps your task list on your device. No account is required, there are no ads, and the free version has no subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Plan what matters, stay on schedule, and own your day with Task King.

name: Taskebi App
description:
Taskebi brings your team's work into one simple app: tasks, projects, chat, boards, calendar and a shared inbox for your customers' messages.

TASKS AND PROJECTS
- Create tasks in seconds, set a due date and time, priority and who does it
- Group work by project with members, roles and permissions
- See what's overdue, due today and in progress at a glance
- Repeating tasks, files and comments with replies
- Turn any chat message into a task

TEAM CHAT
- Direct messages, groups and project channels
- Threads, reactions, mentions, photos and voice messages
- Search the whole history
- Ask for a decision right from the chat and keep a record of it

SHARED INBOX
- Facebook Messenger, Instagram and your website chat in one place, per project
- Decide who on the team can see and answer
- Optional AI replies that follow your notes and price list

BOARDS AND CALENDAR
- Visual boards for ideas, plans and moodboards
- A calendar of your tasks, with Google Calendar and a private calendar feed

MADE FOR EVERY DAY
- Home screen widgets, focus mode and reminders an hour before a deadline
- Easy Mode: a calmer, simpler screen for people who just need their tasks
- Georgian and English
- Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac, always in sync

Connect Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini to create and update tasks by asking in plain words.

name: taskr SL
description:
taskr SL aide une équipe de managers à organiser et suivre ses tâches, ensemble, sur un écran très simple. Tout ce que l'un ajoute ou coche apparaît tout de suite chez les autres.

AUJOURD'HUI, DEMAIN ET LE MOIS
Trois onglets pour voir d'un coup d'œil ce qui attend l'équipe. Touche un jour dans le calendrier du mois pour en voir le détail.

UNE TÂCHE, UNE CARTE
Ajoute une tâche en quelques secondes : un titre, un jour, et c'est tout. Touche le cercle d'une tâche pour indiquer qui l'a faite (une ou plusieurs personnes) : leurs initiales prennent la place du cercle. Tu t'es trompé ? Rouvre la tâche pour la remettre à faire.

DES TÂCHES QUI REVIENNENT
Ouverture, clôture, inventaire… Crée une tâche permanente (chaque jour, chaque semaine ou chaque mois) : elle réapparaît toute seule aux bons jours. Une tâche ponctuelle ne vaut que pour son jour.

SYNCHRONISÉ EN TEMPS RÉEL
Tout le monde voit la même liste, à jour, sur son iPhone.

RÉSERVÉ À L'ÉQUIPE
L'accès se fait avec un code d'équipe, demandé une seule fois au premier lancement, puis avec le choix de ton prénom.

name: TDJ College Point
description:
Welcome to the official app of TDJ College Point!

Stay connected with your church family all week long, not just on Sundays.

Join us live for worship and the Word, or catch up on recent messages anytime. See what's coming up at church and let us know you're coming. Start each day with a Bible verse, and find our service times and directions in one tap.

Want to support the ministry? You can give right from the app. You'll also find links to our Instagram, Facebook, and website.

For our team members and leaders, the app brings together service schedules, songs, assignments, and attendance for cell groups and services.

Available in English and Spanish. ¡Bienvenidos!

name: Tealeaf: Korean Flashcards
description:
Tealeaf puts one Korean, Japanese or Chinese word on your Lock Screen, so every glance at your iPhone becomes a tiny lesson.

THE LOCK SCREEN IS THE LESSON
• A paper word card sits under the clock. Tap it to flip it and see the reading and the meaning.
• Home Screen widgets let you mark a word as known, or bring it back again, without opening the app.
• Gentle spaced repetition brings each word back just before you would forget it.

300 EVERYDAY WORDS PER LANGUAGE
• Starter decks for Korean, Japanese and Chinese, 300 words each.
• Readings in romanization, kana or pinyin, example sentences and spoken pronunciation.
• Meanings in English, Vietnamese, Japanese or Korean.
• Decks show a Beta label until a native speaker has reviewed them.

ROOM HUNT
Point the camera at the things around you, like a cup, a chair or a plant, and Tealeaf turns them into die-cut word stickers for your tea tin. Recognition happens on your iPhone and photos are never uploaded. Find five things a day to finish a hunt poster you can share.

A SMALL DAILY HABIT
A daily goal ring, a streak and paper themes for your widgets.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on this iPhone.

FREE AND TEALEAF PLUS
Tealeaf is free to download and includes one deck of your choice and the Parchment theme. Tealeaf Plus unlocks every deck and every theme. Choose a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. You can manage or cancel a subscription in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://mkhastudio.github.io/legal/privacy

name: TeaShelf
description:
TeaShelf is a work app for merchandisers. It guides a field worker through a store visit step by step and collects shelf photos, so the manager can see how products are placed.

Accounts are issued by the employer: the team manager adds the worker and gives them a login and password or a sign-in link. There is no self sign-up.

What the merchandiser does:
• Today — the day’s stores from the manager’s schedule; the next one is highlighted, handed-in stores fold away.
• “I’m here” — choose a mode: photos only, or photos plus shelf scans; you can switch in the middle of a visit.
• Before photos — the aisle modules from left to right, each one whole, from the bottom shelf to the top with the price tags; each aisle and display separately.
