• After photos — only the aisles that were rearranged; nothing changed is one tap.
• Our products up close — the price tag with the pack above it.
• Competitor promotions — new promotions, or “No new promotions”; promotions already photographed in this store are listed.
• Store product list — the server finds products in the photos; the worker answers only for what it could not see: “Present — photo” or “Missing” with a reason.
• Could not check the store — closed or no access: a few words or a photo of the door.
• Hand in the store — the app reminds about anything skipped. Photos keep uploading on their own, even after hand-in and on a weak connection.

Talking to the manager:
• A chat right on the store screen.
• Inbox — stores the manager sent back and the manager’s marks on photos: a frame where something is wrong and what to do. Answer with a new photo or in words.

Also: the weekly schedule, a monthly summary of visits and working days, an animated “How to shoot” guide for every step, light and dark appearance.

Works without internet too: the route, the store product list and the photos wait on the phone and upload by themselves once the connection is back.

For managers there is a curator mode: who is in the field right now, chats with field staff and review of handed-in stores.

For teams of companies that use TeaShelf. You need an account from your employer to sign in. The app follows your iPhone language: Ukrainian, Russian or English.

name: Telebem
description:
Telebem is a free index for students. Scholarships, exchange guides, volunteering, internships, student prices, and study resources, gathered from the places that run them and found with one search.

-- ONE SEARCH
Type what you need, and Telebem looks through every section at once. Each result links to its official source.

-- SCHOLARSHIPS
Scholarships with who can apply and when they close.

-- EXCHANGE GUIDES
Country guides for exchange students: partner universities, housing, transport, banking, SIM cards and visas. The guides follow ADA University's exchange list, and the practical parts help anyone moving.

-- VOLUNTEERING AND INTERNSHIPS
Programmes and internships in Azerbaijan, with their status and the day we last checked them.

-- STUDENT PRICES
Student discounts in Baku and free software for students, with what to show and where.

-- FREE STUDY RESOURCES
Libraries, past papers, and open-source code packages. Only resources that are legal to read and use.

-- DEADLINES YOU WON'T MISS
Save anything, see what closes next in the calendar, and set reminders. Add your own plans, and show them in iPhone Calendar if you like.

-- SAVE WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
You can browse, search, and save without signing in. Sign in with Apple, Google, or email to keep your list on every device and on telebem.net.

-- YOUR PROFILE AND FRIENDS
Make a profile that is private until you choose to make it public. Add friends, suggest what's missing, and report or block anyone.

-- WORKS OFFLINE
The last copy of each page you opened stays on your phone.

In English, Azerbaijani, and Russian. Free, with no ads in the app.

Telebem isn't affiliated with the organisations it lists. Always confirm details with the official source.

name: Telli: Counter Timer & Money
description:
Telli helps you keep track of the small things that add up. Every tracker answers one simple question: how many times, how much time, or how much money?

COUNT, TIME AND MONEY
• Count: glasses of water, pages read, workouts, anything you do a number of times.
• Time: reading, deep work, meditation, practice. Start the timer and Telli adds up the time for you.
• Money: save toward an amount, or stay under a spending limit, like coffee or eating out.

GOALS THAT FIT YOUR LIFE
Give each tracker its own goal and period: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or all time. Set a goal to reach, or a limit to stay under. You can also give a tracker a start and end date, for example for a 30-day challenge.

LOG IN ONE TAP
Tap + on the Today screen and it counts. Need more detail? Add an entry with its own date and a note.

A TIMER THAT KEEPS GOING
Start, pause and stop. The timer keeps running when you leave the app, and shows on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with Pause and Stop buttons.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Today shows how many goals you've reached and how your week is going. Each tracker has charts, streaks and totals, so you see your progress at a glance.

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
Log a tap or control your timer from Home Screen widgets without opening the app, and add a tracker to your Lock Screen. Use "Add One" in the Shortcuts app.

AND MORE
• A gentle daily reminder for goals you haven't reached yet
• iCloud sync across your devices, no account needed
• Your data stays on your device and in your private iCloud
• Money in your own currency
• Made for iPhone, including iPhone Duo

FREE AND PREMIUM
Telli is free with up to 3 active trackers, weekly statistics, streaks, the tracker and timer widgets, and the Live Activity.

Telli Premium adds:
• Unlimited trackers
• Month and year statistics
• Year and all-time charts for every tracker, plus extra details like goal completion rate and longest session
• The Overview widget, in medium and large sizes

Premium is a weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://deadpixelstudio.io/en/terms_of_use

name: Tenon Nook
description: Tenon Nook is a mindful joinery puzzle. Rotate irregular tenon pieces only, no scaling allowed. Match curved mortise contours by path overlap, assemble them in the correct order to complete nested wooden structures. Collect technical line drawings of every finished joint.

name: TermicaVolo-Parapendio e Volo
description: TermicaVolo est le compagnon de vol libre conçu pour les pilotes de parapente et de paramoteur exigeants. Calculez votre finesse réelle selon la force du vent avec le profil de plané, estimez la base des nuages et les ascendances thermiques, puis vérifiez le cisaillement et les seuils de sécurité Beaufort avant chaque décollage. Tenez votre carnet de vol complet avec altitude maximale, durée et suivi précis des heures de votre voile pour anticiper sa révision. Découvrez des sites de décollage reconnus et préparez vos sorties biplace en toute simplicité, même hors ligne.

name: Testy KPP 2026: Egzamin
description:
Zdaj egzamin KPP za pierwszym razem. Testy KPP 2026 to pytania z bazy na egzamin z kwalifikowanej pierwszej pomocy, z wyjaśnieniami i inteligentnymi powtórkami, które prowadzą Cię do utrwalenia całej bazy.

Na egzaminie KPP dostajesz 30 pytań i musisz odpowiedzieć poprawnie na co najmniej 27 – to aż 90%. Jeden dobry wynik nie wystarczy. Dlatego aplikacja nie każe Ci rozwiązywać testów na ślepo, tylko pilnuje, żeby każde pytanie wróciło do Ciebie we właściwym momencie.

■ CAŁA BAZA PYTAŃ KPP 2026
• 267 pytań do nauki z publicznej bazy Centrum Egzaminów Medycznych (wydanie 2026, 278 pytań) – 11 pytań o wątpliwej treści lub odpowiedzi wyłączamy z treningu i oznaczamy w przeglądarce bazy
• Pytania z kolejnością czynności, pytania z ilustracjami
• 14 działów: BLS i AED u dorosłych, resuscytacja dzieci i noworodków, drogi oddechowe i sprzęt, wstrząs i krwotoki, urazy, oparzenia, zatrucia, stany nagłe (udar, zawał, cukrzyca), poród, segregacja i zdarzenia masowe, ewakuacja, ocena poszkodowanego, anatomia, organizacja systemu i prawo

■ NAUKA, KTÓRA ZOSTAJE W GŁOWIE
• Powtórki metodą pudełek (Leitnera): pytanie uznajemy za utrwalone dopiero po kilku poprawnych odpowiedziach w różnych dniach
• Codzienna sesja na 10, 15 lub 25 pytań – idealna na przerwę na służbie albo dojazd
• Ustaw datę egzaminu, a aplikacja rozłoży nowe pytania i powtórki tak, żebyś zdążył z całą bazą
• Błędne odpowiedzi wracają jeszcze w tej samej sesji i ponownie następnego dnia

■ WYJAŚNIENIA I ŹRÓDŁA
• Do każdego pytania krótkie wyjaśnienie, dlaczego ta odpowiedź jest poprawna
• Podstawa odpowiedzi: wytyczne ERC 2025, zasady KSRG, ustawa o Państwowym Ratownictwie Medycznym
• Uczciwy klucz: gdy odpowiedź przyjęta w bazie różni się od aktualnych wytycznych, pokazujemy obie i mówimy to wprost

■ EGZAMIN PRÓBNY JAK NA PRAWDZIWYM
• 30 losowych pytań, próg 27 poprawnych, bez podpowiedzi
• Wracaj do pominiętych pytań, przerwij i wznów w dowolnej chwili
• Po egzaminie przegląd błędów z wyjaśnieniami – trafiają od razu do powtórek
• Historia wyników z wykresem i linią progu zdania

■ POSTĘPY I SŁABE DZIAŁY
• Ile pytań utrwalonych, ile w nauce, ile jeszcze nie widziane
• Działy, w których popełniasz najwięcej błędów, na samej górze
• Nauka wybranego działu i powtórka tylko błędnych pytań

■ BEZ KONTA, OFFLINE, BEZ REKLAM
• Nie zakładasz konta i nie podajesz danych
• Działa bez internetu – także w remizie, na łodzi czy w górach
• Przerwana sesja czeka dokładnie tam, gdzie ją zostawiłeś
• Kopia postępu do pliku i przeniesienie na nowy telefon

■ DLA KOGO
Dla kursantów KPP: strażaków PSP i OSP, ratowników WOPR i GOPR, policjantów, żołnierzy, ratowników górniczych i wszystkich, którzy zdobywają lub odnawiają tytuł ratownika (recertyfikacja co 3 lata). Przyda się też instruktorom KPP do przeglądania bazy.

■ WERSJA DARMOWA I PEŁNA
Za darmo: 50 pytań w nauce z powtórkami, plan do daty egzaminu i 1 egzamin próbny.
Pełny dostęp – jednorazowo 19,99 zł, bez subskrypcji, na zawsze: wszystkie 267 pytań do nauki, egzaminy próbne bez limitu, nauka wg działu i powtórka błędów. Działa w Chmurze rodzinnej.

Ważne: Testy KPP to niezależna aplikacja do nauki. Nie jest powiązana z Centrum Egzaminów Medycznych ani Ministerstwem Zdrowia. Treść pytań pochodzi z publicznie dostępnej bazy CEM, a odpowiedzi i wyjaśnienia są opracowaniem własnym opartym na aktualnych wytycznych. Aplikacja nie zastępuje kursu KPP ani zajęć praktycznych.

■ ŹRÓDŁA INFORMACJI URZĘDOWYCH
Oficjalne, aktualne informacje znajdziesz tutaj:
• Baza pytań KPP (CEM): https://www.cem.edu.pl/pliki/KPP2026.pdf
• Informacje CEM o KPP: https://www.cem.edu.pl/ppomoc.php
• Ustawa o Państwowym Ratownictwie Medycznym: https://eli.gov.pl/eli/DU/2026/141/ogl/pol
• Rozporządzenie MZ w sprawie kursu KPP: https://eli.gov.pl/eli/DU/2021/411/ogl/pol
• Zasady ratownictwa medycznego w KSRG (KG PSP): https://www.gov.pl/web/kgpsp/zasady-ksrg
Linki do wytycznych ERC 2025 są w aplikacji (Profil → O bazie → Źródła).

name: ThaiUndIch
description:
Mit ThaiUndIch erstellst du deine persönliche Vokabelsammlung und lernst thailändische Wörter mit deutscher Übersetzung, Thai-Schrift und Lautschrift.
Ergänze eigene Vokabeln und wiederhole sie mit Lernkarten in deinem Tempo. Wähle Lernrunden mit 10, 20 oder allen Vokabeln. Decke die Lösung auf und entscheide selbst: „Gewusst“ oder „Noch üben“. Anschließend wiederholst du gezielt die Wörter, die du noch üben möchtest.
Ob begleitend zum Sprachkurs oder zum selbstständigen Lernen: Du bestimmst, welche Vokabeln zu deinem Lernstand passen. Ergänzend findest du in ThaiUndIch Übersichten zu thailändischen Konsonanten, Vokalen und Tonregeln, die dich beim Lernen deiner Vokabeln unterstützen.

Es ist keine Registrierung oder Anmeldung erforderlich.

name: The Blank Atlas
description:
The world was erased. One surveyor is left, with a pencil and a blank page.

The Blank Atlas is a quiet idle game drawn in ink. Mark the ground, raise cairns, and people walk in out of the white to help. A camp grows, survey parties go out, and the map fills in, one map at a time:

• The Blank: your first marks, a camp, and the wolves at the edge.
• The Wetlands: test the marsh, lay causeways of reed, and time your work to the tide while a serpent hunts.
• The High Ground: take sight-lines from peak to peak, and cross the Far Range at night by the light of lamps.
• The Far Edge: someone else's survey is coming in from the other side.
• The Office: where the erasing began.

About three hours from the first mark to the ending. The camp keeps working while you're away, and the game plays fully offline.

The first map is free to play in full. One in-app purchase opens the rest of the atlas, Maps II to V, to the end of the game. There are no adverts, no account and nothing else to buy, and the game collects no data.

Plays in English, Deutsch, Español, Français, 日本語, Português (Brasil) and 简体中文.

name: The Electric Jungle
description:
The Electric Jungle is a neon-lit plant shop in Superior, Colorado: tropicals, cacti, succulents and rare collector plants, hand-picked and sold by people who actually grow them.

With the app you can:

• Shop the whole jungle — every plant we have, in every size, with real photos and care notes.
• Order ahead and pick up in the shop at 2145 Main Street, Unit 6, Superior, or get local delivery where we offer it.
• Pay quickly with Apple Pay or a card.
• Keep your rewards card on your phone. Earn 1 point for every $1; 100 points = $5 off. Show the code at the register, or add the card to Apple Wallet.
• Join the Jungle Club — a monthly plant membership where you pick your plants from the jungle.
• Track your orders.
• Sign in with Apple, or with your email.

Can't find a plant? Ask us from your account — we can source just about any plant in just about any size.

Shop hours: Mon–Fri 5:30pm–10pm · Sat 10am–9pm · Sun 11am–9pm.

name: The Fallacies
description:
Spot the flaw in any argument.

Get a quick intro to the fallacies that slip into everyday arguments, and learn more when you have the time.

A bad argument is much easier to see once you know its name. Here are forty-two of them, one at a time.

Open a box. The first thing you read is short: what the fallacy does, and a line to remember it by. Two choices? Look again.

Sometimes that's enough to catch it the next time someone tells you it's either this or the end of everything.

When you have longer, keep reading. A red herring was once a real fish, smoked until it reeked, and William Cobbett wrote of dragging one across a trail as a boy to pull the hounds off a hare. The Texas sharpshooter fires at the side of a barn, then paints the target around his tightest cluster of holes. Two centuries ago, Laplace watched crowds pile their bets onto lottery numbers that hadn't come up in a while, sure they were due.

From there each fallacy turns practical: how to hear it in a conversation, and what to say when you do, so the talk can get back to the question that was actually asked.

There are questions too, if you want them. Each fallacy has four short rounds, and every answer explains itself, so even a wrong one sharpens your ear.

Some mornings the fallacies come to you. Put Fallacy of the Day on your home screen and a new one is waiting each day.

Save the ones you keep running into, and send one to the friend who needs it most, perhaps after a family dinner. It all lives on your phone, with nothing to sign up for.



That’s it folks!

This text isn't gonna get any more interesting. I mean, I think we've pretty much covered all the good stuff. Still here? Ummmm, ok. How's everything? Good? Cool cool cool. 

What are you looking for? The app description is over. For real, check out the app. It's way better than hanging out in the App Store this long.

Wow, you're dedicated. Do you just love app descriptions? Weird. OK, we're gonna go now. Bye.

© FarFetched 2026

name: The Gain X Project
description:
The official app of The Gain X Project: bold bodybuilding gym wear designed for lifters in Dubai and across the UAE.

SHOP THE FULL RANGE
Browse every collection: oversize sets, training T-shirts, shorts, hoodies, women's wear and accessories. Search by name to find a piece fast.

SEE IT PROPERLY
Swipe through full-size photos, check which sizes are in stock, and see prices in AED.

SAVE WHAT YOU LIKE
Tap the heart on any piece to keep it in your Saved list, ready for when you want it.

FAST, SECURE CHECKOUT
Add to your bag and check out through The Gain X Project's secure store checkout, with the payment and delivery options the store offers.

BE FIRST ON EVERY DROP
Turn on drop alerts to hear about new collections, restocks and sales as they go live. Alerts are optional and you can switch them off at any time in your phone's settings.

No account is needed to browse, save or shop.

name: The Game Is Lying
description:
CAN YOU TRUST THE GAME?

Probably not.

THE GAME IS LYING is a fast, minimalist puzzle game where every instruction might be a trap. Each level gives you only a few seconds to decide: tap, wait, disobey—or question what the screen is really asking.

The rules keep changing. The game remembers your mistakes. And the obvious answer is rarely the right one.

FEATURES
• 30 handcrafted trick levels
• Fast 5–15 second challenges
• Tap, wait, read and think differently
• Instant restarts with no filler
• Minimal design built for quick play
• Works completely offline
• No ads, no account and no in-app purchases

Think you can beat the game?

Don’t trust everything you see.

name: The Kingdom: Pray & Meditate
description:
The Kingdom is a quiet place to pray, or to be still.

You arrive through the clouds at a sanctuary of marble and gold, framed by the Gate of Light. Today's word waits for you. Then there are only two choices: Pray, or Meditate.

PRAY
Write freely, or pray the Lord's Prayer, Psalm 23 or a simple guided prayer. When you offer it, your words gather into a light, and an angel comes down to carry it up into heaven. Keep it in your journal on this device to look back on, or let it go so it is saved nowhere at all.

MEDITATE
Be still and know, the Jesus Prayer, Psalm 23 read slowly, breath of stillness, the light within, loving kindness, or a silent sit. The altar's light breathes with you.

YOUR PATH
Forty lamps line the avenue, one lit for each day you come. Mark prayers as answered and see, over time, how they were.

PRAY FOR ONE ANOTHER
Share a request anonymously if you wish. Others can answer only one way: "I prayed for you." No names, no comments, nothing to argue with. While you are here, everyone else in the Kingdom appears as a small lamp in the sky above the sanctuary, so you know you are not alone.

Scripture is from the King James Version. The Kingdom is Christian by default and welcomes everyone: an optional welcome scroll lets you say what shapes your spiritual life, or choose a quiet thought or only silence instead.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your prayers and journal are kept on your phone, not on our servers. Shared requests follow simple community terms; anyone can report or block.

name: The Lions\' Den
description:
Welcome to The Lion’s Den! Your destination for relaxation, rejuvenation, and holistic wellness.

With The Lion’s Den app, you can easily explore and book a range of massage and wellness services designed to help you relax, recharge, and feel your best. Whether you're looking to ease muscle tension with a Deep Tissue Massage or unwind with a Holistic Aromatic Massage, we offer services focused on promoting relaxation and overall well-being.

Enjoy the convenience of browsing available services, viewing appointment schedules, booking your preferred treatments, and managing your appointments directly from your mobile device.

Take a moment for yourself and make self-care part of your routine. Download The Lion’s Den app today and discover a more convenient way to prioritize your wellness.

Relax. Restore. Rejuvenate. Welcome to The

name: The Pilates People
description:
The Pilates People

Welcome to The Pilates People, your movement and wellness studio in Bonn. Discover a welcoming space dedicated to Reformer Pilates, Mat Pilates, Strength and Barre, where movement, empowerment and community come together. Whether you're new to Pilates or looking to deepen your practice, explore a variety of classes designed to help you build strength, improve mobility and feel good in your body.

With the app, you can:

• Easily book and manage your classes
• View schedules and plan your sessions
• Explore Reformer Pilates, Mat Pilates, Strength and Barre classes
• Manage your credits, passes and memberships
• Discover classes across The Pilates People and The Vinyasa People studios
• Stay up to date with studio news and events

Move with intention, build strength and find your community at The Pilates People.

name: The Star History Tours
description:
Explore the history, architecture, and cultural heritage of an entertainment venue through illustrated articles, themed tours, and interactive learning experiences. Discover its development over time and learn about significant historical milestones.

Browse historical articles organized into three chronological categories: Origins & Foundation, Growth & Transformation, and Legacy & Milestones. Discover architectural developments, historical events, and notable stories. Save your favorite articles for easy access and share interesting discoveries.

Explore five themed historical tours covering the venue’s origins, architectural evolution, cultural heritage, entertainment history, and memorable moments. Each tour includes a detailed description, estimated duration, and itinerary.

Plan your visit by selecting a tour, choosing a date and time, and specifying the number of visitors. Access reservation details and a QR code after confirmation. Manage your reservations, update details, or cancel planned visits in one convenient place.

Expand your knowledge through interactive historical questions covering different periods, architectural changes, and significant events. Discover additional information and explore new perspectives on the venue’s history.

The app brings together historical articles, illustrated content, themed tours, reservation management, and educational activities in a convenient and accessible experience.

name: The Teaching
description: Listen to original workshop recordings from Phil Blecker and Dr. Bob, curated by Ana Talos (Lauren LeMay). Browse each teacher’s workshops by year, choose a recording, and follow along as you listen wherever a timed transcript is available.

name: The Time Machine Detective
description:
Three lighthouse keepers disappeared from a remote Scottish island. What can the evidence actually prove?

The Time Machine Detective is a historical mystery series. Open a case file, compare accounts, and follow each clue back to its source. Use the timeline and map to put events in context. Pin the evidence that matters and write a finding you can revisit or export as a PDF.

Volume One includes three investigations.

• The Light Went Out. Reconstruct the Flannan Isles landing, challenge your theory, and choose the evidence that would change your mind. Play this case free from start to finish.
• Before the Ripper. Compare early Whitechapel reports and trace a newspaper’s claim back through its sources.
• The Last Bearing. Plot a line from Amelia Earhart’s radio report, then decide whether the cutter’s later account changes where you would search.

One permanent in-app purchase unlocks Before the Ripper and The Last Bearing. Case files and progress are stored on the device. No app account, ads, or subscription. Once unlocked, the cases can be played offline. External source links open in your browser.

name: The Wayside Inn
description:
Run a little inn on the road to market and watch it grow, from a wayside cottage to a castle and on along an endless road of grander inns. Free to play; adverts only when you ask for one.

Hold the bell and guests come up the path. Carts take their loot to market, and the coins go back into the inn: more rooms, more carts, better recipes. Keep ringing and the busy taproom earns more. Then put the phone down. The inn keeps earning while you're away, and a letter on the mat says what it took in.

THE INN KEEPS GOING
For two hours to start with, and two hours longer for each lantern you light, up to twelve. Guests check out over time, so give the bell a ring now and then. Carrier pigeons bring small tips, and the innkeeper's list always holds three small jobs that pay keepsakes.

FOUR HEROES, A CAT AND THEIR TALES
Odette the clumsy knight, Mirabel the hedge wizard, Fennick the quiet forager and Tuck the travelling bard live on the lawn. Send one at a time on anything from a five-minute errand to an epic journey of a day and a night, to eight places from the Hollow Wood to the King's Forest, even while the app is closed. They come home with coins, trinkets and a tale in their own voice for the Ledger of Tales, where each hero's own story opens chapter by chapter. Heroes grow to level 30 with perks on the way, and three trinkets of a kind make one better. Pip the cat finds something on his own once a day.

AN ENDLESS ROAD OF GRAND INNS
Earn enough and move up: a market town, a mountain lodge, a harbour, a castle, a royal post-house, a cathedral city, the capital, and then grand inns further along the road for as long as you keep going, each with its own backdrop and loot worth ten times more.

RENOWN AND ROYAL SEALS
When you're ready, hand the keys to a new keeper and start again at the wayside cottage with Renown that adds to everything you earn. Royal seals, earned in play and never sold, make every point of Renown worth a little more, for good.

RESEARCH, HEIRLOOMS AND BOOSTS
Over seventy pieces of research, from the kitchen to the dovecote, each nudge one thing about the inn. Keepsakes buy 21 heirlooms that are never lost, and seven boosts, from Market Day to Feast Day, that stack together.

MAKE IT YOURS
Paint the walls, hang a signboard, put out window boxes and bunting, and give each hero a change of clothes. Just for looks, bought with keepsakes or earned along the way.

THE TRAIL
Take up the week's guild order and your inn is paired with a neighbour's. Fill it together over a few days for keepsakes and a trinket, or take it harder for a royal seal. Send a hero to stay, peek inside their inn, and post a friendly letter with a small gift once a day. Now and then an event week, like Fair Week, brightens every inn. No chat, no typing and no account: the letters are set lines and the inns go by made-up names.

YOUR INN, KEPT SAFE
Your inn is saved on your iPhone and in your own iCloud, so it comes back after a reinstall and follows you to a new phone. Reminders, if you'd like them, say when a hero is home or the lanterns have burned down, never late at night.

GENTLE ON YOU
Hold to ring, tap to collect, and small tips show the way one at a time. Soft sounds let your own music keep playing, and in the evening the moon comes up. VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion and Reduce Transparency are all respected.

FREE TO PLAY
Every keepsake, heirloom and boost can be earned by playing. Adverts are rewarded and only play when you ask: to double a pigeon's tip or the away takings, for a free Market Day every four hours, to bring a hero home early, to stretch a boost, or for half as many again of a guild order's keepsakes.

The shop sells keepsakes in five sizes, a welcome basket (once), the tip jar (every keepsake you find drops one in too; crack it open to keep them) and the Innkeeper's licence, a one-off that lights three more lanterns (18 hours away) and gives every advert bonus without the advert. No subscription.

name: Themochi: Cute Widgets & Icons
description:
Make your iPhone home screen irresistibly cute with Themochi! Discover kawaii themes, aesthetic widgets, pastel wallpapers and matching app icons, all in one adorable place.

CUTE THEMES FOR EVERY VIBE
Explore Strawberry Milk, kawaii animals, dreamy pastels and more. Preview coordinated wallpapers, widgets and icons, then follow a guided setup to bring your favorite look to your Home Screen.

WIDGETS MADE YOUR WAY
Customize clocks, calendars, photos, weather, quotes, countdowns, mascots and a battery pet. Choose small, medium or large widgets, then personalize colors, fonts, photos and stickers.

MEET YOUR MOCHI BUDDY
Choose a lovable companion during onboarding. Your Mochi appears on supported widgets and updates when you change buddies.

WALLPAPERS & MATCHING ICONS
Browse cute wallpapers and save them to Photos. Complete your theme with matching icons and step-by-step instructions for setting them up through Apple Shortcuts.

Find fresh looks, explore trending themes and save your favorites. Make every glance at your iPhone a little more adorable with Themochi!

name: Thermometers: Logic Puzzle
description:
Fill thermometers with mercury so that every row and column holds as many filled cells as the number beside it. Mercury always rises from the bulb, with no gaps.

Thermometers is a logic puzzle with two simple rules and surprisingly deep deductions. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

12 STAGES, 360 LEVELS
• From a small 5 × 5 on the glacier to a 15 × 15 under the sun
• Straight and curved thermometers; earn up to 3 stars on every level, each stage unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone (curved at weekends), with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 5 × 5 to 15 × 15, straight or curved, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Tap a cell for mercury, tap again to mark it as air; drag to fill many cells at once
• Auto-fill: mercury flows back to the bulb, air fills up to the tip (can be turned off)
• Numbers of complete rows and columns are ticked; rows with too much mercury are marked (in amber, or blue if you prefer)
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong marks; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: seven techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: Thread Gears
description:
Thread Gears finds a change-gear train for a lathe on this iPhone.

Enter the leadscrew pitch and the target pitch. The ratio is the target divided by the leadscrew. Each gear is used once, as a simple pair or a compound pair. Exact means the ratio matches. Within 0.1 percent is Approx. Anything wider is No train, and that train is not offered to mount. A compound train must clear the studs. If it fouls, the app swaps a pair and says so. When the thread and the screw use different units, 127 sits on the side the units require. The last gear set stays.

Gears stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Three Taverns Church
description:
This app will help you stay connected with the day-to-day life of our church. With this app, you can watch or listen to past messages, stay updated with push notifications about events and more, read the Bible, and see the Church Calendar.

Mobile app version: 6.24.8

name: Thronera
description:
One settler, one warrior, an empty land. That is all you need to found an empire.

Thronera is turn-based strategy for iPhone and iPad. Found cities, train armies and lead your people through eight eras: from the first spears of the Bronze Age to tanks, jets and missiles. Capture every capital, and the throne is yours.

CAMPAIGN “THE EMPTY THRONE”
Twelve missions in three chapters, told by the chronicler Edda: bring Runa across the winter pass, break a naval blockade, hold Semerun against the steppe and claim Thronera at the end. Every mission has its own map, its own goals and three stars. Or play a free game on a map nobody has ever seen.

NO LUCK, JUST TACTICS
Before every attack you see how it will end. Flanks, terrain, walls and generals decide, never chance. Those who move wisely win.

EIGHT ERAS, 42 UNITS
Chariots, knights, cuirassiers, tanks, stealth jets: every era changes your cities, your troops and the look of the game. Ships, artillery and aircraft are part of it, too.

TEN GENERALS
Orik the Thunder Hammer, Runa Iceshield, Aldemar the last knight: every general has a unique gift and gives unique orders. They lead a unit into battle and grow with every victory.

BUILD YOUR REALM
Army, upgrade and wonder: every city works on three projects at once. Raise eight world wonders, from the Sun Temple to the World Net, before a rival does.

A LIVING WORLD
Every turn is a season. It rains in spring, leaves fall in autumn, and in winter snow covers the land. Ruins hide treasures, and fate cards force you to make hard choices.

YOUR ARMY STAYS
Spend Fame at the camp to train seven troop types up to level 30, recruit generals and study at the academy. Units that rise to elite rank become legends and join you in your next game. If they fall, they are lost forever.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Rivals with plans of their own, three difficulty levels
• Every map is new
• The first mission explains the game step by step
• 35 achievements, daily tasks and daily rewards
• Works offline, no account needed
• Saves automatically and backs up to your iCloud, also for a second device

FAIR
Thronera is free. Everything that makes your troops stronger can be earned by playing. Videos only play when you tap the button yourself. If you like, make a one-time purchase of the Imperial Crown (double Fame, choose your people, gifts without videos), the General Staff (all ten generals) or the Campaign Pack, or pick up some Fame.

Your settlers are waiting. Where will you found your capital?

name: Ticket Master POS
description:
Ticket Master is a point-of-sale app for a business's own staff: it sells tickets at a counter and checks them at a gate. It is for parks, museums and fairs, haat tolls, stand and ghat fees, and public toilets.

Staff choose how many of each kind, collect the total and print a slip with a QR code. The gate checks the slip, and the day's figures show what was sold and what was admitted.

This app does not sell tickets to the public. A visitor buys at the counter and needs no app.

A SALE ON ONE SCREEN
A count for each category, such as adult, child, a vehicle or an animal, the total, and one tap to collect and print.

PRICES YOU SET
Each category has a fixed price at each location, from your own settings. The service works out the total. It is never typed in.

A CHECK AT THE GATE
The slip's code is checked at the gate, the visitors it covers are let in, and a slip already used is caught. A slip for five people can be admitted a few at a time.

SCAN OR TYPE
The gate reads a slip with a handheld scanner, with the phone's camera, or from its code typed in.

PASSES FOR REGULARS
A regular's monthly pass covers the ticket for their vehicle, at no charge.

SLIPS ON THE SPOT
Slips print on a Bluetooth receipt printer. Each lists the categories sold and carries one QR code.

SHIFTS AND REPORTS
Each cashier opens a cash shift and closes it against the expected cash. Owners and managers read money by category and by day, and sold against let in for each location. A voided sale's slip no longer admits anyone.

THE OWNER'S WEB PORTAL
An owner or manager signs in on the web to set the ticket categories and their prices, and to read the reports.

STAFF AND ROLES
Every member of staff has their own sign-in. A cashier sells and takes money. A gate operator lets visitors in and takes no money. Owners and managers set prices and read reports.

ENGLISH AND BANGLA
The whole app, and every slip, in English or Bangla.

NEEDS A CONNECTION
Selling and the gate check need an internet connection.

WHO IT IS FOR
Ticket Master is for businesses. To use it you create a company, or your employer gives you a sign-in.

PRIVACY
No advertising, no analytics and no tracking. The app asks for Bluetooth only when you look for a printer, and for the camera only when staff open the gate's camera scanner to read a slip's QR code. The picture is read on the device and is never stored or sent. The app asks for no contacts or phone identifiers.
Privacy policy: https://parkingmaster.app/ticket/privacy/

Questions: support@parkingmaster.app

name: Tidepaw Tactics
description:
Your cat hero has reached the shore, and a line of enemies is waiting inland. Hold and drag across the field to place your troops. Start with melee soldiers, then change your formation when archers join your roster. Each deployment uses food, so watch your supply as the fight unfolds.

Victories earn coins and unit cards. Between battles, spend your coins on your hero’s vitality, attack or food supply, then take your upgraded squad into the next stage. Reach Stage 3 to open the daily reward chest.

Play offline in portrait mode. Your iPhone saves your stage, upgrades and rewards between sessions.

name: Tik Tik - تك تك
description:
Run through the streets and markets of Arab cities in Tik Tik, a fast and funny endless runner!

Dodge carts, cars and walls, slide under obstacles, jump over barriers and collect every coin on the road, while the chaser of each city tries to catch you.

CITIES
• Ghost Town: a spooky, cartoon haunted town (and its ghost sheriff)
• Cairo: the old market under the pyramids, with a mummy on your tail
• Jeddah: Al-Balad and its wooden rawasheen
• Riyadh 2030: the city of the future, with robots everywhere
• More cities on the way

Earn stars in each city to unlock the next one, or unlock it with coins.

POWER-UPS
• The rocket boost: a burst of speed that smashes through obstacles
• Fly a rocket above the street, run on the clouds, magnets, double coins and shields

MORE
• Pick and upgrade your hero: Saif and Yasmin
• Daily and weekly missions with coin rewards
• Leaderboard: beat your best distance and climb the ranking
• Arabic and English
• No forced ads: a video plays only when you choose a reward

REMOVE ADS
"Remove Ads" gives you the rewards without the videos. It comes as a one-time purchase (Remove Ads Forever) or as a monthly subscription (Remove Ads Monthly). The subscription renews automatically every month at the same price unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://octabit.sa/en/tiktik/privacy

name: Tile Trio: Triple Match Game
description:
Tap tiles, collect three of a kind and clear the whole board!

Tile Trio is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle. Tap any free tile to send it to the tray. Three matching tiles clear away. Tiles that are covered by others stay locked until you free them, so think a move ahead and keep the tray from filling up.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of levels with layered boards
• Every level is generated to be solvable
• Helpful boosters: Undo, Magnet and Shuffle
• Beautiful tile themes: Mint, Night, Candy, Wood and Royal
• One-finger play, no timers, no pressure
• Play offline, anywhere

Tile Trio is free to play with optional ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off banners and break ads for good.

name: Timbee
description:
Keep everyday pet care together with Timbee: a pet passport, care calendar, diary and optional AI assistant.

Save the details you know, scan a vaccination card or vet document, and keep photos and notes with your pet's record. Review recognized information before saving it. Create care tasks and local reminders for appointments, medication and other routines. Track weight, add diary notes and record GPS walks for dogs.

The assistant can help with everyday care questions and use the pet information you choose to share. You can review its actions and confirm changes to care tasks before they are saved. AI answers can be inaccurate and do not replace a veterinarian. If your pet may need urgent help, contact a veterinarian or emergency clinic.

Pet records are stored on your phone. Timbee does not provide cloud backup or sync for these records. Account, usage and diagnostic information is processed as described in the Privacy Policy. Sign in with Apple or Google to use the app; internet access is needed for sign-in and assistant replies. AI features require a separate agreement, and pet-data sharing can be changed in Settings.

name: Timekeeper: Live Race Tracking
description:
Follow a race as it happens. Timekeeper shows live results, split times and the runner's position on the course map, so family and friends always know where their runner is.

WATCH A RACE
• Find any runner by bib number or name
• Follow them on the live course map
• See split times from the official timing system as they are recorded
• Leaderboards by race, category and gender
• Get a notification when the runner you follow reaches a checkpoint

RUN A RACE
• Sign in, enter your bib, and race with GPS
• Your family sees your live location between timing points
• Share a link that opens your position on the map
• Pace, splits and an estimated finish time while you run
• Your race history and results in one place
• Optional: connect Strava to add your activity after the race

HOW TIMING WORKS
Recorded split times come from the official timing system used at the event. Those are the official times. Timekeeper fills the gap between timing points with the runner's phone GPS, so the live map keeps moving between mats.

PRIVACY
Location is collected only while you are joined to a race, and only after you allow it. Leave the race or turn location off to stop. You can delete your account and data from Settings at any time.

Live position and estimates are for convenience. They are not official results and are not a safety service.

Questions: info@timekeeper.co.in

name: Tinh Ban: Lunar Almanac
description:
Tinh Ban is an offline-first East Asian Astronomical Lunar Almanac, hands-free family ritual prayer reader, hardware field measurement toolkit, and cultural study companion — thoughtfully crafted with zero ads and complete on-device privacy.

KEY FEATURES

• Astronomical Lunar Almanac (11 East Asian Regions):
  Calculated directly on your device for 1900–2100 across 11 East Asian timezones, preserving local meridian accuracy (including Vietnam UTC+7). Explore Sexagenary cycles (Can Chi), 24 Solar Terms, Auspicious Hours, traditional festivals, two-way Solar–Lunar date conversion, and New/Full Moon or family memorial reminders.

• Hands-Free Voice Assistant & Background Audio:
  Navigate screens or ask about lunar dates, auspicious hours, and measurements with your voice. Listen to spoken daily almanac briefings, ceremony prayers, and guided breathing meditations even with your screen locked using native Lock Screen playback controls.

• 18 Auto-Fill Family Prayers:
  Save your household names and address locally once to automatically populate 18 traditional ceremony prayers with zero blank placeholders. Features adjustable large text, altar setup visual guides, and hands-free voice narration.

• Interactive 12-Palace Zi Wei, 5-Element BaZi & HD Chart Sharing:
  Explore interactive 12-Palace Zi Wei Dou Shu charts, Solar-Term BaZi (Four Pillars) with 5-Element balance charts, Pythagoras Numerology, and bilingual 64 Hexagrams of the I Ching. Switch effortlessly between Plain-Language and Specialist views, and export high-resolution charts to share with family or study groups.

• Real-Sensor 24-Mountain Compass & 3-Band Lu Ban Ruler:
  - 24-Mountain Compass driven by your device's live magnetometer sensor with smooth heading stabilization, Eight Mansions, and Flying Stars references.
  - 3-Band Lu Ban Architectural Ruler (52.2 cm / 42.9 cm / 38.8 cm) with subtle tactile feedback across measurement boundaries.

• Native iPad & Two-Pane Foldable Support:
  Adaptive two-pane split layout tailored for iPad and dual-screen foldable devices, paired with lightweight Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets and a calm geometric breathing timer.

• Zero Ads & Complete On-Device Privacy:
  Works offline right from first launch with no account sign-up required, no ads, and no third-party tracking. Birth dates and family ritual profiles stay strictly on your device.

CULTURAL & EDUCATIONAL REFERENCE NOTICE
Tinh Ban provides astronomical calendar calculations, measurement utilities, and East Asian heritage reference tools strictly for cultural preservation, educational study, and personal reflection. It makes no deterministic claims about future events and does not substitute for medical, legal, or financial advice.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://tinhban.brainode.one/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://tinhban.brainode.one/privacy/

name: TM
description:
Il tuo stile, il tuo barbiere, il momento giusto per te. Con l’app TM, prenotare è semplice: scegli il servizio, la sede e il professionista a cui affidarti, poi seleziona il giorno e l’orario che preferisci.
Nella tua area personale trovi tutti i dettagli del prossimo appuntamento e lo storico delle tue visite, sempre a portata di mano.
Per una domanda o un’informazione, TM è a tua disposizione nella chat dell’app. Attiva le notifiche per ricevere risposte, aggiornamenti sulle prenotazioni e novità del salone: scegli tu quali comunicazioni ricevere, in qualsiasi momento.

name: todo by Gautam Jangra
description:
todo by Gautam Jangra is a fast, beautiful task manager that keeps everything you need free: no subscriptions, no ads and no account.

PLAN YOUR DAY
- Smart lists: All, Today, Upcoming, Pinned and Done
- Tasks are grouped automatically into Overdue, Today, Upcoming and Anytime
- Add notes, categories, priorities and due dates
- Break big tasks into steps with checklists
- Repeat tasks daily, weekly or monthly

NEVER MISS A THING
- Set a reminder time on any task
- Optional daily planning reminder
- Swipe to complete, pin or delete, with a quick Undo

STAY FOCUSED
- Built-in focus timer (15, 25 or 45 minutes)
- Pick the task you want to focus on and track your sessions

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Daily progress ring, streaks and a 7-day chart
- Progress by category

ON YOUR WRIST
- Apple Watch app that stays in sync with your iPhone
- Tick off tasks or add new ones with your voice

MADE YOUR WAY
- Five colour themes, plus light and dark mode
- Share or export your list as text

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your tasks stay on your device
- No account, no ads, no tracking

name: toiGo — помощник тамады
description:
toiGo — рабочее место тамады: все клиенты, брони, авансы и программы тоев в одном приложении.

ЧАТЫ С КЛИЕНТАМИ
• Переписка из Telegram в одном окне, фильтры «Непрочитанные», «Чеки», «Человек».
• Расшифровка голосовых сообщений клиентов — на кыргызском и русском.
• Итоги переписки и черновики ответов.

ИИ-АГЕНТ (тарифы «Старт» и «Бизнес»)
• Отвечает клиентам днём и ночью — по-кыргызски и по-русски, в вашем стиле.
• Предлагает свободные даты из вашего календаря и ставит предварительные брони.
• Режимы: «Авто» — отвечает сам, «Черновик» — готовит ответ, вы отправляете.
• Сложные вопросы передаёт вам.

КАЛЕНДАРЬ И БРОНИ
• Месяц с занятыми днями и вечерами, свободные даты на виду.
• Карточка тоя: дата, время, место, гости, номер заказа, связь с чатом.

ЧЕКИ И АВАНСЫ
• Клиент присылает чек — toiGo читает банк, сумму и получателя, сверяет с ожидаемым авансом и следит, чтобы номер не повторялся.
• Подтверждённый аванс закрепляет дату за клиентом.

ПРОГРАММА ТОЯ
• Анкета программы вместе с заказчиком, чек-лист на день тоя, сценарии и шаблоны.

ТАРИФЫ
• Базовый — чаты, календарь, брони, чеки, программы (без ИИ-агента).
• Старт — всё из Базового + ИИ-агент до 500 ответов в месяц, до 2 каналов.
• Бизнес — всё из Базового + ИИ-агент до 1 000 ответов в месяц, до 3 каналов, 2 сотрудника.
Подписка оформляется в приложении через App Store и продлевается автоматически каждый месяц, пока вы не отмените её в настройках Apple ID не позднее чем за 24 часа до конца периода.

Условия использования: https://app.toigo.live/terms
Политика конфиденциальности: https://app.toigo.live/privacy

name: TollOrNot: Tolls vs Gas Cost
description:
Toll road or the long way — which one actually costs you less?

TollOrNot does the arithmetic with your car, your fuel price and your distances, and gives you one clear answer: the cheaper route from A to B, and how much you save.

HOW IT WORKS
• Type where you're starting and where you're going. TollOrNot looks up a toll route and a toll-free route on the map, or you can enter the distances and tolls yourself.
• Pick your vehicle and fuel price, then tap See which is cheaper.

SEE THE MATH
• How we calculated this: the formula in plain words, then each route's own numbers — fuel + tolls = total.
• Drive time for every route. Set what an hour of your time is worth and TollOrNot tells you whether a faster toll route is worth the extra money.

THEN DRIVE IT
Open the route you choose in Google Maps, Apple Maps or Waze, from point A to point B.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Garage: save your cars with their fuel economy. Look it up in the U.S. EPA database or type it in. Gas, diesel and electric vehicles.
• Round trips, several tolls per route, and splitting the cost per person.
• Toll estimates for many U.S. bridges and tunnels; distance-based turnpike tolls you type in.
• Fuel price: after a map lookup, TollOrNot can fill in the weekly U.S. EIA average for the trip's state and your fuel grade.
• Your vehicles, trips and settings sync to your account, so they're on every phone you sign in on.
• Miles or kilometers; MPG, L/100 km or kWh/100 km; 10 languages; light and dark themes.

FREE AND PREMIUM
A free account is required. Every new account starts with 5 days of Premium, with nothing to pay. One trial per email address. After that, keep using the free version — with ads, 1 vehicle, your last 5 trips and 2 routes per comparison — or subscribe to Premium, monthly or yearly.

Premium includes:
• No ads
• Unlimited vehicles and trip history
• Compare up to 5 routes at once
• "What if fuel price changes?" slider and a yearly savings projection
• Compare the trip across your other vehicles
• Pinned trips and drive logging
• CSV export and monthly savings reports

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

SOURCES OF GOVERNMENT INFORMATION
TollOrNot uses public information published by these government agencies. Check the original source for official figures:
• Fuel economy: U.S. EPA and U.S. Department of Energy — https://www.fueleconomy.gov
• Average fuel prices: U.S. Energy Information Administration — https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/
• Toll rates:
 – MTA Bridges and Tunnels (New York) — https://www.mta.info/fares-tolls/tolls
 – Port Authority of New York and New Jersey — https://www.panynj.gov/bridges-tunnels/en/tolls.html
 – Bay Area Toll Authority (MTC) — https://mtc.ca.gov/about-mtc/authorities/bay-area-toll-authority-bata
 – Golden Gate Bridge, Highway and Transportation District — https://www.goldengate.org/bridge/tolls-payment/
 – Maryland Transportation Authority — https://mdta.maryland.gov/Toll_Rates/rates_Index.html
 – Delaware River and Bay Authority — https://www.drba.net
 – Mackinac Bridge Authority — https://www.mackinacbridge.org
The fuel economy and fuel price sources are also linked in the app under Settings → Data sources.

NOT A GOVERNMENT APP
TollOrNot is an independent app made by HeronLoop Inc. It does not represent any government entity and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or acting for the U.S. EPA, the U.S. Department of Energy, the U.S. Energy Information Administration, E-ZPass, FasTrak or any toll authority.

TollOrNot is made for driving in the United States: toll estimates are in U.S. dollars. Tolls, fuel economy, distances and drive times are estimates; check posted toll rates before you go.

Terms of Use: https://heronloop.com/apps/tollornot/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://heronloop.com/apps/tollornot/privacy/

name: Tonge
description:
Tonge brings nearby kitchens into one place. Explore restaurants, hotels, and local food spots, browse menus, and discover your next favorite meal.

Choose delivery or dine in, place and pay for your order, and follow updates as the kitchen prepares it. Save favorite dishes and kitchens, manage your orders, and keep up with delivery progress in one app.

Kitchens can share their menus and manage incoming orders through Tonge.

name: tonNUTZ!
description:
tonNUTZ is a chord instrument built on Euler's Tonnetz.

The Tonnetz is a map of harmony that cares about shared notes instead of function. Every major and minor chord is a triangle of its three notes, and triangles that touch share two of those notes. Tap a facet and the chord plays. Step to the facet beside it and exactly one note has moved. All 24 major and minor chords are up there, each spelled out seven times across the surface.

Euler drew it flat, and flat it has an edge, because in his tuning A flat and G sharp were different notes. In twelve equal steps they are the same note, so the map closes on itself in both directions. East meets west, north meets south, and the shape that comes out is not a sheet and not a globe. It is a torus. A donut.

That closure is what makes it an instrument. There is no border to stop at, so you can set off in any direction and keep going. There is the turn, round the hole, and the roll, round the tube, and they are two different routes through the same harmony. The skin rolls with the chords, and if you roll far enough the donut turns inside out.

The steps between neighbours are the neo-Riemannian ones, parallel and leading-tone. Here they are edges you can feel under your finger rather than operations to work out on paper.

BUILDING CHORDS
Tap a facet to play that chord, or another facet of the same chord for a different inversion. Hold to sustain, tap a lit facet to drop it, double tap to solo it, tap the space around the donut to clear.

Hold Stack and keep tapping neighbours to build sevenths, minor ninths, sharp elevenths. Then travel with the shape still held and the geometry comes with you, so the same figure arrives transposed somewhere else on the surface. That is the part a chord chart cannot do.

MOVING AROUND
Drag to spin and roll it. Pinch to zoom, and closer is louder and brighter. Turn on Play while scrolling and the donut sounds whatever you spin into the spotlight.

WHAT THE SURFACE SHOWS
Diminished sevenths run along one diagonal seam and augmented triads along the other. Fifths run round the bands, with sus2 and sus4 on the edge tabs either side of the chord you are on. Tap a seam and it plays.

Trail lights the last eight chords, so you can see where you went. Map lays the donut out flat in the corner. Cube Dance shows the four hexatonic bands, six facets each. Pivot draws a fifth as an arc around the note the two chords share. A keyboard under the stage shows what is sounding, with the chord's name above it.

SOUND
Glide, air and release. More glide rounds the facets off; none cuts them flat.

TUNINGS
Twelve equal steps is only the default. Pick any number of equal steps and the donut rebuilds itself from the chords that tuning actually has, wrapped the way that comes out roundest. Or drag a lit note sharp or flat to retune it by hand.

LOOK
Bare figure or frosted donut. Sprinkles. A tabletop made from your own photos. Full screen, edge to edge, for recording.

No account, no sign-up, nothing collected.

Made by Beat Kitchen.

name: Top Drive - Smacznie i Szybko
description:
Korzystając z naszej aplikacji:
• sprawdzisz aktualne menu w restauracji,
• złożysz zamówienie i zapłacisz wygodnie online (szybki przelew, BLIK, Apple Pay) lub gotówką/kartą,
• sprawdzisz koszt dowozu pod dany adres,
• wykorzystasz kupony promocyjne lub skorzystasz z innych promocji.

name: TopB Store
description:
TopB Store brings your shopping experience together in one app. Explore the store’s catalog, view product details, save favorites, and place orders from your phone.

With TopB Store, you can:

• Browse product categories and search for products.
• View product images, descriptions, and prices.
• Save products to your wishlist.
• Add items to your cart and review your order before checkout.
• Manage your shipping and billing addresses.
• View your order history and order details.
• Use the app in Arabic or English.

Payments

Money Transfer is currently the available payment method for placing orders. Review the payment instructions provided during checkout.

For assistance with products, orders, or payments, use the support contact details provided on this App Store page.

name: TopTrack Music
description:
One song a day. The one that hit hardest.

On TopTrack, everyone gets one pick a day, so it has to count. That turns your feed (the Globe) into a hand-picked list of the best songs your friends heard today, each one chosen to show who they are and what they’re feeling today.

It’s a globe because it’s a world: everyone you care about, each with one song, spinning together. And it sits in yours. Your Globe floats over a setting like the place you live, whether that’s mountains, coast, city, farm, desert, suburbs or woods and lakes. It’s under your real sky, with your real weather, seasons and time of day, because your song of the day belongs to the day you’re actually living.

• Paste a song link, add a caption or a photo, and it lands on the Globe for everyone you follow
• Explore your friends’ taste through their Core, a profile built from every song they’ve picked
• Crown your favorite song of the day. Every crown is a point for whoever picked it, so climb the monthly leaderboard and celebrate your taste
• Hear 30-second samples, or open the whole song in your own music app
• Like songs, leave notes and chat with everyone on your Globe
• Every night at midnight, the day’s songs go into your profile as a playlist

Get a nudge when friends post, so you never miss the day’s best song.

name: Torrtorn
description:
Torrtorn is an offline intake desk for grain dryer yards. After weigh-in, register plate, driver, crop, moisture and net weight. The app scores each ticket 0–100 by moisture risk, estimates the next call, and keeps high-moisture loads moving while a busy or paused tower holds the rest.

How to use it:
• Overview: today’s queue, jobs in progress, finished loads, average score. Feedback is at the top right.
• New ticket: fill the weighbridge fields and issue a ticket.
• Queue: call by priority and advance waiting → unloading → in-tower → done.
• Towers: watch capacity and run state; add or edit towers.
• History: find completed or cancelled tickets by crop.

Everything stays on this device. No account.

name: Toss Bistro
description:
Momo, the bistro's chef, never walks to the tables: he throws the dishes! Pull to aim, let go, and watch the plate bounce off pans, shelves and the bell before landing right in front of the customer.

• 40 handmade levels in 2 kitchens: the neighbourhood bistro and the mountain kitchen
• Chef's dishes: starter, main and dessert, three throws to land in a row
• Trick shots: up to 10 bounces for the boldest, replay and share them in slow motion
• Grow the bistro, tend the vegetable garden, bake bread and dress Momo
• Mystery box opened only with coins earned by playing, odds shown
• No energy, no subscription, no paid draws

Available in French and English.

name: ToyRoll: Retro Film Camera
description:
ToyRoll brings back the disposable film camera on iPhone. Load a film, shoot, wind the wheel and, when the roll is done, develop it and print it in the darkroom. There is no preview, no retake and no settings to stop you: just take pictures and look forward to the prints.

LOAD, SHOOT, WIND, DEVELOP
• 24 films, each with its own colors and grain, from warm everyday color to black and white
• Every frame clicks into place with a turn of the wheel, with a haptic tick for each notch
• Camera sounds for the shutter, the wind, the latch and the rewind crank
• When the roll is full, open the back latch and wind the film back by hand
• The date is burned into each photo the day you take it
• Leave a roll in the camera for weeks and it comes out a little faded, with dust on the film

THE DARKROOM
• Finished rolls become cards in your collection, with their negatives
• Print any photo again its own way: exposure, contrast, color and grain

MAKE IT YOURS
• Paint every part of the camera, from the body to the shutter button
• Wrap patterns, body prints and materials from denim to quilted leather and tweed
• Sticker packs, a charm that swings when you tilt the phone, straps and metals
• Your own lettering on the top and bottom of the camera

LITTLE THINGS TO COLLECT
• Small 3D objects turn up now and then while you shoot; turn them over and hang one on your charm
• Finish a set to open a new camera part

TOYROLL PRO
ToyRoll Pro opens every locked camera preset, including the ones added later. It is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

Support: https://pentarab.com/toyroll/support

Terms of Use (EULA): https://pentarab.com/toyroll/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pentarab.com/toyroll/privacy

name: Tr Connect
description:
Tr Connect è l'app pensata per semplificare il lavoro di ogni giorno dei collaboratori.

Con Tr Connect prenoti in pochi passaggi l'ingresso in ufficio, la scrivania o la sala riunioni, scegliendo data, sede e piano in base alle tue esigenze. Le prenotazioni restano sempre visibili nella pagina iniziale, insieme alle ultime novità.

Nella sezione Comunicazioni ricevi gli avvisi e le notizie aziendali in tempo reale e puoi ritrovarli in qualsiasi momento nell'archivio. Nella sezione Documenti consulti regolamenti, procedure e gli altri documenti condivisi dall'azienda, sempre aggiornati e a portata di mano.

name: Track Builder
description:
A course is assembled piece by piece from straights, left and right turns, loops, jumps and crossings, with piece dimensions and turn angles adjustable and undo within reach. The blueprint reports route length, difficulty and an estimated lap time for the chosen vehicle profile.

Layouts are kept in the Garage and shared as a PNG blueprint or an editable track file that a friend can import. Real laps are timed by tapping Lap at each crossing of the line, sessions are saved, and the fastest times are compared per layout. Online invitations let friends race the same layout on their own schedules and post times to a shared leaderboard. Build challenges draw one of 700 briefs with piece counts and turn limits.

name: TrackShine: Master Your Songs
description:
TrackShine masters your songs in minutes, right on your iPhone or iPad. Built for pop, rock, acoustic, hip-hop and dance: for musicians, producers and content creators who want a track ready for streaming and social media.

HOW IT WORKS
• Open an audio file or the audio of a video.
• TrackShine analyses loudness, spectrum, dynamics and stereo image and gives a clear verdict.
• Pick your target: Streaming (-14 LUFS), Loud (-11 LUFS) or Extra loud (-9 LUFS).
• Turn the Character knob to make your master warmer or brighter.
• Compare before and after with one tap at matched volume, then export your master.

WHAT YOU GET
• A target curve for regular songs, based on measurements of dozens of commercial masters.
• Smart EQ, multiband and parallel compression, tape saturation and a true-peak limiter that does not squash your song.
• Loudness-matched A/B comparison, so you hear what really changes.
• Everything happens on your device: your music is never uploaded and there is no account.

TrackShine is free. The app shows an ad while a master is rendering.

A tip: always listen on your own speakers or earbuds. Mastering is taste, and TrackShine leaves the final call to you.

name: TramAtlas
description:
TramAtlas is a field guide to the world's tramways, drawn from the Tramway Information archive. It answers the question that follows every enthusiast into an unfamiliar city: what is this car, and why does it look like one I have seen somewhere else?

The app treats each city as a small archive file. A destination blind rolls between places, a gauge ruler sorts the catalogue by the width of the track, and every fleet entry carries the year it was checked. Nothing is presented as a photograph of "now": the drawings are original, the dates are printed, and the source sits beside the entry.

For the traveller there is a planner that turns a city, a few interests and the time available into a ride with real stops, walking links and photo points. For the model maker there is a bench where scale, track width and livery are compared with the real car, including the details a kit leaves out. Rides you log stay on your phone and become a private schematic map of the cities you have visited.

TramAtlas is for people who read the destination blind before they look at the cathedral.

name: TRECK: kcal-teller met AI
description:
TRECK maakt bijhouden wat je eet zo makkelijk als een berichtje sturen.

ZEG HET, TYP HET OF MAAK EEN FOTO
"Twee boterhammen met kaas en een appel." Of een foto van je bord. TRECK herkent product en portie, schat kcal en macro's en zet het bij de juiste dag. Zeg je "gisteravond" of "zaterdag", dan komt het daar terecht. Klopt iets niet? Je past het met één tik aan.

JE DAG IN ÉÉN OOGOPSLAG
Een ring laat zien hoeveel je vandaag nog kunt eten, met eiwit, koolhydraten en vet eronder. Je dagdoel rekent TRECK uit op basis van je lengte, gewicht, leeftijd en doel.

IK HEB TREK
Zin in iets? TRECK laat zien wat nog past bij je dag: uit wat je eerder at, of met een tip uit de supermarkt.

RECEPTEN
Recepten met kcal, macro's en portiegrootte per bord. Zie vooraf wat een recept met je dag doet. Of maak een foto van je koelkast en laat TRECK iets bedenken.

VERBRUIK EN GEWICHT
Koppel Apple Gezondheid: je verbruik komt naast wat je eet, met je overschot of tekort per dag. Houd je gewicht bij en zie wanneer je je doel haalt.

SNEL HERHALEN
Wat je vaak eet, staat klaar. Eén tik en het staat erin.

PRIVACY
Je invoer wordt geanalyseerd door Google Gemini (betaalde versie): Google traint er niet op en verkoopt niets. Dat vragen we je eerst. Je kunt alles downloaden en alles wissen. Optioneel slot met Face ID.

GRATIS BEGINNEN
Probeer TRECK gratis, met 7 hapjes AI-tegoed per dag in de eerste 60 dagen (een tekst kost 1 hapje, een foto of spraak 2). Handmatig invoeren kan altijd. Met een abonnement krijg je meer:
• TRECK Plus: 15 hapjes AI-tegoed per dag en extra functies wekelijks.
• TRECK Pro: onbeperkt AI (redelijk gebruik) en extra functies dagelijks.
Abonnementen verlengen automatisch per maand en lopen via je Apple-account. Opzeggen kan tot 24 uur voor de verlenging in je Apple-instellingen. De prijs zie je in de app voordat je koopt.

Voorwaarden: https://treckfood.app/privacy.html#voorwaarden
Privacy: https://treckfood.app/privacy.html

Alle waarden zijn schattingen van AI en geen medisch advies. Heb je een medische aandoening of een eetstoornis, overleg dan met een arts of diëtist.

name: Trick Line
description:
A skateboarding game set in neon cities of the 80s. Land tricks as you ride and chase a high score on every stage.

THREE MODES, 15 STAGES
- Street: dodge boxes and rails on the way to the finish (5 stages)
- Park: score as much as you can in a half-pipe before time runs out (5 stages)
- Race: race the clock to the finish (5 stages)
Ride through New York, Tokyo, Paris, London and Rio.

40 REAL TRICKS
20 flip tricks including the kickflip, heelflip, 360 flip, hardflip and impossible. 5 grabs including the indy and the method. 10 grinds and slides including the 50-50, boardslide and smith grind. Manuals and powerslides too.
All with one finger: swipe in the air for a trick, hold your finger down to grab. The trick guide shows how to do every one.

RIDES LIKE A BOARD
Hit something at a bad angle and you fall, get up and step back on. You can't push on a rail. Every landing and grind is felt through your phone.

BUILD YOUR BOARD
Put together your deck, trucks, wheels, bearings and grip tape from 62 parts. Spend the SP you earn by skating on higher-grade parts: they make you faster, pop higher, and better decks unlock more tricks.

AVATAR
Pick your clothes, shoes, hairstyle, and hair and skin colour.

WORLD RANKING
Compete with players around the world on every stage through Game Center.

PRICE
Free to play with no ads. The only purchase is Pro Parts, a one-time buy with the top parts, including decks that can do all 20 flip tricks.

Available in 11 languages.

name: Triple Bamboo: Merge Puzzle
description:

But watch out for the pandas! They wander around the board and take up space. Box them in so they can't move and they'll turn into lucky darumas you can merge too.

HOW TO PLAY
• Place the next piece anywhere on the board
• Match 3 or more equal pieces to merge them into a better one
• Chain merges to score combos
• Store a piece in the reserve slot and use it when it suits you best
• Trap the pandas to turn them into new pieces
• Plan ahead: when the board is full, the game is over!

FEATURES
• 24 handcrafted campaign levels with new mechanics and goals
• Infinite Mode: play as long as you can and climb the global leaderboard
• Special items: jade crystals, lightning, swap coins and evolution leaves
• Red pandas that dig tunnels and pop up anywhere
• Beautiful zen art and calm music
• Day and night themes
• Short sessions, perfect for a quick break
• Sync your progress with Apple, Google or email
• Optimized for iPhone and iPad

Easy to learn, hard to master. How big can your bamboo city grow?

name: Ultimate Caving App
description:
Ultimate Caving App is a 100% free, ad-free, subscription-free offline cave navigation map, 3D underground dead-reckoning tracker, and peer-to-peer squad radar built specifically for cavers, speleologists, and cave exploration teams operating where cell towers and satellite signals vanish.

100% FREE, ZERO ADS, ZERO SUBSCRIPTIONS, ZERO TRACKING
Every caving tool is permanently unlocked at zero cost with no advertisements, no paywalls, no accounts, and no telemetry or developer servers. All cave tracks, depth profiles, waypoints, and squad links remain strictly on your device and local radios.

OFFLINE CAVE APPROACH MAPS & BUILT-IN DARK CANVAS
- Pre-download OpenTopoMap or custom tile regions around cave entrances before leaving signal.
- Built-in Offline Grid (Dark Canvas) renders your 3D cave trail, entrance anchor, squad teammates, and junction waypoints with zero internet access and zero map downloads required.
- Surface GPS on the hike to the cave entrance automatically calibrates your stride length and compass heading offset before you descend underground.

3D UNDERGROUND CAVE DEAD RECKONING & SURVIVAL HARDENING
When satellite signal drops inside a limestone cave, lava tube, karst passage, or pit, Ultimate Caving App pins a Cave Entrance Anchor and switches automatically to 3D inertial and barometric dead reckoning:
- Kalman-filtered barometric cave depth: tracks vertical drop in metres, feet, or level numbers with an explicit weather-drift advisory after 2 hours without a known-elevation reference.
- Magnetic interference and compass accuracy alerts: monitors live magnetic field magnitude and heading accuracy, inflating horizontal uncertainty honestly near iron-bearing rock, steel ladders, carabiners, or headlamp battery packs so estimates never look artificially precise.
- Rope-pitch and vertical climb warnings: detects rapid barometric elevation changes without footsteps during rappels, climbs, or crawls so you know horizontal position is paused until walking resumes.
- Interactive rotatable 3D cave depth profile and live uncertainty circle on the 2D map.
- Snap drift correction: tap "I'm here" at any surveyed station, junction, or known cave landmark to re-zero accumulated dead-reckoning drift.
- 24-hour crash and battery-swap recovery: atomic on-device trip checkpoints let you resume an interrupted cave trip with an explicit gap-duration warning.

3D FLOOR-GATED GUIDE ME BACK TO THE ENTRANCE
- Reverses your recorded 3D breadcrumb trail back to the cave entrance anchor or any saved junction waypoint, with turn-by-turn bearings and offline spoken prompts.
- Strict 3D vertical floor gating refuses to declare arrival if you are horizontally over a waypoint on the wrong cave passage level.

ZERO-NETWORK P2P CAVING SQUAD MESH & RESCUE BEACON
Phones sharing a squad code connect directly over local peer-to-peer Bluetooth and Wi-Fi (MultipeerConnectivity with required encryption) and UWB Nearby Interaction on supported hardware, with zero cell or internet service:
- Authenticated HMAC squad codes prevent stray nearby devices from injecting false positions.
- Store-and-forward relaying passes teammate positions, cave depth, and battery levels around bends.
- Synchronized visual and audio Sync Beacon (steady, slow, fast, SOS) with auto screen-flash fallback if camera flash is unavailable.

IMPORTANT CAVER LIFE-SAFETY NOTICE
Ultimate Caving App is a supplemental aid only. Dead reckoning drifts, barometers shift with weather, iron rock and gear distort compasses, and batteries fail in cold, wet caves. Never rely on a phone alone underground. Always carry three independent lights, a physical compass, waterproof cave surveys, and a surface callout plan.

Privacy Policy: https://c60llc.com/apps/ultimate-caving-app/privacy/
