• 90-Second Craving Panic Wave: Hit SOS when a craving strikes for a guided breathing wave and 1-tap healthy Panic Swaps.
• Grace Slip Log (Zero Guilt): Had one dessert? Log a Grace Slip to preserve your momentum and Clean Day Rate instead of losing everything.
• Craving Trigger Heatmap: Discover your exact vulnerable hours and emotional triggers.
• Hidden-Sugar Barcode Scanner: Spot 45+ disguised sugar aliases (maltodextrin, dextrose, agave, syrups) online or offline.
• 14-Day Sugar Flu CBT Playbook: Day-by-day science milestones and practical coping strategies.
• Guest-First & Private: Start immediately with zero forced login. Optional cloud backup and 1-tap permanent account deletion anytime.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
UnSweet 90 Pro is available as an auto-renewable Annual plan (with an eligible 3-day free trial) or Weekly plan. Payment is charged to your store account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store or Google Play account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://barbarda.com/unsweet90/privacy
Terms of Use: https://barbarda.com/unsweet90/terms

Wellness Notice: UnSweet 90 is an informational habit-tracking tool and does not provide medical advice.

name: Unwind Knot
description:
A few tangled threads can become something lovely.

Unwind Knot is a relaxing rope puzzle where every thread you free becomes part of a handmade craft. Untangle yarn on a wooden ring, finish your creations and give them a place in your cozy home.

MOVE A THREAD, MAKE A LITTLE MORE
Drag either rope end into an empty, reachable hole. You can also tap a peg, then tap its destination. Work through the crossings and watch the freed yarn become stitches in your next creation.

A HOME MADE BY YOU
Make a striped scarf, a soft rabbit, a patchwork blanket and more. Each item grows across five puzzles. Finish it, enjoy the reveal and place it in its room to open the next craft. Visit My Shelf to see what you have made.

75 PUZZLES, FIVE PLACES TO MAKE YOUR OWN
Start in the living room and follow the path through the kitchen, bedroom, entryway and garden porch. Three-thread puzzles introduce the moves, while later tangles bring up to six ropes and more complex crossings. There are 15 crafts to complete.

YOUR OWN QUIET WORKTABLE
Choose rope styles, board finishes and backgrounds. Adjust sound, haptics, brightness and the thumb gap to make playing comfortable. An illustrated guide helps you get started. Haptics are available on supported devices.

Play at your own pace, without a countdown. The game is included in the app for offline play, and your progress saves on your device. No account is needed. There are no ads or in-app purchases in this version.

Untangle a little yarn. Make a little home.

name: UP2DATE Systems
description:
UP2DATE Systems keeps field jobs in one place. The office dispatches the visit. The engineer files arrival, departure, findings, materials, and photos. Chat stays on the job.

Create an admin account for your company. Add engineers and seniors. They sign in on the phone. A new company can log 50 jobs. UP2DATE approves full access when you are ready.

What you can do

• See new, in-progress, discarded, and completed jobs
• Filter by engineer, trade, client, and visit date
• Assign a job and alert only the people you just added
• File the site report from the phone, with photos
• Message the office on that job, with photos and documents
• Plan the day’s visits
• Add employee logins yourself
• Delete your account in the app or on the web

Each company sees only its own jobs.

name: Urge Surf: Ride Out Cravings
description:
When an intense craving strikes, trying to fight it with willpower often makes it feel stronger. Whether it is reaching for snacks, scrolling social media, smoking, or making impulsive purchases, resisting can feel exhausting.

Urge Surf is a self-help timer built to help you pause, breathe, and ride out cravings using the technique known as "urge surfing."

Cravings are like ocean waves. They rise in intensity, peak, and naturally fade away. Instead of battling the urge, you can ride the wave with calm curiosity until it passes.

How It Works
When a craving hits, open the app and take a pause:
• Choose your urge: Select snacking, cigarette, phone and social media, shopping, or other, then tap "Ride it out."
• Follow the wave: Breathe along with the gentle inhale and exhale guide while the timer counts down (default 10 minutes, adjustable).
• Grounding tips: Rotating suggestions remind you to drink water, notice bodily sensations, name what you feel, stretch, or look out the window.
• Check in: After the timer ends, record whether the urge is gone, weaker, or still strong.

Holding On
If you feel tempted to stop early, a brief pause—waiting a few seconds or watching a short ad—gives you a moment to reconsider and hold on a little longer.

Key Features
• Wave countdown timer with customizable duration
• Mindful breathing guide to steady your pace
• Practical grounding tips to redirect your focus
• Quick post-timer check-in to track urge intensity
• Progress tracking with streaks, daily stats, and weekly history
• Sound and vibration toggles
• Privacy-focused: no account required; data stays on your device

Ad Removal
The app is free with ads. A one-time in-app purchase is available to remove all ads permanently.

Important Disclaimer
Urge Surf is a self-help timer, not a medical device or treatment. It does not provide medical advice and does not guarantee smoking cessation or weight loss. For help quitting smoking, addressing eating habits, or managing health conditions, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.

name: URManager
description:
URManager is property management for hosts and landlords — short-term rentals and long-term leases in one place. This app gives you your whole URManager account on your iPhone and iPad, with notifications the moment something needs you.

BOOKINGS & LEASES
• Vacation stays, month-to-month and long-term leases in one calendar
• Rent and fees billed automatically, with late fees and pro-rating
• Renewals, rent increases and move-in / move-out inspections

GUESTS & TENANTS
• Message guests and tenants from one inbox
• Leads from your listings become contacts and bookings
• Guests and tenants get their own app for check-in details, payments and requests

SMART LOCKS
• Door codes that start at check-in and expire at checkout — no key handoff

MAINTENANCE
• Service requests from tenants and guests, with photos
• Assign them to your team or vendors and track them to done
• Scheduled maintenance that files itself

MONEY
• Income, expenses and receipts in one ledger — snap a receipt with your camera
• Loans, property values and a return-on-investment report per property

AND MORE
• Agreements with e-signatures
• Property websites with a booking calendar
• Ria, an AI assistant that can answer questions about your portfolio and do the busywork
• Team members with roles and permissions

Sign in with your existing URManager account, or create one with email, Google or Apple.

name: Vadual Tide
description:
Explore marine forecasts for coastal cities, ports and stations with Vadual Tide. View predicted sea level in an interactive daily chart and inspect surface current speed and direction where available. Browse the calendar, save your favorite coastal points and compare their charts in local time. Official high and low tide times are available at supported stations.

Forecasts use Copernicus Marine data. The app displays the coordinates of the model point. Coverage varies by place and date. Consult official nautical sources for navigation.

name: Vardela: Shift Work Calendar
description:
Vardela is a fast, clear, and completely offline personal shift planner built for shift workers. Set up your schedule in minutes with no account required, read your calendar with distinct shift colors, and see your real time off.

Key features:
• Flexible setup: Ready-made rotations (2/2/2/2, 24/48, 12/36, 4/2, 5/2, fixed morning/evening/night, weekly rotating), custom cycle builder, or manual entry.
• Today overview: Current and upcoming shift, start/end times, overnight shift continuation, next full free day, and weekly/monthly work summary.
• Color-coded Month & Week Calendar: Morning, evening, night, leave, and free days are clearly separated by color. Supports one-off shift swaps, leave tracking, daily notes/location, and batch day selection.
• Time Off finder: Spot full shift-free days, weekends, and multi-day breaks across 7, 30, and 90 days—with an optional recovery buffer after night shifts.
• Shift reminders & alarms: Separate iOS notifications before shift start, at start, and at end.
• Home & Lock Screen Widgets: Check today's shift and your 7-day lookahead without opening the app.
• Share & Backup: Export week/month schedules as PNG or PDF, sync with Apple Calendar, and keep versioned JSON backups on your device.
• Privacy first: No account, no cloud requirement, no ads, and no tracking. Your schedule stays on your device.

name: Vasca Dagama
description:
This application offers a seamless interface designed to streamline your daily workflow and boost personal productivity. By focusing on intuitive interactions and clean visual elements, it empowers you to manage complex responsibilities with total ease. Every feature is crafted to eliminate distractions, allowing you to concentrate fully on what matters most during your busy schedule. Whether you are coordinating professional deadlines or balancing household chores, this solution adapts to your unique rhythm. You will find that staying organized becomes a natural part of your morning routine instead of an overwhelming burden. The system allows you to categorize different segments of your life effectively, ensuring that no detail slips through the cracks while you move forward with confidence and clarity. These carefully curated tools help you regain control over your time, transforming hectic days into manageable sequences of events that lead toward your personal success in a variety of fast-paced environments.

Experience a smarter way to track progress and achieve your objectives without the friction often associated with standard planning tools. The underlying architecture prioritizes speed and reliability, ensuring that your data remains accessible exactly when you need it. Users often report a significant shift in their mental clarity once they start utilizing these sophisticated yet accessible features. You can monitor your development over time through insightful feedback mechanisms that celebrate your small victories and highlight areas for improvement. This journey towards peak efficiency is supported by a robust framework that respects your privacy and emphasizes user control. Feel the satisfaction of crossing items off your list as you navigate through your commitments, knowing that every action contributes to a more balanced and structured lifestyle where nothing feels left behind or forgotten. Adopting this methodical approach minimizes stress and helps you maintain focus on long-term goals while staying grounded in your current requirements.

Customization options within the software allow you to tailor the experience to fit your personal preferences and functional requirements perfectly. You can adjust the way information is displayed, set specific reminders for critical windows, and create pathways that suit your cognitive style. This level of flexibility ensures that the interface grows alongside your needs, remaining a valuable asset even as your priorities evolve. Engaging with the platform fosters a proactive mindset, encouraging you to map out your intentions before starting the day. By reducing cognitive load, the utility clears space for creative thinking and deeper focus. Join a growing community of individuals who have discovered the power of intentional living through a refined digital companion that understands the value of time and the importance of steady progress in every single endeavor you choose to undertake today. Utilizing these flexible configurations guarantees that your digital environment remains perfectly aligned with your changing habits and objectives as you grow, develop, and strive for greater achievements throughout your ongoing personal development process.

name: Vaulted | Vehicle Storage
description:
Vaulted helps vehicle storage teams manage their daily work from their phone.

Find vehicles, scan registration plates, complete check-in and departure reports, capture photos and keep operational records up to date.

• Search stored vehicles and view vehicle details
• Scan registration plates to find vehicles quickly
• Complete vehicle checks and capture supporting photos
• Manage arrivals, departures and off-site movements
• View schedules and complete assigned tasks
• Upload vehicle photos directly from your phone

Requires an existing Vaulted account and an internet connection. Access depends on your organisation and assigned permissions.

name: VAuthenticator
description:
VAuthenticator protege tus cuentas con códigos de verificación en dos pasos (TOTP y HOTP) y aprobaciones con coincidencia numérica, en una interfaz limpia, rápida y sin distracciones.

Funciones principales:
• Códigos 2FA al instante: consulta tus códigos de 6 u 8 dígitos y cópialos con un solo toque.
• Alta sencilla: escanea códigos QR con la cámara, importa desde una imagen o añade cuentas manualmente.
• Bóveda cifrada en tu dispositivo: tus secretos se cifran localmente con tu frase de contraseña y bloqueo automático.
• Copias de seguridad cifradas: exporta e importa archivos cifrados o activa la copia en la nube opcional.
• Aprobaciones seguras: recibe y confirma solicitudes de inicio de sesión con verificación numérica para servicios compatibles.
• Sin necesidad de cuenta para empezar: funciona 100 % sin conexión para todos tus códigos TOTP/HOTP.

name: VenueTech Pulse
description: Pulse shows point of sale reports on iPhone and iPad for existing VenueTech merchants and their authorized users. There is no public signup. Compare net sales, checks, guests, and average check size across locations. Choose a date range to see when sales peak, then open a location to explore sales mix, guest checks, and employee performance.

name: Verni: Book Local Services
description:
Verni shows you who is free near you and lets you book in a few taps.

FOR CUSTOMERS
• Discover businesses in your feed: barbers, nail studios, garages, clinics, trainers and more.
• See free times on the map, and pick a business by when and where it suits you.
• Look before you book: photos, address, opening status and prices on every business page.
• Choose the service, who with and when, then book.
• Ask Verni's AI for what you need ("a haircut tomorrow morning in Tel Aviv") and get businesses with free times. Check the details before you book: AI answers can be wrong.
• Call a business's AI receptionist right from the app: it answers in your language, tells you about services and free times, and suggests a booking you confirm.
• Message businesses directly and keep every conversation in one inbox.
• Follow businesses you like and save them for later.
• Sign in with your mobile number, Apple, Google or e-mail.

FOR BUSINESSES
Run a business? Switch to your business side in the same account. Put your business on Verni with your photos, services and hours, let customers book your free times, and manage your bookings, your team and your messages in one place. Show your world.
Your own AI receptionist answers customers' calls, day and night.

Verni. Exactly in place.

Verni is built for businesses in Israel.

name: Vert: Elevation Gain Tracker
description:
Vert turns the climbing you already do into a game you can win.

It adds up the elevation gain from your hikes, runs and rides, plus the flights of stairs your iPhone and Apple Watch count, then shows how high you've really climbed: today, this week, this month and all time.

Vert reads your Apple Health data. It doesn't record workouts or show live altitude, so keep using your watch or favorite fitness app and let Vert do the climbing math.

CLIMB REAL LANDMARKS
• Start an expedition up a real landmark, from city towers and hills to famous mountains and Everest.
• Only the climbing you do from now on counts, so every summit is earned.
• Reach the top for a summit badge and a card to share, then pick your next climb.
• 130+ landmarks, with your first one picked for where you live.

WEEKLY QUEST AND DAILY GOAL
• Set a weekly elevation goal and a smaller daily one, and watch the ridge fill up.
• See today's climb split into workouts and flights, a seven-day chart, and your history by week, month and year.
• Famous Climbs shows which landmark your day or your week would reach.
• Level up from Base Camp to Alpine Legend as your lifetime climb grows.

BADGES, CHALLENGES AND RECORDS
• 139 badges for streaks, big days, workouts, stairs, expeditions and more. Tap a locked one to see how close you are.
• Monthly and seasonal challenges, like Everest in a Month.
• Personal records, plus a month and year in review you can share.

TAKE IT WITH YOU
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for today's climb, your weekly quest and your expedition.
• Ask Siri: "How much have I climbed today in Vert?"
• Optional notifications for badges, summits and when you're close to your weekly goal.
• Count everything, only workouts, or only flights climbed.
• Feet or meters, to match your region.

WHERE THE DATA COMES FROM
• Workouts: elevation gain from hikes, runs, rides and more, recorded by Apple Watch or any app that saves to Apple Health.
• Flights climbed: stairs counted by your iPhone and Apple Watch.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Vert only reads from Apple Health, and your data stays on your device. No account needed.

name: Veyl Play
description:
Ένα πορσελάνινο πουλάκι. Ένα καρούλι κλωστής. Ένα μικρό μπρούτζινο κλειδί. Κάθε αντικείμενο έχει τον προορισμό του και η διαδρομή αλλάζει με κάθε συρτάρι που μετακινείς.

Μετακίνησε τα συρτάρια οριζόντια, ευθυγράμμισε τα ανοίγματά τους και άφησε χώρο για να περάσουν τα αντικείμενα. Οδήγησε το καθένα στο αντίστοιχο άνοιγμα συλλογής και, στο τέλος, επέστρεψε όλα τα συρτάρια στην αριστερή τους θέση.

Μικρός χώρος, πολλές έξυπνες διαδρομές:
• 18 γρίφοι σε τρεις συλλογές.
• Περισσότερα συρτάρια, κοινά ανοίγματα και συγκεκριμένη σειρά συλλογής καθώς προχωράς.
• Προεπισκόπηση κάθε κίνησης πριν από την επιβεβαίωση, με δυνατότητα ακύρωσης.
• Ελεύθερη αναίρεση και υπόδειξη για το επόμενο βήμα από την τρέχουσα θέση.
• Συνέχιση ενός ημιτελούς γρίφου με την πρόοδο αποθηκευμένη στη συσκευή.
• Επανάληψη των 30 πιο πρόσφατων ολοκληρωμένων διαδρομών, κίνηση προς κίνηση.
• Κοινοποίηση μιας κάρτας συλλογής μέσω του μενού κοινοποίησης του συστήματος.

Δεν υπάρχει χρονόμετρο στους γρίφους ούτε αναλώσιμο νόμισμα για υποδείξεις. Η μουσική είναι αρχικά απενεργοποιημένη. Η μουσική, τα ηχητικά εφέ, η απτική ανάδραση και η μείωση κίνησης έχουν ξεχωριστές ρυθμίσεις.

Το περιβάλλον του παιχνιδιού είναι προς το παρόν στα αγγλικά. Οι γρίφοι χρησιμοποιούν γράμματα, ανοίγματα και οικεία αντικείμενα. Η βοήθεια και οι σύντομες οδηγίες είναι επίσης στα αγγλικά.

Η εφαρμογή περιλαμβάνει το AppsFlyer για την απόδοση προωθητικών ενεργειών και ενδέχεται να εμφανίσει το αίτημα άδειας παρακολούθησης της Apple. Η επιλογή σου δεν αλλάζει την πρόσβαση στους εγγενείς γρίφους ή την αποθηκευμένη πρόοδό σου.

name: VI Reminders
description:
Chores, but missions.

VI Reminders is a shared to-do list for two people, with the look of a video game mission screen. 
Send your partner a mission and it lands on their phone as a mission card: 

MISSIONS FOR TWO 
- Assign a mission to your partner, yourself, or whoever gets to it first 
- Pick an exact time, or a window: morning, afternoon, evening, night or anytime 
- You both see each other's lists, live 
- Either of you can mark a mission complete, and the other gets a "Mission complete" alert

ALERTS THAT FEEL LIKE A GAME 
- Reminders arrive at the right time, or early if you like 
- New missions from your partner show up instantly

PICK YOUR CHARACTER 
- Choose from a cast of illustrated characters 
- Or turn your own photo into a character with AI (optional, 18+, up to 3 a month)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN 
- Only you and your partner see your list 
- No ads, no tracking, no camera access 
- Your original photo is deleted as soon as your character is drawn 
- Delete your account any time from Settings

name: Viet House
seller_name: A2D SOLUTIONS SP Z O O
description: Viet House w trzciance zaprasza na smakowite dania kuchni wietnamskiej i tajskiej. Przeglądaj nasze menu i zamawiaj na odbiór. Sprawdź status swojego zamówienia po jego złożeniu. Wybierz spośród dań takich jak: gorący półmisek - kurczaka po wietnamsku, zupę tom kha z kurczakiem, sajgonki, ramen smażony z wołowiną, czy pad thaia z kurczakiem. Zapłać online lub gotówką przy odbiorze.

name: Villagers Must Die
description:
One of you is a werewolf, and nobody knows who. Villagers Must Die is a hidden-role party game for friends: lie, accuse, defend and vote before the village falls.

HOW A ROUND PLAYS
Every round has a night and a day. At night the wolves choose someone to hunt, and players with special roles use their abilities in secret. By day everyone talks, accuses, defends and votes one player out of the village. Phases are short, so rounds stay lively.

10 ROLES
Villager, Seer, Healer, Hunter and Watchman defend the village. Werewolf, Alpha Werewolf and Witch play for the wolves. The Jester and the Serial Killer play for themselves. Every role has its own win condition, so every game plays out differently.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Create a room and share a 4-digit code, an invite link or a QR code. Rooms hold 4 to 16 players. Missing seats can be filled with bots, and if a player drops out, a bot takes the seat so the game never stalls.

TALK IT OUT
Written chat for the day discussion, a private chat for the wolves at night, and a chat for the eliminated. Prefer to talk? Join the optional voice chat in the lobby or during the game; you hear only the players in your own group. You can report and block players at any time.

LEARN IN MINUTES
A short introduction and a practice game against bots teach you the basics. Each role explains itself the first time you get it.

PLAY AS A GUEST
No sign-up is needed. Pick a name and an avatar and play. Add an email later if you want to keep your profile on another phone.

IN ENGLISH AND TURKISH
Choose your language on the sign-in screen or in the app settings.

FAIR BY DESIGN
All game decisions are made on the server. Your role stays hidden from everyone else until it is revealed in the game.

name: VILORA — susedia na dosah
description:
VILORA je nezávislá súkromná komunitná aplikácia pre obyvateľov obcí a miest. NIE JE oficiálnou aplikáciou žiadnej obce, mesta ani úradu a nezastupuje žiadny orgán verejnej správy.

ZDROJE VEREJNÝCH INFORMÁCIÍ
Oznamy a podujatia obcí VILORA preberá z ich oficiálnych, verejne dostupných webov, napríklad:
• Cífer: https://www.cifer.sk
• Trnava: https://www.trnava.sk
• Senec: https://www.senec.sk
• Banská Bystrica: https://www.banskabystrica.sk
• Trenčín: https://www.trencin.sk
• Martin: https://www.martin.sk
• Bojnice: https://www.bojnice.sk
Úplný a priebežne aktuálny zoznam všetkých zdrojov podľa okresov: https://vilora.sk/zdroje
Pri každom prevzatom ozname a podujatí je v aplikácii odkaz priamo na pôvodný článok. Záväzné je vždy znenie na webe obce alebo na úradnej tabuli.

ČO VO VILORE NÁJDETE

Požičovne. Kosačka, rebrík, miešačka — od susedov aj od miestnych požičovní náradia a strojov. Kalendár voľných dní pri každej veci, viac vecí v jednom košíku, požičanie aj na hodiny, dovoz a odvoz, vratná záloha. Požičovňa rezerváciu potvrdí a po vrátení je vec opäť voľná.

Komunitná inzercia. Nové aj použité veci od susedov aj miestnych výrobcov, s osobným odberom v okolí alebo poštou, ak ju predajca ponúka.

Predaj z dvora. Vajcia, med, zelenina, ovocie. Susedia označia, čo majú dnes, a vy si to vyzdvihnete o dve ulice ďalej.

Remeslá a služby. Murár, kaderníčka, opravár, masér. Profil s cenníkom, hodnoteniami a rezerváciou termínu online.

Rozvoz jedla a QR objednávanie pri stole. Miestne reštaurácie s denným menu, doručenie domov a sledovanie kuriéra na mape.

Miestne podujatia. Hody, brigády, divadlo aj súkromné oslavy, s pozvánkami a potvrdením účasti.

Miestne oznamy. Oznamy prevzaté z webov obcí na jednom mieste, s odkazom na pôvodný zdroj. Smútočné oznamy si viete vypnúť samostatne.

Straty a nálezy. Stratené kľúče, doklady či zatúlaná mačka — nález nahlásite anonymne.

Susedia a mapa. Overení susedia z vášho okruhu a mapa, kde sú ponuky, podujatia aj prevádzky na jednom mieste.

AKO TO FUNGUJE
1. Vyberiete si obec, v ktorej bývate.
2. Nastavíte okruh v kilometroch — uvidíte aj obsah zo susedných obcí.
3. Vyberiete si, o čom chcete dostávať upozornenia.
Prezerať inzerciu, ponuky z dvora, majstrov aj podujatia môžete bez registrácie.

BEZPEČNOSŤ A SÚKROMIE
Aplikácia je určená osobám od 18 rokov. Pri každom inzeráte, ponuke, podujatí, profile, správe aj recenzii je tlačidlo Nahlásiť; každé nahlásenie posúdime do 24 hodín. Ktoréhokoľvek používateľa si viete zablokovať. Účet aj osobné údaje si zmažete sami v aplikácii (Účet — Súkromie a údaje — Zmazať účet a údaje). Presnú polohu používame len na to, aby sme vedeli, čo je vo vašom okruhu; na pozadí ju nesledujeme. Žiadna reklama. Meranie návštevnosti spúšťame len s vaším súhlasom. Platby medzi susedmi prebiehajú v hotovosti alebo pri prevzatí; aplikácia peniaze nespracúva.

Prevádzkovateľ: súkromný subjekt, nie orgán verejnej správy. Kontakt: info@vilora.sk · https://vilora.sk

name: VIN It: Free VIN Check
description:
Did you VIN it?

Before you buy a car — new, used, or the one sitting in your driveway — check it in seconds. Paste the 17-character VIN and VIN It pulls what the official U.S. government databases know about that exact vehicle. Free. No account. No ads. No paywall.

WHAT YOU GET, FREE
• Full spec decode — year, make, model, trim, engine, drivetrain, body, and where it was built.
• Open safety recalls — every recall on record, with the urgent "stop driving" and "park outside" warnings flagged in red.
• Crash-test ratings — the government's NCAP star ratings: overall, frontal, side, and rollover.
• Owner complaints — how many owners complained, and the parts they complained about most.
• A buyer's checklist — what to look at before you hand over money, in plain language.
• A free theft-check link — straight to the free NICB VINCheck for theft and salvage records.

SIMPLE ENOUGH FOR ANYONE
Copy the VIN from your insurance app, paste it in, tap once. That's it. No sign-up, no menus to learn.

STRAIGHT WITH YOU
VIN It reads the public U.S. government car databases (NHTSA) right on your phone, so there's nothing to charge for. The one thing no app gives away free is a full accident and title history — that's Carfax and AutoCheck, and they charge for it. We don't pretend to provide it. We just make the free government records easy to read. VIN It is an independent app, not affiliated with NHTSA or Carfax.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The only thing that ever leaves your phone is the VIN you choose to check. No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no tracking. Your recent checks are saved on your device only.

Where do you find the VIN? Look through the windshield at the driver's-side dash, open the driver's door and read the sticker in the jamb, or copy it from your registration or insurance app.

Did you VIN it?

name: Vinyl Value: LP Record Scanner
description:
Vinyl Value is the fast, audiophile-grade vinyl record scanner and collection appraiser built for crate diggers, flea market hunters, and lifelong record collectors.

Point your camera at any album cover—or import a photo from your library—and get a realistic estimated market value range in seconds.

INSTANT VINYL IDENTIFICATION & VALUATION
• Fast 1:1 album cover scanner powered by multimodal recognition, plus Photo Library import.
• Realistic Estimated Market Range (such as $45 – $85) rather than rigid single-number guesses.
• Center Label & Matrix Refinement: Snap the center record label to distinguish valuable first pressings from modern reissues.

CONDITION GRADING THAT UPDATES PRICES LIVE
• Toggle smoothly between Mint / NM, VG+, and Good / Fair to see how sleeve and media condition impact market value.
• Pressing & Value Notes highlight key details to check on your pressing, such as label variations, country of origin, and deadwax cues.

YOUR PERSONAL VINYL SHELF
• Save scanned records into a clean dark-mode collection shelf with total collection value range, record count, and top-valued LP.
• Track purchase prices, personal condition grades, and collector notes.
• Display values in USD, EUR, or GBP.

INSURANCE-READY CATALOG EXPORTS
• Export your entire vinyl shelf as a clean CSV spreadsheet or formatted PDF valuation report for insurance records or collection sales.

PRIVACY & SUBSCRIPTIONS
• Photos are used strictly for single-scan identification and are never stored on our servers.
• Start with 3 complimentary successful vinyl scans (non-vinyl shots do not count against your scans).
• Upgrade to Vinyl Value Pro for unlimited cover & label scans, unlimited shelf capacity, full pressing insights, and CSV/PDF exports:
  - Weekly Pro: $4.99 / week
  - Annual Pro: $29.99 / year (includes a 3-day trial)
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://letsdating.app/vinylvalue/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://letsdating.app/vinylvalue/terms/

name: VITRUK: Pausa para Motoristas
description:
Você dirige o dia inteiro? O VITRUK avisa a hora de parar, mostra alongamentos para fazer com o carro parado e traz um guia de bolso para consultar estacionado.

O app é grátis. Sem cadastro, sem anúncio, funciona sem internet. Nós não temos acesso aos seus registros.

GRÁTIS, PARA SEMPRE
• Lembrete de pausa, inclusive com o app fechado (a entrega depende das permissões e das configurações do celular)
• Intervalo de 1 hora, 1 hora e 30 ou 2 horas, você escolhe
• Cinco alongamentos: pescoço, ombros, lombar, punhos e mãos, pernas
• Pontos de alongamento: um ponto por alongamento que você marcar
• Registro de dor de 0 a 10, com gráfico e lista dos últimos 14 dias
• Uma dica por dia
• Guia de bolso: a situação Na parada, completa, com 5 cartões

GUIA DE BOLSO COMPLETO: COMPRA ÚNICA E OPCIONAL
Uma compra única, sem assinatura, libera as outras 4 situações do guia, com 15 cartões:
• Antes de sair (4 cartões)
• Entre atendimentos (5 cartões)
• Calor e chuva (2 cartões)
• Quando o corpo avisa (4 cartões)

O preço aparece na loja antes de você confirmar. A compra fica em Configurações, junto com o botão Restaurar compra, para usar com a mesma conta da loja num celular novo. Comprar e restaurar precisam de internet; depois de liberado, o guia funciona sem internet. Nada do que você registrou fica bloqueado, com ou sem a compra.

Consulte o guia e faça os alongamentos só com o carro estacionado em local seguro.

O VITRUK não promete resolver nada. Ele só não deixa você esquecer de parar.

AVISO
O VITRUK não é um dispositivo médico e não diagnostica, trata, cura nem previne nenhuma condição médica. Para orientação, diagnóstico ou tratamento, procure um profissional de saúde.

name: Vitto Smash
description:
Benvenuto in Vitto Smash! Scegli il tuo Smasher, entra nell’arena e butta fuori tutti gli altri: vince l’ultimo che resta in piedi

ARENE CHE CROLLANO
Ogni mappa cambia mentre giochi:
• La Casa: le stanze cadono una dopo l’altra
• Pizza Gigante: una mano si mangia gli spicchi
• Laboratorio: le teche si chiudono
• Scuola Allagata: rompi i tubi e sali di piano prima dell’acqua


MODALITÀ
• Tutti contro tutti: da solo o a coppie
• Il castello della collezionista: esploralo e attento ai suoi enigmi spaventosi!
• Tutorial nella Casa, per imparare in pochi minuti

SMASHER PAZZI
Vitto, Vernesto, Mammazilla e tanti altri, ognuno con colpi e un’Ultra tutta sua. Sblocca nuovi Smasher, falli crescere e libera i ricordi perduti

GIOCA CON GLI AMICI
Aggiungi gli amici con il codice, crea una stanza privata e sfidatevi

Grafica 3D colorata, partite veloci e tante risate
Gioco gratuito

name: Voice Memo to MP3
description:
Turn a voice memo into a real MP3 file, right on your iPhone.

Save a recording from Voice Memos to Files, choose it here, pick the quality and convert. Listen to the finished MP3 before you save or share it.

YOUR VOICE MEMO. NOW MP3.
• Converts M4A files with AAC audio (like saved voice memos) and WAV files with PCM audio
• Real MP3 encoding with the LAME encoder: constant bitrate MPEG-1 Layer III at 44.1 kHz, not a renamed M4A
• Mono stays mono and stereo stays stereo
• Every file is checked frame by frame and decoded once before you can save it, and its length is compared with the original

CHOOSE YOUR AUDIO QUALITY
• Standard 128 kbps: smaller files, plenty for speech
• High 192 kbps: larger files with more headroom for music
• See the expected size before you convert, then the real size, length, bitrate and channels of the finished file
• MP3 is a lossy format: a higher bitrate keeps more of the original but can't add detail that wasn't recorded

CONVERT LOCALLY. SHARE EASILY.
• Conversion happens on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded and there's no account
• Play the MP3 in the app, rename it if you like, then Save to Files or Share
• Progress follows the audio actually converted, and you can cancel at any time
• Titles, artists and other details from the original file aren't copied into the MP3

GOOD TO KNOW
• One file at a time, mono or stereo, up to 60 minutes or 250 MB
• The app doesn't record, use the microphone, transcribe, remove noise or browse your Voice Memos library. You choose each file from Files, or share an M4A or WAV file to the app
• Copy-protected (DRM) audio and files with more than two channels aren't converted
• Your original file is never changed. Working copies and previews are temporary, stay on your iPhone and are excluded from backups
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics

Selecting and previewing are always free, and your first export is free. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports. It isn't a subscription and never renews. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

MP3 encoding by LAME, used under the GNU Library General Public License (see Open Source Licenses in the app).

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/voice-memo-to-mp3/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/voice-memo-to-mp3/terms

name: Volleo: Pickleball Score Watch
description:
Score pickleball, padel and tennis from your wrist. Tap the half of the side that won the rally: Volleo keeps the score, the server and the side they serve from, and calls it the way you say it, from 0-0-2 to 11-9-2.

When the rules change, Volleo updates them without an app update, and tests every rule set on your device before it uses it.

PICKLEBALL
• Side-out doubles with the 0-0-2 start, the second server and the right server on the right side
• Rally scoring 2026 (provisional) and rally with freeze to 15
• Singles, games to 11, 15 or 21; ends switch at 6 in the deciding game

PADEL AND TENNIS
• Star point (two advantages, then one deciding point), golden point and advantage
• Tiebreaks and super tiebreaks in the right service order
• Tennis with advantage or no-ad and a match tiebreak

ON YOUR WRIST
• One tap per rally on Apple Watch; turn the Digital Crown to undo
• Undo anything, even the point that ended the game
• If the app closes mid-match, it picks up exactly where you left off
• Each match is saved as a Pickleball workout in Apple Health. Heart rate never leaves your devices
• Voice score after every rally, in 7 languages

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Score on the phone too: big halves in portrait, a side-by-side scoreboard in landscape
• Live score on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Stats: rallies won on your serve and theirs, games, partners
• Share cards for your group chat

RULES YOU CAN CHECK
• Every format names the rule it is based on
• Rule packages are signed and replayed against test scenarios on your device before use
• When the rules change, the update reaches you within days

PAY ONCE
• Scoring is free, for every format
• Volleo Pro is a one-time purchase with Family Sharing: unlimited history, stats, voice score, live score, share cards and unlimited players. Your first 3 matches include Pro
• No subscription. No ads. No tracking

Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later, iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later.

name: VoltMossLanes
description:
Swipe onto a glowing four-lane synth grid and see how far your pod can run. VoltMossLanes is a fast, neon, one-thumb lane runner with real depth: an endless track, a 36-level campaign, a shared daily challenge, missions and a locker full of pods.

RUN THE GRID
Swipe left or right to hop lanes. Swipe up to dash: a short invulnerable burst that smashes patrol drones for bonus points. Magenta barrier walls block lanes, violet drones sweep between them, and the track speeds up the longer you survive.

CHAIN THE SPARKS
Every lime energy spark raises your score multiplier, all the way to x5.00. Plan your line, grab the sparks, and watch your distance turn into a huge score.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- CLASSIC: the endless track. Chase your best score.
- LEVELS: 36 handcrafted campaign tracks across six sectors. Each level has three star goals: reach the finish, grab enough sparks, and clear it without a hit. Clear one to unlock the next.
- DAILY RUN: one seeded track per day, the same for every pilot, with its own leaderboard. A new challenge arrives at 00:00 UTC.

MISSIONS AND REWARDS
Complete 19 missions, from smashing drones to earning stars, and claim coin rewards. Log in daily to fill the 7-day reward calendar.

THE LOCKER
Unlock 12 pod skins, each with its own glowing trail, from Acid Moss to full-spectrum Prism. Stock up on Shields that absorb a hit and Magnets that pull sparks to you for 15 seconds. Crashed on a great run? Continue it with coins.

LEADERBOARDS
Climb the Classic, Daily and Stars boards, all-time and today. Pick your own pilot name, or keep the one we generate for you. Your progress is backed up to the cloud automatically, with no account or login.

MAKE IT YOURS
Snap a pilot avatar, record a short victory shout that plays when you beat your best, and save neon score cards to your photos.

PURE CHIPTUNE STYLE
Original 8-bit pulse-wave music and sound effects, heavy neon glow, scanlines and a perspective grid that rushes past.

FAIR AND AD-FREE
There are no ads. Coins are earned on every run, from missions and from the daily reward. Optional coin packs are available for players who want to unlock things faster. Everything can be earned by playing.

Delete your data at any time from Setup.

name: VoxelRay
description:
VoxelRay is a real-time ray-traced destructible voxel sandbox built natively for iPhone.

Tap to shatter travertine colonnades with physics-driven 3D voxel debris, sculpt with Gold, glowing Neon Cyan, Glass, and iridescent Prism Crystal brushes, and shift lighting from golden sunset to midnight obsidian with responsive procedural spatial audio. Powered by Metal ray tracing, optical HDR bloom, and adaptive thermal scaling with zero servers, ads, or tracking.

Key Features:
- Multi-bounce Monte Carlo global illumination, water reflections & optical bloom
- Tap-to-carve spherical destruction with 3D debris physics, camera shake & multi-step Undo
- Free Gold, Neon Cyan, and Glass sculpting brushes plus curated Dawn/Noon/Sunset/Night presets
- Procedural material foley audio & spatial biome atmospheres
- 64-sample Photo Mode convergence with instant iOS Share Sheet export
- One-time Architect Pro and Prism Material Pack unlocks via StoreKit 2

name: Vroep
description:
Navigate Amsterdam on your moped or scooter with Vroep. Street by street, it shows whether you ride on the road or the cycle path, for blue and yellow plates.

In Amsterdam that changes from street to street and from plate to plate. Vroep plans your route around it, and one tap on a street tells you which rule applies there. Free, with no account and no ads.

What you get:
• A route for your plate: blue (snorfiets) or yellow (bromfiets).
• Spoken directions in Dutch or English, even with your screen locked.
• You hear where to move from the cycle path to the road.
• The GVB ferry in your route, with its departure time.
• Road closures are taken into account.
• "Avoid busy roads" for a calmer ride.
• A map of where you may ride: green is road, blue is cycle path, red is not allowed.
• Scooter parking near your destination, and Vroep remembers where you parked.
• A check of whether your scooter may enter the zero-emission zone.

No subscription and no ride limit. Your route is calculated on your iPhone and Vroep collects no data.

Vroep works in Amsterdam, including Weesp. Signs can change, so the sign on the street always comes first. See something different from what Vroep shows? Send a report and read the answer in the app.

name: W.A.R.
description:
W.A.R. is a small radio with four stations: Air, Fire, Earth and Water. Each one plays its own collection of records, in an order that runs like a clock, so everyone tuned to a station hears the same record at the same second.

Tap a glyph to tune in, tap it again to stop. The record's name opens Info: what is playing and how far in, what comes next, who suggested it and when. Vote for more of a record or less of it, and say something about it in Comments, alongside everyone else who is listening.

It keeps playing with the screen off, and the lock screen, AirPods and the car move between the stations.

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Wait. - Impulse Buy Blocker
description:
Pause before you pay.

We have all been there: browsing online or walking through a store, spotting something exciting, and hitting the checkout button before thinking it through. Later, buyer's remorse sets in.

Wait. gives you a simple, effective buffer between the urge to purchase and the decision to spend. Put your desired item on a cooling-off timer, let the initial rush fade, and decide with a clear head whether you truly need it.

How It Works

1. Add What You Want
Enter the item name, price, and a quick note explaining why you want to buy it right now.

2. Choose a Cooldown Period
Let the item sleep for 24 hours, 72 hours (3 days), 7 days, or 30 days. Step away and continue your day.

3. Make Your Decision
When the cooldown timer expires, you will receive a notification asking: "Still want it?" Your original note is shown again so you can evaluate your reasoning with a fresh perspective.

4. Pick One of Three Options
- Bought: If you still need it after cooling down, complete your purchase with confidence.
- Skipped: If the impulse has passed, pass on the item. The unspent money is instantly added to your savings.
- Wait 24h: Still undecided? Give yourself another full day to think it over.

Key Features

- Track Your Saved Money
Every time you skip a purchase, that price is credited to your savings balance. Monitor this month's savings, total accumulated savings, total skipped items, and your overall skip rate. Unlock motivating milestones as your savings habit builds.

- Complete Decision History
Review past items you decided to buy and items you chose to skip. Understanding your past impulses helps you build healthier shopping habits over time.

- Revisit Your Reasoning
Remembering why you wanted something in the heat of the moment is essential for learning your spending triggers. Your initial reasoning is displayed on the decision screen.

- Early Cooldown Unlock
Need to make a decision immediately? Watch a brief 30-second video ad to end the timer early. Those 30 seconds give you one final chance to pause and reconsider.

- Local and Private
No user accounts, no logins, and no servers tracking your behavior. All of your wishlist items, notes, and savings statistics remain strictly on your personal device.

- Flexible Settings
Currency format automatically matches your device region or can be customized manually. Choose your preferred default cooldown duration.

Ad-Free Experience

Wait. is free to use with banner, interstitial, and optional rewarded ads. You can permanently remove all advertisements with a single one-time purchase. No subscriptions or recurring fees.

name: Wake Up Valley
description: Wake Up Valley is a charming animal strategy puzzle game. The animals have fallen asleep, and you must choose the right animal calls to wake them. Study the map, use each sound’s range, and avoid obstacles and dangerous predators. Complete every challenge within the time and call limits, unlock new animal friends, explore increasingly complex levels, and earn three stars with smart planning.

name: Wakefulness
description:
Wakefulness gives teachers one place to take attendance, note classroom observations, and see patterns across lessons.

• Review the class register before syncing attendance to ManageBac.
• Log observations with a press-and-slide gesture on a student card.
• Explore lesson trends and individual observation history in Focus Insights.
• Try the classroom tools with fictional students in the built-in Sample Class.

Live roster and attendance integration requires an authorized Han Academy ManageBac teacher account.

name: Wallkeeper
description:
The enemy is coming for your camp, and the only thing in the way is your wall.

Tap or hold on the field to shoot. You start with rocks in the Stone Age and work up through bows, crossbows, muskets and rifles to a plasma lance. The enemy does the same: clubbers and wolves give way to knights, cannon, tanks and walking machines.

Between waves, spend your gold in the workshop. Every age has either-or choices that shape how you fight. Fire arrows or twin shots? Boiling oil or a masons' guild? A machine gun or explosive rounds? You can't have both.

In the game:
• 30 waves across six ages, then endless waves for as long as you can hold
• Nine towers to build behind the wall, from a slinger's post to a laser turret
• More than 60 upgrades in four branches: arms, wall, towers and camp
• Specialist enemies that change what you shoot first: firebrands that blow up among their own, healers, and drummers who hurry everyone near them
• Spoils after every boss: keep one of three perks for the rest of the run
• Kill streaks, bounty monsters, and a rush option if you want it harder
• A treasury that earns interest while you are away
• A Captain on your gatehouse who levels up for good across every run: three to choose from, each with a Charge onto the field
• Gems to earn and spend on powers, heroes that sally from the gate, and civilisation upgrades you keep for good
• Hand-drawn art and a score that change with every age

Free to play, with adverts between some waves and optional adverts for gems. One Premium purchase removes the between-wave adverts for good. No account needed, and the game itself works offline.

name: Watchet - SSH & AI Agents
seller_name: Chengdu Zhiyuan Chuangxin Technology Co., Ltd
description:
Watchet connects to your own servers over SSH and gathers every Claude Code and Codex session into one inbox. It notifies you the moment an agent needs you, and when you need to step in, a real mobile terminal is one tap away.

AGENT INBOX
• Every agent on every host at a glance, grouped into Needs you, Running and Done
• Manage several hosts, search by project or host

NOTIFICATIONS
• Instant alerts when an agent is waiting for a permission or a choice
• Know when a task is finished

CHAT VIEW
• Terminal sessions rendered as clean chat: Markdown, tables, code and math
• Tool calls collapsed; open any subagent to follow its work
• Reply with text, photos or voice

TERMINAL
• Opens straight into Herdr, tmux or Zellij; swipe between windows
• Customizable key bar with Ctrl, Esc and Tab
• Reconnects automatically after backgrounding or network changes
• Pinch to zoom, terminal themes, two-pane layout on iPad

MORE
• Files: preview images, PDFs and code
• Changes: see Git diffs per file
• Web preview: open the site your server is building, on your phone

PRIVACY
• SSH private keys stay in the device Keychain and are never uploaded
• Terminal traffic goes directly between your phone and your server, never through ours
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID app lock

No account and nothing to deploy: any Linux or macOS host you can SSH into works; agent features need Python 3 on the host.

The basic SSH terminal is free. Watchet Pro unlocks the chat view, changes, files and web preview, as a monthly subscription or a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically and can be cancelled any time in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zycx.ai/watchet/privacy/

name: Watchpost - Car Camera Viewer
description:
Watchpost is an iPhone client for your own tesla-sentry-f50 server, for browsing and playing recordings from Tesla car cameras. To view your recordings, you need a server address your phone can reach and the admin password. No server yet? Tap "Try demo" to explore the built-in samples.

Find events by day
Browse Sentry, Saved and Recent recordings, filter by date or trigger, and check your server's storage summary.

Switch camera views
Choose among the front, rear, B-pillar and fender cameras included in a recording. Events show four or six cameras according to the files available. Pause, jump ten seconds, scrub through a clip or watch in full screen. A marker shows the trigger time.

See recorded driving data
Follow speed, gear, brake, accelerator, steering angle and turn signals as the video plays, when those readings are available. Missing readings appear as a dash, never as a made-up zero.

Export and share
Choose a quality and have your own server create a watermarked video, then save or share it through the system share sheet. Export the current one-minute clip from a single camera.

Try it with sample data
Explore sample footage, fictional places and sample driving data without signing in or connecting to a server. A "Demo data" badge stays visible in demo mode.

Watchpost is an independently developed client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Tesla, Inc. Tesla is a trademark of Tesla, Inc.

name: Water Tracker: Oasis
description:
Drink water. Grow an oasis.

Oasis turns your daily drinking goal into a cozy world that grows with you. Log a drink and your spring flows. Keep it flowing through the day and your oasis comes alive.

WHAT YOU DO
• Log your water in a few taps and watch the spring run.
• Grow your oasis through six stages, from a young seedling to paradise.
• Meet visitors every morning. Pet and feed the animals that stop by, earn their trust, and make friends who stay.
• Farm, fish, gather and craft. Build machines, cook, and decorate.
• Hire helpers who work the land while you drink.
• Follow four seasons, each with its own look, crops and festival day.

GENTLE BY DESIGN
• Nothing is ever lost. Missing a day never sets you back.
• Sleeping is never neglect, and a rain day forgives a slip.
• No accounts to create. Your oasis stays on your device.

OASIS PLUS (optional)
Remove ads and unlock extras. Choose monthly, yearly (with a 7-day free trial), or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Oasis is a game and a habit helper, not a medical app. It does not give medical advice.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://eighterio.com:8447/legal/oasis/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://eighterio.com:8447/legal/oasis/privacy.html

name: Waya Tap
description:
Waya Tap turns your phone into the pager: scan the code at the counter, go sit down, and get alerted the moment your order is ready.

How it works
1) Scan the counter code or your order code at the cashier.
2) See your order number and its status.
3) When it's ready: a lock-screen notification, a live card that updates by itself, and the shop's own tone.

Features
• No sign-up and no account — open, scan, done.
• Instant alert even when your phone is locked.
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
• Tap "On my way" so the cashier knows you're coming.
• Your recent shops are saved for next time.
• Arabic and English.

For shop owners: Waya Tap is part of the Waya platform — turn it on from your dashboard at trywaya.com.

name: Wearly: AI Outfit Planner
description:
Stop staring at a full closet with nothing to wear. Wearly turns the clothes you already own into outfits for today's weather, your plans and your style, in seconds.

SNAP ONCE, DRESS BETTER EVERY DAY
• Photograph several pieces in a row, or pick up to 30 photos at once
• Mirror selfies work too: AI finds every piece and saves each one separately
• Colours, pattern, dressiness, warmth and fit are tagged for you
• Optional studio backgrounds give your closet a clean, catalogue look

WHAT TO WEAR TODAY
• Outfits for the live forecast where you are, or where you're going
• Colour matching and balanced proportions, built only from your own clothes
• Separate ideas for work, date night, party, formal, casual and travel
• "Style around this": pick one piece and see everything it goes with

VIRTUAL TRY-ON
• See a piece, or a whole look, on a photo of yourself before you wear or buy it

RATE MY LOOK
• Snap what you're wearing for a kind, honest outfit score with swaps from your own closet
• "Should I buy this?" shows how many outfits a new piece would make with what you own

PLAN AHEAD
• Events and calendar sync: the right look for a wedding, interview or dinner
• Trip planner with a mix-and-match capsule and a packing list
• A wear calendar, cost per wear and a wishlist

YOUR CLOSET, OFFLINE TOO
• Your saved closet, events and outfits stay viewable without a connection

COMMUNITY
• Share today's outfit, like, comment and follow people you like
• Every post and comment is checked before it appears; report or block anyone in one tap

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your closet and try-on photos are stored privately and never sold or used for ads
• No tracking. Export your data or delete your account anytime, right in the app

WEARLY PRO
Try Pro free for 7 days. Pro unlocks an unlimited closet, every daily outfit idea, events and calendar sync, the trip planner, more AI scans and outfit ratings, and monthly virtual try-ons. The free plan stays free. One-time scan and try-on packs are also available.

Wearly Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings → your name → Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://softilox-innovations-inc.github.io/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://softilox-innovations-inc.github.io/privacy/

Questions or ideas? Chat with us in the app or email support.wearly@gmail.com

name: WedCam – Wedding Guest Photos
description:
Every wedding guest is a photographer. Their phones are full of your best moments — the laughs, the dancing, the candid shots your photographer missed. But couples almost never see them.

WedCam fixes that in one scan:

• Create your event and get your own private QR code
• Print it on table cards — guests scan and upload, no app, no account, no sign-up
• Photos and videos land in your private gallery in full quality
• Watch them live on a slideshow screen at the reception
• Download everything after the party — your memories, all in one place

One flat price per event. Unlimited guests. No subscriptions.
Perfect for weddings, birthdays, and parties.

name: WeGo Partner
description:
WeGo Partner is the delivery dispatch app for registered local stores, restaurants, and businesses. Your customers order from you directly—WeGo gets their order to their door.

Key Features:
• Fast Order Creation: Enter a customer's phone number, customer name, and saved drop-off addresses, select the delivery zone, add a map link and delivery notes, and dispatch to a courier in seconds.
• Live Order Tracking: Follow every active delivery in real time from request and courier assignment through pickup and drop-off, with a clear status timeline and instant push notifications.
• Order Management & History: Filter orders by Open, Delivered, or Canceled across any date range, view full order and delivery-fee details, and cancel open requests when needed.
• Dedicated Support: Reach the WeGo operations team directly whenever you need help with an active delivery or onboarding.

Cash on Delivery Only:
WeGo Partner displays the delivery fee for operational visibility only. All payments are handled strictly via cash on delivery (COD) outside the app. There are no in-app purchases, credit card payments, or digital wallets.

Partner Accounts:
WeGo Partner is intended for approved business partners. New partner accounts are verified and onboarded by the WeGo team—tap "Sign up" in the app to reach us on WhatsApp or visit https://wego.partners.

name: WenzariFuldrex
description: Induction furnace calculator: power, coil, charge, melting and costs.

name: What's for dinner? Recipes
description:
Wat eten we? ("what are we eating?") picks a dish that suits you every day, adapts it to your diet and allergies, and has the shopping list and the steps ready. Free, with no ads and no account.

RECIPES YOU CAN ACTUALLY COOK
More than 2,300 recipes from around the world, from Irish stew to rendang. Dishes with few, common ingredients come first: no hunting for something exotic you will use once. Every recipe has clear steps and cooking times.

ADAPTED TO YOUR DIET AND ALLERGIES
Tell the app in a minute what you cannot or will not eat: allergies, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, lactose-free or a dislike. It does not just hide those dishes, it adapts them. Most dishes with meat or fish come with a vegetarian or vegan version with its own title, ingredients and steps. Gluten-free works for most dishes too; for a few there is no good swap, and you will see that. Allergens shown with recipes are derived automatically and therefore indicative: with a serious allergy, always check the ingredients and the packaging.

COOK WITHOUT HUNTING
Cooking mode with big text, a timer per step and all the chopping done first. Your screen stays on. Close the app or lose power for a moment? You pick up cooking and your timers where you left off.

CHOOSE FAST, CHOOSE TOGETHER
Swipe through dishes and keep what you like: the app learns from your choices. Swipe together with your partner or housemate and see what you both like. Without swiping together, everything stays on your phone.

PLAN THE WEEK
Put dishes on the days that suit you. A planned evening never quietly disappears: whatever you missed waits under Overdue.

ONE SHOPPING LIST
Sorted by aisle, with a price estimate and tidy amounts, leaving out what you always have at home. Already have something? Long-press and it's off the list.

USE UP LEFTOVERS
After cooking you see what is left. "What do I have at home?" gives you dishes that use it up.

SMART SEARCH IN THE COOKBOOK
Type what you have or what you fancy. It understands typos, plurals and synonyms, and only shows what fits your diet.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No ads and no trackers. Your profile and preferences stay on your phone. Make your own back-up and restore it on a new device. Only if you choose to swipe together or turn on friends do a nickname of your choice, your diet and your allergens go to our server. Delete everything with one tap.

The recipes, translations and photos were made with the help of AI and then checked. Photos are illustrative.

name: Wheel of Names: Spin & Pick
description:
Give the next little decision a spin. SpinCove is an independently designed native random name picker and choice wheel that works offline. Add names or options, spin, and enjoy one clear winner.

FREE FOREVER
• Unlimited spins with no account or ads.
• Create a practical wheel with up to 100 entries.
• Type, paste one choice per line, rename, delete and reorder.
• Remove a winner by its exact entry, then reset the round whenever you like.
• Basic palettes, original sound, haptic and reduced-motion controls.
• Dinner, yes/no and who-goes-first starter wheels.
• Save and reopen one wheel locally. Share the result as readable text.

LIFETIME PRO
One payment unlocks premium palettes, custom segment colors, local photo backgrounds and center images, real spin-duration and tick controls, extra original sounds, celebration controls, weighted entries with matching segment sizes, up to 1,000 entries, unlimited locally saved wheels and duplicates, premium templates, library organization and local recent-winner history.

The US base price is $6.99, one time. Your store displays the actual localized price before purchase. No subscription, trial, credits or recurring fee. Restore Purchases is available for the same store account. Apple and Google purchases are separate.

YOUR CHOICES STAY LOCAL
Wheel entries, images and winner history stay on your device. No login, cloud sync, ads, Firebase Analytics or GA4. RevenueCat and your app store process purchase information to verify Pro. Clearing app data or uninstalling can remove local wheels; keep separate copies of important information.

Equal mode gives each eligible entry equal odds. Pro weighted mode deliberately changes odds to match your positive integer weights. Repeated results are possible. SpinCove is a general-purpose utility, not a certified raffle, gambling, lottery or audited drawing service.

Independently developed by Starter Studio, Inc. No official affiliation with the Wheel of Names website is claimed.

name: Wherever GPS
description:
Go anywhere. Wherever GPS simulates your iPhone's location right on the phone, no computer needed.

ONE-TAP TELEPORT
Search for a place, paste coordinates, or paste a Google Maps or Apple Maps share link and you're there. Before you drop a pin, it shows how long the trip would take walking, running, cycling, or driving.

ROUTES
• Plan routes along roads, or draw your own on the map
• Add waypoints, hop between points, loop, or go back and forth
• Pause and continue where you left off, or turn around on the spot
• Import and export GPX

JOYSTICK & RANDOM ROAMING
Steer with the joystick, or set an area and let it wander along the roads, stopping now and then.

NATURAL MOVEMENT
Speed varies, eases in and out, and pauses occasionally. Before any instant jump it always asks you first, so it looks like a real person walking.

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
• Status in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen
• Reconnects automatically and continues from where it stopped
• Favorite places and teleport history
• Shortcuts support for your automations

PRIVACY
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your locations, favorites, and routes stay on your phone.

REQUIREMENTS
• iOS 27 or later
• Developer Mode turned on
• The free LocalDevVPN app (the app walks you through setup in about two minutes)

SUBSCRIPTION
Wherever GPS Pro: monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. It renews automatically after the trial; cancel anytime in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions, and cancel during the trial to avoid being charged.

name: WhichKnot
description:
WhichKnot är en offline-knopguide för camping, vandring, fiske, flytt, segling och nybörjarklättring. På plats behöver du inte komma ihåg vad knopen heter: välj vad du ska göra och vilket rep du har, så visar appen vilken knop du ska knyta, varför, vilka du ska undvika och hur du gör steg för steg.

Svar först, justera sedan

Appen öppnas direkt på svaret: den bästa knopen visas stort med skälen för valet (rätt användning, rätt rep, nybörjarvänlig), svårighetsgrad och antal steg. Under den listas alternativ och en “Avoid”-lista med knopar som uteslutits eftersom repet inte passar, knopen inte går att lösa upp under belastning eller den har en känd varning. Ändra användning, rep, om knopen måste kunna lösas upp under belastning eller din vana i panelen längst ned, så uppdateras svaret direkt utan att du behöver skicka något. Ditt senaste val återställs vid nästa start.

16 vanliga knopar, 115 steg på två språk

Appen innehåller 16 knopar, bland annat bowline, figure eight, figure eight follow-through, clove hitch, two half hitches, square knot, sheet bend, fisherman's knot, double fisherman's, prusik, alpine butterfly, water knot, trucker's hitch, mooring hitch, highwayman's hitch och double overhand stopper. De täcker åtta användningar: fästa vid stolpe, sammanfoga två rep, fast ögla, ändstopp, spänna och dra, snabbt släpp, binda last och klättring. Varje knop har steg för steg, kontrollpunkter, vanliga fel, situationer där den inte ska användas, en säkerhetsnot och källor.

Tydliga gränser för säkerhetskritiskt bruk

Klättring, lastbärande och dragning visar en säkerhetspåminnelse. Knopar som inte får bära last, till exempel square knot, anger sin varning och hamnar under “Avoid”. Varje säkerhetsnot säger när en utbildad person måste kontrollera knuten. Appen är ett studiematerial och ersätter inte utbildning, certifierad utrustning eller bedömning på plats.

Håll koll på det du lärt dig

Markeringar som inlärd, sparade knopar, senast visade och inlärningsprogress sparas på enheten. Fliken My List visar hur många knopar du lärt dig, en förloppsindikator och nästa knop att öva på. Fliken Knots går att söka i på namn, alias eller användning och filtrera på användning.

Offline och privat

Helt offline: inga nätverksanrop, inga behörigheter, inget konto, inga annonser, ingen analys, inga SDK:er från tredje part. Inlärningsstatus och senaste val sparas som JSON på enheten; återställ dem i Settings och avinstallation rensar allt. Innehållet är sammanställt från öppna källor och stegtexterna är våra egna, endast för inlärning.

Gränssnittet och innehållet finns på engelska och förenklad kinesiska.

name: Whisper Dictation
description:
Whisper Dictation turns your voice into text and copies it, ready to paste into any app.

Start without opening the app
• Add the Dictate control to the Lock Screen or Control Center
• Recording continues with the screen locked, and a Live Activity shows it is running
• Stop the same way, and the text is on your clipboard

Accurate, fast transcription
• Powered by Whisper large-v3-turbo through Groq, with your own free API key
• Long recordings, up to 2 hours, are transcribed in parts while you talk
• Recordings are saved as audio files you can replay, share or transcribe again

Private by design
• Recordings and transcripts stay on your device
• Audio goes straight from your device to Groq and never passes through our servers
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking

Sign in with Apple or Google. Also available for Mac, Windows and Android at whisper.devx.ro.

Requires a free Groq API key; the app shows you how to create one in a minute.

name: Whist - Point
description:
Whist - Point holder styr på pointene, når I spiller dansk whist. Ingen papir, blyant eller hovedregning.

SÅDAN VIRKER DET
• Opret et spil med 4 eller 5 spillere. Appen husker navnene fra sidste gang.
• Efter hver runde vælger du melder, melding, antal stik, makker og resultat.
• Appen slår pointene op i pointskemaet og fordeler dem på alle spillere, også ved selvmakker, sol, ren sol, bordlægger og super bordlægger.
• Ved 5 spillere sidder kortgiveren automatisk over.

OVERBLIK UNDERVEJS
• Stillingen og en graf over spillets forløb
• Hvem der skal give kort næste gang
• Ret eller slet en runde, hvis der er tastet forkert
• Hele pointskemaet er ét tryk væk

NÅR SPILLET ER SLUT
• Slutstilling med placeringer
• Del stillingen via Beskeder, Messenger eller mail
• Alle spil gemmes i historikken og kan genoptages

Skærmen forbliver tændt, mens spillet er åbent, så telefonen kan ligge på bordet mellem runderne.

Ingen konto, ingen reklamer og ingen dataindsamling. Alt gemmes kun på din egen enhed.

name: Who’s Watching: Cam Detector
description:
Who’s Watching helps you check a room for hidden cameras — in a vacation rental, a hotel, or a new place.

ROOM CHECK
Connect to the place’s Wi-Fi and tap Check this room. In about a minute the app looks at every device on that Wi-Fi and tells you which ones look like cameras, and why: a live video stream, a camera brand, or a cheap mini spy camera answering as one. It also listens for camera devices nearby over Bluetooth.

AROUND ME
A live list of what’s around you: camera glasses such as Ray-Ban Meta, trackers, drones that broadcast Remote ID, and other devices — with how close they seem.

LENS FINDER
Turn off the lights and sweep the room with your flashlight. A camera lens shines back as a small, sharp dot.

HONEST ABOUT LIMITS
No app can find every camera. Who’s Watching can’t see cameras on a different Wi-Fi network, cameras with a SIM card, or cameras that only record to a memory card. After every check we tell you exactly what was checked and what to look for by eye.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every scan runs on your phone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Scan results are never sent anywhere.

FREE AND PRO
Your first room check is free, along with the live Bluetooth list and the lens finder. Who’s Watching Pro unlocks unlimited room checks: $24.99 per year with a 3-day free trial, or $4.99 per month. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

Device signatures include data from the Fieldwatch project (MIT licence).

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://whoswatching.pages.dev/privacy

name: Wick Trim
description:
Wick Trim keeps each candle wick on this iPhone.

Drag the cut on the wick. A cut that lands 8 to 22 above the wax pool is kept, and the stub is that distance. A cut into the pool does not change the wick. A kept trim stays until you raise the pool. After the pool is raised, one more cut is allowed.

Only a wick that is not kept can be deleted. Only a kept wick can be renamed. Share sends the name, the stub, and whether the wick is kept.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Wild Arena: Toy Battle
description:
Who wins: a flock of ducks or a dinosaur?

Wild Arena is an offline auto-battle game about building a toy army and watching it clash in a miniature arena.

PICK THREE CARDS
Inspect the opposing army, then choose one of three cards in each of three rounds. Add recruits or change your army with size, attack speed, and other effects. Start the battle when you are ready. Your units fight automatically.

TWELVE DISTINCT FIGHTERS
Ducks swarm, chickens charge, gorillas deliver heavy blows, dinosaurs sweep through crowds, and robots fire from range. Slimes, zombies, ninjas, wizards, elephants, giant crabs, and dragons bring their own abilities.

WATCH THE COMBINATIONS WORK
Slimes split when defeated. Zombies can turn eligible opponents into allies. Small fighters surround giants, while area attacks scatter the crowd. Movement, hits, and remaining health decide the actual outcome.

TRY ANOTHER PLAN
Win to advance. Lose or draw to rebuild against the same opponent. One hundred fixed showdowns invite you to read the rival, change a card, and try again under the same conditions. Further stages use tested army matchups.

WHAT WILL YOU WATCH NEXT?
Warp through cosmic hoops, reel foes in with sea-creature tentacles, change abilities with a yokai’s face, or unload helpers from a toy train. Optional additional purchases permanently unlock 20 allies across four themes. Watch their real abilities in free, ad-free battle previews before buying.
Choose a regular ally individually, a pack of four regular allies plus one bonus, or the fixed set of all four launch themes. Bonuses are not sold individually. The set excludes future themes and ad removal. All 12 free allies remain free, and normal stages can be played without purchasing.

• Main gameplay works offline
• No ads or custom login
• Optional permanent purchases and Restore Purchases (connection to Apple required)
• English and Japanese
• Separate music, sound effect, and haptic settings
• Progress and selected cards saved on your device

Will your next army win with numbers, speed, or one heavier hit?

name: Wild Life: Narrate Me
description:
For entertainment only. All narration, titles and voices are generated by AI. The narrator is an AI voice and does not imitate any real person. Results may be inaccurate or silly — that's the point.

Your life is a nature documentary. You just didn't have a narrator.

Film anything ordinary — making coffee, hunting for your keys, your cat stalking a toy — and Wild Life turns it into a dramatic wildlife episode. An AI narrator watches your clip and describes the action in a calm, hushed documentary voice, with captions and an "Episode" title card. Ready to post in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
• Record a clip up to 10 seconds (20 seconds with Pro), or pick one from your library
• Choose a style: Savanna, Deep Sea, Night Jungle or Arctic
• Hit stop. The narrator starts talking in a few seconds
• Share a vertical 9:16 video with burned-in captions to your favorite apps, or save it to Photos

WHAT YOU GET
• A new episode title for every clip ("Episode 4: The Coffee Ritual")
• Documentary-style music and captions, synced to the voice
• "My Episodes": your clips stay on your phone
• No account needed

WILD LIFE PRO
• Clips up to 20 seconds
• All 4 narration styles
• Smaller watermark

You can also buy a one-time pack of 10 clips.

PRIVACY
To write the narration, the app sends a few still frames from your clip (not the video and not the audio) to our AI providers. Frames are processed to create your episode and are not kept by us or used to train AI models. Your videos stay on your device.

The narrator only describes what happens in the clip, never how anyone looks. Please only film people who agree to be filmed.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
• Wild Life Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, available weekly or yearly. The current price and period are shown in the app before you buy and may vary by country.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://garagelab.tech/wildlife/terms
Privacy Policy: https://garagelab.tech/wildlife/privacy

name: Wind Letter Relay
description: Wind Letter Relay is a peaceful pre-planning airflow puzzle. Place a limited number of wind beacons to build combined wind paths. Launch the simulation and watch the paper letter drift, twist and roll through overlapping air currents to reach the receiving station. Collect unique letter messages in your gallery.

name: WireForge: TCP UDP MQTT HTTP
description:
WireForge is a local network debugging toolkit for developers and hardware engineers.

Connect, send, subscribe and inspect — all on your device. No laptop, no account, no ads, no cloud.

PROTOCOLS
• TCP client and server
• UDP client
• WebSocket client
• MQTT client and on-device broker
• HTTP client and on-device server

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Send HEX or UTF-8 payloads and loop sending
• Live timestamped logs with refill and resend
• Subscribe and publish MQTT topics with QoS 0/1/2, retained messages and last will
• Serve local HTTP routes with custom status codes, headers and responses
• Share connections by QR code (scan import requires Pro)
• Built-in CRC, Base64, URL, HEX, JSON and timestamp tools

FREE
All protocols, clients and local servers, live logs, QR sharing, saved connections (3 per protocol) and quick keys (1 group, 2 keys).

WIREFORGE PRO
An optional lifetime purchase or yearly subscription unlocks:
• Unlimited saved connections
• Unlimited quick keys and groups
• QR scan import
• Log refill and resend
• Write history
• Log history search and export

PRIVACY
WireForge does not collect personal data. There is no analytics, advertising or account system. Connection settings, payloads and logs stay on your device. MQTT passwords are never written into QR codes.
