name: ネミル ファッション - 古着・フリマ相場検索
description:
ネミル ファッションは、欲しい商品の「いくらで買えるか」を複数のサイトでまとめて確認するための検索ランチャーです。

【できること】
・キーワードを入力して、フリマ・オークション・ネット通販の検索結果をワンタップで開く
　対応：メルカリ／楽天ラクマ／Yahoo!フリマ／Yahoo!オークション（落札相場）／Amazon／楽天市場／ヨドバシカメラ／ビックカメラ／セカンドストリート／カインドオル
・バーコード（JAN/ISBN）をカメラで読み取って検索。本のISBNは書名を自動で取得
・販売状況（販売中／すべて／売り切れ）と並び順（おすすめ／新着／安い順／高い順）を指定
・服・靴ページ：性別・サイズを指定して検索。マイサイズを設定すれば起動時から選択済み
・検索履歴と保存した検索をいつでも呼び出し

【こんな方に】
・フリマで買う前に相場を確認したい
・同じ商品を複数サイトで比べたい
・服や靴を自分のサイズで素早く探したい

【プライバシー】
検索履歴・設定は端末内にのみ保存され、運営者のサーバーへ送信されません。アカウント登録も不要です。

※本アプリは各サービスの公式アプリではありません。表示される価格・在庫は各サイトの情報です。
※メルカリのリンクにはアフィリエイト（PR）が含まれます（メルカリアンバサダー）。
※各サービス名は各社の商標または登録商標です。

name: ぴたDIY - 収納がぴったり見つかる
description:
ぴたDIY は、収納家具の「この箱、入るかな？」と、突っ張り棚DIYの「柱は何mm？」を、スマホで計算して確かめるアプリです。買う前・作る前に、寸法の失敗を減らします。

■ 収納家具と箱の「入る・入らない」を判定
収納家具の内寸と、箱やバスケットの外寸から、「入る」「たぶん入る」「入らない」を判定し、余白をmmで表示します。箱の向き（幅と奥行の入れ替え）も試します。各社が公式ページで対応をうたう組み合わせも見られます。各社の製品の寸法を収録しています（収録数は順次追加）。

■ 置きたい場所の寸法から探す
置きたい場所の幅・奥行・高さを入れると、収まる製品を探せます。結果とホームの製品の一覧は、フタ付き・キャスター付きなどの特徴や、色・素材で絞り込めます（記載のある製品が対象）。結果は、余白の少ない順や名前順などに並べ替えられます。

■ 収納スペースと手持ちの箱を記録
「マイ」タブでは、お家の収納スペース（棚の中・押入れ・すき間など）の内寸を、写真・メモ・タグと一緒に記録できます。記録したスペースから、合う箱を探せます。持っている箱の外寸を登録すると、その箱が入る棚の区画を探せます。製品はお気に入りに追加でき、「寸法から」で保存した検索条件も、同じ条件で開き直せます。記録は端末の中だけに保存し、外へは送りません。

■ 柱の長さとカット表
天井の高さと突っ張り金具から、2×4材などの柱に必要な長さを計算します。「柱2本＋棚」のレシピでは、棚板の長さ、買う材の長さ、カット表を出します。施工の誤差も見込みます。洗濯機の上、トイレの上、デスクの上、本棚など、6つのテンプレートから始められます。

■ 3Dで確認、数値で直す
できあがりを簡易な3Dモデルで確認できます。斜め・正面・側面・上面の4つの見え方を切り替えられます。部品を置く、指で動かす、90度回す、数値で直す、といった編集もできます。部材表（買い物リスト）も自動で出ます。作った構成は、端末の中に保存されます。

■ ログイン不要・オフラインで動く
アカウント登録は要りません。広告 SDK・分析 SDK は入れていません。入力した寸法や保存した構成は、端末の外には送りません。通信できない場所でも使えます。

■ ご注意
・寸法・判定・カット表は、公式ページや実測の値をもとにした目安です。購入や施工の前に、必ず実物を測り、製品の説明書を確認してください。
・突っ張りの耐荷重や取り付けできる場所は、金具の説明書に従ってください。賃貸住宅では、管理者に確認してください。
・3Dは簡易モデルです。実物の形・色・細部とは違います。
・各社の製品名・ブランド名は、各社の商標または登録商標です。本アプリは各社の公式アプリではなく、各社とは関係ありません。製品の寸法は、各社が公開している情報をもとに記録した値で、変更されることがあります。

name: ひと歩
description:
ひと歩は、毎日の習慣や忘れたくないことを通知で思い出す、シンプルなリマインダーアプリです。

【好きな言葉で通知】
タイトルと通知内容を自由に入力できます。読書や運動の目標から、水やり、日々の用事まで幅広く使えます。

【あなたのペースに合わせて】
毎日の決まった時刻、または分単位の間隔を選んで通知できます。

【あとから編集】
一覧からリマインダーをタップして、タイトル・通知内容・タイミングを変更できます。削除すると、そのリマインダーの通知予約も取り消します。

【すぐに使い始める】
アカウント登録は不要です。リマインダーは端末に保存され、設定画面からテスト通知を試せます。

通知を受け取るには、端末で通知を許可してください。通知の表示時刻は、集中モードや省電力設定など、端末の状態によって変わる場合があります。

name: ポンカ
description:
ポンカは、お店のスタンプカードを iPhone で作って、iPhone で押せるアプリです。
お店はカードを作ってお客さんの QR を読むだけ。お客さんは QR を見せるだけ。紙のカードも、会員登録もいりません。

■ お店のかた
・ラーメン・カフェ・パン・サロンなどのテンプレートか、お店の写真でカードを作れます
・スタンプの絵は、用意した絵からも、お店のロゴなどの画像からも選べます
・押したときの音は「ポン」「チャイム」「ハレ」と音なしから選べます
・レジでは、お客さんの QR を読む → いくつ押すか選ぶ → ポン!いつも 1 個なら、選ぶのを省略できます
・カードが 2 種類あっても、重ねて表示して、どのカードにも押せます
・途中の特典(5 個目で 1 品サービスなど)と、最後の特典を決められます
・お客さんの一覧・今日の数・月ごとの数字が見られます
・電波が弱いときは、6 けたのパスワードで「仮」のスタンプを押せます

■ お客さん
・ずっと無料・広告なし・登録なし
・QR 1 枚で、どのお店でも使えます
・スタンプは近くの iPhone どうしの通信で、カードの中にポンと届きます
・何個中何個かが、カードの表でひと目でわかります
・いまいるお店のカードが先頭に出ます(位置は iPhone の外に出しません)

■ 安心のしくみ
・カードと台帳は iPhone の中だけ。このアプリのサーバーはありません
・スタンプはお店の署名つきなので、お客さん側で数を増やせません
・広告・分析・追跡は入っていません

■ お店 Pro(サブスクリプション)
無料でも、カード 1 種類・マス 5 個まで・お客さん 20 人まで使えます。
お店 Pro では、お客さん無制限・マス 30 個まで・カード 5 種類まで・途中の特典と期限・お店の iPhone 5 台まで(iCloud で共有)が使えます。
・月額と年額があります
・お支払いは Apple ID に請求されます
・期間が終わる 24 時間前までに解約しないと、自動で更新されます
・解約は iPhone の「設定」→ Apple ID →「サブスクリプション」からいつでもできます
・解約しても、いまのお客さんへのスタンプと特典は止まりません

利用規約:https://sites.google.com/view/ponka-pointcard/利用規約
プライバシーポリシー:https://sites.google.com/view/ponka-pointcard/プライバシーポリシー

name: みつわけハニカム
description:
六角の巣の上から、とろとろの蜜が流れ落ちます。
蜜はマスに着くたびに、左下と右下へ半分ずつ分かれて流れていきます。
巣のマスにフタを置いて蜜の道を変え、下に並んだツボに書かれた数と、ぴったり同じ量の蜜を届けてください。

■ 遊び方
・マスをタップするとフタを置けます。もう一度タップで外せます
・「流す」を押すと、蜜が巣を流れ落ちます
・どのツボも数がぴったりなら、ハチたちが「ぶんぶん！」とお祝い
・行き場がなくなるとあふれてしまいます。フタは決まった枚数まで
・最初のステージで、遊び方を指で案内します

■ 500ステージ
・3段の小さな巣から始まり、ステージが進むと巣が大きく、少しずつ難しくなります
・途中で細くなる巣、くびれてまた広がる巣、動かせない壁のある巣も
・ひびの入った壁をタップすると、ハチがかじってこわします
・2つのツボから注がれる蜜を、まとめて分けるステージも

■ きょうの1問
・毎日1問、その日だけの問題がとどきます

■ そのほか
・困ったらヒント（短い動画を見ると、次の1手を光らせます）
・飛んでいるハチをタップすると…？
・効果音・振動はオン／オフできます
・アカウント登録は不要です。進み具合は端末の中に保存されます

※本アプリは無料で遊べます。広告が表示されます。アプリ内課金はありません。

name: 一格时间
description:
一格时间是一款用分钟块记录日常活动的时间日记。读了 30 分钟书、运动了 15 分钟、开了 1 小时会，做完就能记下一笔。

【两步记下这段时间】
在「记录」页点选活动，再选 5、10、15、30 或 60 分钟，自动保存。也可填写其他时长、选择日期和添加备注。

【回顾时间花在哪里】
按日、周、月查看累计时长、分类占比、活动排行与每日变化。也可只看一项活动，再打开对应的记录明细。

【补上漏记，调整错记】
在「明细」里按日期查看每一笔。漏记可以补，已有记录可以修改或删除，操作后也可以撤销。

【按自己的习惯整理活动】
添加自己的活动、设置分类、调整顺序，也可按名称和状态筛选。停用暂时用不到的活动，历史记录仍可查看，并继续计入统计。

采用深绿像素风界面。无需登录，记录保存在设备上，离线也能使用。

name: 中学受験 理科・社会 一問一答
description:
中学受験の理科・社会を、4択の一問一答で覚えるアプリです。小学4〜6年生向け。

■ まちがえた問題だけ、自動で復習
1回目でまちがえた問題は、3日後に「復習」に集まります。復習で続けて正解すると「覚えた」になります。1回分の10問は、全部正解するまで終わりません。

■ おうちの方が学習記録を見られます
今日解いた数・正答率・続けた日数、この7日間のグラフ、苦手な単元、単元ごとの記録を、1つの画面で見られます。

■ 理科・社会 32単元・512問
社会：都道府県と県庁所在地、地図の見方、日本の地形・気候、農業・水産業・工業、資源・エネルギーと環境、貿易と交通、日本国憲法と人権、国会・内閣・裁判所、地方自治・選挙・税、国際連合 など
理科：植物、こん虫、人のからだ、星と星座、太陽と月、天気、流れる水と地層、火山と地震、光と音、電気、ふりこ、てこ、ものの温まり方・とけ方・燃え方、水よう液 など
（歴史は準備中です）

■ 問題は、公的な機関のサイトで確かめたものだけ
国土地理院、気象庁、国立天文台、文部科学省、農林水産省などのページと照らし合わせて確かめた問題だけを入れています。年によって変わる数字（生産量の順位など）は出しません。

■ そのほか
・問題文と選択肢にふりがな付き
・iPhone と iPad で使えます
・広告なし、登録なし、学習の記録は端末の中だけに保存

■ 料金
・10単元は無料で、まるごと解けます（復習も使えます）
・「すべての単元をひらく」（800円・買い切り）で、すべての単元が解けます。あとから増える単元もふくみます。月額ではありません。
・ファミリー共有に対応しています。

name: 元疆
description:
元疆帮你把工位舒展、居家练习和户外散步安排进日常。选好场景和手头的时间，跟着分段计时活动，再用周历和场景地图回顾自己的记录。

• 此刻｜按工位、家里或户外场景、可用时长和活动条件推荐练习。倒计时显示已用时、当前动作、分段进度和下一步提示，支持暂停后继续。
• 运动｜走路计时可设半程折返提醒。动作图鉴提供 6 个坐姿和站姿动作，可搜索、筛选、收藏，查看姿势示意和分步说明，也可直接开始 30 秒练习。活动接力提供 3 套可计时的分段练习。
• 节律｜用周历回顾活动和身体感受，记录精力、感受标签与文字备注，也可添加最长 60 秒的语音备注。每周趋势可以查看每天记录的精力。
• 疆域｜保存活动后点亮对应场景。活动结算时可手动填写地点或获取一次当前位置。可在地点簿按名称查找活动，或在每周探索报告里按次数、时长查看每日和场景分布。

name: 口袋律所-私密工具
description:
口袋律所是一款面向中国法律场景的本地法律研究与材料整理工具。它把问题研究、法条检索、卷宗识别和合同审阅放在同一个工作区，帮助你整理材料、发现待核实事项，并形成供进一步复核的研究草稿。

【从问题开始研究】
输入法律问题，管理不同会话，并将相关材料挂载到当前会话。围绕事实、法律依据与待确认事项梳理研究思路。

【检索法条与核对依据】
在本地法条库按法规名称、条文序号或关键词检索，查看条文、效力信息及来源线索。法条库是随版本提供的资料快照，不保证实时更新，请以官方最新原文为准。

【整理卷宗与识别材料】
支持导入 PDF、PNG、JPG、JPEG、HEIC，以及拍摄多页材料。在设备上进行文字识别，保留页码与证据位置，便于回看材料。

【辅助审阅合同】
从已识别合同文本中整理风险线索、条款原文、证据位置及相关法条，并可通过系统分享导出 Markdown 报告。识别与分析结果可能有遗漏，需要逐项核对原件。

【本机运行，按需下载模型】
无需注册账户。咨询内容、导入材料与工作区数据在本机处理；法律分析不发送至云端模型。首次使用本地生成能力需联网下载约 2.50 GB 的通义千问 4B 模型，建议使用具备 8 GB 或以上运行内存的设备。语义检索模型可按需下载；未安装模型时保留检索与规则分析能力。模型下载服务需要网络，并会接收完成下载所需的网络请求信息。

【重要说明】
本应用是软件工具，不是律师事务所，不提供律师代理或人工律师服务，不建立律师与委托人关系。自动生成内容仅供法律研究和材料整理参考，不构成正式法律意见，不保证结论、时效或案件结果。请核验事实、官方法律文本及适用地区，并咨询具备资质的专业人士。请仅导入你有权处理的材料。

name: 弧垂量
description:
弧垂量用来对架空索做悬链线教学推演。选定索材后，输入跨度、支座高差、预张力和集中载荷，查看跨中垂度、支座拉力和安全系数。

可以对照动载滑过时的离地净空，以及高温、低温下垂度和拉力怎么变。净空高于常用参考、落在参考之间，或可能擦到障碍物和树冠，会分开标出。这些数字只供学习对照，不是索道工程的验收结论。

方案保存在离线档案里。清理临时蓝图缓存时，已经归档的计算方案会留下。

name: 拾页 - 亲子互动学习手账
description:
拾页是一款专为家长打造的亲子互动学习手账工具。拍摄或导入课本目录后，勾选本次要复习的章节范围，3 分钟即可生成孩子免登录即可独立完成并盖章的互动学习手账。

【核心特色】
• 拍一次目录，整学期复用：多级章节树精准圈范围，多学科目录独立密钥加密留存。
• 全屏本机陪伴模式：纯净零广告，家长长按 2 秒防误退，也支持 7 天跨设备分享链接或二维码。
• 做完即看复盘与薄弱点再练：自动统计完成度、用时与得分，归集错题并支持薄弱点一键再练。

name: 日常手记 - 阅读书记随记本
description: 这是一款读书随记本，您可以在其中添加上自己喜欢的书籍，每次观看书籍后都可以记录下来，当你下次想要观看时可以查询记录，接着上次记录进行观看，避免阅读混乱，也能更好的管理书籍。

name: 智控平台-众智科技
description:
SmartGen 智控平台是一款面向众智科技（SmartGen）控制器及扩展模块的移动端配置工具。手机通过蓝牙即可与设备建立连接，随时读取、查看并修改设备参数，让现场调试和日常维护不再依赖电脑，操作更简单、响应更及时。

【主要功能】
· 蓝牙搜索与连接：自动发现附近设备，一键连接，连接状态实时显示
· 配置一键读取：按分组读取设备当前配置，数据清晰呈现，便于核对
· 参数在线修改：逐项修改配置并保存到设备，修改结果即时生效
· 分组清晰：网关设置、WiFi、GPS、云服务器设置、输入口、输出口、模块设置、BMU、电池簇设置、充电和 SOC 设置、保护参数设置等分组一键切换
· 多型号支持：可在设置中切换控制器型号，适配不同设备
· 多语言界面：支持简体中文、繁体中文、英语、俄语、西班牙语、土耳其语和法语

【适用场景】
· 设备安装调试：现场通过手机快速完成参数配置，无需携带电脑
· 日常巡检维护：随时连接设备核对配置，及时发现并调整参数
· 海外项目现场：按母语操作界面，降低沟通成本

【支持设备】
当前支持 CMM366A-WIFI、HBCU310 等支持蓝牙通讯的 SmartGen 设备，具体以实际产品为准。

【使用须知】
· 本应用需配合支持蓝牙通讯的 SmartGen 设备使用，无设备时无法体验完整功能
· 首次使用请开启手机蓝牙，并允许应用访问蓝牙权限
· 应用不会收集您的位置信息，蓝牙权限仅用于发现和连接设备
· 使用前请阅读并同意《用户协议》和《隐私政策》

如需了解产品详情或获取技术支持，请联系众智科技（SmartGen）。

name: 栖息
description:
栖息，把分散的健康数据，整理成容易看懂的日常。

连接 Apple 健康，在 iPhone 上查看睡眠、心率、步数与运动记录，配合 Apple Watch，慢慢了解自己的身体节奏。

【今日状态，一眼了解】
昨夜睡了多久、最近心率如何、今天走了多少步，打开栖息就能查看。

【看懂睡眠与休息】
查看睡眠时长、睡眠阶段，以及睡眠期间的心率、呼吸频率等数据。通过日、周、月、年趋势，了解作息的变化。

【留意心率与压力变化】
查看心率、静息心率与心率变异性，以图表了解长期变化。结合心率与心率变异性估算压力状态，用直观的心情表情呈现，帮助你留意身体的起伏。

【记录日常的每一步】
查看每日步数、目标进度与历史趋势，让散步、通勤和日常活动留下清楚的记录。

【让运动有迹可循】
在 Apple Watch 上记录跑步、散步与骑行，在 iPhone 上回看运动时长、距离、活动消耗，以及已记录的户外路线。

【按自己的喜好使用】
选择喜欢的主题与心情表情，设置步数目标，让健康记录融入自己的日常。

栖息按你的授权读取 Apple 健康数据，可用指标取决于设备支持、授权情况与已有记录。健康记录不会上传至开发者服务器。

栖息用于日常健康记录与参考。压力状态为估算结果，不用于医疗诊断或治疗。

name: 注音符號學習樂園
description:
讓孩子在遊戲中愛上注音！《注音符號學習樂園》專為學齡前與國小低年級兒童設計，結合點字發音、筆劃練習、聽音辨字、拼音積木與弱點特訓，讓零基礎孩子也能一步步建立注音與拼讀能力。

【五大核心學習功能】
1. 37 個注音符號有聲表：完整收錄 37 個注音符號，點擊即可聽發音與查看代表詞彙，方便隨時翻閱練習。
2. 筆劃練習：引導孩子認識符號結構與書寫方向，沒有時間壓力，安心建立手感。
3. 聽音辨字：訓練聲母、韻母與聲調的聽力辨識，邊聽邊找更快記牢。
4. 拼音積木：將聲母、介音、韻母與聲調組合成完整詞彙，練習拼讀邏輯。
5. 冒險地圖與弱點特訓：從新手村、練習場、挑戰島一路闖關，並自動記錄容易答錯的符號，一鍵加強練習。

【給家長的安心設計】
・純粹學習體驗：不干擾孩子學習的介面設計，讓專注力留在注音與拼讀上。
・家長專區與家長鎖：設定、條款與相關資訊皆設有家長驗證機制，降低孩子誤觸風險。
・離線也能玩：核心學習內容可在裝置本機運作，出門搭車或外出時也能隨時練習。

現在就打開《注音符號學習樂園》，陪孩子踏出注音學習的第一步！

name: 海拔指南针 - 查海拔辨方向，户外运动随身工具
description:
每一次出发，都从找到方向开始。

海拔指南针将罗盘、海拔查询、天气气压、运动记录与水平仪装进口袋。无论是城市漫步、周末骑行，还是登山徒步，抬手查看方向与环境信息，让探索更从容。

【方向清晰，出发有数】
实时显示方位与角度，支持磁北、真北切换。锁定目标方向后，查看转向提示；配合校准引导，轻松掌握罗盘的使用方法。

【查看海拔，了解所在】
查询当前位置的地形海拔，查看经纬度与定位精度，并通过海拔历史图表回顾每次打开时的高度变化。地形数据暂不可用时，可回退显示手机定位海拔。

【天气气压，一屏掌握】
查看温度、体感温度、湿度、风向与风速，了解当地天气。结合气象气压与设备传感器，提供多种气压单位、磁场读数及水的沸点估算，丰富你对周围环境的认识。

【记录运动，留住每次出发】
支持步行、跑步、登山与骑行模式。在运动页面记录前台 GPS 轨迹、累计里程、运动时长与平均速度，支持设备计步、暂停和继续。结束后保存运动摘要，方便日后回顾。

【随手测量，轻松找平】
内置气泡水平仪，直观查看横向、纵向倾角。支持以当前平面归零，便于测量相对倾角，满足日常摆放与找平需求。

【日夜皆宜，清晰易读】
支持日间、夜间与跟随系统外观。清晰的刻度、醒目的方向标识，让每一次查看都简单顺手。

使用说明：
• 地形海拔反映地面高程，不代表楼层、桥面或手机的实时高度。
• 运动轨迹仅在运动页面且应用处于前台时记录，切换页面或进入后台会自动暂停；历史记录保存运动摘要。
• 读数受设备能力、定位信号及周围环境影响。含氧量与水的沸点为估算参考。
• 部分功能需开通会员，套餐、价格及权益以应用内展示为准。自动续订套餐可在 Apple 账户的订阅设置中管理或取消。

用户协议：https://photomemory.top/compass/EULA_zhcn_ios.html
隐私政策：https://photomemory.top/compass/privacy_zhcn_ios.html

name: 消厄木魚
description:
是一款專屬於你的療癒電子木魚

工作壓力大、事情不順、心裡悶悶的時候，打開消厄木魚，敲敲他！！！！

【適合這些時刻】
-上班卡關、心情煩躁時
-睡前想放空、讓自己平靜
-想替自己轉轉運、求個好心情

※ 本 App 為放鬆與療癒用途，不具宗教或醫療效果

name: 润广达屏测工具
description:
润广达屏测工具是面向 OLED 驱动方案、面板与模组测试场景的显示与触控检测工具，六大模块覆盖日常产线与验收项目，纯本地运行、不联网、不收集任何个人信息。

【屏幕测试】
17 色纯色色卡（相册式左右滑动）、16 级灰阶阶梯与连续渐变、14 级带数值灰阶标定（28/36/46/56/76/88/98/108/128/156/172/190/210/255，点击任一灰块可单色全屏并左右滑动逐级查看，便于定位低灰偏色与并阶）、彩色渐变（RGB 光谱 / 色相 / 径向 / 中心亮斑）、实时噪点测试、坏点检测、拖影测试。

【串扰测试】
1px 细线阵（间距 1~10px 可调）、细文字（按开源许可版式排布，长英文行与密集小字混排）、1 / 2 / 3px 细棋盘格、点阵与网格（间距 4~40px）、局部色块。

【图片显示】
24 色标准色卡、肤色梯度、色彩球、高细节图、32 级灰阶、连续渐变等内置图表，另含实拍高细节图与 20 张风景样张，支持双指缩放查看细节并可导出到系统相册。

【感光测试】
实时 lux 值、最近 60 秒曲线、最大 / 最小 / 平均值与异常提示。（iOS 系统不开放环境光传感器，本模块在 iOS 上以屏幕亮度作为参考并在页面内标注。）

【触摸测试】共 8 项
画线测试（网格参考、断点自动标注、坐标 / 压力 / 面积、笔数与断点统计、撤销与清除）、多点触控（每指轨迹与编号、实测报点率、静止抖动、丢点与峰值触点数）、触摸精度（3×3 / 5×5 靶心，给出平均与最大偏差 dp / mm 并自动判定合格）、边缘测试（四边 40 段 + 四角覆盖率）、显示对位（区分系统性偏移与随机误差）、触摸热力图（5×5 分区定位不灵敏区）、大面积误触（按接触面积识别手掌按压）、纯色乱触测试（单色静置 / 明暗交替 / 多色循环 / 亮度扫描四种模式，自动记录幽灵触控并生成可复制报告）。

【帧率测试】
UFO 运动、跳帧、拖影追拍，配合数据条显示实测帧率、帧间隔、丢帧率与 P99。

【工具】
刷新率、亮度档位、电池监测（实时读取电池端电压、电流、功率、温度与 60 秒曲线，一键复制报告；iOS 仅显示电量与充电状态并在页面内标注）、屏幕常亮、屏幕参数、隐私政策、联系我们、语言切换（简体中文 / 繁體中文 / English / 日本語 / हिन्दी / 한국어）。

特色：全部测试图本地生成或内置，不联网、不采集任何个人信息，无账号体系与广告；测试页沉浸式全屏、自动常亮、左上角一键退出；精度 / 边缘 / 对位 / 热力图 / 误触 / 乱触均支持一键复制报告，便于填写异常单与客户验收记录。

name: 清记相册
description:
相册里其实有两类东西：多出来的照片，和会过期的日子。
前者靠删，后者靠记。清记相册两件都做。
清：每天三组，翻完就停
清理相册最难的不是删，是「从哪里开始」。打开就是三千张，翻两屏就放弃了。
所以它每天只给你三组，每组最多十张，随机挑，当天分组固定不变。你只需要决定这一张留还是不留，翻完 30 张就收工，第二天再来。进度按天记录，哪天翻过哪些照片都记得住。
记：你拍过的证件，到点它会说
护照、签证、身份证、驾照——这些照片拍完就埋在相册深处，等你想起来的时候，往往已经过期了。
从相册里挑一张，它在本机读出上面的日期，你核对一遍就能设提醒，到点通知你。识别在本机完成，不保存原图、不上传照片——它只记住「这件事几号到期」，不记住证件长什么样。
标记与删除分开
左滑留下一张、右滑跳过、上滑标记删除。所有标记都只存在本机，等你确认后才交给系统，删除的照片仍然躺在「最近删除」里 30 天，随时能捞回来。
相册是它的上下文
照片决定了它还能替你做什么，所以整理做得不比清理少：
· 相似照片聚成一组，挑出最清楚的那张，其余一次清掉
· 截图从照片流里分出来，按时间排好，截完再没打开过的可以成批处理
· 按体积排队，先看清占掉 500MB 的到底是哪几张，不用一屏一屏滑
接下来做什么，你说了算
应用里有一个许愿池，列出正在考虑的方向：按拍摄地点回顾、把一趟旅行整理成一本、证件扫成 PDF、视频专清、批量压缩、把照片藏进应用里……你点一下表示想要，我们按票数排优先级。
这不是付费功能，也不是投票活动，没有奖励。就是想知道你真正需要什么——毕竟它要长成什么样，取决于相册里装着你什么样的生活。
照片不出这台手机
所有缩略图读取、分组、相似度比较、文字识别都在设备本地完成，不上传、不备份。唯一会联网的是许愿池：你主动点某一项时，只发送一个功能编号和一个随机哈希，不包含任何照片信息。
没有账号，不用注册，没有广告，没有第三方统计 SDK，不追踪你在其他应用里的行为。

name: 登録販売者 過去問｜アプ問 予想問題
description:
登録販売者試験の対策に。
試験と同じ5章・120問・午前午後各2時間のオリジナル予想問題5回分、5章23分野1,280問の4択問題、成分と作用・副作用の暗記カード1,769枚、混同注意141組を、すべて自作の解説つきで収録。「試験問題の作成に関する手引き（令和8年4月）」に合わせて作っています。

過去問（北海道・東北ブロック）は問題・解説とも、予想問題の第1回、4択問題の星1、暗記カード、混同注意、漫画の各分野の第1話は、購入しなくても使えます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 予想問題で本試験に備える
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【オリジナル予想問題 5回分】
第1章20問・第2章20問・第3章40問・第4章20問・第5章20問の120問を、午前・午後それぞれ2時間で解く予想問題です。章ごとの問数・時間・五肢択一と四肢択一・正誤の組合せや空欄の問題まで、本試験に合わせて作っています。
・制限時間つきで解ける（途中でやめても続きから解ける）
・採点後は、総得点と5章それぞれの得点を表示し、受験するブロックの合格基準（総得点7割以上・各章の足切り）で合否を判定
・全問に、誤りの選択肢一つひとつまでの解説つき

【受験するブロックを選べる】
北海道・東北、南関東、東海・北陸、関西広域連合、九州・沖縄など、受験するブロックを選ぶと、試験日のカウントダウンと章ごとの足切りの基準がそのブロックに合わせて切り替わります。

【過去問（北海道・東北ブロック）】
北海道・東北ブロック（北海道作問）の過去問を、問題文・正答とオリジナルの解説つきで収録。すべて無料です。本試験と同じ120問・午前午後の形で解け、各章の足切りまで判定します。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 4択問題で基礎を固める
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【5章23分野・1,280問の4択問題】
医薬品に共通する特性と基本的な知識、人体の働きと医薬品、主な医薬品とその作用、薬事に関する法規と制度、医薬品の適正使用と安全対策の5章を23分野に分け、星1（基礎）・星2（本試験レベル）・星3（応用）の3段階で段階的に実力を伸ばせます。
かぜ薬・解熱鎮痛薬・胃腸薬・漢方処方製剤の成分と副作用、リスク区分、販売業の許可、副作用の報告制度まで、出題の多いテーマを網羅しています。

【出題順と出題する問題を選べる】
「順番通り／ランダム」と「すべての問題／未習得のみ」を組み合わせて出題できます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 覚える
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【暗記カード 1,769枚】
成分名と作用・副作用、漢方処方製剤の「しばり」、生薬、人体の器官、法規の要点をカードで確認。「1問1答」「一覧」「赤シート」の3つの見方を切り替えられます。

【音声で聞き流す】
暗記カードを読み上げで聞き流せます。通勤中や家事の間にも学習できます。

【漫画でわかる 23分野・全46話】
ドラッグストアを舞台に、成分の働きや制度のしくみをストーリーで理解できる漫画です。各分野の第1話は無料。

【混同注意 141組・比較カード・並び替え】
似た名前の成分や、まぎらわしい用語・制度を組にして「見分け方」と「ひっかけ」を整理。4択問題や予想問題の解説の下にも、関係する組が出てきます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 忘れない・弱点をなくす
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【二段構えの自動復習】
まちがえた問題は、その日のうちの「当日やり直し」と、忘却曲線に合わせた「復習ボックス」に自動で入ります。

【分野別の正答率グラフ】
分野ごとの正答率を低い順に表示。タップすれば、その分野の弱点だけを集中して解けます。

【弱点プリント（PDF印刷）】
まちがえた問題やブックマークした問題から、紙で解けるA4プリントを作成できます。

【付箋メモ・検索】
問題やカードに自分だけのメモを貼れます。成分名・用語・問題をまとめて検索できます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ 続ける
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【学習スタンプカレンダー】
解いた日にスタンプ。今日の学習数や連続日数、学習時間、直近14日のグラフも確認できます。

【トロフィー・全国ランキング】
連続学習や解いた問題数でトロフィーを獲得。Game Center で、全国のユーザーと正解数や予想問題の得点率を競えます。

【試験日までのカウントダウン・集中タイマー】
受験予定日までの日数をホームとホーム画面ウィジェットに表示。25分集中＋5分休憩のタイマーも使えます。

【iPhoneとiPadで記録を同期】
iCloudで学習記録を同期できます。


＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
■ パック（すべて買い切り・月額なし）
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

【4択問題パック】
4択問題の星2・星3（23分野）と、暗記カードの音声読み上げ（全カード）

【予想問題パック】
オリジナル予想問題 第2〜5回

【フル解放パック】
上の2つのパックに、着せ替えテーマ4種＋限定テーマを加えたセット

【コンプリートパック】
フル解放パックと、漫画 全分野（46話）のセット

漫画は1分野ずつ購入することもできます。お持ちのパックに合わせて、差額で上のパックに切り替えられます。学習でたまるチケットを使って、予想問題を1回分ずつ解放することもできます。
このアプリに広告はありません。

※問題・解説はすべてオリジナルです。法令・制度は「試験問題の作成に関する手引き（令和8年4月、厚生労働省）」に基づいています。本アプリは厚生労働省・各都道府県とは関係のない個人が作成した学習用アプリです。

name: 管口低频
description:
管口低频用来在手机上推演低音倒相箱或密闭箱。先在调谐工台选定箱型、净容积、调谐频率和倒相管内径，再看截止频率、管口风速和频响。

风速顺畅时没有明显风噪。到了临界气喘或严重喘震，就需要加大管径。按当前容积、调谐频率和管径如果算出的管长为负，这个组合不能成管。方案可以归档到声学台账，也可以导出声学标定图纸。

计算在本机完成。箱体设计和图纸都留在设备里，不上传。清理临时图纸缓存时，已经归档的台账会保留。测算只供工程预研和声学设计参考。

name: 素箋
description:
素箋 (Sujian) is a quiet Markdown notebook for iPhone. Open it and write.

Please note: the app's interface is in Traditional Chinese. Your notes can be in any language.

MARKDOWN THAT TAKES SHAPE AS YOU TYPE
• Headings, lists, checklists, quotes, code and links are styled while you write. The syntax stays on the page and fades back.
• Reading mode renders the finished note, with tables and Mermaid diagrams.
• A format bar above the keyboard, Find and Replace inside a note, and tappable checkboxes.
• Stays fast in very long notes.

YOUR NOTES ARE YOUR FILES
• Every note is a plain .md file stored on your iPhone.
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking. The developer runs no server and collects nothing.
• Find notes by text or by #tag, pin the ones you need, and recover deleted notes for 30 days.
• Light and dark paper, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and Increase Contrast are all supported.

AN ASSISTANT ON YOUR TERMS
• Optional. Bring your own API key for Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible service, including a model running on your own computer.
• Ask it to tidy a note, turn meeting notes into a to-do list, or draft a new note from what you already wrote.
• Every change to a note arrives as a diff that you accept or discard, and you can undo it afterwards.
• The app asks before notes first go to a service, and your key is kept in the iOS Keychain.

BACK UP AND TAKE YOUR NOTES ANYWHERE
• Back up to your own Cloudflare R2 bucket, by hand or automatically, and restore on another iPhone. Backups keep earlier versions of each note.
• Export a note as Markdown, PDF or Word, or export everything as a zip.
• Import Markdown and text files, folders or a zip.

ABOUT THE ASSISTANT
The assistant needs your own account and API key with a model provider. That provider's prices, terms and regional availability apply; the hosted services are not available from some regions. Everything else in the app works without it.

name: 薄肌闹钟
description:
薄肌闹钟，帮你同时解决早起+健身拖延。

普通闹钟，按一下继续睡。
薄肌闹钟，帮助你真的醒来。

闹钟响后，先完成挑战——做一组俯卧撑、拍下指定的东西，或者大声说出今天的肯定语——验证通过，闹钟才会停。

【三种挑战，任选一种】
· 俯卧撑：镜头前持续 15 秒，AI 帮你数
· 拍照打卡：拍到牙刷、水杯或窗外天色才算完成
· 正向自我确认：按住麦克风，大声说出今天的肯定语

【不给"再睡五分钟"留机会】
· 按掉闹钟不算数，挑战没完成，它会继续提醒你
· 按掉之后，每分钟闹钟响一次
· 把 App 划掉也没用，后续闹钟已经交给系统，到点照样响

【自律，触手可及】
想关闹钟？先做一组俯卧撑/喝杯温水。
几天之后你会发现，好习惯已经养成了。

今晚设一个闹钟，明早起不来算我输。

需要 iOS 26.1 或更高版本。
俯卧撑与拍照打卡需要相机权限；正向自我确认需要麦克风与语音识别权限。

不需要注册账号，闹钟与打卡数据只保存在你的手机上。

本应用仅为自律打卡、习惯养成工具，不提供医疗建议。

隐私政策：https://baojialarm.cn/privacy-policy.html

name: 虎租号王
description:
虎租号王，专业铜管乐器租赁平台，汇集优质乐器号品，甄选王级品质短笛、C 调小号、B 调小号，品相完好、调试到位，适合练习、考级、演出租借。

我们帮管乐爱好者降低入门成本，短期试学、乐团排练、临时演出都可以按需租乐器，租期灵活，随租随还。玩管乐不必被高价乐器束缚，U 享一站式线上租借服务，选品、配送、回收线上完成。

每件乐器都经过检修保养，音色稳定。平台帮你挑选适配号品，讲解使用要点，售后随时响应。低成本体验管乐魅力，U 享省心租琴，轻松享受玩音乐的乐趣。

name: 跨中沉降
description:
跨中沉降用来推演一根梁的弯矩、剪力和跨中下挠。在梁肋工坊里选定简支、悬臂、两端固定或外伸悬挑，再给定跨度、荷载、材料与截面。

算出的挠度会对照参考限值。落在限值内，或已经超出、需要加大截面或缩短跨度，都会标明。这是教学推演，不是正式的结构校核。

验算方案写入本机档案，计算蓝图可以存进相册。不需要这些记录时，可以清空本地验算历史。

name: 银发梦想家
seller_name: Hainan Manxi Network Technology Co., Ltd
description: 银发梦想家是一款专为退休长者和银发一族打造的“梦想清单、习惯打卡、圆梦账本、时光手账”一站式生活工具。在这里，您可以列下旅行、书画、康养、家人陪伴等心愿，设定预算与完成年份，随时查看圆梦进度；用每日打卡养成散步、练字、早睡的好习惯，查看连续打卡天数与七日活力曲线；用“圆梦金库”记录养老备用金的存入与每一笔圆梦支出；再用时光手账写下当天的天气、心情与幸福评分，回望岁月里的点滴。界面采用明亮的多巴胺配色、大字号高对比排版，操作简单直观，无需注册登录，数据仅保存在本机，安心记录。

name: 随身短信汇
description:
When you travel abroad, carry one iPhone and read texts sent to the iPhones you leave at home. Install the app on both iPhones, sign in to iCloud with the same Apple Account, and choose which phone forwards and which receives.

Follow the illustrated guide or video to set up Shortcuts on the forwarding iPhone. When Messages posts a matching notification, the shortcut forwards its title and text. Personal texts, delivery updates and verification codes can all be forwarded this way. They stay in their original language.

Pause reception in Settings. When you resume, messages waiting in iCloud are saved on this iPhone. Touch and hold a message to select and delete multiple local copies.

Both iPhones need internet access and available iCloud storage. The forwarding iPhone also needs cellular service to receive SMS. Forwarding Messages notifications requires iOS 27 or later. On iOS 17 or later, a Message automation can forward texts by sender or keyword. On iOS 27 or later, both automations can run together. A text that matches multiple rules at the same time is forwarded once. With notification-based forwarding, the available text depends on the preview. Delivery time depends on the network and the system.

name: 雀記ー麻雀スコア記録アプリー
description:
雀記（じゃんき）は、仲間うちの麻雀の成績をかんたんに記録・共有できるスコア記録アプリです。

■ 点数を入れるだけで自動計算
対局ごとに持ち点を入力するだけで、順位・順位点・ポイントを自動で計算します。最後の1人の点数は自動で埋められるので、入力もかんたんです。

■ グループでみんなと共有
グループを作って招待コードを送るだけで、メンバー全員が同じ成績を見られます。アプリを使っていない人も「ゲスト」として記録できます。

■ ランキングと個人成績
・通算ポイント、最高スコア、トップ数、ラス回避率などの部門別ランキング
・ポイントや着順の推移グラフ、着順分布、連続トップなどの記録
・相手ごとの相性
・今月、3か月、期間指定での絞り込み

■ 四麻・三麻の両方に対応
四人麻雀と三人麻雀は別々に集計されます。持ち点や順位点、飛びの有無などのルールもグループごとに設定できます。

※本アプリは成績の記録・集計を行うツールです。金銭のやり取りや賭博を目的とした機能はありません。

name: AoftriByork
description: AoftriByork is a personal garage notebook. Add one or more vehicles, set maintenance intervals by months and/or distance, log each service with an optional photo, and see what is due soon or overdue. Garage, Due, Log, and Bay are the four tabs. Optional local reminders notify you before a scheduled date. All data stays on your device. No account, and no vehicle diagnostics

name: JSCCMKT
description:
Our app is a private desk for the sample Hale household. 

Open the app and you are already at the desk. There is no opening guide. Home shows the active cover card, short paths into wellness, a sample claim, and the clinic list, then the household market value with cash set beside the holdings.

The cover record names the sum, the window, and who is on the plan. Open the member card, pin it into the document vault, and read the household side by side with the plans that already ended. File a sample claim with chips and steppers. Nothing asks you to type. A dental line returns itself so the gap in the health plan stays visible. Premiums, dividends, charges, and settled claims sit on a cash calendar you can switch by year.

Holdings lists each name with day move, result, and yield on cost. Open a position to see income, cost, and the split between the core sleeve and the trading sleeve. Slide shares from one sleeve to the other. The grid bench is arithmetic only: pick a name, step the rates, and read the buy and sell the sample would need. It does not place an order.

name: ¡Ah Chihuahua!
seller_name: Medparh Central de Medios y Publicidad, S.A. de C.V.
description:

name: 1st City — Тайники города
description:
У него есть стрелки, но он не целится. Его слышит вся площадь. Оглянись: может, отгадка прямо над тобой?

1st City превращает прогулку в игру. Министерство тайников прячет шифровки по всему городу, а ты — агент: находишь чужие тайники, прячешь свои и ловишь курьеров.

Лови курьеров
• По улицам ходят пятеро курьеров: Бабушка-связная, Голубь-информатор, Кот-резидент, Двойной агент и Чемодан на ножках. У каждого свои приметы.
• Подойди ближе 40 метров — курьер выйдет к тебе в камеру в 3D. Бросай сетку, когда разрыв кольца дойдёт до метки.
• Промахнулся — курьер увернётся; ищи его на карте и бросай снова. Упустишь — он спрячется у ближайшей достопримечательности, и там появится городской тайник.
• Иных берут только облавой — втроём, с разных сторон. Раз в день по городу бежит Беглец дня.
• Поймал — шифровки из портфеля твои. Если AR на телефоне недоступен, курьер будет рисованным, а место подскажет компас.

Ищи и вскрывай
• Зоны тайников на карте. Войди в круг — Связной пришлёт загадку о предмете рядом, подсказки приходят со временем.
• Наведи камеру на то, что кажется ответом: подсказка скажет «теплее» или «горячо».
• Нашёл — вскрой замок отмычкой: останавливай диски, когда метка окажется наверху. Пять отмычек в день выдают и так.
• Осторожно, муляж: пустышка съедает отмычку.

Прячь у всех на виду
• Сними скамейку, фонарь или ограду — Связной сочинит три загадки разной трудности, выбери свою.
• Положи в тайник шифровки. Вскроют — заберут половину; выстоит — получишь шифровки за упорство.
• Утренний отчёт расскажет, сколько агентов искали и кто вскрыл.
• Отправь другу вызов — ссылку на свой тайник.
• Отметь дом — рядом с ним тайник не спрячешь. Точка хранится только на телефоне.

«Что это?»
• Наведи камеру на дом, памятник или любую вещь на улице, коснись её или обведи пальцем — игра расскажет, что это и какая у неё история. Голосом, с субтитрами и источниками.
• Спроси голосом — ответ придёт следом.

Великий тайник
• Один на весь город, час на закате. Каждые пять минут круг сужается, подсказки приходят по ходу. Первый получает уникальный артефакт.
• У некоторых районов есть свой тайник.
• Карточку итога можно отправить в историю 9:16 или квадратом.

Досье, склад и личное дело
• Шифровка, пролежавшая в тайнике восемь часов, становится артефактом — уликой в досье сезона. Серии по темам, записки курьеров.
• Лишние копии сдай Связному за баллы. На складе за баллы — отмычки, муляжи, подсказки, новая загадка, печать и замок.
• Позывной, звание и опыт — от новобранца до легенды. Рейтинг недели — по городу и по району.
• Первые 300 агентов игры получают номер основателя.
• Явки — заведения-партнёры игры на карте, где они есть: дойди до двери, назови отзыв и получи пропуск.
• Оформление — «Бумага», «Ночь» или как в системе.

Честная игра
• Баллы — только игровая ценность: их нельзя купить или вывести.
• На тайник или рассказ можно пожаловаться — его проверит человек.

Перед игрой
Для игры нужны геопозиция и камера; вопросы голосом — только с твоего согласия. Игра с 14 лет. Игра работает по всему СНГ. Играй пешком, в общественных местах, и смотри по сторонам.

name: A Level Maths: Surdmere
description:
Practise A level and AS Maths with a desk that checks what you know and serves the next idea you need.

WHAT YOU GET
- 75 concepts mapped to every DfE A level maths content statement (88), split into 178 assessable points, each with at least 8 original practice questions. Pure, statistics and mechanics, with an AS toggle. A Coverage screen shows every point, your mastery and the sources.
- Over 2,800 original questions, each with a worked explanation. Computed answers were checked a second way in code.
- Seven labs you can play with: calculus (tangents and area), graph transformations, trigonometry, vectors and forces, distributions and hypothesis tests, projectile motion, and Newton-Raphson and the trapezium rule.
- A Real-World view with 15 build-led problems (design a roller-coaster hill, plan a launch, run quality control for a factory, plan savings and loans, model a medicine dose, check a loaded beam and more): each step teaches just what it needs, then you check it, and finished builds go on your Made-it shelf. Switch between Syllabus and Real-world with one tap.
- A Data desk with an original practice data set for cleaning, outliers and sampling, plus notes on how AQA, Pearson Edexcel and OCR treat their Large Data Set.

PERSONALIZED, IN PLAIN WORDS
Surdmere remembers, on your device only, how well you hold each concept and how recently you practised it. After every quick check it shows you exactly what to reread, links to the example or lab for it, and tells you in one line why it suggests a concept next. Concepts you have not seen for a while come back for review. Study in syllabus order, or switch to the Build-it path; your progress is shared.

OTHER BOARDS (OPTIONAL)
A quiet Other boards chip on each topic and a Curriculum map show where it sits in GCSE, IB and AP, with what differs, so you can prepare extra material if you move between systems. It is free, approximate and can be switched off.

TESTS
Unit tests, a cumulative test, 30-minute practice papers and 36 full-length mock papers (2 hours, about 40 questions) in the structure of AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR A and OCR B (MEI) papers, each ending with a report and a study plan. Practice papers are original; marks are ours, not a board mark scheme.

FREE AND SURDMERE PLUS
Free: all 75 lessons, quick checks, unit and cumulative tests, 30-minute practice papers, the Coverage screen, the Curriculum map, 3 of the 7 labs and 7 of the 15 Real-World builds.
Surdmere Plus (monthly, auto-renewing): the other 4 labs, the other 8 Real-World builds, 36 full-length 2-hour mock papers and quiz lengths up to 20. No free trial. Cancel any time: you keep Plus until the end of the month you paid for and are not charged again. Manage it in your store account settings.

Works offline. No account, no tracking. Text size from 50% to 300%.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR, WJEC/Eduqas, the DfE, Ofqual, the IB or the College Board. Board names are used only to describe which specifications the content supports.

name: Abacus: Soroban & Mental Math
description:
A Japanese abacus, the soroban, on your iPhone: to play with, to learn on, and to practise until the sums go by themselves.

A FRAME THAT FEELS RIGHT
Wooden frame, rods and beads. Tap a bead or push it, and it slides to the beam with a knock, taking its neighbours along as on a real frame. The number is shown above in figures and in words, and under each rod. Five, seven or nine rods.

A SMALL GAME TO START
"Can you show 27?" Set the beads, and the next number comes. They get bigger as you go.

LEARN: TEN LESSONS
The course goes the way abacus classes go:
1. Reading the frame
2. Adding, plainly
3. Taking away, plainly
4. Friends of five: adding
5. Friends of five: taking away
6. Friends of ten: adding
7. Friends of ten: taking away
8. Both friends at once
9. Bigger numbers
10. A column of numbers
Every step is done on the frame, and the app sees when the frame shows the right number. "Show me how" explains any step move by move: which bead, on which rod, and why.

PRACTICE: TEN LEVELS
Rounds of eight sums, each a column of numbers to add and take away. Every level asks only for the moves its lessons taught: level 4 never needs a carry, level 6 always does. Your best time for a round with every sum right is kept.

IN THE HEAD (PRO)
Numbers flash by one at a time, slowly at first, then faster. Picture the beads, add them up and type the sum. This is how abacus students learn to calculate without a frame.

ABACUS PRO
The whole course (lessons 4 to 10), every level of practice (3 to 10), any sum of a drill shown move by move, numbers in the head at five speeds, your record (days in a row, sums per day, best times), the Chinese suanpan with two beads above and five below, and five more woods for the frame.

FREE
The soroban with its small game, the first three lessons and the first two levels of practice.

FOR WHOM
For children learning arithmetic, for parents and teachers who want a counting frame at hand, and for adults who always wanted to know how the abacus works. The app teaches a method of calculating and makes no promises beyond that.

PRIVATE
No account. What you learn and practise stays on your iPhone; the app sends nothing to us.

Abacus Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you, and it turns into the paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

Privacy Policy: https://www.appgeolist.com/app/abacus/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Access Mastery
description:
Access Mastery is an offline guide to VoiceOver, the screen reader built into Apple devices. It takes you from turning VoiceOver on for the first time to working like a power user, on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro. It is written for blind and low-vision people, and for sighted people learning VoiceOver to teach or support someone.

WHAT'S INSIDE
54 chapters, about 48,000 words, all built into the app:
- About This Guide: 2 chapters on how to use the book and how VoiceOver fits together
- iPhone: 25 chapters, from first steps and core gestures through the rotor, typing, braille screen input, text editing, speech and verbosity, Safari, Mail, Maps, Camera, Live Recognition, Bluetooth keyboards, braille displays, and troubleshooting
- iPad: 5 chapters on what is the same, iPad gestures, external keyboards, multitasking, and troubleshooting
- Mac: 9 chapters on getting started, the VO keys, navigating, the rotor, VoiceOver Utility, trackpad gestures, essential keyboard commands, the web, and troubleshooting
- Apple Watch: 4 chapters
- Apple TV: 3 chapters
- Apple Vision Pro: 3 chapters
- Apps, Practice, and Sources: helpful accessible apps, a practice plan, and accuracy notes

Every chapter follows the same layout: Overview, What you'll learn, numbered steps with one action each, a practice exercise, a quick reference summary, and sources. Gestures and key commands are written in words, such as "two-finger double tap," so they read cleanly with speech or braille.

FEATURES
- Two ways to start: "I use VoiceOver," or "I'm sighted and learning VoiceOver," which adds a short orientation on turning VoiceOver on and off safely
- Browse by device, with chapter pages that use real headings for the VoiceOver headings rotor
- Full-text search across every chapter, with the number of results spoken
- Quick Reference: each device's quick reference summaries in one place
- Practice: a real button, slider, and list to try gestures on
- Bookmarks, reading progress, mark-as-complete, and Resume where you left off
- Text size up to the largest accessibility sizes, a stronger contrast option, and support for Reduce Motion, Dark Mode, and iPad multitasking

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking, and no in-app purchases. The app collects no data. Your progress and bookmarks stay on your device.

HONEST NOTES
This guide is not an Apple manual and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple. It was written in November 2026 with AI assistance from Apple's own user guides and support articles, and each chapter lists its sources. It targets iOS 26, iPadOS 26, and Apple's current guides for the other devices. Apple can change gestures and settings in later updates; a chapter on accuracy explains where the book is less certain, and your device and Apple's current guide always win. VoiceOver, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro are trademarks of Apple Inc.

name: ACEXLINE
description:
ACEXLINE is a desktop tool designed for those who value composure and order. With its clean, restrained interface and refined, thoughtful interactions, it transforms the often-tedious task of daily organization into a quiet and efficient process. Free from intrusive pop-ups or flashy distractions, the app presents exactly the information you need, with every essential action always within reach.

Here, you can catalog and register every item, assigning each to its proper place. You can map out your overall layout and workflows, and receive timely, helpful reminders—ensuring that no critical milestone is ever overlooked. Within this structured environment, you can fluidly shift between the big picture and the finer details: gain a macro-level overview to manage the rhythm of your work, or dive into individual entries to review and refine them with ease.

With clear grouping, elegant typography, and a smooth, responsive interface, the app remains comfortable to use even for extended periods. Whether you are performing a quick scan or an in-depth organization session, the experience is crisp and immediate—everything is right at your fingertips. Every change is accurately logged, making it easy to review your progress, while your full history remains accessible, documenting every step of your journey.

Your data is kept secure and private: all records are stored locally on your own device. You can export them at any time as standard-format backup files, making it simple to archive, migrate, or share your information. No matter how much your collection grows, your records remain complete and reliable—and should you switch to a new device, you can easily restore everything exactly as it was.

From the initial onboarding guide to your daily routine, ACEXLINE offers a steady, orderly presence. It doesn’t strive for noise or flashiness; it strives for reliability—ensuring that every little detail is kept in its proper place, so you can stay focused on what truly matters.

name: ACRD
description:
The ACRD App is your companion for ACRD events, bringing schedules, session details, and networking opportunities together in one convenient place.

Explore the agenda, build your personal schedule, and connect with fellow disability representatives, advocates, and law firm professionals. Stay informed with event updates and announcements so you can make the most of your experience before, during, and after each event.

name: Acren: Home Upkeep & Quotes
description:
New: the House Check. Home for the holidays? Snap the labels on six things in any house: smoke alarm, water heater, furnace, space heater, dryer and fridge. In about five minutes Acren estimates how old each one is and checks federal CPSC recall records. No account needed. Send your family a link with the results (no address, photos or serial numbers), or tap Watch this house to get freeze warnings and new recalls for it.

Acren runs your home's to-do list, so you don't have to remember it.

Tell Acren where you live. It looks the home up in official public records, then:
- Builds an upkeep plan that fits your home, with the official reason for each item (smoke alarms, furnace filters, dryer vents, water heater and more)
- Shows what needs you today, in order: safety first, then deadlines, then routine
- Watches National Weather Service alerts and the forecast for your home, with a freeze checklist when it turns cold
- Checks your water heater, furnace and other equipment against CPSC recalls. Snap the label and Acren reads the brand, model and age for you to confirm
- Remembers the dates that matter: insurance renewals, property tax, warranties, smoke alarm replacement
- Keeps a record of everything you've done to the home

Got a repair quote? Acren reads it and shows what it covers, what it leaves out, and the exact questions to send the contractor before you sign. If someone is pushing you to pay fast, by wire, gift card or crypto, Pause before you pay walks you through a short check first.

Acren works for you. Contractors don't pay Acren, and Acren never contacts anyone for you.

Free. Start without an account. Save your home to a free account with Sign in with Apple or an email code to keep it backed up and on every device. Download or delete your data any time.

Acren gives general information from public sources, not legal, insurance or financial advice, and it is not an emergency alert service.

name: Adhanly: Prayer Times
description:
Adhanly shows you the five prayer times for your location, the Qibla direction and the Hijri calendar. Everything is calculated on your phone.

PRAYER TIMES
• Fajr, sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha for your location
• 10 calculation methods with angles and source, such as MWL, ISNA, Umm al-Qura, Egypt, Karachi, Diyanet
• Asr standard or Hanafi
• High-latitude rules, important in northern summers
• Set your location once via GPS or pick from a list of 47 cities

QIBLA
• Compass pointing to the Kaaba, with degrees and distance
• Calculated along the great circle, with the source shown

HIJRI CALENDAR AND RAMADAN
• Umm al-Qura or tabular, adjustable by up to 2 days
• Note: moon sighting may differ
• Ramadan list with suhur and iftar

REMINDERS
• On or off for each prayer, with 0 to 30 minutes lead time
• Suhur and iftar reminders
• System sound, scheduled locally on the device

TASBIH
• Counter with a goal of 33, 99, 100 or 1000
• Daily goal, vibration, history and streak

QURAN
• All 114 surahs in Arabic (Tanzil, Uthmani)
• With Pickthall's English translation

WIDGET
• "Next prayer" on your Home Screen

RESPECTFUL
• No fatwas and no rulings. When in doubt, ask your local community
• Location, settings and tasbih history stay on your device

PURCHASE
Free: all prayer times and methods, Qibla, calendar, reminders, tasbih, Quran and the "Next prayer" widget. Pro as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription or a one-time purchase: fine-tune each time by minutes, more widget styles, statistics and no ads. The free version shows non-personalised ads only in the calendar and under "More", never on times, Qibla, tasbih or Quran. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your store account settings.

Privacy: https://ksp-apps.pages.dev/gebet/datenschutz
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Ads Digital Manager
description:
Repeat Purchase Planner helps small sellers see when customers buy again and how much those purchases contribute after product costs.

Record orders with a customer, order reference, date, revenue, and product cost. The app uses each customer's order history to identify their first purchase and group them by the month it occurred.

See repeat purchase rates at 30, 60, and 90 days. Each rate uses customers who have had the full period to buy again. Open a monthly group to see how many customers returned and how much revenue remained after product costs over that period.

In Marketing, add ad reports manually or import daily USD campaign data from a CSV file in Files. Link a campaign to a customer's first order to see your recorded ad spend per linked new customer. Compare that cost with the group's average 90-day contribution before advertising costs.

Repeat Purchase Planner works offline and stores your records on your device. It uses US English and USD. All features are free, with no account, subscription, or in-app purchases.

name: Ads Digital Manager Suit
description:
Product Drop Manager helps small sellers plan limited product releases and track what happens after launch.

Set up a drop with a launch date, allocated stock, selling price, and unit cost. Record orders as they come in and see how many units are left. The app prevents orders from exceeding the remaining allocation.

Use the Overview chart to track sell-through over time and open the orders behind each day’s results. In Drop Results, see revenue, product costs, other recorded costs, and what remains after recorded ad spend for the linked campaign.

In Marketing → Ads, enter campaign reports manually or import daily USD data from a CSV file in Files. See ad spend, attributed orders and sales, cost per order, and return on ad spend when the report contains the necessary data. Campaigns are managed outside the app.

Product Drop Manager works offline and stores your records on your device. The interface uses US English and all amounts are shown in USD. It is free to use and requires no account, subscription, or in-app purchases.

name: adsumBooking
description:
adsumBooking gives your business a booking page that offers only the times you’re free, and never books two people into the same time. With adsumCalendar connected, every booking goes into it. The people who book with you don’t need an account or an app.

Your booking page
Your services, with their lengths and prices, and the free times, on one page with its own link. Clients see the times in their own time zone, book in a few taps and get a confirmation by email with the booking for their calendar.

Staff
Add everyone who takes bookings, with or without an Adsum account. For each service, clients choose a person, take whoever is free, or book a time when everyone on it is free.

Only the times you’re free
Each person’s hours, their bookings and the busy times in their adsumCalendar are kept off the page. A time someone is booking is held for 10 minutes, so two people can’t take it at once.

On your website
Copy a code from Setup to add the booking form to your site: inside the page, as a button that opens it over the page, or as an iframe for site builders that remove scripts.

Hours
Weekly hours for each person, with more than one range in a day, and changes for single dates, such as a day off or a late Thursday.

Questions
Ask up to 5 questions before someone books.

Confirmations and reminders
Clients get a confirmation and reminders by email, 24 hours and 1 hour before by default, each with a link to move or cancel the booking. You choose the reminders for each service, and get an email for every new, moved or cancelled booking.

Your day on your iPhone or iPad
Bookings by day, for everyone or for one person. Open a booking for the client’s details, their answers and where it is.

Reports
Each month’s bookings by service, by person and by busiest time, and the month as a CSV file.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app. Bookings appear as events in adsumCalendar, and a meeting in adsumCalendar keeps that time off your page.

What it doesn’t do
It doesn’t take payments or deposits, and reminders go by email, not text message.

Privacy
No ads, tracking or analytics. Clients’ details are used for their booking and are shown only to your business. They’re deleted 2 years after the appointment, and cancelled bookings after 90 days.

adsumBooking is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumChat
description:
adsumChat is an end-to-end encrypted messaging app for the people you live and work with. Turn a message into a task in adsumNotes or an event in adsumCalendar, and see the household’s shared list and next event at the top of its chat. It works on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web.

Make a task, add an event
Press and hold a message and choose Make task or Add event. The date and time come from the message. The sheet shows exactly what goes to adsumNotes or adsumCalendar, and nothing else from the chat leaves it.

The plan at the top
A household chat shows its shared list and its next event at the top. On a tablet or computer, the plan sits beside the chat: the list, the next events and the open asks.

Asks
Type “Can someone get Kayode at 4 on Thursday?” and adsumChat offers to ask the household. Anyone can tap I’ll do it, and everyone sees who took it.

Encrypted, every chat
Every chat, group and room is encrypted on your device and opened only on the devices of the people in it. There is no setting to turn it off. It uses Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) with a key exchange built to hold against future quantum computers, so messages recorded now stay private later.

What our servers see
Messages are sent without saying who sent them. Delivered messages are deleted from our servers, and anything undelivered goes after 14 days. You sign up with an email address, not a phone number.

Safety numbers
Every pair of people has a safety number. Compare it in person or scan each other’s code, and you’re told if it ever changes.

Home and work in one list
Your personal chats, your household and every organisation you belong to are in one list, each marked so you know whose chat you’re in. Filter by any of them, or by Unread. Organisations have rooms by topic, such as #drivers.

Messages
Replies, reactions, edits and Delete for everyone. Photos and files up to 100 MB. Search your chats and messages. Disappearing messages for any chat, from 1 hour to 90 days. Read receipts you can turn off.

Invitations
Start a chat and invite people with a link. They join when they open it and sign in.

Your devices
Link a computer or tablet by scanning a QR code with your phone and checking four words on both. Each device has its own keys, and unlinking one removes it from every chat.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app. Make task and Add event use adsumNotes and adsumCalendar when they’re turned on in your account.

Privacy
No ads and no tracking. Messages, photos and files are end-to-end encrypted, so Adsum can’t read them. Screen security hides your chats in the app switcher.

adsumChat is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumContacts
description:
adsumContacts brings your contacts from iCloud and from vCard and CSV files into one address book, and merges the duplicates as it imports. Each merge says why it was made, such as the same mobile number, and can be undone for 30 days.

Duplicates, with the reason
Two cards with the same email address or phone number, and names that agree, are merged on import. Pairs that are less certain, such as “Mum” and “Linda Hughes” with one mobile, wait in Duplicates one at a time, side by side, with what differs. Choose Same person or Not the same; a pair you keep apart isn’t suggested again. Duplicates are found by fixed rules, not by AI.

Import from iCloud and files
iCloud directly, with an Adsum account and an app-specific password. vCard and CSV files exported from Outlook, another contacts app or a phone, with or without an account. Importing the same source again adds what’s new and changes nothing else.

A household book
With an Adsum household, one address book that every adult in it can edit: the school, the GP surgery, the vet.

Undo and restore
Every merge is listed in Merged contacts with Undo for 30 days, which brings back both cards exactly. Deleted contacts can be restored for 30 days too.

Every way to reach someone
Email, Call, Message and Directions at the top of each card, then every number, address, birthday and note. Each card shows where it came from.

Search
Search names, nicknames, email addresses, organisations, towns, labels and any part of a phone number. The list and search read the copy on your device, so they’re instant and work offline.

Labels and starred
Labels in your vCard files come with your contacts. Group people by label, and starred people sit at the top of the list.

Birthdays and anniversaries
With or without the year, and your own dates, such as a name day.

Export
vCard 4.0, vCard 3.0 for older apps, or CSV, at any time.

Without an account
adsumContacts works without an account: the address book stays on your device, and files import on the device. Sign in to sync it between your devices and to import from iCloud directly.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app. Turn on Use in other apps, and adsumMail shows the names and photos of people who email you and suggests contacts as you write; adsumCalendar suggests them for invitations and shows their birthdays. Directions opens adsumRoute.

Privacy
No ads and no tracking. adsumContacts reads the address books you import from and never changes them, and it doesn’t read the contacts on your iPhone.

adsumContacts keeps its own address book: it doesn’t replace the Contacts app on your iPhone or iPad yet.

adsumContacts is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumFind
description:
adsumFind puts your phones, tablets and laptops on one map, whatever they run, with the devices of the people in your household. Where each device is stays end-to-end encrypted: only your own devices can read it, not Adsum.

One map for every device you add
See where each device is, how accurate the position is and how much battery it has left. The list says it in plain words: “With you”, “1.2 km away”, “4 min ago”. iPhones and iPads use this app, and other phones have their own adsumFind app. Macs, Windows laptops and Chromebooks join at find.adsum.ai in a browser and share where they are while it’s open.

When something goes missing
Play a loud sound until someone stops it. Turn on lost mode to show your message and a button to call your number. Ask for a fresh position, get directions, or erase adsumFind and your Adsum sign-in from the device. A command reaches a device when it next checks in; on a phone, that’s the next time adsumFind is open on it.

Family, whatever phone they have
Make a household in your Adsum account and set up adsumFind in it. Everyone in the household sees its devices on one map, whatever phone each person has, and your Personal devices stay yours.

Places
Save home, school or the office. Each device works out its own arrivals and departures, and the Places tab lists who arrived and who left. In a browser at find.adsum.ai, they can also arrive as notifications.

History
A device’s page shows where it has been in the last 24 hours. History is kept for 30 days and deleted when you remove the device.

Sharing with the app closed
On iPhone, adsumFind keeps sharing where the phone is with the app closed once you allow location Always. Turn it off at any time in Settings › Share when closed.

Private by design
Locations, history, places and alerts are encrypted on each device with keys only your devices hold. Adsum stores them and can’t read them. Commands such as lost mode are signed by your own devices, so a device obeys nothing else. You approve each device you add by matching a six-digit code on both screens, and every device shows the same safety number.

What it doesn’t do
A phone that’s switched off shows where it last reported. Erase removes adsumFind and your Adsum sign-in, not everything on the device. Each device is added by someone holding it. It doesn’t work with AirTags or Google’s tags, and it can’t see devices that only use Apple’s or Google’s own Find apps.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app. Your Personal space, your household and your organisation each have their own map, and you switch between them in one tap.

Privacy
No tracking or analytics, and your data isn’t sold. Error reports have emails and long numbers removed, and are deleted after 7 days. Deleting your Adsum account deletes the devices you added.

adsumFind is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumForms
description:
adsumForms makes forms and surveys on your iPhone, iPad or computer, with no limit on responses. Each response can arrive as a row in your adsumDocs spreadsheet, and an answer can add a task to your adsumNotes list, with no automation service to set up.

Rules that add tasks
Write a rule as a sentence: “When they choose Yes, add a task to Clinic: Call {Full name} today, due the same day.” The task’s title takes the person’s answers, and the task links back to the response. Up to 3 rules on each form.

Test before you share
Send a test response, filled in for you, and see the row and the task arrive. Delete the test, and its row and task go with it.

Responses in a spreadsheet
One tap makes a spreadsheet in adsumDocs with a column for each question, or choose one you already have. Earlier responses go in first, then each new response is added as a row.

Questions
11 types: short answer, paragraph, multiple choice, checkboxes, dropdown, number, email, phone, date, time and linear scale. Group them in sections, send people to a section based on their answer, and mark the ones that need an answer. Without signal, your changes are kept on the device.

Colours, logo and layout
All questions on one page, or one question at a time. Your colour and logo, in light, dark or automatic. The “Made with adsumForms” line at the foot can be turned off.

Sharing
A link, a QR code to print, a website embed and prefilled links. Close a form at a date and time, or after a number of responses.

Summary and export
A summary of every question, with counts, bars, the mean and the median, and each response on its own with where it went. Download them as .csv or .xlsx. Get an email for each new response, or one a day; the email names the form and never includes the answers.

What people make
Patient intake, new starter details, volunteer sign-up, event registration, feedback forms, order requests and polls. Start from one of 8 templates or a blank form.

For the people who fill it in
No account and no app: they open the link in any browser. Automated spam is stopped by a bot check that asks people to confirm only when something looks wrong. Every public form has a Report this form link.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app. Responses go to adsumDocs as rows, rules add tasks in adsumNotes, and the response emails come through adsumMail.

Privacy
No ads and no tracking. No AI reads the answers: a rule acts only on the exact answer you choose. Response emails carry no answers.
Privacy policy: https://forms.adsum.ai/privacy
Terms of use: https://forms.adsum.ai/terms

adsumForms is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumMail: email app
description:
adsumMail is email that puts what needs you first. Bills due, parcels arriving and invitations to answer sit at the top of your Inbox. Tracking pixels are removed before you open a message, and there are no ads.

Your address
Sign in with your Adsum account and choose an email address of your own, with a signature for each address.

Needs you
Invitations still to answer, bills due or collected soon and parcels arriving, at the top of the Inbox. Answer an invitation or set a reminder and it leaves the list.

Invitations, bills and parcels
Invitations show the time and place with Yes, Maybe and No, and your answer goes back to the organiser. Bills show the amount and the day it’s due or collected. Parcels show when they’re arriving. Flights, trains, hotels and restaurant bookings show their details at the top. Remind me sets a reminder for the day before a bill is due.

Works with the other Adsum apps
One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app. Answer an invitation and it’s in adsumCalendar. Make a task from a message in adsumNotes, with a link back to it. Attach files from adsumDocs and save attachments to it. Each link is off until you turn it on.

Inbox
Newsletters, notifications and receipts are grouped into one row each inside the Inbox, so mail from people stands out.

Privacy and safety
Tracking pixels are removed, and pictures never load straight from the sender, so senders can’t see your IP address or when you open their message. Unsubscribe from a mailing list at the top of its message. Mail that pretends to come from a company it isn’t from goes to Junk as a likely scam, with the reason shown.

Writing
Send a message later, undo a send for a few seconds, or snooze a message until you need it. The assistant in Compose suggests changes to a draft or to the part you select, for you to accept or reject. It never sends, and you can turn it off in Settings.

Organising
Labels and folders, filters that label, move, archive, star or forward, search, a vacation reply and blocked senders.

Your copy
Download all your mail as mbox and .eml files at any time.

Storage and encryption
Mail is stored on Adsum’s servers, encrypted with a key for each mailbox. It isn’t end-to-end encrypted. Your mail isn’t sold or used for advertising.

adsumMail is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: adsumSign
description:
adsumSign sends PDFs for electronic signature and shows who has signed. Signers sign in their browser on any phone or computer, with a 6-digit code from their email: no account, no app to install.

Send for signature
Upload a PDF of up to 25 MB and 100 pages, or choose a file in adsumDocs. Add up to 10 people, each one to sign or to get a copy.

Fields placed from the document
Signature, initials, date signed, name, text and tick box. Tap to place them, or type [[sign:Client]] in the document and the field is placed there when you upload it.

Signers and order
Everyone at once, or one after another. Each signer enters the code from their email, agrees to sign electronically, then types or draws a signature. The signing pages are in British or American English, German, French, Spanish or Polish.

Reminders and expiry
Reminders go out after 3 and 7 days, then weekly. A request ends after 30 days unless you change it. Remind or cancel at any time, and see when each person opened and signed.

Sealed, with an audit trail
When the last person signs, the signatures are written into the PDF and the audit trail is added as its last pages. The file is sealed and timestamped, so any later change shows. Everyone gets an email with a link to the signed copy.

Verify a document
Anyone can check a signed PDF at sign.adsum.ai/verify. The file stays on their device: only its fingerprint is checked.

What people send
NDAs, quotes, contracts, leases, offer letters, consent forms and policies.

Works with the other Adsum apps
Send a file from adsumDocs, and the signed copy is filed next to it. A quote from adsumFinance that the customer signs is marked Accepted. One Adsum account signs you in to every Adsum app.

Privacy
No ads, tracking or analytics, and no AI reads your documents. We don’t track whether emails are opened. Documents are stored encrypted.

Electronic signatures
adsumSign makes simple electronic signatures, each with a sealed audit trail.

adsumSign is free, with every feature, and has no ads or subscription. Adsum earns its money from paid products such as adsumDraw.

name: Advent for Two
description:
Advent for Two is an advent calendar you make for one person.

Write 24 short notes: memories, plans, inside jokes, reasons you love them. Send the calendar with a link. From December 1, they open one door a day and find what you left behind it.

FOR THE ONE MAKING IT
• Write a note for every day from December 1 to 24
• Send it with one link through Messages, WhatsApp or anywhere else. It opens straight in the app
• See which doors have been opened, and when

FOR THE ONE OPENING IT
• A new door unlocks every midnight, in your own time zone
• Doors swing open with a little celebration
• Widgets show today's door on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, then the note once it's open
• Everything you've opened stays yours to reread

PREMIUM (OPTIONAL, ONE-TIME PURCHASE PER CALENDAR)
• Voice notes: let them hear you say it, behind any door
• Door themes: Gold, Frost, Evergreen or Candy
• Edit after sending: change a note any time before its door is opened

Making and opening calendars is free. There are no ads and no subscription. Sign in with Apple or your email.

Each calendar is private to two people: the one who wrote it and the first person to open its link.

Terms: https://adventfortwo.com/terms
Privacy: https://adventfortwo.com/privacy

name: AendorLix
description: AendorLix helps you notice what costs you energy and what refuels you. Each day starts at **100% charge** (or a morning level you set). Log drains and recharges; watch the amber ring move. All on your iPhone.

name: Afinna: Tuner & Metronome
description:
Afinna tunes your instrument through your phone's microphone and keeps time with a metronome. It opens straight into the tuner: no sign-up, no account and no sales screen before you pluck the first string.

TUNER
• By string: the app works out which string you played and shows whether it is low, high or in tune.
• Plain language: "tighten the peg slowly", "almost there: loosen just a little".
• Chromatic: any note, for any instrument, winds and voice.
• 8 instruments: acoustic guitar, electric guitar, bass, ukulele, cavaquinho, viola caipira, violin and mandolin.
• Alternate tunings: half step down, Drop D, Open G, DADGAD and more.
• By ear: tap a string on the screen and the app plays the note for you to compare. Works without a microphone.
• Adjustable reference A (default 440 Hz) and note names as Do Re Mi or C D E.

METRONOME
• 30 to 300 bpm, with a ruler to drag, −1 and +1 buttons and tempo shortcuts.
• Tap tempo: tap along and the app finds the tempo.
• 2/4, 3/4, 4/4 and 6/8; quarter notes, eighth notes, triplets and sixteenth notes; accent on beat 1.
• Three click sounds.

PRIVACY
Microphone sound is analyzed on your phone. It is not recorded and never leaves the device.

LIGHT AND DARK THEME, in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Afinna is free and shows ads. Alternate tunings, triplets, sixteenth notes and the other click sounds unlock for 24 hours when you choose to watch a short video. If you prefer, you can remove the ads with a one-time payment through the store, no subscription.

name: agentring: AI Agent Calls
description:
agentring lets your AI agent reach you by phone.

When your agent needs a decision, hits a wall or finishes a long job, your iPhone rings like a real call, even when it's locked. A voice AI tells you what's going on, you talk it through, and your agent gets the transcript and carries on. No phone number needed: calls go over the internet straight to the app.

WHAT IT DOES
• Your agent calls you: it rings like any phone call, on the lock screen too, and shows who is calling and why.
• You call your agent: tap "Call agent" and talk to it by voice.
• Messages: your agent texts you, and you reply right from the notification.
• Missed calls: if you can't pick up, you get a missed-call notification.
• Join a call in progress: if you answered on another of your phones, join the call from the app.

WORKS WITH YOUR AGENT
Anything that speaks MCP can reach you: Claude Code, Codex, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes and other MCP clients. Scripts, cron jobs and n8n can use the REST API or the command-line tool.

SET IT UP IN A FEW MINUTES
1. On your computer, sign in at agentring.io.
2. Scan the pairing QR code on your dashboard with this app.
3. Add the MCP server to your agent with the command shown on the dashboard.
Then ask your agent something like: "Run the migration and call me if anything fails."

OPEN SOURCE
agentring is open source under the Apache-2.0 license. You can also pair the app with a relay you run on your own server; in that case calls and messages arrive while the app is open.

PRIVACY
Call audio is not recorded. The app has no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

agentring is not a phone service: it can't call phone numbers and can't be used for emergency calls.

name: Agoo – suivi de colis
description:
Agoo est le carnet de colis des entreprises d'envoi par bateau et par avion (groupage, transitaires). Cette application est réservée au personnel des entreprises qui utilisent Agoo : chauffeurs, agents de dépôt, responsables. Les comptes sont créés par le responsable de l'entreprise : il n'y a ni inscription ni achat dans l'application.

Au premier lancement, tapez le code de votre entreprise (donné par votre responsable) ou lisez une étiquette de colis : Agoo ouvre ensuite directement l'espace de votre entreprise.

• Enlèvement chez le client : expéditeur, destinataire, nombre de cartons, prix convenu.
• Étiquettes 100 × 70 mm avec code QR, à imprimer ou à partager en image vers une imprimante portable.
• Lecture des étiquettes à l'appareil photo, en rafale : chaque carton lu s'ajoute à la liste, puis une seule validation fait avancer tous les colis (dépôt, conteneur, départ, arrivée…).
• Arrivée : dépotage, colis prêts, remise au comptoir avec le code de retrait et la pièce d'identité, ou livraison à domicile.
• Pour le responsable : la caisse du jour, les prix, l'équipe et les droits de chacun.
• Vos clients suivent leur colis eux-mêmes sur la page « Où est mon colis ? », sans compte.
• Pensé pour le terrain : l'accueil s'ouvre même sans réseau.

Agoo est édité par Mavoix Digital SASU (France). Chaque entreprise a son propre espace et ses propres données.

name: AI Guitar Theory PRO
description:
AI Guitar Theory PRO is a textbook app for understanding music theory on the guitar. It grew out of notes the author, who has played music for decades, wrote over the years for himself.

Rather than memorizing hard terms, the goal is to first understand why things sound the way they do. Chord roles are explained with a simple picture: Home (the stable base), Start (things begin to move) and Climax (the peak, whether joyful or sad).

■ A textbook you touch and hear (6 chapters)
• Chapter 1: The 12 notes, keys and scale degrees, the 7 chords, the circle of fifths as a clock
• Chapter 2: The fretboard is a map (strings in fourths, where the same note lives, degree shapes)
• Chapter 3: CAGED (five shapes to play chords anywhere)
• Chapter 4: Chord types (triads, seventh chords, sus, tensions)
• Chapter 5: The climax of another home (secondary dominants, ii–V, tritone substitution)
• Chapter 6: Pentatonics and improvisation (start playing from just two notes)
Tap a diagram to hear it, and the notes that sound light up on the fretboard. Each page has a short exercise, and you can try as many times as you like.

■ AI Teacher
Ask about the page you are reading, right where you are. Answers are short and gentle, using the same picture. Questions and answers are saved in Question Notes so you can look back later.

■ Progression Lab
Line up chords and play them, and Home, Start and Climax show up in color. Break down the progressions of songs you like, improvise with two notes, or make Melody Seeds.

■ Practice games
• Ear Quiz (easy, normal, hard)
• Fretboard Quiz (with time records)
• Play to Answer (listens to your guitar through the microphone)

■ Tools
Tuner, Metronome (with drum rhythms), circle of fifths, Progression Patterns, How Chords Work, Voicings, Chord Dictionary, Intervals and Capo Chart. Choose from 6 sounds, including guitar and piano.

■ 19 languages
Available in 19 languages, including Japanese, English, Chinese, Korean and Spanish.

■ About payment
No ads. Chapter 1, the basic tools (tuner, metronome, Circle of Fifths and more), the Progression Lab and the Ear Quiz on easy are free. Chapters 2–6, tools like Progression Patterns and Voicings, the practice games, and the improvisation and songwriting helpers unlock with a single one-time purchase. You can try each of those tools once for free. No subscription. You can try the AI Teacher a little for free. To keep using it, buy question packs and pay only for what you use (they never expire). If the service ends, the AI features may stop working.

■ Privacy
Microphone sound is only used to measure pitch. Nothing is recorded or sent. Only when you use the AI are your question and the text of the page you are reading sent to the AI. When you have the AI read a chord sheet photo, that photo is sent too (it is not kept). When you ask the AI Teacher by voice, your speech is turned into text on your iPhone only; no sound is sent.

AI answers can be wrong. For anything important, please check against the textbook text.

name: AirStrings
description:
Draw a string in the air. Pluck it with a fingertip. Slide into the next note.

AirStrings turns your iPhone or iPad’s front camera into a space for making music. Pinch your thumb and index finger, move your hand to draw a string, then release. Sweep a fingertip across the string to play it, or approach slowly to catch it, stretch it, and pluck it.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Draw up to six strings labeled Do, Re, Mi, Fa, Sol, and La.
• Play flat, natural, or sharp by striking different parts of a string.
• Hold a string and slide along it to glide smoothly between pitches.
• Play several notes together, including different pitches on the same string.
• Switch between recorded classical guitar, grand piano, concert harp, and FM synth sounds.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Your strings and selected instrument are saved automatically, so you can pick up where you left off. Turn on fingertip markers in Settings to see where the camera detects your fingers. Choose English, Turkish, or your device’s language setting.

AirStrings works offline. The front camera processes hand movements on your device. The app requires camera access for gesture play and works best in good light with your hands clearly visible.

name: AIUse Ledger
description:
AIUse Ledger is a record-keeping app for small law firms and legal teams that use, or are deciding whether to use, AI tools. It gives the firm one place to record which tools it has approved, how it reviewed them, which policies staff have acknowledged, and what clients have agreed to.

AIUse Ledger is invitation-only. Your firm's workspace owner or administrator invites you; there is no public sign-up.

TOOL REGISTER
- Record each AI tool with its vendor, version and status: approved, restricted, prohibited or under review.
- Note allowed uses and the data classes that must never go into the tool.
- See review owners and next review dates, with reminders when a review is due or overdue.
- Keep the full decision history. Status decisions are the firm's own and are recorded, never inferred.

VENDOR REVIEWS
- Work through a versioned review checklist, add risk notes and evidence links.
- Completed reviews are kept as history. A new review never rewrites an earlier approval.

POLICIES AND ACKNOWLEDGMENTS
- Keep draft, published and retired versions of firm policies with effective dates.
- Staff acknowledge the exact published version. When a new version is published, acknowledgments start fresh instead of carrying forward silently.
- See at a glance who still needs to acknowledge.

MATTER AND CONSENT RECORDS
- Identify matters by a short pseudonymous reference instead of client names.
- Record the scope of a client's consent to a tool or use, the date, who recorded it, an evidence reference and any expiry.
- Scope changes and revocations are kept as a timeline. Revoked or expired consents are never shown as current.

USAGE LOG
- Log which tool was used, for which matter reference and for what purpose category.
- No prompts, outputs or documents are stored. Short fields and on-screen guidance help keep client information out.

ACTIVITY HISTORY AND EXPORTS
- Every important change is recorded with who, what and when.
- Owners can export CSV files or open a printable audit pack.

ROLES
- Owner, admin, reviewer and member roles. Members see approved-tool guidance and their own records. Reviewers and admins handle reviews and decisions.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
- No AI runs inside the app, and your firm's records are never used to train AI models.
- No ads, no tracking and no third-party analytics.
- Delete your account at any time in Settings.

IMPORTANT
AIUse Ledger stores what your firm records. It is not legal advice, does not decide whether a tool or use is permitted, does not certify compliance with any law or professional rule, and does not guarantee that privilege or confidentiality is preserved. Recording a client consent is a record entry, not a signature.

Questions: support@code54.dev

name: Algr
seller_name: FANATIK DIGITAL GORUNTU SISTEMLERI PAZARLAMA SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Thanks for being with us! We are constantly iterating and improving—please feel free to leave your suggestions at any time.



Algr is a gemstone reference guide and personal record book, laid out like a museum gallery. Your specimens stand under a spotlight in a dark vitrine, each one drawn as a faceted crystal in the shape of its crystal system. Open one and its museum label card tells you everything you have recorded about it.

Keep your own gemstone records, compare two specimens property by property, pin favourite reference cards and look up terms in an illustrated glossary — all in one quiet, silver-on-navy gallery.

Algr is an educational reference and a place to keep your own notes. It does not identify, grade, value, appraise or authenticate real gemstones, from photos or otherwise.

THE GALLERY
• A spotlight carousel of your specimens: swipe to bring the next crystal under the lamp.
• Every crystal is drawn for its system — cubic, tetragonal, hexagonal, trigonal, orthorhombic, monoclinic, triclinic or amorphous — tinted in its colour, with a slow shimmer and glint.
• A wall label shows the catalogue number, Mohs hardness, crystal system and lustre.
• Switch between All, My records and Samples.

MUSEUM LABEL CARDS
• Catalogue number, name and classification, with a Mohs scale bar.
• Colour families and a colour description, crystal system, lustre and transparency.
• Specific gravity, refractive index, locality, classification notes and curator's notes.
• Add photographs from your library or the camera.
• Pin the specimen as a reference card, add it to Compare, edit or delete it.
• Share the label as a PNG label plate or as plain text.

THE ACCESSION FORM
• A live crystal preview that changes as you choose the system and tint.
• Colour family chips, 16 illustration tints and system tiles that each show their own crystal.
• A two-thumb Mohs range slider from 1 to 10 in half steps, plus lustre, transparency, SG and RI.
• Clear messages if something needs fixing, and a Save button that stays reachable with the keyboard up.

THE ARCHIVE
• Search across names, families, colours, localities and notes.
• Filter by hardness range, colour, crystal system, lustre, transparency, source and favourites.
• Active filters appear as removable chips; sort by recent, name or hardness.

COMPARE
• Put two specimens on pedestals side by side and swap them in one tap.
• A one-line summary of the main differences, two Mohs bars and a row for every property, with differences marked in gold.

REFERENCE CARDS
• Pin specimens and glossary terms as cards, or write your own note cards.
• Add a personal note to any card and filter the drawer by kind.

THE INDEX
• An illustrated glossary of 39 entries written for Algr, from adamantine to vitreous lustre.
• Laid out like a printed museum index, with letter heads, dotted leaders and departments: Optics, Structure, Physical and Cutting.
• "See also" links, and crystal-system entries show their illustration and examples from your gallery.

WORKS OFFLINE, BACKED UP PRIVATELY
• No account and no sign-in — Algr opens straight into the gallery.
• Everything is saved on your iPhone first and works without a connection.
• Your records are backed up automatically to a private cloud space that belongs only to this install of the app; changes made offline are sent when you are back online. A small gallery lamp in every room shows the backup status.
• Curator's office → "Delete all my data" removes everything from your iPhone and from the cloud backup.
• Want to look around first? Curator's office → "Load sample data" adds eight fictional specimens and three reference cards, which "Remove sample data" takes away again.
• Export your whole catalogue as plain text.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no analytics and no tracking.
• The camera is used only when you choose to photograph a gemstone for your own record.
