With a member account: show your member card with its QR code, see your household and your children, send a prayer request, a care request or a testimony to the church, read the church's replies, see your details, turn church notices on or off, or ask the church office to delete your account.

FOR VOLUNTEERS
Volunteers whom the church office has approved can take the register on their phone, even with no signal. The marks are sent when the phone is back online.

NOTICES
If you tap Turn on notices, the church can send news to your phone. You can turn them off in your phone's settings.

PRIVACY
The app has no advertising, analytics or tracking tools. Read the full privacy notice at https://app.allnationsusa.com/privacy.

Questions? Call (770) 923-8383 or email admin@allnationsusa.com. Office hours are Tuesday to Friday, 9am to 3pm.

name: AllySpin Sculpture Park
description:
Discover new forms. Look closer. Keep what inspires you.
 AllySpin Sculpture Park brings sculpture exploration and personal creativity together. Browse an illustrated collection, explore a garden map, discover educational resources, and build your own art journal.
 Discover sculptures by eight artists, with images and descriptions of each work. Explore four styles: Biomorphism, Geometric Abstraction, Kinetic Art, and Light Installations.
 Explore an illustrated garden map with numbered sculpture locations. Tap a pin to preview a work and open its full description.
 Browse eight creative workshops and eight room types. Explore session details, room photographs, amenities, and prices. Use local planning flows to select visit times, workshop places, and accommodation dates, with calculated totals and saved records.
 Create a personal collection in Exhibition Photos and My Creations. Choose your own photographs and add titles, dates, artists, styles, and notes. Revisit, edit, or delete entries whenever you like.
 Organize your essentials with a checklist. Mark items as packed, add your own, and keep your progress between sessions.
 Explore English-language articles and videos about sculpture through links to MoMA, Tate on YouTube, and Khan Academy. Resources open in your browser or video app.
 No account is required. Personal entries, checklist progress, and planning records are saved locally. The bundled collection and personal organization features work offline; external articles and videos require internet access.

name: AltFuel Finder
description:
Whatever you drive, AltFuel Finder shows you where to fill up or plug in.

Choose a fuel and every public station around you appears on the map. Planning a trip? Search any city, address or ZIP code in the US or Canada and see what's available when you get there.

EIGHT FUELS, ONE MAP • EV charging • E85 (flex fuel) • Biodiesel • Renewable diesel • Propane (autogas) • Compressed natural gas (CNG) • Hydrogen • Liquefied natural gas (LNG)

FIND STATIONS FAST • Stations near your current location load as soon as you open the app • Search by city, street address or ZIP code • Pick a search radius of 5, 10, 15, 30, 45 or 60 miles, and the map zooms to fit • The app remembers the fuel you chose last time

THE DETAILS THAT MATTER • Tap any station for its name, address and hours • EV stations show DC fast and Level 2 port counts and connector types (CCS, CHAdeMO, NACS, J1772) • Biodiesel stations show the blends they sell • One tap for turn-by-turn driving directions in Apple Maps

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE • No account, no ads, no tracking • Location access is optional; you can always search instead • Only public stations are shown, so you won't drive to a private fleet pump

Station data comes from the U.S. Department of Energy's Alternative Fuels Data Center (AFDC), maintained by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL). AltFuel Finder is an independent app and is not affiliated with NREL or the Department of Energy. Always confirm availability at the station.

name: AltoPasso-Tecnica Alpina
description: AltoPasso è la tua app dedicata agli sport outdoor, alla tecnica alpina e alla preparazione in montagna. Esplora corsi tecnici guidati per arrampicata, trail running, alpinismo, mountain bike enduro, surf e sopravvivenza. Allenati con routine a intervalli con segnali acustici e gestisci la lista della tua attrezzatura prima di ogni uscita. Usa strumenti pratici anche senza connessione come bussola GPS, clinometro per pendenze, faro SOS, metronomo di cadenza e calcolatore Naismith per stimare tempi di marcia e idratazione. Prenota facilmente uscite con guide certificate e tieni traccia di ogni traguardo nel tuo diario personale con AltoPasso.

name: Always Gıda&Temizlik

description:

name: AlwaysOurs: Couples Space
description:
Say the thing.

You know the one. You typed it, deleted it, typed it again. Always Ours is a private space for you and your person, built so the hard-to-say stuff finally gets said.

JUST YOU TWO
No followers. No groups. No feed. Exactly two people, behind Face ID. Invite your person with a private link or code. No email or phone number needed. On your own for now? Try it with a sample partner first.

US
One chat that's only yours: messages, photos, reactions, replies, stickers and flirt cards. Start side chats for a trip or a plan. Either of you can delete a message for both.

WISHES
Answer yes, maybe or no in private. Only the things you both say yes to ever show up. A maybe or a no never leaves your phone.

PLANS, GOALS AND DEALS
Plan a trip with a shared budget. Set goals and tick off the steps. Write your own house rules and friendly bets.

VAULT
Photos locked with a key that stays on your iPhone, kept out of your camera roll.

JOURNAL
A journal that is yours alone, on your phone only. Add your own photos, and pick a cat or dog to keep you company while you write.

YOUR AI HELPER
Ask the questions you'd never search for. Get help finding your own words. Pick its name or make one up; it is always an AI. Free answers are written right on your iPhone where Apple Intelligence is available. What you tell it is never shown to your partner. It is not therapy, and it says so when a professional is the better call.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your chats and photos live on your two iPhones and in iCloud, not on our servers. We can't read them. No ads. No tracking. Photos never go to AI. Questions to the AI helper go to our AI provider to get a reply and are not stored by us.

FOR ADULTS
18 and over. United States.

Privacy policy: https://always-ours.onrender.com/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://always-ours.onrender.com/terms.html

name: Amable Meta
description:
Amable Meta helps you reach a goal that truly matters to you, without stress and without guilt.

Each quarter you choose one single goal: meditate, exercise, write, organise your schedule, take care of a relationship…

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT: YOUR PERSONALISED WEEKLY GUIDE
It is not a generic habit list. From your answers (your goal, the time you have and what usually holds you back) we prepare a practice guide every week written just for you: what to do, when to do it and how to adapt it if the week gets complicated. Each guide takes one small step beyond the last, so you reach your goal little by little, without strain.

Every day you "water" your goal with a one-minute check-in. Your plant grows with every check-in. And if a day doesn't go well, that's fine: the app doesn't scold you, it helps you come back.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Define your goal for the quarter with a 5-minute guided form.
• Get a personalised practice guide every week.
• Log your practice, how you feel and your surroundings in one minute.
• Watch your plant grow and climb the mountain of your journey.
• Create simple goals with their own calendar and phone alarms.
• Talk to Prácti, your journey companion, about your goal.
• Record a voice note to your "future self".

BASED ON BEHAVIOURAL SCIENCE
Amable Meta draws on Integral Life Practice (Ken Wilber), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, positive psychology and the habit research of James Clear and BJ Fogg: start small, anchor it to what you already do, and be kind to yourself.

HUMAN SUPPORT
There is a real facilitator behind the app. And if you want company, you can join a support group with video sessions every 15 days: people with goals like yours who help each other keep going.

YOUR PRIVACY
Artificial intelligence is only used to prepare your guide and answer you if you allow it. You can delete your account from within the app.

Amable Meta supports habits and goals; it is not a substitute for a health professional.

No distractions. Just your goal.

name: Amazuka Eats
description:
Order your favorite dishes from restaurants near you and get them delivered fast by Amazuka couriers.

• Dozens of restaurants and local dishes
• Order in seconds, no account needed
• Pay on delivery or with Amazuka Pay
• Track your order live
• Delivery fees based on distance, from 1,000 F

Restaurant owners: manage your menu, opening hours and orders right from the app.

name: Ambiente Stereo 88.4 FM
description:
Ambiente Stereo 88.4 FM, ahora en tu iPhone y tu iPad. Escucha la emisora en vivo, entérate de las noticias y disfruta nuestros podcasts, todo en una sola app y sin registrarte.

RADIO EN VIVO
• Un toque y suena la emisora, con el nombre de la canción o del programa que está al aire.
• Sigue sonando con la pantalla bloqueada o mientras usas otras apps, con controles en la pantalla de bloqueo, el Centro de control y tus audífonos.
• Si se cae la señal del internet o cambias de wifi a datos, la radio se reconecta sola.
• Si un servidor falla, la app pasa a otro automáticamente.

DESPERTADOR CON LA RADIO
• Elige la hora y los días, y despiértate con Ambiente Stereo.
• Suena como una alarma, aunque el teléfono esté en silencio (iOS 26 o posterior).

APAGADO PROGRAMADO
• Duérmete escuchando la radio: elige 15, 30, 45, 60 o 90 minutos, o el tiempo que quieras, y la app baja el volumen poco a poco antes de apagarse.

NOTICIAS Y RADIO HITS
• Las noticias de ambientestereo.fm, por categorías.
• El ranking de Radio Hits con las canciones más sonadas.

PODCASTS
• Prédicas, devocionales y programas de la Iglesia Cristiana PAI, con su último episodio a un toque.

TU PRIVACIDAD
La app no pide cuentas ni recopila datos personales. No tiene publicidad ni rastreo.

¿Tienes un problema con la app? En Acerca de → Reportar un problema puedes enviarnos un reporte.

name: Amciant
description: Track what is in your pantry, fridge, and freezer. See what to use soon—all on your iPhone, no sign-in.

name: AME — Astral Metaphysic Engine
description:
AME（Astral Metaphysic Engine）是天與阁 Astral Pavilion 出品的排盘工具，也是天與阁奇门遁甲课程学员的配套工具，iPhone 与 Android 均可使用。

• 奇门遁甲排盘：时家转盘、拆补定局、天禽寄坤。九宫显示八神、九星、八门、天盘与地盘干、寄干、空亡与驿马。
• 四柱与节气：23:00 换日，节气精确到分钟。
• 格局与象意：遁、门迫、击刑、入墓、空亡、驿马；秘笈大全八十一天干组合；常用符号象意作学习参考。
• 万年历与农历：公历、农历、节气、干支一目了然。
• 排盘笔记：保存排盘与批注，只存在您的设备上。
• 全部离线计算：无需注册，无广告，不收集任何个人资料。

格局与象意解读仅供学习参考，不代表确定结果。

AME is a Chinese metaphysics charting app by 天與阁 Astral Pavilion and the companion app for its Qi Men Dun Jia course students, on iPhone and Android. It provides Qi Men Dun Jia charts (rotating plate, Chai Bu method), Four Pillars, the Chinese calendar with solar terms and lunar dates, palace-by-palace pattern notes for study, and a notebook for your own charts. Everything is calculated offline on your phone: no sign-up, no ads and no data collection. Readings are for study and reference only, not certain predictions.

name: AmMudan
description:
爱牡丹 —— 中国牡丹，一品一格

爱牡丹，74 个中国牡丹品种，一株一株讲清楚。

【怎么用】

• 今日：每日一枝牡丹，外加六个花色门牌入口
• 品种谱：74 个品种，按花色、花型、花期、产地检索与排序
• 识花：对着花选特征，一步一步缩小到具体品种
• 栽培：栽前准备、周年管理、越冬、物候与产地要点
• 我的收藏：底栏点开，收藏你标记过的品种，随时可以清空

【里面有什么】

74 个中国牡丹品种，收洛阳、曹州菏泽、武汉、上海等地的传统名种与地方品种。
花色归红、粉、白、黄、紫、复色六系，花型分单瓣、荷花、菊花、蔷薇、托桂、金环、
皇冠、绣球、楼子台阁九型，花期按洛阳产区的早、中、晚三期划分。

每一个品种都写明花色、花型、花期、花径、株高、瓣数、香味、别名与产地，
并附一段识别要点 —— 怎么把它从别的花里认出来 —— 以及生长环境与栽培方法。
御衣黄、洛阳红、大魏紫、夜光白、二乔、冠世墨玉、大胡红、冠群芳，各有各的来历与脾气。

【识花】

站在牡丹跟前，不知道它叫什么的时候用这一页。

按你看得准的特征往下选：花色 → 花型 → 花期 → 细节特征。
细节那一栏是几个只有部分品种才有的记号：瓣基一块深紫斑、叶背一层白绒毛、
叶大而圆厚、叶缘缺刻多而上卷。选得越准，候选越少。

认出来之后，下面就是这一株的完整档案，再点进去看照片与释文。

【栽培】

五节，把一年里的事按顺序讲完：栽前准备、栽植与周年管理、气候与越冬、
物候历（长江流域参照）、中国主要产地。

「十月是牡丹的生日月」这句话落到具体做法上：栽植深度怎么定，施肥的三次时机
分别在几月，北地越冬要培土多厚，南地怎么防湿冷烂根，都有交代，不用自己再去拼凑。

【素材说明】

App 内的文字资料整理自公开发行的牡丹栽培学文献与通行栽培学共识；
74 张品种照片全部是真实照片，来自 Wikimedia Commons，均为 CC BY-SA 2.0 授权，
每张的摄影者、许可协议与原始页面逐条列在「设置 → 出处与说明 → 图片来源与授权」。
App 内不打包任何受版权保护的第三方字体、音频或视频素材。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号，也不请求任何系统权限。
你的收藏标记只存在这台设备的系统偏好设置里，卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。
App 不接广告 SDK、不接第三方追踪，也没有 IDFA。

唯一的联网行为：启动时向我们的服务器发一条安装来源统计，用来判断这次安装归属哪个推广渠道。
请求里只有一个随机设备标识（存在本机钥匙串里）和一组设备参数，不含姓名、邮箱、电话、位置、
照片，也不含剪贴板内容。除此之外 App 完全离线，没有账号、没有云同步，也不推送。

【适合谁】

想认牡丹、想养牡丹，或者在洛阳、菏泽的花期里想弄清楚眼前这一株叫什么的人。

版本 1.0

Watch Amsterdam's trams, metros, buses and ferries move live on the map, and see them in 3D as they run along their tracks through the city.

LIVE MAP

3D CITY VIEW

TRANSIT MAP PLUS

name: Anaora

name: Andrés Barber Shop
description:
Andrés Barber Shop: tu corte, a un toque.

Agenda tu cita en menos de un minuto, sin crear cuenta y sin contraseñas. Elige el servicio, el día y la hora que te queda bien y listo: tu turno queda reservado.

AGENDA FÁCIL
• Reserva en 5 pasos sencillos: servicio, día, hora, tus datos y confirmar.
• Atendemos todos los días de 2:00 p. m. a 9:00 p. m. Cada turno dura 1 hora.
• Ves en tiempo real qué horas están ocupadas y cuáles libres.
• Recibe un recordatorio 1 hora antes de tu cita.
• Consulta o cancela tus citas desde cualquier teléfono con tu número de WhatsApp.

TARJETA DE SELLOS SIN REGISTRO
• Tu número de WhatsApp es tu tarjeta: no hay que descargar ni crear nada más.
• Cada corte suma un sello y, a los 5 cortes, el siguiente va por la casa.

PROMOS Y NOVEDADES

NUESTRO TRABAJO

SERVICIOS

Estilo, precisión y tradición en cada corte. ¡Te esperamos!

name: AnemoLex
description: AnemoLex is an ocean-themed English spelling game. Look at pictures or read names to spell marine animals like dolphin and octopus. Play four modes: timed spelling, bubble letters, animal hunt, and fill-in-the-blank. Earn points, unlock achievements, and save your best results on a local leaderboard. Practice vocabulary while exploring ocean life in short sessions.

name: AnimalMergeBattle
description:
Drag matching animals together and they merge into a higher level, up to 5. New animals still arrive at level 1. An upgrade raises only the fighter you tap.

Five species, five jobs: the mouse holds, the rabbit is swift, the fox shoots, the bear soaks up hits, and the tiger hits hardest. Spend nuts to strengthen one animal on your current lineup. It returns to the fight at full health.

Three ways to play:

Campaign. Clear one level at a time. Merge the board, then send them into battle.
Guard. Endless waves. Win, and the next wave starts. Enemies keep getting stronger. Survivors stay, and new animals keep arriving. The run ends only when your army falls.
Gates. Slide your squad and choose each gate yourself. Every multiplier has its own color inside the arch, marked ×2 or ×3. The multiplier adds numbers, then matching animals merge on their own, still capped at level 5. At the finish line you see each animal’s level, and the battle starts.
Campaign and Guard each have their own achievements. In Settings you can toggle sound and vibration, or erase the save and start over.

name: Ankel
description:
Ankel is a quiet notebook for people with more than one project on the needles. It counts the rows, remembers when you last worked, and keeps the numbers that are easy to lose between sessions. No account, no connection, no ads, no subscriptions.

**COUNT THE ROW YOU ARE ON**
The project page has three keys: +1, +5 and +10, sized for a thumb rather than a form. Every tap is saved with a timestamp, so the counter survives a phone call, a train journey or a closed app. Tapped one too many? Undo takes the last entry back off.

**MORE THAN ONE PROJECT**
Keep a cardigan, a cowl and a blanket in the same place. Each project holds the yarn, the needle or hook size, the stitch, a row target and its own notes. Projects are queued, in progress, paused or finished, and the list puts whatever you worked on most recently at the top.

**EIGHT STITCHES, WRITTEN OUT**
Stockinette, garter, 2×2 ribbing, a simple cable, moss stitch, single crochet, half double crochet and a granny square. Each one comes with numbered steps, a gauge to aim for, and the mistakes that catch people first — curling edges, cables that pull in, turning chains that count as a stitch.

**THE THREE SUMS**
A gauge calculator turns a swatch into a cast-on count and rounds it to your pattern repeat. The yarn planner turns a metre count into skeins, grams and leftover metres, with a ten percent buffer already included. The needle screen converts metric to US sizes, because that numbering is a lookup rather than a formula.

name: Anonyma - Honest Feedback
description:
Want to grow? Collect honest feedback.
Share one QR code and find out what people really think. They answer anonymously in seconds, with no app and no sign-up.

FOR ANYONE WHO WANTS TO GROW
Managers and teams, teachers and lecturers, speakers and presenters, cafés and restaurants, shops and salons, events and workshops, coaches and trainers, hotels and hosts, students, clubs and communities, friends and family, and anyone else who wants to grow.

HONEST FEEDBACK MADE EASY
• Feedback on anything: your event, your talk, your product or you.
• One QR code: print it, show it or share the link.
• Truly anonymous: you see what they wrote, never who wrote it.
• Surveys in seconds: add questions, share, done.
• No sign-up needed: just scan and reply. No app to download.
• Live results: answers and charts update instantly.

THREE STEPS TO GROWTH
1. Create: get your QR code, or build a survey in under a minute.
2. Share: print it, show it or send the link. People answer anonymously.
3. Learn: see what works and what to improve.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Abusive language is filtered automatically, and you can report or block a sender in one tap.

QUESTIONS OR IDEAS?
We would love to hear from you: hello@anonyma.me

Anonyma is for people aged 18 and over.

Terms of Use: https://anonyma.me/terms

name: AntTrails
description:
Guide a little ant through twelve thoughtful garden puzzles. Collect every leaf, avoid the stones, and find a route within the move budget. The ant returns to its nest between leaves. Retrace a step to take it back.

Unlock the trails in order, improve your best routes and earn up to three stars on each level. Enlarge the board when you want bigger squares. Progress and records stay on your device, and all twelve levels are playable for free without an app account.

The free game may show an ad between levels. A video for a next-step hint is always optional: you can keep playing when no video is available. The monthly No Ads subscription removes ads and gives hints directly. The price and monthly renewal terms appear before purchase. Manage or cancel the subscription in your account settings.

The game follows your device language: English, French, Arabic, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian or Simplified Chinese. Arabic menus read right to left while the garden keeps its spatial orientation.

Have an idea for the garden? Send it through the support form.

https://apps.el-bacha.com/en/anttrails/privacy/
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Anvilkin: Idle Forge RPG
description:
Pico is a hedgehog blacksmith. Strike the anvil when the metal glows: every hammer blow forges a piece of gear, and a perfect strike forges the best. Pico equips what you forge and sets off to fight alone, chapter after chapter. An idle RPG, an incremental game where your timing matters as much as your patience.

The Forge
• One strike, one item: weapon, helmet, armor, gloves, boots, belt, ring, amulet.
• Perfect strikes build inspiration, all the way to a masterwork.
• Level up the forge and choose its tooling: gears, bellows, the merchant's scales…
• Customers place orders and pay in materials used in your recipes.

The Adventure
• 240 stages across 24 chapters, each ending with a boss.
• 19 familiars and 18 combat skills to collect.
• Two daily dungeons, daily quests and a free Season Pass.
• 24 forge skins, all in cloisonné enamel.
• Recast once the campaign is over to start again stronger, then head down into the Depths.

At Your Own Pace
• The forge keeps working while the game is closed, for up to 12 hours.
• Plays offline. No account needed: your game is saved on your phone.

Fair
Summon tickets and hammers are earned by playing: they are never for sale, and the only way to buy gems is the Monthly Card, which grants some every day. The shop sells comfort only: that card, a Lifetime Pass and an Ad-Free Pass. The only ads are videos you choose to watch for a reward, five a day at most. No banners, no forced ads.

name: ApertraPupilla
description:
ApertraPupilla plans a macro focus stack before the rail moves. Give it the sensor, the magnification, the depth you need sharp, and the aperture you mean to use. It returns the thickness of one slice, the distance between frames, how many frames that depth takes, and the total travel.

The step uses the magnification form of geometric depth of field, with pupil factor in the sum. A symmetric lens stays at 1. If the exit pupil and the entrance pupil differ, the effective f-number follows. More overlap shortens the step and adds frames. Guard frames sit outside the subject when the ends are hard to judge.

The Airy disc at your wavelength is set next to the circle of confusion you chose: a print estimate, a tighter screen estimate, or two pixel pitches. When the disc is larger, stopping down is no longer buying sharpness.

The rail page turns the step into degrees and tick marks for the screw you have. The run sheet is the order you tick while shooting. Plans stay on the phone. Two of them can be compared, and a field card copies the brief only when you ask. There is no account. Sample wing plans are on the bench, and you can delete them.

name: APOlora
description: APOlora is an application designed to organize structured data, analyze routes and segment variations, and divide an overall target into individual stages. It provides tools for creating printable summaries, compact reference cards, detailed overview sheets, and review reports that compare planned results with recorded data.

name: App Ong Dú
seller_name: ARB VIET NAM JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
App Ong Dú gom ba việc của người nuôi ong dú vào một ứng dụng: công cụ nuôi ong chạy không cần mạng, cửa hàng mật ong dú và tổ giống, và màn quản lý cho trại đang dùng phần mềm ID Ong Dú.

CÔNG CỤ — CHẠY NGAY TRÊN MÁY
• Chẩn đoán đàn: tick những dấu hiệu thấy ở thùng (quân thưa, không có bọc trứng mới, kiến, ruồi nhỏ, thùng nóng…), app chỉ ra nguyên nhân nghi ngờ nhiều nhất và việc cần làm ngay.
• Định giá tổ: chọn số cầu và tình trạng đàn, ra khoảng giá tham chiếu theo giá tổ đang rao ở Chợ Ong Dú.
• Lịch 12 tháng: mỗi tháng nên làm gì, nên tránh gì, theo mùa khô, mùa mưa.
• Từ điển nghề: cầu, bọng, bầu nhộng, chúa tơ… nghĩa, tên tiếng Anh và chỗ hay nhầm. Gõ không cần dấu.
• Sổ tay: ghi nhanh việc ở trại, lưu ngay trên điện thoại, chia sẻ cho người trong trại.
Ra vườn mất sóng vẫn dùng được.

CỬA HÀNG
Mật ong dú đóng hũ 100, 200, 500 ml và tổ ong dú giống từ các trại của Ong Dú. Đặt hàng, chuyển khoản bằng mã QR, trại gọi xác nhận trước khi gửi.

QUẢN LÝ TRẠI
Dành cho chủ trại, nhân viên và nhà đầu tư đang dùng phần mềm ID Ong Dú (app.ongdu.com):
• Số tổ theo tình trạng: mạnh, cần chú ý, mất chúa, chờ tách đàn.
• Tiến độ chăm đàn hôm nay của cả trại.
• Đàn cần chú ý và nhật ký kiểm tra, thu mật, tách đàn mới nhất.
• Mở thẳng sổ tổ, sơ đồ nhà ong, báo cáo; thông báo đẩy khi trại có việc.
Tài khoản trại do trại đăng ký với Ong Dú trên web; trong app chỉ đăng nhập để dùng. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong app.

Kết quả chẩn đoán, định giá để tham khảo, không thay cho việc mở thùng kiểm tra tận mắt.

name: Aqulena Mix - Water Ratio
description:
Plan aquarium water changes with Aqulena Mix. Set up a profile for each tank, estimate the TDS of a water-source mix, and record exchanges as you complete them. Tank measurements, change history, and water-use totals are available to review in one place.

Set Up Each Aquarium
Give each tank a name and enter its working water volume and measured TDS. Keep separate profiles for different aquariums so each water change starts with the right measurements.

Plan a Water Mix
Adjust the proportions of your water sources to estimate the resulting TDS. Use the calculation to plan how much water to prepare for an exchange.

Record Water Changes
Save completed exchanges and return to the history when you need to check earlier work. Recording an exchange updates the tank’s estimate; you can enter a fresh measured TDS in its profile later.

Review Water Use
See the number of exchanges, total water replaced, and pure water used. Per-tank counts make it easier to follow maintenance across multiple aquariums.

name: Arcade Six
description:
These are games I loved playing in the 80s but could never easily find for free. So I made them again: modern, calm and different from what you remember. All six in one app, all six free.

Stacks – Turn and slide the falling blocks into place. A full row disappears. Play classic, pick Zen if you don't want to rush, or try the daily puzzle.
Bricks – Bounce the ball up with your paddle and break the wall. Where the ball hits your paddle decides the angle.
Swarm – A swarm slowly moves down. Shoot them before they get there, and take cover behind the little walls.
Rally – Table tennis against the computer, first to seven. Win, and the computer gets faster.
Maze – Eat all the dots in the maze while three guards chase you, each in their own way.
Mix – The swarm comes down, but all you have is a paddle and a ball.

Keep an eye on the bottom of the screen now and then. Sometimes an animal walks by.

In Dutch and English. Your scores stay on your iPhone.

name: Arcane Rampart: Magic Defense
description:
The ancient realm stands on the precipice of darkness. Out from the Nether Abyss, endless demonic legions march upon the mortal citadel. As the last guardian Archmage, you must channel the elements, fortify your runic rampart, and repel the demonic siege before the realm falls into eternal shadow!

Arcane Rampart is an electrifying single-player roguelite magic defense game that blends intense tactical spellcasting, real-time battle strategy, and deep workshop progression. 

100% AD-FREE & FULLY OFFLINE: No popups, no banner ads, no forced video interruptions, and no internet connection required. Pure, uninterrupted fantasy defense at your fingertips!

==================================================
KEY GAMEPLAY FEATURES
==================================================

4 DISTINCT ARCHMAGE SPECIALIZATIONS
Choose your legendary hero robe, each with unique combat traits and starting elemental mastery:
• Arcane Apprentice: Versatile and rapid spell haste (+15%), initiating battles with focused Arcane Missiles.
• Pyromancer: Wield primordial devastation (+25% Fire Damage) to incinerate incoming swarms with explosive Fireballs.
• Frost Weaver: Master of absolute zero (+0.5s Freeze Duration) to freeze, shatter, and control battlefield choke points.
• Storm Bringer: Harness thunderous wrath (+8% Global Crit Chance) to chain devastating lightning through clustered ranks.

DYNAMIC ROGUELITE SPELL SYNERGIES
Level up during siege waves to unlock and evolve game-changing arcane powers:
• Arcane Missiles: Rapid-fire mystic bolts that puncture through demon lines.
• Blazing Fireball: High-impact area splash damage that leaves scorched earth in its wake.
• Frost Nova: Expansive radial frost blasts that slow and freeze charging hordes.
• Chain Lightning: High-voltage bolts jumping across multiple enemy targets.
• Bastion Restoration: Repair wall integrity on the fly and permanently increase fortress HP.
• Arcane Haste & Focus: Drastically ramp up attack frequency and spell velocity.

TACTICAL SHOCKWAVE SYSTEM
When the rampart is overwhelmed by elite monsters or demonic siege engines, trigger your emergency Arcane Shockwave to repel all attackers, clear the perimeter, and buy vital casting seconds!

DEEP WORKSHOP FORTIFICATIONS
Collect plundered gold and rare arcane runes from defeated enemies to permanently enhance your citadel:
• Fortify Rampart HP & Physical Damage Reduction.
• Boost Spell Power, Critical Strike Multipliers, and Cooldown Recovery.
• Attune Mystic Rune Relics in the Workshop to amplify elemental affinities.

20 HANDCRAFTED CHALLENGE STAGES ACROSS 4 BIOMES
Journey across four visually stunning, treacherous battlegrounds:
• Whispering Forest (Stages 1–5): Face goblin scouts and aggressive feral orcs.
• Scorched Canyon (Stages 6–10): Battle flame-resistant brutes and gargoyles.
• Glacial Ridge (Stages 11–15): Defeat Frost Wyrms and icy shamans.
• Void Sanctuary (Stages 16–20): Confront Nether Spitters, Shadow Titans, and terrifying Abyss Bosses!

ACCESSIBLE, RESPONSIVE & POLISHED
• Silky-smooth 60 FPS mobile performance with crisp spell VFX.
• Full screen adaptation for all modern iOS devices, including Notch and Dynamic Island displays.
• One-hand intuitive controls with optional 2x speed combat toggle.
• English and Traditional/Simplified Chinese multi-language localization.

==================================================
COMMITTED TO PLAYER PRIVACY
==================================================
• Zero third-party advertisements or commercial tracking SDKs.
• No account registration or personal data collection.
• 100% local device save data. Play anytime, anywhere—even on airplanes!

The siege has begun. Man the rampart, incant your spells, and shatter the demonic tide!

name: AreanOtcez
description: AreanOtcez is a private offline journal for keeping someone or something gently on your mind.

name: Arkus: Horas de Obra
description:
O Arkus junta, num só lugar, as horas de quem trabalha em obra: cada pessoa pica no telemóvel e a administração aprova o mês e envia o auto de horas, sem papel nem folhas de Excel.

PARA QUEM ESTÁ EM OBRA
• Picar a entrada, o almoço, o regresso e a saída com um só gesto.
• A localização confirma que está na obra no momento em que pica.
• Ver as horas de cada semana, as horas extra e o que falta aprovar.
• Enganou-se numa picagem? Peça a correção na app e a administração decide.
• Entrar com o número de telemóvel e um PIN de 6 algarismos. Sem SMS e sem palavras-passe.

PARA A ADMINISTRAÇÃO
• Ao vivo: quem está em cada obra, quem está em almoço e quem ainda não picou.
• As picagens longe da obra ficam assinaladas, com a distância aproximada.
• A hora extra aparece à parte, dia a dia, por pessoa e por obra.
• Aprove o mês de toda a equipa e decida as correções pedidas.
• O auto de horas sai feito para cada obra, com horas e valores, em PDF A4 pronto a enviar ao cliente.
• Convide cada pessoa com um link pelo WhatsApp; quem perde o PIN recebe um link novo.
• Exporte o mês em CSV para a contabilidade.

PRIVACIDADE
• Os dados ficam na União Europeia.
• A localização só é guardada quando a pessoa pica.
• Cada pessoa pode eliminar a sua conta na própria app (Conta → Eliminar a minha conta). Os registos de horas ficam com a empresa, que os tem de guardar por lei.

COMO COMEÇAR
O Arkus é para empresas: a conta de cada pessoa é criada pela administração da sua empresa. Para pôr a sua empresa no Arkus, fale connosco pelo apoio em usearkus.app/suporte.

name: Arrow Out: Shape Puzzle
description:
Untangle the paths. Clear every arrow. Experience the purest minimalist logic puzzle.

There is only one rule:
Tap any arrow with a clear path ahead to launch it off the board. Clear every last arrow to complete the stage.

Easy to grasp in seconds, yet deeply satisfying to master. One wrong tap into a blocked path costs a heart—read the interlocking chains, find the key release point, and watch the entire puzzle unravel.

■ ICONIC SILHOUETTE SHAPE BOARDS
Discover a rich collection of handcrafted shape stages—Airplanes, Stars, Butterflies, Rockets, Hearts, Cats, and many more. Every special board brings a fresh silhouette to unravel.

■ DEEPLY INTERLOCKING MAZE LAYOUTS
• Master Spiral Vortexes, Serpentine Mazes, Concentric Fortresses, and intricate knotted paths
• Every single stage is guaranteed 100% solvable with zero deadlocks

■ SCALE UP TO MASSIVE 100×100 GRIDS
Start relaxed and climb into monumental logic challenges—reaching up to 100×100 grids at higher stages. Glide across dense boards effortlessly with silky-smooth 120fps pinch-to-zoom and panning.

■ DESIGNED FOR PURE FOCUS
• Ultra-clean monochrome aesthetic with zero clutter or distracting borders
• Clear crimson feedback marks blocked arrows until you free them
• Smart Hints smoothly glide directly to your next valid move whenever you need a nudge
• Full Light Mode and Dark Mode themes
• No countdown timers, offline playable, and automatic mid-level resume

Whether you have two minutes or an hour to unwind, Arrow Out delivers crisp, tactile brain training at your own pace.

name: ArtStamp: Batch Watermarks
description:
Sign a collection before you post it. Choose up to 50 photos, preview your mark on each image, and save watermarked copies to Photos or share the exported files.

Use your name and the current year, import a transparent logo or handwritten signature from Files, or repeat a subtle mark across the frame. Adjust size, opacity, position and tile spacing. Choose from four typefaces, soft shadows and an optional pill background.

Embed an owner name in a PNG and read it in ArtStamp from Photos or Files. Cropping, resizing or converting to JPEG may erase the label.

Export full-resolution PNG or JPEG copies. ArtStamp renders locally and does not require an account.

name: Arya Chat
description:
Arya Chat is the private chat and sharing app of Arya Tara Ling, a Washington-state 501(c)(3) nonprofit Buddhist organization.

Members, family and friends use Arya Chat to:
- Send direct and group messages
- Share posts with the community
- Stay connected with announcements from the organization

Arya Chat is members-only. There are no ads, no purchases and no public sign-up — accounts are for the organization's own community.

Learn more about Arya Tara Ling at atling.org.

name: Ask Jordy
description:
Ask Jordy is the AI assistant for your company's meetings. Jordy takes the notes, remembers what was decided, and tells you what comes next.

MEETING NOTES THAT WRITE THEMSELVES
• Jordy joins your Microsoft Teams, Zoom and Google Meet calls and sends clear notes when the meeting ends: the summary, the decisions, the action items and who owns each one.
• Notes in the room: for a meeting in person, put your iPhone on the table. Jordy listens and writes the notes. Say "Jordy" to ask a question during the meeting.
• Read the full transcript, or edit the notes before you send them to the attendees.

ASK ABOUT ANY MEETING
• Ask "What did we decide?" about one meeting, or search across all of them.
• Every answer links to the part of the meeting it came from.

YOUR DAY, READY
• Today shows your next meetings, a short brief and what needs your approval.
• Home-screen widgets show your next meeting and the latest recap.

DRIVE WITH JORDY
• Hands-free voice mode with large text for the car.
• Hear your next meeting, the travel time and when to leave. Jordy tells the other attendees if you run late, and joins the call for you.

CHAT WITH JORDY
• Ask about your schedule, your meetings and your company's notes, by text or by voice.

MADE FOR COMPANIES
• Your company admin invites you. Each company's data is kept apart from every other company's.
• You choose if Jordy can use the AI services. You can withdraw that choice in Settings at any time.
• Delete your account in the app at any time.

Ask Jordy needs an account from your company. Calendar features need your company's Microsoft 365.

name: ASPLAYER by ALFTECH SOLUTIONS
description:
ASPLAYER by ALFTECH SOLUTIONS is a modern multimedia player designed for a flexible and personalized viewing experience.

Connect to your own compatible media service using your server address, username, and password. Browse live TV, movies, and series through a modern interface designed for iPhone and iPad.

MAIN FEATURES

• Live TV, Movies & Series — Browse content organized into categories from your configured provider.
• Adaptive Playback — Playback options designed to improve stability across different network conditions.
• Audio & Subtitles — Select available audio tracks and subtitles when supported by the source.
• Continue Watching — Resume supported movies and episodes from your previous playback position.
• Favorites & History — Organize your favorite content and manage your viewing history.
• Parental Controls — Restrict access to certain content using parental protection settings.
• Search — Find content within your connected provider's catalog.
• Multilingual Interface — Switch between English and Spanish.
• AI-Assisted Features — Optional assistance with content searches and synopsis translation.
• Personalized Settings — Adjust playback, display, and other preferences.

BRING YOUR OWN MEDIA SERVICE

ASPLAYER is a multimedia playback application. It does not include preloaded TV channels, movies, series, streaming subscriptions, or login credentials.

A compatible external service and valid credentials are required to access content. Users are responsible for ensuring they have the appropriate rights and authorization to access and play their selected media.

Feature availability, supported formats, audio tracks, and subtitles depend on the connected provider, media source, and device.

Enjoy a customizable multimedia experience with ASPLAYER by ALFTECH SOLUTIONS.

name: Asterism: Photo Constellation
description:
Turn a photo into a constellation.

Pick a photo of yourself, someone you love or your pet. Asterism finds them, draws them in stars and sets them in a glowing night sky: stars on the eyes, the smile, the shoulders, all the way round the figure, joined by thin lines like a classic star chart.

• Made for people and pets: faces, hands, ears, paws and tails become stars
• Touch a star to see its name, or rename it yourself
• Name the stars after a word: "Can" becomes CANIUS, with Alpha Canii, Beta Canii…
• Five skies, from midnight blue to violet nebula, with the Milky Way behind
• A keepsake for someone you miss: add a title and an "In loving memory" line with dates
• Formats for posts, stories and prints

Your photo stays on your phone: everything is drawn on the device, your photo is never uploaded, and you don't need an account.

Creating, customizing and previewing are free. Saving and sharing need a purchase: unlock one artwork once, or get Premium, yearly or monthly, for every artwork and every new sky. Every saved artwork is in print quality, ready for Photos, prints and social media.

Premium renews automatically at the price shown until you cancel. Cancel anytime in Settings, at least 24 hours before it renews.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://canknbr.github.io/asterism-legal/privacy/

Star names are decorative. They are not real or registered star names.

name: AstroAdish: Vedic Astrology
description:
Your Kundali, calculated with care and explained in plain language, in English or Hindi.

AstroAdish turns your birth details into a complete Vedic astrology profile: your birth chart, your current Dasha period, daily and monthly predictions, and answers to the questions that matter to you. No sign-up, no login. Just enter your birth date, time and place.

YOUR KUNDALI AND CHARTS
• D1 birth chart (Lagna Kundali) and Moon chart
• Divisional charts: D2 Hora, D9 Navamsha and D10 Dashamsha
• Planet positions, houses, signs and retrograde status
• Save Kundalis for yourself and your family and switch between them

DAILY AND MONTHLY PREDICTIONS
• A daily reading based on your own chart, not just your Moon sign
• A monthly overview with the themes and timing to watch
• Clear wording, with focus areas instead of vague promises

VIMSHOTTARI DASHA
• Your current Mahadasha and Antardasha and how long they run
• A Dasha timeline showing what has passed and what comes next
• Your birth Nakshatra and birth Dasha lord

ASK ASTROADISH
Pick a topic and a question and get an answer drawn from your Kundali:
• Career: job change, growth, next opportunity
• Love and marriage: relationship outlook, commitment timing
• Finance: current situation, improvement, wealth potential
• Education, children and health

GUIDANCE
• Your Chart Reading: what your Ascendant, Moon sign and planets say about you
• Current Dasha guidance: what this period favours and what needs patience
• Life Phases: the major phases in your chart and what each one emphasises

PANCHANG
• Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana and weekday for the day

NUMEROLOGY
• Name numerology report based on your name
• Generate and share a free Numerology PDF

MADE FOR YOU
• Full English and Hindi support
• Light and dark themes
• Request a consultation with an astrologer from inside the app
• Your privacy matters: no account needed, and you can ask for all your data to be deleted

AstroAdish is for spiritual guidance and self-reflection. It does not replace professional medical, legal or financial advice.

Privacy Policy: https://astroadish.com/privacy-policy
Support: support@astroadish.com

name: ATC Simulator 3D Voice Control
description:
Hold push to talk, clear Seacliff 42 for takeoff, and watch it roll down runway two seven. Pilots answer in distinct voices, read back your FAA clearances, and sometimes make errors or declare MAYDAY. Work the 3D tower, approach radar, or the cockpit at San Diego.

VOICE AND TOUCH COMMANDS
Speak FAA JO 7110.65 phraseology for taxi, headings, altitudes and speeds, clear Fogline two one eight for the ILS runway two eight right approach or tell Tidewell three five to line up and wait. Tap a plane for touch commands. The phone vibrates for understood calls, a MAYDAY and a stall stick shaker.

PILOTS ON THE FREQUENCY
Pilots read back instructions before flying them. They ask to say again, call standby, block calls, or read back wrongly so you must correct them. MAYDAY crews break in frightened and calm down as you handle it. You can also talk to pilots in your own words, recorded in a logbook.

AIRPORTS AND AIRCRAFT
3D airports use aerial imagery with the city, water and mountains.
- San Diego (KSAN) has one runway by downtown and the bay.
- Daily shifts also include flights at San Francisco (KSFO) and Jackson Hole (KJAC), and one trainer lesson is at Palo Alto (KPAO).
- 34 aircraft types, from the Cessna 172 and ATR 72 to the Boeing 737, Airbus A380 and F-16.

THREE SEATS TO WORK
- 3D Tower: Watch from the cab, sequence with strips, handle pushback, taxi, takeoffs and landings, and use light gun signals for planes without a radio.
- Approach Radar: Vector arrivals to the ILS, hold traffic and hand off to the tower.
- Cockpit as Pilot: Fly an airliner on autopilot or a single-engine aircraft with throttle and stick, making every radio call.

CAREER AND DAILY PLAY
The tower career at San Diego ends in a checkride. Shifts open with a one-screen briefing and airport diagram, score out of 100 on separation, delay and phraseology, and show the FAA rule for scored calls. In Open Shift at San Diego you choose settings or work a past day's real timetable and weather, and Daily Shift gives every player the same flights.

ATC ACADEMY
An intro flight to San Diego beside Hal, a retired controller, opens 11 guided lessons on approach, San Diego tower and flying a Cessna 172 at Palo Alto from the engine checklist, as the instructor reacts to mistakes. Use 42 Radio School drills, 18 ground school chapters, a glossary and the FAA handbook.

EMERGENCIES AND WEATHER
Pilots declare MAYDAY for bird strikes, engine trouble, smoke, hydraulic, fuel or medical emergencies. Give priority and send the rescue vehicles. Work dawn, day, dusk or night in rain, snow, fog, low cloud and wind shifts. Wet runways lengthen landing rolls and low visibility brings go-arounds.

OFFLINE PLAY AND LANGUAGES
The simulation, lessons, and handbook work offline. Without a connection, voice control uses the iPhone's own speech recognizer where on-device recognition is available, and touch commands always work. Online adds cloud speech recognition and live directed events. Screens are in English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Traditional Chinese, and Hindi. The radio is always in English.

WHAT IS INCLUDED
- San Diego tower career (5 shifts and checkride) and a Daily Shift rotating over San Diego, San Francisco and Jackson Hole.
- San Diego open shifts in the tower, approach radar and pilot seat.
- San Diego arrival flights in an airliner and a single-engine cockpit.
- 11 Academy lessons on orientation, tower, approach and a Palo Alto trainer.
Everything is included, with nothing to buy and no account to create.

Not affiliated with the FAA, and not for real-world training. Aircraft, manufacturer and airline names are trademarks of their owners, used only to identify them, and imply no affiliation or endorsement.

name: Athena Studio
description:
Athena Studio for iPhone and iPad is the companion to Athena Studio, the free Mac app that runs a team of AI coding agents: a team lead that plans, and an agent per repository. When you step away from your Mac, your agents keep working. This app lets you keep up with them and answer when they need you.

Requires Athena Studio on a Mac (free download at athena.novum-lab.com), signed in with the same Apple or Google account.

WORK
• Questions and decisions from your agents come to the top of Work. Answer a question, or pick the options in a plan's decision console and press Proceed.
• Read the plan behind each task: what is happening now, what blocks it, the checks and the results.
• See the tasks in progress and the ones that finished recently.
• Follow merges as they happen: review verdicts, auto fixes, changed files and commits, and open the pull request on GitHub.
• See your code changes over the last 7 days and your agents' usage.

PANES
• Watch each agent's terminal live, at the size it has on your Mac.
• Type into a pane, use special keys and combos, paste from the clipboard, or send a photo to the terminal.
• Take control from your phone. As soon as you use the pane on your Mac, the Mac takes it back at its own size.

SERVERS
• Check the servers in your pack at a glance: CPU, load, memory and disk graphs for the last hour, day or week.
• See sites, services and containers, scheduled jobs and pending security updates, with warnings when something fails.

REPO SETTINGS
• Turn Auto PR and Auto review on or off for each repository, and choose how merges happen: Auto, Confirm or Manual.
• Switch between your packs.

NOTIFICATIONS
• Get a notification when an agent needs you or finishes a task. Notification content is encrypted on your Mac and decrypted only on your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Terminal output, your input, code and photos are end-to-end encrypted between your Mac and your device. The relay server only passes along encrypted data and can't read it.
• On the same Wi-Fi, the app connects straight to your Mac.
• A new device connects only after you confirm the same code on your Mac.
• Lock the app with Face ID.

Built for iPhone and iPad, in English, Korean, Japanese and Chinese.

Terms: https://athena.novum-lab.com/terms/
Privacy: https://athena.novum-lab.com/privacy/

name: Athleka : coaching sportif
description:
Athleka est l'app du coach sportif : ton coaching ET ton activité au même endroit. Tes clients y retrouvent leurs séances, leur suivi et ta messagerie.

COACHE TES CLIENTS
• Tous tes clients, leurs programmes et leurs séances au même endroit
• Les retours, bilans et check-ins à traiter en un coup d'œil, sans tableurs ni messages éparpillés
• Une bibliothèque d'exercices en vidéo et des programmes réutilisables
• Des tests physiques guidés, les zones cardio et la mobilité de chaque client
• Les séances en salle, les cours collectifs et la réservation par tes clients

GÈRE TON ACTIVITÉ
• Tes prospects et ton suivi commercial, de la prise de contact à l'inscription
• Tes offres, propositions et contrats clients
• Tes paiements encaissés directement sur ton propre compte
• Ton chiffre d'affaires, tes indicateurs et une estimation de tes cotisations
• Ton agenda et ton calendrier de publications pour les réseaux sociaux
• L'app à ton nom et à tes couleurs pour tes clients

POUR TES CLIENTS
• Leur séance du jour, avec chaque exercice expliqué en vidéo
• Le mode guidé : minuteur, temps de repos et bips, il n'y a plus qu'à suivre

name: Athlete Flow - Yoska
description:
Yoska - Athlete Flow is an event operations application designed to help staff and volunteers manage athlete journeys at sporting events.

From athlete registration and wristband verification to baggage handling and event-zone access, Athlete Flow helps event teams coordinate key operational activities through a simple QR-based workflow.

KEY FEATURES

Scan athlete ticket QR codes and verify participant information during registration.

Validate athlete wristbands using QR code scanning to support a smooth check-in process.

BUILT FOR EVENT TEAMS

Yoska - Athlete Flow. Simplifying event operations, one scan at a time.

name: AtlasBloom Sprite Atlas
description:
AtlasBloom turns a small collection of static images into a usable sprite atlas with inspectable regions and matching output files. Prepare assets for a webpage, app prototype or other project without manually maintaining separate image positions and manifests.

ASSEMBLE YOUR INPUTS
Create a batch and choose PNG or JPEG files from Files. Review original and normalized dimensions, source sizes and transparency information. Give each image a display name and a unique resource key, adjust its order, and remove items deliberately. The selected originals are not edited. An explicit practice-assets action creates labeled original examples when you want to learn the workflow.

SET UP AND INSPECT A REAL PACK
Choose canvas width and height, transparent padding and repeated-edge extrusion. Source content keeps its dimensions: the app does not crop transparent borders, scale images or rotate them to fit. Save reusable recipes and apply copied settings to another batch without changing earlier exports.

The documented deterministic shelf method sorts allocated regions by height, then width and your current batch order, and places them row by row. Preview the actual plan, inspect content versus allocated rectangles, and read exact pixel coordinates and normalized UV boundaries. Coordinates use a top-left origin. The method is predictable rather than globally optimal. Unplaced images remain listed with reasons, and every image must fit before generation.

GENERATE A MATCHED PACKAGE
Create an actual atlas PNG, region JSON and CSS together. The PNG contains the full selected canvas; JSON records dimensions, region bounds, settings and the coordinate convention; CSS uses the content region sizes and background positions. The region inspector helps you check how a particular asset maps into the output. The app does not guess engine-specific UV conventions or add a hidden half-pixel offset.

Exports are independent snapshots. Reopen their PNG preview, frozen regions and actual file sizes, then share PNG, JSON, CSS or all three through the system panel. Deleting a batch removes its private source copies while retaining independent exports. Delete an export separately, or confirm Erase all local data in About to remove this app's batches, recipes and internal files. External originals and already shared copies remain separate.

SUPPORTED SCOPE
Up to 20 static images per batch, 8 MiB per image, 2048 pixels per normalized dimension, 32 MiB of batch source files and 16,777,216 decoded pixels. Canvas sides are selected from 256, 512, 1024, 2048 and 4096. Padding is 0-16 pixels; extrusion is 0-8 pixels. No animation import, image editing, compressed texture format or optimal-packing guarantee is included.

The native library is kept in the local app container. No app login is needed to prepare and export your atlas.

name: Attendance Tracker: Roll Call
description:
Who is here today? For teachers, coaches, choir leaders, club organisers and anyone who has to know.

ONE TAP FOR EACH PERSON
Open your group and tap Take attendance. Everybody is in a list with four buttons: present, late, absent, excused. One tap marks the rest as present. Tap a mark again to take it back.

OR CALL THE ROLL
Roll call shows one name at a time, large enough to read across a room, with how often that person has come and how many meetings in a row. Tap the mark and the next name comes.

EVERY MEETING ON A CALENDAR
A month at a glance: the days you met are filled in, darker the fuller the room was. Tap a day to see or change its marks. Give a meeting a title such as Rehearsal, Match or Lesson 12.

EVERY PERSON'S RECORD
Each person has a page: the share of meetings they came to, their current run of meetings in a row, and every meeting with its mark. Excused meetings are not held against anyone.

ADD A WHOLE LIST AT ONCE
Type names one by one, or paste a list from a spreadsheet, a document or a message. Numbering and doubles are taken care of.

REPORTS (PRO)
The whole table, a line for every person and a column for every meeting, as a PDF to print or send, or as a CSV file for a spreadsheet. For all time, this month, or the last 30 or 90 days.

STATISTICS (PRO)
Attendance meeting by meeting as a chart, and the people who have been away most often.

NOTES (PRO)
A note about a person, and a word about one person at one meeting: left early, forgot kit, doctor's appointment.

FREE
One group of up to twelve people, as many meetings as you like, the list and the roll call, the calendar and every person's record.

ATTENDANCE PRO
Groups and people without limit, the PDF and CSV reports, the statistics and the notes.

PRIVATE
No account. Your groups, names and marks stay on your iPhone; the app sends nothing to us.

Attendance Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you, and it turns into the paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Atuvia
description:
Set your pace. Follow your cues.
Atuvia helps you build workouts you can follow by sound. Arrange moves, holds, and rests, then use built-in English cues or your own recorded voice to guide each transition. Keep your attention on the movement, with fewer reasons to check the screen.
PLAN AROUND YOUR PACE
Create a routine from scratch or adapt one of four built-in templates. Arrange your steps, set their durations, and choose the number of rounds, rest between rounds, and preparation countdown. See the total time as you adjust your plan.
MAKE THE CUES YOURS
Choose a built-in instruction such as “Squats,” “Hold,” or “Switch sides,” or record a short cue in your own voice. Listen back, trim it, and save it for use across different workouts. Select No Cue for steps you want to keep quiet.
LISTEN AND KEEP MOVING
Your chosen cue plays at the start of each step, leaving the remaining time quiet for movement or rest. Follow the audio with your screen locked or the app in the background. When you need a break, pause and resume from the same place.
RETURN TO WHAT WORKS
Keep favorite routines easy to find, search workouts by name, or duplicate a plan to try a different pace. Add an optional note or cover photo to recognize it at a glance. After a session, review your training time, steps, and rounds, then choose Save to History to keep the record.
PREVIEW OR SHARE YOUR TRACK
Listen through your routine before training, or export the complete audio as an M4A file. The track includes your preparation countdown, all scheduled rounds and rests, and the finishing cue, ready to save or share through the system share sheet.
No account is required. Your workouts, recordings, cover photos, and saved session history are stored locally on your device.

name: Audio Transcriber – MeetNuvio
description:
MeetNuvio records your meetings and turns them into text on your iPhone or iPad. Press record, put your phone down and talk. When you stop, you have the audio and a transcript with times that you can search, correct, label with speakers' names and export. Everything stays on your device.

RECORD WITH THE SCREEN LOCKED
• One big button to start, with pause and resume. A level meter shows it's hearing you.
• Recording carries on with the screen locked or another app open, so long meetings keep going.
• On iPhone, a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island shows the time, with Pause, Resume and Stop buttons.
• Standard or High audio quality.
• Start a recording with Siri: "Record a meeting with MeetNuvio".

VOICE TO TEXT ON YOUR DEVICE
• Transcribed with Apple's speech recognition on your iPhone or iPad, not on a server. Each language's speech model downloads from Apple once; your audio is never uploaded.
• See the transcript appear as you speak, once the language is downloaded.
• English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and more, depending on your device. Choose a meeting's language, or change it and transcribe again.
• Import audio from Files too: voice memos, interviews, lectures and the sound from videos (m4a, mp3, wav, aiff, mp4, mov and more).

FIND AND REPLAY
• Search every meeting by its title or by anything that was said.
• Listen back with the transcript: the line being spoken is highlighted, and tapping a line plays from there.
• Skip 15 seconds and play at 1×, 1.25×, 1.5× or 2×.
• Mark your important meetings as favorites.

EDIT AND NAME SPEAKERS
• Correct any word, delete lines you don't need, and choose who said each line.
• Rename speakers once ("Speaker 1" becomes "Sarah") and every line follows. Speakers are labeled by you, not detected.

EXPORT
• Copy the text, or share it as plain text (.txt), Markdown (.md) or subtitles (.srt and .vtt), with times and speakers.
• Share the audio (.m4a).

TRY IT FIRST
Tap Try the Sample to see a one-minute meeting transcribed, searched and edited. The sample doesn't use a free recording.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Recordings and transcripts stay on your iPhone or iPad unless you share them. There's no account or sign-up, and MeetNuvio collects no data and doesn't track you. Please ask people before you record them.

PRICING
Your first 2 recordings (recorded or imported) are free. After that, choose a subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase for unlimited recordings. There's no free trial.

The subscription is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Lifetime is a single purchase and never renews.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vaultnuvio.com/meetnuvio/privacy/
Support: support@vaultnuvio.com

name: Aureon Verify
description:
Aureon lets you check in seconds whether an Aureon product is genuine.

Every Aureon product carries an NFC tag with a cryptographic chip and a label with a QR code and a scratch-off PIN. The app checks with the official Aureon server and shows you the result straight away.

HOW IT WORKS
• NFC: hold the top of your phone against the tag. Every read produces a one-time code that cannot be copied or reused.
• QR code and PIN: scan the code on the label, scratch off the PIN and enter it.
• Clear result: green when the product is genuine, yellow when it needs attention (for example it was already verified before), red when the code is not recognised or was copied.
• Product details: name, batch, manufacturing and expiry dates, and the authorised distribution chain.

PRIVACY
• No account and no personal data needed.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Your verification history stays on your phone.

FOR DISTRIBUTORS AND CLINICS
Authorised staff sign in with the account issued by Aureon to record the products they receive.

Available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

This is an unofficial study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or approved by the Australian Government or the Department of Home Affairs, and it does not issue certificates. The questions, explanations and notes are our own, written from “Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond” (© Commonwealth of Australia, CC BY 4.0). Passing practice tests does not guarantee passing the real test. Official information: immi.homeaffairs.gov.au

name: AutoWebtoon
description:
AutoWebtoon is a Safari extension that scrolls webtoons for you, so you can read without touching the screen.

WHAT IT DOES
• Stops so each panel fits the screen. Tall panels are shown in two steps, very tall ones glide down slowly.
• Counts the words in the speech bubbles: more text, longer pause. Art-only panels move on quickly.
• Goes to the next episode at the end.
• Tap to pause, tap again to resume. Swipe up or down for the next or previous panel.

WHERE IT WORKS
WEBTOON (webtoons.com), Naver Webtoon and Kakao Webtoon episode pages in Safari.

HOW TO TURN IT ON
Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions > AutoWebtoon > turn on, and set the webtoon sites to Allow. Then open an episode in Safari.

PRIVACY
Panels and text are measured on your device. AutoWebtoon does not save the comics, and does not collect your name, email or reading list.

Privacy Policy: https://lovesjy201201.github.io/autowebtoon/privacy.html

name: Awelle
description:
Awelle keeps daily pet care . See what has been done, what comes next, and what the next person needs to know.
Create a pet profile and a care guide for meals, walks, supply locations, fears, comfort, and an emergency contact. Add one-time or daily tasks for feeding, walks, cleaning, and play. Record who did the care and when, with a note, a photo, or a short voice message.

Turn on reminders for care tasks, including quiet hours. Awelle includes a few complimentary uses.

For swaps, compare both owners’ estimates to see whether a cash adjustment works for both sides. Sales and swaps work offline. Active promotions open when you launch or return to the app.

name: Aykut Sürücü Kursları
description:
Aykut Sürücü Kursları – Hakkımızda Balıkesir’de sürücü eğitimi alanında hizmet veren Aykut Sürücü Kursları, farklı ilçelerdeki şubeleri ve geniş eğitim yelpazesiyle sürücü adaylarına kapsamlı eğitim imkânları sunmaktadır. Sınavlara Hazırlık Artık Cebinizde!
Bu uygulama sınavlara etkili bir şekilde hazırlanmanızı sağlar. Uygulama içerisinde yer alan video anlatımlar, dijital kitaplar ve interaktif testler sayesinde hem teorik bilginizi geliştirir hem de sınav pratiği kazanırsınız.

Konuya Göre Ayrılmış Kitaplar:
Her ders, konularına göre düzenlenmiş dijital kitaplarla sunulmuştur. Bu sayede hangi konuyu çalışmak istiyorsanız doğrudan o bölüme geçebilir, gereksiz zaman kaybı yaşamadan öğreniminizi sürdürebilirsiniz.

Video Anlatımlarla Görsel Öğrenme:
Her konu için özel olarak hazırlanmış video içerikleriyle öğrenme sürecinizi destekleyin. Görsel anlatımlar sayesinde karmaşık konular daha anlaşılır hale gelir, öğrenme kaliteniz artar.

Dinamik Test Sistemi:
Test çözme bölümü, her seferinde farklı sorular sunarak sizi sınavlara hazırlarken ezberden uzaklaştırır. Gerçek sınav formatına benzer yapıdaki testlerle hem bilgilerinizi ölçebilir hem de eksiklerinizi tespit edebilirsiniz.

İlerlemenizi Takip Edin:
Uygulama içerisindeki test sonuçlarıyla hangi konularda güçlü olduğunuzu, nerelerde gelişmeniz gerektiğini kolayca görebilirsiniz. Bu sayede hedef odaklı bir çalışma planı oluşturabilirsiniz.

Her Zaman, Her Yerden Erişim:
Mobil cihazınız üzerinden istediğiniz zaman uygulamaya erişebilir, dilediğiniz yerde çalışmaya devam edebilirsiniz. Sınav hazırlığı artık sadece sınıfta değil, cebinizde!

Bu uygulama herhangi bir resmi kurum, devlet kuruluşu veya bakanlık tarafından geliştirilmemiştir ve bu kurumları temsil etmez. Sadece bireysel eğitim ve sınav hazırlığı amacıyla tasarlanmıştır. Resmi sınav sistemleriyle doğrudan bir bağlantısı bulunmamaktadır.

name: AyluScan PDF
description:
Scan. Save. Share.

Turn your phone into a convenient document scanner with AyluScan PDF, developed by Aylukha Solutions.

Capture documents using your phone's camera, improve their appearance and turn them into PDF files you can save, organise and share.

Everything you need for everyday scanning

Scan documents: Capture letters, forms, receipts, notes and other paper documents.

Improve your scans: Crop, rotate, adjust and apply filters to make documents easier to read.

Create multipage PDFs: Combine scanned pages into a single PDF document.

Keep your documents organised: Access your saved PDFs from your local document library.

Share easily: Send your PDFs using compatible sharing apps on your device.

Work on drafts offline: Capture and prepare documents without an internet connection.

10 free PDFs every month

Create up to 10 new PDF documents each month with a verified account. Each completed PDF counts as one document, even when it contains multiple pages.

You can explore the scanner and prepare drafts before registering. An account and internet connection are required to finalise new PDFs.

Designed to be simple

AyluScan PDF brings scanning, document preparation and PDF sharing together in one straightforward experience.

AyluScan PDF — Scan. Save. Share.

Developed by Aylukha Solutions.

name: Baba Videos
description:
Baba Videos is a parent-controlled video player for young children. You choose the videos; your kids watch only those.

For parents
• Add a video by pasting a YouTube link, or use Share > Baba Videos from YouTube or Safari
• A profile for each child, each with their own list of videos
• Sort videos into categories and reorder them
• Parent area protected by a PIN (Face ID optional)
• Sign in with Google or Apple to keep the same lists on every family device

For kids
• A simple grid of their approved videos with big pictures
• No search, no comments, no suggested videos
• No links out of the app and no sharing
• Only a parent can switch between children

Videos play in YouTube's official embedded player.

name: Bababa: First Words
description:
Keep the voice of their first words. One tap to record today's “ba-ba”, a name to give it later, and your child's exact age saved forever.

RECORD FIRST, NAME AFTERWARDS
Tap the big button as soon as your child babbles. You don't need to know which word it is: name it when your hands are free.

THEIR AGE, ON EVERY WORD
Enter the birth date once. Every recording shows the exact age: “14 months and 8 days”. Several dated takes for one word, and trimming to keep the right moment.

WATCH THEIR VOCABULARY GROW
A word counter and a timeline by age and by month: see the first words arrive, then pile up.

SHARE WITH A SIMPLE LINK
A link opens a player in the browser: nothing to install for grandparents. You can switch it off at any time.

EVERY LANGUAGE AT HOME
English, French or others: each word has its own language, and so does search.

THEIR FIRST WORDS, YOURS ALONE
Your recordings are private. Only a link you create gives access to a word, and you can switch it off at any time. Without an account, nothing leaves your phone. With an account (email and password), you find your words on another phone.

name: Bakers paris
description:
Bakers, c'est la pâtisserie et coffee shop 100 % sans lactose du 87 avenue Niel, à Paris 17. Tout est fait maison.

name: Balu & Associates
description:
Balu & Associates is an integrated workplace management application designed to simplify project coordination, employee attendance, task management and daily business operations.

Stay connected with your work, monitor project progress and manage everyday activities through one convenient mobile application.

KEY FEATURES

1. Project Management
- View and manage assigned projects.

- Stay updated on project activities and timelines.

2. Task Management
- View assigned tasks and responsibilities.
- Track task completion and progress.
- Monitor deadlines and priorities.

3. Employee Attendance
- Record daily attendance.

4. Work Log & Timeline Tracking

6. Approvals & Notifications
