name: Bastion of Olympus
description:
If you've ever wanted to command the gods of Greek mythology, you need to check out Bastion of Olympus. It's an incredibly engaging strategic card battler where ancient myths meet deep tactical gameplay.

The whole core of the game is about building your ultimate pantheon. You crack open Olympian Packs to collect beautifully drawn cards, hunting for everything from common fighters to legendary gods like Zeus. Before you even hit the battlefield, you get to choose your main "Dealer" or leader like the massive Titan Brute to anchor your deck's strategy.

Once your deck is ready, the battles are super satisfying. You drop your cards onto the board, try to outsmart your opponent's layout, and fight for victory. There’s also a ton of variety in how you play. You can grind through the main campaign map in stages like the Titan's Forge, dive into Dungeons for extra loot, or test your skills against other players in the Arena. There's even a locked Gauntlet mode that gives you something to work toward as you get stronger.

Progression feels really smooth, too. You level up your player profile by racking up EXP from your wins, and there's a constant stream of daily and weekly quests to keep the reward chests flowing. And if you want to speed things up or grab some rare cards, the shop has plenty of gem bundles, packs, and special offers to help round out your collection.

Basically, if you love building decks, climbing the ranks, and unleashing divine powers on the board, Bastion of Olympus is completely worth diving into!

name: BatteryBudget
description: BatteryBudget estimates how long a battery or portable power station can run a load. Enter capacity in watt-hours, average load in watts, efficiency, and reserve. View estimated runtime and usable capacity, then save the calculation for later.

name: Battle Stack
description:
Four stacks of reinforcements. An army to command. Every choice changes the battle.

Battle Stack is an offline strategy auto-battler where you choose who fights next. Pick troops from the tops of four reserve stacks, choose where they enter the field, and watch your formations meet the enemy. When a group falls, the action pauses for your next decision.

CHOOSE YOUR NEXT MOVE
Tap a top card for automatic placement, or drag it to deploy on the left, center, or right. Look ahead at upcoming troops, protect your ranged units, and keep the right reinforcements ready. Each group brings 15 individually simulated soldiers to the field.

BUILD AN ARMY THAT WORKS TOGETHER
Unlock 10 unit types, from Swordsmen and Archers to Mages, Clerics, and Paladins. Combine unit formations and the Wolf, Bear, Stag, and Owl banners to activate bonuses. Learn counters and make the most of the soldiers still standing.

UNITE A DIVIDED REALM
Begin as a Wolf thane defending the frontier. Fight through ten campaigns across forests, mountain passes, a coastal harbour, occupied towns, and the capital's approaches. Follow the story through Level 101, with tactical lessons along the way, then keep testing your command in continuing battles.

WIN THROUGH BETTER DECISIONS
Both armies receive the same troop resources and follow the same combat rules. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard to change the opponent's decision-making, with separate progress for each difficulty.

LEARN, REPLAY, EXPERIMENT
Consult the searchable Battle Guide for units, banners, and tactical advice. Replay completed levels in Custom Game with your choice of ten battlegrounds. Hold the battlefield to inspect the action up close.

PLAY ON YOUR TERMS
No internet connection, account, ads, or in-app purchases. Progress stays on your device. Adjust appearance, music, sound effects, haptics, army markers, and unit health bars in Settings.

Hold the field. Make every reinforcement count.

name: BauPawl – Site Diary
description:
Building or renovating? BauPawl records what happens on your site: take a photo, add a short note, done. No account, no ads, your site diary data stays on your device.

How BauPawl helps:
• Record defects and progress with photos, also as before/after
• Keep photos in original quality on your device and mark them with an arrow, circle, rectangle or freehand (the original stays unchanged)
• Assign each entry to a trade and room, note costs, analyse by room, company and trade
• Enter your own dates and deadlines and get reminded by notification (only if you want it)
• Backup as a file, free of charge
• For iPhone and iPad, in German and English

BauPawl Pro (one-time purchase, no subscription):
• PDF report with letterhead, photos and costs
• Defect documentation to pass on: overview, photos in original quality, marked photos and photo index, for example for your lawyer or expert, optionally without location data

BauPawl is free. You unlock the PDF report and defect documentation once with BauPawl Pro (no subscription). The purchase is handled by the App Store. You can restore your purchase at any time in the paywall and in the settings.

No account. Your site diary data stays on your device. Only what you share leaves it. Only purchase information runs through the payment service provider RevenueCat.

Note: BauPawl documents and prepares material. It is not legal advice; legal questions, deadlines and how to proceed are for your lawyer or an advice service.

By René Lakeit, LynxLoft Apps, Hildesheim, Germany. Privacy policy: baupawl.app/datenschutz.html

name: Bay View Church | Methodist
seller_name: Bay View United Methodist Church Inc.
description:
Whether you have been part of our story for years or you are looking for a place where you can belong just as you are—with no asterisks—this app is your digital front door to life together. We are stepping into a vibrant new season focused on radical inclusion, authentic relationships, and making a tangible impact in our Community in Milwaukee.

With our app, you can:
Stream weekly messages and dive into past sermon series that meet you where you are.
Stay effortlessly synced with community events, gatherings, and local service opportunities.
Get notifications so you never miss what is happening next.
Support our shared mission and ministry securely.

Mobile app version: 6.24.8

name: BaZi Natal: Chinese Astrology
description:
Discover the traditional Chinese art of Four Pillars of Destiny (BaZi) with astronomical True Solar Time precision.

BaZi Natal computes your exact Year, Month, Day, and Hour pillars using longitudinal True Solar Time and the 24 Solar Terms—giving you an authentic natal chart rather than generic sun-sign approximations.

WHAT IS INCLUDED FREE
• True Solar Time BaZi Chart: Year, Month, Day, and Hour Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches with hidden stems and Ten Gods.
• Day Master Profile: Understand your core element, polarity, and elemental balance across Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water.
• 10-Year Luck Cycles (Da Yun): See your active decade cycle and life rhythm at a glance.
• 2027 Fire Goat (Ding Wei) Preview: Explore how the 2027 annual pillar interacts with your personal chart and inspect key seasonal months.
• Multi-Chart Library: Save charts for yourself, family, or friends in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese.

OPTIONAL IN-APP PERSONALIZED REPORTS
Unlock deep, personalized readings generated specifically from your calculated BaZi chart and saved in your in-app library with clean A4 PDF export:
• Love & Relationships Report
• Career & Money Report
• 2027 Fire Goat Month-by-Month Guide
• Complete 9-Chapter Natal Chart Report
• Complete Natal + 2027 Guide Bundle

PRIVACY & TRANSPARENCY
Your birth details stay on your device unless you choose to purchase a personalized reading. When you unlock an optional report, only your calculated chart data and chosen delivery email are sent to our server and Google Gemini to compose your reading—never sold or used for ad tracking.

For entertainment and personal self-reflection purposes only.

name: BCMLinx One
description:
Welcome to BCMLinx One!
 
BCMLinx One offers professional, user-friendly apps with a focus on high-quality service and seamless user experience. With a simple interface and continuous updates, we ensure an easy and efficient experience, available 24/7, anytime, anywhere.

BCMLinx One  is a Computer assembly cost estimator

Download the app and enjoy the app.

name: BDEASY
description:
Ton BDE, ses soirées, sa boutique et ta carte d'adhérent, dans une seule app.

BDEASY réunit toute la vie de ton Bureau des Étudiants. Tu choisis ton école, tu te connectes, et tu retrouves ce que ton BDE publie, sans groupe WhatsApp ni Google Form.

LES SOIRÉES
Toutes les soirées et sorties de ton BDE, avec la billetterie. Tu prends ta place en deux clics et ton billet t'attend dans l'app, avec son QR code prêt à scanner à l'entrée.

LA BOUTIQUE
Sweats, places, adhésion : tu commandes depuis ton téléphone et tu récupères ta commande en un scan. Les adhérents voient leurs prix réduits.

TA CARTE D'ADHÉRENT
Ta carte de membre, toujours sur toi. Tes billets, tes points et tes avantages au même endroit.

LE FIL
Annonces, sondages, photos : tout ce que publie ton BDE, au moment où il le publie, avec les notifications.

LE HUB
L'entraide du campus : jobs, logement, covoiturage, bons plans entre étudiants.

LE RESTO U ET TON AGENDA
Les menus du Resto U et les événements du BDE dans un seul calendrier.

POUR LE BUREAU
Le président lance l'app de son BDE en quelques minutes : sa carte, son équipe, ses premiers posts. Le bureau publie, vend, scanne les billets à l'entrée et valide les membres, depuis le même téléphone.

L'accès est réservé aux étudiants de chaque école : chaque BDE valide ses membres.

name: Beach Outfit
description: Plan what to wear from the first swim to sunset dinner. Turn editorial beachwear into outfits from your own closet, compare dry layers and backup looks, and pack each piece with a clear reason to bring it.

name: Beastguard: Last Stand
description:
Beastguard: Last Stand places one beast at the bottom of a lane. The beast fires straight up by itself. Drag it left or right to aim. Monsters walk down the lane, and each monster that reaches the base removes health. The fight stops at 0 health.

Twelve levels are listed. Levels 1 and 2 last 3 waves. Levels 3 and 4 last 4 waves. Levels 5, 6, and 7 last 5 waves. Levels 8, 9, and 10 last 6 waves. Levels 11 and 12 last 7 waves. A new install can start only level 1. Clearing a level opens the next one. Endless Survival opens after level 3 and keeps sending waves until the base falls.

Rabbit is available immediately. Tiger opens after level 3, Snake after level 6, and Dragon after level 10. Coins from a cleared level, the 7-day sign-in, or an achievement raise that beast's attack or its attack speed, each as far as level 10. Freeze, Bomb, Rage, and Shield are bought with those coins and used during a fight. There is no account, no payment, and no network use.

name: Bee Driver Auto-école
description:
Bee Driver est l'application de l'auto-école Bee Driver, organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi. Elle réunit au même endroit ce qui compte pendant votre formation au permis, et ce dont l'équipe a besoin pour vous accompagner.

L'application est réservée aux élèves de Bee Driver, à leurs responsables légaux et à l'équipe. Votre compte est créé lors de votre inscription chez Bee Driver.

POUR L'ÉLÈVE

Votre chemin du permis
Cinq étapes, de l'inscription à l'examen : dossier, code, heures de conduite, compétences du livret, examen. Vous voyez où vous en êtes et ce qui vous arrête encore, avec le geste qui le lève.

Vos leçons
Réservez un créneau parmi les disponibilités proposées par votre moniteur, annulez une leçon, retrouvez la prochaine. Vos leçons peuvent s'ajouter à l'agenda de votre téléphone.

Vos heures
Heures prévues, heures faites et heures restantes de votre formule, heures de simulateur comprises.

Votre dossier
Photographiez vos pièces, ajoutez votre photo d'identité, signez vos documents. Vous voyez ce qui est reçu et ce qui manque.

Votre livret
Votre progression compétence par compétence, mise à jour par votre moniteur.

Vos paiements
Vos factures, ce qui est payé et ce qui reste dû. Le paiement par carte passe par la page sécurisée de Stripe, en une ou plusieurs fois selon votre formule.

Vos messages
Écrivez à l'équipe depuis l'application et retrouvez ses réponses. Les notifications vous rappellent vos leçons et les documents à fournir.

POUR LES PARENTS

Le responsable légal d'un élève mineur suit son dossier, ses leçons et sa progression depuis son propre espace.

POUR L'ÉQUIPE BEE DRIVER

Moniteurs salariés et indépendants : la journée, le planning, l'émargement des leçons, le bilan de leçon dicté à la voix, la prise du véhicule et le pointage, les heures et les documents personnels. Le moniteur indépendant gère ses élèves et ses disponibilités.

Secrétariat : la journée de travail avec ce qui attend un geste, les élèves, le planning, les examens, les contrats et les factures, les préinscriptions à rappeler.

VOS DONNÉES

Aucune publicité, aucun suivi publicitaire. Vos données servent à votre formation. La politique de confidentialité se lit dans l'application et sur app.beedriver.fr/confidentialite. Vous pouvez demander la fermeture de votre compte depuis votre profil.

À PROPOS DE BEE DRIVER

Auto-école basée à Argenteuil, en Île-de-France, Bee Driver forme au permis B en boîte manuelle et automatique, au permis moto A2 et à la formation 125. Plus de 500 avis d'élèves, note moyenne de 4,98 sur 5.

name: BeeEcho English
description:
BeeEcho English helps you sound more natural in English through shadowing: listen to a clear American voice, read the same sentence aloud, and get instant, detailed feedback.

HOW IT WORKS
• Listen to the model reading — at a natural pace or slowed down.
• Read it back. BeeEcho listens and scores how you sound.
• See which words and which sounds need work, then replay the model and your own take side by side.

FEEDBACK YOU CAN ACT ON
• Every sound scored against American English, not just a single overall number.
• Word completeness, intonation and timing, so you know whether you dropped words, sounded flat or rushed.
• Tap a word to hear the model and yourself and compare the difference.
• A missed-sounds list that shows the sounds you get wrong most often.
• Fair and consistent: the same recording always gets the same score.

PRACTISE WHAT MATTERS TO YOU
• Ready-made passages for everyday conversation, work and study.
• Write or paste your own text — a speech, a presentation, an interview answer — and practise reading it.
• Let AI draft a passage on any topic for you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your recordings are scored and never kept.
• Delete your account and all your data at any time from inside the app.

Made for learners who already know the words but want to say them clearly and confidently.

name: Beeper Box
description:
Beeper Box watches the signals that matter on your servers, and this app puts them in your pocket.

See every host's CPU, memory, disk, and network at a glance, open a host for the full charts, and switch teams in a tap. Search logs and traces with the same filters as the web dashboard. Watch your uptime monitors, open a status page, and see which alerts are firing right now.

Home Screen widgets keep the numbers in view: uptime for a team, firing alerts, host status, monthly usage, or one pinned monitor. The Apple Watch app lists your monitors and adds an uptime complication to your watch face. Push notifications reach you when a team's notification group is set to push.

Beeper Box is a companion to the Beeper Box service. Sign in with your Beeper Box account (create one free at beeperbox.com). Hosts report through the Beeper Box agent for Linux; logs and traces ship from your applications.

Requires iOS 26 or later. Apple Watch app requires watchOS 26 or later.

name: BeerBox: Beer Log & Tracker
description:
BeerBox lets you log the beers you drink with a photo of the can, and lines them up in a fridge on your screen.

Never wonder "Have I had this one before? What did I think of it?" again.
Snap a can and its background is cut out automatically, then it joins the rows of your glass-shelf fridge. Drink the same beer again and it stays a single entry, with every date, rating and note stacking up.

■ Features
・Fridge view — your cans line up on glass shelves. Long-press and drag to rearrange
・Automatic can cut-out — take a photo or pick one from your library. Works with bottles and glasses too
・Color-coded by style — Lager, Pale Ale, IPA, Wheat, Dark, Sour, Non-Alcoholic
・Drink log — a star rating plus color, aroma, palate, finish and how you drank it, almost all with taps. Add as many as you like; see the average rating and how many times you've had it
・Aroma picker — choose where the aroma comes from (hops, malt, roast, fruit, yeast), then tap the closest ones
・Brewery, ABV, size and price — optional details for every beer
・List view — sort by recently had, most had or highest rated. Total drinks and this month's count are tallied for you
・Easy search — filter by name, brewery, style, aroma and palate words, or notes
・Share your fridge — export it as a single image for social media or messages
・Widgets — see your recent beers on the Home Screen and Lock Screen
・Backup — export and import via Files, photos included
・iPad support — made for the big screen as well as iPhone
・Light and Dark Mode

■ Free, no ads
Every feature is free to use. There are no ads.

■ Great for
・Anyone who likes trying craft beers and new releases
・People who want to jot down what they thought of a beer, quickly
・Anyone who wants to look back at "the ones I loved"
・Anyone who enjoys looking over a collection of cans they've drunk

■ Private by design
Everything you enter stays on your iPhone. No account required, nothing is ever sent anywhere.

This app does not encourage drinking. Please drink responsibly and never drink and drive.

name: Beezifi Authenticator
description:
Beezifi Authenticator keeps your two-factor codes and passwords in one encrypted vault on your iPhone. Unlock it with Face ID, Touch ID or a master password, whichever you prefer.

TWO-FACTOR CODES
• Scan a QR code, choose a screenshot from Photos, or type the setup key
• Move your accounts from Google Authenticator with its "Transfer accounts" QR code
• A live countdown on every code, and the next code shown before it changes
• Tap to copy. Copied codes clear from the clipboard on their own
• Favorites, search and sorting
• Works with sites that use standard time-based (TOTP) or counter-based (HOTP) codes, including 8-digit and SHA-256/SHA-512 codes

PASSWORDS
• Logins, payment cards and secure notes
• Link a login to its two-factor code and see both together
• Password history for every login
• A generator for random passwords, easy-to-type passphrases and PINs, with a strength meter

AUTOFILL
• Fill passwords in Safari and apps right from the keyboard
• Fill verification codes automatically on iOS 18 and later
• Every fill asks for Face ID, Touch ID or your master password first

SECURITY CHECK
• Find weak, reused and old passwords at a glance
• A security score with recommendations, worked out on your iPhone

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
• Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID, or type your master password each time
• Change your choice whenever you like
• Auto-lock after a time you choose, and whenever your iPhone locks
• Contents hidden in the App Switcher
• Longer waits after repeated wrong passwords

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• AES-256 encryption, with the key protected by your master password
• No account, no servers, no ads and no tracking. Nothing leaves your iPhone unless you export it
• Your vault stays on this iPhone. Encrypted backups, protected by a password you choose, move it to a new one

Free. No subscription and no in-app purchases.

name: Before You Print
description: Made for 3D printing. Offline estimators for filament and resin usage, cost, and time—plus materials and quick tips—before you hit print. Free forever: no ads, no purchases, no account.

name: BellCut — Ringtone Maker
description:
Make custom iPhone ringtones from videos, audio files, and recordings.

• Pull audio from a video in Photos.
• Open audio from Files or record your own voice.
• Trim up to 30 seconds with a waveform editor.
• Add a fade in or fade out.
• Export a ringtone and use it for a call or regular alarm.

Your one-time purchase includes unlimited exports.

name: Berber Randevu Yöneticisi
description:
Berber Randevu Yöneticisi, berberler ve kuaförler için sade bir randevu takip uygulamasıdır.

• Günlük görünüm: Bugünün randevularını, sıradaki müşteriyi ve boş saatleri tek bakışta görün.
• Haftalık görünüm: Haftanın tamamını takvimde görün, boş saatlere dokunarak hızlıca randevu ekleyin.
• Müşteri takibi: Müşteri adı, süre ve hizmet bilgisini kaydedin; daha önce girilen müşteri adlarını önerilerden seçin.
• Durum takibi: Randevuları geldi, gelmedi, planlı veya iptal olarak işaretleyin.
• Hatırlatma bildirimleri: Randevudan önce, seçtiğiniz sürede cihazınıza bildirim gelsin.
• Ayarlanabilir çalışma saatleri ve randevu aralığı: Açılış-kapanış saatlerinizi ve müşteri aralığını (15–60 dk) kendinize göre belirleyin.

Gizlilik: Tüm kayıtlar yalnızca bu cihazda saklanır. Hesap açmanız ya da sunucuya veri göndermeniz gerekmez.

Geri bildirim için Ayarlar > Geliştiriciye istek gönder bölümünü kullanabilirsiniz.

name: Bereia EBD
description:
O Bereia EBD foi criado para igrejas que desejam organizar a Escola Bíblica Dominical com praticidade e engajar alunos de todas as idades de um jeito divertido.
Para Alunos (Gamificação & Engajamento)XP, Nível e Ofensiva: Acumule XP, avance de nível e mantenha sua sequência de aulas seguidas sem perder o ritmo.   
Ranking e Parabéns: Acompanhe sua posição no ranking da EBD e veja quem te parabenizou.   
Missões e Leituras Semanais: Complete Desafios para ganhar XP e acompanhe seu progresso nas Leituras Semanais por lição e turma.   
Para Liderança e Professores (Gestão Completa)Painel da Igreja: Visualize o resumo da EBD, turmas, alunos, professores, vagas utilizadas e prévia dos campeões.   
Chamada e Relatórios: Faça a chamada por turma, registre presença, visitantes e ofertas, e acompanhe relatórios por turma, EBD consolidado ou equipe (com visualizações em gráficos, planilha e exportação em PDF).   
Caixa e Configurações: Controle entradas, saídas e lançamentos por turma ou período, além de configurar dados da igreja, chave PIX da EBD para doações e plano de vagas.

name: Bernadoo Stashbook
description:
Know what's in every box without opening one.

Stashbook is a catalogue of the things you keep in storage: the garage, the attic, a storage unit, the boxes from the last move. Photograph each box as you pack it, note what's inside, and stick on a label. Months later, search for the thing you need and Stashbook tells you which box it is in, and where.

LOCATIONS, ITEMS, PHOTOS
• A location is a place, like "Garage" or "Storage Room 1".
• An item is a box or a single thing kept there, with a name and notes.
• Add as many photos as you like, from the camera or your library, with a note on each.
• Browse a location as a photo gallery, with each item's photos grouped under its name.

FIND ANYTHING
• One search covers every location: item names, notes and photo notes.
• Results show which location each item is in.

A LABEL ON EVERY BOX
• Every item gets a label with its name and a QR code.
• Scan a label in the app, or with the iPhone Camera, to see what's inside.
• Print on Avery 5163, 5164 or 5160 sheets, one item or a whole location at a time.
• Start at any position, so a partly used sheet is not wasted.
• Move an item to another location and its label keeps working.

DECIDE WHAT HAPPENS TO IT
• Give each item a plan: keep, give to charity, sell, move elsewhere or throw away.
• Add plans of your own, with their own icons and colours.
• Filter a location by plan when it is time to clear it out.

TAKE IT WITH YOU
• Back up the whole catalogue, photos included, as one zip file, and import it on any iPhone.
• Export a CSV spreadsheet for Numbers, Excel or Google Sheets.
• Import a spreadsheet, yours or one you made, to add and update items in bulk.

FIND THE PLACE AGAIN
• If you allow it, a photo remembers where it was taken, with a link to that spot in Apple Maps.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your catalogue and photos stay on your phone.
• No account, no subscription, no ads, no analytics.
• Included in your iPhone's own backup.

FREE TO START
• Free for a catalogue of up to 8 items, with every feature.
• Unlimited Items is a one-time purchase that removes the limit, shared through Family Sharing.
• If you never buy it, everything already in your catalogue stays fully usable.

name: Berthlight
description:
Berthlight is a portrait harbor game .

Draft three beacon families. Place them on a 3D quay. Fuse three matching lights into a taller one. Salt counts as a wild. Raise a net, a lamp, or a chain along a lane, then sound the foghorn. The lights pulse on their own. Taller lights reach farther up their own lane. Dim the rival crown, or lead on living beacon height when the tide locks.

Five harbors open in order: Stillwater, Glassmouth, Riptide Cut, Moonstep, and Black Keel. Each adds one pressure of its own — fog on a rank, a lane that slides, a moon swell, or a keel tax. Open Water keeps dealing new swells from a seed kept on this device. Tonight’s Fog is one local board for the calendar day, with a best hold stored only here.

Holds are graded Shoal, Channel, Deep, or Abyss against the par for that water. There is no account, no chat, and nothing to type. A keeper name is offered, and you can ask for another. Holds, settings, and tide marks stay on the device.

The Fuse Bench is a quiet place to practice a stack, with no score. The Keel Primer is there when you want the words. The quay itself does the teaching.

name: Besishahar Municipality
description:
Besishahar Municipality brings the municipality's citizen services to your phone.

• Apply for sifaris (recommendation) certificates and download the issued letter as a PDF
• Submit grievances and feedback to the municipality
• Share your experience with the service you received through the satisfaction survey
• Track your applications from one place
• Create an account, and delete it at any time from Settings

This app is built and operated by NINJA INFOSYS, a private company, to help citizens apply for services provided by Besishahar Municipality.

---

बेसीशहर नगरपालिकाका नागरिक सेवाहरू अब तपाईंको मोबाइलमा।

• सिफारिसका लागि आवेदन दिनुहोस् र जारी पत्र PDF मा डाउनलोड गर्नुहोस्
• नगरपालिकामा गुनासो तथा सुझाव पठाउनुहोस्
• पाएको सेवाबारे सन्तुष्टि सर्वेक्षणमा आफ्नो अनुभव राख्नुहोस्
• आफ्ना आवेदनहरू एकै ठाउँबाट हेर्नुहोस्
• खाता खोल्नुहोस्, र चाहेको बेला सेटिङबाट खाता मेटाउनुहोस्

यो एप निजी कम्पनी निन्जा इन्फोसिसद्वारा बनाइएको र सञ्चालित हो, जसले नागरिकलाई बेसीशहर नगरपालिकाका सेवाका लागि आवेदन दिन सहज बनाउँछ।

name: BevelWax--Layer Faceting
description:
Astu rauhalliseen vahapajaan, jossa jokainen kappale alkaa pehmeänä särmiönä ja viimeistellään tarkasti suljetuksi pinnaksi.

Valitse aihio hyllystä, tutki mallipiirustusta ja kierrä sitten veitsen suuntavalitsinta. Kahdeksan suuntaa, yksi kerros kerrallaan. Esikatsele leikattavaa aluetta ennen vahvistamista. Suojatut pinnat pysyvät turvassa, joten voit keskittyä tarkkuuteen arvailun sijaan.

Mintunvihreät, korallinpunaiset ja liilanväriset aihiot vaativat kukin omanlaisensa työskentelyrytmin. Ensimmäisissä luvuissa harjoittelet siistien reunojen muotoilua. Myöhemmissä tehtävissä yhdistelet erivärisiä kappaleita toisiinsa sopiviksi kokonaisuuksiksi. Kerää mestarimerkkejä, palaa aiempiin muistiinpanoihin ja jatka keskeneräisiä töitä milloin haluat.

BevelWax on rauhallinen avaruudellinen pulmapeli, jossa yhdistyvät kärsivällisyys, suuntien hahmottaminen ja onnistumisen ilo, kun lopputulos vastaa vihdoin mallia.

name: Beweginc
description:
Beweeg samen met je collega’s voor een goed doel. Met Beweginc doe je mee aan beweeguitdagingen van je organisatie en zie je wat jullie samen bijdragen.

• Kies een goed doel uit de campagnes van je organisatie.
• Doe mee aan beweeguitdagingen en registreer je activiteiten.
• Volg je eigen voortgang en de gezamenlijke impact van je team.
• Bekijk teamactiviteiten en moedig je collega’s aan.

Je hebt een medewerkersaccount nodig. De beschikbare uitdagingen en goede doelen worden bepaald door je organisatie.

name: Beyond Arrival
seller_name: Shanghai Shangtu Education Technology Co., Ltd

name: Bezar
description:
Bezar — sevimli klassik stolüstü oyunları və maraqlı sosial ünsiyyəti bir araya gətirən müasir platformadır! Burada həm real rəqiblərlə onlayn yarışa, həm də yeni insanlarla tanış olub fikirlərini paylaşa bilərsən.

NƏLƏR SƏNİ GÖZLƏYİR?

• Klassik Oyunlar Bir Arada: Nərd, Domino, Loto və Şaşki oyunlarını canlı rəqiblərlə real vaxt rejimində oyna. Sürətli axtarış sistemi saniyələr içində sənə uyğun rəqib tapır.
• Sosial Lent və Hekayələr: Gündəlik anlarını paylaş, digər istifadəçilərin paylaşımlarını kəşf et, bəyən və fikirlərini bildir.
• Yeni Dostluqlar və Ünsiyyət: Oyun zamanı və ya profillər üzərindən dostluq sorğuları göndər, statistikalarını müqayisə et və aktiv icmanın bir parçası ol.
• Fərdi Dizayn və Temalar: VIP, Premium və Elite oyun taxtaları, zərlər və vizual mövzularla oyun təcrübəni öz zövqünə uyğunlaşdır.
• Təhlükəsiz və Rahat Mühit: İstifadəçi şikayət və bloklama mexanizmləri sayəsində sağlam və nəzarət olunan ünsiyyət mühiti.

İstər vaxtını maraqlı oyunlarla dəyərləndirmək, istərsə də yeni dostlar qazanmaq istəyirsənsə — Bezar-ı yüklə və elə indi oyuna qoşul!

name: Bible Cryptogram: Verse Puzzle
description:
Unwind in peaceful daily reflection and keep your mind sharp with Bible Cryptogram: Verse Puzzle — a calm, extra-large-print Christian word puzzle crafted for iPhone and iPad.

Each level gently encodes an inspiring Scripture passage from Psalms, Proverbs, the Gospels, or the Epistles using a classic number-to-letter substitution cipher. Match numbers to letters, uncover cherished words of faith, grace, and wisdom, and reveal the complete Bible verse at your own unhurried pace.

Whether you enjoy morning devotional time, classic newspaper cryptograms, codeword logic puzzles, or gentle daily brain training, Bible Cryptogram welcomes adults and seniors with clear readability and serene sanctuary artwork.

HOW TO PLAY
• Every number from 1 to 26 represents one unique letter across the hidden Scripture verse.
• Tap any blank tile and use the oversized, high-contrast keyboard to fill in matching letters everywhere that number appears.
• Completed letters dim automatically on the keyboard so you can effortlessly see what remains.
• Switch between Short Verse and Full Verse Challenge anytime, or use the Reading Lens magnifier for effortless close-up comfort.
• Need a gentle nudge? Tap a Lightbulb Hint or Number Burst anytime to reveal helpful letters and keep your flow calm and frustration-free.

DESIGNED FOR PEACE, COMFORT & SENIOR READABILITY
• 5 Beloved Bible Translations: Read and decode verses in BSB, KJV, WEB, ASV, or YLT — switch editions anytime with a single tap.
• Extra-Large Print for iPhone & iPad: Oversized bold lettering, generous tile spacing, crisp contrast, and a dedicated Large-Print Easy Read mode tailored for comfortable reading on both iPhone and iPad displays.
• Daily Verse Challenge Calendar: Return each morning for a fresh Daily Scripture puzzle, build your monthly streak, and earn bonus coins.
• Saved Verses Journal: Bookmark favorite decoded passages with one tap to revisit whenever you want encouragement, or share a beautifully framed Scripture Card with friends and family.
• 6 Serene Sacred Art Backdrops: Unlock and display stained-glass and oil-painted biblical sanctuary scenes as you progress.
• Zero Timers & Soothing Audio: Play with no countdown clocks and enjoy calming acoustic piano and harp music you can adjust anytime in Settings.
• Instant Play: Jump straight into your puzzle with no account or sign-up required.

Rediscover cherished passages of Scripture one letter at a time. Download Bible Cryptogram: Verse Puzzle today for a peaceful daily moment of faith, focus, and classic word puzzle joy!

name: Bible in a Verse
description:
Open the app and today's readings are waiting: the day in the Church's calendar, the Gospel, the verse of the day and the saints remembered today. Swipe up for the next verse. Tap when you want to understand it more deeply.

The 73 books of the Catholic Bible in two public-domain translations, one verse per screen:
• Douay-Rheims (1899 American edition)
• World English Bible, Catholic edition, a modern English translation
• Compare any verse in both translations

For Catholics who want to pray with the Mass readings each day, read the Bible from Genesis to Revelation, or pray the Rosary with Scripture in front of them.

TODAY
• The liturgical day and its colour (United States calendar)
• Today's Mass readings, opened in the translation you choose
• Verse of the day, also as a home screen widget
• The saints of the day

READ
• One verse at a time, chapter after chapter
• Random verse, auto-scroll, search
• Share a verse as text or as an image card
• Four themes, or let the colour follow the liturgical season
• Background sounds: rain, a garden, a stream and hymns on the pipe organ

PRAY
• The Rosary: a ring of beads you turn one by one, with the mysteries of the day, their Scripture and fruit
• Traditional prayers: the Memorare, the Angelus, the St Michael prayer, the Act of Contrition and more
• Angelus reminders at 6, 12 and 18 o'clock, and reminders for holy days of obligation

PREMIUM
• Explain it easier, verse by verse
• Deeper study: Catechism references, the Church Fathers on the Gospels, and where a passage is read at Mass
• The Hebrew, Greek and Latin words
• Related verses across the Bible
• Reading plans with progress and a journal: the Bible in a year, the Gospels in 30 days, the Psalms, Advent, Lent, Easter and preparing for Sunday's readings
• A daily lectio divina on the Gospel, and past reflections
• The Scriptural Rosary: a verse of the mystery with each Hail Mary
• Rosary bead materials, colours and sounds, and your Rosary statistics
• Listen to the Douay-Rheims and the prayers of the Rosary, read aloud, at the speed you choose
• Save likes, verses and notes on all your phones
• Every background sound and your own mix

ABOUT THE NOTES
The Bible text is shown exactly as published. The study notes and reflections are written with the help of AI; Catechism references and quotations from the Fathers are checked against their sources. The notes cover every verse of the Douay-Rheims. In the World English Bible, Tobit, Judith and Sirach, translated there from a different Greek text, have no notes.

No ads. Signing in is optional; you only need it to keep your likes, notes and plans on more than one phone.

Premium is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, charged to your Apple account. It renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your account settings.

Terms of Use: https://bibleinaverse-app.web.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://bibleinaverse-app.web.app/privacy.html

name: BIKE RUSHI
description:
Race forward on your bike, time your jumps, and clear deadly obstacles across 50 levels in 5 worlds. Tap to jump—up to three times in the air—dodge spikes, gaps, and traps, collect coins, unlock bikes and outfits, and claim daily rewards. Fast, addictive side-scrolling bike parkour for iPhone and iPad.

Short (App Store subtitle style)
Jump, dodge, and rush through 50 bike parkour levels.

Longer (App Store description)
Hit the road in BIKE RUSH—a fast side-scrolling bike parkour game. Your bike races ahead automatically while you focus on perfect jumps. Chain up to three mid-air jumps, dodge spikes and barriers, clear gaps, and reach the finish line.

Explore five worlds and 50 levels, from green hills to sky challenges. Earn coins, unlock new bikes and outfits in the shop, and come back for daily rewards. Simple one-tap controls, sharp obstacle course action, and endless rush—how far can you go?

name: Bill Tape
description:
Bill Tape is for the person who counts a drawer before closing, with no register account. Write the float, then drag the twenty down the tape. Each full drag adds 20 to the counted amount. The tape shows Short, Over, or Level against that float. Close the drawer and the count stays on this iPhone. Open it later from Closed.

It does not connect to a register, deposit money, or compute tax. The amounts are the ones you write and drag. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Billard Gravité
description:
Une horloge vivante pour votre poignet. Dix boules de billard roulent sur l'écran, rebondissent et s'entrechoquent — et c'est l'inclinaison de votre poignet qui les fait rouler, comme sur une vraie table.

• L'heure et la date restent toujours lisibles au centre.
• Touchez l'écran : la « casse » disperse les boules.
• Appui long : choisissez le nombre de boules (2 à 10) et le thème, billard classique ou néon lumineux.
• Une complication vous ouvre l'app directement depuis votre cadran.
• Le niveau de batterie s'affiche discrètement.

En mode Toujours activé, l'animation se met en pause et l'heure reste affichée. Billard Gravité est une application, elle ne remplace pas les cadrans Apple.

name: Bingo Brigadot
description:
Every number is a rescue decision.

Bingo Brigadot brings Bingo-style line building to a single-player fire rescue puzzle. Oakwood needs your help: choose between two offered numbers, mark your card, and use the supplies you earn to protect buildings and bring residents to safety.

BUILD LINES. CALL IN SUPPORT.
Complete a row to earn a fire engine, a column to gain water and cool burning buildings, or a diagonal to call in an air drop. Each line pays out once, so look ahead before you choose your next number.

PLAN AROUND THE FIRE
Check the forecast and wind direction before the next fire wave. Spend water on a targeted hose action, dispatch an earned engine, or use a Wild to mark the square you need. Support actions do not use ordinary picks, and there is no turn timer.

HELP OAKWOOD THROUGH 20 MISSIONS
Work through a district of rescue challenges with limited picks and changing fire conditions. Meet each mission's resident target, protect the clinic when required, and improve your best results to earn up to three stars.

THREE VEHICLES, DIFFERENT ADVANTAGES
Start with Classic Red and its stronger hose. Complete Mission 5 to unlock Midnight Blue's longer cooling protection, then Mission 11 to unlock Ivory's extra starting water and Wild. Choose the vehicle that suits your approach.

LEARN, RESCUE, RETURN
A hands-on tutorial introduces Bingo lines, the forecast, the hose and the engine. Your mission progress, unlocked vehicles and best results are saved on your device, ready for your next rescue.

Play offline, on your own, at your own pace. No account required.

name: Bismillah: Prayer & Quran
description:
Bismillah is a calm, beautiful companion for your daily worship. Prayer times from 21 calculation methods, the complete Holy Quran, the Qibla, duas and dhikr, on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and in Messages.

No ads. No account. No tracking. Prayer times are calculated on your device, and your location never leaves it.

PRAYER TIMES FOR YOUR CITY
• 21 calculation methods, including Umm al-Qura, Muslim World League, ISNA, Egyptian, Karachi, Tehran, JAKIM (Malaysia), Kemenag (Indonesia), Diyanet (Turkey), Singapore, France, Russia, Dubai, Qatar, Kuwait and more, plus custom angles
• Chosen automatically for your country, and adjustable at any time
• Hanafi or Shafi'i Asr, high-latitude rules, Hijri date adjustment
• Works in every time zone, including daylight saving and the date line
• Midnight and the last third of the night for Tahajjud

GENTLE, CUSTOM REMINDERS
• An alert for each prayer, at the time or a few minutes before
• Jumu'ah and Surah Al-Kahf on Fridays
• Suhoor and Iftar in Ramadan, Tahajjud, Duha, morning and evening adhkar
• Monday, Thursday and white-day sunnah fasts
• A verse of the day, morning or evening

LIVE ACTIVITY AND WIDGETS
• A Lock Screen and Dynamic Island countdown to the next prayer, with the day's timeline and Hijri date
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets in every size
• "Hayya 'ala as-salah" when the time comes

THE HOLY QURAN
• All 114 surahs in clear Uthmani script (Tanzil), set in the Amiri Quran typeface
• English translation by Marmaduke Pickthall
• Search in Arabic or English, bookmarks and "continue reading"
• Fully offline

QIBLA
• A clear compass pointing to the Kaaba from wherever you are

DISCOVER
• Reflect: a verse to ponder, with guidance on Salat al-Istikhara
• Quranic duas organised by theme
• Tasbih counter with haptics, and the 99 Names of Allah with meanings
• Islamic calendar: Ramadan, Eid, the Day of Arafah, Ashura and more
• Prayer tracker with streaks and qada count
• Zakat calculator using gold and silver nisab
• Nearby mosques on the map

APPLE WATCH
• A 24-hour day dial showing every prayer, the time now and a live countdown
• Complications for your watch face
• Tasbih with the Digital Crown
• Works without your iPhone nearby

IMESSAGE
• Islamic stickers for Eid, Ramadan, Jumu'ah and everyday greetings
• Share today's prayer times or a verse as a beautiful card

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• 21 languages, including English, Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Kurdish, Pashto, Sindhi, Indonesian, Malay, Turkish, Azerbaijani, Uzbek, Kazakh, Bengali, Hindi, Malayalam, Tamil, Swahili, Hausa, Somali and French
• Full right-to-left layout, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type up to the largest sizes, dark mode and iPad layouts

May Allah accept your prayers.

Quran text: Tanzil Project (tanzil.net), used under CC BY 3.0 without changes. Translation: M. M. Pickthall (public domain). Prayer time calculation: Adhan (MIT). Amiri Quran font: SIL Open Font License.

name: Bitaqa Tunisie
description:
Bitaqa transforme chaque rencontre de votre équipe en lead qualifié dans votre CRM.

Votre carte de visite digitale
- Partagez-la par QR code, par lien, par e-mail ou par WhatsApp. Votre contact n'a pas besoin d'installer d'application.
- QR code hors ligne : il contient vos coordonnées et marche sans internet.
- Liens, réseaux sociaux, vidéo et galerie photos, dans l'ordre que vous choisissez.
- Activez votre carte ou votre porte-clé NFC Bitaqa avec son code.
- Ajoutez votre carte à Apple Wallet.

Ne perdez plus un seul contact
- Les personnes qui vous laissent leurs coordonnées arrivent dans Contacts.
- Scanner IA : photographiez une carte de visite ou un badge de salon. Le nom, la société, l'e-mail, le téléphone, l'événement et la catégorie du badge sont remplis pour vous.
- Ajoutez un lead à la main, avec une note.
- Notification à chaque nouveau contact.

Sachez qui rappeler en premier
- L'IA donne à chaque lead un score sur 100 : froid, tiède, fort ou chaud.
- Le détail du score : ce qui correspond à votre client cible et les signes d'intérêt.
- Enrichissement IA : trouvez l'e-mail pro, l'e-mail perso ou le mobile qui manque.

Du rendez-vous au CRM, sans ressaisie
- Envoyez vos leads vers HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Odoo, Dolibarr ou Zapier.
- Historique de chaque envoi.
- Export des leads en vCard ou Excel.

Pour les équipes
- Une carte par collaborateur, des équipes avec leur responsable.
- Les leads de chaque équipe et de chaque carte.
- Nom, logo et image de couverture de l'entreprise, appliqués à toutes les cartes.

Statistiques
- Vues du profil, clics sur chaque lien, nouveaux contacts, sur la période de votre choix.
- Widgets sur l'écran d'accueil et l'écran verrouillé, et une app Apple Watch avec votre QR code et vos nouveaux leads.

L'app est en français et en anglais.
Le compte gratuit comprend une carte, 6 liens, le QR code et les statistiques de base. Le scanner IA, le score, l'enrichissement, les CRM, les équipes, la vidéo et la galerie, Wallet, les widgets et la montre font partie du compte Pro de votre entreprise.

Bitaqa est une société tunisienne basée à Sousse. Plus de 200 entreprises utilisent Bitaqa. Une question ? contact@bitaqa.tn

name: Bizzard
description:
Bizzard is the internal ERP app of Mentorcrafts for staff and administrators. Accounts are created by an administrator inside the app, so there is no public sign-up. Sign in with an email and a password on the first screen.

We provide three test accounts, one for each role. Each role sees different modules.

1) Super Admin (full access)
Email: testsuperadmin@mentorcrafts.com
Password: password123
Sees every module: Tasks, Projects, HR (Staff, Attendance, Leave), Payroll, Invoices, Income and Expense, GST report, Announcements and Settings.

2) Admin
Email: testadmin@mentorcrafts.com
Password: password123
Sees the management modules assigned to admins, such as Tasks, Projects, Staff, Attendance, Leave and Invoices.

3) Employee
Email: emel@mentorcrafts.com
Password: password123
Sees only personal modules: My Tasks, My Attendance, Leave requests, Salary and Profile.

How to test:
- Sign in, then open Tasks from the bottom bar.
- From Home, open Quick access to reach Invoices, Attendance and Leave.
- To check leave approval, sign in as the Employee and request leave, then sign in as the Super Admin and approve it.

The app uses the internet to load live data from our server. No payment or in-app purchase is involved. The app collects only the data needed for work: account details, attendance, tasks and leave.

name: Bizzefy Team
description:
Bizzefy Team is for two groups of people: anyone who wants to refer local businesses to Bizzefy, and the people who work at Bizzefy. Business owners use our other app, Bizzefy.

Bizzefy looks after local businesses' websites, Google profiles, reviews and social posts.

REFER A BUSINESS
• Join in a minute with your name, email and a password. No business needed
• Share your personal link, or add a business yourself
• Only refer businesses that agreed to hear from Bizzefy
• See where each one stands: received, in touch, joined

EARNINGS
• See what you have earned, what has been paid to you, and what is still owed
• You earn a flat amount for each business you sent that joins, once its first payment to Bizzefy is collected. The current amount is shown in the app
• Bizzefy pays you directly, outside the app, and records each payment here
• Nothing is bought or sold in the app

FOR THE BIZZEFY TEAM
• Home: what is waiting on the team right now
• Work: every client's requests in one list, urgent first
• Reviews: write a reply; the owner approves it before anything is posted
• Messages: owners waiting on a reply
• Clients: each business at a glance, with one tap to call or email
• Team logins are by invitation from Bizzefy

You can delete your account at any time from inside the app.

name: Black Screen Camera - Album
description:
A dim-screen camera that saves captures in this app — not in system Photos. Tap to shoot, dim or turn off the preview, and organize with in-app folders.

Built for quick, low-distraction capture: gesture shooting, optional volume-key shutter, and in-app folders you organize yourself. Captures are saved in this app.

DIM-SCREEN CAMERA
• Tap once to take a photo
• Hold for video or burst (Pro)
• Dim or turn off the live preview in Settings
• Optional volume-key capture for one-handed shutter
• Front or rear camera, flash and zoom presets
• Optional haptic feedback when a shot lands

CUSTOM BACKGROUND (Pro)
• Show a photo on screen while you shoot — pick one that blends in
• Stay in the app while you shoot

SAVED IN THIS APP
• Every capture is saved in this app — not in system Photos
• Organize with folders and tidy tags
• Browse, preview, and manage photos and videos in one place
• Photos and in-app storage do not require Pro

PRO UNLOCKS
• Hold to record video
• Burst photo for fast moments
• Custom screen background while shooting
• One-time lifetime purchase available in the app

WHY THIS APP
• Dim-screen shooting when you want a quieter display
• Gesture and volume-key capture for speed
• In-app folders — no account required
• Photos are saved in this app

Get started in seconds: open the camera, tap to shoot, swipe to the album, and sort into folders.

USAGE NOTES
Made for moments when a dimmer screen helps cut distraction—venues and concerts, lights-off meetings, and nighttime nature observation (such as photographing insects). Please be mindful of your surroundings and respect others and venue guidelines.

Privacy Policy:
https://blackcap-web-privacy.vercel.app/

Terms of Use:
https://blackcap-web-terms.vercel.app/

name: Blank Sag
description:
Blank Sag keeps lens blanks and polishing laps on this iPhone.

Drag the curve on a blank section. Sag is the radius minus the square root of radius squared minus half the diameter squared. Edge thickness is the blank thickness minus that sag. The blank is too thin when the edge is under the minimum you set.

Among laps inside the tolerance, the smallest radius gap wins. A tie keeps the longer radius. Keep the reading, then compare two saved edges side by side.

Blanks, laps, and readings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. A reference photo comes from the photo library only when you attach one.

name: BlendTemp
description: BlendTemp calculates how much cool and warm water to combine for a target temperature and volume. Enter both source temperatures in Celsius, a target temperature, and the total volume. Save a mix for reuse. The estimate assumes no heat loss.

name: Blob: Photo Storage Cleanup
description:
Give your camera roll a quick review with Blob. Swipe right to Keep or left to set an item aside as Scrap. Compare similar photos and choose which versions you want to keep. Your choices save as you go. Return through Previously Reviewed whenever you want another look.

Browse All Media, Photos, Videos, Screenshots or Similar Photos. Sort by age or measured file size. Review and Clean Up brings your Scrap selections together and lets you restore individual items.

After reviewing your Scrap selections, swipe to request cleanup and confirm in Photos. Removed items normally remain recoverable in Recently Deleted for 30 days. With iCloud Photos, deletion can sync across devices. Lifetime Stats counts confirmed removals and measured file sizes. Actual available device storage can change later.

name: Block Blaster!
description:
Block Blaster!’da parçaları tahtaya yerleştir, satırları ve sütunları tamamla. Aynı hamlede birden fazla çizgi temizle ve kombo serini sürdür.

Klasik modda boş tahtayla başla ve hamlelerin sürdükçe puan topla. İstersen bir rumuz seçip Klasik rekorunu dünya sıralamasına ekle.

Macera modunda on dünyada 100 bölüm keşfet. Elmas, zümrüt, yakut ve opal topla. Kristallere ulaşmak için çizgileri tamamla, mühürleri kır ve anahtarlarla geçitleri aç.

Günlük modda günün bulmacasını oyna ve kendi rekorunu geliştir.

Oyun modları çevrimdışı oynanabilir. Dünya sıralaması internet bağlantısı gerektirir.

name: Block Slash Hero
description:
Block Slash Hero combines a block puzzle and a hero battle on one screen.

You place pieces on the 8×8 board below. Your hero marches along the lane above. Every piece you place brings a monster onto the road; every row and column you complete becomes your hero's attack. Stop clearing lines and the monsters pile up and strike back.

FEATURES
• No timer: think as long as you like, and get rewarded with Frenzy for playing fast.
• Turn-based boss duels: see how many moves are left until the boss attacks, stun it by clearing a line, cancel its attack with a combo.
• Five regions, five rules: ivy, ice, rock, gold seals and curses change the board.
• Four heroes: Elf Archer, Warrior, Crossbow Huntress and Mage, each with its own perk.
• Equipment: eight slots, four rarities, item upgrades and fusion.
• Daily rewards and quests.
• Game Center leaderboard and achievements.
• Playable offline. No ads, no purchases, no account needed.

name: BMS Pocket: Building Controls
description:
BMS Pocket is a field tool for building automation technicians. Connect your iPhone to the controller network, find the controllers, read live values and send commands.

FOUR PROTOCOLS IN ONE APP
• BACnet/IP: scan, devices behind routers, BBMD, points with their priority array
• Modbus TCP: read registers by hand, or use device types that you can edit and save
• OPC UA: read and write variables on servers that accept anonymous access without encryption
• Niagara over oBIX: sign in to a station that has the oBIX service, read and command its points

READ
• Live values, watchlist and point search
• Alarms, overrides and devices that do not answer, on one page
• BACnet weekly schedules and exceptions

COMMAND
• The app asks you to confirm before the first command to each device
• Choose the BACnet priority. The app reads the value back
• All commands held by the app are in one list. Release one or all of them
• Change BACnet weekly schedules by dragging, and review them before you write
• Change advanced properties of BACnet objects

REPORT
• Commissioning checkout, point by point, with a PDF report
• BACnet EDE file, OPC UA tag list and CSV export

PRIVACY
No account, no cloud, no analytics. The app collects no data. Everything it records stays on your phone.

PLANS
• Basic (free): scan all four protocols, read BACnet points and Modbus registers, 100 devices a day
• Pro: also OPC UA, Modbus device types, commands, schedule editing and export files. No daily limit
• Engineer: also Niagara over oBIX, command history and the PDF commissioning report
Releasing a held command is free on every plan.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

BMS Pocket is for trained people, on equipment they are authorized to operate. It is not a safety system.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://umutkedik.github.io/bms-pocket/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://umutkedik.github.io/bms-pocket/privacy.html
Support: https://umutkedik.github.io/bms-pocket/support.html

BACnet is a registered trademark of ASHRAE. Modbus is a registered trademark of Schneider Electric. OPC UA is a trademark of the OPC Foundation. Niagara is a trademark of Tridium. BMS Pocket is not affiliated with or endorsed by these owners.
