name: Bo\/ada Story Builder
description:
Masz pomysł na historię, ale nie wiesz, od czego zacząć? Bovada Story Builder prowadzi Cię krok po kroku przez tworzenie opowieści - od pierwszej sceny aż po finał. Wybieraj gatunek, losuj inspiracje, układaj sceny, buduj bohaterów i zapisuj gotowe historie offline na swoim urządzeniu.

Najważniejsze funkcje
- Gotowe zarysy fabuły - zacznij od sprawdzonej inspiracji i od razu przejdź do pisania.
- Kubiki pomysłów - losuj postać, miejsce, wydarzenie, przedmiot i zwrot akcji, a potem przypinaj najlepsze wyniki.
- Redaktor scen - dodawaj, duplikuj, zmieniaj kolejność i edytuj sceny w wygodnej osi historii.
- Bohaterowie i relacje - twórz postacie z cechami, celem, sekretem i powiązaniami z innymi bohaterami.
- Podpowiedzi do pisania - korzystaj z pytań, tropów i zwrotów akcji dopasowanych do gatunku.
- Wspólne tworzenie - piszcie historię po kolei na jednym urządzeniu, dla 2 do 6 osób.
- Eksport i udostępnianie - kopiuj tekst lub zapisuj historię do PDF z okładką i danymi autora.

Dla kogo
- Dla osób, które chcą pisać opowiadania, ale potrzebują pierwszego impulsu.
- Dla dzieci, młodzieży i dorosłych, którzy lubią kreatywne zabawy słowem.
- Dla nauczycieli, rodziców i grup znajomych szukających inspiracji do wspólnego tworzenia.
- Dla każdego, kto chce porządkować pomysły, sceny i postacie w jednym miejscu.

Dlaczego warto
Bovada Story Builder łączy bibliotekę gotowych historii, losowe kubiki, edytor scen i pomocne podpowiedzi w jednym, dopracowanym narzędziu. Aplikacja działa offline, bez rejestracji i bez potrzeby internetu, więc Twoje historie są zawsze pod ręką. Wszystko zapisuje się automatycznie, a Ty możesz wrócić do pracy w dowolnym momencie.

Stwórz własną opowieść od pierwszego zdania albo wybierz gotowy start i rozwiń go po swojemu. Pobierz aplikację i zacznij pisać już teraz.

name: Board Move
description:
Board Move shows how a solid-wood panel changes width through twelve months.

Photograph an end grain or set the ring angle. The app turns that angle into a mix of tangential and radial shrinkage, then runs the Hailwood-Horrobin equilibrium moisture for each month. The year grid shows the width change. August on the sample oak top binds. A quartersawn cherry door stays inside the groove.

Joinery gives the side gap to leave and the slot length for a button. Compare shows the same panel if every strip were quartersawn. Projects, species and the humidity of each month stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Boingbot Factory: Bot Tycoon
description:
Every springy robot in the Boingbot universe is born in a factory. Now you're the boss of it!

Your tiny hard hat workers wind springs, cast bodies and paint, and every finished bot bounces off the line with a "boing". Rusty Master's broken toy army is rusting the worlds; build a team of your best bots and repair them to save the day.

GROW YOUR FACTORY
• Tap floors to speed up production and upgrade them
• Hire managers: managed floors keep earning while you're away
• Open 21 production halls, from penguins to dragons, ninjas to the Bounce King
• Move to a new factory, earn Golden Bolts and start stronger with permanent talents

COLLECT BOTS
• Common, Good, Rare, Epic and Legendary bots
• 4 roles: Springer, Smasher, Dasher, Cheerer
• Elements, personalities and a unique skill for every kind
• Merge 3 identical bots to raise their stars
• Equip gear, complete set bonuses, craft and upgrade items

TEST RAMP
When a new bot rolls out, test it with Boingbot's hold and release jump. Perfect landings earn quality stars.

AUTO BATTLES
• Line up a team of 5: 2 in front, 3 in the back
• Push through world after world on expeditions and beat bosses; a repaired boss may join your team
• Attack rival defense teams in the arena, climb the leagues, collect trophies
• Daily Tower: a new rule every day, endless floors
• Weekly Community Boss: everyone hits the same giant boss, everyone gets rewards

GUILDS AND EVENTS
• Join a guild or found your own: chat, help, donations and guild tech
• Guild boss, guild wars and a growing territory map
• A new event every day: treasure map, bot race, ramp tournament, invasion and more
• A new season every month with its own theme, rules and costumes

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
Daily quests, login gifts, customer orders and a season pass.

Ads are only shown when you choose to watch one for a reward. No pop up ads.

Free to play with optional in app purchases.

name: Boom Bazaar: Cannon Blast
description:
Aim, fire and watch the whole stack tumble off the table into the sand!
Boom Bazaar takes you to a sunny desert bazaar: tap where you want to hit, clear every table in as few shots as you can, and spend the gold on a bazaar of your own.

SMASH, TOPPLE, BLOW IT UP
• Three weapons: a heavy cannonball that shoves whole stacks over, a scatter shot that fans out into a crowd, and a rocket that bursts on impact.
• Hit a red barrel and the barrels around it go up one after another.
• 24 kinds of goods crowd the tables: tin cans, crates, glass jars and bottles, clay pots, tea glasses, plates, watermelons, pomegranates, piggy banks, ice blocks, hay bales, marble columns, iron safes and more.
• Stone cracks, glass shatters, ice slides, spice sacks burst and evil eye beads fall like dominoes.
• Some tables hold an antique vase: if it breaks, falls or tips over, the level is lost.
• The last target goes down in slow motion.

40 HAND-MADE LEVELS
• Four bazaars of 10 levels each. Clear a level in fewer shots to earn up to three stars; stars open the next bazaar.
• After level 40 the endless bazaar begins: 25 levels picked from bazaars 2 to 4 come back round after round, every other round mirrored.
• No energy, no lives, no timers: retry any level as often as you like.
• Play offline: every level works without a connection. Ads and purchases need one.

BUILD YOUR OWN BAZAAR
• Spend your gold on four stalls and upgrade each one twice: the Spice Stall (Gold Purse: more gold from goods), the Lamp Stall (Big Blast: wider barrel blasts), the Blacksmith (Heavy Ball: cannonballs that hit harder) and the Tea House (Free Continue: continues on the house, up to three a day).
• On a few levels the merchant offers a bargain: clear it with fewer shots and he pays triple gold. Lose, and there is no penalty.

WEAPON SKINS
• Tulip Era, Barbarossa, Treasure, Dragon and Great Bombard: each one changes how every shot looks and comes with its own sounds and its own show when you clear a level.
• Try each one for a level before you buy it. Skins are looks only, with no extra power.
• Market music with darbuka and oud.

Boom Bazaar is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases. Rewarded ads are always your choice. Ads between levels never show before you clear level 15 or after a lost level, and "Remove Ads" turns them off for good. Gold, stalls and every skin can also be earned by playing; buying gold or skins only gets you there faster.

Boom Bazaar is made by Cookinn, a mobile game studio in Istanbul.
Questions or ideas? Write to us at info@cookinn.com.tr
Privacy policy: https://cookinn.fun/privacy

name: BoonBoon
description:
BoonBoon (บุญบุญ) is a cheerful little journal for your good deeds 

Making an offering to monks, donating, volunteering, or simply helping someone today — every kind act matters. BoonBoon lets you note it down in seconds and look back whenever you need a smile.

- Two ways to log merit
• Donation — offerings and gifts
• Action — volunteering, helping at the temple, or the story of a good moment
Attach one favourite photo per entry (location data is removed automatically).

- A feel-good dashboard
See your volunteering count, total donations, how many times you rejoiced in others' merit, and your merit streak — in soft pastel cards.

- Buddhist holy day reminders
Get a reminder the evening before and the morning of each Wan Phra, based on the Thai lunar calendar. Choose full-moon/new-moon days, quarter-moon days, or both.

-Share the merit
Turn any entry into a pretty thank-you card in Peach, Matcha, Sakura or Moon themes and share it on social media.

-Kindness around you
An anonymous feed where you can tap "Sadhu" to rejoice in other people's good deeds. Only entries their owners choose to make public appear — never names, amounts or photos. See something inappropriate? Report or hide it instantly.
-Bedtime reflection
Look back on today's good deeds and revisit happy memories before you sleep.

-Privacy first
• Every entry is private by default
• No ads, no cross-app tracking, no selling data
• Delete your account and all data right in the app

Available in Thai, English and Chinese (follows your device language).

Note: BoonBoon is a personal journal. It does not receive or transfer donations; amounts are self-reported, are not receipts and cannot be used for tax deductions. BoonBoon is not affiliated with any temple or organisation.

name: BowVault: Archery Equipment
description:
Set up your bow for the perfect shot.

BowVault keeps everything about your bow in your pocket: every part, every spec and every sight mark, for recurve, compound and traditional bows.

KEEP YOUR EQUIPMENT TOGETHER
• Add your bows and the parts on them: riser, limbs, sight, stabilizers, string, arrow parts and more
• Pick parts from a catalog of archery products and get their specs filled in for you
• See your bow on a diagram and tap a part to see its details
• Save your sight marks for each distance
• Add notes and photos to your bows
• Use inches and pounds or centimetres and kilograms, whichever you prefer

SCAN A PART LABEL
Point the camera at the label on a part and BowVault finds the brand, model and specs. If a part is not in the catalog yet, you can send it in as a suggestion.

SHARE YOUR SETUP
• Share a bow with a QR code or a link
• Everything is private until you choose to open it. You decide which bows are public
• Follow other archers and see what changes on the bows they share
• Find archery clubs near you and see the archers from your club

MADE BY AN ARCHER
Designed by a French archer. Made in Holland.

BowVault is made by an archer who has been shooting recurve for over 8 years. It is free to use, has no ads and does not sell your data. Send your feedback to support@bowvault.app and help make the app better.

name: Brain Island: Kids Brain Games
description:
Brain Island offers short, playful thinking games for children from preschool to grade 4. In preschool every question is read aloud; grades 1–3 practise question types like those in Türkiye's BİLSEM gifted-education screening, and grade 4 continues as “Brain Practice”. Our guide, Bilge the owl, gives step-by-step hints instead of the answer.

WHY BRAIN ISLAND?
• No ads. No ads or outside links ever appear during play.
• No real name needed. A nickname and an avatar are enough.
• Short rounds. A skill round is 10 questions and takes a few minutes. You set the daily goal and break reminders.
• The parent area is protected by a simple addition question. Subscription and settings live there.

PRESCHOOL (AGES 3–6)
• 24 voiced games on 5 islands: numbers, shapes, colours, directions, memory, before–after and more.
• No reading needed. Every question is read aloud and answers are pictures; “Listen again” repeats the question.
• Three age levels: 3–4, 4–5 and 5–6.

SCHOOL (GRADES 1–4)
• 131 games in 5 areas: Visual, Spatial, Numerical, Logic and Memory, plus 21 action games for attention and tracking.
• New: mirror images, paper folding, sliding shapes, water pipes, colour codes, hidden shapes, scientific thinking and more.
• 100 timed practice tests with 20 questions each.
• Meet-and-greet round: 10 short questions build a starting profile; then every area adapts to your child's level.
• Bilge's hints: first where to look, then the rule, then the last step. A “Why?” button explains the solution.

ISLAND ADVENTURE
• 7 floating islands, each with levels that unlock one by one along a yellow road.
• Stars, badges, a daily chest and a 50-piece wardrobe: hats, glasses, capes, wings… Everything you wear shows on your character.

FOR PARENTS
• Weekly report: days played, questions solved, accuracy and change from last week.
• Skill profile: where your child is confident and what to practise more.
• Test reports: time, skill breakdown and worked solutions.
• Separate profiles for siblings.

LANGUAGES
English, Turkish and Portuguese.

BRAIN ISLAND PREMIUM
The app is free to download and part of it can be played without a subscription. Premium unlocks all games, 100 practice tests and detailed reports.
• Plan: Yearly subscription with a 3-day free trial. Price may vary by country.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period.
• If you cancel before the trial ends, you will not be charged.

GOOD TO KNOW
Brain Island (Zeka Adası) is not an official app of MEB or BİLSEM. Practice tests are for preparation and do not guarantee any screening result. The app is not an IQ test; scores and reports are for following your child's own progress.

Terms of Use: https://bilsemli.com/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bilsemli.com/en/privacy
Support: destek@bilsemli.com

name: Brainagon: Brand New Puzzles
description:
Eight original logic games in one app.

• SHADOWS: build the solid that matches the three views.
• SLICES: split a shape into parts of equal area with a few cuts.
• BEAMS: mirrors and coloured beams to bring to the targets.
• FOLDS: fold the sheet until you get the shape.
• FENCES: place the tiles and close ever bigger fences.
• TILES: cover the region with copies of one shape.
• KNOTS: swap crossings to pull the loops apart.
• BRICKS: rebuild the model with the right bricks.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• 560 levels introducing one new idea at a time, then endless Free play.
• The daily challenge: the same puzzle for everyone, a single attempt, a leaderboard. Easy on Monday, harder and harder until Sunday.
• Matches against real people: find an opponent of your strength, challenge someone by name, ask for a rematch. Or on the same phone, or against the computer.

AND ALSO
• Every game is learnt in a minute, with an animated demo.
• Several profiles on the same device, each with its own progress and badges.
• iPhone and iPad, in six languages: English, Italian, German, French, Spanish and Portuguese.
• All included: no ads, no in-app purchases.

NEW GAMES REGULARLY
Brainagon keeps growing: new games and puzzles are added regularly, included in the price.

name: Branai
description:
Branai is a private morning page. It gives you one small place to begin the day: a question, three possible directions, one branch to carry, and a few words about how the morning felt.

There is no account, no feed, no cloud and no audience. The page lives on this iPhone.

name: Brass Encore
description:
A wing unfolds. A bell rings. Three small machines begin their performance.

In Brass Encore, every show starts at your workbench. Connect springs, gears, cams and linkages to create mechanical birds, blooming flowers, astronomical clocks and other moving inventions. Adjust the timing, test your design and discover how one small change can transform the whole mechanism.

BUILD WITH PURPOSE
Begin with three guided lessons, then take on a workshop full of commissions. Balance space, parts and power as you turn each client's brief into a working creation. Pause a test run, inspect a connection and tune the motion until everything falls into place.

GIVE YOUR BEST IDEAS ANOTHER LIFE
Keep your blueprints and adapt them for three kinds of recurring orders: Reprise, Limited Parts and Compact Build. Repair faulty inventions, save reusable mechanisms and revisit earlier designs to improve their cost, size or timing.

MAKE MUSIC WITH MACHINERY
Arrange pins on a musical cylinder, solve listening and rhythm puzzles, or compose your own pattern. Save a favorite score and use it to accompany your mechanical performers.

TAKE THE WORKSHOP ON TOUR
Bring up to three creations together on stage. Set their positions, coordinate their cues and rehearse a shared performance. Travel through six exhibition routes with different venue requirements and refine your program between stops.

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock new parts and creation themes as your workshop grows. Choose decorative finishes, explore free building, and collect personal bests. Save your blueprints, share them as files, or export a short film of a moving creation.

Your next commission might start with a familiar blueprint. What you make of it is up to you.

name: Bravixo Climb - Route Log
description:
Keep track of the routes you’re working on with Bravixo Climb. Save route details, log attempts and outcomes, and see how many climbs you’ve sent. Your notes and progress stay together as you work toward the next route.

Build a Route List
Add a route name, gym or crag, grade, and wall angle. Keep movement notes for holds, footwork, or the crux so you can revisit your approach before another attempt.

Record Each Attempt
Log attempts and their outcomes for individual routes. Filter the list to show unsent routes when you want to focus on climbs still in progress.

See Your Progress by Grade
View your total attempts and routes sent, with a grade-by-grade breakdown of completed routes.

Keep Past Routes in the Archive
Move routes you no longer need in your active list to the archive, where you can find them again later.

Export Your Training Notes
Share an attempt log as a CSV file, including dates, outcomes, and movement notes.

name: Bravura Lead for Police Tech26
description: Bravura Leads for Police Tech App can be used to scan badges for the Police Tech Event of C5 to track attendees stopping by the booth and to receive updates and information of the events.

name: Breathio: Breathing Exercises
description:
Feel calmer in minutes with guided breathing exercises. Tell Breathio how you feel and get a breath that fits: calm anxiety, ease stress and fall asleep more easily.

WHAT YOU GET
• Start with how you feel: tap one of 12 moods and get a matching breathing practice right away.
• Breathe with confidence: follow a glowing light around the shape, with voice cues, gentle haptics and a calming background sound.
• Five proven techniques: box breathing, 4-7-8, the physiological sigh, 5-5-5 and 4-2-8-2, each with a short guide on when and how to use it.
• Courses that build calm day by day: 20 days to better sleep, 20 days of stress relief, 20 days to less anxiety and 9 days to a happier life.
• Meet Wisp, a gentle AI friend: talk about your day and Wisp can point you to a real practice. Optional, asks for your consent first, and needs internet.
• See what really helps: quick check-ins before and after a session show how your mood shifts over 7 or 30 days.
• Daily reminders at the times you choose, a dark mode made for evenings, and an Apple Watch app for breathing on the go.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap how you feel right now.
2. Follow the suggested breath for a few minutes.
3. Check in afterwards and watch your progress grow.

Every practice and course is free, with no ads. Breathing exercises and your history stay on your iPhone and work offline; only the optional chat with Wisp uses the internet.

Breathio is a wellness app, not a medical device, and does not diagnose or treat any condition. If you are in crisis, contact local emergency services.

Download Breathio and take your first calm breath today.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/privacypolicy-kientran/trang-ch%E1%BB%A7
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/termsofuse-kientran/trang-ch%E1%BB%A7

name: Brewd: Coffee Meetups
description:
Brewd turns the café down the road into the easiest place to meet people like you.

Instead of big events or endless swiping, Brewd runs small, planned coffee meetups we call pours: about 4 to 6 people, a topic, a time and a real café near you. You turn up, order a coffee and talk.

GET STARTED IN A MINUTE
Say hi to Bean, Brewd's AI host. Talk for a minute about what you do, who you'd like to meet and what you're up for next, and Bean pours it into a profile. Prefer typing? You can fill it in by hand and edit it any time.

SEE WHY YOU'D GET ALONG
Every pour and person comes with a plain reason you'd click: shared interests, something they can help you with, or something you can help them with. Brewd even suggests an opening line, so the first minute is never awkward.

JOIN, HOST OR BLEND
• Join a pour with one tap, or join the waitlist when it's full.
• Host your own: pick a café and a time, and Brewd finds the right people.
• Come as a crew: bring friends and join together.
• Start a blend: no host, everyone brings an agenda and Brewd mixes them into one running order.
• Chat with the group before you meet, and get directions or add it to your calendar.

CHECK IN AT THE TABLE
Scan the QR code on your café table to check in and see who else is around.

BUILT FOR SAFETY
• Meetups happen only in public cafés.
• Everyone agrees to simple house rules before joining.
• Block or report anyone in two taps; blocked people disappear for you both.
• Your Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube stay hidden until you've actually met.
• Delete your account and all your data from the app at any time.

EARLY ACCESS
Brewd is starting in Pune and opening city by city. During early access you join by invite: sign in and request one, and we'll let you in as seats open up.

Brewd is free, with no ads.

Questions? support@techynar.com

name: Brickscape – 3D Brick Builder
description:
Brickscape is a calm, colorful 3D brick-building game for kids and grown-up builders alike.

LEARN TO BUILD, STEP BY STEP
• 17 guided models in three levels (Easy, Medium and Challenge): a yellow duck, a pine tree, a puppy, a sailboat, a fire truck, a castle, an airplane, a tram and more.
• Every step shows exactly which bricks you need. Tap a brick in the tray, see where it goes, then press Place.
• Earn stars and coins, keep your combo going and unlock new islands on the adventure map.

BUILD ANYTHING YOU LIKE
• A free-build sandbox with 107 brick shapes and 21 colors: bricks, plates, slopes, tiles, round and special parts.
• Aim first, see a see-through preview, then place. Nothing lands by accident.
• Smart snapping finds the nearest spot that fits and turns the brick for you.
• Move a whole stack at once, recolor, erase, undo and redo.
• Earn stars to open six brick chests full of new shapes.
• Save your builds and come back to them any time.

SIMPLE AND SAFE
• No ads and no in-app purchases.
• No account and no sign-in. No personal data is collected.
• Works fully offline. Your builds stay on your device.
• Available in 17 languages, including English, Tiếng Việt, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português and العربية.
• Made for phones and tablets.

Brickscape is an independent app and is not affiliated with any toy brand.

name: BridgeOne - Kiosco
description:
BridgeOne Kiosco convierte un iPad en un terminal de fichaje para tu empresa, conectado con BridgeOne HR. Colócalo a la entrada de la oficina, la tienda o el almacén y tus empleados podrán registrar su jornada en segundos, sin tarjetas ni relojes de fichar.

FICHAJE RÁPIDO CON PIN
Cada empleado introduce su PIN personal y registra su entrada, sus pausas o su salida. La pantalla confirma el fichaje con su nombre, su foto y la hora exacta, con un aviso sonoro.

TODO SE SINCRONIZA CON BRIDGEONE HR
Los fichajes llegan al momento a BridgeOne HR, donde el equipo de Recursos Humanos consulta las horas trabajadas, las pausas y las incidencias de cada empleado.

SIGUE FICHANDO SIN CONEXIÓN
Si se cae internet, el terminal guarda los fichajes y los envía automáticamente en cuanto vuelve la conexión. No se pierde ningún registro.

CONSULTA DE REGISTROS
Cada empleado puede consultar desde el propio terminal sus fichajes del día.

PERSONALIZADO CON TU MARCA
Añade el logo de tu empresa, elige los colores del fondo y de los botones, y el formato de la fecha. Disponible en español, catalán, inglés y francés, con modo claro y oscuro, en vertical u horizontal.

PENSADO PARA SER UN TERMINAL
Modo de pantalla completa, configuración protegida por la contraseña del administrador y estado de la tablet visible en BridgeOne HR (conexión, batería y fichajes pendientes).

Te ayuda a cumplir con la obligación del registro de jornada.

REQUISITOS
Necesitas una cuenta de empresa en BridgeOne HR con el módulo de fichaje activo. El administrador vincula el terminal con el código de activación que se genera en BridgeOne HR.

name: Bridges by LOT
description:
Bridges is the app of Leaders of Tomorrow (LOT), an education program for young people. Everything you do in the program is in one place, from your first application to graduation.

APPLY
• See which cohorts are open and apply to one.
• Answer the application questions at your own pace, save your answers and submit when you are ready.
• Follow your application and see what comes next.
• Book a time for your interview and add it to your calendar.

IN THE PROGRAM
• See your host family, your city and your facilitator.
• Find your sessions and join them.
• Read the announcements from the program team.
• Do your assignments and read the feedback on your work.
• See your attendance, awards and certificates.
• Sign the documents you are asked to sign and read the program's policies.

MESSAGES
• Talk with your family, your city and your whole cohort, and send direct messages.
• Reply in threads, react, mention people and search past messages.
• Report a message to the LOT team when something is wrong.

FOR THE PROGRAM'S STAFF
Reviewers, interviewers, facilitators, instructors and the program team can do their work from the app: review applications, run interviews, take attendance and follow their students.

STAY UP TO DATE
Notifications tell you when something needs you: a new message or mention, an interview, a session or an assignment. In Messages you choose which conversations notify you, and you can pause notifications at any time.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Update your profile, turn on two-factor sign-in, download a copy of your data or delete your account, all from your profile.

Bridges is for people who take part in the Leaders of Tomorrow program and for those applying to it. What you see depends on your role in the program.

name: BriefAura
description:
Meet BriefAura — the calm, beautifully designed planner for law students who want to walk into class prepared and leave with their outline half-written.

Every tool is built around how law school actually works: you read cases, you brief them in IRAC, you survive cold calls, and your finals outline writes itself from the rules you've been collecting all semester.

BRIEF EVERY CASE IN IRAC
A simple, focused form for every case: Issue, Rule, Analysis, Conclusion, plus side notes. It autosaves as you type, and a four-dot marker shows how complete each brief is at a glance.

PRACTICE FOR COLD CALLS
Flag the cases your professor loves, then run a practice round that quizzes you from your own briefs. Say your answer out loud, reveal, and mark it shaky or got it — shaky cases come back first next time.

AN OUTLINE THAT BUILDS ITSELF
Every rule you write files itself under its outline heading. When finals approach, export the whole thing as a clean, print-ready PDF — each class on its own page, ready to study or share.

STAY AHEAD OF YOUR READINGS
See today's classes, mark attendance, track every reading due, and plan your week with a seven-day agenda. A countdown ring keeps finals day in view.

KNOW THE LANGUAGE OF LAW
A built-in glossary of legal terms with flashcards, so Latin maxims and doctrines stop being a surprise. Flip through a term of the day or a full deck by subject — Torts, Contracts, Civ Pro, Evidence, and more.

A DAILY SPARK OF PERSUASION
Start every study session with an inspirational quote from Ruth Bader Ginsburg, Thurgood Marshall, and other greats. Save your favorites to see them more often.

SCAN, DICTATE, BACK UP
Snap a photo of your notes or casebook page and BriefAura turns it into text for any IRAC section — five scans every month on the free plan. Or tap the mic and talk your brief out.

Manual briefs are always unlimited, free, and forever.

BRIEFAURA PRO
Go further with Pro: unlimited case scanning, cold-call practice, spaced review that brings shaky cases back right before you'd forget them, outline exam mode that hides every rule until you can recall it, and the print-ready outline PDF.

Pro is $4.99 a month or $29.99 a year, with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Use BriefAura with no account at all, or sign in with Apple or Google to back up your semester and restore it on a new phone.

Designed in warm beige, soft salmon and butter yellow with a Lady Justice logo, BriefAura is the study companion you won't mind keeping on your home screen.

Download BriefAura and walk into class ready.

Terms of Use: https://law-school-irac-planner.rork.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://law-school-irac-planner.rork.app/privacy

name: Briefd: What's Happening Here
description:
Briefd is a social network you explore on a map.

Other social apps show you a feed: posts chosen by an algorithm, from people you follow, about anywhere and any time. Briefd works the other way round. There is no feed. You open the map, pick a place and read what people there are sharing right now.

HOW IT WORKS
• Open the map and move to any street, city or country.
• Tap a bubble to read the short notes people left there.
• Write your own note about what's happening around you.
• Every note disappears after 24 hours, so the map is always about today.

EVENTS
• Something happening? Create an event: a place on the map for a few hours or a few days, with a link and a QR code to share.
• People there post live updates (the queue, where to meet, what's on) and anyone signed in can read them from anywhere.
• Only people near the event can write in it: the organiser chooses how near, from 50 m to 2 km.

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
• No feed and no algorithm: you decide where to look.
• No followers and no likes to chase: the place matters, not the person.
• Nothing stays forever: notes vanish after 24 hours.
• No ads and no tracking.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Post with your name or anonymously. Your account is never shown to others.
• Choose how precise the place is: the region, the city or the exact point.
• Report a post or block its author from the post menu.

ALSO
• React with six emojis.
• Translate notes in other languages directly on your phone.
• Available in English, Italian, French, Spanish, German, Chinese, Japanese, Hindi and Arabic.

Sign in with Apple, Google or email to read and write. Briefd is for people aged 16 and over.

name: BrightWord Daily
description:
BrightWord Daily gør det nemt at lære engelsk som dansktalende.

name: Brineside
description:
Brineside is a dedicated logbook for aquarium keepers who want a clear, calm record of their tanks without clutter, accounts, or subscriptions.

Add freshwater, saltwater, brackish, planted, or pond-style aquariums in seconds. Each tank opens as a cross-section view with a brass-and-glass rotary valve dial at the stand for switching between your Tank, Tests, Care drawers, and Journal.

Track pH, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, temperature, GH, KH, salinity, phosphate, calcium, magnesium, or custom parameters you add yourself. Set your own target range per parameter so Brineside compares readings strictly to the ranges you choose.

Review custom-drawn trend charts over 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, or all time, with your target band shaded behind the line and tap-to-inspect notes on every point.

Stay on top of recurring care routines including water changes, filter rinses, feeding, dosing, and glass cleaning. Mark tasks done, snooze by one day, or skip, calculate exact water-change volumes by percentage, and opt in to local daily summaries or per-task reminders.

Keep a waterproof-style journal of your fish, invertebrates, corals, aquatic plants, monthly expenses, and dated tank photos with a before-and-after comparison slider. Export any tank record as CSV or a printable PDF summary, or export your entire logbook as JSON.

Everything stays on your device. Brineside is a record-keeping and reminder tool only; results depend on your own water kit, and the app does not diagnose conditions or offer care advice.

description:

Take a pass toward the tip. The app cuts the tooth in front of the named tooth and leaves the order unchanged. If the first tooth already exceeds, it holds. If nothing is left, the stock is gone.

Passes stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: ButterflyCount
description:
ButterflyCount is a field companion for anyone who stops to watch a butterfly and wishes they knew its name. It follows the way Butterfly Conservation presents its species accounts — size and family, conservation status, caterpillar foodplants, habitat and distribution — and turns that structure into something you can use standing in a meadow with the wind picking up.

The opening page is a flight window. Turn the dial to any month, choose England, Scotland, Wales or Ireland, and the guide narrows to the species that should be on the wing. Each one is drawn rather than photographed, with the upperwing, underwing and resting posture described in plain language, so a quick glimpse on a bramble flower has something to be checked against. Foodplants are listed beside every species, because a butterfly at nectar is only visiting; the plant that feeds its caterpillar is where the next generation begins.

Records are kept the way a transect is walked: the same line, the same sections, the same steady weather. A walk holds the date, site, start time, temperature, cloud, wind and a count for every butterfly seen, and warns you when conditions fall outside the standard survey window. Over a season those walks become a year page — the months in columns, the families in a ring, the species that carried the year — always shown with the number of walks behind them, because effort explains as much as abundance.

For gardeners there is a planting plan built around host plants rather than flower colour, and for the curious there are the recording notes that explain how a notebook entry becomes a national trend. Rare species are named only to genus and never located, so the guide cannot be used as a collecting list.

ButterflyCount keeps everything on your phone. There is no account, no sign-in and no upload, and the only network request checks the public A–Z index for species the guide might be missing. It is an independent companion to the published work of Butterfly Conservation, made for people who would rather identify a butterfly than simply admire it.

name: Cabin Folio
description:
Dear friend,

When the vents smell dusty again, you still cannot remember which car got a new cabin filter last — or whether that part number lived on the glove-box label or a sticker under the hood. Cabin Folio is a small garage notebook for people who keep one or more cars and want a calm place to log cabin air-filter models and replacement timing on this phone.

1. Register each car and its cabin filters
Give the car a short name and its current odometer in miles. Add one or more cabin filters with a part-model note, an optional location note (glove box, under hood), a replacement interval in months (1–120) and/or miles (1–999,999), and the last replacement when you know it. At least one interval is enough for the app to reckon what is due.

2. See what needs care at a glance
The Due board groups filters into Overdue, Soon, and Later so you can open the phone and know which cabin filter to touch first. Never-replaced filters sit in Overdue until you log a change. Tap Mark replaced to write today’s log, stamp the odometer, and roll the next due window forward.

3. Keep cars and part models searchable
Cars lists every vehicle with search. Open a car to edit the odometer, add another filter, review that car’s replacement log, or delete the car and its filters. Filters gathers part-model notes across your garage so you can jump back to matching cars without retyping.

4. Quiet landscape layout, local-only data
The screens stay readable in landscape: a soft mint HVAC wash, clear cards, and actions that sit where your thumbs expect them. Everything lives on this device. There is no account, no ads, and nothing to buy. About covers getting started, Privacy, Support mail to i8ofuw5h@gaowei.bond, and Erase library after two confirmations.

Warmly,
Cabin Folio

description:
