name: Carrelio: Tile Calculator
description:
"This app only uses the total space. It doesn't account for layout or cuts." Carrelio does: it draws your tile layout, tile by tile, and tells you where the cuts land before you mix the first bag.

Enter the room and the tile size: the app lays out the pattern, counts full and cut tiles, and warns you when a cut at the wall is smaller than half a tile. A "Get to green" bar offers the fix a tile setter would make: shift the starting point a few inches, center the layout, turn it 90°, switch to a 1/3 offset, widen the grout joint. One setting at a time: your room and the tile you already bought stay as they are.

FREE, WITH ZERO ADS
• Complete rectangular floor: layout drawn, edge cuts in inches and as a % of the tile
• Straight or 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 offset; centered start or against a wall, adjustable to the inch
• How many tiles and how many boxes, by square feet or by tile count
• Thinset in pounds and 50 lb bags by tile size, recommended trowel, target coverage
• Grout in pounds, baseboard in feet
• Green, orange or red verdict: cuts, joint width for rectified or calibrated tile, offset of large tiles, movement joints
• Perimeter joint deducted from the dimensions
• Inches, mm or cm; 100% offline; no account, no ads

CARRELIO PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• L-shaped floor: one grid across both parts, cuts checked on every wall
• 45° diagonal layout: half tiles and edge pieces checked
• Wall with a door, window or niche: cuts around the opening, niche back and returns counted
• PDF export: dimensioned layout, quantities, shopping list and verdict, ready for your quote
• Every future Pro feature included, for life

BUILT FOR THE JOB SITE
Tile setters and serious DIYers: Carrelio talks layout, cuts, grout joints, rectified tile, back-buttering. In inches the app follows US practice (ANSI A108, TCNA: no cuts under half a tile, 33% max offset over 15", movement joints every 25 ft indoors); in metric, the French tiling code (NF DTU 52.2).

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no trackers, no data collected. Your calculations never leave your device.

name: Cartogeny: 3D Family Tree
description:
Cartogeny turns your family history into a tree you can move through. Generations rise one above another, each family line keeps its own colour, and every person is a point of light you can tap to see who they were and how they connect to you.

FIVE WAYS TO SEE A FAMILY
• Chart: a fan of ancestors rising generation by generation.
• Tree: your family as a living tree, trunk to canopy.
• Roots: the same tree turned over, ancestors reaching down.
• Rings: one ring for each generation or decade, like the rings of a trunk.
• Nebula: each side of the family as its own cloud of stars.

Any person's ancestors, descendants or both can be laid flat into a classic 2D chart.

HONEST ABOUT WHAT IS KNOWN
Family history is full of maybes. Every person and every link shows how sure it is: confirmed, probable, unconfirmed or family memory. Solid, faded, dashed and dotted lines tell them apart at a glance, so a guess never passes for a fact.

YOUR TREE STAYS YOURS
Cartogeny reads your family notes on your device. Your tree is never uploaded. The only thing an account holds is your email address and a record of your purchase.

BRING YOUR OWN FAMILY
• Open a folder of plain-text notes, one per person (the format is simple and documented, and works well with note apps such as Obsidian).
• Or open a .zip of that folder.
• Or start from a GEDCOM file (.ged), the export that Ancestry and most family tree programs and sites can make. Cartogeny shows it as a tree straight away and can turn it into notes you keep.

TRY IT FIRST
The app comes with a made-up sample family of 166 people across more than a dozen generations. Explore every view free, for as long as you like.

ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Opening your own family is a single in-app purchase. It belongs to your Cartogeny account, so it also unlocks Cartogeny on the web at cartogeny.com and on your other devices. Restore it at any time, and delete your account from inside the app whenever you wish.

Cartogeny isn't affiliated with Ancestry or Obsidian. Their names are trademarks of their owners.

Terms of use: https://cartogeny.com/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://cartogeny.com/privacy.html

name: Carwen
description:
A song falls apart in the phrase that always runs out of air or rushes the line. Carwen lets you pick up that phrase, sing it until a take sits, and build the whole piece from lines you can actually keep.
Carwen is a rehearsal room for phrases. Breath and rhythm live on the line you are singing, the accompaniment loops around that line, and the take you trust stays marked so the next pass has somewhere to start.
• Work phrase by phrase, so effort stays on the line that is still shaky instead of restarting the whole song. • Pin breath and rhythm on the phrase itself, and see those marks together with the next focus when you review. • Loop the accompaniment on one line, record several takes, trim before you keep one, and hear the difference side by side. • Keep the take that sits and jot what to watch next, so each pass adds a line you can sing with confidence. • Photograph a paper score or choose one from your library and pin it beside the phrase, so the page matches the breath you marked.
Open a piece, cut a line, mark the breath, loop, listen, keep. The version that sits is the one you carry into the next phrase.
Carwen

name: CaseMinder
description:
Remember what you lent, who has it and when it should come back. Save an item, borrower, due date, storage location and notes in one personal lending ledger.

Spot overdue items, search active loans and mark equipment returned. Keep the returned archive as a history; lending an item again creates a new loan while preserving its earlier record. Share a loan summary when useful. No contacts permission is needed.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: Cassette: Offline Music Player
description:
Cassette plays the music files you already own, fully offline. No streaming, no subscriptions, no account and no Wi-Fi needed.

PICK YOUR FOLDERS
• Choose one or more music folders from the Files app or iCloud Drive
• Folders inside folders are found automatically
• Your files stay where they are and are never copied or uploaded
• Plays MP3, M4A, AAC, ALAC, FLAC, WAV and AIFF

FIND ANY SONG
• Browse your library folder by folder, with artwork and song lengths
• Sort by name, date modified or date created
• Search songs, artists and albums at once

LISTEN ANYWHERE
• Keeps playing in the background and with the screen locked
• Lock Screen and Control Center controls, including scrubbing
• Shuffle, repeat one and repeat all
• Plays straight through a folder and starts over from the top
• Picks up where you left off

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your music never leaves your device. Cassette doesn't collect any data, show ads or need an account.

name: Cast Lid
description:
Cast Lid is a notebook for people who keep earthworm bins. Each bin gets a name and a bedding, then one slip for the day: how long the worms measured, and what went into the bed.

Open Bins to see the trenches in the yard. An empty yard shows an empty trench until you name a bin. On Lid, drag the worm to set today's length in millimetres, then drag manure, scraps, or cardboard into the bed and count the handfuls. Keep this day writes that slip. One bin keeps one slip per date, and keeping again updates that same day.

Slips lists the days you have kept. Open one to read the bin, the length, the feed, and the date. Everything stays on this phone. There is no account, no feed from the network, and nothing to send out.

name: Cat Escape: Sliding Cat Puzzle
description:
The living room floor is covered in napping cats.
Cheese, a little kitten in a red scarf, wants the treat waiting just outside the cat door — but the way is completely blocked.
Gently slide the sleeping cats aside and clear a path for Cheese.

HOW TO PLAY
• Cats lying sideways move left and right. Cats lying lengthwise move up and down.
• Just swipe to slide. That's the whole rule.
• Get Cheese to the cat door on the right to clear the level.
• Fewer moves, more stars. Solve it in the minimum number of moves for 3 stars!

FEATURES
• Seven rooms — Lounge, Kitchen, Balcony, Attic, Rooftop, Alley and Park — with 30 levels each, 210 in all, from easy to tricky.
• Every level is checked by an automatic solver, so every puzzle can be solved.
• Stuck? Use a hint to see the next move, or skip a hard level.
• Meet Cheese, Kkamang, Somi, Calico, Mackerel, Siam and more lovable cats.
• Each level takes just a few minutes — perfect for a quick break.
• No sign-up needed. Start playing right away.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The game is free and contains ads. You can remove ads with a one-time purchase.
• Already bought Remove Ads? Tap Restore Purchases on the Pick a Room screen to get it back.
• Your progress is saved only on your device. Deleting the app also deletes your progress.

Contact: dev@breadnsoft.com

name: Catch Lid
description: Catch Lid is a private tally for a day on the water. When the net comes in, chalk the fishing ground, name each kind of fish, and record the amount as pieces or kilograms. One lid is kept for each day. Past lids lists earlier days. The shelf keeps the fish you have named, and Grounds keeps the places you have chalked. The record stays on this iPhone. There is no account, no network, and nothing to share or export.

name: CatMarble: Stitch & Pounce
description:
Your next bounce is one you create.

Join Pippa, a curious little cat, in a lantern-filled garden where marbles can turn a good idea into a new path. Aim a shot through paired spools to create a glowing thread rail. On your next shot, bounce from the rail you built, light the lanterns, and find a soft landing in the basket.

BUILD THE WAY FORWARD
Touch A1, then A2 during one shot. A new rail appears when that shot ends. A clever setup can open a route that was out of reach before.

TURN A TILE, CHANGE YOUR PLAN
Garden tiles have two faces. Switch them between shots to change the obstacles while your spool anchors stay in place. Choose when to build, when to turn, and when to head home.

100 LITTLE ADVENTURES
Explore ten chapters of fixed marble puzzles. Discover fleeting rails, bell-operated gates, paired tunnels, one-way threads, and numbered lantern chains. Optional petals and three-star goals give you a reason to return with a fresh idea.

TAKE YOUR TIME
There is no countdown and no energy meter. Adjust your aim in half-degree steps, watch the bounce preview, and launch when you are ready. Replay a lesson, ask for a suggested setup, or undo a shot. Assisted clears still earn stars and unlock new levels.

A GARDEN OF YOUR OWN
Collect daily stamps for Buttons and unlock small visual treasures. Missing a day never resets your stamp card. Treasures change your look, never the puzzle physics.

KEEP YOUR FAVORITE RUNS
Local Records saves your own attempts on this device. Compare unassisted clears for each level or revisit recent adventures. There are no fabricated competitors or online rankings.

MADE FOR A COZY MOMENT
Enjoy rounded cartoon artwork, lively bounce effects, gentle sounds, optional haptics, shape labels, and reduced-motion support.

Play the complete campaign offline. No account, advertisements, in-app purchases, or subscription is required.

Stitch a path. Bounce home.

name: cbase - AI Coding Workspace
description:
cbase is the iPhone client for cbase, an open-source, self-hosted workspace for long-running AI coding agents.

A server is required. This app does nothing on its own: it connects to a cbase server that you or your team run (open source under the GNU AGPL, see the support page). You enter your server's address and sign in with the account its administrator created for you. There is no cbase cloud service and no account with the developer of this app.

On your server, every user gets an isolated container in which coding agents work for hours on your projects. Each user brings their own AI provider subscription or API key and signs in inside their own container; cbase ships no model access. From your phone you can:

- Read along as an agent works, send messages, queue follow-ups and answer its questions
- Approve or decline steps that need your consent
- Browse workspaces, projects, files and Git changes
- Open terminals and watch the agent's browser
- Follow scheduled tasks and workflows
- Upload photos and files into a chat or a project
- Delete your account and all its data on the server from within the app (Settings > Account > Delete account)

Privacy: the app talks only to the server address you enter. The developer of the app collects no data; there are no analytics, no tracking and no ads. Your chats, code and credentials stay on your server.

cbase is pre-1.0 and under active development. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any AI provider. English and German.

name: Ceilo: METAR & TAF Decoder
description:
Ceilo turns METAR and TAF reports into plain English, without hiding the raw text pilots trust.

READ ANY AIRPORT
• Search by ICAO code (EGLL, KJFK, LFPG…)
• Raw report and decoding side by side
• Flight category with the standard colors: VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR
• Age of the observation, with a warning when a report is old
• Saved reports for offline reading

DECODING THAT HANDLES THE HARD PARTS
• Variable wind (VRB and 200V280), gusts, m/s and km/h converted to knots
• CAVOK, NSC, NCD, SKC, CLR, vertical visibility
• Runway visual range with trends (R25R/1100U, M0050, P2000)
• Present and recent weather: TSRA, VCSH, FZFG, +SHSN and more
• Trends: NOSIG, BECMG, TEMPO
• US remarks: AO2, sea-level pressure, precise temperature, peak wind, wind shift, lightning, precipitation
• TAF: FM, BECMG, TEMPO, PROB30 and PROB40, with the flight category of each period

FAVORITES BOARD
Your airports at a glance: flight category, wind, visibility and ceiling in plain words.

CEILO PRO
• Runway wind: turn the runway dial to see headwind, tailwind and crosswind for every runway, gusts included
• Best aligned runway, corrected for magnetic variation
• Density altitude, pressure altitude, humidity and estimated cloud base
• TAF timeline: forecast flight category hour by hour, with TEMPO and PROB periods
• Unlimited favorite airports

FREE
Unlimited lookups with decoded METAR and TAF, and 3 favorite airports. The basics stay free.

DATA
Weather data comes from the NOAA Aviation Weather Center (aviationweather.gov), a U.S. government service. Ceilo asks it directly from your iPhone; only the airport codes you look up are sent. No account, no ads, no analytics.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://dravlogy.com/mobile/metar-taf/privacy

Not for navigation: use official briefings. Ceilo is a reading aid; data can be late or missing. Always check the raw report and an official weather briefing before flight.

name: Cellbin
description: Cellbin is a battery drawer notebook. Each cell pack has a size, a chemistry, a count, a bin, the device it serves, and a low-count line. Plus and minus change the count. Low lists packs at or under the line you set. Size totals add counts that share a size word. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Century Motors- سنشري للسيارات
description:
مع تطبيق سنشري للسيارات تقدر تتصفح تشكيلة واسعة من السيارات الجديدة من أشهر الماركات العالمية، وتعرف كل تفاصيلها، وتطلب سيارتك وأنت في مكانك، بكل سهولة ووضوح.

ماذا يقدّم لك التطبيق؟

• تشكيلة متجددة من السيارات الجديدة
تصفّح أحدث الموديلات من أبرز الماركات، مرتبة بشكل واضح يسهّل عليك الوصول للسيارة المناسبة لك.

• تفاصيل كاملة لكل سيارة
صور خارجية وداخلية عالية الجودة، الألوان المتاحة، المواصفات الفنية مثل المحرك وناقل الحركة ونظام الدفع وعدد المقاعد وسنة الصنع، والإمكانيات والمميزات.

• أسعار واضحة
السعر معروض بشكل شفاف، مع السعر بعد الضريبة، لتعرف التكلفة الحقيقية قبل أن تقرر.

• المقارنة بين السيارات
قارن بين أكثر من سيارة جنباً إلى جنب لتختار الأنسب لك عن قناعة.

• البحث والفلترة
ابحث باسم السيارة أو صفِّ النتائج حسب الماركة والمواصفات لتصل لما تريده بسرعة.

• اطلب سيارتك بسهولة
أرسل طلب الشراء مباشرة من التطبيق في خطوات بسيطة، وسيتواصل معك فريق المبيعات لإتمام طلبك.

• خدمة الشركات
حلول مخصصة للشركات والمنظمات والمؤسسات الراغبة في شراء أكثر من سيارة، مع إمكانية التواصل المباشر مع مسؤول مبيعات الشركات.

• العروض
تابع أحدث عروض سنشري للسيارات أولاً بأول.

• الإشعارات
كن أول من يعرف بوصول السيارات الجديدة والعروض الحصرية.

• تواصل سريع
تواصل معنا مباشرة عبر الاتصال أو واتساب، وتعرّف على فروعنا ومواقعنا.

سنشري للسيارات… سيارتك الجديدة تبدأ من هنا.

name: Cheatwave: Cheats for GTA 6
description:
Every cheat, one tap away.

Cheatwave shows each cheat code exactly like your controller, so you can enter long button sequences without mistakes.

COMBO MODE
One giant button at a time, with voice and haptics. Tap or swipe to move through the sequence while you hold the controller. Works in portrait and landscape.

YOUR PLATFORM, YOUR BUTTONS
Switch between PlayStation, Xbox and PC and every code updates instantly: Y B A X, or typed PC codes and in-game phone numbers.

ALWAYS UP TO DATE
New cheats are added as soon as they're verified, with the unlock requirement for each one. Favorites, search and categories help you find the right code fast.

PRO
- Every code, including Pro exclusives
- New cheats the minute they're verified
- Combo Mode with voice

Works with GTA VI and GTA V (story mode, single player).

Cheatwave is an unofficial app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, Sony Interactive Entertainment or Microsoft. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://www.gabrielapps.xyz/cheatwave-policy

name: CheckStamp: Did I Lock It?
description:
Halfway down the street, the thought hits: did I lock the door? Did I turn off the stove?

CheckStamp turns that moment into a tiny habit. Right after you check something, tap it on your Apple Watch. A red ink stamp lands with a gentle tap on your wrist, and the time is saved.

Later, when the doubt creeps in, just raise your wrist: “Front door · 10:32.” There's your own note that you checked.

HOW IT WORKS
• Check the door, then tap “Front door” on your watch. Stamp!
• Feel a little tap on your wrist as the time is recorded.
• Tapped the wrong one? Undo within 5 seconds.
• Wondering later? Raise your wrist and see when you last checked.

MADE FOR A QUICK GLANCE
• Stamps from the last 12 hours show in red. Older ones fade, so today's checks stand out.
• Watch face complications show each item's last stamp time, in several sizes.
• Double tap (on Apple Watch models that support it) stamps your first item hands-free.
• On watchOS 26, use the CheckStamp control in Control Center or the Smart Stack, or the Action button on Apple Watch Ultra, to stamp your first item without opening the app.

YOUR ITEMS, YOUR WAY
Front door, gas stove, hair iron and window are ready from the start. In the iPhone app, add up to 8 items, rename them, pick an emoji, reorder or delete them. Your history from the last 90 days is kept. Not wearing your watch? You can stamp on your iPhone, too.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking, no servers. Your stamps stay on your devices. Your iPhone and Apple Watch sync only with each other.

ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Buy it once and it's yours. No subscription.

A stamp is a record that you checked. It can't see your door or your stove, but it remembers that you looked, so you can stop wondering and get on with your day.

Requires iOS 18 and watchOS 11. The control requires watchOS 26.

name: Chemical Process Design: Vexal
description:
Chemical Process Design: Vexal is a study companion for chemical engineering students working through a plant design course. It follows one question from the first sketch to the final report: is this process worth building, and how would you lay it out?

Pick a path. The syllabus path takes 23 units in teaching order, from flowsheet synthesis and recycle-and-purge balances through reactors, distillation, heat integration, equipment sizing and costing to risk, safety, sustainability, control structure and the design report. The project path starts from an object to make, such as a recycle loop, a splitter, a heat-recovery network or a budget case, and opens the matching lesson at the step where you get stuck. 16 projects with 81 checked steps feed the same progress record as the syllabus path, so you can swap paths whenever you like.

Five labs let you push sliders and watch the equations respond: stepping stages on a McCabe-Thiele diagram, comparing CSTR and PFR volumes on a Levenspiel plot, sliding hot and cold composite curves to find the pinch, tuning a recycle and purge loop, and searching for the reflux that minimises yearly cost. Every lab shows a cited relation and a second-method check.

Practice adapts to you. There are 738 original questions on four levels from Beginner to Research; 543 have numeric answers, each worked out two different ways before it was written in, and 195 are conceptual items for practice. The app remembers what you know, brings back what you are forgetting and points to the lesson behind each miss, with kind and specific feedback. Sessions run 5, 10, 20 or 40 questions, or a length you choose. Ten multi-step design problems and two timed 180-minute paper-style mocks, with no ads, round it out.

What the app covers, in exact numbers: 73 of 73 mapped course points covered with 8 or more questions each. A Coverage screen lists each point with its lesson, questions and cited sources. A separate informational list of NCEES PE Chemical specification points shows 13 of 41 covered, 20 partly and 8 without content; this is not a PE or FE exam product.

Citations open in a wide sheet that you close with a tap. Type size can be set from 50 to 300 percent. No account is needed, everything works offline and your progress stays on your device.

The app is free with ads. A short video unlocks extra features for a day, and an optional monthly subscription turns ads off and unlocks everything. Lessons, worked solutions and your progress are never locked. The subscription is billed to your store account every month until you cancel it in the account settings, and the store shows the price before you confirm. Restore purchases is under More.

For teaching only: models are simplified and costs are illustrative, so nothing here is guidance for building, running or funding a real plant. No link to any university, standards body or publisher named in the sources.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-chemical-process-design-vexal.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: ChenYujong
description:
【成语接龙】一款除首启一条安装来源统计外完全离线的成语接龙文字游戏。

在一方青花瓷面上，把四字成语一枚一枚扣成一条长链。

【玩法一 · 接龙填字（500 关）】
棋盘上摆着几个四字成语，相邻两个成语共用一个字，像两条链子扣上同一个环。
有几格是空的，从下面的候选字里挑一个填进去。
前十关只有两个成语、两个空格、四个字给你挑；每十关往上抬一档 ——
到最后，棋盘上摆着十六个成语、十六个空格，候选字里还混着读得通、接不上的干扰项。
每一关的空位答案只有一个是对的，不会出现「怎么选都错」的憋屈局面。
填完通关，会把这关的成语连同释义摆给你看——顺手又学会几条。

【玩法二 · 自由接龙（无限）】
按老规矩来：上一条的最后一个字，就是下一条的头一个字。
一举成名 → 名落孙山 → 山清水秀 → 水天一色 → 一望无际……
三命用完这轮就结束，看谁接得长。
嫌太规整，也能切成「共字相扣」：下一条只要和上一条共有一个字就算接上。

【玩法三 · 成语词库】
94 条成语逐条配图——不是符号、不是色块，是一幅古画。
每条都带拼音、释义、出处和例句，出处里能看见它从哪本古书里来的。
按六类查找：寓言故事、历史典故、品格修养、做事方法、自然景致、功业成败。
喜欢的点书签收进「我的」。

【关于这个 App】
· 除首启一条安装来源统计外完全离线：不注册、不收集任何个人数据、不做社区、不推广告、不做内购。
· 所有关卡、词库、配图都打包在 App 里，装一次，飞行模式也能玩。
· 成绩、收藏与外观设置只存在你自己的设备上，卸载即清除。
· 支持 iPhone 与 iPad（含折叠屏），深浅色主题，字号可调。

【隐私】
不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。战绩、收藏与外观偏好只存在你自己的手机里，
卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。

唯一会联网的动作：启动时向 apinstall.com 发一条安装来源统计，内容只有一个随机设备标识、
一组设备参数（机型 / 系统 / 屏幕 / 语言地区 / 时区 / CPU 核数）、剪贴板里是否存在邮件地址格式
（有 / 无，不读取内容），以及服务器记录的来源 IP。这些数据不含姓名、邮箱、电话、地址、位置与照片，
只发给这一个单位，不与任何第三方共享，也不用于追踪。

【适合】
喜欢成语、想找点事做的成年人；想给孩子做启蒙的家长；通勤路上想用五分钟活动一下脑筋的人。

下载即玩，五十关一晃眼就到。

name: Chess Checkmates - Silicio
description:
Find checkmate. Learn from your mistakes. Try again.

Chess Checkmates by Ajedrez de Silicio brings together 12,017 unique puzzles to train your mating vision and calculation on iPhone and iPad.

FIVE THEMES
• Mate in 1
• Mate in 2
• Mate in 3
• Mate in 4
• Mate in 5 or more

THREE LEVELS
Intermediate, Advanced and High Level. Choose your training level; it changes only when you decide. High Level starts at mate in 2. Puzzle counts vary by theme and level, with up to 1,000 in each group.

LEARN FROM YOUR MISTAKES
Retry puzzles you missed. Once you have at least five available, build a test from your mistakes. You can also create tests with new puzzles across different themes.

PROGRESS AT YOUR OWN PACE
Open any puzzle from its numbered map or continue where you left off. Track solved puzzles, mistakes and best times. Your Silicio rating changes gradually, and each puzzle affects it only once per profile: repeats never add or subtract points. This is an internal training rating, not a FIDE Elo equivalent.

A BOARD BUILT FOR STUDY
Drag pieces or tap the starting and destination squares. After a puzzle, replay the solution move by move with figurine notation and flip the board. Coordinates stay outside the board.

UP TO FIVE PROFILES
Share a device with up to five users, each with separate results and a chosen level. Profiles and progress stay on the device and do not sync between devices.

Works offline. No advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases. The interface uses English or Spanish according to your device’s language preferences.

Repetition deepens learning.

name: Chess Clock: Blitz Game Timer
description:
A chess clock that is easy to read from both sides of the board, and that knows every way of counting time.

TWO HALVES, ONE TAP
Lay the iPhone between you. Each player has half of the screen, the far half turned around. Tap your half when you have moved: your clock stops and the other starts, the moment your finger comes down. The half whose clock runs is filled with colour, and a shade grows over it as the time goes. In the last seconds it turns red.

THE TIME CONTROLS PLAYERS USE
Ready to choose: bullet (1|0, 1|1, 2|1), blitz (3|0, 3|2, 5|0, 5|3), rapid (10|0, 10|5, 15|10, 25|10), classical (30|0, 60|0, 90|30), and games with a delay. Increment (Fischer), simple delay and Bronstein delay are all there.

MADE FOR A REAL GAME
The screen stays on while a clock runs. A click for each side, a warning when ten seconds are left (or thirty, or sixty), tenths of a second at the end. Pause at any time; the clock also pauses by itself if you leave the app. The sounds follow the silent switch.

CHESS CLOCK PRO: YOUR OWN TIME CONTROLS
Any main time, increment or delay. A second stage, such as "90 minutes for 40 moves, then 30 more". A different time for each side, to give the stronger player less.

CHESS CLOCK PRO: EVERY KIND OF CLOCK
Byo-yomi (a number of periods after the main time) and Canadian overtime (a number of moves in each period) for Go and shogi. An hourglass, where the time you use goes to your opponent.

CHESS CLOCK PRO: A CLOCK FOR THE WHOLE TABLE
Three to eight players with their names, for any board game: the same time for every turn, or a bank of time each. One big field to tap when your turn is done, and everybody's time below it.

CHESS CLOCK PRO: EVERY GAME KEPT
Each game goes into a record: who ran out of time, how many moves, and a chart of the time each move took, with the average and the longest think for both players.

EIGHT LOOKS
Midnight and Felt are free. Tournament, Walnut, Neon, Sunset, Paper and Ocean come with Pro.

FREE
The clock for two with all the usual time controls, increment and both delays, the sounds and two looks.

PRIVATE
No account. Your games stay on your iPhone; the app sends nothing to us.

Chess Clock Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you, and it turns into the paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

Privacy Policy: https://www.appgeolist.com/app/chess-clock/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Chess Openings · Silicon Chess
description:
Train chess openings with 10,453 unique puzzles organized into 14 themes. Practice real decisions from the opening and learn from your mistakes.

THREE LEVELS IN ONE APP
Intermediate (1000–1500), Advanced (1500–2000) and High Level (2000–2500). These are approximate playing-level references: you choose your level and decide when to change it. Each theme has 300 puzzles at Intermediate and Advanced level, and between 102 and 300 at High Level.

LEARN THROUGH REPETITION
Find each puzzle by number, pick up where you left off and revisit your mistakes. Create mixed-theme tests from new puzzles or from your own mistakes when at least five are available.

TRACK YOUR TRAINING
A gradual Silicon Chess rating, history, progress by theme and your best time for each puzzle. Your reference rating is a starting point: Silicon Chess rating is an internal training measure, not an official chess rating. Repeating a puzzle never changes your rating.

YOUR SILICON CHESS BOARD
Drag pieces or tap the starting and destination squares. Review the solution with chess figurines, move numbers and PGN controls; step forward, go back and flip the board. Move sounds and coordinates outside the board.

Create up to five local profiles on one device. The puzzle collection is included and training works offline. The interface follows your device language in English or Spanish. No ads or in-app purchases.

Repetition deepens learning.

name: Chess: Memory & Vision
description:
Can you follow a game once the pieces disappear? Train your chess memory and visualization in three ways. Start with a visible board and remove the visual guides when you're ready.

• Blindfold chess. Play full games against Stockfish 19 at four levels. Choose White or Black and play with pieces, colored circles, or an empty board. Check the last move, resume your game, and share it as PGN.

• Remember openings. Study 60 essential lines with a short explanation of what to remember. Replay the moves, then recall both sides on your own. Aim for three perfect repetitions in a row with pieces, circles, or blindfold. Search 3,815 lines by name or ECO code and save favorites.

• Invisible board. Study a real opening position, hide the pieces, and rebuild both sides from the tray. Compare your answer with the original and try again.

Drag pieces or tap the squares. Track progress by opening and practice mode. Export or restore a JSON backup, including compatible backups from the Android app.

One-time purchase. All training runs on your device, offline, with no accounts, ads, or subscriptions. In English and Spanish. For players who already know the rules of chess.

Created by Ajedrez de Silicio.

name: Chicken Escape 2
description:
Charlie the chicken has had enough of farm life. Tonight, Charlie is breaking out!

Chicken Escape is a charming stealth platformer. Hide in tall grass and haystacks, time your moves while the farmer looks away, and sneak past guard dogs, geese and the cat to reach the exit. Free the caged chicks along the way and lead your little flock to freedom.

FEATURES
- 13 hand-drawn levels across the farm, the pigsty, the barn and beyond
- Stealth gameplay: watch vision cones, hide, crouch and distract
- Boss fights against angry Farmer Joe and other farm bosses
- Rescue caged chicks who follow you as a flock
- Collect coins, corn and golden eggs to unlock outfits and hats for Charlie
- Earn up to 3 stars per level
- Simple touch controls with an on-screen joystick
- Drag the screen to look around and plan your route
- Available in 6 languages

NO ADS. NO IN-APP PURCHASES. NO ACCOUNT. NO DATA COLLECTED.
Everything you unlock is earned by playing. The game works fully offline.

name: Chiplens: Device Info & Specs
description:
See what's really inside your iPhone and iPad. Chiplens shows your exact model, chip, CPU and GPU cores, memory, display, cameras and battery health — and every number is labelled with where it comes from. No ads. No account. Nothing leaves your device.

LIVE DIE
Watch your chip work: each CPU core lights up with its live load. Tap the GPU or Neural Engine to learn what it does.

BATTERY HEALTH LAB
Health, cycle count, real capacity and temperature from your iPhone's own Analytics log, with step-by-step help. Track how your battery ages, and get a charge alert at the level you choose with a Shortcuts automation.

LIVE MONITOR
CPU per core, memory, storage, network speed and thermal state in real time, with 60-second charts.

SPEC LIBRARY & COMPARE
Specs of iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch models, including the newest ones. Compare yours with its predecessor or any other model, with the better spec marked on every row.

HARDWARE CHECKUP
Test the screen, touch, speakers, microphone, cameras, flashlight, buttons and sensors in about two minutes, with a score at the end.

DEVICE REPORT
A clean PDF with a QR code to share when you sell or buy a used device.

ASK ABOUT YOUR DEVICE
Plain-language answers about your own device, generated on device with Apple Intelligence on supported models.

WIDGETS
Battery, My Device and Storage widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy.

HONEST BY DESIGN
iOS doesn't let apps read the CPU temperature, the live clock speed or other apps' usage, and no app can "clean" memory. Chiplens never pretends to.

Private: no account, no tracking, no ads. Data Not Collected.

name: Chord Reading: Guitar Quiz
description:
Chord Reading turns guitar chord diagrams into a quick, friendly game. It was designed by Miss Jennifer Wong, a professional guitar and singing teacher in Hong Kong, and brings the chord drills she uses in lessons into one app.

BEGINNER: 9 ESSENTIAL CHORDS
- C, A, G, E, D, Am, Em, Dm and F
- Read the diagram and pick the right chord name
- Show intervals (R / 3 / b3 / 5) or note names on every dot
- Hear the chord after each answer and learn its notes and CAGED shape
- Choose the timer, number of questions and which chords to practise

ADVANCED: CAGED, DEGREES & PROGRESSIONS
- Chord names: open chords, E- and A-shape barre chords, 7ths, sus4, maj7, dim, aug and more
- CAGED shapes: the same chord in five places on the neck
- Degrees: name each chord's Roman numeral in the key
- Progressions in 9 modes: Major, Natural Minor, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Locrian, Harmonic Minor and Melodic Minor
- Diatonic chord charts (triads and 7th chords) - tap any chord to hear it
- Export a diatonic-chord handout as PDF or print it

ALSO
- 8 languages: bilingual Chinese/English, Traditional Chinese, English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Italian and Korean
- Real steel-string guitar samples, strum or arpeggio, three speeds
- Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac
- Works offline, no ads, no data collected

Great for beginners, guitar students, self-learners and music teachers.

name: Christmas List Tracker Budget
description:
See who still needs a Christmas gift, what’s already wrapped, and how much you have left to spend. Keep every idea with the person it’s for, from the first stocking stuffer to the last present under the tree.

Spot a gift online? Paste the product link. When the shop provides the details, the gift name, photo, and price fill in for you. Shopping in person? Snap a shelf tag to capture the item and read its name and price. You can edit either field, leave the price blank, or jot down an idea before you know where to buy it.

See exactly what each person is getting
Open someone’s list to see their gifts together. Keep stocking stuffers separate from presents under the tree. Bought, wrapped, and given gifts stay visible, so you can check what’s already covered before buying one more thing.

Plan for every Christmas gathering
Create a tree for Christmas morning at home, another for the office exchange, and one for family you’ll visit. Each tree keeps its people and gifts together.

Know what’s left in your budget
See what you plan to spend, what you’ve already spent, and what’s left. Check the totals for one person or your whole Christmas list. Budgets and prices are in US dollars.

Share a list and keep the surprise
Choose which gifts to send and whether to include prices or store links. Preview exactly what the other person will see.

Remember what you gave last year
Save each Christmas by year. Next season, look up what you gave someone before you start their new list.

Explore the sample list for free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks your personal gift planner. No subscription or account is required.

name: ChurchPillar
description:
ChurchPillar helps churches care for people and run ministry in one calm, organized workspace.

- People and households: keep member and guest records together, with each person seeing only what their church role allows.
- Attendance: take attendance on your phone with a simple checklist, add guests, and see who has been missing.
- Follow-up and care: assign next steps and pastoral care so no one slips through the cracks.
- Ministry teams: plan serving schedules and let volunteers accept or decline.
- Groups and events: organize groups, gatherings and calendars.
- Giving: see your giving history and give to your church through your church's own giving page.
- Reports: attendance and engagement reports for pastors and church leaders.
- Secure by role: church owners decide who can see and change what. Sign in with Apple, Google or email.

ChurchPillar is for churches that use it. Your church invites you, or a church owner creates the church's workspace. Church owners can subscribe to a plan on the ChurchPillar website.

Questions? Visit churchpillar.originpillar.org/support.

name: CinderWheel
description:
CinderWheel is a night watch with Ziri, a little fireman who catches falling sparks before they miss the shoes.

Four chutes stand side by side. Sparks drop quickly from the top, each marked Fire, Water, Leaf, or Moon. The shoes at the bottom wear those same marks. Swipe left or swipe right and every shoe slides one chute. A spark scores when it lands on the matching shoe. A miss puts out a lamp.

The fall is fast, so the swipe has to be quick. Chains raise the score. The wick cools while you play and warms again on a clean catch. If the wick goes out, the sparks drop even faster. Beacon Hold, once charged, freezes the fall for a short breath.

Some sparks change the catch. Golden sparks fit any shoe. Frost locks one swipe. Twins demand a second match right away. Cracked sparks burn on a fuse. A pulse spark charges Beacon Hold.

Thirty posts climb the hill. Spark is the easy shift, Flare is quicker, and Inferno shortens the clock and leaves fewer lamps. Earn up to three stars, bank ember chips, and take a dawn ration once each day. Watch, Trail, and Journal sit on the tab bar so the hill, the records, and the next post are one tap apart.

CinderWheel stays on the device. No account, no download while you play, and no server clock. Swipe the shoes. Catch the spark.

name: CircuitKit: Electronics Kit
description:
One purchase unlocks everything — no upgrades, no ads, no subscription, no internet needed.

CircuitKit puts the calculators, reference tables and pinouts that electricians, engineers, makers and students reach for every day into one fast, fully offline app.

CALCULATORS
• Ohm's law, DC / single-phase / three-phase power, voltage divider, series & parallel, Wheatstone bridge
• Resistor colour code (both ways), SMD resistor codes, capacitor codes, inductor colour code, E-series lookup
• LED resistor, reactance & resonance, filter cutoff, RC charge, decibels, RMS, wavelength, air-core coil
• Op-amp, 555 timer, LM317, Zener, transistor switch, star–delta
• Cable voltage drop & sizing (mm² and AWG), PCB trace width (IPC-2221), heatsink, battery life & packs
• Power-factor correction, motor current, breaker sizing, transformer current, energy cost
• Number bases, ADC/DAC, SI prefixes, AWG ⇄ mm², temperature, battery C-rate

PINOUTS (tap a pin on the drawing)
• USB A/B/Mini/Micro/C, Lightning, HDMI, DisplayPort, VGA, DVI, RS-232, ATX, SATA, PCIe, RJ45/PoE, audio jacks, XLR/DMX, MIDI
• Raspberry Pi & Pico, Arduino Uno/Nano/Mega/Pro Mini/Leonardo/Micro, ESP32 DevKitC / S3 / C3 / CAM, ESP8266 NodeMCU / ESP-01 / D1 mini, STM32 Blue Pill
• 60+ ICs: 555, op-amps, comparators, 74HC & 4000 logic, regulators, drivers, optocouplers, ATmega328P, ATtiny85, PWM controllers…
• 20+ modules: nRF24L01, LoRa, HC-05, OLED, TFT, RFID, GPS, DHT, MPU-6050, BME280, A4988, L298N, HX711…
• OBD-II, car radio ISO 10487, automotive relays, trailer plugs

REFERENCE
Standard resistor & capacitor values, capacitor markings, SMD packages, transistors, diodes, regulators, logic families, batteries & coin cells, fuses, AWG/metric/SWG wire, resistivity, mains colours, thermocouples, PT100, I²C addresses, ESP32 GPIO, logic levels, schematic symbols (IEC & ANSI), ASCII, RF bands, IP ratings, world plugs, IEC 60320, NEMA, USB, earthing systems & RCDs and more.

• Engineering input: 4.7k, 4k7, 100n, 2.2M
• Tap a result to copy, share a whole calculation as text
• Favourites, recent items and search
• Light & dark themes, English and Vietnamese

Reference values are for design guidance — always check the datasheet and your local electrical code.

name: Civicue
description:
Civicue is a personal journal for what you notice in public spaces. Note a dark underpass, a blocked ramp, a broken bench or thirsty street trees; keep the place, category, photos and notes; move each item from noted to following up to resolved with a full history; set follow-up reminders; and export tidy PDF or plain-text reports.

Civicue is personal only. There is no public posting and no feed, and it is not connected to, or affiliated with, any council, authority or government service. Nothing is submitted on your behalf: reports are created on your iPhone and shared only if you choose to.

STATUS BOARD
• Large counters for noted, following up and resolved — tap one to see those observations.
• A summary line with open items, the share resolved and any overdue follow-ups.
• Your next follow-up at a glance.
• A bar chart by category and a list of areas with stacked status bars; tap a bar or an area to filter the journal.
• Recent observations.

JOURNAL
• Search, plus Area, Category and Status filters.
• Observation cards with coloured status stripes and drawn category pictograms.

OBSERVATIONS
• Title, category (lighting, cleanliness, accessibility, maintenance, greenery, safety or other), place and area, with suggestions from areas you have used.
• Optional latitude and longitude that you type yourself, with "Open in Maps". Civicue never reads your location.
• Observed date and time, starting status and notes.
• Up to 6 photos per observation from the camera or your photo library, with a full-screen viewer.

STATUS AND HISTORY
• Move an observation through noted → following up → resolved with one tap, and add an optional note to each change.
• Every change, edit, photo and reminder is kept on a timeline, and you can add your own notes to it.

FOLLOW-UPS
• Set a reminder to go back and check a place, with quick presets such as tomorrow or next week.
• Overdue, upcoming and done sections; tick reminders off as you go.
• A local notification arrives on your iPhone when it's time; tapping it opens the observation.
• Resolving an observation closes its open reminders.

REPORTS
• Choose a scope by area, category, status and period (all time, last 30 or 90 days).
• Include photos and history if you like, and add a title and "prepared by" line.
• Create a paginated PDF report with summary boxes, status stripes, photos and history, preview it and share it — or share or copy a plain-text report.
• Export a single observation from its detail page.

WORKS OFFLINE, BACKED UP PRIVATELY
• No account and no sign-in — Civicue opens straight onto your status board.
• Everything is saved on your iPhone first and works without a connection.
• Your journal is backed up automatically to a private cloud space that belongs only to this install of the app; changes made offline are sent when you're back online. A small three-lamp signal shows the backup status.
• Settings → "Delete all my data" removes everything from your iPhone and from the cloud backup.
• Want to look around first? Settings → "Load sample data" adds a fictional journal (8 observations in invented places and 4 follow-ups) that you can remove again in one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no analytics and no tracking.
• The camera is used only when you choose to take a photo; notifications are requested only when you save your first reminder.

Civicue is an independent personal journal. It is not affiliated with any government, council or public authority and does not provide official information or report anything to them.

name: Clap Finder: Find Your Phone
description:
Can't find your phone? Clap twice or whistle. It rings, blinks its flashlight and vibrates, so you can find it by ear, by eye or by touch.

HOW IT WORKS
• Turn listening on once. The app keeps listening with the phone locked.
• Clap twice, or whistle for about a second.
• The phone rings for a minute, or until you tap Stop or unlock it.
• It rings at your phone's volume, so keep the volume up.

IT KNOWS A CLAP FROM OTHER NOISE
The app recognizes the sound of a clap and of a whistle with a sound model that runs on the phone. It is made to ignore talking, typing and other everyday noise.

FREE
• Clap and whistle finding
• Three alarm sounds
• "Don't touch" alarm: a siren when someone moves your phone
• Charger alarm: a siren when someone unplugs it
• A list of what the phone heard, and how many times it found your phone

PRO, ONE PAYMENT
• No ads
• Seven more sounds
• Say anything: type a sentence and your phone says it out loud
• Your own 3-second recording as the alarm
• A sound file of your own as the alarm
• Quiet hours
• Ring length and flashlight pattern
You can also watch one ad to open all of these, apart from No ads, for a day.

GOOD TO KNOW
• While the app listens, iPhone shows the orange microphone dot.
• While you use your phone, listening pauses. It starts again when the phone locks.
• A phone call or Siri pauses listening. If it does not come back by itself, open the app.
• After you restart the phone, open the app once to turn listening back on. A notification reminds you.

name: Claybell
description:
Claybell turns everyday mug workshop arithmetic into clear formulas you can run in seconds.

Eight stations follow a mug from wet clay to the carton: body forming, clay mix, slip and capacity, glaze, kiln firing, printing, packing, and cost and time. Forty-eight built-in expressions cover shrinkage, slip fill, cone temperature, pallet load, unit cost, and the rest of the numbers you reach for at the bench.

Every formula shows its expression and plain-language parameter meanings. Enter your figures, calculate, and file the run to the ledger. Star the formulas you repeat, search by keyword, and reopen a filed run with the same inputs.

Set workshop rates once in Shop—currency, hourly wage, power, clay, and glaze prices—so cost formulas pick them up with one tap.

Orton cone temperatures use self-supporting regular cones at 108°F per hour. Planning numbers only: your scale, pyrometer, and a finished mug still decide the firing.

Claybell is built for potters, slip-cast studios, and small mug lines that want one dependable calculator on the phone in the studio.

name: CleanZen: Smart Cleaner
seller_name: ASTERIX SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT CONSULTING JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
CleanZen helps you get storage back on your iPhone. It looks through everything an app is allowed to see, your photos and videos, the files in folders you pick and your contacts, finds what takes space for nothing, and lets you clear it safely.

Where most of the space comes back from:
- Photos and videos: the same photo saved twice, shots taken a moment apart that look almost the same, blurry photos, old screenshots, screen recordings, bursts and large videos. In each group of look-alikes the best one is kept, and you decide what goes
- Optimize: make large videos smaller with HEVC, turn Live Photos into still photos, and save big JPEG and PNG photos as HEIC. The new copy is saved first, with its date, place and Favorite, and only then is the original offered for removal
- Files: large, old and duplicate files in the folders you pick, and iCloud Drive downloads that can come off the iPhone once they are safely uploaded
- Swipe Mode: go through a month one photo at a time, left to remove, right to keep

And to keep the iPhone in good shape:
- Overview: how much storage is used and free, and how much the photo library takes
- Duplicate contacts: merge people saved more than once, with a backup so you can undo it
- Phone health: storage, temperature and security settings at a glance
- Secret Space: private photos and videos kept inside CleanZen, behind Face ID
- Explain: a short summary of what the scan found and where to start, written by Apple Intelligence on your iPhone
- A storage widget for the Home Screen and Lock Screen, and a Siri shortcut that starts a scan

Nothing is selected for you. When you remove photos, iOS asks you to confirm, and they stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days, so you can still get them back. Files go to the Trash in the Files app. Favorites and the photos you protect are never suggested.

Everything is checked on your iPhone. There is no account, no ads and no tracking, and nothing is uploaded. Photos that are only in iCloud are not downloaded unless you turn that on.

One thing iOS doesn't allow: no app can see how much space other apps use or clear their caches. CleanZen tells you that instead of pretending, and points you to Settings › General › iPhone Storage for it.

Scanning and seeing every result is free, and the free version removes up to 50 items. CleanZen Pro is one purchase with no subscription. It removes the limit and unlocks Optimize and Secret Space, and your family can share it.

CleanZen started as my Mac app for cleaning up disk space, and the iPhone version keeps its rules: nothing goes without you, and what can't be measured is shown as unknown, never guessed.

name: Clear Connect by Clear Group
description:
Clear Connect is the app for Clear Group's own employees at Clear Construction, Clear Architecture, Clear Millwork and Clear Tradework. Sign in with your Clear Microsoft account.

ON THE CLOCK
• Clock in on your project and cost code, switch projects, take a break and clock out in My Time.
• See your shift and its timer on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while you're on the clock.
• Clock in, start a break or end one from the Home Screen widget without opening the app.
• My Time opens with no signal. A punch you make offline is sent when you're back in range.
• Where your role uses it, a reminder asks whether to clock in when you arrive at one of your job sites.

RECEIPTS
• Take a picture of a receipt, or pick several from Photos, and send them to Accounts Payable.

YOUR WORK
• Approve the bills waiting on you.
• Keep up with your team's meetings, to-dos and goals in Cadence, and with your projects.

YOUR LOCATION
While you're clocked in, Clear Connect records where you are when you clock in or out, switch projects or take a break, and, where your role uses it, your route during the shift. It records nothing while you're off the clock. Job-site reminders check for your arrival on the phone itself and never send your location to Clear. You can turn location off in Settings at any time and still clock in and out.

Clear Connect is for Clear Group employees. Privacy policy: https://www.clear.group/privacy-policy

name: Cliko Anvilis
description: Master metalworking through an interactive forging simulation where every strike changes the shape of your workpiece. Control heating, choose the right tools, and perform operations such as drawing, upsetting, bending, and joining components. Measure dimensions, compare results with technical drawings, and correct defects before they become harder to fix. Complete workshop orders while managing material usage, temperature, and manufacturing constraints. Plan operation sequences to improve precision and avoid unnecessary rework. Unlock increasingly complex projects and develop your skills through repeatable engineering challenges.

name: Climogram
description:
Climogram shows what the weather is usually like in a US city or town, at every hour of every day of the year, and how it has changed since 1940. It is the app of climogram.com: the same numbers, charts and sentences, made for iPhone and iPad.

It covers 1,747 places: every city and town of about 30,000 people or more, the main cities of every metro and micro area, and every state capital.

A PLACE AT A GLANCE
Each city opens with a short verdict in plain words and the best time of year to visit. One chart shows the typical temperature for every hour of every day, so you can see at once how hot a July afternoon gets or how cold a January night is. Under it: the twelve months with their highs and lows, then temperature, humidity, air quality, clouds, rain, snow, sunshine and daylight, the night sky, the moon, wind, storms, frost and the growing season.

RIGHT NOW
Where a nearby airport weather station reports, a place shows its latest temperature next to what is normal for this hour and date ("8° warmer than normal"), with the National Weather Service's short forecast and any warnings.

ALERTS
Get a notification when one of your places is unusually warm or cold for the hour, or under a weather warning. Season alerts tell you when the first frost or the last frost is near, or the hottest week of the year begins. You choose the threshold and the quiet hours.

MONTH BY MONTH
Open any month to see it day by day: the typical high and low, the chance of rain or snow, the clouds, the humidity, the wind and the sun.

COMPARE
Put two to five places side by side. Each keeps its own color on every chart, so you can see whose summers are hotter, whose winters are wetter and who gets more sun. Type "Denver vs Austin" in search to start one.

RANKINGS
The warmest summers, the mildest winters, the snowiest places, the latest frosts and more, for the whole country, a region or a state, as a list or on a map.

YOUR PLACES, EVERYWHERE
Star the places you care about. They stay on Home with their temperature right now, and they open without a connection once you have viewed them. "Your climate" shows the place nearest you. Widgets put a place on your Home Screen, Lock Screen or StandBy: today against normal, two places side by side, or a place's climate ring. Ask Siri how today compares to normal, find any place from Spotlight, and share any chart as a picture.

YOUR UNITS
Fahrenheit or Celsius, mph, km/h, knots or m/s, inches or millimeters, miles or kilometers, in any mix. Light and dark appearance.

COMPUTED, NOT WRITTEN BY HAND
Every chart, number and sentence is computed from open climate data and weather station records, and checked against NOAA's official 1991 to 2020 climate normals.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Free, with no account, no ads, no tracking and no analytics. Your saved places and settings stay on your device. If you ask for places near you, your location is used on the device to find them and is never sent anywhere. Alerts are worked out on your device too.

name: Clipferry: Clipboard Manager
description:
Clipferry remembers what you copy, so you can paste it again later: text, links and images.

Press ⇧⌘V in any app on your Mac. Your history opens as a row of cards. Click one, or press Return, and it is pasted where you were typing.

FIND IT AGAIN
• Search as you type
• Cards show where each clip came from and when
• Links show the page title and picture
• Pin the clips you use every day

KEEP IT TIDY
• Coloured folders for the things you paste often: addresses, replies, snippets

MAC, IPHONE AND IPAD

MADE FOR THE MAC

FREE AND PRO
Clipferry is free to use on one device with the last 24 hours of history.

name: CloakFlow
description:
Rehearse the cloakroom before the doors open.

Will faster check-in move the bottleneck backstage? Who should collect coats when one claim spans several zones? What happens when one person shares check-in and handover?

CloakFlow helps theatre, exhibition and campus event organizers rehearse ticket checks, coat retrieval and handover with the staff they have. Follow queues and individual claims, inspect peaks, and compare the effects of a different assignment.

FROM A REQUEST LIST TO A STAFF BRIEFING

1. Explore an example or create your event
Start with an independent, editable theatre example to learn the three-stage replay. Then enter your own requests, storage zones and team.

2. Prepare requests and arrivals
Enter claims individually, generate them from arrival windows, or import a CSV and review validation before applying it. One claim represents one person and may contain multiple coats across zones. Check people, claims, total coats and zone totals separately. Try uniform, simultaneous or custom arrival times.

3. Set timings and staff conditions
Enter check-in seconds per claim, each zone's fixed round trip plus time per coat, and base handover time plus a per-coat extra. Set staff skills, zone qualifications, shifts and changeover time. Record practice runs with the stopwatch or enter measured samples, then review their conversion before applying them.

4. Assign roles and replay
Drag staff into check-in, retrieval or handover, or use the role selector. Shared front desk staff handle one task at a time and prioritize ready handovers. Qualified workers can retrieve different zones for one claim in parallel; handover follows when all coats are ready. The three columns show exact queues and busy staff. Playback speed only changes how quickly the results are replayed.

5. Inspect peaks and individual journeys
Tap a chart or peak to inspect front waits, claims with coats not ready and handover waits. See each worker's task and release time. Find a claim by ID or zone and follow its retrieval and completion records. When a run is blocked, investigate missing roles, zone qualifications or shift coverage.

6. Branch from a pause
Keep earlier events fixed and try later staff moves. A worker finishes the current task before changeover time begins. Compare the branch with its original plan to see the effects on later queues and collection times.

7. Compare improvements and trade-offs
Review metric changes, matching chart units and scales, and input differences. Compare peak front, backstage and handover queues, P90 collection time and total elapsed time. Test one processing-time parameter, try another arrival pattern, or search qualified staff assignments. See changed inputs, tested scope and candidate results before choosing a plan.

8. Check your event targets
Set front-queue, P90 or elapsed limits. Test compressed arrivals, slower retrieval or one absent worker using the same claims and coats. Run changes separately and together, inspect unmet targets, and save a case as an editable event for replay. Keep all tested outcomes with the briefing.

9. Save and rehearse the briefing
Save initial roles, zones, qualifications, scheduled moves and expected peaks. Use the person-by-person view to check current assignments and the next move, or share a staffing image through the system sheet. Duplicate or archive events, recover drafts, and export or restore local backups.

Core planning, simulation, comparison and briefings work locally and offline, with no account required. Available in English and Simplified Chinese, in portrait on iPhone and iPad.

Results depend on the requests, timings and staff conditions you enter and are intended for rehearsal before your event. If anyone remains unfinished, whole-run completion time and collection-time statistics stay pending; completed claims can be viewed separately.

name: Closer Deck
description:
Closer Deck is a 50-question card game for adult couples to play on one phone. Take turns drawing a card and reading the question out loud. Swipe the card aside any time you want to skip a question.

Tap the heart to save a favorite. Switch languages to read the same card in another language, or shuffle the deck to start a fresh round. Your language, progress and favorites stay on your device.

name: Clothes Sort
description:
Tidy the wardrobe, one satisfying puzzle at a time.

Clothes Sort is a calm sorting puzzle: tap a shelf to pick up clothes from the open end, then tap another shelf to slide them next to matching items. Match groups of clothes until every shelf is empty. Easy to learn; tricky to master on later levels.

HOW TO PLAY

• Tap another shelf with space to place them next to matching clothes
• Sort until all shelves are clear to finish the level

Hope you enjoy the game!

name: CNC 101
description:
CNC 101 ile CNC torna operatörlüğünü sıfırdan, kısa ve eğlenceli derslerle öğren. Her ders birkaç dakika; yanlış yaptığın yerleri tekrar sorar, ilerledikçe seviye atlarsın.

NE ÖĞRENECEKSİN
• Tornanın parçaları, eksenler ve sıfır noktaları, iş güvenliği
• Tezgah paneli: modlar, MDI, referansa gitme, el çarkı
• G kod: program yapısı, G00/G01/G02/G03, mutlak ve artımsal hareket
• Devir ve ilerleme: G96, G97, G50, G98/G99
• Takımlar, uç kodları ve burun radyüsü telafisi (G41/G42)
• Parça ve takım sıfırlama, aşınma ile ölçü düzeltme
• Döngüler: G90, G94, G71, G70
• Teknik resim okuma, tolerans, işlem sırası ve gerçek iş

NASIL ÇALIŞIR
• Sanal tezgah paneli: tuşlara basarak gerçek tezgahtaki gibi ofset gir, MDI çalıştır, el çarkıyla takımı parçaya değdir.
• Torna simülatörü: yazdığın programı çalıştır, takımın yolunu ve talaşı gör.
• Kod yazma görevleri: programı sen yaz, uygulama ölçüleri kontrol etsin.
• Ünite sınavları ve süreli usta sınavı; geçince başarı belgesi.
• Kod Avı: 60 saniyede G ve M kodlarını tanı, serini büyüt, rekor kır.

KONTROL ÜNİTESİ SEÇ
Fanuc tarzı, Haas tarzı veya Mitsubishi tarzı panel ve kodlarla öğren. Koordinatları noktalı (X40.) veya noktasız (X40) yazıma göre gösterir; ikisinin farkını da öğretir.

Ünite 0–3 ücretsiz (reklamlı). CNC 101 Pro ile bütün üniteler, Kod Avı hafıza oyunu, usta sınavı ve sertifika açılır; reklam yoktur, kesici uçlar sınırsızdır.

Uygulama sürekli güncelleniyor: yakında freze modülü, yeni modlar geliyor.

Hesap açmak gerekmez.

Kullanım Koşulları (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Fanuc, Haas, Mitsubishi ve Siemens ilgili şirketlerin ticari markalarıdır. CNC 101 bu şirketlerle bağlantılı değildir; paneller eğitim amaçlı benzetimdir.

name: CNJ Free Space
description:
CNJ Free Space finds the photos and videos that take up space on your iPhone for no good reason, and shows them to you so you decide what can go.

WHAT IT FINDS
• Duplicates: the same photo or video more than once. One copy stays, the extras are already ticked.
• Bursts and similar shots: keep the best one and delete the rest with one tap.
• Large videos: sorted by size. Watch each one, delete it or compress it to a smaller copy.
• Screenshots: sorted by age, oldest first.
• Blurry and very dark photos: shots that went wrong, in one place.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Allow access to Photos. The scan runs by itself, on your phone.
2. Check what the app found and tick what can go.
3. iOS asks you to confirm before anything is deleted. Deleted items go to Recently Deleted for 30 days. The space is freed once you empty that album in Photos.

VIDEO COMPRESSION
You can compress a video to HEVC and replace the original with it. You see the size and resolution of both before replacing. Compression lowers quality; the original stays in Recently Deleted for 30 days.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The blur estimate is not always right, so nothing there is ticked for you.
• Sizes shown are the original files. With iCloud's Optimise iPhone Storage on, less is freed on the phone.
• With iCloud Photos, deleting removes the item from all your devices.
• The app's interface is in Slovenian.

PRIVACY
The app collects no data. No account, no ads, no analytics. Photos are processed on your phone and never leave it.

Made by CNJ d.o.o., Ljubljana, Slovenia.

name: ColumnWise Math
description:
ColumnWise Math is a quiet, step-by-step worksheet for written arithmetic: addition, subtraction, long multiplication and long division. Every digit, carry and borrowed value has its own box on a graph-paper grid, so the columns always line up.

FOUR OPERATIONS
• Addition up to 4 digits, with every carry written in its own box.
• Subtraction up to 4 digits, with borrowing. Borrowing across zeros is written step by step: each new value goes in its own box and stays in view.
• Long multiplication up to 3 digits × 3 digits.
• Long division by 1- and 2-digit numbers, with every stage written out: divide, multiply, subtract, bring down.

LEVELS
• Home has one button: start today's practice, or continue where you stopped.
• Levels for each operation, from 2-digit addition to 4-digit division by 2-digit numbers.
• New to the app? Choose an operation, start from the very beginning, or take a short starting-point check (up to 8 problems). You can skip the check and choose a level yourself.
• When problems go smoothly, the app asks before moving you on to the next level.
• In Options you can set the level directly, or practise one skill, such as borrowing across zeros.
• My own problem: type in a problem from your own worksheet, in any of the four operations.

HOW IT HELPS
• The box to fill next is yellow, and the digits you are working with are circled.
• A red line marks the left end of the work, and labels on the right name each row.
• Each digit is checked as you go. You can also choose to check each row, or the whole problem at the end.
• Help when you ask: Hint, Show me this step, and Walk me through this row. Nothing is ever filled in for you; you always type the digit yourself.
• Optional reading aloud: instructions, hints and each digit as it is typed.
• The worksheet follows your device's text size, and the whole problem always fits on one screen.
• Your work is saved after every digit. Stop at any time and continue later.
• As skills return, Options can make it harder: choose the next box yourself, say how many digits the answer will have before the boxes appear, or hide the step-by-step instructions.
• Progress for each operation, and a detailed practice report you can share with a therapist, teacher or family member. Its charts show accuracy and speed over time, how much help was needed, which steps and which parts of the sheet are missed most, and where to focus.

WHO IT IS FOR
• Adults relearning arithmetic, for example after a stroke or a brain injury.
• People who find it hard to keep digits lined up in columns.
• Therapists, teachers, carers and family members who set up practice for someone else. Options let you set the level, choose one skill to practise, and change how checking, help and reading aloud work.
• Students who find written addition, subtraction, multiplication or division hard, including students with dyscalculia or dysgraphia.

CALM BY DESIGN
No timers, no scores while you work, no sounds or animations that rush you, and no pop-ups over the worksheet. Large keys, and a layout that keeps everything you act on to the right of the work.

PRIVATE
ColumnWise Math is free and works fully offline. There is no account, no advertising, no tracking and no analytics. Your work stays on your device. The report is only shared when you tap Share and choose where to send it.

ColumnWise Math is a practice tool. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or measure any condition.

name: com.aunaldi.coinlens
description:
Inherited a coin jar? Found an old quarter in your change? CoinLens tells you which US coins are worth keeping.

Photograph the front of a coin and CoinLens reads the date on your iPhone. In seconds you get three answers:

• IS IT SILVER? Quarters, dimes and half dollars from 1964 and earlier are 90% silver. CoinLens shows how much silver is inside and what it is worth at today's silver price.

• WHAT IS IT WORTH? An estimated value range for a circulated coin, from face value up to key-date prices.

• WHY? A short, plain-English explanation of the series, its metal content and what drives the price.

KEY DATES AND MINT MARKS
Some coins are worth hundreds or thousands of dollars because of one tiny letter. CoinLens knows where the mint mark sits on each design and, only when it actually matters, asks you to check the back.

WORN DATES
Can't read the date? Pick the design instead and CoinLens tells you the range it could be worth.

YOUR COLLECTION
Save coins to your collection and watch the total silver value update when you change the silver price.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. Photos are processed on your iPhone and never uploaded.

PLANS
Your first 3 scans are free. After that, choose:
• CoinLens Pro: $29.99 per year, unlimited scans
• Unlimited Forever: $59.99 one-time purchase
• 50 Scan Credits: $9.99, never expire

CoinLens Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Values are estimates for circulated coins, not a professional grading or appraisal.

Privacy Policy: https://aliosmanunaldi.github.io/coinlens/privacy.html

name: Conciergerie Gestion
description:
Conciergerie Gestion réunit tout le travail d'une conciergerie de location courte durée dans une seule app, à vos couleurs.

À VOTRE IMAGE
• Donnez à l'app le nom, le logo et la couleur de votre conciergerie : ils apparaissent sur l'accueil, vos factures et les pages de vos voyageurs.

PLANNING
• Arrivées, départs et ménages du jour en un coup d'œil.
• Vue par logement sur plusieurs semaines.
• Importez vos réservations depuis les calendriers iCal de vos plateformes de location (Airbnb, Booking.com…).

MÉNAGES ET ÉQUIPE
• Ménage et accueil des voyageurs créés automatiquement pour chaque réservation, avec leur liste de contrôle.
• Attribuez-les à vos intervenants et envoyez-leur leur planning par un simple lien, sans app à installer.
• Suivez l'avancement, les photos et les remarques de l'équipe.

VOYAGEURS
• Un espace en ligne pour chaque séjour : adresse, accès, Wi-Fi, consignes et code d'accès visible au bon moment.
• Discussion avec vos voyageurs depuis l'app, et modèles de messages prêts à envoyer.

PROPRIÉTAIRES ET FINANCES
• Factures propriétaires calculées à partir des commissions et des ménages, en PDF.
• Statistiques : revenus, taux d'occupation, prix moyen par nuit.
• Stocks de consommables : les articles presque épuisés sont signalés sur l'accueil.

ASSISTANT
• Demandez un point sur votre activité à l'assistant intégré (Apple Intelligence, sur les appareils compatibles, tout reste sur l'appareil).

SYNCHRONISÉ ET PRIVÉ
• Vos données sont enregistrées dans votre iCloud et suivent vos appareils (iPhone et iPad).
• Aucune publicité, aucun traceur.

Gratuit pour 1 logement. Offre Pro pour un nombre illimité de logements.

Offre Pro : abonnement mensuel (14,99 €) ou annuel (149,99 €), 1 mois offert à la première souscription. Le paiement est prélevé sur votre compte Apple à la confirmation de l'achat (à la fin de l'essai gratuit). L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement sauf résiliation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours, depuis les réglages de votre compte Apple.
Conditions d'utilisation : https://conciergerie-voyageurs.espace-voyageur.workers.dev/conditions
Confidentialité : https://conciergerie-voyageurs.espace-voyageur.workers.dev/confidentialite

name: Constalio
description:
Constalio, c’est deux métiers dans une seule application : les états des lieux de location classique, dictés à la voix, et les check-in / check-out de la location courte durée, faits sur place ou à distance par vos voyageurs. Sans papier.

— LOCATION COURTE DURÉE : CHECK-IN ET CHECK-OUT —

UN MODÈLE PAR LOGEMENT
Photographiez une fois votre logement, pièce par pièce. Ce modèle devient la référence de chaque séjour : vos voyageurs comparent ce qu’ils trouvent à ce que vous avez montré.

LE VOYAGEUR FAIT SON CHECK-IN ET SON CHECK-OUT
Vous n’êtes pas sur place à chaque arrivée ? Envoyez un lien : le voyageur réalise lui-même son check-in puis son check-out depuis son téléphone, guidé pièce par pièce, en refaisant les photos de référence. Il signe à l’écran, sans application à installer.

LES SÉJOURS S’ENCHAÎNENT
Le check-out d’un voyageur devient le point de départ du suivant. Vous voyez d’un coup d’œil ce qui a changé entre deux séjours, et qui était là à ce moment-là.

VOS RÉSERVATIONS ARRIVENT TOUTES SEULES
Connectez le calendrier iCal de vos annonces : les séjours se créent automatiquement, aux bonnes dates. Constalio vous rappelle quand relancer votre voyageur par WhatsApp, et si le check-out n’est pas fait, vous le réalisez et le signez pour son compte.

— LOCATION CLASSIQUE : ÉTATS DES LIEUX —

DICTEZ, C’EST REMPLI
Entrez dans une pièce, appuyez sur le micro et parlez naturellement : « murs en bon état, une tache au plafond, la fenêtre ferme mal ». Constalio range chaque constatation dans la bonne ligne de la grille, avec son état. Chaque photo est horodatée et rattachée à son élément.

ENTRÉE ET SORTIE, COMPARÉES POINT PAR POINT
L’état des lieux de sortie repart de celui d’entrée. Vous ne constatez que ce qui a changé, et Constalio chiffre les dégradations selon une grille de vétusté ajustable.

— POUR LES DEUX —

SIGNÉ, SCELLÉ, ENVOYÉ
Signature sur l’écran ou à distance, avec un code reçu par e-mail. Le rapport PDF est scellé par une empreinte numérique qui prouve qu’il n’a pas été retouché, puis envoyé automatiquement.

POUR LES AGENCES ET LES CONCIERGERIES
Invitez vos agents, affectez-leur des dossiers ou des logements, suivez toute l’activité depuis le back-office web, à votre logo.

CONFORME
Mentions du décret n° 2016-382 pour la France, de la loi 67-12 pour le Maroc. En français, anglais, espagnol et arabe.

Fonctionne sans réseau : tout se synchronise au retour de la connexion.
Votre premier constat est offert.

name: ConsusFlow

ConsusFlow is an internal business tool operated by Intworks LLC. 
Organizations use it to receive delivery invoices, review the extracted data, and track receiving and inventory.

name: ContrastDeck
description: ContrastDeck helps designers and developers compare text and background colors. Enter two RGB hex values to see the contrast ratio, WCAG AA and AAA results, and a live text preview. Try built-in examples in Standards, or save a pair to review it later.

name: Cortaviel
description: Keep three gauge directions with their signed readings. Cortaviel separates raw values, baselines, strain inversion and declared material assumptions. Check projection rows, nonunique directions and seeded error samples; trace each principal bound to its inputs. Freeze an interpretation and share PDF, CSV or JSON. name: Cosmopin: Solar System 3D
description:
Cosmopin is a live 3D solar system with one difference: you are in it.

Your own pin glows on a real-time 3D Earth, exactly where you stand. Fly from the Sun to your town, watch day turn into night over your home, and see the Moon and the planets where they really are right now.

YOU ARE HERE

• A beam of light marks your place, visible even from the edge of the solar system
• Sunrise and sunset countdowns for your place
• Your journey through space, counted live: how fast you spin around Earth's axis, how you fly around the Sun at about 107,000 km/h, and how far you have traveled since you opened the app

WHAT'S ABOVE YOU TONIGHT
• The Moon: phase, moonrise, moonset and direction
• Planets you can see with the naked eye: best time, direction and height
• Meteor showers you can catch from your latitude

• Sky above you: the view from the ground, with real compass directions

A LIVE SOLAR SYSTEM SIMULATOR
• The Sun, the Moon and all eight planets in their real positions, computed for any moment

WHY? SHORT LESSONS
Day and night, the seasons, the phases of the Moon, why there isn't an eclipse every month, and the northern lights. Every lesson ends with a fact for your own place.

EVENTS
Sunrise, sunset, full moon, new moon, eclipses, equinoxes and solstices: jump straight to any of them.

SHARE
Record an 8-second video of the flight from the Sun to your town and share it.

13 languages. No ads. Your location stays on your device.

description:

Each item appears as a bar stretching from its purchase date to its warranty end date, crossed by a vertical today line. Expired items sit to the left in brick, active cover stretches to the right in sage, and items approaching your chosen threshold stand out in amber. name: Cram Study
description:
You're going to scroll anyway. Scroll your own class.

Cram turns your slides, notes, homework and practice exams into a feed of short study cards. One card at a time, full screen, a few seconds each. No typing. Just tap and keep going.

2. Copy Cram's prompt into an AI assistant you already use, such as Claude or ChatGPT, along with your course files.
3. Paste the deck it writes back into Cram and start scrolling.

Because the deck is built from your own material, every card uses your professor's terms, your slides and your practice questions.

WHAT'S IN THE FEED

Cram brings back the concepts you get wrong, with a different card each time, and eases off the ones you know. You can see what's still shaky and how close each deck is to mastered.

Turn card types on or off, pick topics, set how hard it pushes, add your exam date, and get a reminder to study.

No account. No ads. No tracking. Your decks and progress stay on your phone.

name: CrateLoom
description:
CrateLoom is an index for belongings stored in boxes. Give each crate a name and location, then record the items inside with quantities and notes.
