name: Crease: Paper Fold Puzzle
description:
Fold. Punch. Picture the rest.

A sheet of paper is folded in front of you, once, twice, three times. A punch comes down through every layer. Now the question: when the sheet opens flat again, where are the holes?

Crease is a calm, tactile puzzle for your mind's eye. It is built on the paper-folding questions long used to measure spatial reasoning, turned into something you'll want to play: real folds, real paper, and a small thrill each time the sheet opens exactly the way you pictured it.

HOW TO PLAY
• Watch the sheet fold and the punch come down
• Tap the flat sheet wherever a hole will appear
• Unfold it and see how well you pictured it

TEN CHAPTERS, ONE NEW IDEA EACH
• First Folds and Twice Over: learn how a fold mirrors a hole
• On the Bias: diagonal folds that bend your intuition
• Deep Folds: three folds, eight layers, one punch
• From Memory: the fold diagrams disappear, so the whole sheet lives in your head
• Quick Hands and Master Folds: faster folds and bigger sheets

FEATURES
• 100 hand-picked sheets that get a little harder each time
• A new Daily Sheet every day, the same for everyone, with a streak to keep
• No timers and no lives: think as long as you like
• Replay the folds whenever you need to
• Hints that reveal one hole when you're stuck
• Dyed paper, soft shadows, gentle sounds and haptics
• Plays offline, no account needed
• Premium (one-time purchase): every chapter, unlimited hints, no ads

Can you see it before it unfolds?

name: CropBoard
description:
When you prepare a lesson or put together a notebook of questions to revisit, how many steps does it take to move just one question? I used to trace around it with a lasso, copy it, paste it onto a new page, then move it into place. I made CropBoard to shorten that routine. I also wanted to get through an explanation without stopping to look for a pen or rubber.

Open a PDF or photo and CropBoard automatically identifies the questions. Tap one to bring it onto a fresh board and write your working directly on or beside it. Ready for the next question? Tap the PDF tab at the top to return to the page you were on and choose another.

Swipe the pad at the bottom of the board to switch between pen, highlighter and rubber. Rest your fingers on the pad as you draw dotted lines or shapes. Draw an arc with the compass, or move a straight line across a cubic graph to show the moment one intersection becomes three. Students see only the board on the projector, so they can follow your working.

Save your notes and pick up where you left off. Choose just the pages you need and share them as a PDF or as images.

Save up to three notes for free, with up to three pages in each. A one-off purchase lifts both limits. Give CropBoard a try for free, and if it works well for you, please consider buying it.

Build your chain or collect Shield Charges to activate Royal Guard and briefly widen your shield and slow incoming threats.

Play a patrol when you have a few minutes

A full patrol takes under three minutes if your crown holds out. Fit one in during a lunch break or while winding down at home. Try Daily Guard for a different objective each day such as blocking Dark Arrows or landing precise blocks. Complete daily challenges to earn merit and build your streak.

See how your defense improves

Follow your scores and accuracy across the watchtowers in Guard Route. At the Shield Forge you can see which threats you block most often and how consistently you let helpful objects through. Visit the Guard Hall to revisit completed patrols and compare your scores and best chains.

Make the royal keep your own

Earn merit as you play and unlock new looks for your crown and shield along with trails and impact effects. You can also change the fortress theme and guard crest. Each unlock changes the look of your game while keeping the same challenge.

name: Cube Timer: Speedcubing Stats
description:
A timer for people who solve twisty cubes against the clock, built the way a competition mat works.

HOLD, LET GO, SOLVE
Rest a finger on the screen until the clock turns green, let go to start, touch anywhere to stop. While you solve there is nothing on the screen but the clock. Add +2 or DNF afterwards, or delete the solve.

A SCRAMBLE YOU CAN SEE
Every solve starts from a new random-move scramble, shown with a 3D picture of the scrambled cube so you can check yours before you start. Open the cube large and drag it round to see every side.

INSPECTION
Switch on the fifteen seconds of inspection used in competition. Start late and the app adds the +2, or the DNF, by itself.

THE NUMBERS CUBERS READ
Best, mean and the averages of 5 and 12 are under the clock after every solve. The Stats tab adds your best averages of 5 and 12, the averages of 50 and 100, median and deviation. Averages leave out the best and the worst time, and a DNF counts as the worst.

THE ALGORITHM TRAINER (PRO)
All 21 PLL and all 57 OLL cases. Each has its diagram, its moves, and a 3D cube that plays them move by move: step forwards and back, or let it run. Mark the cases you know, and drill one against the clock; the app keeps your best and average for every case. Three cases are free to try.

CHARTS AND PERSONAL BESTS (PRO)
Your times as a chart with the averages of 5 and 12 running over them, a chart of how your times spread, and a list of every personal best.

EVERY CUBE FROM 2x2 TO 7x7 (PRO)
Scrambles with wide moves and a 3D picture for each size. Every cube keeps its own times.

SESSIONS AND EXPORT (PRO)
As many sessions as you like, and any of them as a CSV file for a spreadsheet.

FREE
The 3x3 timer with scrambles and their 3D picture, inspection, +2 and DNF, one session, all the averages, the full list of times, and three trainer cases.

PRIVATE
No account. Your times stay on your iPhone; the app sends nothing to us.

Manage or cancel your subscription in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription. Cuewise Pro Lifetime is a single payment and does not renew.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: see the Privacy Policy link on this page.

name: CueWorship Slides
description:
CueWorship Slides puts the words on every screen in the room, in step with your band.

Build your service once. Set up your standard Sunday as a template: countdown, welcome, giving, goodbye. Each week the band's songs land in place from your setlist, and you add the sermon.

Follow the band. When your worship leader moves to the next song in CueWorship Stage, the lyrics on the screens move with them.

Pair any TV with a code. Open the display page on a smart TV, Fire TV or computer, type its six-digit code into Displays, and it's on. No cables across the room.

Lyrics over moving backgrounds. Choose a background for each song. Clear the words and the background keeps moving.

No retyping. The words come from Planning Center, or straight off your PDF chart.

Run it from anywhere. On iPhone, Slides is your remote: what's on the screens, the whole service under it, and Next within reach. On iPad, run the whole show: your library, your services and the live screen.

Slides is included in every CueWorship plan. It needs a CueWorship account for your church; sign up at cueworship.org.

name: Cup Drain
description:
Cup Drain keeps one efflux cup on this iPhone.

Each pour stores efflux seconds. Kinematic viscosity is the cup constant times those seconds minus the intercept. A pour shorter than the intercept stays on the batch and stays out of the mean. A temperature slope corrects the viscosity.

The batch is named only when every valid pour is inside the specification and the spread is inside the repeat limit. Moving the slope changes the name. Saved seconds do not change.

The last pour and the last batch stay. Readings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: CurlingSheet
description:
CurlingSheet follows the fours you care about, one end at a time.

Pick a team and the season folds into a single sheet: where they sit on the points board this week, how that position has moved since October, and every game stitched onto one timeline so a run of form reads as a story instead of a table of numbers. Open any game and the score opens with it, end by end, with the hammer marked above each column and steals underlined, so someone new to curling can see why the seventh end decided the match and a long-time viewer can check the sheet in a couple of seconds.

Before a draw, the app tells you what is coming: the last five results, the head-to-head record, and how long until the first rock. And because watching is personal, My Curling Year keeps a quiet record of the finals you stayed up for and the games you saw in the building, then lays them out as a year you can look back on.

For club players there is a draw sheet and a score pad that cover league night without a spreadsheet.

Scores and points come from CurlingZone's public pages. Every screen says how old the snapshot is, and the app is clear that these are tour points, not an official world ranking.

name: Curtain Up: Learn Your Lines
description:
Curtain Up is a scene partner for actors. Upload your sides or the whole play: your partner gives the cues and waits until you finish your line.

Upload in a minute
PDF, Word, plain text or photos of the pages. Roles and scenes sort themselves out, and your lines are under the highlighter. We pick the biggest part; playing someone else? Tap them.

Who reads your partner
• A friend: send a link and they record the lines on their phone, no sign-up. Usually a couple of minutes.
• A castmate, when you rehearse a production together.
• The Curtain Up voice: an AI voice that reads right away, no waiting.

From read-through to off book
Set your deadline and get a plan for the evening: a read-through, runs from memory, takes. Deadline a few days away? The plan spreads over the days.
• Read-through: hear the scene and read along, no mic.
• Run from memory: your lines are hidden, your partner listens and waits for you. Stuck for a few seconds? You get the first word.
• After each run: how much of the part you know and where you stumbled.

Self-tapes
Your line sits big next to the camera with the current word lit up, so your eyes stay on the lens. Forget a word and the prompter has it; you keep going in the same take. Add a slate with your name, role and height. Casting gets a link that opens in any browser and an MP4 in 1080p, and you see when the link is opened. On iPhone, save the take to Photos or Files from the share sheet.

For directors and teachers
Upload the play and hand out roles with a QR code at the first read-through. Actors scan it, pick their role and rehearse at home. Each actor records their part and the others rehearse with that voice; anyone missing is read by the Curtain Up voice. A map by act shows who knows the lines and who's behind. Remind them with one tap, leave a note right on the line.

Your script stays yours
Only you see your sides, and whoever you send the link to. A production's play is seen by its director and its cast.

Curtain Up comes in 10 languages: English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Italian, Polish, Ukrainian and Turkish. Sign in with Apple, Google or email.

name: CutQuote
description:
CutQuote is a quoting and scope-control app for freelance animators, motion designers and small animation studios.

Build a quote by production stage, share a frozen version with your client, and keep track of exactly what was agreed: which revision rounds are included, what changed afterwards, and which milestones are expected, requested or recorded as paid.

QUOTE BY PRODUCTION STAGE
• Line items grouped by stage: brief and script, design and style frames, storyboard, animatic, animation, audio, delivery, and cutdowns or aspect-ratio variants
• Price by fixed fee, hours, days, finished seconds or units
• Mark items as included or as listed exclusions, with included revision rounds per item
• Discounts, a quote-level tax rate and a payment milestone plan
• Reusable rate cards and quote templates
• Exact money math in 12 currencies, recalculated on the server

SHARE A VERSION THAT CANNOT CHANGE
• Sharing freezes a version: its figures, terms and line items can no longer be edited
• Create a private client link and send it yourself however you like; CutQuote never emails your clients
• Your client opens the link in any browser, reviews the quote and accepts or declines it
• Internal notes never appear in the client view, the print view or client exports
• Print or save as PDF

KEEP SCOPE UNDER CONTROL
• Log revision rounds per stage and see at a glance when a stage goes over its allowance
• Change orders against the accepted quote, with their own client link and decision
• Contracted total = accepted quote plus accepted change orders, each counted once
• Milestone ledger for deposits and stage payments, with a history of every status change

WORK AS A TEAM
• Invite collaborators and viewers to your studio workspace with an invite link
• Roles decide who can share quotes, approve change orders or record offline decisions
• An activity log of every change

WHAT CUTQUOTE IS NOT
CutQuote does not process payments or verify them: milestone statuses are notes you record. A client's acceptance records the name they type, the email they enter and the time; it does not verify identity and is not a qualified electronic signature. CutQuote is not tax or legal advice.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• No AI: your quotes and client details are never sent to an AI provider or used for training
• Client links are kept out of search engines and expire
• Delete your account in the app at any time

Terms of Use: https://cutquote.code54.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://cutquote.code54.dev/privacy
Support: https://cutquote.code54.dev/support

name: Cynea
description: Cynea is a small, offline field journal for cloud and sky observation. It holds a fixed catalogue of twenty-four cloud forms, a private record of every sky watch, and five short notes on reading the sky. There is no account, no feed, no map, no sync and no advertising. Everything you need for the next clear horizon is already inside the app.

name: Damp Batch
description:
Damp Batch keeps concrete batch water on this iPhone.

Each mix stores cement, design water, and the saturated-surface-dry weight and absorption of sand and gravel. Drag today's moisture on the bin. Free water is dry weight times moisture minus absorption. Batch water is design water minus that free water. Below half the design water, the ticket is held. Moisture outside 0 to 20 percent is not stored. Issuing a ticket does not change the mix. The last mix stays.

Weights stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Datum: GPS Coordinates
description:
Completely free. The only in-app purchases are optional tips.

Datum shows where you are as a plain coordinate and copies it in one tap. No map to wait for, no account, no ads.

THE FORMAT YOU ACTUALLY NEED
Open the app and your position is on screen as latitude, longitude in decimal degrees, for example 45.37312,-121.69594. No spaces, no letters, no degree signs: exactly what forms, spreadsheets, messages, and other apps expect. Tap it, and it is on your clipboard.

WHAT IT DOES
• Shows your current coordinates, with accuracy (plus or minus meters) and altitude
• Copies them in one tap, or shares them
• Tells you plainly when the GPS signal is weak
• Saves where you are in one tap; add a name and a note then or later
• Keeps a list of saved places you can search, reorder, copy and open in Maps
• Converts any coordinate you type or paste into every other format
• Exports and imports your saved places as CSV, JSON or GPX

FORMATS
• Decimal degrees: 45.37312,-121.69594
• Degrees and decimal minutes: 45° 22.387' N, 121° 41.756' W
• Degrees, minutes and seconds: 45° 22' 23.2" N, 121° 41' 45.4" W
• Each with minus signs or N S E W letters, and the number of decimal places you choose
Pick one as your default, and it is used everywhere: on screen, on copy, and on share.

A FORGIVING CONVERTER
Paste a coordinate from an email, a web page or a photo's details. Datum reads it with or without degree signs, spaces, commas or letters, and with longitude first when the letters say so.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your location is read only while the app is open and never leaves your iPhone
• Saved places are stored on your iPhone
• No account, no sign-in, no analytics, no ads, no tracking, no network connections

GOOD TO KNOW
• Requires iOS 26 or later
• Datum shows numbers, not a map; "Open in Maps" hands a place to Apple Maps
• Accuracy and altitude are shown in meters
• GPS works best outdoors with a clear view of the sky

FREE, FOR GOOD
Datum is made by Stave Hoop Labs, a small lab that builds free utilities. If it helped, you can leave an optional tip from the About screen. Tips unlock nothing; the whole app is free.

name: Dausend Labs
description:
Manage your Dausend Labs website or mobile app project from your iPhone or iPad. Open Client Portal to see project status and milestones, review proofs, approve work, or send a change request. Clients on an update plan can submit edits with an optional photo and check their remaining monthly allowance.

Starting a project? Use Plan My Project to compare starting prices, save your plan on your device, and share a PDF. Create a free portal account to submit the plan, or enter an invite code to join an existing project. You can also browse the studio and use the planner without an account.

name: Dawnhold: 새벽의 기념비
description:
새벽이 올 때까지, 기념비를 지켜요.

Dawnhold는 육각 타일 위에 수호자를 세우고, 같은 수호자를 겹쳐 합체시키며 그림자 무리를 막아내는 세로 화면 헥사 디펜스입니다. 한 손으로 조작하고, 판이 끝날 때마다 조금씩 강해집니다.

■ 14종 수호자, 11명 소환사
파수꾼 · 결정 · 바람 종 · 달 거울 · 등불 · 첨탑 · 연꽃 · 바람연 · 서리꽃 · 가시덩굴 · 혜성 · 해시계 · 물방울 샘 · 공허 구까지 14가지 수호자 라인. 같은 수호자를 겹쳐 3단계까지 합체하고, 별조각으로 13단계 별까지 올려 강화합니다. 소환사는 별지기 · 시간지기 · 공명술사 · 금빛 상인 · 대지술사 · 불꽃술사 · 물결술사 · 바람술사 · 빛의 사제 · 저주술사 · 쌍둥이 소환사 11명. 각자 상시 효과와 쿨타임 스킬이 있습니다.

■ 특수 · 궁극 조합
재료가 보드에 모이면 특수 수호자와 궁극 수호자를 부를 수 있습니다. 특수 수호자는 균열 · 분광 · 진동 · 일식 · 낙인 · 고요 · 감전 · 도금 · 속박 · 화상 같은 약화를 걸고, 서로 다른 약화는 겹쳐서 곱해집니다.

■ 10개 스테이지, 100층
스테이지마다 하늘과 그림자의 속성이 바뀝니다. 5층마다 중간 보스, 10층마다 스테이지 보스가 나오고, 클리어하면 포탑을 그대로 들고 다음 스테이지로 올라갑니다. 물 → 불 → 바람 → 대지 → 물, 빛 ↔ 어둠의 속성 상성을 보고 출전 포탑을 고르세요.

■ 도전 몬스터
50초 안에 도전 몬스터를 쓰러뜨리면 큰 보상을 받습니다. Lv.5부터는 포탑을 강등하거나 봉인하는 저주 스킬을 씁니다.

■ 광고 없음, 추가 결제 없음
한 번 구매하면 끝까지 즐길 수 있습니다. 광고도, 인앱 결제도, 회원가입도 없습니다. 진행 기록은 기기 안에만 저장되고 서버로 보내지 않습니다. 배경음 11곡이 판마다 무작위로 흐릅니다.

문의 · pomodoriga@gmail.com
개인정보처리방침 · https://kankanii.github.io/dawnhold/privacy.html

name: Day to Day Journal
description:
Day to Day is a quiet place to write one note a day, and to look back on all of them.

WRITE YOUR WAY
• Free writing: a blank page, nothing more.
• Guided: a few gentle questions (How did I feel? What stood out? What am I grateful for?) when you don't know where to start. Every question is optional; answer one, or all.
• One note per day, or none. No streaks, no scores, no pressure.

LOOK BACK
• A list of your days, with search, or a calendar view.
• A weekly reflection: your week's answers side by side, plus a few prompts to notice patterns. It is saved to your note for the day.

YOURS ALONE
• Your notes are encrypted on the server, and no one reads them for advertising or analytics.
• Optional PIN lock that is enforced on the server, so a lost phone can't open your diary.
• Export everything as a file at any time. Delete your account and your notes with it.

AT HOME ON EVERY DEVICE
• Use the same diary on your iPhone and on the web at app.daytoday.cc.
• Sign in with email, or with Apple.
• A daily reminder, only if you haven't written yet. It never shows your words.
• Already keep a journal in Day One? Import it.

Day to Day has no ads, no tracking, and no social feed. It is a diary.

name: DayVellune
description:
Build a day that fits your available time. Add tasks with durations, schedule them for a date or keep them in a backlog, and flag the important work.

Compare planned minutes with your daily capacity before committing to more. Mark tasks complete, revise the plan and review seven days of completed minutes. Your backlog and planned tasks stay connected without duplicating the work.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: DD1: Draftwake
description:
A paper glider, a little wind, and one careful delivery.

Sweep the sky to leave a fading ribbon of air. Turn with your next stroke, trim the momentum, and hold a second finger to feather into the harbor. Each numbered ring asks for a small decision; the landing asks for patience.

Fly twenty-four routes across three horizons. Try eight Gust Trials, learn with live lessons, tune a practice breeze, or place your own rings in Route Studio. Change your sail's colors and revisit your recorded flight paths.

An English, portrait physics puzzle with everything included. No account, advertisements, purchases or internet connection required.

name: Dead Reckoning: Survive
description:
Bush plane down. Sixty seconds of light left.

Dead Reckoning is a survival strategy game of hard choices in the deep cold. You are the only passenger to crawl from the wreck. Scramble through the falling dusk to drag what you can from the tail section — rations, a pot, a transponder that might still work. Then the sun goes down, and the arithmetic begins.

HOLD THE CAMP
Keep the barrel stove burning. Ration the food and water. Send a scout into the treeline for supplies and hope they come back, because whoever goes out needs two days to recover. Blizzards roll in. Nights get colder. A journal records every choice you make, for better or worse.

GET RESCUED
Searchers read smoke and signal panels, not intentions. Keep your campfire warm, keep the transponder transmitting, and move the rescue meter — before hunger, thirst and the cold take your fellow survivors one by one.

- Two ways to play: the sixty-second Scramble and the deeper day-by-day Survival mode
- Survivors with hunger, thirst, health and morale to manage
- Daily events with real consequences: frozen meltwater, a buried cargo tarp, a wolf at the treeline, a helicopter that may or may not see you
- Five endings to unlock, from a textbook rescue to the ridge where the smoke finally shows
- Best-record tracking for longest survival, fastest rescue and most survivors saved
- Full sound design: wind, blizzard, fire and a ticking clock

No accounts. No ads. No in-app purchases. Dead Reckoning collects no data — your records are saved on this device only.

The cold is patient. Outreckon it.

Terms of Use: https://dead-reckoning-yzx3udq.rork.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://dead-reckoning-yzx3udq.rork.app/privacy

name: Deadletter Haul
description:
The world stopped. Your delivery route didn't.

Climb into a stubborn armored mail truck and haul the last good things through a city of shambling trouble. Deadletter Haul blends hands-on driving, route planning and satisfying cartoon destruction in a compact offline adventure.

KEEP YOUR MOMENTUM
A moving truck can push walkers aside. A parked truck is a dinner invitation. Watch your hull and fuel, grab repairs and keep the wheels turning before the crowd closes in.

TAKE THE STREET LESS TRAVELED
Drive freely with the steering pad or tap a street to chart a course. The camera follows you through neighborhoods larger than the screen. Open the route survey to plan a fuel detour, find a relay mailbox or spot the depot.

PACK THE RIGHT KIND OF TROUBLE
Pick up an orange weapon crate to arm automatic homing missiles. Every salvo sends four rockets from your truck toward the nearest walkers, leaving smoke trails before bursting on impact and triggering nearby barrel chains. Echo beacons pull walkers toward their sound. Shield batteries buy six seconds of protection. Turbo turbines turn your plow into a wreck-smashing machine. Pickups add fuel, repair the hull, fit armor and restock your tools.

100 DELIVERIES, TEN DISTRICTS
Start in the outskirts and continue through changing streets, detours and hazards. The first ten routes travel through a long crescent, a harbor fork, quarry switchbacks, a market circuit, a garden junction, twin courtyards, canal streets, a foundry figure eight, broken causeways and a midnight spiral. Each has its own longer street plan, with fuel detours, rubble, decoys, armor, relay stamps, mud, barrel chains and timed gates along the way. Later districts combine these ideas with denser crowds. Nearby houses release fast runners into the street. Three special bosses bring telegraphed ground slams, summoned reinforcements and charging attacks, with a depot guardian on every fifth route. Extra weapon caches help you fight your way through.

MAKE EVERY PACKAGE COUNT
Recover lost parcels. Earn up to three stars for a completed delivery, healthy hull and recovered mail. First-time deliveries pay scrap for permanent motorpool armor. Daily care packages add scrap and spare ammunition. Your best scores live on a local delivery board.

A LITTLE APOCALYPSE, A LOT OF CHARM
Rounded mint trucks, orange plows, silly zombies, animated pickups, expanding blast waves and a celebratory delivery stamp give every run a playful finish. No gore. No accounts, advertising, purchases or online requirements.

Take the long way home. The mail must get through.

name: DearPic: Auto Face Photo Crop
description:
Great scenery, but the faces you love look too small in the photo?
DearPic is an automatic face-detection photo cropping app that finds faces in your pictures and instantly suggests clean, closer portrait compositions—without editing or overwriting your original photo.

Instead of manually pinching, dragging, and guessing crop ratios in a complex photo editor, simply pick a photo and compare ready-made framing options side by side.

■ Perfect for
• Bringing out smiles and expressions in travel, family, kids, and group photos
• Turning wide landscape photos into clean 3:4 portrait crops for profile pictures and mobile sharing
• Picking one person in a group photo to generate face-centered framings around them
• Keeping every original photo untouched while saving closer copies

■ Key Features
• Automatic Face Detection & Smart Framing Suggestions
  Instantly generates multiple face-centered crops: Face only (1:1), Close-up, Shoulders included, and With background.
• Landscape to Portrait (3:4) Suggestions
  Automatically suggests a balanced vertical portrait crop from landscape photos whenever possible.
• Choose Any Face in Group Photos
  Tap the face you want to focus on when multiple people appear in the same picture.
• Inspect & Fine-Tune in 4 Directions
  Preview your crop up close and nudge framing up, down, left, or right—plus zoom in or out—before saving.
• Batch Save & Instant Share
  Select multiple favorite crops to save together as new photos or share directly through iOS's share sheet.

■ Privacy First & 100% Free
• Photos and face positions are processed locally on your device using Apple Vision and are never uploaded to our servers.
• Your original photo always stays unchanged; saved crops are created as new photos.
• Free to use with no ads, no sign-up, and no in-app purchases.
• 20 languages built in for offline use.

■ Notes
• Very small or heavily blurred faces may not be detected.
• Output sharpness depends on the resolution of your original photo; DearPic crops without artificially restoring missing detail.

Contact: contact@faithfwd.cc
Privacy Policy: https://www.faithfwd.cc/apps/dearpic/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.faithfwd.cc/apps/dearpic/terms

name: Deck the Tree
description:
Walk, move and decorate your own Christmas tree this December, on your Apple Watch and on your iPhone!

Deck the Tree is an Apple Watch app and iPhone widgets with a snowy Christmas tree that gets decorated as you get closer to your daily goal. Every few hundred steps a new bauble appears, then gifts pile up under the tree, the fairy lights come on, and when you reach your goal the golden star lights up the top. The time hangs from a pine garland on hand-decorated ornaments, with the date, the weather and your daily stats around the tree. Every morning a new, bare tree is waiting for you.

FEATURES
• A Christmas tree decorated by your activity: 23 baubles, 5 gifts, the fairy lights and the golden star
• Choose what decorates it: steps (with your own daily step goal), your Move ring or your Exercise ring
• The time on 4 ornaments hanging from a pine garland
• 6 clock styles: baubles, bells, stockings, wreaths, gingerbread and snow globes
• 30 color themes for the date and the stats
• Current weather, battery, heart rate, active calories and steps at a glance
• Falling snow, twinkling fairy lights and a glowing star
• Tap the screen and the tree sings "O Christmas Tree" while the ornaments swing
• 12-hour or 24-hour time, with or without the leading zero
• Dimmed always-on look that keeps the time easy to read
• Bonus animated watch face: raise your wrist and the tree gets decorated

IPHONE HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Your tree is on your iPhone too, even if you don't have an Apple Watch. Add the Deck the Tree Clock widget (medium or large) to see the time on the same Christmas ornaments as on your watch, with your tree decorated up to today's progress. The clock changes every minute and follows your clock style, colors and 12/24-hour choice. The Deck the Tree widget (small or medium) shows your tree, today's steps, Move or Exercise against your goal, and what gets added next. The widgets read your activity from Apple Health on your iPhone.

APPLE WATCH WIDGET
Add Tree progress to the Smart Stack on your watch: your tree, today's number and the next decoration, without opening the app.

CUSTOMIZE FROM YOUR IPHONE
Use the companion iPhone app to choose what decorates the tree, set your step goal, and pick a clock style and a color theme. A live preview shows the look, and a slider shows how the tree gets decorated on the way to your goal. You can also turn the music, the falling snow and the weather on or off, and choose 12-hour or 24-hour time, with or without the leading zero. Your changes are saved right away: they appear on your watch at once when the app is open there, or the next time you open it. The iPhone widgets use the same settings.

WATCH APP AND WATCH FACE
Deck the Tree is a watch app: the tree, the clock and the song are in the app while it's open on your Apple Watch. From the iPhone app you can also install a matching animated watch face: an Apple photo watch face where the bare tree gets decorated each time you raise your wrist. It includes a complication that opens the app with a single tap. You can also add the complication to your favorite watch face.

Tip: to keep the app on screen longer, open Settings on your watch, go to General, then Return to Clock, and choose After 1 hour.

WEATHER AND HEALTH DATA
The weather comes from Apple Weather and uses your watch's location while the app is open. Deck the Tree reads your steps, Activity rings, active calories and heart rate from Apple Health to decorate the tree and show your stats. Your data stays on your devices.

HELP AND SUPPORT
The iPhone app includes a FAQ section with answers to common questions and a contact page if you need us. The More tab shows our other animated watch faces.

REQUIREMENTS
iPhone with iOS 17 or newer. The watch app needs an Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or newer, paired with that iPhone.

Merry Christmas!

name: Decoded: Daily Quote Puzzle
description:
Every letter in a famous quote has been swapped for a number. The same number always means the same letter. Work out the code and the quote appears, one letter at a time.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• A fresh quote at midnight, the same for everyone
• One try a day, and every solve keeps your streak going
• A Home Screen widget shows today's puzzle and your streak

600+ QUOTES
• Eight categories: Inspiration, Wisdom, Humor, Literature, Science, History, Philosophy and Proverbs
• Four levels, from short and easy to long expert puzzles
• After every solve, "Who said it?" tells you about the person behind the quote

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Pencil marks for guesses that never cost a mistake
• Hints when you're stuck
• Zen Mode hides the timer and mistakes for a slower, calmer puzzle
• Light and dark themes in a classic book style

YOUR LIBRARY
• Every quote you crack is saved
• Mark favorites and search by quote or author
• Share any quote as a beautiful card

GAME CENTER
• Leaderboards for daily time, quotes solved and best streak
• Twelve achievements to unlock

Pay once. No ads, no subscriptions, no tracking. Your progress syncs through your own iCloud.

name: Degraus da Fé: Quiz Católico
seller_name: ANGELO ROBSON MELO DOS SANTOS CONSULTORIA EM TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO LTDA
description:
O quiz bíblico feito para católicos. Teste seus conhecimentos da Bíblia católica, com os 73 livros, de um jeito leve, bonito e fácil de jogar.

No Degraus da Fé, cada rodada é uma escada de 10 perguntas. A cada acerto você sobe um degrau e junta mais talentos, inspirados na parábola de Jesus (Mt 25,14-30). Chegou ao topo? Desafio concluído!

COMO FUNCIONA
• 10 perguntas por rodada, uma de cada vez, sem pressa e sem cronômetro.
• Os degraus 3 e 6 são degraus da garantia: acertando, você leva pelo menos os talentos dali, aconteça o que acontecer.
• Quando houver muitos talentos em jogo, você pode encerrar e ficar com eles.
• Três ajudas por rodada: Pular, Eliminar 2 e Ver dica (que mostra onde a resposta está na Bíblia).
• Toda resposta vem com a citação bíblica, para você ler e aprender mais.

QUASE 2.000 PERGUNTAS DA BÍBLIA CATÓLICA (73 LIVROS)
• Antigo Testamento
• Evangelhos
• Atos, Cartas e Apocalipse
• Livros Deuterocanônicos (Tobias, Judite, Sabedoria, Eclesiástico, Macabeus...)
• Maria nas Escrituras
• Ou Toda a Bíblia, misturando tudo

Três níveis: Fácil, Médio e Difícil. As perguntas vão se alternando, para você sempre encontrar desafios novos.

FEITO PARA TODAS AS IDADES
Letras grandes, botões claros e jogo sem pressa: ótimo para jogar sozinho, com a família, na paróquia, no grupo de oração, no terço ou na catequese.

COMPARTILHE
Ao final de cada rodada, receba uma palavra de ânimo com um versículo da Bíblia e envie seu resultado pelo WhatsApp para convidar amigos e familiares.

SEM ANÚNCIOS
O Degraus da Fé não tem anúncios para ninguém. A versão gratuita traz uma seleção de perguntas do nível Fácil, de toda a Bíblia. A versão completa, com pagamento único e simbólico, libera quase 2.000 perguntas: escolha o tema (Evangelhos, Maria, Antigo Testamento e mais), os níveis Médio e Difícil e os novos pacotes de perguntas.

“Lâmpada para os meus pés é a tua palavra, e luz para o meu caminho.” (Sl 119,105)

name: DelibraLog
description:
Keep a journal of personal project decisions. Write a question, compare two alternatives and rate each on impact, feasibility and confidence from 1 to 5. Set the importance of each criterion and inspect the weighted totals. Make your own choice, reopen it later and record outcome notes. Search your decision library and review past choices. Scores are a thinking aid, not predictions or professional advice.

Free, without ads, purchases or an account. Records stay in local app storage. Eight languages, persistent language selection and System, Light or Dark appearance. Optional fictional samples.

name: DeseGrdPnel
description:
DeseGrdPnel je tiché puzzle na hľadanie zhody. Spárované karty zapĺňajú tmavozelený stôl. Klepnite na dve karty s rovnakou farbou a hodnotou. Ak medzi nimi existuje voľná cesta priamou čiarou, v tvare L alebo Z s maximálne dvoma zákrutami, po trase prebehne svetlo a obe karty zmiznú. Prázdne miesta zostanú prázdne, takže neskôr sa otvoria nové cesty. Ak sa hra zasekne, doska sa automaticky premieša. Klasický režim je časovo obmedzený, Zen režim nemá časový limit.

Hra funguje offline. Žiadne reklamy, žiadny účet, žiadne počítadlo energie. Hviezdy zostanú uložené iba na tomto zariadení.

name: Devil's Codename: Word Party
description:
Convince the AI. Fool your friends.

Everyone picks a secret word. On your turn, give short hints, and an AI judge scores each one from 0 to 100 for how strongly it points to your word. Reach the bar and everyone else gets one guess. If someone cracks it, they take the point. If nobody does, the point is yours. The trick is a hint the AI rates hot but your friends can't read.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Pick a secret word from five you're dealt.
• Give a one- to three-word hint. The heat bar shows its score.
• Reach the bar and every other player gets one shot at your word.
• Nobody guesses it? You score and keep hinting. Too many cold hints and your turn is forfeited.

HOW DEVILISH ARE YOU?
Set the bar at Easy (80%), Normal (90%) or Hard (95%). A higher bar means every hint has to cut closer to the truth.

GAME NIGHT, ANYWHERE
• Online: start a room, share the four-letter code, and play with 2 to 20 players. Friends without the app can join from a web browser.
• Pass and play: one phone, handed around the table.
• No account and no sign-up. Every word you're dealt is new for the whole game.

SMART, PRIVATE SCORING
Hints are scored on your phone by a compact language model, with an AI judge on close calls. No tracking and no ads.

FREE TO PLAY
Host 100 games a month for free, and joining a friend's game is always free. Want more heat? Every Devil's Pass is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited hosting:
• Warm: unlimited hosting.
• Hot: plus a flame by your name on every scoreboard.
• Scorching: plus a gold flame and the exclusive Scorching skin.

name: Dhaka Post
description:
ঢাকা পোস্ট: দেশ-বিদেশের সর্বশেষ খবর, এখন আরও সহজে, আপনার মতো করে।

রাজনীতি, অর্থনীতি, খেলা, বিনোদন, আন্তর্জাতিক, সারাদেশ, লাইফস্টাইল, তথ্যপ্রযুক্তি, মতামতসহ সব বিভাগের খবর পড়ুন বাংলাদেশের অন্যতম শীর্ষ অনলাইন সংবাদমাধ্যম ঢাকা পোস্টের অফিসিয়াল অ্যাপে।

প্রচ্ছদ
• দিনের গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ও সর্বশেষ খবর এক নজরে
• এখন আলোচিত বিষয়, ভিডিও খবর, মতামত ও বিশেষ আয়োজন
• প্রচ্ছদ সাজান: কোন বিভাগ আগে দেখবেন, তা নিজেই ঠিক করুন

আপনার জন্য
• পছন্দের ক্যাটাগরি, প্রিয় ব্যক্তি ও আপনার জেলা বেছে নিন
• "আপনার জন্য" পাতায় সেসব খবর আগে দেখবেন
• প্রিয় ব্যক্তিদের সব খবর এক জায়গায়

আপনার এলাকার খবর
• বাছাই করা জেলার নতুন খবর এলে নোটিফিকেশন পান
• সেটিংস থেকে যেকোনো সময় চালু বা বন্ধ করুন

পড়ুন নিজের মতো
• খবর সংরক্ষণ করুন, ইন্টারনেট ছাড়াও পরে পড়ুন
• গত ৭ দিনে পড়া খবর এক জায়গায় খুঁজে পান
• যেকোনো খবর ডান থেকে বাঁয়ে সোয়াইপ করে দ্রুত সংরক্ষণ বা শেয়ার করুন
• খবরের পাতায় নিচের বার থেকে এক ছোঁয়ায় উপরে, সম্পর্কিত বা পরের খবরে যান
• লেখার আকার নিজের মতো বড়-ছোট করুন
• খবরের ভেতরেই ভিডিও দেখুন, ছবি দেখুন পুরো পর্দায়

আরও
• লাইট ও ডার্ক মোড
• আইফোন ও আইপ্যাডে উপযোগী ডিজাইন
• অ্যাকাউন্ট খোলার দরকার নেই; সংরক্ষিত খবর ও পড়ার ইতিহাস শুধু আপনার ফোনেই থাকে

ওয়েবসাইট: www.dhakapost.com
মতামত ও যোগাযোগ: www.dhakapost.com/contact

name: Die Clear
description: Name the station still under the scrap line with the highest side-clearance percent. Drag the max band without rewriting saved diameters. Lift a named die reading to drop it from the math.

name: Dinersaurs
description:
On iPhone and iPad, Dinersaurs is the controller for the couch co-op cooking game on Apple TV. It needs the game running on an Apple TV; the game is not played on the phone itself.

Open Dinersaurs on your Apple TV, open this app, and you are in. The app finds the TV by itself, with no codes to type and nothing to pair.

• A stick and three buttons: GRAB, CHOP and THROW
• Set the stick's sensitivity to suit your thumb
• A full-screen pad, held sideways like a gamepad, and the screen stays awake while you play
• Buzzes when you serve a dish, get hit or miss an order
• Pick your dinosaur: eight species, twelve colours, seven hats and your own name
• Change the game's settings and pause from your phone
• Reaches a TV that is nearby but on a different Wi-Fi network, as long as both have Wi-Fi and Bluetooth switched on
• Somewhere else entirely? Type the four-letter room code from the TV and play over the internet

Up to eight players can share one kitchen. Friends without the app can scan the QR code on the TV and play straight away, and game controllers work too.

The controller is free and always will be. No accounts and no adverts.

name: Dino Island: Kylo Math
description:
Dino Island: Kylo Math is a dinosaur game for children aged about 3 to 6. Short, friendly math games are the key to everything they want to do: open eggs, buy food, win toys.

HATCH AND RAISE DINOSAURS
• 100 dinosaurs to discover, from T-Rex and Triceratops to Brachiosaurus and Pteranodon
• Feed, wash, brush teeth, put to bed and play with toys
• Every dinosaur eats the right food: a meat-eater says no to plants!
• Dinosaurs live on their own islands: Horn Meadow, Volcano Island, Fish Lake, Sky Island, Long Neck Island and more

EXPLORE AND PLAY
• Visit a park for every country in the world and smash things to find bones and eggs
• Friendly dinosaur sumo with 25 game modes
• Collect toys and skills, and watch your dinosaurs grow

MATH THAT OPENS THE WORLD
• Counting, more and fewer, number order
• Adding and taking away, missing numbers
• Shapes, positions and more, following the Kylo Math 1 lessons
• Every question is read aloud. Tap the words to hear them again.

MADE FOR YOUNG CHILDREN
• Works fully offline
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts
• Collects no data
• Parent area (press and hold the gear for two seconds) to choose how hard the math questions are

name: Dipole Trim
description:
Dipole Trim fits a handful of SWR readings to a parabola and tells you how much to cut.

Each antenna keeps a name, a target frequency and a length. Readings under SWR 3 are fitted to SWR(f) = a(f − f0)² + c. The advice is the length change on each leg. When that change is more than 2 cm, the first cut is 70 percent. An inverted V can take two leg angles from the motion sensors and correct the starting length. Each cut stays on a timeline.

Antennas, readings and cuts stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: DIY Home Help
description:
DIY Home Help turns "I want to build a small bookshelf for my kid's bedroom" into a complete plan in under 15 seconds.

— PLAIN-ENGLISH PROMPTS —
No forms, no templates. Just describe what you want to build like you'd explain it to a friend.

— MATERIALS WITH PRICES —
Every plan comes with a materials list. Tap any item to open Amazon with the right search ready to go. Check off what you already own.

— STEP BY STEP —
Atomic steps with clear instructions, time estimates, and AI-generated reference photos. Safety warnings called out where they matter.

— TOOLS LIST —
Power tools and hand tools with alternatives if you don't have the recommended one. Tap to find them on Amazon.

— REFINE THE PLAN —
"Make it cheaper". "Hand tools only". "24 inches wider". One-line follow-ups and the plan adapts.

— EXPORT TO PDF —
Print your plan or share it with a friend. Everything in one document: hero photo, materials, tools, steps.

— TRACK YOUR BUILD —
Check off materials you've bought, mark steps as done. Your progress stays in the app, no account needed.

— FREE, NO SUBSCRIPTION —
10 plans per day, 100 per month. No paywall. No ads. We earn a tiny commission when you buy materials via the in-app Amazon links — that's how DIY Home Help stays free.

— PRIVACY FIRST —
Anonymous device ID, no signup, no personal info. Delete all your data from Settings any time.

* * *

DISCLAIMER: DIY Home Help plans are AI-generated and for general guidance only. Always verify measurements and follow safety regulations. For structural, electrical, or plumbing work, consult a licensed professional.

As an Amazon Associate DIY Home Help earns from qualifying purchases.

name: DK Moov
description:
DK Moov, voyagez ensemble, vivez plus !

DK Moov organise des sorties et des voyages en autocar au départ de Grande-Synthe, Dunkerque et Calais : journées à Londres, week-ends à Amsterdam, Londres et les Studios Harry Potter, parcs d'attractions, marchés de Noël et bien plus.

Avec l'application DK Moov :
• Découvrez toutes les prochaines sorties avec leurs dates, prix et photos
• Consultez le détail de chaque voyage : horaires, lieux de rendez-vous, prestations incluses
• Vérifiez les documents à prévoir (passeport, ETA pour le Royaume-Uni, autorisation de sortie de territoire…)
• Affichez les affiches en plein écran
• Filtrez les sorties selon votre lieu de départ
• Réservez votre place en ligne en quelques clics
• Recevez des notifications pour les nouvelles sorties, les dernières places disponibles et les jeux concours
• Participez aux jeux et tirages au sort DK Moov

Transport en autocar confortable, ambiance conviviale et programmes pensés pour profiter au maximum de chaque destination.

Téléchargez DK Moov et ne ratez plus aucune sortie !

name: DK Rally
description:
Oficiální aplikace amatérských rally závodů Amatér Rally DK, které se jezdí na letišti v Biskupicích.

Co v aplikaci najdeš:
• Přehled závodů, harmonogram, posádky, startovku a výsledky
• Přihlášku na závod přímo z mobilu, s uloženými auty a navigátory
• Platbu startovného QR kódem a stav svých přihlášek
• Pořadí jezdců v sezóně a novinky ze závodů
• Týmy: založení, pozvánky a týmové hodnocení
• Upozornění na novinky k závodům, přihláškám a platbám (jednotlivé typy si vypneš v nastavení)
• Přihlášení e-mailem, přes Apple nebo Google

Aplikace pracuje se stejným účtem jako web dkrally.cz. Přihlášku můžeš zadat na webu i v aplikaci.

name: Docking - SailVoyager
description:
Reversing stern-to between two boats in a crosswind is the maneuver that worries most skippers in harbor. Docking shows you how, step by step and seen from above, so you reach the slip knowing what to do.

71 MANEUVERS, EACH WITH ITS OWN WIND
Pick the maneuver, tap where the wind is coming from on the wind rose (8 directions or calm) and choose your propeller. You see the boat moving, with the throttle and helm at every moment, and the written steps light up in sync with the animation.
• Stern-to mooring with a lazy line or with your own anchor
• Coming alongside, port side to or starboard side to
• Leaving a stern-to berth: dropping the lazy line or weighing anchor
• Leaving from alongside on a spring or letting the wind blow you off
• Right-handed or left-handed propeller: it changes which way the stern kicks in reverse

WORKED OUT WITH PHYSICS, NOT DRAWN BY HAND
Every maneuver was calculated with a physics simulator of a 9.5 m sailing yacht in 12 knots of wind (8 in the hardest ones): inertia, windage, prop walk, prop wash over the rudder and mooring lines. It only counts if the boat gets in without bumps or fouled lines; in a crosswind she may end up resting on the neighbor's fenders, just as in real life. It is also checked with more and less wind and with the wind shifting a little, and if a maneuver only works in that exact wind, the app tells you.

WATCH OUT FOR THE LAZY LINES
On lazy-line berths, the neighbors' lines rise from the seabed to their bows and run shallow. The app draws them in red and the maneuver keeps clear of them: if your keel, rudder or propeller passes too close, they can foul. With an anchor, it tells you where to drop it so you do not cross your neighbors' chains.

STEP BY STEP, AT YOUR OWN PACE
• Pause, ×1, ×2 or ×4 speed and a bar to jump to any moment
• Tap a step and the animation jumps there
• Which line to get ashore first, when to give a burst of throttle and when to slip the spring
• Wind arrow, the boat's track and neighbors to scale

FOR THE BOAT AND FOR YOUR COURSE
Go over the maneuver before you reach harbor, or get ready for the practical part of your sailing course.
• Works offline
• No account, no ads and no data collected
• In English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Japanese

One-time purchase, no subscription. Made by SailVoyager, the online nautical school.

The maneuvers are a guide for a sailing yacht of about 9.5 m with a single propeller. Every boat, harbor and day is different: always adapt them to your boat, the conditions and your experience.

name: Dome Pilot
description:
You spent two years building it. Then the app that drove it disappeared.

Dome Pilot is a new, independent remote control for the 1:2 scale motorised model kit that connects over Wi-Fi. Set-up takes a couple of minutes, with one step per screen and a picture of which button to press.

• One driving screen: joystick, dome control and the live camera view together
• A stop button that is always in the same place
• Speed limit and a gentle mode for small rooms and small drivers
• Every built-in sound and action, with your favourites up front
• Build your own sequences of actions and sounds, save them and share them
• Take photos and videos through the model's camera
• Use any game controller paired with your iPhone or iPad, and choose what each button does
• Works on your home Wi-Fi or connected straight to the model
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Stop my model with Dome Pilot", play a sound, run a sequence
• Try it without the model using the built-in demo

No account, no ads, no tracking. The app talks only to your model, on your own network.

Compatible with the De Agostini / Fanhome "Build Your Own R2-D2" 1:2 scale part-work model (100 issues, first released 2017).

Dome Pilot is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by De Agostini, Fanhome, Lucasfilm Ltd or Disney. R2-D2 and Star Wars are trademarks of Lucasfilm Ltd. De Agostini and Fanhome are trademarks of their respective owners. The names are used only to say which model this app works with.

name: DominoCard
description:
DOMINOCARD is a calm, deterministic chain-reaction puzzle. Each plate carries a mass and an etched vector: push one and the energy travels onward, waking relays until the chain stalls or the whole station lights. Sixty stages grow from a clean line into forked relays, rotors and sequence gates, plus a Daily Trial, Endless Run and Chain Lab where you build your own lattices.

## How to Play

1. Read the board: each plate shows mass and sigil — Blade north, Ember east, Shard south, Node west.
2. Tap a plate to preview the chain, then press PUSH.
3. A plate falls only when energy meets its mass; matching sigils resonate, alternating ink amplifies.
4. Wake every relay to clear the stage.

name: Donkeys Group
description:
Donkeys Group is the bikers network for riders who ride together.

Join bikers groups, plan group rides, see your whole group on a live map and raise SOS in one tap. Find trusted garages and mechanics wherever the road takes you.

RIDE TOGETHER
• Announce group rides with route, meeting point, pace and slots
• Ride Board with ride rules, so everyone knows the plan
• Live convoy map: see every rider in your group during the ride

RIDE SAFE
• One tap SOS shares your location with your ride group
• Emergency details on your profile for the ride captain
• Ride safety guidelines for every group ride

YOUR RIDING COMMUNITY
• Bikers groups with chat, photos and videos
• Chase riders you like and see their posts in your Chasing feed
• Forum for routes, trip reports, bike help, tyres and gear
• Reels: short ride videos from riders
• Rider Academy: riding tips verified by experienced riders

GARAGES ON THE ROAD
• Service centres, multi brand garages, roadside help and towing
• Filter by your bike brand and find what is open near you

FREE FOR FOUNDING RIDERS
Everything on Donkeys Group is free for riders who join by 23 February 2027.

Donkeys Group is a Hidayah Technologies product, made in Bengaluru.

name: Doodle Ladders
description:
Climb up, slide down, giggle!

Doodle Ladders is snakes and ladders for the whole family, drawn by hand, with silly friends who cheer every ladder and gasp at every snake.

ROLL AND HOP
Roll the die and hop along the board. Ladders zoom you up. Snakes slide you down. Wheee! The first one to 100 wins.

RUN FROM THE SNAKE
Land on a snake and you get a chance to run: trace the path fast before the snake catches you!

PLAY WHILE YOU WAIT
While the others take their turn, play a little game in the margin: catch the bugs, trace a line, find the pairs, number fun, tap the beat. You win Ink, and Ink gets you cards: Shield, Pencil, Lucky Die and more.

UP TO 6 PLAYERS
Play with family on one phone, add bots, or mix both. Little ones, big kids and grown-ups each get a fair game. Party mode adds sleepy snakes, quick duels and surprise rounds. There is a new daily board every day, and a learning mode for first games.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Send a link and play together on two phones, or on a phone and any computer.

BOTS THAT GROW WITH YOU
Baby Bot, Sleepy Bot and Clunky Bot are always free. Mega Brain, Ultra Brain, Doom Brain and Omega Brain come with the Ladders Full Pack or the Doodle Club. The bots play even with no internet.

THE LADDERS FULL PACK, DIAMONDS AND THE DOODLE CLUB
Doodle Ladders is free to play, with no ads and no chat. A grown-up can get the Ladders Full Pack, one time: every Doodle Ladders look, now and later, and the strongest Ladders bots: Mega, Ultra, Doom and Omega Brain. Looks are just for fun: they never change the game.
Diamonds can be earned by playing, and a grown-up can also buy diamond packs (500, 1,200, 3,000 or 8,000 diamonds) to spend on looks. Diamonds and Doodle Club items are cosmetic virtual goods for entertainment only, non-transferable, with no cash value, and cannot be traded or cashed out.
One Doodle account works in Doodle Ladders and Doodle Checkers: your diamonds, looks and Doodle Club are in both.

The Doodle Club is an optional auto-renewing subscription: all club looks and the strongest Ladders bots while it is on, plus 300 diamonds every month.
• Doodle Club (monthly): 1 month, $2.99 per month
• Doodle Club (yearly): 1 year, $19.99 per year
Prices are in US dollars and vary by country; the App Store shows your price before you confirm. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it any time in your Apple ID settings (Settings → your name → Subscriptions).

GROWN-UPS
Snakes and ladders is a first game for counting, taking turns, and learning to win and lose kindly. No ads, no tracking and no chat: players see only names, moves and friendly stickers. No account is needed to play. Sign in with Apple never shares a name or an email with us. Every purchase and every link out of the game sits behind a grown-up question.

Terms of Use: https://doodlecheckers.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://doodlecheckers.com/privacy.html
Questions? support@taproute.io

name: Doomsday Express: Rail Rogue
description:
The world has collapsed into scorched iron and ash. As the last surviving train engineer, your armored express is humanity's final fortress on rails. Build your combat train car by car, re-route generator power in real time, and fight through twelve treacherous wasteland sectors to break through the enemy blockade!

Doomsday Express is a fast-paced roguelite rail-defense strategy game combining 32-bit pixel craftsmanship, modular turret coupling, dynamic power-grid tactics, and branching expedition routes.

==================================
KEY FEATURES
==================================

4 HEAVY ARMORED LOCOMOTIVES
Command distinct powerhouse locomotives, each engineered with unique combat doctrines and active super skills:
• The Vanguard: Balanced front-line juggernaut with Emergency RAM Overdrive.
• Volt Warden: High-tech electrical fortress generating EMP static shocks and rapid shield capacitors.
• Hellfire Behemoth: Incendiary steam monster unleashing heavy blast waves and high hull reinforcement.
• Iron Ark: Long-range tactical transport with expanded coupling capacity and salvage collectors.

MODULAR CAR COUPLING & SYNERGY
Hook up and rearrange weapon cars, defense modules, and support bays between sectors:
• Heavy Gatling Cannon: Sustained kinetic ballistic suppression.
• Plasma Railgun: High-piercing armor-shredding linear beams.
• Aegis Shield Car: Forward-projecting protective barriers to shield adjacent wagons and the locomotive.
• Cryo Mortar: Area-of-effect freezing clusters that slow swarming enemy drones.
• Arc Spire: Chain lightning that arcs between mechanical scavengers.
• Field Repair Bay: In-transit structural auto-welding and hull restoration.
• Drone Hive: Autonomous combat hunter-seeker interceptors.

REAL-TIME GENERATOR POWER ROUTING
Adapt your engine output instantly as combat conditions shift on the fly:
• [1] RAMMING SPEED: Maximizes speed and impact damage to crush ground roadblocks.
• [2] WEAPON OVERCLOCK: Pushes cooling coils to the limit for +45% attack rate and critical strike chance.
• [3] EMERGENCY REPAIR: Diverts auxiliary current to replenish shields and weld battle damage.

12 DANGEROUS SECTORS & EXPEDITION DISPATCH
Chart your course through ruined megacities, irradiated iron deserts, toxic chemical marshes, and frozen industrial chasms. Every station depot offers branching tracks, emergency encounters, and salvage trade. Choose your path wisely—high-risk sectors yield epic relic chips and scrap!

RELIC CHIP ENHANCEMENT MATRIX
Slot powerful wasteland relics to customize each run: Overcharged Capacitors, Thermite Rounds, Kinetic Ram Spikes, Dual Boilers, Autoloader Belts, and Nanite Welders. Discover unstoppable synergies!

DYNAMIC WEATHER HAZARDS
Fight through blinding Ash Blizzards, corrosive Acid Rainstorms, and EMP Ion Tempest strikes that impact projectile speeds, visibility, and shield regeneration.

PERMANENT CODEX & ENDLESS OVERDRIVE
Review unlocked car blueprints, collected relics, and multiple narrative endings in the Station Archives. Conquered Sector 12? Test your ultimate consist in the relentless Endless Overdrive mode!

100% PURE GAMEPLAY — NO ADS, NO PAYWALLS
• Completely offline playable — no persistent internet connection required.
• Zero third-party advertisements or invasive tracking SDKs.
• Full support for iOS notch, Dynamic Island, and widescreen displays.
• Native English and Simplified Chinese bilingual support.

Strap in, Engineer. Sound the whistle and fuel the boilers—the wasteland awaits!

name: DopeCode Pinball
description:
One pinball machine on a dark stage, lit as a product is photographed: glass over the playfield that reflects the lamps above it, inserts that glow up and fade as filaments do, a backbox that flashes, and a display that calls every shot. It is DopeCode's business card: everything in it is drawn, simulated, played and heard by our own software.

THE MACHINE
The ball is a 27 mm, 80 g steel sphere on a table tilted 6.5 degrees, and gravity gives the slope. A flipper strikes along its face, bumpers and slingshots throw the ball back, a fast ball cannot skip a switch. The shots are named in coding's slang: the VIBE CODING ramp, the HOTFIX orbit, the SHIP IT scoop, the LGTM targets, the BUGS bumpers and the A·P·I lanes. Build the multiplier, approve the LGTM bank, ship the jackpot.

THE SOUND
Every sound is made by the game itself as it plays: coils, rubber, steel, switches, the spinner, the plunger, the drain, the chimes, and the ball rolling on wood and on wire as loud as it is fast. Two soundtracks play under it: the arcade's, and DopeCode's own song.

EASTER EGGS
Fourteen ASCII drawings of coding, assembly and AI are hidden in the machine. Each is found by a feat in play: a jackpot, the LGTM bank, a ball kept in play a minute. A drawing found lights up the backglass, and the collection is kept.

HIGH SCORES
The top five are kept on the device, a name given for each on the machine's own letter pad.

PLAY
- Tap to start.
- A finger on the left or right half of the screen holds that flipper.
- A finger in the bottom right corner draws the plunger; let go to launch.
- The button in the top right corner opens the menu: help, sound and music settings, the easter eggs and the high scores.

On an iPhone the table is seen from above, lengthwise; on an iPad held either way the camera fits the screen. Sound follows the silent switch.

No ads, no account, no purchases, and no data collected. The coin door's tap-to-pay panel and its QR code are part of the cabinet: play is free.

name: Draft Backgammon Joy - Offline
description:
Draft Backgammon Joy is real backgammon where nobody rolls the dice.
Four dice sit in a shared pool. You and your opponent take turns drafting two each, then play your moves: hit, enter from the bar, bear off.
Works completely offline: no account, no ads, no timers. Learn it in the 8-step tutorial.

Take the six that lets you escape, or take the six your opponent needs? Backgammon luck stays, but now you can steer it.

WHAT YOU GET
• Full backgammon rules, no doubling cube, with a fresh draft round before every turn
• Three difficulty levels, from a casual game to a computer opponent that plays the draft seriously
• Clear, tactile board with satisfying dice and checkers
• An interactive tutorial that teaches the draft, hitting, the bar, doubles and bearing off
• A hint that suggests the best die to pick and the best move to play
• Local statistics and badges to chase
• Smooth animations and haptics (switch them off any time)
• Works completely offline. No account, no ads, no timers
• Available in 20 languages

HOW IT WORKS
Each round, four dice are rolled into the pool. The players alternate picking one die at a time until each has two. Then you move your checkers using your dice, exactly like regular backgammon: hit single checkers, enter from the bar, build points and race home. Matching dice give you four moves. Bear off all fifteen checkers first to win. The player who picks first alternates every round.

PRIVACY
Draft Backgammon Joy never asks you to sign in. If you agree, the game sends anonymous usage statistics and crash reports to help us improve it. You can say no and the game works exactly the same, and you can change your choice in Settings at any time.

name: Drag Bike 201M Simulator : SSK
description:
Drag Bike 201M Simulator : SSK is a motorbike drag racing game set on the streets of Indonesia. Your own hands decide every race: when you drop the clutch, how much throttle you dare to open, and when you shift. Work the city by day, race at night, then tear into the engine back at the garage.

A RACE IN THREE PARTS
- Hold: pull the clutch, open the throttle, keep the needle in the green zone.
- Launch: drop the clutch the moment the starter's hands come down. Too early is a false start, too late and you are left behind.
- Shift: change gear when the shift light comes on. A little late and the engine hits the limiter. Too much throttle and the front wheel lifts.
Race 100 or 201 meters, one on one or up to four bikes at once.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
- Manual: throttle, clutch, shifts and the front wheel are all yours.
- Casual: just hold GAS and the front wheel is kept down, so you focus on the launch and your shifts.
Choose a chase, rider's eye or handlebar camera.

STORY: BIKE NUMBER 27
You start on your late father's drag bike, a neon-yellow underbone wearing number 27, for one night only before its engine gives out. All that is left is an old underbone. Work, save up, buy your first race bike, then beat the local bosses one by one. Every boss you beat pulls the tarp a little further off your father's bike, until Number 27 runs again.

A LIVING CITY
A wide city of kampung streets, shop rows, a market, warehouses, rice fields and a flyover. Day turns to night: street lamps come on, shops close one by one, and the coffee stalls fill up. People chat on their porches and hang out by the workshops as traffic rolls past.
- Delivery jobs: iced tea, meatball soup, parcels, vegetables, laundry, fruit, even building materials. Deliver on time and each workplace trusts you more.
- Refuel at the gas station or a roadside fuel seller. Run dry and you push the bike.
- Eat at a food stall, hang out over coffee till morning, shop at the minimart, and sleep at home to recover energy.
- At night a stretch of main road is closed for drag racing. Watch from the roadside or line up yourself.

TAKE ON RIVALS AND BOSSES
Ten rivals, each with their own style: quick off the line, strong at the top end, or simply reckless. Negotiate distance and a head start before the race, climb the ladder at each venue, then beat its boss. Your best Stock class times go on the online 100 and 201 meter time boards.

RACE VENUES
- Jalan Sawah at dusk, between rice fields and coconut palms.
- The Warehouse District at night, among stacked containers.
- Jalan Baru, a new road not yet opened, at night.
The crowd lines the roadside, filming on their phones.

BIKES AND GARAGE
The old underbone for work, the Drag Toska as your first race bike, then the Skuter Navy, Ayago Kilat, Sport Angin Malam and Drag Ungu. Every bike has its own engine, gear count, sound and decorative lights.
Swap the engine, carb, CDI, clutch, exhaust, sprocket or roller, tires, rims, handlebar and seat. Every part tells you what it changes: torque, rev limit, clutch bite. Try a bike before you buy it, then prove the result on the test track.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Create a room, pick one from the list of active rooms, or enter a friend's room code.
- Direct race: two to four players, 100 or 201 meters, a single race or best of three, in Stock, Modified or Open class. Every opponent is a real player.
- Shared city: ride the city together, queue for a race on the main road, or challenge the player next to you. Everyone else can watch and root for a rider. The winner stays king of the street until someone beats them.
Greet other players with ready-made phrases and emotes.

DAILY AND WEEKLY MISSIONS
Win races, shift without a miss, deliver on time, explore the city's districts, cross the flyover. Complete missions and collect coins.

Terms of Service: https://sansakastudio.biz.id/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://sansakastudio.biz.id/privacy/drag-bike-201m

name: Drain Board
description:
Dear friend,

If you change your own oil—or share a few cars in the family—remembering “how many miles until the next drain” is easy to lose. Drain Board is a quiet due board for engine oil: register each car with its oil note and interval, open the board to see what is overdue, and tap Mark drained when the pan is empty.

1. Dual-track due board
Each car can use miles, months, or both. When both are set, the tighter track wins. The board groups Overdue, Soon, and Later with counts on a short summary strip. Soon uses a small window (about 15% of the cycle: at least 500 miles on the mileage track, and roughly a week to a month on the calendar track). Never drained yet with an interval set lands in Soon so the first Mark drained is obvious.

2. Garage cards
Add a nickname (up to 48 characters), current odometer, oil grade note (up to 120 characters), optional interval miles and/or months (1–120), last drain miles and date, plus a short note. Search filters the list. Open a car for drain history, edit, Mark drained, or delete.

3. Oils by grade
Browse oil notes as groups with car counts, search grades or nicknames, and open a grade to see every car on that oil with its due status.

4. Mark drained and local quiet
Mark drained writes a drain log, refreshes last drain miles and time, and can confirm the odometer. Everything stays in a local JSON library on this device—no account, no ads, no purchases. About holds Getting started, Privacy, Support (chamkaursingh1971@icloud.com), and a two-step Erase.

The look is warm garage-bench: soft canvas, mustard progress, oil-drop accents, and compact cards that stay readable in landscape on the passenger seat. Drain when it is due, and tell me how it feels.

Warmly,
The Drain Board team

name: Drama Slate
description:
Drama Slate is an illustrated mini-series guide and a private viewing journal. Explore original fictional stories, find an episode summary, and keep track of what you have watched.

• Discover eight mini series across romance, mystery, comedy, and drama.
• Browse 33 episode guides with original cover art and scene stills.
• Save series to your watchlist and mark individual episodes as watched.
• Revisit your episode history and private notes in Watch Diary.

The catalog and your journal are available offline on iPhone and iPad. All catalog titles, characters, and scenes are fictional.

name: Draughts @ the Table
description:
Play English draughts (checkers) at the table against six computer opponents. Move your men diagonally, jump to capture, crown a king on the far row, and take every piece your opponent has, or leave them with no move.

SIX CHARACTERS
Ned, Pip, Tilly, Hazel, Mabel and Rook each play their own way, from Ned, who is just learning the moves, to Rook, who plays it like a tournament. Each plays at Gentle, Usual or Sharp, and each has a few words to say at the table. The strongest look many moves ahead and know their openings and endings.

LEARN FROM EVERY GAME
After each game, a review shows every move that cost you a piece or a result, biggest first, with the better move drawn on the board and the reason. Your statistics track your games, wins, draws, kings and captures: today, over the last 7 days, the last 30 days and all time, by opponent.

NEW TO DRAUGHTS?
- A guided first game against Ned, with a coach for each new idea and the best move shown every turn
- Three short lessons: captures and the shot, crowning and kings, and the basic endings
- The full rules, written plainly
- Optional hints, an "Are you sure?" before a move that loses a piece for nothing, and Undo against the gentler opponents

THE RULES YOU KNOW
English draughts as clubs play it: captures are compulsory, kings move one square, and a man crowned during a jump stops there. Draws by agreement, by repetition and by forty moves each. Play Black, White or each in turn, from the opening or the three-move ballot.

BADGES
Eight badges in bronze, silver and gold, earned each month or each year: Regular, Winner, Crowned, Comeback, Clean Sweep, Multi-jump, Draw Master and Days at the Table. With Game Center, two leaderboards too: wins in the last 30 days and your fastest win against the strongest opponents.

No ads, no account and no tracking.

name: Draw Your Book
description:
Your child draws a hero. They tell its story out loud. Draw Your Book turns it into a real illustrated picture book, read aloud, with words to explore on every page.

• Draw any character — a dinosaur, a robot, the cat next door. Big canvas, with the brushes and tracing shapes tucked away until you need them.
• Tell the story by holding one big button. Speech becomes text on your iPhone or iPad and is never uploaded.
• A friendly story helper asks one question if a part is missing.
• Every page is painted to match your child's drawing, then checked.
• Read along: each sentence lights up as it is read, in a female or male voice. Tap a word to hear it and see what it means.
• Make it for a special day: a birthday, a gift for Grandma and Grandpa, the first day of school, a trip, bedtime, a school project, a thank-you. Add a dedication on the first page.
• Share it as a PDF with family on WhatsApp, Messages or Mail, or print it at home.
• Learning Mandarin? Parents can turn on Chinese learning in Settings: books then also come in Chinese, with pinyin and a native narrator.

The first book is free. After that: one book, five books (they never expire), or a membership with up to 4 books a day and 30 a month — monthly, or yearly with a 7-day free trial (up to 5 books during the trial).

A parent confirms before a book is made and before anything is bought. No ads.

Membership renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Drayen
description:
THE LEDGER
Keep the books on your shelf and the people who wrote them. Give each book a genre, a format, a status and a page count if you know it. Add the rooms where you read, the moods you were in, and the line that stayed open after you closed the book.

A reading note records the book, the date and time, the minutes, the pages, the place and the mood. It is not a score. It is evidence that the hour happened.

THE YEARBOOK
The year assembles itself: pages, hours, reading days, books closed, the shape of the months, the genres you moved through, the authors you returned to, the longest sitting and the best day. No confetti. No badge. Just the year, read back.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
• It does not scan covers, barcodes or ISBNs.
• It does not search a bookstore or import publisher data.
• It does not rate books out of five, recommend titles or summarise them with AI.
• It does not use streaks, targets, leaderboards or public profiles.
• It does not use your location, camera, photos or contacts.
• It does not sync to a server or require an account.

name: DreamHomy
description:
DreamHomy è il portale dedicato agli affitti a medio e lungo termine: case, appartamenti e stanze per studenti, lavoratori e famiglie. Niente affitti turistici o brevi, solo chi cerca davvero casa.

CERCA CASA O UNA STANZA
• Filtri chiari: prezzo, zona, numero di locali, durata del contratto, disponibilità, arredato, animali ammessi e molto altro.
• Ricerca sulla mappa e per raggio dalla zona che preferisci.
• Salva gli annunci nei preferiti e ritrovali quando vuoi.
• Salva le ricerche e ricevi un avviso quando arrivano nuovi annunci.

PUBBLICA IL TUO ANNUNCIO IN 2 MINUTI
• Case intere o singole stanze, con foto e planimetria.
• Riordina le foto trascinandole e scegli la copertina.
• Per le stanze, presenta i coinquilini e il profilo ideale dell'inquilino.
• Metti il tuo annuncio in Vetrina per farlo comparire in cima alle ricerche.

BACHECA RICHIESTE DI AFFITTO
• Chi cerca casa pubblica la sua richiesta: zona, budget, durata e preferenze.
• Se hai l'immobile giusto, contatti direttamente chi cerca.

CHAT INTEGRATA
• Scrivi ai proprietari e a chi cerca casa direttamente nell'app.
• Avviso via email quando ricevi un nuovo messaggio.
• Puoi segnalare annunci, richieste e utenti, e bloccare chi non vuoi più sentire.

GESTISCI I TUOI AFFITTI
• Dashboard con i tuoi annunci, le statistiche e le richieste compatibili.
• Affitti in corso: contratto, scadenze e manutenzioni in un unico posto.

SICUREZZA E PRIVACY
• Gli annunci sono controllati e ogni segnalazione viene esaminata entro 24 ore.
• Puoi eliminare il tuo account e tutti i tuoi dati in qualsiasi momento, direttamente dall'app.

DreamHomy è disponibile in italiano, inglese, francese, tedesco e spagnolo.

name: Drinksy: Water Reminder
description:
Drink enough water without thinking about it. Drinksy reminds you at the times you choose and lets you log a glass with one tap — right from the notification.

Why Drinksy
• No ads, no account, your data stays on your phone
• Reminders with "I drank" and "In 10 min" buttons
• A goal that fits you: suggested from your weight and activity
• Stops reminding once you reach today's goal
• Streaks with a weekly freeze, calendar and 7-day chart
• Tea, coffee, milk, juice and sparkling water — set how much each counts as water
• Quick buttons, your own cups and bottles, undo and edit past days
• Share your goal with a nice image card

Drinksy Pro
• Home screen widgets — log with a tap
• Apple Health: water entries written automatically
• Your own drinks and caffeine tracking
• 30, 90 and 365-day trends, CSV export
• Backup & restore, automatic backup to iCloud Drive
• Color themes, bottle styles, 5 extra water sounds
• Water buddy that grows, weekly challenges and badges
• Goal that adapts to hot weather

Drinksy Pro: monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription (yearly with a 7-day free trial), or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings. Terms: https://aooappsandgames.vercel.app/terms_drinksy.html · Privacy: https://aooappsandgames.vercel.app/privacy_drinksy.html

name: DriveNxt Play
description:
DriveNxt Play is a video app for parked use. Import MP4 or MOV videos from Files, keep them in your library, and play them on your iPhone or iPad. An included preview lets you try playback without an account or importing a file.

On supported CarPlay displays with video capability, play compatible videos from your library while safely parked. On your phone, supported streaming services can open inside DriveNxt Play. Availability, sign-in, subscriptions, and playback depend on the service and region.

Use Open DriveNxt to return to trip planning and navigation in the separate DriveNxt app.

name: Driving+
description:
Keep track of fuel consumption, mileage and vehicle costs with Driving+, from your first fill-up to your next service.

• Log fuel and charging sessions, choose prices and currencies, and attach photos of fuel receipts.
• Record odometer readings and trips. Mark trips as personal or business and add drivers, saved places and notes.
• Compare monthly, quarterly or yearly costs, filter by category and see estimated CO₂ emissions.
• Set reminders for inspections, tyre changes, oil changes or your own maintenance tasks.
• Back up your vehicle data locally and restore it from a backup file on another device.

Driving+ is free. This version has no sign-in, in-app purchases or subscriptions.

name: DRo
description:
DRo는 차량의 계기판 정보를 아이폰과 아이패드에 보여 줘요.
블루투스로 차량과 직접 연결해 속도, 기어, 출력, 배터리 잔량, 주행 가능 거리, 잠금 상태를 실시간으로 표시해요. 서버도 계정도 필요 없고, 데이터는 기기 밖으로 나가지 않아요.
- 읽기 전용: 차량 상태만 읽어요. 주행, 잠금 해제, 깨우기 명령은 보내지 않아요.
- 안전한 키: 페어링 키는 이 기기의 Secure Enclave에만 저장돼요.
- 주행 요약: 주행이 끝나면 거리와 에너지 사용을 정리해 보여 줘요.
- 내 맞춤 계기판: 타일을 길게 눌러 원하는 정보를 고르고, 라이트·다크 테마와 km·마일 단위를 고를 수 있어요.
- 아이패드 지원: 큰 화면에 맞춘 레이아웃을 제공해요.
- 데모 모드: 차량 없이도 가상 데이터로 둘러볼 수 있어요.
페어링하려면 차량 안에서 실물 키 카드가 필요해요. 이 앱의 블루투스 상태 프로토콜을 지원하는 차량과 호환돼요.
DRo는 독립된 앱이며 Tesla, Inc.와 제휴하거나 보증·후원 관계가 없어요.

name: Droid Hands
description:
DroidHands lets the AI agents you use (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Muse, or any app that supports MCP, the Model Context Protocol) use your iPhone for you.

Ask your agent to:
• add a meeting to your calendar, or tell you what's next
• remind you to call someone tomorrow at 9
• look up a friend's number and start a call or a message (you tap Send or Call)
• find where you are, or open directions in Maps
• run one of your Shortcuts and use its result
• copy something to your clipboard, turn on the flashlight, or say something out loud

HOW IT WORKS
Add your DroidHands connection URL to your agent as a custom connector. When the agent connects, DroidHands asks you once what it may do: everything, or only what you choose. Then it works without asking, unless you want it to ask before messages, calls and shortcuts.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• One switch pauses every agent at once.
• Revoke an agent any time; its access ends immediately.
• Every action is in the activity log, allowed or refused.
• Per-tool rules: block a tool, or ask every time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no analytics, no ads. Requests travel from your agent to your iPhone through a relay that stores nothing, or through your own relay. DroidHands is open source (Apache 2.0).
