iPhone lets DroidHands act only while the app is open, so keep it on screen while your agent works.

name: Dronipass: drone pilot theory
description:
Dronipass helps you prepare for remote pilot theory (Regulation (EU) 2019/947) with original lessons and questions written on the EASA syllabus, for three exams in the order you take them. The content is in Italian, German and French.

• A1/A3, open category, complete and free: 9 subjects, 19 lessons and 209 questions; provisional mock exam of 40 questions, pass mark of at least 30 correct answers (75 %). The A1/A3 course and exam take place online and are the prerequisite for the other two exams.
• A2, the additional exam for the A2 subcategory: 3 subjects (meteorology, UAS flight performance, technical and operational mitigations for ground risk), 12 lessons and 150 questions; provisional mock exam of 30 questions (10 per subject), at least 23 correct answers (75 %).
• STS, standard scenarios STS-01 and STS-02: 8 subjects, 21 lessons and 253 questions; provisional mock exam of 40 questions, at least 30 correct answers, or 30 questions for A2 holders (75 %).
• Multiple-choice questions, each with an explanation; mistakes to review and statistics on your progress
• Works offline, no account, no ads, no tracking

The A1/A3 module is entirely free. For A2 and STS part of the app is free: 2 study sessions per topic and 1 mock exam per day. Each module (lessons, unlimited study and mock exams) is unlocked with a one-time purchase, no subscription: A2 4.99 €, STS 9.99 €.

The regulation sets 40 questions for A1/A3, at least 30 for A2 and at least 40 for STS (30 for A2 holders), always with a 75 % pass mark; the duration and distribution of the exam may vary.

Dronipass is an independent training tool: it is not affiliated with ENAC, EASA or any recognised entity, and it does not replace the training or the examination with a recognised entity. The questions are original.

name: Drop a Hot Hoop
description:
Hoop Drop keeps one barrel circle and one hoop on this iPhone.

Close the circle. Heating does not close it. Heat the hoop. Heating does not seat it. Drop the hoop only when the circle is already closed and the hoop is still hot. The hoop seats and goes cold.

Drop while the circle is open or the hoop is cold, and nothing changes. After the hoop stays on, opening the circle leaves it closed and leaves the hoop on. Heating or dropping again does not add a second hoop. You can name the hoop. You can delete the name only while it is not seated. Share sends the circle name and whether the hoop is on. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Drum: Team Chat
description:
The engineering workspace for teams that ship
Review PRs, watch CI, and hand real work to Ringo, your AI teammate without leaving the conversation. Ringo reads diffs and pipelines, not just messages. Hosted in the EU, built for engineers.

name: Dshinio
description:
Welcome! We’ve put great care into building this product and look forward to your valuable suggestions.


Dshinio is a calm origami studio for iPhone. Learn to fold with animated step-by-step diagrams, pick up exactly where you paused, keep notes and paper records for every model, write your own instructions, and display what you have finished in a gallery.

The app is designed like a Japanese folding screen: Learn, Practice, Gallery and Create stand side by side as four paper leaves, and a swipe folds one away as the next unfolds.

LEARN WITH ANIMATED DIAGRAMS
• Eight original models to fold, from gentle first folds to intricate ones: Lantern Tent, Pocket Letter, Reed Boat, Dune Fox Mask, Ridge Fan, Kestrel Dart, Moon Heron and Mountain Shrine Box.
• Filter the library by difficulty (Gentle, Steady, Intricate) or show only your favourites.
• Every step has an animated diagram you can replay. Flaps really swing over the crease, valley folds are dashed in vermilion and mountain folds in indigo.
• Move forward with "Folded · next" or a swipe; steps turn like the pages of a book.
• Diagrams are drawn in the colour of the paper you are using.

PRACTICE AND PROGRESS
• Dshinio remembers the step you are on for every model, so "Continue folding" takes you straight back.
• "On the table" lists every model you have started, with a crease progress bar.
• See how many folds you have finished, how many steps you have creased and your day streak.
• Favourites and your most recent notes are always one tap away.
• Start any model over whenever you like; completions are kept.

NOTES AND PAPER RECORDS
• Write a note for a whole model or for a single tricky step.
• Record the paper you use: size in centimetres or inches, one of ten named colours or your own hex colour, and the paper type (standard, mulberry, foil-backed, kraft or patterned).

YOUR GALLERY
• Record every finished fold with a title, the model, paper, a rating, folding time and a note.
• Add a photo from your library or take one with the camera, or let Dshinio draw a paper still-life of the model in its colour.
• Edit, delete, share the photo or fold the same model again.

CREATE YOUR OWN INSTRUCTIONS
• Write your own sequences: name, description, difficulty and diagram colour.
• Each step uses one of fourteen diagram folds with an animated preview, plus your own words.
• Reorder and remove steps; clear messages tell you if anything is missing.
• A glossary of the fourteen folds plays each one on a tap, with a fold-line legend.

SHARE AND PRINT
• Share any model's instructions as text, or as a printable A4 PDF with every diagram and your notes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up and no login. Dshinio opens straight onto the paper table.
• Everything is saved on your iPhone first and works fully offline.
• Your progress, notes, instructions and gallery records are also backed up privately to the cloud, tied only to this installation of the app. A small hanko seal shows the backup state at a glance.
• Settings > Delete all my data erases your records from this iPhone and from the cloud backup.
• No ads, no analytics and no tracking.

Want to look around first? Tap the seal at the top right to open Settings and choose "Load sample data" to add fictional examples: two custom models, progress and notes on four models, and three gallery pieces. "Remove sample data" takes them away again.

Every model, name and diagram in Dshinio is original to the app.

name: Dual N-Back Memory Training
description:
Dual n-back is the best-known game for working memory: simple to explain, and hard from the first minute.

HOW IT GOES
Every three seconds a square lights up on a grid and a letter is spoken. You compare with what came N steps before. Is the square in the same place as then? Tap Position. Is the letter the same as then? Tap Sound. When nothing matches, do nothing. At 1-back you compare with the step before; at 2-back with the one before that, while new ones keep coming.

A SLOW PRACTICE FIRST
Never played? The practice is a short round at an easy pace that tells you at every step whether it matches and why.

THE LEVEL FOLLOWS YOU
A round has twenty steps that count. Eighty percent right or more takes you a level up; under fifty takes you a level down. So the game stays just hard enough.

HONEST SCORING
After a round: how much was right, and for the square and the letter separately how many matches you caught, how many you missed and how many times you tapped when there was none. Leaving things alone is the easy part and does not raise your score.

MADE TO BE CALM
A dark screen, one light that moves, and the phone's own voice. A button turns green or red the moment you tap it, or stays neutral if you prefer to find out at the end. The letter can be shown on the square as well, for when you cannot hear it.

N-BACK PRO
Every level up to 9-back (the free game stops at 2-back). Sound n-back: the letters alone, eyes closed if you like. Triple n-back: the square, the letter and the colour, all at once. Rounds of your own: faster or slower steps, ten to sixty steps. Your progress: level and accuracy day by day, and where your mistakes are.

FREE
Dual n-back and position n-back at 1-back and 2-back, the practice, standard rounds and your last rounds.

A GAME
N-back is a demanding memory game and a good daily workout for holding things in mind. The app promises nothing more: it is not a test, not a treatment, and makes no claims about intelligence or health.

PRIVATE
No account. Your rounds stay on your iPhone. The letters are spoken by the phone's own voice; the app records nothing and sends nothing to us.

N-Back Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you, and it turns into the paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

Privacy Policy: https://www.appgeolist.com/app/n-back/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: DualTimemark
description:
Capture yourself and the scene together with DualTimemark, a dual-camera photo and video app for iPhone.

TWO VIEWS IN ONE FRAME
Use supported front and rear cameras together. Choose picture-in-picture, top-and-bottom, or side-by-side layouts, swap views, and adjust the picture-in-picture window.

WATERMARKS FOR DIFFERENT MOMENTS
Choose from multiple watermark styles for everyday photos, check-ins, inspections, maps, work logs, and projects. Customize supported fields such as time, date, location, coordinates, and notes. Available details vary by template.

PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
Capture watermarked photos and record videos with sound. Save results to Photos. Optional original-photo saving keeps separate source images alongside the combined result.

MAKE IT YOURS
Adjust supported photo aspect ratios, photo quality, watermark appearance, and the app signature. Interface languages include English, Simplified Chinese, Vietnamese, Thai, and Indonesian.

Designed for iPhone running iOS 26 or later. Simultaneous capture requires compatible multi-camera hardware; available lenses and controls depend on your iPhone. Camera permission is required. Microphone permission is needed for video sound; Photos permission is needed to save media. Optional location access enables location-based details. Weather and map information require an internet connection and service availability.

No account is required. Watermark fields may be customized and are not certified proof of time, location, attendance, or inspection.

name: DucterraVentia
description:
DucterraVentia es un simulador de aire enterrado para quien autoconstruye cabañas, casas de campo o talleres. Reúne el intercambio térmico del tubo, el tiro natural y el riesgo de condensación en un informe comparable antes de abrir la zanja.

Introduce nueve datos: latitud, longitud del ramal, diámetro, profundidad de enterramiento, material, suelo, espesor de cubierta, desnivel entre bocas y número de ramales en paralelo (1–4). La app calcula:
· Temperatura de impulsión en verano e invierno
· Salto térmico de verano y de invierno
· Presión de tiro, caudal natural, velocidad y pérdida de carga por metro
· Inercia térmica del conjunto
· Índice de humedad, punto de rocío y riesgo de condensación
· Consejos de obra para pendiente, drenaje, filtro y rejilla

Planos
Guarda cada cálculo en Planes. Abre el informe para ver todas las métricas o vuelve a Sondeo para editar el trazado y actualizar el plano. Las fichas muestran temperatura de impulsión, riesgo de condensación y estabilidad, y pueden eliminarse.

Diario de campo
Registra temperatura de entrada y salida, humedad en ambos extremos y una nota. La ficha muestra el salto térmico, la humedad de entrada y salida; desliza para borrar.

Curvas
Activa varios planos en Curvas para superponer su temperatura de impulsión mes a mes y leer amplitud, mes cálido y mes frío.

Saber
Tres lecturas sobre galerías centroeuropeas y el oficio del aire enterrado, como contexto de diseño.

Aviso
La app ofrece estimaciones empíricas. No sustituye la prospección del terreno, el cálculo térmico profesional ni el diseño de impermeabilización y drenaje. Ajusta los resultados a la climatología, el nivel freático y la normativa local.

name: Dueslip
description: Dueslip is a household due-date notebook. Record each bill with an amount, a category, and a day of the month from 1 to 28. The due list sorts by the next date. The month grid marks days that have a bill, and a year view totals each month. Mark a bill paid for a specific month without connecting a bank account. One mark is kept per bill per month. All amounts stay on the phone.

name: Dugu Nine Arrows: 3D Archery
description:
Step onto the tower, draw your bow, and chase a perfect 10!

Dugu Nine Arrows is a 3D archery game built around arrow drop, crosswinds, and moving targets. Take direct shots at close, still targets in calm conditions, then learn to read the wind and lead moving targets at long range.

FOUR MODES TO MASTER
• 20-Arrow Score Challenge: Hit bullseyes to earn bonus arrows and chase your personal best.
• Daily Range: A fresh archery range layout each day.
• 16 Training Stages: Practice arrow drop, crosswinds, shots over walls, and moving targets.
• Nine Arrow Trials: You get nine arrows per stage. Play Stage 1 free, then unlock the remaining 8 stages and the Pine Shade, Red Copper, and Frost Blue bow-and-arrow sets with one purchase. Natural Wood is free.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
• Choose Battery Saver, Balanced, or Sharp graphics.
• Play the core modes offline in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, or Korean.

name: Dulle: Doppelkopf offline
description:
Dulle bringt Doppelkopf auf dein iPhone und iPad. Du spielst gegen drei Computer-Gegner – komplett offline, ohne Werbung und ohne Tracking. Mischen, abheben, los geht's.

RE GEGEN KONTRA
Wer eine Kreuz-Dame hat, spielt Re – aber das verrät am Anfang niemand. Beobachte die gespielten Karten, achte auf Ansagen und finde heraus, wer zu wem gehört. Genau wie am Küchentisch.

ALLES, WAS ZUM DOPPELKOPF GEHÖRT
• Normalspiel, Hochzeit und stille Hochzeit
• Ansagen: Re, Kontra, keine 90, keine 60, keine 30, schwarz
• Sonderpunkte: Fuchs gefangen, Doppelkopf, Karlchen, Gegen die Alten
• Abrechnung nach den gängigen Turnierregeln
• Spielliste wie auf dem Block – mit Punkten für jede Runde
• Letzten Stich jederzeit ansehen
• Laufendes Spiel wird automatisch gespeichert

LERNEN LEICHT GEMACHT
Neu bei Doppelkopf oder lange nicht gespielt? Die Regeln sind in der App kurz und verständlich erklärt, inklusive Trumpfleiter. Der Tipp-Modus zeigt dir auf Wunsch die beste Karte.

GROSSE, GUT LESBARE KARTEN
Klare Kartenbilder auf grünem Filz – angenehm zu lesen, auch auf dem iPhone.

KOSTENLOS SPIELEN
Normalspiel, Hochzeit, alle Ansagen und Sonderpunkte, KI-Stufe „Anfänger“, drei Tipps pro Tag und die Statistik deiner letzten 10 Spiele – kostenlos und ohne Werbung.

VOLLVERSION – EINMALIG, KEIN ABO
• Alle Solos selbst spielen: Damensolo, Bubensolo, Farbsolo und Fleischloser
• KI-Stufen „Fortgeschritten“ und „Profi“ – die Profi-KI zählt Trümpfe mit
• Hausregeln: mit oder ohne Neunen, Zweite Dulle sticht die erste, Schweinchen, Hochzeit-Varianten
• Unbegrenzte Tipps
• Komplette Statistik: Siegquote als Re und Kontra, Solo-Bilanz, bestes Spiel

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Spielstände und Statistiken werden nur auf deinem Gerät gespeichert.

Dulle ist ein reines Unterhaltungsspiel ohne Geldeinsätze und ohne Gewinne.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://dulledoppelkopf.xyz/terms/
Datenschutz: https://dulledoppelkopf.xyz/privacy/

name: Dumbo World: Ocean Garden
description:
Care for a little dumbo octopus in your own deep-sea garden.

Feed glowing shrimp, plant seeds the tide brings, and watch Dumbo rest in a shell home. Eat well, rest and explore, and Dumbo grows from a baby into a young dumbo and an adult.

• Swim yourself with a joystick and rise/dive buttons
• Grow plump fruit, firefly fruit, stretch moss, peek flowers and smile fruit
• Raise little creatures in clear light nets and take a grown friend along as a pet
• Explore the echo, current, glass and gloom caves
• Purify gloomlings that lost their light
• Decorate and build around your shell home, with coziness and bond
• Help chatty sea friends and uncover the old tale of the Light Whale

Progress is saved on your device; no account needed. The open sea arrives in an update.

name: Duo Clock - Face Gallery
seller_name: SHIBATA AND COMPANY LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY
description:
Duo Clock turns your iPhone Duo into a desk clock.

Open it about halfway, stand it up like a tent, and the outer display shows a clock face. You can also keep it closed, turn it sideways, and place it on a charging stand. Choose a face that suits your desk, your room, or your mood.

70 FACES

Free: 10 faces, analog and digital
Persons: 8 faces
Animals: 10 faces
Nature: 9 faces
Landscape: 12 faces
Legends: 8 faces
Fantasy RPG: 13 faces

The 10 free faces are yours from the start. The other 60 are sold one at a time, so you only pay for the ones you like. Before you buy, you can preview any face in full screen.

MADE TO SIT ON A DESK

Swipe left or right to change the face
Swipe up or down to adjust the brightness
The screen stays on while charging
The clock shifts slightly every minute to help reduce screen burn-in
Show or hide the seconds and the date

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE

No ads
No account
No data collected
Purchases are tied to your Apple Account and can be restored on a new device

Duo Clock is designed for iPhone Duo. It also works on other iPhone models when you turn them sideways.

The face images were created using generative AI.

name: DuoLedger · 折叠记账
description:
DuoLedger —— 为折叠屏而生的极简记账本。

■ 展开，看见更大的账本
折叠时单手快速记账，展开后秒变财务仪表盘：总览、分类图表、本月对比、钱包健康度一眼看清，大屏空间一点不浪费。

■ 记一笔，只要 3 秒
大号数字键盘、彩色分类、常用备注建议，买完东西顺手就记下，不用来回切换页面。

■ 说一句，就记好了
语音输入金额与备注，在开车、做饭、手上拿着东西时也能轻松记账。

■ 每一笔，都有心情
给消费贴上心情标签，看看情绪如何影响钱包——这是 DuoLedger 独有的消费洞察，配合心情分布图，帮你发现"心情消费"的规律。

■ 预算与周期账单
按分类设置月度预算，接近上限自动提醒；房租、工资等周期账单到期提醒一键入账，不再漏记。

■ 账单日历
热力日历一眼看出哪天花得多，点开即可查看当天明细。

■ 钱包健康度
0–100 分评估你的收支结构，给出清晰、可执行的改善方向。

账目数据仅保存在本机，支持一键导出与恢复 JSON 备份；没有广告，不追踪你的消费行为。

■ 为 iPhone 折叠屏优化
折叠与展开两种布局自然切换，横屏下侧栏导航 + 宽屏报表，竖屏下轻量单列，随处都好用。

从今天开始，把每一笔都记清楚。

name: Duoly
description:
Duoly là nơi riêng của hai bạn. Không có bảng tin, không có người lạ, chỉ có bạn và người ấy.

Câu hỏi mỗi ngày
Mỗi ngày một câu hỏi cho cả hai. Bạn chỉ thấy câu trả lời của người ấy khi cả hai đã trả lời, nên không ai bị ảnh hưởng bởi câu của người kia. Trả lời đều đặn để giữ chuỗi ngày của hai bạn.

Thư gửi tương lai
Viết một lá thư, chọn ngày mở. Người ấy chỉ đọc được từ ngày đó, kể cả bạn cũng không sửa được sau khi niêm phong. Một món quà cho ngày kỷ niệm năm sau, hoặc cho một ngày thường bất kỳ.

Đếm ngày bên nhau
Số ngày yêu nhau ngay trên trang chủ, cùng mốc kỷ niệm sắp tới: 100 ngày, 1 năm, hay ngày hai bạn tự đặt.

Trò chuyện riêng
Khung chat chỉ dành cho hai người: thấy người ấy đang nhập, biết khi tin đã được xem, thả tim hoặc haha cho từng tin nhắn.

Kỷ niệm có ảnh
Lưu lại một ngày đáng nhớ với ảnh, nơi chốn và vài dòng ghi chú. Xem lại theo dòng thời gian hoặc album.

Nhớ bạn
Một chạm để người ấy biết bạn đang nghĩ tới họ.

Và nữa
Bucket list những việc muốn làm cùng nhau, lịch chung có nhắc sinh nhật và ngày lễ, thiệp gửi nhau mỗi dịp lễ, giao diện tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh.

Riêng tư là mặc định
Mọi thứ chỉ hai bạn thấy. Chúng tôi không bán dữ liệu và không dùng nội dung của bạn để quảng cáo. Huỷ ghép đôi hoặc xoá tài khoản bất cứ lúc nào ngay trong app.

Chính sách riêng tư: https://duoly-web.onrender.com/privacy/
Điều khoản sử dụng: https://duoly-web.onrender.com/terms/

name: Dusty: Declutter & Clean Room
description:
Your home doesn't need a weekend overhaul. It needs one small spot, cleared today.

Dusty is a gentle declutter coach that turns "where do I even start?" into a 10-minute mission. Snap a photo of any room, and Dusty finds the quickest win: one surface, one chair, one corner. Then it walks you through tiny steps while a calm timer runs and Dusty keeps you company.

HOW IT WORKS
• Snap a room: take or choose a photo of your bedroom, kitchen, desk, closet, garage or car.
• Pick your spot: Dusty marks 1–3 spots you can clear in about 10 minutes, quickest win first.
• Clear it step by step: rubbish first, then dishes, laundry and things with an obvious home. Tick steps off as you go.
• Snap the after: Dusty compares your before & after photos and shows how much you cleared.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Low-energy days: switch to tiny steps, or run a 5-minute rescue with no photo at all.
• No streaks to lose: set a weekly goal you can actually keep. Missing a day never resets anything.
• Keep or let go: unsure about something? Answer one gentle question at a time, then keep, donate, toss or put it in a "maybe" box.
• Out the door: a donate bag and a reminder to drop it off, because it isn't decluttered until it's left your home.
• Pick the spot yourself: draw a box around any area and Dusty plans just that.

SEE YOUR HOME GET LIGHTER
• A home map with every room, its latest photo and clutter score.
• A gallery of every win, with a before & after slider.
• A personal 4-week plan built from 8 quick questions: quick wins, hotspots, letting go, and keeping it clear.

MADE TO BE KIND
Dusty never judges and never says "messy." Whether you feel a little behind, are short on time or energy, get distracted halfway, or are facing a big change like a move or a new baby, Dusty keeps every mission small and doable.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your room photos are sent securely for analysis and are not stored on our servers. Your before & after photos stay on your phone.

33 LANGUAGES
Dusty speaks English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi and 22 more, and its coaching replies come back in your language too.

DUSTY PRO
Dusty requires a Dusty Pro subscription.  then choose a yearly or weekly plan. Prices are shown in the app in your local currency.

• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or when the free trial ends).
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vQCdbl8EoMoIX29snljEb_QoMUXkasegk13QnqHIS0AhiESjVvLzesVPpW3a6pa_xGy12Poc_kAFUgE/pubL

Clear one spot today. Dusty will be right here with you.

name: Dutie: Shift Schedule
description:
Dutie is a calendar designed for shift work. It shows your schedule the way you already read a calendar, so you always know when you work, when you rest and what comes next.

SCHEDULE
• Set up any repeating pattern: 5 on 5 off, 4 on 4 off, mornings followed by nights, nights only, or a custom sequence
• Create your own shift types with their own start times, lengths and colors
• Mark each day with letters or icons, such as a sun for mornings and a moon for nights

GREGORIAN AND HIJRI
• Every day shows its Hijri (Umm al-Qura) date
• Choose dates in either calendar
• Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, the Day of Arafah, Founding Day and National Day are marked

DAY-TO-DAY CHANGES
• Add extra shifts, record annual, sick or emergency leave, and log swaps with colleagues
• Add notes to any day
• Focus the calendar on a single period, such as a training program

STAY AHEAD
• A live countdown to your next shift, or to your next rest while on duty
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Up to five reminders per shift, from minutes to 14 days in advance
• Ask Siri for your next shift

SMART START
When starting a new program or schedule, Smart Start compares every possible start date and recommends the one that gives you the most rest and matches the days you choose.

INSIGHTS
• Working days, hours and extra hours by month or year
• Annual leave allowance and remaining balance

SHARE AND SYNC
• Share a month or any period up to a year as an image, or save it to Photos
• Add your shifts to Apple Calendar
• View a colleague's or a second schedule alongside yours
• Keep your schedules in sync across iPhone and iPad with your own iCloud
• Export and restore a backup

PRIVACY
• No sign-in or account required
• No ads
• No data collected or shared, and no tracking
• Works fully offline; your data stays on your device and in your personal iCloud

name: Dynasties & Empires
description:
# Dynasties and Empires

**Build. Conquer. Thrive.**

Your empire begins with a single settlement. Its future is in your hands.

Dynasties and Empires is a real-time strategy game that puts you in command of your own growing civilization. Explore the world, develop your settlement, organize your forces and fight to expand your dominion.

Experience a new approach to mobile strategy, with controls designed and optimized specifically for touchscreens.

### STRATEGY DESIGNED FOR TOUCH

Forget complicated interfaces designed for a mouse and keyboard. Dynasties and Empires brings intuitive, responsive controls to mobile strategy.

- Select multiple units with intuitive touch gestures.
- Control groups of units directly on the battlefield.
- Interact with the game world naturally using touchscreen controls.
- Manage your actions with an interface designed for mobile devices.

Strategy should feel natural in your hands.

### BUILD AND DEVELOP YOUR EMPIRE

Transform a small settlement into a thriving kingdom.

- Expand your territory.
- Construct and develop buildings.
- Organize your settlement.
- Manage your resources.
- Plan your expansion and strengthen your position.

Every decision contributes to the future of your empire.

### EXPLORE AND COMMAND

Discover the world around your settlement and take control of your military forces.

- Explore the surrounding terrain.
- Select and command multiple units.
- Position your forces strategically.
- Engage enemy forces and fight for victory.

Your ability to make the right decisions can determine the fate of your civilization.

### EVERY DECISION MATTERS

Build your economy. Develop your territory. Prepare your forces. Expand your influence.

Whether you are developing your settlement or commanding troops in battle, success depends on how you manage your empire.

**Your land. Your army. Your empire.**

Are you ready to build a dynasty that will stand the test of time?

**Play Dynasties and Empires. Build. Conquer. Thrive.**

name: E-zu: Japan Travel Map
description:
E-zu (絵図, "illustrated map") is a beautiful, simple guide to traveling Japan — made for first-time and returning visitors alike.

EXPLORE JAPAN ON A MAP
• Tap a region, then a prefecture, and see its best sights, local specialties, experiences, old towns and screen-pilgrimage spots from anime, films and TV dramas.
• Every prefecture has its own detailed map, with places marked where they really are.
• E-zu picks: the places not to miss are marked Must-see and come first, so you know where to start.
• "Best time to visit" shows the months each place shines. Open Google reviews for any place in one tap.
• Local food: over 470 regional dishes, street foods and sweets from every prefecture, with the must-try ones marked.

WHAT'S ON THIS MONTH
• Festivals, fireworks, illuminations and seasonal moments for every month of the year, with prices and locations.

PLAN YOUR TRIP
• Pick your dates and prefectures, then add places day by day on a clear timeline. Drag to reorder or move a stop to another day.
• Plan with AI: choose what you like — sights, hidden gems, local food, old towns — and Apple Intelligence fills your empty days using only places in the app, on your iPhone.
• Tonight's stay: add your hotel from a list of hotels near your last stop, or find one on Booking.com or Agoda for those dates.
• Tours & tickets: book experiences near any place on Klook, KKday, GetYourGuide or Viator.
• Costs: add what each stop costs in yen and see day and trip totals in your own currency.
• Tickets & seats: keep each ticket, booking code and Shinkansen seat with its stop. Tap to show the code big at the gate — it works offline.
• Before you go: a checklist for your flight, every night's stay, eSIM, rail passes and phrases — with an optional reminder 30 days, 7 days and the day before you leave.
• Add your flights with the airline shown from the flight number, and times in each airport's local time.
• Notes for each day, travel-time estimates and a Google Maps route between any two stops.

SHARE YOUR TRIP
• Trip poster: your route on an illustrated map over your favorite trip photo — or one of your own — ready for a post or a story. Choose which part of the photo shows, lighter or darker, and how soft the background is.
• Itinerary: a beautiful one-page-per-day PDF or images, with big Japanese names, addresses, a QR code for each night's stay, and costs and tickets if you want them.
• Your photos: add your own photos to places and they appear on your map, poster and itinerary.

SHOW IN JAPANESE
• One tap shows a place's Japanese name and full address in big letters — perfect for taxi drivers and station staff.
• Phrases & food card: point-and-show Japanese for everyday moments, and a card that tells restaurant staff which foods you can't eat.

WORKS OFFLINE
• Maps and place information are built into the app, so they work in subways and the mountains. Save your trip's photos for offline too.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no tracking. Your trips, flights, tickets, photos and costs stay on your iPhone.

Available in English, Chinese (Traditional and Simplified), Korean, Thai and Spanish.

Plan with AI needs an iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence; on other iPhones, E-zu suggests a plan that groups nearby places.
Photos from Wikimedia Commons contributors, credited in the app, itineraries and posters.

name: Ear Training: Pitchfold
description:
Train your ear a few minutes a day. Pitchfold plays a sound and you name it: which note of the key, which interval, which chord.

Most ear trainers make you guess. Pitchfold starts with two answers and adds one at a time, so every level is something you can actually hear. When you miss, it plays the answer back slowly: the note walking home to the tonic, the interval one note at a time, the chord broken then together.

• Notes: hear the key first, then one note. Major and minor, 12 levels
• Intervals: rising, falling and played together, from fifths and octaves to all twelve
• Chords: major, minor, diminished, augmented, sus4 and seventh chords
• Tap any answer to hear it before you choose

name: Earthtalk – Translator
description:
Earthtalk is a translator you put between two people.

Lay your iPhone on the table. Each of you gets half of the screen, and theirs turns upside down to face them. Speak, and your words come apart into glowing dust, cross the middle, and arrive in their language.

FACE TO FACE
• Tap your half and speak. Tap again to send.
• Swipe the words left to cancel before they go.
• The other person taps their half and answers in their own language.
• Turn their half to face them with one tap.

NINE LANGUAGES, ANY PAIR
Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Vietnamese and Thai. Earthtalk opens in your iPhone's language and English, and you can change either side any time.

TEXT AND PHOTOS
• Text: type in either language — Earthtalk knows which one you wrote.
• Photo: point the camera at a sign or a menu and its words are translated right where they stand.
• Saved: keep the phrases you need again and show them big to the person in front of you.

OFFLINE
Download the languages you need in Settings and translate on a plane or anywhere without the internet.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Translation is done by Apple's Translation on your iPhone. Nothing you say, type or photograph is sent to us.

name: Easy Oldies 2
description:
Easy Oldies 2 is the revival of a 13-year-old desktop application, now brought to iPhone and iPad.

Give your photos a nostalgic look with nine different color variations inspired by classic photographic effects.  Simply import a picture, browse the nine filtered thumbnails, and select the one you like best.

Once you've made your selection, you can save the filtered image as a PNG file at its original resolution or copy it to the system clipboard for use in other apps.

You can also fine-tune the appearance of your photos by adjusting hue, saturation, brightness, and contrast.  These color adjustments are applied to both the original image preview and all nine color variation thumbnails, allowing you to explore different looks in real time.

- Nine Color Variations -

Easy Oldies 2 offers the following nine filters:

- Chrome – Exaggerated colors
- Fade – Diminished colors
- Instant – Distorted colors
- Mono – Low contrast
- Noir – Exaggerated contrast
- Process – Enhanced cool tones
- Tonal – Tonal black and white
- Transfer – Enhanced warm tones
- Sepia – Classic sepia effect

The intensity of the Sepia effect can also be adjusted to achieve your preferred look.

- Getting Started -

Follow these simple steps to transform your photos:

1. Tap the Start button on the Home screen.
2. On the Picture screen, tap the Import toolbar button to access your Photos library.  Select a picture to work with.
3. The imported picture will appear below the Import toolbar button. Further down, you'll find four Picker controls in a horizontal scroll view.  Use them to adjust hue, saturation, brightness, and contrast as desired.
4. Below the adjustment controls, you'll find nine color variation thumbnails.  Tap any thumbnail to select it.  The selected thumbnail will be highlighted with a red border.  When using the Sepia filter, you can also adjust its intensity.
5. To use the selected filtered image in another app, tap the Copy toolbar button.  The image is copied to the system clipboard at its original resolution.
6. To save the selected filtered image as a PNG file, tap the Export toolbar button.

Rediscover your photos with a touch of nostalgia.  Easy Oldies 2 makes it simple to give your favorite pictures a timeless, old-fashioned appearance.

name: EasyCardSafe
description:
Schluss mit dem dicken Portemonnaie: EasyCardSafe bewahrt deine Kundenkarten, Mitgliedsausweise und andere wichtige Karten sicher auf deinem iPhone auf – immer griffbereit, wenn du sie brauchst.

KARTEN IN SEKUNDEN ERFASSEN
• Vorder- und Rückseite mit der Kamera fotografieren oder aus der Fotomediathek wählen
• Kategorien: Kundenkarte, Mitglied, Ausweis, Zahlung, Gesundheit und Sonstiges
• Eigene Farbe und Notiz für jede Karte, z. B. für Mitgliedsnummern

DEINE DATEN GEHÖREN DIR

• Kein Tracking, keine Werbung

BACKUP MIT PASSWORT

name: Eazy-Goal
description:
EazyGoal helps you do what you set out to do, one day at a time.

TODAY'S GOALS, NO EXCUSES
Write down what you want to achieve and each day see only what's due: daily, on chosen weekdays, X times a week, or once with a deadline. Tick it off when it's done.

• Mini Goals: break a Goal into steps; finish them all, then tick it.

• Miss a day and it shows red in your year, but nothing piles up: tomorrow starts clean.
• Need a break? Pause a Goal without losing anything.

YOUR YEAR IN SQUARES
Every day of the year is a square: green for done, red for missed. The calendar lives in the same card, with your events and deadlines. "Day 327 of 365": see how much of the year is left.

GOALS OF THE YEAR AND OF LIFE
Your list of resolutions for this year, the next, and for life. What you don't reach in a year moves on to the next or you let it go; past years stay as a record.

VISION BOARD
A free collage of your photos, words and stickers on cork, paper, night sky or sunset. Drag them, turn them, resize them. "Visualize" plays it full screen, photo by photo, every day.

NUDGES THAT PUSH

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
No account, no internet, no ads, no server. Everything stays on your phone. Save a copy to a file whenever you like and restore it on another phone.

In 24 European languages, with light and dark mode.
Free, forever.

name: EC Eng-Vie Dictionary
description:
EC Eng-Vie Dictionary is a free learner's dictionary for Vietnamese learners and teachers of English. Everything is inside the app, so it works fully offline: no account, no ads, no data collected.

THREE DICTIONARIES IN ONE
• English–English: clear definitions grouped by part of speech, with examples.
• English–Vietnamese: a Vietnamese meaning for each sense, shown under the English definition (turn it on or off with one tap).
• Vietnamese–English: look up a Vietnamese word, with or without accents, and see its English equivalents.

BUILT FOR LEARNERS
• IPA for British and American English, and read-aloud with the voices built into your iPhone or iPad.
• CEFR levels (A1–C2) for each sense, plus a "Top 3000" tag for the most useful words.
• Bilingual example sentences, phrasal verbs, idioms, synonyms and opposites, word families and word origins.
• Prepositions used with a word, common collocations, and example sentences grouped by position.
• Finds the right entry when you type an inflected form (went → go, children → child) or make a spelling mistake (recieve → receive).
• Save words or single senses to your own word lists and export them to CSV for Excel, Anki or Quizlet.
• Double-tap any word inside an entry to look it up.
• Light and dark themes, two colour schemes, adjustable text size, English or Vietnamese interface.
• Designed for both iPhone and iPad.

ABOUT THE CONTENT
136,000+ English words and phrases and 116,000+ Vietnamese words, built from open data: Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0), Open English WordNet, CEFR-J and Octanove vocabulary profiles, Tatoeba sentences, and Wikipedia text for usage patterns. Learner notes, simplified definitions and Vietnamese meanings that were newly written for this dictionary with the help of AI are always marked "AI". The dictionary data is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0; full sources and licences are in the app's About page.

PRIVACY
The app works without the internet, does not collect or share any data, and has no ads or analytics. Your history and word lists stay on your device; you can back them up to a file yourself.

Also available as a website: dictionary.edtechcorner.com. Made by Edtech Corner.

name: Echorium Soundscape
description:
Every room has its own acoustic character. Echorium lets you discover how that character changes when you reshape the space, move a sound source, or replace a single surface.

Start with an empty canvas and build your own acoustic environment. Draw walls and partitions, define the room's geometry, and experiment with concrete, wood, foam, and fabric. Each surface influences how virtual sound behaves across low, mid, and high frequencies, turning material choices into visible differences.

The real exploration begins in Pulse Lab. Send luminous sound pulses through your design and follow their journeys as they bounce between walls, lose energy, and reach listening points. Switch between reflection trails, animated wavefronts, energy heatmaps, and absorption views to uncover patterns that would otherwise remain invisible.

Move a receiver into a different corner and see which reflection paths find it. Replace a wooden wall with acoustic panels and compare the resulting echo patterns. Replay individual moments, inspect arrival sequences, and discover how small changes can transform the entire virtual soundscape.

Spectrum gives every experiment its own acoustic identity. Explore frequency responses, reflection distributions, arrival timelines, and a distinctive Echo Fingerprint that captures the modeled behavior of your design. Preserve different configurations as snapshots and revisit your acoustic experiments in Archive.

Echorium isn't a sound recorder or a conventional room planner. It's a visual playground where architecture, materials, and sound reflections meet, built around interactive experiments rather than static diagrams.

Created for curious minds, sound enthusiasts, designers, and anyone interested in the hidden behavior of sound. Echorium works entirely offline, using illustrative acoustic models for creative exploration and learning rather than professional acoustic measurement or certified engineering analysis.

name: EcoLink
seller_name: Ligoo New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
EcoLink brings cloud monitoring for compatible hybrid inverters to your iPhone. See how your home generates, stores, and uses energy, and check the status of your inverter and connected devices.

See where your energy goes. Follow power flow between your solar panels, battery, grid, and home loads. Check battery charge and see when your system imports or exports power.
Track system performance. View current power and energy production by day, month, or year. Select inverter readings to compare on historical charts.
Monitor your equipment. Find inverters and data collectors, check their operating status, and review active alarms and event history.
Manage supported devices. Access inverter settings and quick controls when your account permissions and equipment allow. Use Bluetooth to view live readings on compatible equipment nearby.

Cloud monitoring requires an EcoLink account with access to a compatible system. To explore the app with sample data, tap Try Demo on the sign-in screen.

name: EcoVigil
description:
Mould needs a wet surface, and the surface that gets wet first is the coldest wall in the room. EcoVigil works out which wall that is from your local weather forecast and three facts about the room, then tells you when it will sweat, when to open the windows, and where mould will show first. No sensors, no gadget, nothing to buy.

HOW IT WORKS

1. The hourly forecast for your town (temperature, humidity, dew point) for the week ahead, from Open-Meteo.
2. Three taps per room: what kind of room it is, how well its coldest wall is insulated, how it is ventilated.
3. Building physics does the rest. The ISO 13788 temperature factor gives the inside surface of the coldest wall; the dew point of the room's air says whether water will form on it. The gap between the two is the warning.
4. Add what you can see. An EPA-based checklist and a tap-to-mark wall survey turn stains, smells and mould into evidence the verdict can use.

WHAT YOU GET

• Home. Rooms ranked worst first, each with a four-step meter (Dry, Watch, Damp risk, Urgent) and one plain sentence saying why. The greeting names the room that needs you today.

• Wall versus dew point. Outside, dew point, coldest wall and room air on one scale, with the margin in words: "1.5 °C to spare" or "condensing now".

• Week. Wall temperature against dew point for seven days, then a card per day with a bar of risky hours. See the bad morning coming.

• Air-out timer. Opening windows only dries a room when outdoor air holds less water than the room, which the app checks for you. When it does, start a ten-minute timer and get a nudge to close up before the heating is wasted.

• Evening-before reminders. Switch them on and get a notification at 8 pm when tomorrow morning looks like a wet-window day, for every room.

• Daily habits per room. Can I dry laundry here today? Fan after showers? Heating low rather than off? Three or four lines that change with the weather.

• Inspect. Eight yes/no questions from the EPA mould guide, weighted by how strongly each predicts an active problem. Then a wall survey: stand facing the wall, tap each patch to mark OK, stain, damp or mould, add a photo and notes.

• Hygrometer override. Own a cheap hygrometer? Type in what it says and the app uses your number instead of the estimate for 24 hours.

• Guide. What dew point, wall factor and surface humidity mean, what the app assumes, the habits that work, the limits, and every source.

PRIVACY

No account. No ads. No tracking. No analytics. The only thing that leaves your phone is a coordinate rounded to about a kilometre, sent to Open-Meteo to fetch the forecast. Rooms, readings, inspections, surveys and photos stay in the app. Reminders are computed on the phone.

METHOD AND SOURCES

Dew point by the Magnus formula; surface temperature by the ISO 13788 temperature factor; indoor moisture load from the ISO 13788 humidity classes, scaled by ventilation and outdoor temperature; mould criterion 80 % humidity at the surface; indoor humidity guidance from the US EPA, ASHRAE 62.1 and the WHO dampness and mould guidelines. Weather by Open-Meteo.

NOT A SURVEY

EcoVigil is a research prototype that estimates from public weather and three settings per room. It cannot see leaks, rising damp or plumbing failures. For persistent damp, get a professional survey; if someone at home has respiratory symptoms, see a clinician. EcoVigil is not affiliated with any agency or standards body.

name: Edios Bistro King
description:
Warm lights are glowing across the patio, the grill is sizzling, and hungry guests are already taking their seats at your bistro!

In Edios Bistro King, you are the chef, host, and owner of a charming 3D corner restaurant. Start small with two cozy velvet booths and a hot grill, then build your kitchen into a bustling 10-table hotspot filled with sizzling dishes, warm candlelight, and joyful dinner rushes.

COOK, TORCH, POUR, AND SERVE
- Master 5 lively kitchen stations including the Flame-Broiler Grill, Golden Deep Fryer, Starlight Shake Mixer, Warm Pastry and Espresso Bar, and Caramel Torch Station.
- Time every dish to perfection for piping-hot bonus tips and watch the grill closely so nothing burns when the evening rush heats up!

GROW FROM TWO BOOTHS TO A FULL HOUSE
- Play through 12 handcrafted Career shifts, replay your favorites for 3-star ratings, or see how far you can go in Endless Rush.
- Spend earned Crowns to open new dining wings including Indoor Alcoves, a Cobblestone Patio, a Parasol Courtyard, and a Red-Carpet VIP Salon.
- Upgrade to twin grills, warming heat lamps, and recruit helpers Nova and Luna to keep every table smiling when every seat is full.

RELAX IN FREE-PLAY SHOWCASE
- Take a breather after a big shift and step into Free-Play Showcase anytime to stack wild 12-layer signature burgers, listen to live accordion music on the patio, and explore your glowing twilight courtyard at your own pace.

Play offline anytime on the couch, on a flight, or wherever your next cooking craving strikes!

name: Edios ICanMakeThat
description:
Stop staring at a half-full fridge wondering what to cook. I Can Make That turns the ingredients you already own into balanced, satisfying meals—without forcing a grocery run, asking for camera permissions, or requiring an internet connection.

INSTANT PANTRY MATCHING
• Tap from 102 everyday kitchen staples organized across Proteins, Produce, Dairy & Eggs, Pantry & Grains, and Spices & Sauces.
• Type or paste natural fridge lists (like "2 chicken breasts, scallions, garbanzos, EVOO, lemon")—the offline parser resolves aliases and quantities automatically.
• Start in one tap with 4 curated Starter Presets (Weeknight Basics, Plant-Powered Fridge, High-Protein Pantry, 5-Ingredient Rescue), saved locally on your iPhone and iPad.

84 CURATED OFFLINE RECIPES
• Ranked in real time by Makeability % so "Ready Now (100%)" and "1 Smart Swap Away" dishes rise straight to the top.
• Search by craving ("creamy garlic pasta", "tacos", "salmon", "soup") or exact ingredient.
• Every dish includes prep & cook times, exact quantities, interactive step-by-step instructions, and complete per-serving nutrition (calories, protein, carbs, net carbs, fat, and fiber).

51 DIET-AWARE SMART SWAPS
• Missing buttermilk, heavy cream, white wine, sour cream, pine nuts, or eggs? Built-in culinary swap rules show exact replacement ratios using items already in your kitchen.
• Every swap obeys your active dietary filters—so plant-based and dairy-free cooks never get dairy, egg, honey, or wheat substitutes suggested by mistake.

7 STRICT LIFESTYLE FILTERS
• Combine Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Keto / Low-Carb (up to 15g net carbs), and High-Protein (28g+ protein) with ingredient-level verification.

PORTION SCALING, PRINT & MACRO CAPSULES
• Scale any meal cleanly from 0.5x to 6x servings with automatic culinary fractions and proportional batch nutrition.
• Print clean kitchen recipe cards via AirPrint or Save-to-PDF, or share portable JSON Macro Capsules through the native iOS/iPadOS Share Sheet.
• Zero accounts, zero telemetry, zero ads, and 100% offline reliability.

name: EdiosSpinalArc
description:
Edios SpinalArc is a 100% offline interactive 3D peripheral nervous system, cranial nerve, autonomic axis, and stretch-reflex reference studio crafted for students, educators, and anatomy learners on iPhone and iPad.

SIX INTEGRATED NEUROANATOMY MODULES
1. Interactive 3D Spinal Cord & Peripheral Plexus Atlas
Orbit, pinch-zoom, and inspect all six regions—Cervical (C1–C8), Thoracic (T1–T12), Lumbar (L1–L5), Sacral & Cauda Equina (S1–S5), Brachial Plexus (C5–T1), and Sciatic Nerve (L4–S3)—paired with action-potential impulse particles and a live sensory dermatome territory map.

2. The 12 Cranial Nerves Masterboard (CN I – CN XII)
Filter all twelve cranial nerves by Sensory, Motor, or Mixed modality and inspect brainstem nuclei origins, skull foramina pathways, and core physiological roles.

3. Autonomic Nervous System Axis
Compare thoracolumbar Sympathetic (T1–L2, Norepinephrine) and craniosacral Parasympathetic (CN III, VII, IX, X & S2–S4, Acetylcholine) outflow side by side across pupils, heart rate, bronchioles, and GI motility, with dedicated Vagus Nerve (CN X) neurochemistry notes.

4. Monosynaptic Stretch Reflex Arc Simulator
Trigger the interactive patellar tendon stretch animation and explore computed conduction latencies across the four foundational deep tendon reflex pairs: Biceps (C5–C6), Triceps (C7–C8), Patellar (L2–L4), and Achilles (S1–S2).

5. Pathway & Nerve-Root Reference
Study textbook neuroanatomy pathway models—including crossed spinal tract architecture, lumbosacral root distribution, CN VII upper-versus-lower cortical pathways, and sciatic branching.

6. Study Quiz & Native PDF / Share Export
Check your recall across five neuroanatomy pathway questions and export a clean study summary or print-ready PDF reference sheet offline via AirPrint and the iOS Share Sheet.

PRIVACY & EDUCATIONAL NOTICE
- 100% offline bundle with zero external trackers, zero network telemetry, and zero ads.
- Educational peripheral nervous system, cranial nerve, autonomic axis, and reflex-arc reference studio for students and learners. Not a medical device, neurological exam tool, or substitute for a licensed physician or neurologist.

name: Edstream SMS
description:
Edstream brings your whole school to your phone, online or offline.

FOR TEACHERS
• Record continuous assessment (CA) and exam scores for each subject you teach
• See your assigned classes, subjects and student rosters
• Track scoring progress with live totals and grades
• Send announcements to the students in your classes

FOR SCHOOL LEADERS
• Management hub with student, staff and expense overviews
• Manage classes, sections and subjects
• Set up academic sessions and terms
• Approve or reject expense requests
• View master results, class rankings and report cards
• Manage staff and student records

FOR STUDENTS
• Check results and report cards by term
• View your class timetable
• Read school notices and announcements

WORKS OFFLINE
No internet? Keep working. Records you have opened stay available, and changes you make offline are saved on your phone and sync automatically once you are back online.

SECURE ACCESS

Edstream is for schools using the Edstream school management platform. Your school administrator provides your login.

name: EduFlow by Aylukha

EduFlow helps school communities work together through better access to information and connected digital tools.

EduFlow — Empowering Every Learner

Developed by Aylukha Solutions.

name: EduGears AI LMS
description:
Missed a message from your trainer? Not sure what's due this week? Want to know whose work is waiting for you? EduGears AI puts your organization's learning platform in your pocket.

EduGears AI is the mobile app for the EduGears AI LMS. Sign in with the account your school, college or training organization gave you — the same one you use on the web.

• Open your course activities — lessons, quizzes and AI activities your organization has set up — right in the app

FOR PARENTS AND GUARDIANS (organizations using EduGears AI SIS)

Available in 13 languages, including Arabic (right-to-left), Hindi, Chinese, Spanish, French and German.

name: EGG FLIGHT
description:
EGG FLIGHT — Aim. Fly. Splat.

Step up to a brass carnival launcher and send a perfect ceramic egg soaring through the air. Feel the angle, control the power, read the arc — then watch it fly.

Start with still targets and learn the joy of a clean hit. As you advance, moving rails, swinging rings, bounce pads, and precision challenges push your timing and prediction skills further.

50 handcrafted levels across Sunny Yard, Brass Workshop, and Floating Garden. Unlock stylish egg skins, collect trophies, and chase three-star clears.

No slingshot clichés. Just refined physics, elegant aiming, and the satisfying splash of a perfect shot.

AIM. FLY. SPLAT.

name: EHNWHUB
description: EHNWHUBThis tool is designed for recording daily expenses and reconciling consolidated charges. You begin by logging the actual payment, then enter sub-totals or estimated ranges for the individual items covered by that transaction. For items that can be calculated, the system displays the derivation process and supporting data; any amounts that cannot yet be allocated are placed in a "pending" queue, and in the event of a discrepancy, you can cross-reference the original source records. Payments made across multiple accounts can be reconciled collectively, and incoming refunds can be linked back to the original expenses. You can also import billing statements, verify account balances transaction by transaction, and attach relevant details as justification for how an expense was broken down. Monthly reports track categorized spending alongside any unallocated balances, with full traceability back to the original transaction logs. Additionally, the expense planning feature allows you to monitor category-specific spending limits and recurring bills, helping you determine how much budget remains for the current month.

name: Ekkly: Bible Party Games
description:
Game night for your youth group, small group or family, with the Bible at the centre.

Pass one phone around the room and play six party games built from Scripture. No setup, no accounts, no cards to lose.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Charades: act it out, no talking. Flip the phone to pass or score.
• Describe It: talk all you like, just never say the three banned words.
• Draw It: grab paper and sketch Bible people and stories against the clock.
• Finish the Verse: we start a famous verse, your team ends it.
• Who Am I?: hold the phone to your forehead and work out which Bible character you are.
• Guess the Book: hear a verse and name the book it comes from.

PLAY SOLO
• Manna: guess the daily five-letter Bible word in six tries.
• Daily Verse: one verse a day to complete and keep your streak.
• Verse Builder: put the words of a verse back in order before time runs out.
• Book Rush: sort as many verses into their books as you can.

Everyone gets the same daily puzzle, so you can compare with friends.

BUILT FOR GROUPS
• Teams, timers and rounds you can set in seconds
• Easy, Medium and Hard decks for every age
• Packs for Bible Characters, Bible Stories, Miracles, Places & Things, Church Life, Famous Verses, Psalms & Proverbs and Words of Jesus, plus Christmas and Easter
• Streak reminders you can turn off any time

SCRIPTURE YOU CAN TRUST
Every verse is taken word for word from the World English Bible, a public domain translation, and checked against the source text.

EKKLY PRO
One payment, yours forever. Unlock every card, Hard mode, the Christmas and Easter packs and unlimited solo runs, and remove all ads. No subscription.

name: Ekonomi Sürücü Kursu
description:
İzmir’in Balçova ilçesinde faaliyet gösteren Ekonomi Sürücü Kursu, sürücü adaylarına kaliteli, güvenilir ve çağdaş eğitim anlayışıyla hizmet sunmayı hedefleyen bir eğitim kurumudur. Trafikte bilinçli, dikkatli ve sorumluluk sahibi sürücüler yetiştirmeyi temel ilke edinen kurumumuz, ehliyet sahibi olma sürecini yalnızca bir belge edinme aşaması olarak değil, güvenli sürüş alışkanlıklarının kazanıldığı önemli bir eğitim yolculuğu olarak görmektedir.

Sınavlara Hazırlık Artık Cebinizde!
Bu uygulama sınavlara etkili bir şekilde hazırlanmanızı sağlar. Uygulama içerisinde yer alan video anlatımlar, dijital kitaplar ve interaktif testler sayesinde hem teorik bilginizi geliştirir hem de sınav pratiği kazanırsınız.

Konuya Göre Ayrılmış Kitaplar:
Her ders, konularına göre düzenlenmiş dijital kitaplarla sunulmuştur. Bu sayede hangi konuyu çalışmak istiyorsanız doğrudan o bölüme geçebilir, gereksiz zaman kaybı yaşamadan öğreniminizi sürdürebilirsiniz.

Video Anlatımlarla Görsel Öğrenme:
Her konu için özel olarak hazırlanmış video içerikleriyle öğrenme sürecinizi destekleyin. Görsel anlatımlar sayesinde karmaşık konular daha anlaşılır hale gelir, öğrenme kaliteniz artar.

Dinamik Test Sistemi:
Test çözme bölümü, her seferinde farklı sorular sunarak sizi sınavlara hazırlarken ezberden uzaklaştırır. Gerçek sınav formatına benzer yapıdaki testlerle hem bilgilerinizi ölçebilir hem de eksiklerinizi tespit edebilirsiniz.

İlerlemenizi Takip Edin:
Uygulama içerisindeki test sonuçlarıyla hangi konularda güçlü olduğunuzu, nerelerde gelişmeniz gerektiğini kolayca görebilirsiniz. Bu sayede hedef odaklı bir çalışma planı oluşturabilirsiniz.

Her Zaman, Her Yerden Erişim:
Mobil cihazınız üzerinden istediğiniz zaman uygulamaya erişebilir, dilediğiniz yerde çalışmaya devam edebilirsiniz. Sınav hazırlığı artık sadece sınıfta değil, cebinizde!

Yasal Bilgilendirme:
Bu uygulama herhangi bir resmi kurum, devlet kuruluşu veya bakanlık tarafından geliştirilmemiştir ve bu kurumları temsil etmez. Sadece bireysel eğitim ve sınav hazırlığı amacıyla tasarlanmıştır. Resmi sınav sistemleriyle doğrudan bir bağlantısı bulunmamaktadır.

name: Eldir
description: Eldir is a small, offline color studio for designers, developers and anyone choosing colors. Dial in a base color with HSL sliders or a HEX field, generate six classic harmony palettes, check WCAG contrast for readable text, convert between HEX, RGB and HSL, and save palettes on your device. No account, no connection, no advertising — just a calmer way to work with color.

name: ELITE ACADEMY CENTER
description:
Descarga nuestra App gratuita y benefíciate de todas sus ventajas : 

Reservas 
Consulta de horarios 
Promociones 
Descuentos 
Actualidad 
Sistema play 
Amigos 
Ranking 
Campeonatos 
Agenda 

Y muchas mas ventajas, todo en la palma de tu mano

name: ELORA
description:
ELORA es la aplicación oficial para controlar tu inodoro inteligente ELORA desde tu iPhone mediante Bluetooth.

Controla todas sus funciones desde una interfaz clara y sencilla, sin buscar un mando adicional, y disfruta de un momento de relax a tu medida.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES

• Lavado y confort: lavado posterior, lavado femenino, masaje oscilante, masaje pulsante y ajuste de la posición de lavado.
• Ajustes rápidos: posición de lavado, intensidad del agua, temperatura del agua, del asiento y del secado, y velocidad del secado.
• Secado y climatización: secador con temperatura y velocidad regulables, asiento climatizado y luz infrarroja.
• Automatizaciones: descarga automática, sensor de proximidad, apertura y cierre automático de tapa y asiento, control con sensor de pie y tiempos de retardo configurables.
• Higiene: desinfección UV, desinfección de la cánula y del circuito de agua, escudo de espuma, aromaterapia, luz nocturna y luz ambiental.
• Energía y mantenimiento: modo ahorro de energía, modo ausencia, modo de espera, calibración de tapa y asiento, restauración de ajustes de fábrica y recordatorios de cambio de filtro y de recarga de espuma.
• Perfiles: modo infantil y dos usuarios con ajustes propios.

CÓMO FUNCIONA

1. Activa el Bluetooth del iPhone.
2. Abre la aplicación y busca tu dispositivo ELORA.
3. Conéctalo y empieza a controlar las funciones desde la pantalla de inicio o desde Ajustes.

La aplicación utiliza el permiso de Bluetooth únicamente para detectar y conectar con tu inodoro ELORA.

COMPATIBILIDAD

Las funciones y opciones disponibles pueden variar según el modelo de ELORA. Algunas opciones pueden aparecer en la aplicación aunque el modelo conectado no las incluya.

IDIOMAS

Español, inglés, francés

name: Elrai
description:
Elrai is a small, offline notebook for walking fields. It holds a fixed catalogue of twenty-four kinds of open ground, a private record of every field walk you make, and five short notes on reading grass and choosing a month. There is no account, no feed, no map, no sync and no advertising. Everything you need for the next walk along a headland is already inside the app.

**A FIELD PAGE, NOT A DASHBOARD**
Meadow Today opens with the date and a plain-language month window: the card tilts toward the ground that usually suits the month, never the day's weather or the light over the grass. One sand-coloured button starts a field walk. Below it sit three suggested fields and the two most recent walks. The page is deliberately short; the field is outside.

**TWENTY-FOUR FIELDS, SIX GROUPS**
Four meadow fields, four pasture, four hedgerow, four fen, four downland and four field margins. Each entry carries a name, origin, group, access band, season band, typical length, a short field note and a where-to-walk-it hint. Filter by group or browse the fixed sections; a field you have logged shows how many days it appeared in.

**A FIELD WALK, PROPERLY KEPT**
The editor asks for the date and time, duration in fifteen-minute steps, a route name and the pack. Conditions are four capsule groups: shape (out & back, loop, point to point, field edge), light (sheltered, mixed, open, full sun), weather (clear, overcast, rain, windy) and grass (short, growing, long, lodged). Pick any of the twenty-four fields passed, give each a count and an optional note, then add one note for the whole walk. Save and the walk joins the local log.

**THE RECORD ACCUMULATES**
The Walk Log groups every field walk by month. Open an entry to see its route, light, weather, grass, every field passed and the notes you kept. Insights totals field days, field records, fields seen and hours; breaks the catalogue down by group; draws a thirty-five-day dot strip and six monthly columns; and names the field you return to most.

**FIVE FIELD NOTES**
Short offline essays on a first field walk, reading a field's grass, the six kinds of open ground, a field without a forecast, and leaving the margin exactly as you found it. They are written for a beginner with sturdy boots and a small notebook, not for a guidebook.

**BUILT TO BE QUIET**
No account. No login. No cloud sync. No ads. No analytics. No in-app purchases. No notifications. No location, camera, contacts, microphone or tracking permission. The app makes no network request at all: the catalogue, the guide and your journal all live on this iPhone. Field walks and preferences are written to one local JSON file; deleting the app removes it. The privacy summary is readable offline, and the hosted policy is the authoritative version.

**A NOTE ON THE MONTH CARD**
Elrai never predicts the weather or the light. The month card is a rough calendar bias: hedgerows in winter, meadows in spring, downland in high summer, field margins after autumn. A local forecast, the wind over the grass and the state of the ground still rule the decision, and the app says so plainly.

name: Elrex
description: Elrex is a small, offline logbook for the night sky. It keeps a hand-picked catalogue of thirty-one objects and a private record of every night you spend under it: the site, the hours, the seeing, the transparency, the Bortle class, the gear and a note for each object you found. There is no account, no feed, no sync and no advertising. Everything you need for the next clear night is already inside the app.

name: Elvara: Elder Care
description:
When you care for an older loved one, the details add up. Was today's medicine marked as taken? When is the next visit? What did you want to ask the doctor? Elvara gives those details a place on your iPhone.

Start with a name or nickname for the person you care for. From Home, you can record a daily check-in, see today's medicine progress, and look up the next appointment.

• Medicines: Record the schedule and dose you already follow, mark a dose as taken, and see when your recorded stock is running low.
• Visits: Save appointment dates, times, and clinician names so you can find the details before you leave.
• Health log: Enter blood pressure, blood sugar, and weight readings manually. Review previous entries and see a chart of the systolic readings you recorded.
• Care Notebook: Keep dated observations and collect questions for the next appointment.
• Care Circle: Keep a personal list of family members and caregivers, with optional roles and phone numbers. Turn on Elder-friendly mode for larger text.

Elvara works offline. It saves your care profile and entries on your iPhone so you can pick up where you left off after closing the app. There is no sign-in, cloud sync, or advertising.

Elvara is for personal record-keeping. It does not take measurements, diagnose conditions, recommend treatment, or contact emergency services. Use your healthcare professional's guidance when making medical decisions.

name: Embassy Cinemas
description:
Plan your next big screen experience from the comfort of your mobile; anytime, anywhere! Getting showtimes and booking tickets at Embassy Cinemas in Valletta could not be easier!

Watch trailers, explore film times, and see what's showing at Embassy Cinemas in one easy to use app. Still not sure what to see? No problem! Use filters in the app to browse what's showing now, what's coming soon, and special performances, to help you decide.

The easy to use booking system allows you to choose your film time, pick your seats, and select your tickets all in one simple order! Better than that, once you have finished your booking your e-tickets will be waiting for you in the app, so no need to queue to collect them at the cinema!

You can also log in to your Embassy account to manage your account, view your ticket wallet and access your rewards, and turn on notifications to get reminders about your upcoming performances.

name: Ember Rally: Campfire Rain
description:
The storm is rolling in and your little campfire is all that stands between the forest and the dark.

Every raindrop that hits the fire dims it by 10%. Every tiny ember that walks into the flames grows it by 50% and calls two more embers from the forest. Tap the rain away, keep the embers safe on their walk home, and watch the chain reaction take off until the whole screen is on fire.

ONE TAP TO PLAY
Tap raindrops before they land. Crack heavy storm drops. Dry out muddy clods so they turn into fresh embers. Levels last under a minute.

ENDLESS LEVELS, NEW SURPRISES EVERY CHAPTER
The goal climbs from a few hundred percent into the millions and billions. Every chapter brings a new twist:
- Fireflies: catch them for a +25% boost
- Hailstones that need three taps
- Sneaky raccoon bandits that try to run off with your embers
- Thunderclouds: break them up before the lightning strikes
- Frost wisps that drift in to chill the flames
After level 60 everything mixes together, and it never ends.

DAILY BLAZE
A special storm every day with its own twist, a streak to keep alive and a campfire chest.

FLAMES AND CAMPSITES
Unlock azure, jade, amethyst, sunburst and rainbow flames. Travel from the pine forest to a misty lake, a snowfield, desert dunes, an autumn grove and the aurora peaks.

BOOSTERS
Umbrella stops the rain, Bellows rushes every ember to the fire, Kindling doubles the blaze when you need it most.

- Short, satisfying levels with stars to collect
- Original music and sound, cosy night-forest look
- Plays offline
- 36 languages

Ember Rally contains ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase removes the banner and between-level ads for good; optional reward videos stay available. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

name: Emberstep: Dungeon Delve
description:
Explore pixel-art dungeons one step at a time, then turn every encounter into a deckbuilding puzzle. Play cards in ascending mana cost to build a combo and multiply their effects. Use Wild cards to bridge costs, block incoming attacks, and time your strongest plays against charging bosses.

• Explore six campaign dungeons from a first-person perspective. Find hidden supplies, break torches, and decide which fights to take.
• Grow your deck during each expedition. Choose new cards, socket gems, and combine weapons at evolution altars.
• Discover 22 adventurers, each with their own starting deck, signature weapon, and play style.
• Unlock an Endless dungeon with freshly assembled floors and rising difficulty.
• Learn the controls and combat in a replayable tutorial. Resume expeditions from a local save.

One purchase includes the complete single-player game and offline play.

name: Encaixou! Quebra-Cabeças
seller_name: MC TECH CONSULTORIA E SERVICOS EM TI LTDA
description:
Encaixou! é um quebra-cabeça clássico, feito para quem gosta de montar com calma e ver a imagem aparecer peça por peça.

COMO É JOGAR
• Peças com encaixe de verdade, que se juntam com um clique e passam a andar em grupo.
• De 24 a cerca de 1000 peças: escolha o tamanho a cada partida.
• Bandeja de peças que rola, com filtro de bordas e ordenação por cor.
• Zoom com dois dedos para trabalhar nos detalhes.
• Progresso salvo sozinho: pare quando quiser e continue depois.
• Imagem-guia opcional no quadro.

IMAGENS
• 96 imagens em 13 pacotes: Rio de Janeiro, Fauna do Brasil, Praias, Cachoeiras e Rios, Fundo do Mar, Sabores, Mercados e Vilas do Mundo, Ateliês, Jardins e Pátios, entre outros.
• Um pacote com fotografias autorais de Magnun Coutinho.
• O pacote Rio de Janeiro é grátis, e todo pacote tem uma imagem de amostra para experimentar.

COMPRAS E ANÚNCIOS
• Cada pacote é uma compra única: comprou, é seu, e pode restaurar em outro aparelho.
• Existe a opção de levar todos os pacotes de uma vez.
• A versão grátis mostra anúncios apenas entre as partidas, nunca durante a montagem. Qualquer compra remove esses anúncios.
• Você também pode assistir a um anúncio para liberar uma imagem avulsa.

Funciona em iPhone e iPad.

name: enCoralBeaconHarbor
description:
CoralBeaconHarbor kutsuu lapset suunnittelemaan reittejä rauhallisella satamaseikkailulla.

Ohjaa pientä venettä selkeillä ylös-, alas-, vasemmalle- ja oikealle-painikkeilla pitkin merelle merkittyjä väyliä.

Kerää norsunluunvalkoinen majakanvalo, avaa tarvittaessa sillan portit, huomioi yksisuuntaiset virtaukset ja kuljeta valo turvallisesti jokaiseen määrättyyn poukamaan.

Ensimmäisissä satamissa harjoitellaan yksinkertaisia reittejä. Myöhemmillä matkoilla mukaan tulevat merivirrat, kytkimet ja tarkasti suunnitellut siirtomäärät.

Harjoitustyökalut kehittävät samoja taitoja monipuolisesti: kompassivihjeitä, valon kattavuuden laskemista, vuoroveden ajoituksen arviointia, reittien luonnostelua, avaruudellista hahmottamista testaavia tehtäviä, sanasto-osion ja matkapäiväkirjan.

Käyttömukavuuden asetuksissa voi valita suuremmat ohjauspainikkeet, selkeämmät kontrastit, ääneen luettavat vihjeet ja vähäisemmän liikkeen, jotta jokainen pieni merenkulkija voi keskittyä rauhassa ennakointiin ja ongelmanratkaisuun.

name: EngliGo
seller_name: ARB VIET NAM JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
EngliGo helps you learn English with explanations in your own language — Vietnamese, Indonesian, Thai, Khmer, Lao, Burmese, Chinese, Korean, Japanese or Russian.

PICK YOUR LANGUAGE
Choose your native language once and the whole app speaks it: menus, word meanings and tips.

FLASHCARDS THAT REMEMBER FOR YOU
Spaced repetition brings each word back right before you forget it. Study in three ways: flip cards, quiz, or listen & choose. A starter set is built in, and word decks from A1 to B2 (more than 7,000 words) download once and then work fully offline.

PRONUNCIATION PRACTICE, OFFLINE
Train your ear with minimal pairs chosen for speakers of your language — ship/sheep, light/right, think/sink and more. Hear each word at normal or slow speed, test your ear, then record yourself and compare.

A LITTLE EVERY DAY
Set a daily goal, keep your streak, and turn on a study reminder at the time you choose. Word of the day on the home screen, with one-tap listen, save and share.

THE FULL COURSE INSIDE
Open the complete engligo.com course from the Lessons tab: learning path, review, practice tests, grammar, a learner's dictionary and read-aloud practice. Sign in to keep your progress across devices.

Free to use. No ads. Delete your account at any time from the Me tab.

name: Entre Nous : Cartes à jaser
description:
Entre Nous transforme n'importe quelle soirée en vraie conversation.

Choisissez un numéro, la carte se retourne et révèle une question. Le joueur répond à voix haute, raconte, se dévoile… ou passe son tour. Pas de bonne ou de mauvaise réponse : seulement des histoires.

400 QUESTIONS QUI FONT JASER
Ton plus beau voyage. Ta pire job. Ta pire chicane. Le conseil que tu donnerais à toi-même il y a dix ans. Et, pour les adultes, des questions beaucoup plus osées.

DEUX MODES DE JEU
• 18+ : toutes les questions, y compris les plus coquines.
• Famille : les questions adultes sont retirées automatiquement dès qu'un joueur a moins de 18 ans.

SIMPLE ET ÉLÉGANT
• Entrez un numéro, la carte se retourne.
• « Sauter » passe à la question suivante.
• Une question déjà posée ne revient pas dans la même partie.
• « Nouvelle partie » remet tout à zéro.

TROIS LANGUES
Français, anglais et espagnol. Changez de langue en tout temps, même en pleine partie.

RESPECT DE LA VIE PRIVÉE
Aucune question ne demande de nom : chacun décide de ce qu'il raconte. Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucune donnée collectée. L'application fonctionne hors ligne.

Parfait pour les soupers entre amis, les soirées en couple, les voyages et les longues routes.

name: EOS Home Dekorasyon
description:
EOS Home Dekorasyon, ev dekorasyonu mağazaları ve toptan alım yapan bayiler için mobil katalog ve sipariş uygulamasıdır. Traverten, Murano camı, dekoratif saat ve aksesuar koleksiyonlarını inceleyin.

• Malzemeye ve koleksiyona göre ürün keşfedin.
• Seçki Masası’nda ürünleri bir araya getirin ve satın alma öncesinde karşılaştırın.
• Onaylı bayi hesabınızla fiyatları inceleyin, sepetinizi hazırlayın ve teslimat bilgilerinizi kontrol edin.
• Siparişlerinizi takip edin. Ürün kalemlerini, sevkiyat durumunu ve genel toplamı sipariş fişinde görün.

Kataloğu misafir olarak inceleyebilirsiniz. Bayi fiyatları ve toptan sipariş işlemleri için onaylı bayi hesabı gerekir.

name: Ephling: Breathwork & Calm
description:
Ephling is a voice-guided breathing app. Close your eyes: your guide can call you by name and your phone's gentle pulse carries your breath. No need to watch the screen.

FEEL YOUR BREATH
• Breathe by touch: a soft pulse that rises as you breathe in and fades as you breathe out.
• Six guides, each with their own voice and colour. If you like, yours greets you by name.
• A breath sound like an ocean wave, and music matched to every session.

START WHERE YOU ARE
• 38 moments: Stressed, Can't sleep, Angry, Overthinking, Low energy… a breath for the moment you're in.
• 98 breathing techniques: box breathing, 4-7-8, cyclic sighing, resonance breathing and more.
• 25 programmes and a 7-day journey to begin: a few minutes a day.

THERE FOR SLEEP
• Sleep sessions keep going with the screen locked. Pause and resume from the Lock Screen.
• When it ends it says "Sleep well", and leaves a quiet good-morning for the morning.

EPHLINGS
• Little glass friends who breathe with you. Air flows into their nose as they breathe in, and faint ripples leave their lips as they breathe out.

YOURS
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Your health data never leaves your device. If you like, sessions are added to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes.
• Your guide's voice downloads once, then works offline.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Moments are always free, and so are the first 3 days of the 7-day journey. Ephling Premium unlocks every technique, every programme and the whole journey.

Ephling Premium is a yearly or monthly subscription. The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Prices are shown in the App Store for your country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Ephling is a wellness app. It does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment or advice. If you have a health condition or are pregnant, talk to your doctor before starting breathing exercises. If you feel dizzy or unwell, stop and return to your normal breath.

Terms of Use: https://ephling.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://ephling.com/privacy

name: Eray Aydınlatma
seller_name: NIRVANA DIJITAL HIZMETLER VE YAZILIM ANONIM SIRKETI
description: Eray Aydınlatma Evinize ve yaşam alanlarınıza değer katan avize, lambader, LED aydınlatma ve dekoratif ürünleri keşfedin. En yeni tasarımları, avantajlı fiyatları ve özel kampanyaları Eray Aydınlatma güvencesiyle inceleyin. Hayalinizdeki aydınlatmaya kolayca ulaşın, alışverişin keyfini çıkarın!

name: Error Echo
description:
That gap looked bigger a second ago.

Error Echo is a fast, single-player precision runner. Tap to reverse direction, then keep tapping to thread tight gaps, dodge hazards, and time your next move. No swiping required.

Start with the free levels. A one-time Full Game purchase unlocks all 10 levels and the full range of modes, including Orb Hunt, Error Zero, and Infinity. Take on new challenges and try to beat your best.

No ads. Gameplay works offline. An internet connection is needed to buy or restore the Full Game upgrade.

name: Erynel
description:
Erynel is a quiet, offline companion for brewing better coffee at home. It brings together the four things that actually improve a cup — a reliable recipe, the right amounts, a steady pace, and honest notes on how it tasted — in one simple app that works without a connection or an account.
Eight classic brewing methods are built in, from V60, Chemex and flat-bottom pour-over to French Press, AeroPress, Espresso, Moka Pot and Cold Brew. Each recipe lists its ratio, water temperature, grind, total time, every timed stage, expected flavors and two practical barista tips.
