Search by name, family or flavor, filter by family, and heart the recipes you reach for most.

name: ESA – Agiza kutoka China
description:
ESA brings you goods from China at good prices, through group orders.

Pick products in the open sales window, pay with mobile money, and follow your order step by step — from purchase and the trip from China to its arrival in Tanzania.

• EASY ORDERING — choose colour, size and quantity, add to your cart.
• PAY BY PHONE — the payment prompt comes straight to your phone through Selcom.
• TRACK YOUR ORDER — see the stage of every parcel, with an SMS at each step.
• PAY SHIPPING — when goods arrive, pay shipping for one parcel or all of them with one prompt.
• COLLECT OR GET DELIVERY — collect at our office, or ask for delivery inside or outside Dar.
• HELP — send a support request with pictures and read our reply in the app.

Full guide in Swahili and English: esa.co.tz/docs

name: Escape: Attic Full of Cats
description:
Escape Game: Attic Full of Cats is a point-and-click escape game set in an old attic that is full of cats. Cats are sitting on the very things you need: on a trunk lid, in a yarn basket, on a trapdoor in the floor. Give a cat what it wants (dried fish, a toy...) and it moves to a new spot, revealing what was hiding underneath. Look closely at where a cat's eyes are pointing, its collar and its bowl to work out what it wants. The Storage Attic, the Sewing Room and the Cat Tower Room are all open from the start. Available in English, Japanese and Chinese (Traditional and Simplified); no login needed; free to play with ads (a one-time "Remove Ads" purchase, ¥300 in Japan).

THREE ROOMS
- Storage Attic - old boxes and bags piled up under the roof.
- Sewing Room - a sewing corner with a machine and baskets of yarn.
- Cat Tower Room - the cats' playground, with the way down to the stairs.

GIVE THE CATS A TREAT
- Hand a cat the right thing and it moves away, uncovering what it was sitting on
- Offer the wrong thing and nothing happens; you can never get stuck
- Each cat's looks and belongings are the clue

MORE PUZZLES
- Collect items and combine them
- Some objects are only decoys, so look closely before you choose
- Stuck? Tap the lightbulb for a hint (the last hint is unlocked by watching a video)

FEATURES
- Warm hand-drawn coloured-pencil illustrations
- Autosave: stop any time and pick up where you left off
- No login, no account
- Japanese, English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese

ADS AND PURCHASE
There is a banner at the bottom of the screen, an optional video ad if you choose to watch one for a hint, full-screen ads when entering or clearing a room, and an ad on the clear screen. A one-time "Remove Ads" in-app purchase turns off all ads.

Make the cats happy and find your way out of the attic.

name: Escrutinia
description:
Escrutinia es una iniciativa ciudadana independiente. No es una app oficial: no pertenece al Ministerio del Interior, a la Junta Electoral ni a ningún partido. El resultado oficial es el que publican las autoridades electorales.

El domingo 29 de noviembre, al terminar el escrutinio, cada mesa electoral cuelga en la puerta una copia del acta con sus resultados. Escrutinia reúne las fotos de esas actas que hace la gente, lee las cifras, las comprueba y las suma en un recuento paralelo, abierto y mesa a mesa.

CÓMO FUNCIONA
1. Adopta tu mesa: busca tu municipio y elige la mesa donde votas o que tienes cerca. La app te avisará el domingo por la tarde.
2. Fotografía el acta: al cerrar el colegio, haz una foto al acta de la puerta, del Congreso o del Senado. Un marco te ayuda a encuadrarla.
3. Revisa las cifras: Escrutinia las lee solo y te las enseña junto a la foto para que confirmes que están bien o corrijas lo que haga falta.
4. Listo: tu acta se suma al recuento y puedes seguir su estado en «Mis actas».

COMPROBACIONES
Cada acta pasa una serie de comprobaciones antes de sumar: que las cuentas cuadren, que la mesa exista, que los votantes no superen el censo, que la misma foto no se use para dos mesas y que no haya señales de una imagen retocada. Una mesa queda verificada cuando dos personas distintas suben actas que coinciden. Si algo no encaja, el acta no suma hasta que una persona la revisa.

PENSADA PARA EL DOMINGO
- Sin cobertura: la foto se guarda y se envía sola cuando vuelve la red.
- Sin cuenta: no pedimos correo, nombre ni teléfono.
- Guía del testigo con lo que conviene saber antes de ir a la mesa.
- Hasta las 20:00 del domingo puedes practicar: lo que subas antes no cuenta.

RESULTADOS ABIERTOS
Los resultados del recuento ciudadano se publican en escrutinia.grupooro.es, por mesa y sin datos personales.

PRIVACIDAD
Sin publicidad, sin rastreo y sin cuenta. La cámara y la galería solo se usan para la foto del acta. Política de privacidad: escrutinia.grupooro.es/privacidad

name: ESG Gap Analysis Workbook
description:
ESG Gap Analysis Workbook takes you through a full review of a company's sustainability report, step by step, and tells you how ready it is to publish.

It is built for sustainability analysts, ESG reporting teams, consultants and students who need to check a report against the main standards and explain the gaps clearly.

HOW IT WORKS
1 Extract: pull out what the report actually says (scope, emissions, targets, claims) with page references, before judging anything.
2 Standard checks: rate each requirement for ISSB (IFRS S1 and S2), GRI, TCFD and SBTi as Met, Partly met, Not met or N/A. The app works out an alignment score per standard and overall.
3 Claims test: put the report's boldest claims ("carbon neutral", "100% renewable", "net zero") through five tests: baseline, boundary, arithmetic, assurance and target. The risk verdict (low, medium or high) calculates itself, and you write the true, evidenced wording next to the original.
4 Materiality: test the materiality process, then check each expected topic for a KPI, a target, an SDG link and a Singapore Green Plan 2030 pillar, and flag topics that are missing.
5 Findings: one register for every gap, with severity, evidence, what is missing and the fix.
6 Roadmap: turn findings into actions sorted into quick wins, 6-12 months and longer-term, with an owner and a measure of success.
7 Summary: the alignment score, a suggested readiness rating, findings by severity, top findings and what to fix first, all pulled through from the earlier sheets.

Logs keep your evidence sources, any AI prompts you used and how you checked them, and the data you still need from the company. The Deck map links each sheet to the slide it feeds.

TRY IT IN ONE TAP
"Load sample company" fills every sheet with a worked review of a fictional cloud software company, so you can see what a finished analysis looks like before you start your own.

SHARE YOUR RESULTS
- Copy summary for slides: a ready-to-paste executive summary.
- Copy table for Excel: any table pastes straight into Excel or Google Sheets.
- Back up or restore: copy your work as backup text and paste it back on another device or for a teammate.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. Your work is saved only on your device. No ads, no analytics, no tracking, and nothing is uploaded.

The workbook is a structured review aid. It is not legal, audit or assurance advice and does not certify compliance with any standard. Standard names belong to their owners; the app is not affiliated with the IFRS Foundation, GRI, TCFD or SBTi.

name: eSIM Coupons
description:
eSIM coupons is the easiest way to compare eSIM prices and save on mobile data when you travel.

Designed for travelers, digital nomads, and frequent flyers, this app gives you instant access to the best deals from top eSIM providers. Instead of searching through multiple websites, you can explore updated prices, coupons, and exclusive offers all in one place.

Whether you are landing in Europe, exploring Asia, or traveling globally, eSIM coupons helps you choose the right plan quickly and at the best possible price.

What you can do with eSIM coupons:

• Compare worldwide, regional, and local eSIM plans
• Access verified discounts and promo codes
• Get instant activation through trusted eSIM partners
• Filter plans by country, data amount, and duration
• Suitable for business travel, tourism, backpacking, and remote work

Your next trip deserves effortless connectivity.

Save money. Stay online. Travel smarter with eSIM coupons.

name: Estebn
description:
Estebn is a simple, private log for your car's fuel and maintenance, in English and Arabic.

LOG IN SECONDS
• Fuel fill-ups with litres or gallons, amount and odometer, full or partial tank
• Oil changes, services and workshop name
• Insurance, car licence and driver licence with their expiry dates
• Tyres: fitting, rotation and replacement by position
• Several cars, each with its own records and odometer unit

KNOW YOUR REAL CONSUMPTION
• Fuel economy measured between full tanks, so partial fills are counted correctly
• Per-fill-up chart and an overall figure in L/100 km, km/L or mpg
• Monthly spending by car and by category, with a month-to-month comparison

NEVER MISS A DATE
• "Needs attention" on Home for oil changes, insurance and licences that are due soon
• Optional reminders on your iPhone before each due date

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account and no sign-up. Records are kept on your iPhone
• Optional automatic backup to your own iCloud, encrypted on your iPhone with a recovery code that only you hold
• Save a backup file or export a spreadsheet (CSV) whenever you like
• No ads, no tracking, and nothing is sent to us

ENGLISH AND ARABIC
• Full right-to-left Arabic layout, with Arabic-Indic digits
• Kilometres or miles, litres or gallons, and your currency

Reminders are suggestions based on the dates and readings you enter. Always follow your car maker's service schedule.

name: EV Crash Check
description:
EV Crash Check helps the owner of an electric car do a guided first assessment after a crash: answer hazard questions, photograph the damage from every angle, and get a preliminary pre-teardown report to take to your garage and insurer with evidence in hand.

Safety comes first
- Before any photos, the app asks hazard questions: smoke, unusual smells, leaking fluid, heat, or damaged orange cables.
- If there is a sign of danger, the app tells you to stop, keep away from the car and call a specialist.
- High-voltage warnings appear at every relevant step. The app never asks you to touch or disconnect a high-voltage part.

Guided photos
- A step-by-step photo guide, each angle with an example picture and a short note on where and how to shoot.
- Covers the whole car, the damaged areas, the plate, the VIN and the odometer.
- You can also add photos you already took from your photo library.
- Your original photos are never altered.

Read data from the car (optional)
- With an OBD adapter, the app can read fault codes and readings to add to the report.
- It is strictly read-only: the app never writes anything to the car and never clears fault codes.
- No adapter? The app works fine without one.

Preliminary report, before teardown
- Lists the visible damage and the places where hidden damage is suspected and needs a teardown to confirm.
- Gives the repair cost as a range, to compare with your garage quote.
- Clearly marks anything that was not checked, and never treats it as fine.

Your data
- No account and no login. Each case has its own private code.
- The "Delete case" button removes the case data from our server.
- Data is kept for 12 months after a case is closed, then deleted automatically. A case stopped because of a hazard is kept as evidence for the same period and cannot be deleted in the app.
- No ads, no selling of data, no tracking across other apps.
- Copies you send to a garage or insurer have faces and other cars' plates blurred.

Please note
- This is not an insurance appraisal and not a final repair price. Prices shown are a preliminary estimate before teardown.
- It is not a safety certification of the car or its battery. If the battery may be damaged, a certified high-voltage technician must inspect it.
- The result is not a decision by a garage, an insurer or the car maker.

Support: https://evcheck.donaus.com/support
Privacy policy: https://evcheck.donaus.com/privacy

name: Exact Size Photo Print
description:
Put a photo on paper at the exact size you need. Pick a photo, type the width and height in inches or centimeters, and Exact Size Photo Print makes a one-page US Letter or A4 PDF with the photo centered at that size. A 3 × 4 inch photo is placed as exactly 3 × 4 inches on the page.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick one photo with the system photo picker. No full library access needed.
• Type any width and height, or tap a common size such as 4 × 6, 5 × 7 or 8 × 10 in, or 10 × 15 cm.
• Switch between inches and centimeters at any time. The size you typed doesn't drift when you switch.
• Choose US Letter or A4, portrait or landscape.
• See the photo on the page right away, with the size labeled and the margins measured.

FIT OR CROP, NEVER STRETCHED
• Fit Entire Photo keeps the whole picture inside your size and tells you the real printed size when the photo's shape is different (a square photo in 3 × 4 in prints at 3 × 3 in).
• Fill & Crop covers your size exactly. The parts that will be cropped are shown dimmed, and you can drag the photo to choose what stays.

PRINT-READY PDF
• A real PDF page at the paper's exact dimensions, with the photo placed as an image (not a screenshot).
• Preview the actual PDF before you save or share it.
• Pixels per inch at your size is shown for information, with a gentle note if the print may look soft.
• A reminder appears when the photo is close to the paper edge, since printable margins vary by printer.
• Location and camera details from the photo aren't included in the PDF.
• Save to Files or share the PDF, then print it at Actual Size / 100% with fit-to-page scaling turned off.

The printed size depends on your printer and its settings. Print at Actual Size or 100%.

Selecting and previewing are always free, and your first export is free. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports. It isn't a subscription and never renews. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

Your photo is processed on your iPhone. There's no account and nothing is uploaded unless you choose to save or share the PDF.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/exact-size-photo-print/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/exact-size-photo-print/terms

name: Exam Saathi - JEE , NEET
description:
Exam Saathi – School ERP & Online Examination Platform
Exam Saathi brings your school's examinations and everyday school work into one app. Students take scheduled exams and follow their progress, teachers run exams and manage their classes, parents stay informed about their child, and school administrators oversee it all from their phone.
Exam Saathi is designed for schools using the Exam Saathi platform. Users can securely sign in with credentials provided by their school.
Online Examinations
Create question papers using smart or manual question selection.
Support for multiple-choice, numerical, matching and written questions.
Schedule online examinations with defined timing and duration.
Optional camera, microphone and tab-switch monitoring during examinations.
Monitor ongoing examinations and manage student participation.
Scan OMR answer sheets using a phone camera where enabled.
Support written answers in English, Gujarati and Hindi.
Results & Student Progress
View examination scores and detailed performance reports.
Track subject-wise and chapter-wise performance.
Access examination history and question-wise answer reviews.
Download student report cards in PDF format.
Practise difficult chapters and monitor learning progress.
School ERP Management
Attendance: Manage daily student attendance and view monthly records.
Homework: Assign, submit, review and evaluate homework.
Timetable: Access class schedules, periods and teacher timetables.
Circulars & Notices: Share important school announcements.
Polls: Conduct polls for students, parents and school staff.
Study Materials: Share notes, worksheets and educational resources.
Information Desk: Access school information and communicate with the school office.
For Students
Attend scheduled online examinations.
View examination results and academic performance.
Download report cards.
Track homework, attendance and class timetables.
Access notices and learning materials.
For Teachers
Create question papers and schedule examinations.
Monitor examinations and evaluate student performance.
Manage class attendance and homework.
Share educational resources.
Access teaching schedules and student progress reports.
For Parents
Monitor their child's academic progress.
View attendance records and examination results.
Track homework and upcoming examinations.
Receive school notices and circulars.
Communicate with teachers and school staff where enabled.
Manage information for multiple linked children.
For School Administrators
Manage students, teachers, classes and parent accounts.
Monitor school-wide examinations and academic results.
Manage access permissions for different school modules.
Oversee school activities through a centralized system.
Privacy & Security
Exam Saathi provides role-based access to school information, with separate databases for individual schools. Camera and microphone permissions are used for enabled examination monitoring features.
Feature availability may vary according to each school's configuration.
Developed by Trixon Tech Pvt Ltd.
For account-related assistance, please contact your school.
For other inquiries, contact: info@trixontech.io

name: EZ Fire Escapes
description:
EZ Fire Escapes is the work app of EZ Fire Escapes LLC, a New Jersey company that inspects, repairs and certifies fire escapes.

Our inspectors use it on site to:
• Photograph each fire escape with the in-app camera (full resolution, location-tagged, kept separate from the personal photo library)
• Write inspection reports with findings and repair options for every fire escape
• Create engineering inspection reports, with AI help that the inspector reviews and approves
• Issue fire escape certificates for New Jersey and New York
• Prepare quotes and invoices for building owners and email them with the PDF
• Find every report, certificate, quote and photo for a building in one search

Accounts are created by the company for its staff. There is no public sign-up.

name: Fabletide
description:
Fabletide is an interactive story studio for iPhone. Write tales in chapters and scenes, give every scene choices, watch the branches draw themselves on a story map, then play your story in an immersive candlelit reader and collect its endings.

Your stories sit on a shelf of illustrated covers. Swipe through them, filter drafts and finished tales, and open any one to step inside its story room.

STORIES, CHAPTERS AND SCENES
• Give each story a title, a logline, a genre, a cover palette and an illustrated cover motif.
• Add, rename, reorder and remove chapters. Scenes in a removed chapter move to a neighbouring chapter, so no writing is lost.
• Every scene has a title, its text, an illustration, the characters who appear in it and up to six choices.
• Mark any scene as an ending: good, bittersweet, twist, tragic or open.

CHOICES THAT BRANCH
• Point a choice at an existing scene, at a brand-new scene that is created when you save, or leave it unwritten and decide later.
• Deleting a scene leaves the choices that led to it unwritten rather than broken.

THE BRANCH MAP
• See your whole story as illustrated scene cards joined by curved arrows. Pan, pinch to zoom, and drag cards wherever you like.
• Auto-arrange by depth, fit the map to the screen, and use Link mode to draw a new branch by tapping one scene and then another.
• Unwritten choices show as glowing stubs with a "+" to write the scene they lead to.
• Story Health lists dangling choices, dead ends, unreachable scenes and a missing opening or ending, and jumps straight to the scene.

CHARACTERS
• Build a cast for each story with drawn crests, roles, up to eight traits and notes.
• Tag characters in scenes and see where each one appears.

THE READER
• Play your story on full-screen parchment pages with the scene illustration, chapter title cards and numbered choice buttons.
• Step back, change the text size, and see when a path has not been written yet.
• Reach an ending to earn a wax seal. Fabletide records the readthrough and tracks how many endings you have discovered.

SHARE YOUR SCRIPT
• Export any story as a readable plain-text script, with its cast, chapters, numbered scenes, choices and endings, and send it with the share sheet.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up and no login. Fabletide opens straight to your shelf.
• Everything is saved on your iPhone first and works fully offline.
• Your stories are also backed up privately to the cloud, tied only to this installation of the app. A small candle shows the backup state at a glance.
• Settings > Delete all my data erases your stories from this iPhone and from the cloud backup.
• No ads, no analytics and no tracking.

Want to look around first? Open Settings and tap "Load sample data" to add three original, fictional sample stories with maps, characters and endings. "Remove sample data" takes them away again.

name: Fabri - 3D Printing Workshop
description:
Fabri is a 3D printing workspace for designing practical parts, organizing STL models, and planning assemblies in 3D.

Build and assemble
• Design a part. Choose a cable clip, desk tray, or divider template. Describe the dimensions you need, use AI to suggest parameters, and fine-tune the part in a 3D preview.
• Arrange parts in 3D. Import STL files or add parts from the model library. Move, rotate, and scale each part in Assembly Studio, then save the layout or export the assembly as a single STL file.
• Keep your models together. Save your parts to a personal STL library so you can preview, export, or add them to an assembly later.

Learn and troubleshoot
• Explore illustrated tutorials on first prints, desk organizers, and fitting parts together. Browse part photos and assembly instructions for projects like a ripple clock or leaf-shaped coasters, or watch short project videos.
• Get help with a failed print. Describe the issue or attach a photo in the print advisor for AI-assisted troubleshooting and settings to try.
• Document your work in Maker Talk. Write a project update with a photo or video, browse printing topics, or reply to a discussion.

name: Face2Face: 2 Player Chess
description:
Face2Face is 2 player chess for two people sitting opposite each other, sharing one iPhone or iPad, just like a real board on the table between you.

Most chess apps are designed for one player, so in a pass-and-play game whoever sits on the far side sees every piece upside down, and you end up turning the device round every move. Face2Face fixes that. The pieces are drawn as if you were looking down on a real board from above, so they look right from both sides of the table. Neither player gets the "good side".

EVERYTHING FACES ITS PLAYER
Your name, clock, captured pieces and menu sit at your end of the screen, facing you. Draw offers, take-back requests and the result appear the right way up for each player.

PROPER CHESS RULES
• Only legal moves, and players always take turns
• Castling, en passant and promotion to any piece
• Check, checkmate and stalemate
• Automatic draws for threefold repetition, the fifty-move rule and not enough pieces to mate

A CHESS CLOCK THAT FITS YOUR GAME
• No clock, 1, 3+2, 5, 10, 15+10 or 30 minutes
• Your own time and increment, or different times for each player to even out a game between players of different strength
• Adjust either clock mid-game

11 FAMOUS TRAPS TO PLAY OUT TOGETHER
Act out classic chess traps like the Fishing Pole, Légal's Mate, Scholar's Mate and the Halosar Trap. An arrow shows every move, each player is told what to play, and at the end you see exactly how the trap worked.

MADE FOR THE TABLE
• Four boards: Classic green, Midnight purple, and Tournament green and Tournament purple with white v black pieces
• Three piece styles: top-down, classic and double-headed
• Tap or drag to move; legal moves are shown when you pick up a piece
• Wooden move sounds, a gentle haptic tap on each move and an animated promotion picker
• The screen stays on during a game
• Close the app and your game is saved, paused, ready to carry on

FREE TO PLAY, ONE-OFF UNLOCK
Play 3 games a day free on the Tournament green board, plus two free traps. A single one-off purchase unlocks unlimited games, all four boards, all 11 traps and every future feature. No subscription and no adverts.

Perfect for local two player chess with family and friends, chess clubs, classrooms and travel. Offline chess with no adverts, no accounts, no internet connection needed to play and no data collected.

name: FacetGrid: Spatial Block Game
description:
FacetGrid is a crisp, tactile 8x8 spatial block puzzle crafted for iPhone — zero ads, zero energy bars, and zero intrusive popups.

KEEPING THE CORE PURE, SHARPENING EVERY MOVE:
- Tactical Endless: Place polyomino triplets onto the 8x8 board, chain consecutive combo streaks with a visible 3-move fuse, and earn 90-degree Pivot Charges from multi-line clears.
- Hold Pocket Vault: Stash one tricky piece per wave into your Hold Pocket to set up devastating cross-clears and All-Clear sweeps.
- Pure-Color Prism Resonance: Complete any row or column in a single matching color hue for +50% Resonance points and an instant Pivot recharge.
- Pure Classic Mode: Traditional 8x8 block placement with zero tools or rotation for purist high-score chasing.
- Daily Seeded Gauntlet: Each calendar day brings one shared board layout and a deterministic piece sequence. Earn Bronze, Silver, or Gold, track your daily streak, and share an emoji board mosaic of your result.
- 18 Expedition Stages: Harvest Prism Gems, melt Frosted Ice, and crack armored Stone Cores across three handcrafted chapters.
- Kinetic or Zen Focus Mode: Switch between energetic shard bursts and harmonic pentatonic chimes or calm, minimal-motion Zen play — plus four tactile themes and optional colorblind facet glyphs.
- Home & Lock Screen Widgets: Preview today's seeded Daily board and jump straight into the challenge.

name: Farkle Table: Dice & Score
description:
Classic Farkle, two bots, pass and play and today's challenge are free for good. Five more rule sets, the other two bots and statistics are free for 14 days, then a one-time purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account.

Farkle Table is the dice game your family already plays, on a wooden table on your iPhone or iPad. Roll six dice, set aside the ones that score, then bank your points or push your luck. Play bots that tell you why they bank or roll, or pass the device around the table.

THE TABLE
• Six big dice that tumble onto the mat; tap a die to set it aside
• Roll says how many dice you throw, Bank shows the points you would keep, and the table says why when you can't bank yet
• Farkles, hot dice and the last round are called out on the table

YOUR FAMILY'S RULES
• Seven rule sets, from Classic to Big scores: three pairs, straights, four of a kind and more, each scored the way that table plays it
• Pick the target and whether everyone gets a last turn
• Classic and Quick to start; Traditional, Doubling, Adding, Opening 500 and Big scores with the Full Version

BOTS THAT TELL YOU WHY
• Mabel banks early, Otto plays the odds, Rex pushes his luck and Juno plays the scoreboard
• After every move, a bot says what it banked and how often rolling on would have farkled
• Bots wear a BOT tag, and they see only the dice on the table, as you do

PASS AND PLAY
• Up to eight people and bots at one table
• Each person's turn starts with their name, so nobody plays someone else's roll
• On iPad, the whole table is bigger

FAIR DICE YOU CAN CHECK
• Every roll comes from the game's code: enter a friend's code to play the same dice
• The summary shows each player's farkles against the expected number, and how lucky the dice were
• Today's challenge: ten turns with the same dice for everyone

MADE FOR EVERY PLAYER
• Dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver, with every roll read as a sentence
• Pips or numbers on the dice
• Sounds and haptics you can turn off
• Works offline; every game is saved after every roll

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPad or iPhone, and in your own iCloud or computer backups if you use them.

name: Fast Dealer Trade Driver
description:
Fast Dealer Trade Driver is the app for approved Fast Dealer Trade drivers. Fast Dealer Trade moves cars between dealerships in Orange County, California, for dealer-to-dealer trades.

- Get an alert the moment a run is booked, and accept it in one tap. The first driver to accept gets the run.
- Follow each run step by step: pickup, the swap at the partner dealership, and the return.
- Get directions in Apple Maps and call the right dealership contact with a tap.
- Take time-stamped condition photos at every handoff, and check each VIN by scanning the door-jamb barcode.
- See what you've earned this week and month, and when you'll be paid.

You need an approved Fast Dealer Trade driver account to use the app. Apply at fastdealertrade.com/drivers/apply.

name: FateCardas: Cardology & Astro
description:
FateCardas gives you a daily reading built from two traditions, read together: the ancient 52-card system of cardology and Western tropical astrology, with numerology alongside.

Enter your birth date and FateCardas works out your birth card, places it against today's real sky, and writes it up as a clear, grounded briefing. No birth time or place is needed to start. Your exact birth date is enough.

YOUR DAILY READING
- A short summary that ties today's sky to your cards
- Today's Sun sign and degree, the Moon's sign and phase with its percentage of illumination, the planetary ruler of the day, and how today's Sun relates to your natal Sun
- Daily, Monthly and Yearly views
- A reading that refreshes with the sky every day

YOUR CARDS
- Your birth card: in cardology, every day of the year is keyed to one playing card, and yours is fixed for life
- Your card of the day: your birth card woven with the universal card everyone shares today, so the result is personal to you and to today
- The tarot twin for each card, plus its traditional meaning
- Tap any card for its full story

YOUR NUMBERS AND YOUR CHART
- Your Life Path number, with the full calculation shown step by step
- A natal snapshot with a birth chart wheel showing the sky on the day you were born
- Your Sun sign at its exact degree
- Add your birth time and place (optional) to include your rising sign, Midheaven and whole-sign houses

COMPATIBILITY
Enter two birth dates to compare both people's Sun signs, birth cards and cards of the day, and see one real connection between your two charts.

THE KEY
A built-in reference that explains the terms your readings use: suits, numbers, numerology, signs, elements, planets, days, aspects, the Moon and houses, and the cards.

YOUR CHRISM CALENDAR
A monthly calendar that marks when the Moon passes through your Sun sign, with notes on the traditional practices for that window.

SHARE IT
Save your reading as an image to share with friends.

FREE ON IOS
FateCardas is free to use on iPhone and iPad. Optional Premium is available on the web at fatecardas.com for people who want a deeper daily synthesis, full natal story, full card correspondences, the complete Key library, unlimited compatibility, reading history, and exploring other dates.

HOW IT IS MADE
Solar and lunar positions are calculated with established astronomical formulas, and birth cards follow the traditional 52-card date chart. Every reading states the positions and cards it is based on, so you can check the details yourself. The written summaries are generated from those calculations.

Available in English and Spanish.

FateCardas is meant for reflection, self-understanding and enjoyment. It does not predict the future, and it is not a substitute for professional medical, legal, financial or psychological advice.

Questions or feedback? Write to support@fatecardas.com
Privacy policy: https://fatecardas.com/privacy

name: Feather - Video Compressor
description:
Make large videos easier to save, send, and share.

Feather Video Compressor helps you reduce video file sizes right on your device. Choose a ready-made preset or set a custom target size, then compress your video without uploading it.

• Choose a compression preset or enter a custom target size
• Trim your video before compressing
• Compare the original and compressed video and file sizes
• Save to Photos or Files, or share with another app
• Find previous exports in your compression history

Try three exports for free. Unlock unlimited compression with a one-time purchase of $1.99.

name: Feather Fence
description:
Birds are raiding the field! Guide the cat across the soil and build wooden fences. Reach the grass again and every area without a bird turns into green garden. Fill enough of the field to pass the level.

But watch out: if a bird touches your fence before it's finished, you lose a life.

• Simple controls: just swipe (arrow buttons optional)
• 30 levels with up to 3 stars each, on Easy, Normal and Hard
• Rocks, trees, a speedy blue bird and a sparrow that walks on the grass
• Adjustable bird speed: slow, normal or fast
• No ads, no accounts, no internet needed
• Plays in English and Turkish

name: FeederCount: Backyard Birds
description:
Keep a field notebook for the birds you see at a backyard feeder. During a watch, record how many birds of one species are visible together. FeederCount keeps the largest group for each species separate from the number of observations, so later visits do not inflate a flock peak.

Use a starter list or add your own species. Record your place and notes, undo a mistaken count, and add a completed watch to your history. Compare a species across watches and share the underlying observations as CSV. Start with a clearly labeled sample notebook.

The app works offline and needs no camera, account or location access. All observations are entered by hand.

name: FeedOut
description:
FeedOut collects the sites you follow into one feed, scores every story and turns the best ones into original, ready-to-publish articles with AI.

• Reader: all your sources on one fast screen with cover images.
• Curated library: add hand-picked sources for tech, business, sports and more in one tap.
• Content groups: set topic, tone and language — FeedOut prepares new articles for you every day.
• My articles: edit, translate and export to Word or Markdown.
• Publish: send straight to WordPress, Telegram, Bluesky, Mastodon and more.
• Notifications: know when your content is ready.

Turkish and English interface. New accounts start with a short trial and starter credits. There are no in-app purchases.

name: Felt Post
description:
Felt Post keeps one mould and its felts on this iPhone.

Dip an empty mould and water enters. Shake while the water is still in and the sheet forms. Couch that sheet onto an empty felt. The sheet lands and the mould is empty again.

Couch before the sheet is formed and the sheet stays on the mould. Couch onto a felt that already holds a sheet and both stay as they are. A couched sheet stays on its felt. Share sends the mould name and the felt name. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Feltshot--Plan each shot
description:
Värikkäät helmet saapuvat lähtöalueelle, joka koostuu jousista, liukuvista esteistä ja kallistuvista tasoista.

Valitse oikea kulma ja säädä kaikki mekanismit ennen heittoa. Kun helmi lähtee liikkeelle, sen reitti on ennalta määrätty, ja sen on päädyttävä samanväriseen kohderuutuun.

Viisi rataa esittelee pelialueen osat yksi kerrallaan. Helmien opas kertoo eri osien toiminnasta, harjoittelupöytä näyttää koko kulkureitin ja päiväkirja tallentaa heitot laitteellesi.

Peli ei vaadi käyttäjätiliä. Äänet kuuluvat vain silloin, kun napautat, vaihdat sivua, käynnistät heiton tai saat sen päätökseen.

name: Feltwise
description:
Feltwise builds the math you need at a poker table: outs, pot odds, equity, combinations, bet sizing, and stack-to-pot ratio.

Each day you get a short adaptive session weighted toward topics you miss. Questions use real hole cards and board textures—flush draws, open-enders, pot raises, and combo blockers—not abstract drills.

Idag shows today’s focus hand, lets you filter flop or turn spots, and tracks the last fourteen days. Ämnen maps all ten topics with formulas and six worked examples. Svagheter surfaces what you miscalculate once there is enough data.

Lock an answer to see the correct line and the arithmetic behind it. Swedish interface. Educational probability practice.

name: Fenzit
description:
Fenzit is the work app for field service teams. Assign jobs, track attendance, and manage leave in one place — so every record stays trusted across your team.

FOR OWNERS AND SUPERVISORS
• Create jobs in seconds — pick the customer, skill and technician
• Track every job from scheduled to done, with workflow steps, notes and photos from the field
• Attendance check-ins with an office geofence, late markers and worked hours
• Approve leave in one tap — including on behalf of others
• Keep customer records with sites and full job history

FOR TECHNICIANS
• See a clear list of today's jobs — what, where and for whom
• Step each job through its workflow with site photos and notes
• Check in and out at the office or customer site; location is read only when you check in
• Apply for leave and get responses in the app

SIMPLE, AND MADE FOR FIELD TEAMS
• Sign in with your phone number and a one-time code — no passwords
• Works on the iPhone you already have
• Each company's data stays separate and private
• Photos and signatures stay private, shared only through links that expire

Every team gets 90 days free to try Fenzit.

Privacy policy: https://fenzit.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://fenzit.com/terms
Support: hello@fenzit.com

name: Fernmere: Cozy Farm & Village
description:
Fernmere is a cozy farming life sim you can play completely offline, with no WiFi needed. Sixty years ago the village of Fernmere vanished beneath a reservoir. Now the dam is coming down, the lake is falling, and the valley is waking up.

Move to Highfold Farm with your Gran, who grew up here before the flood. Plant your first radishes, watch the water drop one Lowering at a time, and help a lost village come back to life.

FARM LIFE THROUGH THE SEASONS
• Grow thirty crops and an orchard of fruit trees
• Harvest, cook at Gran's stove and sell at the market
• Craft sprinklers, beehives and fish ponds
• Chickens, cows, and a dog or cat of your own

REBUILD A LOST VILLAGE
• Restore the hall, the bakery, the chapel and twelve cottages
• Welcome families home on the Sunday train
• Run the village inn and earn its stars
• Make your farmhouse yours, room by room

DIG UP MEMORIES
• Mudlark on the old lake bed for one-of-a-kind finds
• Show each one to Gran and hear the story she remembers
• Fill the Memory Book and the village museum

FRIENDS, ROMANCE, FESTIVALS AND FISHING
• Befriend more than thirty villagers, and fall in love if you like
• Five seasonal festivals through the year
• Catch 36 kinds of fish, including four legends
• Fill your nature journal with birds, insects, wildflowers and stars
• Explore 25 calm floors of the old quarry (no monsters, ever)

RELAXING BY DESIGN
• No fail states, no combat and nothing that withers while you're away
• Play offline anywhere, no WiFi needed, with no account, no ads and no in-app purchases
• One-thumb controls, text size, left-handed mode and high contrast

Fernmere is waiting for you to come home.

name: FerroGo: Stud & Metal Finder
description:
FerroGo turns your phone's compass sensor into a stud, metal and magnet finder, and is honest about what that can do. No adverts, no account, no tracking, and it works without an internet connection.

WHAT IT FINDS
• Screws and nails, so you can find the wooden studs and joists they're fixed into
• Steel studs, iron and steel pipes, and rebar close to the surface
• Magnets, and steel things lost close by
It can't find gold, silver, copper, aluminium, wood or live wires, and no phone app can. Expect a few centimetres of range, and check with a proper detector before drilling near cables or pipes.

A DETECTOR THAT DOESN'T JUMP ABOUT
• Shows the change from a zero point, so a reading means the same in every room
• Uses field strength, not direction, so tilting the phone doesn't set it off
• "Getting closer", "Strongest here" and "Passed it" tell you where the screw is
• Geiger clicks or rising beeps, plus vibration
• Four sensitivities, a 10-second graph, and µT, mG or gauss

WALL SCAN
• Zero on a bare patch, slide along the wall, and every screw is numbered on a trace with a buzz
• Save scans with a label and look at them again later

MAGNET POLE FINDER
• Tells you which pole of a magnet faces the phone, how strong it is, and the change in each direction

FIND MY SENSOR AND PHONE CHECK
• Every phone keeps its sensor somewhere different. Find yours in seconds with a key, and FerroGo marks the spot
• Phone check tells you whether your phone's sensor works, how steady it is, and whether a magnetic case is spoiling it

KEEP WHAT YOU FIND
• Save readings, scans and magnets with labels and notes, and export them to a spreadsheet (CSV)
• Light, dark and high-contrast Sunlight themes. Works with VoiceOver and larger text

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
FerroGo has no account and no adverts. Everything stays on your phone and in your phone's own backup. You can also save a backup file wherever you like, protected with a password if you choose.

FerroGo helps you find likely spots. It isn't a safety device.

name: Ferry Messenger: Calm DMs
description:
Ferry Messenger is a calm place for your Instagram direct messages, and only them. No feed, no stories, no reels, no ads: you open it, read and answer your chats, and close it.

• Several accounts at once, each with its own colour, so you always know who you're writing as.
• Chats, photos, videos, voice messages, GIFs, shared posts and reels, replies and reactions.
• Requests from people you don't follow wait in Requests until you accept or delete them.
• Archive chats and mark them unread, on your iPhone.
• Private by design: you log in on Instagram's own page, your session stays in your iPhone's Keychain, and the app sends nothing to its developer. No analytics, no tracking.

Good to know: there are no notifications; new messages arrive while the app is open. End-to-end encrypted chats can't be shown.

Ferry Messenger is free and open source (AGPL-3.0). It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Instagram or Meta.

name: Feuture
seller_name: Far East Organization Centre Pte Ltd
description:
Feuture. Built for What's Next.

Feuture brings teams, tasks and assets together in one smart platform to keep buildings and equipment running smoothly.

Feuture Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) manages maintenance from the first fault report to the finished job.

Key Features of Feuture CMMS
• Work at a glance
The dashboard shows pending approvals, work orders and assets right after sign-in. Widgets can be adjusted to show what matters most.

• Public fault reporting by QR code
Anyone can scan a QR code to report a fault, with no account or app needed. Reports can be sent anonymously and go straight to the maintenance team.

• Track every job to the finish
Search and filter work orders, check their status, and see who each job is assigned to.

• Smart assignment, done automatically
Jobs go to the right person, matched by location, skills, workload and roster.

• A complete asset register
One central register for all equipment and assets, with each asset's status and full maintenance history. Add assets one by one, or import a whole list at once.

• Plan maintenance ahead
Set up maintenance schedules, see active and inactive plans, and view upcoming work on the work order calendar.

• Reports and insights
Clear reports and useful insights show how maintenance is performing.

Who it is for
Facility managers, building owners, maintenance teams and technicians who want a simpler way to run day-to-day maintenance.
Visit https://www.feuture.com/ for more information.

Privacy policy: https://www.feuture.com/en/personal-data-protection-policy

name: FH Aufnahmetest Österreich
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer Fachhochschule, Universität oder Pädagogischen Hochschule.

An Fachhochschulen in Österreich musst du vor Studienbeginn immer ein Aufnahmeverfahren bestehen, für bestimmte Studien an Universitäten ebenso. Mit FH Aufnahmetest Österreich bereitest du dich gezielt auf den schriftlichen Aufnahmetest vor und trainierst die Bereiche, die dort typischerweise geprüft werden.

Das trainierst du in der App:
- Logisches Denken: Zahlenreihen, Wortbeziehungen und Matrizen
- Mathematik und Grundrechenarten
- Sprache, Textverständnis und Englisch
- Merkfähigkeit
- Fachwissen je nach Studienrichtung, zum Beispiel Biologie, Chemie, Medizin, Informatik und Soziale Arbeit

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- Hochschule Campus Wien (früher FH Campus Wien)
- FH Joanneum
- FH Technikum Wien
- Studierfähigkeitstest Österreich
- Aufnahmetest Psychologie
- Lehramt in Österreich
- Wirtschaftsuniversität Wien
- Veterinärmedizin

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Testbereichen
- Tausende Übungsaufgaben mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du schon sicher bist und wo du nacharbeiten solltest
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Aufnahmetest
- Eine Community mit anderen Studieninteressierten

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs für deine Hochschule schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo. Jeder weitere Kurs kostet dich danach weniger.

Offizielle Informationen zu Zulassung und Aufnahmeverfahren findest du auf Studienwahl.at, dem Portal des österreichischen Wissenschaftsministeriums: https://www.studienwahl.at/Content.Node/voraussetzung_und_fristen.de.php

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: Fierce Stormtails
description:
Fierce Stormtails brings together three distinct action challenges in a single jungle-themed collection designed for quick sessions and long-term replayability.

In Storm Archer, you face off against a rival in turn-based bow duels. Drag back to set your aim angle and shot power, then release. Wind direction shifts between rounds, forcing you to adapt. Land a headshot for double damage, or grab a floating orb mid-duel to restore health. Twelve increasingly difficult opponents test your precision across varied weather — sun, clouds, sunset, and rain each change visibility and wind behaviour.

Jungle Striker puts a ball at your fingertip. Draw a curved path through the pitch, threading past defenders and a moving keeper to reach the net. Collect gold tokens along the way for bonus points. The fewer attempts you need, the higher your star rating.

Thunder Karts drops you into a sixty-second top-down arena race. Steer by touching the screen, pick up crates to load storm bolts, and fire them at rival karts to score points. Obstacles, tight corners, and aggressive bots keep every lap unpredictable. Finish in the top three to earn stars.

Every game features twelve hand-tuned levels, a three-star rating system, personal best tracking, and procedurally generated music and sound effects that give each session a fresh feel. Progress, stats, and records are saved locally so you can pick up right where you left off.

name: FifteenTenFive – HST Planner
description:
FifteenTenFive plans, runs and logs Hypertrophy-Specific Training (HST) cycles. Give it your 15, 10 and 5 rep maxes and it works out every set of every workout: two weeks each of 15s, 10s and 5s, a final block, then Strategic Deconditioning.

PLANNED FOR YOU
• Loads worked back from your rep maxes, rising a little every workout and rounded to the plates you own.
• Full-body, upper/lower and other templates, or your own routine from 45 built-in exercises. Kg or lb.
• Checks for common mistakes, such as loads that start too light, blocks that start too far below the last (zig-zag) and rep maxes that don't fit together, each with a one-tap fix.
• Change any planned workout by hand; recalculating keeps your edits.
• No rep maxes yet? Estimate them from any set, or run a test week.

MADE FOR THE GYM FLOOR
• Big numbers and plus and minus buttons, so logging a set takes a tap or two.
• A rest timer with a notification, warm-up sets, a plate calculator and form cues.
• Shift the plan when life gets in the way, swap an exercise, or end a cycle early.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• A calendar of sessions, load and estimated 1RM charts, rep max history and weekly volume.
• Bodyweight and measurements, weekly check-ins, and a summary after each cycle with suggested new rep maxes.

LEARN AS YOU GO
Short articles explain mechanical load, frequency, progressive load, deconditioning, zig-zag, negatives, warm-ups, recovery, nutrition and safety.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your training log stays on your iPhone and is included in its own backup. You can also save a backup file anywhere, such as iCloud Drive, and restore it on any phone.

FifteenTenFive gives general training information, not medical advice. Check with a doctor before starting a new programme. FifteenTenFive is an independent app and isn't affiliated with the creators of HST.

name: Fihirana Advantista
description:
Ny hira 800 ao amin'ny Fihirana Advantista, ao anaty findainao. Vakio, henoy ary zarao ny hira fiderana an'Andriamanitra, na any am-piangonana, na any an-trano, na an-dalana. Ao anatin'ny fampiharana avokoa ny tononkira rehetra, ka tsy mila Internet ianao hamakiana azy.

TONONKIRA MAZAVA
• Ny hira 800 rehetra, misy ny andininy sy ny fiverenany voalamina tsara
• Ny mpanoratra ny tononkira sy ny mpamorona ny mozika, ary ny feo fototra sy ny refy
• Haben'ny soratra azo ovaina, ary tononkira ankavia, afovoany na ankavanana
• Endrika mazava na maizina, loko maromaro ho an'ny pejy, ary taratasy sepia malefaka amin'ny maso
• Tsy maty ny efijery mandritra ny famakiana

HENOY NY HIRA
• Henoy ny feon'ny hira, miaraka amin'ny tononkira eo imasonao
• Ampidino ny feo mba hihainoana azy na dia tsy misy Internet aza: hira iray, ny hira tianao, na ny rehetra
• Averina ihany ny hira iray raha te hianatra azy ianao

HITANAO AVY HATRANY
• Fikarohana amin'ny laharana, ny lohateny na ny tenin'ny tononkira
• Laharan'ny hira: ampidiro ny laharana dia misokatra avy hatrany ilay hira
• Lohahevitra 12 sy zana-tsokajy maro: Salamo, Andriamanitra, Jesosy Kristy, Fanahy Masina, Ny Fiangonana, sy ny maro hafa
• Ny mpanoratra sy ny mpamoron-kira rehetra, miaraka amin'ny hira nataon'izy ireo
• Hira kisendrasendra, raha te hahita hira vaovao ianao

HO AN'NY FIANGONANA
• Fampisehoana: andininy tsirairay, soratra lehibe, azo aseho amin'ny écran lehibe
• Ambadika maro hisafidianana ho an'ny famakiana sy ny fampisehoana

ZARAO NY HIRA
• Zarao ho sary ny hira iray manontolo na ny andininy tsirairay
• Endrika ho an'ny Status, efamira na lava, miaraka amin'ny ambadika tianao na sary avy amin'ny findainao

ISAN'ANDRO
• Hira androany: hira iray isan'andro eo amin'ny fandraisana
• Ny hira vao novakiana sy ny hira tianao, mba hahitanao azy haingana indray

TSOTRA SY MANAJA NY FIAINANA MANOKANA
Tsy mila kaonty, tsy misy dokam-barotra, ary tsy angonina ny mombamomba anao. Azo ampiasaina amin'ny teny malagasy, frantsay na anglisy ny fampiharana.

Ho voninahitr'Andriamanitra anie ny hira rehetra!

name: Fillnote
description: Fillnote is a cylinder notebook for propane, butane, or MAP gas you keep at home. Each cylinder has a label, a gas word, a kilogram size, a percent you estimate, a place, and the date you last filled it. A bar shows that percent. Low means 20 percent or less. Fills are dated notes of a refill and do not change the percent by themselves. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Find Objects-Tidy up the room
seller_name: Hong Kong sea bird technology co., limited
description:
How much of the room can you tidy before time runs out? Start with the picture list. Scan the clutter for hidden objects, tap what you spot, and watch matching items drop into their boxes. Each find clears a little room to see what’s underneath.

There’s a puzzle in deciding what to pick up next. Something in the way? Set it aside on the tray. It’ll move into a box when it’s needed, but space is tight. Keep a slot free, and use a hint when that last item has you stumped.

name: Find.kz
description:
FIND — объявления о запчастях для автомобилей и телефонов в Казахстане.

КУПЛЮ
Не нашли нужную деталь? Опишите, что ищете: марку, модель, состояние, бюджет. Запрос увидят продавцы и разборки и напишут вам в WhatsApp.

ПРОДАМ
Продаёте запчасть? Добавьте фото, цену и пару слов — объявление сразу появится в ленте.

ДВА РАЗДЕЛА
• Авто запчасти — с фильтром по марке автомобиля.
• Запчасти для телефонов — дисплеи, аккумуляторы, камеры, корпуса и другое.

УДОБНО
• Поиск по ленте.
• Связь в один клик через WhatsApp — без посредников и комиссий.
• Объявления вашего города.
• Отметка «Продано» / «Найдено», редактирование и удаление своих объявлений.

БЕЗОПАСНО
На любое объявление можно пожаловаться, любого пользователя — заблокировать. Модераторы проверяют жалобы в течение 24 часов.

FIND не участвует в сделках и не принимает оплату: вы договариваетесь с продавцом напрямую.

Сделано by Azat Idrissov

name: Findly: Nearby in One Tap
description:
On the road, there's always the same thing missing - you urgently need a restroom, a cafe, a gas station, or a pharmacy, and opening Maps and typing a search every time is friction you don't need. Findly removes that extra step: one tap on a category icon, and Google Maps is already open with results nearby.

ONE TAP INSTEAD OF TYPING
No database of places of its own that will always go stale somewhere or miss your city. Findly is a smart launcher on top of Google Maps: tap a category, the app takes your location and instantly opens a nearby search. Up-to-date data, directions, photos, reviews - Google Maps itself already does all of that, better than anyone.

CAN'T FIND THE RIGHT BUTTON? TYPE YOUR OWN SEARCH
A "Custom search" button right on the home screen - type anything you need (e.g. a vet clinic, a laundromat), and Findly opens a nearby search for it in Google Maps, exactly like the ready-made categories.

ON FOOT OR BY CAR - DIFFERENT NEEDS, DIFFERENT BUTTONS
One tap switches the whole set of categories to match your situation, and the app remembers your last choice - no need to switch the mode again every time you open it:
- On foot/hiking - drinking water, hostels, museums, beaches, markets, parks, nature reserves, castles & palaces, bike rental, transit stops, luggage storage
- By car - gas stations, EV charging, car repair, tire shops, parking, hotels, campgrounds, scenic viewpoints with parking
- Always handy - cafes, restaurants, pharmacies, ATMs, restrooms, currency exchange, banks, cafes with Wi-Fi

In foot mode, Findly also hints Google Maps toward a tighter search radius - roughly a 15-20 minute walk, not the whole district.

4 COLOR THEMES
Night, Day, Olive, Steel - pick whichever is easiest on your eyes, day or night.

WORKS ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD
Findly isn't tied to any single country or city - it works everywhere Google Maps does. The interface comes in 8 languages: English, Deutsch, Italiano, Français, Español, Polski, Українська, Русский.

7 DAYS FREE
Try everything in Findly free for 7 days. After that, one single purchase unlocks it forever - no subscription, no recurring charges.

MINIMAL DATA
No database of its own, no account, no ads. Your location is used only the moment you tap a button, to pass it on to Google Maps - and it's never stored anywhere else.

Findly is simply the tap you'd have made in Google Maps anyway - just without the extra typing and the lost time.

name: Firecloud Mobi V2
description:
Firecloud Time Attendance helps employees and managers track work time, shifts, and tasks from their phone.

Clock in and out quickly, confirm attendance with facial recognition, and keep records linked to where work happened. Managers can oversee their team, clock people in or out, and review activity in one place.

FEATURES
• Clock in / out with a clear view of hours worked against your shift
• Facial recognition for secure attendance verification
• Manager tools to clock individuals or multiple team members
• Shift overview for you and your team
• Activity history with searchable clock records
• GPS location capture for clock events, with map view for managers
• Task list with start/complete flow and photo evidence
• Offline clocking that syncs when you’re back online
• Push reminders for clocking
• Face ID / fingerprint unlock after first login

WHO IT’S FOR
Employees and managers using Firecloud Time Attendance through their company.

SIGN IN
Use the Employee Number and ID Number provided by your employer. There is no self-registration.

Firecloud  Time Attendance made simple.

name: Fisher's Horizon
description:
Start with a borrowed fishing rod and a room above the net shed. See how far the sea can take you.

You've just arrived in Home Harbor. Follow the old fisherman's letter to the wooden pier, cast toward the shadows in the shallows, and sell your first catch at Mia's market. Earn the keys to the Old Gull and take your first delivery out to the Lighthouse.

PLAY THE OPENING CHAPTER FREE
- Meet Old Fisher, borrow his rod, catch and sell fish, and pass his three-species test to earn the Old Gull.
- Upgrade the Old Gull with Engine II, pick up the Sturdy Rod, and deliver Pip's parcel to Ines at the Lighthouse.
- Keep fishing, trading, and running Home Harbor–Lighthouse jobs offline with no time limit.

YOUR CAREER ROADMAP (UNLOCK FULL GAME — ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
Grow from a local angler to Master Captain of a cruise liner across 7 ports, 12 ships, and 4 seasons:
- Local Fisher: Earn the Old Gull and take your first deliveries.
- Trusted Skipper (Cargo License): Pass Pip's cargo trial and move up to the Bluefin (fish finder) or Workhorse (24-crate hold).
- Island Captain (Passenger License): Pass Tom's passenger trial, run smooth island crossings in the Island Hopper, or answer SOS calls in the Seagull tug.
- Ferry Captain (Ferry License): Complete Hilda's rainy crossing trial and run scheduled Coral Line and Volcano Line ferry timetables in the Coral Ferry or Island Queen.
- Ocean Captain (Tourism License): Pass Lani's whale-watching trial and lead Kai's sightseeing tours to Whale Point, Sunset Arch, and Volcano Bay in the Sunset, or fish the open ocean in the Explorer.
- Master Captain (Cruise License): Pass Kai's dress rehearsal, fund the Cruise Terminal, and plan multi-stop itineraries with Marisol aboard the Ocean Dream and the flagship Horizon—then return to the old pier for one more catch.

MAKE THE HARBOR YOUR OWN
- Fund 7 Home Harbor upgrades, from the Large Fish Market and Marina to the Hotel, Aquarium, and Festival Grounds.
- Discover 55 fish species and follow local clues to land 8 Legendary Fish for your Fish Book and Captain's House.
- Celebrate four seasonal festivals: Boat Day, Summer Festival, Fisher Bay's Big Catch Contest, and Lantern Night.

Make a fisher of your own across up to three save slots, steer comfortably with Dock Assist, and adjust text size or turn on Easy Hook for a longer hook window. Unlocking the full game is a single one-time purchase across all fisher slots, and your existing save continues right where you left off.

name: FitHabit - For You
description:
FitHabit is a weight-loss coach built around one simple daily habit: close three rings. Eat your planned meals, do a short home workout, and reach your step goal. No gym, no special ingredients, no account.

MEALS FROM WHAT YOU CAN BUY
Tell FitHabit where you live and tick the ingredients you can actually get. Every day it plans breakfast, lunch and dinner using only those ingredients, sized to your calorie and protein targets.
• Exact grams, plus simple portion guides like "about one palm" or "one fist"
• Step-by-step cooking instructions for every meal
• Swap any meal for another that fits the same calories
• Out of something today? Switch it off and today's meals update instantly
• Supports halal, no pork, no beef and vegetarian diets

TARGETS MADE FOR YOU
Enter your age, height, weight and goal. FitHabit calculates your BMI, daily calorie target and macros with a safe, steady deficit. Targets update automatically as you lose weight.

HOME WORKOUTS, NO EQUIPMENT
• Daily guided sessions matched to your fitness level
• Quick Burn: 8-minute sessions for busy or desk-heavy days
• Low-impact, knee-friendly mode
• Animated exercise guides, a clear countdown and voice cues
• Library of 37 bodyweight exercises with form tips

THREE RINGS, ONE STREAK
Workout, steps and meals: close all three to complete your day.
• Daily streak with streak freezes, so one bad day doesn't erase your progress
• Weekly goal: complete 5 of 7 days to earn a freeze
• Steps from Apple Health, or enter them yourself

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Weekly weigh-ins with a clear trend chart
• Current and best streak, meal adherence and a monthly history calendar
• Gentle reminders for workouts, meals, an evening check-in and desk breaks

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
FitHabit works without an internet connection. There is no account and no sign-up, and your data stays on your phone.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese.

FitHabit provides general guidance, not medical advice. It is intended for adults aged 18 and over. Consult a doctor before starting any weight-loss or exercise program, especially if you have a medical condition.

name: Flap Crate
description: Flap Crate is a packing list for the cartons you are moving from one room to the next. Name the destination room, then write a carton with its name, what is inside, and whether it is ordinary or fragile. Pull the flap down to close it. Drag the closed carton onto the truck bed to mark it loaded. The floor shows what is still open, each room lists its cartons, and the truck lists what is already loaded. Everything stays on this iPhone. There is no account, no shipment tracking, and no connection to a moving company.

name: Fleet-Watch
description:
Fleetwatch is the mobile command centre for electric fleets run with Transvolt. It puts the live alert queue, the fleet map and the breakdown board in the hands of the people who keep vehicles moving, so an over-speeding truck, a stalled bus or an overheating battery gets handled in minutes, not at the end of a shift.

LIVE ALERT QUEUE
• Over-speeding, route deviation, harsh braking, idling, overheating, GPS gaps and more, as they fire
• Critical first, with the vehicle, the site and how long ago it happened
• Push notifications for breakdowns, so nothing waits for someone to open the app

ACT ON EVERY ALERT
• Acknowledge, call the driver, mark attended, no answer, escalate or resolve, each with one tap
• The driver on duty and the vehicle's live speed, battery and coolant, right on the alert
• A full timeline of who did what, and when

FLEET MAP
• Every vehicle on the map, coloured by status: moving, idle, charging, down, off route or no signal
• Live counts at the top; tap one to narrow the map
• Browse every vehicle in a list and jump straight to it on the map

BREAKDOWNS
• Raise a breakdown in seconds, with the category and a note
• Track each one from open to acknowledged to resolved
• Resolved history with turnaround times

TRIPS AND HISTORY
• Recent trips with their milestones, and a replay of where the vehicle went
• A searchable log of every alert, by day, severity and type

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Works on iPhone and iPad
• Keeps working on a weak signal; queued actions send when you're back online
• Light and dark appearance

WHO USES FLEETWATCH
Fleetwatch is used by the operations, maintenance and control-room teams of the fleet operators, industrial clients and transport agencies that run electric fleets with Transvolt, by their outsourced field and maintenance partners, and by Transvolt's own teams. Each organisation sees only its own sites and vehicles. Accounts are issued by your organisation.

name: Flick - Local File Reader
description:
Flick is a private, local-first multimodal file reader and clip workspace for iPhone and iPad. Keep PDFs, Markdown notes, screenshots, code, and videos in one offline space: search a single phrase to jump straight to the matching page, screenshot text, or video timestamp, flip through active files like a deck of cards, and save exact moments to revisit anytime.

KEY FEATURES
• Cross-Format Full-Text & Screenshot OCR Search
  Search offline across Markdown, HTML, plain text, PDF text layers, text inside images (on-device Apple Vision OCR), and video captions. Tap any hit to jump right to the source—images automatically zoom and highlight the matched text region, and PDFs open directly to the matching page.
• Deck Switching & iPad Side-by-Side Split Reader
  Flick through active files in a tactile fan deck while keeping each file’s exact page, scroll position, crop, or playback timestamp intact. On iPad, open any two documents side by side with independent controls and reading positions.
• Clips 2.0: Save Exact Moments & Export Review Cards
  - Video & Audio: Mark custom A–B start and end points, toggle seamless A–B loop from a floating bar, and save multi-frame storyboard clips—built for courses, dance, music, and motion study.
  - PDF & Documents: Save selected PDF quotes or exact paragraphs, attach personal notes to any clip, and filter clips by Space.
  - Share & Export: Render crisp 1080 px editorial clip cards or export a structured Markdown review outline per Space.
• On-Device Offline Transcription
  Transcribe audio and video privately on your device (Auto, English, or Chinese) into a searchable timeline. Tap any line to jump playback, swipe to save a line as a clip, and find spoken words directly from global search.
• Custom Spaces & System Share Extension
  Organize related PDFs, notes, screenshots, and videos into custom Spaces. Open from Files, iCloud Drive, Photos, or send files directly via the iOS Share Sheet. Authorize companion folders in place to load relative Markdown/HTML images and stylesheets.

SUPPORTED FORMATS
• Video & Audio: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WEBM, MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV and more (AVKit + compatibility engine with playback speeds, PiP, embedded & external SRT/ASS/VTT subtitles)
• Documents & Web: PDF (outline, thumbnails, async search, password unlock), Markdown (offline rendering, syntax highlighting, tables, task lists, source view, print), HTML (offline static mode by default, optional local JS), RTF, Office / iWork via Quick Look
• Code & Large Text: Chunked indexing for 100 MB+ logs, line numbers, wrap toggle, go to line, cross-section search, UTF-8 / UTF-16 / GB18030 / Latin-1 encodings, Swift / JSON / JS / Python highlighting
• Images & Archives: JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, animated GIF/APNG, EXIF metadata, original resolution, ZIP browsing & on-demand extraction

100% LOCAL & PRIVATE
No account required, no ads, and no tracking. Reading, indexing, OCR, and speech transcription run locally on your device—your files never leave your hands.

FLICK PRO
All format viewing and core Deck switching are free with no ads. Upgrade to Flick Pro via an auto-renewing annual subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase to unlock unlimited Spaces and Clips, watermark-free poster cards, and advanced productivity features. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://getpocketlab.com/flick/privacy.html?lang=en
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Flota - Soferi
description:
Flota Șoferi este aplicația pentru șoferii firmelor de transport. Ai cursele, documentele și salariile la un singur loc, direct pe telefon.

CURSELE TALE
• Toate cursele într-o listă, cu filtre: Planificată, Confirmată, În curs, Finalizată
• Pentru fiecare cursă vezi locul și data de preluare și de predare, clientul și numărul de înmatriculare
• Ora estimată de sosire, calculată de la poziția ta
• Schimbi statusul cursei cu un simplu gest de glisare

CMR ȘI DOCUMENTE
• Vezi CMR-ul cursei imediat ce dispeceratul îl generează
• Atașezi poze sau fișiere PDF direct la cursă, de pe telefon

LOCAȚIE LIVE
• Cât timp ești pe cursă și aplicația e deschisă, locația ta este trimisă dispeceratului la fiecare 30 de secunde
• Vezi pe hartă poziția ta, locul de preluare și locul de predare
• Poți opri trimiterea locației oricând, cu un singur buton

SALARII
• Istoricul salariilor, lună de lună
• Detalii clare: brut, prime, avans, rețineri și net
• Deschizi fluturașul de salariu direct din aplicație

PROFIL ȘI SETĂRI
• Fișa ta de șofer, cu datele de contact și de angajare
• Temă luminoasă, întunecată sau după setarea telefonului
• Schimbi parola și ceri ajutor direct din aplicație

IMPORTANT
Aplicația este destinată șoferilor angajați ai firmelor care folosesc platforma Flota. Contul îți este creat de firma la care lucrezi. Dacă nu ai date de autentificare, contactează dispeceratul.

name: FMS Engine
description:
FMS Engine – Fleet Management System

FMS Engine merupakan aplikasi Fleet Management System yang dirancang untuk mendukung pengelolaan, pemeriksaan, dan pemantauan operasional armada kendaraan secara lebih efektif, terstruktur, dan terintegrasi.

Melalui FMS Engine, pengguna dapat mengakses berbagai fitur yang membantu pelaksanaan aktivitas operasional armada, mulai dari pemeriksaan kendaraan hingga pencatatan aktivitas operasional.

FITUR UTAMA

Vehicle Inspection Mendukung proses pemeriksaan kondisi kendaraan untuk membantu memastikan armada dalam kondisi layak operasional.
Fleet Management Membantu pengelolaan data dan informasi armada kendaraan dalam satu platform.
Operational Monitoring Mendukung pemantauan aktivitas operasional armada agar proses kerja lebih terorganisir.
Inspection Records Memudahkan pencatatan dan pengelolaan hasil pemeriksaan kendaraan sebagai dokumentasi operasional.
Operational Reporting Mendukung penyediaan informasi dan laporan aktivitas operasional armada.

MANFAAT PENGGUNAAN FMS ENGINE

Mempermudah proses pemeriksaan kendaraan.
Membantu meningkatkan efisiensi operasional armada.
Mendukung pencatatan aktivitas secara digital.
Memudahkan pengelolaan informasi kendaraan.
Mendukung proses monitoring dan evaluasi operasional.

OPTIMALKAN PENGELOLAAN ARMADA ANDA

Dengan FMS Engine, proses pemeriksaan dan pengelolaan operasional armada dapat dilakukan melalui satu aplikasi yang praktis dan terintegrasi.

Gunakan FMS Engine untuk mendukung operasional armada yang lebih efektif, tertata, dan terdokumentasi.

name: Focus Timer: Pomodoro & Study
description:
A clean Pomodoro timer for work and study. Set a focus block, take your breaks, and watch your day fill in. No ads, no account, and no free trial that turns into a charge.

THE TIMER
- Classic 25/5 Pomodoro, a longer 50/10 setup, or your own lengths
- Short and long breaks that follow on their own, or wait for you
- A count-up mode for open-ended work
- Alerts and sound when a block or break ends, even with the app closed
- Keep the screen awake while the timer runs

TASKS, GOAL AND STREAK
Add what you are working on and tick it off. Set a daily goal in focus blocks and watch the bricks fill in. Keep your streak going day after day.

STATS
Today, this week, your streak and the last 7 days, all free.

FOCUS PRO
- Strict mode: once a focus block starts, it cannot be paused or skipped
- Six focus sounds: brown, pink and white noise, rain, ocean and fireplace
- Every stat: 12-week heatmap, your best hours, week over week, time per task and label
- Labels for Work, Study, Reading or your own
- Pause or skip right from the notification
- 16 timer colors
Monthly, yearly, or a one-time lifetime price. Subscriptions renew until you cancel in Settings.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
No sign-in, no tracking. Export your history any time.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://plainworkgroups.duckdns.org/privacy/focus

name: FoldGauge
description:
Turn dimensions into a practical material estimate. Save separate projects with length, width and quantity, then include an allowance for cuts and waste.

Set a cost per square metre and your currency label to review estimated costs. Compare each project with your combined material totals. Search saved estimates, edit dimensions and share a summary. Dimensions use metres; estimates exclude installation and tax.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: Foldwise: Unfold Counter
description:
How often do you really open your iPhone Duo? Foldwise counts every unfold and shows you the patterns.

COUNTS FOR YOU
Set up two Shortcuts automations once, with Foldwise's step-by-step guide, and every time your phone opens or closes, it's counted, even when Foldwise is closed. While the app is open it also sees half-open, tent-style use. Pause counting any time in Settings.

SEE YOUR DAY
• Unfolds today, compared with the same time yesterday
• Your first and last unfold, time spent open and your longest session
• Unfolds by hour

FIND YOUR PATTERNS
• The last 7 days, 30 days or 12 months, with your daily average
• A heatmap of when you unfold, by weekday and hour
• Hinge wear: your lifetime unfolds against your phone's rated fold cycles. Had the phone a while? Add your earlier unfolds so the total starts from the right number.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN
Small, medium and large widgets with today's count, your all-time total and the last 7 days. Choose what the small one shows. Lock Screen widgets keep today's count a glance away.

ON YOUR WRIST
An Apple Watch app and complications with today's count, the last 7 days and all time, updated from your iPhone.

JUST ASK
"How many unfolds today?" Ask Siri, or use Foldwise's actions in your own shortcuts: unfolds today, in the last 7 days and in total.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your history stays on your phone, and you can export it as a CSV file or delete it at any time.

Requires an iPhone Duo with iOS 27.2 or later. On other iPhones, Foldwise shows a demo with a sample history.

name: FollowDeck
description:
FollowDeck is a deal-stage follow-up copilot for independent consultants, freelance creatives and solo advisors. It tracks where each client sits - proposal, quote, contract, delivery, invoice, payment - and reminds you of the next step, so nothing slips and no payment goes quiet.

WHY FOLLOWDECK
- See every deal by stage. Move a client from proposal to paid without juggling notes, mail and contacts.
- Know what needs you today. An overdue, today and upcoming board surfaces stalled quotes, pending proposals and unpaid invoices.
- Follow up at the right time. Stage-based default timing and reminders keep your nudge polite, not pushy.
- Log in seconds. Capture an interaction or a commitment in a few lines of text.
- Built into Apple. Works with Shortcuts, App Intents, home-screen and Lock Screen Widgets and Spotlight search.
- Private by design. Your client data stays on your device; no account required to start.

FOR WHO
Independent consultants, designers, writers, developers, marketers and solo advisors who handle 5-50 clients and keep losing follow-ups across apps.

HOW IT WORKS
Add a client, add the deal you are chasing and the stage it sits in. FollowDeck keeps a Today board of what is overdue, due today and coming up, and a pipeline board grouped by stage. Log a call, message or meeting against the client, and the record moves forward with its last-contact date. Snooze a follow-up to tomorrow, in three days or in a week when the timing is not right yet. Export your clients and follow-ups as CSV, or write a full JSON backup you can restore later on another device.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
FollowDeck does not send invoices, process payments, book meetings, run team seats or do accounting. It is the lightweight follow-up layer around the work you already do.

FREE VS PRO
- Free: up to 20 clients, manual reminders, today/overdue/upcoming board, interaction history, local JSON/CSV export, home-screen widget, Shortcuts / App Intents and Spotlight, plus stage-based next-step suggestions derived from your own records.
- Pro: unlimited clients, automated follow-up sequences, cross-device sync, message templates, advanced reports, and model-assisted draft suggestions. Pro is a monthly or annual subscription; pricing and any free trial are shown in the purchase sheet before you buy.

PRIVACY
Your client records stay on your device; the first build does not transmit them to a server. You can export or delete your data at any time. Privacy policy: https://lm203688.github.io/followdeck-site/privacy.html

name: For Men Store
description:
For Men Store es una tienda de ropa y calzado para hombre, con local en el Shopping Jardín, sobre la Avda. San Blas. Con esta app llevás el catálogo completo en el teléfono: cada prenda con sus fotos, sus talles y su precio, y el pedido listo en dos toques.

QUÉ VAS A ENCONTRAR

• Camisas: sociales, de mangas largas, de mangas cortas a rayas y de lino.
• Polos: clásicas, de tricot y de líneas, en varios colores.
• Remeras básicas de algodón.
• Jeans slim.
• Pantalones de vestir y sport de sarga.
• Bermudas de lino.
• Calzados: tenis y zapatenis de cuero y aldeanas.

LO QUE PODÉS HACER DESDE LA APP

• Ver el catálogo completo con fotos y precios en guaraníes.
• Elegir el talle de cada prenda antes de pedirla.
• Buscar por nombre o recorrer las categorías.
• Guardar tus favoritos para no volver a buscarlos.
• Armar el carrito y hacer tu pedido en minutos, con cuenta o sin ella.
• Elegir entre delivery por la zona, encomienda a otra ciudad o retiro en el local.
• Guardar tus direcciones de entrega.
• Ver tus pedidos y repetir una compra anterior sin volver a armarla.
• Escribirnos por WhatsApp desde la app.

CÓMO SE HACE EL PEDIDO

Armás el carrito, elegís cómo recibirlo y el pedido queda registrado. Después lo seguimos por WhatsApp para coordinar el pago y la entrega.

ENTREGAS Y ATENCIÓN

Delivery por la zona, encomienda a otras ciudades del país o retiro en nuestro local del Shopping Jardín, Avda. San Blas 252, km 1. Atención de lunes a sábado de 9 a 20 h y los domingos de 9 a 17 h.

Los precios están en guaraníes.

name: Forge Upset
description: Forge Upset is a forge log for one bar on this iPhone. Heat the end through black, red, orange, and yellow until it is white. Strike that white end and the length drops by one. Strike the middle and the bar bends while the length stays. A strike that is not white only leaves a scale mark. Quench locks the length, and later strikes do not shorten it.
