The last upset stays on the bar. Open the upset list or share the text you choose. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: FormulaQuay
description:
Build an atom ledger from the formulas you enter. FormulaQuay expands grouped symbols, counts each element and keeps a fixed-reference composition beside your original text.

INSPECT YOUR FORMULAS
Enter a title, an ASCII formula and optional notes. Inspect parentheses, element symbols and integer subscripts with concrete syntax feedback and a readable expansion tree. Save, search, edit, duplicate and reopen your formulas.

USE AN IDENTIFIED REFERENCE
Look up each element's atomic number and nominal reference weight from NIST SP 966 (June 2024). The app supports all 118 named symbols, with 84 numerical reference weights. The 34 parenthesized isotope mass numbers are excluded and remain unavailable, never zero. This compact table does not list individual uncertainties or element-specific footnotes. Element Detail provides the source, author acknowledgement and reuse information.

CHECK CONSERVATION
Specify the species on both sides of an equation. Obtain a unique minimum positive integer ratio when supported, then inspect a separate left/right atom ledger, the signed input matrix and bounded rational calculation trace. Equation species are copies; later formula edits do not rewrite them.

KEEP THE RESULT
Freeze an independent report containing the source copy, revision and reference/rule versions. Later source edits or deletion leave that snapshot intact. Generate actual CSV, JSON and paginated PDF files with source acknowledgement. See filenames, byte counts and hashes; preview a selected file or explicitly share it through the system sheet. Reports can be reopened later or deleted with confirmation.

SCOPE
Formulas support up to 120 ASCII characters, parentheses depth four, integer subscripts 1–999 and an expanded atom total of 1,000,000. Ions, isotopes, electrons, square brackets and hydrate-dot syntax are not supported. Equations accept 2–8 species and at most 12 elements. Only a unique, nonzero, all-positive solution with normalized integer coefficients no greater than 1,000,000 is accepted. No solution, extra freedom, mixed signs and checked integer overflow stop with an explanation.

Reference formula mass is nominal and approximate, without uncertainty propagation or isotope analysis. FormulaQuay checks the expressions you supply; it does not predict products, reaction feasibility, quantities, experimental conditions or laboratory procedures. Local tools require no account.

name: Founia
description:
Your base makeup can look great when first applied and completely different a few hours later. Founia helps you see what changed, where it changed, and what you may want to try next.
Start with photos of freshly applied makeup, then add matching photos after two, four, six, eight, or a custom number of hours. Line up both views for a clearer comparison and look closely at areas such as the forehead, nose, cheeks, under eyes, mouth, or chin.
Record the products, amounts, tools, and application steps you used. Mark visible changes like separation, oiliness, caking, powderiness, oxidation, patchiness, or emphasized pores. Add notes and choose one adjustment for your next comparison.
Over time, Founia brings repeated observations together so you can see which areas change most often and review results from consecutive comparisons. Instead of relying on memory or changing several things at once, you can make clearer, more deliberate choices about your base makeup routine.

name: FQ Lite
description: When organizing the accounts each month, you can first...FQ LiteVerify and record transaction amounts, then log any ad hoc income or expenses. The ledger separates fixed expenses, flexible expenses, and remaining balances, while items that have not yet occurred are kept in a "pending confirmation" list. Once budgets are set for specific categories, the system can identify the exact transaction that first exceeds a set limit. You can also reconcile account balances by comparing them against the closing figures on your statements, matching individual transactions one by one. At the end of the month, you can review spending trends over several consecutive months, trace original transactions by account or category, and compile your budget, income/expenditure data, and reconciliation results into a comprehensive monthly report.

name: Fractal: Mandelbrot Explorer
description:
The most famous picture in mathematics, to wander in with two fingers.

PINCH, DRAG, DIVE
The fractal fills the screen. Pinch to zoom, drag to move, double-tap to dive in. The picture is worked out on the graphics chip: a quick one at once, the fine one a moment later. Tap once and everything but the picture disappears.

EVERY POINT HAS A JULIA SET
Switch on Julia and a small map of the Mandelbrot set appears. Drag the dot across it and watch the Julia set change shape under your finger: dragons, rabbits, dust and whirlpools.

A TOUR OF FAMOUS PLACES
Seahorse Valley, Elephant Valley, the Little Twin on the needle, the Double Spiral, Douady's Rabbit and more to open with one tap. Keep places of your own with a name.

COLOURS AND RELIEF
Palettes are rings of colour: spread them, turn them, and see the same place anew. Switch on relief and light falls from the side, as if the picture were carved in stone.

SAVE A PICTURE
The picture is worked out again at the size of your screen, sharp to the last pixel, and handed to the share sheet: for a wallpaper, a message or a print.

FRACTAL PRO: A MILLION TIMES DEEPER
The free app zooms to ×20,000. Pro goes to ×100 billion: the app then counts with two numbers for each one, and the picture stays sharp where ordinary precision turns to blocks.

FRACTAL PRO: SIX MORE FAMILIES
Burning Ship, Tricorn, Cubic, Quartic, Celtic and Newton's fractal for the three cube roots of one, each with its own Julia sets (Newton has none).

FRACTAL PRO: PICTURES THAT MOVE
Let the colours flow through the picture on their own, and let a Julia set walk around the map by itself.

FRACTAL PRO: MORE OF EVERYTHING
Sixteen palettes instead of four. Pictures in 4K, upright, wide or square. The whole tour of more than thirty places, and as many places of your own as you like.

FREE
The Mandelbrot set and its Julia sets to ×20,000, four palettes, relief, seven places of the tour, three places of your own, and pictures at the size of your screen.

PRIVATE
No account. Your places stay on your iPhone; the app sends nothing to us.

Fractal Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you, and it turns into the paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

Privacy Policy: https://www.appgeolist.com/app/fractal-explorer/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Frame Cinema
description: Frame Cinema is an on-device film notebook and creative tool. Open it and start using it right away. No registration, login, or payment is required.

name: FrameLab: Lossless Exif Frames
description:
Turn your photography into exhibition-grade prints—at 100% original resolution.

  FrameLab automatically reads your photo's camera Exif metadata and pairs it with refined gallery borders. Engineered for photographers who refuse to pay $2.99/week or lose sharpness to cheap compression apps.

  KEY FEATURES
  • Automatic Exif Typography: Dynamically formats your real camera model, lens, focal length, aperture, shutter speed, and ISO in crisp monospaced layout.
  • 100% Lossless Full-Res Export: Preserves original resolution (including 48MP shots) and Display P3 wide color with zero quality degradation.
  • 10+ Curated Gallery Templates: Museum wide white, darkroom obsidian, frosted glass backdrop, film perforation, and editorial print layouts.
  • Fast Batch Framing: Apply your favorite frame and photographer signature to up to 20 shots in one seamless streaming export.
  • Privacy-First Photo Workflow: Uses Apple's system PhotosPicker and Add-Only save permission—never asks for full library access and never uploads a single photo. Optional GPS stripping before sharing.

  HONEST PRICING
  3 classic gallery frames with lossless export are free forever with zero watermarks. Unlock all 10+ templates, batch export, and custom presets with a single $5.99 one-time purchase.

  Privacy Policy: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/framelab/privacy.html
  Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
  Support: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/framelab/support.html

name: FrameRibbon
description:
FrameRibbon is a local GIF inspection and frame-extraction tool. See what an animation declares, inspect its composed display frames, and create a handoff that keeps original metadata separate from preview choices.

REVIEW AND CONFIRM AN ORIGINAL
Choose a GIF from Files, inspect its canvas, frame count and timing summary, enter a title and confirm import. The source is copied without editing or re-encoding your external file. An explicit practice action creates a labeled original 12-frame moving-dot GIF that still passes through import review and confirmation.

KEEP RAW TIME DISTINCT
GIF Overview and Timing Inspector preserve raw centisecond delays, including the difference between zero and a missing delay. Positive raw delays determine their declared duration. Missing or zero values use a labeled 100 ms fallback for preview only. If any delay is absent, the declared total stays Unknown instead of becoming an invented original duration. ImageIO timing observations remain separately identified.

INSPECT ACTUAL DISPLAY FRAMES
Preview decoded frame patches composed with canvas offsets, transparency, local palettes, interlacing and supported disposal behavior. Disposal 0 is kept for preview, 1 keeps the canvas, 2 restores the affected background and 3 restores the previous canvas. The disclosed background policy and system scheduling can differ from other players.

Use Play/Pause, Previous/Next, preview speed and repeat controls. These change the preview rather than source timing. Inspect a frame's patch rectangle, transparency index, interlace flag, disposal and delay. In Inspect, filter All, Fallback or Selected frames and choose up to 24 frames in original sequence order.

EXPORT PIXELS WITH THE FACTS
Generate selected full-canvas PNGs, a paginated contact-sheet PDF and/or complete timing JSON. PNG retains alpha without a checkerboard baked into the pixels. The PDF uses a labeled white background. Timing JSON covers every source frame, including nullable raw delays, zero values, preview fallbacks and disposal metadata. Export Detail lists actual filenames, bytes and SHA-256; preview the PDF or share available files through the system panel.

Frozen export groups survive deletion of an imported GIF. Delete source copies and thumbnails separately from generated groups, or confirm Clear all GIFs and exports in About. External originals, previously shared copies and system backups remain separate. The native tools need no app login.

SUPPORTED SCOPE
GIF87a/GIF89a up to 15 MiB, 1-200 frames, 2048 pixels per side, 2,097,152 canvas pixels and a 60-million canvas-pixels-times-frame-count budget. Export selections contain 1-24 frames. Plain-text rendering, user-input flags and reserved disposal modes are unsupported. FrameRibbon does not edit GIF timing, re-encode user GIFs or promise identical playback across players.

name: FreeFall Cam
description:
FreeFall Cam turns your phone into two cameras from another decade.

THE CAMCORDER
Record video that looks like it came off a tape: soft colour, tape noise, the odd tracking wobble, and the on-screen date and counter burned into the picture. What you see in the viewfinder is what lands on the tape.

THE FILM CAMERA
Flip to photo mode for disposable-camera stills: warm flash, grain and the date stamped in the corner. Hold the shutter to shoot a looping burst.

IT DEVELOPS
Every take goes to your tape library and develops in the background, so you can keep shooting. Play it back, save it to your camera roll, or erase it.

YOURS
Nothing you shoot is uploaded. Tapes and photos stay on your phone until you save or delete them. There are no ads and no tracking.

MORE LOOKS, FREE
Try the camera without an account: 5 photos and 10 minutes of tape. A free account (an email, a password and a 6-digit code to confirm it's you) removes the limit and opens the Looks list, where you add more film looks to your camera with a tap. Your looks follow your account to a new phone, and you can delete the account in the app at any time.

FreeFall Cam is made by the people behind Project Freefall.

name: Fridge Tidy
description:
Fridge Tidy
Open. Sort. Refresh.

Fridge Tidy is a cozy organizing puzzle game where you tidy a real fridge, shelf by shelf. Drag foods into the right places—upper shelf, produce drawer, door rack, freezer—and follow each level’s fridge plan.

Early levels teach simple sorting. Later levels add space limits, tall bottles, spoiled and expired items, and trash sorting. Clear the bad food, put everything back in order, then tap CHECK FRIDGE.

Warm kitchen vibes, gentle feedback, and that satisfying moment when a messy fridge finally looks fresh again.

Features

Drag-and-drop fridge organizing (not tap-to-sort)
Multi-shelf fridge: shelves, drawers, door rack, freezer
120 levels with rising challenge
Spoiled food cleanup and simple waste sorting
Food Guide, fridge collection, and daily tasks
Soft, calming kitchen art style
Perfect for short, relaxing play sessions—one tidy fridge at a time.

name: From The Ground Up
description:
Build your way across the Georgia coast in an original construction match-3. Join Nathan, your jobsite foreman, and match hard hats, bricks, tools and materials across 250 puzzle jobs inspired by real streets and towns.

• Take on projects from Savannah, Pooler, Tybee and other Georgia communities.
• Clear job goals, beat boss jobs and charge Foreman Power with every match.
• Use the Nail Gun, Bobcat and Oscillating Tool when the board gets tight.
• Earn daily rewards, complete missions and climb the optional Jobsite Leaderboard.
• Play the whole campaign offline and back up your progress in Files.

Optional purchases include item packs and custom-character unlocks. App Store checkout and the shared leaderboard need an internet connection.

name: Ftiey
description:
Ftiey — Discover the value. Care for the sound.

Every instrument has a story. Ftiey helps you explore musical instruments, understand what to look for when assessing their condition, and build thoughtful maintenance habits.

EXPLORE MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS
Discover guitars, strings, keyboards, and wind instruments. Learn about their characteristics, craftsmanship, and the details that influence their condition and value.

CARE WITH CONFIDENCE
Explore practical cleaning, storage, and maintenance guidance. Find troubleshooting articles for common instrument problems and learn when professional attention may be needed.

KEEP A MAINTENANCE LOG
Organize your instrument care with personal records. Add tasks, choose icons, track completion, and keep your next maintenance session in sight.

ASK FTIEY AI
Have a question about instrument care or appraisal? Chat with the AI assistant, describe what you have noticed, and ask follow-up questions.

CONNECT THROUGH MUSIC
Explore musician profiles, follow other users, and exchange messages about instruments, maintenance routines, and musical experiences.

From your first instrument to a treasured collection, make care part of your musical journey with Ftiey.

name: Fuego Lento
description:
Fuego Lento ist ein gemeinsamer Raum für Paare auf iPhone, iPad und Mac.

In Noi teilt ihr Nachrichten, Sprachnachrichten, Fotos, Videos und Dateien. Der Paarraum wird per Einladung eingerichtet. Geteilte Inhalte werden vor der Übertragung über iCloud verschlüsselt.

Sammelt Wünsche, schlagt Termine vor und findet gemeinsam eine passende Zeit. Der Coach unterstützt beim klareren Formulieren und beim Verstehen einer Nachricht, sofern Apple Intelligence auf dem Gerät verfügbar ist. «Eine Frage für uns» gibt euch einen Gesprächseinstieg.

Für die Einrichtung und Einladung des Paarraums ist der einmalige Duo-Kauf erforderlich. Die eingeladene Person braucht keinen eigenen Duo-Kauf.

name: Fulcimen
description: Fulcimen unterstützt Angehörige bei der Vorbereitung auf eine Pflegebegutachtung. Erfassen Sie den Hilfebedarf in sechs Lebensbereichen, führen Sie ein Pflegetagebuch und behalten Sie Nachweise sowie den MD-Termin im Blick. Dokumentieren Sie einen Widerspruch, verfolgen Sie den unverbindlichen Fristüberblick und teilen Sie Ihre Vorbereitung als PDF. Ihre Angaben werden lokal auf dem Gerät gespeichert; ein Konto ist nicht erforderlich. Die Selbsteinschätzung dient der Gesprächsvorbereitung und ersetzt weder eine amtliche Pflegegradeinstufung noch medizinische oder rechtliche Beratung.

name: Fürdőritmus
description:
A Fürdőritmus a budapesti gyógyfürdőzés hétköznapi segédje: az orvosi receptúra, a meleg medencék és a helyi órák kerülnek egyetlen, offline füzetbe.

RECEPTÚRA-FÜZET
Rögzítsd az orvos által előírt kúrát: medencehő-sáv, az ázás időtartama, heti gyakoriság és a javasolt napok. Az app ebből heti napirendet állít össze, követi, hány alkalom teljesült, és a kúra vége előtt helyi értesítéssel emlékeztet a megújításra. A lezárult kúrák archívumba kerülnek a hozzájuk tartozó fürdőzésekkel és átlagos hatásukkal.

A TE CSÚCSIDŐ-TÉRKÉPED
Minden látogatásnál egy perc alatt rögzítheted: mennyire volt tele a fürdő, mennyi volt a turista, mekkora volt a tényleges hőfok. Idővel a saját jegyzeteidből rajzolódik ki a hétvégén és hétköznap külön-külön, óránkénti zsúfoltsági térkép – így te is tudni fogod, mikor érdemes menni, és mikor kerüld.

MEDENCE–CÉL PÁROSÍTÁS
Ma gyógyulni, lazítani vagy társaságba vágysz? Állítsd be a célt, a kívánt hőfokot és az időablakot: az app kikeresi a legjobban illő medencéket a hat fürdő katalógusából, súlyozza a saját óratérképedet, és ellenőrzi az aktív receptúra-szabályt is – ha a medence hőfoka kívül esik az előírt sávon, azonnal szól.

ILLEMKÁRTYÁK
Törölköző a padra, telefon a zsebbe, zuhany a medence előtt, sapka az úszósávokban: a budapesti fürdőzés íratlan szabályai kötelező és illem jelöléssel, fürdőnkénti különlegességekkel.

JEGYZETEK, CSAK A TIED
Melyik fürdő, melyik óra alatt esik jól? Jegyzetfüzet kitűzéssel, címkékkel, hangulat-jelöléssel. Semmi nem hagyja el a készüléket: nincs fiók, nincs felhő, nincs reklám.

PÉLDÁDATOKKAL VAGY ÜRESEN
Az első indításkor választhatsz: belépés példaadatokkal (négy heti látogatás, egy aktív kúra, néhány jegyzet), vagy üres füzettel. A példaadatok bármikor törölhetők.

FONTOS
Az app becsléseket ad a budapesti fürdőzési tapasztalat alapján. Nem orvosi eszköz: a kúrád rendjét az orvosod, a fürdő nyitvatartását, jegyárát és házirendjét a fürdőhatóság szabja meg. A katalógusban szereplő medencehőfokok tájékoztató jellegűek, és a saját tapasztalatod alapján bármikor kijavíthatod.

name: Furlo: Dog & Cat Training
description:
Raising a puppy or a new kitten, or fixing habits in an older pet? Furlo gives you a clear plan for today, so you always know what to practice next.

Free, with no subscription and no in-app purchases. One app for dogs AND cats. Add your pet, answer a few questions about their age and behavior, and get recommended courses with short, day-by-day lessons.

TRAINING THAT FITS YOUR PET
• 8 dog courses: potty training, basic commands, leash walking, stopping biting and chewing, barking control, staying home alone, watchdog basics and new dog basics
• 6 cat courses: litter box training, stopping scratching, calm cat, carrier and vet visits, play and night routine, new cat basics
• Step-by-step lessons with quick logs and a "How did it go?" check-in after each day
• Streaks and progress tracking to keep you consistent

AN AI COACH FOR EVERY COURSE
• Each course has its own coach you can message at any time
• The coach knows the course you are on and how your pet is progressing
• A separate AI Chat tab for any other pet question
• AI answers are general guidance for training and daily care, not veterinary advice

CARE, ALL IN ONE PLACE
• Feeding schedule with reminders, and a shared "fed" status so nobody feeds twice
• Walk tracking on a map for dogs
• Progress log for each pet

SHARE WITH YOUR FAMILY
• Invite family members with a code so everyone sees the same plan, meals and progress
• Manage several pets and switch between them in one tap

SIMPLE, FREE AND PRIVATE
• Every course and feature is free, with no subscription and no in-app purchases
• Sign in with Apple or Google
• Delete your account and data from the profile screen at any time

Furlo works for first-time pet owners and experienced ones alike. Short daily sessions, positive and gentle methods, and a plan you can actually follow. 

Disclaimer: Furlo provides general training and care information. It does not replace advice from a veterinarian or a certified behaviorist. If your pet shows aggression, pain or sudden changes in behavior, contact a professional.

name: Fuse Weather Loft
description:
The weather loft's roof hatches are stuck. Help Pip, a pocket-sized bomb with a lit fuse, climb through a tower of spinning wheels and pop them open.

Catch a teal rim and ride it around. Tap when Pip is pointing toward the next wheel, then use up to two smaller pops to adjust your flight before you dock again. Each catch refills your pops. Hit a copper edge and you'll bounce back, so watch where the rim is headed.

COLLECT WIND FOR THE BIG GAPS

Ride a charge wheel to scoop up three orbiting wind bottles. Once Boost is ready, line up your launch and streak across a gap in a trail of fire and sparks.

READ THE WHEELS AND THE WEATHER

Find a way past broken rims, lopsided cams, and rotating iris dials. Dodge paper swifts and drifting squalls, or fit a Cloudglass shield to soften a hit. On relay flights, dock at the star-marked wheel to unlatch the hatch and reverse the next wheel's spin.

OPEN 100 HATCHES

Climb through five illustrated chapters, from the copper machinery of Copper Eaves to the northern lights of Aurora Roof. Earn up to three stars per flight, replay levels to beat your best scores and times, and claim Cloudglass through Daily Check-In.

Play the full campaign offline. Your progress and personal records are saved on your iPhone.

name: FusorChess
description:
Fusor is chess with one new idea: your pieces can merge.

Move a piece onto one of your own and they fuse into a single piece that moves like both. A rook fused with a bishop sweeps like a queen. A knight riding a queen can jump and slide. Split them again whenever you like. Everything else you know about chess still applies, so you can start playing in two minutes.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Rated games online, matched to players near your level
• Four bots, from beginner to a Pro bot that thinks with AI
• Send a friend a link and play live or one move a day
• Pick up a daily game whenever it's your turn

A PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• The same position for everyone, every day
• Build a streak and share your result

CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD
• Earn your rating and see where you stand

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
• Drag or tap to move, with smooth animations and haptics
• Notifications when it's your move, if you want them
• Play as a guest, or sign in with Apple, Google or email to keep your rating on every device

Fair play matters: usernames are filtered, and you can report or block any player.

Fusor is free, with no ads.

name: FZ Delivery boy
description:
FZ Delivery Boy is the official app for Foodzippy delivery partners. Manage your deliveries, stay connected with customers and keep track of your earnings, all from one place.

KEY FEATURES

• Orders: See new, ongoing and completed orders in one list and update the status at every step of the delivery.

• Live Tracking: Follow the delivery route and share your live location so customers always know where their order is.

• In-App Calling: Call customers directly from the app without sharing your personal number.

• Subscriptions: View and manage subscription-based deliveries and their details.

• Instant Notifications: Get notified the moment a new order arrives or an order changes.

• Earnings: Check your daily and total earnings clearly, so you always know what you have made.

• Profile and Support: Update your profile details and reach out to support whenever you need help.

Note: This app is only for registered Foodzippy delivery partners. Login credentials are provided by Foodzippy. Location access is used to show your live position during deliveries.

name: G1 Practice Test: Canada
description:
Unofficial app: it is not affiliated with or endorsed by any provincial government, licensing office or insurer. We wrote the questions, explanations and diagrams ourselves from the facts in each province's official driver's handbook.

Get ready for the written knowledge test in Ontario (G1), Quebec, Alberta (Class 7), British Columbia or Saskatchewan — in English or French.

PRACTICE TEST IN YOUR PROVINCE'S FORMAT
• Ontario: 40 questions in two parts, road signs and rules of the road, 16 of 20 needed in each
• Quebec: three parts — Highway Safety Code, road signs and driving a passenger vehicle
• Alberta, British Columbia and Saskatchewan: the number of questions and pass mark of your province's test
• See which part needs more work after every test

OVER 400 QUESTIONS FOR EACH PROVINCE
• Road signs, right of way, speed, alcohol and drugs, new-driver rules, fines and demerit points
• Every answer explained from the provincial handbook
• Diagrams of real road situations, drawn by us
• Mistakes come back until you know them

REFERENCE SECTION
• All road signs of your province, with flashcards: "I know it" or "again"
• Demerit points and speeding fines in clear tables
• Licence steps (G1 → G2 → G and the others), what they cost and how long they take
• What to bring on test day and where to take the test
• For newcomers: exchanging a foreign licence

AFTER THE KNOWLEDGE TEST: ROAD TEST PREP
• What the G2 and G road tests check, and what fails you on the spot
• Road test checklist you can tick off
• Parallel parking, reverse parking, three-point turn, roadside stop and highway merge, step by step with diagrams

ENGLISH OR FRENCH
• The whole app works in both official languages
• Quebec questions are written from the French handbook, not translated

FULL ACCESS
Some questions in every topic, one practice test and the basic reference pages are free. Full access opens all questions, unlimited practice tests, the full sign deck and the road test guides.
• Weekly or monthly subscription: renews automatically at the same price until you cancel. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.
• Lifetime: a one-time payment, no renewal.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://yurgon.app/canada-driving-test/privacy/

name: Gaelun
description: Gaelun is a small, offline field journal for the rocky shore. It holds a fixed catalogue of twenty-four common animals and seaweeds, a private record of every visit you make, and five short notes on reading the water. There is no account, no feed, no map, no sync and no advertising. Everything you need for the next low water is already inside the app.

name: GaffarsTeleprompter
description:
Gaffar's Teleprompter is the premier professional teleprompter and multi-camera studio recording app designed for content creators, keynote speakers, journalists, educators, and video producers.

Deliver flawless presentations with natural eye contact, simultaneous dual rear camera recording, a floating live viewfinder, and intelligent voice-follow scrolling that moves dynamically as you speak.

WHY CREATORS CHOOSE GAFFAR'S TELEPROMPTER

1. FLOATING CAMERA VIEWFINDER
Keep your eyes locked on the camera lens without losing your place. A draggable, corner-snapping picture-in-picture window displays your live video feed right on top of your scrolling script, ensuring perfect framing, eye contact, and confidence during every take.

2. DUAL REAR CAMERA RECORDING
Harness the full power of your iPhone's camera hardware. Record simultaneously from two rear lenses at once: 1x Wide for your primary presentation and 0.5x Ultra Wide for wide-angle context. Both video angles save directly to your photo library in synchronized high quality, giving you multi-cam production flexibility in post-production.

3. REVOLUTIONARY IPHONE DUO COVER SCREEN MODE
When using an unfolded iPhone Duo, launch your script on the outer cover display facing you while your high-resolution rear cameras record your shot. A live viewfinder preview is shown right next to your script, turning your foldable device into an all-in-one broadcast studio.

4. INTELLIGENT VOICE FOLLOW
Never worry about setting the wrong scroll speed. Our on-device voice recognition tracks your spoken words in real time, automatically advancing the script at your natural pace and pausing when you pause. Works completely offline with zero latency.

5. PRECISION PROMPTER CONTROLS
- 60 to 120 FPS ultra-smooth ProMotion text scrolling
- Adjustable Words Per Minute (WPM) speed override per script
- Horizontal reading eyeline guide for effortless eye contact
- Smart pause markers: insert tags like [pause 3s] for timed holds
- Automated cue filtering: stage directions in brackets and headings are hidden during speech
- Mirror mode for hardware beam splitter glass rigs
- Studio dark obsidian theme engineered for low glare and OLED battery efficiency

6. SCRIPT LIBRARY AND TAKE MANAGEMENT
- Organize scripts with custom color tags, pins, and instant search
- Track multiple takes with elapsed duration and read times
- Spoken word count calculation that excludes bracketed cues
- Instant script import and export via text and markdown files
- Automatic iCloud synchronization across your devices

7. COMPLETE ON-DEVICE PRIVACY
Your scripts, voice recordings, and video feeds are processed entirely on your device. No cloud processing, no tracking, and no external audio transmission.

Transform your video presentations with Gaffar's Teleprompter today.

name: Galaksi Dostları
description:
Küçük astronotumuz galaksinin sonuna ulaşmak istiyor! Gezegenden gezegene zıpla, parlayan yıldızları topla ve 35 bölümlük uzay macerasını tamamla.

• 35 bölüm: başlangıç adasından buz gezegenine, kristal köprülerden canavar kalesine
• Bölüm sonu patronları: kocaman, yumuşacık ve sevimli! Halka dalgalarının üstünden zıpla, şeker toplardan kaç, başı dönünce vur
• Yenilen patron dostun olur: minik hâli yanında uçar, Dostlar Salonu'nda heykeli belirir
• Açık dünya: Galaksi Merkezi'nde gez, istediğin bölümün kapısına gir
• Mağaza: topladığın yıldızlarla kıyafet, vizör, kask, ayakkabı ve uçan pet al
• Gövde dalışı: çift zıpla, havada vur düğmesine bas ve yere çarparak etrafındaki canavarları devir
• Arkadaşlarla oyna: aynı Wi-Fi'deki arkadaşının adına dokun, onun oyununa ışınlan; arkadaşının açtığı bölümlere birlikte girebilirsin, ayrı düşersen "Yanına git" ile yanına ışınlanırsın
• Çocuklar için güvenli: reklam yok, satın alma yok, internet ve hesap gerekmez, hiçbir veri toplanmaz

Kolay dokunmatik kontroller: sol tarafta joystick, sağda zıpla ve vur düğmeleri.

name: galsen-life
description:
Bienvenue dans GALSEN-LIFE, la première simulation de vie urbaine et jeu de rôle (RP) en monde ouvert au coeur de Dakar !

Explorez plus de 10 km2 fidèlement modélisés d'après la vraie ville de Dakar en 3D : parcourez les ruelles animées de la Médina, les boulevards modernes du Plateau, Rebeuss, Fass, Gueule Tapée et admirez le coucher de soleil sur la Corniche ou la baie de l'Anse Bernard.

UNE EXPÉRIENCE SÉNÉGALAISE UNIQUE ET AUTHENTIQUE
- Conduisez les véhicules emblématiques de la capitale : le mythique Car Rapide jaune et bleu "Alhamdoulilah", les taxis jaune et noir, les clandos, les motos Jakarta et les bus Tata.
- Retrouvez les véritables monuments : la Place de l'Indépendance, la Grande Mosquée, le Marché Sandaga, Tilène, la Gare de Dakar, l'Assemblée nationale et la Porte du Troisième Millénaire.

FAITES CARRIÈRE ET GAGNEZ VOS FCFA
À Dakar, chaque métier a son patron et ses réalités :
- Taximan : Prenez des clients à Petersen et déposez-les à bon port selon le compteur kilométrique.
- Livreur en Jakarta : Récupérez le thiéboudienne chaud "Chez Adja" et livrez-le avant qu'il ne refroidisse !
- Vendeur de Café Touba : Tenez votre stand au marché Sandaga.
- Kiosques Wave et Orange Money : Gérez les dépôts et retraits des habitants et touchez vos commissions.
- Métiers d'action : Rejoignez la Police pour patrouiller, le SAMU pour secourir les citoyens, ou intégrez les factions de quartier.

LA LUTTE TRADITIONNELLE SÉNÉGALAISE (LÀMB)
Entraînez-vous, développez votre force, signez avec une écurie et entrez dans l'arène au rythme des tambours de sabar pour des combats de lutte intenses et spectaculaires.

SMARTPHONE EN JEU CONNECTÉ
Utilisez votre téléphone virtuel moderne :
- Wave et Orange Money : Envoyez de l'argent et payez vos achats en FCFA.
- GPS interactif : Localisez en un toucher plus de 200 points d'intérêt réels.
- Keur (Immobilier) : Louez une chambre à la Médina, achetez un appartement au Plateau ou une villa de luxe avec piscine et garage au Cap Manuel.
- Sape et Mode : Habillez votre personnage en grand boubou traditionnel, tissus wax, bazin ou tenues de ville modernes.

MULTIJOUEUR EN LIGNE OU SOLO HORS-LIGNE
- Jouez en solo hors-ligne ou rejoignez des milliers de joueurs sur le serveur officiel.
- Chat vocal de proximité (VoIP) réaliste et spatialisé pour discuter naturellement avec les personnes autour de vous.
- Créez votre groupe (Mbokk), organisez des courses de voitures ou défiez vos amis.

Prêt à vivre votre aventure dakaroise ? Téléchargez Galsen-Life et faites-vous un nom dans la capitale de la Teranga !

name: GamIDomI: split timer
description:
Millora el teu speedrun amb un seguiment pensat per a jugar de manera més intel·ligent. Marca punts clau, compara cada tram amb el teu millor temps i descobreix exactament on guanyes o perds segons el recorregut.

Funcions clau
- Creació de rutes amb punts de control - defineix el teu recorregut, reordena les fites i afegeix pistes útils per saber quan marcar cada etapa.
- Temporitzador amb comparació precisa - veu el temps total, la diferència fins al punt i la diferència del tram per saber si vas per davant o per darrere del teu rècord.
- Anàlisi de cada intent - revisa l’informe complet, detecta el tram més lent i obre directament l’entrenament d’aquella secció.
- Entrenament de trams - repeteix només la part que necessites, afegeix notes a cada prova i compara resultats sense perdre l’historial del recorregut complet.
- Plantilles editables i prova inicial - comença de pressa amb models preparats per a plataformes, curses, caps i recollida d’objectes.
- Funciona sense connexió - tot es guarda al dispositiu, amb historial, versions, rècords i ajustos sempre disponibles.

Perfecte per a
- Jugadors que fan speedrun i volen saber on recuperar segons en una ruta.
- Qui entrena caps, fases o seccions concretes i necessita repetir només el tram important.
- Persones que volen comparar estratègies diferents sense perdre rècords anteriors.
- Usuaris que prefereixen una eina offline, ràpida i enfocada a la millora real.

Per què triar aquesta app
GamIDomI: split timer està dissenyada per ajudar-te a entrenar amb precisió, no només a mesurar temps. Cada partida queda registrada amb les seves variants, cada tall es desa a l’instant i cada informe et porta directament al punt que més et fa perdre temps. La interfície és clara, visual i optimitzada per fer servir amb una sola mà, amb vibració, so i mantenir la pantalla activa durant el mesurament.

Si vols convertir cada intent en una oportunitat de millorar, aquesta és l’eina que necessites. Crea la teva primera ruta, comença a mesurar i baixa els teus temps avui mateix.

name: GanIA
description:
GanIA es una solución digital diseñada para modernizar la gestión de ganadería, especies menores y fincas agrícolas.

Administra tu ganado —bovino, equino, porcino, caprino y ovino—, tus cultivos y tus finanzas desde un solo lugar. Lleva el control total de tu finca de forma fácil, rápida y desde tu celular o computador.

Dashboard Inteligente
Visualiza en tiempo real el estado de tu ganadería y finca:
• Distribución de animales
• Ingresos, egresos y balance
• Alertas importantes
• Tareas pendientes
• Indicadores productivos

Módulo de Ganado Multi-Especie
Gestiona bovinos, caballos, cerdos, cabras y ovejas de forma profesional, cada uno con su propio ciclo:
• Registro de animales (manual o con IA)
• Ficha individual por animal
• Control de peso y crecimiento
• Producción de leche
• Conversión alimenticia (ideal para porcinos)
• Estado reproductivo según cada especie
• Historial sanitario y tratamientos
• Costos por animal
 Módulo de Cultivos
Optimiza la producción agrícola:
• Registro de cultivos y lotes
• Clima en tiempo real según la ubicación de tu finca
• Seguimiento de siembra y cosecha
• Control de gastos agrícolas
• Planes de fertilización
• Proyección de rendimiento
• Rentabilidad por cultivo

 Gestión de Lotes y Mapa
Control visual de tu finca:
• Marca la ubicación exacta de tu finca
• Registro de terrenos y cálculo de áreas
• Asignación de animales
• Visualización en mapa con límites de cada lote

 Nutrición y Dietas
Planifica la alimentación de tu finca:
• Creación de planes de alimentación
• Registro de alimentación con descuento automático de inventario
• Control de conversión alimenticia por lote

 Inventario de Finca
Controla todos tus recursos:
• Alimentos
• Insumos
• Herramientas
• Maquinaria
• Medicamentos

 Gestión de Tareas
Organiza el trabajo en tu finca:
• Creación y asignación de tareas
• Recordatorios automáticos
• Seguimiento de estado
• Alertas de retrasos

 Finanzas Agropecuarias
Administra tu finca como un negocio:
• Registro de ingresos y gastos reales
• Integración con ganado y cultivos
• Balance mensual
• Rentabilidad por actividad
• Proyecciones financieras
• Exportación de reportes a CSV

Asistente Inteligente con IA
Consulta toda la información de tu ganadería:
• Producción
• Gastos
• Estado de animales
• Historial
• Recomendaciones inteligentes

 ¿Para quién es GanIA?
• Ganaderos y criadores de bovinos
• Criadores de caballos, cerdos, cabras y ovejas
• Agricultores
• Fincas mixtas
• Cooperativas
• Empresas agropecuarias

Transforma tu ganadería y tu finca con tecnología e inteligencia artificial.

name: Gatherform
description:
Good company deserves a thoughtful place at the table.

Gatherform is a quiet, complete hosting desk for your iPhone. Plan a dinner, arrange a small celebration and create personal place cards, entirely offline.

MAKE ROOM
Start with one of eight original layouts or an empty gathering. Move tables by touch, choose round, long or square shapes, adjust the number of seats and preview a fresh table arrangement before applying it.

WELCOME YOUR PEOPLE
Add guests one at a time or paste a name on each line. Keep your own group labels and private notes. Tap a guest and then a seat, swap people, or use the readable seating review. Preview filling open seats while keeping existing assignments in place.

MAKE IT PERSONAL
Compose your place cards directly. Move the name and ornament, explore six starting styles, choose ink and paper colors, change the typeface and add your own welcome line. Preview actual guest names, including longer names that wrap across lines.

KEEP EVERY POSSIBILITY
Edits save automatically. Undo and redo recent changes, save named versions, compare arrangements, favorite a gathering and duplicate it for another occasion. Mark arrivals as your guests join you.

TAKE IT TO THE TABLE
Create an eight-up place-card PDF, a guest CSV or an editable gathering file. Choose A4 or US Letter for cards, inspect the output, then save or share it using the system share sheet.

FREE TO PLAN, WITH AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE
Plan and edit offline, design and print place cards, and save one named version free. Gatherform Plus is a one-time purchase that adds seating-map PNGs, printable host sheets and up to 20 named versions per gathering. Apple handles purchase and restore. No accounts, ads or subscriptions. Your names and notes stay in local app storage unless you share a file.

Sample gatherings contain fictional names and are fully editable. The room layout is an illustrative planning aid; check your actual space and preview a test sheet before printing.

name: GaugeRoute
description:
Convert length, area, volume, mass and temperature in a practical measurement workspace. Choose units, enter a value and save a named calculation with notes. THE TRACE BENCH

Plus labs for binary, hex and shifts, logic gates and truth tables, sorting and searching, the fetch-decode-execute cycle, images, sound and file size, ciphers and network packets.

name: GCSE Physics Prep: Physvane
description:
GCSE Physics revision that adapts to you. Physvane covers the whole separate-science (triple) physics course for Foundation and Higher tier, with the equation sheet at the centre. Suits AQA, Pearson Edexcel and OCR Gateway courses; O Level and IGCSE learners will find much of it similar.

COVERAGE YOU CAN SEE: a built-in Coverage screen tracks your mastery against every point of the DfE GCSE physics content and the AQA, Pearson Edexcel and OCR specifications. Independent study aid, not affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson, OCR, Ofqual or the DfE.

EQUATION DECK AND SOLVER
Every GCSE physics equation is a live card. Tap one, choose the unknown, type what you know with its units, and Physvane converts prefixes, checks your rearrangement, shows the working step by step and flags unit mistakes such as milliamps used as amps. Forty-two equations, each linked to its lessons.

EIGHT PRACTICALS YOU RUN YOURSELF
Specific heat capacity, thermal insulation, resistance and I-V, density, force and extension, force mass and acceleration, ripple-tank waves and refraction through a block. For each one you plan the variables, set up, take readings, plot your own graph and write a conclusion, then answer a question worked out from your results.

SEPARATE-SCIENCE DEPTH
Moments and levers, fluid pressure, lenses and ray diagrams, ultrasound and seismic waves, black-body radiation, fission and fusion, generators, microphones, loudspeakers and transformers, gas pressure and volume, and the life cycle of stars with red-shift are full topics, not footnotes. 58 topics, over 690 original questions with explained answers. After every quiz you get a Fix it link to the exact lesson card for what you missed, the next best topic and one line on why. Weak topics come back on a schedule. Everything runs on your device; no account.

Switch any time; your progress is shared.

SEE WHERE EACH TOPIC SITS NEXT

TESTS WITH A REPORT
Unit tests, cumulative tests and mock papers for Foundation or Higher, with a report of weak topics and a seven-day study plan.

FREE WITH ADS, OFFLINE

name: Gem Grid: Block Puzzle
description:
Gem Grid is a satisfying block puzzle you can play anywhere — offline, no account, no forced ads.

Drag the three pieces onto the 8×8 board. Fill a whole row or column and it bursts in a shower of sparks. Clear several lines at once, or clear on back-to-back turns, to build combos and rack up huge scores. There's no timer: think, plan, and play at your own pace. The game ends only when none of your pieces fit.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic — endless play for your best score, with a fair piece picker that keeps the game winnable.
• Adventure — 36 hand-tuned levels across three chapters, each ending in a boss level. Hit target scores, collect colored gems, clear lines, and beat move limits to earn up to 3 stars.
• Daily Challenge — a fresh puzzle every day. Build your streak and fill your calendar.
• Revive — stuck? Watch a short optional video for a second chance each run.

POWER-UPS
• Bomb — blast a 3×3 area.
• Single Block — drop one square exactly where you need it.
• Reroll — swap your three pieces for new ones.
Earn coins by clearing lines and winning levels, then spend them on power-ups and themes. Grab a free power-up every day, or top up in the shop.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Five gorgeous themes: Classic Gems, Neon Grid, Candy Pop, Woodcraft and Aurora Glass.
• 18 achievements and detailed stats to track your progress.
• Crisp sound effects and native haptic feedback on every place, burst and combo.

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Plays offline — perfect for flights, commutes and anywhere without signal.
• No forced ads: videos only play when you choose a reward (revive, double coins, daily free power-up).
• Optional shop: coin packs, a one-time Starter Pack, and Remove Ads, which makes every reward free.
• No sign-up. Your progress is saved on your device.

Easy to learn, hard to put down. How big can you combo?

name: GetWoof: pożycz psa
description:
Pożycz psa. Podaruj radość.

GetWoof łączy właścicieli psów z sąsiadami, którzy chętnie pójdą na spacer. Ty masz chwilę oddechu, pies ma towarzystwo, a sąsiad ma radość z psiego przyjaciela.

Jak to działa:
• Załóż konto w minutę, bez hasła: wystarczy kod z maila.
• Dodaj profil, a jeśli masz psa, jego zdjęcie i opis.
• Zobacz osoby z Twojej dzielnicy (pokazujemy tylko dzielnicę, nigdy adresu).
• Wyślij zaproszenie, porozmawiaj w czacie i umówcie się na spotkanie zapoznawcze.

Dodatkowo:
• Skaner karm: zeskanuj kod z opakowania, a pokażemy skład według jawnych kryteriów i cenę za kilogram.
• Poradniki o psach, wybiegi i weterynarze całodobowi w wielu miastach.

Bezpieczeństwo i prywatność:
• Zgłaszanie i blokowanie osób jednym przyciskiem; zgłoszenia sprawdzamy w ciągu 24 godzin.
• Usuniesz konto w aplikacji w Ustawieniach.
• Między członkami nie płyną żadne pieniądze. GetWoof nie jest usługą opieki ani ubezpieczycielem.

Aplikacja jest darmowa. Niektóre linki do sklepów (np. Ceneo) są linkami partnerskimi: możemy dostać prowizję, a Ciebie nie kosztuje to nic.

Pytania? woof@getwoof.pl

name: GLITCH REWIND
description:
見つかっても、巻き戻せばいい。
ドット絵の潜入・脱出アクション。

■ 時間を巻き戻す
ボタンを押しているあいだ、時間が逆に流れる。警備員に捕まっても、もがいているうちに巻き戻せば、捕まる前に戻れる。ただし戻せるのは最大10秒。ゲージが尽きたら、もう戻れない。

■ バグを起こす
何が起きるかはわからない。敵が固まる、目が見えなくなる、吹っ飛ぶ、床をすり抜けて落ちる、分身が現れる、セキュリティが落ちる——。外れたら、巻き戻して起こし直せばいい。

■ 地下10階から地上へ
収容区画、医務区画、培養区画、研究区画、レーザーの実験場、暗いサーバー区画、監視室、水槽の並ぶ貯水区画、警備区画、そして搬出口。監視カメラ、点滅するレーザー、足音を立てて巡回する警備員をかわして進む。

■ 調べる・隠れる
警備端末でレーザーを止め、保管庫からカードキーを取り出し、ロッカーに隠れてやり過ごす。各階に残された資料を読むと、少女がなぜここにいるのかが少しずつわかっていく。

■ むずかしい・エンドレス
「むずかしい」では、扉の前に動かない重装兵が立ち、レーザーは消えず、見失った敵はあたりを探し回る。力を使わなければ通れない。
エンドレスでは、毎回ちがう階が自動で作られる。どこまで上がれるか。全国ランキングで記録を競おう。

■ 能力覚醒
ストーリーを「むずかしい」でクリアすると、新たな力に目覚める。巻き戻しても自分はその場に残り、警備員や警報など、自分以外の時間だけが戻る。同じ研究所が、まったく別の攻略になる。

■ 操作
画面の左側をさわった場所にスティックが出て移動。右側の◀◀で巻き戻し、BUGでバグ、「調べる」で調べる・隠れる。縦持ち・横持ちのどちらでも遊べます。右上のⅡボタンでいつでも一時停止できます。

• Hell und Dunkel, Dynamic Type und VoiceOver

Kein Halsband zur Hand? Tippe auf dem ersten Bildschirm auf „Ohne Halsband ausprobieren“ und teste alle Funktionen mit einem simulierten Display.

GlitchLED ist eine unabhängige App und steht in keiner Verbindung zu den Herstellern der gesteuerten Halsbänder.

name: Globe Hopper: Geography Quiz
description:
Hop on a little plane and fly around the world! Globe Hopper is a relaxing geography game played on a beautiful 3D globe you can spin and zoom with your fingers.

COUNTRY MAPS IN 3D
Over 110 countries as 3D dioramas with mountains, rivers, castles and caves – Slovakia, the USA, Iceland, Brazil, Japan, Nepal and more. Explore them, collect photo postcards of famous places and earn stars in six quiz rounds, up to the blind-map master. And in the Vatican you go on patrol with the Swiss Guard through a 3D model of the city.

ROAD TRIPS ON FAMOUS ROUTES
Drive Route 66, cycle the Danube and the Loire, hike the Camino, the Inca Trail or up Kilimanjaro – over 40 road trips by car, bike or on foot. Find the next stop on the map, travel there and hear its story with a photo and a quiz. Collect a stamp for every finished trip and the hiker, cyclist and driver badges; a new leg of the day waits every day. A narrator can read the stories aloud.

CLIMB REAL MOUNTAINS IN 3D
Walk up Kriváň, Rysy, Mont Blanc, Mount Fuji, Half Dome and five more summits along their real trails: jump over what lies in the way, step around falling stones and answer a quiz over the summit’s panorama. In the Three Peaks Challenge you climb Ben Nevis, Scafell Pike and Snowdon on one clock – can you do it in 24 hours? And two treks take several days, with nights at a camp: the Skyline Trail in the Canadian Rockies and the Inca Trail to Machu Picchu.

FIND COUNTRIES ON THE GLOBE
Tap the right country among all 198 – from Russia to tiny Tuvalu. Missed it? You see what you tapped and get a second try, so you learn as you play.

A TRIP AROUND THE WORLD
22 stops from Central Europe to the Pacific islands. Every stop has three rounds: meet the countries, capitals & flags, and the region master round where you pin capitals on the map and score by how many kilometres you are off.

COLLECT LANDMARKS
Master a region and win a hand-made 3D sticker for your album: the Eiffel Tower, Taj Mahal, Mount Fuji, the Statue of Liberty, the Pyramids and many more.

BORDER HOP
Get from one country to another across as few borders as you can. The globe shows the land with no borders on it – a country appears only once you name it, and lights up green, amber or red by how close to the shortest way it lies. A new route every day, the same for everyone, and more for the world, Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas. Too easy? Play blind: not even the land shows.

DAILY CHALLENGE
Ten new questions every day – the same for everyone. Keep your streak going and share your result. More in Challenges: a weekly quiz, a 60-second blitz, the highest mountains, country records, rivers and lakes, islands and seas.

PRACTICE & ATLAS
Train countries, capitals, flags or city pins for any continent. Explore the atlas: tap any country to see its flag, capital, population, area and neighbours.

• 9 question types: countries, capitals, flags, city pins, neighbours, who has more people…
• No account, no ads; the game plays offline (photos of places load when online)
• Free to play: the globe game with the daily challenge and the globe challenges, the first round of every country map, one whole map and one mountain climb of your choice, and the first leg of every road trip. One optional purchase unlocks the rest, with three more planes and three living skies – no subscription
• 14 languages
• Suitable for kids, students, travellers and quiz fans

name: Glow's Grief Journey
description:
When we lose someone or something we love, our hearts go on a journey. Glow the firefly walks with children through five magical lands, each one gently exploring a different grief feeling.

- Foggy Forest: when it doesn't feel real
- Volcano Valley: when grief feels like anger
- Wishing Well: worries, what-ifs and "if only"
- Rainy Lake: sadness and missing someone
- Sunrise Hill: carrying love and memories forward

Children can visit any land, in any order, as many times as they need. There is no finish line and no right way to grieve. Children earn gentle stars for trying, never for getting it right.

Inside the app:
- Calming activities, from dragon breaths to memory lanterns
- A Heart Jar to save memories, wishes and comfort ideas
- My Reflections, My Comfort Tools and My Growth pages
- A Grown-Up Guide with what to say, what to avoid, and when to reach out for extra support
- A grown-up corner in every land: what your child is learning there, how to help, and a moment for your own heart
- A full grown-up grief journey through the same five lands, with gentle practices and a private grown-up journal
- "Add my own" on the choices, so kids and grown-ups can name feelings in their own words
- Every line read aloud in a warm, gentle voice by Maxine Golden, so children who can't read yet can play too
- Gentle sparkles and chimes, with an option to turn sounds off

Made for children grieving a death, a pet, a move, a family change, or a loss in foster care or adoption. Created by Maxine Golden, Pre-Licensed MFT, Center for Parent Coaching, Brainspotting & Therapy, drawing on more than 25 years of work with foster, adoptive and court-involved families.

Privacy: the app collects no data. Anything a child or grown-up writes stays only on their device. Links out of the app are protected by a grown-ups-only check.

This app supports children and families. It does not replace therapy or medical care.

name: GMG Suite – Moyens généraux
description:
GMG Suite est l'application mobile de la plateforme de gestion des moyens généraux GMG Suite. Elle donne aux techniciens, gestionnaires, administrateurs et prestataires un accès direct aux interventions, aux rondes techniques et aux notifications de leur espace, sur site comme en déplacement.

Réservée aux organisations clientes de GMG Suite : l'application ne permet pas de créer de compte. Connectez-vous avec l'email et le mot de passe que vous utilisez sur le site web ; votre compte est créé par l'administrateur de votre espace.

LES MÊMES DONNÉES QUE SUR LE SITE WEB
Un ticket créé, une ronde terminée ou un devis validé dans l'application est aussitôt visible sur le site web, et inversement. Vos droits sont les mêmes partout : chacun retrouve les sites et les tickets de son périmètre.

INTERVENTIONS
• Liste des tickets avec recherche par numéro ou titre, filtres (site, statut, priorité, catégorie, assigné, type) et raccourci « Assignés à moi »
• Création d'un ticket : site, bâtiment, catégorie, titre, description, priorité
• Fiche complète : statut, photos avant et après, discussion, historique et commentaires, pièces utilisées
• Avancement selon votre rôle : prise en charge, passage en cours, attente pièces, travaux terminés, clôture
• Délégation à un prestataire rattaché au site
• Devis : consultation, validation signée à l'écran, refus motivé
• Contrôle des travaux et rapport d'intervention signé sur place par le contrôleur et le prestataire, avec génération du PDF

RONDES TECHNIQUES
• Rondes du jour, rondes à prendre et historique
• Exécution bâtiment par bâtiment, pièce par pièce et point par point : conforme, anomalie, commentaire, photos
• Signalement d'une anomalie avec création du ticket, photos du point jointes
• Récapitulatif et taux de conformité en fin de ronde
• Supervision des rondes pour les gestionnaires et les administrateurs

ACCUEIL
Un tableau de bord adapté à votre rôle : « Ma journée » pour le technicien, « Supervision de mes sites » pour le gestionnaire, « Vision de l'espace » pour l'administrateur (tickets ouverts, devis à valider, travaux à contrôler, rondes du jour, alertes stock…).

PORTAIL PRESTATAIRE
Les prestataires retrouvent les demandes qui leur sont confiées : dépôt de devis (PDF ou photo), démarrage et fin des travaux avec compte-rendu et photos, signature du rapport, échanges avec le client.

NOTIFICATIONS ET PROFIL
• Notifications dans l'application, avec le nombre de non lues et des préférences par type d'événement
• Modification de vos prénom, nom et téléphone
• Logo et couleurs de votre espace, thème clair ou sombre selon les réglages du téléphone

CONFIDENTIALITÉ
• Session conservée chiffrée dans l'espace sécurisé du téléphone
• Aucune publicité, aucun traceur publicitaire, aucun outil de mesure d'audience
• L'appareil photo et la photothèque ne servent qu'à joindre des photos aux tickets et aux rondes

BON À SAVOIR
• Une connexion à internet est nécessaire : l'application ne fonctionne pas hors connexion.
• L'application est en français et conçue pour l'iPhone, en mode portrait.
• La configuration de l'espace, le stock, le planning, les achats fournisseurs (commandes), les documents et les contrôles réglementaires se gèrent sur le site web gmgs.fr : l'application ouvre ces pages dans son navigateur intégré.

GMG Suite est édité par DAN-AGENCY. Questions et assistance : contact@gmgs.fr.

name: Goal Grove: Fun Soccer
description:
Goal Grove puts seven-a-side soccer on a little pitch tucked between round green trees. Kick off, knock the ball around and chase a winner over two short halves, with Stripes the zebra blowing the whistle and handing out lemon cards instead of red ones.

ONE THUMB, TWO BUTTONS
Nudge the stick to keep the ball at your toes, push it all the way to burst into space. Tap B to slip a pass to a glowing teammate. Hold A to wind up a shot, then let it fly.

LEVEL? PENALTIES!
No game ends in a draw. Tied after the second half, both sides line up for a shootout: stop the sliding marker to pick your spot, or guess left, middle or right as the keeper.

TWENTY-EIGHT GROVE CLUBS
Made-up sides from soccer-loving cities, each with its own kit, critter and four ratings for shooting, passing, defending and pace.

ROOKIE HELP FOR SMALL FEET
Switch it on and shots aim themselves, defenders track back on their own and the penalty marker slows down. Younger players still get to celebrate.

COACH, WATCH OR PLAY A FRIEND
Pick the tactics from the touchline and let your side do the running, sit back while two computer sides play it out, or challenge someone next to you over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. Game Center invites work from further away.

FREE, WITH NOTHING HIDDEN
All clubs and modes are included. There are no ads and no sign-ups, and your results stay on this device. If you enjoy the grove, you can leave an optional tip in Settings. Tips unlock nothing.

Goal Grove is an independent game. Its clubs, players and pictures are original and it has no tie to any real league or club.

name: Gökçeli Sürücü Kursu
description:
ÖZEL GÖKÇELİ SÜRÜCÜ KURSU 1990 1990 yılından bu yana tecrübe, güven ve kaliteli eğitim anlayışıyla geleceğin bilinçli sürücülerini yetiştiriyoruz. Amacımız yalnızca ehliyet sahibi olmanızı sağlamak değil; trafikte kurallara uyan, bilinçli, dikkatli ve güvenli sürücüler olmanıza katkıda bulunmaktır.

Sınavlara Hazırlık Artık Cebinizde!
Bu uygulama sınavlara etkili bir şekilde hazırlanmanızı sağlar. Uygulama içerisinde yer alan video anlatımlar, dijital kitaplar ve interaktif testler sayesinde hem teorik bilginizi geliştirir hem de sınav pratiği kazanırsınız.

Konuya Göre Ayrılmış Kitaplar:
Her ders, konularına göre düzenlenmiş dijital kitaplarla sunulmuştur. Bu sayede hangi konuyu çalışmak istiyorsanız doğrudan o bölüme geçebilir, gereksiz zaman kaybı yaşamadan öğreniminizi sürdürebilirsiniz.

Video Anlatımlarla Görsel Öğrenme:
Her konu için özel olarak hazırlanmış video içerikleriyle öğrenme sürecinizi destekleyin. Görsel anlatımlar sayesinde karmaşık konular daha anlaşılır hale gelir, öğrenme kaliteniz artar.

Dinamik Test Sistemi:
Test çözme bölümü, her seferinde farklı sorular sunarak sizi sınavlara hazırlarken ezberden uzaklaştırır. Gerçek sınav formatına benzer yapıdaki testlerle hem bilgilerinizi ölçebilir hem de eksiklerinizi tespit edebilirsiniz.

İlerlemenizi Takip Edin:
Uygulama içerisindeki test sonuçlarıyla hangi konularda güçlü olduğunuzu, nerelerde gelişmeniz gerektiğini kolayca görebilirsiniz. Bu sayede hedef odaklı bir çalışma planı oluşturabilirsiniz.

Her Zaman, Her Yerden Erişim:
Mobil cihazınız üzerinden istediğiniz zaman uygulamaya erişebilir, dilediğiniz yerde çalışmaya devam edebilirsiniz. Sınav hazırlığı artık sadece sınıfta değil, cebinizde!

Yasal Bilgilendirme:
Bu uygulama herhangi bir resmi kurum, devlet kuruluşu veya bakanlık tarafından geliştirilmemiştir ve bu kurumları temsil etmez. Sadece bireysel eğitim ve sınav hazırlığı amacıyla tasarlanmıştır. Resmi sınav sistemleriyle doğrudan bir bağlantısı bulunmamaktadır.

name: Golden Mirage: Match 3 Vegas
description:
Match your way to Vegas!

Golden Mirage is a glamorous match-3 puzzle game set in a forgotten 1950s Las Vegas casino. Swap cherries, diamonds, clovers, grapes and lucky 7s, clear each level's goals, and earn stars to restore the casino one dazzling room at a time. Then head to Hollywood and light up a grand old movie palace.

MATCH, BLAST & CASCADE
• Match 3 or more slot symbols to clear them
• Make Dice Bombs, Lucky Chips, Roulette Blasts and Jackpot Orbs
• Swap two specials together for huge combos
• Watch the marquee lights race as your cascades climb from "Nice!" to "JACKPOT!"

RESTORE OLD VEGAS
• Spend stars to roll out the red carpet, hang the chandeliers and light the neon
• Watch every restoration sparkle to life
• 12 places to rebuild, from the casino floor to the penthouse and a Hollywood premiere

240 HAND-TUNED LEVELS
• Velvet ropes, card stacks, vaults, money bags and more
• Hard and Super Hard levels pay extra stars
• Boosters like the Hammer, Swap and Shuffle when you need a hand

DAILY REWARDS
• Spin the Lucky Wheel every day
• Fill the High Roller Vault as you win
• Win in a row to start levels with free specials

Golden Mirage is free to play, with optional in-app purchases and ads. It's a puzzle game: coins have no cash value and there's no real-money gambling.

HIGH ROLLER PASS (optional subscription)
$4.99 per month for 200 coins every day, an extra life, double vault coins, a free +5 moves once a day, and no ads. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bradlow.tv/goldenmirage-privacy-policy/
Questions? support@bradlow.tv

name: GomiNavi: Japan Trash Days
description:
GomiNavi is a garbage collection calendar and reminder app for people living in Japan.

■ Set up with just your postal code
Enter your 7-digit postal code. In supported areas, GomiNavi sets up the official collection days for your district automatically. You only pick a district when one postal code covers more than one.
If your building has different rules for some categories, you can switch just those categories to your own schedule.

■ Know what goes out today, in one second
The top of the home screen shows what to put out today and tomorrow.
For categories collected every other week or once a month, such as cans, bottles, plastics and non-burnable waste, GomiNavi shows the next pickup and how many days are left. A monthly calendar shows what is coming up.
It handles 1st/3rd and 2nd/4th week schedules and months with a 5th week. Public holidays and the New Year period are flagged so you can check them.

■ Reminders the night before and that morning
Set reminder times to the minute, and turn reminders off for any category. All reminders are scheduled on your device.

■ Not sure how to sort it? Search
Look up how to throw away items such as batteries, spray cans or frying pans. Some cities show their official item list.
For oversized garbage (sodai gomi), jump straight to your city's online or phone booking and its disposal sticker information, where available.
If an item isn't listed, save your own note for it.

■ Notes and sharing
Add a note to a collection day, like "throw out the broken plate on the next non-burnable day".
Share the collection days you entered yourself with family or neighbors by link or QR code.

■ Six languages
日本語, 한국어, English, 简体中文, 繁體中文 and Tiếng Việt. Switch the language inside the app. The wording is written for people living in Japan, not a word-for-word translation.

■ Supported areas (official data)
Hokkaido: Sapporo, Ebetsu, Kamisunagawa / Tokyo: Bunkyo, Koto, Ota / Kanagawa: Yokohama, Kamakura / Ishikawa: Kanazawa, Tsubata, Uchinada / Shizuoka: Hamamatsu, Ito, Kikugawa / Aichi: Nagoya / Nara: Ikoma / Saga: Saga
Anywhere else, enter your collection days yourself and use the calendar and reminders in full. More areas are coming.

■ About ads
The only ads are a banner at the bottom of the screen. Nothing covers today's and tomorrow's garbage.

Collection days are based on each municipality's open data. Schedules can change, so please also check notices from your city.
Contact: https://tlaboratory.net/app/gominavi/support/

name: goPrevina OHS
description:
goPrevina is the all-in-one Occupational Health & Safety (OHS) platform built for safety officers, enterprises, and advisory firms.

• Risk assessments & preventive planning: track hazards, corrective measures, deadlines, and owners in one workspace.
• Field inspections & QR scanning: log findings with photo evidence, checklists, and LOTO equipment verification right on site.
• Workforce, PPE & training: track protective equipment deliveries, certifications, and automated renewal alerts.
• Incidents & corrective actions: document investigations and maintain full audit traceability for ISO 45001.
• Contractor coordination & documents: manage sites, contractor compliance, and safety records centrally.
• Nora AI assistant: dictate inspection notes by voice and speed up daily safety workflows.
• Flexible deployment: connect to your organization's goPrevina server or explore the built-in demo environment.

name: GottlieIRC
description: Open the fee bundle and select an activity to record a payment; click on the amount to view the breakdown of tuition, parking cost-sharing, and bundle discounts. Use the plan comparison feature to toggle between activities and see the projected variance for the month of suspension, subsequent months, or any selected period; you can also compare monthly passes versus pay-per-use rates based on estimated parking frequency. Upon receiving a payment, you may either retain the existing cost allocation or apply saved proportional rules. Alternatively, you can import billing statements to match line items against existing transactions, then record any additional charges, refunds, or deferred credits. The payment calendar displays expected transaction dates, budgets are tracked by service month, and monthly reconciliations preserve the chosen plans, variances, and supporting billing documentation.

name: GourmetSA
description:
GourmetSA — o app do garçom

Lance pedidos de mesas e comandas direto do celular, conectado ao sistema GourmetSA do seu restaurante.

• Abra a mesa ou comanda pelo número, pelo mapa ou lendo o QR Code
• Cardápio por grupos, com busca e leitura de código de barras
• Monte o item com opcionais, adicionais e itens obrigatórios
• Pizza meio a meio e de três sabores, com borda, massa e opcionais por sabor
• Consulte o consumo, imprima a conferência e receba por PIX
• Pedidos salvos no aparelho e enviados mesmo se a rede oscilar

Requer o sistema GourmetSA instalado no restaurante.

name: Grain Sorter
description: Guide colorful grains with angled baffles, sort them into slots to hit custom color quotas. Relaxing gravity physics puzzle with sandbox workshop, replay snapshots & gentle clay art style.

name: Gramivelle
description:
Keep your ingredient proportions while changing the batch size. Create recipes with ingredient names and masses in grams, choose a target mass and see a calculated scaling worksheet.

Record a batch to keep an independent snapshot of the exact quantities. Later recipe edits leave previous batch amounts intact. Search and edit your recipes, inspect batch history, delete records with confirmation and share a scaled worksheet. This is arithmetic scaling; cooking time and processing must be adjusted separately.

name: Gramtrail
description:
Gramtrail is an offline gear logbook and pack weight calculator built for hikers and backpackers who weigh their equipment on a kitchen scale.

Log each piece of gear once in your personal library with its exact weight in grams, kilograms, ounces, or pounds. Assign a category such as Shelter, Sleep, Pack, Clothing, Cooking, Water, Food, Electronics, First aid kit, Misc, or your own custom label. Add optional notes, maker details, and a photo from your camera or library.

When you plan a hike, create a trip list and pick items from your gear library or add one-off entries for that specific route. Mark each item as carried, worn, or consumable, and organize gear across compartments like your main pack body, top lid, and hip belt pockets.

As you build a list, the hanging brass spring scale and backpack cross-section update live. Carried items stack inside the pack silhouette with heavier items placed lower and block height scaled to item weight. Tap any block in the cross-section to inspect that item or change how it is carried.

Track four clear numbers for every trip:
- Base weight (carried non-consumable equipment)
- Worn weight (clothing, footwear, and poles worn on trail)
- Consumable weight (food, water, and stove fuel)
- Total weight on the scale

Set your own target base weight to see the exact numerical difference in grams or ounces. Open the Charts tab to inspect a custom category donut chart, a carry-type split bar, and a ranking of your heaviest individual items. Tap any segment to list the items inside it.

On packing day, switch to Pack Mode for a large-target checklist with progress tracking, item reordering, an unpacked-only filter, and an optional keep-screen-awake switch while you load your pack.

Everything stays on your device with no accounts, no cloud sync, and no tracking. Import existing gear spreadsheets via CSV with column mapping and error checking, or export any trip as a CSV file or a printable category-grouped PDF manifest through the system share sheet.

Gramtrail is a weight calculator and list tool only. It does not provide safety, fitness, or medical advice, and it does not suggest target pack weights.

name: GraphTrace
description:
Which tasks are affected if one slips, and who owns them? Open a project spreadsheet in GraphTrace, select a task and follow its dependencies back to the rows that created them.

IMPORT YOUR SPREADSHEETS
Bring in Tasks, People and Dependencies from CSV, TSV or Excel (.xlsx). Match your columns once. When two people share a name, choose the right person and GraphTrace remembers your choice for later imports.

TRACE A DEPENDENCY
Explore the spreadsheet beside its graph on Mac or a wide iPad. Select a row to highlight its item. Select a connection to see its name and source evidence. On iPhone, look up a task to see affected work, owners and how many steps away each task is.

REVIEW THE WEEK
Save a baseline before importing updated sheets. Compare which tasks and owners are newly affected. Insights help you spot circular dependencies, bottlenecks and work waiting on prerequisites. A what-if schedule lets you explore a delay using the durations you choose.

WORK OFFLINE
Your project stays on your device. Export a graph as an image or PDF, or transfer a project file to open a separate copy on another device. The built-in walkthrough includes a website launch project you can explore immediately.

GRAPHTRACE PLUS
The sample and one editable project are free. Plus lets you create and import additional projects. Existing projects remain accessible and exportable after a subscription ends.

Plus renews monthly. Eligible new subscribers receive a seven-day free trial, followed by the monthly price shown before purchase. Prices vary by storefront. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or billing period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account subscription settings.

Privacy Policy: https://springdatauk.github.io/graphtrace-pages/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: GraphWillow
description:
GraphWillow helps you build and understand small undirected weighted networks. Enter your own nodes and costs, solve a shortest route or connection forest, and keep the exact graph revision and algorithm decisions behind the result.

MAKE EACH CONNECTION EXPLICIT
Create a named graph, add uniquely labeled nodes and enter edges between different nodes. Costs accept zero and up to three decimal places. Zero represents a real connection; a dash in the adjacency matrix means no edge. Edit an existing pair instead of adding a parallel copy. Save your network deliberately, with unsaved-change choices when leaving the editor.

Use a movable canvas to understand the connections, or inspect the symmetric adjacency matrix in creation order. Tap a matrix cell to reach its endpoints. Changing a node's position changes its layout, not its identity or cost. An explicit practice action creates a labeled six-node, nine-edge teaching network.

SOLVE THE TASK YOU MEAN
Choose a saved revision in Solve. Dijkstra shortest path reports total exact cost, the reconstructed route and distances from the source, with unreachable nodes identified. Equal costs follow the displayed creation-order rule rather than an unexplained choice. Inspect the settle, improve and keep trace, step through it, and optionally highlight the current edge.

Kruskal minimum spanning forest connects each component with a minimum-cost tree, rejecting edges that would create a cycle. A disconnected graph retains its separate components and isolated nodes. Review selected edges, component membership, total cost and the accept/reject trace. Equal-weight choices follow a stated endpoint-order rule; other equally optimal answers can exist.

FREEZE A RESULT AND GENERATE FILES
Save a path or forest report with its independent graph snapshot. Editing or deleting the current network does not rewrite that report. In Report Detail, choose CSV tables, network JSON and/or a paginated PDF. Generate actual node, edge, result and trace tables, a structured network report and file-hash manifest. CSV text protection is identified while JSON retains original labels.

Reopen saved reports after restarting, preview the actual PDF and share the files you choose. Deleting a network keeps frozen reports; deleting a report removes its internal exports. About provides confirmed clearing of this app's networks, reports and outputs. Previously shared copies and system backups are separate. No app login is required for the native workspace.

CLEAR BOUNDS
Up to 40 nodes and 200 edges per graph. Labels are 1-16 characters and unique ignoring case. Costs range from 0 to 1,000,000, inclusive, in exact thousandths. Negative costs, self-loops, parallel edges and directed graphs are unsupported. Cost is an abstract value supplied by you, not geographic distance or navigation guidance.

name: Grass365!
description:
Grass365 is the field app for Grass365 teams, crews and franchise partners. Sign in with your Grass365 account to see the jobs you are working and keep each one up to date from the site.

MY JOBS
Your open jobs, nearest first, with status, dates and distance.

UPDATES
Add photos, video and notes to a job in a couple of taps. Mark up a photo to point something out. Reply to any update.

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
Updates are saved on the phone and sent when you are back in range. Nothing is lost.

WHO SEES IT
Choose team only, team and crew, or everyone on the project.

CHECK IN AND OUT
Note when you arrive at a site and when you leave, with one tap, or automatically if you turn on Record site visits.

PEOPLE
Call the customer, the crew lead or the office with one tap, and see who is on site.

DIRECTIONS
Open the job's address in Maps.

A Grass365 account is required. This app is for Grass365 staff, crews and partners.

name: GrilloCOM
description:
GrilloCOM is a private app just for your family. Chat, share photos, plan dinners and trips, and see who's where, all in one place that only your family can see.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your family's messages, photos, videos, voice messages, files and shared locations are end-to-end encrypted. Only your family's phones can read them. Not even we can.

ONE HOME FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• A family Home page with everyone's status, what's coming up, birthdays and weather for each home
• A family chat plus private chats, with photos, voice messages, reactions and replies
• Events everyone can RSVP to, with reminders
• Shared lists for groceries, chores and packing
• Countdowns, polls and "Let GrilloCOM pick"

KNOW EVERYONE GOT THERE
• Check In: let the family know you're home safe
• A family map with arrival alerts, only when you choose to share
• Flight tracking: see when a family member's plane takes off and lands

KEEP WHAT MATTERS
• Shared photo albums and memories from past years
• Wish lists, so gifts stay a surprise
• Family Info for Wi-Fi, doctors and emergency numbers

MADE FOR EVERY AGE
Big, clear text, simple help pages, and support for iPhone Text Size, Bold Text, Reduce Motion and VoiceOver.

description:
Groove Seat keeps each board on this iPhone.

name: GuideToVegetables
description:
中国蔬菜大全 —— 一百二十一种菜，一个一个讲清楚

中国蔬菜大全，117 种中国蔬菜，按可食部位分成 10 个大类，每一种都配真实照片。

【怎么用】

• 图鉴：一张农时一览，十类 × 十二个月画成十条生长带，一眼看出哪个月该种什么；下面是十大类的实拍照片墙
• 分类：按可食部位分的十一类，点开就是这一类的全部条目
• 农事：十二个月的农事历，每月列出可播种、可定植、可收获的菜，当季重点病虫害与管理要点
• 我的：收藏、种植清单、图片来源与授权、隐私政策、意见反馈

【每一种菜都写清四件事】

• 生长环境：温度区间、昼夜温差、光照、土壤质地与 pH、湿度、连作与轮作、整地施肥、海拔与茬口
• 营养价值：每 100 克的成分含量、传统功效、适宜人群与需要当心的忌口
• 虫害防治：最常发生的几种病害与虫害，逐个写清发病条件、危害部位和防治办法（农业、物理、生物与低毒药剂）
• 种植心得：怎么选种、什么时候育苗最容易成活、哪些常见错误会让产量掉下来、采收与贮藏的要点，还有产地老农的农谚

【关于分类】

叶菜类、白菜甘蓝类、根茎类、瓜类、茄果类、豆类、葱蒜类、菌菇类、香辛叶类、山野特色——按吃的部位分，不按科属分。同类的菜脾气相近，管理办法也相近，照着做能少走弯路。

【关于农事历】

每月一张，标出这个月该播什么、该栽什么、该收什么，以及当季最容易犯的病害：霜霉病、软腐病、疫病、白粉病、灰霉病……每一条都写清什么时候高发、怎么防。

【素材说明】

本 App 的种植与营养文字全部原创编写；菜图全部是真实拍摄的蔬菜照片，来自开放版权图库，
每一张的作者与许可协议逐条列在「我的 → 图片来源与授权」里。本 App 不打包任何受版权保护的
第三方字体、音频或视频素材。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号，也不请求任何系统权限。你的收藏、种植清单与外观设置只存在你自己的
设备里，卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。

唯一的联网行为：启动时向我们的服务器发一条安装来源统计，用来判断这次安装归属哪个推广渠道。
请求里只有一个随机设备标识（存在本机钥匙串里）和一组设备参数，不含姓名、邮箱、电话、位置、
照片，也不含剪贴板内容。除此之外 App 完全离线，没有账号、没有云同步，也不推送。

唯一由你主动提交、会离开这台设备的内容，是你在「我的 → 意见反馈」里写下的那段文字。

【适合谁】

自己种菜的、想认全菜市场里那些菜的人、家里有阳台想种两盆的人，以及想知道一种菜到底是什么、
怎么长的、怎么防虫的人。

版本 1.0

name: Gurbani Scroll
description:
