Log a feed with the flour weight, the water weight and the room temperature. Haldan estimates when the starter will peak and when it next needs feeding, then shows where it sits in the cycle: Rising, Ready, Past peak or Hungry. The estimate follows the temperature you recorded — five hours at 24 °C, closer to seven in a cold kitchen — because the jar is not on a clock.

name: Haldyn
description:
Haldyn is a logbook for freshwater, planted and saltwater aquariums. Record a test, and each reading is checked against the comfortable band for that kind of water: pH, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, temperature, and salinity for a salt tank. Out-of-range values are marked, not hidden, so a drift is visible before it becomes a loss.

**A TREND, NOT A GUESS**

Seven readings in a row say more than any single one. The statistics screen charts nitrate over your last eight tests, shades the comfortable band behind the bars, and shows the average of the last four. The tank score folds readings, test age and water-change age into a single number you can watch.

name: Halfull
description:
Can you pour a cone to exactly half its volume?

Your eye judges by height — physics judges by volume. A cone tipped down is only half full at 79% of its height. Hold anywhere to open the lab tap, release when you think it is half full, and watch your vessel lift and pour straight into the measuring cylinder to reveal the truth.

HOW IT PLAYS
• One-finger control: press and hold to pour, release to stop.
• Realistic decant animation: watch your pour stream from the rim into a calibrated measuring cylinder.
• Instant visual lesson: ghost lines reveal where true half was and how far off your eye was.

TWO MODES
• Daily Challenge: five hand-picked vessels every day, the same set worldwide. Your five deviations add up to your day score — lower is better, like golf. Share your spoiler-free score card with friends.
• Endless Mode: stay within the margin to keep your streak alive. Beyond 1/2, face 1/4, 1/3, 2/3, 3/4, and “Match it” rounds where you pour the exact same amount into a completely different shape.

72 VESSELS TO DISCOVER
Pour into lab glassware, kitchen jugs, drinks of the world, garden containers, and curious shapes — from Erlenmeyer flasks and Chemex carafes to teapots, rubber boots, lava lamps, and oil lamps. Track your best accuracy and earn badges in the Collection Album.

FAIR & FOCUSED
• Play offline anytime, no account required.
• Optional one-time “Remove ads” purchase removes ads between runs and lets you retry without watching a video (supports Family Sharing).

Order food, ask the way, bargain or check in at a hotel, each with a mission. Or describe your own scenario, or rehearse an interview built from your resume.

Speaking, pronunciation and tones
• Every syllable is scored right on your iPhone
• See your pitch curve next to the model speaker
• Feedback on tones, initials and finals
• Tone pairs, minimal pairs, tongue twisters and shadowing

Pinyin and HSK course
Start from zero with a complete pinyin course, then follow the HSK 3.0 path from HSK 1 to HSK 6: 135 units, 561 lessons and 24 exercise types. The course covers 636 grammar points, 5,362 HSK words and 1,940 characters, all with audio.

Chinese characters
• Stroke order animation, then trace and write by hand with feedback
• 214 radicals and character components

Reading and listening
• 417 graded stories with pinyin above every character
• Show, hide or tone-color the pinyin; simplified or traditional characters
• Tap any word for its meaning; narrated audio with speed control
• 463 listening items: dialogues, announcements and dictation

Smart review and mock exams
Review with spaced repetition, 8 card modes and a mistakes notebook. Then take 96 timed mock tests in the real formats: HSK 3.0 levels 1-6 and speaking, HSK 2.0 levels 1-6, HSKK, TOCFL, YCT and BCT with official timers and a predicted score.

More ways to learn Mandarin
• 412 chengyu idioms, 120 culture articles, 40 classical poems and 600 everyday phrases
• Dictionary, translator and a camera scan to read Chinese text around you
• Daily goal, streaks, badges and reminders

Who it is for
Beginners starting from 你好, travelers to China, Taiwan or Singapore, HSK candidates, heritage learners and professionals. The interface is available in 20 languages. Lessons are explained in English; the AI tutor can also explain in your app language.

Free and Hanzoo Pro
Hanzoo is free to download. Free learners get the first chapter of the pinyin course and of each HSK level, a few minutes of tutor chat every day with any tutor, a set of free role-plays plus a daily scenario, daily reviews and pronunciation checks, and some stories, listening and mock tests. Hanzoo Pro unlocks the whole pinyin and HSK 1-6 course, unlimited tutor chat, every role-play, all mock exams, the full grammar and vocabulary and offline audio, and removes the daily limits. Choose weekly with a 7-day free trial, or yearly.

Start today and learn Chinese one conversation at a time.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

name: Haydi Namaza Net
seller_name: NEW FUTURE TECH BILISIM VE TEKNOLOJI HIZMETLERI LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Haydi Namaza Net; namaz vakitlerinden Kur'an ve hatim dinlemeye, sesli kitaplardan Ramazan imsakiyesine kadar ibadet hayatınızı kolaylaştıran tek bir uygulamadır. Reklam yoktur, üyelik zorunlu değildir.

VAAZ VE SOHBETLER

• Arka planda ve ekran kapalıyken dinleme, indirip internetsiz dinleme

SİYER-İ NEBİ
• Peygamber Efendimizin hayatını anlatan sesli ve yazılı içerikler
• Siyer bilgi yarışması ile öğrendiklerinizi eğlenerek pekiştirin

KERAHAT VAKİTLERİ VE NAFİLE NAMAZLAR
• Namaz kılınması mekruh olan kerahat vakitlerini öğrenin
• Sabah, kuşluk, öğle, ikindi, akşam, evvabin, yatsı ve teheccüd namazlarının vakitleri ve farzları

RAMAZAN MERKEZİ

• İslami e-kitaplar; yer imi, yazı boyutu ve gece modu ile rahat okuma

name: Haz Peak
description:
Haz Peak keeps one weld coupon on this iPhone.

Each indent stores a position and a Vickers hardness. The heat-affected zone starts at the fusion line and runs the HAZ width toward the base metal. The named indent is the hardest one inside that band. A harder indent outside the band stays on the coupon and is not named.

Moving the fusion line or the width changes which indent is named. Saved hardness does not change.

The last indent and the last coupon stay. Readings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: headsup: Tilt & Guess
description:
headsup is a fast, friendly guessing game for the people you're with. Hold your phone up to your forehead, let everyone else see the word, and guess it from their clues before time runs out.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick a deck and a round length: 30, 60 or 90 seconds.
- Hold the phone sideways at your forehead, screen facing your friends.
- They describe, gesture or act it out. Tilt down when you get it, tilt up to skip.
- When time is up, see a word-by-word recap of what you got and what you skipped.

EASY TOPICS EVERYONE KNOWS
Eight built-in decks with 40 cards each: Animals, Food & drink, Everyday things, Simple actions, Jobs, Sports & games, Places and Nature. Cards are short, familiar and fun to act out, so kids, grandparents and first-time players can all join in.

MAKE YOUR OWN DECKS
Write a deck of inside jokes, family names, holiday themes or class vocabulary. Your words stay exactly as you typed them.

MADE FOR REAL ROOMS
- Bold, extra-large cards that are easy to read from across the room.
- Steady tilt detection with a short reset between cards, so one nod never counts twice.
- Prefer tapping? Play with on-screen buttons instead of tilting.
- Sound and haptic feedback, both of which can be turned off.
- A round pauses automatically if you leave the app, and you can pick up where you left off.
- Share your score with one tap, or play again with the same deck.

ENGLISH AND CHINESE
The interface and built-in decks are available in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. The app follows your device language, and you can switch at any time in Settings.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking and no internet connection needed. Your decks, settings and last score are stored only on your device.

One purchase, everything included: all decks, custom decks and every feature. No in-app purchases.

name: Hearthbell
description:
Hearthbell keeps a household's due dates on the iPhone. It covers house jobs, garden jobs, cars, medication reminders, water, appointments, bills, subscriptions, and a yearly plan. There is no account. The app does not sell anything inside the app.

The bottom bar is Today, House, Garden, Automobile, Medications, Water, Appointments, Bills, Subscriptions, Yearly plan, and Profile. Today stays first. Profile stays last. You can reorder the middle sections and hide any of them. Hiding a section leaves its records on the device.

name: Heist Companion: GTA 6 Guide
description:
Heist Companion is an unofficial guide for the new open-world crime game on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Cheats, the story, money, police heat and the road to 100%, all in one app. It works offline.

CHEAT CODES
• All 61 cheats in one list, with the button inputs for PS5 or Xbox
• How to unlock each cheat, and what it turns off (trophies, saving)
• Filter by player, combat, vehicles and world, and star your favorites
• Mark each cheat as unlocked as you find it in game
• New codes are added as the community finds them, with an optional alert when one goes live

COUCH MODE
• Show any cheat on a big second screen, one button press at a time
• Prop your iPhone next to the TV and enter codes without pausing to read

MISSION TRACKER
• Every story mission, chapter by chapter
• Warnings before anything missable: saves to make, money to move, side missions that disappear
• Story progress always shows how far you've got

100% CHECKLIST
• Robberies, gang operations, collectibles and more, with counters for each
• Overall completion so you know what's left

GUIDES
• Money planner: the best earners for the chapter you're on
• Lose the cops: what every wanted star means, heat icons and escape tips
• Beginner tips, saving, gangs and a trophy roadmap

SHARE YOUR MILESTONES
• Finish a chapter or a category and get an achievement card
• Add your gamer name and share it with friends

BUILT FOR IPHONE DUO
• Unfold for side-by-side layouts: cheat steps next to your list, missions next to chapters
• Works folded on the cover screen too, and on every other iPhone

YOUR PROGRESS STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
• No account or login
• Export a backup of your progress and import it on another iPhone

Heist Companion is free with ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase turns them off for good.

Heist Companion is an unofficial fan-made guide. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto, GTA and related names are trademarks of their owners and are used here only to describe the game this guide covers. Cheat codes and guide content come from player reports and may change after game updates.

name: Helios GPS
description:
HELIOS GPS es la app oficial de Helios para monitorear tus vehículos y equipos GPS desde el celular, estés donde estés.

Con HELIOS GPS puedes:
• Ver tus vehículos en tiempo real en el mapa, con su estado en colores: en movimiento, ralentí, estacionado o desconectado.
• Revisar el historial de recorridos y reproducir rutas.
• Recibir notificaciones al instante: encendido y apagado, exceso de velocidad, entrada y salida de geocercas y más.
• Generar reportes en PDF o Excel y compartirlos.
• Bloquear y desbloquear tu vehículo y activar el parqueo seguro (si tu plan lo incluye).
• Compartir la ubicación en tiempo real con un enlace.
• Ver el video en vivo de tus cámaras (si tu plan lo incluye).

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta del servicio de rastreo de Helios. Si todavía no la tienes, contáctanos:
 · fisidro@outlook.es

name: Helix: Private Family Network
description:
Helix is a private home for your family’s story: who you come from, what they were like, and the moments worth keeping.

• Build your family tree together, and see it as a family tree or as the Family Pie, a wheel of everyone around you
• Give every person a profile with photos from each stage of life, their story, favorite quotes, and how couples met
• Leave notes for someone: encouragement, a memory, a funny moment, with a photo or a recorded voice note
• Seal a note as a time capsule that opens on a day you choose
• Share photo albums and tag who’s in each picture
• Keep the family cookbook, with the story behind each recipe
• Remember birthdays, anniversaries and big family events, and see what happened on this day
• Record an interview with a relative, and Helix can turn it into text and suggest story highlights for you to review
• Invite relatives with a link. Each family line sees its own side, and Private notes stay between the writer and the person they’re for

Helix is private to your family. No ads, no tracking.

name: Hello, Sarasota!
description:
Hello, Sarasota! This is a local's guide to what is happening in Sarasota, Florida. It lists upcoming events from more than a hundred local organizations: theatres, music, galleries, festivals, parks, libraries, game shops, volunteer days and more.

FIND SOMETHING TO DO
• See what is on today, tomorrow or this weekend.
• Switch to the month calendar to see how many events each day has, and tap a day to see them.
• Filter by kind: stage and screen, music, art, festivals and food, community, family, outdoors, games, tech, volunteering.
• Show only free events, or events that suit a date night, kids, seniors, pets, a sensory-friendly outing or going solo.
• Search by event, venue or organization.

SAVE EVENTS AND STAY INFORMED
• Save an event and get a reminder the evening before and two hours before it starts.
• Get an alert if a saved event is cancelled, postponed or sold out, or if its date, time or place changes.
• Follow an organization and get an alert when it adds events.
• Tap I'm Going on an event and see how many others are going.
• Add any event to your calendar, open the organizer's page for tickets, get directions, or share it.

MORE OF THE CITY
• Every organization has its own page with what it does and what it has coming up.
• Weekly regulars: markets, tours, open mics and game nights.
• A short list of things to do, and nine short histories of the city.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account and no sign-in. The app collects nothing about you. Your saved events, the organizations you follow and your settings stay on your device. Tapping I'm Going adds one to a shared count and sends nothing else.

Events come from each organization's own calendar. Dates shift, so always confirm with the organizer before making plans.

name: Helpful Home
description:
Helpful Home is the companion app for customers of Helpful Home Property Management, a handyman and property maintenance company serving Hunterdon County and the Morristown area in New Jersey.

Instead of texts, voicemails and lost notes, everything about your property's upkeep lives in one place: what you've asked for, when it's scheduled, and what's been done.

SEND A REQUEST IN SECONDS
• Snap a photo of the problem and send it. Add the details now or later.
• Describe the job, set how urgent it is, and add a due date if there's a deadline.
• Attach links, such as a product page or the furniture you need assembled.

FOLLOW EVERY JOB
• See when a request is received, scheduled, in progress and completed.
• Get a notification when Helpful Home schedules or updates your request.
• Every change is logged, so you always know where things stand.

SEASONAL MAINTENANCE CHECKLISTS
• Get spring, summer, fall and winter checklists suggested for your home.
• Tick the items you want done and send them as requests with one tap.

ALL YOUR PROPERTIES
• Manage your home, rentals, vacation homes and commercial properties from one account.
• Invite a tenant, spouse, family member or property manager to a property so they can send and follow requests too.
• Hand a property over to a new owner when it changes hands.

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• Sign in with your Apple or Google account. There are no ads.
• Your information is used only to handle your maintenance requests and is never sold.
• Delete your account anytime from your profile.

The app is for Helpful Home Property Management customers. Questions or want to become a customer? Email info@helpfulhomepm.com.

name: Herdkin
description:
Herdkin is an offline-first cattle and ranch management app built on a working family cattle operation. Sign in once, download your herd to encrypted on-device storage, and record every animal, chute weight, calf, treatment, task, and equipment service without needing cell bars in the pasture or working alley.

CHUTE-SIDE & PASTURE CATTLE RECORDS (100% OFFLINE)
• Complete herd inventory by class: cows, bulls, replacement heifers, steer calves, bull calves, and heifer calves
• Fast ear-tag, mother-tag, color, pasture location, Angus registration, and 15-digit 840 electronic ID (EID) lookup
• Optional Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) stick-reader pairing for 134.2 kHz ISO 11784/11785 EID wands in the alley or chute
• Chute-side weighing with automatic Average Daily Gain (ADG) and weight history tracking
• Field calving records linking dam, sire, birth weight, calf sex, and calving notes
• Herd health, vaccination protocols, batch treatments, and meat/milk withdrawal tracking
• Breeding soundness, AI/bull exposure records, cull watchlists, and sale lot history

CREW WORK, EQUIPMENT & RANCH OPERATIONS
• Shared farm work tasks, priority queues, crew assignments, and hours tracking
• Tractor, loader, baler, and chute equipment maintenance schedules by engine hours or calendar intervals
• Live USDA cattle and regional hay market price reference charts
• Multi-device background synchronization when you return to Wi-Fi or cellular coverage

name: Heritage Shiori
description:
Explore Japan's 27 UNESCO World Heritage Sites in a list and on a map.
Pick a site and get a one-day plan right away: highlights in order of distance, with lunch included.
Japan has 27 World Heritage Sites, yet few people know where they are or how to see them in a day. This app was made to help you plan without stress.

- List and map of all 27 sites, with short descriptions in English and Japanese and a "visited" mark
- One-day plans for each area, with visit times, travel times (walk / train or car) and lunch
- Set times in 5-minute steps, reorder or remove stops; get warnings when a visit is too short or entry closes
- Search nearby restaurants, cafés, sights and souvenir shops with Apple Maps and add them
- Opening hours and closing days for each stop, seasonal closures, and quick links to official sites

Pricing: descriptions, visited marks and the map are free for all 27 sites. You can use one plan for free (Himeji Castle, Atomic Bomb Dome, Itsukushima Shrine, Nikko or Shirakawa-go). A one-time purchase (JPY 500 or local equivalent) unlocks all plans. No subscription.

Times are estimates. Opening hours can change; please check official websites before you go.
Privacy: no location, no accounts, no ads, no analytics. Your data stays on your iPhone.

name: HEXALUNE
description:
빛나는 결정 행성 사이로 날아오르세요.
HEXALUNE은 한 손으로 즐기는 세로 비행 슈팅 게임입니다.

■ 10개의 행성, 10명의 보스
노을 성운에서 사건의 지평선까지, 행성마다 배경과 적, 기믹이 모두 다릅니다.
스테이지마다 2분을 버티면 보스가 나타나고, 페이즈가 바뀔 때마다 탄막이 거세집니다.
중간 보스를 격파하면 보급 룰렛으로 강화를 받습니다.
■ 나만의 편대
기체 8종, 파일럿 8명, 주무기 12종, 윙맨 8종을 골라 조합합니다.
파일럿마다 패시브·필살기·고유 스킬이 달라서 같은 무기라도 손맛이 달라집니다.
전투 중에는 레벨업 카드 3장 중 하나를 골라 빌드를 키우고,
모은 골드로 공격·배율·치명타·장갑·보호·흡수 6가지 스탯을 영구 강화합니다.

■ 5가지 모드, 3가지 난이도
· 스테이지 — 10개 행성을 차례로 돌파
· 무한 모드 — 10개 구역을 계속 순환하며 기록에 도전
· 보스 챌린지 — 보스 10종이 연속으로 등장
· 이클립스 — 모든 빛이 꺼진 뒤 깨어나는 진 최종 보스, 5페이즈
· 일일 행성 — 매일 바뀌는 행성에서 지형 돌파와 탄막 회피에 도전
노멀·하드·엑스퍼트 난이도로 같은 행성을 더 세게 즐길 수 있습니다.
■ 한 손 조작
화면을 끌면 기체가 손가락을 따라옵니다. 조이스틱 방식도 고를 수 있어요.
주무기와 윙맨은 자동으로 쏘고, 오른쪽 아래 버튼으로 필살기를 씁니다.
가만히 쏘고 있으면 파일럿 고유 스킬 게이지가 차오릅니다.
기체 가운데 작은 점이 판정이라 탄막 사이를 아슬아슬하게 지나갈 수 있습니다.

■ 광고 없음, 추가 결제 없음
한 번 구입하면 모든 콘텐츠를 광고 없이 즐길 수 있습니다.
인터넷 연결 없이도 플레이할 수 있고, 계정 가입도 필요 없습니다.

※ 진행 기록은 기기에만 저장되며, 앱을 삭제하면 함께 삭제됩니다.

name: Hinge Mahjong
description:
Under a coral moon, a paper crane opens a quiet table of mahjong tiles. None of them can be picked up. You fold, swing and strike them into place instead.

Hinge Mahjong is not another tap-two-tiles game. Each of its three mechanisms moves tiles in a different way, and each one asks you to think a move ahead.

BOOK FOLD
Tap a leaf to preview the fold. Landing frames show where every tile will go: gold tiles will pair, red tiles will clash. Tap again to fold the leaf over like a page. Matching faces clear, and a mismatch bounces the leaf back.

HINGE RELOCATION
Tap a free socket to move the hinge pin, then swing the arm. When all three pads land on matching tiles, the triplet clears. Sockets hidden under tiles open only after those tiles are gone, so the order matters.

SPRING FLAP
Tap a stop on the outer ring to aim the flap, then drag the lever down to load the spring and let go to strike. Gold stops accept only a narrow window of tension, so every release counts.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 54 hand-checked levels, 18 per mechanism, each with a verified solution
• A short, playable lesson for every mechanism that you can replay at any time
• Unlimited undo and restart, plus two solver hints per level that light up one good move
• Up to three stars for clean, efficient solutions
• A Tile Atlas of all 34 classic tiles, filled in as you clear them
• 14 achievements earned through play, never bought
• High contrast, reduced motion and on-board interaction guides
• Layouts made for small and large iPhones and for iPhone Duo, folded or opened

name: Hit Rope Monster
description: A casual mobile game. You guide a little monster up a vertical level while it drags a friend hanging from a rope: dodge traps and enemies, collect coins and keep climbing before the acid catches you.

name: Hitched! Caravan Parking
description:
Reversing a caravan? No problem!

In Hitched! you park your rig with just one thumb: up drives forward, down reverses, sideways steers. A dashed trail shows where the caravan will swing. You’ll still break a sweat, just like on a real campsite.

11 CAMPSITES, 165 LEVELS
Woodland camping, a lakeside slipway, sloping mountain pitches, festival mud, an icy winter site, a ferry port against the clock, tight old-town alleys, a farm with barns and chickens, motorway services between lorries, an Alpine pass full of hairpins and the North Sea coast with its tide.

HIT THE MOTORWAY
Speed towards the exit, brake in time, then park it neatly.

YOUR GARAGE
9 cars and 8 trailers: from teardrop to twin-axle, from a classic camper to a mini wheel loader. Plus paint jobs, roof boxes, kayaks, bike racks, awnings and upgrades.

33 JOBS
Customers need exactly the right trailer: the boat under the height barrier into the boathouse, the chip van through the narrow town gate, the horses into the stable. Plus old-town alleys where every inch counts.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
Three missions a day with a weekly chest, a daily challenge with an online leaderboard, daily bonus and the Endless Tour. Every trailer levels up, and in the stamp book you collect every trailer at every campsite. Plus achievements and a career from rookie to camping legend.

MOTOR MOVER
Too tight? With the mover you push the caravan on its own and turn it on the spot.

- Fair: everything can be earned without paying. Ads are optional for bonuses, plus the occasional short break between levels. Premium removes the ad breaks.
- Real towing physics: drawbar, jackknife angle, surfaces and slopes.
- Levels work without an internet connection.

Whether you’re a seasoned camper or a caravan beginner: learn to reverse without anyone shouting “left! No, the other left!”

name: Hizashi
description:
Hizashi is a language app for learners who mean it: English, Japanese, Chinese and Korean in one place. Follow a daily study path, take mock tests and get AI feedback on your writing and speaking - no need for a separate app for every language.

FOUR LANGUAGES, ONE ACCOUNT
• English: vocabulary, grammar, listening and speaking by CEFR level A1-C2; IELTS and TOEIC practice.
• Japanese: kana, kanji, vocabulary and grammar by JLPT level N5-N1; write kanji in the correct stroke order.
• Chinese: vocabulary and grammar by HSK level.
• Korean: Hangul, vocabulary, grammar and TOPIK practice.
• Switch subjects in one tap; each subject keeps its own progress.

A DAILY STUDY PATH
• Each level is a stage, and each day brings one study sheet sized for a day: new words, grammar, listening, speaking and review.
• Always know what to study today, how far you have come and how long until the next level.
• Start from zero or jump straight to your level.

MOCK TESTS FOR SIX EXAMS
• IELTS, TOEIC, CEFR, HSK, TOPIK and JLPT - practice tests written by Hizashi to follow each exam's format.
• Timed tests, answers with explanations, and a history of every attempt.

AI FEEDBACK ON WRITING AND SPEAKING
• Submit an essay or record a spoken answer and get an estimated score for each criterion within minutes.
• Speaking: replay each sentence, see unclear words, fillers and speaking pace, with model answers.
• Writing: see mistakes, sentence-by-sentence fixes and a model answer one level higher.

VOCABULARY AND GRAMMAR THAT STICK
• Flashcards scheduled with the FSRS algorithm: hard cards return sooner, known cards space out.
• Ready-made decks by JLPT, HSK and CEFR level, or build your own.
• Dictionary and grammar with examples and audio.
• A flashcard widget on your home screen.

YOUR OWN STUDY SPACE
• A 3D study room with a slime companion, decorated your way.
• A Pomodoro timer for focus, and boards for handwriting, diagrams and notes.
• An audio player for lessons and vocabulary that keeps playing with the screen off.

APP LANGUAGES
Vietnamese, English, Japanese, Indonesian, Filipino, Burmese and Nepali.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free to start: alphabets and pronunciation warm-ups, a third of the study sheets on every stage, the first two tests of each mock-test type and 30 AI credits a month. Premium unlocks all content in all four subjects, adds more AI grading and removes ads. Ultra adds the largest AI allowance and a fast speaking-grading lane.

Terms of Use: https://hizashi.app/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://hizashi.app/privacy-policy/

IELTS, TOEIC, HSK, JLPT, TOPIK and CEFR are exams or frameworks owned by their respective organizations. Hizashi is not affiliated with them. Mock tests are written by Hizashi; AI scores are estimates for practice, not official exam results.

name: Hlaneopt
description:
Hlaneopt keep the bills that renew on their own. See what they add up to each month, which ones are still active, and which ones come due in the next few days. Pause a bill, mark it cancelled, or open the month and read the cash that lands there. A yearly bill makes its month taller. Nothing is charged. The figures are the ones you type.

Then keep the once-a-year split of a shared house. Enter the costs — tax, water, insurance, the stair, the garden — and choose how each one is shared: by living area, by the people in the flat, equally, or by use. The owner can keep a holdback. Each flat can have already paid an advance, and someone who lived only part of the year carries a smaller weight. Folio House adds the shares, takes off the advances, and shows who is in credit and who still has a balance due.

Read the same note as a paper page, share it as a PDF made on the device, and seal it when the year is finished. A reminder can be set locally for next year’s note. The household list is a template. A sealed year keeps its own copy.

Linden House is already on the first page, so you can see a full year before you change a single figure. Your name is only a greeting. Euro, dollar, or pound. One ledger file, stored in the app’s private folder. No account, no bank connection, and no network. Uninstalling the app removes the file with it.

Folio House does not move money. It is not a bank, a tax office, or a bill from a court.

name: HoleHarbor
description:
Plan numbered hole centers, inspect their geometry, and keep a reproducible report.

HoleHarbor builds Circle, Line and Grid patterns from dimensions you enter in millimetres. Give a pattern a name, define its workpiece and hole diameter, then set the layout parameters. A proportionate drawing and complete coordinate list keep the same bottom-left origin, positive x to the right and positive y upward.

INSPECT THE LAYOUT
Pan or zoom the drawing without changing the saved coordinates. Select a numbered hole to inspect x/y, all four edge margins and its nearest neighbor. Previous and Next let you visit the other holes. The Coordinate Guide explains numbering, axes and SVG coordinate mapping.

CHECK THE GEOMETRY
Choose the pattern explicitly in Checks. Review outside holes, overlaps and your requested edge-margin findings, then open the affected hole. The checks describe the stated geometric rules; they are not manufacturing approval.

SAVE AN INDEPENDENT REPORT
Choose numbering, center marks and diagnostic marks in Export Setup. Freeze and generate a CSV, SVG or PDF file from an independent snapshot. Report Detail shows the actual filename, byte count and SHA256, with file generation, PDF preview and system sharing. Source edits or deletion leave frozen reports intact. Search and reopen patterns and reports, duplicate a pattern, or delete selected items with confirmation.

SCOPE AND LIMITS
Up to 200 holes per pattern. Grid rows and columns are each 1–100, with at most 200 holes in total. Workpiece dimensions are 1–10000mm and hole diameter 0.1–100mm. ASCII decimal inputs have at most three places; coordinates remain within ±20000mm and angles satisfy angles from 0 degrees (inclusive) to 360 degrees (exclusive). The display uses six decimals while checks use unrounded geometry with a 0.000001mm tangency tolerance.

HoleHarbor is a geometry tool. It does not control machinery, produce machining code, certify clearances or promise 1:1 printing. PDF output fits the page. Sharing is your explicit choice. About provides privacy information, a confirmed clear action and access to restoring the last validated library backup.

name: Home Waters
description:
Home Waters is a quiet fly fishing game for people who love moving water.

Wade into five rivers of eastern Idaho: the Henry's Fork, the South Fork of the Snake, the Teton, the Fall, and Warm River. Each one has its own skyline, its own riverbed, and its own mix of trout.

THE CAST
Casting is all timing. Stroke, pause while the loop unrolls, and stroke again. Clean false casts carry more line. Rush it and the loop collapses.

THE TAKE
Watch the fish rise from below the surface. Drift a dry fly over a feeding trout, set when the indicator dips on a nymph rig, or swim a streamer past a big brown and strip it home.

THE FIGHT
Reel when he rests and let him run when he bolts. Light tippet draws more takes and breaks sooner. Big fish run longer and harder, and you will feel every head shake.

WHAT'S IN THE BOX
• Five rivers, each painted by hand in pixel art
• Five times of day, from dawn to moonlight, each with its own hatch
• Dry flies, a hopper, a mouse, a nymph rig, and a streamer
• Tippet from 1X to 6X
• Rainbow, brown, brook, Yellowstone cutthroat, cutbow, and mountain whitefish
• One river legend hiding in each river, showing only in the right light
• Six anglers, each with their own way of releasing a fish
• A fishing log and trophy wall
• Original music and river sounds
• Haptics for the take, the run, and the strain on the line
• Idle mode: set it down and let it fish

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No data collected. Pay once and it is yours. Plays fully offline.

Every fish goes back.

name: Hometown: City Builder
description:
Hometown is a city-builder on the real map of a real place, made of paper.

Pick one of more than a hundred towns from around the world, or search for your own: Hometown builds it on your phone from open map data. Its streets, rivers, coast and hills are the real ones, and so are its dangers. A river town floods. A dry town burns in summer. Towns on a fault line shake.

You are the mayor. Start as a village of sixteen homes, as a town, or as the city today.

• Open streets, and families come to live on them.
• Build markets, schools, clinics, fire watches and parks where they are needed.
• Districts ask for things. Keep your promises: they vote every four years.
• Beat out fires, build walls against the water, dig families out after a quake.
• Pass laws, start big works like trams, metros and embankments, and build your town's own landmarks.
• Grow from a few dozen people to millions, over thirty years and more.

The weather and dangers of every town come from real records: ten years of daily weather, a century of earthquakes and decades of storm tracks.

Everything is drawn as cut paper: little houses that grow, trees, water and seasons. The music follows your town, its seasons and its troubles.

Made to play with one hand. No ads and no account. Starting as a village, your first term (four years) is free in every town; one purchase unlocks every year after, and starting as a town or as today's city.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Weather by Open-Meteo.com and NASA POWER. Earthquakes from the USGS. Storms from NOAA IBTrACS.

name: HookedBooks
description:
HookedBooks is a simple, distraction-free reading app. Every book comes with the app, so you can read anytime, anywhere — even without an internet connection.

Enjoy timeless classics like Pride and Prejudice, The Hound of the Baskervilles, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, Dracula and Treasure Island, carefully formatted for comfortable reading — plus original stories you won't find anywhere else.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 20+ books across mystery, sci-fi, fantasy, horror, adventure, romance and more
• Classic literature from the public domain, cleanly formatted with chapters
• HookedBooks Originals — short novels written for this app

COMFORTABLE READING
• Real page-by-page reading: tap or swipe to turn pages
• Adjust font size, line spacing, background theme and brightness
• Night mode for reading in the dark
• Jump to any chapter from the table of contents

YOUR LIBRARY
• Add books to your shelf and pick up right where you left off
• Bookmark your favorite pages and jump back anytime
• Reading history and reading time stats
• Browse by genre or search by title, author or genre

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account or sign-up needed
• No ads, no tracking
• Your shelf, progress and bookmarks stay on your iPhone

Questions or ideas? Tap Me → Feedback in the app. We'd love to hear from you.

name: Hoop Heights: Fun Basketball
description:
Hoop Heights is a quick, cheerful basketball game played three against three on rooftop courts high above thirty cities. Your team always shoots at the top basket. Win the ball and the whole court flips over in a blink, so the action keeps running up the screen.

THREE ON THREE, UP THE SCREEN
Drag one thumb to drive, tap a teammate to pass, then hold and release to shoot. Get close enough and the shot becomes a dunk. On defense, reach in for a steal or leap for a block, then watch the court turn your way.

CALL THE PLAY
Before each quarter your crew huddles up: Pick and Roll, Give and Go, Solo or Swing on offense, and Shadow, Wall or Swarm on defense. In Coach mode you make every call while your players do the running. Or sit back in Watch mode and let two computer teams play it out.

THIRTY ROOFTOP CREWS
Teapots from Boston, Taxis from New York and twenty-eight more, each with a mascot, colors and its own mix of inside scoring, outside shooting, defense and speed.

PLAY A FRIEND
Two devices in the same room can play over a local connection, or meet through Game Center. One plays home, one plays away, and both see their own team attacking the top.

HELP FOR NEW PLAYERS
Rookie Help turns every shot into a simple tap, slows the free-throw needle and keeps fouls off your side. Switch it off and try All-Star when you feel ready.

GENTLE ON THE EARS
A zebra referee named Stripes, bouncy sounds, a soft crowd and a happy little tune when you win. A miss gets an "ooh" from the crowd, never a buzzer.

FREE, ALL OF IT
Every team and mode is included, with no ads and no sign-up. Saved games stay on this device. If you enjoy the rooftops, you can leave an optional tip in Settings. Tips unlock nothing.

Hoop Heights comes from a small independent studio. Its teams, mascots and courts were all invented for this game.

name: Hooper: Basketball Life Sim
description:
Hooper is a basketball life simulator. Start as a kid with a ball and a dream, and live every step of the journey: youth leagues, high school, college, the draft, a pro career, retirement and beyond.

BUILD A LEGEND
Create your player, pick an origin and grow your skills season by season. Train, rest, find mentors and earn your shot.

OWN THE BIG SHOT
Clutch moments are in your hands. Time your release, thread the pass and make the play when the game is on the line.

LIVE EVERY GAME
Make the calls that swing the result, earn minutes, fight for a starting spot and chase MVPs, All-Star nods and championships.

LIVE A WHOLE LIFE
Love, family, friends, money and fame. Sign contracts and endorsements, buy homes, handle the media and decide what kind of person you become.

THEN RUN THE BENCH
When your playing days end, retire into coaching and build a dynasty.

PLAY FREE, NO ADS
The full career, birth to retirement, is free. Optional packs, Hoop Coins and the VIP subscription speed things up or add extra systems. No ads, no loot boxes, no random paid rewards. All players, teams and leagues are fictional.

HOOPER VIP (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
VIP gives 2x training energy, a Hoop Coins stipend, Coach's Eye and a free weekly energy refill while active.
- VIP Weekly: $2.99 per week.
- VIP Monthly: $7.99 per month, with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers.
Prices are in USD and may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or when the free trial ends). The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://hooper-app.vercel.app/privacy

Hooper is made by Kamario Games Studio: https://kamario.games/studio/

name: Hoopjot: Basketball Stats
description:
Hoopjot keeps basketball stats while the game is on, so you can watch it instead of writing on paper.

TAP A PLAYER, THEN A STAT
Big keys for 2PT, 3PT, free throws, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers and fouls. Tap the stat first if that is quicker. Tapped the wrong kid? Undo is one big button.

BUILT FOR THE BENCH
Track your whole team, or just your own kid. Count the other team's points and fouls by quarter. Team fouls, bonus and foul-outs follow the rules you pick: youth, rec league, college style, international or pro style.

THE BOX SCORE BUILDS ITSELF
Points by quarter, a full player table with field goals, threes, free throws, rebounds, assists and more. Share it as an image with the team in one tap. Edit any play afterward if you missed one.

SEASON STATS AND HIGHS
Averages for every player, team leaders, a points chart by game, career highs and milestones.

FREE STAYS FREE
One team, unlimited games, players and seasons, the full box score and image sharing cost nothing.

HOOPJOT PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION)
More than one team, plus-minus, shot charts for a game or the whole season, and PDF and CSV export. Pay once and keep it, shared with your family.

YOUR DATA
No account. Works offline. Optional iCloud sync with your own iCloud.

Hoopjot is not affiliated with any league, brand or governing body.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Hoplume
description:
Ten glass marbles wait in your point of the star. Get every one of them into the point opposite before anyone else does — and find the long jump chains that carry a marble halfway across the board in a single turn.

HOW A TURN WORKS
Tap one of your marbles and glowing rings show where it can go. Step into a neighbouring hole, or jump over any marble, yours or a rival's, into the empty hole behind it. Land, and if another jump is open, keep going. Nothing is ever captured; jumped marbles stay where they are, so every crowded corner is a ladder you can climb. The first player with all ten marbles home crosses first.

THE BOARD
A full six-pointed star with 121 holes: a 61-hole centre and six points of ten. Each seat gets its own colour — Coral, Sky, Amber, Mint, Violet and Rose — and the star fills in for 2, 3, 4 or 6 players.

VERSUS BOTS
Sit at the star against 1, 2, 3 or 5 computer opponents and choose their strength:
• Easy plays loosely and leaves openings.
• Medium pushes steadily towards its target point.
• Hard looks a move ahead and builds its own jump routes.
The bots move with a short pause, so you can follow every hop they make.

PASS & PLAY
One phone, up to six people. Each seat is a human player; the board shows whose turn it is and how many marbles each colour already has home.

AFTER EVERY MATCH
A results card ranks the table by marbles home, counts the moves played and offers an instant rematch. The History page keeps your last 20 matches with player count, opponents and move totals, and the hub tracks matches played, times you crossed first and your longest jump chain.

12 TROPHIES
From First Crossing to Chain of Seven, Hundred Hops, Full Star and Swift Line (finish first in 40 of your own moves or fewer), each trophy glows once you earn it.

BOARD-GAME LORE QUIZ
Ten questions per round from 24 facts about Halma, Stern-Halma and the star board's relatives — who invented Halma, why "Chinese checkers" is really German, how many holes the star has — with a short note after every answer.

CALM BY DESIGN
Glass orbs drift behind a deep night sky (you can switch the animation off), soft haptics confirm each landing, and the whole game runs offline with no account, no adverts and no purchases.

Pick a seat, find the chain, hop across the star.

name: HotSpot - What's On Now
description:
HotSpot shows where people are gathering right now and what's happening nearby, on one map.

Made for travelers visiting Japan and anyone who wants to find something fun today.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See busy areas on the map, colored from lively to packed
• Find events, pop-ups, exhibitions, live shows and festivals happening now, today, or in the next two weeks
• Search any place or event, or jump to popular areas like Shibuya, Shinjuku, Asakusa, Namba and Gion
• Read what people are posting on social media about each spot
• Get there easily: walking or transit directions, Google Maps, and a card with the address in Japanese to show a taxi driver
• Add events to your calendar and save favorite spots and areas
• Use it in English, Japanese, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, French or German

PRIVACY FIRST
No account needed. Your location is used only while the app is open, rounded to about 150 m and sent with an anonymous ID that changes every day. It is deleted from our server after 2 hours, and areas are shown only when at least 5 people are there.

Crowd levels are estimates based on places, time of day, social activity and anonymous reports. Event details come from public web pages and may change, so check the official site before you go.

Privacy Policy: https://kotomori.app/en/hotspot/privacy
Support: https://kotomori.app/en/hotspot/support

name: HOXROCKS
description:
HOXROCKS gives your business a digital way of working.

See every job, every moment of the day. Give your team the HOXROCKS app and immediately gain clear visibility of your mobile workforce.

• Fill in your organisation's forms on site, with photos, signatures, barcodes and location
• Work offline: everything is saved on the phone and sent the moment there is signal
• See your jobs and tasks, update their progress and finish them in the field
• Message the office and get notified the moment a job changes

No more filing cabinets: every completed job is stored online and found in seconds from your HOXROCKS dashboard.

Sign in with the account your organisation's administrator created for you.

name: HRMS-Techworld
description: HRMS-Techworld is an employee management application that allows staff to check attendance, apply leave, view payslips, submit requests, and receive notifications. Designed for seamless HR processes and easy access on mobile.

name: HSGC Algo
description:
Keep everyday vehicle records in one place. Add entries as you go, find previous activity, and look at trends over the period you choose. Review monthly spending, see upcoming tasks alongside your records, and export a copy when you need it.

HSGC Algo works offline and stores your garage on your device. It is free to use and works without an account.

name: HSGC One
description:
Bring the records and dates you rely on into one place. See what needs attention, add an entry as it happens, and find related notes and documents when you need them.

Review monthly and cumulative trends, narrow a report to the records that matter, and open the entries behind a total. Keep a report for your own files or share it with someone you choose.

Your records are stored on your device. HSGC One supports local reminders and password-protected backups and adapts to iPhone, iPad, and the inner and outer displays of iPhone Duo.

name: Hummania: Rhythm Sing Along
description:
Notes float up to a clay toy singer's mouth. Tap, hold and swipe on the beat and it sings every note. The longer your combo, the weirder it gets.

SING ON THE BEAT
• Tap, hold, swipe and roll: four kinds of notes, quick to learn
• Hold a long note and the singer's head swells until it pops
• No game over: the song never stops, so you can always enjoy the show
• Easy, Normal and Hard charts for every song

THE WEIRDER THE BETTER
• Every phrase brings a different toy singer
• Keep the combo going for giant heads, long necks, stacked heads and extra arms
• Choirs of toys join in on the chorus, and SHOW TIME lets your singer dance solo

15 SONGS, 12 STYLES
• Pop, disco, lo-fi, chiptune, samba, reggae, rock, zither, swing, tango, trap and drum & bass
• Travel from the Little Club to the Rooftop and the Moon Pier
• Go for an S rank and a Full Combo on every chart

COLLECT YOUR AUDIENCE
• Meet 21 kinds of toys and 24 special guests
• A different guest drops by every day
• Every venue fills an album as you clear its songs

SHARE THE WEIRDNESS
• Save a clip of your run and send it to friends

Plays offline. No ads. Play in English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español, Français.

name: Hump Throw
description:
Hump Throw keeps one lump of clay on this iPhone.

Spin the wheel, then press the hump across the center. A still wheel does not center the clay. Open only after it is centered, or the clay is thrown off. After the floor stays, pull up to add one wall step. Pull down and the wall drops. A third pull cracks the rim and the height stays. Round the rim only when it is not cracked. Cut the crack to drop one step.

You can name the lump. You can delete it only before it lifts off. Share sends the name and whether it can lift off. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Hundeführerschein Training
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zur IHK, zu einer Behörde oder zu einem Hundeverband.

In mehreren Bundesländern brauchst du für bestimmte Hunde oder schon für den ersten Hund einen Sachkundenachweis, oft Hundeführerschein genannt. Mit Hundeführerschein Training lernst du das Wissen für die theoretische Sachkundeprüfung und bereitest dich auf die praktische Prüfung und das Fachgespräch vor.

Das lernst du in der App:
- Verhalten, Erziehung und die Beziehung zwischen Mensch und Hund
- Hundetypen, Zucht und Haltung
- Anatomie, Gesundheit und Erste Hilfe
- Recht und Transport
- Ablauf der praktischen Prüfung und des Fachgesprächs

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- Sachkundenachweis Hund (IHK)
- Hundeführerschein Niedersachsen
- Praktische Prüfung und Fachgespräch
- Sachkunde für Hundetrainer nach § 11 Tierschutzgesetz
- Digitales Übungsheft zur Sachkundeprüfung Hund

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Prüfungsthemen
- Übungsfragen mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du noch Lücken hast
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin
- Eine Community mit anderen Hundehalterinnen und Hundehaltern

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Die Regeln zum Hundeführerschein legt jedes Bundesland selbst fest. Offizielle Informationen zum Hundeführerschein in Bremen findest du bei der Senatorin für Inneres und Sport: https://www.inneres.bremen.de/inneres/buerger-und-staat/hundefuehrerschein-30149

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: Hunt Play: Mine for Bucks
description:
Hunt Play is a free mining game with 22 quick Arcade games, made by the team behind Hunt Browser.

THE MINE
• Send your miners into six caves, from Copper Hill to the Fire Core.
• Come back when the timer ends and claim Coins, gems, ores and Bucks, the game's top points.
• Every lucky find shows its odds before you dig.
• Some runs hit a cave-in or a flooded tunnel. Wait, and it clears for free.
• Your phone tells you when your miners are back.

THE WORKSHOP
• Upgrade your miners, make gear from what you find, and swap finds with other players for Coins.

THE ARCADE: 22 QUICK GAMES
Gem Swap, Gold 2048, Bull Run, Cart Dash, Stack Bars, Mine Sweeper Pro, Market Words, Gem Solitaire, Daily Sudoku, Price Guess, Cave Ludo, Chess Blitz, Ore Sort, Vault Blocks, Rock Blast, Gem Trio, Gem Pop, Cart Train, Pipe Works, Pixel Dig, Gem Four and Claim Boxes.
• Worlds of 10 levels, with stars, keys and a vault to open.
• Today's pick and a daily high-score board.
• Practice: all 22 games are stored on your phone and play with no internet.

EVERY DAY
• Check in for a bigger chest on day 7 and finish daily quests.
• Climb a weekly league with players of your level.
• Invite friends with your code.

FAIR AND CALM
• Free to play. Nothing is sold in this app, and it shows no ads.
• Set a daily time limit or take a 7-day break in Settings.
• 30 languages, light and dark themes, and a Lite mode for older phones.

Sign in with a 6-digit code sent to your email. No password and no phone number.

Questions: hello@huntbrowser.com

name: Hushly: Baby Sleep Sounds
description:
Help your baby fall asleep — and stay asleep — with 20 gentle sounds that play all night long.

Hush works fully offline: no account, no ads, no tracking. Every sound is synthesized on your device in real time, so it never loops with an audible seam — nothing wakes the baby.

SOUNDS
• White, pink and brown noise (softened and deep)
• Rain on the roof, thunderstorm, ocean waves
• Fan, hair dryer, vacuum, car ride, train
• Womb sounds, heartbeat, music box lullaby
• Wind, forest stream, crickets, morning birds

MIXES
Combine up to 3 sounds with individual volume levels. Save your mixes and bring them back with one tap.

SLEEP TIMER WITH GENTLE FADE
Choose 3 minutes to 8 hours. The sound fades away smoothly over the last 7 seconds — no abrupt cutoff, ever. The timer lives in Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen.

GENTLE WAKE-UP
Set your wake time: playing sounds slowly crossfade into birdsong, or a good-morning notification arrives in silence.

BABY-SAFE VOLUME
Cap every sound at a level you choose — a gentle limit for little ears.

APPLE WATCH
Control everything from your wrist — no glowing phone screen at 3 a.m. The Watch app can even play sounds on its own, no iPhone needed.

NIGHT MODE
A red tint keeps the screen from waking the baby during night feeds.

COMPLETELY FREE
All 20 sounds, the full timer and the Apple Watch app — completely free. No subscription, no ads, no catches.

Privacy: we collect no data whatsoever. Privacy Policy: https://formu1a.github.io/hush-privacy/
Support: toz1fq@bk.ru

name: HXZG
description:
Thank you for giving our app a try. Your support is what keeps us improving.

We steadily polish this Cold Cabinet experience so decaying notes are easier to rescue, and if anything feels off—rot meters, Rescue queue, Oral stage, or Insights—please reach out right away so we can help.

Unread notes compost into noise until the vault feels opaque. HXZG gives you a Cold Cabinet home with Urgent / Chill / Stable shelves, then lets you stock subjects, track rot, run rescue sessions, speak ideas aloud, and read rot diagnosis. It is a personal on-device education utility only—no cloud vault.

Place notes on shelves, open Rescue sorted by rot, run Oral recall, then browse Insights and Card wall. Optional photos stay on this iPhone. Settings let you export a backup or clear local data whenever you want a clean start.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking, and no upload of your vault. Notes, cards, preferences, and notices stay on this iPhone. HXZG only helps you rescue what is rotting—it never sells your data and never requires a login to begin.

name: IB Physics Prep: Planetwick
description:
IB Physics Prep: Planetwick helps IB Physics SL and HL students practise, understand and revise. It works offline, with no account.

LEARN YOUR WAY
- Syllabus view: follow the five themes in order, A Space, time and motion; B The particulate nature of matter; C Wave behaviour; D Fields; E Nuclear and quantum physics.
- Real-World view: build things, from a safe roller-coaster loop to a wave measurement plan, and meet the physics exactly when each step needs it. Your builds go on a Made-it shelf.
- Switch between the two views at any time. Your progress is shared.
- SL and HL toggle: HL-only content stays hidden at SL.

PRACTISE AND ADAPT
- Short quizzes after every lesson, with question lengths of 5, 10, 20 or all.
- Wrong answers link straight to the material you missed, with a one-line reason for what to study next.
- Unit tests, mixed practice and mock-style sets with a report and study plan.
- Command-term trainer: learn what Define, Explain, Calculate, Evaluate and the others ask for, then drill them.
- Internal assessment coach: checklists and questions that help you plan your own investigation. It never writes your work.

SEE IT MOVE
- Interactive labs for projectile motion, springs, double slit, radioactive decay, the photoelectric effect, gas laws and circuits.

READABLE AND HONEST
- Text zoom from 50 to 300 percent, with large, clear type.
- Optional Other boards chip and Curriculum map show where a topic has similar content in A Level and AP courses.
- Every question and explanation is original. Topic names and SL/HL levels follow the published IB Physics subject brief; check your own guide and teacher for exact requirements.

FREE AND PLANETWICK PLUS
About half of Planetwick is free: all lessons and worked examples, concept checks with review links, unit tests, mixed practice, the command-term trainer, the internal assessment coach, Coverage, the Curriculum map, and five of the twelve labs plus two of the five Real-World builds.
Planetwick Plus (monthly subscription) adds the other seven labs, the other three builds, full-length practice mocks, quiz lengths of 20 and all, and your personal study plan. No free trial. Cancel any time: cancelling takes effect at the end of the period you have paid for, so you keep Plus until then and are not charged again. Manage or cancel in your store account settings.

name: Ice Fishing FM
description:
Move an orange hydrophone from hole to hole and listen for fish beneath the ice. Tune the receiver, compare waveforms and signal strength, and pin readings to see what changes with depth. Look for echoes, overlapping rhythms, and fish that move between holes.

Pick a depth and lure, drop your line, and strike when the bite pattern repeats. Reel in the fish and ease off when the line tension climbs. File your catch in the field journal to unlock the next expedition.

Follow a recurring signal across three lakes to a sunken training beacon. Use the field guide to learn the rhythms of eight fish species, then play back synthesized recordings of your catches in the journal. File the recovered beacon to unlock repeatable Free surveys on all three lakes.

Ice Fishing FM is an offline, single-player game. You can play with the sound muted using waveforms and visual bite cues.

name: Icebreaker: Conversation Cards
description:
Good questions for good company. Open a deck, read the card on top, and see where the conversation goes.

TWELVE DECKS, 360 QUESTIONS
Quick Icebreakers, Would You Rather and Team Meeting are free. With Pro: Deep Talk, Date Night, Family Dinner, Friends Night, Classroom, Road Trip, Funny and Weird, First Day and This or That. Thirty cards in each, and every question was written for this app.

SWIPE THROUGH THE CARDS
Each deck is shuffled when you open it. Swipe the card away for the next one, go back to the one before, and at the end shuffle and play again.

A QUESTION EVERY DAY
The first screen shows a new question each day, for the breakfast table or the start of a call.

PLAY WITH A GROUP (PRO)
Add the names of the people in the room. In Hot Seat each card picks one person to answer, and everybody gets the same number of turns, never twice running. In Everyone, the card names who starts and the question goes round. Set a clock of 30, 60 or 90 seconds if answers tend to run long.

KEEP THE GOOD ONES
Tap the heart to keep a question, and find them all under Favourites. Ten are free; Pro keeps as many as you like. Share any question as text.

WRITE YOUR OWN DECK (PRO)
Questions for your book club, your class, your team's retrospective or your family's holidays: give the deck a name and a colour and add up to a hundred questions.

FOR
Teachers on the first day of term, managers who open meetings, hosts, couples, families at dinner, friends on a road trip, anyone who has run out of small talk.

FREE
Three decks with ninety questions, the question of the day, ten favourites.

PRIVATE
No account. Names, favourites and your own decks stay on your iPhone; the app sends nothing to us.

Icebreaker Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you, and it turns into the paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

name: ID Front & Back PDF
description:
Put the front and back of a card on one PDF page.

When someone asks for a copy of both sides of your ID, insurance card or membership card, ID Front & Back PDF makes that page in under a minute. Add the front, add the back, check the preview and save the PDF.

HOW IT WORKS
- Two large slots, Front and Back. Fill them in any order.
- Import Photo picks an existing picture with the system photo picker. Capture uses the camera with a simple card-shaped frame.
- Tap a side to rotate it 90 degrees, adjust a crop rectangle or replace it.
- Swap Front & Back with one tap if they went into the wrong slots.
- Preview PDF shows the exact file: front above back on one US Letter or A4 page, each side fitted without stretching, with Front and Back labels outside the images. Pinch to zoom.
- Save to Files or share the PDF. The file gets a generic name such as ID-front-back-k3m9qx.pdf, never your name or card number.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your images are processed on your iPhone. There is no account, no server, no ads and no analytics.
- The camera is used only when you tap Capture. Captured photos aren't saved to your photo library, and Import Photo works without camera access.
- Location and camera details from your photos are left out of the PDF. Your original photos are never changed.
- The working PDF is a temporary file protected by iOS and excluded from backups. Clear Current Document removes it, and leftovers are removed the next time the app opens.
- The app hides its preview in the app switcher. It can't block screenshots you take yourself.

WHAT IT ISN'T
The app doesn't read, verify or certify your card, and it doesn't detect card edges automatically: you frame and crop each side yourself. The PDF is a copy, not an official document, and no particular printed card size is promised.

PRICING
Selecting and previewing are always free, and your first export is free. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports. It isn't a subscription and never renews. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

name: Immortal's Forge: Roguelite
description:
Step into the celestial forge and forge your path from a mortal blacksmith to an ascended supreme immortal!

"Immortal's Forge" blends the addictive satisfaction of idle crucible smithing with heart-pounding roguelite horde survival combat. Strike the divine anvil, discover hundreds of legendary weapons and relics, unleash devastating flying swords, and cleanse ancient realms swarming with demonic fiends!


GAMEPLAY HIGHLIGHTS

STRIKE THE ANVIL · INFINITE ARTIFACT FORGING
Every strike of your divine hammer yields new possibilities! Upgrade your sacred crucible to forge gear across six tiers of rarity—from Common iron to Divine celestial relics. Equip and refine weapons, robes, helmets, boots, amulets, and spirit rings to unlock unique affixes like Life Steal, Critical Burst, Counter-Strike, and Stun!

ROGUELITE SURVIVOR COMBAT · DEFEND THE NINE HEAVENS
Venture into perilous secret realms overrun by thousands of demonic creatures. Enjoy seamless single-thumb controls as you weave through bullet-hell barrages! Collect spiritual crystals to level up mid-combat, unlocking flying swords, spinning protective flame orbs, and celestial thunder strikes.

ULTIMATE WEAPON EVOLUTION · MYRIAD SWORDS ARRAY
Fuse and awaken your sacred arts into devastating Ultimate Awakenings! Turn humble flying blades into the screen-clearing "Myriad Swords Slaying Array", transform sparks into the infernal "Nine Heavens Flame Ring", and summon holy lightning to obliterate legendary Demon Kings!

CULTIVATION REALMS & DAO ENLIGHTENMENT
Progress from a humble Mortal through Qi Condensation, Foundation Establishment, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, all the way to Heavenly Tribulation Ascension! Each breakthrough permanently elevates your celestial stats and power rating.

CELESTIAL VAULT · 100% CLEAN & FAIR GAMING
No intrusive pop-ups, no forced video advertisements, and no predatory microtransactions. Enjoy pure, unadulterated cultivation and hack-and-slash roguelite fun at your own pace, anytime, anywhere—with complete offline progression support!

CORE FEATURES

• Satisfying Idle Smithing: Automated forging with smart auto-equip and dismantle mechanics.
• Intense Horde Survival: Face swarms of 50+ simultaneous mobs and screen-shaking World Bosses.
• Dual Battle Modes: Demon Tower progression and vast open Secret Realm survival maps.
• Rich Affix & Rarity System: Customize your build with Dodge, Critical DMG, and Life Steal.
• Dynamic Screen Adaptation: Optimized for iPhone notch, Dynamic Island, and iPad displays.
• Offline Friendly: Your cultivation and progress save safely on your device.

Will you remain a mortal of flesh and bone, or forge your destiny and cross the Nine Heavens?
Download Immortal's Forge today and ignite the celestial flame!

name: Improv Jam: Scene Partner
description:
Improv Jam is an AI scene partner and coach for practising improv between classes.

Pick an exercise, tap Start, and talk out loud. Your AI partner speaks first, listens, and builds on what you say, in a different voice each time. When the exercise ends you get one note: something you did well, quoting your own words, and one thing to try next time. Then try again, and your partner quietly sets up chances to practise that tip.

19 exercises across seven skills:
• Agreement: Yes, and; That's right, Bob; Gift giving
• Listening: Last word, first word; Word-at-a-time story; Repeat-back
• Who, what, where: Opening lines; Start in the middle; Three-line scenes
• Being specific: Eight things; Zoom in
• Character: Character monologue; Hot seat
• Emotion and relationship: Big reaction; Emotion switch; About us
• Putting it together: Two-minute scene; Shrinking scene; Argument to agreement

Each exercise comes with its one rule, an example, three tips and a short teaching video.

The partner and the notes are made by AI, using OpenAI's voice and language models. Your voice goes to OpenAI only while a scene is on.

Rounds take two to four minutes. Headphones help. Sign in with Apple or Google to play. Improv Jam is free for now, with 20 minutes of practice per account. It has no ads, and saves nothing you say.

For adults, 18 and over.

name: InchScribe｜分數計算機 英尺英吋換算
description:
InchScribe 是專為英尺英吋設計的分數計算機。直接輸入 5' 7 3/8"，分數加法、分數減法、分數乘法、分數除法都能一次算好；結果同時顯示英尺英吋、總英吋、小數英尺與公制，英吋換算、英尺換算、毫米換算都不必再另外查表。

木工、裝潢、DIY 與工地現場都用得到。不論是木工尺寸、門框尺寸還是層板尺寸，看著捲尺刻度直接輸入，木工計算、尺寸計算、長度計算都不用再自己換算分數。它是手機裡的木工工具，也是隨身的量尺工具。

【主要功能】
・分數計算：英尺、英吋、分數混合輸入，加減乘除一次算好
・尺寸換算：同時顯示總英吋、小數英尺與公制，英制換算、公制換算一次完成
・分數換算：貼上 67.375 in 這類小數尺寸，也會換成英吋分數顯示
・對半找中心：一鍵把尺寸對半，快速找到中心點
・互動捲尺：結果畫在捲尺刻度上，一眼對照位置
・智慧貼上：貼上 5 ft 7-3/8 in 等文字，自動辨識成尺寸
・快捷分數：常用分數一按輸入
・記憶功能：MS、MR、M+、M−、MC，連續計算更方便
・精度設定：顯示到 1/8、1/16、1/32 或 1/64 英吋，精確值不會被改動
・一點就複製：總英吋、小數英尺、公制數值都能直接複製

【InchScribe Pro 終身版】
一次購買、終身使用，沒有訂閱：
・計算紀錄：查看最近 100 筆計算，一點就能帶回計算機（免費版可看最近 10 筆）
・收藏：最多收藏 40 筆常用尺寸（免費版 1 筆）
・自訂快捷分數：依照你的工作習慣設定 5 個常用分數
已購買的使用者，可在「設定 → 恢復購買」取回 Pro。

計算紀錄、收藏與設定只存在你的裝置上，不需要註冊帳號。

name: Infinite Sky : Space Explorer
description:
Fly through the Solar System and out to the Milky Way.

Infinite Sky is an astronomy explorer for curious minds of every age. Spin the planets, follow moons and spacecraft along their orbits, then zoom out past the Kuiper Belt until the whole Milky Way spreads out around you.

EXPLORE IN 3D • The Sun, planets, dwarf planets, moons, comets and asteroids, with real maps and measured shapes • Missions and spacecraft shown where they are on the date you choose • Travel through time and watch the planets move • Switch to true scale to see how vast space really is

BEYOND THE SOLAR SYSTEM • A Milky Way map built from measured spiral arms, with famous nebulae, star clusters and black holes in their real places • Fly Here to the Orion Nebula, the Crab Nebula, Betelgeuse and more • Real telescope images from Hubble, Webb and ESO, with full credits • Explore nebulae and star systems in 3D

LEARN AT YOUR LEVEL • Six explorer modes, from Little Explorers to Stargazer Pro, each with its own words, facts and detail • Lessons and quizzes that track your progress • Read to Me for younger explorers • Meet Cosmo, a friendly space guide who answers questions. Cosmo uses Apple Intelligence on supported devices and its own space library everywhere else, all on your device.

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY • Up to six explorer profiles, each with a nickname, an astronaut avatar, progress rings and badges • A grown-up question before changing modes, opening links or changing settings • Optional Family iCloud Sync keeps explorers the same on your devices, using your own iCloud • World of the Day and Next Sky Event widgets

LOOK UP TONIGHT • See which planets and constellations are in your sky tonight • Upcoming oppositions, close pairings and alignments, worked out on your device • Live Compass on iPhone and iPad points the sky chart at the real sky

PRIVATE BY DESIGN Infinite Sky works offline. No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your explorers and progress stay on your device.

Images and data credits are listed in the app under About & Credits. No endorsement by NASA, ESA or ESO is implied.

name: Ink Examen
description:
What stayed with you today?

Ink Examen is a guided evening prayer inspired by the Ignatian Examen. Remember one moment from your day and name how you felt. Write a few lines or take a moment to reflect quietly.

Move the watercolor heart. Did that moment draw you closer to God or further away? Think back. Did it cross your mind to talk to God about it?

The Examen works offline. Drafts and entries are saved on your device. Find past entries by date, feeling, or keyword.

Download for free and complete three Examens at no cost. A one-time purchase unlocks your fourth Examen and every one after it. You can always read your past entries for free.

name: Inkleaf Notes
description:
Inkleaf is a notebook for handwriting, sketching and marking up documents on iPhone and iPad. Open the included “How a Leaf Makes Sugar” note to explore editable ink and a replay of the page being written and drawn.

• Write with Apple Pencil on compatible iPads. Switch pens, adjust line weight, and use the eraser or lasso to edit handwriting.
• Create multipage notes with ruled, grid or blank paper. Organize notebooks in folders and jump to important pages with bookmarks.
• Import PDFs and photos, annotate documents, and add text, sticky notes or tables.
• Record audio within a note and replay it from the page.
• Search typed text and export standard PDF or PNG files. Free exports include an Inkleaf watermark.

Inkleaf Pro is a one-time purchase. It unlocks watermark-free exports, advanced PDF options, handwriting conversion and search, offline recording transcription with supported language packs, document version history, split reading and additional page backgrounds.

Start the optional 7-day trial from the Pro screen. The trial does not renew or charge you when it ends. You can keep using the basic features for free.

name: Insami
description:
Hi! I'm Insami.

Meet Insami, a tiny ginseng friend who repeats what you say, gets grumpy when you poke too much, and even answers your calls.

■ Repeat after me
Hold the microphone button, say something, and let go. Insami repeats it right back in a high, cute voice. Love it? Tap "Replay" to hear it again and again.

■ Poke and pat
Give Insami a little tap. Tap the head and Insami jumps in surprise; tap the body and Insami giggles. But poke too much and you might hear "Stop poking me!" Press the Hit button and Insami shouts "Ouch!"

■ Call Insami
Press the Call button and Insami picks up with "Hello?" Ask anything, and Insami answers with "Yes", "No", or "I don't know". What should I eat today? Will tomorrow be sunny? Ask Insami!

■ 8 mini games
· Climb: jump higher and higher
· Rock Paper Scissors: play against Insami
· Whack-a-Mole: tap when it pops up
· Leaf Catch: catch leaves, dodge rocks
· Memory Match: find the pairs
· Quick Tap: tap when it says "Now!"
· Higher or Lower: guess the next number
· Rock Dodge: dodge the falling rocks

■ A hidden secret
Say a certain phrase to Insami and something strange happens. Only for those brave enough to handle a little scare.

■ Settings
Adjust the voice and music volume to your liking.

■ Play with peace of mind
· No sign-up, no ads.
· Your voice recordings stay on your device and are never sent to our servers.
· The microphone and speech recognition are used only for "repeat after me", calls, and the hidden secret.

name: Interlock Split
description: Interlock Split finds an open contact in a series safety chain of eight contacts, T0 to T8, with the power isolated and a continuity tester in hand. Place the red lead and the black lead on two terminals and record Beep or Silent. A beep proves every contact in that span. A silent span keeps the suspects. The app names the next pair of terminals so each reading halves what is left, until one contact remains. A span that is already proven is refused, so a reading is never wasted. Drag the broken contact into the slot once it is repaired, then test T0 to T8: a beep closes the chain, silence sends you back to the contacts not yet proven. Tap a reading to flip it or swipe to delete it, and the chain is worked out again from every reading. Keep several chains, find one by name, and share the readings as text. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Interval Timer – HIIT & Tabata
description:
Interval Timer is a simple, clean workout timer for HIIT, Tabata, strength training rest periods, planks and running intervals. Set your work and rest times, tap start, and follow a big countdown you can read from across the room.

WHO IT'S FOR
• Anyone who wants exact rest times between strength training sets
• Tabata (20s on / 10s off) and HIIT fans who need a quick start
• Plank holds and running intervals
• People who want a timer with no account and no sign-up

BUILT-IN PRESETS
• Tabata: 20s work / 10s rest x 8 rounds
• HIIT: 40s work / 20s rest x 10 rounds
• Plank: 60s work / 30s rest x 3 rounds
• Running: 3 min / 1 min x 5 rounds

CREATE YOUR OWN WORKOUTS
Build custom presets with prepare, work and rest seconds, number of rounds, number of sets, rest between sets and your own name. Save the routine you actually do and start it in one tap.

CLEAR AND EASY TO FOLLOW
• Big countdown with round display
• Color changes by phase: yellow for prepare, red for work, green for rest
• Pause, skip and stop controls
• Beep and vibration in the last 3 seconds of each phase
• Screen stays on during your workout

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Completion screen with total time and rounds
• History of your finished workouts
• Weekly total workout time
• Sound and vibration can be turned on or off in settings

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• No account, no sign-up
• Your data stays on your device
• Works offline
• Available in 7 languages

ABOUT ADS
Free to use. Ads appear only on the home screen and during rest periods, never while you are working out. You can remove all ads with a one-time purchase.

Whether you train at home, at the gym or outdoors, Interval Timer helps you keep every work and rest period on schedule.

name: InvexaGrowth
description:
InvexaGrowth is a private ledger for shared tables and personal cash, kept only on this phone.

Split a dinner the way it actually happened. Mark who had each plate, add tax and tip, and leave a table open until everyone has claimed. When the night is done, fold the circle into the fewest handoffs and mark each one paid. Circles remember the Sunday pair, the flat, the cabin, and the road trip — each with its own people, notes, and running balance.

Alongside the circles, Allot keeps a personal month. See what is left against the line you set, file unfiled costs into piles, and read the calendar as cash in and cash out. Nothing here connects to a bank. Account names are labels. The sample ledger is ready the first time you open the app, and you can replace it with a blank book whenever you want.

No account. No network. No ads. Your names, amounts, and handoffs stay in a file on this device.

name: IronAlly: AI Gym & Lift Log
description:
IronAlly is an iPhone and iPad strength training app that combines an interactive 36-muscle anatomy map, zero-friction workout logging, CNS recovery readiness, and an on-demand AI fitness coach.

DESIGNED FOR SERIOUS LIFTERS IN REAL GYMS
- Zero-Checkmark Logging: Start a session and every planned set is ready immediately. Adjust weight or reps in one tap with thumb-zone steppers, plate math, and automatic warmup ramps (50% / 70% / 85%).
- 36+ Muscle Anatomy & Fatigue Heatmap: Explore front and back anatomical muscle groups across 357 exercises and 9 equipment types. Visual fatigue shading models 72-hour large-muscle and 36-hour small-muscle recovery automatically.
- Smart Self-Evolving Templates: Your templates adapt after each completed workout while Bad-Day Protection guards your progressive overload baseline against fatigue or deloads.
- Overtime Rest Timer & Live Activities: Built-in rest timers transition smoothly into overtime count-up on Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with subtle audio ducking so your music never stops.
- Apple Health & CNS Recovery Readiness: Read-only HRV, sleep stages, resting heart rate, and body composition metrics power a daily 0-100 CNS readiness gauge and RPE guidance.
- On-Demand IronAlly AI Coach (Pro): Request AI weight calibration, snap gym equipment or meal nutrition macros, analyze lifting form videos, and review weekly training blocks whenever you choose.

PRIVACY & DATA SOVEREIGNTY
- 100% offline core workout logging in basement gyms with zero account required.
- Zero third-party ads or cross-app tracking. Apple Health data stays strictly on your device.
- Full JSON backup/restore, CSV import (Strong, Hevy, Xunji), and Face ID protection for private physique photos.

SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING
Core strength logging, 357-exercise anatomy library, fatigue heatmap, timers, and CSV/JSON export are free. Upgrade to IronAlly Pro ($6.99/month or $49.99/year with a 7-day free trial) to unlock unlimited AI coaching, vision equipment and nutrition scans, and video biomechanics analysis. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple ID settings.

Health Disclaimer: IronAlly is a fitness tracking tool, not a medical device, and does not provide medical diagnoses or clinical advice.
