name: IRONBEAT
description:
IRONBEAT is a training log built for people who lift. Log every set on your iPhone or Apple Watch, see exactly how much stronger you're getting, and let your Watch tell you when you're recovered enough to push.
LOG FASTER, ON YOUR WRIST OR PHONE • Guided workouts from your own routines, with rest times and the weight to beat • Log sets on Apple Watch with the Digital Crown, synced live with your iPhone • Warm-up sets, effort ratings and "reps left in the tank" for honest progress • 120+ exercises, searchable by name, muscle or equipment, plus your own
PROGRESS ON EVERY MACHINE Cable stacks and machines differ between gyms: some show kg, some lb, some only numbers. IRONBEAT tracks progress per machine, in that machine's own units, and suggests your next weight or rep target. Use two machines for the same exercise and it learns how they compare.
SEE YOUR STRENGTH • Estimated one-rep max and records for every lift • A muscle map that shows your strength level per muscle group • Weekly volume and workout history
RECOVERY FROM YOUR APPLE WATCH A daily recovery score from heart rate variability, resting heart rate and sleep, plus sleep stages, heart rate zones during workouts, cardio fitness, steps and more, all from Apple Health.
FOOD AND MACROS • Describe a meal in your own words, search, scan a barcode or snap a photo • Calories, protein, carbs and fat against targets for your goal: lose, maintain or bulk • A weight forecast based on what you eat and what your Watch says you burn, which corrects itself from your real weigh-ins • Recognising meals uses Apple Intelligence on your iPhone
PHYSIQUE LOG Front, side and back photos with an outline of your last photo so the angles match, short videos, notes and measurements. Compare any two dates with a before/after slider or watch your progress as a timelapse.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account, no ads, no tracking. Your workouts, meals, photos and health data stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch. Save a backup file to iCloud Drive whenever you like.
IRONBEAT is for training and general fitness. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice.

name: IronLab: Golf Iron Training
description: Build a more reliable iron game in 28 days. Follow four weekly training blocks, from solid contact and distance control to shot shaping and approach decisions. Each lesson includes a motion demonstration, a practice question and a ten-shot drill. Record your results, track your progress and build a personal carry chart in yards or meters. Works offline in English and Simplified Chinese.

name: IT Market Square
description:
IT Market Square connects you with trusted service providers close to where you are, from plumbers and mechanics to tailors, electricians, cleaners, tutors and licensed professionals.

FIND HELP NEAR YOU
• See providers around you on a map, with distance and arrival time
• Search hundreds of services across home repairs, automotive, beauty, events, tech, legal, health and more

TRUST BUILT IN

GET IT SORTED FAST

• Rate the service when the job is done

FOR SERVICE PROVIDERS
• Create your profile free and get job requests from people nearby
• Switch yourself online when you're ready to work
• Build your reputation with a verified badge and good reviews
• Already a customer? Start offering your service from the same account

IT Market Square: Connecting services, simplifying life.

name: Itinerando: viagem em grupo
description:
Planeje a viagem inteira num lugar só — e com quem vai junto.

No Itinerando cada viagem é um projeto compartilhado: convide o grupo, montem o roteiro dia a dia, dividam os gastos e guardem os documentos, sem planilha, sem grupo de mensagens perdido.

EXPLORAR E RECOMENDAÇÕES
• Os principais pontos turísticos de cada destino

LEMBRETES

VIAGEM DE CARRO
• Rota pelas estradas, km, tempo ao volante e custo de combustível — ou de recarga, no elétrico

Itinerando — sua viagem inteira, num lugar só.

name: ITSABADMANTING
description:
ITSABADMANTING is a free, invite-only social network for UK rap fans, artists, producers and DJs, aged 18 and over.

Create a profile, follow people, post and comment, shout people out, and discover artists and scenes. Artists can share releases and community drops. There are no paywalls and no in-app purchases.

You can report and block other members. Export or delete your account in Settings → Your data.

ITSABADMANTING is operated by 9791 Media LTD. 18+ only.

name: itsyPetsy
description:
itsyPetsy helps you find pet care near you, book it, and keep your pets' health records in one place. It's for dog owners, cat owners and anyone with a pet, and for the vets, groomers, walkers and sitters who look after them.

Find and book pet care near you
• Vets and animal clinics, dog groomers and cat groomers, dog walkers, pet sitters, pet boarding and kennels, dog daycare, dog trainers and pet transport
• Sort by distance, rating or price and read reviews from other owners
• Pick a time and send a booking request. The provider confirms it
• Anyone you booked before is listed first, with Book again
• Nearby pet businesses that aren't on itsyPetsy yet also show up, with phone numbers and directions

Emergency vet finder
• Open Emergency Vet from the home screen to see vets around you, with clinics that are open now at the top
• Call or get directions with one tap
• Pin the clinics you trust so they stay at the top of the list
• Works from your last known location if the signal is weak

Pet health records
• A profile for each pet: photos, breed, age, weight, vaccinations, due dates and medical notes
• Notes on food, routine and what your pet likes, so a sitter or walker knows what to do
• Add a photo and the app suggests a breed, which you can change
• A wellness score based on what you've entered. It's a rough guide, not a diagnosis

Reminders
• A reminder the day before and an hour before each confirmed appointment, on your phone and by email
• Add any booking to your phone's calendar

Communities for your kind of pet
• Join communities by animal and breed: dogs, cats, birds, rabbits and small pets, reptiles, fish and horses
• Ask other owners a question, run a poll, or share photos of your pets
• Messages with providers and other owners, including photos and voice notes

Pet adoption and lost pets
• Rehome a pet or find one to adopt. Listings are free, and selling animals isn't allowed
• If a pet goes missing, post it in Lost & Found so people nearby can help, and report pets you've found

For pet care providers
Vets, groomers, walkers, sitters, boarders and trainers can list their business, set their own services and prices, and take bookings. We check each provider's ID and business documents before anyone can book them. Clients pay you directly, and itsyPetsy charges a marketplace fee on completed bookings.

Also in the app
• Stay signed in to several accounts on one phone and switch between them
• Fingerprint or face sign-in
• Dark mode

Good to know
itsyPetsy doesn't give veterinary advice. In an emergency, contact a vet straight away. Providers are independent businesses and are responsible for the services they offer. How many providers you'll find depends on your area.

Questions or ideas? Use Send Feedback in Settings or email contactprautof@gmail.com.

name: IV Lens: Appraisal Scanner
description:
IV Lens reads the appraisal screen of Pokémon GO while you play and turns it into exact numbers. Start a screen broadcast once, appraise as usual, and every Pokémon is saved to a collection on your iPhone with its IVs, level, PvP ranks and raid strength.

SCAN WHILE YOU PLAY
• Reads the three appraisal bars, CP, HP and the catch date in about a second
• Spots shiny, shadow, lucky, Dynamax and Gigantamax Pokémon
• A banner for each scan, with quick fixes: Not shiny, It's shadow, Correct…
• A floating overlay shows IVs and league ranks over the game
• Quick scan: check league ranks without adding the Pokémon to your collection
• Also reads screenshots and screen recordings you already have

KNOW WHAT TO KEEP
• IV percentage and PvP rank for Great, Ultra and Master League
• Ranks for the current cups, including Little Cup and themed cups
• The best level and CP for each league, and whether to evolve first
• Storage helpers: what to transfer, what to trade, the best of each species
• Copy a search string and paste it into the game to find those Pokémon

BUILD FOR BATTLE
• Suggested PvP teams from your own Pokémon, with roles and type coverage
• Counter a team: the best answers you own to any three opponents
• The full ranking of every Pokémon in each league, with movesets, matchups and rank-1 IVs
• Power-up planner: stardust and candy to reach each league's cap
• Raid and Max Battle counters for the current and coming bosses, with dates and weather boosts: your best Pokémon, or the best of all Pokémon to build a team
• The best raid attackers of each type

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Everything is kept on your iPhone, with a daily backup and undo for bulk changes
• Home screen widget with your collection, recent scans and top PvP pick

IV Lens only reads what's on your screen. It doesn't connect to, change or automate the game, and it needs no login.

Game data and rankings come from PvPoke (MIT licence) and PoGoAPI, updated weekly. Raid bosses and events from LeekDuck (via ScrapedDuck).

IV Lens is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Niantic, Nintendo, The Pokémon Company or Game Freak. Pokémon and Pokémon GO are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: Jacks Casino Horse Trails
description:
Explore scenic horseback riding routes, discover horses that match your experience, and book trainer-led lessons. Plan your riding activities, check weather conditions, and learn essential guidelines for interacting with horses.

Browse eight riding routes with images, difficulty levels, durations, and detailed descriptions. Choose your preferred date and time, then select a horse for your ride. Alternatively, allow the club to assign an available horse suitable for your experience.

Discover 12 horses through individual profiles featuring photos, ages, temperaments, and recommended rider experience. Select a horse for an existing reservation or start a new booking directly from its profile.

Find a suitable riding companion by answering five questions about your experience, confidence, preferred pace, temperament preferences, and riding goals. Receive two personalised horse recommendations with explanations of each match.

Explore eight riding lessons, each led by a dedicated trainer. View lesson descriptions, difficulty levels, locations, and trainer information. Choose a date and available time slot to reserve your training session.

Check weather conditions for your selected date before planning a ride. Explore eight different weather conditions and view clear suitability indicators to help you make informed decisions.

Learn essential guidelines for interacting with horses through 20 concise educational cards. Discover recommended practices, important precautions, and behaviours to avoid around horses.

name: JANO Actas
description:
JANO Actas graba tus reuniones presenciales y prepara el acta en el propio iPhone.

Deja el iPhone en el centro de la mesa y pulsa el punto rojo. Al terminar, la app transcribe la reunión, separa quién habla y saca el acta en un archivo Markdown (.md), lista para guardarla o pasársela a tu IA.

• Catalán y castellano, aunque se mezclen en la misma reunión. También inglés, francés, alemán e italiano.
• Quién habla: separa las voces (Persona 1, Persona 2…). Si al empezar hacéis una ronda de presentaciones («Soy…», «Sóc…»), pone el nombre a cada voz.
• Escucha un trozo de cada voz y cámbiale el nombre: se cambia en el acta y en el resumen.
• Resumen con la IA de Apple: decisiones, tareas y temas abiertos (en los iPhone con Apple Intelligence).
• Sigue grabando con la pantalla bloqueada.
• Envía el acta por correo o mensaje, o guárdala en la app Archivos.

Privacidad
La grabación, la transcripción y el acta se hacen y se guardan en tu iPhone. No salen de él salvo que tú las envíes. No hace falta cuenta. Lo único que se descarga de internet es el modelo de voz (unos 600 MB), una sola vez y después de preguntarte.

Antes de grabar, avisa a los asistentes de que se graba la reunión.

name: Japan Trip Japanese: Coco&Mico
description:
Your first trip to Japan? Coco and Mico, two cats from Japan, teach you the Japanese you'll really use, scene by scene.

- Airport, train, convenience store and Help & Health: free forever
- Hear every phrase, read the signs and practice with short quizzes
- Phrasebook: show any phrase to staff in big letters
- Collect a stamp for every scene in your travel passport
- Theme packs for food, onsen, shrines, shopping, Shinkansen, anime, hotels, drugstores, festivals, family travel, Osaka & Kyoto talk and more: buy once, keep forever, works offline
- Living, working or studying in Japan? The Live & Work packs cover job interviews, office life, konbini and restaurant jobs, caregiving, factories, construction, farms, fishing, car maintenance, warehouses, bus and taxi driving, hotels, cleaning, language school, business keigo, city hall, clinics and apartment hunting

One-time purchases. No subscription. No ads. Works offline.

name: Jarnote
description: Jarnote is a home canning notebook. A preserve is a name and a style such as jam, pickle, or sauce. A batch records the date, how many jars, the jar size in milliliters, the process minutes, the headspace, and the shelf. Aged batches are those dated at least 365 days before today. Nothing is uploaded and no recipe service is used.

name: JellyLane
description:
Jelly Lane is a one-finger roll down a night alley.

A mint jelly carries a chit of porch bowls. The glowing crate waits at the far end. Drag sideways to steer. Pull down to brake. Creep into a bowl while its bell is glowing, stay out of the headlamps, and reach the crate before the street lamps dim.

Eight streets teach the ward one trick at a time. Even Lane is wide and kind. Then come puddles, porch bells, narrow curbs, a steep pitch, bowls that must be filled in order, moth gusts, and warm steam. Loose rolls remix a street you already know, so the cobbles are never the same twice. Tonight's Seed is a calendar lane stored only on this phone.

Shells, charms, and scoops change grip, warmth, and how clean a night can be. Crest marks from finished deliveries unlock them in the wardrobe. A clear night is graded Crisp, Gloss, or Soft.

name: Jemuvapi
description: Pick an activity card, put together a plan for tonight, and use the timer when you’re ready to begin. Save the moments you want to remember and revisit them in Memories.

name: Jitota
description:
Jitota is the AI-native business orchestration system: your team, your inbox and an AI teammate in one workspace. Autonomously automated assembling: the AI drafts, gathers and follows up, and nothing leaves until you approve it.

CHAT WITH YOUR TEAM AND YOUR AI TEAMMATE
Channels, group rooms and direct messages, with an AI teammate you can ask in any room. It answers, prepares drafts, checklists and questions, and waits for your decision. Report or block any message, including AI replies.

OUTBOX: EVERYTHING WAITING ON YOU
Drafts to approve, questions to answer and follow-ups to send, in one list. Approve, edit or reject with feedback.

ATLAS: EVERY JOB AS A TRIP
Jobs, launches and events become trips with stops and due dates, shown as a metro map or a plain list.

SHARED MAIL
Your team mailbox inside the same workspace, next to the conversations it belongs to.

BUILT FOR TEAMS
Sign in with your Xuperson ID. Lock the app with Face ID or your fingerprint, and get notified when something needs you. Sign-up is by invitation; your data stays in your workspace, and you can delete your account in Settings.

Just-in-time, over-the-air.

name: Jobblaget
description:
Jobblaget samlar arbetsdagen för personal hos företag som använder Flyttfirma.co eller Stadfirma.co.

Se dina uppdrag, följ arbetsinstruktioner och håll kontakten med arbetslaget i en gemensam personalapp för flytt och städ.

DINA UPPDRAG
• Se dagens och kommande uppdrag i kalendern.
• Öppna uppdragsdetaljer, adresser och arbetsinstruktioner.
• Följ checklistor och dokumentera arbetet med bilder där företaget har aktiverat funktionerna.

ARBETSTID OCH KOMMUNIKATION
• Stämpla in och ut och registrera raster.
• Se dina registrerade arbetstimmar.
• Håll kontakten med arbetslaget via chatt.
• Ta emot notiser om jobb och meddelanden när du aktiverar notiser.

PLATS UNDER ARBETSPASS
Jobblaget använder din plats vid in- och utstämpling. Under instämplade uppdrag samlar appen också in platsdata i bakgrunden när du har gett nödvändiga platsbehörigheter, även när appen inte används eller skärmen är låst. Platsen delas med företagets behöriga arbetsledare i personalkartan för att samordna uppdrag och visa beräknad ankomsttid. Bakgrundsdelningen stoppas när du stämplar ut. Du styr platsbehörigheten i telefonens inställningar.

KONTO BEHÖVS
Du behöver ett konto kopplat till en personalprofil hos din arbetsgivare på Flyttfirma.co eller Stadfirma.co. Tillgängliga funktioner beror på vad ditt företag har aktiverat.

Support: https://flyttfirma.co/kontakt
Integritetspolicy: https://flyttfirma.co/integritetspolicy#jobblaget

name: jobwi
description:
jobwi reúne en una sola app todo lo que necesitas para buscar trabajo: encontrar ofertas, organizar tus candidaturas y preparar los documentos y la entrevista.

QUÉ PUEDES HACER

• Explorar ofertas de empresas reales, filtradas por puesto, área, provincia y nivel. Cada oferta indica cuánto encaja con tu perfil.
• Guardar las que te interesan en el carrito y solicitarlas cuando quieras.
• Seguir el estado de cada candidatura: enviada, vista, respuesta, rechazada.
• Crear y adaptar tu CV y tu carta a cada oferta, y descargarlos en PDF.
• Practicar entrevistas con simulacros y recibir análisis de tus respuestas.
• Hacer pruebas de estilo y habilidades y ver tu informe.
• Guardar búsquedas y recibir avisos cuando aparecen ofertas que te encajan.
• Consultar experiencias reales de otras personas que han buscado empleo.

PERFIL MAESTRO

Rellena tu perfil una sola vez con tu experiencia, formación, habilidades e idiomas. jobwi lo reutiliza en todas las herramientas: documentos, entrevistas y candidaturas.

VISIBILIDAD PARA EMPRESAS

Tú decides si las empresas pueden encontrarte:
• No visible: ninguna empresa te ve.
• Anónimo: solo un resumen profesional sin tu nombre ni tus datos de contacto.
• Visible: también ven tu nombre.
Puedes cambiarlo en cualquier momento.

GRATIS

Puedes crear tu cuenta y usar jobwi sin pagar. Los planes de pago amplían las herramientas de preparación de documentos, entrevistas y análisis.

jobwi es un servicio español, en español, para buscar trabajo en España.

name: Jordan Dairy Supervisor
description:
Jordan Dairy Supervisor gives Jordan Dairy supervisors and sales managers full control of daily route operations from their phone.

YOUR OPERATION AT A GLANCE
A live dashboard shows orders, deliveries, vehicles on route, loadouts, customers, products and assets, plus every item waiting for your decision.

LIVE FLEET TRACKING
Follow every vehicle in real time with status, stops completed, delivered value and cash collected per driver. Message a driver directly from their card.

LOADOUTS BY DRIVER
See which vans are pending, loading or loaded, with product and unit counts for each loadout.

SETTLEMENT CENTER
Track settled vs. pending vehicles across all routes. Enter cash received, review returned stock and receipts, and settle in one tap.

REQUESTS & APPROVALS
Approve, hold or reject return, damage and driver requests, with a clear approval chain.

KPIs & INSIGHTS
Route completion, orders delivered, cash collected, order trends and orders by status for any date range.

FRESHNESS & TRACEABILITY
Watch perishable stock by expiry (FEFO), and trace every product lot and batch from warehouse to customer.

ALSO INCLUDED
Next-day load planning, orders by driver, discrepancy invoices, driver chat, products & assets catalog, and full English/Arabic support.

Sign-in requires a Jordan Dairy supervisor account.

name: Jornadas Gastronómicas
description:
Turn your town's food festivals into a way to discover, vote and win.

During each festival, the participating restaurants serve a dish created especially for the occasion. Jornadas Gastronómicas puts everything you need in your pocket so you don't miss any of them.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Festivals: see the current, upcoming and past food festivals in your area.
• Festival dishes: check each restaurant's dish, with photo, description, opening hours and price.
• Map: find the nearest participating restaurants and get directions.
• Favourites: save the places you want to visit.
• Vote and enter the draws: ask for your code at the restaurant when you try their dish, rate it in the app and enter the prize draws of the edition.
• News: keep up with what's new in each festival.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Pick an active festival in your town.
2. Browse the restaurants and their dishes.
3. Visit the place and enjoy the dish.
4. Ask for your code, vote in the app and enter the draws.

Jornadas Gastronómicas is an independent platform: it does not belong to any town council or public body. The app is in Spanish and English.

name: Joy Akademi
seller_name: JOYKEK DIJITAL REKLAM VE PAZARLAMA DANISMANLIK HIZMETLERI LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Joy Akademi eğitimlerin artık cebinde. Derslerine kaldığın yerden devam et, haftalık ilerlemeni gör ve hedefine her gün biraz daha yaklaş.

KALDIĞIN YERDEN DEVAM ET
Uygulamayı açtığın anda sıradaki dersin karşında. Hangi eğitimde ne kadar ilerlediğini, kaç dersin kaldığını tek bakışta görürsün. Web sitesinde izlediğin dersler uygulamada da tamamlanmış görünür; ilerlemen her cihazda aynıdır.

RAHAT İZLEME
Ders videoları telefona göre ayarlanmış kalitede açılır. Tam ekrana geçip telefonunu yan çevirdiğinde video tüm ekranı kaplar. Altyazı, hız ve bölüm seçimi oynatıcının içindedir.

HAFTALIK İLERLEME
"Bu hafta" şeridi hangi günler çalıştığını gösterir. Her pazar akşamı o haftanın özeti gelir: kaç gün giriş yaptın, kaç ders bitirdin, kaç ders seni bekliyor. Eğitimin dörtte birini, yarısını ve dörtte üçünü bitirdiğinde seni haberdar ederiz.

BİREBİR DERSLER
Birebir eğitim programındaysan yaklaşan derslerini görür, ders saatinde uygulamadan tek dokunuşla katılır, geçmiş ders kayıtlarını yeniden izlersin. Dersin olduğu gün hatırlatma bildirimi alırsın.

SI EĞİTMENİN YANINDA
Ders ekranındaki Faruk Toprak SI, izlediğin dersin özetini çıkarır, terimleri açıklar ve dersle ilgili sorularını yanıtlar.

SERTİFİKA
Eğitimi tamamladığında sertifikan profilinde hazır olur; PDF olarak kaydedip paylaşabilirsin.

ÜCRETSİZ DERSLER
Hesabında henüz eğitim yoksa eğitimlerin müfredatlarına göz atabilir, ücretsiz dersleri hemen izleyebilirsin.

Joy Akademi hesabınla giriş yap; hesabına tanımlı tüm eğitimler uygulamada kendiliğinden görünür. Bildirim tercihlerini Profil > Bildirimler ekranından istediğin zaman değiştirebilirsin.

name: Judebo AI
description:
Judebo AI is a chat assistant that answers your questions, helps you write and translate, explains pictures and creates images from your description.

The AI models run on our own servers. Your messages are sent over an encrypted connection to our servers and are not passed to third-party AI providers. We do not store the text of your messages after the answer is returned; your chat history stays on your device.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Chat with the assistant in your own language: it answers in the language of your last message.
- Attach pictures and documents (photos, PDF, text files) and ask about them.
- Create images from a text description and see them right in the chat.
- Report any answer that is offensive, wrong or misleading with one tap, using the Report button under the answer.
- Sign in with Apple, Google or an e-mail address and a password.
- Create API keys for your own tools and scripts in the app menu.
- Delete your account and its data at any time from the app menu.
- The interface is available in many languages.

AI answers can be inaccurate. Please check important facts yourself and do not use the answers as medical, legal or financial advice.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://ai.judebo.com/privacy

name: JumpCastleMall
description:
Planning a birthday, school day, or family gathering? Browse toddler, family, and party-ready inflatable castles, check day rates and coverage areas, save favourites, and add hires to your cart by rental length.
At checkout, collect from a nearby pickup point or choose delivery with cash on delivery. Sign in to manage addresses, track orders, and cancel when needed. Clear screens, simple steps — from browse to booking in one place.

name: Junto: Car Service
description:
Junto connects you with your car service. One app for every shop that runs on Junto.

- Find a shop: pick what you need, an oil change for example, and see which shop has the next free time. Or open the map and see the shops nearest to you.
- Shop page: opening hours, branches, services and prices, reviews and the next free time.
- Book a visit: pick the service, the car and a time on one sheet, or tap a quick pick such as "tomorrow morning". Move or cancel it in one tap.
- Your car in seconds: scan the registration certificate and the plate, make, model, year and VIN fill in by themselves. The certificate is read on the phone and the photo is never sent anywhere. Or pick the make and model from the list.
- My garage: every car you own in one place, with each shop it has visited. Share a car with a family member by phone number.
- Follow your car: received, being worked on, ready. See what was done and when it will be ready.
- Approve extra work: the mechanic found something? See the photos and the price and decide on the spot.
- Pay by card: pay the invoice on the shop's own secure bank page.
- History: every visit and invoice, and your inspection and insurance dates, in one place.
- Reviews: rate the visit afterwards.

Sign in with your phone number and an SMS code, no password. Links in the shop's SMS open straight in the app. Available in Georgian, English and Spanish.

name: Just a Chessboard
description: Try an opening from a book or revisit a move that caught your eye. Play both sides on your iPhone, then tap a move in the history to see the position just after it. Your game is saved on your device. No account or internet connection is needed.

name: Kachimushi: Eye Reflex Drills
description:
Kachimushi is a 3 minute daily set of short games for peripheral vision, flash reading and reaction. Every result is measured in milliseconds or seconds, so you can see how you change day by day.

TODAY'S 3 MINUTES
Pick a goal (wide, fast, react or balance) and today's condition. The app chooses 3 games, including your weakest one. Swap any game with one tap.

7 GAMES
- Edge Catch: keep your eyes on the center and spot where a dot flashes far out
- Schulte: tap 1 to 25 in order without moving your eyes from the center
- Reaction Tap: tap the instant it lights up; at higher levels, wait on the X
- Moving Catch: read the number on a passing ball
- Flash Read (Pro): read digits shown for a moment
- Timing (Pro): tap when the ball meets the line
- Multi Track (Pro): follow the marked dots among many
Difficulty adapts to your results.

TESTS
Reaction and Schulte tests under fixed conditions give a grade from Kyu 10 to Dan 5.

RECORDS
Daily score chart, personal bests, 7 day trend, streak and badges.

KACHI
A red dragonfly that only flies forward. It grows in 5 stages as you finish your daily sets. Accessories are earned by playing, never sold.

No ads, no account. Data stays on your iPhone. A 5 second break between games. Respects the iPhone setting to dim flashing lights.

PRO (one-time purchase)
Flash Read, Timing and Multi Track, full history, Pro games in the daily set. No subscription.

Kachimushi is a training game. It is not a medical device and does not test, improve or treat eyesight.

name: Kaelen
description:
Kaelen is a quiet field log for birds — a small notebook for the birds you actually saw, the places you returned to, and the hour that made the day.

Not a photo identifier. Not a rarity chase. Not a social feed. Kaelen keeps one honest record at a time and lets the year assemble itself.

WHAT IT HOLDS

• A life list of your own birds, with common name, scientific name, group, residence and a field note.
• Places you know by name: habitat, region, the way in, and what the patch feels like.
• Sightings with date, time, count, weather, behaviour signs and a written note.
• A yearbook that reads months, species composition, places, the best hour and the most numerous bird.
• A local JSON file you can export, restore or keep beside your paper notebook.

HOW IT WORKS

Open Field. The last note is there, with the hour and the weather. Open Sightings to search the log or narrow it by season. Open Birds to see what you have met and what is still to find. Open Places to see the patches that keep giving. Open Yearbook when you want the long view.

Adding a note takes a few taps: bird, place, date, time, count, conditions, signs, and one line worth keeping. Everything else is optional. The note is the product; the count is secondary.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

Kaelen does not identify birds from photographs or audio. It does not use GPS, maps, routes or opening hours. It does not have accounts, ads, purchases, analytics, leaderboards, streaks or a social feed. It does not sync to a server.

The only network request happens if you choose to open the hosted privacy page. Every working feature is offline.

name: Kardiagram
description:
Kardiagram turns your Apple Health data into a clear picture of your day.

YOUR DAY ON ONE TIMELINE
See every heart rate reading from midnight to midnight, colour-coded by intensity, with sleep stages, workouts and activity in the same view. Your low, resting and peak heart rate, HRV and steps sit at the top,.

WORKOUTS IN DETAIL
Every workout gets its own heart rate chart, time in each heart rate range, active energy, and 1- and 2-minute recovery. Runs add pace, heartbeats per mile and VO₂ max, compared with your recent runs.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Kardiagram has no accounts, no servers, no analytics and no ads. Your health data never leaves your devices.

name: Katra Wellness Studio
description: En la aplicación de Katra Wellness Studio vas a poder encontrar toda la información generada en el sistema administrativo de gimnasios NETGYM. Allí podrás ver tus rutinas, planes alimenticios, asistencias, deudas, historial de compras, entre otros datos.

name: Keeper Wanted: Idle Defense
description:
WANTED: lighthouse keeper on a remote sea. Term: 1,000 days. Pay: $10,000,000.
One condition — never put out the light at night.

Keeper Wanted is a pixel-art idle tower defense game where you hold back sea monsters with a harpoon. Play by hand for that satisfying hit, or let the lighthouse fight on its own while you're away — it's an incremental idle game you can play offline.

▶ Throw, reel, smash
Tap the sea to throw your harpoon, hold to reel a monster in and smash it on the rocks. Quick taps for speed, long reels for heavy hits. Your own hands are always faster.

▶ Harpoon guns fight for you
The lighthouse's harpoon guns keep firing even when you let go, and you can buy more with gold. Leave them on duty when you're busy, and jump back in when you're not.

▶ Earn gold while away
Even with the game closed, the lighthouse keeps working. Collect the gold piled up in the storeroom when you're back and pour it into upgrades. No internet needed — a true offline idle game.

▶ Every monster, a new trick
Sharks you can't hit while only the fin shows. Drowned hands that drag back what you reel. Puffers that bounce harpoons when they puff up. Every monster needs its own trick, and new ones arrive with each season.

▶ Tug of war with giant bosses
On certain nights a giant boss rises from the sea. Bosses use several skills, and below half health they fly into a rage. Hold on to yank them in, and unleash Flash, Net and Harpoon Rain to wipe out the whole wave.

▶ Lights out, rise stronger
Stuck? Put out the light. Your upgrades reset, but you earn pearls, and what you buy with them stays for good. Easy nights rush past on the riptide — prestige, the lighthouse way.

▶ The rules, and the last keeper's journal
"Clawed things cannot be pierced. Smash them on the rocks." New rules open as the days go by, and journal pages drifting in by bottle tell the island's secret, one page at a time.

▶ It begins and ends as a webtoon
From the night you find the ad in your tiny rooftop room to the dawn of day 1,000, the story unfolds in webtoon panels. Autumn moonlight, winter aurora, foggy spring, a red summer storm — the sea and the music change with every season.

Ads only play when you choose to watch one for a reward. No paid loot boxes.

name: Keeptow
description:
Keeptow is not just another habit tracker filled with pastel icons, sunset photos, and platitudes like "believe in yourself—you can do it!" Think of it as a dark, focused laboratory where you build yourself into a functional system. No cute mascot, no affirmations, and no interface that gets in the way of your thinking.

The app consists of five distinct sections, each designed for a specific purpose:

DASHBOARD — your morning command center. At a glance, you can see your daily agenda, your current energy level, and a single insight from your personal knowledge base—something concrete worth reflecting on. This morning check-in takes less than a minute, yet it sets the trajectory for your entire day.

EXECUTE — a workspace stripped of all unnecessary embellishments. It features a Pomodoro timer, a "deep work" mode, and tools to help you maintain focus. Hit "start" and dive into your task—the interface is intentionally designed to keep distractions at bay.

LEARN — concise, 3–5 minute lessons covering topics like Stoicism, neuroscience, biohacking, and systems thinking. Forget 40-hour courses that you end up abandoning by the second week. Each lesson concludes with a mini-quiz: it reveals whether you’ve truly grasped the concept or simply skimmed through it, fooling yourself. The app tracks this distinction honestly.

ANALYTICS — not just pretty charts for the sake of a nice report. This is real data: it shows where you have consistent streaks, which days of the week things tend to fall apart, and where you might be lying to yourself by claiming things are "fine overall." Look at the numbers, then draw your own conclusions.

BUILD — organize your habits into chains rather than just ticking off isolated boxes. Create structured sequences—like a morning protocol, an evening routine, or a dedicated work block. Tailor everything to your own rhythm and link your actions to specific daily triggers.

The design is dark and intentional—neon purple, cyan, and gold set against an almost-black background. This isn’t just following a trend; it’s genuinely more comfortable to use in the evening. No pastels. No nature photography. No inspirational quotes plastered over clouds.

Ghost Mode: hide all the numbers with a single toggle when you just need to get to work—without constantly tracking every tiny step.

Notifications are strictly functional: three daily priorities in the morning, and a brief summary of the day in the evening. No endless stream of trivial reminders.

Spotlight Search: access lessons and tools directly from your iPhone’s home screen, without needing to open the app.

Keeptow doesn’t promise happiness or try to motivate you with images of someone else’s success. It simply shows you, with total honesty, what is actually happening—and provides the levers you need to change it.

Download it. Run it for one day. Look at the numbers.

name: KEPLR Команда
description:
KEPLR Команда — рабочее приложение сотрудников школ, которые работают на KEPLR: администраторов, педагогов и руководителей.

• Чаты с родителями и учениками, чаты педагогов, общий чат команды и мультичат (Telegram, MAX, ВКонтакте) в одном месте.
• Голосовые и видеосообщения, фото, файлы, пересылка, «Поделиться» из других приложений.
• Расписание занятий и событий, замены педагогов.
• Задачи и уведомления.
• Онлайн-уроки и рабочие встречи прямо в приложении.
• Планы уроков, учебники, чек-листы, гайды и база знаний.

Приложение только для сотрудников школ на KEPLR. Учётную запись выдаёт школа, открытой регистрации нет.

name: KEPLR Ученик
Kerfline: Sheet Cut Planner
description:
Stop buying an extra sheet of plywood you didn't need.

Kerfline lays out your cut list on stock sheets in seconds and shows you exactly where every part goes. It's built for the shop: it works offline, needs no account, and has no ads or subscriptions. You pay once and it's yours.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your sheet: 4×8, 4×4, 2×4, 5×5, metric 2440×1220, or any custom size.
2. Set your blade kerf: 1/8" by default, or whatever your blade cuts.
3. Add your parts on the number pad, then tap a fraction key (1/8 to 7/8, or 16ths) to get 23 1/2 or 11 5/16. Set a quantity for each part.
4. Tap Optimize layout. Kerfline tests dozens of layout strategies and keeps the one that uses the fewest sheets, leaving the biggest usable offcut on the last one.

BUILT FOR REAL CUTTING
• Every layout uses guillotine cuts: straight, edge-to-edge cuts you can make on a table saw, track saw, or panel saw.
• Each cut accounts for the kerf, so parts come out true to size.
• Grain lock keeps cabinet sides and face panels running with the grain. Unlocked parts rotate freely to save material.
• Inches with fractions or millimetres, and you can switch any time.
• A clear diagram for every sheet shows part names, sizes, and yield.
• Share the whole cut plan as one image to print, text, or pin above the saw.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Kerfline has no networking code. Your projects stay on your iPhone, and nothing is collected, tracked, or uploaded.

Great for cabinets, bookcases, shop furniture, closet builds, built-ins, and anything else cut from sheet goods.

name: Kertia
description:
Kertia es la app para organizadores, facilitadores y porteros que usan la plataforma Kertia.

EN LA PUERTA
• Escanea pases con la cámara: resultado inmediato en verde o rojo, con sonido y vibración.
• Funciona sin conexión y sincroniza al volver internet.
• Controla reingresos, salidas, áreas y aforo en vivo.
• Lee pulseras y tarjetas NFC.

EVENTOS
• Revisa las ventas de entradas y aprueba o rechaza pagos deslizando.
• Busca asistentes y entrega kits.

CAPACITACIONES
• Muestra el QR de asistencia, marca presentes y emite certificados verificables.

Tus participantes no necesitan instalar nada: se registran y reciben su pase desde el navegador.

Se necesita una cuenta de Kertia. Créala gratis en kertia.app.

name: Kettlebell Swat
description:
Train with Coach Swat. Kettlebell Swat puts a real kettlebell coach in your pocket, talking you through every rep, every round and every rest.

Pick up a bell, press start and follow along. Coach Swat's voice cues each move as it begins, counts you through the work and keeps you moving through the rest, so you never have to stop and check your phone. The coaching voice is a lifelike text-to-speech voice modeled on Coach Swat's cues, not a live recording.

TRY A FREE WORKOUT
Start with a complete beginner session, fully coached from warmup to cooldown, and free forever. No account needed.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Coach-led follow-along workouts with voice cues, a countdown timer and optional music
- Seven workouts: Full-Body Swing Power, Iron Legs, Upper Body Armor, Core Forge, Snatch Attack, Get-Up Grind and a 15-minute express session
- Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced levels for every workout, each with a coached warmup and cooldown
- A library of 47 kettlebell moves with demos and form cues, filterable by movement and muscle
- Build your own workouts: pick the moves, set work, rest and rounds, and Coach Swat coaches you through it
- A fresh workout on Today every day, plus streaks and a 28-day history on Progress

MEMBERSHIP
The free workout and its moves are always free. A Kettlebell Swat Membership unlocks every workout at every level, the full move library and the workout builder. Choose monthly or yearly; both start with a 1-week free trial for eligible new members.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically at the same price and length unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Grab your bell. Let's go.

Terms of Use: https://kettlebell-swat-site.rork.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kettlebell-swat-site.rork.app/privacy

name: Keyer Rhythm
description:
Keyer Rhythm times every key-down and the gaps between them.

A session splits key-down lengths into dits and dahs, then reads the gaps as element, letter, or word spaces. Speed is 1200 divided by the dit. The decoded Morse text sits above a gantt of the marks. Drag the boundary and the last character can change from D to K.

Letters ranks the characters you miss. The weakest three fill most of a new practice line. Drift plots dit length across sessions and marks a point that leaves the control limits.

Sessions stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: KHDC Schools
description:
KHDC Schools is a unified digital school management mobile application designed to connect students, teachers, and participating educational institutions in one secure and easy-to-use platform.

Whether you are a student tracking your daily classes and exam results or a teacher managing attendance, study materials, and academic progress, KHDC Schools brings essential school management tools directly to your mobile device.

KEY FEATURES FOR STUDENTS
• Personalized Dashboard: View your student ID summary, daily schedule, school announcements, notifications, and quick shortcuts in one place.
• Academics & Study Materials: Access enrolled subjects, syllabi, and downloadable PDFs or study resources anytime.
• Class Routine & Holiday Calendar: Check your weekly timetable, export class routines as PDF, and view the monthly school holiday calendar.
• Attendance Tracker: Monitor monthly attendance statistics, daily attendance logs, and summaries at a glance.
• Exams, Results & Admit Cards: View term-wise marksheets and academic performance reports, and download exam admit cards in PDF format.
• Live Classes: Join scheduled online classes directly from your dashboard.
• Fees & Billing Statements: Review fee invoices, billing details, payment history, and download fee statements.
• Library, Leave & Certificates: Track borrowed library books, apply for leave with supporting documents, and submit or download certificate requests.

KEY FEATURES FOR TEACHERS
• Teacher Dashboard & Routine: View daily teaching schedules, quick actions, and class summaries.
• Attendance Management: Take and submit student attendance, export attendance reports, and record teacher check-in/check-out.
• Classes, Materials & Grading: Upload study materials, manage assignments, review submissions, and enter exam marks.
• Leave & Approvals: Manage personal leave requests and review student leave applications.
• Student Directory & Profiles: Access class student lists and academic profiles easily.

MULTI-SCHOOL & BILINGUAL SUPPORT
• Select your participating school from the KHDC Schools directory before signing in.
• Switch seamlessly between English and Bangla inside the app.
• Secure login with institution-managed accounts and password recovery support.

Note: Accounts for KHDC Schools are provided and managed by participating educational institutions. Please contact your school administration if you need login credentials or assistance.

name: KI-Fragrance Парфумерна школа
description:
Застосунок для учнів школи Ксенії Петрусенко. Доступ дає школа: обліковий запис створюємо, коли ви приєднуєтеся до групи. Реєстрації в застосунку немає.

Усе навчання поруч: уроки, щоденне тренування нюху, описи ароматів і ваші власні записи. Відкрили застосунок — і одразу видно, на чому ви зупинилися.

УРОКИ
• Програма курсу з модулями та прогресом: що пройдено, що читаєте зараз, що попереду.
• Розділи уроків з текстом, фото й відео. Повертайтеся до теорії будь-коли, перед заняттям чи після.
• «Читати далі» відкриває саме той розділ, де ви зупинилися.

ЩОДЕННИК НОТ
• Щодня позначайте, як упізнаєте кожну ноту тижня: правильно, не правильно чи не відчуваю.
• Тиждень у вигляді таблиці: видно, які ноти вже впізнаєте впевнено, а над якими ще варто попрацювати.

ОПИСИ АРОМАТІВ
• Опишіть парфум з флакончика лише за підписом на наліпці, не знаючи назви.
• Після перевірки ви побачите справжню назву аромату й коментар до свого опису. Застосунок повідомить, щойно опис перевірено.

ПЕРЕМОГИ ТИЖНЯ
• Записуйте нові бренди й парфуми, з якими познайомилися за тиждень, і свої враження. Викладач відповідає на ваші перемоги.

НОТАТКИ ПРО СИРОВИНУ
• Як звучить матеріал на блотері й на шкірі, через годину і через день. Про один матеріал можна писати кілька разів.
• Пошук за матеріалом або текстом нотатки.

ПАРФУМЕРНА ПІДБІРКА
• Ваша бібліотека ароматів, розкладена за родинами: цитрусові, квіткові, деревні та інші.
• Для кожного парфуму: фото, бренд, головна нота й опис вашими словами.
• Пошук за назвою, брендом, нотою чи описом.

ЗРУЧНО
• Світла й темна тема, або як у системі телефону.
• Зміна пароля та видалення облікового запису в профілі.

Школа Ксенії Петрусенко вчить чути парфуми: впізнавати ноти, описувати аромат професійно, а не словами «стійкий і шлейфовий», і розуміти, кому він підійде. Застосунок допомагає робити це щодня, між заняттями.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Kids' church
description:
Kids' church keeps a church's children's team organised in one place.

• The rota: the next eight weeks of services, who's teaching each class, and which classes still need someone.
• Fill a gap: volunteer, add a teacher, or ask the team on WhatsApp with the dates already written in.
• Lessons: the title, Bible passage and notes for each class, there for whoever is teaching.
• Files and links: colouring sheets, songs and anything else the team uses, kept together.
• Reminders: a notification at 6pm the evening before you teach, with the lesson. Leaders also hear on Sunday evening when a class in the next two weeks has no teacher. Each can be switched off.
• The team: leaders add teachers and leaders, and keep the WhatsApp group a tap away.

Only people a leader has added can sign in, with Google, Apple or a code sent to WhatsApp. Nothing about the children is kept, and there's no advertising or tracking.

name: Kindlehaven
description:
Gather your friends, light the fire and build a haven through the long winter.

Kindlehaven is a cozy co-op village builder. Grow your camp into a mighty fortress, one log, one stone and one good friend at a time.

BUILD A HAVEN TOGETHER
• Build your camp into a mighty fortress
• Keep the fire burning to see your village through the cold
• Tame wild beasts and bring them home
• Craft tools and forge gear for the journey ahead
• Crawl the dungeons for rare loot and adventure

YOUR HERO, YOUR CAMP
Create your own hero, then shape your village however you like. Every camp grows a little differently.

BETTER AROUND THE FIRE
Kindlehaven is made for playing together.
1. Host a town
2. Share the code with your friends
3. Build together. No account needed.

Build. Brew. Survive. The fire's lit, and there's a spot saved for you.

MADE BY WILDHEART GAMING
Kindlehaven is made by Wildheart Gaming, an independent studio making games that bring people together.

Questions or feedback? Email games@wildheartgaming.com

name: KinoRoll: Text Behind & Light
description:
Turn any everyday photo into a museum-grade magazine cover, sunlit 3D studio portrait, or silky 60fps spatial cinema clip — 100% on-device with full offline privacy.

HAIR-LEVEL TEXT BEHIND SUBJECT
• Dual Smart Masking: blends on-device hair-level foreground matting (clean fur, hair, ears, and hands) with continuous 3D depth slicing for cityscapes and architecture.
• Full Editorial Typography Freedom: 5 layouts (Magazine, Neon Title, Vertical Cinema, A24 Poster, 35mm Card), curated serif, sans, script & mono fonts, 8 editorial color swatches, hollow outline toggle, multi-line headlines (1–3 lines), smooth angle rotation, and direct finger drag positioning.
• Clean, Editable Layouts: customize or clear top tags and date stamps freely — zero watermarks.

INTERACTIVE 3D STUDIO RELIGHTING
• Understands your photo's 3D depth so sunlight and shadows naturally wrap around faces, pets, cups, and walls.
• 7 Interactive 3D Light Rigs: Venetian Blinds Sun, Dappled Leaf Sun, Architectural Window Grid, Golden Hour Rim, Cyber Dual Neon, Studio Spotlight, and Optical Prism — drag the 3D Light Orb directly on your photo to sculpt light in real time.

AUTHENTIC OPTICAL FILM & ATMOSPHERE
• 8 Film Stocks: CineStill 800T, Portra 400, Kodak Gold 200, Polaroid 600, Classic Neg NC, Super-8 '78, CCD 2003, and Ilford HP5 B&W with warm halation and organic film grain.
• Real Optical Atmosphere: Black Pro-Mist diffusion, 35mm analog light leaks, soft sun haze, and far-background bokeh.
• Hold-to-Compare & Gyro Tilt: hold the eye button for instant before/after comparison, or tilt your iPhone for live 3D depth parallax.

SAVE DIRECTLY TO PHOTOS & SHARE
• Shoot with the native iOS camera or import from Photos.
• Save HD 4:5 posters, 9:16 vertical clips, or 16:9 frames and silky 60fps 3D MP4 videos straight to your Photos library — ready for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts.

FLEXIBLE PRO PLANS — ANNUAL OR LIFETIME (IPHONE & MAC UNIVERSAL)
• Free forever with zero ads: 4 complete Director Looks (Venetian Sun, Chungking Neon, Kyoto Polaroid, Pure Spatial 3D), 4 Film Stocks, full typography controls, 3D relighting, and direct Poster PNG & 3-second 60fps MP4 save to Photos.
• KinoRoll Pro Annual ($9.99/year with 3-day free trial) or Lifetime ($19.99 one-time buyout), Family Shareable across iPhone & Mac: unlocks all 10 Director Looks, all 8 Film Stocks (Classic Neg NC, Super-8, CCD, Ilford HP5), multi-shot 60fps Cinema Reel export, full-resolution 2K/4K poster export, and ongoing new film stocks, light rigs & director look updates.
• Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or billing period in Apple Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://mac.iktu.cn/kinoroll/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Kipzo: İngilizce Öğren
description:
Kipzo, Türkçe konuşanlar için hazırlanmış eğlenceli bir İngilizce uygulaması. Konular herkes için aynı; soruların zorluğu senin seviyene göre değişir.

SEVİYE SINAVI (A1 – B2)
Dinleme, okuma ve dil bilgisi sorularıyla seviyeni belirle ya da kendin seç. A1'de seçmeli sorular, B2'de şıksız yazma ve dikte.

50 KONU, 200 DERS, 500 KELİME
Selamlaşmadan iş görüşmesine. Her konu 4 ders: yeni kelimeler, dinle ve anla, hikâye ve tekrar. Her kelime Türkçe çevirili örnek cümleyle.

DİNLEME - AMA İSTERSEN SESSİZ
Kelime ve cümleler İngilizce okunur; yavaş dinleyebilirsin. Ortam uygun değilse "Şu anda dinleyemem" de, sorular yazıya dönüşsün.

MESLEK İNGİLİZCESİ
Mühendis, yazılımcı, doktor, hemşire, psikolog, barista, aşçı, makyaj, polis, öğretmen: her mesleğe özel 6 ünite.

⏰ GÜNLÜK VE HAFTALIK HEDEF
15 dk, 30 dk ya da 1 saat: hedefini seç, Kipzo ilerlemeni göstersin.

6 LİG, 6 HAFTALIK SEZON
Amatör Lig'den Süper Lig'e yüksel. 20 kişilik grubunda coin'e göre yarış: ilk 5 üst lige çıkar, son 5 düşer. Sezon birincisi coin ve sürpriz hediye kazanır (kurallar uygulamada).

ARKADAŞLAR, MESAJ VE DÜELLO
Ligden profillere bak, arkadaş ekle, mesajlaş, aynı 10 soruyla düello yap. Mesajlaşma yalnızca karşılıklı arkadaşlar arasında; uygunsuz mesajlar filtrelenir, şikayet ve engelleme var.

HEMEN DENE
İlk 5 dersi kayıt olmadan dene. Devam etmek, coin kazanmak ve ligde yarışmak için ücretsiz hesap aç; ilerlemen korunur. Hesabını istediğin an uygulamadan silebilirsin.

Kipzo Coin uygulama içi sanal bir puandır, parasal değeri yoktur, satın alınamaz ve paraya çevrilemez.

Gizlilik: https://kipzo.netlify.app/privacy.html
Kullanım şartları: https://kipzo.netlify.app/terms.html

name: KitLatch
description:
The trouble with a good kit bag isn't packing it. It's what's missing from it next time.

KitLatch keeps a calm checklist for each bag you carry, from the camera bag and gym bag to the toolbox and swim kit. Tick items as you pack, start an outing, and when you get home, check off what came back. Anything still missing is flagged gently, so you can deal with it before the next trip.

How it works:
• Kits built from ready templates or from scratch
• Essentials starred, with quantities on every item
• Pack mode with one-tap "pack everything"
• Check out to a destination and see how long you've been away
• Check in on return, with missing items listed clearly
• An outing history, so you can see where things went

For photographers, swimmers, climbers, tradespeople, parents with nappy bags, and anyone tired of buying the same charger twice.

Private by design: everything is stored on your device.

name: Kitted:Parts&Kits
description:
Kitted is a parts manager for hobby electronics projects. It compares your parts lists with the parts in your inventory. It shows which project you can build today. It also shows the parts that you must buy.

To start a project, import a parts list. Kitted reads CSV, TSV, plain text and PDF files. You can also paste rows of text or use a picture of a printed list. Kitted compares each row with your inventory. On supported devices, built-in AI helps to read lists that have an irregular layout.

To pick parts, hold a parts bag in front of the lens. Kitted reads the code or the part number on the label. A bracket shows the label, and a line points to the applicable row of the list. Kitted puts a tick on the row and decreases the quantity in the bin. You do not type values.

Each project has a status on the board: Needs parts, Ready, Picking, Kitted or Done. The status changes when your inventory changes. Each card shows the next action. The Today screen shows the next step, the projects that are nearly ready and the changes since yesterday.

The Missing parts list shows the parts that your open projects need. Kitted gives parts to projects in the sequence of their priority. To order parts, make a purchase order from this list with one tap. Record your suppliers and their delivery times. When an order arrives, receive it. Kitted then adds the parts to your inventory.

Before you buy a part, look for a substitute in your inventory. Kitted does not change a project until you confirm the substitute.

Put your parts in racks and bins. Each bin has a tag, for example A4-1. Keep a task list for each project. Export a daily report as a PDF file. Use Bench mode to show larger text and to keep the screen on.

Kitted helps you build your next project with the parts that you have.

name: KitTrellis
description:
Build reusable packing kits for trips and field equipment. Add items with quantities, unit weights and notes. Check off packed items and see progress and total kit weight update immediately.

Search kits, filter unpacked items, edit or delete records, duplicate a kit with a fresh checklist, reset packing, and export a readable list through the system share sheet.

Records are stored locally. No account, advertising or in-app purchases. Choose one of eight languages and a light, dark or system appearance. Example kits are optional fictional data available in Settings.

name: Kiwi Tamil Samoogam
description:
Kiwi Tamil Samoogam (KTS) is a not-for-profit community organisation for Tamil-speaking families in New Zealand. This app is the official digital membership card for KTS members.

WHAT THE APP DOES
• Sign in with the KTS membership account you created on the KTS website.
• See your membership card: your name, member number, membership year and status.
• Show your member QR code at KTS events so organisers can confirm your membership.
• Pull down to refresh your membership details at any time.

If your membership is pending, expired or not yet approved, the app shows your current status and explains how to complete or renew it on the KTS website.

FOR EXISTING MEMBERS
Accounts are created and managed on the KTS website (kts.org.nz). The app does not offer registration, payments or purchases. Visit kts.org.nz to learn more about joining KTS.

name: Kleinmond – Baby Tracker
description:
Kleinmond is a calm companion for your baby's day. Logging sleep, feeds and diapers takes one tap – even at 3 a.m., one-handed, with a dimmed screen. You keep track without having to think, and see at a glance how the day has gone so far.

With Kleinmond Plus you also get a personal sleep window: an approximate time range for the next nap and for bedtime, based on your baby's age and on your own entries from the last few days.

FREE FOREVER
• Sleep with a timer or added afterwards
• Breastfeeding timer for left and right, including the last side used
• Bottles, solids, diapers and pumping
• Growth: weight, length and head circumference
• Notes for any moment
• Day band and history: the whole day at a glance
• Edit or delete entries any time
• Home and Lock Screen widgets with quick logging
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island for running timers
• Night mode with a warm, dark design
• Multiple babies, e.g. for siblings or twins

KLEINMOND PLUS
• Sleep window & bedtime suggestion: Kleinmond shows an approximate time range for the next nap and for bedtime – first based on age, then more and more personal based on your entries. With an optional reminder shortly before.
• Insights & weekly summary: day and night sleep, feeds and diapers over the week, in clear charts.
• Track together: share a baby via iCloud with your partner, grandparents or a caregiver. Everyone sees the same entries, including running timers.
• PDF and CSV export: overviews to take along, e.g. to your paediatrician or midwife appointment.

The sleep window is a rough guide, not a fixed plan. Every baby is different – you know yours best. Kleinmond is an organiser for your daily routine, not a medical product.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• No account needed
• Your entries stay on your iPhone and, if you like, in your private iCloud
• No tracking, no ads, no analytics tools
• Delete all data with one tap

SUBSCRIPTION AND FREE TRIAL
Kleinmond Plus is available as a monthly subscription for €6.99 or a yearly subscription for €39.99. You can try Plus free for 7 days. After the trial, the price is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically for the same period unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel it any time in your Apple ID settings under "Subscriptions".

Privacy Policy: https://kleinmond-site.noel-2a0.workers.dev/privacy

name: Kleo: Parent Helper
description:
Kleo is the parent helper: your kids' plans, pick-ups, to-dos and notes in one place. Less to remember, more peace of mind.

KIDS' PLANS
• School, kindergarten, nursery and activities – a timetable or just the hours.
• One-off events: trips, birthday parties, appointments.
• Cancel or move a weekly activity for one day without breaking the whole plan.

PICK-UPS AND DROP-OFFS
• Know who drops off and who picks up today.
• Confirm with one tap; the person picking up gets a reminder.

TO-DOS AND LISTS
• Tasks with due dates, like "Pay for the school trip".
• Packing lists, ready the day before.
• To-dos assigned to a parent or caregiver.

NOTES
• School, health, contacts, clothing sizes, food – always at hand.
• Voice dictation.

SHARED FAMILY PLAN (PREMIUM)
• One plan on both parents' phones – changes show up in seconds and it works offline.
• Grandma or the nanny can see the plan and confirm their pick-ups.
• Notifications about changes: who's picking up, cancelled activities, a new to-do for you.
• Every new family gets 30 days free. Premium is bought for a year – one for the whole family, with no automatic renewal.

On a single phone everything is free: no account, no limits, no ads. You can also explore a sample family first.

Shared plan data is stored on servers in the European Union. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

Terms: https://kleofamily.com/en/terms
Privacy policy: https://kleofamily.com/en/privacy-policy

name: Ko(t)ordinaten
description:
Every runner knows it: mile 14, no porta-potty anywhere – off into the bushes. Ko(t)ordinaten turns those moments into a map your running group will laugh about.

DROP A POOP
One tap, the map jumps to you, nudge the pin into place, done. The app remembers the time.

LOG A PAST POOP
Forgot? Search the place, put the crosshair on it – add the time only if you still know it.

POOP PROFILE
Race or training, urgency on a slider (from “Could have waited” to “Last Minute”), bush or porta-potty, paper, view, run and kilometer.

NEAREST LOO
Public toilets nearby from Apple Maps and OpenStreetMap – with walking directions.

POOP STATS
Favorite areas, favorite time of day, records like your highest poop, and badges such as “Repeat Offender”, “Peak Pooper” or “Code Brown”.

YEAR IN POOP
Your yearly review as an image to share in the group chat.

ALWAYS AT HAND
Widgets for Home and Lock Screen, a Control Center button, Siri (“I need to go with Ko(t)ordinaten”) and the Action button.

GERMAN OR ENGLISH
Pick your language right at the start or anytime in the settings.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your poops live on your iPhone and in your private iCloud. Export as JSON or GPX anytime.

name: Koi Garden: Zen Pond & Sleep
description:
A cherry blossom garden above. A living koi pond below.

Koi Garden turns your iPhone into a small Japanese courtyard. Petals drift down from the cherry tree, cross into the water and float away. Your koi glide beneath the surface, bending and turning like real fish, while the garden's reflection trembles on every ripple.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Fold it halfway and stand it on your desk: the garden rises on the upper screen, the pond lies flat on the lower one, and the two meet at the crease as one scene. On any other iPhone the garden and pond share one screen.

TOUCH THE WATER
• Tap the pond and ripples spread; the koi come to see what happened.
• Touch and hold to scatter food, and watch them gather to eat.
• Trail your finger through the water.
• Tap the cherry tree to shake loose a shower of petals.

THE WIND IS YOURS
Breathe gently toward your phone and the breeze picks up: branches sway, petals fall faster. The microphone only listens for your breath while you switch it on — nothing is ever recorded.

YOUR OWN KOI
Give each koi a name in your koi book. They grow on the days you feed them, and every second day you visit a new one swims in — from classic Kohaku and golden Ogon to rare Tancho, Asagi and Goshiki.

BREATHE WITH THE POND
Guided breathing on the water: a ring of light swells as you breathe in and a wave crosses the pond with every breath. Calm (in 4, out 6), Focus (box breathing) and Sleep (4-7-8), with a soft cue at each turn so you can close your eyes. Keep a daily streak.

DESK CLOCK, SLEEP TIMER, WIDGETS
Stand your iPhone Duo on the desk or nightstand and the garden shows a quiet clock. Set a sleep timer and the sound and the light fade away together. Add the pond to your Home Screen or StandBy with a widget.

SOUNDS FOR CALM AND SLEEP
Garden, breeze, rustling leaves, birdsong and rain — original ambient soundscapes that keep playing with the screen locked.

FREE, OR YOURS FOREVER
Koi Garden is free with a small ad beneath the pond. One purchase removes ads for good and unlocks every sound, the six rare koi, every breathing rhythm and longer sessions. No subscription.

name: Kökbörü: Shattered Sky
description:
When the sky shattered, three realms lost their balance. Kökbörü: Shattered Sky is a top-down survival action game inspired by Turkic mythology.

Choose your hero, step onto the steppe and hold out against wave after wave of creatures. Pick a new power every level, upgrade your weapons, combine them with the right accessory to evolve them, and face the lord of the realm.

FEATURES
• 11 heroes, each with a signature weapon, a passive ability and an ultimate.
• Three realms, three lords: Tepegöz in the Sacred Steppe, Kamos on the Ice Mountain, Erlik Han in the Underground Kingdom.
• Weapons, spell books, accessories and companions: build something different every run.
• Weapon evolutions: max out a weapon and combine it with the right item.
• Chests that rise in tier as you tap them.
• Three difficulty levels, plus Endless Mode after you defeat the lord.
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements for longest survival and most kills.
• Permanent upgrades and an armory to grow stronger between runs.
• Portrait and landscape play with one-handed controls.
• Playable offline. No ads.

The game is free. It includes optional in-app purchases (coin packs and three legendary heroes).

name: KOKO: Korean Voice Calls
description:
KOKO is a Korean friend and travel coach you talk to by phone.

Pick up, speak Korean, and find out whether you sounded like a friend or a stranger. KOKO focuses on the part textbooks skip: Banmal (casual) and Jondaetmal (polite), and when to use each.

FOUR COACHES
- Jimin: a college student near Hongdae. All Banmal, with teasing for stiff endings.
- Minjun: for beginners. Mix in English anytime and get one short phrase to say at a time.
- Seoyeon: a Seongsu cafe manager. Polite, real-world service Korean.
- Hyunwoo: your senior. Starts polite, then offers to switch to Banmal.

PRACTICE BEFORE YOU FLY
- T-money top-ups, subway routes and taxis
- Cafes, restaurants, less spicy, splitting the bill
- Sizes, tax refunds, convenience stores
- Restrooms, directions and Wi-Fi
- Hanging out with Korean friends
- Or type any situation and call

DURING THE CALL
- Live Korean transcript with optional English
- Stuck? Tap for three things you could say
- Slow, normal or fast speech

AFTER THE CALL
- A tone score and a card for every line
- Compare your voice with a native-style voice
- Save phrases and review them on a calendar

ON A SCHEDULE
Choose a time and KOKO rings you. Miss it, and it tries again.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Speech, replies and recordings are processed and kept on your iPhone. No account.

REQUIREMENTS
iOS 26 and an Apple Intelligence iPhone (iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, or iPhone 16 and later) with Apple Intelligence on. Coaches use AI and can make mistakes.

SUBSCRIPTION
Calls need KOKO Monthly. New subscribers get 1 week free, then $4.99 per month in the US (price varies by country). It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: KoreanGo: Travel Korean
description:
Heading to Seoul or starting Korean from scratch? Struggling to tell plain vs. aspirated vs. tense consonants apart (불 vs. 풀 vs. 뿔), write balanced Hangul blocks, or speak politely in cafés and shops?
KoreanGo brings 40 interactive Hangul Jamo with guided writing, 100 real-world Seoul dialogue videos, 12 practical roleplay missions, and a live two-way voice interpreter together in one clean portrait app built for one-handed use.

FIVE CORE PILLARS

1. Structured 15-Unit Korean Roadmap + Linking & Politeness Rules
- Progress step by step from all 40 Jamo, native vs. Sino-Korean numbers, and cafe orders to Korean BBQ, K-beauty shopping, Incheon Airport, T-money subway transfers, hotels, and clinics.
- Clear Revised Romanization and IPA with standard and 0.7x slow native studio audio on every word and example.

2. 40 Hangul Jamo + Stroke Writing Canvas + 24 3-Way Ear Drills
- Tap any Jamo for initial and batchim sound breakdowns, mouth placement guides, and interactive stroke-by-stroke canvas practice right on the page.
- Train your ear with 24 blind minimal-pair drills contrasting plain (불/달/자다), aspirated (풀/탈/차다), tense (뿔/딸/짜다), vowel contrasts (ㅓ/ㅗ, ㅡ/ㅜ), and final batchim stops.

3. 100 Real-World Seoul Dialogue Videos (200 Studio Recordings)
- Organized chronologically across 5 trip categories—Dining & Cafes, Shopping & K-Beauty, Airport & Transit, Hotel & Sightseeing, Social & Urgent Help—with bilingual transcripts, IPA, and cultural tips.

4. 12 Guided Speaking Missions · 160 SM-2 Flashcards · 18 Grammar Drills
- Practice 3-round cafe, BBQ, T-money, check-in, and emergency missions where staff speak first and helpful Hangul hints stay visible on screen while you speak.
- Review 160 essential cards with spaced repetition (SM-2) and 320 studio audio clips, plus 18 Korean drills covering 은/는 vs. 이/가, 을/를, 에서/으로, 아요/어요 politeness, and counters.

5. Instant 2-Way Live Voice Interpreter (Rightmost Tab)
- Speak or type in English / 繁中 / 简中 / 日本語 ⇄ 한국어 for fast two-way translation, natural Korean voice playback, and fullscreen display cards.

PRIVACY FIRST
- No sign-up, no ads, no third-party tracking. Your study progress stays privately on your device.

name: Kosma Scanner: Barcode & QR
description:
Kosma Scanner is a barcode and QR code scanner for warehouses, shops and stocktaking. Point your iPhone or iPad camera at a code and the count is done, with a file ready for Excel or your accounting system.

SCANNING SESSIONS
Every receiving, shipment or stock count is a separate session with its own name and mode.
• Summing mode: a repeat scan raises the count, and boxes are entered as ×N.
• One-by-one mode: every scan is a separate row with its time. Made for serial numbers, returns and product marking.
• Total scans and Unique counters are always on screen.
• Correct a quantity by hand, undo the last scan, search by code or name.

SCANNING
• Camera: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, QR, DataMatrix, Code 128 and other formats.
• Flashlight right in the camera view.
• External Bluetooth scanner in keyboard mode.
• A beep on scan, a double beep on a repeat, a low one on an error. Vibration has its own switch.

PRODUCT CATALOG
Load CSV or XLSX from 1C, Excel or Google Sheets and see names instead of codes in the session. Columns are detected automatically, Windows-1251 is read. Free — up to 500 items, Pro — unlimited. In Pro the catalog can also be loaded from your API.

PLAN / FACT (PRO)
Stocktaking against a task: load a file with codes and quantities, and after the count you see shortages, surpluses and codes not in the task. The differences can be exported.

GS1 AND CHESTNY ZNAK
Decodes the code data: GTIN, serial number, batch, expiry date, production date. In one-by-one mode the app warns if the code was already in the session.

STORAGE LOCATIONS
Scan a location barcode and the next items go there. The export gets a Location column.

MERGING SESSIONS (PRO)
Several devices, one session: add an export file from another device, and quantities of identical codes in one location are summed.

EXPORT
• CSV with “;”, “,” or Tab separator — free.
• XLSX and e-mail to a set address — in Pro.
• Send the file via Share or save it to Files.

SEND TO YOUR SYSTEM (PRO)
Connect the scanner to 1C, a WMS or your in-house service.
• Address, POST or PUT, Bearer, Basic or API-key authorization.
• Connection test and a ready curl command for developers.
• Send a session as JSON with one button; a resend creates no duplicates, and every attempt is kept in the send history.
• Google Sheets: session rows appear in your spreadsheet.
• Tokens and passwords are kept in the device Keychain.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 3 sessions a month, reset on the 1st; one more can be earned with a short video, once a day at most. Scans and session time are not limited, and a started session can be finished. Catalog up to 500 items, CSV export, storage locations. With ads.
Pro — a monthly or yearly subscription: no session limit, no ads, unlimited catalog, catalog from your API, plan / fact, XLSX, e-mail to a set address, Google Sheets, sending to your API, merging sessions. A 7-day free trial for new subscribers.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you subscribe.

SCANS STAY ON THE DEVICE
Every scan is written to device memory at once: if the app closes or the battery runs out, your scans stay where they were. Scans are not sent to Kosma servers; in Pro they go only to the address you set.

INTERFACE
Dark and light themes, large buttons for work in gloves. Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi and Russian.

Made for warehouse staff, store clerks, owners of small warehouses and shops, and integrators of 1C and other accounting systems.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kosma.tech/scanner/privacy/

name: KPOS TableOrder
description:
KPOS TableOrder puts a self-ordering menu on every table. Guests browse your menu, order and call a server from an iPad at their table, and orders go straight into your KPOS system, just like orders entered by your staff.

This app is for restaurants that use KPOS. You need a KPOS merchant account to sign in, and the iPad must be on the same Wi-Fi network as your KPOS station.

For guests
• Browse dishes by category, or search in any menu language. Search forgives small typos.
• See dish photos and details, with required and optional choices clearly marked.
• Add notes for the kitchen before placing an order.
• See what the table has already ordered, and add more items.
• Tap Call Waiter or Ready for Check to alert your staff.
• Optional member sign-in with a phone number and a text-message code.
• 9 languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, Vietnamese, Tagalog and Arabic.

For restaurants
• Bind each iPad to a table on your floor plan. Staff actions need an employee passcode, so guests can't change settings.
• Sold-out dishes are greyed out, and categories outside their serving hours are hidden.
• Menu changes reach the iPads within about 3 minutes.
• All-you-can-eat mode: price tiers per guest, time limits, last-order time, waits between orders and item limits.
• Courses, large photo cards, a floating cart and your own menu page layouts.
• Works with Guided Access to keep the iPad locked to the app.
• Copy settings from one iPad to the others by scanning a code.

Payment is handled by your staff. The iPad does not take payments.

Designed for iPad in landscape.

name: Kudahtor
description:
Greece has more bird species on record than almost anywhere else in Europe — pelicans
 nesting in flooded willow groves, vultures soaring over gorges named after gods, falcons
 that time their entire breeding season to catch the southward river of migrating songbirds.
 Most of this happens far from the usual tourist trail, in lagoons and mountain forests that
 most visitors never reach.

 Halycon is a field companion built for the people who want to find them.

 AN ATLAS OF 25 SPECIES AND 10 HOTSPOTS
 Every bird comes with a detailed profile: how to recognise it in the field, the best months
 to look, and which wetlands or cliffs to visit. Alongside the biology sits a section on myth
 and lore — the Little Owl that appeared on Athenian coins, the kingfisher whose legend gave
 this app its name. Greece is old enough that almost every bird has a story.

 A JOURNAL THAT GROWS WITH YOU
 Log sightings directly from a bird's page or from a hotspot. Add a photo, the exact count,
 a note about behaviour. Your records appear on a map, in a chronological log, and as a life
 list of postage-stamp illustrations — one for each species you've confirmed.

 KNOW WHAT TO LOOK FOR TODAY
 The Atlas tab opens with a live banner showing how many species are currently present in
 Greece. Filter by habitat, by season, or search in English, Latin or Greek. Each bird's page
 shows a 12-month strip so you can plan a trip around the right window.

 IDENTIFICATION PUZZLES AND XP
 The Enclosures section has identification challenges that reward careful observation. Get a
 species right, earn XP, unlock new stamps. A quiet way to sharpen your eye between outings.

 OFFLINE, PRIVATE, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
 Everything works without a connection. Your sightings stay on your device; nothing is sent
 anywhere. No login, no subscription, no background tracking.

 Built for anyone who has looked up at a sky over the Aegean and wondered what just flew past.
 Or who already knows exactly what it was, and wants to write it down.

name: Lab Relações Prêmio
description: Treine a lógica dedutiva conectando informações reais sobre premiação, pesquisadores e anos. Em cada sessão, você define um contexto específico e o aplicativo organiza a malha de conexões entre as datas e valores. O motor local valida suas escolhas, destacando exatamente onde a lógica falhou na tentativa anterior. O resultado é um mapa solucionado que evidencia os passos correctos e os pontos onde a eliminação estava errada. Ao encerrar a prática, o aplicativo recomeça focando os vínculos onde você mais tem dificuldade.

name: LaikaRun
description:
Lost among the stars, Laika just wants to go home.

Switch lanes, jump over obstacles and collect stars across six story runs. Tune in to radio messages from Earth along the way, and uncover different endings depending on how your journey unfolds.

• Simple lane-switching and jump controls
• Six story runs with multiple endings
• Radio messages from Earth
• Use coins to continue after a crash
• Progress saves automatically, so you can pick up where you left off

name: Lali: Guitar Live & Friends
description:
Find your people through guitar and music.

Lali is a guitar live-streaming community where music brings people together. Discover performances, share your love of guitar, and meet new friends who connect with your sound. Whether you’re an experienced player, a beginner, or someone who simply loves listening, there’s a place for you on Lali.

Meet new friends through guitar live streams
Enter guitar live-streaming rooms, discover the people behind the music, and chat with other viewers. Exchange song recommendations, talk about your favorite playing styles, and turn a shared musical moment into a new connection.

Discover music and people you’ll love
Explore For You, Follow, Popular, and Video Sharing to find guitar live streams and video posts. Like and save your favorites, follow interesting people, and keep up with their content. Search for live-streaming rooms and explore the rankings to discover more of the community.

Join the conversation
Be part of the experience with live chat. Share a live-streaming room with friends, connect with fellow guitar fans, and send virtual gifts to show your appreciation. Every performance offers another opportunity to meet someone who shares your taste in music.

Create your own guitar live-streaming room
