Bring people together around your passion for guitar. Personalize your live-streaming room, welcome viewers, and chat with your audience. Let your musical interests introduce you to new friends.

Keep the connection going
When you follow each other, continue the conversation through private messages. Swap practice ideas, discuss a favorite song, or simply stay in touch. Your message center brings your conversations and community notifications together.

Explore guitar with an AI companion
Unlock permanent access to the AI Guitar Assistant for guitar questions, practice inspiration, and song suggestions. Explore new ideas at your own pace and bring more music into your everyday life.

Make Lali your own
Personalize your profile, share your interests, and manage your account preferences. Reporting and blocking tools are available to help you manage your interactions.

Come for the guitar. Stay for the people. Make your next musical connection on Lali.

name: Lamplight Dispatch
description:
The diner is waiting for a coffee order. The cinema needs its ticket. Both letters move when you take a turn.

In Lamplight Dispatch, you run the mail tubes beneath a neon-lit town. Tap a brass switch to change its exit and move the mail, or tap Advance to follow the open arrows. Find the shortest delivery and your route earns a gold postmark.

Learn the switches on six Old Town routes. Use the stamps you earn to open ten books with three more puzzles each. Play the rotating Daily Dispatch for extra stamps, collect 18 postal seals across the game, and return to a favorite route to improve your score.

Hints show you a way forward. If two letters jam, watch the collision rewind and try a different switch.

The game is free to download. An optional rewarded ad can add 10 stamps to your wallet when available. Try the first Night Market ferry route for free. A single optional purchase opens the full 20-route district.

name: Lamplight Tarot
description:
Lamplight Tarot is a tarot table at night: green felt, warm lamplight and a real deck of cards.

Pick what's on your mind, deal a spread, and turn the cards over one at a time. Each card shows what it means where it fell. When the last one is up, Apple Intelligence writes the whole spread up as one reading, privately on your device, and leaves you with a question to sit with.

ASK WITHOUT TYPING
• 15 topics in five groups: Open, Love, Work, Self and Crossroads. One tap, nothing to type
• Nine spreads, from a single card to the ten-card Celtic Cross, with Decision, Horseshoe, Relationship, Chakra and Year ahead in between
• Shuffle, then cut the deck yourself, as you would at a real table
• Reversed cards, or turn them off

A READING THAT FITS TOGETHER
• Each card's keywords and meaning, upright or reversed, appear as you turn it
• Tap a card for a closer look: the art up large, where it fell, and both of its meanings
• Once the spread is complete, a written reading ties the cards into one story
• No Apple Intelligence? You still get a reading, put together from the card meanings

CARD OF THE DAY
Pick any of the twelve star signs and turn over that sign's card for today. Everyone with the same sign gets the same card all day, so you can compare with a friend. If it speaks to you, keep it in your journal.

288 WAYS TO DECK OUT YOUR CARDS
• Six decks, oldest first: the 1491 Sola Busca, the 1650 Viéville woodcuts, the Tarot de Marseille, the 1898 Tarot Nouveau, Pamela Colman Smith's 1909 deck and the modern Soimoi. Whichever you choose, the meanings stay the same
• Six card back designs, each in eight colorways
• Six reading cloths, from green felt, wool and linen to a frosted windowpane at night, in 46 colors in all. That's 13,248 ways to set the table

YOUR JOURNAL
• Save a reading just as it was dealt: the spread, the deck, the cloth, and every word of the reading
• Add a note the same day or weeks later
• Look back through every reading by month, each with a little fan of its cards

SHARE A READING
Send the spread to a friend as a picture, shaped for Messages or for Stories, or as plain text to talk it over. What the reading was about and your notes stay out unless you add them.

AND
• Browse all 78 cards, and swipe through the deck one card at a time
• Quiet table sounds: the shuffle, the deal, each card turning over. Off with one switch
• On iPad, and on iPhone Duo opened out, the cards and the reading sit side by side. Fold the Duo mid-reading and nothing is lost

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your readings stay on your device. No account, no ads, no subscription
• Readings are written on the device itself, so they work offline
• Anonymous usage counts help decide what to make next. Never your readings, your notes or the cards you drew, and one switch in Settings turns them off

name: LamplightReel
description:
Walk a miniature night block and keep the roofs from folding.

Lamplight Reel is a portrait 3D porch game. Living sounds — bells, kettles, ovens, fountains, crickets, radios, chimes, and gulls — sing in short pulses. Step into a bright ring and hold Spool while the voice is actually singing. The clip winds onto a short reel. Houses pinned to that voice can stand back up. If the street goes truly quiet, the wick burns fast and the roofs hinge flat.

Each of the twelve streets asks for its own set of voices. Spare noise still fits on the tape, but it does not hold a roof, and a full reel pushes the oldest clip off. Echo spends a charge to carry the last clip across the near roofs. When every asked voice is spooled and the block is holding, press Done, tidy the spare clips, and bank a Hum, a Choir, or an Anthem.

A new wind reshuffles a street you already know. Tonight's Block is a fresh layout from the date on this phone, with a porch best that never leaves the device. Chorus marks buy a wider ear, a longer reel, more echoes, and a calmer wick.

name: Lappa: Running Coach
description:
Lappa is a running coach that builds a personal plan for your goal race and stays in your ear for every workout. From 5K to marathon; from your first run to your next personal best.

TRAINING THAT FOLLOWS YOUR SLEEP
Lappa talks to the Sleep Debt app. Each morning it checks your sleep debt and today's capacity; after a short night it suggests turning a hard session into an easy run with one tap. Without Sleep Debt, it uses last night's sleep from Apple Health.

A PLAN BUILT FOR YOU
• 5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon plans, plus walk-run to get you started from zero
• Base, build, peak and taper phases based on your current fitness and race date
• You choose your run days and your long run day
• Missed a workout? It's smartly fitted into the rest of the week
• Suggests updating your paces as your fitness improves

A STEP-BY-STEP VOICE COACH
• Warm-up, intervals, tempo, fartlek, hills and long runs: every step with a target pace
• Voice guidance: "Speed up a little", "Last 100 meters", kilometer and pace updates
• Live workout on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Live map while you run

APPLE WATCH
• Leave your phone at home: workouts run step by step on your watch, with haptic pace alerts
• Voice coach on the watch, through its speaker or headphones connected to the watch
• Live map, heart rate, cadence and elevation on your wrist
• The next 2 weeks of workouts on your watch; slept badly? Run the easy version with one tap
• Free run, treadmill and walk; auto-pause and double tap for laps
• Optionally send your planned runs to Apple's Workout app
• Today's workout on your watch face and in the Smart Stack
• Start with one press of the Action button on Apple Watch Ultra

DEEP RUN ANALYSIS
• Speed-colored route and a 3D map flyover
• Pace and elevation charts, kilometer splits
• Target vs. actual pace on every rep
• Coach comments and personal bests
• Share cards ready for your Instagram story

WALKS
Record free walks too; they're saved to Apple Health as walks and don't affect your running records.

GARMIN, COROS, SUUNTO
If your watch syncs with Apple Health, your runs arrive in Lappa and are automatically matched to your planned workouts.

STRENGTH & MOBILITY
Ready-made strength, hips & core and stretching sessions for runners, added to your plan automatically.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Weekly volume, plan adherence, streaks, 18 badges and personal bests from 1 km to the marathon.

APPLE HEALTH
Your runs and sessions are saved to Apple Health with route, distance and calories.

LAPPA PREMIUM
The first two weeks of your plan and the core features are free. Premium unlocks your full plan, Sleep Debt adaptation, Apple Watch, workout analysis, coach comments and the complete library.
• Monthly and yearly subscriptions
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends
• Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings
• If a free trial is offered, any unused portion is forfeited when you purchase a subscription

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: in the app and at the link on this page.

Lappa is available in English and Turkish.

Lappa is a training tool and does not give medical advice. Consult a doctor about your health before starting a new exercise program.

name: Lapset
description: After a swim, it is easy to forget the distance and time, and pace comparisons can mislead when sessions use different strokes or pool lengths. Lapset lets you log each swim with its pool length, stroke, distance, and time, then shows an average pace only for sessions that share the same stroke, pool length, and chosen measure: active or total time. Create a set with fixed work and rest intervals, run or pause its timer, and review the times before saving the swim to your log. Follow technique steps, mark the ones you have practiced, add a photo to a session, and record a short voice note for playback.

name: LaptopVR
description:
LaptopVR turns your iPhone into a VR headset with five monitors for your Mac. Slip your iPhone into a VR headset and your Mac's displays appear around you, staying where you put them as you turn your head.

LaptopVR needs the free LaptopVR app for Mac. Download it at:
https://laptopvr.app

FEATURES

• Screens that stay put: every display holds its place, like real monitors on a real desk.
• One Mac, up to five displays: add as many as four extra monitors. macOS treats each one as real, so windows drag across as they always have.
• Choose your surroundings: keep your own room in view through the iPhone's camera, or pick a colour, a gradient, or your own image.
• Cinema: turn the lights down and put one enormous screen in front of you.
• Follow: bring your screens along when you look away.
• Fast enough to forget it's streaming: hardware video at up to 120 frames per second, over a cable or Wi-Fi.
• Record your view: save a video or screenshot of your whole setup to your Mac.
• Privacy screen: cover your Mac's own display while you work in the headset.

WHAT YOU NEED

• A Mac with macOS 26 or later and LaptopVR for Mac
• A VR headset for iPhone: the kind with two lenses that your phone slips into
• A cable between the two, or a Wi-Fi network they share

GETTING STARTED

1. Install LaptopVR on your Mac and your iPhone.
2. Plug your iPhone into your Mac, or put them on the same Wi-Fi network.
3. Tap Enter Headset, slip your iPhone into the headset, and look around.

PRIVACY

LaptopVR has no accounts and collects no data. Your screen goes straight from your Mac to your iPhone and nowhere else.

name: LastRow Tickets
description:
Find local shows and buy admission with LastRow Tickets. Browse upcoming events or search by show, city, or venue. Use the Free admission filter to find events with complimentary entry.

Open an event to check its date, time, venue, and admission price. When you’re ready, continue to LastRow’s secure website to get your tickets. Displayed admission prices include applicable taxes and fees.

On event day, open My Tickets. Add tickets using the private link from your confirmation email, then open your saved pass online to show its QR code at the door. If you’ve misplaced the email, you can request a fresh link from the app.

name: LaTrust POS
description:
LaTrust POS turns your phone or tablet into a cash register for shops, cafés, restaurants and local businesses.

SELL FAST
• Items by category, search and barcode scanning with the camera
• Current ticket with quantities, discounts and comments
• Cash payments with change, card or Mobile Money
• Numbered receipts, available at any time

SELL EVEN OFFLINE
• Without Internet, sales stay on the device and are sent as soon as the connection is back
• Several tills in the same store stay up to date with each other

MANAGE THE TILL
• Open and close shifts, cash in and cash out, cash difference
• Refunds linked to the original receipt

YOUR TEAM
• Each employee opens the till with their PIN
• Rights by role: owner, administrator, manager, cashier

EVERYTHING IN YOUR BACK OFFICE
• Items, stock, customers, employees and stores are managed in the LaTrust POS web back office
• Sales reports by item, category, employee and payment type

A LaTrust POS account is required to use the app. Available in French and English.

name: Lavis - une couleur par soir
description:
Lavis est un carnet que l'on peint plutôt qu'un journal que l'on remplit.

Chaque soir, une seule question : de quelle couleur était aujourd'hui ? Vous trempez le doigt dans un godet, vous posez une touche de peinture sur la page, et vous ajoutez un mot si vous en avez envie. Pas d'humeur à choisir dans une liste, pas de note sur dix, pas de graphique.

Au fil des soirs, les touches s'assemblent : une page par mois, puis une année entière qui forme un tableau abstrait, différent pour chaque personne.

UN VRAI GESTE DE PEINTRE
• Une boîte de 15 pigments aux noms poétiques : Orage tiède, Matin de miel, Bleu dimanche, Rouille, Menthe nerveuse…
• Touchez deux godets pour les mélanger : la nouvelle couleur reçoit un nom, que vous pouvez garder dans votre boîte.
• Le geste compte : un appui long charge le pinceau et donne une tache douce, un geste vif laisse une touche nerveuse.
• La peinture fuse dans le papier, puis sèche et devient mate en quelques secondes.
• Une légende manuscrite sous la touche, si vous voulez garder un mot du soir.

UNE COULEUR TIRÉE D'UNE PHOTO
• Choisissez la photo du soir : Lavis propose la couleur dominante et deux voisines.
• Touchez la photo pour prélever une autre couleur, comme une pipette.
• La photo reste attachée au soir, dans votre carnet.

VOTRE ANNÉE EN TABLEAU
• L'année se lit comme une rivière de touches, des bleus d'hiver aux ocres d'automne.
• Pincez pour ouvrir un mois, touchez une touche pour retrouver le soir : sa couleur, son nom, sa légende, sa photo.
• Un soir oublié reste blanc. Vous pouvez le rattraper quand vous voulez ; la touche garde un fin liseré de crayon.

UNE AFFICHE À GARDER
• Exportez votre année en story, en fond d'écran ou en PDF A3 à imprimer.
• Trois mises en page : la rivière seule, avec les mois, ou le titre en grand.

DOUX ET PRIVÉ
• Un seul rappel le soir, à l'heure que vous choisissez, avec la phrase de votre choix. Il se tait si vous avez déjà peint.
• Verrouillage avec Face ID.
• Aucun compte, aucune publicité. Vos soirs, vos légendes et vos photos restent sur votre iPhone.
• Exportez toutes vos données en un fichier, ou effacez le carnet à tout moment.

POUR TOUS LES YEUX
• Deux apparences : papier coton clair ou carnet noir, ou comme l'iPhone.
• Une trame différente pour chaque pigment, pour distinguer les couleurs sans la teinte.
• Textes compatibles avec la taille de police choisie sur l'iPhone, et VoiceOver.
• Haptique et son de pinceau, désactivable.

Lavis ne mesure rien et ne vous juge pas. Il garde simplement une trace, en couleur, de chacun de vos soirs.

name: Lawn Master
description:
Every lawn is a job, and every job is on the clock.

Lawn Master is a top-down mowing game about doing honest work well. Start in a neighbor's backyard with nothing but a sickle. Finish on a golf course with a fleet of fairway mowers. In between: apartment grounds, city parks and a stadium pitch on derby day.

MOW IT RIGHT
• Drive too fast and you leave patches. Find the ideal speed and the cut comes out clean.
• Lay down straight stripes to build combos.
• Stay out of the flower beds. The owners notice.
• Hit the target before the timer runs out, then go back for all three stars.

FIVE TOOLS, FIVE WAYS TO PLAY
• Sickle and scythe: swing by hand, timing matters.
• Push mower: slow, steady, forgiving.
• Lawn tractor: wide deck, wide turns.
• Zero-turn mower: spins in place and cuts faster than anything else.

THE WEATHER HAS OPINIONS
Rain leaves puddles that slow you down. Wind blows clippings around. Snow hides the grass until you clear it. Every job plays differently depending on the sky.

PEOPLE AND OTHER OBSTACLES
A dog that will not move. Kids who run across the lawn you just finished. A building manager with strong feelings about priorities. They all have something to say about your work.

12 JOBS, 36 STARS
Earn stars for finishing, for finishing with time to spare, and for a top quality grade. Unlock new equipment as you go, then replay any lawn in Free Mow with no timer.

COMPETE ON GAME CENTER
Two leaderboards: total stars, and total time to spare across your best runs.

MADE TO BE PLAYED BY EVERYONE
• Color blind modes and a pattern option for unmowed grass
• Reduced motion, adjustable interface size and message speed
• Subtitles for sound cues
• Optional time limit assist

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. Plays offline.
Available in English and Turkish, on iPhone and iPad.

name: Le Backgammon – Board Game
description:
Backgammon, the great classic board game, on a French marquetry board: points in light and dark wood, a cherry-wood board, ivory and ebony checkers. Free, no ads, no account, no connection needed.

A COMPUTER THAT HELPS YOU IMPROVE
• Three opponents: Lucien (beginner), Margot (intermediate) and Le Comte (strong).
• The Hint button shows you the best move when you are unsure.
• Your mistakes are marked during the game, with the move you should have played.
• At the end of the game, your average error tells you whether you are improving.

FAIR DICE, AND WE SHOW YOU
• The dice come from a secure random source, the same for you and the computer.
• The computer never knows the rolls to come, and the level changes nothing about the dice.
• The Statistics page counts your dice and the computer's, face by face, and your doubles.

THE DAILY PUZZLE
• A new position every day: find the best move, one try.
• Share your result in one line.

ALL OF BACKGAMMON
• Single game or match to 3, 5 or 7 points, with the doubling cube and the Crawford rule.
• Single, gammon and backgammon.
• Two players on one phone.
• Move checkers with a tap or a drag; blinking ghost checkers show where each one can go.
• Pip count, home board on the left or right.
• Full rules in the app, in English and French.

SIMPLE AND RESPECTFUL
• No ads, no purchases, no coins.
• Works offline, no account, and collects no data.
• Your game is saved after every move: pick it up whenever you like.

name: LeanHabits
description:
LeanHabits helps you build a routine one small action at a time.

Start with a name. Choose three starter habits, create your own, or hold the microphone on Today and say the habit name. Pick an icon and a color. Voice creation uses Apple Speech with your permission, and the app does not save the recording.

Set a schedule that fits your life. Check in daily, on chosen weekdays, at fixed intervals, or a set number of times in a period. Track quantities with at-least or at-most goals. Review and edit past entries and add notes.

Focus with a 5-, 15-, 25- or 45-minute Pomodoro. Pause and resume from the app or widget, and get a notification when the timer ends. Track your streaks, strength, completion rates and weekday patterns. Add local reminders and check in from the Today widget.

Your habits, notes and reflections stay on your device. Export a JSON backup or CSV, and import a backup or a Loop Habit Tracker database. No account, ads, tracking or subscription. Built for iPhone and iPad with light and dark appearances and 18 interface languages.

name: Learn Turkish with Seda
description:
Learn Turkish with Seda is made by Seda Sürel, a certified teacher of Turkish as a foreign language who has taught adult learners around the world for more than ten years. She is the author of Turkish vocabulary books and bilingual children's books, and she runs learnturkishwithseda.com. Seda believes good Turkish education should be open to everyone, so the app is free, with no ads, no payments and no sign-in.

The app brings her years of teaching into one place. You can study a topic, practice it right away and come back to it later. Grammar, words, culture and games are connected, so each part of Turkish supports the others. Quizzes explain why an answer is right, so you learn from your mistakes.

HOW SEDA TEACHES TURKISH

Turkish builds meaning with suffixes. Seda shows a word being built step by step, so you see what each piece adds and can use the same pattern with new words. The explanations come from her own lesson materials.

STUDY AND PRACTICE

Grammar from A1 to C1: 94 lessons that follow the levels on Seda's website, each with practice questions and explanations. The program is built on Türkiye's 2025 curriculum for teaching Turkish as a foreign language, adapted for adult learners.
Placement test: find your starting level. Your report stays on your phone, with every question and its correct answer.
Turkish Logic: Seda's essays on how suffixes build meaning, and a guide to the case each verb takes.

WORDS

10,000 Words: the most used Turkish words in order of frequency, practiced in rounds of ten and searchable in Turkish or English.
Flashcards in Seda's voice: over 500 illustrated cards she recorded herself. Cards you know come back less often.
Listening: Listen and Choose and Listen and Write use Seda's own recordings, so you hear real Turkish from the first day.
Smart Review: the words and questions you miss come back at the right time until you know them.
Today's word: an optional daily notification with one word and its meaning.

GAMES

Suffix Tiles, Suffix Crossword, Sentence Builder, Memory Match, Listen and Write, and a Journey Through Türkiye with 64 stops. Each game practices a real part of the language, so playing is also studying.

CULTURE, HISTORY AND LITERATURE

Heritage brings Seda's articles into the app: Turkish authors and literature, history, places across Türkiye and everyday culture. Each page ends with a short quiz.
Culture topics: more than 60 short lessons on everyday life in Türkiye, from tea and breakfast to holidays, expressions like "kolay gelsin" and "geçmiş olsun", and the stories behind them, each with its own quiz.
Idioms and proverbs: 1,029 sayings, many with their literal meanings, and a practice round that asks for the meaning or the saying.
Graded Reading: short texts from A1 to C1 with audio read by Seda.
New blog posts from her website appear in the app soon after they are published.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your progress stays on your device, and the app does not collect personal data.
Lessons, words and games work offline, and pages you have opened stay available offline.
You can zoom any page with two fingers if you prefer larger text.

ABOUT SEDA

Seda holds university degrees in comparative literature and in history. She also holds a TESOL certificate from Arizona State University and a certificate in teaching Turkish as a foreign language from Istanbul University-Cerrahpaşa. Her studies in literature and history shape her teaching: she treats language and culture as one subject, which is why Turkish authors, history and everyday culture have a large place in the app next to grammar. If you would like one-to-one lessons with her, you can book them on her website.

name: LED Banner: Big Text Sign
description:
Type a message, tap Show, and your phone becomes a big, bright sign that people can read from across the room.

No ads. No subscription. No account. Free to use, and if you want more, one payment unlocks everything for good, shared with your family.

PERFECT FOR
• Airport pickups: "WELCOME HOME MOM" on a real-looking split-flap board
• Game day: stadium-screen letters in your team colors
• Concerts: bright LED letters the band can read from the stage
• Birthdays, weddings, parties and the really big question
• Noisy bars, busy streets, quiet libraries: say it without shouting

FREE, AND ACTUALLY USEFUL
• Classic LED, Bold and Neon styles with any color
• Fit (the whole message, as big as it gets) or Scroll (a scrolling banner, letter-perfect at full size)
• Emoji and right-to-left languages
• Screen goes to full brightness while the sign is up and doesn't fall asleep
• Works fully offline

PREMIUM (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• 26 more styles: split-flap, flip-dot, highway sign, taxi light, Vegas marquee, cinema marquee, jumbotron, stock ticker, segment display, 8-bit arcade, terminal, LCD watch, typewriter, neon tube, hologram, rainbow wave, gold glitter, fire, ice, police strobe, hazard, disco, hearts, Christmas lights, birthday confetti, chalkboard
• Save as many signs as you like and swipe between them
• Play all: your saved signs take turns automatically
• Mirror: flip the sign so it reads right in a car's rearview mirror or through a window
• Pulse to music: the sign beats along with the room
• Family Sharing included. Restore anytime.

Every Premium style previews live on your own message before you decide.

LIGHT-SENSITIVE?
Styles that flash ask first, and Gentle Mode keeps every effect slow and soft. Gentle Mode is on automatically when Reduce Motion or Dim Flashing Lights is on.

Questions or ideas? support@easy8.pro

name: LED Banner: Scrolling Text!
description:
LED Banner makes bright scrolling LED signs on your iPhone.

Type your message, tune the look, and play it live on a glowing board. Start from ready templates for shops, parties, greetings, notices, and more—or build your own from scratch.

Edit every detail
• Words and colors
• Motion, speed, and frame
• Live preview as you change things

Save and reuse
• Keep banners in your library
• Pin the ones you use most
• Open any save and play again

Go big on Stage
• Landscape play for a larger sign
• Great for desks, counters, events, and photos

Share what you make
• Picture, GIF, or video
• Share with the apps you choose, or save to Photos

Make it yours
• Light or dark theme
• App look accents
• Optional haptics

Your banners and settings stay on your device. No account needed.

Questions? Open Settings → Feedback, or email dixitadobariya31@gmail.com.

name: Leonida Companion Guide
description:
Stop pausing the game to search the web. Leonida Companion Guide is the companion that stays open on your phone while you play: what is where, what to watch for in the next mission, and which car your money can actually buy.

MAP
• Hundreds of markers: collectibles, heist spots, shops, hidden places
• Pinch to zoom, drag, tap: smooth and fast
• The things the in-game map does not show come first
• Mark what you found, filter what is left
• Safe codes and short tips right on the marker card

MISSIONS
• Story, side missions and heists on one timeline
• Spoiler shield: outcomes stay hidden until you have played them
• Missable warnings before a mission locks something out for good
• Decision branches: which choice changes what
• Full score requirements and step-by-step notes

GARAGE
• Filter vehicles by your budget
• Compare two vehicles side by side: speed, acceleration, on-road, off-road and durability
• Keep a wishlist and tick off what you own

YOUR PROGRESS
• How much you have completed and what is left in each region
• Achievements and a region-by-region breakdown

WHY LEONIDA COMPANION GUIDE
• Free, with no ads
• No account needed, your progress stays on your phone
• Dark theme, one-handed use, built for quick glances between missions
• Available in 9 languages: Türkçe, English, Español, Português (Brasil), Deutsch, Français, Italiano, 日本語, Русский

This is an unofficial fan-made guide; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game names and trademarks belong to their respective owners. The map and artwork are original drawings made for this app.

name: Leonida Map: Community Guide
description:
Explore Leonida with an unofficial map built on community research. Search for a place by name, filter the map by category, and tap a pin for details.

• See the real-world reference. Where coordinates are available, open Apple Maps satellite imagery without leaving the app. The pin marks the real-world location; it doesn’t confirm its in-game counterpart. Satellite imagery requires an internet connection.

• Make the map your own. Mark places Want to Go, Explored, or Revisit. Add notes, find your saved places in My List, or export the list and notes as a JSON file. No account required.

Leonida Map is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with Rockstar Games. Place names, positions, and real-world matches are based on community research and may change. See the app for map and data credits.

name: Let's Predict
description:
Predict the biggest football matches before kick-off, earn points as the goals go in, and challenge your friends in private leagues.

HOW IT WORKS
• Open Home to see today's big matches from the Saudi, English, Spanish and Italian leagues, domestic cups, the UEFA Champions League and the AFC Champions League Elite.
• Predict the score, choose the goalscorers (with a penalty option), and add red cards if you like.
• Edit your prediction as often as you like until kick-off. Everyone's picks stay hidden until full time.

SCORING
• Exact score: 3 points
• Correct result or draw: 1 point
• Correct clean sheet: 1 point per team
• Correct goalscorer: 1 point, or 2 if you predicted a penalty and they scored from the spot
• Own goal by a player you picked: 1 point
• Correct red card: 2 points per player
You never lose points, and penalty shootouts don't count.

LIVE POINTS
• Watch your points change during the match. Final points are confirmed after full time.

PRIVATE LEAGUES
• Create a private league, invite friends with a code or link, and see who leads.

COMPLETELY FREE
• No prizes, payments or ads.
• Browse as a guest and sign in only when you want to predict or join a private league.
• Available in Arabic and English.

Note: This is an independent app for entertainment. It is not affiliated with any club, league or football federation. Club and competition names and logos belong to their respective owners.

name: letmewoof
description:
letmewoof 支持多标签网页浏览和基于规则的图片阅读。

• 多标签浏览。输入网址或搜索词，在标签页总览中查看预览并切换网页。
• 网页工具。收藏常用网页、查看本机浏览记录、复制或分享链接，以及在网页内查找内容。
• 私密浏览。私密标签页独立于普通浏览会话。关闭所有私密标签页即可结束会话。
• 规则阅读。可从文件导入规则，或创建自己的规则。配置兼容的 JSON 源后，可以浏览作品列表、进入章节并垂直滚动阅读图片。App 内提供规则编写指南。

无需注册账号。安装时规则列表为空，可按需添加自己的来源。

name: Lien
description:
Lien là trợ lý phiên dịch và ghi chép cho doanh nghiệp, đi kèm nền tảng BotHub (bots.aibanhmi.com).

PHIÊN DỊCH HỘI THOẠI
• Phiên dịch hai chiều trên một điện thoại: mỗi bên nói tiếng của mình, app đọc to bản dịch.
• Phòng hội thoại qua hai máy: mời đối tác bằng mã QR, mỗi người nói và đọc bằng ngôn ngữ của mình.
• Chế độ rảnh tay hoặc bấm giữ để nói; lọc tạp âm nơi đông người.
• Mẫu giọng: app chỉ nhận câu nói bằng giọng của bạn, bỏ qua người bên cạnh, tivi, loa.
• Gói dịch ngoại tuyến để dịch khi mất mạng.

CUỘC HỌP
• Ghi âm cuộc họp, kể cả khi tắt màn hình.
• Tự chuyển thành văn bản và tóm tắt nội dung chính.

TÀI LIỆU VÀ NHÓM CHAT
• Hỏi đáp trên thư viện tài liệu của công ty.
• Theo dõi nhóm chat Web, Telegram, Zalo đã kết nối; gợi ý trả lời đối tác.

Lien dành cho nhân viên của doanh nghiệp đã đăng ký BotHub. Tài khoản do quản trị viên doanh nghiệp cấp.

name: LiftAlign Remote
description:
Control your LiftAlign laser from your iPhone or iPad. Tap the power button beside a bay to switch its laser on or off. When a laser is on, its card shows how much time is left for it automatically shuts off. Compatible LiftAlign hardware is required and sold separately.

# Keep track of the lifts in your shop
Give each device a familiar name, like “Bay 1” or “Alignment bay.” See which devices are connected, check Bluetooth signal strength, and see changes made with the physical remote or the button on the laser.

# Add a LiftAlign
With the laser powered on, open the app and tap Add LiftAlign. Allow Bluetooth access when prompted. You can pair your iPhone or iPad with the laser in either of two ways.

Use your remote when the laser is mounted out of reach. Hold the remote that already controls the laser next to your iPhone or iPad. Press and release its button once. This also switches the laser on or off.

Or use the pairing button if the laser is within reach. Choose “I don’t have my remote” in the app. Hold the small button underneath the laser for two seconds, then release when the green light blinks.

With either method, tap Add lift beside the matching device to finish. Your physical remote keeps working.

Saved devices reconnect when they are nearby and the app is open. Bluetooth control works offline, without an account. Your device list and custom names stay in local app storage.

name: Light Pop: Reflex Arcade
description:
Quick taps. Bright lights. One more run.

Tap the safe lights, avoid the red, and keep the board from filling up as the pace increases. Build combos and chase your best score in Light Pop, a colorful reflex game from Eighth Day Studio.

CHOOSE YOUR CHALLENGE
Play on a 2 x 5 board or a larger 3 x 7 grid. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard and keep up as each run gets faster.

POWER UP YOUR RUN
Look for special lights with clear symbols: a turtle, heart, lightning bolt, and 2x bonus. Use their effects to help keep your run going.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from four themes: Neon Arcade, Pinkin Groove, Soft Glow, and Solar Pop. Adjust sound and haptic feedback in Settings.

CHASE YOUR BEST
Track your gameplay statistics, unlock achievements, and compare scores on online leaderboards. Use a made-up nickname for public rankings.

Light Pop includes ads between runs and optional rewarded ads for an extra life. Remove Ads Forever is an optional one-time purchase that permanently removes all ads, with no subscription. Online features and advertising require an internet connection.

Support and more information: https://lightpop.rydru.com/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/light-pop-eighth-day-studio/privacy-policy

name: Light Up SG
description:
Singapore is small enough to finish and big enough that almost nobody has.

Light Up SG turns the island into a map you colour in by going there. The 325 zones start grey. Walk into one and it turns red. Keep going until the whole island is yours.

LIGHTS UP AS YOU WALK
• Leave it in your pocket. With Always Allow, zones light up and landmarks and MRT stations check in on their own.
• It does not keep GPS running all day. iOS wakes it when you reach somewhere new.
• Plan a 20, 40 or 60 minute loop from where you are, and follow it on the Lock Screen.
• Wear an Apple Watch? Your outdoor workouts light up the map too.

A STAMP ALBUM OF THE ISLAND
• 124 hawker centres. A photo of what you ate earns the stamp.
• Every open MRT station and 57 landmarks, from the Merlion to the four corners of the island.
• Each with a short background note, like a museum label.

54 ACHIEVEMENTS WORTH A SCREENSHOT
• Walk the Rail Corridor from north to south. Reach the four extreme points. Eat at five hawker centres. Catch the sunrise at East Coast.
• Every achievement makes a card with your own photos, ready to post.

LISTS YOU CAN PASS ON
• Six curated lists to start with: ten hawker centres with which stalls to find, first time in Singapore, free night views, a one-day route, photo spots and nature walks.
• Make your own and share it as a card.

YOURS, AND ONLY YOURS
• No account. No server. Your records stay on your iPhone.
• English and 中文.

Already been around? Import from Photos and the places you have photographed light up in one go.

name: Liguilla: resultados de ligas
description:
Liguilla reúne los resultados, calendarios y clasificaciones de las ligas municipales y escolares de toda España: Juegos Deportivos Municipales, juegos escolares, ligas locales y más, en 27 secciones de 13 provincias.

• Elige tus equipos, clubes o ligas al abrir la app y tendrás sus próximos partidos y últimos resultados en la pantalla principal.
• Avisos al momento cuando tu equipo tenga resultado, o cuando cambie la fecha, la hora o el lugar de un partido.
• Clasificaciones, calendarios y campos de cada liga, por deporte y categoría.
• Sin conexión: tus partidos y las últimas clasificaciones que abriste siguen disponibles.
• Comparte un partido o una clasificación por WhatsApp con un toque.

Sin cuentas, sin anuncios y sin cookies de seguimiento. Solo equipos: nunca nombres de deportistas.

Liguilla es un proyecto independiente y no oficial. Los datos vienen de las webs públicas de cada organizador (ayuntamientos, institutos municipales de deportes y diputaciones), enlazadas en cada liga.

name: Lilyveil
description:
Compose a quiet garden on a hexagonal field.
Place lily ponds, bridges, flower beds, fountains, and trees with a light tap, then lift a piece to rethink the plan.
Guide water, bees, and butterflies until their paths close together in one living cycle.
As circuits awaken, ruined patches return to open soil ready for a new stroke.
Each season shifts the balance, turning careful layouts into higher scores and richer atelier unlocks.

name: LineSieve
description:
LineSieve is a local text workbench for repeated cleanup tasks. Paste or type text, then arrange rules to trim line edges, remove blank lines, remove exact duplicate lines, sort lines, or change case. Order matters: inspect the live result before copying or sharing. Save named recipes, edit their rules, apply them to a new draft, and review up to 100 saved processing results with original and output text. Text stays on this device unless you choose to copy or share it. Input is limited to 100,000 characters.

Free, without accounts, advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Core functions work offline. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance.

name: Link Wax
description:
Dear friend,

I wax or drip-lube chains between rides and still lose track of which bike is due next. Link Wax is a clear “what’s due next” board on the phone you already carry: keep each bike and chain on this device, set how often that chain should be waxed, and log the visit when you finish at the stand.

1. Bikes and chains
Add a bike with a name and optional current mileage (0–1,000,000 mi). On that bike, add one or more chains with a wax product or method—Squirt, Ceramic Speed, hot melt, drip, or whatever you use—then set an interval in miles (1–100,000) and/or days (1–3,650). You can record last waxed mileage and date so the board starts from a real baseline.

2. Due board
Open Due to see chains grouped into Overdue, Soon, and Later. Each card shows remaining miles and days (or Never waxed when you have not logged a visit yet), plus the bike name. Tap Mark waxed to save today’s visit, optionally update the bike’s current mileage, and refresh the board immediately. Soon uses a small window—about 15% of the cycle, and at least roughly 20 miles on the mileage track—so the next stand stop is obvious.

3. Waxes and history
Waxes groups chains by product name so you can jump back to the chains that share a bottle or melt. From a bike or chain you can edit details, review wax logs, and delete when a chain is retired. Search works on both the bike list and the wax list.

4. Look and feel
The screens stay readable in landscape at the stand: soft parchment canvas, olive accent, and calm overdue / soon / later colors for quick glances. Everything stays on this device. There is no account, no ads, and no sync of your bike library to developer servers. Erase local data from About when you want a clean slate. Support mail goes to chamkaursingh1971@icloud.com.

Wax when it is due, and tell me how it feels at the stand.

Warmly,
The Link Wax team

name: Lins Vocab：冰島文旅遊單字（Ferðaorð）
description:
Ferðaorð（旅行的字）是給台灣人的冰島旅遊冰島文單字卡。冰島人英文很好，旅客開口講冰島文的機會不多，所以這個 App 的重點是「看得懂」：路標與路況、天氣警報、告示、菜單與超市標籤、泳池與溫泉的規矩，再加上最基本的禮貌用語。依「旅途中有多常用得到」排順序，一站一課，像沿著一號環島公路一站一站往前走。

■ 免費與完整課程
・App 免費下載。必備線 33 站（338 張字卡）、常用線前 2 站試學、字母與發音 11 課、基礎文法 17 課、數字聽力、6,000 詞離線字典與搜尋，永遠免費
・完整課程（App 內購買，一次買斷、永久使用、沒有訂閱）：解鎖其餘的常用線與進階線（84 站、987 張字卡）與進階文法 11 課
・換手機或重裝，用同一個 Apple 帳號就能恢復購買

■ 1,353 張字卡、119 站
・28 個主題：寒暄與應答、機場與入境、自駕與路況、租車與加油、巴士與渡輪、住宿與露營、餐廳點餐、菜單與料理、超市與食材、藥局與日用品、看醫生與症狀、緊急與安全、天氣與極光、自然景點與動物、泳池與溫泉、標示與告示、店員與廣播常說的話……
・名詞標出陽性／陰性／中性、屬格單數與主格複數，還能展開完整的 16 格變格表（路標與菜單上的字多半是變化後的樣子）
・每張都有國際音標（IPA，可關）、旅途情境的例句與台灣用語的中文解釋，常附一句提醒（單線橋怎麼讓車、泳池要先淋浴）

■ AI 合成語音發音
・每個單字與例句都有預錄的發音：AI 合成語音（Guðrún 女聲、Gunnar 男聲，不是真人錄音），可交替播放、可放慢速度

■ 字母與發音、文法、數字
・字母與發音 11 課：þ、ð、æ、ö 與 ll、hv、送氣這些冰島文特有的念法
・文法 28 課（基礎 17、進階 11）：語序、四個格、動詞、旅行句型，最後教你看懂路標與告示，每課有填空、選句子、聽句子三種練習
・數字、日期、時間：1～4 跟著名詞的性別與格變化，另有價錢、日期、時間、數量、風速氣溫路況的念法，數字聽力 451 題，聽完用數字鍵填答

■ 9 種測驗與學習統計
看冰島文選中文、看中文選冰島文、選名詞的性別、選帶定冠詞的寫法、聽發音選單字、聽例句選意思、拼字、聽寫等。答錯的字會記下來，可以挑出來再考。學習時間、連續天數、三條線各走到哪裡，一頁看完（只存在手機裡）。

■ 查得到變化後的字
路標、菜單上的字常是變格後的樣子：輸入 flugvellinum 會指回 flugvöllur（機場）。沒有冰島文鍵盤也能查：þ 打 th、ð 打 d、æ 打 ae、ö 打 o。字卡以外還有約 6,000 詞的離線字典。

■ 離線、不用註冊
所有字卡、字典與發音都內建在 App 裡，沒有網路也能用（只有購買與恢復購買需要網路）。不需帳號、沒有廣告、不蒐集任何資料。

資料來源：名詞變格與詞形取自 BÍN（冰島 Árni Magnússon 研究所，CC BY-SA 4.0）；國際音標與字典英文釋義取自英文維基詞典（經 kaikki.org 整理，CC BY-SA 4.0）；詞頻排序參考 wordfreq；字型 Zen Old Mincho、教學手寫字霞鶩文楷 TC（SIL OFL 1.1）。字卡例句、中文解釋與文法課文由 AI 撰寫，經規則檢查與另一個 AI 交叉審稿。

name: Lint Lash Laundrette
description:
Pip has the late shift at a laundrette full of very unusual clogs. Grab a braided whip and take on 50 action puzzles across five chapters, from the foam-filled Pocket Wash to the sweepers of Midnight Spin.

Tap the floor to move. Press, drag to aim, and release to crack the whip. Hold longer to reach distant targets and break reinforced fixtures. Knock a yarn spool into the next row or crack a pressure valve to loosen nearby grilles and fans. Clear every marked lint knot, then snag the floating spin ring and climb the ribbon onto the second-floor landing.

Five pickups change what your next move can do. Fan out three ribbons, burst nearby fixtures, arc electricity between targets, extend your reach, or stitch a lost heart back into place. Walk around bolted equipment, dodge charging Soap Slugs and Lint Mites, and watch for spinning fans and sharp lint burrs. You have three hearts per cycle.

- Explore 50 compact stages with a fixed view that follows Pip through each 2.5D drum.
- Replay clears to earn more stars and improve your personal rankings on this iPhone.
- Claim a daily stamp to keep an extra Pop Stitch in reserve.
- Play offline with no account required.

name: listomania.app
description:
listomania keeps your family's lists in one place, and helps you get through them.

• Shared lists that update instantly for everyone
• A shopping list that sorts itself by aisle and learns what you buy most
• Chores and home maintenance that come back on schedule, with a history of when they were done
• My Day, due dates, reminders, steps, photos and starred tasks
• Assign tasks to each other and get notified
• Ask listomania: type or say "add eggs and bread to shopping" or "assign these to Sam, due Friday"
• Share a recipe from Safari and its ingredients land on your shopping list
• Weekend plans put in a sensible order, and a bucket list that suggests ideas when the weather is right

listomania is invite-only: you'll need an invitation from the person who runs your listomania.

name: LITS: Logic Puzzle
description:
Shade one tetromino (four connected cells) in every outlined region. Two tetrominoes of the same type may never touch along an edge, all shaded cells must form one connected group, and no 2 × 2 block may be fully shaded.

LITS is a classic logic puzzle with three simple rules and surprisingly deep deductions. Each region hides an L, I, T or S; working out which one, and where, is the whole game. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

12 STAGES, 360 LEVELS
• From a small 6 × 6 sand pit to a 12 × 12 citadel
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each stage unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone, with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 6 × 6 to 12 × 12, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert)
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Tap a cell to shade it, tap again for an X; drag to mark many cells at once
• Finished tetrominoes show their letter and, if you like, their own colour
• Optional automatic X marks for finished regions and 2 × 2 corners
• Filled 2 × 2 blocks, identical shapes that touch, wrong regions and cut-off cells are marked (in red, or blue if you prefer)
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong marks; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: eight techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: Little Roast
description:
Your coffee cart is open. One pot of black coffee, one counter, and a few coins coming in every couple of seconds. Where it goes from here is up to you.

Little Roast is a calm idle game about turning that cart into a coffee company. The shop earns while you watch, and you decide what to spend it on.

RUNNING THE SHOP
• Fifteen drinks to add to the menu, from Black Coffee and Espresso to Mocha and Iced Caramel Latte. Each one earns on its own, and you can see exactly how much.
• Tap Serve to sell a cup yourself. Tap enough and a Rush starts: for a short while, every drink earns double. You never have to tap. It just helps.
• Six machines, each with one job. The Roaster makes drinks worth more, the Grinder makes them faster, and the Milk Steamer and Flavor Bar open new kinds of drinks.
• Twenty-four staff to hire: baristas who each have a favourite drink, counter help who serve for you, and a host who brings in special orders.
• Pick a roast, catch the current trend, and take special orders when they turn up. Miss one and nothing is lost.

SIX ORIGINS
Once the business has grown, travel to a new coffee origin: Tanzania, Sumatra, Ethiopia, Colombia, Brazil and Jamaica. You start a fresh shop there and bring your Origin Stamps with you. Unspent stamps raise all income, or you can spend them on five permanent perks. Every origin bends the rules a little and has an optional challenge, and finishing one opens a side business: Wholesale Beans, Bottled Cold Brew, a Subscription Club, Franchise Licences and Roastery Works.

NO GUESSWORK
Tap your income to see where every coin comes from. Tap a drink to see what is boosting it and when its next milestone lands.

WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Close the game and the shop keeps earning for up to two hours, at a reduced rate. When you come back, it tells you how long you were gone and what it made.

ALSO
• Portrait and one-handed, with original pixel art.
• No internet connection, account or sign-up needed to play.
• 16 achievements and a cookbook of every drink you've discovered.
• Settings for sound, vibration and reduced motion.

VIDEOS, PURCHASES AND YOUR DATA
• Videos are optional. Watch one to double what the shop earned while you were away, to start a Peak Hour, or to take a Catering Order. Each offer tells you what you get and how often you can use it. No banners, and nothing that interrupts play.
• Three optional one-time purchases: Café Pass lets you claim video rewards without watching, Golden Tamper doubles all income for good, and Night Owl lets the shop earn longer, at a better rate, while you're away. Each is bought once and can be restored on your devices.
• You can finish all six origins without buying anything.
• Play statistics are your choice. After the tutorial the game asks once whether it may send anonymous statistics, like how long a chapter takes or which upgrades get bought. Nothing is sent before you answer, and nothing at all if you say no. You can change your mind in Settings.
• If a video ever shows something it shouldn't, Settings > Report an ad takes you to our support page.
• Videos, purchases and statistics use the internet when it's there. Playing doesn't need it.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: little things · soft to-do
description:
little things is a gentle to-do list for anxious days

every morning you draw your mood with a soft spray can - any colors, any shapes. your drawing quietly becomes the background of your day

then just two things:
- my intention - how you want today to feel
- little things - small tasks you can handle

when you finish something, your drawing gently bounces and a tiny sound plays

a few small joys:
- a simple week strip with tiny copies of your drawings
- plan a few days ahead or look back at yesterday
- hold the empty space at the bottom to breathe with soft kalimba sounds
- swipe left to delete, drag to reorder

no accounts, no ads, no tracking. everything stays on your iphone

name: Livreur LivreurCravate
description:
LivreurCravate Livreur est l'application dédiée aux coursiers et chauffeurs partenaires du réseau LivreurCravate.

    Gagnez des revenus en livrant repas, colis, courses et commandes e-commerce à vos clients avec un outil professionnel pensé pour votre
    quotidien.

    FONCTIONNALITÉS PRINCIPALES :

    • Réception des courses en temps réel : Soyez alerté dès qu'une commande est disponible à proximité avec tous les détails du trajet.
    • Guidage GPS précis : Accédez facilement aux adresses de retrait chez les commerçants et aux adresses de livraison des clients grâce à la
    navigation cartographique intégrée.
    • Suivi des gains : Consultez le récapitulatif de vos gains par jour, par semaine et par mois en toute transparence.
    • Communication directe : Appelez ou échangez par message avec le client ou le vendeur directement depuis l'application en cas de besoin.
    • Validation rapide : Confirmez le retrait et la remise du colis en un clic avec justificatif de livraison.
    • Gestion du statut : Passez en ligne ou hors ligne selon vos disponibilités de travail.

    Rejoignez la communauté LivreurCravate et commencez à effectuer des livraisons en toute liberté.

name: LivreurCravate
description:
LivreurCravate est votre marketplace et service de livraison express du quotidien.

    Accédez aux meilleures boutiques, restaurants, supermarchés et commerces de proximité depuis votre smartphone. Faites vos achats en quelques
    clics et faites-vous livrer où vous voulez, quand vous voulez.

    POURQUOI CHOISIR LIVREURCRAVATE ?
    
    • Un large choix de produits : Mode, électronique, beauté, alimentation, repas préparés, produits frais et bien plus encore sur une seule
    application.
    • Livraison express et soignée : Nos coursiers partenaires acheminent vos commandes rapidement et avec le plus grand soin.
    • Suivi en temps réel : Visualisez sur la carte l'avancée de votre livraison, de la préparation en boutique jusqu'à votre porte.
    • Recherche intelligente : Trouvez facilement vos produits grâce à la recherche par catégorie, par filtre ou via la recherche vocale intégrée.
    • Paiement simple et sécurisé : Réglez vos commandes en toute confiance via vos moyens de paiement mobiles habituels ou à la livraison.
    • Historique et favoris : Retrouvez vos commandes passées, sauvegardez vos articles favoris et suivez vos colis sans effort.
    • Service client réactif : Une assistance disponible à tout moment pour répondre à vos questions et vous accompagner.

    Téléchargez LivreurCravate dès aujourd'hui et profitez d'une expérience de shopping et de livraison premium.

name: Long Screenshot & PDF Scan
description:
Stitch scrolling captures, scan multipage PDFs, and keep the original and translated text together. For iPhone and iPad.

Stitch long screenshots
Choose images, files or frames from a screen recording. Use suggested overlaps, adjust seams directly, and export a long image or paginated PDF.

Scan multipage PDFs
Capture or import several pages. Review automatic edge detection, adjust corners and curved pages, and batch-apply color, grayscale or black-and-white enhancement.

Translate and keep both languages
Recognize a whole page or selected text. Choose Apple Translation or the app’s offline engine. Preview and export translated text directly beneath the original. Availability depends on language models.

Split and merge PDFs
Split by page range or reorder files and merge them. Choose Original, Standard or Small File when exporting.

Organize and back up
Sort projects into folders, rename them and keep editing. Export an editable backup that retains the source files.

This app requires a Scan Pro subscription. Choose a monthly or annual plan. Eligible subscribers can try every feature free for seven days. Your subscription renews at the displayed price after the trial. To avoid renewal, cancel in Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before the trial ends.

Terms of Use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Lookmira
description:
Lookmira är en dagbok för smink som du redan har avslutat.

Skriv ner utseendet: dagen, ett namn, en eller flera stilar, de produkter du använt, en anteckning och en bild från din bibliotek. Naturlig, arbetsdag, kväll, helg och fest finns inbyggda, och du kan välja mer än ett. En produkt är ett namn du skriver in, till exempel läppstift, ögonfjäder, foundation, blus, liner eller ögonpensel. Det är en linje i det utseendet, inte en separat garderob med nyanser.

Kalendern visar vilka dagar som har ett utseende. Öppna en dag för att se bilden och listan. Märk en favorit när du vill ha den tillbaka. Att återskapa detta utseende kopierar titeln, stilarna, produkterna, anteckningarna och bilden till en annan dag, så att du kan bära det igen utan att skriva om det. Sök fungerar genom att hitta ett utseende efter stil eller produktnamn.

Första gången du öppnar Lookmira finns det redan tre exempel på utseenden, så dagboken är inte tom. De är vanliga poster. Ta bort dem när dina egna utseenden är tillräckliga.

En påminnelse om att logga dagens utseende är avstängd tills du aktiverar den. Om du gör det blir det en lokal meddelande på denna iPhone vid den tidpunkt du väljer. Inget av detta skickas någonstans.

Det du hittar:

- Ett utseende med datum, titel, bild, stilar, produkter och anteckningar
- Skapa, redigera och ta bort  
- En kalender med dagarna du har antecknat  
- Favoriter  
- Skapa nytt utseende och en lista med senaste inlägg  
- Sök efter stil eller produktnamn  
- Exempel på utseenden vid första lanseringen, som du kan ta bort  
- Ett valfritt påminnelsemeddelande som stannar borta tills du väljer att aktivera det  
- Integritetspolicy och villkor, läsbara i appen  

Lookmira har inget konto och inga köp. Dagboken förblir på denna enhet. En sida som appen kan öppna använder ett nätverksförbindelse, och spårning kan läsa reklamidentifieraren om du tillåter det. Om du avvisar Fotografier kan du fortfarande skriva ett utseende utan bild.

Detta är en dagbok med utseenden du har avslutat. Den försöker inte sminkas på en livekamera. Produkterna du listar är anteckningar bredvid en bild, inte en lagerlista och inte en butik.

name: Loomlight Caravan
description:
A little light. A long way home.

Meet Tavi, Noma, Liri, and Bront: four small guardians with a very bright idea. Together with a magical lantern caravan, they are bringing the morning back to a world of hidden trails and curious night creatures.

In Loomlight Caravan, your path is your plan. Draw a loop from the lantern, connect your guardians, and bring the light home. Each guardian acts when a pulse reaches them. Change their order and discover a different combination of sparks, shields, piercing light, and gentle knockbacks.

DRAW YOUR OWN DEFENSE
Connect neighboring stops into a glowing loop. Choose where your guardians stand, watch the incoming trails, and make the most of your light budget. Need a starting point? A trail hint is always there to help.

TURN THE TIDE WITH A FLIP
As your journey grows, unlock the power to reverse new pulses. The same friends can create a different combo in the opposite order. Pick your moment and let the light do something new.

100 STOPS TOWARD THE SUN
Travel through ten regions, from lush meadows and glassy marshes to moonlit fields and a citadel at dawn. Meet six kinds of night visitors and ten chapter bosses. Directional gates, flooded links, shutters, warm paths, and memory beads give your plans new possibilities.

A CARAVAN THAT KEEPS MOVING
After every wave, your lantern moves to its next stop. Rebuild around the new source and find a fresh way to protect it. Earn up to three stars by finishing the journey, protecting the caravan, and completing each level's mastery challenge.

YOUR OWN LITTLE LEGENDS
Local Scores keeps your real successful runs on this device. Revisit your wave loops, compare personal records, and improve your campaign score.

LITTLE GIFTS, NO LOST STREAKS
Claim daily Glow Coins and collect colorful light charms. Missed days never reset your check-in cycle. Every reward is cosmetic, so progress always comes from your decisions.

MADE FOR A COMFORTABLE JOURNEY
• Core gameplay works offline.
• No account, advertisements, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.
• Pause whenever you like and resume an interrupted run.
• Adjust music, sound effects, and haptics.
• Choose Reduce Motion and High Contrast options.

Draw a loop. Flip the flow. Bring the dawn home.

name: Lovehalo
description:
Lovehalo is a private little space for the two of you.

Pair with your partner using a short code, then grow closer every day:

• Question of the day: answer on your own, then discover your partner's answer.
• Swipe quizzes: agree or disagree, green flag or red flag, who's more likely... swipe each card and compare your answers.
• Love notes: little messages and photos, in real time.
• Your memories: a shared timeline and photo gallery, just for you two.
• Draw for them: your doodle appears on your partner's screen.
• Games for two: tic-tac-toe, connect four, guess the word, mimes and more.
• Bucket list and plans: dream together and count down to what's next.
• Your streak: keep the flame going day after day.
• Widgets: days together, streak, love notes, countdowns, your list and a photo of you two on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

Private by design: only your partner sees what you share. No ads, no tracking. You can delete your account and data anytime from the app.

LOVEHALO PREMIUM
One subscription unlocks Premium for both partners: all quizzes, all widget styles, all games and unlimited memories. Choose a monthly or yearly plan; the yearly plan may include a free trial for eligible users.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://skadigitalstudio.com/lovehalo/privacy

name: Loyalshy
description:
Loyalshy guarda en tu iPhone las tarjetas de fidelidad de los negocios que te gustan.

  Escanea el QR del mostrador o acerca el móvil a su etiqueta NFC: se abre la página del negocio con su
  horario, su wifi, la carta y sus tarjetas. Pon tu nombre y tu email, toca «Añadir a Cartera» y la
  tarjeta queda en Apple Wallet. En caja la enseñas y te sellan la visita.

  · Sin crear cuentas ni recordar contraseñas.
  · Tus tarjetas, en Apple Wallet: siempre a mano, también sin conexión.
  · Wifi, carta, reseñas y llamada, todo en la página de cada negocio.
  · En «Mis tarjetas» ves todas las tarjetas de Loyalshy de tu Wallet y vuelves a la página de cada 
  negocio.

  Loyalshy lo usan cafeterías, peluquerías y tiendas para premiar a sus clientes habituales.

name: Lui Office
description:
All your documents. One app. One purchase.

Lui Office lets you open, edit and create documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDFs on iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscription, no account, no ads. Buy it once and it's yours on all your devices.

PDF
• Highlight, underline and add notes and stamps
• Sign documents with your finger, Apple Pencil or a saved signature
• Fill in forms, merge, split, reorder and compress PDFs
• Scan paper documents with the camera and make them searchable (OCR)
• Convert PDFs to editable documents, text or images

DOCUMENTS
• Rich text with styles, tables, images, lists and page layout
• Open and save files compatible with Microsoft Word (.docx), as well as ODT, RTF, Markdown, HTML and EPUB
• Dictation, spell check, word count and export to PDF

SPREADSHEETS
• Over 90 formulas, charts, filters and sorting
• Conditional formatting, frozen rows and number formats
• Open and save files compatible with Microsoft Excel (.xlsx), plus ODS and CSV

PRESENTATIONS
• Beautiful themes, charts, shapes and animations
• Presenter view with notes and timer on an external display or AirPlay
• Open and save files compatible with Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx), plus ODP; export to PDF, images or video

NOTES WITH APPLE PENCIL
• Notebooks with lined, grid, dotted and Cornell paper
• Rough shapes snap into perfect lines, circles and rectangles
• Handwriting turns into typed text

MORE
• Search inside every document, not just file names
• Ready-made templates for resumes, invoices, letters, budgets and more
• Password-protect your files with AES-256
• Face ID lock, iCloud Drive sync, widgets, Shortcuts and Control Center actions
• Dark mode and 24 languages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your files stay on your device or in your own iCloud Drive. Lui Office collects no personal data and has no tracking.

Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint are trademarks of Microsoft Corporation. Lui Office is not affiliated with Microsoft.

name: LUMA
description: LUMA aplikacija omogućava jednostavno rezervisanje termina u našem studiu. Pronađite slobodne termine i rezervišite svoj termin za trening u najkraćem mogućem roku.

name: Lumen Code
description:
Lumen Code — send files without internet.

Move files and text between a screen and a camera. No shared network, pairing or account is needed. Once installed, the app works fully offline.

SEND WHAT YOU NEED
Choose a file or type text on one device. Point the receiving phone at its screen. View received text and images, then save or share them. Suitable for documents, photos and configuration files; individual files can be up to 256 MiB.

MADE FOR REGULAR USE
The phone app typically receives faster than the web version. Clear progress and live speed show how the transfer is going. Missed frames do not mean starting over: keep scanning to collect more data.

WORKS ACROSS DEVICES
Transfer between phones, computers and the free web version at lumencode.link. Useful when devices cannot share a network or USB connection.

ONE PURCHASE
No subscription, advertising or in-app purchases. Final pricing is shown by the store.

LOCAL PROCESSING
The app makes no network connections and collects no data. Files and camera images are processed on your device. The protocol and source code are available under the MIT License.

BEFORE YOU TRANSFER
The displayed code is not encrypted or authenticated. Encrypt sensitive files first and check their source. The code changes colour as often as the screen refreshes (up to 60 times a second on most screens, 120 on fast ones); do not look at it if you are sensitive to flashing light. The app asks for confirmation before the first playback.

Privacy: https://lumencode.link/privacy
Support: hello@mondaylabs.ltd
Source: https://github.com/mondaylabsltd/lumen-code

name: Lumen Leap PuzzlePro
description:
Push a Drop Block too hard in Lumen Leap PuzzlePro and it keeps sliding until something stops it, so every move matters. Guide Pip across 72 gravity puzzles: nudge Drop Blocks down, flip them into Lift Blocks that fall up, and build a path to the light-beam exit.

Each of the six worlds layers one new idea on the last. Glass floors crack under a second landing and shatter on the third, so you have to decide which tile to burn and which to save. Pressure plates hold a gate open only while a block rests on them, which means you have to park a block before walking through. Portals send a block to its paired twin without triggering the plate under the first, so you can carry weight across the room without losing it on the way.

Collect all three Prism Shards in a level to perfect it; miss one and the medal stays bronze until you come back. Stuck? Hold Rewind to scrub the last twenty seconds frame by frame to the moment before the mistake, with three charges per run. Spend a hint token to watch a ghost solve the room once, then try it yourself. Finish a level clean and your own replay returns as a Ghost Racer the next time you play, so chasing your best is a race against your own hands.

A fresh Daily Prism puzzle unlocks at midnight and a daily streak pays bonus XP. Trade collected shards in the Shard Forge for new skins, motion trails and portal effects for Pip. No account, no ads and nothing to buy; your run history, stats and cosmetics live on your device and work offline.

name: Lumengraph
description:
Lumengraph calculates your Human Design bodygraph with astronomical precision and explains it in plain language.

Should you respond or initiate? Decide on the spot or wait for emotional clarity? Human Design maps your energy from the exact moment and place you were born – a deeper, more personal picture than a sun sign. Enter your birth date, time and place and get your chart in seconds.

YOUR DESIGN AT A GLANCE
• Your Type: Generator, Manifesting Generator, Projector, Manifestor or Reflector – with its Strategy and Signature
• Your inner Authority for making decisions
• Your Profile and Incarnation Cross
• Defined and open centers, channels and gates

PRECISE CALCULATION
• Design date from the exact 88° solar arc (not "88 days") and the true lunar node
• Planetary positions from the VSOP87 astronomy engine
• Historical time zones and daylight saving time resolved automatically
• Birth place search with Apple Maps – no location permission needed
• Birth-time precision modes for when you only know the approximate time

GO DEEPER
• Crisp vector bodygraph with every planet activation, in Modern or Classic style
• Full readings of Type, Authority, Profile, Definition and channels
• Line, color and tone details and the Four Arrows (Variables)
• Circuitry overview
• Clean PDF report to keep or share

RELATIONSHIPS AND GROUPS
• Relationship compatibility with a composite chart: connection formula from 9-0 to 0-9, electromagnetic, companionship, dominance and compromise channels
• Penta analysis for families and teams of 3–5 people

DAILY TRANSITS
• Today's planetary weather overlaid on your own chart
• See which centers and channels the transits activate for you
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: Daily Energy, Pro Transits and Couple Today
• Optional daily reminder at a time you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in
• No ads, no trackers, no third-party analytics
• Saved charts, names and notes stay on your device
• Birth data is sent over HTTPS only to calculate the chart and is not stored on any server

ENGLISH AND CZECH
Switch the whole app between English and Czech at any time.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Lumengraph is free to download. Create charts and explore your bodygraph for free. Unlock more with optional in-app purchases:
• Single Complete Chart – full reading and PDF for one chart, forever
• Pair Composite Reading – one complete relationship reading, forever
• Lumengraph Pro (monthly or yearly subscription) – all charts, Composite, Penta, PDF export, live widgets and daily notifications
• Unlimited Lifetime – everything, one payment, no subscription

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.getlumengraph.com/privacy
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Lumengraph is an unofficial educational tool. It is not affiliated with Jovian Archive and is not a substitute for professional advice.

name: LumenScrim
description:
Plan a lighting setup before you move a stand.

LumenScrim is a studio lighting workbench for photographers. Build an overhead plan with lights, flags, a subject and a camera. Move equipment directly on the layout or enter exact positions. Change output, beam angle, stand height and color temperature to explore the setup.

Switch to Meter to see modeled illuminance across a horizontal plane. Drag the A–B line to read a cross-section, scrub the profile to locate a reading, or place probes at specific points. View readings in lux or in stops relative to the subject reference.

Save takes so you can compare and restore arrangements. Share a lighting diagram, export readings as a CSV, or pass along an editable lighting project.

Includes original setups for portraits, still life and rim lighting, plus an empty studio. Projects work offline without an account. Readings are modeled estimates for planning and comparing setups.

name: LumiGlance
description:
Learn vocabulary around your interests with LumiGlance, in the app and through Live Activity on your iPhone Lock Screen.

Choose Russian, English or Brazilian Portuguese for the interface, then learn either of the other two languages.

• 20 topics and 1,000 themed vocabulary cards.
• A word and its translation together.
• Got it saves a word to your learned bank; Review postpones it until the next day in your phone’s local time.
• Return individual learned words for another review.
• Simple statistics and a study streak.
• Light and dark themes.

Your included vocabulary and learning history stay on your device. Learn offline, without an account or subscription.

Live Activity requires a supported iPhone and is controlled by iOS settings. After an answer, a confirmation appears, followed by the next card after about five seconds. iOS may delay updates or end the session. Buttons do not extend the screen-sleep timer.

name: LuminaFlash: FSRS Flashcards
description:
Modern editorial typography meets the world's smartest spaced-repetition algorithm.

  LuminaFlash is a calm, beautifully crafted flashcard studio built for medical students, language learners, and exam preparation. Powered by the modern FSRS algorithm and 100% native iOS design, it delivers effortless studying without legacy menus or expensive yearly subscriptions.

  KEY FEATURES
  • One-Tap .apkg & CSV Import: Bring your existing Anki decks—including Cloze deletions and embedded media—in seconds.
  • Modern FSRS Scheduling: Learns your exact memory curve to cut unnecessary reviews by 20%+ compared to legacy SM-2.
  • Magazine-Grade Reading Comfort: Warm paper, sepia, and OLED dark themes with refined typography built for long study sessions.
  • Tactile 3D Card Flip & Shortcuts: One-hand swipe rating, Core Haptics feedback, built-in TTS pronunciation, instant Undo, and external keyboard support.
  • Calm Progress Tracking: Clean study heatmaps, retention insights, and Home Screen review widgets without stressful streak guilt.
  • 100% Local-First Privacy: Study offline anywhere and export your JSON/CSV backups anytime.

  HONEST PRICING
  Study up to 3 decks completely free forever with full FSRS scheduling. Upgrade once ($5.99) for unlimited decks, themes, and deep retention analytics—zero subscriptions.

  Privacy Policy: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/luminaflash/privacy.html
  Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
  Support: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/luminaflash/support.html

name: Lumo Scan - QR & Barcode Scan
description:
Point your camera and read QR codes and barcodes in an instant.

FEATURES
• Reads QR codes, product barcodes and more
• Reads codes in saved photos and screenshots
• Shows a link before you open it, so you are never sent to a site automatically
• Shows Wi-Fi network names and passwords clearly, ready to copy
• Actions that match the content: phone, email, text and product codes
• Searchable history with filters, favorites and renaming
• Optional history limit (favorites are always kept)
• Light for dark places, plus vibration and sound settings
• Open the scanner from Control Center (iOS 18 or later)

PRIVACY
Scanned content and history are stored only on your device.
No account is needed.

ADS
Free to use, with ads.
A one-time Remove Ads purchase hides all ads.

name: Lumolo: Curated Videos
description:
Lumolo is a calm, carefully curated video app for families.

A CHECKED LIST, NOT AN ENDLESS FEED
Every channel is checked before it is added: YouTube's Made for Kids status, age restrictions, live streams and a visual review of its recent videos. There is no search box and no feed of recommendations — only the channels on our list.

YOUR LANGUAGES, YOUR COUNTRIES
Choose exactly which languages and countries videos come from: English, Azerbaijani, Turkish, Russian, Spanish, Arabic and many more.

GROWN-UPS STAY IN CHARGE
• A daily time limit and a bedtime that changing the clock can't get around
• Settings protected by a grown-up check and a PIN
• Hide any channel on this device
• Links that would leave the app always ask a grown-up first

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no sign-in, no analytics, no tracking and no ads of our own. Favorites and watch history stay on your device.

ABOUT THE VIDEOS
Videos are played with YouTube's official embedded player. YouTube may show its own ads inside its player; Lumolo never adds any. Lumolo uses YouTube API Services — by using Lumolo you agree to be bound by the YouTube Terms of Service (https://www.youtube.com/t/terms).

name: Lumos Nights
description:
Lumos Nights puts your professionally installed LED lighting in the palm of your hand. Turn your home's lights on and off, set the mood with one tap, and let your house dress itself for every holiday of the year.

SET THE MOOD
• 30 designer looks — Classic Christmas, Winter Wonderland, Spooky Glow, Stars & Stripes, Warm White and more
• Create your own looks with team colours or any colours you like
• Moods only change the lights that are on, so the rest of the house stays exactly how you left it

HOLIDAY AUTOPILOT
• Flip one switch and your home shows the right look for every holiday — Valentine's, St. Patrick's, Easter, July 4th, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's and more
• Lights come on at sunset and go off at bedtime, all year
• Holiday dates that move (Easter, Thanksgiving) update automatically every year
• Runs on your lighting controllers, so it works even when your phone is off

MUSIC SHOW MODE
• Play music near your phone and your whole house dances to the beat
• Six show styles and colour themes — perfect for parties and the holidays
• Your lights return to normal the moment the show ends

LIGHT SCAN
• Point your camera at your house and Lumos Nights learns where every light is
• Then colour your home by side — or just type "left side green, right side red"
• Uses Apple Intelligence on supported iPhones, entirely on your device

SIRI
• "Hey Siri, turn on Lumos Nights"
• "Set Lumos Nights to Classic Christmas"
• Works with the Shortcuts app for automations

STUDIO FOR FINE-TUNING
• 200+ effects with speed, intensity and palettes
• Segments: split your roofline into sections, each with its own colour and effect
• Save and recall your favourite presets
• Sleep timers and daily schedules

SEE IT ON YOUR HOUSE
• Preview any look on a photo of a house before you buy

BUILT FOR LUMOS NIGHTS CUSTOMERS
• Finds your lights on your home Wi-Fi automatically
• Call, text or book a service visit with Lumos Nights right from the app
• Private by design: no account, no tracking — the app talks only to your own lights

No lights yet? Tap "Try the demo" to explore everything with simulated lights.

Lumos Nights works with WLED-based lighting controllers installed by Lumos Nights.

name: Luvma
description:
Come closer. Luvma is where a live, a voice room, and a short moment sit on the same shelf. You do not need a perfect introduction. Showing up is enough.

Stay for a live that is already on, or sit down in a voice room and talk. Create a room when you want a hall of your own. Leave a photo, a video, and a few words from the day you are in.

Follow the people who stay with you, and message them one to one. A virtual gift is a small way to say you are still here. Diamonds are in-app purchases. Profiles, reports, and blocks are there when you want them.

name: Lux In Turkey
description:
Lux In Turkey is the companion app for invited participants of LuxInTurkey 2027 in Istanbul. Use it to complete your registration, keep your travel details up to date and find the information you need before and during your stay.

Sign in with the account created through your LuxInTurkey invitation. There is no public sign-up: the app is for invited guests whose participation has been confirmed.

YOUR REGISTRATION, STEP BY STEP
The Panel shows what is done and what comes next:
• Personal details – company or agency, name, job title, country of residence, email and phone.
• Passport details – nationality, date of birth, passport number, issue and expiry dates, and a passport scan as a photo or PDF.
• Flight details – arrival and departure flights with airline, flight number, airports and local times, plus your e-ticket.
Your progress is saved after each step, so you can stop and come back later. Flight details can be added once your flights are confirmed, and you can update your details if your plans change.

GUIDANCE
Read the information the LuxInTurkey team publishes for your stay, open attached files and confirm required items with "I acknowledge". Your booking code is shown at the top and can be copied with a tap.

DAY FLOW
See your programme day by day, with the time, location and details of each activity, once the team publishes your itinerary. Day Flow and FAQ open after you have acknowledged the required guidance.

FAQ
