Answers to common questions about the programme, accommodation, flights and transfers, and preparing for your journey.

NOTIFICATIONS
If you allow notifications, you are notified when your Day Flow programme is updated and when the LuxInTurkey team sends you a message. All notifications are also kept in the app: tap the bell to read them.

YOUR DATA
The app connects to the LuxInTurkey service over HTTPS and keeps your sign-in token in the device's secure storage. If you allow notifications, the app registers a notification token for your device; you can turn notifications off in your device settings. You can replace or remove an uploaded passport file or ticket at any time. To request access to or deletion of your data, email amean.hesaplar@gmail.com.
Privacy policy: https://login.luxinturkey.com/privacy

name: LxTerm Shell
description:
LxTerm puts a real Linux system on your iPhone: Debian 13 for arm64, unmodified, running right on the device. Install software with apt, write Python with pip, keep sessions alive in tmux and connect to your servers over SSH. No jailbreak, no cloud machine, no account.

A REAL LINUX SYSTEM
• Debian's own arm64 programs, exactly as Debian builds them
• apt and dpkg work: thousands of packages from Debian's archive are one command away
• bash, coreutils, Python 3, curl, nano, less and tmux come installed
• pip installs Linux packages from PyPI, including compiled libraries such as polars
• git, ssh, vim and more: just apt install them

MADE FOR THE PHONE
• A native iPhone app with a fast terminal and several shells in tabs
• A key row with Esc, Ctrl, Tab, arrows and the symbols a phone keyboard hides
• Ctrl-C, Ctrl-Z and job control work as on any Linux machine
• Your terminal is still there when you come back
• Themes and adjustable font size

PRIVATE
• Everything runs on your iPhone. LxTerm collects no data.
• The network is used only when you ask for it (apt, pip, ssh, curl)

HOW IT WORKS
iOS does not let apps generate machine code, so LxTerm brings its own AArch64 interpreter and Linux system-call layer. Heavy number crunching is slower than on a computer; everyday command-line work, scripting and learning Linux feel right at home.

LxTerm is free and open source (GPL-3.0). Debian is a registered trademark of Software in the Public Interest, Inc. LxTerm is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Debian Project.

name: M9 Box
description:
M9 Box is the iPhone app for Box, the cloud file storage service your company subscribes to. Your files stay on your company's own server, and the app gives you access to them from anywhere.

To sign in, enter your company's server address and your login. The app does not create accounts: access is granted by your administrator. The app is free; the service is paid for by your company.

FILES
- Browse folders, open and preview documents.
- Upload photos and videos from your iPhone, including in the background.
- Share files by link.
- Open and edit documents on your company's own server.
- Mark favorites for offline use.
- Access Box from the iPhone Files app.

CHATS
- Chat with your coworkers.
- Voice and video calls with your team.
- Incoming calls ring like a regular iPhone call.

TASKS
- Task lists and subtasks synced with the server.

CALENDAR AND CONTACTS
- Sync your Box calendar and contacts with the iPhone Calendar and Contacts apps. Sync only starts after you grant access.

NOTIFICATIONS
- Get alerts for messages, calls and shares.

PRIVACY
Your files, contacts, events and messages go only to your company's server, not to M9 Network. We collect app usage data with Firebase Analytics to fix errors and see which screens are used.

OPEN SOURCE
M9 Box is derived from open source software, licensed under GPLv3 with an App Store exception, and its source code is published.

Questions about your account or server access: contact your company's administrator.

name: Ma: Focus Timer
description:
Ma is a calm, minimal focus and break timer for iPhone and Apple Watch, inspired by the Japanese concept of intentional space between moments.

Start a session in a single tap and stay focused without clutter, streaks, or nagging charts.

DESIGNED FOR CALM FOCUS
• Clean paper-and-ink aesthetic in both Light (Washi) and Dark (Sumi) modes
• Signature brushed progress ring that quietly marks your work and break phases
• Four ready-to-use activities out of the box: Work (50 + 10 min), Study (25 + 5 min), Reading (25 + 5 min), and Play (50 + 10 min) plus a quick one-off Custom timer
• Customize activities with your own names, icons, ink colors, and durations

RELIABLE ALARMS THAT ACTUALLY RING
• Powered by Apple’s Alarm system so work and break timers ring reliably on time even in Silent mode or Focus
• Handcrafted alert tones: Wood block, Singing bowl, Soft bells, or Silent (vibration only)
• Extend any ringing session by +5 minutes or stop right from the alarm

EVERYWHERE ON APPLE
• Live Activities on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• Native Apple Watch companion app and watch face complications that stay in sync with your iPhone
• Home Screen widgets, Control Center & Action Button controls, and Siri / Shortcuts support

COMPLETELY PRIVATE
• Zero data collected, zero analytics, zero ads, and no account required. Everything stays on your devices.

name: Maarif Atlas
description:
Maarif Atlas, Türkiye Yüzyılı Maarif Modeli'ne (TYMM) göre hazırlanmış bir eğitim platformudur. Öğretmenler derse hazırlanır, öğrenciler ortak yazılılara çalışıp kazanım oyunları oynar, veliler de çocuklarının hangi hafta ne öğrendiğini takip eder.

HAFTALIK PLAN
• İlkokul, ortaokul, Anadolu, fen ve sosyal bilimler liselerinde 1–12. sınıf planları
• Her hafta işlenecek ünite, konu ve öğrenme çıktıları
• Ölçme-değerlendirme önerileri, değerler ve okuryazarlık becerileri

ORTAK YAZILI (OYSS)
• Sınıf ve derse göre örnek yazılı kâğıtları ve senaryolar
• Soru puanları, konu dağılımı ve cevap anahtarı
• Öğrenciler için çalışma, öğretmenler için yazdırılabilir kâğıt
• Veliler ve öğretmenler için ortak yazılı rehberleri

KAZANIM OYUNLARI
• Haftanın kazanımlarına uygun oyunlar ve etkinlikler
• Öğrenciler sınıfına göre dersleri seçip oynar
• Öğretmenler sınıfta tahtada açar

ÖĞRETMENLER İÇİN
• Her ay ve her ders için hazır aylık rapor taslağı
• Sene başı, ara ve dönem zümre toplantı tutanakları
• Plan, rapor ve tutanakları Word olarak indirme ve paylaşma
• Sınıflarım: Derslerinizi kaydedin, bu haftanın planı hep hazır olsun

Karanlık mod desteklenir. Kayıt ücretsizdir, kart bilgisi istenmez.

Maarif Atlas bağımsız bir eğitim platformudur; Millî Eğitim Bakanlığı ile resmî bir bağlantısı yoktur. İçerikler yayımlanmış öğretim programlarına dayanır.

name: MADZINE AU Bundle
description:
MADZINE AU Bundle is one app that contains four Audio Unit (AUv3) plug-ins. After installing the app, load the plug-ins inside a host app that supports AUv3, such as a DAW. In the host they appear as six entries: MOD HUB (MIDI and CV versions), Universal Rhythm (MIDI and built-in drums versions), ChaosTrio and Oscilloscope.

MOD HUB
A modulation source.
- SEQUENCER with 8 stages, two groups (A and B) and CROSSFADE between them
- Six LFOs
- DRAW mode for drawing your own curves
- A mixer that sends any blend of the sources to four outputs
- MIDI version: sends MIDI CC and notes, with SCALE quantize
- CV version: outputs control signals at audio rate

Universal Rhythm
A rhythm pattern generator.
- Four roles: Timeline, Foundation, Groove and Lead
- Nine styles
- STEP EDIT for velocity, probability, decay and ratchet on each step
- MIDI version: sends notes on MIDI channel 10
- Drums version: plays built-in drum sounds, with a sampler that offers slicing and granular playback
- MULTI-OUTPUT for sending voices to separate host channels

ChaosTrio
An audio effect with three slots.
- Each slot runs DELAY, weiii Documenta or KARPLUS
- Five routings between the slots
- Lorenz chaos modulation
- SIMPLE and FULL views

Oscilloscope
An audio analysis plug-in.
- Oscilloscope with trigger
- SPECTRUM with a reference curve
- FOURIER BOX view
- Audio passes through the plug-in

All four plug-ins
- DARK and LIGHT themes with adjustable hue
- Built-in HELP in English, Traditional Chinese and Japanese
- Parameters available to host automation and MIDI CC

Requires a host app that supports AUv3 plug-ins.

name: Mafia Night: Narrator
description:
Mafia Night is a voiced narrator for Mafia and Werewolf. Put one phone on the table and it runs the game, so the person who usually moderates gets to play too.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add 4 to 20 players and pick the roles.
2. Pass the phone around. Each player holds the screen to see their role, and it hides again when they let go.
3. Put the phone in the middle. The narrator wakes each night role in turn, and the role that wakes taps its choice without a word.
4. In the morning the narrator tells everyone what happened. A discussion timer runs, the town votes, and the app reveals who is out.
5. The app checks the win conditions automatically.

AFTER THE GAME
A night-by-night recap shows what everyone did, including who lied to your face. Share it with your group as an image.

YOUR HOUSE RULES
Turn on the rules your group plays with: nobody is out on the first night, the Doctor may save themselves, roles are shown when a player is out.

LOCAL LANGUAGES, LOCAL NAMES
The narrator speaks English, Bulgarian, Ukrainian, Greek, Polish and Czech, and the game uses the name people know at home: Mafia, Мафия, Мафія, Παλέρμο, Mafia, Městečko Palermo.

FREE
Up to 8 players with four roles (Mafia, Doctor, Detective and Civilian). Play as many games as you want: the free game never locks.

FULL GAME, ONE-TIME UNLOCK
- 9 to 20 players
- Six more roles: Don, Sheriff, Jester, Bodyguard, Lovers, Maniac
You pay once. There is no subscription.

PLAYS WITHOUT INTERNET
The narrator's voice is built into the app, so games run without a connection, including everything you have unlocked. Buying or restoring the full game needs a connection.

No account needed.

name: Magic Bag RPG
description:
A little bag. A growing storm of magic.
Arrange 10 kinds of magic, merge matching tiles, and discover how neighbors change each spell. Fire, ice, lightning, venom, bombs and lasers combine with speed, split, size and power tiles.

Battles run automatically while you organize. Watch fireballs multiply, steam erupt and lightning spread. Buy new spells with gold, expand your bag to 6×6, and face a boss every five waves.

Every run helps the next. Spend earned crystals on permanent upgrades, rethink your layout, and push further.

• Portrait play with quick, tactile bag puzzles
• Core gameplay works offline
• Japanese and English

Optional in-app purchases and ads are available. Ad removal disables banners and automatic interstitials; voluntary rewarded videos remain available. Purchases and ads require internet. Progress and gems are stored locally on this device. Consumable gems cannot be restored after deleting the app or changing devices.

name: Mahfil: Namaz, Kur'an, Dua
description:
Mahfil, Arapça bilmeden de ibadetini öğrenip yapabilmen için hazırlanmış ücretsiz ve reklamsız bir İslami rehberdir. Bütün dualar ve Kur'an Türkçe harflerle, anlamıyla birlikte; her bilgi kaynağıyla gösterilir.

NAMAZ
• Diyanet'in ilçe takvimine göre namaz vakitleri, vakit bildirimleri ve kerahat vakitleri
• Namaz nasıl kılınır: beş vakit, vitir, Cuma, bayram, teravih ve cenaze namazı adım adım (Hanefî)
• Abdest anlatımı, nafile namazlar, kaza namazı sayacı
• Kıble pusulası

KUR'AN
• 114 sûre, tecvid kurallarına göre renklendirilmiş Türkçe okunuş ve meal
• Hafız sesiyle dinleme, ayet tekrarıyla ezber, hatim takibi
• Ezber kontrolü: ezberinden oku, atladığın kelimeyi göster

DUALAR VE ZİKİR
• Namazda okunanlar, namazdan sonra tesbihat, günlük ve korunma duaları
• Zikirmatik: sayıyı sen belirle, hadislerde geçen zikirler, kendi zikir listen
• Esmâü'l-Hüsnâ: 99 isim ve anlamları

BİLGİ KÜTÜPHANESİ
• Halk arasında yanlış ya da eksik bilinen konular; her biri âyet, hadis ve Diyanet fetvasıyla kısa bir ders
• Her gün bir soru, istediğin kadar "Bir bilgi daha"

RAMAZAN VE MÜBAREK GECELER
• İmsak ve iftar sayacı, oruç bilgileri, iftar duası
• Kandil ve Kadir gecesi için ne yapılabileceği, kaynaklarıyla

KOLAY KULLANIM
• Büyük yazı seçeneği, sade ekranlar, Arapça metin yalnız istersen
• İlim Yolu: dinî kavramları kelime oyunuyla öğren

GÜVENİLİR VE GİZLİ
• Her dinî bilgi en az iki kaynakla karşılaştırılır; kaynaklar uygulamada gösterilir
• Hesap açmak yok, reklam yok, kişisel veri toplanmaz

name: Mahjong Vorynth
description:
Mahjong Vorynth is a mechanical strategy puzzle played on a circular tower seen from above. Three rings turn on their own gears: twelve tiles outside, eight in the middle, four at the heart. Each turn snaps to a precise angle. When Blossom or Ring tiles of consecutive rank line up on a seal axis, you awaken that seal.

This is not pair-matching solitaire. The puzzle is positioning. Outer, middle, and inner rings move in different steps, some gears lock until a seal opens, and later chambers ask for a chosen court, a chosen rank, or a clear before the clock stops. Sixty levels across six floors are built from solved towers and scrambled by reversible rotations, so every layout has a real route.

Easy gives a wider move budget and two hints. Medium plays the intended gearing. Hard shortens the budget, removes free hints, and speeds the time chambers. Stars come from the score you can actually earn: chows, seal bonuses, leftover moves, and time still on the clock. Hints cost score.

A rotating miniature tower greets you. The floor map, the engineering journal, the guided practice tower, and the control panel are each their own instrument. Progress, records, and settings stay on the device.

No ads. No purchases. No wagering.

name: Mairan
description:
Mairan is a quiet tea journal for iPhone.

Keep the tea on your shelf, the vessel you pour from, and the minutes you actually give them. A steep is not a rating in Mairan. It is a record: leaf, water, vessel, time, place, mood, and one line about what stayed.

A TABLE, NOT A DASHBOARD
Open to the last steep, the teas currently in hand, and a short log of recent minutes. No streak, no daily target, no badge.

STEEPS, KEPT
Record the tea, the vessel, the date and time, minutes, leaf weight, water temperature, infusions, place, and mood. Search the whole log. Filter by mood. Six tea types, six moods, five vessel kinds — enough vocabulary, no scorecard.

name: Mallessa's Luxury
description:
Travel comfortably with Mallessa’s Luxury. Whether you’re heading to work, visiting family, or planning a getaway, book your bus tickets anytime, anywhere.

Key Features:

Easy Ticket Booking – Choose your route, travel date, and preferred seat in a few simple steps.  
Download Your Tickets – Keep your ticket handy for a smooth boarding experience.  
Simple, Convenient Design – Find your trip and complete your booking with ease.  
Comfort on Every Journey – Plan your next trip with Mallessa’s Luxury.

Your next journey starts here. Book. Ride. Relax.

name: Malmheim
description:
Malmheim is a real-time strategy game in full 3D space, made for touch on iPhone and iPad.

You start with a single mining ship at the edge of the sector. Mine ore and crystal, deploy a base station, research new hulls and build a fleet to drive out the space pirates and monsters that hold the region. Every match takes 10 to 20 minutes, so a whole battle fits a coffee break.

TRUE 3D BATTLES
Orbit the camera freely, pinch to zoom and send ships above or below the action by raising the move marker with two fingers. Flank from underneath, hide in nebulae and strike where the enemy isn't looking.

BUILD AND COMMAND
• Seven ship classes: miners, scouts, fighters, corvettes, frigates, destroyers and repair ships.
• Rock-paper-scissors counters, so the right fleet beats the bigger one.
• Three tiers of research unlock new hulls, faster drills, armour and rail guns.
• Repair ships patch up your fleet and salvage wrecks for ore.

A LIVING SECTOR
• Pirates build outposts and raid you harder the richer you grow.
• Monsters attack everyone: a guardian holds the crystal nest, and leech packs hunt the routes.
• Fog of war and nebulae that blind your sensors.

CAMPAIGN AND SKIRMISH
• A three-mission campaign: Brimgard, Fafnir's Hoard and Ragnarok.
• A skirmish on Shattered Reach for a quick match.

MADE FOR PLAYING ANYWHERE
• Controls built for touch, with game controller support.
• Adaptive music that follows the battle from calm mining to all-out war.
• Battery saver and graphics settings for longer sessions.
• Plays fully offline. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.
• Optional anonymous diagnostics, off unless you turn them on.

name: Manga & Comics · Next Volume
description:
Next Volume estimates when the next book of each of your series should come out, from the rhythm of the volumes you already own. Manga, comics and bandes dessinées, all on one shelf.

• Upcoming books: an “expected around” estimate worked out on your phone from each series’ past rhythm, with a gentle alert when a series runs later than usual.
• “Do I have it?”: type a title or a number in the shop, or read the barcode, and see at once if you already own it. No more duplicates.
• Series page: owned, read, to-be-read pile, missing numbers, specials and omnibuses.
• Wishlist to share as text or as a QR code.
• Signed copies and bookplates with a keepsake photo, loans with a reminder.
• Online records by ISBN, only when you ask (BnF, openBD, Open Library): only the ISBN is sent.
• PDF inventory and backup file.

“Expected around” dates are estimates, never official dates: only the publisher decides.

Privacy: no account, no tracking. Your shelf stays on your phone.

Free for up to 15 series. The full version is a one-time purchase with no subscription: unlimited series, notifications, signed copies, loans, PDF inventory and wishlist QR code.

Available in 25 languages.

https://sogerg.github.io/next-volume-legal/

name: Mangpai BaZi: Four Pillars
description:
You were born at a precise hour, under a precise sky. Two thousand years ago, Chinese astronomers wrote that moment down as eight characters, four pillars of two, and called it your BaZi.

Mangpai BaZi reads those eight characters in the tradition of the Mangpai lineage: masters who worked from memory and touch instead of guesswork, famous for saying what a chart shows — and nothing it doesn't.

NOT YOUR SUN SIGN. YOUR WHOLE ARCHITECTURE.
Western astrology asks where the planets were. BaZi asks what you are made of: which of the Five Elements you carry, which you lack, and how the characters in your chart push, protect, and pull against one another. The result is less a horoscope and more a blueprint.

HOW WE READ
First, Host and Guest — what in your chart is you, and what is the world you meet.
Then, the Structural Work — the single job your chart is built to perform, and the engine that drives it.
Finally, the Timing — the decade, the year, and the solar month when that work comes due.
Every conclusion points back to a specific character in your chart. No vague fortune-cookie lines. The same birth data always returns the same reading.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Your Chart in Three Seconds — a plain-English portrait of your nature, before a single technical term.
• True Solar Time — born in Toronto, London, Sydney, or New York? We correct your clock time to the sun's real position over your birthplace, historical daylight saving included.
• The Master Life Book — an 8-chapter, ~5,000-word personal reading covering nature, vocation, wealth, love, roots, wellbeing, your decades, and the year ahead.
• Synastry for Two — not zodiac-animal matching. We examine whether your roots clash, whether the Partner Seat is pierced, and whether you draw strength from the same element.
• Birth Hour Rectification — don't know your birth time? Answer two steps of objective life milestones to narrow down the hour that fits.
• Year Ahead, Month by Month — guided by the 24 solar terms: when to advance, when to hold.
• The Dunhuang Gallery — mineral-pigment illustrations inspired by classical cave murals for every archetype and symbolic star.
• English & 繁體中文 — switch languages with one tap. Read your chart in English; share it with family in Chinese.

MANGPAI PRO & OPTIONAL UNLOCKS
Core Four Pillars casting, Three-Second Overview, Host/Guest Structural Work, Five Elements, Decade Chapters, basic Symbolic Stars, current solar month, and Chapter 1 preview are free. Subscribe quarterly or yearly (Mangpai Pro), or unlock individual readings as needed. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://bazi.mangpai.me/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bazi.mangpai.me/privacy
Support: https://bazi.mangpai.me/support
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Mangpai BaZi is offered for cultural exploration and self-reflection only. It does not provide medical, legal, financial, or relationship advice.

name: Mantel: Photo Frame & Clock
description:
Turn your iPad into a beautiful digital photo frame and bedside clock.

Mantel plays any album from your photo library as a slideshow, with an elegant clock on top. Put an old iPad on the mantel, your nightstand, a shop counter or your desk, and let your memories play.

PLAY ANY ALBUM
• Your albums, shared albums and smart albums
• Photos and videos, including ones stored in iCloud
• New photos synced from iCloud join the slideshow automatically
• Picks up right where it left off when you come back

BEAUTIFUL SLIDESHOWS
• Crossfade, Ken Burns or slide transitions
• Change photos every 2 seconds to every hour
• Shuffle, chronological or newest first
• Fill the screen or show the whole photo
• Smart cropping keeps faces in view, so heads aren't cut off
• Videos play to the end, muted or with sound. Muted videos won't interrupt your music

A CLOCK YOU'LL LOVE
• Four styles: Corner, Big Clock, Info Bar, or Custom
• Custom layout: drag the clock, date and photo info anywhere
• See when and where each photo was taken
• Follows your iPad's 12/24-hour setting

MADE FOR THE BEDSIDE
• Night Mode turns the screen black on a schedule and dims it all the way down, then wakes up in the morning
• Optional dim, warm clock at night
• Keep Screen Awake for an always-on frame

YOUR LANGUAGE
• English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語 and 한국어, switchable right in the app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos never leave your device. No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.

Mantel is free. If you enjoy it, you can buy the developer a coffee. Tips are optional and don't unlock anything.

Works on any iPad running iPadOS 15 or later, including older models like iPad Air 2.

name: ManyGrow: Automação de Direct
description:
ManyGrow é a automação de Direct e comentários com inteligência artificial da GrowSoft. A IA responde DMs e comentários do seu perfil do Instagram em segundos, qualifica leads e organiza tudo num CRM simples, com espaço para sua equipe entrar quando precisar.

RESPOSTA AUTOMÁTICA COM IA
• IA que entende a intenção da mensagem, não só palavra-chave
• Responde comentários e envia a resposta no privado automaticamente
• Boas-vindas automáticas na primeira DM
• Follow-up automático para quem parou de responder

FLUXOS VISUAIS
• Monte automações arrastando blocos, sem programar
• Gatilhos, tags e segmentação de contatos
• Templates prontos para começar em minutos
• Automações, fluxos e contatos ilimitados

CRM E ATENDIMENTO
• CRM de social selling para organizar conversas e leads
• Qualificação automática: leads quentes, mornos e frios
• Passagem da IA para um atendente humano (1 atendente incluso)
• Campanhas segmentadas para listas de interessados

AGENDA DE PUBLICAÇÕES
• Agende post, Reel, carrossel e Story no dia e na hora que você escolher
• Feed, Reels, carrossel e Stories na mesma fila

NO APP PARA IPHONE
• Painel ManyGrow completo, com atualização ao puxar a tela
• Lembrete diário para revisar conversas e leads
• Central de ajuda com perguntas frequentes
• Compartilhe o ManyGrow e gerencie seus dados em Ajustes

INTEGRAÇÕES
• Conecte seu agente de IA via MCP
• API e webhooks para casos avançados

API OFICIAL
O ManyGrow funciona sobre a API oficial da Meta, sem métodos não oficiais, para mais estabilidade e segurança para o seu perfil. É preciso um perfil profissional ou comercial.

Para usar o app, entre com o e-mail e a senha da sua conta ManyGrow.

Aviso: ManyGrow é um produto da GrowSoft e não é afiliado, patrocinado nem endossado pela Meta ou pelo Instagram. Instagram é marca registrada de seus respectivos titulares.

Contato e suporte: contato@growsoft.io
Exclusão de conta e dados: https://growsoft.io/manygrow/excluir-conta/

name: MaoMao Learn Chinese
description:
Learn to understand and speak Chinese, one phrase a day, with Mao the black kitten.

Every morning Mao brings you one useful phrase. Hear it in a clear, natural voice, slow it down, say it out loud and see your tones. It takes about 35 seconds. That's all you have to do. No backlog, no pile of reviews, no guilt.

• One phrase a day: real things people say, in the order you need them
• Hear it, say it: a natural voice, a slow version, and a mic that shows your tones
• Mao's path: 500 stepping stones through a painted world, from the garden to above the clouds, with friends to meet and little games along the way
• It remembers for you: phrases come back just before you forget them, as a quick question
• Talk with Mao: build whole sentences, word by word, on a quiet rainy evening
• Writing is optional: speaking comes first, characters when you want them
• Your streak forgives you: Mao naps on the days you miss
• Home screen widgets: today's phrase and your streak at a glance

Want more? Phrase packs for food, travel, work, love, slang, tea and more, each with a card game and its own final game. The Food pack is included. Live wallpapers, chat stickers, app icons and a Chinese name written just for you. Everything is bought once and stays yours, or earned with the coins you win by learning. No ads, ever. No subscription.

Your progress stays on your phone. With an optional account, it follows you to a new phone.

name: Marbling Gall
description: Marbling Gall is a shop log for a marbling bath on this iPhone. Drop a tight color bead and note its size in millimetres. Touch gall and only a tight bead spreads. If another drop lands while a bead is still tight, the latest tight bead is sealed and gall will not open it later. Lay a sheet only when no bead is tight. The last saved sheet stays. Open a saved sheet to read each bead, or share the states you choose. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Marchling Meadow
description:
Mother Hen's chicks have wandered off across the spring fields. Draw her route home with one finger, and every chick follows exactly one tile behind the one in front.

The puzzle is the line itself. Each chick you gather makes the line longer, the line can never cross itself, and a long line needs room to turn. Plan loops, detours and tight corners so that everyone ends up in the coop.

LOOK, DRAW, MARCH, HOME
• Drag from Mother Hen and the route snaps to the tiles under your finger.
• A faint preview shows where the whole line will stand when the route ends.
• Numbered badges show the order in which chicks will join.
• A red outline marks any tile the line can't enter, with the reason written below the board.
• Drag back along the footprints to erase. Restart is instant.
• Lift your finger on the coop and watch the march, hop by hop.

SIX CHICK PERSONALITIES
• Basic chicks join when Mother Hen walks right beside them.
• Sleepy chicks need two visits: the first wakes them, the second time they join.
• Tiny chicks slip under low fences.
• Splashy chicks happily wade through puddles.
• Brave chicks let Mother Hen shove hay bales.
• Lead chicks take over at the coop and lead the rest of the line onward.
Each personality wears its own accessory, so none of them relies on colour alone.

A MEADOW FULL OF FEATURES
Tall fences, puddles, stepping stones, flower beds you can cross only once, hay bales, garden gates with latch posts, low fences and one-way bridges. Every feature and personality is introduced in its own short, playable lesson.

FOUR SEASONS, 40 MEADOWS
Dewdrop Spring, Buttercup Summer, Haystack Autumn and Frostfeather Winter, ordered from gentle to clever. Earn a star for bringing everyone home, one for finishing within par and one for collecting every golden seed. Every meadow has been checked by a solver, so all three stars are always possible.

DAILY MEADOW
Once Dewdrop Spring is finished, a fresh puzzle blooms every day, built only from chicks and features you have already met in a lesson. Each day has a special condition: Seed Sweep days count only when every golden seed comes home, and Perfect March days set par to the shortest route that brings every golden seed home, so three stars stay possible every day. Keep a streak going and, if you like, switch on an optional daily reminder.

A LIVING FARMYARD
Every chick you bring home appears in your farmyard, wandering and napping around the coop. Stars unlock decorations such as a birdbath, sunflowers, a windmill and bunting, and you choose which ones to display. The Chick Album collects each personality with its favourite spot.

CALM BY DESIGN
No timers, no enemies, no ads and no in-app purchases. The game works fully offline, keeps your progress on your device and collects no personal data. Optional soft sound effects mix with your own music, and there are settings for haptics, drawing assist and reduced motion.

name: Marimba Latina
description:
Marimba Latina brings the marimbas of Central America and Mexico to your iPad: the national instrument of Guatemala, the singing marimbas of Chiapas, the folk marimbas of Nicaragua and the full sound of a marimba band.

NINE SAMPLED MARIMBAS
• Marimba Chapina (Guatemala)
• Marimba Chiapaneca Mexicana (Chiapas, Mexico)
• Marimba Centroamericana
• Marimba de Arco, Marimba de Masaya, Marimba de Monimbó and Marimba de Somoto (Nicaragua)
• Marimba del Teatro Nacional, a concert marimba
• Conjunto de Marimbas, several marimbas played together

54 READY-TO-PLAY PRESETS
Six presets for every marimba: Classic, Stage Ready (light reverb and compression for punch), a Character preset, Dry, Cinematic (huge reverb and delay) and Urban (synced delay, saturation and compression for modern Latin productions). Browse them by marimba and style, search, and star your favorites.

PLAY THE BARS
Tap the marimba bars on the screen. Tap lower on a bar for a stronger stroke, and use several fingers to play chords. Struck bars light up in bright orange.

SHAPE THE SOUND
• ADSR envelope, velocity response, tune, pan and pitch-bend range
• Delay with tempo sync, saturation and compression, each with its own power switch
• Reverb with size, decay, pre-delay, damping, diffusion, width and mix

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
• Standalone app, or as an Audio Unit (AUv3) instrument inside GarageBand and other host apps
• Connect a USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard
• Save your own presets

All sounds are included in the app: no account, no subscription, no extra downloads.

name: MarketApp Franchise
description:
MarketApp Franchise – Manage Your Business Network

Your Franchise. Your Businesses. One Smart Platform.

MarketApp Franchise is a business management application designed to help franchise operators register, organize, and manage businesses within their assigned franchise zones.

Whether you're registering new businesses, managing existing listings, organizing commercial buildings, or updating business information, MarketApp Franchise brings essential management tools together in one convenient platform.

KEY FEATURES

1. Franchise Zone Management

Manage businesses within your assigned franchise zone through a centralized dashboard. Browse registered businesses, search listings, access business details, and keep your franchise network organized.

2. Easy Business Registration

Register new businesses through a simple and structured process. Add business names, categories, establishment years, registration types, owner information, contact numbers, and location details.

3. Business Listing Management

View and manage registered businesses from one place. Search businesses by name, explore business categories, review addresses, and access individual business profiles.

4. Building Management

Organize commercial buildings within your franchise zone. Search existing buildings, view building information, and add new building records to maintain an organized location structure.

5. Business Information Management

Keep business profiles accurate and updated. Manage business names, categories, contact information, registration details, establishment years, and linked business information.

6. Product and Service Tags

Manage product and service information associated with businesses. Create and update tags, define price ranges, add descriptions, and organize offerings to help businesses showcase their products and services.

7. Business Photo Galleries

Showcase registered businesses through image galleries. Upload business photos, review existing images, and remove outdated pictures to maintain attractive business profiles.

8. Business Address Management

Maintain structured business location information, including areas, markets, buildings, floors, and shops. Keep business addresses organized and accessible.

9. Multilingual Support

MarketApp Franchise offers language selection options, including English, Urdu, and Arabic, to provide a more accessible experience for different users.

10. Simple and Convenient Navigation

Access essential franchise management features through an organized interface. Navigate between business listings, registration, buildings, notifications, language settings, and other available tools.

WHY CHOOSE MARKETAPP FRANCHISE?

• Manage businesses within assigned franchise zones.
• Register new businesses quickly and conveniently.
• Search and organize business listings.
• Maintain business profiles and contact information.
• Manage commercial buildings and locations.
• Organize product and service tags with pricing.
• Upload and manage business photo galleries.
• Access important features through a simple interface.
• Choose from multiple language options.

BUILT FOR FRANCHISE OPERATORS

MarketApp Franchise is designed for authorized franchise operators and business management personnel who need an organized way to maintain their local business networks.

The platform helps simplify business registration, reduce repetitive administrative work, and keep important business information accessible.

EMPOWERING LOCAL BUSINESS COMMUNITIES

MarketApp Franchise supports the growth of local business networks by connecting business registration, listing management, and location organization within one digital platform.

From adding your first business to managing an expanding franchise zone, MarketApp Franchise provides the tools needed to keep your business network organized.

Download MarketApp Franchise today and experience a smarter way to manage your franchise operations.

name: MarkupGrove
description:
MarkupGrove is a local Markdown writing and document-delivery workspace for your iPhone. Edit the source you control, navigate its structure, and turn a saved revision into an actual HTML or paginated PDF file.

WRITE A DOCUMENT YOU CAN REOPEN
Create a document or import UTF-8 Markdown/text from Files. Edit the title and body using the native editor, with syntax insertion controls and undo/redo. Draft saving and explicit Save are separate: the draft status identifies what has been written, while Save commits a document revision. Available saved drafts can be offered for restoration after reopening; unsaved memory is not described as protected storage.

ORGANIZE WITHOUT LOSING THE SOURCE
Use Outline to find supported headings and return to their source location, including repeated heading names. Find & replace works on literal text in the current draft, with case matching, current/all replacement and undo. It does not run regular expressions or replace content in other documents. Create editable templates and use a copied template as a new draft; later template edits do not rewrite existing documents.

PREVIEW THE DOCUMENTED MARKDOWN SUBSET
Native preview supports ATX headings, paragraphs, single-level lists and quotes, horizontal rules, fenced and inline code, emphasis, strong text and valid HTTPS links. Unsupported constructs remain visible as literal syntax. Tables, task boxes, nested lists, mathematical notation, images and embedded HTML are not rendered as those features. The preview does not execute scripts or fetch remote images or fonts. A supported link opens only through an explicit user action.

EXPORT A SPECIFIC SAVED REVISION
Preview the current draft, then deliberately save before exporting. HTML is generated from the supported parse tree with escaped text, a fixed style and no user scripts or remote resources. Choose A4 or Letter paper, 12/14/16-point body type and 16/20/24 mm margins for PDF. PDF uses actual pagination rather than a single screenshot of the preview.

Reopen immutable exports in Exports, inspect their real file size and source revision, preview the PDF or native representation, and share the selected file through the system panel. Deleting a source document keeps independent exports. Delete an export separately, or confirm Erase all local data in About to remove documents, drafts, templates and internal outputs. External originals and previously shared copies remain separate.

SUPPORTED SCOPE
Each source is limited to 256 KiB of UTF-8 and 5,000 logical lines. Up to 40 documents, 20 templates and 50 exports. Imported line endings are normalized for editing, with the original import retained separately. This is a stated Markdown subset, not complete CommonMark compatibility, a script editor, a website publisher or a PDF-editing tool.

No app login is required for the native writing tools. The working library is stored in the app's local container.

name: Marquee: Daily Movie Puzzle
description:
A new movie lights up the marquee every day. Can you name it?

Marquee is a daily movie-title puzzle with old Hollywood glamour. Guess letters to fill in the title on a glowing theater marquee. Every wrong letter eats a piece of your popcorn, and you only get six. The year, genre and a clue help you along.

NOW SHOWING, EVERY DAY
• One new title a day, the same for everyone
• Build your daily streak and protect it with Streak Savers
• Share your result without spoiling the answer

MOVIE MARATHON
• Can't stop at one? Keep playing with extra titles after the daily show
• 2 free Marathon titles every day
• Nearly 3,000 movies, from 1930s classics to the latest blockbusters

A NIGHT AT THE MOVIES
• Art deco marquee, glowing bulbs and flipping letter tiles
• Open a free gift envelope every day
• Replay any show you missed from the calendar

Marquee is free to play, with optional in-app purchases and ads. Tickets reveal letters, buy extra popcorn and unlock past shows and extra Marathon titles.

BOX OFFICE PASS (optional subscription)
$2.99 per month or $19.99 per year for unlimited Marathon titles, no ads, every past show and 2 free tickets each week. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Marquee is not affiliated with any film studio. Movie titles are used for trivia only.

Privacy Policy: https://bradlow.tv/marquee-privacy-policy/
Questions? support@bradlow.tv

name: MASTER ANTS
seller_name: ATLANTIK GRUP YATIRIM BILISIM HIZMETLERI PAZARLAMA VE TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
With MASTER ANTS, you can order the service you need in just a few taps—from house cleaning and towing to tire services, roadside assistance, and moving.
•  Select a service and answer a few questions: Your price is calculated instantly based on your answers; you don't have to wait for quotes.
• Choose a date and time: The system finds a suitable specialist in your area for your selected time slot.
• Pay securely once your specialist is found: You make your payment after being matched with your specialist. Your card details are not entered directly into the app; you complete your transaction via a secure payment page.
• Track the process in real time: You are notified when your specialist is on the way, and the job begins with a matching code shared at the door.
• Manage everything from one screen: You can control your orders, payments, and addresses in one place, and reorder a completed service with the same preferences in a single step.

name: MASTER ANTS PRO
seller_name: ATLANTIK GRUP YATIRIM BILISIM HIZMETLERI PAZARLAMA VE TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
MASTER ANTS PRO is the business app for specialists providing services on the MASTER ANTS platform. Before accepting incoming job offers, you can review their details and your payout, manage jobs step by step in the field, and easily track your earnings and payments.

To use the app, you need an approved MASTER ANTS PRO account. If you don't have an account yet, you can apply directly through the app and start receiving jobs once your application is approved.

JOB OFFERS
• You receive job offers matching your services, service area, and working hours.
• The offer screen displays the job time, area, customer-answered questions, your payout, and the response deadline.
• You can accept or decline offers with a single tap.

ON-SITE JOB MANAGEMENT
• Job time, address, and customer details are shown on a single screen, and you can get directions with one tap.
• You can send an automatic notification to the customer using the "On my way" option.
• Confirming job start and completion steps with a slide action eliminates the risk of accidental taps.
• For jobs requiring photos, you can take before and after photos directly inside the app.
• If you encounter a situation on site that differs from what was specified in the order, you can propose a change and continue with the updated scope once the customer approves.

EARNINGS AND PAYMENTS
• You can view your total balance, withdrawable balance, and held balance in real time.
• You can easily submit withdrawal requests through the app.
• You can upload job invoices to the system and copy required invoice details with a single tap.

ACCOUNT AND TEAM MANAGEMENT
• You can upload required documents by taking a photo with your phone camera or selecting files from your device.
• You can customize your working hours and days off as you wish.
• You can update your service area and answer questions related to your services.
• You can add new members to your team and carry out field operations together.
• You can complete training modules and message the support team in-app whenever you need help.

Real-time notifications ensure you don't miss new job offers or updates throughout the process.
You can request account deletion in the app under My Profile → Delete Account.

name: Mathe-Jahrmarkt Schule
description:
Mathe-Jahrmarkt Schule ist die Version des Mathe-Jahrmarkts für schuleigene iPads. Kinder am Ende der Grundschule und am Anfang der weiterführenden Schule üben auf einem Jahrmarkt mit 30 Buden: vom Einmaleins über Stellenwerte und schriftliches Rechnen bis zu Größen, Geometrie, Mustern sowie Daten und Zufall. Grundlage ist das Kerncurriculum Mathematik Grundschule Niedersachsen; die Aufgaben passen zu allen Bundesländern.

FÜR DIE KINDER
• Bis zu 32 Kinder auf einem iPad, jedes mit eigener Eintrittskarte und einem Bildpasswort aus drei Jahrmarkt-Bildern
• Alles enthalten, kein Zusatzkauf: Bronze, Silber und Gold an allen Buden, Jahrmarkt-Check, Sternenmarkt mit Brüchen, Dezimalzahlen und schriftlicher Division, die ganze Bauinsel
• Bei Fehlern hilft Flinka in kleinen Schritten, danach kommt eine ähnliche Aufgabe
• Das Fundbüro holt falsch gelöste Aufgaben nach 1, 3 und 7 Tagen zurück
• Pausen-Erinnerung nach einstellbarer Zeit

FÜR LEHRKRÄFTE
• Lehrerbereich mit PIN: Klassen anlegen, Namensliste einfügen, Bildpasswörter als Kärtchen drucken – für jüngere Kinder auch Anmelden ohne Passwort
• Klassenübersicht mit Ampel je Kompetenzbereich, häufigen Fehlermustern, Stand je Bude und der Entwicklung im Jahrmarkt-Check (vorher – nachher)
• Einzelbericht für jedes Kind; beides auch als PDF
• Aufträge an die Klasse oder an einzelne Kinder, direkt aus der Auswertung; die Kinder sehen ein blaues Fähnchen an der Bude
• Bauinsel im Unterricht steuerbar: immer offen, nach jeder Übungsrunde 10 Minuten oder geschlossen
• Klassenliste und Ergebnisse zwischen den iPads weitergeben, zum Beispiel per AirDrop – verschlüsselt mit der Lehrer-PIN
• Kurzanleitung und Elternbrief zum Ausdrucken
• Verfahren der schriftlichen Subtraktion wählbar, wie in der Fachkonferenz festgelegt

DATENSCHUTZ
Keine Konten, keine Server, keine Werbung, kein Tracking, keine In-App-Käufe. Alle Daten bleiben auf den iPads der Schule. Ein Vertrag zur Auftragsverarbeitung ist nicht nötig, weil keine Daten beim Anbieter ankommen.

FÜR SCHULEN
Erwerb über Apple School Manager. Ab 20 Lizenzen gilt der halbe Preis. Die App läuft auf dem iPad, im Hoch- und Querformat.

name: MClean: Photo & Video Cleaner
description:
MClean helps you clean up your photo library: it finds duplicate photos, similar shots, blurry photos, screenshots and videos that take up a lot of space. You review everything before anything is deleted.

EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
MClean compares photos on the device with Apple's Vision framework. Your photos, videos and contacts never leave your device. No account, no ads, no data collected.

MADE FOR BIG SCREENS
On iPad and iPhone Duo, MClean uses two columns: lists sit next to details, and photo grids get more columns. Landscape and resizable windows work too.

NOTHING IS DELETED AUTOMATICALLY
• Whatever you pick goes to MClean's Bin first. Deleting always goes through the iOS confirmation.
• Favorites are protected, and blurry photos are never pre-selected.
• Deleted photos stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days. MClean reminds you to empty it, because that is when the space actually comes back.

FREE
• Scan the whole library; later scans only look at what changed
• Similar shots, with the best shot of each group suggested
• Duplicate photos and videos, blurry photos, screenshots, large videos, Live Photos
• Swipe mode: left to remove, right to keep, unlimited
• Hide photos in the iOS Hidden album
• Monthly storage report (turn on notifications if you like)
• Delete up to 30 items in bulk per day

MCLEAN PRO, ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Unlimited bulk delete
• Keep the best shot in every group with one tap
• Compress videos to HEVC at the same resolution, keeping date, location, Favorite and albums
• Turn Live Photos into still photos
• Shrink your library: convert JPEG photos and PNG screenshots to HEIC, checking every photo before the original goes to the Bin
• Copy photos to an external drive or NAS, verifying each file's hash before the original goes to the Bin
• Clean up contacts: fix old Vietnamese 11-digit numbers, merge duplicates, delete empty contacts. Every change is backed up as a vCard first, and the latest change can be undone
MClean Pro supports Family Sharing.

GOOD TO KNOW
• If "Optimize iPhone Storage" (or "Optimize iPad Storage") is on, most originals live in iCloud, so deleting them mostly frees iCloud space.
• Compressing videos, converting Live Photos and shrinking the library create new items and move the originals to the Bin. Captions and face tags of the originals are not carried over.
• Contacts have no Recently Deleted. MClean saves a vCard backup before every change, and the latest change can be undone. Notes of merged or deleted contacts are not in the backup.

Requires iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 or later.

name: MeasureGo: Level, Ruler, Angle
description:
MeasureGo puts a bubble level, a ruler, a protractor and a stud finder in your pocket, and tells you plainly what it measures. No adverts, no account, no tracking, and it works without an internet connection.

A LEVEL THAT SAYS WHICH SIDE IS HIGH
• Bullseye level for flat surfaces, a vial for edges, and a plumb mode for posts and door frames.
• Plain words and arrows, such as "Right side high", so you know which way to adjust.
• Lock the orientation to measure steep slopes past 45° without the display flipping.
• Degrees, percent, mm per metre, inches per foot, 1:n ratios and roof pitch (x/12).
• Hold a reading with a tap. A beep and a vibration tell you when it's level.
• Calibrate in seconds on any flat surface, even one that isn't level: flip calibration cancels out the slope.

A RULER YOU CAN TRUST
• Centimetres and inches side by side, with fractions down to 1/32 in, or decimals.
• Measure with two lines that snap to the marks, and nudge them a mark at a time.
• Box mode for width × height and area. Circle mode for diameter, circumference and ring sizes (UK, US, EU).
• Add up several lengths with a running total, or go full screen for the longest ruler.
• Calibrate with a bank card, a coin or another ruler for accuracy on any phone.

ANGLES THREE WAYS
• Protractor: drag the arms over anything on the screen, with a double scale and snap to common angles.
• Angle finder: rest the phone on a surface or edge to read its angle, zero it on one surface, or measure the angle between two surfaces for mitres and bevels.
• Photo angles: measure a roof pitch, a chair leg or a cut from a photo, with a magnifier for precise points. Share the photo with the angle drawn on it.

STUD FINDER
• Uses your phone's magnetic sensor to find the screws and nails that fix plasterboard to studs, and other metal behind walls.
• A gauge, a 10-second graph, clicks and vibration as you sweep. Three sensitivities and one-tap zero.
• Honest about its limits: it finds metal, not wood, and only close to the surface.

KEEP WHAT YOU MEASURE
• Save any reading with a label and a note, then share it or export them all to a spreadsheet (CSV).
• Light, dark and a high-contrast Sunlight theme for working outdoors. Works with VoiceOver and larger text.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
MeasureGo has no account and no adverts. Your readings and calibrations stay on your phone and are included in your phone's own backup. You can also save a backup file wherever you like, protected with a password if you choose.

Accuracy depends on your phone's sensors and screen. Calibrate for the best results, and use a dedicated tool where accuracy really matters.

name: MEB AGS Hazırlık 2027

İÇERİK
AGS'nin bütün alanlarında 189 konu anlatımı, 865 test ve 14.149 çözümlü soru:

KONU ANLATIMLARI
Konular sade bir dille, alt başlıklara bölünmüş ve sınavda çıkan kavramlar öne çıkarılmış şekilde sunulur. Her konunun başında İçindekiler vardır.

TESTLER
Soruyu işaretlediğin anda doğru cevabı ve açıklamasını görürsün. Yanlışlarını görmek, testi tekrar çözmek ve eksiğini kapatmak kolaydır.

İKİLİ SEÇİM
En çok karıştırılan iki seçenekten doğrusunu seçtiğin hızlı alıştırma modu. Coğrafya, Mevzuat ve Maarif Modeli'nde 43 set ve 579 öncül.

KENDİ SINAVINI OLUŞTUR
Dersleri ve soru sayısını seçip kendine özel deneme kur. Süre geri sayımlı işler, sonunda netini görürsün.

İNTERNETSİZ ÇALIŞ
Tüm konu anlatımları ve testler uygulamanın içindedir; internet olmadan da çalışabilirsin.

İLERLEME TAKİBİ VE TOPLULUK
Hangi konuları bitirdiğini ve başarı oranını takip et. Takıldığın soruyu toplulukta sor.

HESAP GEREKMEZ
"Misafir olarak devam et" diyip hemen başlayabilirsin. Hesap açarsan ilerlemen cihazlar arasında senkronize olur; Google ve Apple ile tek dokunuşta giriş yapabilirsin.

ÜCRETSİZ BAŞLA
Her dersin ilk konu anlatımı ve ilk testi, ilk deneme ile Tarih'in 1. ünitesinin tamamı ücretsizdir. Geri kalan içerik için isteğe bağlı Premium aboneliği sunulur.

PREMIUM ABONELİK
AGS Hazırlık Premium, otomatik yenilenen abonelik olarak sunulur:

Browse the live catalogue, place delivery orders, track fulfilment, and get order updates — all from your phone.

• Explore poultry and livestock healthcare products with packs, prices, and eligibility
• Search and filter the catalogue to find what you need
• Create an account with your mobile number and keep delivery addresses on file
• Add products to your cart and place cash-on-delivery or other available payment requests
• Track order status from confirmation through delivery
• Receive in-app notifications for order updates (you control notification preferences)
• Read company profile, mission, vision, services, and head-office contact details
• Reach Medhouse support for product inquiries, account verification, or complaints

WHO IT IS FOR
Veterinary doctors, pharmacies, distributors, commercial farms, poultry farmers, livestock farmers, and other retail customers who buy from Medhouse.

Medhouse Pharmaceuticals is based in Mangowal West, District Gujrat, Punjab. Products marked for sale can be added to the cart. Some products may require account verification or an inquiry before purchase. An order placed in the app is a request until Medhouse confirms it. Prices and packs on a placed order remain as shown at checkout.

medough connects you with home chefs in your area. Browse local kitchens, see what they're cooking this week, and order straight from the people who make it.

From fresh bakes and celebration cakes to curries, pasta, burgers and family recipes, every kitchen on medough is a real home cook running a small food business.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Discover kitchens near you, with photos, menus and reviews
• Order for same-day collection or delivery, where the kitchen offers it

• Follow your favourite kitchens and get notified when they post a new menu or announcement
• Message a kitchen about your order

name: MeetWindow
description:
When everyone replies with a different time, finding a slot for lunch or a meeting can take longer than making the plan. MeetWindow puts those replies side by side.

Enter the day, a shared time zone, and the time you need. Add each person's available hours as they reply. Calculate the periods when everyone is free for long enough. A reply that is still missing stays open until you have the person's times.

Try the Saturday lunch example to see where three people's availability overlaps.

Save one project with up to 12 entries for free. Lifetime is a one-time purchase that lets you save more projects, add more entries, and share reports. You can use the app offline without creating an account. To keep a backup, choose iCloud Drive or another location in Files.

name: meiyuPav
description:
meiyuPav は、灯の下で宝石と金属を見極めてから、髪型・服・靴を逆算する、ひとりで遊ぶパズルです。アカウントも通信対戦もありません。

小閣にあるのは鑑定灯とベルベットボックスだけ。石が先に話します。光は柔らかく暈るのか、それとも鋭く光るのか。台座の金属は暖色か、冷色か。服と髪はその後ろに続き、主石の存在を奪ってはいけません。ボックスが開いたとき、この装いが石に合うかどうかが決まります。

遊び方 ・石題を読み、灯の色を切り替えながら主石を回して観察する ・切工の気質、色沢、金属の寒暖を判定して提出する ・ワードローブの制約を読み、衣鏡で髪型・服・靴を逆算する ・ベルベットボックスへ入れて登場させ、得点と登場カードを受け取る

判定が偏ると、ブリーフも着こなしもずれます。灯の角度を変えて見直すか、衣鏡に戻って着換えてください。一度見た登場演出は、あとから短く飛ばせます。

収録 ・パールの朝会、ローズクォーツのデート、エメラルドの晩餐、ムーンストーンの劇場 ・本編12ステージと隠し2ステージ。隠しステージは、その石の本編3つをすべて星3にすると開きます ・石譜では、通した場に対応する切工・金属・生地の語彙が点灯します ・登場カードは鑑定アーカイブに残り、共有するか写真ライブラリへ保存できます ・公式ガイドで、切工の見方、偏った鑑定の読み方、ボックス登場の流れを確認できます

カメラと写真は、現場の光を見比べるときと、登場カードに絵を添えるときにだけ使います。使わなくてもクリアできます。進捗はこのiPhoneに保存されます。

name: Memoria - 디지털 전시관
description:
사진을 단순히 저장하는 앱이 아니라, 하나의 전시 경험으로 만드는 앱 — Memoria.

Memoria는 사진 보관함과 폴더에 쌓여 있던 소중한 순간들을 스크롤 동선, 조명 변화, 앰비언트 사운드, 캡션이 어우러진 나만의 디지털 전시관으로 만들어 줍니다. 여행 기록, 포토 에세이, 모바일 청첩장까지 누구나 몇 분 만에 완성할 수 있습니다.

주요 기능

• 100% 온디바이스 프라이버시: 계정 가입이나 외부 서버 전송 없이, 모든 사진과 .gallery 프로젝트는 사용자의 기기에만 안전하게 보관됩니다.

name: Memoriva
description:
Memoriva is a private keepsake box for the moments you want to keep.

Every memory rests as an instant-film print on a river of years. Scroll down the gold thread, or drag the year scrubber on the right edge to travel straight to any year. Tap a print and it opens as a full-screen story — photos, words, place, the people who were there and how it felt.

No account. No sign-in. Memoriva opens straight to your memories, works fully offline and keeps everything on your iPhone.

KEEP A MEMORY
• Several photos per memory, from your library or the camera
• A title, the date, your story, a place and the people who were there
• A mood — joyful, tender, calm, nostalgic, proud or bittersweet
• Categories (Family, Travel, Milestone and more, or your own)
• Mark favourites with a berry heart

ORGANISE YOUR YEARS
• A timeline grouped by year and month, newest or oldest first
• Albums that gather memories from any year, with their own colour
• Album chips at the top to filter the river in one tap
• Search across titles, stories, places, people, moods, categories and albums, with filters and sorting

REMEMBER WHAT MATTERS
• “On this day” — see memories from today's date in earlier years
• Yearly “On this day” reminders for the memories you choose
• Important dates — anniversaries, birthdays, milestones and remembrance days with countdowns, years since, and yearly reminders (on the day, or 1, 3 or 7 days before)

KEEPSAKES
• See your memories per year, the moods of your archive, the people you remember with most and your categories — drawn as gentle charts you can tap

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
• Export a memory as a PDF story with its photos, or your whole archive as a story book PDF
• CSV exports of memories and important dates
• Full JSON backups, with or without photos, and import with Replace or Merge
• Automatic daily recovery snapshots (the latest seven), plus snapshots before every import or clear
• Restore sample data or clear everything from Settings

DESIGNED WITH CARE
• Light and dark appearance, tuned rose-paper and evening palettes
• Haptics you can switch off, Dynamic Type for reading text, VoiceOver labels and Reduce Motion support

Memoriva collects no data at all: no analytics, no ads, no tracking and no network connection.

name: Memory Cube - Photo Art
description:
Turn your favorite photos into keepsakes worth displaying.

Memory Cube transforms your photos into glass-inspired digital artworks for your own personal shelf. Celebrate family moments, travel memories, and the little things that make life yours.

CREATE YOUR OWN PHOTO ART
Choose a photo, then customize the shape, thickness, engraving style, and finish. Crop, zoom, rotate, and flip your image to find the perfect fit.

BUILD A PERSONAL COLLECTION
Arrange your artworks with a long press, swipe between shelves, and give each shelf a name. Customize the room design and lighting to create a space that feels like you.

KEEP MEMORIES CLOSE
Tap an artwork to view it up close, edit its title, share it, or set it up for a Home Screen widget.

CREATE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Use Boxes to make new artworks. Collect Boxes through daily login bonuses and optional rewarded ads, or purchase additional Boxes in the app.

MORE POSSIBILITIES WITH PREMIUM
An optional monthly or annual subscription lets you create without spending Boxes and unlocks exclusive shapes, engraving styles, room designs, and lighting colors. Some features require Premium.

No account registration is required. Japanese and English are supported, and you can change the language in Settings. All artworks are digital creations within the app; no physical product is supplied.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://memory-cube-official.tuteton.chatgpt.site/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Mensur Barbershop
description:
Mensur Barbershop in Prishtina, since 2013. Book your next cut in seconds.

LIVE AVAILABILITY
See every free time for each barber as it happens. Pick your barber, or choose "Anyone" for the first free time. If someone books the same time a moment before you, the app instantly shows you the nearest free times.

INSTANT CONFIRMATION
Your booking is confirmed straight away. Payment is made in the shop.

REMINDERS AND UPDATES
Get a reminder the day before and two hours before your appointment, and a notification if your barber is running late.

MANAGE YOUR BOOKINGS
Change the time or cancel in a few taps. Add your booking to your calendar and get directions to the shop.

IN ALBANIAN AND ENGLISH
The app is in Albanian and English, with light and dark mode.

Opening hours: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 19:00, Saturday 09:00 to 15:00.
Questions? info@mensurbarbershop.com or +383 44 663 083.

name: MENU-99 Remote
description:
A companion app that presses the buttons of MENU-99, a launcher for Mac, from your iPhone.

Put your iPhone next to your Mac and use it as a dedicated button pad: just tap.

- Shows the buttons you set up in MENU-99 on your Mac: apps, files, URLs, scripts, shortcuts, snippets, timers and more
- Tap a button and it runs on the Mac, in the background, without changing the app you're using
- Switch between pages 1–10 with the tabs or by swiping
- The look follows the skin you chose in MENU-99 on the Mac
- Answer confirmation dialogs on the Mac (such as "Save changes?") from your iPhone
- Quit the frontmost app on the Mac
- See timers count down, and feel a vibration when time is up

Connecting: the app finds Macs on the same Wi-Fi automatically. The first time only, enter the 4-digit code shown on the Mac.

Requires MENU-99 for macOS. Without a Mac, tap "View a Sample Without a Mac" on the first screen to try the button screen.

name: Menusic
description:
For staff of restaurants and cafés that use Menusic. Your venue's owner creates your account.

Menusic is the app your team uses during a shift. Waiters, captains, cashiers, kitchen and bar stations, and owners each see what their job needs.

FLOOR AND ORDERS
- See every table at a glance: who is seated, how long they've been there, the total so far, and which tables need you.
- Find a table by its number, filter by section, or show only your own tables.
- Seat guests with one tap, then add dishes from a menu sorted by category.
- Move between tables without going back: the other tables stay on the screen.
- Takeaway and delivery orders, quick sales, discounts, tips and split bills.

KITCHEN AND BAR
- Each station sees its own tickets as soon as they are sent, oldest first.
- Mark dishes as being prepared and ready; waiters see "Food ready" on the table.

PAYMENT
- Take cash or card, see the change to give, and print receipts and bills.
- Open and close a shift with its cash count.

FOR OWNERS AND MANAGERS
- Today's sales, open orders, stock levels, bookings and loyalty at a glance.

Works in English, Arabic and Kurdish, on iPhone and iPad.

Accounts are created by your venue in the Menusic dashboard at menusic.com; there is no sign-up in the app.

name: Meraki Love - Premium Dating
description:
MERAKI LOVE — Where Meaningful Connections Begin

Love has no boundaries. Your perfect connection might be closer than you think—or thousands of miles away.

MERAKI LOVE is a premium dating experience designed for people who want more than casual swiping. Discover interesting people, build genuine connections, and explore the possibility of finding someone truly special, wherever they are in the world.

Connections Without Boundaries
Don't limit your possibilities to your city or neighborhood. Explore people from different places, cultures, and backgrounds. Your next meaningful connection could be anywhere.

Designed for Meaningful Dating
Discover people, explore their profiles, express interest, and start conversations with those who catch your attention. Make every connection count.

A Premium Experience
Enjoy a premium dating experience designed to make connecting more meaningful, personal, and enjoyable.

Privacy Matters
Your personal experience matters. MERAKI LOVE is designed with privacy and user safety in mind.

Pay Once. Enjoy Forever.
No recurring subscriptions. No monthly payments. No paying again and again.

Get premium lifetime access with a one-time payment and enjoy the MERAKI LOVE experience for life.

One connection can change everything.

Download MERAKI LOVE and start discovering what's possible.

MERAKI LOVE — Meet. Connect. Fall in Love.

name: Merchmix Vertex
description:
Vertex by merchmix puts your order operations in your pocket. Check what needs attention, act on it, and keep every order moving, wherever you are.

Vertex is built for the teams who run merchandise and order operations: operations managers, customer service, warehouse and store staff, finance and administrators. What you see and can do depends on your role and permissions.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Command Centre – A live overview of the work that matters right now, with badges and alerts for items that are overdue or at risk.
• Work queue – See tasks assigned to you and your team, track SLA countdowns, and claim, assign, block, resolve, escalate or cancel work in a couple of taps. Every item keeps a full activity timeline.
• Orders – Search and filter orders, open the full order workspace, create new orders, and take actions such as refunds and goodwill credits. Download and share tax invoices as PDFs.
• Fulfilment and store orders – Follow orders through picking, dispatch and collection, and see which ones must leave today.
• Delivery and shipments – Track shipments and their status from dispatch to doorstep.
• Returns – Review return requests, inspect and receive returned goods, and see where each return stands.
• Inventory – Check stock by SKU and location, manage supply pools, preorder campaigns and stock transfers, and record inbound stock.
• Sourcing – Review and decide how orders are sourced when a person needs to make the call.
• Customers – Look up customers, their orders and open cases in one place.
• Finance – View payments and invoices, and raise and approve goodwill refunds.
• Network – Manage locations, location groups, service areas, opening hours, closed dates and capacity.
• Automation – Review and edit the rules that drive sourcing and routing.
• Integrations – Monitor integration messages, templates and configuration settings.
• Insights – See key performance readings with prior-period comparisons.
• Admin – Manage users, roles, teams and review the audit log (for authorised administrators).
• Global search – Find any order, customer or record from one search box.

Terms: https://merchmix.co/terms-and-conditions
Privacy: https://merchmix.co/privacy-policy

name: MeridianSlot
description:
Find meeting times across time zones without an account or calendar connection. Create a plan with two to eight participants, their system time zones and available hours. Set a date and a duration from 15 to 240 minutes.

Compare shared windows on a 15-minute grid with each participant’s local date and time. Availability may cross midnight, and calculations use the device’s daylight-saving rules. Save independent slot snapshots and share the times. Dates are based on the first participant’s zone. This app does not send invitations or reserve calendars.

name: Mesh Expose
description:
Mesh Expose keeps screen exposure times on this iPhone.

Drag to the last solid step on the wedge. Each step changes the stored time by one stop. A correction outside one quarter to four times is not written. Move the lamp between 30 and 150 cm and the time scales by the square of the distance. Two tests more than one step apart wait for another test. The last screen stays.

Times stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Mesh Flood
description: Mesh Flood is a shop log for one screen on this iPhone. An empty mesh becomes one coat only when the squeegee enters the top edge and leaves the bottom edge without lifting. A coated mesh saves a sheet only when the next stroke enters the bottom edge and leaves the top edge. A second flood clogs the mesh, and a print on a clog saves nothing. Wash returns a clogged or coated mesh to empty and does not add a sheet. A stroke that lifts inside the mesh is not written. Open a saved sheet or share the text you choose. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: MetatoCue
description:
MetatoCue è l’app pensata per chi essicca le castagne nel metato tradizionale della Garfagnana e della Toscana.

Calcola quanto carico regge il ripiano, quanta legna di castagno serve, quando finirà il ciclo e quanta farina di neccio potrai ottenere.

Funzionalità principali: • Capacità di essiccazione — area del ripiano e spessore dello strato (20–90 cm) per stimare il carico fresco
• Fabbisogno di legna — stima della combustione lenta in base a volume, peso e giorni di ciclo
• Pianificazione cicli — registra data di carico, ore di fuoco e fine prevista (spesso almeno 40 giorni)
• Resa del prodotto — intervallo di castagne secche e farina di neccio (resa secca fino al 30% del fresco)
• Confronto scenari — confronta spessori, carichi e consumo di legna con un punteggio di efficienza

Pensata per produttori e piccoli laboratori: interfaccia chiara, calcoli rapidi e dati salvati sul dispositivo.

MetatoCue — dalla raccolta alla farina di neccio, con il ritmo del metato.

name: Meteogram: Hourly Forecast
description:
Meteogram shows the weather forecast for a place as one clear chart. Instead of a list of numbers, you see the next days as stacked panels that share a single time axis, so you can read how temperature, rain, clouds, wind, and pressure change hour by hour.

WHAT YOU SEE
- Temperature, with the dew point as a dashed line
- Precipitation as bars, with rain and snow in different colours
- Low, mid and high clouds as three separate bands
- Wind speed and gusts, with direction arrows
- Air pressure
- A header for each day with a weather icon and the lowest and highest temperature
- Night shading, a "now" line and day labels

READ ANY HOUR
Touch and drag across the chart to scrub through time. A vertical line follows your finger and shows the values of every panel for that hour. You can also tap a spot on the chart to read the values there. Scroll sideways to move through the forecast.

YOUR PLACES
- Search for a city by name
- Save favourite places, reorder them and remove them with a swipe
- Use My location to get the forecast where you are. Location is optional: the app asks only after you tap the button, only while you use the app, and works fully without it
- The selected place is remembered

CHOOSE YOUR DATA
By default the app automatically combines the available weather models, choosing a model for each hour and each value. If you prefer, you can choose a single weather model in Settings. The chart looks the same whichever model you use, and it shows where the data comes from and when the source changes. Where a model has no data for a value, the chart shows a gap instead of a guess.

ALWAYS WITH YOU
- The latest forecast is saved on your iPhone, so it shows immediately and stays available offline, with the time of the data
- Pull down to refresh
- English and Polish
- Light and dark appearance, or follow the system
- Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion support
- Metric units

FREE AND PRIVATE
Meteogram is free. There is no account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. A Sources and licenses screen lists every data source with its license and link. If you like the app, you can leave a voluntary tip in Settings. A tip is optional and unlocks nothing.

A forecast is an estimate of the future and can change. Do not rely on it alone for decisions that affect safety.

Weather data: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0)
Place search: GeoNames
Meteogram is an independent app and is not endorsed by any data provider.

name: Metro Snake: City Run
description:
The classic snake game takes a road trip across America.

Guide your snake through 100 real US cities, from Burlington to New York City. Grab glowing map pins, dodge traffic, ride subway tunnels and race the clock across 1,000 hand-tuned levels. Every stop gets harder, faster and more fun.

RIDE THE METRO MAP
• 100 cities on 6 colorful transit lines, from Hometown Local to Big City Express
• Every city has 10 stops, each named after a real local spot: Beale Street, the French Quarter, Wall Street and more
• Clear a city, collect your report card and transfer to the next line

10 WILD WAYS TO PLAY
• Rush Hour: time your crossings as cars cruise the avenues
• Subway: dive into a tunnel and pop out across town
• Blackout: the power's out, so trust your headlights
• Parade Day, River Crossing, Construction Zone, Central Park mazes, Gold Rush and more
• Every city ends with a City Limits boss stop

COMBOS & POWER-UPS
• Chain pins fast for ×2, ×3 and ×5 coin combos
• Turbo: go faster and earn double coins
• Ghost: slide through your own tail and the cones
• Magnet: pull nearby pins straight into your mouth
• Shield: survive one crash
• Freeze: stop traffic in its tracks

BEAT THE CLOCK
• Finish under the target time for 3 stars and up to triple coins
• Earn coins, claim a daily bonus and skip any level you're stuck on
• No walls to crash into: slide off one edge and you appear on the other side

MADE FOR QUICK PLAY
• Levels take under a minute, perfect for a coffee break or a commute
• Swipe controls, or turn on the on-screen D-pad
• Classic green LCD mode for old-school phone fans
• Original music and sound, with haptics
• Plays fully offline. No account, no sign-up

Free to play with ads between some stops. Go Ad-Free once and they're gone for good. Optional coin packs are available in the Shop.

Can you ride all 100 cities?

name: Microbe Mogul
description:
Microbe Mogul is a tycoon game where you are one bacterium in a vast, living lake, and the business you build is real biochemistry.

Catch glucose with your transporters, then research and place enzymes to break it down step by step. Every molecule is drawn from its real structure, every reaction follows the real equation, and every enzyme only works when the right molecules bump into its active site.

BUILD A REAL METABOLISM • All ten steps of glycolysis, plus fermentation, the link reaction and the whole Krebs cycle • An electron transport chain in your membrane, driving a proton gradient you can see • Sulfate reductase for breathing in the low-oxygen mud, and acetate overflow when CoA runs short • Regulation at work: ATP switches PFK-1 off, F1,6BP switches pyruvate kinase on

EARN, RESEARCH, UPGRADE • Earn evolution points (EP) for every step your molecules reach, and spend them in a zoomable tech tree • Upgrade each enzyme: faster catalysis, longer reach, a tighter grip, long-range pull • Join enzymes into complexes with a scaffold protein so each hands its product to the next • Grow your senses, your sight, your proton store and your membrane's flexibility

EXPLORE THE LAKE • A shoreline lake more than a thousand cell lengths across, with beaches, plant roots, winding crevices, islands and rock formations • Shallows, open water and a dark, oxygen-poor deep, each with its own food and dangers • Swim with flagella that run on your proton gradient: steer from the cell's front, turn on the spot, reverse, or steer like a car • Squeeze through narrow gaps to reach hidden pantries of food

A LIVING FOOD WEB • Grazers eat plankton that grow in the sunlit water; scavengers live on the dead; mud dwellers hide in the cracks • Chasers tear prey open, lurkers swallow it whole, and far out in the deep lives the Giant • Hunters can come for you too. Flee, hide in a crack, or grow too big to swallow (or choose Peaceful lake or Hardcore) • The whole lake keeps living while you are away: bodies eat, divide, hunt and die out of sight

WATCH EVOLUTION HAPPEN • Every bacterium carries genes for speed, size, armour, smell, bite and more, and each one has a cost • Daughters inherit their parent's genes with small mutations, so strains drift to suit where they live • Rare innovations appear: a second flagellum, light harvesting, toxin glands, spores, slime coats, an engulfing mouth • Tap any bacterium to see its vitals and a Genes panel, and follow the whole lake in the Field guide

LEARN AS YOU PLAY • A glossary for every molecule, enzyme, organism and mechanic, which says where the game simplifies the real thing • A Pathway panel that finds the jam in your pathway and tells you how to clear it • Tap any molecule to see everything that makes it and uses it

Made for curious players and students (13+) studying biology. Plays offline, with no ads, no in-app purchases and no data collected. Several named saves let you try different runs.

name: Mill Offset
description: Mill Offset checks a closed milling path against the cutter radius on this iPhone. Name the job, drop a closed contour in millimetres, and set the radius. Each edge moves inward by that radius. If two offset edges that do not share a corner cross, or an offset edge turns back on itself, the path is marked Will gouge and kept. Otherwise it is marked Will clear. Drag a vertex, change the radius, or remove a point and the offset is drawn again. A job needs at least three points. Share sends the job name, the radius, and the sentence. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: MimeMeadow
description:
MimeMeadow is a local EML inspection and attachment-extraction tool. Open a message file you already have, understand its headers and MIME parts, and export the bytes or structural report you actually need. It does not connect to a mailbox or send email.

REVIEW THE ORIGINAL
Choose an EML in Files and review the import findings before accepting a read-only copy into your library. Inspect source bytes, SHA-256, subject and declared sender/date fields, then add a local title or note without rewriting the original message. A displayed sender or date is not verified identity or authenticated chronology.

FOLLOW HEADERS AND PARTS
Browse headers in their original order, including ordinary duplicates. Switch between raw folded values and unfolded display, inspect byte spans, and copy the raw or displayed value deliberately. Supported encoded-word display covers UTF-8, US-ASCII and ISO-8859-1; unsupported content retains its original text and a diagnostic.

Explore a multipart tree and inspect each part's path, media type, parameters, transfer encoding and original body range. Explicitly decode a supported leaf using Base64, the documented quoted-printable subset, 7bit, 8bit or binary. Raw encoded body export and decoded attachment export are separate actions. Invalid data is not silently repaired or described as a successful extraction.

PREVIEW AND EXPORT WITH CONTEXT
Preview supported text or PNG/JPEG images. Long text previews are labeled as truncated while complete decoded-byte export remains separate. HTML is shown as source text; the native preview does not execute it or fetch remote images. Other file types remain identified by their actual metadata rather than receiving a guessed renderer.

Export the original EML, a raw part body, a decoded leaf, complete structure JSON or a paginated structure PDF. The PDF covers the message summary, part tree and findings, not the complete message body. Exports show actual bytes and hashes and can be shared through the system panel. Independent outputs survive deletion of the source message. Delete outputs separately, or confirm Erase all data in About to remove the local library, caches and internal outputs.
