External originals and previously shared copies remain separate.

SUPPORTED SCOPE
EML sources are limited to 8 MiB each, with up to 50 messages, 256 parts and eight nested levels. Text supports strict UTF-8, ASCII and Latin-1; image preview supports PNG/JPEG up to 4096 pixels per side and 16 MP. This is a documented subset, not a complete RFC validator. It does not decrypt messages, verify signatures, judge attachment safety, extract archives or support Outlook MSG/mbox.

No app or mailbox login is required for the native tools. Choose files and sharing destinations yourself.

name: Mind the Moles
description:
Dig around the sleeping moles, mark their naps, and bring every bed into bloom.

Mind the Moles is minesweeper in a kitchen garden. Each number tells you how many moles are napping in the patches around it. Work out where they are, leave them be, and the bed bursts into flower.

A GENTLER KIND OF MISTAKE
Wake a mole and the game does not end. That bed is simply fenced off, just as you left it, until you bring the beds around it into bloom. Then the fence comes down and you can finish it.

FAIR WHEN LOGIC RUNS OUT
Sometimes there is no way to know. If you are forced to guess and guess wrong, it is forgiven: the mole is marked and you carry on.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Endless Meadow – a garden with no edge, and more moles the further you wander.
• Levels – one plot at a time. Wake fewer moles to keep more blossoms, and wake none to win the daisy crown.
• Daily plot – one small garden a day, the same for everyone, with a result you can share.

A ROBIN FOR WHEN YOU ARE STUCK
Not sure about a patch? Send the robin. She digs it if it is safe and marks it if a mole is there.

MADE BY HAND
Every tile is cut a little differently. The music is an original tune written for the game. A short guided lesson teaches you everything in under a minute.

NOTHING ELSE
No ads. No timers. No purchases. No accounts. It collects no data and works offline.

name: Mines: Logic Puzzle
description:
Each number tells how many of its eight neighbours hold a mine. Mark every mine and every safe cell. Nothing explodes and you never have to guess: every puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

Mines is a minesweeper-style logic puzzle with one simple rule and surprisingly deep deductions.

12 SEA REGIONS, 360 LEVELS
• From a small 5 × 5 in the harbour to a 15 × 15 under the aurora
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each region unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone, with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 5 × 5 to 15 × 15, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Tap a cell for a mine, tap again for safe; drag to mark many cells at once
• Mine / Safe switch
• Hold a number to light up its eight neighbours and count the mines around it
• Numbers with too many mines, or too few cells left, are ringed (in red, or blue if you prefer)
• Completed numbers fade, so you see where work is left
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong marks; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: six techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: MiniWonder: 117 Wonders Atlas
description:
Explore 117 world wonders on a hand-drawn map. Pan and pinch to find a landmark, then watch its miniature model rise piece by piece.

Open a guide to read the history, inspect architectural details, and browse credited photographs. From the Forbidden City to the Taj Mahal, every model, guide, and photo is included for offline use.

Browse by region on the world map, compare monuments on the timeline, or test your memory with a quiz. Your passport keeps your favorites, the wonders you have seen, and your quiz results on this device.

Read in English or Simplified Chinese on iPhone and iPad. No account required.

name: Minutely: AI Meeting Notes
description:
Minutely turns meetings, lectures, calls and voice memos into clear, useful notes.
Tap Record and watch the transcript appear as people talk. When you're done, Minutely Pro writes a summary, key points, action items and detailed topic-by-topic notes, and you can ask questions about anything that was said.
RECORD WITHOUT WORRY
• Live transcript while you record, free and unlimited
• Keeps recording with the screen locked
• Pauses for phone calls and resumes automatically
• Saves as you go, so a dead battery or a crash never costs you the meeting
• Warns you if it isn't hearing anything
NOTES YOU CAN USE (MINUTELY PRO)
• Summaries, key points and action items with owners
• Detailed notes for lectures and long meetings
• Choose the style: meeting, lecture, interview, phone call or voice memo
• Choose the length: brief, standard or detailed
• Ask anything: "What did we decide?", "Draft a follow-up email", "Explain this simply"
EASY TO FIX AND SHARE
• Edit the transcript, or fix a misheard name everywhere at once
• Re-transcribe from the saved audio
• Import recordings and videos from Files and Voice Memos
• Share notes, transcripts and audio anywhere
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up
• No ads and no tracking
• Transcription happens on your iPhone, and your audio never leaves your devices
• Notes sync to your iPhone, iPad and Mac through your own private iCloud
MINUTELY PRO
Recording, live transcription, playback, editing and iCloud sync are free. Minutely Pro adds AI notes and Ask, with a 7-day free trial.
Minutely Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. Includes a fair-use allowance of about 40 hours of AI notes per month.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://minutely-api.recap-api.workers.dev/privacy

name: Mireqon Draw - Anime Practice
description:
Take a closer look at your drawing practice with Mireqon Draw. Import a reference image or a finished study, examine proportions with a grid, check the structure in mirror view, and compare saved versions as your work develops.

Study Proportions with a Grid
Place a grid over an imported image to look more closely at spacing, placement, and scale. Use it as a guide when working from a reference.

Check the Image from Another Angle
Switch to mirror view to inspect shapes and composition with fresh eyes. It can help you notice differences that are easy to miss while looking at the original orientation.

Explore Reference Colors
Extract colors from an image to examine its palette and keep useful color relationships in mind during practice.

Save and Compare Studies
Keep versions of your drawing studies in a portfolio. Select a reference and a study to inspect their proportions and contours together, or compare two saved versions to review how your work has changed.

name: Miscat
description:
One morning Miscat wakes up on a strange rooftop in Istanbul. Home is far away: on the shore of Lake Van, with all the other Van cats. For a marble-shaped cat with one blue eye and one amber eye, there is only one way back: roll.

SIX LANDS, SIXTY LEVELS
• Istanbul: Galata rooftops, gutters, ferries and seagulls
• Aegean: windmills, vine pergolas, dolphins and tides
• Cappadocia: fairy chimneys, hot air balloons, potter's wheels
• Black Sea: tea gardens, cable cars, fog and logs drifting down the river
• Mardin: stone houses, kites, donkeys and sandstorms
• Van: icy rooftops, icicles, thin ice and swimming in the lake

SOMETHING NEW IN EVERY LEVEL
Ride a balloon in one level, get launched by a catapult in the next. Run from sun to shade, or dive under a wall before your air runs out. No level repeats the last.

SIX BOSSES
Captain Gull, Captain Octopus, Lord Eagle, Uncle Bear, Shahmaran and the Lake Monster. Each has its own trick; each takes six hits.

A HAND-PAINTED WORLD
Rooftops, bazaars, valleys and lakes drawn in watercolor and ink.

WARDROBE
Spend the fish you collect on a fez, a bow tie, a captain's cap, a flower crown or a gold crown for Miscat.

NO ADS, NO IN-APP PURCHASES
Buy once, play everything. Works offline. Turkish and English.

name: Mislata AI Workspace
description:
Mislata AI is the sovereign enterprise AI workspace built for teams and organizations that want AI-powered productivity with full data control.

• Nexa AI Assistant: chat across your documents, emails, and notes with verifiable citations.
• Knowledge Spaces: organize projects, files, and teams with strict workspace isolation.
• Documents & Office: preview, generate, and edit Word and Excel files and manage electronic signatures.
• Unified Communication: team messaging, space channels, integrated mail, and audio/video meetings.
• Notes & Secure Vault: voice-transcribed notes and an encrypted corporate vault.
• Multi-platform & Multi-tenant: connect to your organization's Mislata AI server from iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

name: MLOTC
description: MLOTCDesigned for those with multiple income streams. You can log shifts, mark any variations on the timeline, and cross-reference calculated amounts against settlement statements—item by item. If you spot discrepancies in work hours or incorrect pay rates, you can drill down from the variance to the specific shift to log and track follow-up actions. When bank deposits arrive in batches, you can allocate a single payment across multiple settlement periods or expense reimbursements, or conversely, group multiple deposits into a single period. Personal ledger pages allow you to record expenses, search for transactions by amount, and reconcile them with bank statement periods. Additionally, features for work planning, payment scheduling, and monthly budgeting help you track upcoming commitments and compare them against actual outcomes.

name: Moanalua PAC
description:
The official app of the Moanalua Performing Arts Center (PAC) at Moanalua High School in Honolulu, Hawaii, a 694-seat theatre for concerts, recitals, dance, plays, ceremonies and community events.

FOR EVENT ORGANIZERS AND CLIENTS
- Get an instant price estimate: pick your event type, date and times, and see crew, equipment and facility costs add up as you go.
- Check open dates before you request a booking.
- Send a quote request straight to the PAC team.
- Look up your booking with your reference number.
- Upload your run of show (program, rundown or cue list) and build out sound, lighting, video and stage cues with the PAC crew.
- Read the FAQ: load-in, rehearsals, tickets, parking and more.

FOR PAC STAFF AND CREW
- See your shows, run of show and department checklists.
- Pick up open shifts or overtime instantly, and clock in and out.
- Crew radio: a hold-to-talk walkie-talkie with channels for sound, lighting, backstage and front of house.
- Log work, equipment needs and custodian requests for every event.
- Get notified about new shifts, pickups and updates.

Staff and crew sign in with the account the PAC manager added to the crew list.

name: Mochi Bowl: Cozy Merge Puzzle
description:
Drop mochi into the bowl. When two of the same kind touch, they merge into a bigger one.

Snow, sakura, mango, matcha, taro… keep merging until you make each level's goal. But the bowl only holds so much: stack past the golden line and it spills. Every drop counts.

• 5 WORLDS, 40 LEVELS
First Reunion, Rice Bowl Days, Frosted Cups, Lotus Bloom and Mid-Autumn Moon. Every world brings a new bowl and a new twist: chopsticks that block the way, frozen mochi that only crack when you merge right next to them, spinning chopsticks, and a tall glass goblet for the festival finale.

• GENTLE START, REAL CHALLENGE
The first levels teach you the basics. Later ones ask you to plan ahead, and the last world will test you.

• GLASSY AND CALM
A night-sky palette, mochi that shine like glass and squish when they land, and an original music-box soundtrack.

• THREE STARS PER LEVEL
Use fewer mochi to earn more stars. Clearing a level is just the start.

• PAY ONCE, NO ADS
World 1 (8 levels) is free. One purchase unlocks the full journey forever, with Family Sharing. No ads, no energy timers, no daily chores, no internet required, no data collected.

Available in 10 languages.

name: Moje zahradka
description:
Moje zahradka je malý zápisník pro všechny, kdo má za městem kousek zeleně – zahrádku, chalupu se záhony nebo pár řádků za domem. Nečte forecasty za vás a nepošle vás do mraku. Místo toho spojí tři věci, které zahrádkář stejně počítá v hlavě: předpověď na víkend, síly rodiny a práci, která volá z řádku.

CO APLIKACE DĚLÁ

• Pozemky a plodiny
Zapište si každý záhon: co na něm roste, jaká je půda a kam slunce svítí. K orientaci i půdě dostanete stručnou radu – na jih patří rajčata, do polostínu petržel.

• Počasí na víkend
Předpověď na sobotu a neděli přepíšete z Českého hydrometeorologického ústavu nebo z aplikace, kterou sledujete. Zálivka za deště? Postřik před deštěm nebo ve větru? Opěry při 40 km/h? Apka každou práci podle podmínek odhlásí a vysvětlí proč.

• Rozvrh podle sil
Těžké rytí na dopoledne, lehká sklizeň na odpoledne, polední pauza mezi tím. Každý člen rodiny dostane úkol podle svých sil – děti si přijdou na své, ale rycí vidle jim do rukou nedostanete.

• Seznam nářadí
Podle rozvrhu sestaví košík na sobotu i neděli zvlášť: motyka, rukavice, konev, provaz na opěry. Ručně přidané položky zůstanou, odškrtnuté zmizí.

• Zápis úrody
Kila, gramy, svazky i kusy – co zahrádka dala, zůstane zapsané. Přepočet na kilogramy je odhadem, ale pro rodinné srovnání stačí.

• Roční přehled
Na konci sezony spočítá, který pozemek se vyplácel, který měsíc byl nejrušnější a která plodina přerostla. Navrhne, co příští rok změnit – třeba střídat řádky nebo nechat půdu odpočinout.

PROČ TAKTO

Zahrádkování je radost, ne dashboard. Rozhraní je proto klidné, papírové, bez šumu – jako zahrádkářský zápisník, který leží na stole u chaty.

UPOZORNĚNÍ

Výpočty vycházejí ze zvyklostí českých zahrádkářů a slouží pro rodinné použití. Nejde o odborné poradenství – k samotnému postřiku, hnojení a ochraně rostlin se vždy držte etikety přípravku a rad zahrádkářského poradenství.

name: Mood Garden: Journal & Diary
description:
Mood Garden is a private mood tracker and daily journal that turns your days into a garden: a Year in Pixels that blooms. Log your mood in about 5 seconds, and each day plants a flower.

WHY MOOD GARDEN
• A mood tracker that takes 5 seconds: pick how today felt, tap what you did, done.
• A daily mood journal that grows: a week becomes a flower bed, a month a garden plot, and your year a whole garden, like a Year in Pixels you can walk through.
• A private diary with a lock: no account, no cloud, no ads. Your journal stays on your phone, encrypted, with an optional PIN or Face ID lock.
• An emotion tracker for every kind of day: notice your feelings without judging them.

LOG IN 5 SECONDS
• Five moods: Radiant, Good, Okay, Low and Rough. Rename them or change their colors.
• Tap your activities (sleep, work, friends, exercise, outdoors, reading and more) or add your own.
• Add a one-line note or a photo if you like: a micro journal and photo diary, one line a day.
• Check in as often as you want; your daily flower reflects the average of your feelings.
• Forgot a day? Backfill up to 7 days.

YOUR GARDEN
• Every mood grows something. Bright days bloom in sunny colors; rough days grow brave cacti and mushrooms, never a dead plant.
• Week, month and year views, with seasons that follow the real calendar.
• Unlock new plants and garden decor (paths, a pond, benches, lanterns) as your garden grows.
• Tap any flower to reread that day's diary entry.

INSIGHTS: NOTICE PATTERNS IN YOUR DAYS
• Year in Pixels: your whole year as a mood calendar in petal colors, plus a mood chart of your month.
• Mood mix, activities and moods side by side, and a word cloud from your notes.
• A monthly bloom report, such as "Days with outdoors were often Good or Radiant."
• Your mood tracker data is calculated on your phone. These are simple counts, not advice.

GENTLE HABITS & DAILY PROMPTS
• Streaks shown as watering cans, with a free "rain day" each week, so missing a day never feels like failing.
• 365+ gentle journal prompts for self-reflection and gratitude journaling, one for each day, like "What made you smile today?" Lovely for gratitude and self-care.
• One optional evening reminder, at a time you choose.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• An offline mood tracker: works without internet, with no account and no sign-up.
• Your mood journal and diary are encrypted on your device. Lock them with a PIN or Face ID.
• Password-protected backups you control, plus CSV and PDF exports.
• Share cards show only your garden and mood colors, never your notes, photos or activities.

ALSO
• A home-screen widget with your week of flowers and a quick check-in.
• Day and dusk themes, large text, screen reader support and reduced motion.
• Works fully offline, anywhere: a diary that is always with you.
• No ads and no in-app purchases. A cozy mood journal for your emotions, made with care.

Mood Garden is a personal journal for self-reflection. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis or treatment. If you're struggling, please talk to someone you trust or contact local emergency services.

name: Moodshake: Cocktail Bar
description:
Moodshake puts you behind the counter of your own little bar.

Name your place and open the doors. Guests arrive one by one, each with a mood and a story, and they rarely say exactly what they want. Listen, read between the lines, then build the drink.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a glass, then add a spirit, a syrup and a mixer
• Finish with a garnish and ice, shake and serve
• Every guest rates how well you understood them: match, taste and look
• Alcohol-free requests count just as much as the rest

A BAR FULL OF STORIES
• Hundreds of combinations, each with its own reaction
• Regulars with their own personalities and moods
• Themed days take your bar to a tropical beach, a rooftop at night or a neon party

GROW YOUR BAR
• Earn sales and tips, level up and unlock new ingredients
• Short, relaxing sessions you can play anywhere, even offline

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to play, with a short ad at the end of each day and an optional ad for bonus coins
• A one-time purchase removes the end-of-day ads
• Available in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Japanese

Moodshake is a game for adults. In real life, alcohol is for adults only — please drink responsibly.

Privacy Policy: https://jorniaco.com/games/moodshake/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Moonsprites
description:
Light up Bellroot before the Moonfair.

Moonsprites is a cozy merge game set in the moonlit world of the novel Moonsprites: The Last Light by A. Alexander G. Help Nira, a young pathmender, and her friends Pipp, Kio and Sera mend the silverways and light every lantern in town.

MERGE AND LIGHT UP BELLROOT
• Merge sparks into lanternflowers, silver wire into singing silverways and glass beads into the seventh bell
• Five families of items, each with eight levels to discover
• Restore seven moonlit districts, from the Willow Roots to the Moonfair Square
• Then welcome all seven colonies to the Moonfair in six new camps, from Thistledown to Crown-of-Dew

THE REAL MOON
• Bellroot's moon follows the real one in your sky
• On full-moon nights every order pays 25% more glimmers, and each full moon brings a free Full Moon pack
• A Home Screen and Lock Screen widget shows tonight's moon

COLLECT 100 MOONSPRITE CARDS
• Every card has its own serial number; your first of each is a gold 1st Edition
• About one card in sixty is Moonlit, glowing over the moonlit grass
• Fill a place's page and it turns gold. There may be a secret or two…
• Trade with friends sitting nearby, over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth

TUNE THE SILVERWAY
• Listen like Nira and tap each colony's song back
• Seven songs to learn, playable with VoiceOver and by feel

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• No ads. No tracking. Data Not Collected
• Card packs are earned by playing, never sold
• Optional in-app purchases ask a grown-up first
• Reduce Motion support; in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Italian and Chinese

Act 1 ends where the book begins: when the seventh bell falls silent, Nira's story continues in Moonsprites: The Last Light. Act 2 takes place after the book, with no spoilers.

name: MopaCheck: Cleaning Log
description:
MopaCheck is proof that every zone was cleaned. Your team scans the QR code or NFC tag in each zone as they clean it. You see it in the app right away: which zone, who and when.

It is built for cleaning companies that service offices, apartment buildings, gyms, stores and restaurants. And for anyone who wants to replace the paper log on the restroom door.

What you can do
• Set up your sites and the zones in each one: restrooms, lobby, locker rooms, break room...
• Print a QR code for each zone, or write an NFC tag by holding your phone to it.
• Add your team and send each person their access link by WhatsApp or email. No password needed.
• See the cleaning log for each site, with zone, team member, date and time.
• Schedule cleanings: which zones are cleaned and in what time window. For example, restrooms every two hours.
• Get an alert when a scheduled cleaning is missed.
• Review the issues your team reports, with their photos.
• Get reports: a PDF certificate of the cleanings in a date range, and an Excel export.

How to start
1. Create a site and its zones.
2. Put the QR code or NFC tag in each zone.
3. Your team installs MopaScan and signs in with their link.
4. Every time they clean a zone, they scan it. You see it here.

Built for real work
• Your team's app works offline and sends the scans when the connection is back.
• A zone only counts when its QR code or NFC tag is scanned. Typed codes don't count.
• Available in English and Spanish.

Two apps, one for each role
This app is for managers and supervisors. Cleaners use MopaScan.

You need a MopaCheck account. You can create one in the app. Learn more at mopacheck.com.

name: MopaScan · MopaCheck Team
description:
MopaScan is the app for the people who do the cleaning. Scan the QR code or tap your phone on the NFC tag in each zone as you clean it. Your manager sees it right away, and it's clear you covered every zone.

What you can do
• Sign in with the link your company sends you. No password.
• Scan the zone's QR code with the camera, or tap your phone on its NFC tag.
• See today's cleanings and how many zones you have done.
• Get a reminder when a cleaning starts or is about to close.
• Report an issue with a photo: no soap, a leak, something broken...
• Get messages from your manager.

Works offline
Basements, parking garages and storerooms don't always have signal. The app keeps your scans and sends them on its own when the connection is back.

Your position, only when you scan
The app records where you are only when you scan a zone or send an issue report. Never in the background. That data goes to your company and is not used for advertising.

Before you start
Your company has to add you to MopaCheck and send you your access link. If you manage a cleaning team, the app you need is MopaCheck: Cleaning Log.

Available in English and Spanish.

name: Morse Quest - Code Trainer
description:
Morse Quest turns Morse code into a game you can finish.

Each lesson teaches two letters. You hear the code, read it, build it from dots and dashes, then tap it out on a telegraph key with real timing. Miss one and it comes back later in the lesson. Fifteen lessons take you from E and T to the full alphabet and all ten digits.

LEARN
- 15 short lessons, ordered from the simplest codes to the longest
- Five kinds of exercise: meet, listen, read, build and key
- Three hearts per lesson, up to three stars for a clean run
- Adjustable speed from 8 to 24 words per minute

KEEP GOING
- XP, levels and a daily goal
- Day streaks
- 8 badges to earn

PUZZLES
- Story packs where every answer is a Morse message
- Decode what you see, encode what you read, or work by ear alone
- First Contact, the first pack, is free
- Hints for stuck moments

TELEGRAPH KEY
- Free practice with a live decoder
- Short press for a dot, hold for a dash
- Full code chart one tap away

FAIR BY DESIGN
- All lessons are free
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Progress stays on your device

PUZZLE PASS
An optional one-time purchase unlocks three more story packs: Shipwreck Signals, Spy Cables and Deep Space, 24 puzzles in total. No subscription. Hint packs are sold separately.

Privacy Policy: https://morsequest.tolgadurman.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://morsequest.tolgadurman.com/terms/

name: Mosaic Hush
description:
Mosaic Hush is a refined 3D tile-matching puzzle designed for focused portrait play. Study the arrangement, identify matching tiles, and make each choice with care as you work toward a clean finish.

Crisp visual feedback keeps the objective easy to follow, while the spatial presentation gives familiar matching play a fresh sense of depth. Start a puzzle when you have a few minutes, settle into its patterns, and enjoy the satisfaction of steady progress.

3D tile-matching puzzle play

Clear, approachable interactions

Portrait sessions suited to quick breaks

A polished visual style built around focus

Whether you prefer a brief reset or a longer puzzle session, Mosaic Hush keeps the experience direct: observe, match, and complete the arrangement.

name: Mossmere: Living Aquarium
description:
Mossmere is a tiny freshwater ecosystem that lives on your iPhone, drawn entirely in glowing ASCII characters, 200 to the width of your screen.

You start with water, sand, a few minerals and a lamp. Then you bring in life, one species at a time, and put it wherever you like. Eighteen species are free and seven more come with Plus: microbes, algae, eight kinds of plants, water fleas, snails that graze, burrow or hunt, shrimp, and fish from schooling minnows to air-breathing corydoras. Every one of them changes the water in its own way.

FIVE VARIABLES, ONE LIVING SYSTEM
Dissolved oxygen, nutrients, organic waste, algae and water stability all run in a single simulation. Plants make oxygen in light and use it at night. Microbes turn waste into nutrients and need oxygen to do it. Overfeed, and the leftovers rot, microbes boom, nutrients climb, algae races ahead and the water turns green — until water fleas eat it, if the fish don't eat them first.

AQUASCAPE FREELY
• Place plants, stones and wood anywhere, and turn or move them whenever you like. Reshape the substrate into a slope, an island or a valley.
• Tie moss and anubias onto wood and stone. Bury an anubias and its rhizome rots.
• Crypts melt after a move, a hairgrass carpet needs strong light, rotala blushes red, and clumps planted too close slow each other down.
• Caves, shrimp tubes and coconut shells shelter fry from hungry fish; catappa leaves feed the biofilm.
• A high-output lamp, CO₂ and root tabs for planted-tank fans, each with its trade-offs.

SEE WHY IT CHANGES
• The monitor lists exactly what added to and took from each variable over the last day.
• Events tell you the cause and what you could try.
• 57 ecological relationships to discover as your tank shows them: assassin snails halting a snail boom, a betta catching shrimp, guppies breeding faster than you can count.

A TANK THAT NEVER ENDS
• No levels and no finish line. The goal is a system that keeps growing more complex and still looks after itself.
• Stable means everything stays in a healthy range for a day and a half; values still rise and fall with day and night.
• One tank day takes 2.4 minutes, or 18 seconds fast-forwarded.
• Close the app and time keeps passing, slowly and capped. If something risky happens while you are away, the tank pauses and tells you when you return.
• Pinch, drag and zoom into a real 3D tank. Tap any animal to follow it, hide the interface to simply watch, or save a picture.
• Three research tracks, commissions and 30 honours for the long run.

FAIR AND QUIET
• Free to play. No ads, no accounts, no data collected. Your tank is saved on your iPhone and in your own iCloud.
• Mossmere Plus, a one-time purchase, adds neon tetras, a betta, crystal red shrimp, amano shrimp, nerite snails, marimo balls, duckweed, three light colours and 500 shells.
• Shells only save time: everything they buy can be earned by keeping a healthy tank.

Mossmere is a game. Its ecology is simplified for play and is not a guide to real aquariums.

name: MotoIntercom - Kask Telsizi
description:
MotoIntercom - Kask Telsizi, motosiklet sürücüleri ve artçılar için geliştirilmiş internetsiz canlı sesli iletişim uygulamasıdır.

Mobil şebekenin çekmediği dağ yollarında, otoyol sürüşlerinde veya grup gezilerinde ekstra donanıma gerek kalmadan telefonunuzu profesyonel bir kask interkomuna dönüştürün.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER:
• İnternetsiz iPhone ↔ iPhone Bağlantısı: Wi-Fi ve Bluetooth üzerinden doğrudan (P2P) eşleşerek şebeke olmadan kesintisiz konuşun.
• Android ↔ iPhone Desteği: Kişisel Erişim Noktası (Hotspot) veya aynı yerel Wi-Fi ağı üzerinden Android ve iPhone cihazlar arasında canlı ses aktarımı.
• Kristal Netliğinde 44.1 kHz Ses: Çift taraflı aktif mikrofon ve ayarlanabilir mikrofon hassasiyeti (ses eşiği) ile rüzgar sesini azaltın.
• Kask Bluetooth Kulaklık ve Arka Plan Desteği: Ekran kapalıyken bile kesintisiz ses iletimi ve Bluetooth kask kulaklıklarına otomatik ses yönlendirme.
• Eldiven Dostu Tasarım: Sürüş sırasında kolay kullanılabilen büyük mikrofon aç/kapat ve bağlantı butonları.
• 12 Dil Desteği: Türkçe, İngilizce, Almanca, Fransızca, İspanyolca, Rusça, Arapça, Farsça, Hintçe, Urduca, Bengalce ve Endonezce.
• Gizlilik Odaklı: Üyelik veya hesap gerektirmez. Ses verileri yalnızca iki cihaz arasında anlık iletilir, kaydedilmez ve hiçbir sunucuda saklanmaz.

PRO Sürüm (Tek Seferlik Satın Alma):
Uygulama içi tek seferlik satın alma ile tüm reklamları kalıcı olarak kaldırabilir, satın alımlarınızı dilediğiniz zaman geri yükleyebilirsiniz.

name: Motorcycle Permit Test USA
description:
Unofficial app: it is not affiliated with and does not represent any state motor vehicle agency, rider training program or other government body. We wrote the questions, guides and diagrams ourselves from the facts in each state's motorcycle manual and state law. Official information: https://www.usa.gov/state-motor-vehicle-services

Get your motorcycle license step by step, in English, in Spanish, or both.

ALL 50 STATES AND DC
• 1,470 questions: riding skills every state tests, plus your state's own rules on the permit, rider course, laws and fees
• Every question has an explanation and the manual page it is based on
• Practice tests in your state's format, mistake review and a readiness score

YOUR PATH TO THE LICENSE
• Step by step for your state: age, instruction permit and its limits, knowledge test, skills test, fees and what to bring on test day
• Rider course instead of the skills test: whether your state accepts it, and a link to the state's list of courses
• Tick off each step as you go

STATE LAWS
• Helmet law and lane splitting for every state, side by side
• Each rule shows the law it comes from and the date we checked it

HAND SIGNALS AND CHEAT SHEETS
• 15 hand signals for turns, stops and group riding, with a quiz
• Cheat sheets with diagrams: lane position, braking, curves, intersections, following distance, group riding and gear — each with a short self-check

SKILLS TEST
• The exercises most states use: slow U-turn, cone weave, sharp turn, stop in a box, quick stop, swerve
• What the examiner watches and where riders lose points

AFTER THE TEST
• Pre-ride check before every ride: tires, controls, lights, oil, chain, stands
• Your first season: rain, wind, your first passenger, night riding, heat and long trips
• 156 motorcycle terms as flashcards

ENGLISH AND SPANISH
• Every question in both languages; the other language is one tap away
• Some states give the knowledge test in English only — study in Spanish, then check the English wording

FULL ACCESS
Free: 10 questions in every topic, one practice test for your state, your state's path, laws, hand signals, cheat sheets and the pre-ride check. Full access opens everything: weekly or monthly subscription that renews automatically until you cancel, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; manage or cancel in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://yurgon.app/motorcycle-permit-test/privacy/

---

name: Mov.me
description:
O Mov.me é o painel da sua página de Links na Mov.me, agora no iPhone. O que você faz no painel do computador, faz aqui, com telas feitas para o celular.

MONTE A SUA PÁGINA
• Adicione, edite e mude a ordem dos seus Links arrastando com o dedo
• Troque fotos direto da câmera ou da galeria
• Blocos prontos: vídeos do YouTube, música, agenda, formulário de contato, redes sociais e Pix na bio
• Veja a prévia da página na hora, antes de publicar

DEIXE COM A SUA CARA
• Escolha o visual da página e ajuste o fundo, as cores, as fontes, os botões e os ícones das redes

ACOMPANHE OS RESULTADOS
• Visitas e cliques de cada Link
• De onde vieram as visitas
• Contatos e agendamentos que chegam pela sua página

DIVULGUE
• Copie o seu endereço Mov.me com um toque
• Compartilhe a página e o QR Code pelo menu do iPhone

SEGURANÇA
• Entre sem senha, com um código enviado ao seu e-mail ou WhatsApp
• Abra o painel com Face ID
• Saia de todos os aparelhos quando quiser

Para usar o app, é preciso ter uma página na Mov.me.

Dúvidas: suporte@mov.me

name: Mov.ms: Encurtador de Links
description:
O Mov.ms é o painel do seu encurtador de links, agora no iPhone. Crie, edite e acompanhe seus links curtos de onde estiver.

LINKS CURTOS COM O SEU NOME
• Encurte qualquer link em segundos
• Escolha o nome do link (mov.ms/seunome) ou use um código curto
• Mude o destino depois, sem trocar o link que você já divulgou
• Organize com etiquetas, busque, duplique e arquive

MÉTRICAS DE CADA CLIQUE
• Cliques e pessoas diferentes, dia a dia
• De onde vieram: Instagram, WhatsApp, YouTube, Google e mais
• Aparelhos, cidades e horários
• Leituras do QR Code

PIXEL DE ANÚNCIO
• Ligue o pixel do Meta, do Google, do TikTok e de outras plataformas nos seus links
• Aviso de privacidade para quem clica, de acordo com a LGPD

QR CODE
• O QR Code de cada link, pronto para divulgar

SEGURANÇA
• Entre sem senha, com um código no e-mail ou no WhatsApp
• Abra o painel com Face ID
• Destinos conferidos contra golpes e vírus

Compartilhe seus links pelo menu do iPhone com um toque.

Dúvidas: suporte@mov.ms

name: Move Snacks
description:
Sports day used to happen once a year. Now it happens every day, right where you're standing, a few minutes at a time. It's built the way the best speed coaches train: real athletic moves, served up like a game, so the work feels like play.

Hit Make a Move. A slot reel, a claw machine or a rocket deals you a surprise lineup: bear crawls, broad jumps, stair sprints, balance holds, dance breaks, core work. There are 48 moves in the rotation and you never know what's coming. Every so often a golden wild move drops in.

And every snack has a race. Beach Run, Star Run or Bolt Run turns the screen into a track and everything comes straight at you. Jump it. Duck it. Dodge it. Punch it. Run in place the whole way, grab the coins, and cross the finish line right as the song lands its last beat.

A pixel athlete shows you every move, a ring runs the clock, and the whistle calls time. During the rest the next move plays first, so you're ready before it starts. Nobody has to read a word.

It has its own soundtrack: stadium walk-out music on the menu, a shuffled mix while you work, a song for every race, plus whistles, claps and a full stadium fanfare when you finish.

Run it your way:
• 3, 5 or 7 moves. Easy, Medium or Spicy. Quick, Normal or Roomy rests.
• No room to jump? No stairs? No ball? Switch those moves off.
• Star your favourites and one shows up in every snack.
• Pick any single move or race from All Moves.

Set the days and the time, and it'll call you back out once on any day you haven't played.

Works offline on iPhone and iPad, upright or sideways. Prop it up or throw it on the TV. No ads, nothing to buy, no account, no data collected.

Sports day, every day.

name: MoveBox Moving Inventory
description:
MoveBox helps you keep an inventory while moving. Label boxes, assign them to rooms, and record their contents so you can find items later. Browse boxes by room, search your inventory, and mark boxes as unpacked to track progress.

Your inventory is stored on your device.

name: MQ Dash
description:
MQ Dash is a clean dashboard for the Hermes model-quota endpoint and provider readings you configure on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

QUOTAS AND TOKEN USAGE
View plan allowances, reset windows, and 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day token usage reported by your Hermes quota service. Toggle providers independently in the Plan Quotas and Token Use sections; newly reported providers appear without an app update.

CACHE-FIRST, MANUAL REFRESH
Your last known snapshot appears immediately. Refresh is manual and in-app on Apple, including Mac keyboard shortcuts; there is no periodic background refresh. Values not reported by a provider remain Unknown or a dash rather than becoming misleading zeros, and stale-cache states explain when a refresh could not reach your host.

SIX THEMES AND ADAPTIVE LAYOUTS
Choose from six themes and use compact, rail and multi-column provider layouts across iPhone, iPad and resizable Mac windows.

DIRECT AND PRIVATE
Connect to your Hermes quota page over LAN, Tailscale or HTTPS, with an optional bearer token stored in Keychain. Requests go directly to the service you configure. There is no developer account server and no developer analytics.

FREE, WITH A ONE-TIME PREMIUM
MQ Dash is free on iPhone and iPad and shows one small banner ad at the bottom of the dashboard. A one-time Premium purchase removes the banner. It is not a subscription.

TRY IT WITHOUT A HOST
Choose Explore with sample data on the first screen to open the dashboard on invented readings before you connect your own host.

name: Mueen Provider
description:
Welcome to the "Mueen Provider" app, the official platform designed specifically for service providers, technicians, and professionals to efficiently manage their operations and increase earnings.

"Mueen Provider" delivers an integrated work environment that allows you to receive maintenance and home/commercial service requests instantly, navigate to client locations using real-time maps, and update order statuses effortlessly.

Key Features for Service Providers:
• Instant Order Notifications: Receive real-time alerts for service requests in your area.
• Flexible Order Management: View full job details and easily accept or decline requests based on your availability.
• Precise GPS Navigation: Integrated Google Maps routing for fast and accurate navigation to the client's location.
• Digital Wallet & Earnings Tracking: Keep track of your revenues, completed jobs, and financial history transparently.
• Direct Client Communication: Communicate smoothly with customers through calls and in-app updates to ensure top service quality.
• Dedicated Technical Support: Continuous assistance to help you solve any issues during service delivery.

Join the Mueen Provider network today and elevate your business with modern technology!

name: Mulora
description:
Mulora is a community for sharing how silk sleepwear feels in real wear.
Write down the fabric label, size, and length, and describe how it feels when you move. Add close photos of the collar, cuffs, and seams. When you wash it, return to the same post and add how the size and surface changed.
Look up records by season and material, then talk with others in the comments about fit and everyday use. Post a photo story or a short wearing video, and keep your own wears in your Drawer.

name: Muz Cumhuriyeti
description:
Serengeti: Banana Republic 3D delivers a fresh 3D board-strategy experience packed with tactical dice rolls, lively biomes, and a built-in map workshop!

Roll the dice, plan your route, gather the target number of bananas, and race to the Exit Gate before your rival does!

KEY FEATURES:
• Two Game Modes: Enjoy classic tactical racing in "Normal Mode" or drop slippery traps in "Banana Peel Mode".
• Online 1v1 & Smart AI: Challenge a clever AI opponent solo or create a room for real-time online multiplayer matches.
• Banana Skates & Jungle Hazards: Glide across the board on banana skates, navigate rivers, and outsmart roaming predators and tax-collecting rivals.
• 4 Unique Biomes: Play across Wild Jungle, Lakes & Islands, Canyon & Labyrinth, and Treasure Arena maps.
• Map Editor & Community: Design your own 3D maps from scratch, test them live, share with a map code, and play community creations!
• Day & Night Themes: Switch visual atmospheres anytime.

Who will rule the Serengeti? Roll the dice and start the banana chase!

name: MVM Educational Trust
description:
App For All
To provide the power of technology in the hands of Parents, Teachers, and School Admin.
The module provides an easy way to manage teacher Attendance and Leave. 
A complete solution to automate attendance taking, attendance reporting, and attendance analytics

name: My Cards: Card Scanner
description:
Photograph a business card and My Cards reads the text, saves each field, and lets you find the card later by any word on it.

SNAP AND SORT
- Point the camera at a card and it captures automatically. You can also pick a photo from your library.
- Name, company, title, phone, email and address are filled in for you.
- Check and correct the result before saving.
- Reads Korean, Japanese and English cards.

FAST SEARCH
- Find a card from part of a name or company, or a few digits of a phone number.
- Searches every word on the card and your notes.
- Matches are highlighted.

REACH OUT
- Call, message or email from the card screen.
- Favorites, notes and the original photo.

YOUR CARDS STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
- Text recognition runs on your iPhone only. Photos and card details are never sent to a server.
- No sign-up, no login, no ads.
- Scan, save and search without an internet connection.
- Card data is not included in iCloud backups or transfers to a new iPhone, so cards do not move with you when you change phones.
- Deleting a card also permanently deletes its photo.

APP LANGUAGES
English, 한국어, 日本語

■ すばやく検索
・名前や会社名の一部、電話番号の数桁だけでも見つかります。
・名刺に書かれたすべての文字とメモまで検索します。
・一致した部分をハイライト表示します。

■ すぐに連絡
・詳細画面から電話、メッセージ、メールをワンタップで。
・お気に入り、メモ、元の写真の表示。

■ 名刺はあなたのiPhoneの中だけ
・文字認識はiPhone内だけで処理します。写真や内容をサーバーに送りません。
・会員登録、ログイン、広告はありません。
・インターネットなしでもスキャン・保存・検索できます。
・名刺データはiCloudバックアップや新しいiPhoneへの移行に含まれません。機種変更の際、名刺は引き継がれませんのでご注意ください。
・名刺を削除すると写真も一緒に完全に消去されます。

■ 表示言語
日本語、한국어、English

name: My Shevchenkove
description:
My Shevchenkove is made for people who live in Shevchenkove, a village by the lake next to Bilohorodka, 9 km west of Kyiv, or come here often. It puts in one place what you usually look for on different websites and in chats.

• Power. The DTEK outage schedule for your queue today and tomorrow: is there power now, when the next outage starts and when power comes back. You choose your queue once.
• Weather in the village now and for three days.
• Transport. Minibuses 748 and 749 to Zhytomyrska, Sviatoshyn and Nyvky metro stations, community route No. 2, stops in the village.
• Useful. Community and emergency phone numbers, waste collection days, shelters, what to do during long blackouts.
• City Lake. What is known about the residential complex by the lake: phases, dates, sources.
• Places. Shops, cafes, pharmacies, the lake and landmarks with a link to the map.
• Events nearby and a short history of the village.

The data comes from open sources: power schedules from the outage-data-ua repository (DTEK Kyiv Regional Grids data), weather from Open-Meteo, contacts from the Bilohorodka community website. Facts link to their sources. If something is out of date, write to admin@townhub.eu and we will fix it.

The app shows the last downloaded data even offline. No registration, no ads, no tracking. Available in Ukrainian, English and Polish.

This is an unofficial app, not affiliated with DTEK, the carriers or the community council.

name: My Tinkly
description:
MyTinkly is your happy place for cute stuff — greeting cards, wall planks, photo frames, sippers, mugs, keychains and more, designed and made with love.

• Shop cute products for every mood and moment
• Make it yours with names, photos and designs
• Fast, secure checkout with UPI, cards and Cash on Delivery
• Track your orders live and get delivery updates
• Save favourites and get price-drop and back-in-stock alerts
• Free shipping on orders above ₹499

Made with love in India.

name: mycodex · 手腕问答
description:
mycodex 是一款适用于 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 的问答助手。抬腕听写一个问题，阅读简短回答，或拿起 iPhone 继续同一段对话。

• 在 Apple Watch 上使用系统听写或键盘。读完回答后向下滚动即可继续追问。
• 在 iPhone 查看完整的对话记录，需要了解近期信息时可以开启联网查询。
• 用内置示例离线体验提问、回答和追问。

正式问答需要你自己的 OpenAI API Key 和具备模型访问权限的 OpenAI API 项目。API 用量计入你的项目。应用在你同意后才会把问题和必要的上下文发送给 OpenAI。

使用手表版时，Apple Watch 需要与 iPhone 配对。配对的 iPhone 负责发出问答请求。

name: MyJamo
description:
MyJamo — рабочее пространство для команды в вашем телефоне. Задачи, чаты, звонки, календарь, файлы и документы собраны в одном приложении, поэтому больше не нужно переключаться между сервисами и искать, где обсуждали важное.

Откройте MyJamo утром и сразу увидите ближайшие встречи и свои задачи. А когда нужно что-то сделать быстро, просто скажите об этом Jamo AI.

ВЕСЬ ДЕНЬ НА ОДНОМ ЭКРАНЕ
• Ближайшие встречи и личные задачи на главном экране
• Сроки и просроченные задачи сразу заметны
• Быстрое переключение между организациями и проектами

ЗАДАЧИ И ПРОЕКТЫ
• Удобный список и канбан-доска
• Статусы, приоритеты, типы и сроки
• Исполнители и подзадачи
• Фильтры и поиск по задачам
• Отдельные пространства для каждого проекта

ОБЩЕНИЕ С КОМАНДОЙ
• Личные чаты, группы и каналы
• Закреплённые сообщения, чтобы важное не потерялось
• Упоминания коллег и обмен файлами
• Аудио- и видеозвонки прямо из чата
• Поиск по чатам и сообщениям
• Уведомления о сообщениях и звонках

КАЛЕНДАРЬ И ВСТРЕЧИ
• Месяц и план дня на одном экране
• События личные и по проектам
• Видеовстреча добавляется при создании события
• Подключение к встрече в одно касание

ФАЙЛЫ И ДОКУМЕНТЫ
• Личные файлы и материалы проектов в одном месте
• Доступ к файлам для коллег
• Раздел «Доступные мне» со всем, чем с вами поделились
• Страницы и документы проектов
• Корзина: удалённое хранится 30 дней

JAMO AI — ВАШ ПОМОЩНИК
Скажите или напишите, что нужно сделать, а Jamo AI возьмёт рутину на себя:
• Создаст задачу или встречу
• Изменит статус задачи
• Напишет коллеге
• Подскажет, что у вас сегодня
• Покажет, что просрочено
• Найдёт свободное время в расписании
• Расскажет, что нового в файлах

Jamo AI может ошибаться, но всё, что он сделал по вашей просьбе, можно отменить.

БЕЗОПАСНЫЙ ВХОД
• Вход по электронной почте или номеру телефона
• Двухфакторная аутентификация
• Коды восстановления доступа

ДЛЯ КОГО MYJAMO
Для стартапов, агентств, продуктовых, маркетинговых и дизайн-команд, отделов компаний и всех, кому важно работать слаженно, видеть сроки и не терять договорённости в переписках.

MyJamo работает на iPhone и iPad и доступен на русском и узбекском языках.

Соберите команду в MyJamo и держите всю работу под рукой.

name: myStarGoods Global
description:
myStarGoods Global is the official app for 1:1 live video call fan events, connecting fans around the world with their favorite artists.

KEY FEATURES

1. Real-time 1:1 live video calls
Event winners join a high-quality, one-on-one video call with the artist. In the waiting room you can see your status and get notified when your turn comes up.

2. Quick verification, no sign-up
Join with the winner information you received: the last 4 digits of your phone number, your name and your access code. No account or password needed.

3. Device check before the call
Test your camera and microphone before you enter the waiting room, so nothing goes wrong when your moment arrives.

4. Chat with event staff
Ask questions and get announcements from the event staff while you wait.

5. Safe and secure events
Only verified participants who complete ID verification can enter the waiting room, keeping every event safe and comfortable.

6. Your data is deleted after the event
myStarGoods Global does not keep permanent membership accounts. Personal information collected for an event is automatically and completely deleted after the event ends.

Enjoy a special moment with your artist on myStarGoods Global.

name: Mystic Stones
description:
Gizemli Taşlar Online (Mystic Stones Online) is a strategic medieval stone-tile tabletop game set inside a candlelit ancient castle hall.

Take your seat at the carved round table, command stones engraved with 16 distinct emblems, and outthink your opponents to claim the crown!

GAMEPLAY & STRATEGY
• Play your stones onto the ancient table — the highest number wins the round.
• On a tie for the highest number, Red triumphs over Black.
• Read emblem matches, manage your rack wisely, and time your strongest moves to maximize your score.
• Enjoy smooth drag-and-drop or single-tap controls designed for touchscreens.

GAME MODES
• Single Player (Castle Arena): Challenge the West, North, and East Castles at your own pace with no turn timer pressure.
• Online Multiplayer (Live Table): Create a private room code to invite friends or join live 4-player matches anytime.

KEY FEATURES
• 16 crisp, distinctive ancient emblems
• 24 medieval character portraits to customize your profile
• 3 handcrafted stone themes & atmospheric audio effects
• Full portrait and landscape support for iPhone and iPad
• Daily leaderboard & personal match score history
• English and Turkish language support

Ruling requires courage and demands intelligence. Step up to the table and make your move!

name: MysticalMerchant
description:
You have a small wagon, a few goods to sell, and four settlements to trade with. Buy wax where it’s cheap, haggle over a shipment of salt, or take a guild contract. Make room for the cargo and get it there on time.
- Haggle for a better deal. Prices and stock change from day to day. Your reputation and relationships with local vendors give you more ways to negotiate.
- Take on delivery contracts. Start with small orders and work your way up to wholesale shipments. Each contract has a destination and a deadline.
- Choose when to take a risk. Help an herbalist, step into a market dispute, or keep moving. Your choices affect your health, your earnings, and how people treat you.
- Grow your business. Unlock new goods, upgrade your wagon, and earn titles and achievements.
- Explore a dark fantasy world. Pixel art brings its fairs, roadside encounters, and characters to life.

name: Naam Dhara: Jaap Mala Panchang
description:
Shri Naam Dhara (श्री नामधारा) is a pure, distraction-free digital sanctum crafted for seekers of inner peace and continuous spiritual discipline (साधना निरंतरता). 

Designed with sacred reverence, authentic Vedic precision, and high-performance fluid design, Naam Dhara accompanies you in daily Naam Jaap, mantra remembrance, and live Vedic astrological timings.

KEY FEATURES:

1. 108-BEAD MALA & COSMIC FLOW COUNTER
• Authentic 108-bead sacred ring and continuous vertical flow mode.
• Responsive haptic touch feedback and temple bell acoustics designed for closed-eye chanting.
• Multi-mala counter, daily target streaks, and Sankalp vows.
• Full-screen distraction-free chanting and hands-free Car (Yatra) mode.

2. AUTHENTIC VEDIC PANCHANG & CHOGHADIYA
• Real-time Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, and Karana calculated with precise astronomical algorithms.
• Auspicious Day & Night Choghadiya with countdown timers for Shubh, Labh, and Amrit muhurats.
• Brahma Muhurat, Abhijit Muhurat, Rahu Kaal, and planetary Hora timings.
• City selection with live sunrise, sunset, and solar-lunar positions.

3. SACRED MANTRAS & SCRIPTURAL PAATH
• Authentic Vedic shlokas, stotrams, and divine names in authentic Devanagari Hindi with English transliteration.
• Meaningful spiritual insights and custom mantra creation.

4. VRAT, FESTIVALS & SEVA
• Accurate Ekadashi, Pradosh, Purnima, Amavasya, and festival calendar.
• Direct connection with authentic Gau Seva (cow care) and saint traditions.

5. 100% PRIVATE, AD-FREE & OFFLINE
• Completely free forever with zero commercial advertisements.
• Operates 100% offline on-device — your sacred sadhana data remains entirely private to you.

May the continuous stream of the Divine Name bring serenity, wisdom, and auspiciousness to your life.

name: Naelan
description:
Naelan is a small, offline ledger for sourdough: the starter and its last feed, the loaf and its formula, and the flour still on the shelf. No account, shop, sync or advertising. Every working feature works offline.
Today opens with the jar on the counter: its flour, hydration and next feed. One tap logs a feed and resets the clock. Three numbers show what the year has used: loaves baked, flour weighed and average hydration. Below, the next planned bake, the last three loaves and one pantry warning keep the morning honest.

name: Nagi — Calm New Tab
description:
Nagi replaces Safari's new tab with a calm, private dashboard.

• Minimal clock, date & a greeting by time of day
• Your shortcuts, a simple task list, daily focus & a Pomodoro timer
• Beautiful bundled wallpapers & gradients (rotate daily), light/dark themes
• Command palette, zen mode, drag-to-reorder
• Optional weather & web search — OFF by default
• 日本語 · English · Tiếng Việt

Privacy first: no account, no tracking, no ads. Your settings stay on your device. Optional features only connect to the internet when you turn them on, and we tell you exactly which service each one uses.

Free, forever.

name: Nail Line
description:
The picture is still on the floor. Name the frame, write how tall it is, how far the wire drops, and how high the center should sit. Nail Line turns those three numbers into one sentence: how many inches up the nail goes. Open Frames later and the same sentence is still there.

Nail Line does not read a level, judge whether the wall can hold the picture, or make a file. There is no account. The height stays on this iPhone.

name: Nailmelle
description:
Nailmelleは、ネイルデザインを考え、手元で試し、記録するアプリです。

【指ごとに、自分らしいデザイン】 ラウンド、オーバル、スクエア、アーモンドの4種類の爪の形、12色、ワンカラー・フレンチ・ドット・ラメを組み合わせられます。すべての指への一括適用にも対応しています。

【カメラで手元の印象を確認】 背面カメラに映した片手に、デザインを2Dで重ねて試着できます。手の甲を向けて指を広げ、大きさや位置を調整してください。一時停止した画像は、デザインと合成してアプリ内に保存できます。 表示位置は手の関節からの推定です。実際の爪の輪郭や奥行きを正確に再現するものではありません。左右の手は同じデザインを使います。

【名前とメモをそえて記録】 作ったデザインや試着画像、写真ライブラリから選んだネイル写真を、名前・メモと一緒に保存。保存したデザインは再編集して、新しい記録として残せます。

【端末内に保存】 アカウント登録は不要です。カメラ映像の処理とネイル記録の保存は端末内で行います。写真ライブラリ全体へのアクセス許可は求めません。 クラウド同期、写真アルバムへの書き出し、記録のエクスポートには対応していません。アプリを削除するとアプリ内の記録も失われます。

【広告について】 記録画面や保存完了後に広告を表示する場合があります。広告配信には通信を使用し、Googleの広告SDKが配信・測定等に必要な情報を取り扱います。カメラ映像やネイル記録を広告SDKへ渡す処理はありません。詳しくはプライバシーポリシーをご確認ください。

name: Nairea
description:
Nairea is a small, offline companion for brewing and tasting tea. Browse a library of teas, follow suggested brewing numbers, time your steep, and keep a four-dimension tasting journal. No account, no connection, no advertising — just a calmer cup.
Thirty-two original tea entries across eight families: Green, White, Yellow, Oolong, Black, Pu-erh, Floral and Herbal. Each family has a short introduction, and each tea carries its origin, appearance, aroma, taste, recommended water temperature, leaf amount, steep time, infusion count and a brewing tip. Search by tea name, family or origin.

name: Natter!
description:
Natter! is a British social network for people aged 18 and over, built for proper profiles and a bit of fun, just like the early internet.

Make a page that's actually yours, with skins, colours, a profile song, Top Friends, photo albums and a whiteboard your mates can doodle on. Follow people, post, comment, send messages, join groups, and settle arguments with quizzes and polls.

There are no in-app purchases and no ads in this app. You can report and block other members, and you can export or delete your account in Settings, Your data.

Natter! is operated by 9791 Media LTD. 18+ only.

name: NavLiveConnect
description:
NavLiveConnect is the onboard app for boaters: chart, weather, routing and boat monitoring in one place, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

• Chart and marine weather: wind, gusts, waves and currents, side-by-side comparison of several forecast models, kept up to date.
• Routing: computes a route from the weather, your boat's polars and the wind and sea limits you set yourself.
• Anchor alarm: watches for drift, siren even with the screen locked, time-sensitive notifications.
• Instruments: connects to your boat's Wi-Fi NMEA 0183 gateways, customizable dashboards, wind dial.
• Tracking and logbook: track, onboard messaging, journal, maintenance, regattas.
• Offline: download charts and forecasts before you leave; routing works without a network.

Access is invitation-only during the beta: request yours at app.navliveconnect.com.

Important: NavLiveConnect is a decision aid. Charts and forecasts are indicative, are not certified for navigation, and do not replace official charts or a proper lookout. Not for use as a primary means of navigation.

name: NCD
description:
De app van NCD, het netwerk voor commissarissen, toezichthouders en bestuurders. Log in met je NCD-account en heb het ledenportaal altijd bij de hand.

IN DE APP
• Agenda & evenementen: bekijk ledenbijeenkomsten, masterclasses en kringactiviteiten en meld je aan
• Aanmeldingen en PE-punten: zie waarvoor je bent ingeschreven en houd je permanente educatie bij
• NCD Academie: leergangen en programma's voor toezichthouders en bestuurders
• Kringen en ledenlijst: vind andere leden en de kring bij jou in de buurt
• Berichten: blijf in contact met andere leden en met NCD
• Vacaturebank: toezichthoudende en bestuurlijke functies
• Lidmaatschap: je lidmaatschap, facturen en profiel op één plek

MELDINGEN
Ontvang een pushmelding bij nieuwe berichten en belangrijke updates. Tik op de melding en je gaat direct naar het juiste onderdeel.

De app is bedoeld voor leden van NCD. Je logt in met het e-mailadres en wachtwoord van je NCD-account.

name: Neckartakt
description:
Neckartakt shows you when your next tram or bus leaves – live and with delays, for every stop in the rnv area: Mannheim, Heidelberg, Ludwigshafen, Weinheim, Viernheim, Schriesheim, Bad Dürkheim and the whole region.

No journey planner, no ticket shop – just what matters at the stop.

LIVE DEPARTURES
• Line, direction and departure in real time
• Delays at a glance, with scheduled and actual time
• Trips without live data are marked as scheduled
• Refreshes on its own while the app is open
• Lines in their real colours

FIND STOPS
• Nearby: all stops around you, sorted by distance
• Search by name

FAVOURITES
• One tap on the star is all it takes
• Your stops appear on the home screen with their next departures
• Arrange them in any order

YOUR WAY
• 5, 10, 15, 20 or 30 departures per stop
• Light, dark or follow your system
• 13 languages: German, English, Turkish, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Romanian, Ukrainian, Russian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Greek

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• Free, no ads, no in-app purchases
• No account, no sign-up
• Favourites and settings stay on your device
• Your location is used on your device only and never transmitted

Timetable and real-time data are provided by Rhein-Neckar-Verkehr GmbH (rnv). Neckartakt is an independent project and not affiliated with rnv.

name: Nekonade - Cozy Cat Petting
description:
Gently stroke a cat with your finger. That's all. A calm little app for unwinding.

Under the chin, the cheeks, the head, the back. Pet a spot it likes and the cat narrows its eyes and starts to purr. With the purring sound and a soft vibration in your hand, it feels like petting a real cat.

- Reactions change with where you pet
  Chin, cheeks, head, back, belly: each spot gets its own reaction.
  Every cat has favorite spots in every pose.
  Blinks, ear twitches and breathing move slowly and naturally.

- Four poses in a warm home
  Chin & cheeks, belly-up, curled up and stretched out.
  A sofa, a rug, a kotatsu (heated table) and a wooden floor.
  The room's light follows the time of day: morning, day, evening and night.
  Ambient rain or a crackling fireplace.

- Made for bedtime too
  The sleep timer slowly dims the screen and fades the sound.
  Full-screen landscape, so it's just you and the cat.

- Meet 11 cats
  Ginger Tabby, White, Tuxedo and Calico are with you from the start.
  Petting earns Treats, which you can use to meet new cats.
  The Cat Book shows how long you've petted each cat and its favorite spots.

- Choose your petting hand
  Six sleeves such as knit, sweatshirt and pajamas, and four skin tones.
  Or hide the hand entirely.

The app contains ads. Buying "Remove ads" hides the menu banner and the ads shown after meeting cats.

Terms of Use: https://stack-works.dev/neko-nade/en/terms.html

name: Neon Bastion: Sudoku
description:
Neon Bastion: Sudoku combines a 9x9x6 3D rotating cube Sudoku with real-time hexagonal territory warfare.

- Switch seamlessly between 3D rotating cube mode and classic flat 2D grid mode.
- Challenge Daily Core Maps across 5 difficulty tiers and compete on Daily, Weekly, and Monthly clear-time leaderboards.
- Battle in 1v1 Hex Arena to raise your Honor Rank.
- Unlock tactical items and energy refills in the Geranium Shop.

name: NesaVakit: Namaz Vakti, Kuran
description:
Bir hayır duanız yeter.

NesaVakit; namaz vakitleri, ezan vakti bildirimi, kıble pusulası, sesli Kur’an-ı Kerim, Türkçe meal, imsakiye ve Diyanet yayınlarını tek uygulamada sunar. Tamamen ücretsiz ve reklamsızdır; hesap açmanız gerekmez, hiçbir bilginiz toplanmaz. Her Müslümanın günlük ibadetinde yanında olması için hazırlandı.

İL İL, İLÇE İLÇE NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ
• Türkiye’nin 81 ilinde ve ilçelerinde Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı’nın resmî namaz vakitleri: İstanbul, Ankara, İzmir, Bursa, Konya, Antalya, Sakarya ve diğer tüm iller
• Bulunduğunuz il ve ilçe konumunuzdan otomatik bulunur; seyahatte vakitler kendiliğinden güncellenir
• İmsak, güneş, öğle, ikindi, akşam ve yatsı vakitleri tek ekranda
• İçinde bulunduğunuz vakit ve vaktin çıkmasına kalan süre (sabah namazı, öğle namazı, ikindi namazı, akşam namazı, yatsı namazı)
• Hicrî ve miladî tarih
• İnternet yokken de indirilen takvimden çalışır

EZAN VAKTİ BİLDİRİMİ
• Her vakit için ayrı ayrı açılıp kapatılabilen namaz vakti hatırlatması
• Yumuşak uyarı sesi ya da kendi seçtiğiniz ezan kaydı
• Odak ve Rahatsız Etme modunda da duyulabilen zamana duyarlı bildirim

KIBLE PUSULASI
• Açılır açılmaz çalışan kıble bulucu
• Kıble açısı, Kâbe’ye uzaklık ve “sağa / sola dönün” yönlendirmesi
• Doğru kıble yönüne gelince titreşimle haber verir

KUR’AN-I KERİM VE MEAL
• 114 sure, sure arama ve kaldığınız yerden devam
• Diyanet’in özgün Mushaf’ı (Arapça), gerçek kitap gibi sayfa çevirme
• Ayet ayet sesli Kur’an dinleme: Osman Şahin, Mehmet Çevik, Cüheyni
• Türkçe meal ve sesli meal okuması; tek dokunuşla aynı surenin meali
• Yasin, Mülk, Fetih, Kehf gibi surelere hızlı erişim
• Çift dokunuşla yakınlaştırma, sayfalara işaret ve notlar
• Ekran kapalıyken de Kur’an dinleme

RAMAZAN VE ORUÇ
• İmsakiye: imsak (sahur) ve iftar saatleri
• Ramazan günlerini ayrıca listeleme; oruç tutanlar için iftara kalan süre

DİYANET YAYINLARI
• Diyanet Kur’an Radyo, Diyanet Radyo ve Diyanet TV canlı yayınları

Vakitler, Kur’an-ı Kerim, meal, sesli okumalar ve yayınlar yalnızca Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı’nın resmî kaynaklarından alınır. NesaVakit bağımsız bir uygulamadır; Diyanet’in resmî uygulaması değildir. Açık ve koyu tema desteklenir.

name: Net Word Grid
description:
The letter-dice word game for friends and family on different phones. Everyone gets the same board and the same clock; when time’s up, everyone’s lists are scored side by side.

PLAY TOGETHER OR ANYTIME: Together games start each round for everyone at once, with a countdown. Anytime games give everyone the same boards to play at their own pace before a deadline, so a game can stretch over a day or two.

SPELL ON THE BOARD: Trace a word in one stroke or tap one letter at a time. Like pen and paper, nothing is checked during the round; you find out which words count when it’s over.

SEE EVERY WORD: After each round, see everyone’s words, the ones only you found, and every word you missed, with its path on the board and what it means, from a dictionary built into the app.

YOUR GAME, YOUR RULES: 4×4 or 5×5 boards, round length, the shortest word allowed, and three ways to score: classic (shared words cancel), rarity (words few others found score more), or longest word. Each player can set their own shortest word, so younger and newer players can play alongside experts. Optionally reroll boards with too few words.

EASY TO SHARE: Create a game and send its six-letter code. No accounts or sign-in; pick a name and play. Offensive words are left out unless you choose otherwise.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking. Games are deleted after 30 days.

name: NetProbe: Network Tools
description:
Get a clearer view of your connection with NetProbe: Network Tools, a practical network toolkit for iPhone.

CHECK YOUR CONNECTION
Run DNS, TCP, TLS and HTTPS checks against a target you choose. Review the result and timing of each step to help investigate connection issues.

MEASURE SPEED AND CONNECTION QUALITY
Measure download and upload speeds, HTTP latency and jitter using Cloudflare test endpoints. Follow live progress and revisit completed results in History.

DISCOVER LOCAL DEVICES AND SERVICES
Find responding devices and advertised Bonjour services on your current Wi-Fi network. View available addresses, service details and device information. Names and device types depend on the information returned by the network.

EXPLORE NEARBY BLUETOOTH
View nearby Bluetooth Low Energy broadcasts, including available names, signal levels and advertised services. BLE scanning reads advertisements without connecting to or pairing with devices.

CHECK TCP PORTS
Test up to 32 selected TCP ports on a host you own or have permission to test. See whether each connection succeeds, is refused, times out, or encounters an unreachable target.

REVIEW AND SHARE RESULTS
Revisit past checks, add device notes within individual local network scan records, and delete saved records. Export a CSV summary with sensitive details redacted.

PERMISSIONS AND DATA
No account is required. Local Network and Bluetooth permissions are requested when you use their respective scan features.

Test history is stored on your iPhone and is not automatically uploaded by NetProbe: Network Tools. Connection checks contact your selected target. Speed tests contact Cloudflare, which receives your public IP address and processes it under its privacy policy.

USAGE INFORMATION
Local discovery depends on device responses and visible service advertisements. Some devices may be absent from scan results. BLE signal strength varies with surroundings and does not determine exact distance.

Support: support@streambeeline.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.streambeeline.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.streambeeline.com/terms.html

name: NeuraPEC – Posta certificata
description:
NeuraPEC è il modo più semplice per leggere la tua posta elettronica certificata (PEC) dall'iPhone.

IL MESSAGGIO, NON LA BUSTA
Ogni PEC arriva chiusa in una busta di trasporto. NeuraPEC la apre per te: tocchi e leggi subito il messaggio originale, con mittente, data certificata e allegati. Niente più file postacert.eml da aprire a mano.

LE RICEVUTE SOTTO OGNI INVIO
Accettazione, consegna, mancata consegna: NeuraPEC raggruppa le ricevute sotto il messaggio che hai inviato e mostra lo stato per ogni destinatario. Vedi subito cosa è stato consegnato, cosa no e perché.

SALVA LE RICEVUTE COME PROVA
Con "Salva ricevute" ottieni un file ZIP con le ricevute originali (.eml) firmate dal gestore e un riepilogo PDF, pronto da archiviare o da girare al tuo avvocato o commercialista.

ALLEGATI, P7M E FATTURE ELETTRONICHE
Apri PDF e documenti, estrai il contenuto dei file .p7m e leggi le fatture elettroniche in sintesi: numero, fornitore, righe, imponibile, IVA e totale.

NESSUN ACCOUNT, NESSUN SERVER
NeuraPEC non ha server: l'app si collega direttamente al tuo gestore PEC su connessione cifrata (IMAP su TLS). Password e messaggi restano sull'iPhone, la password nel Portachiavi. Puoi bloccare l'app con Face ID. Nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento. Puoi aggiungere più caselle PEC, senza costi.

GESTORI
Provato con caselle Aruba PEC. Con gli altri gestori si usa la configurazione manuale: server IMAP e porta indicati dal tuo gestore. Se hai la verifica in due passaggi, usa la password per i programmi di posta del tuo gestore.

PROVALA SENZA PASSWORD
"Prova la demo" apre una casella di esempio con messaggi, allegati, una fattura e sei invii con le loro ricevute. Funziona anche senza connessione.

NEURAPEC PRO
La prima casella è gratis, con tutte le funzioni di lettura. Con Pro:
• caselle PEC illimitate, con la vista "Tutte le caselle";
• Registro invii: un file con ogni PEC inviata, destinatario e stato di consegna, più tutte le ricevute originali.
Pro mensile 3,99 €, annuale 19,99 € o per sempre 39,99 € (pagamento unico). Gli abbonamenti si rinnovano automaticamente e si disdicono dalle impostazioni dell'ID Apple almeno 24 ore prima del rinnovo.
Termini d'uso: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://www.neurafit.it/neurapec/privacy/

COSA NON FA IN QUESTA VERSIONE
• Non invia PEC: per ora è in sola lettura.
• Non verifica le firme digitali di messaggi e documenti.
• Niente notifiche istantanee: per le scadenze apri l'app.

NeuraPEC è un programma di posta per leggere una casella PEC che hai già: non rilascia caselle PEC. Il valore legale di messaggi e ricevute viene dal gestore, non dall'app.

NeuraPEC non è affiliata ad Aruba né ad altri gestori PEC.

name: NeverMiss: Meeting Alarms
description:
Meeting alarms and calendar reminders you can't sleep through. NeverMiss turns the important events in your Apple, Google and Outlook calendars into reminders that get louder, ending in a full-screen alarm that rings even on silent.

A notification is easy to swipe away. For job interviews, doctor and dentist appointments, flights, client calls and school pickups, NeverMiss escalates until you've noticed.

Reminders that get louder
• A gentle nudge first, then a Time Sensitive alert that breaks through Focus and Do Not Disturb
• Then a full-screen alarm that rings on silent and repeats until you act
• "I'm on it" stops the reminders; snooze or "Running late" when you need a minute

Every calendar, one countdown
• Works with Apple Calendar, Google Calendar and Outlook / Microsoft 365, with as many accounts as you have
• A live countdown to your next event on the Lock Screen
• NeverMiss only reads your calendars. It never changes your events.

Smart about what matters
• Rules mark interviews, doctors and flights as critical automatically
• Each importance level gets its own reminder flow: Gentle, Balanced or Bulletproof
• Join Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams in one tap, right from the alarm

On your iPhone, Mac and Apple Watch
• Full-screen alarms and a menu bar countdown on your Mac
• Your next event and "I'm on it" on your wrist
• Settings and "I'm on it" sync through iCloud

For ADHD, time blindness and back-to-back days
If you lose track of time, hyperfocus, or run from meeting to meeting, NeverMiss is the persistent reminder that won't let an important appointment slip by.

NeverMiss Pro unlocks Bulletproof flows, unlimited alarms and unlimited calendars. Monthly, yearly (with a 7-day free trial) or lifetime.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://nevermiss.events/terms
Privacy policy: https://nevermiss.events/privacy

name: New Braunfels Local Guide
description:
NBTX Guide is a local guide to New Braunfels, Texas.

Browse local businesses by category, from food and drinks to river outfitters, shops, health and wellness, and local pros. Search by name, see places near you on the map, and call, get directions or visit a website in one tap.

Ask the chat about New Braunfels businesses, river levels, events and plans for your visit. Answers are written by AI from NBTX Guide and official sources, so check details before you go.

Check the Comal and Guadalupe rivers before you go. River levels come from USGS gauges, with a 7-day chart and a link to each gauge page.

Find New Braunfels events through the official calendars for Visit NBTX, the City of New Braunfels and local venues.

Know about an event or a business we should add? Send it from the app. We review every submission. Own a listed business? Claim it from its page.

NBTX Guide is free to use. Businesses marked Premium pay for an enhanced listing. No account is needed to browse.

name: NEXMin
description: NEXMin Conçu pour la gestion des dépenses personnelles échelonnées. Une fois les tâches saisies et chaque étape confirmée comme étant terminée, vous pouvez consulter le montant dû, les échéances de paiement à venir ainsi que le solde total restant. En sélectionnant le « montant dû », vous accédez au détail des coûts, pouvez enregistrer des paiements ou associer l'élément à des comptes existants. Un même paiement peut être réparti sur plusieurs étapes, et des acomptes peuvent être affectés dès lors que leur objet est défini. Tout nouvel élément, ajustement tarifaire ou annulation est d'abord enregistré sous forme de proposition, ce qui vous permet d'évaluer son incidence sur le coût total et les soldes à régler avant toute validation définitive. En cas de remboursement, le système assure le suivi du montant convenu et du montant réellement perçu ; une fois le dossier soldé, vous pouvez consulter son historique complet, incluant les modifications apportées, les paiements effectués et le montant net final de votre dépense personnelle.

name: NEXUM cri
description: En la aplicación de NEXUM vas a poder encontrar toda la información generada en el sistema administrativo de gimnasios NETGYM. Allí podrás ver tus rutinas, planes alimenticios, asistencias, deudas, historial de compras, entre otros datos.

name: Nexus: Last Signal
description:
Seventeen years after the first colony went silent, a transmission arrives with your name on it.

You are Benjamin, a former AEGIS agent. On the other end of the signal are answers about your family, about the lost colony and about ORION, the intelligence that may be the last witness of what happened.

A STORY WORTH FINISHING
• 8 chapters, from the Fallen City to the heart of the Nexus
• Memorable characters, choices that change conversations and three different endings
• Logs, audio records and artifacts that reveal what AEGIS kept hidden

REAL-TIME COMBAT
• Shoot, dodge and use abilities with controls built for touch
• 16 bosses with phases, weak points and patterns to learn
• Enemies that flank, retreat and hide: every area needs a plan

EXPLORE AND GROW
• Maps full of secrets, hidden chests, secret rooms and a complete Codex
• Break barrels, crates and pods to find rare weapons, modules and looks
• Three skill trees, gear, modules and workshops at the Outpost
• New Game+ and the Challenge Arena when you want more

FAIR TO YOU
• Chapter 1 is free. The full campaign is a one-time purchase, no subscription
• Cosmetics never change stats: nobody buys an advantage
• Plays offline; your progress stays on your device and in your own iCloud
• No ads and no data collection

Modern pixel art, music by independent artists, and text in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

A game by Noob Perdido Studio.

name: Nexversion: Learn AI
description:
Build practical AI skills for your work, your ideas and your next ambition. Nexversion brings structured lessons, useful exercises and AI guidance into one focused learning experience.

CHOOSE YOUR LEARNING ROUTINE
Choose a 10-, 15- or 20-minute routine during onboarding. Set a goal, adjust your preferences and move through the material at your own pace. These are learning targets; setup and optional refinement can take longer.

EXPLORE SIX COURSES
Each course contains 28 lessons across four modules:
• Practical AI Foundations
• AI for Business
• AI Automation & Agents
• AI Content & Marketing
• AI for Work & Careers
• AI Entrepreneurship

LEARN, PRACTISE AND REVIEW
Work through clear explanations, practical tasks, review checklists and knowledge checks. Save your exercise drafts, return to earlier lessons and keep your progress linked to your account. Distinct course and module colours make your next step easy to find.

ASK YOUR AI TUTOR
Ask for a simpler explanation, a practical example or feedback on work you choose to share. The tutor uses OpenAI and asks for permission before sending your questions and selected context. Daily usage limits apply. AI responses can be incorrect, so check important answers.

KEEP WHAT YOU CREATE
Export your saved course work. Complete a course's requirements to earn and share a Nexversion PDF completion certificate. Certificates record course completion and are not accredited qualifications.

MAKE PROGRESS YOUR WAY
Enable optional daily reminders and milestone haptics. Manage your subscription, restore purchases and access account deletion from Profile.

ACCESS AND SUBSCRIPTIONS
The course collection can be previewed without payment. An active paid subscription is required for training and the AI tutor. Available App Store subscriptions renew weekly, monthly or every three months. The current local price and billing period are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your Apple subscription settings. Deleting the app or your Nexversion account does not cancel a subscription.

An internet connection is required for lessons, saving and AI guidance. Third-party tools mentioned in lessons may require separate accounts or payments.

Privacy: https://nexversion.com/privacy
Terms: https://nexversion.com/terms
Support: https://nexversion.com/support
Apple standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: NibPath
description:
