Trace beautiful letterforms with Apple Pencil. NibPath scores every stroke, tracks your streak, and prints practice sheets — all offline, with no account and no subscription.

FEATURES

• Six script styles — Copperplate, Foundational, Gothic, Italic, Modern Brush, and Uncial — each with a full reference alphabet and stroke-order guides.
• Guided tracing on a PencilKit canvas with adjustable guides: baseline, x-height, ascender, descender, and ductus arrows. Trace with Apple Pencil or your finger.
• On-device accuracy scoring compares your path to the guide and rates coverage, deviation, and smoothness from 0 to 100.
• Fine, medium, and broad nib options, with per-letter progress tracking.
• Daily streak, average accuracy, and weekly minutes, visualized with clear charts.
• Printable worksheets: export a practice grid as PDF or PNG and share it.
• Custom scripts: add your own alphabet and notes.
• Today's Letter, streak, and weekly minutes widgets, plus Shortcuts support.
• Optional App Lock keeps your practice private.

PRIVACY FIRST

NibPath works 100% offline. No account, no cloud, no analytics, no ads. Your handwriting and progress never leave your device. We collect no data.

SUPPORT

Questions or feedback? Email tiansuqun@outlook.com.

name: Nico - Time Between
description:
Meet Nico, a scheduling workspace for turning message context into one clear availability commitment.

Nico separates what was said from what is ready to confirm. In Chats, select messages that contain useful timing details, then shape an Availability Mandate with a proposed window and participants. Each person's limits remain separate. The organizer reviews the required responses before confirming the version of record.

Confirmed details stay visible. If plans change, Nico opens a repair flow instead of silently rewriting the record, so source messages, responses, and the final decision remain easy to inspect.

NICO ASSIST
Nico Assist uses the messages you select to suggest boundaries and wording on this device. Nothing is sent to a language model. Review and edit every suggestion before saving.

YOUR WORKSPACE
In this version, profiles, conversations, availability, mandates, reports, and blocks stay on this iPhone. Messages are not delivered to another person, and records do not sync across devices. This version does not include subscriptions or in-app purchases.

SAFETY AND CONTROL
Report a person or message, block an account, and reverse the block from Profile. Reports stay on this device and are not automatically sent to a moderation service. Delete your profile and its records from Profile, then Delete account.

Nico is a scheduling workspace, not an emergency service or a calendar system of record.

PRIVACY, TERMS AND SUPPORT
Privacy Policy: https://nicorbin.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://nicorbin.com/terms-of-service
Support: https://nicorbin.com/support

name: NIDAA - نداء
description:
NIDAA turns your phone into the pager for your café or restaurant order.

How it works:
• After you order, the cashier shows you a QR code.
• Scan it with your Camera and NIDAA opens instantly. No download, no sign-up.
• Follow your order: Received, Preparing, Ready.
• When it's ready your phone rings and vibrates, and your order number shows on the lock screen.
• Tap "I'm on my way" so the staff know you're coming, and the alert stops.

Why NIDAA:
• No account and no personal data: we never ask for your name or number.
• Works even when your phone is locked or you're in another app.
• Arabic and English.

Note: if your iPhone is on silent while locked, the alert arrives without sound.

NIDAA is a service for subscribed cafés and restaurants. To use it in your café: getnidaa.com

name: Nimbus Gasket Bureau
description:
The sky station needs a repair crew, and you have just the arms for the job.

Play a tiny rubber courier in an airborne weather bureau. Press and hold a ring to extend your mitten and swing beneath it. Release on the forward arc to retract your arm and fly across the gap. Land on a ledge to line up the next grab, or chain swings in midair.

CHANGE THE PRESSURE

Red valves switch your gauge between Amber and Violet. Match the gauge to a pressure socket to take that route. Look for ordinary brass rings, supply detours, spring pads, and moving hoops. Some airlocks need a weather kit from farther back in the corridor.

CROSS 100 SKYWAY ROUTES

Start in the Training Duct and work your way to Nimbus Core. Early routes teach one trick at a time. Later routes bring together drifting rings, static puffs, fans, wide gaps, and pressure switches. Keep an eye on your three hearts. Hold the green airlock until your courier is fully inside before time expires.

GRAB A LITTLE HELP

Pick up lightning for longer reach, an hourglass for eight extra seconds, or a tailwind for a faster release. A cloud shield absorbs one hit. Visit the Daily Stamp station to earn spare shield patches for future flights.

BUILD YOUR FLIGHT RECORD

Earn up to three stars per route and revisit cleared routes to improve your times. See your personal rankings on this iPhone. Play with sound, haptics, or gentler motion using the in-game settings.

Made for iPhone. The game plays offline. No account, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: Ninoku: Ninja Number Garden
description:
Fill the garden with your ninja crew!

Ninoku is a calm logic puzzle with a garden twist. Every row, every column and every box must hold each plant exactly once. Plant seeds, watch them sprout, and cheer as mini ninjas jump, flip and bounce across the board.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
- Seeds: plant the missing seeds from the tray
- Swap: the garden is full but mixed up; swap tiles to fix it
- Plants or numbers: switch to classic numbers any time
- Grids of 4x4, 6x6, 8x8 and 9x9, easy to hard
- Every puzzle has exactly one solution

BONUS ROUNDS
- Shadow Garden, Harvest Rush, Crow Raid, Swap Relay and Diagonal Dojo
- Lantern Night after dark, Wind Gust on windy days
- Golden Seed for triple points

EVERY DAY
- Daily Dojo: one garden a day, build your streak
- Earn belts from white to black

HELPFUL, NOT PUSHY
- Notes for planning, hints paid from the points you win
- Optional timer and reshuffle rule
- An illustrated how-to-play guide

SIGHTS AND SOUNDS
- Original cartoon art, a ninja garden by day and night
- 5 original soundtracks
- Optional weather in the scenery

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Works fully offline
- No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking, no in-app purchases

Available in English and French. Suitable for all ages.

Ninoku is published by AppsSolutely Apps, a division of 4MEC Limited (UK).
Privacy Policy: https://4mec.co.uk/ninoku/privacy.html
Support: https://4mec.co.uk/ninoku/support.html

name: Ninos Pizza Lieferservice
description:
Ninos Pizza Lieferservice – Ihre Lieblingsgerichte bequem bestellen

Entdecken Sie die große Auswahl bei Ninos Pizza Lieferservice in Kirchheim unter Teck! Von knusprigen Steinofen-Pizzen und American Pizza über vegane Pizzen bis hin zu Pasta, überbackenen Nudelgerichten und herzhaften Grillgerichten ist für jeden Geschmack etwas dabei.

Freuen Sie sich außerdem auf frische Salate, griechische und indische Spezialitäten, XXL-Burger, Schnitzel, Maultaschen, Snacks und leckere Desserts. Für Familien und den gemeinsamen Genuss gibt es praktische Sparmenüs mit Pizza, Salat, Getränken und weiteren Lieblingsgerichten.

Laden Sie die App herunter, entdecken Sie unsere Speisekarte und bestellen Sie Ihre Lieblingsgerichte direkt auf Ihr Smartphone!

name: NIPPO - 現場の日報・作業報告書
description:
**現場の日報作成を、もっと簡単に。**

NIPPO（ニッポ）は、建設業・設備工事・現場作業に携わる職人さんや個人事業主のための、シンプルな作業日報アプリです。

毎日の作業内容を記録し、現場写真を添えて、PDFの日報を作成・共有できます。

**■ NIPPOでできること**

【かんたん日報作成】
現場、作業日、天候、作業時間、休憩時間、作業人数、作業内容などを入力して日報を作成できます。

【現場ごとに日報を管理】
現場情報を登録し、現場ごとの日報をまとめて管理できます。

【作業写真を添付】
現場写真を日報に登録。写真ごとのコメントや並び替えにも対応しています。

【PDF作成・共有】
作成した日報をA4サイズのPDFとして発行。写真やコメントを含めた作業報告書を共有できます。

【日報の複製】
過去の日報を複製して、新しい日報を作成できます。毎日の入力作業を効率化します。

【CSVデータ出力】
登録した現場・日報・写真情報をCSV形式で出力できます。

**■ 30日間無料でお試し**

NIPPOは、初回利用開始から30日間、日報を件数制限なく作成できます。

無料期間の利用にクレジットカード登録は必要ありません。無料期間の終了によって自動的に課金されることもありません。

無料期間終了後は、Proプランへの登録で新しい日報の作成を継続できます。

**■ NIPPO Pro**

月額680円（税込）

Proでは、日報を件数制限なく作成できます。

サブスクリプションは自動更新されます。解約しない限り、現在の契約期間終了の24時間前までに更新が行われます。購入後の管理・解約はAppleアカウントのサブスクリプション設定から行えます。

**■ こんな方におすすめ**

name: Nivo Ski
description:
NivoSki estime le risque d'avalanche le long de votre itinéraire de ski de randonnée.

Chargez une trace GPX, ou touchez un itinéraire sur la carte : NivoSki découpe la trace en segments de 50 m et calcule le risque de chacun. Le calcul utilise la pente, l'orientation, l'altitude, l'heure de passage et le bulletin d'estimation du risque d'avalanche (BERA) du jour. Le modèle est appris sur des accidents réels et sur des milliers de sorties sans accident.

GRATUIT
- Analyse d'une trace GPX, avec le risque de chaque segment et ses facteurs
- Cartes IGN et OpenTopoMap, couches Pentes, Neige, Pistes et Traces
- Vos traces Google Drive et Strava
- Mode trail : distance, dénivelé et horaire

PREMIUM
- Risque en temps réel : le risque suit votre position et l'heure, même hors trace
- Mode hors-ligne : la carte, le calcul du risque et le panorama fonctionnent sans réseau dans la zone téléchargée
- Panorama : le relief en 3D qui suit la boussole, avec le nom des sommets
- Suivi d'un proche : sa position Garmin LiveTrack ou COROS sur votre carte

L'abonnement Premium est mensuel (2,99 €) ou annuel (19,99 €), avec 2 semaines d'essai gratuit. Il se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf résiliation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période.

IMPORTANT
NivoSki est une aide à la décision. L'app ne remplace ni le bulletin officiel, ni la formation, ni votre jugement sur le terrain. Le risque zéro n'existe pas en montagne.

name: Nomi Pass: Restaurant Rewards
description:

One account lets you show your member QR, collect points by scanning receipts, and redeem rewards at any store that uses Nomi. Each store's points, stamp cards and vouchers are kept separate and can only be used at that store.

SCAN THE RECEIPT, COLLECT
• After you pay, scan the QR on the receipt, the kiosk or the payment page, and the points or stamps go straight onto that store's card
• Each order can be collected once
• The first time you collect at a store, the app shows exactly what that store will see, and you join only if you agree

YOUR MEMBER QR
• A full-screen member QR that changes every 30 seconds, ready for staff or the kiosk to scan
• Works even when the store has no internet

ONE CARD PER STORE
• Points, stamp card progress and your level at that store at a glance
• Rewards: once you have enough points, turn them into a voucher the store offers
• Voucher wallet: vouchers from the store and the ones you redeemed, with terms and expiry dates
• Points history: every earn, redemption and expiry

NOMI LEVEL
• Your level grows with visits to stores that use Nomi over the past year: Newcomer, Regular, Gourmand, Connoisseur
• It is a badge: staff can see the level name when they look you up. It is not points and cannot be exchanged for anything

FIND STORES
• Search by name, or turn on Near me to see stores around you that use Nomi
• Open a store's ordering page from its card, and book a table when the store takes reservations

NOTIFICATIONS
• Points collected, stamp card complete, voucher expiring, level up. Turn them off any time in the app
• Offers and news from a store arrive only if you turn on "Get offers and news from this store" on that store's page. It is off by default and you can turn it off any time

YOUR DATA
• Each store only sees your history at that store, never what you do at other stores

• Leave a store at any time, or delete your Nomi account in the app

GOOD TO KNOW
• Points, stamp cards, vouchers and rewards are set by each store and can only be used at the store that issued them. They cannot be transferred or exchanged for cash
• Orders from delivery platforms do not earn points
• Sign in with an email code or an account you already use

name: NSHRMS
description:
Welcome to nshrms – your all-in-one Employee Self-Service (ESS) and Human Resource Management solution designed to simplify your daily work life. Whether you are working from the office, visiting clients, or managing field operations, nshrms keeps you seamlessly connected with your organization's HR workflows right from your mobile device.
Say goodbye to manual registers and paperwork. With nshrms, employees can record attendance, request leaves, track official travel, view salary slips, and monitor shift schedules with complete transparency, accuracy, and speed.

Key Features of nshrms

1. Smart Attendance & Geo-Punch
In-Punch & Out-Punch: Mark your daily attendance with a single tap.
Geo-Location Verification: Accurate GPS verification ensures attendance is registered from designated office or client premises.
Selfie Verification: Built-in front camera snapshot provides secure identity authentication for every punch.
Real-time Status: Instantly see your punch timings and daily working hours.

2. Complete Leave & Time-Off Management
Leave Applications: Apply for Casual, Sick, Earned, or privilege leaves in seconds.
Compensatory Off (C-Off): Submit C-Off generation requests for weekend or holiday work and settle earned days easily.
Short Leave & Permission: Quick applications for partial day or hourly permissions.
Leave Cancellation: Manage and cancel planned leaves before they take effect.
Balance & History: Track remaining leave quotas and historical approval logs in real time.

3. On-Duty & Tour Tracking
On-Duty (OD) Requests: Register official outdoor visits, client meetings, and duty passes.
Tour Applications: Submit outstation tour requests with complete travel plans and agendas.
Route & Distance Tracking: Automated location updates during active duty shifts calculate accurate travel routes and distance for smooth reimbursement.

4. Miss-Punch & Regularization
Miss-Punch Requests: Forgot to punch? Submit regularization requests directly to your supervisor with remarks.
Audit Trails: Clear records of pending, approved, and rejected regularization entries.

5. Employee Reports & Instant Payslips
Monthly Payslips: Access and download official salary slips and tax summaries securely in PDF format.
Attendance History: View detailed monthly attendance logs, present days, late marks, and overtime records.
Leave Reports: Monitor overall time-off consumption anytime.

6. Calendar & Holiday Schedule
Stay updated with upcoming national holidays, company events, and scheduled offs through an intuitive monthly calendar.


Security & Data Privacy

We value your privacy and security. nshrms adheres to enterprise-grade data security standards:
Work-Hours Only Tracking: Location tracking is active only during your duty shifts (between Check-In and Check-Out) for attendance and travel verification. Tracking stops immediately upon Check-Out.
No Third-Party Sharing: Your personal information, photos, and location coordinates are used exclusively for internal HR management and are never shared or sold.


Who is nshrms for?

Employees: Enjoy transparent attendance logging, instant leave requests, real-time balance tracking, and hassle-free payslip access.
Managers & HR Teams: Faster approval cycles, zero attendance discrepancies, accurate field tour logs, and simplified payroll processing.

name: OBD Labs: Car Scanner
description:
OBD Labs turns your iPhone and an OBD-II adapter into a calm, precise diagnostic bench. It reads what your car's computer has stored, explains it in plain language and tells you how urgent it is.

READ AND UNDERSTAND
• Stored, pending and permanent fault codes from any OBD-II car
• A 1–5 severity rating for every code, with a shape, a number and a label, so it never relies on colour alone
• "Can I keep driving?" for each fault
• Check-engine lamp status, readiness monitors, freeze frame and VIN
• Offline library of nearly 800 generic SAE J2012 codes, written in our own words in English and Turkish
• Extended scan of other control units such as ABS, airbag and instruments on most CAN cars (beta, read-only)
• Pick your car from a list; make and model year are filled in from the VIN automatically

ON-DEVICE AI DIAGNOSIS (Pro)
On iOS 26 and later, Apple Intelligence writes a diagnosis for your exact make, model and year right on your iPhone: likely causes ranked, checks from cheapest to most expensive and the parts involved. Your codes and VIN never leave the phone. On earlier iOS versions, OBD Labs opens targeted web searches for the code and your car instead.

CLEAR CODES SAFELY (Pro)
Checks the engine is off and the battery is healthy, warns you that readiness monitors will reset, archives the codes and freeze frame first, clears them, then scans again to show what came back.

MORE TOOLS
• Live data: engine speed, road speed and coolant for free; load, fuel trims, O2 sensors, air flow, battery, intake temperature and more with Pro, with graphs, recording and CSV export
• Emissions readiness: ready or not ready, monitor by monitor
• Used-car check: spots signs that codes were cleared recently (distance and warm-ups since clear) and exports a PDF report
• Garage with history for every car, VIN decoding, a home-screen widget, a Live Activity and "Scan my car" with Siri
• Battery cranking test

ADAPTERS
Supported: ELM327-compatible Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) adapters, such as Vgate iCar Pro BLE, Veepeak BLE and OBDLink CX, and ELM327 Wi-Fi adapters.
Not supported: classic Bluetooth adapters (the kind that pair with a PIN in Settings). iPhone only allows those through Apple's MFi programme.
No adapter yet? Tap "Try without an adapter (Demo)" and explore every screen with a simulated car.

FREE AND PRO
Free: connect, scan, see how many faults there are, each code and title, the severity rating, and three live gauges for one car.
OBD Labs Pro: full explanations, on-device AI diagnosis, code clearing, freeze frame, all live data, emissions readiness, used-car PDF, unlimited cars and history. Available yearly (with a 7-day free trial), monthly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. A single car report is also available as a one-time purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.

OBD Labs is for information only and doesn't replace a professional diagnosis.

name: OceanOccurrence
description:
Every diver asks the same question before getting in the water: who is down there? OceanOccurrence answers it with evidence. Choose the sea you are about to dive and the app reads the historical occurrence records published by OBIS, the Ocean Biodiversity Information System, then shows which species have actually been recorded in that water, how often they appear, and at what depth.

The result is not a wish list. Each species carries a plain-language hint — common, uncommon or rare — based on the share of the local record set it accounts for, so you can decide where to spend your bottom time. A depth band narrows the answer to the water you will really be in, and a year window keeps old surveys from being mistaken for today's ocean.

After the dive, log the date, water temperature, maximum depth and the species you met, flag the identifications you are unsure about, and attach a photo. Across a season the logbook becomes a personal timeline of encounters. When you want to contribute, export your records as a Darwin Core table and submit them to any citizen science programme.

OceanOccurrence is built around the way divers plan and remember dives: no account, no advertising, and your records stay on your phone.

Understand your sleep

Find your focus

See your progress

name: OldMapLayer
description:
Some addresses keep their history in plain sight. A yard wall that follows a line nobody can explain, a street that bends for no reason, a warehouse standing where the water used to be. OldMapLayer is for the people who want to know what the ground under an address used to be, and are willing to spend an evening finding out.

It starts with the sheets. Archives across Europe and North America have been scanning their historical maps for decades, and OldMapsOnline has spent years bringing those scans together, place by place and year by year. OldMapLayer puts that material on your phone as a working desk: a sheet on the table, a rule across it, and the present day underneath. Drag the rule and the nineteenth century gives way to the street outside, block by block, at exactly the same scale.

The years matter, so they are always in reach. A surveyor's rule runs along the bottom of the desk and moves you from the earliest sheet held for a place to the latest, and every stop is a different reading of the same streets. A railway viaduct appears, then goes. A river becomes a sewer, then a road. Names shift. You can watch a town decide what it was going to be.

What makes the comparison honest is that it is measured. Every sheet carries a registration figure, taken from the control points the archive matched to real coordinates, and the app shows that figure plainly and tells you what it means. Paper stretches and folds; the further a feature sits from a control point, the more it drifts. If the fit looks wrong you can nudge the sheet by eye and see the offset you have applied. The app will keep reminding you that a line printed in 1889 is evidence, never a boundary.

For anyone chasing a specific address, a docket keeps the work together: the sheets that cover it, the notes you write against them, and captures of the comparison stage, all stored on the phone with the source and licence attached to each plate. And because a buried watercourse is the kind of thing a buyer wants to know about before rather than after, a site brief reads the sheets for flood history, made ground and former industry, and says in the plainest terms that it is a reading of old maps and not an environmental survey.

OldMapLayer is quiet, offline-first and free of accounts. No sign in, no advertising, no tracking. The plates, the notes and the conclusions are yours, and they stay on your device.

name: OLT SHOT TIMER
description:
SHOT TIMER is a sound detection timer for iPhone and Apple Watch.

Automatically detect sound events, measure elapsed time, and track intervals with a clean, easy-to-read interface.

Both iPhone and Apple Watch support independent timing. Sessions recorded on Apple Watch can be synchronized to iPhone, allowing you to review your timing history in one place.

KEY FEATURES

• Independent timing on both devices
• Automatic sound event detection
• Elapsed time and event interval measurement
• Adjustable detection sensitivity
• Minimum interval adjustment to reduce duplicate detection
• Random and fixed start delays
• START BEEP and PAR BEEP
• Session history and review
• Apple Watch history synchronization
• Japanese and English language support

SHOT TIMER provides a streamlined timing experience for training sessions and sound-based timing activities.

Developed by OLT INDUSTRIES.

name: Olvvex
description:
Olvvex is a tool designed for on-site measurement and decoration planning, offering AR distance measurement, wall height estimation, area calculation of planar polygons and slope estimation. It supports horizontal and inclination readings, manual entry, material usage calculation and tile layout preview. After logging in, you can save the measurement sketches and project notes to your personal account for easy viewing and management. The reference assistant provides preset operation guidelines and guided calculations. Loading reference content requires an internet connection. AR and sensor readings are only for estimation. Before construction, procurement or installation, please use appropriate independent instruments to verify the key dimensions and follow the product instructions and local regulations.
Privacy Policy Link
https://telegra.ph/Olvvex-Privacy-Policy-11-24
Terms Of Service Link
https://telegra.ph/Olvvex-Terms-of-Service-11-24
EULA Link
https://telegra.ph/Olvvex-End-User-License-Agreement-11-24

name: Om: Mantra & Mala Japa Counter
description:
Close your eyes. Stay with the Name.

Japa is a quiet helper for chanting on a mala. Chant aloud and Japa listens on your iPhone. A soft buzz in your hand marks each chant and a bell marks each full mala, so your mind can rest on the mantra, not on the beads.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a mantra. Pick one of twelve well-loved mantras, written in their own script and in English letters, or add your own in any language.
2. Chant it three times so Japa learns your voice. Or skip, and count by tap.
3. Close your eyes and chant.

Counting by tap for now? Japa learns your voice from your taps, and Voice turns on by itself when it is ready.

WHAT YOU GET
• Voice or tap, in any language
• A ring that turns green when Japa hears you clearly, amber when it is less sure, and red when it cannot hear you well
• A soft buzz for each chant. Choose how strong, or add a small chime
• A bell at the end of each mala
• Home: every mala you have ever chanted, today's malas and your days in a row
• Choose which mantras add up on Home
• A calendar of every day of your practice
• Your chant on the Lock Screen. Press +1 to count without unlocking
• If Japa cannot hear you, a soft tone tells you to tap
• Silent during phone calls. Your taps still count
• Finish always asks first, and your chants are saved
• A daily reminder
• Widgets, Control Center, the Action Button and Siri
• Works at the largest text size, and with VoiceOver

GOOD TO KNOW
Voice works best in a fairly quiet room. A very short mantra, such as "Om" on its own, is easier to count by tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your voice is heard on your iPhone and is never recorded or sent anywhere. Your mantras and history stay on your phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.

PRICE
Free for a month. Then $0.99 a month or $7.99 a year. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Cancel anytime in your iPhone's Settings. Your history stays either way.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://japa.obraup.com/privacy

Japa needs an iPhone with iOS 26 or later.

Om. Begin when you are ready.

name: Omari - Explore
description:
Omari Yard is a sorting game built around one machine: a magnet claw hanging over a toy scrap yard. Drag the claw along its rail, tap the power button, and nearby pieces snap onto the magnet. Tap again to let go - everything you grabbed drops as one load, so plan the grab before you lift.

Every piece is a circle, a square, or a triangle, and each bin accepts only its own shape. Carry your load past beams without bumping them, release over the matching bin, and wrong drops wait in a rework slot. Each finish earns up to three gears: one for clearing the yard, one for no misdrops, one for staying within the optimal grab count.

- Recycle Yard - 40 built-in levels adding beams, stacks, multi-piece grabs and tighter grab budgets.
- Builder - start from five rack templates, place pieces and drag beams, then win one playthrough to save your challenge.
- Specimen Box - keep before-and-after photo records of your own toy sortings, compared side by side or with a slider.
- Settings - toggle haptics or reduced motion.

name: On Point Pro
description:
On Point Pro is the field-operations app for Albakio's sales and marketing teams. Plan your day, record every school visit, claim expenses and stay in touch with your team, all from one app.

• Attendance: clock in and out, and see your monthly attendance at a glance
• School visits: log visits with purpose, notes and photos, and review your full visit history
• Expenses: submit claims with receipts and track approvals
• Distance: see daily and monthly distance travelled during field work
• Performance: track visits, samples and working days
• Saved schools: keep your regular schools one tap away
• Notifications and team chat: instant alerts on approvals and visits

Accounts are issued by your administrator. Location is used only during your working day, for attendance and visit verification.

name: ON TIME Staff
description:
ON TIME is the attendance app for the staff of Flare Technical Services (Flaretech) and Gas Needs in the UAE. It is for company staff only: logins are created by the company office, and there is no public sign-up.

Staff can clock in and out at their site, see their attendance calendar, hours and overtime, ask the office to fix a missed clock-in or clock-out, and get shift reminders and office messages. Clock-ins and clock-outs made without signal are saved and sent when the signal is back.

Drivers start their shift with their vehicle and record who boards and where each person is dropped, morning and evening.

name: Ondi: Offline Music Player
description:
Ondi plays the music you already own — from your own folders, on Mac, iPhone and iPad.

Point it at a folder and it builds a library from the tags in your files. Put that folder in iCloud Drive and the same library appears on every device, with your stars, play counts and playlists kept in step.

YOUR FILES, WHERE THEY ARE
• Add any folder: on the device, in iCloud Drive, on an external drive
• Nothing is imported or converted — Ondi reads your files in place
• Changes in a folder are picked up automatically
• Rename, move or retag a file and it keeps its stars and play counts
• Edit titles, artists, albums, years and covers — saved into the files themselves

ONE LIBRARY ON EVERY DEVICE
• Library, stars, play counts and playlists sync through your private iCloud
• Listening on two devices at once adds up instead of overwriting
• Music that is only in iCloud shows up in your library and downloads when you play it
• On iPhone and iPad, choose what to keep offline: everything, or just your starred tracks, playlists and chosen albums

BUILT FOR LISTENING
• Gapless playback
• MP3, AAC, Apple Lossless, FLAC, WAV and AIFF
• ReplayGain
• Queue, shuffle and repeat
• Lock Screen and Control Center controls, media keys, AirPlay
• Picks up where you left off

FIND ANYTHING
• Search as you type across artists, albums and tracks
• Accents and letter case do not matter
• Type Cyrillic names in Latin letters: "kino" finds Кино

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your library is stored in your own iCloud, not on our servers

Ondi does not stream or sell music and does not use your Apple Music library. It plays audio files you have.

name: One Day, One Light
description:
One verse a day. Two languages. One family reading together.

One Day, One Light gives you one carefully chosen Bible verse each day, and lets you read it in two languages, one right above the other. Parents read in their first language, children in English, and the whole family stays on the same verse.

TWO LANGUAGES, SIDE BY SIDE
• Choose any two: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Simplified Chinese or Traditional Chinese
• The verse, its short note, the full chapter and your share images all appear in both languages; turn on the devotional in both too
• Made for bilingual families and multilingual churches, and for anyone learning a language through Scripture they already love

FEW, AND CHOSEN WITH CARE
• About 365 verses, each chosen by hand. No endless feed
• Pick a mood (Anxiety & Peace, Weary & Rested, Gratitude & Praise, and more) and most daily verses will speak to it
• Every verse comes with a short note and a devotional you can read in a minute
• Special verses and greetings for 16 Christian holidays, from Christmas to Easter

QUIET BY DESIGN
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• A gentle daily reminder. No streaks, no pressure
• Save favorites and share beautiful verse images
• Works fully offline; favorites sync across your devices with iCloud
• No ads, no account, no data collected

PRO: PAY ONCE, KEEP IT FOREVER
• Choose several moods at once
• Large widget, tap ↻ for another verse, and a different mood and theme for each widget
• 10 themes, including Green Pastures and Church Year, which changes color with the seasons of the church
• Look back at any past day’s verse and devotional
• Up to 3 reminder times a day
• Family Sharing supported. No subscription.

Bible texts: World English Bible, Chinese Union Version, Reina-Valera 1909, Bíblia Livre, Louis Segond 1910 and Luther 1912, all public domain or openly licensed.

name: One Dollar Shop
description:
One Dollar Shop is a small, quiet catalog. Everything in it costs either $1.00 or $10.00 — that is the entire price list.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• 18 everyday items across home, accessories and apparel, split into $1 Picks and $10 Picks
• Category browsing in a plain single-column list — no carousels, no banners, no countdown timers
• product pages with one large photo, the price, and up to five plain facts such as size, material and care
• a cart that keeps your items between launches, and checkout in three short screens
• saved addresses, order history and cancellation, all inside the app
• English and Chinese, light and dark mode

WHY IT LOOKS LIKE THIS
A shop does not have to shout. The background is matte paper, the icons are single-colour line drawings, and prices always keep the same size and weight. Nothing blinks, and nothing moves unless you touch it.

ABOUT THIS VERSION
This release is a browsing and ordering catalog. Items can be added to the cart, and orders can be placed and reviewed. Payment is not handled inside the app: tapping Pay opens the Alipay app when it is installed, and otherwise offers a shortcut to install it.

name: One Island
description:
One Island brings the Isle of Man's everyday information and services together in one clear place.

Stay informed
- Local news from Isle of Man publishers
- Official public notices
- Weather for the island
- Road closures, roadworks and travel disruption

Get around
- Request a taxi from a participating, locally licensed driver, see the fare before you confirm, and follow the vehicle on the way
- Plan bus journeys and see where the bus is while you wait
- Ferry sailing status and disruption
- Flight arrivals, departures and Ronaldsway Airport status

Discover more
- Events and activities across the island
- Places to visit, eat and spend the day

Alerts
- Optional notifications for travel updates, notices and other information you choose
- Change what you receive at any time in Settings

For licensed taxi drivers
- Sign up in the same app, complete onboarding, and go on duty to take trips
- Precise location is shared with dispatch and passengers only while you are on duty, including when the app is in the background

Clearly sourced
Important information shows where it came from and when it was last checked, so you can see whether something is live, scheduled, officially sourced or submitted by an organiser.

Built on the Isle of Man
One Island is built and operated on the Isle of Man by One Island Limited, for residents, visitors and island businesses.

A free One Island account is needed to use the main features of the app. You can also use One Island on the web at https://app.oneisland.im.

Questions or feedback: support@oneisland.im

name: One More Clue
description:
A chair is empty after the last performance. Two halls held the same tribute. Six messages explain why Ada could have been at either one. You can open one more source. Which will you choose?

One More Clue is a collection of short, original detective stories. Read the six messages, weigh two accounts, then open a voicemail, a timestamp or a deleted draft. Pick your theory and the fact that rules out the other explanation. Every source can prove the answer, but each asks you to think a different way.

Each mystery includes a full explanation and an ending. Revisit a finished case to try another source. Your casebook keeps your first verdict.

Three mysteries are free. A one-time Season One purchase opens ten additional cases. All thirteen are included in the download. Play offline, read complete transcripts of every voicemail and take as long as you like. No timers, accounts, ads or paid hints.

name: One Small Bulb: Rocket Climb
description:
The moon burned out. Somebody has to change the bulb.

You're the neighborhood handyman, so you bolt legs onto your boiler, grab a spare bulb, and launch. Drag to aim, release to fire, and hold while flying to thrust that way. Every rooftop, crane, cloud, balloon and space station between your house and the moon is a place to land, and you have to land soft and straight, because you're carrying glass.

ONE CLIMB, NO CHECKPOINTS
It's one continuous climb from your roof to the moon. Where you land is where you launch next. Miss, and you fall past everything you climbed. Close the app and your spot is saved. The spot before you fell is not.

ONE FINGER
Drag, release, hold. That's the whole control scheme. The physics does the rest, and the physics is not on your side.

TEN ZONES, 5,300 M
Rooftops, a construction site, low clouds, airline routes, weather balloons, the high sky, meteors, satellites, a space station, and finally the moon. The rooftop cat swats you off if you stand still too long.

MOM IS ON THE RADIO
She wants to know when the boiler is coming back. And the broken bulbs are coming out of your allowance.

FALLING IS HALF THE SHOW
The pilot cam reacts before you do, the neighbors hold up scorecards, and the scream gets longer with every meter. Big falls come with a replay.

No ads. No in-app purchases. Buy once, play to the moon. Works offline.

name: One Tap Pickleball
description:
One Tap Pickleball makes organizing a regular game painless, and keeping score of any game effortless.

Your organizer invites you by text or email. Open the app and tell them in one tap whether you're Playing, Maybe, or Not playing. No group-chat scrolling, no spreadsheets, no "who's coming?"

SEE WHO'S IN
Every game shows the time, place, notes, and who has said they're playing, with just first names and last initials. If a game fills up, you're put on the waitlist and moved up automatically when a spot opens.

KEEP SCORE OF ANY GAME
Open the Score tab, tap Start a game, and type who's playing. No event needed. Tap a team's big plus button for every point. Made a mistake? Undo it. Game point and win-by-two are shown as you play, and you get a full score history.

ON YOUR WRIST TOO
The Apple Watch app opens your live match automatically. Tap a team to add a point and feel a small buzz. Undo and Finish are right there. Your watch signs in through your iPhone, so there's nothing to type.

BUILT FOR REAL GAMES
- Quick, simple sign-in with a one-time code sent to your phone or email
- Your sign-in is stored securely on your device
- You can delete your account any time from inside the app

FOR ORGANIZERS
If you run a group, an Organize tab appears after you sign in. Create games, send invitations, manage your player list, and set up courts and rotations, all from your phone.

name: OnlyPlans PoV
description:
OnlyPlans PoV takes a drawing from OnlyPlans onto site. Choose a project, a drawing and a page, show where you are standing on the plan, and the page lies on the floor around you at its real size, with every door, camera and device standing where the design puts it.

For a security designer or installer on a site walk:

- See the design in place. Through the camera on an iPhone or iPad that tracks the room, the plan lies on the real floor. On any other device, walk through it on the screen.
- Find each item. Each door's devices stand as tiles at the height they usually go: card readers, exit buttons, door contacts, locks, etc.
- Record a site survey. Tick or cross each door and each of its devices, and add a note where something needs fixing. Every tick, cross and note is saved on the device at once and sent when there is a connection, so a basement with no signal loses nothing.
- Get there. A path along the drawing's walls leads to the item you choose, and a small map shows where you are.
- Keep the plan lined up. If it drifts, stand at an item and say so, and the plan moves back to it. Adjust turns, raises and lowers it by hand, and Plan sets how strongly it shows.
- Share the result. Export a survey's report as a spreadsheet to send on, and the office sees the checks in OnlyPlans as they arrive.

The app opens only after the device's own unlock (Face ID, Touch ID or the passcode). The camera is used only to place the plan on the floor: its picture stays on the device and is never kept or sent.

OnlyPlans PoV needs an OnlyPlans account. Your firm's administrator gives you access in OnlyPlans; there is no sign-up and nothing to buy in the app. Only people who can run drawings in OnlyPlans record surveys; others can look round and read them.

name: OnTime HRMS
description:
OnTime HRMS adalah solusi manajemen sumber daya manusia (HRM) terintegrasi berbasis cloud yang dirancang untuk mempermudah operasional dan produktivitas perusahaan modern.

Fitur Unggulan OnTime HRMS:
• Presensi & Kehadiran Online: Absensi real-time berbasis validasi GPS (geofencing) dan verifikasi biometrik wajah (Face Recognition).
• Manajemen Lembur & Izin: Pengajuan dan persetujuan lembur, cuti, serta tukar shift secara instan langsung dari aplikasi.
• Pemantauan Lapangan (Live Tracking): Memastikan koordinasi dan pelacakan posisi tim lapangan berjalan transparan dan akurat selama jam kerja.
• Manajemen Tugas & Aktivitas: Pantau penugasan harian dan laporkan bukti pekerjaan (activity evidence) secara terstruktur.
• Pengajuan Dana & Klaim (Fund Request): Kemudahan pengajuan anggaran operasional hingga pelaporan pertanggungjawaban (LPJ).
• Riwayat & Slip Gaji (Payroll): Akses riwayat pembayaran dan unduh slip gaji digital dengan aman kapan pun dibutuhkan.
• Log Kendaraan Operasional: Pengajuan peminjaman kendaraan kantor serta pencatatan odometer keberangkatan dan kepulangan.

Optimalkan pengelolaan tenaga kerja Anda dengan sistem yang transparan, aman, dan efisien bersama OnTime HRMS.

name: OpenCode -Client
description:
OpenCode Client is an unofficial native iPhone and iPad client for OpenCode, the open-source coding agent that runs on your own computer or server.

When your agent gets stuck, OpenCode Client helps you resolve it from your phone:

• Inbox-first: approvals, working sessions, and recent sessions in one place
• Approve from a notification or Live Activity
• Pair by scanning an OpenCode QR code
• Multi-server: LAN, Tailscale, and HTTPS servers in one inbox
• Review diffs and leave line comments
• Browse files, search, and preview syntax-highlighted code
• Face ID app lock and offline cache

OpenCode Client is a client, not a hosted AI service. You need an OpenCode server running on your Mac or Linux machine. No account is required.

Tap "Try the demo" on the connection screen to explore the app without a server.

This app is unofficial and is not affiliated with the OpenCode project.

name: Orange Wedge
description:
Orange Wedge adalah perangkat manajemen bengkel lokal yang dirancang khusus untuk bengkel sepeda motor di Indonesia. Alat ini menyederhanakan proses pembuatan estimasi biaya (*quotation*), surat perintah kerja (*work order*), dan pelacakan pembayaran—sekaligus memberikan gambaran yang jelas mengenai keuntungan yang diperoleh, baik dari jasa pengerjaan maupun suku cadang.

Alur Kerja Menyeluruh: Estimasi Biaya → Surat Perintah Kerja → Pembayaran
Buat estimasi biaya sebelum memulai pengerjaan, atau langsung buat surat perintah kerja.

Templat Layanan & Paket Standar:
Terapkan biaya jasa dan suku cadang untuk layanan umum—seperti ganti oli, perawatan rem, atau servis rutin—dengan sekali klik.

Penetapan Harga Suku Cadang (Berbasis *Markup*):
Hitung harga secara otomatis dengan menambahkan persentase *markup* pada harga modal. Harga dapat disesuaikan secara manual dan dikunci; sistem akan menampilkan laba kotor dalam bentuk Rupiah (IDR) maupun persentase.

Berbagi via WhatsApp dengan Sekali Klik:
Kirim estimasi biaya, pengingat pembayaran, atau pemberitahuan layanan langsung kepada pelanggan melalui WhatsApp menggunakan templat yang tersedia.

Manajemen Pelanggan & Kendaraan:
Kelola profil pelanggan dan data untuk beberapa sepeda motor per pelanggan; dilengkapi fitur pemindaian kode QR untuk memasukkan nomor pelat kendaraan.

Pengingat Layanan & Pengambilan Kendaraan:
Atur jadwal janji temu, pemberitahuan lokal, dan tindak lanjut (*follow-up*) melalui WhatsApp.

Laporan Laba Kotor:
Pantau pendapatan (*omzet*) dan laba harian, mingguan, atau bulanan, dengan rincian penghasilan dari jasa pengerjaan dan suku cadang.

Fungsi *Offline* (Luring):
Data disimpan secara lokal di perangkat Anda—sangat cocok untuk bengkel dengan koneksi internet yang tidak stabil. Sistem ini menggunakan mata uang Rupiah (IDR) dan antarmuka dalam Bahasa Indonesia.

Fokus pada kebutuhan esensial: Dirancang untuk keperluan penagihan (*invoicing*) dan pembukuan harian, tanpa kerumitan manajemen inventaris yang kompleks, dukungan untuk banyak lokasi, penjadwalan staf yang rumit, atau pembuatan faktur pajak resmi.

name: Orbit Team Workspace
description:
Orbit brings your team's work into one place: tasks, docs, chat, calls and dashboards, on your phone and on the web.

PLAN AND TRACK WORK
- Lists, boards and calendars for every project
- Statuses, priorities, due dates, subtasks and checklists
- My Work shows what is due today and what is overdue
- Custom fields, tags and time tracking

STAY IN SYNC
- Comments and mentions on every task
- An Inbox for everything that needs you, with push notifications
- Team chat and voice or video calls
- Docs and wikis that several people can edit at the same time

SEE PROGRESS
- Dashboards with charts of your team's work
- Goals, sprints and timesheets

BUILT FOR TEAMS
- Invite your team, set roles and keep private spaces private
- Sign in with an email code, no password to remember
- Delete your account any time from Settings

Orbit works with the Orbit web app, so everything you do on your phone is there on your computer too.

name: OrderCheck: Check Deliveries
description:
A delivery has arrived, and the bag, receipt, and order confirmation tell slightly different stories. OrderCheck gives you one place to sort them out.

Enter the quantities you ordered, were billed for, and received. See what you paid for but did not receive, and record substitutions so you can see their impact on the bill. Leave a received quantity blank while you are still checking. A confirmed zero means nothing arrived for that item.

Try the included groceries example before checking your own delivery.

Save one project with up to 12 entries for free. Lifetime is a one-time purchase that lets you save more projects, add more entries, and share reports. You can use the app offline without creating an account. To keep a backup, choose iCloud Drive or another location in Files.

name: OrgBnB: Stay with Colleagues
description:
OrgBnB is a home-sharing community for people who work at the same companies. You sign in with your work email, so the people whose homes you see, and who see yours, are colleagues.

Stay in a colleague's home
Browse homes shared by people at your company, from a weekend in another city to a longer stay. Pick your dates, check the price, and book in a few taps. OrgBnB adds no service fee to bookings: you pay the price the host set.

Swap homes for the same dates
When you and a colleague need each other's home at the same time, propose a direct swap: your home for theirs, on the same dates. A swap involves no money and no credits. It is confirmed when the other person accepts.

Earn and spend credits
Earn OrgBnB credits by listing your home (up to 150), inviting colleagues, and hosting colleagues who pay with credits. Spend them on stays at hosts who accept credits. One credit is worth about €1 of a stay. Credits can't be bought or cashed out.

Host your own home
Add photos, amenities, availability and a nightly price in euros, or €0 to host colleagues for free. Choose whether you accept credits, whether guests can pay you on arrival, and whether you're open to direct swaps. Card payments reach you through Stripe, and you stay in control of your calendar.

See homes on a map, with privacy built in
Explore listings on a map. Locations are shown approximately, offset by up to 150 meters. The exact address is only shared with guests who have a confirmed booking.

Talk to people before you stay
Message your host or guest inside the app, and leave a review after a stay so the next person knows what to expect.

How it works
1. Enter your work email. We send you a sign-in link, so there is no password to remember.
2. Browse homes at your company, or list your own.
3. Book with euros or credits, or propose a swap for the same dates.

Good to know
- You must be 18 or older and employed at a participating company.
- Payments are for physical stays only: in euros by card through Stripe, or to the host on arrival when they allow it.
- You can delete your account at any time from Profile.
- Questions? Write to support@orgbnb.com or use the chat in the app.

OrgBnB is a platform for members to host and stay with each other. Each stay is between the two members, and OrgBnB does not own or operate the homes listed.

name: Orion’s Space Adventure
description:
Orion is a farm kid on Nova X-12, a planet where farms, cars and buildings all float. One night, everything in the Milky Way goes dark. Spacecraft Nova calls it a malfunction. Orion sets out to find the truth.

Play 29 story missions across six chapters, each with its own gameplay:
• Catch crops at the Cyber Farm and climb to safety as the farm loses power
• Rewire the substation and track 54 moons as they flicker out
• Steer a falling space taxi down to a safe landing
• Tap out Morse code to call a friend for a ride home
• Win over Ravion, leader of the Rhyktors, and rally his army to the beat
• Fly into battle against Spacecraft Nova and face the Admiral

Earn stars, buy gear upgrades and unlock trophies. Then replay every mission in the harder Admiral Mode, or chase a high score in Krystal Rush.

Features
• Hand-drawn style art built for iPhone and iPad
• Original music and sound for every chapter
• Game Center leaderboards
• Easy Mode and left-handed controls
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account needed

Based on the short story “The Fascinating Spacecraft” by Maximilian Grand.

name: OrngPages: Skills & Shops
description:
OrngPages is India's online skill directory. Find verified skilled workers and local shops near you, and contact them directly by call or WhatsApp. No middleman and no commission on your job.

FOR CUSTOMERS
• Search any skill: electrician, plumber, carpenter, mechanic, mason, painter, tailor, maid, cook, nanny, driver, tutor, handicraft artisans and hundreds more
• See the nearest people first, using your location or PIN code, anywhere in India
• Call or WhatsApp directly and agree the price yourself
• Read ratings and reviews from real customers
• Find nearby shops and their offers: supermarkets, medical stores, garages, hardware, furniture and more
• Get notified about offers from shops near you (you choose how many a day)
• Safety tools: share your booking, emergency contact and SOS
• Use it in English or your own language, including Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali and more

FOR SKILLED WORKERS
• Create your free profile in minutes with your mobile number
• Get calls and WhatsApp messages from customers near you
• Earn the Orange Master skill certificate with top customer ratings
• Get guidance on government skill schemes and certification
• See how many people viewed your profile
• Open to job offers from shops and businesses if you want

FOR SHOPS AND SMALL BUSINESSES
• List your shop with photos, timings and directions
• Show "Online order available" and take orders on WhatsApp
• Send offers to customers within 5 km
• See views, calls and direction requests

Registration is free for workers, shops and businesses who join by 31 December 2026.

OrngPages is a product of Hidayah Technologies Private Limited, Bengaluru. Workers and shops are independent and set their own prices. OrngPages is not a government body; scheme guidance is for information.

name: Ortopedi Reyonu
description:
Ortopedi Reyonu ile ortopedik ürünleri telefonunuzdan inceleyin.

Varis çorapları, dizlikler, bel korseleri, boyunluklar, el ve ayak bileği destekleri ile diğer ürün kategorilerini tek bir yerde keşfedin. Kategori ve marka seçenekleriyle aradığınız ürünlere ulaşın; ürün bilgilerini ve mevcut seçenekleri inceleyin.

Ortopedi Reyonu'nun mobil mağazasında:
• Ürün, kategori veya marka arayabilirsiniz.
• Ortopedik destekler ve korseler gibi farklı ürün gruplarını inceleyebilirsiniz.
• Favoriler, sepet ve hesabım sayfalarına ulaşabilirsiniz.
• Sağlıklı Hareket Rehberi yazılarını okuyabilirsiniz.

name: Osevel
description:
Osevel is the second confirmation for AI agents that work on your databases.

Your team lets AI agents work on databases through Osevel. Most of what an agent does runs on its own. When an agent asks for something your rules call risky — a change on production, an irreversible step, many rows at once — Osevel stops and waits for a person. This app is where that person confirms.

HOW A CONFIRMATION WORKS
• You start the action in the Osevel panel on your computer. The panel shows a short code.
• Your iPhone gets a notification. Open the request and read what it will do: the agent, the database, the rule that stopped it, how many rows and tables, and the SQL when there is any.
• Type the panel's code, look at the phone for Face ID, then enter your app PIN. All three, every time.
• If something looks wrong, don't confirm. The request runs out on its own.

KEYS THAT STAY ON YOUR PHONE
• Your confirmation key is made in the iPhone's Secure Enclave and never leaves it. Osevel's servers never hold it.
• The app talks to your organisation's connector over its own end-to-end encrypted channel. Our cloud only passes the encrypted messages along.
• Notifications carry no content — only "Something waits for you to confirm." The details are fetched inside the app, after you unlock it.
• The app locks itself when it has been in the background.

SET UP IN A MINUTE
Open the Osevel panel on a computer, choose to enrol a phone, and scan the code it shows. Both screens then show the same 8-digit code; an admin of your organisation checks it and approves the phone.

ALSO IN THE APP
• Watch: your organisation's agents, databases, alerts and recent activity at a glance.
• Choose which alerts reach you; confirmation requests always do.
• Light and dark appearance, alternative app icons.

TRY IT FIRST
Tap "Try the demo first" on the welcome screen to walk through set-up and a confirmation on sample data. The demo never touches a real account or database.

WHAT YOU NEED
Osevel for iPhone works with an Osevel account and an organisation in the Osevel panel (osevel.com). It does not connect to a database by itself, and it cannot start actions — it only confirms the ones you started.

Privacy: no ads, no tracking, no analytics in the app. Privacy policy: https://osevel.com/privacy/

name: osmEmbroidery
description:
osmEmbroidery は、写真から刺繍データを作る iPad・iPhone アプリです。背景を切り抜いた写真を読み込み、色数や細かさを調整して、刺繍ソフトで開ける .cnd ファイルと色の対応表を書き出します。

書き出したデータは、刺繍ソフトの中で、色ごとの面（フィル）として選んで、縫い目の間隔や角度を直せます。写真をそのまま点の集まりにするのではなく、あとから編集しやすい形で渡すことを大切にしています。

■ 写真と寸法
・背景を透明にした PNG などを読み込みます
・仕上がりの幅と高さを mm で指定。比率を固定したまま幅だけ変えることもできます

■ 色
・色数を 2〜16 色から選び、写真を減色します
・色合いを「オリジナル」「セピア」「モノクロ」「ポップ」から選び、明るさと茶色みも調整できます
・色チップをタップすると、その色だけを好きな色に変えられます。塗り分けの形は変わりません
・縫う順番は「淡い色から」「濃い色から」「面積の大きい色から」のルールで並べ、ドラッグで入れ替えられます

■ 領域と重なり
・小さすぎる塊を外し、隣の色で埋めます
・オーバーラップ代：先に縫う色を、後から縫う色の下へ指定の幅だけ広げ、布の縮みで隙間が出にくくします。仕上がりの見た目は変わりません
・毛並みからべた塗りまで、縫う方向の目安を線で表示します。写真を長押しすると線を出したり隠したりできます

■ 縫い順の再生と動画
・縫う順番に沿って、領域ごとに塗っていく様子を再生します。一時停止、シーク、速度の切り替えができ、色替えの位置も表示します
・その様子を MP4 の動画として書き出せます

■ 書き出し
・刺繍ソフト用の .cnd ファイルと、色の順番と RGB をまとめた色の対応表（CSV）を書き出します
・フィルが多い写真は、ファイルを自動で分けます。各ファイルの先頭に同じ位置の小さな四角が入るので、刺繍ソフトで重ねて貼り合わせられます
・共有シートから、ファイル・メール・AirDrop などへ渡せます

■ コレクション
・作った作品を、写真と設定ごとコレクションに残せます。同じ写真で設定を変えた作品も別々に残せます
・一覧から作品を開いて、続きを作ったり書き出し直したりできます

■ 使いやすさ
・スライダーの数値を長押しすると、テンキーで数値を直接入力できます
・操作は「元に戻す」「やり直す」で行き来できます
・背景は白と黒から選べます。写真の色と被らず、見やすい方を選んでください
・閉じても作業は端末に残り、次に開くと続きから始められます
・iPad を横にすると写真と調整を横に並べて表示します。iPhone と縦の iPad では写真を大きく表示し、調整は別の画面で行います（iPhone は縦の画面で使います）

■ iCloud Drive（任意）
・設定でオンにすると、作業（写真と設定）とコレクションを自分の iCloud Drive に置き、同じ Apple ID の別の端末で続きができます

■ プライバシー
・ユーザー登録不要。広告・アクセス解析・トラッキングはありません
・減色や書き出しの計算はすべて端末の中で行います。AI やクラウドでの処理は使いません
・写真や作業を開発者のサーバーへ送ることはありません。端末の外に出るのは、ご自身が共有したファイルと、オンにしたときのご自身の iCloud Drive だけです

※ 糸のメーカーや糸番号は扱いません。糸は刺繍ソフトの側で当ててください。
※ 書き出したファイルを開くには、.cnd 形式に対応した刺繍ソフトが必要です。

name: Øtâf
description:
Øtâf suit vos livres de la première idée à la vie en librairie, avec les contrats et l’argent qui vont avec. Faite par un auteur de bande dessinée, pour les auteurices de BD et de romans.

DE L’IDÉE AU LIVRE
• Idées et post-it, dossier de présentation, démarchage des éditeurs
• Scénario de BD ou chapitres de roman, storyboard
• Planning, rythme réel et date de fin estimée

LES CONTRATS À LA LOUPE
• Avance, échéancier, taux, cessions : Øtâf repère ce qui manque ou ce qui coince
• Rencontres et dédicaces payées, avec Chorus Pro pour le secteur public
• Bourses du CNL et autres aides, du dossier au versement

L’ARGENT, SANS SAISIE EN DOUBLE
• Ce qui est à facturer et ce qui est attendu, avec ou sans Indy
• Relevés de droits vérifiés avec votre contrat, ventes estimées avec Filéas
• Votre carrière en chiffres, année après année

AVEC VOTRE MAISON ET VOTRE BUDGET
• Si votre maison utilise Øtâf-Éditeurices, vous choisissez ce qu’elle voit ; elle vous envoie ses dates, ses paiements, le BAT et ses relevés
• Reliée à BAA, l’appli de budget des artistes-auteurices, par un dossier de votre iCloud Drive : chaque avance prévue arrive dans vos prévisions, et ce qui est arrivé sur votre compte revient coché
• Où en est le livre : une page en PDF pour votre éditeur ou votre coloriste, sans l’argent ni le contrat

VOS DONNÉES RESTENT À VOUS
• Pas de compte, pas de publicité, pas de pistage, pas de serveur
• Votre bibliothèque est un fichier dans votre iCloud Drive, à jour sur iPhone, iPad et Mac
• Rappels programmés sur l’appareil, calendrier « Øtâf » tenu à jour
• Sur un ordinateur emprunté, ouvrez votre fichier le temps d’une séance : rien n’y reste

Øtâf est gratuite. Le site otaf.sebastienvassant.com reste ouvert pour les PC et Android.

name: Otterly: Photo Cleaner
description:
Otterly turns cleaning your photo library into a game you actually want to play.

Swipe through your photos one at a time with Otterly the otter by your side: left to delete, right to keep, up to save as a favorite. Every photo you go through earns XP – the same whatever you choose – so you level up, keep your streak and unlock badges.

CLEAN YOUR WAY
• Month by month, newest or largest first
• Smart piles: screenshots, screen recordings, videos and On This Day
• Find duplicates, blurry and very dark photos with an on-device scan
• Duplicate groups one at a time – keep the best with one tap

A FRIENDLY OTTER
• Otterly reacts to what you do and celebrates your progress
• Daily goal, streaks, levels and badges keep you going
• Relaxing sounds and music, with full control in Settings

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your photos never leave your iPhone – nothing is uploaded
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Nothing is deleted until you confirm, first in Otterly and then in Apple's own dialog. Deleted photos stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.

FREE TO TRY
Go through as many photos as you like for free and delete up to 100. Otterly Premium unlocks unlimited deletions – monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Need just a few more? Buy 200 extra deletions.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your iPhone Settings.

name: OurRemote: Wi-Fi TV Remote
description:
OurRemote is a Wi-Fi remote for the television you already own. It lets you use your phone to control Google TV and Android TV devices on your home Wi-Fi. It is not a streaming service and has no channels or programmes of its own. It is not connected with any streaming service or channel provider.

It finds your TV on the same Wi-Fi automatically, or you enter its IP address. Pair once with the code shown on your TV.

Use the d-pad and OK, Back, Home, and the keyboard. Playback buttons are Play/Pause, Rewind, Fast forward and Replay. There is also Power, Mute, volume up and down, and channel up and down. Power is a toggle and does not promise to turn a TV on. Power, volume and channel work only where your TV supports them.

The app talks to your TV on your home network. You don't need a Google account, and you don't create an OurRemote account.

If you change Wi-Fi or the connection drops, the app tries to reconnect and explains what to try if it can't.

The basic remote is free. No account needed.

Free to use. Optional Pro, by subscription or a one-time purchase, adds more TVs and themes.

Your TV's name and connection details stay on your phone, and NqApps doesn't receive them. There are no ads and no analytics. Purchases are handled by Apple.

OurRemote uses the remote feature built into Google TV and Android TV devices. If a TV software update changes that feature, the app or some buttons may stop working until we update it.

Works with TVs and streaming devices that run Google TV™ or Android TV™ OS and are on the same Wi-Fi as your phone. Pair once with the code shown on your TV. Not for Roku, Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS) or Fire TV.

OurRemote is an independent app made by NqApps. It is not an official Google app and is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Google LLC. Google TV, Android TV and Android are trademarks of Google LLC. Other names are trademarks of their owners.

OurRemote Pro is optional. Choose OurRemote Pro Monthly, OurRemote Pro Yearly (with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers), or a one-time OurRemote Pro purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://naushadqamarz.github.io/ourremote/terms/
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://naushadqamarz.github.io/ourremote/privacy/

name: Out of Bed: Mission Alarm
description:
Out of Bed is an alarm clock that keeps ringing until you are up. To stop it, finish a short mission: solve a few sums, shake the phone, type a sentence, walk some steps or scan a barcode in another room.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set an alarm and pick its mission.
• When it rings, tap Start mission and do it. While you work on the mission the sound gets quieter, and it gets loud again if you stop.
• Slide to stop on the lock screen and it rings again 15 seconds later, until the mission is done.
• Alarms ring on Silent and in Focus, even when the app is closed.

FREE
• Unlimited alarms
• Math (easy and medium), Shake and Type missions
• Three alarm sounds
• Your mornings: when you got up and how fast

PRO, ONE PAYMENT
• No ads
• Walk, Scan and Memory missions, and hard math
• Seven more sounds, or a sound file of your own
• Wake-up check: one more ring a few minutes after the mission, in case you fell back asleep
You can also watch one ad to open all of Pro, with no ads, for a day.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Out of Bed needs iOS 26 or later (it uses iPhone's alarm system).
• An alarm nobody answers stops after 15 minutes. You can change this in Settings.
• After 3 minutes on a mission, you can switch to math.

name: Out of Body: Astral Guide
description:
Travel beyond, safely.

Out of Body is a gentle five-step guide to astral voyaging — free, with no sign-up and nothing to buy. Everything happens calmly, at your own pace, in the privacy of your own room.

A FIVE-STEP PATH

1. Welcome — arrive, breathe, and read a word from the maker of the journey.
2. Understand — what astral projection is, and how the app guides your body into deep relaxation while your mind stays gently awake.
3. Protect — a peaceful invocation, calling on Archangel Michael's blue protective light and Archangel Raphael's emerald-green healing light, so you begin from love, never fear.
4. Relax — a guided sequence that lets the body fall asleep: settle in, breath awareness, a head-to-toe scan, heavy and light, and a gentle intention.
5. Journey — a soft voice guides you for five minutes, then three hours of slow binaural sound carry you into the voyage.

THE THREE-HOUR JOURNEY

Stage 1, Settle (7–9 Hz, the first 30 minutes): your guide speaks, then the sound takes over. Body softens, mind slows.

Stage 2, Voyage (4–7 Hz, 30–150 minutes): theta, the dreamlike threshold — body asleep, mind gently awake.

Stage 3, Deep rest (3–4 Hz, 150–180 minutes): slow, spacious rest. Nothing to do but let yourself sleep.

DESIGNED TO BE GENTLE

The journey ends with a long, quiet fade — no wake-up voice, no chime, nothing to startle you. A soft reminder helps you stay completely still before you begin. Plug in your phone, turn on Do Not Disturb, and let the audio keep playing, even with the screen locked.

FOR THE BEST EXPERIENCE

Use earphones, so the brainwave audio reaches each ear clearly. Choose a quiet space where no one will disturb you. An eye mask helps.

Out of Body works entirely on your device. There is no account, no sign-up, and no data collection — simply begin, and travel softly.

name: OutcomeLoom Probability
description:
Turn explicit outcome weights into a complete distribution of independent sums.

OutcomeLoom is a focused workbench for finite integer outcomes. Keep the weights you entered, combine saved models, examine every result value, and freeze an explainable report. It does not invent probabilities from outside data or treat a model as a prediction.

BUILD REUSABLE WEIGHTED MODELS
Create named models with a unit label, optional notes and up to64 rows. Give each integer outcome a positive relative weight. Duplicate outcomes are combined for calculation while the original rows remain in the saved input. Search, edit, duplicate or delete your models; sample models are loaded only when you choose them.

COMBINE INDEPENDENT TERMS
Add1–4 saved model terms with matching unit labels. Repeating a model means independent identically distributed draws. Sparse convolution merges equal sum values at each stage and keeps the complete probability mass. A bounded calculation is rejected if it is too large; tails are never silently discarded and a random simulation is never substituted.

INSPECT NUMBERS, NOT JUST A CHART
See a discrete probability plot or cumulative view alongside the complete sorted PMF/CDF table. Inspect the mean, variance, support and probability-update work. Query inclusive P(X≤k), a closed interval P(a≤X≤b), or the lower quantile—the smallest supported outcome whose CDF reaches your probability. The editable practice pair gives outcomes1,2,3 with probabilities0.125,0.5,0.375; mean2.25 and variance0.4375.

FREEZE AND EXPORT
A named report deep-copies each input model, original rows and revision together with the full result. Later model changes or deletion cannot rewrite it. Search or rename reports, inspect thresholds again, and share real whole-table CSV or paginated PDF files. About offers an actual JSON library backup, validated restore and explicit local erase.

CLEAR BOUNDARIES
Input integer outcomes−1000…1000, positive integer weights1…1000000,1–64 rows/model,1–4 terms, up to8192 result values and200000 probability updates.32 models,100 reports and a16 MiB library. Computation uses Double precision. Units are explicit labels with no conversion; correlation, continuous fitting, MonteCarlo simulation and real-world prediction are outside the scope.

Core modelling works locally. No App account, advertising or in-app purchase is required. You control exported files, system sharing and device backups.

name: Outdays: Activity Weather
description:
Don't check the weather. Know when to go.

You can't change the weather. But you can change your day.

Outdays turns the forecast into answers for the things you love doing outside. Running, surfing, hiking, cycling, walking the dog, a backyard BBQ or a weekend road trip. Choose your activities and discover when to go, how long favorable conditions will last and why.

Less forecasting. More living.

YOUR WEATHER, YOUR WAY

• See your next good outdoor window the moment you open the app.
• Know which days are Good, Possible or Not today for your activities.
• Understand why, with temperature, wind, rain, sky and other conditions checked against your preferences.
• Choose from dozens of ready-made activities or describe your own in a sentence.
• Fine-tune what good weather means to you.

FIND THE GOOD IN A BAD WEATHER DAY

• Escape Window: Rain all day? Not necessarily. Discover breaks in unfavorable weather that you might otherwise miss.
• Chase the Sun: Find nearby places where conditions look better for your activity.
• Weekend Drop: Discover your best outdoor opportunities for the upcoming weekend.
• Rare Moments: Catch promising sunsets, rainbow opportunities and remarkable night skies.

JUST ASK

"Can I surf tomorrow?"
"When should I walk my dog?"
"What's the best day for a hike?"
"Can I drive to Los Angeles this weekend?"

Get straightforward answers based on your forecast and activity preferences. worded by Apple Intelligence on supported iPhones, including Apple's Private Cloud Compute. Official 
 warnings always come first. Official warnings always come first


MAKE OUTSIDE HAPPEN

• Together: Find a time that works for your friends and make an outdoor plan.
• Plan Something: Add an outing and get a heads-up if forecast conditions become unfavorable.
• Activity alerts: Get notified before a good weather window opens.
• Road trips: See weather along your route, potential hazards and better departure times.

MORE THAN JUST TEMPERATURE

Explore surf swell height and period, tides, water temperature, air quality, nearby activity spots and road conditions, where supported.

Safety comes first. Official weather warnings override activity recommendations, and supporting scientific sources are available within the app.

DISCOVER YOUR OUTSIDE DNA

How many good days did you get outside? What activities define you? When are your best outdoor hours?

Explore your activity patterns, streaks and personal Outside DNA. Optionally connect Apple Health to combine workout and walking data with your outdoor weather history.

A LITTLE WEATHER GOES A LONG WAY

Home and Lock Screen widgets, countdowns to favorable conditions, morning summaries, customizable reminders and optional calendar integration help you make more of your day.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account. No ads. No analytics. No tracking.

Your activities and history stay on your device and in your personal iCloud. Apple Health data stays on your iPhone.

OUTDAYS FREE

One activity of your choice, personalized recommendations, alerts, reminders, official warnings, a Home Screen widget and surf swell at one spot. Explore the full seven-day forecast during your first week, then continue with today's outlook. Includes three condition changes, one Ask question and one Escape Window sample.

OUTDAYS PRO

Unlock unlimited activities, full seven-day forecasts, unlimited fine-tuning, Ask, Escape Window, Weekend Drop, Chase the Sun, Together, monitored outings, Rare Moments, Insights, Outside DNA, nearby places, road trips, marine conditions, Apple Health, calendar integration, Lock Screen countdowns and morning summaries.

Available as a monthly or yearly subscription. Cancel anytime.

Life happens outside. Outdays helps you make more of it.

Weather data: Apple Weather.
Marine data: NOAA.
Air quality: EPA AirNow and participating federal, state, local and tribal air agencies (preliminary data).

Terms of Use: https://hashsecure.us/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hashsecure.us/privacy

name: OverlayCam: Before & After
description:
OverlayCam helps you take before-and-after photos from the same spot and the same angle.

Guided back to the spot
- Take your before photo in the app and it remembers the space around you, the phone's angle and your location.
- From a distance, a big arrow shows how far and which way to go. The taps get faster as you get closer.
- Up close, two crosshairs guide you. Move the white one onto the yellow one and a vibration tells you you're lined up.
- The level guide matches the phone's tilt too.

Compare and share
- Compare right after you shoot: touch and hold to see the before photo.
- Make a dated before-and-after image, side by side or top and bottom, and share it.

Many places
- Save as many places as you like and see every photo taken at each one.
- Or use an older photo from your library as the guide.

Also
- 3:4, 1:1 and 9:16 ratios, grid, adjustable opacity
- Take photos with a volume button.
- No account, ads or tracking. Your photos and location are never uploaded; they leave the app only when you share them.

Use it for fitness progress, woodwork, gardens, home makeovers or construction sites.

name: Overload: Antrenman Defteri
description:
Overload, spor salonunda not defterine yazdıklarını telefonda tutman için yapıldı: hangi hareketi yaptın, kaç set, kaç tekrar, kaç kilo. Sade bir defter gibi görünür, gerisini kendisi hesaplar.

PROGRAMINI KUR
Hazır şablonla başla (Tam vücut ya da Push / Pull / Legs) veya kendi günlerini yaz. Yapacağın hareketleri favorilere ekle; program kurarken önce onlar çıkar, birkaçını birden seçebilirsin.

ANTRENMANDA
Kilo ve tekrarlar bir önceki antrenmandan hazır gelir. Seti bitirince işaretle, dinlenme sayacı kendiliğinden başlar. Her hareketin altında geçen seferki setlerin yazar.

HAREKET KÜTÜPHANESİ
Serbest ağırlık, makine ve kablo hareketleri: her birinin hareketi gösteren bir çizimi, nasıl yapıldığı ve dikkat etmen gerekenler kısaca yazılı. Kütüphanede olmayan bir aleti kendin ekleyip salondaki makinenin fotoğrafını çekebilirsin.

İLERLEME
Her hareket için tahmini 1RM grafiği ve en ağır setin. Haftalık özette antrenman, set ve toplam yük sayısı, geçen haftayla karşılaştırma ve yeni rekorların görünür.

TARTI VE VÜCUT AĞIRLIĞI
Xiaomi Mi Smart Scale 2 kullanıyorsan tartıya çıkman yeterli: Overload ölçümü Bluetooth üzerinden okur ve kaydeder. Kiloyu elle de girebilir, Apple Sağlık'tan alabilir ya da Sağlık'a yazabilirsin.

GİZLİLİK
Hesap yok, reklam yok, takip yok. Tüm kayıtlar yalnızca telefonunda tutulur; Overload internete veri göndermez.

Tamamen ücretsizdir. Uygulama içi satın alma yoktur.

name: OW Production
description:
OW Production helps farm teams record harvest production in the field, including when the connection is unavailable.

RECORD EACH HARVEST
Choose the date and plantation, enter small, medium and large caisson counts, and see the estimated weight. Add a delivery note (BL), receiving client and optional notes.

FIND THE RIGHT PLANTATION
Browse your farm, block, sector and greenhouse hierarchy using reference data synchronized from your organization.

WORK OFFLINE
After signing in and synchronizing reference data online, save harvest entries on the device. Review pending and synchronized entries in the queue, then synchronize when a connection is available.

FOLLOW PRODUCTION
Review estimated kilos, caisson totals, production breakdowns and recent entries in the dashboard.

OW Production requires an existing OptiWare account and access to an organization. English and French interfaces are available. An internet connection is required for sign-in, initial reference-data synchronization and sending records to the main system.

name: Own Course
description:
Was ist dir wichtig, und was ist dein nächster Schritt? Mit Own Course hältst du persönliche Ziele fest, ordnest sie nach Priorität und verfolgst deinen Fortschritt im eigenen Tempo.

• Führe eine priorisierte Zielliste und eine Bucket List.
• Halte nächste Schritte, Zwischenziele, Termine und Notizen fest.
• Wiederhole deine Zielsätze in der Morgenroutine und nutze lokale Erinnerungen.
• Schaue in „Mein Weg“ zurück und nutze geführte Übungen unter „Für mich“.
• Sichere deine Einträge bei Bedarf als private JSON-Datei.

Own Course ist kostenlos und werbefrei. Die Kernfunktionen sind offline nutzbar.

name: OWN IT by Flaretech
description:
OWN IT is the staff app for Flare Technical Services LLC and Gas Needs in the UAE. It is for company employees only. Accounts are added by the company, and there is no public sign-up.

name: P.S. Notes
description:
A little note every morning, from someone who loves you.

P.S. is for two people. One writes. The other reads.

You write a note and seal it for a morning. That morning they find an envelope, open it, and a pen writes the note out in front of them, stroke by stroke. It can sign it, too, with a signature you draw yourself.

A NOTE CAN WAIT FOR ITS MOMENT

• For a morning: sealed tonight, there when they wake.
• For a place: left at the grocery store, it finds them when they get there.
• For a sky: one that waits for the first snow, or for rain.
• For a feeling: "open when you can't sleep". It stays in the drawer until they decide it is time.
• For the two of you: one that opens only when you are in the same room.

AN ENVELOPE CAN HOLD MORE THAN WORDS

• A song, which arrives as a cassette with the label in handwriting. Tap it and it plays in Spotify.
• A photograph, which arrives as an instant picture and develops while they watch.
• A poem, on a scrap torn out of a notebook.
• A P.S., which turns up an hour after the note is opened.

AND SOME ARE READ DIFFERENTLY

• Behind fogged glass, which clears when they breathe on the phone.
• On a walk, one word for every step.
• In mirror writing, to hold up to the glass.
• Written in a hurry, or with all the time in the world.

QUIET BY DESIGN

No feed, no streaks, no points. One envelope in the morning, and a drawer of the ones that are waiting.

Everything the app can ask permission for is optional, and off until you turn its feature on. Your phone notices places and weather by itself: where you are is never sent to us. The microphone only measures how loud a breath is, and nothing is recorded.

You sign in with Apple and invite the person you want to write to. You can write to more than one person; each has envelopes of their own, and none is shown anything about the others.

Deleting your account deletes everything you wrote or received.

Privacy: https://psnotes.app/privacy.html
Support: https://psnotes.app/support.html
