name: PaceGo: GPS Speedometer & HUD
description:
PaceGo is a GPS speedometer, head-up display and trip log that just works: no adverts, no subscriptions, no account, and it doesn't need an internet connection. Your location and your trips stay on your phone.

A SPEEDOMETER YOU CAN READ AT A GLANCE
• A clear dial or big digits, in mph, km/h, knots or m/s.
• Speed straight from your phone's GPS, updated every second and smoothed just enough. It reads zero when you stop, and says "GPS signal lost" instead of showing an old speed.
• Dials made for the trip: car, motorbike, bicycle, walk or run (with pace), boat (in knots) or other.
• Distance, time, average and top speed, altitude, heading and a clock.
• Light and dark themes, portrait or landscape, and the screen stays on.

SPEED ALERT
• Pick a limit from road-sign buttons or type your own.
• A chime, beeps or a soft tone, with a buzz, when you go over. Once, or every 10 or 30 seconds while you stay over, with an optional tolerance. It won't chatter when you drive right at the limit.

HEAD-UP DISPLAY (HUD)
• Lay your phone on the dashboard and read your speed reflected in the windscreen.
• Mirrored, full brightness, in green, cyan, white or amber; turns red over your limit.

TRIPS RECORDED PROPERLY
• Keeps recording with the screen off or another app open.
• Distance that doesn't creep up at traffic lights, tunnels bridged instead of lost, and a top speed that one glitchy reading can't set.
• A summary of every trip: the route drawn on screen, moving and total time, average and top speed (with the time you reached it), climb, time over your limit, and speed and altitude charts. Add a name and notes.
• Trips are saved as you go, so nothing is lost if your phone closes the app.
• Export a trip as GPX, KML or CSV, or your whole trip log as a spreadsheet for mileage records.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
PaceGo has no account and no adverts. It uses your location only to measure your speed and record your trips, and it never leaves your phone. Trips are included in your phone's own backup, and you can save a backup file wherever you like.

Please drive safely: set PaceGo up before you set off, and follow the road signs. GPS speed can differ from your vehicle's speedometer (car speedometers are made to read a little high), and PaceGo doesn't know local speed limits.

name: PacketMesa Inspector
description:
Inspect a saved packet capture without turning your phone into a capture tool.

PacketMesa reads supported classic PCAP files, keeps their original bytes and timestamps, and helps you select a traceable subset. See packet fields, follow directed flows, apply exact filters and export original record bytes with a CSV audit trail. It does not open sockets, sniff traffic or decrypt a stream.

READ THE ORIGINAL FILE
Import a classic PCAP2.4 Ethernet file from Files or explicitly create the synthetic practice capture. Inspect the full source SHA, byte order, microsecond/nanosecond resolution, snap length and actual record counts. Both little- and big-endian variants are supported. Timestamps retain their integer seconds and original fractional digits rather than being rounded through a floating clock.

LOOK THROUGH THE LAYERS
Browse packets by original index, protocol, addresses, captured/original lengths and decoding diagnostics. Inspect Ethernet MAC/type; IPv4 version, IHL, total length, flags, fragment offset, addresses and TTL; supported unfragmented TCP ports/sequence/ack/data offset/flags, UDP ports/length and ICMP type/code. Truncated or unsupported layers keep raw bytes and visible warnings. Fragmented IPv4 packets are not given invented transport ports or flow membership.

FILTER EXACTLY
Combine protocol, source/destination IPv4 and source/destination port predicates. Nonempty fields are ANDed exact matches; blank means wildcard. This is deliberately not a BPF or substring query language. Directed TCP/UDP five-tuples keep reverse directions separate, with counts and original packet indices still attached.

FREEZE A REAL SUBSET
Choose matching packets and write an immutable subset PCAP plus full CSV. The original24-byte global header and selected16-byte record headers/payloads are copied without re-encoding, in original order. Saved exports retain the input SHA, filter, indices and output file hashes; reopen, inspect real bytes and share through system sharing. The practice capture contains4 packets; UDP plus destination port53 selects original packet3 and exports a real82-byte PCAP.

BOUNDED SCOPE
PCAP≤16 MiB/10000 records, Ethernet link type1, snap length1–262144. No pcapng, modified PCAP, other link types/FCS flags, IPv6/VLAN decoding, live capture, stream reassembly, TLS decryption or checksum-validity certification.30 saved captures/100 exports. Invalid file structure is rejected; packet-layer problems remain explicit diagnostics. No App account, advertising, IAP or third-party analytics SDK is required.

WHO IT IS FOR
Citizens, students, tenants, landlords, employees, small business owners and anyone who wants to understand their legal rights in Pakistan in simple language.

description:
Téléchargez notre application PANACHE HOLIFORMER pour toujours avoir votre studio préféré dans votre poche !
À partir de notre application, vous pouvez planifier et programmer vos cours, consulter les horaires, vous inscrire, et bien plus encore !
Optimisez votre temps et ne manquez plus jamais les dernières informations qui seront toujours à portée de vos mains. N’attendez plus et téléchargez PANACHE HOLIFORMER dès maintenant.

name: PanelRatio
description:
Calculate how many identical rectangular pieces fit on a sheet. Enter sheet and piece dimensions, edge margins and spacing. PanelRatio compares the original and rotated uniform orientations, shows rows and columns, and calculates the percentage of sheet area used.

Convert dimensions between millimeters and inches, choose A4, A3, Letter or Legal sheet presets, compare diagrams, save named layouts, search saved calculations, edit or delete them, and export dimensions and yield.

Calculations and saved layouts work offline. No account, ads or purchases. Eight languages and three appearance modes. This is a uniform rectangular layout calculator, not a mixed-orientation nesting or printer driver tool. Allow for bleed, printer limits and cutting tolerances before production.

name: Pantry Tales: Goods Sort 3D
description:
Love a perfectly organized shelf? Pantry Tales is a cozy 3D goods sorting game with a heartwarming story. Sort goods, match 3 identical items and clear every shelf in this relaxing sort puzzle, then use your stars to restore Hazel Street's little shops.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag goods from shelf to shelf, or tap to move them
• Match 3 of the same item in a row and they pop with a sparkle
• Clear the front row to reveal the next layer of goods behind it
• Sort and organize every shelf to win, with no timers and no pressure
• Stuck? Undo, shuffle or start the shelf again, always free

A COZY STORY ON HAZEL STREET
Nana Bea is retiring and hands you the keys to The Little Pantry. Restock the shelves, earn stars and restore the bakery, the flower shop, the bath shop, the toy corner, the park café and more. Read Nana's letters, meet the neighbours and light up the whole street for the Hazel Street Fair.

MORE THAN A SORTING GAME
• 240 handcrafted 3D sorting levels, from relaxing to brain-teasing, each one checked to be solvable
• Triple match surprises: paper bags, sealed boxes, little cabinets, dusty goods and delivery crates
• Morning Restock: a fresh daily sort puzzle
• Weekly Delivery: five relaxed bonus shelves every Sunday
• Cozy seasonal shelves through the year
• 200 cute goods to collect in your Pantry Album
• Decorate your own shop with the decorations you earn
• Biscuit the sleepy shop cat naps on your shelves

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Offline play: no Wi-Fi needed
• Calm mode, tap-to-move controls, larger text and reduced motion
• Satisfying sounds and gentle haptics

If you love sorting games, triple match 3D puzzles, organizing games and restocking goods on a shelf, you'll feel right at home in Pantry Tales. Play offline and start sorting today!

Hand-built shops from low-poly 3D models.

name: Paper Plane Run: Sky Trails
description:
Fold a plane. Find your line.

Launch from a slingshot and glide through handcrafted paper skies. Thread tight gaps, catch updrafts, collect stars, and tuck into a dive to build speed.

Fly Journey chapters through paper cities, harbors, and storm fronts. Each chapter brings new flight objectives, rival pilots, and illustrated postcards to collect.

Chase a distance record in Classic, change your tactics on Daily and Weekly routes, or make a course in the route editor. Spend earned stars on new planes and upgrades.

Choose Touch Aim or Joystick, adjust the graphics and motion, and play the main game offline. No account is required.

name: Paperdue
description: Paperdue is a document-date notebook. Each paper has a title, a kind, the last four characters of a number, an expiry date, and where you keep the paper. Days are counted from today to that date. A negative number means it is already past. Soon lists papers that expire within 60 days or are already past. Renewals are dated notes that the paper was renewed. Nothing is uploaded and the full number is never stored.

name: Paperless Chat
description:
Unofficial app for Paperless-ngx.

Paperless Chat answers questions about your document archive. You ask, for example, about your electricity bill for 2024 or the notice period of a contract. The answer comes from the server that runs your Paperless-ngx and names the documents it is based on.

Requirements
• A Paperless-ngx server, version 3.0 or later, that you run yourself or have access to.
• The AI feature is set up in your Paperless-ngx.
• A user account on that server.

Features
• Ask a question and read the answer as it arrives. You can stop it at any time.
• Sources under every answer: preview in a sheet, the full document in the viewer, share with other apps.
• History of your chats, stored on your device.
• Have answers read aloud in natural-sounding voices, in English and German. The voices are included in the app and work without a network or download. Amounts, dates and abbreviations are read out in full.
• Speak your questions instead of typing. Recognition runs only on your device.
• Voice mode: you speak, the question is sent after 2 seconds of silence, the app reads the answer aloud and then listens again. Recognition and reading aloud run on your device only.
• Sign in with username and password or with an API token. Scan the server address as a QR code.
• Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode.
• German and English, with support for large text and VoiceOver.
• Demo without a server: tap "View demo" on the sign-in screen.

Privacy
No data goes to us or to third parties. The app only talks to your own server. There is no account with us, no tracking and no ads. Credentials are kept in your device's Keychain.

A note on the connection
Self-hosted servers on a home network are often reachable only over http or with a self-signed certificate. The app works in that case too and shows a permanent notice about the unencrypted connection.

Common question
If the answer only appears all at once at the end, your reverse proxy is buffering the stream. The help page at paperlesschat.app/en/help explains how to turn that off.

Paperless-ngx is a free open-source project and is not affiliated with this app. Provider: B.OE Labs UG (haftungsbeschränkt).

name: Paperveil
description:
Make your own layered paper stencils with Papervane, a focused offline studio crafted for printmakers, stencil cutters, and paper artists.

CUT YOUR DESIGN
Stamp geometric shapes or draw freehand openings with organic curves. Drag, rotate, and scale individual cutouts on virtual stock, then add paper bridges to shield intricate areas. Build multi-color plates from scratch or start from eight curated editable template designs.

CHECK THE PAPER
Inspect every printing plate for disconnected paper islands before cutting. Tap highlighted areas to isolate islands and add paper connectors with a single tap. The Press Inspection dashboard summarizes total cut openings, disconnected islands, and registration margins across all active plates.

SET THE REGISTRATION
Simulate real-world screenprint and risograph presses. Drag individual color plates to test alignment offsets. Use the interactive comparison slider to inspect perfectly aligned vector art alongside registration variations, and personalize paper stock and ink shades.

KEEP AND SHARE YOUR WORK
Export high-resolution color proofs as standard 1200 px PNG images or save editable project files directly to Files. Browse your saved studio prints, undo and redo cut operations seamlessly, and preserve project revisions locally.

PRINT PACK
An optional one-time in-app purchase unlocks printable PDF cutting templates with industrial registration crop marks and crosshairs, along with ultra-sharp 1600 px and 2400 px PNG exports.

Papervane is designed for offline creative workflows with zero mandatory accounts or external servers. All design work and print files remain private on your device.

name: ParadeLine
description:
See exactly where Santa is when your local fire company brings him through the neighborhood.

ParadeLine shows your town's Santa run or parade on a live map, so you know when to head outside, with no more waiting in the cold or missing him by a street.

FOR FAMILIES
• Find your parade by fire company or town, or tap Near me.
• Watch Santa's sleigh and the fire trucks move along the route in real time.
• "When will Santa reach me?" Pick your spot and see an estimated arrival time, based on how fast the parade is actually moving tonight.
• Santa alerts: get a notification 5 to 30 minutes before he reaches your spot.
• Recommended viewing areas point you to a good spot if your street isn't on the route.
• No account needed to watch.

FOR FIRE COMPANIES
• Turn-by-turn directions for parade drivers, with spoken instructions.
• Drivers' locations stay live on the public map even with the phone locked.
• Plan routes, invite your crew, and customize your map with holiday themes, banners, safety messages and a donation link at paradeline.com.

Your location stays on your phone unless you're a driver sharing on the parade map, or you turn on a Santa alert. ParadeLine doesn't track you or show ads.

ParadeLine works where a participating fire company or organization has set up its parade. Departments can learn more at paradeline.com.

name: parkim.az Driver
description:
parkim.az Driver is the personal cabinet for drivers who work with a taxi fleet. See your balance, rides and earnings on one screen.

What you can do:
• See your current balance and latest balance entries
• Browse rides by day, week and month and follow earnings on a chart
• Open any ride to see its breakdown and commissions
• Browse the fleet's rental cars and send a request
• Contact your fleet by phone or WhatsApp
• Register and choose your fleet from the list

The app is for drivers of taxi fleets that use the parkim.az fleet management system. To sign in you need the password given by your fleet, or you can register in the app.

Privacy: the app does not use your location, contacts or photos and shows no ads. You can delete your account in the Profile section.

name: Part 107 Drone Test Prep 2027
description:
Study for the FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot knowledge test (UAG) with 1,034 original practice questions. Every explanation quotes the regulation or FAA handbook passage it comes from.

THE CHART QUESTIONS, ON REAL CHARTS
Since October 26, 2026 the test shows sectional chart images on screen. The app has 184 chart and figure questions that use current FAA sectional excerpts and the FAA testing supplement. Pinch to zoom, just like you'll need to read them on test day.

MOCK EXAMS THAT FEEL LIKE THE TEST
60 questions, 2 hours, 70% to pass. Questions are drawn in the same proportions as the real test: Regulations, Airspace, Weather, Loading and Operations. The timer keeps running if you leave the app. Flag questions, review them, and see where you lost points.

EVERY ANSWER EXPLAINED AND CITED
You get the right answer, why each wrong option is wrong, and the exact source: 14 CFR Part 107, AC 107-2A, the AIM, the Pilot's Handbook or the Aviation Weather Handbook.

REVIEW THAT STICKS
Questions you miss come back after 1, 3, 7 and 16 days until you know them. A readiness score shows when you're ready to book.

ALSO
• Study by ACS area and task
• Question of the day and an optional daily reminder
• A countdown to your test date
• Works offline. No account. No ads. No tracking.

FREE AND PRO
Free: a 15-question diagnostic, the question of the day and one study topic. Everything else needs Pro: $24.99 one time, or $4.99 per week after a 3-day free trial.

Subscription terms: the weekly plan renews automatically at $4.99 per week unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. If you cancel during the free trial at least 24 hours before it ends, you won't be charged.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://abhishek10879.github.io/appdocklabs/part107/privacy.html

Part 107 Drone Test Prep 2027 is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), the U.S. Department of Transportation, PSI Services LLC, or any testing provider. Practice questions are original unless labeled "FAA sample question." Charts and figures are reproduced from public-domain FAA publications for training only and must not be used for navigation. Regulations change: always consult the current 14 CFR Part 107 and FAA guidance before flying. Using this app does not guarantee that you will pass the FAA knowledge test or obtain a Remote Pilot Certificate.

name: Pasar Malam Tycoon: Night Fair
description:
An empty field, one martabak cart and a big dream. Build the busiest night market in Indonesia!

Put up a Ferris wheel, a carousel and a swinging pirate ship. Fill the stalls with cilok, satay, kerak telor and iced tea. Switch on the lights, open the gates and watch the crowds roll in every night.

DAYTIME: SET UP SHOP
• 36 rides, food stalls and games from a real Indonesian pasar malam: from kiddie rides to a mini roller coaster, from cotton candy to balloon darts and the Wall of Death.
• Lay out stalls, paths, string lights, toilets and bins however you like.
• Watch the power! Go over the generator's limit and the whole market blacks out.

NIGHT: LIGHT IT UP
• Hundreds of visitors ride, snack and pay. The happier they are, the bigger tomorrow's crowd.
• Set your own ticket and food prices.
• Saturday night brings huge crowds; Thursday night packs the Haunted House.
• Rain, pickpockets and lost children in the crowd. Are you ready?

UPGRADE AND GROW
• Upgrade every ride and stall to earn more and draw bigger crowds. Builders work while you keep selling.
• Hire staff: sweepers, generator technicians, ride operators, security guards, a dangdut stage MC and a foreman.
• Finish daily tasks and collect login rewards to earn Emas (gold).

FROM VILLAGE TO BIG CITY
Start on a village field, then move to the regency square, the harbour town and finally the big city. Every town is bigger, busier and has better rides.

EARN WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Your market keeps earning even when you're not playing.

Free to play, no forced ads. Ads are only reward videos you choose to watch. Play in English or Indonesian.

---

IN-APP PURCHASES
Pasar Malam Tycoon is free to play and offers optional purchases: Emas packs, special offer packs, permanent items (No Ads, Double Income, Third and Fourth Builder, Night Watch, Super Generator) and subscriptions.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
• Boss Pass (1 month) and Weekly Pass (1 week) are auto-renewable subscriptions.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends.
• Manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://hendrynug.com/games/pasar-malam-tycoon/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://hendrynug.com/games/pasar-malam-tycoon/privacy.html

name: Passages : Interactive Fiction
description:
Write the story. Then let someone else choose how it ends.

Passages is a pocket studio for interactive fiction. You can write branching, choose-your-path text adventures on your iPhone, play them as you go, and read hundreds of free, top-rated stories by other writers. You don't need an account or any code.

BUILD BRANCHING STORIES
• Each passage is one card on a visual map, and arrows show where each choice leads.
• Type a choice in [[double brackets]] and Passages creates the next passage, already connected.
• Pinch, drag and rearrange the map. You can also switch to a list view or search to jump to any passage.
• Broken links are flagged, so no path ends in a dead end by accident.

WRITE CHOICES THAT MATTER
• Track keys found, gold spent and secrets learned with variables, so later scenes react to what the player did.
• A snippet bar above the keyboard holds links, macros and the names of passages you've already written.
• Add pictures, GIFs, music and sound to any passage.
• Style the whole story with your own CSS and JavaScript.
• Works with four story formats: Harlowe, SugarCube, Chapbook and Snowman.

PLAY EVERY PATH YOU CREATE
• Play from the start, or from any passage, the way your readers will see it.
• Progress saves automatically, so there's no save button to forget.
• Switch between phone and desktop layouts to check how your story reads on each.

DISCOVER FREE STORIES
• Browse top-rated and newest free interactive fiction, with ratings from players on IFDB.
• Add a game to your library with one tap. It downloads with its art and sound and plays offline afterwards.

COLLECT YOUR OWN SHELF
• Keep everything you write and play in one library, with covers, authors and descriptions.
• Import .html, .zip and .twee files, or a whole game folder like an itch.io download, from Files or any app's share sheet.

SHARE IT WITH ANYONE
• Export a single HTML file that plays in any browser, a zip with your cover and media, or plain-text Twee for version control.
• Keep writing on your computer and import the file back. Passages updates the story instead of making a copy.

LEARN AS YOU GO
• A five-minute guide covers passages, links, choices and variables.
• Two finished starter games are included: The Keeper's Log, a branching mystery, and Ashen Road, a tiny RPG with dice-rolled fights. Play them, then take them apart.

PASSAGES UNLIMITED
Passages is free to download. You can play every game and write up to 2 stories of 6 passages each. A single one-time purchase, Passages Unlimited, removes the limits: unlimited stories and passages, and editing for any game in your library. There's no subscription.

Made by one independent developer, with no ads and no tracking.

Twine® is a registered trademark of the Interactive Fiction Technology Foundation. Passages is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. Games in Discover are listed on IFDB and downloaded from the IF Archive. They belong to their authors.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Passo Luso
description:
Начните учить европейский португальский с алфавита и первых слов. Passo Luso — спокойный бесплатный курс для русскоязычных взрослых, которые живут в Португалии или готовятся к переезду.

В курсе 8 тем, 31 урок и 224 задания: буквы, числа, чтение, знакомство, кафе, город и транспорт, семья и занятия, время и встречи. 65 иллюстрированных слов помогают связывать написание со значением. Есть задания на выбор картинки по слову и на слух.

10 коротких уроков чтения объясняют ударение, безударные гласные, C/Ç, G/J, GU/QU, S, R/RR, конечное L, CH/NH/LH, носовые звуки и X. Те же правила доступны как справочник и из объяснения ошибки.

Слушайте слова и названия всех 26 букв в обычном или медленном темпе. Выбранные португальские слова произносятся автоматически; эту возможность можно отключить в настройках. Ручные кнопки звука остаются доступны. Ответ проверяется только после нажатия «Проверить».

Словарь ищет слова по-русски и по-португальски, сохраняет закладки. Приложение помнит шаг урока, результаты и ошибки для повторения. Уроки, картинки, словарь и прогресс работают без интернета.

Для произношения нужен установленный системный голос iOS европейского португальского (pt-PT). Если его нет, приложение предлагает зрительную практику и инструкцию по установке. Это учебная практика, а не независимая оценка уровня.

Без учётной записи, подписки, покупок и активной рекламы. Курс помогает сделать первые шаги, но не обещает полного уровня A1.

name: PassReach: Passport Visa Index
description:
See where your passports can take you on an interactive 3D globe. Check entry rules for 199 destinations, compare passports with a travel partner, and plan your next trip offline.

PassReach turns global visa rules into a color-coded 3D map so you can tell at a glance where you can travel visa-free, get a visa on arrival, apply online, or need a visa in advance.

EXPLORE ON A 3D GLOBE
• Spin and tap any of 199 destinations to see entry status and typical stay length
• Combine multiple filters (Visa-free, Visa on arrival, Apply online, Visa required) on both the globe and the searchable list
• Switch seamlessly between the 3D globe and a fast A–Z destination index

TRAVEL TOGETHER
• Add a travel partner or group to see destinations you can all visit together
• The globe updates automatically to reflect the group's shared entry requirement
• Inspect any country to see each traveler's individual requirement side by side
• Toggle travelers on or off directly from the toolbar without leaving the map

MULTIPLE PASSPORTS
• Hold dual citizenship? Add all of your passports and PassReach automatically picks your best entry option for every country
• View alternative passport options right inside each destination sheet

PRIVATE & OFFLINE-FIRST
• Works offline anywhere—great for flights and border planning
• Your passport selections and traveler names stay strictly on your device
• PassReach is free, with no ads, no account, and no tracking

Made for iPhone and iPad, and runs on Apple silicon Macs. PassReach is a trip-planning reference; always confirm current entry requirements with official embassy or airline authorities before traveling.

name: Patchbay: Signal & Scope Lab
description:
Patchbay is an offline modular signal and oscilloscope studio for iOS designed around clear wave physics, tactile controls, and calm visual geometry.

MODULAR PATCHING & WAVEFORMS
Connect oscillators, LFOs, mixers, and comparators with virtual patch cables. Adjust frequency, phase, and modulation depth to shape complex waves in real time.

OSCILLOSCOPE & XY LISSAJOUS VIEW
Switch between time-domain traces and XY phase plots with adjustable beam brightness, grid divisions, and phosphor persistence.

TACTILE & STANDBY MODES
Experience subtle CoreHaptics feedback on jacks, toggles, and detents, or dock your phone horizontally for a quiet StandBy scope display.

Runs completely offline with SwiftData patch presets and no ads or tracking

name: Pawfolio
description:
Pawfolio är den lugna platsen för allt som hör till din hunds, katts eller andra husdjurs vardag. Samla måltider, vikt, vaccinationer, veterinärkontakter och små minnen i en tydlig och personlig översikt – utan konto, reklam eller onödigt krångel.

**EN TYDLIG DAG**
Se dagens matplan, nästa mål och senaste hälsoanteckning direkt när du öppnar appen. Markera en måltid med ett tryck och få en enkel överblick över veckans rytm.

**HÄLSA ÖVER TID**
Logga vikt, symtom, medicin, vaccinationer och veterinärbesök. Följ vikttrenden, se kommande vårdtillfällen och skapa ett tydligt vårdkort som du kan dela med din veterinär eller spara som en kopia.

**MATPLAN OCH FODER**
Lägg in måltider med tid, portion och veckodagar. Håll koll på foderlagret och se hur mycket som är kvar. Aktivera måltidspåminnelser när du själv vill.

**DAGBOK MED PLATS FÖR KÄNSLA**
Spara bilder, stämningar och små berättelser från vardagen. Filtrera minnena efter dag eller stämning och bygg en personlig tidslinje över tiden tillsammans.

**ALLT VIKTIGT I PROFILEN**
Samla ras, födelsedatum, mikrochip, försäkring och veterinärkontakt. Har du flera husdjur får varje vän en egen profil, matplan och dagbok.

**DIN INTEGRITET**
Dina uppgifter sparas lokalt på enheten. Pawfolio kräver inget konto, innehåller ingen spårning och visar inga annonser. Du kan själv dela ett vårdkort när du vill.

Pawfolio är ett personligt anteckningsstöd för husdjursvardagen. Appen ställer ingen diagnos och ersätter inte veterinärens bedömning eller näringsrådgivning.

name: Pawsana: Yoga at Home
description:
Pawsana builds a short yoga flow for the time and space you actually have today, then guides you through it breath by breath.

YOUR FLOW, BUILT FOR TODAY
Pick 3, 5, 10, 15 or 20 minutes. Pick where you are: on a mat, in bed, or standing in a small room in work clothes. Tap the spots that feel stiff today, like neck, shoulders, low back, hips or hamstrings. Pawsana puts together a flow from 43 beginner poses, and every pose shows why it is there, for example "For your low back". Don't like it? Shuffle for a new one.

BREATHS, NOT A STOPWATCH
Each pose is held for a few breaths. A large breathing circle shows when to breathe in and out, at a Slow or Easy pace. When the breaths are done, the next pose starts by itself, so you never reach for your phone. A gentle chime and a calm voice tell you the pose and what to focus on (English uses an AI voice recorded once; other languages use your iPhone's voice). You can turn the voice off.

CLEAR POSES FOR BEGINNERS
Every pose has a picture, three short cues, an easier version, and when to skip it. Browse the full pose library by body area and place.

SEE WHAT HELPS
After each flow, rate your stiff spots Better, Same or Worse. The Journal shows how each area has felt over the weeks, and your next flows lean on what you rated. If an area felt worse twice in a row, Pawsana goes gentler there.

A WEEKLY GOAL THAT FITS A BUSY LIFE
Choose 2 to 5 days a week. Hit your goal and the weeks add up. Missing a day never breaks anything.

PROGRAMS
7 Mornings is free: a week of short wake-up flows. Pro adds Desk Reset (ten standing breaks) and Sleep Wind-down (seven slow evenings in bed).

FREE AND PRO
Free: 3, 5 and 10 minute flows for every place and body area, 7 Mornings, the full pose library and 14 days of charts.
Pawsana Pro, paid once: 15 and 20 minute flows, Wind down, Desk Reset and Sleep Wind-down, saved flows and your full history.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your flows and notes stay on your iPhone. Finished flows can be saved to Apple Health as yoga workouts if you turn it on.

GOOD TO KNOW
Pawsana is a general exercise guide, not medical advice. Move within a comfortable range and stop if anything hurts. If you have a health condition, talk to a professional before starting.

name: Paxomerith Pure Logic
description:
omerith Pure Logic offers three card-logic puzzles that turn suits and ranks into deduction tools.

In Suit Code, a compass maps each suit to a directional arrow. Read the compass, find the matching arrow for every card on the grid, and lock it in. Later chapters flip the arrow for royal cards, mirror certain rows, or rotate the entire compass row by row — each twist layering a new rule on top of the last.

Card Mosaic starts with a valid card grid that has been broken into shaped pieces. Pick a piece from the tray, fit it back into the gap whose outline matches, and make sure no card repeats in its row, column or box. Misplace too many pieces and you lose a heart, so read the grid before you tap. Advanced boards hide some cards face-down and toss in decoy pieces that fit nowhere.

Royal Grid is a constraint puzzle: fill every empty square from a card palette so that no card appears twice in any row or column. The four chapter modes range from simple suit placement on a four-by-four board to a sixteen-card grid where every row and column must hold each suit and each rank exactly once.

Each game has forty hand-verified levels across four chapters, all with a unique solution. A Daily Challenge rotates a new puzzle every day. The Workshop lets you tune puzzle parameters and save custom layouts for practice. Full move-by-move Replay lets you review any finished session, and Insights tracks your progress and session patterns over time. Unlimited free hints, complete undo history, and detailed accessibility options — including high contrast, suit text labels for colour vision differences, and VoiceOver support — round out the experience.

name: PDF Scanner – PDF ProMaster
description:
PDF ProMaster turns your iPhone and iPad into a document scanner and PDF toolkit. Your files are processed on your device and are never uploaded by the app. There is no account and no sign-up.

SCAN TO PDF
• Point the camera at a page: the page edges are found and the page is straightened for you
• Auto-capture can take the photo by itself when the page is steady
• Drag the corners to adjust the crop whenever you need to
• Choose a look: Auto, Smart Enhance, Grey, B&W or Original
• Scan many pages into one PDF
• ID card mode puts the front and back on one A4 page, at real size, ready to print
• Passport mode for the photo page and any extra pages
• Copy text from a scanned page – the text is read on your device
• Add your signature, the date or your own text while you scan
• Or make a PDF from photos you already have

PDF TOOLS
• Edit PDF – change existing text, add text, draw, highlight and white-out
• Sign PDF – draw your signature, add the date or type your name, and place it on any page
• Merge PDF – join several PDFs into one
• Split PDF – pick the pages you need, or cut a file into parts
• Compress PDF – make files smaller to email or upload
• Word to PDF – turn a .docx file into a PDF
• Images to PDF – turn photos into a PDF

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works offline – the app does not use the internet
• No account and no tracking
• Your files are saved on your device, in the Files app › PDF ProMaster
• Open PDFs and photos straight from Files, Mail and other apps

PDF ProMaster is made by PDF ProMaster Ltd in the United Kingdom. Questions or ideas? Email hello@pdfpromaster.com.

name: PDFRefine: Sign & Edit PDF
description:
PDFRefine is the simple way to sign and edit PDFs on your iPhone.

Open a contract, form or letter from Files, iCloud Drive or another app, then:

• Sign it: draw your signature with your finger, type your name in a handwriting font, or use a photo of your signature
• Fill it in: add text, your name and today's date anywhere on the page
• Edit it: replace a line of text with matching font and size, highlight, white out, tick boxes, draw, add shapes and pictures
• Share it: save to Files or send by Mail, AirDrop and Messages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your documents are opened and edited on your iPhone and are never uploaded to a server. No account is needed.

WORKS IN YOUR LANGUAGE
PDFRefine is available in 22 languages, and text you add supports Latin, Cyrillic and many other scripts.

PRO
Editing and previewing are free. PDFRefine Pro lets you download and share your finished PDFs, as many as you need. Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store settings.

Terms of Use: https://pdfrefine.online/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pdfrefine.online/privacy

name: Peace Garden: Meditation
description:
Make a little room for quiet.

Peace Garden brings a small crystal garden to your phone. Choose a one-, three- or five-minute guided pause, or stay for a while with garden music and the sound of rain.

A practice that fits your day
Start with a short guided pause or explore five practices in the mindfulness basics collection. A physical Zen garden is optional.

A garden to return to
Visit in daylight or moonlight, and choose clear skies, rain, snow or mist. A little stone companion and occasional visitors make each visit feel different.

Make the sounds your own
Listen to garden music, adjust the rain and fireplace sounds, and set a 30- or 60-minute sleep timer. Temple Stream, the garden and its built-in guided practices are available offline. Other music tracks stream when you choose to play them.

Keep the moments you want to remember
Read a daily note, revisit encounters and practice records in My journal, or share a card with someone. Your journal is saved on your device.

Peace Garden is free to use and requires no account.

name: Pebbleglow TV PadPro
description:
Turn your iPhone into a smart, beautiful TV remote. It connects over Wi-Fi to Samsung, LG, Roku and Android / Google TVs, with no extra hardware or setup. Navigate with a smooth D-pad, swipe on the touchpad, open your favourite apps and type with your phone's keyboard. A clean, soft-touch design keeps every control easy to reach in one hand. If your remote goes missing or its batteries die, just pick up your phone and keep watching.

Features
- Full remote: D-pad, volume, channels, playback, number pad and colour keys, all on one screen.
- Touchpad and Air Mouse: swipe to navigate, or point your phone to move the on-screen cursor (supported models).
- Apps: launch YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video and more straight from your phone.
- Keyboard and voice typing: search and log in faster with your iPhone keyboard or your voice.
- Inputs, sleep timer and shortcuts: switch HDMI sources, schedule the TV to turn off, and run one-tap routines.
- Connection Check: finds connection problems and tells you how to fix them.

How to Use
1. Connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network.
2. Open the app and allow Local Network access when asked.
3. Tap My TVs. Your TV is found automatically, or you can add it by IP address.
4. Choose your TV, then select Allow on the TV screen (or enter the code shown).
5. Start controlling with buttons, the touchpad, apps or your voice.
6. If something doesn't respond, open Connection Check for step-by-step help.

Benefits
- Never lose the remote: your phone is always with you.
- One app for every TV: works with Samsung, LG, Roku and Android / Google TVs at home.
- Faster typing: no more letter-by-letter searching with arrow keys.
- Clear feedback: you see when a command has reached the TV, and features your TV can't use are clearly marked.
- Private: no account or sign-up, and your profile stays on your device.
- Comfortable design: soft, readable controls with haptic feedback.

name: Peekpot – Cooking with Pip
description:
What's for dinner? Just shake your phone and Pip, the little pot, suggests a recipe. Not feeling it? Shake again.

SHAKE
• Shake your phone or tap Pip to get a suggestion
• One-tap filters: All, Meat & Fish, Vegetarian or Vegan
• Savory, Dessert or Baking
• By time: up to 30 minutes, 30 to 45 minutes, or longer
• Seasonal suggestions, and Pip dresses up for the season too

SHOP
• Your shopping list is sorted by supermarket section: produce first, then on through the store
• Change the number of servings and all amounts adjust
• Check off what's in your cart and watch the progress bar fill up
• Things you usually have at home (salt, oil, spices) are listed separately under "Pantry"

COOK
• Only one step on screen at a time, nice and relaxed
• Each step shows just the ingredients you need right now, with amounts
• A progress bar shows how far along you are
• Start timers with one tap, even several at once
• Timers keep running in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen
• Pip cheers you on through every step and celebrates with you at the end

RECIPES
• 505 recipes, 319 of them vegetarian and 39 vegan
• From quick pasta to soups, curries, cakes and desserts
• All recipes are built into the app, so it works offline
• New recipes arrive with app updates

FAIR
• 100 recipes are free forever
• A one-time purchase unlocks all recipes, including every future one. No subscription.
• No ads, no account, no tracking
• English and German, switch right in the app

Have fun cooking with Pip!

name: Peekproof: Safe Photo Share
description:
Handing your phone to someone to show a photo? With Photos, one swipe and they are scrolling through your whole gallery.

Peekproof shows only the photos and videos you pick. Nothing before, nothing after.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick photos in the app, or share them straight from Photos with "Show with Peekproof"
• Hand over your phone; they can swipe only through what you picked
• To exit, long-press the corner and confirm with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No gallery access needed: photos are picked with Apple's system picker
• No account, no servers, no analytics, no tracking
• Everything stays on your device

BUILT FOR SHOWING
• Clean full-screen viewer with pinch and double-tap zoom
• Videos and Live Photos (Pro)
• No share, delete, edit or info buttons on screen
• An end card when they reach the last photo
• App switcher preview is blurred

LOCK THE WHOLE PHONE
Turn on Strict Lock and Peekproof guides you through Apple's Guided Access, so nobody can leave the app until you unlock it.

SEE WHO GOT CURIOUS
A summary after each showing tells you whether someone tried to swipe past the end or leave the viewer.

QUICK START
Show your most recent photos from Shortcuts, the Action button, Control Center or Spotlight.

PEEKPROOF PRO: ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Unlimited photos per showing (free: 5)
• Videos and Live Photos
• Unlimited saved sets
• Custom end card and summary sharing

Great for vacation, baby and pet photos, for showing work to clients, or for handing your phone to a child.

name: Peg Key
description: Peg Key keeps a spare key and the person who borrowed it. Write the key, write who has it, then press and hold the key until it leaves the peg. Out lists that key and that name. The pages can be read in English, Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish, German, or Japanese. The loan stays on this iPhone.

name: Peli: Pet Lover Community
description:
Peli is a place to keep a journal for your pets and talk with other pet owners. Start with a photo from the day your pet came home, write down something funny that happened on a walk, or save a note about the first time they learned to sit. Each pet can have their own profile, photo album, and journal.

Trying to remember when you last weighed your pet or when their next vaccination is due? Look through your journal by pet, record type, or month. You can log weight, vaccinations, deworming, grooming, and vet visits, then check weight trends and set reminders for upcoming care.

If you’re curious how someone else helped a new pet settle in, view their profile, send a friend request, and chat one-on-one. When your pet’s adoption anniversary comes around, you can pick a virtual gift from their profile. Gifts use credits available through optional in-app purchases.

name: PEMB 2027
seller_name: M B CONSULTORIA E TREINAMENTO EM PROD E QUALIDADE LTDA
description:
O PEMB 2027 é o aplicativo oficial da convenção de Planejamento Estratégico da MB Consultoria, em São Paulo, de 30 de novembro a 6 de dezembro de 2026.

Para os convidados e as lideranças da MB:
• Agenda completa, com horários, locais e orientações de cada dia.
• Mapa de São Paulo com os locais da programação e rotas.
• Estratégia: cultura e valores, mapa estratégico, indicadores e plano de ação, com edição colaborativa.
• Diário do PEMB: pesquisa rápida do dia e reflexão.
• Conteúdo: fotos, vídeos, links e arquivos compartilhados pelo grupo.
• Avisos e informações de viagem.

Uso restrito aos convidados do evento. É necessário criar uma conta com e-mail e senha.

name: Penny Park: Birleştir & Kur
description:
Penny Park, para taşlarını birleştirdiğin ve kazandıklarınla kendi mahalleni kurduğun bir bulmaca oyunu.

Taşları kaydır, aynı olanları birleştir: kuruşlar liraya, liralar altına, altınlar mücevhere dönüşsün. Art arda birleştirerek kombo yap, kazancını katla.

Oyunlarda biriktirdiklerinle mahallene yeni eşyalar al: kedi, ağaç, büfe, ev, villa, park, gökdelen ve daha fazlası. Her eşyayı istediğin yere yerleştir, mahalleni üç boyutlu olarak izle.

ÖZELLİKLER
• 24 seviyelik birleştirme zinciri
• 19 eşyayla büyüyen 3B mahalle
• Aldığın her eşya kazancını kalıcı olarak artırır
• 34 başarım
• Bilgisayar rakiplerle Zenginler listesi
• Kendi avatarını tasarla
• İnternet gerektirmez, hesap açmak gerekmez
• Reklam yok, uygulama içi satın alma yok
• Hiçbir kişisel veri toplanmaz

Oyundaki para tamamen hayalidir; gerçek parayla alınmaz ve gerçek paraya çevrilmez.

name: Perchnote
description:
Perchnote is a personal field notebook built for birdwatchers who want a quiet, tactile place to record every sighting.

Write entries in seconds with offline species search powered by the IOC World Bird List (v15.2, CC BY 3.0) or add any custom species name. Record counts, dates, places, field notes, behavioral tags, and your own photos—all stored privately on your device.

What you can do in Perchnote:
- Field Log & Trip Mode: Jot down single sightings or log a full checklist for one place and date. Browse your entries by day with pencil-ticked calendar strips and "On This Day" memories.
- Life List & Year List: Track your life species, this year's species, this month's species, and total entries, complete with family pencil sketches and "LIFER" ink stamps.
- Folded Field Map: View your birding spots as clustered pins filtered by year or species. Pins work offline; base map tiles load from Apple Maps when connected.
- Birding Goals: Set yearly, monthly, or family-specific targets with progress rings, pace stamps, and optional local reminders.
- Private Export: Export your notebook as a printable PDF, CSV spreadsheet, or JSON archive, with options to round coordinates to ~1 km or hide locations entirely.

Perchnote is a personal logbook only. It does not identify birds from photos or sound, does not provide range maps or identification tips, and has no accounts, ads, or social feeds.

name: Performise
description:
Performise brings your entire workforce, daily operations, and team communication into one modern mobile workspace—so employees and managers can stay aligned from anywhere without juggling scattered tools.

KEY CAPABILITIES

• Verified Attendance & Leave Management
Clock in and out in seconds with foreground workplace location checks and optional front-camera verification. Track daily shift logs, view leave balances, submit leave requests, and approve team requests on the go.

• Tasks, Subtasks & Performance
Stay on top of daily priorities with filterable task lists, interactive subtasks, deadline tracking, and AI-assisted performance insights. Complete 360° peer reviews and monitor individual and team progress in real time.

• Team Chat, Mail & Instant Alerts
Message colleagues directly or collaborate in team channels with document and attachment sharing. Receive real-time notifications for task assignments, approvals, messages, and payroll updates—with customizable alert tones.

• Invoicing, Expenses & Payroll
Create client invoices, record payments, and generate clean A4 PDF invoices and receipts you can open, save, or share directly from your phone. Submit and approve expense requisitions with full audit trails and review payroll status effortlessly.

• Events, Meetings & SafeBox Vault
Coordinate live events, equipment assignments, and team calendars in one place. Access company credentials safely through the PIN-protected SafeBox Vault with timed access requests.

• Multi-Workspace & Dark Mode
Switch seamlessly between company workspaces, customize your profile, and work comfortably day or night with automatic system light and dark themes.

PRIVACY & SECURITY
Performise is built for workplace transparency and security. Location is checked strictly when you clock in, clock out, or configure an office boundary—never in the background. Camera access is used only when you initiate attendance verification. Performise contains no ads and does not track you across other apps or websites.

name: Perihelion: Comet Heist
description:
A sun is going out. Before it does, it sends one parcel past the last lamp.

You are the comet courier. Hold a star to bend around it, and release when the verdigris spear crosses the ring.

Act One is free to start, with four routes and no time limit. One purchase unlocks the full heist: all sixteen routes across four acts, on one life.

Hold anywhere to bend around the nearest star, moon, or pulsar. The spear shows the exact path you will fly if you let go now. Release while it crosses the ring, then catch the next body before the dark takes you. Add a second finger to tighten your turn, or switch targets when more than one body is in reach.

Skim close to a body for a graze. Cut into the inner third for a sear. Score again inside a few seconds to build a chain from Kiss and Skim through Whip, Sling, Perihelion, and Horizon.

Four acts, sixteen skies:
Outbound (free): Cinder, Twins, Beads, and Clock. Suns, chains of moons, and a pulsar that blinks.
The deep: Glass, Maw, Procession, and Last light. Shards that shatter, orbiting worlds, and black holes.
Homeward: Carousel, Lighthouse, Strait, and Home. Rings riding moons, twin pulsars out of step, and tight runs between holes.
The unlit: Threshold, Echo, Undertow, and Kindling. Paired doors that carry you and your spear from one sky to another, ending at the sun that never lit.

Practice any route you have reached from the title screen. Chase best scores, fastest times, and twelve marks. Every sound and chord is synthesised in real time, with its own band for each act and its own key for each route. Plays in portrait or landscape, with reduced motion and camera shake settings.

No ads, no subscriptions, no accounts, and no tracking. Plays completely offline.

name: Pesticide Applicator Exam Pro
description:
Study for your pesticide applicator license exam with practice questions written from the national Core training material, structural and general pest control topics, termite and wood-destroying organism topics, and state law packs for selected states.

PICK YOUR STATE
Choose your state and the exams you're preparing for. The state guide shows each state's agency, the exams for structural and general pest control, and, where the agency publishes them, the number of questions, time limit, passing score, fees and retake rules. Every fact links to the official agency page it came from, with the date it was checked.

PRACTICE THAT TEACHES
• Instant feedback with a clear explanation after every answer
• Every question cites its source (manual chapter and page, or the official rule section)
• Practice by exam or by chapter
• Missed questions come back on a spaced-repetition schedule until you get them right
• Bookmark questions to review later

EXAM SIMULATOR
Timed practice exams that follow your state's question count, time limit and passing score where the agency publishes them. Otherwise a clearly labeled default format. See your score, pass or fail, your weakest topics, and review every answer.

MORE STUDY TOOLS
• Flashcards for key terms: signal words, label sections, formulations, PPE and more
• Calculator drills for calibration, mixing and area math with step-by-step solutions
• Readiness ring for each exam, chapter progress and a daily study plan toward your exam date
• Works 100% offline. No account, no ads, no tracking
• English and Spanish

FREE AND PRO
Free: the state guide for every state, 40 Core practice questions, a 20-question practice exam and flashcards for two chapters.
Pro (weekly or monthly auto-renewing subscription): all question banks and state law packs, the full exam simulator, missed-question review, the study plan, calculator drills and all flashcards. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your Apple ID settings.

IMPORTANT
Independent study tool. Not affiliated with the EPA, NASDA or any state agency. The questions are original practice questions, not questions from any actual exam. Always confirm current requirements with your state.

Terms: https://www.pestshift.com/apps/pesticide-exam/terms
Privacy: https://www.pestshift.com/apps/pesticide-exam/privacy

name: Pet Arabia Bahrain
description:
Good things for good pets.

Pet Arabia, now in your pocket. Food, litter, treats, toys and care for dogs, cats and small pets, delivered to your door across Bahrain.

SHOP IN A FEW TAPS
• Shop by pet and by category
• Search the whole shop
• Brands your pet knows, including Taste of the Wild, Royal Canin and Purrify

REPEAT DELIVERY
• Put food, litter and pads on repeat delivery
• Pay a lower price every month

PET COINS ON EVERY ORDER
• Earn 10 Pet Coins for every BD 1 you spend
• Turn your Pet Coins into discounts
• See your balance in the app

LITTLE TREATS
• Spin the wheel for a shopping coupon, with a new spin on every order
• Invite a friend: they save on their first order and you earn 750 Pet Coins

Pet Arabia has looked after Bahrain's pets since 2009.

name: Peter's Zeurkalender 2027
description:
Als geen ander weet Van Straaten situaties te schetsen waarin mensen vaak iets van zichzelf herkennen.
 
Thuis, op kantoor, in een fraai landschap of in een rokerig café komen we zijn personages tegen: zichzelf overschattende mannen, onhandige minnaars, jaloerse vrouwen, uitgebluste echtparen, onzekere pubers of oude vrouwen met veel te jonge mannen. Een feest van herkenning.

name: Phantom Gate
description:
Step through dimensional rifts and claim legendary bounties in Phantom Gate—a fast-paced, one-handed action roguelike set inside treasure vaults fractured by arcane portals.

MASTER THE PHANTOM GATES
Drag anywhere on screen to dodge enemy fire while your arcane flintlock automatically aims and shoots. Dash into glowing Phantom Gates mid-battle to warp across the arena, unleash a devastating Void Nova, reset your Phase Dash, and enter Phantom Veil—allowing enemy bullets to pass harmlessly through you while revealing hidden Veiled Chests bursting with gold.

FOUR WANTED BOUNTY CONTRACTS
Take on escalating expeditions, each guarded by a unique Realm Warden:
• Vault of Echoes — Face Aurelius the Hollow across 5 treasure-packed chambers.
• Sunken Observatory — Outgun phantom musketeers and defeat Captain Marrow.
• Astral Catacomb — Survive lethal Rift Heat and challenge Archon Veyl.
• Endless Phantom Rift — Descend indefinitely against the Rift Leviathan and extract with your fortune whenever you dare.

RISK, REWARD & EXTRACTION
After every cleared chamber, draft powerful relics and pick your next portal:
• Crimson Hunt Gate — Track crowned Bounty Elites for high multipliers.
• Gilded Vault Gate — Unveil 3 hidden treasure chests guarded by Gilded Mimics.
• Smuggler's Bazaar Gate — Spend run gold on relics, vitality seals, and healing elixirs.
• Cursed Shrine Gate — Strike forbidden pacts for immense power at a steep cost.
• Extraction Gate — Bank 100% of your multiplied haul safely—or push deeper at the risk of losing most of your loot.

18 ARCANE RELICS & GUILD ARMORY
Combine Common, Rare, Epic, and Cursed relics—from ricochet shots, piercing volleys, and chain-lightning criticals to homing phase daggers and cursed golden crowns. Bring banked gold back to the Guild Armory to permanently upgrade 6 hunter gear tracks, fill out your Relic Codex, and chase new personal records.

FEATURES
• Intuitive one-handed controls with auto-aim flintlock, Phase Dash, and Rift Pulse
• Deep build synergies across 18 distinct relics and cursed shrine pacts
• 6 permanent Guild Armory upgrades (5 ranks each) and full Relic Codex
• Built-in sound effects and tactile haptic feedback toggles
• 100% offline single-player experience with local progress saving

name: Pharoah Auto
description:
Pharoah Auto turns your iPhone or iPad into a high-contrast, glare-free driving media and trip notes cockpit engineered for rapid glanceability and zero telemetry.

• High-Contrast Driving HUD: Oversized tactile controls designed for daytime glare, night driving, and colour-blind clarity.
• Dead-Zone & Tunnel Queue Deck: Keep your curated audio cues, route notes, and SÉLO Music playlists ready offline.
• Sovereign Trip & Waypoint Scratchpad: Record parking bays, route checkpoints, and mileage notes locally.
• Multi-Language Cockpit: Instant switching between English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR).
• Zero Location Harvesting: Pharoah Auto never uploads your routes, speed, or driving history to the cloud.

name: Pharoah LinkBond
description:
Pharoah LinkBond delivers sovereign multi-path network diagnostics, Wi-Fi + Cellular failover monitoring, and packet-loss resiliency testing directly on iPhone and iPad.

• Real-Time Multi-Path Link Telemetry: Inspect active Wi-Fi, 5G/LTE cellular, and Ethernet interface stability in one high-contrast cockpit.
• Instant Failover & Jitter Benchmarking: Measure round-trip latency, route continuity, and packet variance across redundant uplinks.
• On-Device Route Audit Log: Save and compare field connectivity snapshots locally without cloud telemetry.
• Built-In Multi-Language Cockpit: Instant in-app switching between English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR).
• Sovereign Privacy by Design: Zero advertising SDKs, zero tracking, and 100% local diagnostic storage.

name: Pharoah Mail
description:
Pharoah Mail is an encrypted message composition studio, header hygiene auditor, and local sovereign mail vault built for high-privacy executives and security-conscious professionals.

• On-Device Encrypted Draft & Message Vault: Compose, inspect, and seal sensitive correspondence before transmission.
• Mail Header & Tracker Hygiene Audit: Detect tracking pixels, external beacon links, and sender spoofing anomalies.
• Cryptographic Fingerprint Verification: Validate recipient key fingerprints and signed message blocks offline.
• Multi-Language Interface: Full support for English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR).
• Zero Cloud Harvesting: All drafts, templates, and audit logs remain strictly on your iPhone or iPad.

name: Pharoah Mobile Shield
description:
Pharoah Mobile Shield provides real-time on-device security posture checks, network exposure auditing, and permission hygiene verification for iPhone and iPad.

• Device Posture & Integrity Scanner: Audit OS hardening settings, network interface state, and local exposure vectors.
• Wi-Fi & Captive Portal Risk Inspector: Evaluate untrusted hotspots, gateway anomalies, and clear-text exposure.
• Security Checklist & Lockdown Guide: Step-by-step hardening controls for executives and travelling teams.
• Multi-Language Cockpit: Switch effortlessly between English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR).
• 100% On-Device Operation: Zero background telemetry, zero analytics SDKs, and zero external data collection.

name: Pharoah Privacy Audit
description:
Pharoah Privacy Audit inspects device permission exposure, sensor access vectors, and file/link metadata leaks entirely on your iPhone or iPad.

• Sensor & Permission Exposure Audit: Review camera, microphone, location, Bluetooth, and local network access risk.
• Link & URL Tracking Parameter Stripper: Cleanse outbound URLs of UTM, click-ID, and cross-site tracking tokens.
• Privacy Scorecard & Remediation Steps: Actionable hardening recommendations stored locally on your handset.
• Built-In Multi-Language Selector: Instant switching between English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR).
• Sovereign Zero-Data Policy: No user data ever leaves your device.

name: Pharoah Safe Room
description:
Pharoah Safe Room prepares boardrooms and private offices for confidential discussions with on-device acoustic masking synthesis, ambient floor inspection, and physical meeting security checklists.

• On-Device Acoustic Masking Generator: Synthesize calibrated multi-band audio masking directly from your device speaker.
• Boardroom Counter-Surveillance Checklist: Structured pre-meeting sweep protocol for RF, optical, and smart-device risks.
• Local Session Log: Record room clearance verification timestamps offline on your iPhone or iPad.
• Multi-Language Support: Switch seamlessly between English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR).
• Zero Recording or Cloud Upload: Pharoah Safe Room never records or transmits audio.

name: Pharoah Scarab
description:
Pharoah Scarab is an on-device cryptographic digest calculator, high-entropy passphrase generator, and hardware key companion utility for iPhone and iPad.

• Cryptographic Hash & Digest Engine: Compute and verify SHA-256, SHA-512, and HMAC fingerprints locally.
• High-Entropy Key & Passphrase Forge: Generate sovereign random tokens and recovery phrases using hardware RNG.
• Air-Gapped Verification Scratchpad: Compare binary checksums and key fingerprints without network exposure.
• Multi-Language Interface: Full support for English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR).
• Zero Telemetry: All generated keys and digests exist strictly on-device.

name: Pharoah Vehicle Scanner
description:
Pharoah Vehicle Scanner combines an offline OBD-II Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) reference analyser with an in-cabin BLE/RF tracker sweep checklist for drivers and fleet operators.

• Offline OBD-II DTC Lookup & Analysis: Decode powertrain (P), chassis (C), body (B), and network (U) fault codes instantly.
• Vehicle Privacy & Tracker Inspection Checklist: Audit OBD ports, cabin trim, and Bluetooth beacon exposure.
• Local Service & Inspection Vault: Save vehicle diagnostic notes and maintenance records directly on your device.
• Multi-Language Cockpit: Built-in English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR) selector.
• Sovereign Privacy: Zero location tracking, zero VIN harvesting, and zero cloud uploads.

name: PHASELINE Spatial Rhythm
description:
The lights come up. The beat drops. Your hands are the controls.

PHASELINE is an immersive rhythm game for Apple Vision Pro. Step into the arena and meet the music with every move: punch red crystals with your left hand and blue with your right, push flat-hand plates, trace glowing spirals, and dodge obstacles as the track builds around you.

FIND YOUR RHYTHM
Explore 100 original tracks across a range of styles and moods. Pick a difficulty, find your flow, and chase a better score with accurate, well-timed hits.

CHOOSE YOUR ARENA
Play in seven fully immersive arenas, including Phase Runway, a mirrored red-and-blue hexagonal tunnel. Room Runway and Room Pulse bring holographic lights into your surroundings. In Nova Room, lights pulse on scanned walls and translucent crystals pick up the room’s lighting as they emerge from a fractured portal. Sparks bounce off mapped surfaces and leave a flash where they land. Play Neon Heartbeat in Phase Runway or any room arena for a dedicated two-lane chart.

BRING YOUR OWN MUSIC
Choose an audio file from Files and PHASELINE maps it as the music plays. You can also open compatible rhythm-map ZIP files that you created or have the rights to use.

Hand tracking powers the controls. Make sure you have enough clear space to move comfortably. DRM-protected Apple Music tracks cannot be imported.

name: Phautix
description:
Description
Take better photos and videos, every time.
Phautix is a camera that coaches you while you shoot. Choose a classic cinematic shot, line up with the on-screen guide, and capture the moment you're on target. No more guessing whether the angle is right.
12 cinematic shot styles
Eye-Level, Low Angle, High Angle, Dutch Angle, Medium Close-Up, Close-Up, Extreme Close-Up, Long Shot, Bird's-Eye View, Crane Shot, Over-the-Shoulder and Establishing Shot. Pick a style from the image gallery and Phautix guides you into position.
Live shot guide
Choose between three guide styles: Phone, Horizon and XYZ. Each shows when you're lined up and turns green when you're ready.
Auto Capture
Turn it on and Phautix takes the photo for you as soon as you're in position. You set how strict the match needs to be.
Everything you need to shoot
Photo and video modes
Front and back cameras
Dual camera: Split, Side by Side and Picture-in-Picture
Pinch to zoom
Auto Zoom for smooth, cinematic zooms in video
Lens choices: Ultra Wide, Wide, 2x, Telephoto and Macro (on supported iPhones)
Self-timer: 3 or 10 seconds
Light control with adjustable brightness
Stabilizer that warns you when your hands are shaky
Dark detection that tells you when the scene is too dark
Auto Focus that follows the face in frame
Rule-of-thirds grid
Face guide to help you frame portraits

name: Phone Storage Cleaner
description:
"Storage almost full" again? Phone Storage Cleaner scans your photo library, videos, contacts and inbox, shows exactly how much space you can free up, and clears it in a few taps.

FIND WHAT'S WASTING SPACE
• Duplicate photos: exact copies grouped together, with the best shot kept
• Similar photos: bursts and near-identical shots, so you keep the one you like
• Screenshots and screen recordings you no longer need
• Blurry photos
• Live Photos and large photos sorted by size

VIDEOS

SMART & 100% ON DEVICE
• Similar Series – the sharpest shot with open eyes stays, the rest goes.
• Duplicates across years – the same image saved again months later.
• Expired screenshots – old tickets and codes found by on-device text recognition.
• Accidental shots (pocket, thumb, floor), eyes-closed photos and note photos (parking spot, Wi-Fi, price tags).
• Blurry photos, Space Hogs, screen recordings and 1–3 second videos.
• One tap: keep only the best shot in every series.

MORE SPACE, SAME MEMORIES
• Shrink Videos – choose resolution, bitrate and frame rate. The size forecast is measured with a short test encode, so you know the result before you start.
• Shrink Photos – pick the maximum resolution and quality; metadata stays.
• Live Photo Diet – keep the photo, drop the motion clip.
• Storage Goal – “I need 8 GB” and Pic Clutty plans the fastest route.
• Storage X-Ray – where your space goes by type, year and source. Shows what really sits on your iPhone and what lives only in iCloud, plus a forecast and a timely reminder.

ORGANIZE LIKE A PRO
• Filters: not favorites, no album, selfies, portraits, bursts and more – multi-select and act.
• Albums: create, rename, delete – and swipe up and hold to drop a photo straight into an album.
• Clean up just one album: every stack works inside the album you choose.

TOGETHER
Duo Mode: two people swipe the same photos – on one device or two devices via an iCloud link. Only what you both toss ends up in the bin.

PEACE OF MIND

• Real storage numbers only – never fake alerts, never inflated savings.

• No account, no tracking, no data collected. Analysis runs on your iPhone with Apple’s Vision framework.

HABIT & REWARD
Cleanup receipt after every session, Clutty Karma weekly recap, Lock Screen and “On This Day” widgets, plus Siri & Shortcuts (“Clean up screenshots with Pic Clutty”).

FOR EVERY SCREEN
Light and dark mode, iPhone, iPad with sidebar and keyboard shortcuts, and foldable iPhone. English and German.

name: Pickering Casino Golf Club
description:
Welcome to Pickering Casino Golf Club, the friendly companion for every golfer who loves a good day on the course. Ride in comfort. Explore a fleet of golf carts with two and four seats, quiet electric models and spacious utility options. Compare seating and storage at a glance, then reserve the cart that matches your plans for the day.

Never miss a big moment. Follow upcoming tournaments, from the Pickering Open to the Autumn Classic and the Twilight Scramble. A live countdown shows exactly how long until the first group tees off, and a gentle reminder can arrive fifteen minutes, an hour or even a full day before play begins. All event times are shown in Toronto local time, so planning your visit is simple.

Keep score the easy way. Start a round for up to four players, enter strokes for each hole and watch the totals update as you go. Made a slip? Undo the last hole with a single tap. When the round is complete, final results are ranked automatically and a hole by hole breakdown lets you relive every shot.

Choose your club with confidence. Tell the Club Selector where your ball is resting, on the fairway, in the rough, in the sand, near a water hazard or on wet grass, and how far you are from the target. In an instant you will see a suggested club along with a clear explanation of why it works for that shot.

Play smarter every week. Discover a growing library of golf tips covering swing, putting, short game, bunkers, strategy and practice. Filter by topic, save your favourites with a tap and read them one at a time whenever you want to focus on a single idea before your next round.

Designed with care. Friendly hints guide you through each section the first time you visit, smooth animations make every screen feel alive, and support for Reduce Motion keeps things calm when you prefer it. Your reservations, scores and saved tips stay on your device, ready whenever you are.

Pickering Casino Golf Club brings your tee times, carts, tournaments, scorecard and coaching tips together in one elegant app. Download it today and make your next round the best one yet.

HANDS-FREE ON THE COURT

A coloured frame around the screen shows it is listening, so you can see it from across the court. Prefer to tap? One big button does the same. On a noisy court, a clip-on mic helps the app hear you, but it isn't required.

SCORE AS A TEAM
Each game is 10 minutes. A rally earns team points by its length: 10 seconds is 1 point, and 90 seconds or more is 25. One long rally beats several short ones.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Every game is saved to your team: your best game, your longest rally, highs, streaks, and charts by day, week, month, and year.

TRY IT FIRST

Voice works on the iPhone itself: no audio is recorded or sent. No ads, no tracking.

name: PipmuralSlots
description:
Turn the slices. Wake the story.

An apple is out for a rainy walk. A watermelon is napping in a rind recliner. A grape is painting its next masterpiece. Their pictures have slipped out of place, and three little reels hold the pieces.

Pipmural Slots is a picture puzzle about seeing the whole window. An apple can look perfect at the top while the melon and grape below it are still a jumble. Your goal is to restore all three stories at the same time.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Read the three goal postcards above the board. They show the complete pictures you need in the top, middle and bottom rows.
2. Swipe a reel up or down, or tap its arrows. Each reel holds the left, middle or right slice of the artwork. Moving a reel changes all three visible pieces in that column.
3. Watch the whole board. In linked puzzles, every unlocked reel turns together. Use the latches to hold a column while the others move, then release it when you need a new pairing.
4. Follow the window's rule and latch limit. Some puzzles allow two held reels; one-latch puzzles keep at least two reels moving. Later gears reverse the middle reel or move the right reel two scenes per turn.
5. Match every row to its goal picture to complete the window. Wake up its cast, collect the finished composition and earn stars based on your turns. Replay a window to improve your best result.

A little hint can suggest your next step. Undo a turn or restart whenever you need a fresh look. There is no timer, and using hints does not reduce your star score.

24 WINDOWS, FOUR WAYS TO THINK
Work through four chapters of picture combinations. Start with Free reels, learn Linked reels, then try Mirror gears and Double-step gears. The changing rules and one- or two-latch limits ask you to plan how the columns work together.

SIX FRUIT FRIENDS
Meet Rainy-day Apple, Watermelon Daydream, Grape the Artist, Cherry on Skates, Lemon in Orbit and DJ Orange. Visit your collected cast in My postcards and play their little animated moments. The six original scenes appear in different arrangements throughout the campaign.

A NEW WINDOW EACH DAY
Open the Remix room for a daily puzzle generated on your device. For another challenge, choose a reel rule and, in linked modes, a latch setting, then make a fresh window. A remix code lets you load the same puzzle again or pass its arrangement to a friend.

MAKE A POSTCARD
In Postcard Studio, choose an earned character, paper and frame. Add a short note and an illustrated stamp. Earn your first stamp by completing a window, then collect seven more through campaign milestones. Your latest design stays saved as a local draft. Share your finished design as a static 1200 x 1000 PNG through the iOS share menu.

Keep your progress on your device and return to an unfinished window whenever you like. Adjust sounds, haptics and illustration motion to suit your pace. Everything works offline, with no account, ads or in-app purchases.

One little turn. A whole new story.

• Blue lines for your own bell, computed from place notation for every row
• Place bells and lead-end work: dodges, makes and hunting, lead by lead
• Spaced review cards so methods stay learned between practice nights
• Tap-to-ring practice in the bell circle with a striking strip in milliseconds
• 48 classic methods from Doubles to Maximus, plus any method you write in place notation
• Calls and touches: bobs and singles, checked for truth

Without a subscription: Plain Hunt and Plain Bob on every stage with blue lines, place bells and ringing practice, review cards and the peal book. Plainhunt Plus is a monthly or yearly subscription: every method in the book, the full review plan, practice on every method and stage, your own methods and striking history. It renews automatically; cancel any time in your Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before renewal.

Plainhunt is an independent app and is not linked with any ringing society or guild. Method names and place notation are checked by hand against published method collections; every row is computed on your device. Striking figures are estimates: they depend on your phone's touch and audio delay, so calibrate once and use the speaker or wired headphones.
