name: Plainspoke: Speak Clearly
description:
Five minutes a day to speak clearer. Your voice never leaves your phone.

Read a line out loud and watch every word light up as Plainspoke hears it: clear, unclear or skipped. It measures your pace, your fillers and how lively your voice sounds, and compares every session to your own starting line. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone, so nothing you say is uploaded.

A FIVE-MINUTE DAILY SESSION
• Warm-up, a sound drill, a tongue twister, a read-aloud passage and 30 seconds of free talk
• Built around your goals: clearer words, slower pace, fewer fillers, a stronger voice
• Tomorrow's sound drill picks the sound that slipped most this week

SEE EVERY WORD LAND
• Words turn mint when they land, amber when they blur, gray when you skip them
• A live pace meter with your target band
• A waveform that moves with your voice

CLEAR, HONEST NUMBERS
• Clarity, pace in words per minute, fillers, pitch range and volume steadiness
• A 20-second baseline on day one; every session is measured against it, not against anyone else
• "Still slipping" shows the exact words to work on

FREE TALK
• 60 topics: interview questions, presentation openers and everyday prompts
• A live transcript that highlights "um", "uh" and filler "like"
• Long pauses marked, so you can see where you lost the thread

A LIBRARY OF 180 DRILLS
• Consonant pairs: P/B, T/D, K/G, R/L, S/Z/SH, TH, V/W and word endings
• Tongue twisters, pace control, vowels, pauses, projection
• Classic passages to read aloud: Lincoln, Twain, Austen, Dickinson, Shakespeare and more

PROGRESS YOU CAN HEAR
• Clarity, pace and filler charts with your baseline line
• A practice calendar and streak
• Then vs Now: the same passage on day one and today, back to back
• A progress card to share

REHEARSE YOUR OWN TEXT
• Paste a speech or toast, set a target length, rehearse it section by section
• Every run is timed and scored; lines you rush get highlighted

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
• Your streak, today's sound and the twister of the day on your Home Screen
• Lock Screen widgets
• "Start today's warm-up" with Siri, Shortcuts or the Action button

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone, recordings stay on your iPhone, and you can delete everything in one tap. Plainspoke has no server.

PLAINSPOKE PRO
The daily session, your baseline, three drill categories, one free talk a day, seven days of progress and all widgets are free, forever. Pro adds the full library of 180 drills, unlimited Free Talk, My Text rehearsal, Then vs Now, your full history and every card style. Choose yearly with a free one-week trial, monthly, or unlock Pro once, for life.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://aquatic-alto-bc9.notion.site/Plainspoke-Privacy-Policy-4215ee35e479802d9c51e7d76f04af59

Plainspoke is speaking practice, not speech therapy. For stuttering, voice pain or a speech disorder, talk to a licensed speech-language pathologist.

name: Plan Cưới: Kế hoạch đám cưới
description:
Plan Cưới giúp các cặp đôi Việt Nam chuẩn bị đám cưới từ lúc bắt đầu đến ngày trọng đại, trong một ứng dụng duy nhất.

HỎI HOA, TRỢ LÝ CƯỚI BẰNG AI
Hỏi Hoa bất cứ điều gì về đám cưới: nên đặt nhà hàng trước bao lâu, lễ ăn hỏi cần chuẩn bị gì, chi phí trung bình ở thành phố của bạn. Hoa trả lời theo ngày cưới, ngân sách và kế hoạch của chính bạn.

VIỆC CẦN LÀM THEO NGÀY CƯỚI
Danh sách việc cần làm tự sắp theo ngày cưới, nhắc trước từng mốc: xem ngày, đặt nhà hàng, chụp ảnh cưới, may áo dài, gửi thiệp. Đánh dấu xong từng việc và biết mình đang ở đâu.

NGÂN SÁCH CHIA HAI NHÀ
Ghi từng khoản chi, chia phần nhà trai và nhà gái, theo dõi tiền đặt cọc và khoản còn phải trả. Sổ mừng ghi lại từng phong bì để biết tổng tiền mừng mỗi bên.

KHÁCH MỜI VÀ SƠ ĐỒ BÀN
Lập danh sách khách theo nhà trai, nhà gái, bạn bè, đồng nghiệp. Chọn mẫu sảnh, để Hoa xếp khách vào từng bàn, kéo chỉnh rồi in sơ đồ gửi nhà hàng.

TÌM NHÀ CUNG CẤP
Tìm nhà hàng tiệc cưới, studio chụp ảnh, váy cưới, trang điểm, áo dài, vest chú rể trên khắp Việt Nam. Xem ảnh, giá tham khảo, đánh giá và so sánh trước khi liên hệ.

AI STUDIO
Dùng ảnh của chính bạn để thử trước váy cưới, kiểu trang điểm và kiểu tóc.

THIỆP CƯỚI ONLINE CÙNG ZENLOVE
Xem các mẫu thiệp cưới online của đối tác ZenLove ngay trong app, rồi tạo thiệp và gửi đường link cho khách qua Zalo, Messenger.

XEM TUỔI VÀ NGÀY CƯỚI
Tính tuổi Kim Lâu, xem tuổi vợ chồng theo âm lịch, xem lịch âm cho ngày cưới.

MẸO HAY VÀ CỘNG ĐỒNG
Đọc cẩm nang cưới, xem video mẹo hay và trao đổi kinh nghiệm với các cặp đôi khác.

Đăng nhập bằng email, Google hoặc Apple để lưu kế hoạch của bạn.

Góp ý: help@plancuoi.com

name: Planetto: Cosmic Merge
description:
Start with dust. Reach the Sun.

In Planetto, drop objects into a container. When two matching objects touch, they merge into the next level up. Keep the container from overflowing and aim for the biggest planet you can reach.

Highlights
• 11 levels of cosmic evolution: Travel from dust and pebbles through meteorites and comets, on to the Moon and Jupiter, and finally the Sun.
• Free play mode: Play without limits and beat your own record.
• Daily Challenge: A daily run that everyone plays with the same sequence of objects. Three goals: bronze, silver and gold.
• Collection: Every planet you reach is saved in your collection. The ones you have not discovered yet stay hidden behind a "?".
• Power-ups: Shake, Pop and Upgrade help you out when a run gets tight.
• Streak and rewards: Play every day to grow your streak and complete the 7-day reward calendar.
• There is a secret waiting to be discovered inside the container.

Your daily habit
A new challenge every day. Everyone gets the same sequence of objects, so you can compare your results and keep your streak alive. A run usually lasts 5 to 15 minutes, so it fits well into a short break.

Play offline
The game can be played without an internet connection. No account or sign-in is required.

Free to play. Contains ads. You can make a one-time in-app purchase to remove interstitial ads. Rewarded ads always stay optional.

name: Playbryn Arcade
description:
Playbryn Arcade is a tight trio of mini-games packed into one gentle, offline-friendly loop. No login, no ads, no real-money purchases — just three distinct game feels sharing a single star economy, daily streaks, and a growing shelf of achievements.

HUE VOLLEY — COLOR MOSAIC PUZZLE
A mosaic of coloured tiles sits on the left; only the right-most tile of each row is exposed. Dock cannons from queues on the right and watch them auto-fire at tiles of their own colour until their ammo runs out. The twist: if the dock fills up and nothing can shoot, you jam. Plan which colours you bring in. Deploy Extra Dock, Sweep, and Shuffle boosters when the board gets tangled.

KNOT LOOM — RELAXING THREAD PUZZLE
Each pin on the board shows how many threads must be stitched to it. Drag between pins to weave yarn and reveal the hidden picture. Simple to start, meditative to master. Stuck? A Hint booster reveals one correct thread.

VORTEX RUSH — ARENA ACTION
Pilot a storm drone around a tight arena. Swallow smaller rival drones to grow your mass, boost past the bigger ones, and finish the round with the largest total. Spend stars between rounds on permanent upgrades — Magnet, Radar, Storm Surge, and a few cosmetic storms.

CORE LOOP
• Three distinct play styles — reactive puzzle, calm logic, bursty arcade — all in one app
• Earn stars by playing, spend on boosters, upgrades, and cosmetics
• 7-day rolling daily reward with growing payouts (10 → 75 stars)
• Rotating daily challenge with its own bonus pool
• Achievement shelf with 15+ medals (First Steps → Rising Legend)
• Session history and per-game stats on the Dashboard

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO REAL MONEY
• Everything stays on your device by default
• Stars have no cash value and cannot be bought
• No in-app purchases, no ad interruptions
• Works offline after the first launch handshake

DEVICE SUPPORT
• iPhone and iPad
• iOS 15.1 and newer
• Landscape gameplay, portrait welcome screen
• Haptics, sound effects, system-matched colour accent

INSTALL ATTRIBUTION & PRIVACY
We use Adjust for install attribution so campaign performance can be measured. iOS will ask once whether to allow tracking — if you decline, attribution still works without an advertising identifier. Full policy at https://www.privacypolicies.com/live/73f5346a-bf58-4eb8-9449-b4466bf8fde6

We hope Playbryn Arcade becomes part of your break routine — a few mosaics on the commute, a loom puzzle in the evening, a vortex round whenever you want a jolt. Enjoy.

name: Playcaller: Football Coach
description:
YOU CALL THE PLAY. YOUR TEAM RUNS IT.

Playcaller puts you on the sideline as the head coach of a football club. Pick the play, watch all 22 players run it on a 3D field, and see in plain words why it worked or why it didn't. Then make the next call.

NEW TO FOOTBALL? START HERE.
You don't need to know the sport. Every call says what it is for before you choose it, the arrows on the grass show your plan, and every result comes with a one-line reason. A glossary explains the words you'll meet. You'll understand the game by coaching it.

KNOW FOOTBALL? CALL IT YOUR WAY.
Twenty-seven offensive plays and fourteen defences: inside and outside runs, read options, quick game, play-action, deep shots, screens, zone, man, pressure and disguise. Go for it on fourth down, kick, or punt. Your coach suggests a call; the decision is yours.

A GAME IN TEN MINUTES
The short game plays the routine downs for you and hands you the ones that decide it: third and fourth downs, the goal line, the last two minutes. Want every snap? Switch to the full game from the menu.

FOOTBALL THAT BEHAVES LIKE FOOTBALL
Every play is simulated with all 22 players: blocks are won and lost, linebackers fill the gap, receivers get open or don't, punts bounce and get fair caught, and kick returns sometimes break. Coaches on the other sideline call plays the way real coaches do in the same situation.

BUILD A CLUB OVER YEARS
Take over one of eight fictional clubs. Play the season and the playoffs, then renew contracts, trade, and draft the next class. Train your players and watch them develop, age and retire. Your club's records and history stay with it.

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE
• Plays offline. No account, no sign-in, no advertising.
• Your career is saved on your device.
• Every club and player is fictional.

Your first season, with its playoffs and draft, is complete and playable from start to finish. A single in-app purchase opens every season after it. There is no subscription.

name: PlayDeck Console
description:
PlayDeck Console is a self-contained developer console for Google Play, App Store Connect and Microsoft Store on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

ONE DASHBOARD, THREE STORES
Connect only the stores you manage and view apps side by side or filter by store. Inspect release states, version tracks, builds, TestFlight groups, in-app purchases, subscriptions and supported Microsoft Store submissions.

CUSTOMER REVIEWS AND VITALS
Read ratings and customer reviews, post supported public replies after confirmation, and inspect available Google Play crash, ANR and error data. Review data refreshes manually in the app; there is no background review-alert service.

API EXPLORERS
Browse operations from the bundled Google Play, App Store Connect and Microsoft Store API catalogs. Every mutating operation requires explicit confirmation; connecting a store is optional when inspecting the bundled explorers and appearance settings.

DIRECT AND PRIVATE
Supply your own Google Play service-account JSON, App Store Connect Team API key or Microsoft Partner Center credentials. Keys are stored in platform Keychain storage and requests go directly to official provider APIs over HTTPS. PlayDeck has no developer-operated server, ads or analytics.

name: PlayerFlow Coach Console
description:
Coach focused reaction training with PlayerFlow Coach Console.

Coach Console connects by Bluetooth to a nearby PlayerFlow smart rebound training system. It gives coaches a fast, simple way to run reaction drills from an iPhone without relying on a gym Wi-Fi connection.

With Coach Console, you can:
- Connect to a nearby PlayerFlow training system.
- Select a reaction pace and session duration.
- Start and stop drills from the sideline.
- Follow live hits, score, accuracy, pace, and time remaining.
- Hear start, success, miss, and final-countdown cues.
- Review hits, misses, score, passing accuracy, average reaction time, and consistency when a session finishes.

PlayerFlow Coach Console is designed for coaches and players using compatible PlayerFlow smart rebound panels. PlayerFlow hardware is required to run drills.

name: PlayLocalCourts
description:
Play more tennis and pickleball with people near you.

PlayLocalCourts is for local meet groups and ladders. Find a group at your courts on the map, or start your own in a minute.

MEETS
• Weekly meets and one-off sessions, with a player limit and an automatic waitlist
• Tap "I'm in" or "Maybe", see who's coming and their level, and say if you're running late
• Reminders before meets, and a notification when a spot opens up

LADDERS
• Singles and doubles ladders: challenge the players just above you and move up when you win
• Private chat to set up each match, and scores that update the ladder

CHAT
• Group chats for finding hitting partners, court news and extra sessions
• Private messages to other members

FOR ORGANIZERS
• Approve members, schedule meets, cancel for rain, email the group, print a flyer with a QR code

Notifications for meet changes, chat replies and ladder challenges, so you never miss a game. Free, no ads.

name: Pledge Prep: Citizenship Test
description:
Preparing for the Canadian citizenship test? Pledge Prep is for Canada's test only. It does not cover the U.S. naturalization test.

Pledge Prep turns the official study guide, Discover Canada, into 542 original practice questions. Each one comes with a short explanation and the chapter and section it is based on, so you always know where to read more.

PRACTISE LIKE THE REAL TEST
• Timed mock exams: 20 questions, 30 minutes, 15 correct to pass
• Questions drawn from every chapter, plus your own province or territory
• Pause the timer at any time. Questions stay hidden while you are paused
• Review every answer when you finish

LEARN WHAT YOU MISS
• Smart review brings back each mistake after 10 minutes, then 1, 3, 7 and 14 days
• Reviews are timed to finish before your test date
• Bookmark tricky questions and practise them later

STUDY YOUR WAY
• Chapter-by-chapter study with progress for each chapter
• Test-date countdown and a readiness score
• Questions for all 13 provinces and territories
• Read-aloud uses your iPhone's built-in voices and works offline

CHINESE EXPLANATIONS FOR EVERY QUESTION
Questions are in English, like the real test. Under each answer you can show a full explanation in Simplified Chinese (简体中文) or Traditional Chinese (繁體中文). The app interface is also available in French and Chinese.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your answers, test date and progress stay on your iPhone.

FREE TO START
Chapters 1 and 2 and one full mock exam are free. One payment unlocks every chapter, every province and unlimited mock exams. No subscription, no renewal.

FACTS THAT CHANGE
A few facts in the guide are out of date, such as office holders and the number of electoral districts. These questions are marked with the date they were last checked, and the explanation tells you what changed.

NOT A GOVERNMENT APP
Pledge Prep is an independent study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Government of Canada or Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC). Questions are original paraphrases, not official test questions. Discover Canada is free on canada.ca and remains your primary resource. For test dates, rules and your application, always check canada.ca.

name: Plotveil
description:
Plotveil is an offline companion for mystery script nights.

• Top segmented control: Scripts, Session, Clues, Debrief
• Stacked cards for scripts and local tools
• Role randomizer and session notes
• Clue checklist and venue wishlist
• Desk for guide, haptics, privacy, support, and clear
No login. Airplane Mode OK.

name: PlugNET Móvel
description:
Bem-vindo ao aplicativo da PlugNET Telecom, a sua operadora de telefonia móvel digital que simplifica a sua vida!

Com o app PlugNET Móvel, você tem tudo o que precisa na palma da mão:

Controle Total: Acompanhe seus planos, saldos e consumo de dados em tempo real.

Recargas e Pagamentos: Recarregue e efetue pagamentos de forma prática e rápida diretamente no app.

Gestão Simplificada: Alterne planos, contrate pacotes extras e resolva tudo sem burocracia.

Atendimento Facilitado: Conte com suporte personalizado sempre que precisar, de forma simples e eficiente.

Aqui, você tem liberdade, praticidade e zero complicações. Baixe agora e descubra como é fácil gerenciar sua linha com a PlugNET Telecom!

name: PlugRota
description:
Share one home charger between two electric cars. Enter each car’s charging needs, when it can plug in and when it has to be ready. PlugRota works out which car to charge first and when to move the cable.

• Compare charging schedules and estimated costs using your electricity tariff.
• See how much charge each car can receive before departure.
• Save your plan and set an optional cable swap reminder.

Designed for UK households. Planning uses UK time and prices in pounds. The cable swap and any charger timers are set by you.

name: PLUSHIEPLANETSA
seller_name: FANATIK DIGITAL GORUNTU SISTEMLERI PAZARLAMA SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Welcome! We look forward to accompanying you on your journey—please feel free to share your valuable suggestions.


PLUSHIEPLANETSA is a calm laundry room for your iPhone. Keep every garment's care label, drop clothes into a basket that sorts itself into safe loads, log each wash and never run out of detergent.

THE BASKET THAT SORTS ITSELF
Queue clothes for the next wash by tapping them on the garment rail. PLUSHIEPLANETSA groups the basket into loads by colour family (whites, lights, brights, darks), keeps wool, silk and hand-wash items in a separate delicates load, sets aside anything marked "do not wash" for the dry cleaner, and picks the lowest temperature allowed by every label in the load.

START A LOAD
Choose the programme, temperature and detergent, optionally ask for a reminder when the wash is done, and press Start. The drum spins, the cycle is logged, the clothes leave the basket, and the detergent shelf is updated.

YOUR WARDROBE WITH CARE LABELS
• Add garments with category, colour, fabric, notes and an optional photo
• Set the care label with clear symbols: washing temperature or hand wash, bleach, drying, ironing and dry-cleaning
• See each garment's wears, washes, wears per wash and full care history
• Search, filter by category and sort by name, most worn, most washed or recently worn

CARE GUIDE
• A legend of care symbols, shown in °C numbers or Fahrenheit-style heat dots
• Step-by-step stain guides for wine, coffee, grass, grease, blood, ink, make-up, sweat, chocolate, tomato, mud and candle wax, with separate steps for cotton & linen, delicates and synthetics
• Add your own notes on what worked
• An ironing checklist: add items or pick them from your wardrobe, tick them off, clear finished ones

SUPPLIES
Track detergent, softener, stain remover and more as doses. Every logged load uses its dose, low items are flagged in the app, and you can get a low-stock notification.

LAUNDRY DAYS & REMINDERS
Set recurring laundry days with weekly reminders, and an optional "wash is done" reminder when you start a load.

STATISTICS
Washes per week, temperature split, most washed and most worn clothes, and detergent use over the last 30 days. Export a PDF report, CSV files or all your data as JSON.

YOUR ACCOUNT, OFFLINE FIRST
Create an account with your email address. Everything is saved on your iPhone first and works offline; changes sync to your private account when you're connected. Edit your profile, change your password, sign out, or permanently delete your account and data from Settings.

Light and dark appearance, haptics, Dynamic Type support and VoiceOver labels are built in.

Stain and care tips are general household guidance — always follow the garment's own care label.

name: Pluto - self care journey
description:
Self-care is better with a friend. Meet Pluto, a little bird who grows as you take care of yourself.

Every small thing you do for yourself, like drinking water, getting out of bed, taking a breath or texting a friend, gives your bird energy. Fill the energy bar and your bird heads out on an adventure, then comes home with stories, discoveries and treasures to share.

TINY GOALS, REAL PROGRESS
Pick gentle goals from hundreds of ideas or write your own. Check them off with a happy tap and watch your bird light up. Finished goals tuck away neatly so your day feels calm, not crowded.

A COZY HOME TO MAKE YOURS
Earn Rainbow Stones and decorate your bird's room with furniture, plants, lamps and wallpaper. Dress your bird in hats, scarves and outfits. Move, swap or remove anything in the room.

A JOURNEY THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Level up from Hatchling to Pluto Legend. Unlock titles, treasure chests and Streak Repairs, and earn bronze, silver and gold achievements as you build habits that last.

TOOLS FOR HARD MOMENTS
Breathing exercises, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, affirmations, guided reflections, quizzes, movement routines and a first aid kit for tough days. Log your mood, name your emotions and spot patterns over time.

MADE FOR REAL BRAINS
Whether you live with depression, anxiety, ADHD, autism or just a busy week, Pluto goes at your pace. No guilt, no pressure. Pause your streak when life happens.

ALWAYS PRIVATE
No account needed. Your journal, moods and goals stay on your iPhone.

PLUTO PLUS
Pluto is free to download and use. Pluto Plus unlocks the full self-care library (every reflection, quiz, routine, breathing pattern and goal idea), soundscapes, deeper insights and daily shop deals.
Plans: Monthly $7.99 or Yearly $59.99. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pluto-selfcare.gamingsym1.workers.dev/privacy

Pluto is a self-care companion, not a medical device or a replacement for professional care. If you are in crisis, please contact your local emergency number.

name: PlyoLens
description:
PlyoLens (antes FlightMark Assist), una app de Houseflow creada por Iván López, te ayuda a revisar saltos deportivos mediante vídeo.

RESULTADOS MÁS CLAROS
Consulta tarjetas de altura estimada, vuelo, contacto y RSI cuando corresponde. Sigue la evolución de hasta 12 saltos revisados y compara resultados del mismo deportista y protocolo. Los Drop Jumps se separan por altura de cajón. Los resultados pendientes de revisión quedan fuera de las gráficas. Diseño en negro y amarillo.

ABRE, REVISA Y CONFIRMA
Importa un vídeo desde Fotos o graba desde la app. En dispositivos compatibles puedes seleccionar captura de 120 o 240 fps. Revisa a 0,25×, 0,5×, 1× o 2×, avanza fotograma a fotograma y ajusta contacto inicial, despegue y aterrizaje. Confirma las marcas antes de guardar.

CÁLCULOS TRAZABLES
Consulta tiempo de vuelo, altura estimada por tiempo de vuelo y, en Drop Jump, tiempo de contacto y RSI. La vista de diagnóstico muestra timestamps, eventos, unidades, fórmula y versión del cálculo. Cambiar la velocidad de reproducción no cambia las métricas.

HISTORIAL Y EXPORTACIÓN
Organiza deportistas y evaluaciones, revisa resultados y exporta informes. El procesamiento y almacenamiento se realizan en el dispositivo, sin cuenta, anuncios ni servidor de PlyoLens.

APOYO OPCIONAL CON AIRPODS
Durante una captura conjunta, los AirPods compatibles pueden registrar señales de movimiento de cabeza. Revisa curvas y cambio de orientación respecto al reposo junto al vídeo. Esta función es experimental: no modifica automáticamente las mediciones ni se ha demostrado que mejore su precisión. Puedes utilizar la app sin AirPods.

LÍMITES DE LA MEDICIÓN
La altura por tiempo de vuelo es una estimación que supone una altura similar del centro de masas en despegue y aterrizaje. La nitidez, los fotogramas disponibles y la revisión de eventos condicionan el resultado. No se ha establecido equivalencia con una plataforma de fuerzas. La app no mide fuerza, asimetría de apoyo, posición absoluta de cabeza ni desplazamiento directo del centro de masas. No está destinada a diagnosticar enfermedades ni a tomar decisiones médicas.

La interfaz está disponible en español. La captura de alta frecuencia y las funciones de movimiento dependen del dispositivo y los accesorios compatibles.

name: PMD Odd Time Speed Ramp
description:
PMD Odd Time Speed Ramp is an iPhone metronome for practising unusual time signatures and building speed gradually. Set a steady click for everyday practice, or build a phrase that changes meter from bar to bar.

Odd Time
Set a time signature for each of up to four bars and choose which bars to play. Adjust the primary and secondary pulses, or use Custom Count on supported meters to edit individual clicks and accents.

Speed Ramp
Choose a starting tempo, a target tempo, and the size of each BPM step. Increase the tempo after a set number of bars or a timed interval. Add an audible cue for tempo changes or reverse the ramp when it reaches its target.

Metronome and Mixer
Adjust click sounds, levels, and mutes. Follow the full-screen display or the wooden pendulum. Close the Odd Time editor to return to your regular metronome setup.

Save and Export
Save named patterns for later practice and export WAV audio to use as a practice track. Open the offline User Manual from the information menu for step-by-step instructions.

name: PocketMic
description:
iPhoneに話すと、Macのカーソル位置に文字が入る。

PocketMicは、iPhoneのキーボードの音声入力で話した言葉を、Macでいまカーソルがある場所へそのまま入力するアプリです。メールの返信も、チャットも、資料の下書きも、口元のiPhoneに話すだけ。Macの内蔵マイクより声を拾いやすく、⌘Vを押す必要もありません。

■ 使い方
1. Macで、文字を入れたい場所をクリックしておく
2. iPhoneでPocketMicを開き、キーボードの音声入力で話す
3. 話し終わると、Macのカーソル位置に文字が入る

■ おもな機能
・Macに直接入力：同じWi-FiにあるMacへ、話した文字を送ってカーソル位置に入力します（無料のMac用アプリ「PocketMic for Mac」が必要です）
・自動でクリップボードにコピー：入力が止まると自動でコピー。ユニバーサルクリップボードでMacに⌘Vして貼ることもできます
・続けて話すと入れ替え：送ったあとに続けて音声入力すると、前の文章は自動で消えて新しく話した内容に。前の文章は履歴に残ります
・届いたかが色でわかる：Macに入力できたら画面のふちが緑に、届かなかったらオレンジに光ります
・つながる前に話しても大丈夫：Macにつながっていない間に話した分は、つながりしだい送ります
・書き足した分だけ送る：入力欄に文章を溜めたままでも、Macに同じ文が二重に入りません
・コピーの履歴：直近30件まで残り、タップで呼び戻せます
・アプリを開けばすぐ入力：開いた瞬間にキーボードが出て、このアプリで最後に使ったキーボードに切り替わります

■ Mac版について

name: Pointiz : badges et pointage
description:
Pointiz tient le registre de présence de votre établissement : mairie, administration, entreprise, école.

Réservée aux établissements qui utilisent Pointiz : l'espace et les comptes sont créés par le responsable de l'établissement. On ne s'inscrit pas et rien ne s'achète dans l'application. Au premier lancement, tapez le code de votre établissement.

LA BORNE D'ENTRÉE
• Une tablette ou un téléphone posé à l'entrée, relié une seule fois par un code donné par le gérant.
• Chacun pointe avec son badge à code (montré à l'appareil photo), sa carte NFC ou son code à 6 chiffres.
• Arrivée ou départ reconnu tout seul, à l'heure ou en retard selon l'heure prévue de la personne.
• L'heure retenue est celle du serveur, pas celle de l'appareil.
• Sans réseau, la borne continue d'enregistrer : elle date chaque pointage d'après la dernière heure reçue du serveur et l'envoie dès le retour du réseau. Le gérant voit l'heure de réception, avec une alerte si l'écart dépasse 30 minutes.
• La borne affiche seulement le prénom et la photo de la personne qui pointe, jamais le registre : l'accueil voit tout de suite qui pointe. Réglage « photo obligatoire » possible.

LES BADGES
• Un badge par personne, à imprimer au format carte, avec un code de secours à 6 chiffres.
• Badge perdu : un nouveau est créé, l'ancien ne marche plus.
• Carte NFC : associez une carte à une personne (Chrome sur Android, et l'iPhone).

L'ESPACE DU GÉRANT
• La journée d'un coup d'œil : qui est là, qui est en retard, qui n'est pas encore arrivé, sur une frise de 6 h à 10 h.
• Rapports par période : jours de présence, retards, absences, heures, départs non pointés ; export en tableur.
• Corrections avec un motif obligatoire : un pointage s'annule, il ne s'efface pas, et chaque geste est inscrit au journal.
• Comptes de gestion pour vos responsables, avec des droits limités.

LE POINTAGE DEPUIS LE TÉLÉPHONE (si le gérant l'autorise)
• La personne touche « J'arrive » : sa position est demandée une seule fois, à ce moment-là, et le pointage n'est accepté que si le téléphone indique une position dans le rayon du lieu de travail. Seule la distance au lieu de travail est gardée, jamais la position. La personne n'est jamais suivie le reste du temps.

VOS DONNÉES
• Hébergées en Europe de l'Ouest, effacées automatiquement chaque jour après la durée de conservation choisie par l'établissement (12 à 60 mois).
• Aucune publicité, aucune mesure d'audience, aucune donnée vendue.

Pointiz est édité par Mavoix Digital SASU (France).

name: PolyCairn
description:
PolyCairn is a focused workspace for one-variable polynomials with rational coefficients. Enter the coefficients you mean, compute within a clearly bounded exact-arithmetic engine, and keep the inputs and steps alongside the result.

BUILD A COEFFICIENT LIBRARY
Create a polynomial by exponent rows using signed integers or p/q fractions. Values are reduced with positive denominators, and high zero coefficients are removed. Explicit zero is a valid zero polynomial. Name, note, duplicate and search saved definitions. You can also import the tool's documented UTF-8 coefficient CSV with the header power,numerator,denominator after reviewing the complete input.

CALCULATE AND FOLLOW THE WORK
Choose addition, subtraction, multiplication, division or formal differentiation. Arithmetic results retain rational coefficients rather than silently saving rounded decimals. Division shows quotient, remainder and the actual sequence of leading terms, subtracted polynomials and successive remainders. Inspect the relationship A = BQ + R, then deliberately save a result, quotient or remainder as a new independent polynomial.

Evaluate at an integer or rational x using exact Horner steps. The fraction result and any approximate decimal display remain distinct. Changing the source or x calls for a new calculation. The engine checks intermediate arithmetic bounds and reports an exceeded limit instead of quietly replacing an exact result with floating-point output.

PLOT WITH AN EXPLICIT BOUNDARY
Choose an x-domain and draw 401 evenly spaced Double samples. Inspect a sample's x, y and status. Non-finite values or values outside the plotting range create a visible break rather than a clipped connecting segment. The curve is approximate numeric sampling; it does not find or certify all roots.

FREEZE AND EXPORT
Save arithmetic, evaluation or plot reports with copied coefficients, settings and complete steps or samples. Editing or deleting a current polynomial does not rewrite a frozen report. Generate real CSV, JSON or paginated PDF files, inspect their byte counts and hashes, and share the files you choose. Delete an individual report and its internal outputs, or confirm Erase all data in About. External source files, previously shared copies and system backups are separate.

SUPPORTED LIMITS
One variable x, degree at most 16. Manual coefficient numerators have absolute value at most 1,000,000,000; denominators are 1-1,000,000. CSV input is at most 65,536 bytes and 17 data rows. Rational arithmetic is bounded Int64 arithmetic, not arbitrary precision. Plot domains satisfy −1000 ≤ minimum less than maximum ≤ 1000. This is not a general expression parser, symbolic integration system, root solver or data-fitting tool.

The native coefficient library and reports are stored locally in the app container. No app login is required.

name: PolySiege: Turn-Based Strategy
description:
Ancient armies on a hex map. Every fight is decided by where you stand and which way you face.

Choose your leader, Alexander and the Macedonians, Caesar and the Romans, Genghis Khan and the Mongols, or Qin Shi Huang and the Qin, each with their own units and strengths. Grow your cities, win over villages, raise squads, research your way from horses and archery to siege engines, and march.

FACING AND FLANKS
A squad is strong to its front and weak to its flanks and rear. Hold a line, turn to meet a charge, or send cavalry around the side and strike where the enemy cannot answer.

GAMES YOUR WAY
• Quick Battle: a short fight on a small map, ready in seconds.
• Skirmish: a full game against several computer players at four difficulty levels, with teams, fog of war and maps from tiny to large.
• Online: invite friends with a code or a link and play on phones and computers together, with shared vision for team-mates. No account needed.

MADE TO BE PLAYED
• Plays fully offline.
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking.
• Saves after every move and picks up where you left off.
• Plays on phones, tablets and the web.

name: PooperScooperAI
description:
PooperScooperAI is the back office for pooper-scooper businesses that run on Jobber or Sweep&Go. This app puts it in your pocket.

- Inbox: every lead and customer conversation, by text and email, with the ones waiting on a reply first.
- Lead assistant drafts: send them as written, edit them, or dismiss them. Turn the assistant off for anyone, any time.
- Quotes: send a priced quote page from your own rates, then see who opened it and who said yes.
- Your numbers: revenue, recurring clients, cost per customer, crew hours and money owed, with what needs your attention first.
- Mass Text and follow-ups: tell everyone on a route about a weather delay, and see how each follow-up is doing.
- Settings: connect Jobber, Sweep&Go, Facebook and Google, register your texting with the carriers, and edit the quote form on your website.
- Notifications for new leads, replies, drafts waiting for you, accepted quotes, and a dropped connection. Each kind has its own switch.

A PooperScooperAI account is required. Businesses sign up at pooperscooperai.com, and staff join by invite from the owner.

name: Portal Glyph
description:
Portal Glyph is an offline puzzle studio built around one craft: card-circuit composition.

Each chamber deals a fixed pool of patterned cards. Edges carry glyph channels—vein, ribbon, lattice, spiral. Identical glyphs dock; blanks never connect. Drag cards onto the grid, tap to rotate through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°, and seal every required card into a closed loop with no open ports or false joins.

This is not solitaire, not match-3, and not a battle game. There is no random draw, no timing pressure, and no narrative campaign—only deliberate rotation and docking.

Progress through three tiers: • Intro — compact square seals and first locked cards
• Standard — decoys to leave in the tray, mixed glyphs, wider galleries
• Master — rotation locks, corner-suit constraints, nested circuits

Tools stay simple: undo one step, reset the board, track moves and stars. Progress and preferences save on device. No account, no ads, no tracking, no push notifications.

name: Pose & Go: Pose Camera
description:
Know where to stand, what to do with your hands and how to fit everyone in the shot. Pose & Go puts a pose outline over your live camera preview so you can line up the frame before you shoot. The outline stays in the viewfinder. Your saved photos and videos stay clean.

Choose from 94 built-in poses for solo portraits, pairs, groups and playful photos. Move, resize or mirror the guide, or create a new outline from a photo on your iPhone. The app creates the outline on your device. Switch between an outline and a reference photo for each built-in pose.

Adjust exposure, focus, shutter speed, ISO and white balance on supported cameras. Shoot photos or videos, and explore Live Photos, portrait, slow motion, time-lapse and other modes where your iPhone supports them. Use Apple Watch as a remote when your iPhone is in position.

Review your latest shot from the camera thumbnail. With permission, Pose & Go adds photos and videos to your Photos library automatically.

name: Posely: Pose Ideas & Coach
description:
Posely shows you how to pose for a photo, so you know what to do when the camera comes out.

Pick where you are: a city street, a coffee table, the beach, golden hour, a trip, date night, a night out or home. Posely gives you a pose to copy and three steps to get into it.

EVERY POSE HAS
• A picture to copy
• Three clear steps
• Four small tips: hands, shoulders, body angle and expression

GUIDE CAMERA
• The pose is laid over your camera, so you or your friend can line the shot up
• Front or back camera, with a 3 or 10 second timer
• Photos save straight to your library

TODAY
• Six poses each day, starting with what you have coming up
• Shuffle for new ideas and save the ones you like

28 poses for women and men. No account and no ads. Your answers stay on your iPhone. The people in Posely's pictures are not real: every picture was made for the app.

POSELY PREMIUM
Posely needs a subscription, yearly or weekly.

Posely Premium is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

name: POTATO or BUNNY
description:
ジャガイモか、うさぎのおしりか。

飼いうさぎのおしりを投稿したら、海外の人に「potato」と言われた——
それ、本当に見分けられますか？

出てくる写真やイラストが「ジャガイモ」か「うさぎのおしり」かを当てるだけ。
1回でも間違えたら終わり。何連続まで行けるかを世界中の人と競おう。

■ だんだん本気で難しくなる
ズーム、ぼかし、モザイク、回転、モノクロ、制限時間1秒。
しっぽの無いうさぎや、割れ目のあるジャガイモも出てきます。

■ 今日の10問
毎日0時に入れ替わる、世界共通の10問。結果は緑と赤のマスで、ネタバレなしにシェアできます。

■ 正解発表がたのしい
間違えると、どんな体勢のうさぎだったか、何という品種のジャガイモだったかが分かります。

■ うさぎのモデルは「ぷっしゅ」
写真のうさぎは、Instagram・TikTokで人気のうさぎ「ぷっしゅ」です。

・広告なし／完全無料
・アカウント登録なし
・日本語／英語

name: PounceCask
description: PounceCask is a stationery-themed timed picture quiz. Choose Word Match: see an English word and tap the matching item among four pictures; or Spot Hunt: find the named item on a nine-tile grid, and misses stay on the board. Score for hits, lose points for misses, with combo bonuses in Hunt. A guide introduces a dozen school supplies. Scores are saved to a local leaderboard so you can beat your best anytime.

name: Pour Match
description:
Pour Match keeps two-part resin batches on this iPhone.

Pour part A, then part B. When B overshoots the ratio, catch-up adds the A that brings the mix back. A pour under 5 g is not kept. If the A can cannot cover the add, the pour stays off ratio and the can stays put. The last batch cannot be deleted. Changing the ratio does not change pours already stored.

Readings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Powline: Ski & Snowboard
description:
Your whole mountain day, in one app. Powline tracks every run, tells you where the powder is, and helps get you home safe. Built for skiers AND snowboarders.

NEVER LOSE A DAY
• Tap Record, put your phone in your pocket, and ride. Powline detects every lift and run on its own.
• Crash-proof: your day is saved every few seconds, so a dead battery or a closed app never loses it.
• Battery Saver turns GPS down while you're on lifts.
• Fix anything in one tap: split or merge runs, mark a lift, trim the drive home. Every edit can be undone.

KNOW WHERE THE POWDER IS
• A daily Powder Score (0–100) for your mountain, from fresh snow, temperature, wind and sunshine.
• A plain-English verdict every morning, tailored to how you ride.
• 7-day snow forecast and the best bets on YOUR pass this weekend.
• Powder alerts when your favorite resorts are about to get dumped on.

EVERY TRAIL, EVEN OFFLINE
• Clean trail maps for hundreds of resorts, with runs by difficulty, lifts, lodges and first aid.
• Download a resort and it works with zero bars on the chairlift.
• 3D terrain view, run search, and "Get me to the lodge" using only runs at your level.

SAFETY BUILT IN
• Crash detection: if you take a hard fall and don't move, Powline counts down, sounds an alarm and gets a text with your location ready for your emergency contacts.
• SOS screen with your exact coordinates for ski patrol.
• Avalanche danger levels for the backcountry (US).
• Last-chair and sunset reminders.

YOUR AI COACH
• Have a friend film 10 seconds of you riding. Get what you're doing well, the #1 thing to fix, and a drill for your next run.
• Compare old and new clips side by side.

YOUR SEASON, BEAUTIFULLY
• Season goal ring, total vertical ("That's 3.2 Everests"), calendar heatmap, records and badges.
• Powline Wrapped: your season story, made to share.
• Instagram-ready share cards of any day. Export GPX.

LEARN TO SKI OR RIDE
• A game-like Learn path for first-timers, with separate ski and snowboard lessons, plus etiquette, layering and trail-sign guides.

POWLINE PRO
Free: today's snow report, trail maps, the first Learn lessons and the safety tools (SOS, crash alerts). Pro adds automatic run tracking, powder alerts and everything else.
• Yearly: 3-day free trial, then billed yearly.
• Weekly: billed weekly.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID / Google account at confirmation (after the free trial, if any). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your account settings.

Terms: https://powline.netlify.app/terms/ · Privacy: https://powline.netlify.app/privacy/ · Support: https://powline.netlify.app/support/

Trail data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Weather data from MET Norway and the US National Weather Service. Powline is an aid, not a substitute for training, judgment or calling for help.

name: PPX Studio
description:
PPX Studio is a tidy archiver for iPhone and iPad.

Compress files and folders without the cloud and without loss: everything runs on your device. PPX Studio supports its own PPX format, ZIP, tar.xz/tar.gz/tar.bz2 and single-file xz. Extract archives, verify CRC and choose the destination folder.

WHY PPX STUDIO
• PPX: solid streams, LZMA2, BCJ filters and deduplication — a format built for maximum compression.
• ZIP and tar.xz for compatibility with other tools.
• Every block and file verified with CRC32.
• No network: the engine runs on 127.0.0.1 and your files never leave the device.
• Native file and folder pickers, share sheet and the Files app.
• Dark theme, iPhone and iPad, English and Russian UI.

HONEST ABOUT COMPRESSION
No lossless format can compress every file 4×: random data and already-compressed photos/video do not compress. PPX Studio delivers 4–5× on text, code and logs and never inflates an archive: incompressible data is stored as is.

iOS LIMITS
• No PPMd/CM: archives made on a Mac with those codecs cannot be opened on iPhone.
• No RAR: the format is proprietary. RAR extraction is available in the Mac app.
• 32 MiB blocks and one worker so iOS does not terminate the app for memory.

FILES
Imported files are copied into the app container. Results are available in Files → On My iPhone/iPad → PPX Studio and through the share sheet. .ppx files open in PPX Studio.

NO ADS, NO TRACKING
The app collects no analytics and sends no data.

name: PracticeSplit
description:
PracticeSplit helps you organize focused practice into manageable stages. Create multiple plans, name and reorder stages, set their durations, and start a timed session. Review completed sessions in History and filter them by plan.

Your plans and history are stored on your device.

name: Prajna Yoga
description:
Download our app Prajna Yoga to always have your favorite studio in your pocket!
From our app, you can plan and schedule your classes, view schedules, register, and much more!
Maximize your time and never miss out on the latest information that will always be at your fingertips. Don't wait any longer and download Prajna Yoga now.

name: Prawnwire
description:
Prawnwire is the inbox for mailboxes your organization runs on Prawnwire. Read and answer mail and keep your calendar on your iPhone, with the same mailboxes, settings and calendars you have on the web and in the desktop app.

MAIL
- Conversations sorted into Primary, Transactions, Updates and Promotions.
- Formatted mail fitted to your screen, with remote images held back until you allow them.
- Reply, reply all and forward, with a few seconds to undo after you press Send.
- Swipe to archive, delete, star or mark as read, or select many messages at once.
- Search one mailbox or all of them.

MAILBOXES
- Every mailbox you use in one inbox, or one at a time.
- Add mailboxes you keep with other providers.

CALENDAR
- Invitations appear as a card in the message. Accept, answer maybe or decline without leaving it, and join the meeting from there when it is about to start.
- Your week, with Google Calendar and other CalDAV calendars you connect kept in sync both ways.

SETTINGS THAT FOLLOW YOU
- Appearance, read receipts and sending settings are saved to your Prawnwire account, so the web, the desktop app and your iPhone stay the same.

Prawnwire needs a mailbox from an organization that uses Prawnwire.

name: Praya4
description:
# If Pray – Your AI Prayer Companion

If you don't know how to pray, we'll pray with you.

Build a stronger and more consistent prayer life with If Pray, your AI-assisted Christian prayer companion. Whether you're starting your day, seeking comfort, praying for your family, or growing closer to God, If Pray helps you pray with confidence through guided, Scripture-based prayers.

**Experience Echo Prayer**

Discover a unique way to pray. Listen as If Pray speaks one sentence at a time, then repeat it aloud before moving to the next. Stay focused, pray intentionally, and develop confidence in speaking to God.

**KEY FEATURES**

**1. Echo Prayer**
Follow guided prayers one sentence at a time. Listen, repeat, and pray at your own pace with adjustable speed and different voice options.

**2. AI Prayer Generator**
Share what's on your heart, and receive personalized, Scripture-based prayers for your everyday challenges, concerns, and blessings.

**3. Prayer Categories**
Explore prayers for Morning, Evening, Healing, Protection, Anxiety, Family, Marriage, Children, Business, Financial Breakthrough, Forgiveness, Thanksgiving, Spiritual Warfare, and more.

**4. Bible Integration**
Discover relevant Bible verses, understand their meaning, read complete chapters, and listen to the Audio Bible.

**5. Prayer Journal**
Save personal prayers, track answered prayers, record testimonies, and add photos and notes to remember your spiritual journey.

**6. Prayer Chain & Groups**
Share prayer requests, join prayer groups, pray anonymously for others, and receive encouragement from fellow believers.

**7. Daily Prayer Reminders**
Create a consistent prayer routine with reminders for morning, noon, evening, bedtime, and fasting.

**8. Prayer Timer**
Set aside dedicated time for prayer with sessions of 5, 10, 15, or 30 minutes, or one hour.

**9. Worship Mode**
Create a peaceful atmosphere with instrumental worship music and relaxing sounds of rain, ocean, forest, and piano.

**10. Fasting Companion**
Track your fasting schedule, explore Scriptures, organize prayer times, and receive water reminders.

**11. Emergency Prayer**
When you don't know what to say, tap once to begin a guided prayer starting with: "Lord, help me."

**12. Prayer Streaks**
Stay motivated with consecutive prayer days, weekly goals, monthly challenges, and faith milestones.

**13. Family Prayer**
Invite family members to pray together and provide children with age-appropriate guided prayers.

**14. Offline Prayer**
Access available prayer content even when you don't have an internet connection.

**GROW IN FAITH WITH AI-ASSISTED TOOLS**

Explore your faith with an AI Prayer Coach, Scripture Recommendations, Bible Study Companion, Daily Devotionals, and Spiritual Growth Tracker.

If Pray is designed to support your personal relationship with God, not replace it. Our mission is to help believers develop a consistent prayer life through Scripture-centered guidance and meaningful prayer experiences.

**Start your prayer journey today with If Pray.**

One prayer at a time. One step closer to God.

name: Pressure Tap Online
description:
ONE TAP. 60 SECONDS. 3 LIVES.

Think you're fast enough? Prove it in Pressure Tap Online, a competitive reflex game where every second counts!

Test your reaction speed, challenge opponents, and push your limits in intense 60-second matches. Stay focused, react quickly, and make your three lives count.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

ONLINE 1V1
Challenge players in real-time reflex battles! Earn ranking points and climb the global leaderboards. If no player is available, a bot opponent keeps the action going.

SOLO MODE
Train your reflexes and challenge yourself. Improve your reaction time, sharpen your focus, and aim for better scores.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Invite your friends to private 1v1 matches. Find out who has the fastest reactions without affecting your competitive ranking.

FAST, VARIED CHALLENGES

Every match features a variety of quick-thinking tasks designed to test your speed, accuracy, timing, and concentration.

As the clock runs down, the pressure rises. Can you survive until the final second?

CLIMB THE RANKINGS

Compete in ranked matches, earn points, and progress through competitive tiers from Bronze to Legend. Each season brings another opportunity to prove yourself.

UNLOCK AND CUSTOMIZE

Earn Coins, complete daily missions, unlock achievements, and personalize your experience with unique backgrounds, animated premium themes, and cosmetic rewards.

GAME FEATURES

- Fast-paced 60-second matches
- Real-time online 1v1 battles
- Private matches with friends
- Solo reflex challenges
- Competitive rankings and seasonal progression
- Daily missions and achievements
- Unlockable themes and cosmetic customization
- Simple controls, challenging gameplay

ARE YOU FAST ENOUGH?

Three lives. One minute. Endless pressure.

Download Pressure Tap Online and put your reflexes to the test!

name: Presta Heure - Pointage
description:
Presta Heure, c'est l'application de pointage et de gestion de chantiers pensée par un patron du BTP, pour les équipes de terrain.

Fini le carnet, les SMS et les feuilles d'heures papier : vos ouvriers pointent en quelques secondes, vous validez les heures depuis votre tableau de bord, et vous exportez tout pour le secrétariat social.

POUR L'OUVRIER — simple et rapide
- Pointage en 1 geste : arrivée, départ, pause
- Position enregistrée au moment du pointage seulement
- Choix du chantier, changement en cours de journée
- Trajets inter-chantiers comptés automatiquement
- Photos et documents joints au chantier
- Demandes de congé directement dans l'app

POUR LE PATRON — tout sous contrôle
- Tableau de bord temps réel : qui pointe, où, depuis quand
- Validation des heures en un clic
- Calcul automatique des heures et heures supplémentaires
- Planning : qui va sur quel chantier, jour par jour, avec adresse et itinéraire
- Gestion des chantiers, tâches et bons d'intervention
- Suivi des congés et soldes mis à jour automatiquement
- Export CSV + PDF prêt pour le secrétariat social

FAIT POUR LES MÉTIERS DE TERRAIN
PME du bâtiment, gros œuvre, finitions, électriciens, HVAC, photovoltaïque, maintenance, dépannage et équipes multi-chantiers.

L'ouvrier pointe et encode en quelques secondes. Le patron pilote tout depuis son ordinateur ou son téléphone. Plus de feuilles papier, plus d'erreurs de recopie, des heures justes.

Essai de 14 jours, sans engagement.

Créé sur le terrain, en Belgique.

name: Pricelert: Price Drop Tracker
description:
Never overpay again. Pricelert watches the products you want and sends you a notification the moment the price drops.

Paste a link from almost any online store, set the price you want to pay, and let Pricelert do the checking for you. No account. No sign-up. Your tracked products stay on your phone.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Paste a product link from your favorite shopping site.
2. Pricelert opens the page and detects the current price automatically.
3. Set your target price and how often to check.
4. Get an alert when the price drops to your target.

PRICE DROP TRACKER FOR ALMOST ANY STORE
Track products from major marketplaces and independent online shops. Pricelert reads the price from the product page, so you are not limited to a short list of supported stores.

SMART PRICE DETECTION
Pricelert finds the price for you using the structured data on the page. If it picks the wrong number, tap "Not This?" and tap the right price on the page. The app remembers your choice for that product.

SET YOUR TARGET PRICE
Choose the price range you are happy to pay. By default, Pricelert suggests 70 to 80 percent of the current price, and you can change it for every product. Get an alert when the price reaches your target.

DEAL ALERTS THAT MATTER
- Price drop alerts when a product gets cheaper
- Target price alerts when it reaches the price you want
- Price rise alerts so you know when to buy before it goes up
- Price check failed alerts so you never track a broken link without knowing

FLEXIBLE CHECK SCHEDULE
Decide how often each product is checked, from every hour to once a week. Watch a hot sale closely or check a wishlist item once a week.

PRICE HISTORY
See how the price of every product has changed over time. Know if a sale is a real deal or just a normal price before you buy.

CHECKS IN THE BACKGROUND
Pricelert checks your products in the background, even when the app is closed, and notifies you when something changes. Stores that only show prices to a browser are checked with a built-in browser when you open the app.

OPTIONAL CLOUD CHECKS
Turn on Cloud checks in Settings to let our server check prices and send push notifications for you. This helps alerts arrive on time when your iPhone has not run the app in the background. It is off by default, it needs no account, and turning it off deletes your data from the server.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account or email needed
- Tracked products and settings are stored on your device
- Cloud checks are optional and can be turned off at any time

PRICELERT PRO
Upgrade to Pricelert Pro for more control, such as shorter check intervals. The core features of price tracking and alerts are free to use.

PERFECT FOR
- Wishlist items you want at a better price
- Electronics, fashion, home goods, and gifts
- Holiday sales, flash sales, and seasonal discounts
- Anyone who wants to save money on online shopping

name: Primary Science Master
description:
Primary Science Master is the complete PSLE Science practice companion for primary-school students in Singapore, built from thousands of exam-style questions for Primary 3 to Primary 6.

Every question comes with the correct answer and a clear, worked explanation — so your child learns the reasoning, not just the result.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 3,500+ multiple-choice questions across P3, P4, P5 and P6
• Practice by topic — covering the syllabus topics for each level
• Practice by level — focus on your child's year
• Mixed sets for quick, varied revision
• Timed mock papers that mirror the real exam format
• "My mistakes" — every wrong answer is saved so your child can try it again

LEARN FROM EVERY ANSWER
Get it right and you'll see "Great!" with the reasoning. Get it wrong and you'll see "Good try!" with the correct answer and a full explanation of why. Mistakes turn into lessons.

COMPETE — LIVE QUIZ BATTLES
Turn revision into a game. One person sets up a competition and shares a 6-character code; classmates and friends join with a nickname and answer the same questions, with a live leaderboard. Friends without the app can even join from any web browser — no download needed.

DOWNLOAD & PRINT
Save any mock paper as a PDF — questions only, or questions with answers — perfect for offline practice and homework.

DESIGNED FOR FAMILIES
• No account or sign-up required
• No ads
• Works on iPhone and iPad

Unlock the full question bank, all mock papers and PDF downloads with a single one-time purchase.

Start mastering PSLE Science today.

name: Prime Site Management Hub
description:
Prime Site Management Hub is the simple way for construction crews and supervisors to run the job site.

FOR WORKERS
• Scan the gate QR code, take a selfie and sign in. The foreman approves it.
• Keep your safety cards (SST, OSHA, scaffold and more) in one place, with reminders before they expire.

FOR FOREMEN AND PROJECT MANAGERS

• Create people and roles, choose what each role can see, and export hours.

Accounts are created by your company. Ask your owner to add you.

name: Priv-Games
description:
Four small games. One app. Play offline, on your own against the computer or with another person on the same iPhone or iPad.

Priv-Games brings together Tris, Four, Mine and Dama in a simple collection with no ads, accounts or in-app purchases.

CHOOSE YOUR GAME
• Tris: take turns placing X and O. Connect three symbols horizontally, vertically or diagonally.
• Four: drop a disc into a column and build from the bottom up. Connect four discs to win.
• Mine: a competitive, turn-based take on minesweeper. Uncover one square per turn on a shared 8 × 8 field with 10 mines. A safe square earns 1 point plus its number; hitting a mine loses the game. The first tap and its neighbors are safe. If all safe squares are uncovered, the higher score wins.
• Dama: Italian draughts, with mandatory captures, multiple jumps and promotion to kings. Legal pieces and destinations are highlighted to guide your moves.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose 1v1 to share the device with another person, or 1vCPU to face the computer. All computer decisions run on your device. Mine’s CPU uses only clues that have already been revealed.

A small red timer shows the elapsed game time. Restart or leave using the on-screen controls, with confirmation before interrupting an ongoing game.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• All four games work offline.
• No account, advertising, analytics or tracking.
• No in-app purchases or subscriptions.
• In the current version, games, scores, results and other game data cannot be saved, exported, synchronized or shared. They remain only in memory during use.
• No online multiplayer, chat or online leaderboards.

Available in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean. The app follows your device’s preferred languages.

For iPhone and iPad with iOS/iPadOS 26 or later. Portrait interface.

name: Privateer
description:
Swipe right on your next job.

Privateer puts jobs from employers across Australia in one place, from the Kimberley to the CBD. Swipe right to save the jobs you like, swipe left to pass, then apply straight to the employer. No recruiters, no middlemen.

FOR JOB SEEKERS • Real jobs from employers' own careers sites, checked every hour • Browse every job without making an account • Scroll through jobs, or switch to Swipe: right to save, left to pass • See where the jobs are on a map of Australia • Apply on the employer's own site • Filter by FIFO, DIDO, pay listed or no experience needed • Aviation, mining & FIFO, hospitality, maritime, trades, healthcare, retail, office & admin and more • Get a reminder before your saved jobs close • Build a clean one-page résumé from your profile with the AI résumé builder • Chat with employers once they say yes too • Free to use

FOR EMPLOYERS • Free to post jobs while we launch • Post a job in minutes and preview it as you type • Your job sits in the swipe deck alongside jobs from WA's biggest employers • Job seekers find it with FIFO, DIDO, pay and no-experience filters • Everyone who applies lands in your list, with their profile and résumé • Shortlist, search and export applicants for your team

SAFE AND IN YOUR CONTROL • Every employer is checked by the Privateer team before it can post • Employers can only message you once you've both said yes • Block or report anyone from inside a chat • Delete your account and everything in it at any time, from your profile

name: PrivLink
description:
PrivLink is a private, end-to-end encrypted messenger with no phone number, email or account.

Your identity is created on your phone with cryptographic keys and protected by a PIN. You add friends only by scanning each other's QR code, so nobody can find or message you unless you agree.

FEATURES
• Text, photos and voice messages, end-to-end encrypted
• One-to-one encrypted voice calls (peer-to-peer when possible, encrypted relay when needed)
• Messages stay on your device; our server only relays encrypted data and never stores chat content
• Messages are only marked delivered when your friend actually received them
• Safety numbers to verify a friend, block and unblock
• Encrypted chat backup you can restore on iPhone or Android
• Delete your identity at any time: removes your data from the device and our server
• Works with PrivLink on Android

PrivLink is for users aged 18 and over.

name: Pro-Tech Title & Trust
description:
Pro-Tech Title gives real estate agents, buyers and sellers fast closing-cost estimates from Pro-Tech Title & Trust LLC in Fernandina Beach, Florida.

TITLE QUOTE
• Owner's and lender's title insurance premiums calculated from Florida promulgated rates
• Simultaneous-issue lender's policy, endorsements, title search and municipal lien search
• Closing, recording, doc stamp and intangible tax estimates, split between buyer and seller
• County default for who pays for the owner's policy, with the option to change it

SELLER NET SHEET
• Estimated net proceeds to the seller
• Mortgage payoffs, commissions, seller concessions and other costs
• Property tax, assessment and HOA prorations based on the closing date

SAVE AND SHARE
• Save quotes and net sheets on your iPhone, or create a free realtor account to keep them in the cloud and reopen, edit or rename them on any device
• Create a branded PDF of any estimate and send it with Mail, Messages, AirDrop or Files
• Works offline once installed

ORDER AND CONTACT
• Email an estimate or start a new title order to Pro-Tech in one tap
• Tap to call or text, or open the office location in Maps

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads and no tracking. An account is optional: without one, saved estimates stay on your device. With one, only you (and Pro-Tech, to support you) can see your saved estimates, and you can delete your account in the app at any time.

All figures are estimates for illustration only. Actual charges are determined by the contract and confirmed at closing. Contact Pro-Tech Title & Trust LLC at (904) 432-3026 to verify all costs and fees.

name: Professor V Aliens
description:
Professor V Aliens

The lights go out. A mothership hangs over the skyline. And the men in black are already coming for you.

You’re the professor. You have a Tesla coil, three chances, and a whole city to bring back to life.

Tap to aim and fire in any direction. Build a live circuit through streets, parks, rail yards, and rooftops. Shoot around obstacles, stop the men in black before they reach you, and watch streetlights flicker on behind you. As daylight fades, glowing alien orbs hunt you down. Pick your shots carefully. The streets are still full of civilians.

Alien bosses fight back. Regular bosses take two shocks and charge faster after the first hit. At every 200-point milestone, a Master Alien joins the hunt with its own attack and dodge pattern. It takes three hits to bring one down.

When the grid is ready, the gigantic City Devourer drops in. Land five shocks while it charges, then strike the Main City Connection. Watch the mothership break apart overhead and the skyline light up, one neighborhood at a time.

Save London, Tokyo, Rio de Janeiro, Cairo, Cape Town, and Sydney, each with its own battleground, mothership, and soundtrack. Track your rescues in the City Log and see how far you can push your high score.

How many cities can you save before your third chance runs out?

name: Profusause
description:
Our app is a private money desk for the month you are in. It keeps a ledger, a plan, and a number desk on this iPhone. Nothing is fetched, and nothing leaves the device.

Current shows what is left in the plan. Committed marks count from day one. The rest of each allotment is spread across the remaining days, so you can see whether spending is inside the flexible pace. Switch months, open the calendar, or read a short note about the period.

The ledger records spend, receive, and move marks across your channels. Name the merchant, pick a category, and mark a payment as committed when it is already promised. Paste a short list and file several marks at once. Search the book, review a day, or walk closed months in the archive.

Plan holds category allotments and savings goals. Drift lets you try a different plan with sliders. Those sliders do not change the book until you edit an allotment yourself.

Desk estimates the sums people look up beside a budget: installment, two-loan compare, growth, fixed and recurring deposits, a levy worksheet, stacked discount, sales tax, split bill, fuel, exchange, gratuity, and provident. Loan math uses a nominal annual rate divided by twelve. Tax bands are stored in the app and are a reference, not a filing and not advice. Exchange rates are a card you can edit and restore. Our app does not quote live prices.

name: ProLiDAR Object: 3D Scanner
description:
Turn your iPhone Pro into a 3D scanner for real objects.

Walk slowly around a shoe, a tool, a piece of furniture or a spare part, and ProLiDAR Object captures it with the LiDAR scanner and camera, then builds a photorealistic, textured 3D model right on your iPhone. No cloud, no account, no waiting for uploads.

SCAN REAL OBJECTS
• Guided capture with Apple Object Capture – the app shows you where you still need to scan
• Several passes at different heights and a "Flip object" pass to capture the underside
• Photorealistic textures straight from the camera

SEE IT IN 3D AND AR
• Spin, pan and zoom the model with your fingers
• Place the object in your room in AR at real scale

REAL DIMENSIONS
• Length, width and height calculated from the model
• Centimetres or inches

EXPORT ANYWHERE
• USDZ for iPhone, iPad, Mac and AR Quick Look
• OBJ for Blender, CAD and 3D-printing workflows
• PLY for mesh tools such as MeshLab and CloudCompare
• Share by AirDrop, e-mail or save to Files

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscriptions
• Scanning and model building happen entirely on your iPhone

Best results: matte objects on a plain surface in even light. Shiny, transparent and very thin objects are hard to scan.

Languages: English, Polish, German, Spanish.
Requires an iPhone with LiDAR (iPhone 12 Pro or newer Pro models) and iOS 17 or later.

name: ProLiDAR Plan: Floor Plan 3D
description:
Turn your iPhone Pro into a professional floor plan scanner.

Walk around a room and ProLiDAR Plan uses the LiDAR scanner to find walls, doors, windows and furniture automatically. In about a minute you get an accurate floor plan with every wall length, the area of each room and the ceiling height.

FLOOR PLANS IN MINUTES
• Automatic walls, doors, windows, openings and furniture (Apple RoomPlan)
• Scan the whole flat room by room in one session
• Area of every room, total area, wall area for painting, ceiling height

3D AND 2D VIEW
• Rotatable 3D model of your home: spin, pan and zoom with your fingers
• Clean 2D plan with dimensions that you can rotate and zoom
• Try the model in AR at real scale

MEASURE ANYTHING
• Live tape measure and spirit level in the camera
• Distances, areas and volumes in the 3D scan
• Detects flat surfaces and shows how level they are
• Compare two scans of the same place to see what changed

SHARE AND EXPORT
• Professional PDF report with the plan and all dimensions
• 3D model export (USDZ, OBJ)
• Saved projects you can open any time

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Everything is processed and stored on your iPhone

Languages: English, Polish, German, Spanish.
Requires an iPhone with LiDAR (iPhone 12 Pro or newer Pro models).

name: Prong Close
description: Prong Close keeps one four-prong seat. The stone is off the seat, proud of the floor, or seated on the floor. Drop the stone onto the floor to seat it. Let go above the floor and it stays proud. Push an open prong only after the stone is seated, and that prong locks. Push while the stone is proud, and that prong bends and the stone leaves the seat. Straighten a bent prong and the stone stays off the seat. Lift a locked prong and the stone stays seated. When all four prongs are locked, the sentence says the seat is closed. There is no fifth prong. Names and claw states stay on this iPhone. Share writes this seat as text.

name: Protein Scout
description:
Eating out in Dubai and trying to hit your protein? Protein Scout ranks the dishes of 231 UAE restaurants, more than 15,000 in all, by protein and calories for the goal you set.

SEE WHAT FITS BEFORE YOU ORDER
• Set your goal once: lose fat, build muscle, stay in shape or eat well on GLP-1 medication. Protein Scout works out the protein and calories one meal should have, or use your own numbers.
• Every dish gets a clear verdict: fits your meal, fits with changes, or low in protein.
• Search for a dish, a cuisine or a restaurant, or browse Dishes and Restaurants.

ASK FOR THE RIGHT CHANGES
• For dishes that almost fit, Protein Scout suggests changes such as salad instead of fries or sauce on the side, and shows the new numbers.
• Show the waiter a card with your request, in English or Arabic.

BUILD THE WHOLE MEAL
• Build my order puts together a main and sides that fit your meal, with the total.

ANY MENU, EVEN WITHOUT NUMBERS
• Photograph a menu or add screenshots: Protein Scout reads it and estimates protein and calories for every dish in about a minute.

NEAR YOU
• Turn on Near me to see our restaurants within a short walk, nearest first.

RAMADAN
• In Ramadan your day is split between iftar and suhoor.

Numbers published by restaurants are marked with a star; the rest are estimates shown with "~". They are guidance, not medical advice.

PROTEIN SCOUT PRO
Four well-known chains are free: KFC, Shake Shack, P.F. Chang's and Pret. Pro unlocks every restaurant, reading menus from photos and Near me.

name: pspsps: Pet a Cat
description:
Meet a cat that feels real.

A photo-real cat naps on a linen bed, right under your finger. Stroke its back and watch the fur part under your hand. Rest your finger and feel it purr, through the speaker and through the phone itself.

PET IT YOUR WAY

name: Pulla – Photo Stamps
description:
Pulla turns your photos into perforated stamps and lets you collect them in little notebooks.

• Make a stamp: Pick a photo or take one through the stamp-shaped viewfinder, choose a style, save. Turn on the cutting moment in Settings: press and hold, and the holes punch open one by one.
• Postmark: The photo's date and city are stamped on. On New Year's, Valentine's Day and your birthday, the postmark changes.
• Stick: Place stamps on notebook pages at any angle. Pick the cover, paper and pattern.
• Write on the back: Flip a stamp and leave a note. Every stamp has its own serial number.
• See the map: Every place you made a stamp, on a map.
• Share: As an image or a cutting video, send it to a friend in an envelope, or use it as a sticker in Messages.
• Home Screen: A widget shows a stamp from your collection every day, starting with ones from this day in past years.
• Complete: Finish a notebook and get every page as a PDF.

No account, no ads. Your stamps stay on your device and in your iCloud.

name: PulseNote: Offline Voice AI
description:
PulseNote is a voice recorder and offline transcription notebook for meetings, interviews, lectures, and ideas. Record immediately, or download an offline voice pack to add on-device speech recognition and live captions. After the voice pack is installed, transcription works in Airplane Mode. No account is required.

Record and capture key moments
• Record audio, including while the screen is locked.
• Add flags while recording to mark moments you want to revisit.
• Import existing audio files for offline transcription.

Review and organize
• Read timestamped transcripts and tap a segment to hear the original audio.
• Search your notes and organize them with tags.
• Choose from offline voice packs, including multilingual packs that support up to 99 languages. Language coverage varies by pack.

Export on your terms
• Export transcripts as Markdown, plain text, or SRT subtitles.
• Export recordings as WAV files.
• Recordings and transcripts are processed on your device. An internet connection is used to download voice packs. You can share a copy of your files using the system share sheet.

name: Pump Slip
description:
Pump Slip is for the moment you walk away from the pump. Name the car, write the miles on the odometer, and write the gallons that went in. The first slip says there is no earlier fill. The next slip for that car divides the miles since the last fill by the gallons and keeps one sentence. Open Fills later and the sentence is still there, with the miles, the gallons, and the time you kept it.

It does not find a station, take a payment, or make a file. There is no account. Everything stays on this iPhone.

name: PUMPIN 友達と一緒に頑張れる
description:
PUMPINは、いつものトレーニング仲間と通う、もうひとつのジムです。

トレーニングの記録をつけるだけでなく、仲間が今日も来ていることがわかる。最後の1セットを応援し合える。PUMPINには、そんな一緒に鍛える楽しさがあります。アプリを開けば、ジムの入口、自分のロッカー、手形が並ぶ壁、そして今日来ている仲間がわかるフロアが待っています。

通った日が、手形になる

入口でチェックインすると、その日の手形が壁に残ります。点数もランキングもなく、通った日の手形が少しずつ増えていきます。休む日も、休養日として記録できます。

最後の1セットに、仲間の応援を

最後の1セットを始める前に宣言すると、仲間が「いけ！」と応援を送れます。応援がまとめて届くのは、セットを終えた瞬間。離れた場所で鍛えていても、仲間が背中を押してくれます。

みんなでジムのドアを育てる

グループで週の目標を決めましょう。全員が達成するとジムのドアが一段階成長し、達成できなかった週は一段階戻ります。ウィークリーボードでは、手形とチョークの丸で、今週誰が来たかをひと目で確認できます。

フォームを撮って、見比べる

フォームスタジオでは、動きを15秒撮影し、気になる箇所にピンを付けられます。過去の動画と重ねてフォームの変化を確認できるほか、仲間も「ここ良いね」「ここを見てみて」と、気づいた箇所にピンを残せます。

離れていても、一緒にトレーニング

仲間と同じライブルームに入れば、ビデオ通話をつなぎながら一緒にトレーニングできます。仲間の今日のメニューは、種目、重量、回数、セット数まで確認できます。集中したいときは、画面上の表示を隠して、相手の映像だけに切り替えられます。

自分たちらしいジムに

ロッカーの色を選び、節目ごとにステッカーを集めましょう。ジムのルールや壁に掲げる言葉も、自分たちで決められます。招待コードとパスワードを共有すれば、いつもの仲間を招待できます。

「今日も来てたね」と気づいてくれる仲間がいる。PUMPINで、いつもの仲間とトレーニングを始めましょう。

name: Punch Ride
description: Punch Ride is for the moment a ten-ride card is still on the counter and the next square is open. Name the card, then press the square die until the next open square fills. What is left stays on this iPhone. Open the index, then the stubs, and read the card and the time that square was pressed. Punch Ride does not sell a fare, join a transit system, or make a file.

name: Puntos – Chores & Rewards
description:
Puntos en familia turns household chores into a game the whole family wins.

Kids earn points for making the bed, setting the table or reading for a while, and redeem them for rewards you choose together: an ice cream, picking dinner or a movie afternoon. Along the way they build habits, learn to save and work towards a goal.

FOR PARENTS
• Give points for a chore with one tap, or add and subtract points with a reason
• Create daily routines and approve them when kids mark them as done
• Your own catalog of chores and rewards, with different points for each child
• Behavior rules with warnings: at the last warning the points are deducted
• Family calendar with birthdays, reminders and routines
• Several adults per family, each with their own account

FOR KIDS
• Their own iPhone or iPad, paired with a QR code
• They see their points, what they earned this week and their savings goal
• They mark routines as done and see how close each reward is
• They can give points to their siblings, always with a grown-up's approval
• Weekly challenge between siblings and bonus points on their birthday

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Spanish and Catalan (Mallorcan).

SUBSCRIPTION
Try it free for 14 days. Then choose the plan that suits you:
• Family: up to 2 kids and 2 adults, with one year of history
• Family Plus: up to 5 kids and 5 adults, with unlimited history
Monthly or yearly billing. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage and cancel it in your Apple account settings.

Privacy: https://puntos.techmallorca.es/privacidad.php

name: Puppet Pip Puzzle Hall
description:
Puppet Pip Puzzle Hall pairs two original skill-and-strategy puzzles inside a handcrafted puppet-theatre world where every button hangs from cotton strings, every panel is edged with braided rope, and suit-shaped characters sway gently like marionettes.

In Suit Shooter, a wall of colourful suit-shaped bricks dangles above a felt stage. Aim your cutter, release to fire, and match three or more bricks of the same suit to cut them loose. Bricks left without support tumble away for bonus points, while each miss pushes the wall closer to a danger line drawn in flames. Earn powerful Joker, Blast, Blade, Fire and Lightning cutters through skilful play, and tackle special bricks like chain-reaction Bombs, two-hit Ice blocks, colour-shifting Chameleons and score-doubling Stars.

In Suit Maze, guide glowing orbs through procedurally generated mazes shaped like hearts, diamonds, spades and clubs. Swipe to rotate the entire maze while gravity keeps pulling downward. Later levels introduce coloured gates that only accept orbs of a matching suit, turning each maze into a timed sorting challenge.

Both games offer 60 hand-tuned levels across four difficulty modes, six themed chapters from Felt Parlour to Grand Marionette, and a boss encounter every tenth stage. Earn up to three stars per level, then open star chests to unlock cosmetic styles for cutters, bricks, maze walls and backdrops.

Stay sharp with Daily Challenges that refresh every 24 hours, a daily visit streak that rewards a free power cutter, and an Endless mode where the wall never stops creeping. Track every run in a screenshot-backed History and chase 35 hand-drawn trophies that span both games.

name: Pupwise: Puppy Training
description:
Pupwise is a training plan for the week your puppy is in, with a potty timer, a clicker, and feedback on short videos of each cue.

Tell the app your puppy's name, age and what is hardest right now. Every day it picks two or three short sessions that fit that age, starting with what matters most to you.

YOUR DAY
• A countdown to the next potty break, worked out from your puppy's age and moved up after meals, naps and play
• Log pee, poop, accidents, meals and naps with one tap, and see the day on a single line
