• Days without an accident, counted for you

TRAINING
• 20 reward-based skills: name, sit, down, come, stay, crate, potty, gentle mouth, alone time, handling, loose lead, leave it, drop it and more
• Guided sessions: one step at a time, a countdown, and a big clicker that counts the treats
• Skills for later ages are marked until your puppy is old enough

VIDEO FEEDBACK
• Film 5 to 15 seconds of a cue. Pupwise looks at six still frames and tells you whether it counted, what went well, what to change and the next step
• The video itself stays on your phone

A COACH TO ASK
• Ask about biting, crying at night, pulling, jumping, anything. Answers fit your puppy's breed and age and use reward-based methods only

GROWING UP
• A checklist of first meetings with people, sounds, places and handling, timed to the weeks when new things are easiest to accept
• Where your puppy is in its first year, and what that stage needs

YOUR PUPPY, FRONT AND CENTRE
• Add a photo and Pupwise cuts your puppy out as a sticker for the app. The photo stays on your phone

NOT A VET
Training plans, feedback and answers are general, reward-based training guidance. They are not veterinary advice: ask your vet about health, food, vaccines and anything that worries you.

CREDITS
A video check costs 1 credit, and so does each answer from the coach. The plan, log, potty timer, clicker, lessons and checklist cost nothing. Your first credits come with the free trial of Pupwise Weekly, a subscription that adds credits every week; unused credits carry over. Packs of credits are sold separately and do not expire. If a check or answer fails, its credit comes back.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pupwise Weekly renews automatically every week until cancelled. A free trial, where offered, converts to the paid subscription unless cancelled at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://gateway-production-7724d21c.up.railway.app/legal/pupwise/privacy

name: PUR REFORMER
description:
Téléchargez notre application PUR REFORMER pour toujours avoir votre studio préféré dans votre poche !
À partir de notre application, vous pouvez planifier et programmer vos cours, consulter les horaires, vous inscrire, et bien plus encore !
Optimisez votre temps et ne manquez plus jamais les dernières informations qui seront toujours à portée de vos mains. N’attendez plus et téléchargez PUR REFORMER dès maintenant.

name: Purple Grand Player
description:
Purple Player turns your subscription into a beautiful, easy TV app.

Sign in with your provider's M3U link or Xtream Codes login, or type it on another phone by
scanning a QR code, and your live channels, movies and series are sorted and ready to watch.

LIVE TV, THE WAY YOU EXPECT
- A full TV guide with what's on now and next
- Switch categories and channels without leaving the player
- The Channel Wheel: your most-watched, recent and favourite channels a swipe away
- Catch up on shows from past days when your provider offers an archive

MOVIES AND SERIES
- Posters, ratings and details on every title
- Pick up where you left off, episode by episode
- Recommendations slide across the home screen

SUBTITLES IN YOUR LANGUAGE
- Auto subtitles: choose a language once and they turn on by themselves
- Purple Player remembers your choice for each series
- Adjust subtitle size, colour and timing

MADE FOR YOU
- Text size from Small to Extra large
- Profiles for everyone in the home, each with their own favourites and history
- Explore your channels on a world map, country by country
- Picture in Picture and AirPlay

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your playlist login is encrypted and never shown in the app
- No ads

Important: Purple Player is a player only. It doesn't include any channels, movies or series.
You need your own subscription from a provider, and you are responsible for the content you add.

name: PurrQueens: Cat Logic
description:
PurrQueens brings cozy Paper & Ink craft to classic territory logic puzzles: place one aloof cat in every row, column, and color region — without any two cats touching side-by-side or diagonally.

PURE LOGIC — ZERO GUESSING
Every single puzzle in PurrQueens is mathematically verified to have one unique solution solvable purely through deduction — no frustrating 50/50 coin flips.
- Explain-Why Hint Coach: Stuck on a tough grid? Hints spotlight the exact row, column, or territory bottleneck and explain the rule instead of spoiling the whole answer.
- Effortless Controls: Tap to cycle X and Cat, drag one finger across tiles to paint multiple X's in one sweep, or toggle Smart Auto-X to automatically clear spaces around placed cats.

COZY CAT SANCTUARY & REACTIVE COMPANIONS
- Meet Miso, Nori, Yuzu, Matcha, Boba, Pebble, Mochi, and Cinnamon — expressive illustrated cats who sit beside your board, blink while you think, flinch gently on mistakes, nap in Zen Mode, and celebrate victories.
- Earn Yarn from solving boards to adopt new companions and unlock Paper & Ink color palettes (with optional Colorblind Territory Symbols).

DAILY HABIT & 50 VERIFIED CHAPTER BOARDS
- Daily Cat Grid: A fresh 6x6 to 8x8 puzzle every day with a 7-day offline archive, streak tracking, and earned Catnap Streak Freezes.
- 50 Campaign Boards across 5 chapters (5x5 Sunbeam Porch up to 9x9 Starlight Observatory) plus Infinite Free Practice.
- Home & Lock Screen Widgets: Track your daily solve status and active streak at a glance.
- Spoiler-Free Victory Cards: Share your time and territory mosaic without spoiling cat spots for friends.

100% offline, zero ads, zero accounts, and zero tracking.

Privacy Policy: https://purrqueens-legal.netlify.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://purrqueens-legal.netlify.app/terms.html

name: PuzzleShooterCube
description:
Puzzle Shooter Cube Games is a mobile mini-game collection that combines different gameplay experiences in one project. It features interactive game modes, progression between activities, score tracking, and responsive player feedback.
Tic-Tac-Toe
A competitive take on the classic game featuring an AI opponent, timed rounds, score tracking, and animated feedback.

3D Maze
A 3D exploration challenge built around movement, collectible coins, and time-based objectives.

name: PWRBRK
description:
PWRBRK makes hockey easier for coaches, players and parents.

DRILLS
Over 140 drills with drawings for on-ice and off-ice training. Search by age, category, position and equipment. Draw your own drills: select, mirror, move to the other half of the rink, line up cones and draw a slalom course with one tap.

PRACTICES
Pick drills for a practice and set the times. The app suggests times that fill the practice and counts the water breaks. Share the practice with the team, as a link or as a PDF. During practice, Run the practice counts down each part and tells you when it is time to switch.

THE TEAM
Invite the other coaches. Connect the team calendar from Svenska lag and get the practices in your phone's calendar. Shared notes, a goalie rotation and carpooling for away games keep the staff on the same page.

LEAGUES
Standings, games and lineups from SHL, HockeyAllsvenskan, Hockeyettan, SDHL and NDHL. Follow teams and players and see what happened since last time.

KNOWLEDGE
Rules for every level, situations and battles. The equipment guide explains skates and sticks: sharpening, profile, flex and curve. Test yourself in the quiz, and every answer has a source. Fitness tests such as the Cooper test, with a calculator for interval pace.

LANGUAGE
Menus are in English and Swedish. Drills, rules and the quiz are in Swedish for now.

PWRBRK is in beta and free. Missing something? Write to go@pwrbrk.com.

PWRBRK is run by ODL AB, Borås, Sweden.

name: PyLearn: Python Öğren
description:
PyLearn ile Python'u adım adım, uygulama içinde kod yazarak öğren.

• 50 modül, 150 ders: değişkenlerden fonksiyonlara, dosya işlemlerinden tkinter ile pencere uygulamalarına kadar
• Her ders için otomatik kontrol edilen alıştırmalar
• Modül sonu sınavları, hata avcısı ve hızlı kodlama alıştırmaları
• 3 uygulamalı proje
• Yerleşik kod editörü: Python sembol çubuğu ve otomatik tamamlama
• Python doğrudan cihazında çalışır; ilk açılıştan sonra internet gerekmez
• Python hata mesajları Türkçe açıklanır
• Hesap açarsan ilerlemen cihazlar arasında senkronize olur; hesap açmadan misafir olarak da kullanabilirsin

Öğretmenler için
• Sınıf oluştur, öğrenci hesapları aç ve ödev ver
• Öğrencilerin ilerlemesini ve teslimlerini takip et, rapor al

Gizlilik
Verilerin reklam amacıyla kullanılmaz ve satılmaz. Hesabını istediğin zaman uygulama içinden silebilirsin.

name: Pyramid Solitaire
description:
A quiet take on the classic pyramid patience game.

Clear the pyramid by pairing two exposed cards whose values add up to thirteen. Aces count as one, Jacks eleven, Queens twelve, and a lone King clears itself.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Seven-row pyramid with stock and waste piles, built on the standard rules
• Three difficulties — Easy, Classic and Expert — each with its own rewind, hint and recycle limits
• Twelve handcrafted levels across three themed trails, each scored from one to three stars
• A daily challenge generated offline from your local date, so every player opens the same deck
• Combo scoring that rewards consecutive clears with a multiplier up to 3×
• Hints that highlight a legal move, single-step undo, and a time rewind to any earlier moment of the deal
• Four gradient themes, including a deep night palette, with card backs to match
• Soft synthesized chimes and gentle haptics, both switchable
• Full statistics: games, victories, best combo, top score and win rate by difficulty
• Autosave that resumes the exact deal after the app closes
• English and French, switchable inside the app

EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
No network connection, no account, no advertising. Progress, star ratings and daily records live only on this device, and you can erase them from Settings at any time.

DESIGNED FOR CALM
Warm gradients, rounded cards drawn entirely in code, and particles that fade as quickly as they arrive. Play for five minutes or fifty; the table waits for you.

No logos. No noise. Just thirteen.

name: QDCF
description:
Our team keeps improving this paper-trading pad so one written sheet stays honest, and if you hit a snag with Folio, Cue, Market, or Lots, contact us promptly—we are here to fix it.

A quote without a written size, stop, and exit is easy to chase. QDCF gives you Folio to draw a sheet, Cue to hold the thesis, Market for US equity quotes, and Lots for paper positions. It is a personal on-device simulation only—no broker and no real funds.

Draw a sheet, open Cue, place a paper buy or sell after the confirmation, then review Lots. Optional camera or photo-library images stay on this iPhone as a profile picture. Profile lets you open Privacy, Terms, Feedback, and erase local paper trades whenever you want a clean start.

Private by design: no account, no ads, and no upload of your sheets. Plans, lots, and the local name stay on this iPhone. Quote refresh may contact a public market feed. QDCF never moves real money and never requires a login to begin.

name: QianguSong
description:
千古诵 —— 读 · 背 · 诵，一部可以捧读的刻本

千古诵，95 篇唐诗宋词与文言蒙学，从「这个字什么意思」讲起。

【怎么用】

• 卷首：四大门类与选本摆开，读到哪里接着读
• 文库：95 篇诗文，注释、翻译、赏析逐条俱全
• 词牌：36 个词牌，格律、句式与代表作对照
• 诵读：逐字注音跟读，背下来记一笔
• 我的：收藏与背诵进度，只存在本机

【里面有什么】

95 篇诗文，涵盖诗、词、文、蒙学四大门类。每篇都写齐六件东西：
朝代、作者、正文、注释、白话译文、赏析 —— 缺一件就不收。

正文逐字注音，标点按古式缩在右上角；详情页可切刻本竖排（右起直下，
两侧带朱丝界栏），也可留在横排注音模式。

注释与译文是这一版的重心：「羁」字怎么讲、「轻云蔽月」说的是谁、
「无可奈何花落去」好在哪里，都逐条说清楚，而不是让人自己猜。

【怎么背】

「诵读」页把一篇拆成一句一句：先听示范朗读，再逐句跟读，
然后是全篇遮挡与逐句填空两种背法。背出来了记一笔 —— 生、半熟、熟三档，
熟了就从「今日一诵」里毕业。

【为什么这样编】

网上的「唐诗三百首」App 多半是一张列表：题、作者、正文，点进去还是那三行字。
其实会背诗的人不缺诗，缺的是一部随身带着、随时能读、能注音、能对译、
还能当堂背下来的书。

所以宁可少收一百首，也要把收了的一首写全。

【素材说明】

配图为公版古画真迹扫描，随 App 一起安装，不在运行时从网络获取；
每份素材的作者与许可协议在「我的 → 图片来源与授权」逐条列出。
诗文原文属公有领域，注释、白话译文与赏析均为本 App 原创编写。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。你的收藏、背诵记录、朗读语速与字号
全部保存在这台设备上，不会上传到任何服务器，也不会与他人同步。卸载 App 即全部删除。

联网只有一类，全部指向开发者自建服务器：首启时发一条安装来源统计，用来判断这次安装
归属哪个推广渠道。请求里只有一个随机设备标识与设备参数，不含姓名、邮箱、电话、位置、
照片，也不含剪贴板内容；除此之外全程离线。不接入第三方 SDK，不含广告与统计代码，
不收集任何类别的用户数据。诗文、词牌、选本与配图全部随 App 打包，在设备本地读取。

【适合谁】

中学生与大学生（课内古诗文、考试默写）、中文爱好者（想按词牌、按选本系统读一遍）、
家长与教师（给孩子做跟读与背诵打卡）。

版本 1.0

name: QNU Security
description:
QNU Security gửi cảnh báo đến điện thoại của bạn ngay khi hệ thống kiểm soát vào ra phát hiện người lạ.

• Thông báo đẩy tức thời, kể cả khi không mở app
• Chạm vào thông báo để xem chi tiết: thời gian, thiết bị, vị trí
• Danh sách cảnh báo kèm huy hiệu số cảnh báo chưa xem
• Lọc cảnh báo chưa xem và đánh dấu đã xem
• Thống kê cảnh báo trong ngày ngay trên trang chủ

Chỉ tài khoản quản trị do QNU cấp mới đăng nhập được. Khi đăng xuất, thiết bị ngừng nhận thông báo.

Ứng dụng dành cho nhân sự được QNU ủy quyền. Vui lòng liên hệ bộ phận quản trị hệ thống của QNU để được cấp tài khoản.

name: QR 나무
description:
링크를 넣으면 QR 코드 위에 나무 한 그루가 자랍니다.

나무를 누르면 잎과 가지가 내려앉아 스캔할 수 있는 QR 코드가 되고, 다시 누르면 나무로 돌아옵니다.

■ 계절마다 다른 나무
한 해를 열두 시기로 나눠, 오늘 날짜에 맞는 나무가 자랍니다.
초봄의 매화, 한봄의 벚나무, 늦봄의 이팝나무, 초여름의 느티나무, 장마의 버드나무, 한여름의 배롱나무, 초가을의 감나무, 한가을의 단풍나무, 늦가을의 은행나무, 초겨울의 구상나무, 한겨울의 소나무, 늦겨울의 동백나무.
다른 시기의 나무도 골라서 볼 수 있습니다.

■ 명절과 기념일
설에는 까치와 복주머니, 추석에는 보름달과 토끼, 크리스마스에는 전구와 선물이 나무에 달립니다.
정월대보름, 삼일절, 식목일, 부처님오신날, 어린이날, 단오, 현충일, 칠석, 광복절, 한글날, 동지, 한 해의 마지막 날과 새해 첫날에도 그날의 모습으로 바뀝니다.
음력 명절 날짜는 기기에서 계산합니다.

■ 인사 카드
나무와 인사말, QR 코드를 한 장의 카드로 만들어 공유할 수 있습니다.
카드의 QR 코드는 넣은 링크로 연결됩니다.

■ 같은 링크, 같은 나무
같은 링크는 언제나 같은 모양의 나무로 자랍니다.

■ 개인정보
계정이 없고, 광고와 분석 도구가 없습니다. 넣은 링크와 보내는 사람 이름은 기기에만 저장됩니다.

name: QSO Rose
description:
QSO Rose turns a ham log into a 16-sector bearing rose.

Each contact keeps a call, a Maidenhead grid, a band, a UTC time and a mode. The home grid comes from one location fix or from what you type. Bearings and distances use the great circle. Drag the beam around the rose, set the width from 30 to 120 degrees, and switch to the long path. The count is the stations inside that beam. Hours filter the same rose. ADIF import keeps CALL, GRIDSQUARE, BAND, QSO_DATE, TIME_ON and MODE, and skips a duplicate call on the same minute and band.

The log, the rose and the plot stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Quatro Espelhos
description:
Há dias em que é difícil saber por onde começar. O Quatro Espelhos dá-te o primeiro passo: uma pergunta.

Escolhe um baralho, vira a carta e escreve o que te vier à cabeça. Desliza para a próxima, ou fecha quando quiseres. A tua resposta fica guardada automaticamente.

PORQUÊ CARTAS
Uma página em branco intimida. Uma boa pergunta abre caminho. Cada carta foi escrita por pessoas, com cuidado, para te ajudar a olhar para o que vives a partir de um ângulo novo.

12 BARALHOS PARA O QUE A VIDA TRAZ
O Corpo Que Fala · A Cabeça Que Não Para · O Peso Que Se Carrega · A Casa Vazia · O Nó Na Garganta · Quem Cuida Também Sente · O Espelho Trocado · O Que Não Se Diz em Casa · O Corpo Que Mudou · A Noite Longa · O Trabalho Que Consome · A Raiva Que Não Sai
Cada baralho tem 20 cartas. Escolhes pelo que estás a viver, não por um rótulo.

O TEU ESPELHO DA SEMANA
No fim da semana, o Espelho mostra-te quantas cartas escreveste, em que dias, que baralhos escolheste e as palavras que se repetiram. Guarda a tua frase da semana e recebe uma pergunta para levares contigo. O Espelho conta; não interpreta. Quem tira conclusões és tu.

PRIVADO DE VERDADE
• Sem contas, sem registo, sem e-mail.
• Sem nuvem: o teu diário fica só no teu telemóvel.
• Sem publicidade, sem rastreamento, sem notificações a cobrar tarefas.
• Funciona sem internet.
• Exporta o teu diário (cópia ou PDF) quando quiseres, e importa-o num telemóvel novo.

EM QUATRO LÍNGUAS
Português de Portugal, português do Brasil, inglês e espanhol. Muda de língua quando quiseres.

PENSADO PARA O MOMENTO
Modo escuro por defeito, para escreveres à noite sem luz forte. Abre depressa, tem sempre um botão para sair e nunca te pergunta "tens a certeza?".

COMPRAS OPCIONAIS, SEM SUBSCRIÇÃO
• Espelho da Semana aprofundado: escolhe a semana que queres aprofundar, compara-a com as anteriores e recebe uma pergunta extra. Pagas essa semana uma vez e fica desbloqueada para sempre.
• Espelho do Ano: os padrões do teu ano numa imagem que podes guardar.

O Quatro Espelhos é um diário de reflexão pessoal para o dia a dia. Não é um serviço de saúde e não substitui o apoio de um profissional.

name: Que Rico
description: Ignite your passion for rhythm and join a thriving movement community with the Que Rico Latin Dance Company app. Operating as a training resource, this app makes it effortless to manage your class schedule and elevate your skills from anywhere. Instantly view real-time availability for drop-in group classes, secure your spot in salsa and bachata choreography sessions, or book custom private lessons. Seamlessly purchase class passes, track your performance training calendar, and manage your studio membership directly from your phone. Download the app today to eliminate scheduling friction and step onto the dance floor with confidence.

name: Quicklabelmaker
description:
Quicklabelmaker turns your photos into playful, share-ready images in seconds. Pick a style, choose a photo, and save.

16 STYLES
• CCTV: security-camera labels with a timestamp
• Glass: glassy labels over your photo
• Fisheye: a bulging lens effect
• Fisheye Text: words that bulge out of the photo
• Doodle: draw freely on your photo
• Word Search: circle hidden words
• Tape: torn paper tape
• Sticky Note: paper notes on your photo
• Censored: pixelate faces
• Puzzle: cut your photo into jigsaw pieces
• Measure: size arrows and labels
• Receipt: turn a photo into a receipt
• Frame: photos in windows
• Stamp: postage-stamp edges
• Instant: instant-photo frames with a caption
• Stickers: old-school price tags

EASY TO USE
• Crop to 1:1, 4:5, 4:3, 16:9 or 9:16, and your labels move with the photo
• Undo and redo every change
• Save as PNG, JPG or PDF, or share straight to your favourite apps

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your phone. Your photos are never uploaded, and the app collects no data.

FREE TO TRY
8 styles are free to use and save. The other 8 can be tried for free, and a one-time purchase unlocks saving with all of them. No subscription, no ads.

name: Quiet Quotes: Cryptogram
description:
Today's quote and 300 puzzles are free for good. The rest is free for 14 days, then a one-time purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account.

Quiet Quotes turns famous lines from public-domain books into cryptograms: every letter of the quote has been swapped for another. Work out the code and the quote appears, with who said it and where. Every puzzle can be solved by reasoning alone, and the game's own solver checks each one, so you never have to guess.

A QUOTE A DAY
• A new quote every day, the same for everyone
• A streak, a calendar of the days you solved, and your best times
• Share your result without giving away a letter of the answer

HINTS THAT TEACH
• Show me a deduction points to a word and says why one letter must be right
• Check marks only the wrong letters
• Reveal a letter when you want to move on
• Hints are free and unlimited; a solve without them earns three stars and counts toward your bests

ABOUT 2,300 PUZZLES, GENTLE TO FIENDISH
• Five difficulty levels, graded by how much reasoning a puzzle needs
• Browse the archive by difficulty, by era or by author
• Each solved quote shows its author, their years and the work it comes from
• Save the quotes you like and read them again

CALM BY DESIGN
• No lives, no energy, no ads, and no timer unless you turn it on
• Quotes wrap like text in a serif face, with large letters on iPad
• Dynamic Type, dark mode and full VoiceOver play
• Type with the on-screen keyboard in QWERTY or A to Z order, or with a hardware keyboard on iPad, arrow keys included
• Show the code as numbers instead of letters if you prefer
• Works offline

THE QUOTES
Every quotation is in the public domain in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada, and is taken, with its author and work, from a quotation book published in 1905.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPad or iPhone, and in your own iCloud or computer backups if you use them.

name: Quillmoss
description:
Quillmoss is a calm club for classic card games. Eighteen games live under one
roof — from the flagship Solitaire table to Hearts, Spades, Bridge, Euchre, Gin
Rummy, FreeCell, Spider, TriPeaks, Golf, Pyramid, Sevens, Go Fish, Crazy
Eights, Concentration and more. Every game ships with crisp rules, an
unobtrusive tutorial, and three AI difficulty tiers so you can play at the pace
that suits you.

MADE FOR UNHURRIED PLAY
• Fully offline — your table is always open, no connection required.
• Lacquer-dark aesthetic designed to be easy on the eyes at any hour.
• Haptics, sound and animation all tunable, including a Reduce Motion mode.
• Pass-and-play seats for family nights, resumable solo sessions for everyone
  else.

A SIGNATURE EXPERIENCE FOR EVERY GAME
• Solitaire — Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Golf, Pyramid, TriPeaks, Sevens
• Trick-taking — Hearts, Spades, Euchre, Bridge
• Rummy family — Gin Rummy, Rummy
• Family rounds — Go Fish, Crazy Eights, Concentration

AI RESIDENTS WORTH FACING
Nine named residents staff the club, each with a distinct style — from
Newcomer-friendly to Expert. Your own skill level is read from how you play, so
suggested difficulty is always fair rather than punishing.

PLAYER INTELLIGENCE
Quillmoss quietly keeps a portrait of your game. Six studio instruments let you
inspect it: a Player DNA helix, your Strategy Fingerprint radar, Decision
Patterns spectrum, Game Mastery Map constellation, Performance Timeline, and a
24-hour play rhythm. Share your card as an image when you're proud of a run.

DAILY RITUALS, NEVER PUSHY
• A seven-day login streak that rewards presence, not grind.
• Rotating daily and weekly missions that respect your time.
• A Daily Discovery that surfaces a different corner of the club each day.
• Seasons that mark the year without timers that force you back.

A COLLECTION WORTH BUILDING
Dozens of card backs, table themes and environments unlock through play. Pick
the Lagoon table for a cool evening, the Garnet room for something warmer.
Avatar styles, frames and titles follow the same quiet taste as the rest of the
club.

ACHIEVEMENTS, PRESTIGE, LEADERBOARDS
More than one hundred achievements, from first wins to deeply specific feats
("Shoot the Moon", "Flawless Deal", "Centurion"). Weekly and season
leaderboards track you against the residents — no stranger lobbies, no
toxicity.

PRIVACY FIRST
Everything meaningful stays on your device. Your profile, statistics and
game history live locally. We ask for Photos access only when you tap Share,
and for Notifications only if you opt in to daily reminders.

Pick a chair. Deal the cards. Welcome to Quillmoss.

name: Quinielero
description:
Quinielero es la quiniela de marcadores de tu grupo: la de los amigos, la oficina o la familia, ahora en el teléfono y sin Excel.

LLENA TU QUINIELA EN UN MINUTO
Pon el marcador de cada partido con + y −. Puedes cambiarlo hasta el cierre de la jornada, y lo que pones sólo lo ves tú.

SIGUE LA JORNADA EN VIVO
Los marcadores se actualizan solos mientras se juega. Ves cuántos puntos llevas, cuántos sumarías si los partidos terminan así y en qué lugar vas.

LA CARRILLA Y LA TRIBUNA
Cada gol cambia la carrilla de la jornada. En cada partido puedes reaccionar y dejar tu frase para el grupo.

LA TABLA AL MOMENTO
La tabla general con tu lugar resaltado, tus puntos de cada jornada y la tabla de la Liga MX.

SIN CONTRASEÑAS
Entras con la liga personal que te manda el organizador o con un código de 6 números que llega a tu correo.

Quinielero es para grupos privados: el organizador da de alta a los participantes y arma cada jornada. La app no maneja dinero ni apuestas.

name: Quotlet
description:
Quotlet is the mobile companion to Quotlet for macOS, built for developers who code with Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini (Antigravity). Check your remaining AI quotas, track active coding sessions, inspect token analytics, and send remote commands to your Mac—all from your iPhone or iPad.

REAL-TIME QUOTA MONITORING
• View 5-hour and weekly usage limits for Claude, Codex, and Gemini side by side.
• See exact reset times, countdown timers, and health indicators so you never hit a rate limit unexpectedly.
• Switch across multiple synced Macs and check online status at a glance.

LIVE CODING SESSIONS
• Track active, waiting-for-approval, and completed sessions across Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini.
• Filter by provider, status, or project, and search session titles instantly.
• Inspect per-session token breakdowns (input, output, cache read, cache write) and event timelines.

REMOTE COMMANDS & TERMINAL
• Start a new session, resume an existing thread, or fork a Claude session directly on your Mac from your phone.
• Remote execution is opt-in per Mac, restricted to your recent projects, and fully logged.
• Watch command progress, inspect results, or cancel running tasks remotely.

USAGE ANALYTICS
• Review daily token trends over 7 or 30 days across all providers or per tool.
• Compare token volume and request counts by project and by model.

PRIVACY-FIRST BY DESIGN
• Quotlet Cloud syncs only quota percentages, token counts, and session metadata—never your API keys, OAuth credentials, or source code.
• Sign in securely with a 6-digit email verification code.
• Manage and revoke signed-in devices anytime, or permanently delete your account and cloud data directly inside the app.

FIVE LANGUAGES & NATIVE EXPERIENCE
• Full support for English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
• Native SwiftUI interface with Light and Dark Mode for both iPhone and iPad.

REQUIREMENTS
Quotlet for iOS/iPadOS works with Quotlet for macOS (free & open-source at quotlet.com) signed into the same Quotlet Cloud account.

DISCLAIMER
Quotlet is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google. Claude, Codex, and Gemini are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: Quran Words: Learn Quran Words
description:
Understand what you recite.

About 300 words cover three quarters of the Quran's text. Quran Words teaches them one by one, from the most frequent to the rarest, in a few minutes a day.

A PATH TO UNLOCK
• 6 levels and 60 lessons: from your first steps to solid foundations.
• Each lesson introduces 5 new words, then lets you play with them.
• A placement test to start further if you already know some words.

LISTEN, UNDERSTAND, REMEMBER
• Every word read aloud, and its verses recited by a great reciter (al-Afasy, al-Husary and others).
• Its translation in English, French or Arabic, its root, and well-known verses where it appears (many from Juz 'Amma).
• Varied exercises: multiple choice, listening, pairs, true or false, find the word in the verse.
• Recitation (beta): recite a verse, the app recognizes which one and checks the word you learned.
• Spaced repetition: words come back at just the right time so you never forget them.

A GAME THAT MAKES YOU COME BACK
• Daily streak, streak freezes, daily goal, gems and chests.
• 26 stickers to collect.
• Gentle reminders (never pushy) and a word of the day each morning.
• Home and lock screen widgets, shortcuts and a "Review 1 word" control.

RESPECTFUL
• Free, no ads, no account.
• Your progress stays on your phone. No data collected.
• Quran text from the Tanzil project, reproduced without modification.

Bismillah, and enjoy learning!

name: R3CO
description: Connect the massage device via Bluetooth. Select a mode, set a timer, and adjust the intensity. It’s simple to use.

name: Racha: mejora 1% cada día
description:
Racha convierte tu día en una meta simple: mejorar 1% cada día. Registras lo que haces, ves tu avance y cuidas tu racha.

TODO EN UN SOLO LUGAR
• Hábitos con horarios: cuidado de la piel, protector solar, dientes, estiramientos, oración y tareas de orden.
• Puntaje diario y racha de días cumplidos.
• Propósitos: planea tres por la noche y márcalos durante el día.

ENTRENAMIENTO
• Pesas por circuitos, con descansos y cronómetro de serie.
• Peso, repeticiones y ejercicios por segundos, como la plancha.
• Técnicas: dropset, 21s, rest-pause y negativas.
• Recomendación de qué hacer la próxima vez según tu historial.
• Planes guardados por grupo muscular, para empezar sin perder tiempo en el gym.
• Cardio, pasos y actividad en Live Activity durante tu entreno.

COMIDA, AGUA Y CUERPO
• Plan de comidas con horarios y registro de lo que sale del plan.
• Agua con meta según tu peso, sueño, peso corporal y fotos de progreso.
• Ánimo diario y lectura con temporizador.

REPORTES
• Resumen semanal en PDF con gráficas: volumen, récords, evolución de cada ejercicio, nutrición, sueño y conclusiones.

CONECTA CON SALUD
• Lee pasos, sueño, calorías y datos de tu reloj desde Apple Salud, y guarda ahí tu agua, peso y estado de ánimo.

TUS DATOS SON TUYOS
• Sin cuenta, sin anuncios y sin enviar tu información a ningún servidor.
• Respaldos automáticos y una copia opcional en la carpeta de Archivos que elijas.

Racha es una herramienta de seguimiento personal. No da consejo médico ni sustituye a un profesional de la salud.

name: RAFIKI Pin
description: RAFIKI Pin is the field app for the RAFIKI Outreach team and its partners in Kenya and Tanzania. Find every water project on a map, pin a well's exact location with your phone's GPS, record site visits with photos and voice notes, report and follow repairs, keep receipts, and see every project report in one place. Share a private field link with someone at a project: what they send is encrypted so only you can read and approve it. Works offline and sends everything when you have signal. Sign-in is for RAFIKI Outreach staff and invited partners.

name: Rally Fisher
description:
Rally Fisher is an unofficial map of the restaurants in the 15th Rally Fish, in Matosinhos, from 10 to 29 November 2026.

The offer is 4 euros for one appetizer and one glass of wine or beer. This app is a community guide. It is not the official event app. Hours and prices can change, so check with the venue. When you arrive, say you are a Rally Fish customer.

Find a place
• Browse every restaurant on a map and in a list
• See the dish, photo, address, phone number, area, and opening hours
• Check what is open now, or pick a day and a time window
• Filter for vegetarian dishes, award winners, favorites, and places you have or have not visited
• See how far a restaurant is from you
• Get directions, call the restaurant, or open it in Google Maps
• Share a link to a single place

Keep your own notes
• Save favorites
• Mark restaurants you have already visited
• Rate each place from one to five
• Favorites, visited marks, and ratings stay on this device

The map uses Apple Maps. Times use the Europe/Lisbon clock.

Place data, photos, and event information belong to their owners and the event organisers.

name: Rally: Volleyball Scoreboard
description:
Volleyball scoreboard, team generator and score keeper in one app. Open Rally, draw the teams and play.

VOLLEYBALL SCOREBOARD
• One tap scores a point
• Drag up or down to adjust
• Sets to 15, 21 or 25, best of 1, 3 or 5
• Full-screen score in landscape
• Change the rules mid-match
• Works for indoor, beach and pickup volleyball

RANDOM BALANCED TEAMS
• Add players with a level and up to two positions
• Draws that balance level and position
• Swap players or draw again
• Share the teams as an image

SCORE KEEPER AND STATS
• Track who scored: attack, block, ace or opponent error
• Match summaries and day reports
• Rankings for points, wins, average, aces and blocks

QUICK MATCH
Just need the score? Start without adding anyone.

No account, no ads, no purchases. Players and matches stay on your device, and the scoreboard works offline.

The app interface is in Brazilian Portuguese.

name: RallyMargin
description:
RallyMargin is a dedicated tennis practice journal built for players, coaches, and enthusiasts who want to chart their training sessions with accuracy. Map where each tennis ball lands, record net faults, and organize your repetitions into focused drill blocks with customizable target zones.

CORE PRACTICE CHARTING
• Interactive Court Canvas: Tap the precise spot where the ball lands on a regulation court view.
• Target Zones: Select standard zone presets or custom-draw rectangular landing targets directly on the court.
• Stroke Categorization: Track forehands, backhands, serves, volleys, and net shots with instant feedback.
• Quick Editing: Press and hold any landing marker to adjust coordinates, update stroke types, or remove shots.

ANALYSIS & PLACEMENT REPLAY
• Heat & Density Map: Visualize court landing clusters to evaluate depth, width, and margin from the lines.
• Sequential Replay: Step through your practice chronologically to identify stamina trends and timing patterns.
• Block Comparison: Compare accuracy percentages and target hit rates between different drill routines.

RECORDS, BACKUPS & SHARING
• Complete Offline Storage: All practice data stays strictly on your device with zero account requirements.
• Multi-Format Export: Export court charts as print-ready PDFs, raw stroke data as CSVs, or native RallyMargin backups.
• Guided Onboarding: Start immediately with an interactive trial practice or explore built-in sample sessions.

name: RapTango - Music Party Sync
description:
RapTango turns the phones in the room into one sound system.

Start a party, and every phone that joins plays the same song at exactly the same moment. Ten phones on a table sound like one big speaker. No cables, no pairing, nothing to carry.

HOW IT WORKS
- Open a party and share the code, the QR or a link.
- Friends join from the app, or straight from a browser with nothing to install.
- Hold a phone next to the host's phone and it joins with a touch.
- Pick a song. Everyone hears it together, in sync down to the millisecond.

THE MUSIC
- Search for any song, play one of your playlists, or let AI build a playlist for the mood.
- Guests can add songs to the queue, if the host allows it.
- When the queue runs out, the music keeps going with songs that fit.
- Tune the sound for the room: Club, Cinema, extra bass, or stereo spread across the phones.
- Every party is saved as a playlist you can play again.

THE HOST IS IN CONTROL
- Play, pause, skip and seek for everyone at once.
- Set the volume of every phone from your own.
- Fire sound effects that land on all the phones at the same instant.
- Send a voice message to the whole party, with funny voice effects.
- Keep control from the lock screen.

MORE THAN MUSIC
- Karaoke: the lyrics move with the song and the whole party sings along.
- Song video: watch the video in sync, or lay phones side by side and they become one giant screen.
- Light shows: line up the phones and waves of light run across them on the beat.
- Party games: Tango Rush (tap the tiles on the beat), Tango Hop (steer the ball onto the tiles) and Drop Zone (defend the dance floor together).

TOGETHER
- Party chat with photos and video bubbles.
- Emoji reactions that fly across every screen.
- Add friends and know when their party starts.
- Public parties you can join any time, or private ones just for your crew.

RapTango speaks 16 languages and is made for house parties, road trips, the beach, the gym, and every moment that needs more sound than one phone can give.

name: Rasterbator: Poster Maker
description:
Turn one photo into a wall-size poster you can print at home. Posterloom creates a real multi-page PDF with neighboring pieces of your image, ready to trim, align and assemble.

CHOOSE. PREVIEW. PRINT.
Import a JPEG or PNG from your device, or start with our original demo artwork. Choose A4 or US Letter, portrait or landscape, and Fit or Fill. See the sheet layout, assembled dimensions and source-resolution hint before exporting.

FREE, USEFUL POSTERS
Create and share a complete 2×2 poster as a four-page PDF. No account, watermark or purchase is required. Share the PDF to save it or send it to a destination you choose, or use your device's native Print action. Print at Actual Size / 100%, single-sided, using the selected paper and orientation.

POSTERLOOM LIFETIME PRO
One non-consumable purchase unlocks larger 3×3 (nine-page) and 4×4 (sixteen-page) poster layouts. Add overlap and trim guides for easier assembly. The US base price is $6.99; your actual localized price is shown by the App Store before purchase. No subscription, renewal, trial or consumable credits. Restore Purchases is available inside the app.

LOCAL PHOTO PROCESSING
Your source images and generated PDFs stay on your device unless you choose to share or print them. No account or image-upload service is required. Purchase providers process the data needed to verify Lifetime Pro. Print quality depends on the source image, printer and paper; the app does not invent missing image detail or mail physical posters.

Posterloom is independently developed by Starter Studio, Inc. and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rasterbator.net.

Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Posterloom Terms: https://posterloom-appfactory.netlify.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://posterloom-appfactory.netlify.app/privacy
Support: https://posterloom-appfactory.netlify.app/support

name: Rattlebop: Cartoon Music Maker
description:
Rattlebop is a music toy for the whole family. Pick a band of cartoon characters, give each one a sound and press play. Every loop stays in time and in key, so whatever you make sounds good. No lessons needed.

Two bands to play, no internet needed:
• Scrapyard Robots: seven junkyard robots and twenty scrap-metal sounds
• Kitchen Beats: pots, pans and a kettle that can carry a tune

What you can do
• Tap a sound to hand it to the next free character, or drag it onto one to swap
• Mute, solo and edit each part
• Change the chords, tempo, swing and key
• Build a drop and hear the whole band crash back in
• Find the secret combos that bring a guest star on stage
• Record your own voice after a count-in, and it loops in time with the band
• Record a take, then save or share it

Made for kids and grown-ups
• No ads, no tracking and no accounts
• Nothing to buy
• Saving, sharing and links out of the app sit behind a grown-up check
• The microphone is only used when you choose to record your voice, and recordings stay on your device

name: Razor Dive Academy
description:
Make preparation part of the adventure with Razor Dive Academy. Explore dive profiles, organise your plans, estimate group costs and learn more about the underwater world.
 Browse location profiles across reefs, caves and shipwrecks. Compare listed prices, dive durations and experience levels, then read about each site's underwater features.
 Choose dates and times for dives and training sessions. Save plans on your device, follow the countdown to an upcoming dive, and change or cancel your plans when needed.
 Explore eight training session profiles covering different experience levels. Review their focus, skills and listed prices before adding a session to your plans.
 Swipe through four scuba equipment sets, compare their specifications and rental rates, and associate your preferred set with a planned dive.
 Calculate costs for one to eight participants and up to three dives per person. Adjust transfer, equipment rental and dedicated instructor options to see a detailed total and average cost per person. Carry your selections into the planning form.
 Discover eight marine creatures, learn about responsible behaviour around them, and test your knowledge with true-or-false questions and explanations.
 Read conduct rules covering buddy awareness, equipment care and respect for marine life. Share individual rules through your device's sharing menu.
 Browse a searchable collection of English-language article and video links. Filter by format and save useful resources for later.
 Your plans, calculator selections, quiz answers and saved resource links are stored on your device. Core features work offline; external articles and videos require an internet connection.
 Razor Dive Academy is a planning and educational companion. Saved plans do not create confirmed reservations with a dive operator. Prices are estimates based on the app's listed rates; confirm availability, suitability and final costs directly with your provider. Educational content does not replace qualified instruction or diving certification.

name: Readybin
description: Readybin is a home cellar notebook for bottles you already own. Record the producer, variety, vintage, the years you consider early or past, the shelf, how many bottles remain, and how many glasses are left in an open bottle. A pour log subtracts glasses. The board marks Early, Ready, or Past by comparing those years with the year on this phone. Nothing is uploaded and no shop or review service is used.

name: Real Ruler Protractor
description:
Measure with a true-to-scale ruler and a full 360° protractor on your phone screen.

• Real-size ruler on both edges
• Draggable red guide with haptic feedback
• 360° protractor for angles
• Millimeters, centimeters, and inches
• Units follow your region, change anytime

No account. No internet required for measuring.

name: Recio — Screen Recorder
description:
Recio is a screen recorder built for the final deliverable, not just the capture.

Most people don't want a recording — they want a video they can send. That means editable captions, a file size that fits in an email, and audio you can actually hear. Recio does the whole chain.

CAPTURE
- Full screen, drag-to-select region, a single window, or an app
- Camera and microphone, with system audio and mic kept on separate tracks
- Five quality presets with size estimates shown before you hit record
- Pause / resume, keystroke and pointer effects, timer stop

LIVE CAPTIONS
- On-device speech recognition: nothing is uploaded
- Edit every line and its timing; keep a custom glossary
- Export .srt / .vtt, or burn captions into the picture
- Transcribe system audio and microphone separately

DELIVERY
- Live captions, offline re-transcription, and image-sequence export
- Recompress to an exact target size in MB
- Trim, split and reorder, remove tracks, remux, GIF, still frame, color adjust, fades
- Presentation tools: zoom, freeze frame, chapters, presenter overlay

PRIVACY
Everything happens on your device. No account, no cloud, no data collection.

IPHONE / IPAD
Recording runs through a system broadcast extension, so it keeps going while Recio is in the background. Library, crop, save to Photos, and caption burn-in all work on mobile too.

Free in 1.0: the complete capture and export pipeline, no watermark, no time limit.

name: Recipeek: Photo to Recipe
description:
Not sure what to cook? Just take a photo.

• Photo of ingredients or your fridge → recipes you can make right now, using what you already have
• Photo of a finished dish → the recipe to make it yourself
• Calorie breakdown: snap a dish to estimate its calories and protein / fat / carbs
• Clear, beginner-friendly steps with heat levels, times and doneness cues
• Built-in step timers, grouped ingredients (main / extra / seasoning) and per-serving nutrition estimates
• Set servings, how many ideas you want, and your tastes or restrictions — "no spicy food", "air fryer only"
• Share any recipe as text in one tap
• English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어

Free to use. No account, no ads.

Recipes, calories and nutrition values are generated by AI and are estimates — please check ingredients yourself if you have allergies or dietary needs.

name: Reclaim: Recycling Depot
description:
Reclaim is a single-player puzzle game set in a greenhouse recycling depot. Tap a cart to move it one square in the direction of its arrow. If crates are lined up in front of it, the cart pushes them together. Match each crate to the recycling hatch marked with its symbol.

Each hatch accepts one crate. Once it closes, carts and crates can move across it. Delivering one crate early can open the route for another, so the order of your deliveries matters.

Start with a straight delivery, then work through crate chains, two crate types, and puzzles that require carts facing different directions to hand off a crate. Use Undo to try a different move or Restart to puzzle out a new route. Play offline on iPhone and pick up where you left off with progress saved on your device.

name: ReelHalt: Block Reels & Shorts
description:
ReelHalt opens Instagram, YouTube and Facebook in a clean view with Reels and Shorts removed. Your messages, profiles, search and regular feed stay available, so you keep what you need and skip the endless short-video feed.

HOW IT WORKS ON IPHONE
iOS does not let any app change what the official Instagram or YouTube apps show. ReelHalt therefore gives you its own clean view: the mobile websites of these services, signed in with your own account, with Reels and Shorts hidden and blocked. Use ReelHalt instead of the official apps when you want to scroll less.

FREE
• Instagram clean view: Reels tab and Reels in Explore hidden, direct messages open
• YouTube clean view: Shorts shelf and Shorts links hidden
• A Reel a friend sends you in DMs still opens
• Today's counter: Reels and Shorts blocked
• Modes: Block all or Count only

REELHALT PRO
• Facebook clean view without Reels
• Insights: weekly chart and your streak
Monthly, yearly or lifetime. No free trial. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
You sign in directly with each service; ReelHalt never sees your password. The pages you open are not sent to us. Counters stay on your device. No ads.

Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Turkish.

Terms of Use: https://reelhalt-api.eczapharm-busater.workers.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://reelhalt-api.eczapharm-busater.workers.dev/privacy

Instagram and Facebook are trademarks of Meta Platforms, Inc. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. ReelHalt is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by them.

name: Refula
description:
Refula is a private workspace for photographers who want to separate selects from rejects after a shoot — calmly, on the iPhone they already carry.

Your camera roll stays untouched. Refula never deletes or edits originals. Ratings and notes live only inside the app, on your device.

HOW IT WORKS

Session — Create a cull project (portrait, wedding, street, and more).
Import — Pull photos from your library into the session.
Cull — Swipe or tap Keep, Maybe, Reject, or Skip. Skip leaves a shot unreviewed so you can come back later.
Board — Review each pool on a grid. Tap for full view, adjust ratings, read EXIF, add shot notes.
Export — Copy Keep shots to a new Photos album, or export a plain-text cull list to share or archive.
BUILT FOR REAL WORKFLOWS

• Burst groups — Similar shots are clustered on device so you can compare side by side before you choose a hero frame.
• Canvas & compare — Single-card culling or pair review for burst sets.
• EXIF at a glance — Time, filename, and camera metadata when you need context (read-only).
• Undo & resume — Pick up where you left off; project progress is saved locally.
• Backup — Export and restore cull data as JSON from Settings (your photos stay in Photos).

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• No sign-up, no analytics dashboard, no server upload of your images.
• Marks, burst groups, and notes use local storage (Core Data).
• Export copies keeps to your album only when you ask.

WHO IT’S FOR

Wedding and event photographers, portrait artists, and anyone with hundreds of shots and one evening to narrow them down — without Lightroom on the road and without risking the original files.

Refula is not a cloud gallery, AI filter pack, or bulk delete tool. It is a focused culling layer between import and delivery.

name: RegistreArmures
description:
RegistreArmures est un carnet de formes et de chantier pour les ateliers de restauration, les groupes de reconstitution et les chercheurs. Il ne contient aucun jeu d'exemples : à la première ouverture, le registre est vide et se construit pièce par pièce.

REGISTRE — Classez lamelles et accessoires par époque (Han, Wei N., Tang, Song, Ming), tradition (Plaines, steppes, marine du Sud, cortège) et catégorie (lamelle, écaille, brassard, jambière, couvre-nuque, casque, liens, doublure, rivet, ferrure). Pour chaque pièce : dimensions de débit, épaisseur forgée, perçages, laque et tannage, traces d'usage, état du fragment.

FICHE TYPOLOGIQUE — Rattachez les sources (ouvrage, page, planche, niveau, note), indiquez le niveau de provenance et le risque de fidélité ; joignez photos et estampages par couche ; consignez laçage, recouvrement, articulation et ensembles supérieur, inférieur et associés.

SCHÉMA DE LAÇAGE — Filtrez par époque et par articulation, visualisez l'ordre de recouvrement et les perçages, zoomez, changez de planche, touchez une lamelle pour voir sa place dans l'ensemble.

NOTES — Consignez par volume les opérations, les pièges à éviter et les substituts, avec ressemblance visuelle, équivalence mécanique et risque de fidélité.

COMMANDES — Ouvrez un dossier de restauration, choisissez les accessoires, faites avancer les huit étapes (relevé, débit, forgeage, perçage, laçage, assemblage, patine, essayage), notez les travaux du jour, obstacles et corrections, la mécanique du port et la livraison.

Listes, sources et dossier final s'exportent.

name: Relay for OpenCode
description:
Начните задачу в OpenCode на компьютере и продолжайте разговор с iPhone или iPad. Relay показывает сессии вашего сервера: какие задачи выполняются, где нужен ответ и какие результаты вы ещё не открывали.

Выберите рабочую папку и модель, напишите сообщение или приложите файл. Читайте ответы по мере их появления, отвечайте на вопросы агента и подтверждайте запросы разрешений. После завершения задачи вы увидите длительность, список изменённых файлов и построчное сравнение кода.

Для диктовки можно добавить собственный ключ OpenAI API. Relay отправит запись напрямую в OpenAI для распознавания и вставит текст в черновик. Вы решаете, что отправить агенту. Распознавание оплачивается отдельно в вашем API-проекте; для текстового чата ключ OpenAI не требуется.

Для работы со своими проектами нужен доступный с устройства сервер OpenCode V2. Подключитесь по одноразовой ссылке или QR-коду. Можно сначала открыть демо-пространство: это локальные примеры переписки и изменений, для которых не нужны сервер или ключ.

Relay — независимый клиент, не связанный с разработчиками OpenCode.

name: Relay Ridge
description:
Guide an inspection rover through grid-based puzzles in Relay Ridge. Visit every beacon to open the exit, then find a safe route to it.

The rover remembers two directions, one horizontal and one vertical. Turns alternate between the two axes, and each direction stays set until you replace it or clear it. If the active axis has no command, the rover waits for that turn. A direction that gets you through one corner can send you into trouble when its turn comes around again.

Check the next-move preview before you advance. When a level gives you a limited number of clears, decide where an intentional pause will help you avoid a hazard or line up your next move. If a move goes wrong, undo the turn or restart the level. There’s no countdown, so you can take your time planning the route.

name: Relojería de Oro
description:
Relojería de Oro is a shop for watches, gold and silver on Avinguda de Jaume III in Palma, with its own workshop. The app puts the shop on your iPhone.

APP ONLY
From time to time we publish benefits that only exist in the app. Tap "Show code" to get your personal code with a QR. Show it at the register and you're done. The code is visible offline too.

THE COLLECTION
Watches, jewelry, gold and silver with large photos. Filter by category or brand, save your favorite pieces and ask us on WhatsApp or by phone with one tap.

THE SHOP
Today's opening hours, map and directions, and who to talk to for buying, selling and the workshop. Plus: how to sell gold and silver, how to sell or consign your watch, and what our workshop does.

NO SIGN-UP
No account, no password, no personal details. News alerts only arrive if you switch them on in the app, and you can switch them off at any time. "Delete my data" deletes everything, on your iPhone and on our server.

In Español, Català, Deutsch and English – change the language in the app's settings.

name: Remeow: Virtual Pet To Do List
description:
Meet the pet that remembers for you.

Remeow gives you a pet of your own. It hatches from an egg, lives in your iPhone's Dynamic Island, and reminds you about the things you need to do in its own voice. Finish a task and it's delighted. Miss one and it speaks up.

JUST SAY IT
Tell your pet what you need, out loud or typed: "remind me to water the plants at 6", "every Monday and Thursday", "wake me up at 6:30". It sets the reminder or alarm and answers you.

REMINDERS YOU WON'T MISS
• Your pet rings in its own voice, and gets louder if you don't get to it
• Repeats your way: daily, weekdays, chosen days, every few hours
• Tick things off from the Dynamic Island, the Lock Screen or the room's whiteboard
• A heads-up before calendar events (your events stay on your iPhone)
• Real alarms, like the Clock app's, on iOS 26 and later

GET THINGS DONE TOGETHER
• Focus sessions: your pet reads a book beside you while you work
• Break a big task into tiny steps
• Plan my day: type everything on your mind and get a plan with times
• Breathing exercises for when you need a calm minute
• A cozy goodnight, with a look at tomorrow

A PET WORTH LOOKING AFTER
• 8 animals: cat, dog, duck, bunny, penguin, fox, panda and dragon
• Feed it, dress it up and decorate its room
• Finished tasks send it on adventures, and it comes home with a postcard and a story
• Keep a scrapbook diary together, with photos, stickers and a mood calendar

FRIENDS
Add a friend with a code, send each other reminders and treats, and see how many tasks you each finished today. Never what your tasks are.

YOUR DATA
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• No account to create
• Your pet's AI brain (Claude, by Anthropic) is asked for permission first, and you can turn it off

SUBSCRIPTION
Remeow needs a subscription, weekly or monthly. New subscribers can try it free for 3 days. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the free trial ends, or when you confirm the purchase if there is no trial. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your App Store account settings. Diamond packs, used for outfits, animals, food and things for the room, are separate one-time purchases; diamonds can also be earned for free.

Terms of Use: https://adarshyadav.com/apps/remeow/terms
Privacy Policy: https://adarshyadav.com/apps/remeow/privacy

name: Renoleadz
description:
RenoLeadz is the companion app for contractors who receive renovation leads through RenoLeadz.

• Dashboard – your numbers, today's visits and your next appointment at a glance
• Leads – filter, search and open each lead's details and notes
• Schedule – week view of your visits and tasks
• Tasks – add, complete, reschedule and delete
• Directions – Google Maps route to your next visit
• AI quotes – speak or type the job and get quote items and prices, then edit them
• Quote PDFs – preview, share, email or print
• Face ID sign-in and a choice of themes

A RenoLeadz contractor account is required. Sign in with the account provided by RenoLeadz.

name: Rent Ruckus
description:
Rent Ruckus is a roguelite brawler about property. One island, every toy that wandered in, and a landlord with a storm.

You are a boiler worker with a crowbar. Drop onto the island, bonk everything that moves, and pick a new toy at every level. Max a toy while you own its partner and it evolves. Stand still on the campfire to pay the note and clear your stars. Cross the yellow property line and you become wanted.

THREE BOSSES, EACH WITH A SECOND ACT
Baron Brick starts leaping and raining bricks. The Auditor crosses the floor with red tape. The landlord calls in bailiffs, then serves homing notices. Beat the landlord for a rent holiday, then cash out or keep going while the island gets meaner. Wade into the marsh after four minutes to wake the Sump Pump.

SHORT RUNS, ONE MORE TRY
• Dash through a hit at the last moment for a perfect dodge and a slow-motion counter.
• Chain bonks to keep your combo and double your drops.
• Elites arrive armored, hasty, splitting, volatile or vampiric.
• Steal the kart, drop a wall, hide in a box or send the goose.
• Every run pays receipts. Spend them in the workshop on nine permanent fixtures.
• Twenty-two trophies, and a file on every resident you bonk.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Touch controls with one thumb on each side. Game controllers and iPad keyboards work too. Plays fully offline.

FREE, WITH ONE OPTIONAL PURCHASE
The whole island is free: every boss, the marsh, the workshop and every trophy. The Full Lease is a one-time purchase that adds two heroes, Gutter Goblin and Overtime Intern, and opens the two harder leases, Rent hike and Final demand, once you earn them. No ads, no timers, no subscriptions.

name: Rental Inspection: LeaseProof
description:
LeaseProof is a 100% offline iPhone property inspection and handover report generator for tenants, landlords, and short-term rental hosts.

WHY PAPER FORMS & PHONE CAMERAS ARE NOT ENOUGH
Loose camera-roll photos lack structured room context, meter numbers, keys counts, and signatures. LeaseProof turns a 10-minute walkthrough into an organized, court-ready PDF folio — even in basements or vacant apartments with zero signal.

BUILT FOR TENANTS, LANDLORDS & AIRBNB HOSTS
• Room-by-Room Walkthrough: 8 preset rooms with Good / Fair / Damaged single-tap capsules, notes, severity ratings, and Mark Remaining Good shortcuts.
• Auto-Stamped Evidence Photos: Every photo displays capture timestamp, room name, and defect status in a crisp contact strip, with EXIF/GPS stripped locally.
• Utility Meter Vision OCR & Keys: Scan electricity, gas, cold water, hot water, and heating meter numbers on-device with Apple Vision and count handed-over keys.
• Move-In vs. Move-Out Slider: Compare baseline move-in photos side by side with an interactive divider and automatic New Damage flags.
• Dual Signatures & SHA-256 Tamper Lock: Collect landlord and tenant signatures on screen and seal the report with a SHA-256 fingerprint printed on every PDF page.

100% OFFLINE · DATA NOT COLLECTED
No accounts. No cloud uploads. Everything stays safely on your iPhone.

SUBSCRIPTIONS & PRICING
Create your first property, capture unlimited photos, scan utility meters, and preview watermarked PDFs free. Upgrade to LeaseProof Pro (Weekly Pass with 3-day free trial, Annual Pro, or one-time Lifetime Unlock) for unwatermarked legal PDFs, Before/After comparison, dual signatures with SHA-256 lock, Airbnb turnover templates, and unlimited properties. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in Apple Settings.

name: RentReal
description:
Two places can have similar rents and very different costs over a year. RentReal lets you compare the numbers before you choose a home.

Enter the rent, recurring extras, one-time fees, refundable deposit, and any first-year discounts. See the estimated monthly cost, the rent, fees, and deposit due at move-in before discounts, and the first-year cost without the refundable deposit.

Try the included apartment comparison to see how a higher monthly rent can still lead to a lower first-year total.

Save one project with up to 12 entries for free. Lifetime is a one-time purchase that lets you save more projects, add more entries, and share reports. You can use the app offline without creating an account. To keep a backup, choose iCloud Drive or another location in Files.

name: RepairBuddies: Job Card & Bill
description:
RepairBuddies keeps every device in your repair shop on a digital job card, from the moment it comes in to the moment the customer collects it. Customers follow the repair on their own phone, so they stop calling to ask "is it ready?".

Made for mobile, laptop, computer, TV, AC and appliance repair shops, at the counter and at the customer's home.

JOB CARDS IN SECONDS
• Customer, device, brand and model, IMEI or serial number, problem and estimate
• What was left with it (charger, cover, SIM…), its condition and up to 8 photos, so there are no arguments at pickup
• Advance taken, ready-by time and the technician on the job
• Print a job slip with a QR code on a receipt printer

CUSTOMERS SEE THE REPAIR LIVE
• Every job has its own page: status, expected ready time, bill and amount to pay
• Send the link with one tap; no app to install for the customer
• "Notify me when it's ready" on the customer's page
• Customers approve or decline your estimate on their page before you start the work
• Customers see all their repairs in one place by logging in with their mobile number

SAFE HANDOVER
• Every job has a 4-digit pickup code. The device is handed over only with the code
• Too many wrong codes lock the job and the owner is told

BILLS AND GST
• Parts and labour, advance and payments by cash, UPI or card
• Print the bill or save it as a PDF, or send it to the customer
• GST tax invoices with CGST and SGST for shops with a GSTIN, numbered per financial year

HOME VISITS
• Book a visit with the address and time; repeat customers' addresses fill in by themselves
• Each technician sees their own visits, with call and directions buttons
• The customer gives a visit code when the work is done, so you know the visit happened
• Customers are told when the visit is booked and when the technician is on the way

SPARE PARTS
• Keep a list of your parts with stock at each branch
• Parts on a bill come off the stock by themselves, and you are warned when one runs low

BRANCHES, TEAM AND REPORTS
• Run several branches; staff only see the branches you give them
• See every branch on one screen: in the shop, ready, late and visits today
• Reports: jobs in and out, money billed and collected, repair time and work by technician

SIMPLE AND SECURE
• Log in with your mobile number and password, or with a one-time SMS code
• Works on iPhone and iPad, and in any web browser on a computer
• Customers' phone numbers and addresses are never shown on public pages

RepairBuddies is made by CarryBuddies.

name: Repeat Row Studio
description:
Paste a supported English instruction such as “Repeat rows 3–8 4 times”, or enter the range yourself. Check the first row, last row and total repetitions before you start. Finish each row with a tap, undo a mistaken tap and return to the same place after a break. Keep multiple projects on your iPhone or iPad. All projects stay on the device. One purchase unlocks the entire app.

Build a project in sections. Keep each original instruction and your notes beside the counter on iPad. Finish a section and the next begins automatically; undo works across sections too.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: ReservaSimple: Agenda digital
description:
Tus clientes pueden reservar una cita incluso mientras estás atendiendo. Comparte tu enlace de ReservaSimple y deja que elijan servicio, profesional y horario, las 24 horas, sin descargar ninguna app. Cuando entra una reserva, recibes un aviso en tu iPhone.

TU AGENDA, SIEMPRE A MANO
Consulta tus citas por día, semana o mes. Si un cliente te llama o te escribe, puedes ver los horarios libres y registrar la reserva en ese momento. Si cambia de planes, abre el turno para reprogramarlo o cancelarlo.

UN ENLACE PARA RECIBIR RESERVAS
Comparte tu página de reservas por WhatsApp, en tu perfil de Instagram o en tu sitio web. Tus clientes ven los horarios disponibles, eligen el que les conviene y reciben la confirmación por correo. También pueden agregar la cita a Google Calendar.

AVISOS PARA CADA PROFESIONAL
Recibe notificaciones de reservas nuevas, cambios y cancelaciones. Elige en cada teléfono de qué profesionales quieres recibir avisos y toca una notificación para abrir esa reserva.

CITAS Y PAGOS EN UN SOLO LUGAR
Consulta los datos del cliente, el servicio, el horario y el estado del pago en la misma ficha. Puedes solicitar un anticipo o el pago total, revisar comprobantes de transferencia y confirmar los cobros pendientes. Mercado Pago está disponible en los mercados compatibles.

LA AGENDA DE TODO TU EQUIPO
Configura los horarios y servicios de cada profesional. Si dos personas ofrecen el mismo servicio a precios distintos, puedes asignar una tarifa a cada una. Consulta tus estadísticas para ver la evolución de tus ingresos, las cancelaciones y los medios de pago más utilizados.

ReservaSimple está pensada para peluquerías, barberías, centros de estética, consultorios, estudios de pilates y otros negocios que atienden con cita previa.

Empieza con hasta 30 reservas al mes y profesionales ilimitados en el plan gratuito. Configura tus servicios y horarios, comparte tu enlace y recibe tu primera reserva.

name: ResiduxMod
description:
ResiduxMod is a bench tool for quadratic residue diffusers.

Choose a prime, a design frequency, a well width, and a fin thickness. The app writes the residue sequence, turns each residue into a well depth, and draws one period as a section: wood, slots, and the residue under each slot. Open a well to see the index, the square, the residue, and the depth in millimeters or inches, along with the round-trip phase at the design frequency.

Pick a frequency and an incidence angle, then draw a polar. The curve is a phase-grating estimate for rigid, locally reacting wells in the far field. It is not a room measurement. Evenness describes how widely the energy is shared around the arc. Mirror is the share of that energy still falling within 12 degrees of the specular angle. A flat plate gathers into one spike. A residue panel breaks that spike into lobes.

Save more than one panel and compare two polars at the same frequency and incidence. Notes keep the room, the mount, and the finish with the panel. The shop sheet is plain text you can copy into a build list. Speed of sound sits on the bench, because every depth is a fraction of a wavelength.

name: Resistance Band Strength Plan
description:
Build full-body strength at home or on the road with Resistance Band Strength Plan—short 10–25 minute resistance band workouts and structured 21–30 day plans built for the bands you already own.

Start immediately with 6 free resistance band workouts and all 44 illustrated exercises, then unlock any 21–30 day program with a single one-time purchase. No subscriptions, no accounts, and everything works offline.

ADAPTS TO YOUR BAND KIT
Own only a long loop band? Traveling in a hotel room with no door anchor? Select what you have—long resistance band, mini loop band, door anchor, or chair—and the app automatically swaps exercises that need gear you don’t have.

WHAT YOU GET
• 6 free resistance band workouts: 10-Minute Full-Body Band Express, Beginner Band Foundations, Travel Band Workout (No Anchor), Upper-Body Push & Pull, Glutes & Legs Mini-Band Session, and Core & Shoulder Stability.
• 12 structured 21–30 day strength programs (one-time purchase each or all in one bundle):
  - Beginner Band Strength (28 days)
  - Full-Body Band Strength (30 days)
  - Travel Band Plan (No Anchor, 21 days)
  - Stronger Upper Body (30 days)
  - Stronger Legs and Glutes (30 days)
  - Stronger Back and Shoulders (28 days)
  - Stronger Arms and Chest (28 days)
  - Mini-Band Glute Strength (28 days)
  - Door-Anchor Full-Body Plan (30 days)
  - Chair-Friendly Band Strength (28 days)
  - Core and Total-Body Stability (21 days)
  - Intermediate Band Strength & Volume (30 days)
• 44 clear exercise demonstrations with 4-step setup, anchor, and tempo cues covering squats, hinges, presses, rows, shoulders, arms, glutes, and core.
• 6 difficulty levels: start at level 0 and scale reps or hold times step by step as you get stronger, then move up to a heavier band.
• Adjustable rest timer between exercises, built-in rest days every third day, and workout streak tracking.
• Create your own custom workouts and custom challenges (optional one-time unlocks).

HONEST PRICING — NO SUBSCRIPTIONS
• All 6 workouts and all 44 exercises are free.
• Buy individual programs once and keep them forever, or unlock all 12 programs, custom builders, and ad removal in one complete bundle.
• Purchasing any program removes ads from that program’s sessions.

BUILT ON EVIDENCE & BAND SAFETY
Every exercise includes practical band-safety and setup cues (midfoot anchoring, door-anchor hinge-side placement, controlled tempo, and stopping 2–3 reps before form breaks), plus an in-app Sources & Band Safety screen linking to peer-reviewed resistance-training research and the PAR-Q+ readiness check.

This app provides general fitness workouts, not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult your doctor before starting if you have a heart condition, high blood pressure, a joint or bone condition, recent eye surgery, or are pregnant. Calorie and time figures are estimates.

name: ResistorCode
description:
ResistorCode 是一把专治电阻色环的随身小工具：不用背色码表，点几下就出阻值；手上只有目标阻值，也能反查出该用哪几道色环。

【正向计算】
四环、五环、六环全支持。点选每一道色环的颜色，顶部实时给出阻值、误差区间与温度系数。选择器会按环位过滤颜色——数字环只有黑到白，倍率环才出现金银，误差环才有「无色 ±20%」，从根上避免选出不存在的组合。

【反向查询】
输入目标阻值，选好环数与误差，App 在 E24 / E96 标准表里按对数距离找最接近的标称值，给出偏差百分比、该值的 E 系列归属，以及对应的完整配色。点「应用到计算器」即可回到主界面继续改环。

【SMD 代码换算】
支持三种数字写法与一种字母写法：
· 三位数：472 = 47 × 10² = 4.7 kΩ
· 四位数：1002 = 100 × 10² = 10 kΩ
· R 记法：4R7 = 4.7 Ω，R47 = 0.47 Ω，47R = 47 Ω
· EIA-96：01C = 100 × 100 = 10 kΩ

【常用阻值表】
E6 / E12 / E24 / E48 / E96 五张标准表内置，点任意数值即可复制到剪贴板，做 BOM 或核对物料表时随手可用。

【为什么它足够轻】
· 完全离线：不申请网络权限，不做任何请求
· 零权限：不读相册、不读通讯录、不定位、不追踪
· 无账号：打开即用，没有注册和登录
· 无广告、无内购、无第三方 SDK
· 深色模式适配，黑色环与灰色环在深色背景上照样看得清
· 支持 iPad，横竖屏都能用

适合电子爱好者、硬件工程师、维修与教学场景使用。

name: Resultadoz
description:
Resultadoz es el sistema de gestión para restaurantes. Esta app es para dueños, socios y encargados que ya usan Resultadoz en su local: el salón en vivo, desde el teléfono.

QUÉ VAS A VER
• Lo vendido en el turno, lo cobrado y lo que falta cobrar, al momento.
• Las mesas abiertas: cuánto lleva cada una, el mozo y hace cuánto se abrió.
• La caja del turno y los medios de pago.
• La comparación con el mismo día de la semana pasada.
• El reporte del día en PDF, el mismo que llega por mail.

SIN ABRIR LA APP
• Widget en la pantalla bloqueada y en la de inicio: lo vendido en el turno y los cubiertos.
• Actividad en vivo: mientras el turno está abierto, los números en la pantalla bloqueada y en la Dynamic Island.

AVISOS
• Cuando se abre o se cierra un turno, cuando un cierre tiene diferencia de caja, una anulación y más. Cada uno elige qué le llega.

SEGURIDAD
• Los importes se tapan en el selector de apps.
• Entrás con tu cuenta de Google, de Apple o con el usuario que te dio tu administrador. Cada uno ve sólo lo que su rol permite.

La app es de sólo lectura: no se cargan ventas ni se cobra desde acá. Para usarla tu local tiene que tener Resultadoz. Más información en resultadoz.com.

name: RetroPad Pocket
description:
RetroPad is an Amiga, Commodore 64 and Game Boy emulator for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. Play the classic computer and handheld games you own, with real covers, auto-save and controls made for touch.

AMIGA EMULATOR
• Boots right away with AROS, the free Amiga system ROM included in the app
• Use your own Kickstart ROM for the best compatibility
• ADF, ADZ and DMS floppy disks, with the Amiga mouse on the touchscreen, a trackpad or a mouse

COMMODORE 64 (C64) EMULATOR
• Starts straight to READY with the free Open ROMs, or with your own KERNAL, BASIC and character ROMs
• D64 and G64 disks, PRG, P00 and T64 programs, CRT cartridges and TAP tapes
• On-screen RUN/STOP, RESTORE and function keys, or type on a hardware keyboard

GAME BOY, GAME BOY COLOR AND GAME BOY ADVANCE (GBA) EMULATOR
• GB, GBC and GBA games with built-in emulated BIOS
• Battery saves kept for every game
• On-screen D-pad, A and B, L and R, Start and Select

A LIBRARY THAT FEELS LIKE A SHELF
• Covers made automatically from each game's own title screen
• Continue Playing: every game saves itself when you leave
• Search, and filter by system
• Import from the Files app, from other apps or by drag and drop, ZIP archives included

MADE FOR IPHONE, IPAD AND IPHONE DUO
• Touch controls placed around the picture, in portrait and landscape
• Hardware keyboards and mice, with pointer lock on iPad
• Layouts for iPhone Duo open, closed or half open

RETROPAD PRO (one-time in-app purchase)
• Controller support: PS5, Xbox and other Bluetooth game controllers
• Save states: six slots per game, plus Quick Save and Quick Load
• 4× fast forward
• CRT and scanline filters
• Auto-fire
• Custom covers from Photos or Files
Playing stays free: every system, the on-screen controls, keyboard and mouse, and the automatic save.

NO GAMES INCLUDED
RetroPad does not include any games or commercial ROMs. Play the games you own or free homebrew, and import the original system ROMs you own for the best compatibility.


Amiga, Commodore 64, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, PlayStation and Xbox are trademarks of their respective owners. RetroPad is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

name: Reuring
description:
Welkom bij de app van Strandpaviljoen Reuring, op het grootste stadsstrand van Nederland, gewoon hier in Hoorn. Met deze app word je beloond voor elk bezoek.

SPAAR PUNTEN BIJ ELK BEZOEK
Check in bij je bezoek en verdien 1 beloningspunt + 1 XP voor elke euro die je uitgeeft. Je punten worden automatisch bijgeschreven.

DOE MEE AAN UITDAGINGEN
Verdien extra punten met onze uitdagingen. Kom bijvoorbeeld 3x van maandag t/m donderdag dineren en ontvang 500 extra punten.

WISSEL IN VOOR BELONINGEN
Wissel je punten in voor een drankje naar keuze (ook 0%) en andere beloningen.

STIJG IN NIVEAU
Verzamel XP en stijg van Brons naar hogere niveaus voor nog meer voordelen.

NODIG VRIENDEN UIT
Verwijs een vriend en ontvang samen extra punten.

ALTIJD OP DE HOOGTE
Bekijk onze activiteiten, reserveer direct een tafel en ontvang als eerste onze acties.

Download de app, check in bij je bezoek en begin vandaag met sparen.

name: RFR Yönetim
seller_name: RFR EGITIM BILISIM TEKNOLOJILERI VE PRODUKSIYON SANAYI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
RFR Yönetim, kurumunuzun CRM işlemlerini tek hesabınızdan takip etmenizi sağlar.

• Aday ve öğrenci kayıtlarını görüntüleyin ve yetkilerinize göre düzenleyin.
• Görüşmeleri ve takip işlemlerini yönetin.
• Görevlerinizi ve iş akışınızı takip edin.
• Hesabınıza ait yönetim bildirimlerinden haberdar olun.

Uygulama, kurumunuz tarafından tanımlanmış bir RFR Yönetim hesabı ve internet bağlantısı gerektirir. Görüntülenebilen bilgiler ve kullanılabilen işlemler, hesabınızın kurum ve erişim yetkilerine göre belirlenir.

name: Rib Belt
description:
Dear friend,

When the belt squeal comes back after a rainy week, you still cannot remember which car got the last serpentine check — or whether that ribbed-belt length lived on a glove-box note or a photo in your camera roll. Rib Belt is a small garage notebook for people who keep one or more cars and want a calm place to log accessory and drive-belt specs and check or replace timing on this phone.

1. Register each car and its belt specs
Give the car a short name and its current odometer in miles. Add one or more belt specs with a part note, an optional length note you copy from the belt stamp, a check or replace interval in months (1–120) and/or miles (1–999,999), and the last inspected or replaced values when you know them. At least one interval is enough for the app to reckon what is due.

2. See what needs care at a glance
The Due board groups belts into Overdue, Soon, and Later so you can open the phone and know which drive belt to touch first. Never-serviced belts sit in Overdue until you log a check or change. Tap Mark inspected or Mark replaced to write today’s log, stamp the odometer, and roll the next due window forward.

3. Keep cars and belt specs searchable
Garage lists every vehicle with search. Open a car to edit the odometer, add another belt spec, review that car’s inspect or replace log, or delete the car and its belts. Specs gathers belt-spec notes across your garage so you can jump back to matching cars without retyping.

4. Quiet landscape layout, local-only data
The screens stay readable in landscape: a cobalt bay wash, clear cards, and actions that sit where your thumbs expect them. Everything lives on this device. There is no account, no ads, and nothing to buy. About covers getting started, Privacy, Support mail to i8ofuw5h@gaowei.bond, and Erase library after two confirmations.

Warmly,
Rib Belt

name: Ribbon & Return
description:
Write a thank-you note, a poem, or the letter you’ve been meaning to send. Each key leaves a slightly different mark on the paper. A bell sounds near the margin. Press Return and the carriage slides back for the next line.

Choose a sheet of cream, kraft, or airmail blue paper. Type with the round typewriter keys, your usual keyboard, or a hardware keyboard. For a late-night letter, switch on the desk lamp. Its pool of light follows the line as you write.

Leave a typo crossed out, or hold a word and draw correction tape across it to lift it off the page. When you send the finished sheet as an image or PDF, it keeps the ink, paper, and marks you chose. You can also print it or copy just the words.

Letters save as you type. File them under colored dividers in the Letter Tray and search for a line you remember. A Home Screen widget can take you back to the letter on your desk. Letter text stays hidden on the widget until you choose to show it.

Ribbon & Return works offline. You can save a backup from the Workshop and bring your letters to another device.

name: Riccardo Record
description:
Record, recap and share meetings and ideas.

Riccardo Record turns a tap on your wrist into a clear recap of what was said.

Two buttons on your Apple Watch: Quick Note and Meeting. Tap one and talk, or let a whole conversation run while you stay in it. During a meeting, tap the screen when something matters: that moment stands out in the recap. A third, smaller button opens your recaps on the watch, so you can read and send them from your wrist.

Your iPhone turns the audio into text, tells who said what and writes the recap: key points, decisions, and next steps with who owns them. One tap sends it on WhatsApp or by email.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no server, nothing collected. Recaps use Apple Intelligence on iPhones that support it; without it you still get the transcript and your marked moments.

MADE FOR PEOPLE WHO TALK FOR A LIVING
Consultants, event organisers, managers: stay in the conversation, not in your notes.

- Quick Note: one tap, start talking.
- Meeting: records the whole conversation.
- Marks: tap the screen and the moment stands out in the recap.
- Who said what: speakers are told apart on the iPhone.
