- The recap: key points, decisions, next steps with owners.
- One tap to WhatsApp or email.

Let people know when you record them, and follow the law where you are.

name: Rich or Not: Block Puzzle Game
seller_name: RENA GAMES OYUN YAZILIM VE PAZARLAMA ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Welcome to Rich or Not - Block Puzzle Game. If you enjoy logic games, brain teasers, and satisfying business puzzles, you'll love solving thousands of handcrafted levels. Transform poverty into prosperity and win in this addictive block-puzzle strategy game!

Can you make every citizen rich, or will your moves lead to failure? Rich or Not - Business Puzzle combines classic block-fitting gameplay with a unique wealth-transformation twist. Place grid blocks strategically, flip poor citizens into thriving billionaires, and build your business empire level by level! 

KEY FEATURES 
• Unique Puzzle Mechanics: Drop geometric blocks onto the grid to transform citizen states from poor to rich, but be careful: blocks also transforms rich citizens to poor!
• Strategic Brain Teasers: Plan every block placement carefully. One wrong shape can block your board and ruin your strategy!
• Satisfying Rewards & Progression: Reach your rich citizen quota, collect massive cash stacks, and unlock exciting level challenges!
• Vibrant Visuals & FX: Enjoy colorful, expressive characters, rich animations, and rewarding victory effects as you build wealth.
• Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple drag-and-drop mechanics paired with deep tactical gameplay that keeps your brain engaged.

HOW TO PLAY RICH OR NOT?
• Every block you place changes the state of the citizens underneath.
• Drag and drop geometric blocks onto the grid strategically.
• Flip struggling citizens into happy, thriving billionaires.
• Reach the level target before running out of space on the board.
• Complete every business puzzle using pure logic and spatial planning.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE RICH OR NOT?
• If you enjoy block puzzle games, state-toggling logic puzzles, or classic grid brain teasers, you'll immediately feel at home.

Think you have what it takes to manage the grid and bring fortune to the city? Download Rich or Not - Business Puzzle now and start your journey to wealth!

name: Richard Blows
description:
Meet Richard. He's a vacuum. The farm is overrun with roosters. You see where this is going.

Drag to steer Richard around the barnyard and hold SUCK with your other thumb to pull the birds in before their timers run out. Every five catches in a row raises your multiplier. Fill the suction meter and Richard goes into OVERDRIVE: double the reach, double the points, and he completely loses control.

ON THE FARM
Roosters, hens and fast little chicks
Golden eggs worth big points, if you're quick
The Mega Rooster: heavy, proud, and wearing a crown
The fox. Do NOT suck up the fox. He bites.

THE FEED STORE
Every run earns corn. Spend it on a wider nozzle, a bigger motor, a bigger bag and a longer overdrive.

A WHOLE DAY ON THE FARM
The sun comes up, crosses the sky and sets as the waves get harder, and by night the stars are out and the hayloft light is on.

MADE WITH LOVE (AND SUCTION)
Every sound is made in the game: Richard's motor, the squawks, the siren, the banjo
Haptics on every catch
No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Your best score and your corn stay on your device.
Works great on iPhone and iPad, with a space-bar SUCK on a keyboard

Cock-a-doodle VROOM. An entirely unreasonable day on the farm.

name: RideHaven Rides
description:
RideHaven Rides is Zimbabwe's smarter way to get around. Request a ride in seconds, set a fare that works for you, and travel with verified drivers, whether you're heading across town or to another city.

WHY RIDERS CHOOSE RIDEHAVEN

• NAME YOUR FARE
Don't accept one fixed price. Offer your fare, receive counter-offers from drivers, and choose the deal that suits you. Need a faster pickup? Boost your fare to attract drivers sooner.

• CITY-TO-CITY TRAVEL
Going further? Book intercity trips between 16 Zimbabwean cities, with the same bidding flow you already know. Plan ahead, agree a fair price, and travel with confidence.

• LIVE TRIP TRACKING
Watch your driver arrive in real time and follow your route on the map. Share your live trip link with family or friends so they know you're safe, and they don't even need the app to follow along.

• DRIVER DETAILS YOU CAN TRUST
See your driver's name, rating, and vehicle details before you get in. Rate every trip so the community stays reliable.

• EXTRAS MADE EASY
Add multiple stops along the way, and let your driver know about luggage so you get a vehicle that fits.

• NO MORE ENDLESS WAITING
If no driver is available, we tell you quickly so you can adjust your fare or try again instead of being left waiting.

FOR DRIVERS

Turn your car into income. Receive nearby ride requests, send counter-offers, and keep control of your earnings.
• Choose the trips you want to take
• Track your earnings from your driver dashboard
• Top up your driver wallet securely using Pesepay
• Accept local and intercity requests

BUILT FOR ZIMBABWE

RideHaven is designed around how people really travel here: flexible fares, local payments, and routes between our cities, not a copy of a foreign product.

SAFETY FIRST

• Live trip sharing with trusted contacts
• Driver ratings and rider feedback
• Trip details visible throughout your journey

GET STARTED IN MINUTES

1. Create your account
2. Enter your pickup and destination
3. Set your fare and send your request
4. Pick the best driver offer and ride

Questions or feedback? Reach us anytime at support. We read every message and keep improving RideHaven for you.

Download RideHaven Rides today and travel on your terms.

name: RideNote: Family Ride Planner
description:
RideNote keeps your kids' class rides in one place for the whole family. Mom plans the week, Dad drives, Grandma covers Wednesdays — and everyone sees the same schedule.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
• Every ride today: time, child, class, from and to
• Who is driving each one, and which are yours
• This week view with your rides and rides that still need a driver
• A home screen widget with today's rides and to-dos

SET IT ONCE, IT REPEATS
Add each regular ride with its days of the week, time, places and usual driver. RideNote fills in every week for you. Pick the places on a map, and RideNote suggests how early to remind the driver based on the distance, with a few minutes to spare.

CHANGE JUST ONE DAY
Running late or out of town? Change the time, skip the day, or ask someone else to drive. They get a notification with Accept and Decline buttons, and you're told the moment they answer. Other days stay as they are.

DROP-OFF AND PICKUP
Add a drop-off, a pickup, or both for each class, each with its own driver. For a pickup, RideNote can check where the pickup driver is shortly before and tell them when to leave, based on the drive to the class.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
When it's time to leave, the ride you drive shows on your lock screen with a countdown to arrival and a Directions button. It goes away a few minutes after the ride, or when you tap End.

REMINDERS FOR THE DRIVER
Only the person driving gets the reminder (everyone, if no one is set). Tap it to open the ride and start directions in the navigation app on your phone. When you're made the driver of a ride, you're told right away.

NOTES FOR THE RIDE
Leave a note on a ride, like "Bring indoor shoes". The driver sees it in the reminder.

SHARED TO-DOS
Keep a family to-do list for things like supplies and forms, with due dates and the child they're for.

JOIN IN SECONDS
Create a family and send the invite link or show the QR code. The other parent opens it and joins — no account, no password.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no account, no tracking. Your family's schedule is shared only with the people you invite.

English and Korean.

name: Ridgeline Rally: Pace Notes
description:
Ridgeline Rally is a point-to-point rally game where every second counts and your co-driver reads the road for you.

Fifteen hand-shaped stages across five regions:
• Azure Coast – fast tarmac sweepers on cliff roads above the sea
• Pine Valley – loose gravel through dark forest
• Red Canyon – dusty desert tracks under a low sun
• Glacier Pass – packed snow, ice and hairpins high in the Alps
• Midnight Ridge – the finale, mountain tarmac at night with only your lights ahead

PACE NOTES
Just like a real rally, your co-driver calls every corner before you reach it: LEFT 3, RIGHT 5 TIGHTENS, HAIRPIN LEFT, "into" the next bend. Learn to trust the notes and carry speed.

REAL CAR FEEL
An all-wheel-drive rally hatchback with suspension, grip that changes with the surface, and a handbrake for sliding through tight corners. Kick up dust on gravel, snow spray on ice.

CHASE YOUR GHOST
Your best run drives with you as a ghost car, and every split time shows if you are ahead or behind. Earn bronze, silver and gold medals on every stage.

GARAGE
Eight rally liveries to unlock with gold medals.

No account, no sign-in, no birth-date questions. Just you, the car and the road.

Optional purchases: Remove ads, Pro Garage (all liveries).

name: Rilo: Jungle Jumper
description:
Rilo doesn't stop. Neither should you.

Leap from totem to totem through a misty jungle — but the moment Rilo lands, the totem shudders and starts to sink. Hesitate and it drops out from under you.

ONE THUMB, TWO MOVES
Tap for a quick hop. Hold for a soaring leap. That's the whole game — about four seconds to learn, and a lot longer to master.

HOT POTATO
Every totem is a countdown. Landing is only half the job; the other half is deciding, instantly, where you're going next.

BUILT TO BE FAIR
No surprise deaths. Every gap is crossable, every totem is reachable, and the speed climbs gradually so you always have a shot at one more point. When you fall, it's because of your timing — not the game's.

CHASE YOUR FRIENDS
Game Center leaderboards. Your best run, their best run, settled.

• Pay once. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no accounts.
• Plays completely offline.
• Collects nothing about you.

name: Ripenora
description: Ripenora is a fruit-themed wheel puzzle where you spin the harvest wheel, place juicy fruits into a ripen ring, and clear creative orbit goals. Enjoy Harvest Trail levels, Endless Grove runs, Daily Blend challenges, and a collectible Fruit Codex. Bright visuals, smooth controls, and playful fruit energy make every spin a fresh little puzzle.

name: Risedial: Sourdough Starter
description:
Know when your starter peaks. Bake on your schedule.

Risedial watches your sourdough starter for you. Log a feeding and the jar on your screen rises with it, counting down to the peak. Mark a few peaks and Risedial learns how fast your starter really is, so the next prediction fits your kitchen. No weekly plans, no ads, and the widgets are free.

YOUR STARTER, RIGHT NOW
• A live jar that rises from the feed line toward the peak
• Countdown to peak and the best window to mix
• Drag the jar to look ahead in time
• Rising, near peak, peak, falling or hungry, at a glance
• Peak and hungry reminders

FEEDINGS THAT ADD UP
• 1:1:1, 1:2:2, 1:5:5 or your own ratio, in grams
• Mix up to three flours: bread, whole wheat, rye, spelt and more
• Rise check: snap the jar, drag three lines, get the rise in percent
• History: time to peak and kitchen temperature, side by side
• Fridge mode with a weekly feeding reminder

BAKE ON YOUR SCHEDULE
• Pick the time you want bread; Risedial plans every step backward
• Autolyse, mix at peak, bulk with fold reminders, shape, cold retard, bake
• Timings adjust to your kitchen temperature and your starter
• Follow the next step on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• A simple timer, free for everyone

FORMULAS AND BAKER'S MATH
• A baker's percentage calculator: change any gram, see hydration instantly
• Scale by flour, loaves or total dough; grams or cups
• Six formulas written for Risedial: Country Loaf, Sandwich Loaf, Focaccia, Bagels, Pizza Dough and Discard Pancakes

NEW STARTER? 14 DAYS, DAY BY DAY
• What to feed each day, what you might see, and when to start over

EVERY LOAF, REMEMBERED
• A bake journal with crumb photos, ratings and notes
• Share a loaf card: hydration, bulk time, cold retard and your starter's age

WIDGETS, FREE
• Your jar and time to peak, the next bake step, and the rise curve on your Home Screen
• Peak time on your Lock Screen

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Everything, including your photos, stays on your iPhone. Risedial has no server.

RISEDIAL PRO
Tracking one starter, peak predictions, rise checks, two weeks of history, the calculator, three formulas, the simple timer, ten journal entries and all widgets are free, forever. Pro adds the Bake Planner, the Live Activity, unlimited starters, all six formulas plus your own, full history, an unlimited journal and every loaf card style. Choose yearly with a free one-week trial, or unlock Pro once, for life.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://aquatic-alto-bc9.notion.site/Risedial-Privacy-Policy-4215ee35e47980bf8761d69e75132860

Predictions are estimates for home baking. General baking guidance, not food-safety advice.

name: Rising Tide Chess Joy
description:
Rising Tide Chess Joy is real chess played on a shrinking island. Twice during the game the tide rises and floods the outer ring of the board, washing away every piece that stands there. First the board shrinks to six by six, then to four by four. Plan your pieces and your king around the countdown, because the tide always arrives on time.

WHAT YOU GET
• Full chess rules, including castling, en passant and promotion
• A computer opponent that understands the tide, with three difficulty levels
• Always-visible tide countdown and a clear warning for pieces in danger
• A special tide check rule that keeps kings from drowning: get out in time or lose
• An interactive tutorial that teaches the tide, the king rule and the shrinking board
• A hint that shows a strong move
• Local statistics and badges to chase
• Elegant pieces, flowing water and haptics (switch them off any time)
• Works completely offline. No account, no ads, no timers
• Available in 20 languages

HOW IT WORKS
Play chess as usual. After the 12th move of each side the outer ring floods, then six moves later the next ring floods. Pieces on flooded squares are removed. On your last move before a tide, your king must be off the doomed ring, just as it must not stay in check. Pawns promote on the farthest remaining rank, castling is only possible before the first tide, and on the final four-by-four board ten moves each without a capture end in a draw.

PRIVACY
Rising Tide Chess Joy never asks you to sign in. If you agree, the game sends anonymous usage statistics and crash reports to help us improve it. You can say no and the game works exactly the same, and you can change your choice in Settings at any time.

name: RitualDeck
description:
Turn repeatable work into clear procedures. Write ordered steps, start a run and check each step as you go. Current progress persists when you leave or relaunch the app. Finish only after every step is complete and keep a dated snapshot in your run history. Editing a template preserves the steps of an already active run. Search procedures, review completion totals and share a procedure summary.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: Rivalry: Live Auctions
description:
Rivalry is the fastest way to buy and sell second-hand and collectible items through live auctions.

LIVE BIDDING
• Every bid updates on everyone's screen at the same moment.
• Every bid extends the clock; a bid near the end pushes the remaining time to at least 1 minute. No one can quietly snatch an item in the last second.
• Automatic bidding: enter the most you are willing to pay, and the system raises your bid only as much as needed.

LIVE STREAM AUCTIONS
• The seller turns on the camera and shows items one by one; you watch, chat and bid with a single tap.
• Streams can be scheduled for later; tap "Remind me" to get a notification when one starts.

FEED
• Discover items by swiping full screen; zoom into photos and double-tap the ones you like.

EASY SELLING
• Take a photo and publish your listing in a few steps; schedule it to start on a later day and time if you like.
• Set a hidden reserve price; if bids stay below it, the item is not sold.
• Edit or remove your listing until the first bid arrives.

SAFE TRADING
• After the sale, buyer and seller message each other in the app; payment, shipping and delivery steps are tracked.
• Ratings and reviews are public.
• Report and block users; new listings are automatically screened for prohibited items.
• Location data is removed from photos, and your exact address is never shown.

12 LANGUAGES
Available in 12 languages, including English and Turkish.

Rivalry does not hold money; payment is made directly between buyer and seller.

name: Road to Victory: The Ops
description:
Run your crew down Victory Drive and build the biggest squad on the block!

Road to Victory is a fast, satisfying crowd runner and squad shooter. Drag to aim, shoot the gates to charge them up, cross blue to recruit, and crack RAPID and POWER crates to upgrade your shots. Break through The Ops, the robot crew running Victory Drive, survive their horde rush and take down their boss as it sweeps, slams and shells the road.

• 250 BLOCKS: palm-lined medians, live oaks with Spanish moss, gas stations, plazas and neon strips, from golden hour to neon nights, summer storms, the Thunderbolt marsh, fog, hurricane season and festival night.
• BOSSES THAT FIGHT BACK: Lock-on Slams, Lane Sweeps, Pincer Strikes, Mortar Salvos, Shockwaves, Cross Charges and Scatter Mines. They get enraged at half health, and a huge district boss waits every 10 blocks.
• RISKY GATES: ×2, minus and ÷2 gates, plus charge gates you can flip from red to blue with steady fire.
• YOUR LEADER, YOUR STYLE: skin tone, oversized jersey and number, bandana, fitted cap, durag or beanie, chains, kicks and blaster skins, all with a live 3D preview in the Locker.
• UPGRADE YOUR ARMY: permanent Fire Rate, Damage and Starting Squad upgrades. Rank up the Carbine, Pulse Repeater and Ion Cannon and pick your bullet color. Call in Shield, Airstrike and Rapid Fire when it gets heavy.
• PLAY WITH FRIENDS: add friends by code or username, chat 1:1, send hearts and free daily gifts, and see where everyone is on the Victory Drive map.
• SEÑOR COUGHLIN'S MONTHLY RAFFLE: a free monthly giveaway for a one-of-a-kind in-game item. One free entry every day; purchases never give entries. Virtual item only, no cash value. Apple is not a sponsor of, and is not involved in, this raffle. Official rules: https://road-to-victory.vercel.app/raffle-rules.html
• PLAYS OFFLINE: every block works without internet.

Fair to play: the whole game can be beaten for free. Optional rewarded videos give bonuses only when you choose to watch. No forced ads, no loot boxes.

All characters, businesses and crews are fictional.

name: RoadReel: Drive & Trip Reels
description:
Every drive, a reel.

RoadReel turns your drives, motorcycle rides, and flights into something worth keeping. Record a trip with one tap, and watch it back as a cinematic drone-camera flyover of your actual route — complete with real elevation, live speed telemetry, and your photos pinned right where you stopped for them.

RECORD DRIVES & FLIGHTS
Start recording with one tap. RoadReel tracks your route, speed, distance, sharp bends, and elevation climb in the background, even with your screen off. Switch to Flight Mode (Pro) to log commercial or private flights with GPS alone.

WATCH YOUR 3D DRONE REEL
Every finished drive becomes an automatic reel: switch between Drone, Follow, Top-down, Hybrid Auto, and adaptive FPV Drone camera angles. Choose from 5 live telemetry HUD overlays (Cluster, Minimal, Pilot, Studio, and Arc) and 13 royalty-free instrumental soundtracks.

4-TAB PRO VIDEO STUDIO & HD MP4 EXPORT
Open the CapCut-style 4-tab Video Studio (Director, Edit, Style, Audio & Text) to apply 1-tap Pro Presets, trim route endpoints, add speed ramps, layer custom typography titles, grade with 7 colour looks, and export 1080p MP4 reels in Story (9:16), Feed (4:5), Square (1:1), or Wide (16:9) at up to 60 fps.

CRAFTED SHARE CARDS & 5 THEMES
Personalize every tab, share card, and exported reel across 5 distinct looks:
• Sunset Editorial (Free): Warm travel journal paper, Instrument Serif headings, and terracotta accents.
• Dune Cinema (Pro): Obsidian luxury canvas, brushed graphite surfaces, and champagne-ember glow.
• Field Atlas (Pro): Survey map sheets on pale sage, pine ink, and neatline tick marks.
• Boarding Pass (Pro): Aviation porcelain ticket stock, perforated stubs, and monospace telemetry.
• Petrol Pump (Pro): Motorsport carbon & amber instrument cluster at night, cream enamel by day.

GARAGE, FUEL & EV EFFICIENCY
Log fuel fill-ups or electric vehicle (kWh) charges in the Garage. RoadReel calculates your true full-tank-to-full-tank efficiency (km/L or L/100 km), cost per km, estimated tank level, and what each trip actually cost you across 30 currencies (AED, INR, USD, SAR, EUR, GBP, and 24 more). Keep your vehicle registration (Mulkiya / RC), insurance, and licence organized in the Document Wallet, and import or export Fuelio CSV logs anytime.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your library is local-first and works offline without an account. Trim the first and last 200 m, 500 m, or 1,000 m of any shared route, set Home and Work private zones, and create AES-256-GCM encrypted backup archives.

FREE AND PRO
RoadReel is free for unlimited drive recording, 1080p 30 fps silent MP4 exports, Sunset Editorial theme, up to 2 vehicles, 1 multi-drive journey, Fuelio CSV import/export, GPX export, and cloud sync. RoadReel Pro is optional and available as an auto-renewing Monthly or Yearly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before renewal in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://roadreel-b63bd.web.app/privacy

name: Roam: When in Roam
description:
A private map of where your friends are going next. Invite-only: no public profiles, no strangers, no feed to scroll. A friend brings you in.
Roam is a private travel network for a closed circle of friends. Post where you're going, see where everyone else will be, and find out when your paths cross.

It is invite-only. There is no sign-up page and no public profile. A friend brings you in with a link, and only your friends ever see your plans.

WHAT YOU DO WITH IT

• Post a trip in a few taps: where, when, and who can see it.
• See every friend's upcoming trips on one map and one calendar.
• Tap "I'm in" on a friend's trip, or "Interested" if you might be.
• Get a notification when a friend will be in the same city as you, or is coming to yours.
• Make a plan around a trip - a dinner, a hike, a night out - with a seat count, and see who's coming.
• Each trip and each plan has its own chat, with mentions and reactions.
• Keep a trip's checklist, its stay details and a shared photo album in one place.
• Say which city you're in right now, so friends passing through know.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• Your friends list is yours alone. Nobody can see who you know.
• Every trip is Open (your friends), Invite only (the people you name), or Private (just you).
• Passing on a trip is silent. Nobody is told.
• No ads, no tracking across apps, no algorithm deciding what you see.

GETTING IN

Roam is for people who were invited. If a friend sent you a link, open it and you're in. If you already have an account, sign in with your email and the six-digit code we send you.

Available in English, Russian, Arabic, Spanish and French.

name: Rocky Blocky
description:
Rocky Blocky is a calm block puzzle. Place pieces on an 8×8 board and clear lines.

Play numbered levels or switch to Endless. There is no timer.

Levels use hearts. You lose one heart only when a level fails, not when you leave, and not in Endless. One heart returns about every 20 minutes.

Heart Refill fills all 5 hearts once. Unlimited Hearts is a one-time purchase on your Apple ID and can be restored.

name: Rodaklik
description:
RodaKlik is an all-in-one automotive marketplace and community connecting buyers, sellers, dealerships and vehicle enthusiasts.

Discover cars and motorcycles, explore dealer videos, connect directly with sellers, make offers and engage with fellow automotive enthusiasts.

Whether you're buying, selling or simply exploring, RodaKlik brings the automotive world together in one convenient platform.

RodaKlik – Semua Kendaraan. Satu Klik.

name: Roli: Capture Ski Moments
description:
Roli is built for freestyle slalom skaters, blending training tracking with real‑world skating community.
Find nearby skating meet‑ups, keep track of every trick you practice, and watch highlight clips shared by fellow skaters. Receive tailored trick suggestions matching your skill level. Log your practice attempts, successful landings and personal notes, with landing‑rate statistics updating instantly.

Browse short skating clips with intuitive playback controls: tap to pause, double‑tap to like, swipe to navigate between videos. Interact with content through comments, slow‑motion highlight marks, gifts and shares. Explore other skaters’ profiles filled with their clips, performance stats, then connect through direct text chats.

Discover 18 graded flat‑slalom tricks ranging from difficulty 1.0 to 3.0. Filter by trick category or search in both English and Chinese. Join existing local skating gatherings or create your own sessions, setting venue, time and skill requirements. Skill difficulty is visualized through cone‑layout graphics instead of conventional star ratings.

Celebrate great skating moments with cones, the in‑app currency. Spend cones to turn favourite clips into half‑speed highlights or send virtual gifts to creators.

A thoughtful community space lets you report inappropriate content and block disruptive users for peaceful interactions.

name: Roller Rush - Home Run
description:
Grab your roller and run!

Roller Rush is a fast, funny endless runner from All About Home, a small family-run renovation and decorating business in Surrey.

Swipe to dodge vans, jump paint tins and slide under scaffold boards as you race down a street full of renovations. Run up plywood ramps and sprint along the roofs of the All About Home vans!

• Simple swipe controls, a guided first run, and speed that keeps building
• Coins in lines, arcs and up on the van roofs
• Power-ups: Coin Magnet, Double Coins, Super Trainers and the trusty Hard Hat
• Upgrade every power-up to make it last longer
• Tool Crates: collect 30 tools across 5 Toolbox sets, from the Sash Brush to the Golden Roller
• Unlock runners: Sparks the electrician, Chippy the carpenter, Bloom the gardener, Pip the plasterer, plus secret runners for finishing sets
• Missions that raise your score multiplier all the way to x30
• Seasonal Christmas Cracker tools, only in December
• Music, haptics, iPhone and iPad, and it works offline

Roller Rush is free to play with ads. A one-off Remove Ads purchase turns off ads between runs and gives you a free "keep running" every run. Tool Crates are earned by playing and are never sold.

name: Rolletto Casino Lantern Nights
description:
Explore a world of glowing lanterns, creative installations, and colorful light displays with a convenient festival companion. Discover exhibitions, browse upcoming events, reserve places for activities, and plan your visit using helpful tools in one app.

Browse a collection of decorative lanterns, illuminated sculptures, and artistic displays. Explore detailed descriptions, learn about unique designs, materials, and lighting techniques, and find exhibition locations on the interactive festival map.

Discover scheduled lantern performances, musical light displays, and evening shows. View event descriptions, dates, starting times, durations, and locations. Choose the number of attendees, make a reservation, and receive a QR code with your booking details.

Navigate the festival grounds using an interactive map. Find exhibition areas, performance zones, creative workshops, food courts, relaxation spaces, and visitor facilities. Select a location to view additional information and explore nearby attractions.

Take part in creative workshops featuring lantern crafting, painting, origami, and decorative lighting. Browse available activities, explore materials and schedules, and find workshop locations. Reserve places for yourself or a group and access your booking details through a QR code.

Use the built-in festival assistant to find helpful information about event schedules, reservations, exhibition locations, workshops, and visitor guidelines. Quickly access answers to common questions while planning your festival experience.

Keep your show and workshop reservations organized in one place. Review booking details, access QR codes, check reservation statuses, and manage upcoming activities. Reservations require only the number of attendees, with no account registration or personal contact information needed.

From exploring illuminated exhibitions to attending performances and joining creative activities, the app provides practical tools for organizing your visit. Discover festival attractions, plan your schedule, and enjoy a convenient way to explore the world of lantern art.

name: Roneva
description:
Roneva is a quiet starry petri dish for turn-based territory strategy. Expand your cells through adjacent division and two-step jumps, turning local advantages into territorial control against an AI or a local friend.

Challenge daily puzzle boards, review critical moves after matches, and replay your tactical choices. All current features are completely free to open.

name: Roomburn: AI Room Roasts
description:
Roomburn is for entertainment only. All roasts, scores and voices are generated by AI and are not real opinions. Voices are original AI voices and do not imitate any real person. The app roasts rooms and objects only, never people. Frames from your video are sent to an AI provider to create the roast and are not stored after generation.

Think your room is fine? Let's find out.

Film your room for 5 seconds. Our AI looks at the mess, the decor, the cable chaos and that chair you use as a closet, then roasts it out loud with a funny original voice. You get a vertical video with big subtitles, a Room Score out of 10 and a backhanded compliment at the end. Post it in one tap.

HOW IT WORKS
• Film: point your camera at your room for 5–8 seconds, or upload a clip from your gallery. No faces needed.
• Get roasted: the AI writes a short roast about your room and reads it out loud.
• Share: save or post your 9:16 clip with subtitles and your Room Score.

WHAT YOU GET
• Roasts about your room and your stuff only: decor, mess, lighting, posters, setups. Never about people.
• A Room Score out of 10 to brag about (or fix).
• Big word-by-word subtitles, ready for vertical video.
• Your roast history, saved on your device, so you can re-share anytime.
• A report button on every roast if something feels off.

GO PRO
• Up to 30 roasts a day
• Savage mode: sharper jokes, still friendly
• 4 original AI voices
• A smaller watermark

Your video stays on your phone: the final clip is made on your device. Only a few still frames are sent to create the roast.

Prefer not to subscribe? A Roast Pack gives you 10 roasts as a one-time purchase that does not renew.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
• Roomburn Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, available weekly or yearly. The current price and period and any free trial (for example 3 days) are shown in the app before you buy and may vary by country.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends.
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings.
• Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://garagelab.tech/roomburn/terms
Privacy Policy: https://garagelab.tech/roomburn/privacy

name: RoomGlide
description:
RoomGlide helps you plan a rectangular room using dimensions you measure and enter yourself. Build a reusable furniture library, try alternative arrangements, and keep a report of the positions and geometric findings behind your choice.

START WITH MEASUREMENTS
Create a room, enter its width and depth in whole millimetres or centimetres with one decimal place, then add furniture definitions with names, dimensions and optional notes. Choose a labeled color and your own uniform clearance requirement. Adding furniture to a layout makes an independent snapshot, so later library edits do not silently resize an existing arrangement.

PLACE, INSPECT AND COMPARE
Use the layout canvas or exact numeric coordinates to position items. Rotate rectangles by 90 degrees, duplicate a layout to try another arrangement, and save changes deliberately. Geometry Audit separates room-edge excess, positive-area furniture overlap and intrusions into the clearance bands you entered. Touching an edge is different from overlapping it. Locate the relevant placement and inspect the measured reason for each finding.

Compare two layouts of the same room using the same room dimensions. Review item counts, findings and position differences, then freeze a report. The sum of furniture footprints can count overlaps more than once; it is not an occupied union-area measurement.

KEEP USEFUL OUTPUTS
Reports retain their own room and layout snapshots after the current room changes or is deleted. Generate a paginated PDF, a 2048-by-2048 PNG or complete coordinate and findings CSV output. Preview or share the actual files through the system panel. Deleting a report removes its internal outputs; removing furniture definitions keeps already placed snapshots. About offers confirmed erasure of the local library and reports. External originals, shared copies and system backups are separate.

CLEAR LIMITS
Room sides: 500-50,000 mm. Furniture sides: 50-20,000 mm. User-defined clearance: 0-3,000 mm. Up to 100 rooms, 10 layouts per room and 60 items per layout. Only rectangles and 0/90-degree rotation are supported. The app does not measure with a camera or AR. Findings follow your input and the stated geometric rules; they do not certify safety, accessibility, circulation or building compliance. PDF diagrams fit the page and are not scale drawings.

The native planning tools require no app login. Your working library is saved in the app's local container, and you choose which output files to share.

name: ROOT SPORTS & COMMUNITY
description: Bu uygulama ile spor salonuna giriş çıkışlarınızı kolayca yönetin. QR kod ile hızlıca giriş yapın, üyelik bilgilerinizi görüntüleyin ve güncel kalın. Spor salonu deneyiminizi bir üst seviyeye taşıyın!

name: Roovet Shop
description:
Roovet Shop puts the whole Roovet marketplace in your pocket: Roovet Brand fashion, sneakers, handbags, electronics, beauty and more from verified sellers.

FIND IT FAST
Search the full catalog with live suggestions, then narrow results by price, stock and sort order. Browse by department, or open Today's Deals to see every price drop in one place.

SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE
Every product page shows real photos, options, stock, delivery estimates, the seller's full description and verified customer reviews. Save items to your list, or keep them in Save for later until you're ready.

SAME-DAY DELIVERY IN JACKSONVILLE
Look for the Karu badge. Karu is Roovet's own same-day delivery service in the Jacksonville area, with live driver tracking and photo proof of delivery.

CHECK OUT SECURELY
Pay with PayPal. You review and approve every payment in PayPal, and you're charged only after you approve. Track your orders from the You tab.

ROOVET REWARDS
Spin for a daily reward and earn points on your orders.

SHOP WITH ROOVET AI
Not sure what to pick? Ask Roovet AI to compare products, suggest gifts or find something within your budget.

A Roovet account is needed to check out. Browsing is open to everyone.

name: Rosa: Daily Rosary
description:
Pray the Catholic Rosary with guided audio and on-screen beads. Start with today’s mysteries, pray a single decade, or pick up where you left off. Follow the words in silence, or listen at your own pace.

• Guided Rosary: follow each prayer and bead with English, Brazilian Portuguese or Mexican Spanish audio. English uses an iOS voice you can prepare offline. Brazilian Portuguese and Mexican Spanish Rosary audio is included.
• Daily Mass readings: read or listen to the readings and Gospel for every day of 2027 in Brazilian Portuguese, using the Bíblia Portuguesa Mundial edition for personal reading.
• Prayer library: discover chaplets, novenas, litanies, all 150 Psalms and Holy Week guides. Most of this library is in Brazilian Portuguese.
• Private intentions: keep your intentions, reflections and progress on your device. Review a prayer invitation before sharing through iOS.
• App Language: choose English, Brazilian Portuguese or Mexican Spanish in Rosa’s Settings.

The download, daily Rosary and readings are free. One optional purchase unlocks 20 original Brazilian Portuguese audio meditations to play offline. No account, advertising or subscription.

name: Rose Window: Bible Trivia Quiz
description:
Today's ten and 300 Sunday-school questions are free for good. Every other quiz, the Bible reader and Scholar levels and family rounds are free for 14 days, then a one-time purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account.

Rose Window is Bible trivia where every answer shows its verse, so you can check it for yourself. Ten questions a day light a stained-glass rose window, quizzes go book by book and chapter by chapter, and a family can pass one iPhone or iPad around the table.

EVERY ANSWER SHOWS ITS VERSE
• Tap an answer and the verse it comes from appears beneath it, with its reference and a short note
• Read the passage shows the verses around it
• Questions are written to ask only what their verse says, and to avoid matters that Christian traditions read differently
• See something wrong? Tell us, and the fix comes in the next update, listed in What's New

TODAY'S TEN
• Ten questions a day, the same for everyone, from easy to harder
• Each right answer lights a pane of the rose window, and your streak shines at its centre
• One missed day a week is forgiven
• Share your day's window as text

BOOK BY BOOK
• Questions across all 66 books, at three levels: Sunday school, Bible reader and Scholar
• The Bible window: 66 panes that light up as you learn each book
• Chapter by chapter, in the order the text runs, or by theme: the parables, the kings, miracles, journeys and more

FAMILY ROUNDS
• Two to eight players pass one iPhone or iPad around the table
• Everyone answers in private, then the verse shows who was right
• Everyone's score at the end, and ties are welcome

EASY TO READ
• Large text from the start, with Larger and Largest a tap away
• No timer unless you turn one on
• VoiceOver reads every question, answer and verse
• Dark mode, and sounds and haptics you can turn off
• Works offline

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPad or iPhone, and in your own iCloud or computer backups if you use them.

Scripture quotations are from the World English Bible (WEB), which is in the public domain.

name: RosterHearth: Shift Calendar
description:
See work and family plans in the same week. Add early, late and overnight shifts, repeat a shift weekly, or paste a roster. Get from a schedule change to a plan you can share.

KNOW WHAT’S ON THIS WEEK
Use a calendar with separate colors for your shifts, your partner’s shifts and family plans. Overnight shifts appear on both days.

READ A POSTED ROSTER
With Plus, select a photo or use the camera. A text scan runs on your device. Preview the extracted rows, correct any dates and confirm what to save.

FIND EVENINGS TOGETHER
With Plus, see gaps of at least 30 minutes between 5 and 10 p.m. based on the schedules you entered. Replacing a confirmed shift records its previous times.

SHARE A SCHEDULE SNAPSHOT
Send a copy of your upcoming shifts by text. The recipient can paste it into the free app. Re-send a snapshot when your roster changes.

The free download includes the main workflow. Plus is a one-time Apple in-app purchase. Restore Purchases is available in Settings.

name: RotaCove
description:
Keep recurring upkeep out of your memory and in a clear dated agenda. Create a routine, choose its interval in days, estimate the minutes and set the next due date. Complete it to schedule the next date from today, or undo the last completion. Search by title, area and notes; filter due routines and review your completion history. No reminders or calendar access are required.

Free, without ads, purchases or an account. Records stay in local app storage. Eight languages, persistent language selection and System, Light or Dark appearance. Optional fictional samples.

name: Rotate Bay
description:
Dear friend,

I wanted a clear “which car is due for a tire rotation” board on the phone I already carry in the garage. Rotate Bay keeps each vehicle, tire size note, and rotate interval on this device so you can see what is overdue, log a visit when the wheels come off, and look up sizes later without digging through door stickers or old invoices.

1. Garage and rotation schedules
Add a car with a nickname, current odometer (0–999,999 mi), and an optional note. On that car, add one or more rotation schedules with a tire size (for example 225/65R17), optional DOT note, and an interval in months (1–120) and/or miles (1–999,999). You can record last rotated date and miles so the board starts from a real baseline.

2. Due board
Open Due to see schedules grouped into Overdue, Soon, and Later. Each card shows the car name, tire size, DOT note when you added one, and what is left on the tighter track (miles or days). Tap Mark rotated to save today’s visit, optionally refresh the car’s current mileage, and update the board immediately. Schedules that still need an interval stay visible so you can finish setup.

3. Sizes and history
Sizes groups schedules by tire size note so you can see which cars share a fitment. From a car you can edit details, add another schedule, review rotate logs, or delete when a vehicle leaves the bay. Search works on the garage list and the sizes list.

4. Look and feel
The screens stay readable in landscape at the bay: night-pit clipboard colours, amber accents, and calm overdue / soon / later cues for quick glances. Everything stays on this device. There is no account, no ads, and no sync of your garage library to developer servers. Erase local data from About when you want a clean slate. Support mail goes to i8ofuw5h@gaowei.bond.

Rotate when it is due, and tell me how it feels in the bay.

Warmly,
The Rotate Bay team

name: Rotor Hole
description:
Rotor Hole keeps one balancing plane on this iPhone.

Each hole stores an angle and a mass. A hole lighter than the minimum stays on the rotor and stays out of the residual. The named hole is the seated hole whose mass vector lines up most with that residual.

Dragging the angle changes which hole is named. Saved grams do not change. Lifting a seated hole keeps its grams and takes it out of the sum.

The last hole and the last rotor stay. Readings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Rotorcast: Drone Weather
description:
Rotorcast tells you if you can fly your drone now, and when the next good window is.

ONE CLEAR ANSWER
• Go, Caution or No-go for right now, with the reasons in plain words
• Slide your finger along the hours: the screen changes color with the verdict
• Hour by hour for the next 12 hours (free) or 2.5 days (Pro)
• Best flight windows: every hour within your limits, grouped for you (Pro)

EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS FOR A FLIGHT
• Wind speed and direction, shown as moving wind lines, and gusts
• Estimated wind at your flight height (from the 10 m forecast; shown as an estimate)
• Chance of rain and rain amount, thunder
• Fog, as a sign of poor visibility
• Temperature, with a warning when batteries drain faster
• Kp index (geomagnetic activity) that can make GPS less reliable
• Sunrise, sunset and civil twilight, calculated for your spot

LIMITS THAT FIT YOUR DRONE
Start from a size (mini under 250 g, camera drone, large drone, FPV) and adjust every limit: wind, gusts, rain, temperature, Kp and flight height (Pro).

YOUR SPOTS
Save your flying spots with your location or coordinates, swipe between them and compare them at a glance (unlimited spots with Pro).

HONEST AND PRIVATE
• Free plan that is really useful, no ads
• No account, no analytics, no tracking: your spots stay on your iPhone
• The forecast comes straight from MET Norway, the Norwegian Meteorological Institute. Kp from NOAA.

Rotorcast shows weather only. It has no airspace, no-fly zone or legal information: always check your local drone regulations and airspace before you fly. You are responsible for your flight.

FREE AND PRO
Free: Go/no-go now and the next 12 hours for 1 flying spot.
Rotorcast Pro (monthly or yearly subscription): 2.5 days hour by hour, best flight windows, unlimited spots and your own limits for each drone. Prices are shown in the app.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://dravlogy.com/mobile/drone-weather/privacy

Weather data from MET Norway, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Kp index from NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center.

name: Routeprint
description:
Routeprint is a trip planner that draws every journey as a rail-map route line.

PLAN DAY BY DAY
Add flights, trains, drives, buses, boats, walks and hikes, the places you visit and where you sleep. Morning, afternoon and evening for every day. Drag to reorder, move things between days, undo anything.

EVERY LEG HAS ITS OWN LINE
Your trip becomes a rail map: flights dashed, trains on rails, boats on waves, hikes in dots. Stations, days and nights at a glance.

POSTERS WORTH PRINTING
Turn a trip into a poster: a classic route line, a contour survey sheet or a stack of tickets. Share it as an image, a print-ready A4 PDF or plain text, or send a trip card to friends.

YOUR TRAVELS, COUNTED
Countries, places, days on the road and the distance you've covered, with every trip drawn on a world map.

ROUTEPRINT PRO
One purchase, yours for good. No subscription.
• Add from a booking: paste a confirmation email and Apple Intelligence adds the flights and stays, on your device
• Survey sheet and Ticket stack posters, dark posters, print-ready PDF, no Routeprint mark
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen: a countdown to your next trip and your travel stats
• iCloud sync across your iPhone and iPad
• Stats by year

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your trips stay on your device, or in your own iCloud if you turn on sync.

Made for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, in English and Spanish.

name: RouteTrace: Route Planner
description:
Plan a run, a ride or a walk the way you would on paper: draw it.

DRAW IT
Trace a route on the map with one finger, move the map with two. Tap Done and RouteTrace snaps your line to the streets, footpaths and cycle lanes it follows — with the distance, the climb and an estimated time.

OR JUST SAY IT
"8 km run, hilly, by the water." "25 km ride, flat." Describe the route you feel like and RouteTrace makes it for you, starting where you are: loops that come back to your door, chosen for the terrain you asked for and steered past parks and water. Don't like the first? Tap Next, or ask for others.

KNOW EVERY CLIMB
Every route has an elevation profile, so the hills come as no surprise.

FOLLOW IT
Start a route and RouteTrace shows where you are on it, your pace, distance and time — and tells you when you've left it. Recording carries on with the phone locked in your pocket.

ON YOUR WRIST
Your routes go to Apple Watch and stay there, so you can leave the phone at home. Follow them, record the workout, and even create a new route on the watch itself.

IN APPLE HEALTH
Finished workouts are saved to Apple Health with their route, so they show up in Fitness and the other training apps that read Health.

TAKE IT ANYWHERE
Export routes and workouts as GPX, FIT or TCX for Strava, Garmin Connect, Komoot, Wahoo and most GPS devices. Import routes from GPX, TCX, KML and FIT files.

YOURS ALONE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your routes stay on your iPhone and your watch.

ROUTETRACE PRO
One saved route is free. RouteTrace Pro, a one-time purchase, gives you unlimited routes and export in every format.

Maps and directions from Apple Maps. Elevation from the open Terrain Tiles dataset; heights are approximate and not for navigation.

name: Rovai
description: Rovai is a small, offline notebook for walking rivers. It holds a fixed catalogue of twenty-four kinds of river ground, a private record of every river day you make, and five short notes on reading water and choosing a month. There is no account, no feed, no map, no sync and no advertising. Everything you need for the next walk along the bank is already inside the app.

name: Rovela - Life
description:
Rovela is a habit-focused tracking app designed to help users build and maintain daily routines through simple check-ins. Users can create custom habits or use templates for activities like reading and exercise. Each action is recorded with a single tap, supporting multiple check-ins per day. Logging habits requires in-app coins, though new users receive a small number of free entries to test the features.

The app provides visual feedback through progress bars, daily streaks, and weekly heatmaps. Users can monitor consistency and unlock milestone badges for 7, 30, or 100-day targets. These achievements and levels provide long-term motivation as you progress through your goals.

For data management, Rovela includes tools to edit habits, undo entries, and export history as CSV files. All records are stored locally on your device to ensure privacy. Settings allow for personalized reminders and a simple way to clear all local data at any time.

name: Rovos
description:
Rovos is a quiet, offline reading companion. It brings your bookshelf, a daily reading plan, a simple focus timer and a private collection of passages together in one calm app that works without a connection or an account.
Add every book you own or plan to read: title, author, genre, total pages, current page, reading status (Wishlist, Reading or Finished), an optional target date and a star rating. Search by title, author or genre, filter by status and tap a book to see its progress, deadline and session history. Everything is editable and can be removed with a confirmation step.

name: Rufflety Mix
description:
Welcome to the coop! Rufflety Mix is a cheerful feather-sorting puzzle game. Tap a nest to lift its top feathers, tap another nest to drop them on a matching color, and fluff every nest before your moves run out.

SORT, MATCH, FLUFF
• Simple tap-and-drop controls that are easy to learn
• Fill a nest with a single color and it gets a bow
• Every drop uses a move, and finishing in fewer moves earns up to 3 stars
• Every Adventure level is checked by a solver, so each one can be finished within its move limit

FIVE GARDEN WORLDS
Travel from Sunny Coop through Berry Orchard, Frostpetal Meadow and Rainbow Ridge to Ember Bloom. Each world has its own scenery and its own chicken friend, and new mechanics arrive one at a time with a short tutorial card.

SPECIAL FEATHERS AND NESTS
• Hidden feathers: tucked under shells until they reach the top
• Golden feathers: collect them for treasure goals
• Wild feathers: take the color of the first feather they touch
• Frozen feathers: chip the ice by fluffing nests
• Rainbow feathers: fit with every color
• Popper pods: pop the top group of a nest
• Latched, ribbon and twig-perch nests that change your plans

DAILY CHALLENGE
A new puzzle every day with its own twist. Solve it to grow your streak and earn bonus boosters.

HELPFUL BOOSTERS
Rewind a move, Ruffle the feathers into a fresh solvable mix, Pluck a feather, Unlatch a nest or grab a Seed Snack for 5 extra moves. Earn more by 3-starring levels, finishing worlds and solving Daily Challenges.

COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
Discover every feather type in the Collection, unlock plume styles with your stars, meet five chicken friends and earn 12 badges.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Every color carries its own shape mark (sun, heart, drop, leaf, star, diamond), so colors aren't told apart by hue alone
• Calm motion setting, VoiceOver labels and support for larger text
• Sound effects, music and haptics you can switch on or off

PLAY ANYWHERE
Rufflety Mix works fully offline. No accounts, no ads, no in-app purchases and no tracking. Your progress is saved only on your device. An optional daily reminder for the Daily Challenge can be turned on in Settings.

name: RunFable
description:
RunFable brings every run from every watch into one place, and lets you take your data with you.

Your runs end up scattered: some on an Apple Watch, some on a Garmin, older ones on a COROS or Polar, and years more in other apps. RunFable merges them into one de-duplicated timeline on your iPhone or iPad, with full GPS routes, real runner stats and one-tap export to open formats.

EVERY WATCH, ONE TIMELINE
- Apple Health: Apple Watch and any watch that syncs to Health, such as COROS, Polar, Suunto and Wahoo
- Garmin Connect: sign in on Garmin's own page and your runs come in with full routes
- Import GPX, TCX and FIT files, or a whole ZIP export such as your Strava archive

EXPORT EVERYTHING
- Any run as a GPX file, or the original FIT file for Garmin runs
- Your whole history as one standard archive
- Open formats that work with other apps and services

EVERY RUN, MAPPED
- Full GPS route maps, splits per mile or kilometer, heart rate zones and elevation
- Best efforts from every run, found automatically

STREAKS AND STATS
- Daily mile, weekly and monthly streaks, counted in the local time where each run happened
- Personal bests from 1K to 100 miles, distance milestones, mileage trends and badges
- See how this week ranks against every week you have ever run

PLAN AND FOLLOW
- Get a suggested loop from where you are, or import a GPX route, and follow it live while you run

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account and no RunFable server. Your runs are fetched straight to your device and stay there.
- No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

RunFable is free.

Apple Watch and Apple Health are trademarks of Apple Inc. Garmin, COROS, Polar, Suunto, Wahoo and Strava are trademarks of their respective owners. RunFable is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

name: RUV VI: AI Photo to Game Art
description:
Turn your own photos into illustrated posters and cinematic scenes with RUV VI, an AI photo editor

• Create a solo or duo poster. Start with a template and use one photo or bring two people together in a single composition
• Give your photo a game-inspired look. Choose a setting and outfit to create a cinematic scene around your portrait
• Make the details your own. Add and adjust visual overlays such as a mini-map, status bars, and a custom notification in Sticker Studio
• Share your finished image using your device’s share menu

AI generation uses an internet connection and sends the photos you select to OpenAI for processing with your permission

Each AI generation costs one coin. You can buy coins as in-app purchases

Terms of Use — https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy — https://telegra.ph/RUV-VI-Privacy-Policy-11-23

name: RydePace
description:
RydePace is a minimal, distraction-free trip counter designed for drivers. With a sleek dark cockpit design, it lets you log and count your daily driving distances with quick single-tap presets.

FEATURES:

• Quick Distance Clickers:
Tap large tactile buttons to quickly count common drive distances:
- Short Trip (Default: 8 km — Quick city errands)
- Medium Trip (Default: 25 km — Daily commute)
- Long Trip (Default: 85 km — Highway travel)
- Intercity (Default: 240 km — Long trips)

• Weather Condition Selector:
Choose your active road weather before adding a trip:
- Clear
- Rain
- Heavy Rain
- Snow

• Daily Goal Indicator:
Set a daily distance target and watch the visual progress bar fill up as you add your drives.

• Visual Breakdown Charts:
- Clear category bar chart showing your distance share.
- Multi-colored ring chart showing weather distribution.
- Simple daily, weekly, and monthly pace projections.

• Custom Distances:
Change the default kilometer values of any category and tune your daily goal to match your own driving routine.

•Notes:
Keep quick road reminders, tire check notes, or route memos handy.

Simple, tactile, and designed for smooth everyday use.

name: S Crazy Joker
description:
PROTECT THE JOKER. DON’T COLLAPSE THE TABLE.

A cheeky Joker sits on a stack of wooden blocks. Tap the extra planks so physics topples the structure the way you want—and land the Joker safely in the green zone. One bad tap and the whole table collapses.

HOW TO PLAY
• Study the supports, then tap removable wood
• Watch live physics: tip, slide, collide
• Land the Joker in the safe zone and settle to clear
• Fall off the edge or to the ground to fail

LEVELS
• 13 poker-rank stages from A to K
• Rising pressure from intro to advanced
• Star ratings unlock the next stage
• Local progress—play offline anytime

FEATURES
• Fully offline, no account
• Sound & haptics toggles
• Custom avatar (Photos / Camera)

name: Şabanözü Yıldız Sürücü Kursu
description:
Trafiğe ilk adımı atmak sadece bir ehliyet sahibi olmak değil; kendinize ve sevdiklerinize karşı büyük bir sorumluluk üstlenmektir. 2020 Yılından bu yana Şabanözü Yıldız Sürücü Kursu olarak çıktığımız bu yolda temel amacımız; yalnızca sınavı geçmenizi sağlamak değil, her koşulda güvenli, sakin ve bilinçli birer sürücü olarak trafiğe çıkmanızı desteklemektir.

Sınavlara Hazırlık Artık Cebinizde!
Bu uygulama sınavlara etkili bir şekilde hazırlanmanızı sağlar. Uygulama içerisinde yer alan video anlatımlar, dijital kitaplar ve interaktif testler sayesinde hem teorik bilginizi geliştirir hem de sınav pratiği kazanırsınız.

Konuya Göre Ayrılmış Kitaplar:
Her ders, konularına göre düzenlenmiş dijital kitaplarla sunulmuştur. Bu sayede hangi konuyu çalışmak istiyorsanız doğrudan o bölüme geçebilir, gereksiz zaman kaybı yaşamadan öğreniminizi sürdürebilirsiniz.

Her Zaman, Her Yerden Erişim:
Mobil cihazınız üzerinden istediğiniz zaman uygulamaya erişebilir, dilediğiniz yerde çalışmaya devam edebilirsiniz. Sınav hazırlığı artık sadece sınıfta değil, cebinizde!

Yasal Bilgilendirme:
Bu uygulama herhangi bir resmi kurum, devlet kuruluşu veya bakanlık tarafından geliştirilmemiştir ve bu kurumları temsil etmez. Sadece bireysel eğitim ve sınav hazırlığı amacıyla tasarlanmıştır. Resmi sınav sistemleriyle doğrudan bir bağlantısı bulunmamaktadır.

name: SacredBreath
description:
SacredBreath is a quiet place to breathe. A single full-screen light breathes with you — it opens as you inhale, rests as you hold, and settles as you exhale. Just follow it.

TWO BREATHING VISUALS 
• Lumen Orb — a sphere of aurora light swells on the inhale and settles on the exhale.
• Ink Lotus — a bud opens into layered petals on the inhale and folds closed on the exhale. Both are drawn live with Metal at 60 fps, smooth and calm.

SIX BREATHING PATTERNS 
Relax · Sleep 
• Gentle Exhale (4-2-6) — a slightly longer exhale slowly loosens the body. 
• 4-7-8 Breathing — a long hold and a very long exhale, good before sleep. 
• Double Exhale (4-0-8) — an exhale twice as long as the inhale lets tension go. Focus · Calm 
• Box Breathing (4-4-4-4) — four equal stages bring a scattered mind back in order. 
• Resonance Breathing (5.5-0-5.5) — about 5.5 breaths a minute. 
• Triangle Breathing (4-4-4) — a short hold keeps you calm, clear and awake.

A VOICE THAT BREATHES WITH YOU Choose Hana, a calm, warm voice, or Ian, a low, steady one. A short cue marks each stage, and soft breath sounds flow with each stage's length. Set each volume on its own, or turn either off.

SESSIONS YOUR WAY 
• Pick any length from 1 to 60 minutes; your recent lengths stay one tap away. 
• Every session ends as an exhale completes, with a quiet bell and a light haptic. 
• The remaining time and the current stage count down under the visual. 
• Pause at any moment — the light holds still until you return.

QUIET BY DESIGN 
No account, no sign-up, no feeds. Open the app and breathe. Supports Reduce Motion and dark, tinted and light home screen icons.

SacredBreath is a relaxation tool, not a medical device. If you feel dizzy, return to your natural breath.

name: SafeLeaf: Pet Plant Poison ID
description:
SafeLeaf is a fast, distraction-free flower, mixed-bouquet, and houseplant poison scanner built for cat parents, dog owners, and families with young children.

Instead of burying lifesaving toxicity warnings beneath complex gardening menus, SafeLeaf answers one critical question in 1 second: Is this plant safe to bring into my home?

KEY FEATURES
• 1-Second Traffic-Light Verdict: Instantly see separate Red (Deadly Organ Failure), Amber (Toxic / Oral Irritant), and Green (100% Non-Toxic) safety ratings for Cats, Dogs, and Kids.
• Mixed-Bouquet Multi-Stem X-Ray: Snap a gift bouquet from the florist to spot hidden deadly Oriental or Easter Lilies, Sago Palm fronds, Tulips, or Calla Lilies tucked among safe roses.
• Deceptive Lookalike Trap Warnings: Clearly distinguishes True Lilies (fatal feline kidney failure even from pollen) from Peace Lilies, Lucky Bamboo (Dracaena—toxic) from True Bamboo, and Daylilies.
• 100% Free Vet Emergency Handover PDF: Export a clean bilingual clinical PDF with your plant photo, active toxin name, toxic plant parts, and watch-for symptoms—plus 1-tap 24/7 Animal ER map search.
• Offline Truth Database & Fridge Pass: Search 46+ verified plant families and 95+ colloquial aliases 100% offline, suggest safe florist swaps, and print a Pet-Sitter Fridge Safety Pass.

SUBSCRIPTION & PURCHASE TERMS
Offline search across 95+ plant names, Vet Emergency Handover PDFs, and your first 2 live AI camera scans are completely free with no account required. Optional SafeLeaf Pro plans include Monthly, Annual (with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers), and a one-time Lifetime unlock for unlimited live camera & mixed-bouquet scans and unlimited Safe Home storage. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in Apple Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://aimlrouter.com/safeleaf/legal/privacy.html

Samagrah — equal service, seamless operations.

name: SAMAN: Couples App
description:
SAMAN is a calm, beautiful app for couples who want to grow closer in everyday life.

Link your phones with a couple code and share one space: plan dates, answer questions together, keep your memories and watch your relationship grow.

250 DATE IDEAS
From blanket forts and stargazing to ice skating, hot springs and road trips. Browse by season, mood or budget, save favorites to your wish list, or spin the wheel when you can't decide. Every idea comes with a short plan so it's easy to make it happen.

QUESTIONS THAT GO DEEPER
211 conversation questions in 8 themes, from light warm-ups to the deep end. Swipe through together, save the ones you love and earn points for every conversation.

SHORT LESSONS ABOUT LOVE

PLAN TOGETHER

YOUR STORY

name: Sample Board
description:
Sample Board lays out a 4 by 4 grid of pockets so you can see which feed and spindle speed cuts clean.

Each column is a feed and each row is a spindle speed. Tap a square to cycle Clean, Fuzzy, Burn and Chatter. The recommendation stays inside the largest clean region and prefers the higher feed. Burn cells draw the minimum chipload line. Window plots chip load against surface speed. G-code writes the pockets, pausing before each spindle row. Refine tightens the grid around the clean cell and shifts it back inside the machine limit.

Tools can be typed or read from a CSV. Boards stay on a timeline and two of them can be compared. Feed, spindle, grades and notes stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: SampleHarbor
description:
SampleHarbor helps you understand a finite set of numeric observations. Bring your own measurements, durations or counts, validate every row, and explore their distribution using explicit descriptive rules.

START WITH THE COMPLETE SAMPLE
Paste one number per line or choose a one-column UTF-8 CSV or text file. Select whether a CSV has a header rather than relying on a guess. Review validation errors by logical row, name the dataset, add an optional unit label and save. Invalid values and internal blank rows are not silently skipped or turned into zero. Editing creates a deliberate replacement of the current sample; the source file is not rewritten.

EXPLORE WITH READABLE DEFINITIONS
Choose 1-100 histogram bins and inspect counts and proportions. Bins are equal width, with the final bin including the maximum; a constant sample is explicitly shown as a constant sample. The empirical CDF reports the fraction of actual observations less than or equal to a chosen threshold, including repeated values.

Review n, minimum, maximum, sum, mean, range, quartiles, median, IQR and sample standard deviation. Sample SD is unavailable for one observation. Quantiles use the stated linear-interpolation rule, with the adjacent sorted observations and interpolation details available to inspect. Results use approximate floating-point arithmetic, with a fuller precision display when needed.

Optional Tukey reference markers identify observations strictly beyond Q1 - 1.5 IQR and Q3 + 1.5 IQR. They do not remove data or establish that an observation is an error. Compare two saved samples using shared histogram boundaries and descriptive summaries. Different unit labels require an explicit check; the app does not convert units or claim a significant difference.

KEEP THE INPUTS BEHIND A REPORT
Save a frozen single-sample or comparison report. Reopen it after current datasets change or are deleted. Generate actual PDF, complete original-order CSV and sorted CSV files. CSV preserves all observations with their indexes, ranks and reference flags. PDF includes the distribution, settings and definitions; its limited raw-value preview is labeled, while the CSV carries the complete data.

Delete a dataset while retaining its independent reports, delete a report and its internal outputs separately, or confirm Erase all local data in About. External originals, previously shared files and system backups remain separate. The local native tools require no app login.

INPUT AND INTERPRETATION LIMITS
Each dataset accepts 1-10,000 finite values, absolute value at most 1e12, within 1 MiB of UTF-8 input. Use dot-decimal numbers or scientific notation, without currency symbols, grouping commas or embedded units. The app describes the supplied sample; it does not fit probability models, run hypothesis tests, predict future outcomes or provide medical, financial or statistical-significance advice.

name: Sanayi Ustası
description:
Babandan kalan kapalı dükkânın anahtarı artık sende. Sanayi sitesinde çırak olarak başla, arızayı kendi ellerinle bul, ustalığını kanıtla ve sanayinin en büyük servisini kur!

HİKÂYE

name: Sand Match - Color Puzzle
description:
Connect sacks of colorful sand and pour them into beautiful pictures!

Sand Match is a relaxing color puzzle with a satisfying twist. Drag your finger across sacks of the same color to tie them into a chain. Let go, and the sand pours out into the picture below, filling it part by part until the whole scene comes to life.

HOW TO PLAY
• Connect 3 or more sacks of the same color, in any direction
• Longer chains pour more sand and earn bonus sand
• The picture fills in order: watch which colors it needs next
• Sand the picture can't take yet waits in the slots, so plan ahead and don't let them overflow

FEATURES
• Hand-crafted sand pictures: a sunset sailboat, a happy whale, a fox in the forest, a pirate ship, a unicorn and many more
• Colors grow from 3 to 7 as you progress
• Tricky sacks to master: tied sacks, crates, covered sacks, ice, nets, timer sacks, chameleon sacks, stones, locked slots, move limits and sandstorms
• Hard and Very Hard levels with bigger coin rewards
• 4 handy boosters: Scoop, Shuffle, Broom and Rainbow Sack
• Bonus boosters as you play
• Daily rewards and daily missions
• Collect every finished picture in your gallery
• Smooth, satisfying sand that really flows
• Play offline, anytime

Pick a chain, pour the sand and watch the picture appear. Can you fill them all?

name: Sarao: Pocket Nightclub
description:
Your music, a whole nightclub. Sarao turns your iPhone into a pixel-art club: up top, a dance floor full of people; down below, your DJ booth with the decks spinning.

SPIN YOUR MUSIC
• Pick a playlist or an album from your library, or search for a song.
• The cover of the song that's playing spins on one deck while the next one waits on the other.
• Tap a song to play it right away, or load it on deck B so it plays next.
• Works with Apple Music. Without a subscription, the songs you've bought or uploaded still play.

A DANCE FLOOR THAT DANCES TO WHAT'S PLAYING
• Every dancer is different: outfits, hairstyles, sunglasses, caps and glow sticks in detailed pixel art.
• Electronic, reggaeton, rock, pop or classical: the moves, the outfits and the lights change with the genre.
• The lights take their colours from the cover, which also shows on the LED wall at the back.
• Tap someone on the floor and they'll say something.

THE BOOTH IS YOURS
• Air horn, claps, a confetti drop and a rewind, all on top of the music.
• Tap the left deck to set the tempo.
• Turn on "The floor hears the music" and the mic follows the song's beat. If the music plays on a speaker, it fires the drop by itself too. Nothing is recorded.

PARTY CLASSICS
• Play Macarena, YMCA, The Ketchup Song (Aserejé), Gangnam Style or "Todos abajo" and the whole floor knows the dance.

YOUR CLUB, YOUR NAME
• Name your club and pick the neon colour: it lights up at the back of the room and on the front of the building.
• Step outside: the queue, the bouncer and the door. Out there the music sounds quieter. Tap the door to go back in.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• Open: the dance floor and the booth on the big screen.
• Half folded, the hinge splits the booth from the dance floor, like a laptop or like a book.
• Closed: your club's door seen from the street. Open it and you're in.

Also works in landscape on any iPhone.

NO SMALL PRINT
• One-time purchase: no subscriptions, no ads, no account.
• Sarao collects no data. Your music and whatever the mic hears stay on your iPhone.
• No Apple Music at hand? Open the test session, with music made for Sarao.

name: Sarbi ERP & Bayi
description:
Sarbi ERP & Bayi, Sarbi Çiğköfte bayilerinin günlük şube operasyonlarını hızlı, düzenli ve zahmetsiz biçimde yönetmesi için tasarlanmış resmi bayi mobil uygulamasıdır.

name: Sawsum Construction Calculator
description:
A feet-inch-fraction calculator and nine material estimators for builders, in one iPhone app.
The calculator and three estimators cost nothing; Sawsum Pro is paid once: no subscription, no ads, no account, no tracking.

The calculator (free)
• Add, subtract, multiply and divide in feet, inches and fractions: 12' 6-1/2" + 3-7/16" just works. Length × length gives area, area × length gives volume.
• Precision of 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 or 1/64 inch, fractions reduced, carries handled, and an ≈ mark whenever a result is rounded.
• Imperial or metric with one switch, and both in one line: 8 ft + 30 cm.
• A running tape: add a note to a line ("north wall"), tap a line to reuse its result, and see any result in decimal feet, inches, yards, metres or millimetres.

Free estimators
• Concrete: slabs, footings and round columns, summed. Cubic yards or cubic metres, premix bags by size, and a ready-mix order rounded up to the next quarter yard.
• Gravel: rectangles, circles and triangles at any depth. Volume, and weight in tons or tonnes for gravel, crushed stone, sand, limestone or topsoil.
• Paint: walls and ceiling, minus doors and windows, with coats and coverage. Gallons and quarts, or litres, to buy.
Copy or share any result as text.

Sawsum Pro, a one-time purchase
• Mulch & Soil: cubic yards, cubic feet or litres, and how many bags of the size you buy.
• Lumber & Board Feet: board feet per line and in total, linear feet and cost, with actual sizes shown next to nominal.
• Drywall: sheets for walls and ceilings in the sizes you hang, plus joint tape, compound and screws.
• Tile & Flooring: tiles and boxes, with grout joints and a larger waste allowance for diagonal or herringbone layouts.
• Stairs & Stringers: number of risers and treads, exact riser height, tread depth, total run, stringer length and angle, compared with the code guidance you pick (IRC, or a comfort rule).
• Roof Pitch & Rafters: angle and slope from the pitch, common and hip or valley rafter lengths with overhang, roof area, squares and bundles.
• Saved projects: keep estimates and tape lines together per job, with client and address.
• PDF export: a project as a tidy PDF with inputs, results and a cost total, ready to send.

Numbers you can check
Every estimator shows the figures it relies on, such as bag yield, material density, paint coverage, finishing rates or bundles per square, says where each comes from, and lets you change it. Results show the net quantity and the quantity with waste side by side. Add a price per yard, bag, sheet or board foot and a cost line appears.

Made for the job site
Large keys, high contrast in sunlight, light and dark appearance, key haptics, Dynamic Type, and VoiceOver that reads 5' 3-1/2" as "5 feet 3 and one half inches".

Private
No account and no sign-in. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Sawsum has no network code at all: your numbers, tape and projects stay on your iPhone. The purchase is handled by Apple.

Estimates only
Results are estimates. Check them against your local building code and your supplier's product data before you order or build.

name: Saxeva
description:
Saxeva turns a MIDI wind controller (such as Clarii, EWI and other MIDI wind instruments) into a real-sounding saxophone in your hands.

• Four saxes: soprano, alto, tenor and baritone, built from real saxophone samples.
