No controller yet? Tap Demo on the Play screen to hear a sample phrase through the style you choose.

A MIDI wind controller is needed to play.

name: Scanwords in English
description:
Scanwords in English - thousands of classic arrow word puzzles on your phone! Read the clues, fill in the answers and complete the grid. A relaxing brain game that trains your memory, general knowledge and vocabulary every day.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a cell in the grid - its clue appears on the blue bar
• Tap the letters below in the right order
• A correct answer flies into the grid and reveals letters for other words
• Letters you already know from crossing words are filled in for you

3000 LEVELS
• From small grids with easy clues to big, tough scanwords
• Levels unlock in order, each a little harder than the last
• Enough for months of daily play

DAILY PUZZLE
• A new big scanword every day
• Coins for solving it, double on Sundays
• Keep your streak going and set records

TENS OF THOUSANDS OF CLUES
• Geography: countries, capitals, rivers and mountains
• Literature, music, art and mythology
• Nature, science, history, sports and everyday life
• Names, short words and crossword classics

HINTS
• Reveal a letter, a word or 5 random letters
• Watch a video to get coins
• A gift every few levels

AND MORE
• Statistics and achievements
• Play offline, no internet needed
• Big letters and an easy keyboard
• Beautiful design and smooth animations

Love scanwords, arrow words and crosswords? Then Scanwords in English is for you. Download it and solve your first puzzle right now!

name: Schublade: Paperless Archive
description:
Schublade is the iPhone app for your own document archive. Every letter, invoice, and receipt goes into one drawer that you host yourself, and the whole archive stays at hand on your iPhone, even offline.

SCAN AND SEND
• Scan paper with the built-in document scanner.
• Share PDFs and photos from Mail, Files, Safari, or any other app.
• Watch each document arrive while your archive reads it.

THE FACTS, READ FOR YOU
Your archive recognizes the text and names each document with its sender, date, and category. Amounts, due dates, IBANs, and invoice numbers sit right under the original, and one tap copies them.

FOUND IN SECONDS
Search by sender, category, or any word on the page. Browse by month, or narrow the list to one sender.

EVERY ORIGINAL, EVEN OFFLINE
Schublade keeps a copy of your archive on your iPhone, so you can find a contract on a plane or a receipt in a basement. Originals you open stay on the device, within a limit you choose.

SCAN FROM ANYWHERE
Start a scan from the Home Screen, Control Center, the Lock Screen, the Action Button, or Siri.

YOUR ARCHIVE, YOUR DATA
Schublade has no account with us, no analytics, and no ads. It talks only to the archive you connect it to.

REQUIRES A SCHUBLADE ARCHIVE
Schublade connects to a Schublade archive that you run in your own Cloudflare account. To connect, enter the archive's address and a token issued in its Settings.

name: Scooter X: Skatepark Tricks
description:
Want to grind out to an epic 360, or bri flip into a bar whip like a pro on your phone? How about a buttercup or flair from the couch?

Now you can with Scooter X, the ultimate in skatepark scooter simulation! With tricks, grinds and plenty of ramps, you'll be in a new world of scooter fun.

With intuitive finger controls, take control of your deck and bars with a swipe. Pull off freestyle tricks, chain them into combos and land them clean.

- Four skateparks full of ramps, rails and bowls
- 27 flip, grab, grind and jump tricks, with a trick book to learn them
- Earn XP, level up and upgrade speed, balance, jump and spin
- Customise your scooter and rider: bars, decks, wheels, shoes and gloves
- Daily rewards and daily goals to come back for

Practice for a game of scoot, or just ride like a pro!

Scooter X is free to play with ads. A one-off Remove Ads purchase turns off banner and between-run ads.

name: Score All: Live Scoreboard
description:
Score All keeps score for your game and shares it live. Pick a sport or game, tap to score, and everyone you send the link to sees the same scoreboard on their phone, a TV, or a screen at the field.

- Dozens of sports, plus card, dice and yard games, with the rules you actually play
- A scoreboard link and a TV code: nobody needs the app to watch
- Works at the park: keep scoring with a weak signal, and it catches up when you're back online
- Tournaments with brackets, courts and "You're up on Court 2" alerts
- Leagues and teams: rosters, schedules, standings and who's coming
- Your game history, ratings and lifetime record
- Score graphics for your live stream
- Scan a TV's code with your camera to put your game on the big screen
- Made for iPhone and iPad

Free to start. Some features need a Pro or Premium plan.

name: Screenshot to JPG
description:
Turn the screenshots you pick into real JPG copies, ready for an upload form, a shared folder or a colleague who asked for JPG.

Select up to 50 screenshots or other still images in the order you want. Tap Convert to JPG and each one becomes a standard JPG file, named Screenshot-001.jpg, Screenshot-002.jpg and so on. Your original screenshots stay unchanged in Photos.

WHAT YOU GET
• Real JPG files, not renamed PNGs: every image is decoded and encoded again as a standard sRGB JPG
• The same pixel size as the original, with the picture upright (only images above 60 megapixels are scaled down, and the app says so)
• Transparent areas filled with white, since JPG has no transparency
• Location and descriptive metadata left out of the copies
• Every file listed with its dimensions and its actual size

SAVE OR SHARE THE BATCH
• One image: Save JPG to Files or Share JPG
• Several images: Save ZIP to Files saves one ZIP containing all the JPG copies, which you or the recipient may need to extract. Share JPGs sends the separate JPG files in one share, and Share ZIP sends the ZIP

GOOD TO KNOW
• JPG is a lossy format. Files are encoded at a fixed high quality setting.
• A JPG can be larger or smaller than the original. Text-heavy screenshots often get bigger, so no size reduction is promised.
• If an item can't be loaded or converted, the app shows exactly which one and lets you retry or remove it. A batch is only offered for export when every remaining image converted.
• The app uses the system photo picker and only sees the images you choose. It doesn't ask for access to your whole library.
• No account, no ads, no tracking.

Selecting and previewing are always free, and your first export is free. After that, a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports. It isn't a subscription and never renews. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/screenshot-to-jpg/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/screenshot-to-jpg/terms

name: Sea Command
description:
Sea Command is a naval strategy game set in a fictional present day war at sea between NATO and Russia. You command real classes of warships, with their missiles, radars and aircraft, in the Baltic, the Far North, the Atlantic, the Mediterranean and the Pacific.

TWO CAMPAIGNS
• Operation Open Seas: 32 missions with the US Navy and its NATO allies, from corvettes and light frigates in the Baltic to the final battle off the Kuril Islands.
• Operation Bastion: 30 missions on the Russian side, from the Kaliningrad coast to the Barents Sea, the Norwegian Sea and the Pacific. Your bombers, fighters and radar aircraft take off from real Russian air bases.
• From the middle of each campaign on, the enemy is hidden by fog of war. You have to find them with your sensors and aircraft while they search for you.

HOW YOU FIGHT
• Drag a ship to set its course. Drag it onto an enemy ship to take aim.
• Split a salvo across up to eight directions and time the missiles to hit together, to overload the enemy's defenses.
• Defend in layers: long- and short-range surface-to-air missiles, close-in guns, decoys. A sea-skimming missile comes over the radar horizon only 25 to 35 km out.
• Switch your radars off to stay hidden, and listen for the enemy's.
• Launch carrier aircraft for combat air patrol, strikes, armed reconnaissance, airborne early warning and aerial refueling. On the Russian side, Tu-22M3 bombers and Su-30SM fighters fly from land bases.
• Ships can lose radars, launchers, engines and flight decks. Fires spread unless the crews put them out.
• Give orders by voice: hold the microphone button and speak, in English or Italian.

THE SEA
• One continuous zoom, from 250 km high down to a few meters above the waves.
• The weather follows its own rules: clouds build up, storms form and drift. Rain shortens radar range, and a gale closes the flight deck.
• Day and night follow the game clock. At night the moon lights the sea.
• Speed time up to ×300 when nothing is happening. The game slows down by itself when an enemy missile closes in.

ALSO IN THE GAME
• Academy: 26 short lessons for each side, from moving the map to air defense, voice orders, sensors and weather.
• Free play, on either side: choose one of 33 seas, the forces, the distance between the fleets, fog of war, the weather, the start time and the difficulty, or let the game set up a battle for you.
• Three difficulty levels: Recruit, Officer, Admiral.
• Dossiers on the ships, aircraft and weapons of both sides, with photos and technical data.
• Ships answer your orders over the radio, each with its own voice: in English on the American side, in Russian on the Russian side

name: SealPad - Sign & Stamp PDF
description:
Need to stamp or sign a PDF right now—without signing up for a weekly subscription or uploading confidential contracts to someone else's server?

SealPad is a fast, 100% on-device PDF and photo stamping & signing tool designed for freelancers, small business owners, and anyone who handles paperwork from their phone.

[Key Features]
• Scan Real Paper Stamps (Pro): Stamp on white paper, snap a photo, and SealPad removes the paper background locally on your device—producing a crisp, alpha-transparent PNG stamp.
• Digital Stamp Creator: Create custom circular, oval, or square rubber stamps and East Asian name/company seals with inkpad texture and color presets.
• Smooth Handwritten Signatures: Draw and save clean signatures and initials with adjustable pen weight and ink tone.
• 30-Second PDF & Photo Signing: Open any PDF from Files or Mail (or a photo from your library), place your stamp, signature, date, and text fields, then export a flattened, non-editable copy straight to Mail, Messages, or AirDrop.
• Multi-Page Edge Straddle Seal (Pro): Apply a matching half-seal along the right or top edge of every page in multi-page agreements with one tap.
• Transparent PNG Export (Pro): Export any saved stamp or signature as a transparent PNG ready for Word, Pages, Excel, or Google Docs.
• Optional Face ID Vault Lock: Keep your saved personal and company seals protected locally.

[Free & One-Time Pro Unlock]
• Free: Open PDFs and photos, create 1 digital stamp and 1 signature, add dates and text, and export up to 3 watermark-free documents per month.
• SealPad Pro (one-time purchase, never a subscription): Save unlimited scanned physical stamps, store unlimited stamps and signatures, export transparent PNGs, apply multi-page straddle seals, and save unlimited documents every month.

[Privacy & Scope]
Zero accounts, zero analytics tracking, zero server uploads. All stamps, signatures, and contracts stay strictly on your iPhone or iPad. SealPad is a visual document signing and stamping tool, not a government-certified PKI digital certificate or notarization service.

name: Seam Rivet
description:
Seam Rivet keeps one lap seam on this iPhone.

Rivets sit along the seam. Drag a rivet to a new inch. The named gap is the first opening wider than the pitch. When every gap fits, the last gap is named.

Changing the pitch changes only that limit. The rivets stay where you left them. A rivet that would land on another one holds.

Two rivets must remain. Saved readings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Search Center
description:
Select text in Safari and search for it on a site that you choose.

When you select text on a web page, Search Center shows a bar of search buttons next to the Copy menu. Tap a button. A new tab opens with the search results for your text on that site. You do not copy, paste or type the text again.

THE BAR
• The bar shows next to the Copy menu. It does not cover the text that you selected.
• The bar uses light mode or dark mode, the same as your device. It also uses your text size.
• The bar can show site names, site icons, or both.

YOUR SEARCH SITES
• You can add each site that has a search page. In the site address, put %s where the selected text goes.
• You can change the order of your search sites. You can also edit or remove them at any time.
• You can save your list in a backup file. Use this file to move the list to a different iPhone or iPad.

THE APP
• Tap one button to open the Safari settings and turn on the extension.
• The app shows if Search Center works in Safari.
• The app shows your search sites, a "Try it in Safari" page, and the backup function.

PRIVACY
• Search Center does not collect data. It has no accounts, no analytics, no ads and no tracking.
• Your text stays on your device until you tap a search button. Then Search Center sends only the selected text, and only to the site that you chose.

ONE PAYMENT
There is no subscription. You pay one time and you get all updates. With Family Sharing, your family can also use the app.

REQUIREMENTS
Search Center is a Safari extension. After you install it, do these steps:
1. Open the app.
2. Tap Open Settings.
3. Turn on Search Center.
4. Allow it on all websites.
Search Center needs iOS 26.2 or iPadOS 26.2, or later.

name: Seasons: Seek & Find
description:
Tap everything. Something always happens.

Seasons: Seek & Find is a searching game across four seasons. Explore busy, funny places, read the clues and discover who is hiding. Every discovery transforms the landscape: the village lights up, the valley blooms, the boats come home, the fog lifts.

EVERY PLACE, A NEW IDEA
• Christmas Village: sweep the snow
• Valley in Bloom: blow the petals away
• Fishing Village: lower the tide
• Harvest Hills: brush the fog aside
• The Museum After Dark: explore by torchlight while the exhibits move in the dark
• Glacier Lodge: open buildings and look inside
• Flower Market: collect objects and set off chains
• Seaside Fair: switch from day to night
• The Midnight Train: take the passengers where they need to go
• The Tiny Forest: enter smaller and smaller worlds
• The Island and the Abyss: make things sink and float
• The City in the Rain: see what the reflections hide

IN ALL
• 240 mysteries and 36 secrets without clues
• A fox with a scarf hidden in every place
• No timers, no penalties
• No ads, no account
• Playable offline
• Progress synced through iCloud between iPhone, iPad and Mac
• English, Italian, Spanish, French and German

FREE AND PREMIUM
Four places, one per season, are completely free. You can try the first 3 mysteries of the other eight. Pack 1 unlocks the Museum, Lodge, Flower Market and Seaside Fair; Pack 2 unlocks the Train, Forest, Abyss and City in the Rain, four large places that open up step by step. Each pack is bought once and forever, on its own if you like, and works on iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscription.

name: Seat Chit
description:
Seat Chit is for people sharing one meal at one table. When the bill is on the table, the people sitting there divide it themselves.

Write the name of the meal and the amount. Move the tip dial. Drag a chair onto the table for each person who is sitting there. The iPhone works in cents: it multiplies the amount by 100 plus the tip percent, divides by 100, then divides that total by the number of seats. Any leftover cent goes to the earlier seats, one cent each. The share for each seat stays on this iPhone for you to read.

Seat Chit does not create a file, collect money, or connect to a payment service. It does not give investment advice and it does not connect to a bank. It does not deal with health or with children.

name: SecaderoCue
description:
SecaderoCue es la herramienta práctica para productores y elaboradores de pimentón ahumado al estilo tradicional de La Vera.

Planifica cada lote de secado, calcula la carga del secadero, estima la leña de encina o roble y sigue el cronograma de encendido, volteo y finalización. También proyecta el rendimiento de fresco a pimentón y controla el coste por kilo.

Diseñada para el trabajo real en el secadero: clara, rápida y centrada en la temporada.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES

• Capacidad de carga
Introduce el pimiento fresco y el área del secadero para saber cuántos lotes necesitas.

• Estimación de leña
Calcula el consumo de encina o roble según tamaño, carga y historial de lotes.

• Seguimiento del secado
Registra encendido, volteo y fin de cada lote, con estado y progreso.

• Rendimiento
Estima el paso de pimiento fresco a seco y a pimentón molido.

• Costes de elaboración
Suma leña, mano de obra y tiempo para obtener el coste unitario.

• Resumen de temporada
Consulta en el inicio lotes activos, pimentón estimado y leña prevista.

Ideal para explotaciones y secaderos que trabajan con el método tradicional de humo vertical, propio del Pimentón de la Vera.

name: Sehion Retreat Centre
description:
Plan your retreat. Join the prayer. Never miss an event.

The Sehion app brings Sehion Retreat Centre, Attappady, to your phone. Book a retreat in minutes, see what's happening at Sehion, and send your prayer intentions from wherever you are.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Book retreats
See upcoming retreats with dates and details, then reserve your place straight from the app. No calls, no waiting, no paperwork.

See events
Check upcoming conventions, including the First Friday, Second Saturday and Third Friday conventions. Get dates, timings and details before you plan your trip.

Follow the prayers
Stay in touch with the prayer programmes at Sehion, from the weekly Daivasahayam Koottayma to the monthly Japamala Pradakshinam, even when you can't be in Attappady.

Submit prayer intentions
Have something on your heart? Send your intentions in a few taps and let the Sehion community pray with you. For yourself, your family or someone who needs it.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Everything in one place: retreats, events and prayers
• Fast, simple and easy to use
• Works for families, youth, parents and anyone planning a visit
• Free to download

ABOUT SEHION
Founded in 1997 by Rev. Fr. Xavier Khan Vattayil, Sehion Retreat Centre is the official retreat centre of the Palakkad diocese. Set in the hills of Attappady, it has welcomed people for over 25 years to retreats, conferences and worship.

CONTACT
Sehion Retreat Centre, Thavalam P.O, Attappady, Palakkad, Kerala, India, 678 582
+91 7034052995 | info@sehion.org | sehion.org

Download Sehion and plan your next retreat today.

name: SELO Music Studio OS
description:
SELO Music Studio OS is the sovereign mobile music production companion, lyric and arrangement pad, and direct-to-fan release organizer for independent artists and producers.

• Studio Session & Arrangement Pad: Draft lyrics, chord progressions, BPM/key metadata, and stem mix notes.
• On-Device Audio Reference Deck: Audition session cues and track mastering readiness checklists.
• Direct-to-Fan Release Packager: Organize ISRC, split sheets, artwork cues, and Pharoah Tube distribution metadata.
• Multi-Language Studio UI: Built-in English (EN), Spanish (ES), and French (FR) language switching.
• Sovereign Artist Ownership: Zero cloud scraping, zero AI training harvesting, and 100% local vault storage.

name: Séminaire France 2027
description: Votre expérience événementielle, à portée de main. Retrouvez dans une seule application tout ce dont vous avez besoin : enregistrement, programme, inscription aux activités, informations pratiques, dress code et temps forts. Un espace pensé pour vous accompagner avant, pendant et tout au long de nos événements.

name: Sempre Control
description: Com o Sempre Control , o aplicativo móvel versátil projetado para capacitá-lo, aumentando a segurança e a conveniência em seu serviço de monitoramento. Seja implantado como uma solução de segurança abrangente.

name: SereneCare24 – вакансії догляд
description:
SereneCare24 – Робота для доглядальниць літніх людей у Німеччині

Додаток з актуальними вакансіями для доглядальниць літніх людей у Німеччині.

УСІ ВАКАНСІЇ В ОДНОМУ МІСЦІ
• актуальні пропозиції роботи з проживанням у німецьких родинах
• у кожній вакансії: місто й земля, зарплата нетто, дата виїзду, потрібний рівень німецької та кого доглядати
• позначка «НОВА» – вакансії, додані за останні 7 днів

ЗРУЧНІ ФІЛЬТРИ
• виїзд: від зараз або за місяцем
• рівень німецької: комунікативна, B1, B2

СПОВІЩЕННЯ ПРО НОВІ ВАКАНСІЇ
Увімкніть сповіщення одним дотиком – щойно з’явиться нова вакансія, ви отримаєте повідомлення на телефон. Торкніться сповіщення, і додаток відкриє саме цю вакансію. Не потрібно дзвонити й питати.

ПОВНИЙ ОПИС І ЗВ’ЯЗОК
Кнопка «Переглянути вакансію» відкриває повний опис на сайті serenecare24.pl, де можна залишити заявку або зв’язатися з нами. Розділ «Академія» – поради для доглядальниць: німецька мова, догляд за літніми людьми, життя й робота в Німеччині.

А ТАКОЖ
• працює й без інтернету – показує останній збережений список вакансій
• мова додатка: українська або польська
• безкоштовно, без реклами й без реєстрації – не потрібні ім’я, телефон чи e-mail

SereneCare24 – агентство, яке допомагає доглядальницям знайти легальну роботу з догляду за літніми людьми в Німеччині.

name: SeteQuadra
description:
SeteQuadra is for the person who runs a regular futsal, volleyball or basketball game for the same group of friends: the one who books the court, gathers the players and collects the money afterwards.

You start with the places where you play. A venue keeps its address, whether it is indoor or outdoor, the sports it is used for, the price per hour and a phone number. From a venue you can open it in Maps, call it, or create a new game there.

A game has a sport, a venue, a date, a time, a length and a number of places. With Repeat weekly turned on, the calendar fills the next 8 weeks and keeps adding weeks as you open the app. You can change a single game or this and the following ones, cancel a game and restore it later.

Invite writes a short message with the day, the time, the venue and the places left, and hands it to the share sheet, so you can post it in your group chat. As the answers come in, you mark each player as in, maybe or out. When the places are full, the next player who says yes goes on the waiting list, and the first one waiting moves up when someone drops out. After the game has ended nobody moves up on their own, so the line-up stays as it was played.

The venue's price per hour times the length of the game becomes the first cost, and you can add others, such as water or bibs. The total is split between the players in the line-up to the penny, and you can leave someone out of the split. Tick who has paid, even before the game, and send the summary with everyone's share. For games in reais the summary includes your Pix key. The app does not move any money; it keeps track of who has paid you.

History shows the games already played with attendance, spending and what is still owed. On the Players tab you see how many games each person has played and how much they owe you, and you can tick off an unpaid share from their page.

Add to iPhone Calendar opens the iPhone's own new event window with the game filled in. The app is in English and Brazilian Portuguese and works in pounds or reais. If you delete the app, its data goes with it.

name: SETTE - Media Monitoring
description:
SETTE е апликација за медиумски мониторинг и деловни информации за клиентите на SETTE. Следете што пишуваат медиумите за вашиот бренд и не пропуштајте ниту еден тендер што е важен за вас.

МЕДИУМСКИ КЛИПОВИ
• Печатени, онлајн и ТВ/радио клипови за темите и брендовите што ги следите
• Сентимент за секоја вест и преглед на позитивни, неутрални и негативни објави за последните 24 часа
• Досег и индекс на видливост за секој клип
• Филтри по категорија, медиум, автор, датум и сентимент, со зачувување на филтрите
• AI резимеа и извоз

ТЕНДЕРИ И ИЗВЕСТУВАЊА
• Огласи за јавни набавки од Северна Македонија, Косово и Албанија
• Известувања за доделени договори со носители и вредности на договорите
• Филтри по категорија, држава, вредност, договорен орган и носител

ПРОДАЖБИ И СТЕЧАИ
• Јавни продажби на подвижен и недвижен имот
• Стечајни постапки и собранија на доверители

АНАЛИТИКА
• Клипови по датум, таг, медиум и автор, со трендови на сентиментот

ИЗВЕСТУВАЊА
• Push известувања за нови тендери и клипови според вашите претплати

Апликацијата е достапна на македонски и албански јазик. Потребна е претплата на SETTE; најавете се со вашата SETTE сметка.

—
SQ: SETTE — monitorim mediatik, tenderë dhe analitikë për klientët e SETTE. Hyni me llogarinë tuaj SETTE.

EN: SETTE is a media monitoring and public tender tracking app for SETTE clients: press clippings with sentiment, public procurement notices from North Macedonia, Kosovo and Albania, property sales, bankruptcies, analytics and push notifications. A SETTE subscription is required.

name: SGCSE
description: 재무 타임라인을 열고 3일, 7일 또는 14일 단위의 기간을 선택(드래그)하면, 해당 기간 내의 총 결제 금액, 월 예산 대비 비율, 그리고 개별 거래 내역을 확인할 수 있습니다. 선택한 기간이 여러 달에 걸쳐 있는 경우, 각 월이 전체 금액에서 차지하는 비중을 분석할 수 있습니다. 또한, 동일한 길이의 두 기간을 비교하여 저장함으로써 시간 경과에 따른 지출 변화를 추적할 수 있습니다. 결제, 환불, 이체 내역을 발생 즉시 기록하고, 하나의 거래가 여러 목적을 포함하는 경우에는 이를 세분화하여 나눌 수 있습니다. 반복 결제나 할부 항목을 미리 설정해 두었다가, 실제 거래가 처리되면 이를 해당 항목과 연결하십시오. 거래 목적에 따라 예산을 설정하고, 계좌 내역을 항목별로 검토하며, 확정되지 않은 날짜나 환불 상태와 같은 보류 중인 항목은 작업 대기열(task queue)을 통해 관리할 수 있습니다. 월말에는 차액이나 불일치 사항을 기록하고, 향후 검토 시 참고 자료로 활용할 수 있도록 결산 보고서를 저장해 두십시오.

name: Shadelume
description:
Shadelume is Hitori under a soft aurora. Every grid is packed with numbers, and too many of them repeat. Your job is to shade the extras away until each row and column tells a clean story.

HOW A GRID WORKS
Tap a cell once to shade it, a second time to mark it as kept, and a third time to clear it. A grid is finished when three things are true:
• No number appears twice among the unshaded cells of any row or column.
• Shaded cells never sit side by side (corners are fine).
• Every unshaded cell can reach every other one without crossing a shaded cell.
Conflicts glow as you play: two shaded cells touching, or two kept cells holding the same number in a line. Undo steps back one mark at a time, and Hint quietly fixes a single cell, wrong marks first.

FIVE-MINUTE SPRINT
One clock, three hundred seconds, as many grids as you can clear. The run opens on 5×5, moves through 6×6 and 7×7, and climbs to 8×8. Stuck on one? Skip it and keep moving. The Sprint page charts your last ten runs as bars and keeps your record above them in huge numerals.

ZEN
Pick any of six sizes, from 5×5 to a roomy 10×10, and play an endless line of grids with nothing chasing you. Each solve lands you straight on the next. Zen counts how many you have finished at every size.

ARCHIVE AND STATS
• Archive lists your last 25 solves with mode, size, time and hints used.
• Stats adds up puzzles solved, your highest sprint, minutes spent thinking and hints taken, with a bar for each Zen size.
• Six badges to earn, from Clear sky for a first solve to Aurora runner for nine grids in a single sprint and Wide horizon for a 10×10.

PUZZLE HISTORY QUIZ
Ten questions per round drawn from 22 facts about where pencil puzzles come from: the "leave me alone" phrase behind Hitori's name, Euler and his 36 officers, the Tower of Hanoi, the first crossword of 1913 and more. A short note explains each answer.

MADE TO STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY
• Works fully offline, with no account and no adverts.
• Progress is saved on your device.
• Haptics and the breathing aurora background can each be switched off.
• Plays in portrait or landscape, on phone or tablet.

Shade a few numbers, and watch the grid clear.

name: Shake Your Mind
description:
Shake Your Mind — рабочее приложение для сотрудников баров, ресторанов и кафе, подключённых к сервису Shake Your Mind.

Учить
• Тренажёр по меню вашего заведения: состав блюд и коктейлей, короткие раунды по 5 минут.
• Аттестация, уроки адаптации, общая база классических коктейлей и английский для гостей.

Чек-листы смены
• Открытие, закрытие и задачи в течение смены — отмечайте пункты прямо с телефона.
• Фото к пункту, когда управляющему важно видеть результат.

Заготовки
• Сиропы, кордиалы, суперджусы, авторские коктейли и премиксы — все техкарты под рукой.
• Пересчёт под нужный объём: ×0,5, ×2, ×3 или под вашу тару.

Ещё
• Профиль: баллы чек-листов, что знаете и что стоит подтянуть.
• Ваш график смен и добавление в календарь телефона.
• Для управляющего: показатели недели, отчёт за месяц, заявки и настройки.

Сотрудники входят по приглашению заведения: через Telegram или по коду, который выдаёт управляющий. Без заведения доступны классические коктейли и тренажёр — вход по почте или через Apple.

name: shapr: Gym & Home Workout
description:
No more scribbled notes and guessing at the bench: shapr remembers every set for you – and shows you how you get stronger week after week.

ONE TAP. SET SAVED.
Last time’s weight and reps are already filled in. You lift, shapr keeps track. Mistyped? Undo or edit any set later.

AT THE GYM AND AT HOME
• Machines, dumbbells, body weight and cardio
• 178 exercises with guides – plus your own exercises in seconds
• Every exercise shows the sets from your last workout
• Weight steps that match your machines and dumbbells – even odd weights like 37 kg

PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE
• Dashboard with weekly rhythm, streak and personal bests
• Statistics for every exercise: start, current value and progress
• Workouts per week and total volume at a glance
• Muscle map: which muscle groups have you trained – and which ones are waiting for you?

SHARE YOUR WINS
New personal best? shapr turns it into an image for your story or status – with changing quotes that get you hyped for the next workout.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• No account, no sign-up – just start
• Your workout data is stored on your device
• Works without an internet connection
• Backup as a file: you decide where it lives

Light or dark, English or German – shapr adapts to you.

Get shapr and turn your next workout into an upgrade.

name: ShelfLife: Warranty & Receipts
description:
Ever had an appliance break two days after its warranty expired—or spent an hour digging for a receipt?
Want to know what your favorite gear actually costs per day, or when your water filter is due?

ShelfLife is the calm, private home asset manager that keeps every belonging organized, protected, and cared for. Catch just one free warranty repair or timely return, and ShelfLife pays for itself for years.

■ ADD ITEMS IN 3 SECONDS (NO TEDIOUS FORMS)
• Smart Receipt & Order OCR: Scan paper receipts or import order screenshots on-device to autofill item name, price, date, and serial number—even in batches.
• Voice-to-Asset Entry: Just say "Dyson V12, bought in March for $450, 2-year warranty, living room" to build an item card hands-free.
• Barcode & Photo Valuation: Scan UPC/EAN barcodes or snap a photo to classify items and estimate replacement value locally.

■ KNOW YOUR TRUE COST PER DAY & RESALE VALUE
• Automatic daily cost calculation (purchase price ÷ days owned) with custom target daily-cost goals and progress rings.
• Track resale recovery rate when you sell or retire gear, and generate verified digital Asset Certificates & shareable milestone cards.
• Repair-or-Replace Advisor: Enter a repair quote to compare warranty coverage, depreciated value, and past repair spend before you decide.

■ NEVER MISS A WARRANTY, RETURN WINDOW, OR CLAIM
• Track return deadlines, manufacturer warranties, and extended coverage with proactive alerts and Lock Screen Live Activities.
• Archive receipts and full PDF user manuals with instant full-text search—look up error code "E03" in seconds offline.
• One-Tap Claim Packets & Home Coverage Reports: Export receipts, serial numbers, replacement costs, Excel workbooks, and insurance-ready PDFs.

■ EFFORTLESS FILTER CYCLES, MAINTENANCE & SUPPLIES
• Track water filters, air purifiers, espresso descaling, brush heads, and home maintenance with interactive Home Screen widgets (tap once to check in and reset).
• Dedicated Household Supplies section tracks paper goods, pet care, pantry, and medicine quantities & expiry dates.
• Loan Tracker: Remember what you lent, to whom, and when it's due back.

■ QR STORAGE BOX LABELS & INSTANT INVENTORY
• Organize by room and storage box, snap inside-the-box photos, and print AirPrint QR labels—scan any box to see what's inside without unpacking.

■ PRIVATE BY DESIGN — YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account required, no ads, no third-party tracking. OCR, PDF search, and valuation run privately on your device.
• Sync automatically via personal iCloud, share privately with family via CloudKit, or export password-encrypted backups including every receipt and manual.

FREE VS. SHELFLIFE PRO
Start free with up to 8 active assets, 3 receipt attachments, 3 consumable reminders, 3 active loans, and 5 voice entries per month (overflow entries save safely as local drafts so input is never lost).
Upgrade to ShelfLife Pro (Yearly or One-Time Lifetime) for unlimited assets & attachments, PDF manual search, Excel/PDF insurance & claim exports, resale certificates, annual home reviews, and Family Sharing.

SUBSCRIPTION & LIFETIME TERMS
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Yearly subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.
• Lifetime Pro is a single one-time purchase with no recurring charges.

Privacy Policy: https://lovemelovemydog1314-pixel.github.io/app-policies/shelflife/privacy.html?lang=en-US
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Shiba & Lantern Garden
description:
Seat one puppy in every row, every column and every colour. Puppies never touch, not even at a corner. That is the whole rule, and it is enough for hundreds of puzzles.

TWO GARDENS, ONE GAME
New in this version: Shiba Garden, a bright board with four fluffy shiba puppies. The original Lantern Garden is still here, one tap away in the top right corner of the home screen. Your levels, hints and items are shared between both.

ONE ANSWER, NO GUESSING
Every board has exactly one solution and can be solved by reasoning alone. If you are stuck, a hint shows the next step and tells you why it is true.

FROM 5×5 TO 10×10
300 levels that grow from small warm-up boards to full 10×10 grids, plus a new daily puzzle every day. After level 300 the boards keep coming.

SHIBA GARDEN
• Three bones per board: a wrong seat costs one
• Each board is marked Easy, Medium or Tricky
• Daily check-in with a small gift every day
• A short how-to-play shown once

LANTERN GARDEN
• The moonlit 3D garden from version 1.0
• Light lanterns before the rocks pile up on the keeper

MADE TO BE COMFORTABLE
• Undo, restart, and three free hints on every board
• Music and sound effects with separate switches
• English, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish and Traditional Chinese
• Plays offline. No account, no adverts, no subscription

IN-APP PURCHASES
Extra hints and items can be bought alone or in packs. They are optional: every level can be finished without them.

Support: https://256btc.com/lantern/

name: Shim Pack
description: Stack shims under each machine foot. Thin leaves stay out of the sum. The named foot is the one still short by the most. Drag the target gap without changing saved thicknesses. Lift the thickest seated shim on the named foot to take it out of the sum.

name: Shimmo: Water Sort Puzzle Game
description:
Shimmo is a relaxing liquid sorting puzzle. Tap a tube, tap another, and pour until every tube holds a single color.

Simple to learn, satisfying to master:
- 1000 handcrafted levels that grow from gentle to tricky
- One finger, portrait mode, play anywhere
- No timer, no lives, no pressure. Restarting a level is always free
- Glowing liquids, smooth pours and a soft, calm soundtrack
- Optional hints, an extra empty tube and a second chance, each yours for watching a short video, always your choice
- Available in 12 languages
- Works offline, no account needed, progress saved on your device

Free to play. The game shows ads from later levels on. A one-time purchase, Remove Ads, removes banners and full-screen ads for good, and you can restore it on any of your devices. Optional reward videos stay, so you can still earn a hint.

Privacy: no account, and we do not collect personal information ourselves. Ads are served by Google AdMob, with your consent where required. Privacy policy: https://dotfourteen-code.github.io/privacy.html

Questions or ideas? Write to nurzhan.dev@gmail.com.

name: Shingle Course
description:
Shingle Course keeps one roof of courses on this iPhone.

Lay the starter course first. A field course covers the nail only when the butt sits on 3, 4, or 5 and the side joint is more than one step from the previous joint. A butt on 1, 2, or 6, or a joint that sits too close, sends that course back. The covered count does not change. After five covered courses, the ridge caps only when the last butt is 4. After the ridge is capped, another course does not change the roof.

You can name the roof. You can delete it only before the ridge is capped. Share sends the name and whether the ridge is capped. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Shipley Farms
description:
Shop Shipley Farms beef from your iPhone.

Five generations of family farming in the Appalachian Mountains of Vilas, North Carolina. We work with sister partner farms who raise to our standards, and our beef is cut and packed to order on the farm here in Vilas.

In the app you can:
• Browse steaks, roasts, ground beef, beef shares and curated boxes
• Ship anywhere in the United States by UPS, or pick up free in Boone, Blowing Rock or Vilas
• Ask Siri: "Order ground beef from Shipley Farms" or "Reorder from Shipley Farms"
• Find any product from iPhone search
• Sign in to see your past orders

Pasture raised. No added growth hormones. Dry aged in-house. NC Century Farm certified.

The app shows the same store as our website, so prices, stock and your cart are always the same in both places.

Questions? Email beef@shipleyfarmsbeef.com or call 828-484-1872.

NO SHORTCUTS SINCE 1872

name: Sianoplan
description:
Sianoplan to polny pamiętnik i doradca na czas sianokosieni – zrobiony pod mazurskie łąki, od Giżycka po Pisz.

CO TU JEST:

· WILGOTNOŚĆ SIANA (Moduł I)
Trzy dni słońca, poranna rosa i wilgotność powietrza – z tego licznik wylicza, czy dziś wypada wjechać kosiarką, czy jeszcze poczekać. Próg prasowania masz podanych na dłoni.

· PLAN DNIA W POLU (Moduł II)
Aplikacja rozkłada pracę: rano koszenie, w południe przewracanie, wieczorem prasowanie. Gdy wstaje wiatr, idzie mgła albo zacina deszczyk – jeden dotyk włącza alarm i rozkład działania: zwijać, formować pryzmę, przykrywać.

· DESZCZ ZNAD ZACHODU (Moduł III)
Wiejski model pogodowy ocenia ryzyko popołudniowego prysznicy znad zachodu i podaje, ile czasu zostawić na przykrycie stosów plandeką.

· POLA I ZWÓZKA (Moduł IV)
Rysujesz własną mapę zagrody: działki, stogi, pryzmy, miejsca z plandekami. Znaczniki przeciągasz palcem, a aplikacja wyznacza najkrótszą trasę zwózki balotów – mniej jazdy, mniej wilgoci.

· SĄSIEDZKA ZMOWA (Moduł V)
Zapiski zmowy: komu pomagasz, kto pomoże tobie, kto pożyczy wiatę na deszcz. Telefony pod ręką, rachunek godzin domyka się sam.

· KSIĘGA POLNA (Moduł VI)
Paliwo, sznur, naprawy maszyn; straty po deszczu i pleśni. Rok do roku widzisz koszt jednego balotu i uczysz się wybierać lepszy dzień na koszenie.

W ALMANACHU – wiejskie prawa pogody, objaśnienie wyliczeń i miejsce na nazwę gospodarstwa.

WAŻNE: Sianoplan liczy po wiejsku, na podstawie doświadczeń zbieranych przy mazurskich jeziorach. To pomocnik do spraw rytmu pracy – nie zastępuje oficjalnych komunikatów IMGW-PIB ani własnego oka rolnika.

Zapiski zostają w telefonie. Nic nie wychodzi w sieć.

name: SICB 2027 Annual Meeting
description:
This is the SICB 2026 meeting app for the Annual Meeting being held in Portland, Oregon.The app will allow you to sign-in and favorite sessions or presentations allowing you to create your own custom itinerary.
Filter the sessions, presentations, or participants to drill down and find the information you are looking for.
Update your profile and create virtual badge.Post on the social feed for the conference to engage with your community and presenters.

name: SideBySide Bible
description:
SideBySide Bible vous permet de lire la Bible dans deux langues en même temps, verset par verset.

LIRE CÔTE À CÔTE
• Malgache (Baiboly 1865), français (Louis Segond 1910) et anglais (King James)
• Deux versions alignées verset par verset, sur iPhone comme sur iPad
• Textes inclus dans l'application : la lecture fonctionne sans connexion
• Thème clair ou sombre, taille du texte réglable

ÉTUDIER
• Recherche dans toute la Bible
• Surlignage en couleurs, notes sur les versets
• Traduction d'un verset dans les autres langues en un geste
• Copie et partage des versets avec leur référence

PRÉPARER UNE PRÉDICATION
• Outils pour construire une homélie ou une prédication libre à partir des passages choisis
• Vos prédications sont enregistrées dans votre compte

COMMUNAUTÉ
• Partagez une réflexion sur un verset avec d'autres lecteurs
• Groupes d'étude, commentaires et réactions
• Signalement des messages et blocage des utilisateurs ; aucun contenu offensant n'est toléré

Un compte gratuit est nécessaire seulement pour enregistrer vos notes et participer à la communauté. Vous pouvez supprimer votre compte et vos données à tout moment depuis l'application.

name: Sigil: Custom Keyboards
description:
Completely free. The only in-app purchases are optional tips.

Sigil is a keyboard whose keys are whatever you say they are. Build one in the app, key by key, give it its own colours, and type with it in any app.

MAKE YOUR OWN
• Tap a key and say what it types, what it shows and what it stands for
• Add rows, capitals, numbers and symbols
• Give every keyboard its own theme: colours, key shape and lettering, for light and dark
• Keep several keyboards active and move between them with one key. The colours change with them

THE GALLERY
• Browse keyboards and themes other people have made and add one in a tap
• Publish your own under a random name. No account, no sign-up
• Every submission is reviewed before anyone else sees it, and anything can be reported
• Send a friend a keyboard's code or link, or just the file

READ IT AND WRITE IT
• Convert: paste text to turn it into a keyboard's symbols, or back into plain text
• A convert key on the keyboard does the same without leaving your chat
• Practice: learn a keyboard a few symbols at a time. It gets harder as you improve
• Comes with Runes, ROT13 and Morse, with more in the gallery

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The keyboard works without Full Access and sends nothing anywhere. What you type stays on your iPhone
• Full Access is optional. It only lets the convert key paste and copy
• The gallery is the only part that goes online, and only after you turn it on
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking

GOOD TO KNOW
• Requires iOS 26 or later. iPhone only
• A keyboard can only type text: every key types Unicode characters, not pictures
• Symbol ciphers are for fun and for stopping a casual glance. They are not encryption
• iOS does not show third-party keyboards in password fields, and some apps do not allow them

FREE, FOR GOOD
Sigil is made by Stave Hoop Labs, a small lab that builds free utilities. If you enjoy it, you can leave an optional tip from the About screen. Tips unlock nothing; the whole app is free.

name: SignalPatch
description:
Which security advisories affect the software you run? SignalPatch brings vulnerability disclosures, known exploitation and end-of-support notices into one iPhone inbox.

Start with the Website or IoT platform watchlist, then add your own runtimes, packages and infrastructure. The priority inbox opens on the last 14 days. Change the time range, filter by severity, or open a finding to read the publisher’s guidance. Acknowledge it, mark it fixed or suppress it as you work.

Connect a GitHub account, GitLab group or individual repository to see which projects reference an affected dependency. Matching runs on your iPhone against supported dependency files. Git credentials stay in the iPhone Keychain.

Set a push threshold for new matches or choose alerts only for confirmed project matches. Your first sync fills the inbox quietly. iOS may delay background delivery of project-only alerts.

SignalPatch Monthly is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://raunoa.com/signalpatch/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: SigXElite
description: When you only remember a dollar amount, you canSigXEliteEnter an amount to search for individual transactions, the sum of multiple expenses, or the actual net payment after deducting refunds. If you cannot recall the exact amount, you can specify a range and then narrow down the results by date, account, or purpose. Expand the results to view the original ledger entries, verify refund receipt dates, check the receiving accounts, and identify associated payments. During reconciliation, you can add or remove transactions, monitor the variance between the current total and your target, and save these specific combinations. Once an original entry is corrected, you can compare the saved amount, the current amount, and the history of changes. You can also record income, expenses, and transfers; review statements; track recurring income and expenses against spending limits; and consolidate cross-month refunds or unresolved discrepancies into a single case file.

name: SilenceCut: Trim Pauses
description: Trim long pauses from recordings and keep the original audio. Create searchable transcripts on supported iPhones, then tap a line to play it. Recording and importing new audio require Pro.

name: Silicio Chess Doctor
description:
Silicio Chess Doctor analiza tus partidas y te ayuda a decidir qué practicar. Importa partidas públicas de Chess.com o Lichess, abre un archivo PGN o pega tus partidas. Elige al jugador que quieres estudiar y revisa su diagnóstico.

El informe reúne las decisiones más importantes y muestra qué conviene entrenar en aperturas, juicio posicional, cálculo y finales. Abre las posiciones en el tablero, compara alternativas y reproduce las variantes para entender cada hallazgo.

El análisis se ejecuta en el dispositivo. Guarda tus informes para consultarlos y practica a tu ritmo. También puedes exportar una copia de tus informes desde la app.

El primer diagnóstico por instalación es gratuito. Los diagnósticos adicionales se venden por separado o en un paquete de tres mediante pagos únicos. Puedes recuperar el saldo sin usar con la misma cuenta del App Store.

Ajedrez de Silicio E.I.R.L. desarrolla esta app de forma independiente. Chess.com y Lichess son servicios externos.

name: Singline: Vocal Pitch Monitor
description:
Singline draws your singing voice in real time on a piano keyboard, so you can tell right away if you are on pitch, sharp, or flat. Built natively for iPhone and iPad, with no ads, no subscriptions, and 100% on-device processing.

LIVE PIANO-ROLL PITCH CANVAS (FREE)
• Continuous pitch line aligned with piano keys and note names
• Live note readout with signed cents offset (−50 to +50 ¢) and dual color + arrow/text indicators
• Adjustable tolerance (±10 to ±50 ¢), Reference A4 (440–444 Hz), Middle C (C4 or C3), and letter or Fixed Do labels
• Auto-follow scrolling or manual pan and pinch-to-zoom across the keyboard
• Tap any key for a gentle synthesized reference tone, hold to sustain, or toggle continuous Reference mode (speaker-safe fallback prevents mic feedback; Bluetooth headphones play tones in your ears while capturing cleanly through the device mic)

VOCAL RANGE TEST & RECORDINGS (FREE)
• Guided 3-step range test measures your lowest and highest comfortable notes (with optional falsetto), octave span, and suggested voice type, plus an exportable share card
• Keep up to 3 saved recordings for free with automatic offline pitch refinement, synced playback, 5-second skip, A-B section looping, out-of-tune phrase highlights, and a neutral summary

SING ALONG WITH SONGS — BETA (FREE DEMO INCLUDED)
• Practice unlimited times for free on the built-in demo song "I Miss U" (Aussens@iter ft. snowflake, CC BY 3.0)
• Wear headphones while singing; octave-invariant scoring counts singing an octave higher or lower as in tune, with gray dashed markers on non-scored harmony sections

SINGLINE PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE (UNIVERSAL)
Buy once to unlock Pro across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. No subscription, no auto-renewal, no ads:
• Unlimited Recordings & Range History: keep every take and every vocal range result
• Target-Note Exercises: 4 guided drills (Long Tone, 5-Note Scale, Triad Arpeggio, Octave Jump) automatically matched to your vocal range, 40–120 BPM
• Keys & Solfège: 12 roots and 5 scales (Major, Natural/Harmonic Minor, Major/Minor Pentatonic) with Movable Do and numbered notation (1–7)
• Import Audio & Video: analyze M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF, or audio from MP4/MOV (up to 10 minutes) via Files or Voice Memos Share
• Import Your Songs (Beta): on-device vocal separation, suitability check, real-time ±6 semitone transposition, 3-level Original Vocal volume (Normal / Low / Off for backing track), and automatic timing alignment (DRM-protected streaming songs cannot be imported)
• MIDI Import & Export: import Standard MIDI (.mid) tracks with automatic melody selection, synthesized guide audio, and metronome, or export recorded vocal takes as MIDI

BUILT FOR iPHONE & iPAD
• One-handed portrait controls and wide landscape canvas on iPhone
• Two-column iPad layout with extra-large note readouts readable from a music stand 1–2 meters away, plus Split View and Stage Manager support

PRIVATE & OFFLINE BY DESIGN
• No account or sign-up required
• All pitch analysis, vocal separation, recordings, and MIDI files stay strictly on your device and are never uploaded
• Microphone access runs only while you actively practice, test, or record

REQUIREMENTS & CREDITS
• Requires iOS 18 or iPadOS 18 or later
• On-device vocal separation powered by Spleeter by Deezer (MIT License)
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: SINTRAK
seller_name: CABINET D'ETUDE ET DE DEVELOPPEMENT INFORMATIQUE DE GUINEE
description:
SINTRAK est l'application de sécurité et de suivi GPS de vos véhicules, éditée par CEDIG SARL à Conakry.

Suivez toute votre flotte en temps réel depuis votre téléphone : voitures, camions, engins et motos équipés d'un boîtier GPS SINTRAK.

-SUIVI EN DIRECT
• Position de chaque véhicule actualisée en continu, le long des routes
• Statut instantané : en mouvement, moteur allumé, arrêté, hors ligne
• Suivi d'un ou de plusieurs véhicules à la fois
• Votre position et la distance jusqu'au véhicule, avec l'itinéraire
• Fonds de carte au choix : plan, satellite, relief…

- TOUTES LES INFORMATIONS DU VÉHICULE
• Niveau de carburant par réservoir et seuils d'alerte par engin
• Kilométrage total et du jour
• État du moteur (ACC), tension, durée de stationnement
• Signal GPS, altitude, vitesse et direction

- ALERTES INSTANTANÉES
• Coupure de l'alimentation du boîtier, boîtier déconnecté
• Fuite ou remplissage de carburant
• Moteur allumé ou coupé
• Entrée et sortie de zone, excès de vitesse, SOS
• Notifications sur le téléphone, même application fermée, par SMS, WhatsApp et e-mail

- LIMITES DE VITESSE PAR ZONE
• Limite dans chaque ville ou village
• Zones et tronçons de route dangereux (ex. N1) avec leur propre limite
• Alerte dès qu'un véhicule dépasse la limite

- IMMOBILISATION EN CAS DE VOL
• Coupure du moteur à distance, protégée par mot de passe
• Rétablissement en un geste une fois le véhicule récupéré
- ASSISTANT INTELLIGENT
• Posez vos questions en langage naturel : « Où est mon camion ? », « Quelles alertes aujourd'hui ? »
• Réponses basées uniquement sur les données de votre compte

- GESTION DE FLOTTE
• Comptes, sous-comptes et boîtiers organisés en arborescence
• Recherche rapide d'un équipement par son nom ou son numéro
• Connexion par compte utilisateur ou directement par équipement

- ABONNEMENTS
• Consultation de l'état de l'abonnement de chaque boîtier
• Renouvellement simple par Mobile Money

- TROIS LANGUES
Français, anglais et chinois.

- IMPORTANT
SINTRAK fonctionne avec les boîtiers GPS installés par CEDIG SARL ou ses partenaires. Un compte vous est remis lors de l'installation. Pour équiper vos véhicules, contactez-nous au +224 622 862 208 ou à info@cediguinee.org.

SINTRAK — Sécurité & suivi GPS. Une solution CEDIG SARL.

name: Sippora
description:
Every cup of coffee has a story, and every sip is a chance to discover something new.

Sippora is a place for coffee lovers to explore flavors, find inspiration, and enjoy the little moments that make coffee special.

Discover a new coffee each day, explore different coffee styles, and find your next favorite cup. From rich and bold flavors to smooth and creamy creations, there is always something new waiting to be tasted.

Make your brewing moments even better with practical coffee tips and simple tools. Follow a brewing timer, explore different brewing methods, and find little ways to bring out the best in every cup.

Coffee is even more enjoyable with something delicious on the side. Discover delightful pairings, from buttery cookies and flaky croissants to cakes and other sweet treats, and find the perfect companion for your favorite coffee.

And when you find something worth sharing, join the conversation. Share your coffee moments, exchange ideas, and connect with others who appreciate the simple pleasure of a good cup.

Whether you're discovering coffee for the first time or already have a favorite brewing ritual, Sippora is here to make every coffee moment a little more special.

name: Sirkly - Public Communities
description:
Sirkly is a home for public communities. Find people who care about the same things, ask questions, share what you know and follow useful channels.

Start your community
Create a group where everyone can post, or a channel where admins publish, and share its link with your audience.

Polls and quizzes
Ask your community with a poll or run a quiz with a correct answer, and see results live.

Voice rooms
Open a voice room for your community and take questions with raised hands.

Verified official communities
Verify your Instagram, YouTube, store or app with a simple code to enter official communities for your field. We never ask for another service's password.

A safer space
Report any message or user and block anyone. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours, and offensive words are hidden automatically.

Sirkly is for users aged 18 and over. You can delete your account at any time from Settings.

name: sit hütte
description:
sit hütte sits at 2,070 metres on the Tschuggen in Arosa, Switzerland: mountain fusion food, a large sun terrace and events with a view. With the app you know what it looks like up there before you leave the valley.

TODAY
• Live webcam from the terrace
• Weather and temperature at the hut
• Sun path: when the sun arrives and how long it stays
• Today's specials

MENU
• The full menu with prices: food, drinks, wine
• Allergens and marks such as vegan for every dish

EVENTS AND NEWS
• All upcoming events with date, time and place
• News and pictures from the hut
• Notifications if you want them. You choose whether you care about events, specials or news.

BOOK A TABLE
• See free days and times right away
• Pick your area: terrace, lounge or sun loungers
• Booked in a few steps

CLUB
• Sign in with your email, no password
• Offers for club members only
• Collecting points is coming soon

MÄUSE-PASS
For seasonal workers and locals in Arosa: the Mäuse-Pass gives you a discount and offers of your own. You apply for it right in the app.

The app is available in German and English.

name: SizeDrop: File Compressor
description:
Make photos, videos, and PDFs fit common upload limits. Choose a file, select a 2 MB, 10 MB, or 25 MB limit, and compress it on your iPhone. Preview the input, compare the file sizes, then share or save the output from the iOS share sheet.

All compression happens on your device. The app works offline with local files and requires no account.

name: Skanvordlar özbek tilida
description:
«Skanvordlar özbek tilida» – telefoningizda minglab klassik skanvordlar! Savollarni öqing, javoblarni yozing va jadvalni töldiring. Har kuni xotira, bilim va söz boyligini çarxlaydigan sokin aql öyini.

QANDAY ÖYNALADI
• Jadval katagini bosing – uning savoli kök panelda çiqadi
• Pastdagi harflarni töğri tartibda bosing
• Töğri javob jadvalga uçib tuşadi va boşqa sözlar uçun harflarni oçadi
• Kesişmalardan ma'lum harflar özi qöyiladi

3000 BOSQIÇ
• Oddiy savolli kiçik jadvallardan katta va qiyin skanvordlargaça
• Bosqiçlar ketma-ket oçiladi, har biri oldingisidan biroz qiyinroq
• Oylab har kungi öyin uçun yetadi

UÇ ALIFBO
• Lotin, yangi lotin (Ö, Ğ, Ş, Ç) yoki kirill – özingizga qulayini tanlang
• Alifboni istalgan vaqtda menyuda almaştiriş mumkin

KUN SKANVORDI
• Har kuni yangi katta skanvord
• Yeçganingiz uçun tangalar, yakşanba kuni – ikki barobar köp
• Kunlar seriyasini saqlang va rekord örnating

ÖN MINGLAB SAVOLLAR
• Geografiya: davlatlar, poytaxtlar, viloyat va tumanlar, daryo va toğlar
• Adabiyot: Navoiy, Bobur, Qodiriy, Çölpon va jahon adabiyoti
• Tabiat, fan, tarix, sport, milliy taomlar va urf-odatlar
• Ismlar, qisqa sözlar va skanvord klassikasi

YORDAM
• Harf, söz yoki 5 ta tasodifiy harfni oçing
• Video körib tanga oling
• Har neça bosqiçda sovğa

YANA
• Statistika va yutuqlar
• Internetsiz öynaş mumkin
• Yirik harflar va qulay klaviatura
• Çiroyli dizayn va silliq animatsiyalar

Skanvord va krossvordlarni yaxşi körasizmi? Unda «Skanvordlar özbek tilida» – aynan siz uçun. Yuklab oling va birinçi skanvordni hoziroq yeçing!

name: Skanwordlar türkmen dilinde
description:
«Skanwordlar türkmen dilinde» – telefonyňyzda müňlerçe nusgawy skanword! Soraglary okaň, jogaplary ýazyň we tagtany dolduryň. Her gün ýadyňyzy, bilimiňizi we söz baýlygyňyzy kämilleşdirýän rahat akyl oýny.

• Aşakdaky harplara dogry tertipde basyň
• Dogry jogap tagta uçup barýar we beýleki sözler üçin harplary açýar

• Geografiýa: döwletler, paýtagtlar, welaýatlar, derýalar we daglar
• Edebiýat: Magtymguly, Kemine, Mollanepes, Zelili we dünýä edebiýaty

• Atlar, gysga sözler we skanwordyň nusgawy soraglary

IKI DIL
• Türkmen ýa-da rus dilinde oýnaň
• Dili islän wagtyňyz sazlamalarda çalşyp bilersiňiz

ÝENE
