name: Skate: Tuesday Games
description:
Skate real city streets with one thumb.

Tap to ollie, swipe to flip, and land on rails, ledges and benches to grind them. String tricks together into big combos, nail each spot's named gaps, and find the hidden letters that spell out the city's name.

START IN PORTLAND
• Six spots: Downtown, Skidmore Fountain, Burnside Skatepark, North Portland, the SE Waterfront and Zoo Bomb
• Dodge or ollie light rail trains, joggers, bikes, shopping carts, goats, penguins and Zoobombers on little bikes
• Bridges, Mt Hood, Big Pink, Paul Bunyan and the food carts roll by behind you

ONE-THUMB TRICKS
• Ollies, kickflips, heelflips, shove-its, 360 flips and grabs
• 50-50s and boardslides on rails, ledges, benches, curbs and fountains
• Quarter pipes that send you flying
• Swipe to switch lanes

GOALS AND SECRETS
• Five goals at every spot, from high scores to named gaps
• Hidden letters at every spot: find them all to spell out the city and win a special board
• Skate as Pat, Sammy or Angie the dog, in the colors and board you pick

PLAY ANYWHERE
• A tutorial teaches every move, one at a time
• Plays entirely offline
• No ads, no account, no data collected
• Retro 8-bit art and sound, with haptics

The tip jar is optional and unlocks nothing. Every tip helps us keep making games.

name: Skills Up: уроки рисования
description:
В Skills Up School четыре направления: рисунок, цифровая живопись, 2D-графика и 3D-графика. Выберите курс, посмотрите работы студентов и попробуйте уроки бесплатно.

Рисунок. Начните с основ или выберите, что хотите освоить: скетчинг, реалистичный портрет, наброски или фигуру в движении.
Цифровая живопись. Разберитесь, как свет и цвет создают объём, и примените это в этюдах.
2D-графика. Придумывайте персонажей, рисуйте окружение, изучайте концепт-арт и дизайн игрового интерфейса. В каталоге есть курсы по Photoshop и Procreate для художников.
3D-графика. Попробуйте моделирование и скульптинг, создание стилизованных персонажей, иллюстрацию в Blender или художественное текстурирование. Для знакомства со скульптингом есть курс «Введение в ZBrush».

Как попробовать курс
Посмотрите программу, познакомьтесь с кураторами и выберите курс по работам студентов. Пробный доступ открывается на 7 дней. В карточке указано, сколько уроков доступно и можно ли отправить работу на проверку. Есть и отдельные бесплатные курсы по геймдеву, 2D-графике и цифровой иллюстрации.

Заполните форму и подтвердите почту или войдите в аккаунт школы. В разделе «Моё обучение» можно смотреть уроки и отмечать пройденное. Если в курсе предусмотрен разбор, отправьте файл или ссылку на работу. Когда куратор ответит, вы получите ответ в приложении и пуш, если разрешили уведомления.

name: Skipzone: HF Band Conditions
description:
Skipzone tells you which HF band to try right now, and when your next DX path will open.

It reads live space-weather data from NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center: solar flux, Kp, X-ray flux, storm scales and alerts. It then runs its own ionosphere model on your iPhone and rates every band from 160 m to 10 m for your location. Each verdict comes with a reason, such as the estimated MUF and LUF, daylight absorption, a flare blackout or a geomagnetic storm.

FREE
• Best band now and a 24-hour outlook strip for every band from your QTH
• Space-weather dashboard: solar flux with a 30-day trend, Kp, X-ray class, solar wind and Bz, NOAA R/S/G scales
• Live gray-line map with day, night and twilight, your station and the point where the Sun is overhead
• Alerts in plain language with what each means for HF, a Kp forecast, a 3-day outlook and recent flares
• Grid tools: your Maidenhead locator from GPS or typed in, distance and beam heading between any two locators

SKIPZONE PRO
• Path openings: an hour-by-hour band chart to any grid square or DX region, short and long path, with distance, heading, hops and best windows
• 24-hour gray-line time scrubber with your path drawn on the map
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that refresh on their own
• Background storm, radio-blackout and proton alerts

Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple ID settings.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Band verdicts are estimates from a simplified model, not a full propagation prediction. Use them to decide what to try first.
• Your location is stored only as a grid locator, on your device. No account, no ads.
• Data source: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. Skipzone is not affiliated with NOAA.
• The app is available in English and Japanese.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://arifinazis.github.io/AppFactoryBlueprint/compliance/privacy_policy/skipzone.html

name: Sky Surfers: Glide Valley
description:
Run down the deck, leap off the edge and glide over the valley!

Sky Surfers is a relaxing paragliding game: every flight takes you a little further. Run with your finger to take off, circle in rising thermals to climb, fly through the rings, grab the coins and diamonds floating in the air and land on the field across the valley.

FEATURES
• Five hand-made valleys, each at a different time of day: midday sun, morning meadows, golden afternoon, sunset over the woods
• Real but easy flight: a wing that banks into turns, thermals, head wind, air tunnels and soft landings
• You run the launch: reach the edge at full speed for a perfect take-off
• Upgrade your wing, your launch and your income; a new wing design and a new outfit every five levels
• A jump ramp you unlock and raise with diamonds
• Treasure chest, shop and coins to collect in the sky
• No forced ads
• Short flights, perfect for a quick break

How far can you glide?

name: Skyprism
description:
Ride a board along an endless rail in the sky and race from one world to the next!

Skyprism is a 3D endless rail ride. Hold the left or right side of the screen to lean and steer, tap JUMP to leap over rocks, and ride into the light to reach the next world.

HOW IT WORKS
- 16 worlds to find: Fields & River, Coastline, Undersea Canyon, Dusk City, Aurora Night, Space, Saturn's Rings, Dark Forest, Future City, Floating Isles, Castle Above the Clouds, Glacier, Volcano, Desert Ruins, Sakura Torii and Neon Night City.
- Start your next run in any world you have already found.
- Choose your rider: Girl, Fox or Dragon.
- Change as you go: your rider changes outfit in a flash of light in the 3rd world, and your board evolves up to 4 stars in the 3rd, 6th and 10th worlds.
- In space, your rider wears a space suit, and flying saucers cruise by.
- Collect light orbs, grab glowing crystals for big points and pass close to rocks for a NEAR MISS.
- At a fork, pick the SAFE ROAD or the DANGER ROAD for more points.
- Watch out for the monsters in the Dark Forest!
- Three modes: EASY (no rocks, just the ride and the view), NORMAL and HARD (3 hits and the run is over).
- Section goals, missions and three daily challenges give you bonus orbs. Spend them on new colors for your rider and board.

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE AND TABLET
- No ads
- Plays offline - no account, no sign-in
- Your progress is saved automatically on your device
- Feel the hits and the big moments through vibration
- Play in portrait or landscape

name: Slate: Quake Seismograph
description:
Slate turns your iPhone into a calm, sensitive seismograph, then shows you how what your phone felt lines up with earthquakes reported around you.

TRACK EARTHQUAKES
• Live U.S. Geological Survey reports on a full-screen map, largest first
• Search any city or place and see quakes within 500 km
• Filter by magnitude, time, distance and sort order, as a map or a list
• Works worldwide, with or without location access

UNDERSTAND EACH QUAKE
• Energy in tons of TNT, how common that size is, and how deep it was
• ShakeMap intensity, Did You Feel It? reports and PAGER population exposure, when USGS publishes them
• Fault motion as a beach ball and an animated block diagram
• Real seismograms from nearby stations, with P- and S-wave arrivals
• Aftershocks over 30 days and 30 years of the area's history

RECORD WITH YOUR PHONE
• Lay your phone flat and watch a live seismograph trace
• Record for a few minutes or a whole night
• Mark moments, then review each recording in History
• Feel a recording played back through haptics and sound

COMPARE
• Line up your trace against a quake's origin and expected wave arrivals
• See a rough estimate of the expected shaking next to your phone's quiet level

LEARN
• A magnitude explorer from M1 to M9.5
• A wave timing lab that shows how scientists find distance
• A short quiz, plain-language articles, and experiments to try with Record

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your recordings stay on your device. Slate sends only your approximate location to USGS, as a search area.

Slate is for learning and exploration. It is not an earthquake alert or early warning system, and a phone is not a scientific seismometer. For alerts, use an official service in your area.

Earthquake data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Seismograms from EarthScope's FDSN web services.

name: Sleep Sounds & Stories
description:
Sleep Meditation is your personal space to unwind, quiet your mind, and enjoy a more peaceful night. Create your perfect sleep atmosphere by mixing rain, ocean waves, fireplace sounds, and soothing noise. Follow gentle breathing exercises, listen to relaxing stories, and wake up refreshed with a gentle alarm.

- PURPOSE

The purpose of Sleep Meditation is to make relaxation and better bedtime habits part of everyday life. Our goal is to provide a peaceful, easy-to-use space where you can escape daily stress, calm your thoughts, enjoy soothing audio, and create a personalized nighttime routine.

Whether you want to relax after a busy day, enjoy peaceful moments, improve your bedtime routine, or wake up more gently, Sleep Meditation brings everything together in one convenient app.

-CREATE YOUR PERFECT SLEEP SOUNDSCAPE
200+ soothing sounds: Enjoy rain, thunder, ocean waves, fireplaces, forests, birds, crickets, wind, fans, and much more.
6 types of noise: White, pink, brown, blue, grey, and green noise.
Relaxing audio: Explore calming music, singing bowls, zen gardens, and ASMR sounds.
Binaural beats: Discover immersive audio for relaxation, rest, and focus.
Immersive 8D audio: Experience sounds that move around you. Headphones recommended.
Custom sound mixes: Combine multiple sounds, adjust individual volumes, save your favorite mixes, and share them.

- BEDTIME STORIES THAT HELP YOU UNWIND
Enjoy gentle, relaxing bedtime stories designed to help you settle down.
Turn any text into a soothing listening experience by typing or pasting your own story.
Record personal bedtime stories in your own voice and share them with someone special.

- YOUR PERSONAL NIGHTTIME ROUTINE
Personalized sleep plan: Answer a few simple questions to receive a bedtime plan tailored to your preferences.
Sleep timer: Choose when your sounds stop, with a gentle fade-out that gradually lowers the volume.
Automatic sound detection: Auto-stop gradually fades your sounds when your phone remains still.
Smart masking: Help cover distracting background noises with soothing sounds.

- A BEAUTIFUL CLOCK FOR YOUR NIGHTSTAND
Choose from 12 elegant analog clocks and 7 digital clock designs.
Enjoy beautiful nighttime scenes featuring the real moon, twinkling stars, and an animated arc leading to your alarm.
Keep your display dim and comfortable for nighttime viewing.
Lock the screen to prevent accidental touches from interrupting your rest.

- WAKE UP GENTLY
Choose from gentle nature-inspired alarm sounds.
Alarms are designed to sound even when your iPhone is in silent mode.
Enable wake-up missions that challenge you to solve math problems, shake your phone, or type a phrase before dismissing the alarm.

- EXPLORE THE CALM STUDIO
Track your mood with simple daily check-ins.
Build healthy bedtime habits with a nighttime routine you can complete every evening.

- MORE FEATURES TO MAKE YOUR NIGHTS BETTER
Remote sound control: Turn a second iPhone into a remote for your sound machine when both devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
Siri shortcuts: Ask Siri to play your favorite sounds or start your wind-down routine.
Sleep Focus: Start your relaxation routine with your iPhone's Sleep Focus.
Calming videos: Enjoy relaxing videos and beautiful story films.
Your own recordings: Record real-world sounds and add them to any sound mix.
Privacy first: No account required. Your recordings, sleep history, and personal notes stay on your device.

- MAKE EVERY NIGHT A LITTLE MORE PEACEFUL

Create your perfect atmosphere, discover relaxing bedtime stories, enjoy guided breathing, and build a nighttime routine that feels right for you.

Download Sleep Meditation today and make peaceful nights part of your everyday life.

Sleep Meditation is designed for relaxation and general wellness. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/sleep-meditation-stories/home

name: Sleepia
description:
Sleepia는 숲과 바닷가의 고요한 달밤에서 다른 사람들과 함께 잠드는 수면 공간이에요.

마음에 드는 곳에 자리를 펴고 누우면, 폰이 밤새 잠을 재고 아침에 보고서를 만들어 드려요. 누군가의 잠자리 옆에서, 혼자가 아닌 밤을 보내 보세요.

■ 함께 잠드는 3D 공간
· 키 큰 나무가 울창한 깊은 숲속과 파도가 밀려오는 달밤의 바닷가
· 걸어 다니다 마음에 드는 곳에 누우면, 다른 사람들에게 내 잠자리가 보여요
· 잠든 사람 위로는 작은 z가 떠올라요
· 쓸수록 열리는 이불, 베개, 전등으로 잠자리 꾸미기

■ 수면 측정과 보고서
· 폰을 베개 옆에 두면 뒤척임과 소리로 잠든 시각과 잠의 깊이를 추정해요
· 코골이가 들린 시간과 정도, 원하면 코골이 녹음까지
· 수면 목표와 모자란 잠, 오늘의 메모별 비교 통계
· 얕은 잠일 때 맞춰 깨우는 알람, 취침 시간 알림
· 건강 앱에 수면 기록 적기 (켜을 때만)

■ 잠을 돕는 소리
· 빗소리, 파도, 바람, 나무의 숨결을 섞어 듣고, 시간이 지나면 저절로 꺼져요
· 잠들기 전에 읽어 주는 이야기와 명상

■ 수면 기록은 폰 안에만
수면 기록, 마이크 소리, 코골이 녹음은 폰 안에서만 분석하고 저장해요. 어디에도 보내지 않아요. 로그인하지 않아도 모든 기능을 쓸 수 있어요.

■ 안심하고 함께 쓰는 공간
불쾌한 이름은 자동으로 걸러지고, 누구든 이름표를 눌러 가리거나 신고할 수 있어요.

Sleepia는 의료 기기가 아니에요. 수면 측정은 폰의 센서로 추정한 참고용이며 질병을 진단하거나 치료하지 않아요.

개인정보 처리방침: https://sleepia.co/privacy/
이용약관: https://sleepia.co/terms/

name: Slice Circuit
description:
It’s 30–40. Your opponent sends a short ball. Swipe into position, wait for the bounce, and tap to send it back down the court.

Slice Circuit is a single-player pixel tennis game. Play a quick game against the computer, settle in for a set, or take a player through four tournaments in Career mode. Grass plays fast and low. Clay gives you time to reach the ball. Hard courts put your timing to the test on tour.

• Learn to move, serve and return in a guided warm-up, then practice with the ball machine.
• Choose Easy, Medium or Hard. You can adjust the difficulty during a career.
• Create a player, choose a look and work your way up the tour rankings. Three career slots give each run its own record.
• Win trophies, unlock champion kits and replay your best rally.
• Hear the crowd applaud and an available on-device umpire call the score. Music, applause and voice have separate volume settings.

Play offline on iPhone or iPad. Your careers and preferences save on the device.

name: Slide Spotlight
description:
Slide Spotlight turns your iPhone into a precision presentation pointer and slide remote.

Requires the free Slide Spotlight Receiver desktop app (macOS, Windows, or Linux), available at no extra cost at https://etnatech.it/slidespotlight. Start the receiver on your computer and pair in seconds over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth LE by scanning the QR code or entering the 4-digit code.

WHILE YOU PRESENT
• Press and hold the pad and tilt your iPhone to move the pointer smoothly across your slide
• Slide up or down while holding to adjust the spotlight or magnifier size in real time
• Previous and Next buttons advance slides cleanly (works with Keynote, PowerPoint, Google Slides, PDFs, and any app controlled with arrow keys)
• Double-tap the pad to click at the pointer position (great for starting videos or links)
• Works over local Wi-Fi or Bluetooth Low Energy when conference Wi-Fi is restricted

POINTER MODES
• Laser Dot (Free): crisp pointer dot on your presentation with slide controls included
• Spotlight (Pro): dims the rest of the screen and illuminates a focused circle around what you point to
• Magnifier (Pro): zooms in live on charts, code, and fine details

SLIDE SPOTLIGHT PRO (OPTIONAL)
Unlock Spotlight, Magnifier, custom laser colors, adjustable spotlight dimming, starting sizes, and pointer trail with Pro Monthly, Pro Yearly (includes a 7-day free trial), or Pro Lifetime.

Privacy Policy: https://etnatech.it/slidespotlight/privacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://etnatech.it/slidespotlight/terms

name: Slidegate
description:
Swipe colourful blocks across the board and slide each one out through the gate of its colour. Every block slides until it hits something – getting the order right is everything.

• 300 solver-checked levels across 15 worlds with their own board shapes
• Ice blocks, lock & key, axis blocks, double-layer blocks and colour-switch gates
• Six power-ups: undo, hint, time stop, hammer, melter and colour vacuum
• A symbol on every colour – colour-blind friendly
• Daily rewards, stars and coins

No ads, no tracking, no account. Plays fully offline.

You earn coins by playing. If you want to speed things up, optional coin packs and a one-time starter pack are available – no subscriptions, no random rewards.

name: Sliding Block !
description:
Press. Slide. Solve.

Sliding Block is the classic sliding-number puzzle played on soft, realistic keyboard keycaps, seen from straight above. Every key presses down under your finger and glides into the empty slot with a creamy keyboard thock.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: work through levels that get steadily trickier, from Very Easy to Advanced. No timer pressure. Every level's difficulty is measured, not guessed.
• Speed Run: a new challenge board every day for each size. Beat your best time on the same board, with no undo.

THREE BOARD SIZES
• 3×3 Easy, 4×4 Classic (the famous 15 puzzle), 5×5 Expert. Each size has its own level progression.

16 KEYCAP COLLECTIONS
Each set is its own keyboard, with its own colours, finish and a delicate surface print: a soft linen weave, gingham, frosted glass, stardust, gold pinstripes and more. Five sets are yours from the start: Nature, Pastel, Vanilla, Ocean and Candy. Seven more unlock as you complete Classic levels: Christmas, Sakura, Winter, Halloween, Sunset, Cosmic and Retro Arcade. Four premium sets are optional purchases: Crystal Glass, Pearl, Matcha Latte and Midnight Gold.

HINTS WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
Tap Hint and the right key lights up, with an arrow toward the gap. You start with 3 free hints. Earn more by watching a short ad, or buy a hint pack.

SO SATISFYING
• Keys respond the instant you touch them
• Slide a whole row or column with one tap
• A rippling, glowing finish every time you solve

SOUND SHOP
Creamy Keyboard is the free signature sound. Optional sound packs: Thocky Keyboard, Clicky Keyboard, Jelly Pop, Glass Taps, Wooden Keys, Bubble Pop and Retro Arcade. Preview every pack before you buy.

No account needed and no pop-up ads. Ads only play when you choose to watch one for a hint. Works offline.

name: Slitherlink: Loop Puzzles
description:
Draw one closed loop so that every number counts its lines. Slitherlink is the classic Japanese logic puzzle: simple rules, deep thinking, and the quiet joy of a loop that finally closes.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• The same daily puzzle for everyone: easy on Monday, big on Sunday.
• Keep your streak going and see the last four weeks at a glance.

FOUR LEVELS, ENDLESS PUZZLES
• Easy 6×6, Medium 8×8, Hard 10×10 and Master 12×12.
• Every puzzle is new and has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone. No guessing.

HINTS THAT TEACH
• Stuck? A hint first shows any wrong mark, then explains the next step in words: “This number needs every side that is still open.”
• Learn the tricks one by one until you no longer need hints.

MADE FOR FINGERS
• Tap a side for a line, again for a cross, again to clear it.
• Or draw with your finger from dot to dot.
• Undo, start over, and a clock that pauses when you leave.

TIMES AND STATISTICS
• Best and average time for every level, your streak and your longest run.
• Light and dark design, iPhone and iPad.
• No account, no ads. Your progress stays on your device.

The first month is free. After that, Slitherlink is a monthly subscription, charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed and cancelled in the App Store settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: SlonX
description:
SlonX — мессенджер на основе открытого протокола Matrix для личного и группового общения.

Возможности SlonX:

• Личные и групповые чаты.
• Сквозное шифрование (E2EE) для защищённых переписок.
• Голосовые и видеозвонки.
• Отправка фотографий, видео и файлов.
• Push-уведомления о новых сообщениях.
• Подключение к совместимым Matrix-серверам.
• Синхронизация переписки между устройствами.

SlonX использует открытую экосистему Matrix, позволяя пользователям выбирать сервер для общения и взаимодействовать с другими пользователями сети Matrix.

Для использования приложения необходима учётная запись на совместимом Matrix-сервере.

name: Smart Sort: Bead Puzzle
description:
Restore beautiful bead pictures, one color at a time.

Each picture hangs on strings of beads, but the beads are all mixed up. Pull the wrong beads off into your tray, then tap a color to thread it back onto every string that needs it. Watch the picture come together from the top down.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap a loose bead to pull it, and the beads below it, into your tray.
- Tap a color in the tray to fill every string that is ready for it, all at once.
- No string ready yet? Park the beads at the bottom of a string and come back for them later.
- Keep restoring until the whole picture is complete.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Relaxing: no timer, no move limit, no game over.
- Satisfying: one tap can fill many strings in a single sweep.
- Smart: plan your tray space to set up the biggest sweeps.
- Beautiful: every level reveals a new bead picture.
- Play anywhere: no Wi-Fi needed.

Sort the colors, clear your mind, and bring each picture back to life. Download Smart Sort and start restoring!

name: SmartCabin
description:
Follow your Pilatus PC-24 flight from your seat. SmartCabin is an independent passenger app designed to work with the iCMS 3 cabin management system on compatible PC-24 aircraft.

Join the aircraft’s passenger Wi-Fi to see where you are, where you’re going, and how much flying time remains. The map works without an internet connection. A dashed line shows the route ahead and a solid line traces the path you’ve flown.

Before departure, see the expected flight time and, when downloaded, the forecast for your arrival. In the air, follow altitude, speed, distance remaining, and estimated arrival in the destination’s local time. After landing, revisit your flown route in the flight recap.

On equipped aircraft, tap the thermometer to view and adjust the cabin temperature setpoint. Tap the lightbulb to choose Day, Night, or All Off. Available readings and controls depend on the aircraft’s cabin installation.

A lightweight world map comes with the app, download shaded terrain, worldwide runways, regional airport layouts, and forecasts for offline use. You can download the latest weather over any internet-connected Wi-Fi network before departure. If Wi-Fi is unavailable, a SIM or eSIM with an active mobile data plan is a convenient way to update the forecast before boarding.

SmartCabin is for passenger information and cabin comfort only. Arrigoni Aviation develops and supports SmartCabin independently, without affiliation with or endorsement by Pilatus Aircraft Ltd. or the iCMS 3 manufacturer.

name: SmartVote GH
description:
SmartVote is the easy way to vote for your favourite nominees in award shows, pageants and competitions across Ghana.

Find an event, pick a category, choose your nominee and pay with Mobile Money (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash or AirtelTigo Money) through Hubtel. Your vote counts as soon as the payment is approved and you get a receipt straight away.

What you can do:
• Browse live events and their categories and nominees
• Jump straight to a nominee with their nominee code
• Pay and vote in a few taps with Mobile Money
• See live and final results for each event
• Check every successful vote you made with your number, with the transaction ID and reference
• Reach SmartVote support by WhatsApp, phone or email

The same events can also be voted on at smartvotegh.com or by USSD.

name: Smash: Everything Badminton
description:
Smash is a badminton tracker that keeps your games, training, and progress on your device. It works without an account, shows no ads, and collects nothing about you. The complete project is opensource.

Log a match in a few taps. Pick your opponent, choose 15 points, 21 points, or continuous play, and keep score game by game. You can play a best-of-three or run as many games as you like.

Training has its own session type. Add several drills to one session and give each one its own sets done and difficulty. A session holds both play and training, so one card shows everything you did that day.

Players and tournaments each have a tab. Search by name, check your record against each opponent, and follow results across tournaments. The dashboard shows a form rating that goes up when you beat stronger players and drops when you lose to weaker ones. Coach's Corner looks at the last 30 days and points out patterns, like how you play in deciding games.

Data lives on your device first. Turn on iCloud and it syncs across your own devices. You can export a backup with a password whenever you want, and restore it later.

Smash is free and open source under the MIT license. There is no subscription and nothing to buy.

name: snapmarker
description: Markers for Green/Blue screen replacement with buttons to replicate app

name: SnapSweep - Photo Swipe Clean
description:
Reclaim gigabytes of iPhone storage in minutes - without paying $9.99/week subscriptions.

SnapSweep turns tedious photo cleanup into a smooth, tactile card-swiping flow. Swipe right to keep memories, swipe left to stage blurry shots, screenshots, and duplicates in a safe review vault before deleting anything.

KEY FEATURES
- Effortless Swipe Cleanup: Review photos month by month or by large files and screenshots with responsive gesture controls.
- Safe Staging Vault: Nothing is deleted until you review your staging tray and confirm with Apple's native system delete prompt.
- 100% On-Device Processing: Your photos never leave your iPhone. Zero cloud uploads, zero accounts, and zero analytics tracking.
- Storage Saved Counter: Watch exact megabytes and gigabytes freed in real time as you declutter.
- Instant Undo: Changed your mind? Pull any photo back out of the staging vault with a single tap.

HONEST PRICING
Clean your first sessions free with zero ads. Unlock unlimited cleanup sessions forever with a single $5.99 lifetime purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/snapsweep/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/snapsweep/support.html

name: Snowday
description:
Ready, set, snow!

Welcome to Snowday, a cozy Christmas-themed arcade game filled with moving targets and snowy fun. Grab a snowball, take aim, and see how many festive ornaments you can hit before the clock runs out!

Whether you're looking for a relaxing holiday moment or a faster challenge, there's a difficulty level for you.

HOW TO PLAY

Choose a difficulty and an unlocked level.
Touch and drag toward a moving ornament to aim.
Release to throw your snowball—or simply tap to toss.
Hit the required number of targets before time runs out.
Complete a level to unlock the next one!
GAME FEATURES

Three difficulty modes: Enjoy a cozy round or take on the faster Blizzard challenge.
12 levels for difficulty: Work your way along the snowy trail at your own pace.
Moving festive targets: Time your throws and aim ahead to make each hit count.
Your personal stats: Keep track of rounds played, wins, targets hit, accuracy, and best score.
Christmas atmosphere: Enjoy a winter-inspired world with snowy scenery and festive colors.
Pick your pace, practice your aim, and make every snowball count!

name: SnowScope: Snow & Powder
description:
SnowScope tells you where the snow is, where to ski today and this weekend, and when the next powder day is coming. A clear snow forecast and snow report for more than 2,100 ski resorts in the Alps, the Pyrenees and the USA (West and North-East), plus Scandinavia and Western Canada.

WHERE TO SKI TODAY
• Live snow map: snow depth and new snow on a relief map, day by day for the next 7 days
• Powder score from 0 to 10 for every resort, with the reasons in plain words
• The best resorts for today and for the weekend, ranked by their snow
• Pistes coloured by how good they are to ski right now, and the best runs of the resort
• Mountain weather hour by hour: snow, wind, temperature and freezing level

POWDER ALERTS
• A morning alert when one of your favourite resorts gets fresh snow
• Powder alerts for a single resort or a whole region, such as the Dolomites
• 7-day snow depth and new snow for every resort, at the base and at the top

SKI TRIP PLANNER
• Enter your start town, how long you are happy to drive, your level and what matters to you: fresh powder, a snow-sure base, a short drive or fewer crowds
• Get the ski resorts that suit your dates, explained, with hotels and chalets nearby
• Season opening dates and snowmaking conditions, so you know who opens first

ON THE MOUNTAIN
• Share a resort with friends in one tap

SAFETY
• Official avalanche danger levels with a link to the official bulletin, always free
• SnowScope never replaces the avalanche bulletin or local advice

THIS SEASON VS PAST WINTERS
• See how this winter compares with past seasons at your resort

Available in English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.

Free: the snow map, resort pages and mountain weather for today and the next 2 days, the top 3 resorts of the day and a morning powder alert for your favourite resort. Free with ads; you choose in the iOS prompt whether they may be personalised.
SnowScope Pro, €4.99 a month or €29.99 for the whole season (1 year, 7 days free to start): the full 7-day and 15-day forecast, the 72-hour snow totals, this season vs past winters, the full powder ranking, unlimited powder alerts, the trip planner for any date, and no ads. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your App Store settings.
Terms of use: https://snowscope.app/terms/ · Privacy policy: https://snowscope.app/privacy/

name: So That's AI
description:
Learn AI with clear explanations, simple illustrations and useful comparisons—at your own pace.

So That’s AI is an illustrated guide to artificial intelligence for beginners, curious adults and busy professionals. Understand how AI works, what the major models and platforms do, and how the pieces fit together. No technical background required.

UNDERSTAND THE FOUNDATIONS

Discover what artificial intelligence is, how language models produce responses, and what makes generative AI different. Learn how models are trained, what happens during inference, and why AI can get things wrong.

MAKE SENSE OF MODELS AND PLATFORMS

Explore ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Microsoft Copilot, along with model families such as Llama, Gemma, Qwen and Mistral. Understand the difference between a model, an app and a platform, with explanations of their strengths and limitations.

DECODE THE TERMINOLOGY

Find clear definitions of tokens, context windows, prompts, APIs, agents and other AI and workflow terms. Go beyond a one-line definition with explanations that connect each idea to the bigger picture.

SEE HOW THE TOOLS FIT TOGETHER

Understand desktop applications, local and cloud AI, automation and creative tools. Explore how image, video and audio AI work, and where tools such as Ollama, LM Studio and ComfyUI fit into a workflow.

BUILD YOUR UNDERSTANDING

Learn about privacy, reliability, evaluation and the limits of AI. Build the knowledge to follow conversations, understand product claims and ask more informed questions.

A GUIDE YOU CAN KEEP COMING BACK TO

- 13 chapters and 134 lessons.
- 185 explained AI and workflow terms.
- Profiles of 38 models, tools and platforms.
- Illustrations, diagrams and comparison tables.
- Search, bookmarks and personal notes.
- Adjustable text size and light and dark modes.
- Offline reading and PDF chapters to save for later.

Read from the beginning or go straight to the topic you want to understand. Take your time, revisit an explanation and follow your curiosity.

So That’s AI. AI, made understandable.

name: Sochi Gate
description: Sochi Gate provides a convenient way to explore income summaries, organize plots, review production cycle status, analyze cost and net profit totals, check monthly reports, and log harvests and sales. Move between overall conditions and individual entries while comparing collection time, volume, processing method, and net profit across harvests and products in a clean, structured workspace. Log sales, costs, and income figures, then generate and share a monthly PDF report.

name: Socrate : culture générale
description:
Socrate, c’est la culture générale en 10 minutes par jour.

Chaque jour, une leçon courte, en cartes à faire défiler : un peu de lecture, un schéma, une image, puis une question pour retenir. Comme Socrate, l’app ne fait pas de longs discours : elle pose des questions.

ONZE THÈMES
Histoire de France, philosophie, sciences, art et culture, intelligence artificielle, géopolitique, psychologie, argent et finances, tes droits au quotidien, éloquence, et l’actualité expliquée et datée.

CE QUE TU Y TROUVES
• Une leçon du jour, choisie selon tes thèmes préférés.
• Un fil « Pour toi » : cinq faits, une question, et la flamme de l’Olympe s’allume.
• Des quiz et des vrai ou faux après chaque idée.
• Des tableaux célèbres expliqués détail par détail, avec zoom.
• La révision espacée des cartes que tu gardes.
• Un jeu pour remettre les événements dans l’ordre, des défis de 7 jours, des widgets.
• La chouette d’Athéna, qui réagit à tes réponses.

DES LEÇONS SOURCÉES
Chaque leçon cite ses sources, datées et consultables. Les sujets d’actualité affichent leur date de vérification.

SANS COMPTE, SANS PUBLICITÉ
Pas d’inscription, pas de traceur. Ta progression reste sur ton iPhone et dans ton iCloud.

GRATUIT ET PREMIUM
Gratuit : la première leçon de chaque thème, la leçon du jour, 3 séries par jour, la révision et les widgets.
Premium : toutes les leçons et toute l’actualité, sans limite, l’écoute des leçons, la couleur et l’icône de l’app. Abonnement mensuel ou annuel (7 jours d’essai gratuit sur l’annuel), ou achat à vie. Les abonnements se renouvellent automatiquement et s’annulent à tout moment dans les réglages de ton compte Apple.

Conditions d’utilisation : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sokoni Hub
description:
Sokoni Hub is a marketplace for shoppers in Qatar. Browse African groceries and everyday goods from independent vendors, order on your phone, and pay cash on delivery.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Shop products from local vendors in one app
• Add items to your cart and checkout in minutes
• Drop a delivery pin on the map so the rider finds you
• Pay cash on delivery — Sokoni Hub does not take card payments in the app
• Search by voice with Ask Sokoni (hold the microphone)
• Track orders and get status updates
• Book selected local services where listed

LANGUAGES
English, Swahili, Luganda, Twi, and Arabic.

WHO IT IS FOR
Residents in Qatar. New accounts use a Qatar mobile number (Ooredoo or Vodafone). You can also sign in with email after you have an account.

HOW IT WORKS
Sokoni Hub is a digital marketplace. Vendors sell and deliver their own goods. Payments are settled between you and the vendor (typically cash on delivery).

SUPPORT
Website: https://sokonihub.qa
Privacy: https://sokonihub.qa/privacy
Email: support@sokonihub.qa
WhatsApp: +974 6604 6431

name: SOLAPI - 솔라피
description:
솔라피 모바일 앱으로 언제 어디서나 메시지 발송 현황을 확인하고 고객을 관리하세요.

■ 대시보드
발송 현황, 잔액, 최근 활동을 한눈에 확인할 수 있습니다.

■ 메시지 발송·조회
SMS, LMS, MMS, 알림톡, 친구톡 발송 내역을 조회하고 건별 상세 결과를 확인합니다.
그룹별, 상태별 필터로 원하는 메시지를 빠르게 찾고, 앱에서 바로 문자를 보낼 수 있습니다.

■ CRM (고객 관계 관리)
고객, 회사 등 개체별로 레코드를 추가·수정·관리합니다.
세그먼트로 고객을 분류하고, 캘린더 뷰로 일정을 확인할 수 있습니다.

■ 앱 승인 (2차 인증)
콘솔 로그인이나 중요한 작업을 할 때 휴대폰으로 온 요청을 Face ID로 승인합니다.

■ 알림
발송한도 승인, 잔액 부족 같은 주요 이벤트를 푸시 알림으로 받습니다.

■ 설정 및 관리
발신번호, API 키, 웹훅, 발송한도, 사용량을 모바일에서 확인하고 관리합니다.

기존 SOLAPI 콘솔(console.solapi.com) 계정으로 로그인하여 이용할 수 있습니다.

문의: support@solapi.com
홈페이지: https://solapi.com

name: Solevo
description:
Your shoes last longer when you remember what they are made of, how you cared for them, and where wear first appeared. Solevo keeps that information together in a practical shoe journal.
Create a profile for each pair with photos, brand, color, material, size, condition, and personal notes. Add care entries after cleaning, polishing, conditioning, waterproofing, or repair, with before-and-after photos and the products you used.
When a pair begins to change, document the outsole, heel, toe, or upper with dated photos, written notes, wear levels, and optional voice notes. Compare two checks side by side to see what changed. A separate left-and-right sole timeline helps you photograph the same areas over time.
Built-in guides explain how to care for leather, suede, canvas, mesh, nubuck, and synthetic materials. Choose a material and a current need to get clear tools, steps, and methods to avoid.
Solevo replaces scattered photos and forgotten details with one useful history for every pair you own.

name: Solomon's Seal
description:
Turn the rings. Crack the code. Open the chest.

Solomon's Seal is a calm, satisfying puzzle game about the locked treasures of history. Every level is an ancient chest sealed with cipher rings. Rotate the rings until their symbols match the code, before you run out of moves.

Every ring is connected. Turn one and its partners turn with it, so every move is a small chain reaction. Press and hold any ring to see which rings it moves, then plan your solution.

Easy to learn, endlessly clever:
• Linked rings that turn each other, and powerful rings that control several at once
• Reversed links that turn a ring backwards
• Locked rings that open only when their condition is met
• Mirror rings, Caesar shifts, faded symbols and burning fuses
• Seals of up to four rows that test real logic

JOURNEY THROUGH 6 ERAS
Travel from the Stone Age to Ancient Egypt, Rome, China, the Renaissance and the Ottoman Empire. Every era has its own symbols, its own map and its own legendary chest.

OPEN LEGENDARY CHESTS
Beat the final level of each era to open a famous chest: Cleopatra's Pearl Earring, Caesar's Laurel Wreath, Leonardo's Wing Sketch and more.

BUILD HISTORIC VILLAGES
Every level you solve earns a star. Spend stars to raise the Sphinx, finish the Colosseum and build the Silk Road, and watch each village come to life.

FILL YOUR TIME MUSEUM
Collect a priceless artifact from every era and complete your own museum of history.

COMPETE AND SHARE
Climb the weekly league, add friends with a code, and see who unlocks the most eras.

DAILY REWARDS
Claim a free gift every day, keep your win streak going for free boosters, and use golden keys, hints and extra moves when a seal gets tough.

• 300 handcrafted levels, with new levels every month
• Difficulty that rises smoothly, without frustrating spikes
• No timers, no pressure: play at your own pace
• Closed the game mid-level? Pick up right where you left off
• Works offline

Solomon's Seal is free to play. It shows optional ads and offers optional in-app purchases. A one-time "No Ads" purchase removes the ads between levels.

name: Solshot
description:
Solshot is an offline sun planner for the people who work with sunlight but are not photographers: homeowners checking whether a garden gets winter sun, patio and deck builders planning shade, gardeners picking a spot, solar installers scouting a roof, and anyone who wants to know when the golden hour actually happens at a given address.

WHAT IT DOES

SUN PATH DIAGRAM
A polar sun-path chart drawn the way you look at the sky: north at the top, bearings clockwise, the horizon as the outer ring and the zenith at the centre. Your day's arc is drawn in amber, with the June and December solstice arcs and the equinox arc behind it for reference, plus a marker for the sun right now.

SUNRISE, SUNSET, SOLAR NOON
Times to the minute, the bearing the sun rises and sets on, the highest point of the day and its altitude, and the length of daylight.

LIGHT WINDOWS
Golden hour and blue hour for the morning and the evening, plus civil, nautical and astronomical twilight — the times when the light and the shadows behave the way you expect.

SHADOW PLANNER
Enter the height of anything — a fence, a tree, a wall, a person — and see how long its shadow is at 9 AM, noon and 3 PM, and which way it points. Flat-ground geometry, stated plainly, no fake 3D.

REVERSE SEARCH
Pick a bearing or a sun height and ask when it happens next. "When is the sun due west?" gets a date, a time and the altitude at that moment. The search runs over the next 370 days at five-minute resolution and refines each hit by bisection.

CALIBRATION
Real compasses drift, and phone compasses drift more. Solshot lets you enter a fixed bearing offset so the numbers match a known line on site, and an altitude offset for a horizon that is not perfectly flat. Both are shown in the app so nothing is hidden.

PRESETS AND MANUAL COORDINATES
Eight US presets plus a manual latitude and longitude. Solshot never asks for location permission, never reads your GPS and never phones home: the whole app works with the radios off, on a plane, in a basement.

WHO IT IS FOR
- Homeowners comparing rooms, gardens and roofs across the seasons
- Landscapers, deck builders and patio designers planning shade
- Gardeners choosing where to plant
- Solar buyers checking roof orientation before calling an installer
- Photographers who want a planner without a subscription

WHAT IT IS NOT
Solshot is a planning tool, not a surveying instrument. Solar position comes from the NOAA algorithm computed on device and is accurate to about 0.02°, but sunrise and sunset move by minutes behind hills and buildings, and shadows are computed for flat ground only. Not for legal surveying.

NO SUBSCRIPTION, NO ADS, NO ACCOUNT
One purchase, every feature, forever. No sign-in, no analytics, no tracking, no third-party code that reports anything. The privacy label is "no data collected" because that is literally true.

Requires iOS 16.4 or later. Universal app: iPhone, iPad and the wide split layout adapt to the screen.

name: SOME Conspiracies
description:
Not all the conspiracies. Just some.

SOME Conspiracies is a museum of the world's most famous conspiracy folklore — where each theory came from, what believers point to, and what the record shows, kept in one place and told straight.

Every theory in these halls is presented as what people believe — folklore people hold, never asserted as fact by this app. Every claim is attributed to its believers, and every file carries the documented record beside the belief.

EVERY FILE, FIVE ROOMS
The Claim — the belief, stated fairly in believers' terms.
Where It Came From — the person, the date, and the moment it started. This is the room nobody else builds.
The Evidence File — what believers point to, presented as their case.
The Record — what is documented: official findings, verified history, confessions, retractions, and what remains genuinely unexplained.
The Culture — the films, shows, songs, and memes the theory spawned.

THE FOUR SHELVES
Sky & Space — Roswell, Area 51, the Moon landing, ancient astronauts.
Earth Mysteries — the Bermuda Triangle, Atlantis, Bigfoot, the Loch Ness Monster, Mothman.
Power & Secrets — the JFK assassination, the Illuminati, reptilian rulers, the Philadelphia Experiment.
Strange Beliefs & Pop Lore — Flat Earth, Paul Is Dead, the Mandela Effect, Birds Aren't Real.

FREE IN THE MUSEUM
Eight marquee files are free and complete, and the Claim and Where It Came From sections of all 24 files are always free. A rotating File of the Day keeps the door open.

SOME CONSPIRACIES PREMIUM — THE VAULT
Premium opens every file in full: all 24 files complete, Origin Timelines on every file, the Document Shelf of real declassified U.S. government documents (Project Blue Book, MKULTRA releases, the JFK Records releases), every new file drop, offline reading, and bookmarks.

Premium is an auto-renewable subscription: $6.99/month, or $59/year ($4.92/month) with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan. Founding offer: during the launch window, the first year of the annual plan is $39; it renews at the standard $59.

Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://reginalpolk-ui.github.io/app-privacy/some-conspiracies.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

No accounts. No sign-in. No analytics, no ads, no tracking — the museum runs entirely on your device.

name: Sonata Flow
description:
Sonata Flow is a piano practice companion that listens while you play. Put your phone on the music stand, press Start, and play along. Every note you play is checked against the score in real time, so you know right away whether it was the right note, on time, early, late or missed.

PRACTICE WITH INSTANT FEEDBACK
• The score scrolls with the beat and a cursor shows where you are.
• Each note changes color the moment you play it: green for correct, red for a wrong note, orange for early or late, gray for a note you missed.
• See the note the app heard, so you can tell a slip from a real mistake.
• Grand staff support for pieces that use both hands.

A METRONOME THAT KEEPS YOU HONEST
• Every run starts with a one-bar count-in.
• Keep the metronome on for steady time, or switch it off once you feel the pulse.
• Slow the tempo down to 50% to learn a passage, or push it to 120% when you are ready.
• The timing window relaxes when you practice slowly, so slow practice stays encouraging.

A SUMMARY AFTER EVERY RUN
• See your accuracy for the whole piece.
• Get short, specific feedback such as "Bar 7: 2 missed notes" or "right hand rushing".
• A list of trouble spots shows which bars had wrong notes, early or late notes and missed notes.
• One tap starts a slow loop of your hardest bars at 70% speed.

LOOP THE HARD PARTS
• Practice just the bars that trip you up. The loop is highlighted on the score.
• The app keeps checking every pass and restarts the colors each time round, so you can watch a tricky passage get cleaner.
• Go back to the whole piece whenever you like.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Your recent sessions appear on the home screen with accuracy, length and the trickiest bar.
• Today's warm-up suggests a short slow loop on the bars you have struggled with over the last two weeks.

BUILT-IN PIECES
Start right away with pieces for beginners:
• C Major Scale
• Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
• Ode to Joy
• Twinkle, Twinkle with both hands

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Listening happens entirely on your iPhone. Audio is analyzed on the device and never recorded or uploaded.
• No account and no sign-in.
• Practice history stays on your phone.
• Practice works offline, even in airplane mode.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Sonata Flow works with an acoustic piano or a digital piano played through its speakers. Place your iPhone near the instrument in a quiet room for the best results.
• It works best with melodies played one note at a time. When several notes sound together, it recognizes one of them and gives credit to the rest of the chord.
• The microphone is only used while you practice, after you tap Start. You can turn access off at any time in Settings.

Whether you are picking up the piano for the first time or polishing a piece, Sonata Flow turns practice time into clear, focused progress, one bar at a time.

name: sonIQforge
description:
Every great show starts behind the scenes. In sonIQforge you are the concert production engineer who gets the venue ready before the lights go down.

Each level is a short, clear puzzle:

• PLACE the equipment. Tap speakers, microphones, a mixing console, amplifiers and lights, and they take their spots on a 3D stage.
• WIRE it up. Tap a plug, then a matching socket. XLR and jack cables are color-coded, so you always know what fits. Run out of power outlets? Add a power rack.
• TUNE the sound. Move volume, bass and treble sliders into their marked zones and watch every part of the audience turn green.
• SHAPE the light. Pick a style (Rock, Pop, EDM, Jazz or Acoustic) and a color, and see the beams sweep across the stage.
• RUN THE SOUNDCHECK. Get a clear checklist of what works and what doesn't, fix the problems yourself, then start the concert.

Your setup decides the show. Hear your own mix with original music, watch the crowd come to life, and earn up to three stars for placement, cabling, sound quality, lighting and safety.

FEATURES
• 36 levels across 6 chapters, from an underground club to a stadium tour
• A fully 3D venue you can rotate and zoom
• New challenges in every chapter: subwoofers, stage monitors, balconies, wind and rain, moving lights, limited setup time and unexpected equipment faults
• Original synthesized music that reacts to what you connect and how you tune it
• Made for iPhone and iPad
• Works offline, no account, no ads, no in-app purchases

BUILD THE SOUND. CREATE THE SHOW.

name: Soot: Learn Words in Context
description:
Learn new words and expressions by using them in sentences. Read the meaning, fill the blank by typing or speaking, then listen to the complete sentence. Ask for a hint when you need one.

Start at your level and set your own daily goal. Soot brings earlier words back for review so you can practice what you have learned.

Practice English, Spanish, Japanese, and Mandarin Chinese. English is included with the app. Download the other basic packs with their sentence recordings for offline practice.

name: Soroban Flow
description:
Practice with the soroban, the Japanese abacus by Supercerebros. Move the beads in each column and watch the represented number change. You can also enter a whole number and see it appear as bead positions.

• Choose how many columns to use, with room for numbers up to thirteen digits.
• Undo moves, clear the board or switch to focus mode.
• Follow the built-in guide to learn about five-value and unit beads.
• Keep practicing offline. The app saves your last abacus position on your device.
• Use the interface and help in English or Spanish. The app follows your device language, or you can choose a language in the help screen.

The optional “Free lesson” button opens “Introduction to Soroban”, the first exercise in “Soroban from scratch”. This external lesson is in Spanish and can be started as a guest in your browser with an Internet connection. Your App Store purchase gives you access to the abacus. No account, subscriptions or in-app purchases are required.

name: SortIVelle
description:
SortIVelle is a recycling and sorting studio for your pocket. Find out how to sort everyday items, learn what materials are made of, keep a record of the recycling you really do, and play a hands-on game that grows your own virtual recycling center.

Identify. Sort. Build.

SORT GUIDE
• Search more than 50 everyday items, from newspapers and PET bottles to batteries, light bulbs and paint
• Eight categories: paper and cardboard, plastic, glass, metal, organic, electronic, special and general waste
• Every item shows how to sort it, how to prepare it, contamination and safety warnings, and the recommended disposal method
• Not sure what you are holding? Answer five quick questions and see likely matches. If several things fit, the app shows them all instead of pretending to be certain
• Clear, honest guidance: the app separates what is technically recyclable from what your local service accepts and what actually gets recycled, and never invents local rules

MATERIAL ENCYCLOPEDIA AND COLLECTION
• 28 materials explained in plain language: PET, HDPE, PVC, LDPE, PP and PS plastics, paper and cardboard grades, clear, green and brown glass, aluminum, steel, iron, copper, organic matter, electronics, batteries and more
• Characteristics, common products, how each material is recycled, preparation, contamination and compatibility
• Open a material for the first time to add it to your collection and earn Eco Points

MY RECYCLING TRACKER
• Record what you actually recycle, compost or drop off: paper, plastic, glass, metal, composting, e-waste, batteries and more
• Quantity in pieces, grams, kilograms, liters or bags, with an optional note and photo
• Estimated amounts are always kept apart from measured weights
• Filter by category and date, edit or delete any record, and see weekly and monthly activity charts calculated only from your own records
• Your real-world records are never mixed with game progress

THE RECYCLING CENTER
• A live conveyor belt brings objects to your station. Drag each one to the bin of its material, or tap the object and then a bin
• 30 levels with different challenges: calm belts, rush hours, hidden objects to inspect, dirty items to rinse, mixed items to take apart and limited-mistake runs
• Build combos, collect stars and learn why a mistake was a mistake
• Process sorted materials with five machines: Paper Press, Plastic Shredder, Glass Crusher, Metal Compactor and Organic Composter, each with its own upgrades
• Grow your facility through five stages, from a Starter Station to an Eco Innovation Center
• Customize it on a simple grid with more than 45 conveyors, bins, shelves, plants, lights, floors, wall decor and backgrounds

CHALLENGES, ACHIEVEMENTS AND PROFILE
• Daily and weekly challenges that never punish a missed day
• Twelve achievements with real unlock conditions
• Profile with clear statistics and charts, plus a separate history for real-world records and game sessions

DESIGNED FOR EVERYDAY USE
• Colorful, friendly design with light and dark appearance
• Works fully offline. No account, no sign-in, no ads
• Private: everything stays on your device
• A relaxed belt speed option for a calmer game

IMPORTANT
SortIVelle gives general recycling guidance. Rules differ by country, city and collection service, so always check what your local waste authority accepts. Eco Points are a game currency with no monetary value.

name: Sound Chat: Text over the air
description:
Sound Chat sends text between phones in the same room as sound. Type a message and tap Send: your phone plays it as a quick run of tones, and every phone nearby with Sound Chat open hears it and shows the text.

No internet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or pairing, and no account. The phones only have to hear each other.

HOW IT WORKS
• Sound Chat listens while it's open. Messages from phones nearby appear in the conversation, each person in their own colour, with their name if they set one.
• Turn on Confirm What I Hear, and your phone answers each message it hears with a short chirp. The sender then sees who heard it. If nobody did, move closer or turn the volume up and send again: phones that already have the message won't show it twice.
• Audible chirps are the most reliable and reach farthest. Ultrasound is nearly silent but works only up close, and some phones can't hear it. Every phone listens for both at once.
• A message holds up to 560 bytes (560 Latin letters, about half as many in Cyrillic). Longer messages take longer to play, and the composer shows how long.

PRIVATE WHEN YOU WANT
Ordinary messages can be read by anyone nearby with Sound Chat. Set a secret word, and your messages and name are encrypted on your phone before they play: only phones with the same word can open them. The word itself never goes on air. A long phrase is much harder to guess than a short word.

IN THE BACKGROUND
Turn on Listen in the Background, and Sound Chat keeps listening after you leave it, only while the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island show that it is, with what it has heard and a Stop button. It can also notify you about each new message.

PRIVACY
Sound is decoded on your phone as it arrives. It is never recorded, stored or sent anywhere. Sound Chat makes no network connections: no accounts, no analytics, no ads. Your messages and names stay on your phone.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Keep the phones within a few metres, with the volume up.
• While a phone is sending, it can't hear others, so take turns.
• Plain text sent from other ggwave apps shows up too.
• iPhone and iPad, in English and Ukrainian.

Sound Chat is free. It turns text into sound with ggwave by Georgi Gerganov.

name: SoundFerry
description:
Turn a nearby compatible iPhone or iPad into a wireless speaker for audio that’s already playing.

Open SoundFerry on both devices. Choose Send Audio on one and use the other as a speaker. After pairing, open the media output picker in Control Center on the sending device and select the speaker.

• Connect directly over Wi-Fi Aware, without joining the same Wi-Fi router.
• Adjust the speaker’s playback volume from the sending device, or tap the center of the receiver screen to mute.
• Watch the receiver’s particles respond to sound.

Sending requires iOS or iPadOS 27 or later. Receiving requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. Both devices need Wi-Fi Aware support. Availability depends on the source app and its content’s support for system media output.

name: Soundform: Reverse Audio
seller_name: Shenzhen Force Mars Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
Hear your voice from a different angle.

Soundform brings reverse playback, recording, voice effects, audio conversion, and meeting notes into one easy-to-use audio studio. Capture an idea, give it a new sound, and share what you create.

RECORD. REPLAY. REVERSE.
Record a voice memo, a melody, or a moment. Pause and resume your take, save it with a name, then listen forwards or backwards. Explore the waveform to find the part you want to hear again.

FIND A NEW SOUND
Try six playful effects: Echo, Helium, Robot, Reverb, Radio, and Deep Bass. Choose a character, hear a preview, and give your recording a different personality. Start with a new recording, import an audio file, or enter text to turn your words into spoken audio.

CHOOSE YOUR FORMAT
Convert audio to MP3, AAC, WAV, AIFF, FLAC, ALAC, CAF, WavPack, Ogg Vorbis, or Ogg Opus. Adjust the available sample rate, bit rate or bit depth, and mono or stereo settings to suit your file. Review file details, keep track of completed conversions, and export the result.

TURN SPEECH INTO NOTES
Record a meeting or an idea and turn speech into editable text. Choose a transcription language, follow the live transcript, then review the recording and refine your notes. Save or share the audio and text when you are ready.

KEEP YOUR SOUNDS TOGETHER
Find recordings and voice changes in your library. Check the duration, file size, and creation time. Rename a take, replay it, save a copy to Files, or remove what you no longer need.

SHARE WHAT YOU MAKE
Send a reversed recording, a new voice, or a converted audio file through the iOS share sheet. From a quick voice memo to a funny sound for a friend, it is ready when you are.

Recordings and saved files stay in the app's library on your device. Speech recognition availability and accuracy depend on the language, device, and system services; some transcription may require a network connection. Character voices use system speech voices and audio effects.

name: SpacioHub
description:
SpacioHub is the room booking app for your workplace.

See which rooms are free right now, book one in two taps, and get on with your day. Your phone reminds you before every meeting and helps you keep the room.

BOOK IN SECONDS
- See every room that is free now, with how long it stays free
- Book 30 minutes, an hour, or pick your own time
- Filter rooms by number of seats

NEVER LOSE YOUR ROOM
- A heads-up 15 minutes before your meeting
- Scan the code on the room door to check in, so the room is not released
- Extend a meeting by 30 minutes from your bookings

ASK MIRA
- Type what you need: "Book a room for 6 people tomorrow at 2pm"
- Mira finds rooms, checks your schedule and looks up colleagues

INVITE VISITORS
- Add a guest ahead of time so reception and your team know they are coming

STAY IN THE LOOP
- Alerts for new bookings, changes and room orders
- Announcements from your workplace on the Home screen

WORKS WITH YOUR WORKPLACE
- Sign in with your work email, Google or Microsoft account
- Pairs with SpacioHub door displays outside each room
- Your admin sets up rooms, teams and rules; you just book

SpacioHub needs an account from your workplace. New businesses can sign up at spaciohub.com.

name: Speak To Win: Speaking Coach
description:
Find out why people don't listen to you.

Speak for 30 seconds. Speak To Win shows you what works in your voice, and what holds you back: your pace, your pauses, your filler words, your melody, the way your sentences end.

Then your personal coach trains you, one short day at a time.

YOUR VOICE, MEASURED
- Answer a simple question, out loud, like in real life.
- See your pace, your pauses and how your voice carries.
- Listen back to yourself, and see exactly what people hear.

ONE SHORT DAY AT A TIME
Every day takes 10 to 15 minutes:
- Comeback: a skill you know, a little harder
- Lesson: one new technique
- Train: your voice, measured
- Train again: until it feels natural
- Real-life test: the meeting, the date

Your next day opens tomorrow. A little every day is how it sticks.

EVERYTHING GREAT SPEAKERS DO
- Pace and pauses: slow down, and let silence work for you
- Breath and power: a voice that carries without shouting
- Voice melody: sound sure of yourself, never flat
- Filler words: drop the um, the like, the sorry
- Clear articulation: every word lands the first time
- Structure: one sentence, then three points
- Conversation and charm: first lines, questions, real listening
- Storytelling: stories people remember and repeat
- Body language: posture, hands and eye contact that holds
- Calm under pressure: a two-minute routine before any big moment

FOR THE MOMENTS THAT MATTER
In meetings, on first dates, meeting new people, with your friends, when you negotiate, in job interviews.

SEE YOURSELF GET BETTER
Every skill comes back a little harder, and the app shows you the number. Every 7 days, a final test gives you a score out of 100 and the skill to train next.

SUBSCRIPTION
Speak To Win is a subscription: monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Privacy: https://speaktowin.app/privacy/
Terms: https://speaktowin.app/terms/

name: SpectraBay
description:
SpectraBay turns a short integer PCM WAV into an inspectable frequency analysis. Choose the actual samples and settings, read the computed bins, and save the numeric result with the information needed to understand its scale.

START WITH REAL PCM
Choose a supported WAV from Files and confirm the import after reviewing its header. Clip Overview shows sample rate, channels, bit depth, duration and source SHA-256. An explicit Create synthetic sample action creates a real 1-second mono PCM16 WAV at 32,768 Hz containing a labeled 1024 Hz sine, so you can explore the workflow without a private recording.

SET THE ANALYSIS QUESTION
Select a saved clip and sample interval [start, end), including the start and excluding the end. Choose Mono, Left, Right or the arithmetic stereo Mean as available. Select FFT length 1024, 2048 or 4096, a Hann or rectangular window, and original PCM scale or unit-peak normalization. The setup shows bin spacing, half-window hop, complete window count and unused tail samples.

READ NUMBERS AS WELL AS COLOR
Switch between the root-mean-square amplitude of each bin across windows and an individual window. Move the bin control to inspect frequency, linear amplitude and digital-reference dB. A logarithmic frequency curve omits DC from the curve while retaining its numeric readout. Window gain and single-sided endpoint scaling are handled explicitly; normalization records its factor.

Inspect a spectrogram from the same computed windows. Bounded display grouping is identified separately from the underlying bin/window values. The peak table lists up to five non-DC local maxima, with a defined tie rule; silence has no invented peak. Digital amplitude dB is not sound-pressure level, and a frequency bin is not an exact pitch estimate.

SAVE AND TAKE THE RESULT WITH YOU
Save an analysis, reopen it in Reports, and explore the frozen numeric spectrum and settings. Compose actual spectrum CSV, window-summary CSV and/or PDF output, with source/settings provenance and a file-hash manifest. A window summary is not a full spectrogram matrix. Preview the PDF or share the real files you choose. A saved numeric analysis can remain readable if its original is missing, while a fresh analysis requires an intact original.

Delete an individual analysis and its outputs while keeping the clip, or delete a clip with its associated analyses and internal exports. About provides confirmed clearing of the app library. External originals, already shared copies and system backups are separate. The native tools require no app login.

SUPPORTED INPUT
Complete little-endian RIFF/WAVE, format tag 1, signed 16/24/32-bit integer PCM, one or two channels, 8-48 kHz, at least 1024 sample frames, at most 30 seconds and 12 MiB. Float, Extensible WAV, compressed audio and multiple data chunks are unsupported. This app does not record a microphone, edit audio or classify sounds.

name: Spike Ticket
description: Spike Ticket keeps a print job and puts that ticket on the spike. Drag it up and to the right, at least 70 points across and 48 points up, and the ticket covers the spike. Spiked lists the job. The pages can be read in English, Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish, German, or Japanese. The ticket stays on this iPhone.

name: Spindle Cascade Mind
description:
Spindle Cascade Mind brings together three original logic puzzles, each built around a different way of thinking. Patchwork asks you to study cut-out holes and choose exactly the right set of patches — mirror images and rotated look-alikes are there to trip you up. Bead Cipher gives you a colour key mapped to cradle directions; paint every bead correctly, and on harder chapters the key folds away from view so you rely on memory alone. Peg Cascade sends marbles through a cabinet of tilting pegs — flip the gold ones until every marble lands in its matching colour bin.

All 54 levels are handcrafted and solver-verified, so each has exactly one fair solution. A daily challenge with streak tracking adds a fresh board every day across all three games. Journey mode ties your progress into a chapter-based map with mastery titles and star ratings, while Insights breaks down your solve times, move counts and achievements. Workshop mode lets you design, test and save your own boards for any of the three games.

Hints, undo and restart are always available at no cost. No account or sign-in is needed — your progress, replays and Workshop creations are stored locally on your device.

name: Spite & Malice: vs Computer
description:
Spite & Malice is the two-player card game, played here against the computer.

Play a full game on your iPhone or iPad. Choose one of three computer levels: Easy, Medium or Hard. Your results are kept for each level, with your current and longest win streak.

PAY ONCE. NO ADS. NO ACCOUNT.
• One price. No subscriptions and no in-app purchases.
• No ads on any screen.
• No account and no sign-in.
• No internet connection needed. Everything stays on your device.

CARDS YOU CAN READ
• Large, clear cards on iPhone, larger still on iPad.
• Light and dark mode.
• Menu and screen text grows with the system text size, up to the largest accessibility size.
• VoiceOver reads every card and every pile.

HOW A TURN WORKS
• Build piles up from Ace to Queen. Kings and jokers are wild.
• Play from your hand, from the top of your payoff pile, or from the top of your four discard piles.
• End your turn by discarding a card on one of your four discard piles.
• The first player to play the last card of their payoff pile wins.
• A summary of the rules is inside the app.

MADE FOR QUICK GAMES
• Undo your last move during your turn.
• Save your game and continue later, exactly where you left it.
• Statistics: games, wins and losses by level, current streak and longest streak.
• The computer's moves are animated. You can turn the animation off in Settings.

Spite & Malice is a traditional card game. This app is an independent version with its own card drawings.

name: Spool Yard: Thread Sort
description:
Pull colored spools from the front of your racks and weave each pattern on the loom. Matching threads weave immediately. Other colors wait in three holding slots. Read the next threads, undo a pull, or restart the pattern to try a different route.

Tap Start weaving for ad-free play. Adult studio adds optional rewarded undos and a one-time Studio Pass that removes studio banners and includes unlimited undos.

name: Spotvale: Spot the Difference
description:
A museum with a curious owl curator called Lumo... The walls are bare and the paintings are waiting for you. Find the seven differences between two illustrated pictures, and every painting you solve is hung in your museum.

Spotvale is a calm, beautiful spot-the-difference game. These aren't ordinary photos: they are storybook scenes painted in rich detail. Reading rooms, Mediterranean harbors, magic workshops, gardens and festivals.

Highlights
• Hundreds of clever differences: vases that change color, keys that vanish, tiny objects sneaked onto a shelf.
• Pinch to zoom: both paintings zoom and pan together, so no detail escapes you.
• Build your museum: five wings, each with its own theme. Solved paintings hang on the walls in golden frames.
• Lumo: a kind, curious and slightly pompous owl curator. He cheers you on, gives hints and sometimes yawns. Fully voiced in 11 languages.
• Every difference is a note: find all seven and a little melody is complete.
• Painting of the Day: the same painting for everyone, every day. Keep your streak and share your result.
• No rush: no time limit and no lives; the clock only tracks your personal best. Stuck? Use the magnifier (with gold or a short ad).
• Play anywhere: works offline, 11 languages.

Free to play with ads. An optional one-time in-app purchase removes the ads between paintings.

name: SpurGemHaul
description:
SpurGem on pystysuuntainen pulmapeli puupalkkien tukemassa kaivoksessa. Värikkäät vaunut kuljettavat jalokiviä rautakiskoja pitkin, ja jokaisen vaunun on päästävä oman väriseen varastoon.

Napauta pyöreää kääntöpöytää tai kolmionmuotoista vaihdetta vaihtaaksesi kahden raideosuuden yhdistelmää. Valitse vaunun lähtövuoro napauttamalla sitä. Värillinen reittiesikatselu näyttää kulkureitin ennen kuin vaunut lähtevät liikkeelle.

Kaksi vaunua ei voi käyttää samaa risteystä samalla vuorolla, eikä samalla kiskonosuudella voi olla kahta vaunua yhtä aikaa. Neljä huolellisesti suunniteltua kuljetustehtävää etenevät yksinkertaisesta vuorottelusta kolmen vaunun risteävään reittiin.

Jalokiviluettelo esittelee kuljetettavat jalokivet ja raideosat. Vaihdeharjoituksessa voit pyörittää yhtä kääntöpöytää ja kokeilla pientä risteystilannetta. Kuljetusmuistio tallentaa tulokset tähän laitteeseen, ja tallennetut tiedot voi myös tyhjentää.

name: Squad Up: Rally Your Squad
description:
Your people. One tap.

Tap SQUAD UP! and everyone in your squad gets an alert. Each person answers with a real time: in now, 5, 15 or 30 minutes out, or can't make it. You know in seconds if you've got enough to play, not after 40 texts.

BUILT FOR CREWS
• Gaming squads on console and PC
• Pickup basketball, flag football and Turkey Bowls
• Soccer, run clubs and Sunday league

PLAN AHEAD
• Schedule a game and set a player goal, like 10 for 5-on-5
• Get a reminder before it starts
• Not sure when everyone's free? Offer a few times and let the squad vote

MORE THAN A GROUP CHAT
• Squad chat with @mentions, plus RSVPs, in one place
• Challenge another squad and report the score
• Quiet hours, so alerts don't wake you up
• Report or block anyone, any time

JOIN IN SECONDS
Make a squad and share the invite link or code. Friends join in seconds. No account needed to try it: pick a name and you're in. Save it later with Sign in with Apple, Google or email.

name: Stack It Sky High
description:
Stack it sky high — one tap at a time!

Stack It Sky High is a one-tap stacking game. A block slides back and forth above your tower — tap to drop it. Land it perfectly and the full block stays. Drop it off-centre and the overhang is cut away, leaving a smaller block to build on. Miss the tower completely and you lose a life.

Climb 1,000 levels: the target grows by 1 block every level, up to 30 blocks, with a checkpoint every 10 levels. Earn coins for perfect drops and spend them in the store.

Simple to learn, hard to master — how high can you stack?

Free with ads.

name: Stack Tower Merge
description:
Match identical blocks to make bigger numbers and reach the goal in each level. Plan ahead to make room on the board and work around each world’s obstacles.

• Play 115 levels across six worlds: Tower, Forest, Ice, Volcano, Candy, and Cave.
• Tackle logs, ice, lava rocks, chocolate bars, and timed challenges.
• Use power-ups when you get stuck, and return to the map to replay levels and beat your high scores.

Stack Tower Merge does not require an account. The optional one-time Remove Ads purchase removes banner ads and ads shown between matches. You can still choose to watch rewarded videos for in-game bonuses and power-ups. The current in-game interface is in Brazilian Portuguese.

name: Stadmaatje
description:
Den Haag ontdekken en je weg vinden, stap voor stap.

Stadmaatje brengt de plekken en praktische informatie van Den Haag samen op één kaart. Zoek wat je nodig hebt, bekijk wat er dichtbij is en plan je volgende stap.

• Bekijk echte 3D-gebouwen in het centrum, met bootjes en je eigen personage.
• Zoek sportvelden, eten, bioscopen en plekken in de stad. Dichtstbij eerst.
• Check bij sportvelden de verlichting, sluitingstijden en drukte-indicatie.
• Ontdek evenementen, wandelingen, Haagse Markt en plekken voor vandaag.
• Bekijk afvalcontainers en ophaaldagen voor je adres.
• Volg een verhuisgids met praktische stappen voor wonen in Den Haag.
• Open routes in Apple Kaarten of Google Maps.

Stadmaatje is gratis en bevat geen advertenties. Je logt in met Apple, Google of je e-mail.

name: StageDial
description:
StageDial turns a work session into an ordered sequence of timed stages. Create a sequence with named stages lasting 1 to 180 minutes, then select it in Session. Start, pause and resume the current stage, move to the next stage deliberately, or finish early. A saved deadline restores the countdown after relaunch. Each stage waits for your action before the next begins. Completed sessions retain their actual active time and stage count. This is a foreground work timer; it does not play alarms or send background notifications.

Free, without accounts, advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Core functions work offline. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance.

name: Stagione Basket: game tracker
description:
Stagione Basket is your basketball season notebook: log each game in a few seconds and the app gives you back stats, milestones and memories to share with your family and the team.

FOR PARENTS (Athlete profile)
• Points, free throws, 2s and 3s (made and attempted), minutes, fouls and rating
• Starter or off the bench
• Live from the stands: game clock, quarters and overtime, +1 +2 +3 for both teams, made and missed shots, fouls
• Shot chart: where the points came from, basket by basket (paint, mid-range, three)
• Shooting percentages, points per game, best game, share of the team's points
• Game-by-game and month-by-month trends, points per opponent, home and away
• Milestones and records: first points, first three, first double-figure game, point number 100, and how far the next one is
• The next game at the top, with a reminder
• "The season so far": the story of the season to swipe through and share, also as a video
• Player card, monthly stickers and a PDF season book
• Images of the game, the month, the season and the goals, ready for WhatsApp

description:
Star Jar turns the classic star chart into a world your kids can't wait to grow.
