name: StateOrchard FSM
description:
Follow every input through a finite state machine—and keep the evidence.

StateOrchard is a local deterministic Mealy-model notebook. Define a small transition table, replay an input word, find a shortest route between states, or compare two models for the shortest output difference. Cycles are supported. It is not a hardware controller, AI model generator or a claim that a depth-limited search proves equivalence.

MAKE THE RULES EXPLICIT
Name states, declare single-character input symbols, choose an initial state and edit or import real transition CSV/JSON. Each state/input pair can have only one next state and output. Empty output is retained and displayed as epsilon. Incomplete drafts may be saved, with missing pairs listed clearly; running, path search and comparison require a complete deterministic table. Unreachable states are shown rather than quietly removed.

REPLAY EACH STEP
Run up to256 input characters without silently skipping spaces or changing case. Inspect the state before, input, state after and output at every step. Output boundaries remain a sequence, including empty outputs. An empty word is a valid zero-step trace; an unknown symbol produces an actionable rejection at its actual position.

SEARCH, WITH A REASON
Breadth-first state search returns a shortest input path, using the declared alphabet order to break ties. Equal start/target gives the empty path; exhausting reachable states gives No path. Compare two complete models with the same input-alphabet set using product-state BFS. A differing output yields a shortest distinguishing word with both complete traces and the first differing step. Only exhaustion of all reachable pairs is called Equivalent; reaching the chosen depth limit is Inconclusive.

FREEZE AND EXPORT
Save trace, path or comparison evidence with complete model snapshots and revisions. Later model edits or deletion cannot rewrite reports. Export actual transition CSV and model JSON, or a frozen report’s transition/trace CSV, full JSON and paginated PDF. Inspect filenames/bytes and use native preview/system sharing. Formula-like CSV text receives an explicit safety prefix while JSON preserves original values.

FINITE, DELIBERATE LIMITS
1–24 states,1–8 single-character input symbols,192 transitions,32 output characters,256 trace symbols, comparison length1–128 and at most576 reachable state pairs. Imports≤256 KiB;30 models/50 reports/8 MiB library. Exports≤16 MiB, PDF content≤2 MiB/500 pages. No network model service, hardware capture, advertising, App login or IAP is required.

name: StayCharted AMT
description:
StayCharted AMT puts the AI models your team trained in StayCharted AI Model Trainer on your phone.

Take a photo of a part, a product or a defect, or type a question, and get the answer your team's own model gives, with how confident it is. When the model isn't sure, the question goes to your team to check, and their answer teaches the next version.

Know what something is? Send it as a training example: a photo or text with the category it belongs to. Someone on your team approves it before it teaches the model, so nothing changes until a person has checked it.

Sign in with your StayCharted account to use every published model in your workspace. Field technicians, contractors and counter staff without an account can use one model with an access code or its QR code. Whoever made the code decides how long it works, on how many phones, how many answers a day, and whether it may send examples.

- Photos are resized on your phone and sent only to answer your question or to send your example.
- The app never asks for your location.
- No ads and no tracking.

Models are built and trained in StayCharted AI Model Trainer on the web (amt.staycharted.com). The app uses models that are already published.

name: Staystamp: Schengen 90/180
description:
Staystamp counts your days in the Schengen area and tells you, in one look, how many you have left.

The rule is simple to say and hard to do in your head: no more than 90 days in any 180 days. Enter your trips once and Staystamp does the counting, day by day.

Since April 2026 the EU's Entry/Exit System counts your days at the border. Staystamp helps you count them before you go.

SEE WHERE YOU STAND
• Days left today, in one big stamp
• A 180-day grid with every Schengen day marked
• When days come back, and how many

PLAN BEFORE YOU BOOK
• How long can I stay if I enter on this date?
• Do these dates fit? If not, see the first day that goes over and the earliest entry that works
• Planned trips count too

EVERY COUNTRY, EVERY YEAR
• Days per country for each calendar year, Schengen or not
• Entry and exit days both count, and a travel day counts for both countries

COUNTRIES HANDLED WITH CARE
• All 29 Schengen countries, with the dates Croatia, Bulgaria and Romania joined
• Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City count; Andorra does not
• Islands and overseas territories follow clear rules, listed in the app

YOUR TRIPS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
• No account, no server, no ads, no tracking
• Works offline
• Export a backup file whenever you like and restore it on a new iPhone

Light and dark mode, large text and VoiceOver are supported.

Staystamp is free. All features are included.

NOT OFFICIAL ADVICE
Staystamp is not official advice and is not connected to the European Union or any government. Residence permits, long-stay visas, bilateral agreements and other exceptions are not taken into account. Check with the authorities before you travel; the border officer always has the final say.

name: StepClasp
description:
Turn recurring work into an ordered procedure you can actually follow. Build a template with named steps, reorder it and keep useful notes. Start a new run whenever you repeat the process.

Each run has its own step list and progress. Check steps as you work, finish only when all steps are complete, and review active or completed runs. Editing the template never rewrites an existing run. Search procedures, edit them, share a numbered list and delete records with confirmation.

name: StepDocket
description:
Build reusable procedures from ordered steps and notes. Move steps into the right order, start a run and check off each action. Progress is saved immediately, so you can leave and resume later. Finish after every step is checked and review completed runs. Each run keeps its own procedure snapshot, so template edits never rewrite past work.

Core workflows work offline. Free, with no ads, in-app purchases or account. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian in Settings. Light, Dark and System appearance are included. Export your local records as JSON.

name: StepHarbor
description:
StepHarbor turns repeatable work into reusable step lists. Create a process with a category, notes and ordered steps. Reorder or remove steps while editing. Start a fresh run that keeps its own snapshot, even if the original process later changes or is deleted. Check or uncheck steps as you work, finish only when every step is complete, and review finished runs in History. Search your process library by name or category.

name: Stick Set
description:
Stick Set keeps each line on this iPhone.

The stick measure is 6. Each sort is only width 1, 2, or 3. A sort joins when its width fits the space left, and the space left drops by that width. A wider sort stays outside and the line does not change. Space left 0 means the line is justified. Pull the last sort back only while the line is not justified. After the line is justified, placing and pulling do nothing. A justified line cannot be deleted.

You can name the line. Share sends the name and whether the line is justified. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: still.: Phone Down Focus Timer
description:
still. is a focus timer you start by putting your phone down.

name: Stillweft - Darkroom Proofing
description:
Stillweft brings the deliberate elegance of the classic photographic darkroom into a modern, tactile iOS experience. Designed for photographers, visual artists, and print purists, Stillweft simplifies the curation of contact sheets, precision crop calibration, and sequence proofing.

KEY CAPABILITIES:

1. BATCH CURATION & CONTACT SHEETS
Import photo collections into sandboxed working projects. Generate traditional high-density contact sheets with customizable grid geometries, margin balances, and paper format simulations.

2. PRECISION CROP EDITOR
Inspect individual frames with dynamic zoom and compositional guide overlays. Calibrate aspect ratios with non-destructive crop bounds that preserve original source files.

3. SEQUENCE WORKFLOW & KEEPER MARKS
Tag candidate frames directly on the proofing table. Drag handles to refine frame sequences, compare adjacent exposures side by side, and build structured portfolios.

4. DENSITY & EXPOSURE INSPECTION
Evaluate luminance distribution, micro-contrast, and tonal balance with calibrated inspector tools designed for film and digital captures alike.

5. PRINTS & ARCHIVAL EXPORTS
Export complete contact sheets as high-resolution bitmap sheets or multi-page PDF documents. Share project packages with standard JSON descriptors for cross-device backup.

Stillweft works entirely on device with zero required accounts, ensuring that your raw captures and private proofs stay safely inside your local workspace.

name: Stitch Screenshot Combiner
description:
Completely free. The only in-app purchases are optional tips.

Stitch joins overlapping screenshots into one tall image. Scroll through a chat, an article, a recipe or a settings page, taking a screenshot at each step. Pick them in Stitch and it works out their order and where each one overlaps the next.

WHAT IT DOES
• Joins two screenshots or dozens into a single image, at full size
• Works out the order from the content, even if you pick them out of order
• Shows a header or footer that repeats in every screenshot just once
• Works whether or not you cropped the screenshots first
• Hides the scroll bars that screenshots catch
• Shows the result before you save, with every join marked

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Drag any join up or down if it needs a nudge; double tap to put it back
• Crop the top and bottom of the result, or remove the top or bottom bar in one tap
• Save as JPEG or PNG, or share straight to another app
• Optionally delete the screenshots you used. iOS asks you to confirm first

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything happens on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded
• No account, no sign-in, no analytics, no ads, no tracking
• Stitch only sees the screenshots you pick

GOOD TO KNOW
• Requires iOS 26 or later
• Leave a little of the previous screen visible in each screenshot. If two share nothing, Stitch places them end to end and tells you
• It is a stitcher, not an image editor, and it cannot take scrolling screenshots for you

FREE, FOR GOOD
Stitch is made by Stave Hoop Labs, a small lab that builds free utilities. If it helped, you can leave an optional tip from the About screen. Tips unlock nothing; the whole app is free.

name: StockLoom
description:
Track everyday household consumables in whole units. Give each supply a location, current quantity, low-stock threshold and target quantity. name: Story Dice: Roll and Create

Whether you're making up a bedtime adventure, practicing creative writing, or telling a funny story with friends, Story Dice makes it easy to get started.

ROLL, REVEAL & IMAGINE

MAKE EVERY STORY YOUR OWN

Arrange your illustrated dice in any order you like. Begin with a mysterious place, introduce an unusual character, or let an unexpected object change the direction of your story.

TELL IT OR WRITE IT

What story will your next roll inspire?

name: StowBay Load Space
description:
StowBay is for warehouse loaders stuffing a truck or van bay. Enter the next carton’s length, width, and height in inches and see Fits or No Fit plus cubic feet left on the same screen. Tap Load into bay to subtract that volume and add the carton to today’s manifest. Set empty bay size on Bay, review what you loaded on Manifest, and clear the bay when the truck leaves.

Everything stays on your device. No account, ads, or purchases.

Sample on first launch: bay 8×7×6 ft with one seed tote already loaded so remaining capacity is visible immediately.

name: Stowglen
description:
Stowglen is a moving ledger that runs entirely offline. It does not just count how many boxes you packed — it records what was inside each box at the moment you sealed it, which trip carried it, who confirmed the receipt, and which drawer it finally ended up in.
BEFORE THE MOVE: TURN BOXES INTO RECORDS
Start a move with an origin, a destination and a date. Rooms, furniture, drawers and shelves become named placement spots, so a location is "Study / Bookcase / Shelf A" instead of "somewhere in the study". Boxes hold pouches, codes are yours to choose (1–16 characters), printed on the label and easy to say out loud.
Log items with whole-number quantities, notes and photos. A duplicate name raises a warning but never merges two records silently — two identical chairs are two chairs. Drafts survive interruption and only enter the ledger when you save.
ON MOVING DAY: SEALING IS THE PROOF
Sealing a box creates an immutable snapshot: a seal version, the time, every pouch, item and quantity inside at that moment. Later edits cannot rewrite it, so "there were four of them when I sealed it" stays checkable.
Labels are real QR stickers: a 100×70 mm single label, a six-up A4 sheet, or a PNG. Print them from the system print dialog. Edit something relevant and the label is marked as needing a reprint, rather than leaving outdated paper on the box.
Trips carry the day: a route, a vehicle name and the boxes you plan to load. Scanning a label finds the box — with a flashlight, manual code entry and a fallback when camera access is denied. The scan only identifies the label; loading and receipt are always your confirmation. Nothing is ever auto-received on arrival, because that is how boxes get lost.
IN THE NEW PLACE: UNPACK BY ROOM, PLACE BY SPOT
Unpack room by room, choosing furniture and shelf, switching boxes as you go. The sealed baseline and your current placement progress are counted separately, so repeating an action never inflates the total. Confirm placed, keep in the box, or flag for checking — each leaves its own record.
WHEN SOMETHING DOESN'T ADD UP
Not found here, found elsewhere, quantity differs, unexpected item — each difference needs a reason, optional notes, an evidence photo, and can be linked to the exact record it belongs to. "Not found" stays unresolved in a move-level inbox instead of quietly disappearing.
FIND ANYTHING LATER
Search item names, notes and box or pouch codes, filtered by placed, still in a box or needs locating, across one move or all of them. Every result shows the full recorded path, the last confirmed location and time, the seal-level check status and the event history.
A RECORD YOU CAN HAND OVER
Inventory PDFs optionally include item history and a photo appendix; trip manifests export on their own; and a full checksummed backup (.stowglen) carries every record plus the referenced photos. Restore verifies before replacing, or imports the file as an independent copy without touching your current data — and your existing ledger is backed up before any replacement.
IT STAYS ON THIS DEVICE
No account, no cloud sync, no analytics, no advertising. The ledger and photos live on your phone. Camera access is asked for only when you scan a label or take a photo, and photos come from the scoped system picker rather than your whole library. Files leave the app only when you choose a destination in the share sheet.
Designed for iPhone on iOS 15 and later.

name: Stratum Delta
description:
A Stratum Delta egy mobil számítási eszköz, amelyet geotermikus fűtési projektekhez fejlesztettek ki. Lehetővé teszi a kúttervezők, szivattyútelepítők és fűtésmérnökök számára, hogy – közvetlenül okostelefonjukról – gyorsan elvégezzék a hőegyensúly-ellenőrzéseket, beleértve a kutat, a szivattyút és az épületet is. Az alkalmazás teljesen offline módban működik; minden adat helyileg, a készüléken tárolódik, és nincs szükség felhasználói fiók regisztrálására.

Az olyan paraméterek megadásával, mint a kút hőmérséklete, az áramlási sebesség, a hőmérséklet-különbség (ΔT) és az épület jellemzői, az alkalmazás automatikusan kiszámítja az épület hőterhelését, a kútból kinyerhető hőmennyiséget, a szükséges térfogatáramot és emelőmagasságot, valamint az energiafogyasztást és az üzemeltetési költségeket. Az eredmények egy intuitív „egyensúlyjelzőn” (piros, sárga és zöld jelzésekkel) jelennek meg. Emellett az alkalmazás felhívja a figyelmet a lehetséges kockázatokra – például a hőmérsékletek és a kúttípusok közötti eltérésekre, a nyílt rendszerű kutaknál a vízutánpótlás tervezésének hiányára, vagy a megfelelő szivattyú hiányára –, lehetővé téve a problémák azonosítását és kezelését már a tervezési szakaszban. Széles körű kúttípus-támogatás: Az alkalmazás kezeli a nyílt rendszerű kutakat, a zárt rendszerű talajhőcserélőket (szondákat), valamint a termálforrásokat és egyéb geotermikus forrásokat. A rendszer a hőmérsékleti tartományok alapján automatikusan ellenőrzi az egyes kúttípusok megfelelőségét, és javaslatokat tesz a típusok közötti választásra.
Intelligens hőegyensúly-számító motor: Kiszámítja az épület hőterhelését – akár a alapterület és a fajlagos hőterhelés szorzata, akár ismert hőveszteség-értékek alapján –, és értékeli a kutak rendelkezésre álló hőkinyerési kapacitását (az SCOP-érték figyelembevételével). Megadja a fennmaradó kapacitás százalékos arányát, valamint az éves villamosenergia-fogyasztást és a becsült költségeket.
Automatikus szivattyúkiválasztás: Beépített szivattyúkatalógussal rendelkezik; a rendszer a megadott munkapontok (térfogatáram × emelőmagasság) alapján automatikusan kiválasztja a megfelelő szivattyúmodelleket. A felhasználók saját elemekkel is bővíthetik a katalógust.
Talajhőcserélő hosszának számítása: A hőigény, a fajlagos hőkinyerési teljesítmény, a fúrásmélység és a fúrások száma alapján gyorsan meghatározza a talajhőcserélő csővezeték teljes szükséges hosszát.
Helyszíni ellenőrző lista: Projekt-specifikus, lépésről lépésre követhető kivitelezési ellenőrző listát biztosít, amely lehetővé teszi a munka előrehaladásának valós idejű nyomon követését. PDF-jelentés exportálása: Egyetlen kattintással hivatalos jelentés készíthető, amely tartalmazza a hőegyensúlyi paramétereket és a kiválasztott szivattyúmodelleket. A jelentés a rendszer beépített megosztási felületén keresztül közvetlenül továbbítható az ügyfeleknek, vagy elmenthető dokumentációs célból.
Szerepkör alapú felhasználói élmény: Az első indításkor a kezdőképernyő a felhasználó szerepkörének (pl. tervező, kivitelező stb.) megfelelően alakul ki. A kezelőfelület négy, könnyen áttekinthető fülre tagolódik: Kezdőlap, Projektek, Szivattyúk és Egyebek.
Gyorselérésű eszközök: A funkciók között megtalálhatók mértékegység-átváltók, gyorsbecslő eszközök, valamint az alapértelmezett paraméterek (például SCOP, hőmérséklet-különbség – ΔT, illetve a szivattyú emelőmagasságához tartozó biztonsági tényezők) központi beállítási lehetősége.

name: Stringing Band
description: Stringing Band keeps one groove on this iPhone. Each shoulder is square or pared. The band starts at the mouth. Slide it while a shoulder is still square and it stops at that shoulder and stays in the groove. Pull it back to the mouth. A pared shoulder stays pared. Pare the left shoulder, then the right. When both are pared, slide the band and it seats at the far end. A seated band does not pull out. Name a groove, open it from the list, and share the sentence. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: STTVScapital One
description:
STTVScapitalOne is a household ledger that stays on this phone. Keep the doorstep slips, the papers that expire, the words for a cheque, a hill plot in ropani, and a short fuel note — all in one desk.

The sample house, North Porch, is already on the first screen. Hari’s milk slip is open. Ram’s jars and Gopal’s cylinder are settled, with the deposit and the count still with you. A licence, a registration, motor insurance, and road tax are dated. One scooter and one terrace plot are filled in so you can see the shape before you change a figure.

Suppliers
Each card shows the rate, what is still owed, and the last round. Same as last repeats the previous quantity. Delivered adds a round at the rate on the card. Paid takes a whole sum or a part of it, and it never takes more than the open balance. Jars and cylinders also keep a count of what is still at the house, and Returned brings one back. History lists every line. Settle pays a supplier down to zero. The month page marks the days that hold a line or an expiry.

Renewals, fuel, and land
A paper shows issued, expires, and days left. Inside 45 days the pill turns clay. Renew +1 year keeps any days still left. Fuel records a fill against the odometer and only counts economy when the reading moves forward. Land measure adds ropani, aana, paisa, and daam, then shows square metres and a Terai bigha comparison. The two land systems are shown side by side. They are not treated as the same measure.

In words
Type an amount on the keypad. Lanebook writes the figures and the cheque line. Cheque style, paisa, and the lakh scale or the million scale are switches you can see. Copy places the line on the clipboard of this phone. Saved copies stay in the book. A 0–99 table and a scales page sit beside the writer.

Guides
Short notes explain the slip, the deposit, renewals, the cheque line, the plot, and what never leaves the phone. Binders group those notes. A directory points at the rooms of the desk. Records keeps the local totals.

On this phone
There is no account and no login. The book is a file in the app. Airplane mode changes nothing, because Lanebook does not use a network. Names, plates, and plot titles come from lists on the phone. Amounts use the keypad. Nothing you keep is published, and there is no shared board of other houses. Changing the currency name changes the label and the grouping. It does not convert an exchange rate.

Lanebook is for a quiet house book: slips, dates, words, a plot, and a tank.

name: Sua Cortesia
description:
O Sua Cortesia conecta quem curte um bom evento a quem produz. Encontre shows, festas, réveillons e muito mais, garanta sua cortesia gratuita e entre com um QR Code, sem fila e sem complicação.

PARA QUEM VAI AO EVENTO
• Veja os próximos eventos e filtre por estado, cidade, data e categoria.
• Use "Perto de mim" para achar eventos na sua região.
• Veja detalhes, atrações, local no mapa e como chegar.
• Retire sua cortesia em poucos toques e receba o ingresso com QR Code no app e por e-mail, em PDF.
• Receba avisos do produtor e lembretes do seu evento direto no celular.

PARA QUEM PRODUZ
• Cadastre seu evento com pôster, atrações, local no mapa e quantidade de cortesias.
• Acompanhe retiradas e a ocupação em tempo real.
• Valide a entrada lendo o QR Code do ingresso pela câmera do celular.
• Envie até 8 avisos por evento, com imagem, para quem retirou cortesia.
• Gerencie perfis de casas e produtoras e os ingressos do seu evento.

SEGURO E SIMPLES
Cada ingresso tem um QR Code assinado, pessoal e de uso único. Seus dados são tratados conforme a LGPD.

Dúvidas? Fale com a gente em suporte@suacortesia.com.br.

name: SubLabel
description:
SubLabel ist die professionelle Etikettier- und MHD-Lösung für Gastronomie, Systemgastronomie, Bäckereien und Großküchen.

Mit SubLabel erstellen und drucken Mitarbeitende im Küchenalltag in Sekundenschnelle normgerechte Frische-, Vorbereitungs-, Auftau- und Haltbarkeitsetiketten – ohne manuelles Nachrechnen von Ablaufzeiten.

Funktionen im Überblick:
• Schneller Etikettendruck: Produkt auswählen, Mitarbeiter-Kürzel antippen und direkt auf kompatiblen Bluetooth- oder Netzwerk-Thermodruckern (TSPL / ESC/POS) ausdrucken.
• Automatische MHD-Berechnung: Hinterlegte Haltbarkeitsketten (z. B. Haltbarkeit, Auftau, Anbruch) berechnen das exakte Produktions- und Ablaufdatum automatisch.
• Live-Synchronisation: Produkte, Kategorien, Mitarbeitende, Drucklayouts und Sprachpakete werden in Echtzeit mit dem SubLabel Cloud-Portal synchronisiert.
• Ablauf-Überwachung (Live-Monitor): Behalten Sie aktive Produkte und ablaufende Chargen jederzeit farbcodiert im Blick.
• Mehrsprachige Oberfläche: Ideal für internationale Küchendienste – Wechsel der Bediensprache direkt in der App.

name: Sudoku-Case file puzzle
description:
Case File Sudoku is a detective-themed sudoku puzzler. As a reviewer in the old harbor district, you take on cold cases left unresolved for years. Solve the grid, archive the clues, and piece scattered witness statements and transcripts into the full truth.

**Gameplay**

- Classic sudoku: each digit appears once in every row, column, and bold region, with no repeats.
- Five rule variants: Standard, Diagonal, Jigsaw, Killer, and Odd/Even, raising the difficulty step by step.
- Six difficulty levels, from Tutorial to Expert, suited to newcomers and veterans alike.
- Notes mode tracks candidates; Undo, Erase, and Notes are unlimited and free.

**Story**

- Five connected case files with 200 review levels, from the missing watchmaker to the final mystery.
- Each level is tied to witness statements and transcripts. Clear levels to collect evidence, transcripts, and truth fragments, then assemble the case in the file review.
- Open questions, uncovered truth, and closure reports unfold as you progress.

**Daily Case**

- A fresh case every day. Keep your review streak going and sharpen your deduction.

name: SUITWISP
description:
A small puzzle. A good hand.

SUITWISP turns familiar playing cards into a thoughtful sliding puzzle. Swipe across a four-by-four board, collect cards into stacks of up to five and build the hand shown on screen. Every board starts with a fixed arrangement. No random cards appear after a move.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

JOURNEY
Work through 20 handcrafted puzzles, from a pair to a straight flush. Complete a hand to unlock the next level, or return to a puzzle you have already unlocked.

DAILY HAND
Return for a hand selected by the current UTC date. The selection rotates through the same 20 bundled puzzles. Re-entering on the same UTC date resumes that day's run.

HAND LAB
Explore all 20 puzzles from the start, with 99 moves per attempt. Practice does not change your Journey unlocks.

MAKE EVERY MOVE COUNT
Undo a move, restart a board or ask for an on-device hint. Only a swipe that changes the board uses a move. Your three mode runs and Journey progress are saved on your device.

An emerald felt table, ivory cards and traditional red-and-black court engravings bring a familiar deck to a new kind of puzzle. Designed for landscape play, with no countdown timer in the native puzzle.

The current game interface is English only. The native puzzle has no wagering, cash prizes or redeemable rewards.

name: Sumby: Analytics & Revenue
description:
Your numbers live in five tabs. Sumby puts them on one screen and adds them up.

Connect the tools you already pay for. Sumby reads them with read-only keys and shows visitors, sources and revenue side by side, for every site and store you run.

READ THE BRIEF, SKIP THE DASHBOARD
Every morning, yesterday in plain words: how many people came, where they came from, what they read and what they bought. No charts to decode before coffee.

WHO'S ON YOUR SITE RIGHT NOW
A live view of current visitors: where they came from and which page they're on.

SEE WHO AI SENDS YOUR WAY
People who found you through ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI assistants, counted on their own instead of hidden under "referral".

CLEAN NUMBERS
Bots are filtered out and your own visits are left out, so the count is people, not noise.

EVERY BUSINESS YOU RUN
Group projects into businesses. Look at one, or all of them at once.

WORKS WITH
PostHog, Google Analytics 4, Plausible, Mixpanel, Stripe, Polar, Shopify, RevenueCat and Meta Ads.

ALSO
- Widgets for your Home Screen and desktop
- Notes on the chart, so you remember what you shipped and when
- A map of where your visitors are
- Light and dark, built for iPhone, iPad and Mac
- Your setup syncs through your own iCloud

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account to make. No server of ours in between. No tracking code to add to your site. Your keys stay in your keychain, and your numbers never reach us.

PLANS
Free: one source per project, a short daily brief, live view and notes.
Pro: every source on each project, the full brief, your own dashboard per business and every widget. Starts with a 3-day free trial.
Studio: everything in Pro, all businesses in one view and one brief across all of them.

One subscription covers Sumby on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.sumby.app/privacy

name: Sunex
description:
Sunex – Delivery, Shipping & Logistics

Create shipments, track packages in real time, and manage your deliveries in one simple app.

• Create shipments in seconds
• Real-time package tracking
• Cash on delivery (COD) tracking and payment requests
• Delivery cost calculator
• Instant status notifications
• Arabic and English support

Download Sunex and ship with confidence.

name: Sunflower Kart: Hamster Racing
description:
Hamsuke, Kurosuke, Princess Milk and the Hedgehog King race four karts for three laps around courses full of sunflowers.

- EASY CONTROLS
The kart accelerates on its own. Slide the on-screen wheel left or right to steer and down to brake.
Push it up and let go to hop - jump over the steps on the course!

- 4 COURSES
Sunflower, Mountain, Desert and Castle, with hills, steps, dash panels and sandstorms.

- ITEMS FROM SUNFLOWER POTS
Seeds (3 shots), an acorn that chases anyone in sight, invincible jelly, a power battery (faster for 20 seconds)
and a hamster wheel for a dash. In last place you may get a bunny that warps you right behind the kart ahead!

- BUILD YOUR KART
Mix tires (slick / tread) and motors (hyper / torque).

- PLAY TOGETHER
2 Players: lay your iPhone or iPad on a table and split the screen, sitting face to face.
2-4 Players: connect two devices on the same Wi-Fi (up to two players per device; CPUs fill the empty karts).

After the race, the hamsters celebrate (or sulk) on the podium.

Japanese and English. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account. The app never connects to the internet (for Wi-Fi races, the two devices on the same Wi-Fi connect directly).

name: Sunny Words: Large Print
description:
Sunny Words is a calm, classic word search made to be easy on the eyes.

BIG, CLEAR LETTERS
Every puzzle uses large, bold letters. Choose Large, Extra Large or Huge text, and switch on High Contrast for crisp black on white.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Slide your finger across a word, or simply tap the first letter and then the last letter. No fiddly gestures needed.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Come back for the Daily Puzzle and build your streak.

18 RELAXING TOPICS, ENDLESS PUZZLES
Garden, Kitchen, Birds, Travel, Weather, Ocean, Baking, Music, Hobbies and more. Every topic has an endless supply of fresh puzzles.

THREE LEVELS
• Easy – 8×8, words go across and down
• Medium – 10×10, adds diagonals
• Hard – 12×12, words in every direction

FRIENDLY HINTS
Stuck? A hint shows where a word starts. Tap again to reveal the word.

NO RUSH
No timers to beat, no pressure. Your progress is saved automatically, and puzzles work offline.

Sunny Words is free to play with ads. A one-time purchase removes ads.

name: SunPatch: Track Sun & Shade
description:
The spot that looks sunny at breakfast may be in shade by noon. SunPatch helps you compare places you are considering for a plant.

Choose a window, balcony, or another spot and record the hours when you checked it. Mark each observation as direct sun, partial sun, or shade. Compare the recorded times and see where you observed the most direct sun.

Try the included window and balcony example. The comparison uses your observations, so you can add more when you have had a chance to watch the light change.

Save one project with up to 12 entries for free. Lifetime is a one-time purchase that lets you save more projects, add more entries, and share reports. You can use the app offline without creating an account. To keep a backup, choose iCloud Drive or another location in Files.

name: SunPurr
description:
SunPurr is a quiet, sunlit pocket cat companion and on-device personal diary.

Whether you want to unload a busy day, keep a brief evening note, or slow down for a couple of minutes, Christmas is right there—no streak pressure, no social noise, and no lectures.

KEY FEATURES
• Cozy Text Chat & Optional Dictation
Write whatever is on your mind in text, or press and hold the mic button to dictate speech into text. Your cat replies gently in real time and lets you long-press any reply to report issues.

• On-Device-First Memory
Long-term preferences, pets, and life details are extracted into your iPhone's local SwiftData storage—never uploaded into a cloud user-profiling database. Inspect, delete individual entries, or wipe all memories anytime in Settings.

• Your Cat's Own Footprints & 54 Keepsakes
While you're busy, your cat sunbathes by the window, watches the rain, or gathers one small keepsake a day for your 54-slot shelf. Leave personal diary notes on the Life page anytime.

• In-Chat 4-6 Guided Breathing
Whenever things feel heavy, open a calm 4-6 breathing session directly inside the chat with soft ring pacing, optional ambient rain/ocean sound, and gentle haptics.

• 90+ Cat Breeds & Custom Nickname
Choose from over 90 cat breeds and give your companion a name only you two share.

PLANS & PRIVACY
• Free tier includes 5 AI chat turns per day, unlimited Life footprints, keepsakes, personal notes, and 4-6 breathing.
• SunPurr+ raises daily chats to 60/day (Monthly or Yearly), or add +50 never-expiring chat credits anytime.
• Not medical advice or therapy. If crisis language is detected, SunPurr immediately surfaces verified crisis hotlines and emergency contacts.

Privacy Policy: https://sunpurr.alphaxcom.cn/privacy.html?lang=en
Terms of Service: https://sunpurr.alphaxcom.cn/terms.html?lang=en

name: SunRoster: Window Sun Log
description:
When you walk into an apartment or rearrange a room, it helps to know when direct sunlight actually reaches the glass—and when neighboring buildings or trees block it.

SunRoster turns a quick compass reading at the window into a full-year daylight and shading log for your home.

Today's Sun Dashboard
Open the Home tab to scrub through the day on an interactive solar arc. Watch estimated solar altitude and azimuth shift from sunrise to sunset, check day length for your city's latitude, and see which rooms are currently in direct sun, indirect shade, or strong afternoon sun.

Compass Lock & Obstruction Angle
Hold your device flat near a window sill to read its facing direction in degrees, or select a cardinal direction manually. Add window dimensions and an exterior obstruction angle to account for rooflines, balconies, or trees across the street.

Monthly & Seasonal Calendar
Review a 12-month matrix of estimated daily direct sun hours, split between morning and afternoon exposure. Compare spring and autumn equinoxes against summer and winter solstices to see how low winter sun reaches a south-facing room or how high summer sun clears an overhang.

Shading, Curtains & Indoor Plants
Each window profile includes a daylight score, a suggested curtain open-and-draw schedule, optional local reminders, and practical shading notes—whether that means sheer drapery, solar screens, or exterior awnings. A built-in plant light catalog pairs each room's estimated daily sun hours with suitable foliage and placement distance from the glass.

Multi-Residence Profiles & PDF Reports
Organize windows across multiple homes or rooms, archive older entries, and export a clean PDF summary when planning with architects, landlords, or interior planners. All records are stored locally on your device.

name: SureFix.London
description: SureFix.London app for engineers to receive jobs and produce reports and accept job completion signatures as well as raise invoices and pdf reports

name: Sushi Rush Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Sushi Rush!

Dive into a cozy Japanese sushi shop and join our cute sushi cat on a fun, satisfying puzzle journey.

Match and launch tasty sushi pieces to clear chains before they reach the end. Strategize your shots, create delicious combos, and unlock amazing power-ups to blast through tricky levels.

 Game Features
• Numbers of handcrafted tasty puzzle levels, fresh challenges waiting for you
• Adorable sushi cat companion and warm Japanese-style sushi house scenes
• Satisfying chain-clearing effects & mouth-watering sushi visuals
• Easy to learn, perfect for quick casual play sessions
• No rush for time, enjoy relaxing puzzle fun anytime
• Play offline! Enjoy the game anywhere without an internet connection

Sit back, sip green tea, and clear all the sushi chains!
Start your tasty puzzle adventure now~

name: SuzzleCue
description:
SuzzleCue er et hurtigt poker-puslespil, hvor du trækker stier gennem nabokort, til værdierne præcis rammer dagens mål. Når summen passer, låses linjen — og du spiller videre, til hele brættet er ryddet.

Sådan spiller du • Træk over nabokort (op, ned, venstre, højre) • Ram målet præcis for at låse linjen • Ryd alle kort for at vinde

Kortværdier A = 1 · 2–10 = tallet · J = 11 · Q = 12 · K = 13

Spilmodi • Klassisk – ren sum-jagt • Uden samme farve – ingen to kort må dele farve • Skift farve – rød og sort skal skifte • Daglig – samme bræt for alle, ny udfordring hver dag • Blitz – beat uret og få ekstra sekunder • Zen – roligt og uden tidspres

Mere i appen • Tip, fortryd og nyt bræt • Dagligt arkiv for de seneste dage • Statistik, streak og bedste tider • Alt gemmes lokalt — ingen konto

Ingen køb i appen. Ingen reklamer. Ingen Game Center. Bare dig, kortene og summen.

name: Svitlo: Ukraine Power Outages
description:
Svitlo shows when your power goes off and when it comes back, based on the official schedules of your grid operator in Ukraine.

• Countdown to the next change: "Power on — 1 h 20 min until the outage" or "Power off — back on at 16:30".
• Today's and tomorrow's schedule on one 24-hour bar.
• Reminders before an outage and when power should be back on.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Lock Screen countdown and the Dynamic Island.
• Emergency outage alerts when the operator says the schedule is suspended.
• Several addresses: home, cottage, your parents' place or flats you rent out — all on one screen.
• Queue by address: for many regions the app finds your outage queue from your street and house number.

Schedules come from public sources: websites and official Telegram channels of the regional grid operators (oblenergos, DTEK, Yasno) and open datasets. The app is unofficial; during emergency outages power can go off outside the schedule.

No ads, no sign-up, no data collection. Your addresses stay on your phone.

name: SwingCatch: Golf Swing Cam
description:
Stand your phone up at the range and just swing. No buttons to press: SwingCatch finds each swing on its own and keeps only that swing.
Every swing replays right away. Look up, and the swing you just hit is already playing.
Film with your iPhone, watch on your iPad. No walking back to the phone after every shot.

■ Hands-free recording
• Nothing to start, stop or rewind
• Keeps only the swings that hit the ball, trimmed to the swing itself
• If you like, swings without a ball are kept too, marked as practice swings
• Films at 60, 120 or 240 frames per second, as far as your camera allows

■ Instant replay
• The swing you just hit loops on screen right away
• Slow it to 1/2, 1/4 or 1/8 speed, or step one frame at a time
• Turn on "Slow only at Impact" and only the moments around impact slow down, while the rest plays at normal speed
• The moment of impact is marked on the timeline, so you can jump straight to it

■ Joint angles on the video
• Angles of your spine, both hips, both knees and both elbows, drawn over the video with lines and numbers
• Each hip is the angle between your spine and that thigh, measured left and right separately, so you can see which hip opens first
• Open swing videos from your photo library too, and see their swings and angles

■ Two devices
• Your iPhone is the camera, your iPad is the screen
• Each new swing shows up on the iPad right away
• Only your own devices connect, registered with a 6-digit code
• Connects directly, even with no Wi-Fi router around
• If a phone call or another app breaks the connection, it reconnects on its own when you come back

■ Practice history and saving
• Practices are kept by date, and you can continue a past practice, filmed the same way as before
• Each swing video is saved with the sound of the ball strike too
• See how much storage each practice, and all of them, take up
• Save the swings you like to Photos exactly as filmed, with the same frame rate (240 frames per second stays 240), quality and sound

Everything runs on your device. No account, nothing sent to any server, no ads.

name: Swipe Ring
description:
In a sunny garden, a round wooden board hangs above a sparkling fountain. Glossy candy rings dangle from its pegs, each with one small gap, linked together in little chains. Your goal sounds simple: drop every ring into the fountain.

【Turn, tap, slip】
You never pull a ring free by hand. Turn the whole board left or right and every gap turns with it, or tap one ring to spin its gap a quarter turn either way. When a gap faces up, that ring slips off and falls, taking every ring hanging beneath it. The next peg below may catch it, or it may slide straight through and splash into the water.

【The gold ring goes last】
Every board has one shiny gold ring, and it must be the last ring to reach the fountain. Glass rings shatter if they touch anything on the way down, and stone rings are too heavy to tap, so only turning the board moves them. One turn changes every ring at once, so each move asks you to think a few falls ahead.

【120 boards and a Daily Ripple】
Four chapters of thirty levels climb from clever openers to long chain reactions that reward careful planning. Match the par for three stars, undo freely, and spend glow on a hint when you need a nudge. A new Daily Ripple board appears every day, and your solved days light up across the week.

【A bright garden to relax in】
Candy-colored rings, a wooden board that spins with a satisfying click, splashes in the fountain and a trophy for every chapter you complete.

Turn the board, watch the rings let go, and fill the fountain.

name: SyncoraMPRO
description: Explore Connected Vehicle through advanced engineering calculators. Analyze vehicle-to-vehicle communication, network performance, connectivity, latency, signal reliability, and intelligent transportation parameters with specialized mathematical tools.

name: Synerdraft
description: Build competitive team compositions through a tactical drafting simulator. Choose roles, ban characters, and adapt to your opponent's picks. Evaluate team synergy, counterpicks, map control, and strategic trade-offs. Run simplified match simulations to discover weaknesses and missed opportunities. Compare alternative drafts under identical conditions to understand which decisions improve your results. Challenge yourself with tournament scenarios, limited character pools, and adaptive opponents. Refine your strategy through repeatable experiments and decision-driven outcomes.

name: Synkro Motion
description:
Your athlete's movement in 3D, from your phone.

Synkro Motion turns ten seconds of video into a 3D skeleton and 43 angles, right and left, placed against their published norms. No markers, no cameras to calibrate: your smartphone is all you need, on the road, the track, in the lab or in the clinic.

FILM AND ANALYSE
• Film your athlete, or import their video, and start a 2D or 3D analysis.
• Your athlete sends you a video of their ride or training camp? Import it and analyse it wherever you are.
• A notification tells you as soon as the analysis is ready.

READ THE REPORT
• The 3D skeleton, overlaid on the video and viewable from every angle.
• Angles and curves, right and left, placed against their norms.
• Two analyses side by side: what an adjustment changed, what moved between two sessions.
• Export the report as a PDF, or the video, and send it to your athlete.

FOLLOW YOUR ATHLETES
• Their files, analyses and videos, all in one place.
• Your calendar and your statistics, on the dashboard.

CYCLING, RUNNING, THE CLINIC
• Bike fitting and performance, on the trainer or on the road.
• Running gait, on the treadmill or outdoors.
• Walking, squats, jumps and functional tests.

WHO IT IS FOR
Bike fitters, coaches and strength and conditioning staff, sports physios and podiatrists, clubs and teams.

A MEASUREMENT, NOT A VERDICT
Every analysis comes with a full report and its sources. Motion measures and compares; you know the athlete, and the decision stays yours.

In English, French and Dutch. Data hosted in France, GDPR compliant.
A Synkro Motion account is required to use the app.

name: SynopReader
description:
SynopReader is for people who would rather read the observation than the forecast. It takes the raw surface and aviation bulletins that meteorological services exchange every day and turns them into something you can actually follow, while keeping the original coded text one tap away.

Open the app and the panel shows the latest report of your active station: temperature, dew point, pressure, wind, visibility and cloud layers, laid out the way a station plot is meant to be read. Every figure is paired with its timestamp and with the delay between the observation and its arrival, so you always know how fresh the picture is. Below the panel, the curve of the last hours shows how temperature and dew point have moved, which is usually the quickest way to tell when a front has gone through.

Search the catalogue by aviation indicator, synoptic number or name, keep the airports and islands you care about in a personal list, and open any station on the map. Bulletins are saved as you read them, so the last copy is still there when the signal drops. When a code such as CAVOK or BKN020 does not ring a bell, the bilingual glossary explains it in plain language, with an example of how it appears in a real bulletin.

The data comes from the public international exchange published by Ogimet. Reports can be missing, delayed or badly encoded, and the app says so instead of hiding it: a bulletin describes what has just happened, it is not a forecast, and it should never be used for a critical decision.

name: Synthetic Big Watermelon
description:
Drop cute fruit. Crash matching ranks. Climb all the way to the legendary Super Melon.

Feijoa Forge is a bright, juicy orchard playground inspired by the viral watermelon-merge craze — but packed with extra modes, soft animations, and a whole grove of adorable looks.

ONE ORCHARD · THREE WAYS TO PLAY

Melon Merge
Aim, drop, and watch matching fruits bounce, collide, and fuse into the next rank. Stay under the crest line and chase that crowned Super Melon.

Fruit Ribbon
Swap neighbors, clear three-or-more, and ride cascade combos for big scores. Short, satisfying match sessions when you want a quick win.

Rank Relay
Lift fruit from column to column until every stack is tidy. A calm sorting puzzle with the same cute faces you already love.

ENDLESS · TRIPLE · HEX
Unlock Endless Mode for no-finish-line melon runs. Earn Super Melon clears to open Triple (3→1) and Hex (6→1) merge rules for wilder chains.

GROW YOUR GROVE
Earn forge coins as you clear stages. Dress the orchard with Wardrobe looks — Axel Axolotl, Cappy Cap, Hedge Pip, Glim Glider, Chime Leon, and more. Flip through the Codex as your fruit ladder fills in.

WHY PLAYERS STAY
• Soft, cheerful fruit art with tiny smiles
• Physics drops that feel fair and juicy
• Daily-friendly sessions — one more merge is always calling
• No account needed. Just open and play.

Ready to forge the Super Melon?
Tap Start — the grove is waiting.

name: Tabula: Tab Cleaner & Sorter
description:
Hundreds of open tabs and no time to look through them? Tabula reads them for you.

Tabula works with its own Safari extension. It sees the title and address of every open tab, sorts them into groups with Apple Intelligence, and suggests for each one: keep it, read it later, or close it.

YOU DECIDE, TABULA TIDIES
• A checklist per group, with a short reason for every suggestion
• Two lists, Close and Read Later: swipe a tab to move it between them
• Tick or untick a whole group in one tap
• Nothing closes until you tick it

CLOSES QUIETLY
• Approved tabs close the next time you use Safari
• The page you are looking at is never closed under your eyes
• Every closed tab stays in Recently Closed, ready to open again

TALK TO YOUR TABS
• "Close my shopping tabs", "What do I have open about my trip?"
• Tabula finds the tabs by meaning and shows them as a checklist

FEELS LIKE SAFARI
• A tab overview with each site's icon and page picture
• Swipe a card away, search your tabs, filter by group
• Read Later keeps pages after their tabs are gone, and any of them can go to Safari's Reading List

PRIVATE
• Sorting runs on your iPhone with Apple's on-device model
• No account, no analytics, no data collected

Smart sorting and chat use Apple Intelligence; without it Tabula sorts tabs by site. Turn on the Tabula extension in Safari once; the app shows where to tap.

name: Tactile Pins
description:
Tactile Pins is the pin art toy from the desk drawer, rebuilt as a real 3D model with thousands of sliding pins. Press from behind and the shape stands out of the front.

PRESS
• Push with a finger, a whole hand or an Apple Pencil. The longer you hold, the deeper the pins go.
• Wide or Thin: a whole fingertip, or a touch that moves only a pin or two for detail.
• Stamps: solid shapes rounded like moulded stamps, in three sizes.
• Magnet: pull pins back toward you to draw raised lines or rub parts out.

PRESS IN REAL THINGS
• Point the camera at a toy, a hand or a face and move closer: the nearer it gets, the deeper it goes.
• Press in: hold still and the app cuts the subject from its background and presses a clean 3D shape.
• LiDAR and depth cameras measure real distance; every other iPhone, iPad and Mac works it out with a depth model that runs on the device. Nothing leaves your device.

BOTH SIDES AT ONCE
• Open out an iPhone Duo, or turn an iPad on its side, and the toy can be shown twice, side by side: press on the back and watch the shape rise out of the front as you go. The "2 sides" button switches between one view and two.

TURN IT ROUND
• Drag to turn the whole toy, pinch to zoom, and Flip between the back, an edge-on view and the front.
• Gravity is real: tip it over and the pins slide. Reset lets every pin fall home. Undo takes back any press.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Paint individual pins, or pour paint into a raised shape and it fills to the edges.
• Pin finishes from silver to gold to rainbow, and moving backgrounds from aurora to galaxy.
• Save creations to the gallery, share a creation as a QR code that another device can scan (no internet, no account), and export an STL file for 3D printing.

ON A MAC
The same toy in a window of any shape. On a Mac with a touch screen, press the pins with your fingers just as on iPad; with a mouse or trackpad, click and drag. Keyboard shortcuts for Save, Gallery, Reset, Flip and Undo.

FREE, WITH ONE OPTIONAL PURCHASE
The pins, magnet, both cameras and Press in are free, with 8 stamps, 5 paint colours, 4 pin finishes, 2 backgrounds and 3 saves, and you can always scan someone else's code. The Full Set is a single one-time purchase that opens every stamp, colour, finish and background (including gold and rainbow pins and your own photo as a background), unlimited saves, sharing by code, In colour camera capture and 3D printing files. No ads, no subscriptions, no accounts, no data collected.

name: TactoDesk: Tactics Board
description:
TactoDesk is the tactics board for coaches. Pick a sport and the pitch, court or rink is drawn to the rules — then draw players, balls, cones and runs, animate them frame by frame and keep every exercise.

THE BOARD — YOUR MAIN TOOL
• 19 sports: football, futsal, handball, basketball, volleyball, ice hockey, field hockey, floorball, bandy, rugby union and league, water polo, lacrosse, American football, netball, korfball, Gaelic football, beach soccer and more
• Players, goalkeepers, balls, cones, mini-goals, zones and lines for passes, runs, dribbles and shots
• Frames: show how the play develops step by step and play it as an animation
• Made for touch: one bar on the phone, tools on the side on the tablet; the pitch turns with your device
• Ready-made templates to start from, or draw from scratch

SHARED LIBRARY
• Exercises from coaches around the world, with the organisation, coaching points and progression
• Filter by sport, part of the session and level
• Share your own exercises with your name on them

TRAINING BUILDER
• Build a session from your exercises: warm-up, main part, final part
• Minutes, sets and rest for every part; the session's time and load add up by themselves
• Split players into groups and print the session or save it as a PDF

PLANNER AND STATISTICS
• A calendar for every team: planned and done trainings, matches with match-day markers
• See what you really trained: minutes, load, directions and the most used exercises

TEAMS
• Rosters with numbers, names, positions and kit colours — put a team on the board in one tap

YOUR ACCOUNT, EVERYWHERE
Sign in with your TactoDesk account and your exercises, trainings and teams are on your phone, tablet and computer. Download all your data any time; delete your account from the app.

The board is free to start. Some features — more sports, animation, the training builder, planner, statistics and AI drafts — are part of TactoDesk plans.

Help: https://tactodesk.com/help/
Privacy: https://tactodesk.com/privacy/
Terms: https://tactodesk.com/terms/

name: Tagistry
description:
Tagistry is a private equipment logbook for the things you own and maintain. Add a bicycle, appliance, tool, or any other piece of gear, then print or save a Tagistry QR label that points back to that record.

Scan a label with the camera, or pick the same image from your photo library, and Tagistry opens the matching asset. Each record can hold a photo, location, serial number, condition, purchase details, warranty dates, and a usage meter.

Log inspections, cleaning, repairs, and part replacements with the date, cost, and notes. The planner keeps upcoming work in one place, marks overdue tasks, and can send a local reminder at the time you choose. The dashboard shows what is due, what you have spent, and which warranties are still active.

Your registry stays on this device. Tagistry does not require an account, does not upload your notes or photos, and does not connect to or control your equipment. Export a backup when you want a copy, and import it later to restore the same registry.

name: TakTakBeam: Scan & Share
description:
Send photos, files and contact cards from one screen to another phone's camera. iPhone to Android, Android to iPhone, and everything in between. No Wi-Fi, no Bluetooth, no cables, no account, no phone number.

HOW IT WORKS
Pick a photo or a file. Your screen turns into a moving pixel-art code. The other person opens TakTakBeam, taps Receive and points their camera at it. Little pixel critters jump into the file as it builds, and a moment later it is there, checked and intact.

MADE FOR MOMENTS LIKE THESE
• The group photo: one person shows it, everyone films it at the same time, on any mix of iPhone and Android. Original quality, no group chat needed.
• No signal: on a plane, in the metro, at a festival, abroad with roaming off. Light always works.
• Someone you just met: pass a photo or a document without giving your phone number.
• A whole room at once: show the code once, and everyone who points a phone at it gets the file.
• Files you would rather not upload: they go from a screen to a camera and nowhere else.

YOUR CONTACT AS A PIXEL CARD
Make a contact card once: name, photo, phone, chat apps, e-mail, socials, website, birthday. Each time you share it, you choose exactly what goes on it. The other person films it and can call, message or follow in one tap, or add it to their contacts. Two Android phones can also trade cards by touching.

IT CHECKS WHAT YOU RECEIVE
TakTakBeam tells you what each received file really is and warns before a risky one is opened: programs, scripts and files dressed up as something else. Every transfer is verified, so a damaged file is never handed over as if it were fine.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• The app does not use the internet at all
• Nothing leaves your phone before you choose what to share

MAKE IT YOURS
• 9 themes, from arcade pixels to clean daylight and high contrast
• 9 pixel-art scenes painted into the code
• 17 languages, including right-to-left Arabic
• Follows your text size and reduced-motion settings

GOOD TO KNOW
Both devices need TakTakBeam. It is best for photos, documents, tickets, contact cards and short videos; it sends up to 512 MB at once and large files take a while. Hold the phones about a hand apart, facing each other, out of direct sunlight. The sending screen flickers quickly while it works.

Free. No ads. No subscription.

name: Tango Lyve: from us
description:
Skab en rørende videohilsen, hvor venner, familie eller kolleger hver især bidrager med et klip, og saml det hele til én færdig film. Tango Lyve: from us gør det let at planlægge, indsamle, redigere og eksportere en personlig videohilsen direkte på din iPhone.

Her får du en fleksibel arbejdsproces, hvor du vælger et scenarie, sender opgaver til deltagerne og samler deres optagelser i en gennemført film med intro, scener og afslutning. Alt gemmes lokalt, så du kan arbejde offline og fortsætte præcis der, hvor du slap.

Funktioner
- 24 redigerbare scenarier til fødselsdag, bryllup, studentergilde, familie og kolleger - kom hurtigt i gang med en færdig struktur
- Tydelige scene-kort med opgave, kameraretning, varighed og deadline - gør det nemt at instruere alle deltagere
- Import fra Fotos, Filer og Del-menuen - modtag videoer fra beskedapps og placér dem direkte i det rigtige projekt
- Klipredigering med trim, beskæring, lydstyrke og navnetekst - finpuds hver scene uden at miste originalen
- Montage på tidslinje med træk-og-slip, stykredigering og titler - skab en film, der flyder naturligt fra scene til scene
- Forhåndsvisning og eksport i MP4 med H.264/AAC - gem i Fotos eller Filer og del videre med det samme

Perfekt til
- Fødselsdagshilsner, hvor flere personer fuldender en fælles idé eller frase
- Bryllupsvideoer, hvor familie og venner samler minder, råd og ønsker i én film
- Afsked til en kollega, hvor teamet kan bidrage med historier, tak og gode ønsker
- Familiefortællinger, hvor klip fra forskellige steder bindes sammen til en fælles scene

Hvorfor vælge os
Tango Lyve: from us er skabt til at gøre samarbejdsvideoer enkle, personlige og smukke. Du får en mørk, professionel videostudie-følelse, automatisk lagring, offline-adgang og en intuitiv arbejdsgang fra første scene til færdig eksport. Med den indbyggede prøve kan du se, hvordan konceptet virker, og derefter bygge din egen version med det samme.

Start din næste videohilsen i dag, og saml alle stemmer i én film, der bliver husket.

name: Tanımla: Kelime Yarışı
description:
Tanımla, arkadaşlarınla aynı anda oynadığın bir Türkçe kelime yarışması.

NASIL OYNANIR
Herkese aynı anda bir tanım ve kelimenin harf kutuları gelir. 30 saniyen ve tek cevap hakkın var. Ne kadar hızlı bilirsen o kadar çok puan alırsın.

TAKILDIN MI? BİR HARF AL
Kelimenin yarısına kadar harf açabilirsin. Açtığın harfi sadece sen görürsün, ama kelimenin sana değeri düşer. Risk mi, garanti mi?

ARKADAŞLARINLA YARIŞ
• Oda kur, 6 haneli kodu paylaş, herkes aynı anda oynasın
• Oynarken sesli sohbette konuşun
• Kimin cevap verdiğini görün; doğru mu yanlış mı, süre dolunca hep birlikte açılır
• Oyun başlayınca bildirimle haberin olsun

ZİRVEYE ÇIK
• Haftalık, aylık ve tüm zamanlar sıralaması
• İstatistiklerin, rozetlerin ve seviyen
• Gördüğün kelimeler sana tekrar sorulmaz

KİŞİSEL
• Profil fotoğrafı ya da kendi rengin
• Kolay, orta ve zor seviyeler; 5–20 kelimelik oyunlar
• Tek başına 5 kelimelik antrenman

Hesapsız (misafir olarak) da oynayabilirsin.

name: Tanuki & Kappa: Sweet Replies
description:
Make every conversation a little more fun with Kappa & Tanuki!

Meet two adorable friends who bring cheerful reactions, funny expressions, and heartwarming moments to your everyday chats. From saying thank you and good morning to celebrating little victories, these cute Japanese characters are ready to express what words sometimes can't.

name: Tap Tone
description:
Tap Tone grades a soundboard billet from one knock.

Measure length, width, thickness and weight. Pinch the billet at 22.4 percent of its length and hold Tap while you strike the middle. The phone keeps one second of sound, draws the spectrum from 20 to 800 Hz, and picks the first bending mode. Drag the copper marker onto another peak if the loudest one is the wrong mode.

Stiffness and the speed of sound come from the free-beam formula. Sitka spruce is Grade A at 5800 m/s or faster, Grade B from 5200, and Grade C below that. A speed above the species ceiling is marked Check tap.

Open Thickness and drag the stiffness handle. The section shows the reference thickness and the thickness to plane. Pair two halves: a gap over 4 percent reads Halves differ. History keeps each strike. Share a plain list of sizes, stiffness, speed, grade and target thickness.

The recording is not kept. Billets stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: TapnumCue
description:
TapnumCue er et rolig kortpuslespill der du senker verdien på spillkort til et tilfeldig mål — fra A til K.

Slik spiller du
Trykk et kort. I klassisk modus synker kortet og naboene (opp, ned, venstre, høyre). Er en nabo allerede på målet, er trykket blokkert — planlegg rekkefølgen med omhu. I blandede nivå styrer fargen bølgen: hjerter, ruter, kløver og spar.

Hva du får
• 50 håndlagde nivå
• Brett fra 3×3 til 5×5
• Tilfeldig mål hver gang (A–K)
• Kort tegnet i kode, spillestil i mørkt filt
• Angre og omstart når du står fast
• Fremgang og merker underveis
• Spilles helt uten nett

Ingen kjøp i appen. Ingen Game Center. Ingen iCloud. Bare deg, kortene og målet.

name: Tara – Daily Card Oracle
description:
The veil is thinner than you think.

Tara is a quiet daily card oracle for iPhone. Hold the orb, let the deck shuffle, and receive the card meant for this moment. Then ask the Oracle, sit with a sound ritual, and notice what comes up. It's calm, private and grounded, with no ads.

DRAW YOUR CARD
• 112 cards, each with a message, a frequency and a small ritual
• Three-card spreads for questions that need more room
• Every card you meet is kept in your Gallery
• A Home Screen widget with today's card

ASK THE ORACLE
• Ask a question and Tara answers through the card you draw
• Readings are reflections, never predictions
• Premium readings are composed privately on your iPhone by Pauram Intelligence

SOUND AND RITUAL
• Guided rituals of 3, 5, 10 or 20 minutes
• Five sound packs: Lunar Cycle, Deep Sleep, Solfeggio Sanctuary, Sacred Geometry and Shadow Work
• Optional spoken guidance

THE 13 PRIMORDIALS
Thirteen cards that are never bought and never drawn at random. They appear only through steady practice, and each one carries a story worth keeping.

YOUR SIGIL
Tara draws a sigil that is yours alone. It grows as you return: a quiet record of your practice, written in light instead of numbers.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• Open it and your reading becomes an open book: the card on one page, its message on the other
• Stand it half-open on a table and a ritual becomes an altar, the breathing light facing you and the controls within reach
• Two hidden discoveries that only appear on iPhone Duo

EARTH SIGNS
Turn on Earth Signs and today's real weather becomes part of your reading. Weather is provided by Apple Weather.

THE PAURAM PROMISE
• No ads, ever
• No trackers
• Oracle readings created on your iPhone
• No account needed; Sign in with Apple is optional
• Delete everything at any time in Settings

TARA PREMIUM
Tara is free to download with daily cards, the Oracle and 3-minute rituals. Tara Premium is an optional subscription that adds premium cards, 5, 10 and 20-minute rituals, every sound pack, and Pauram Intelligence readings. Sound packs can also be bought on their own, and each includes bonus cards drawn at random. The odds are shown before you buy.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Pauram Intelligence readings need an iPhone with Apple Intelligence. Other iPhones get Tara's built-in readings.

Tara is for reflection, meditation and relaxation. It is not medical, financial or legal advice.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://www.pauram.com/apps/tara/privacy.html

name: TarotLuna
description:
Choose a question and lay out a spread on a moonlit table. Draw one card for a next step, follow the past, present and future across three cards, compare two paths, or explore a full ten-card Celtic Cross.

Read each card in its position. Try a relationship, work or personal growth perspective on the same spread. Open the bilingual guide to explore all 78 cards and their upright and reversed meanings. Return to a spread saved on this device in Nights Past, or share a reading as an image.

Drawing cards and browsing the guide are free. Open three different readings for free on this device. Revisiting a reading uses the same allowance. From the fourth spread onward, the reading sheet previews the opening sentence. A single purchase unlocks every reading. You can restore the purchase on iPhone or iPad with the same App Store purchase account.

name: TaskNest: To-Do & Planner
description:
TaskNest is a to-do list, planner and habit tracker in one app. Write things down in plain words, see them on a calendar, decide what matters with the Eisenhower Matrix, then get them done with a Pomodoro timer. Everything works offline and without an account; sign in only if you want to sync between your iPhone and iPad.

CAPTURE IN SECONDS
• Quick Add understands dates, times, tags, lists and priority as you type: "Pay rent every month on the 1st #home !1"
• Add from widgets, Siri, Shortcuts, Control Center or the Share sheet in other apps
• Checklists, subtasks, notes, attachments (photos, scanned documents, files, voice memos)

ORGANIZE YOUR WAY
• Lists, folders, sections and tags, with colors and icons
• Smart lists: Today, Tomorrow, Next 7 Days, Inbox, Completed
• Custom filters with AND/OR rules
• List, Kanban and timeline views; drag and drop to reorder, reschedule or move
• Ready-made list and task templates

NEVER MISS A THING
• Reminders at the times you choose, several per task
• Flexible repeats: every weekday, the 2nd Monday of the month, every 3 days after completion, skip weekends and holidays
• Location reminders: get reminded when you arrive at or leave a place

PLAN YOUR TIME
• Calendar with Month, Week, 3 Days, Day and Agenda views
• Drag unscheduled tasks onto the calendar
• See your iPhone calendar events next to your tasks (read only)

FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS
• Eisenhower Matrix: urgent and important at a glance, with your own matrix views
• Pomodoro and stopwatch with focus records, Live Activity and Dynamic Island
• Estimate pomos per task and see how much focus each task took

BUILD BETTER HABITS
• Daily, weekly or "3 times a week" habits, yes/no or with a goal (8 glasses of water)
• Streaks, monthly calendar, check-in notes and moods, reminders that keep going until you check in
• Countdowns and anniversaries, including lunar calendar dates

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Statistics for tasks, focus time and habits by day, week and month

WORK TOGETHER
• Share a list with family or teammates through an invite link, with edit or view-only access

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen: task lists, Quick Add, habits, countdowns, focus, calendar, matrix
• Sidebar layout and drag and drop on iPad
• Dark mode, color themes, alternate app icons, custom swipe actions
• App Lock with Face ID or a passcode
• Import and export (JSON backup and CSV)
• VoiceOver and Dynamic Type support
• English and Vietnamese

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Without an account your tasks never leave your device. With an account (Sign in with Apple, Google or email) they sync securely, and you can delete your account and data in the app at any time.

TASKNEST PRO
TaskNest is free to use. TaskNest Pro raises the limits for heavy use: up to 299 lists and habits, 999 tasks per list, 5 reminders per task, 9 matrix views, custom filters, larger attachments and more members in shared lists. Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription; the yearly plan may include a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://task-manager-9d7cc.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://task-manager-9d7cc.web.app/privacy

Questions or ideas? Write to ngocminhtrang2k4@gmail.com

name: Tawam: Duplicate Cleaner
description:
Tawam clears the duplicates from your phone without anything leaving it. We suggest what stays; you decide.

Contacts
- Duplicate names, even when spelled differently.
- Duplicate numbers in any format: 05…, +966… and 00966… are one number.
- Names without numbers.
- Merge into the card you choose, with the name you want, or Merge All after reviewing.
- Add country codes to local numbers, add a prefix to a set of names, and put them in a group.
- Export a full vCard copy and save it wherever you like.
- An undo history for every change, and Undo All.

Photos
- 100%: the exact copy, by the file's SHA-256.
- 90% and 80%: the same photo after compression, resizing or cropping.
- A suggestion of what to keep, with the reason: highest resolution, largest file, favourite, oldest. Screenshots are never suggested.
- You decide: select any photo to delete, even the suggested one; at least one of every group stays.
- Photo print: its shape in 64 squares, its details, and how close it is to each twin.

Videos
- Clips with the same size and length.
- Five frames along each clip reveal the similar ones.

Deleted
- Deleting always goes through Recently Deleted, where items stay for 30 days.
- Missing names and numbers: a daily copy of your contacts, on your phone, spots whatever disappears, whoever removed it, and brings it back in one tap.
- Lock Deleted with Face ID or your own code.

Privacy
- No account, no server, no uploads.
- Fingerprints are only numbers; everything Tawam keeps stays on your phone and goes with the app.
- Nothing is deleted before you confirm.

Arabic and English, with dark mode. By Nasaq Studio.

name: Tboavo
description:
Tboavo is a cooking app for exploring recipes and learning kitchen skills. Browse dishes by cuisine, search by ingredient, and follow recipes with ingredient lists, preparation steps and cooking timers. Watch cooking videos, explore chapter guides, save lessons and track your learning progress on your device. Kitchen sidekick matches your questions with prepared cooking tips and links to recipes or lessons in the app.
