name: TD Pro Driver
description:
TD Pro Driver is the driver app for carriers that run their dispatch on TD Pro (TruckDispatch Pro).
Your carrier invites you. You sign in with the e-mail address they used, and your loads, messages and documents appear in one place.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See the loads assigned to you, with every pickup and delivery stop.
• Accept or decline a new load.
• Mark pickups and deliveries as you complete them.
• Share your GPS location with your dispatch team while you are on an active load, so they can see where the load is without calling you. Tracking stops when the load is delivered.
• Scan signed proof-of-delivery (POD) papers and send them to dispatch.
• Ask for a Comcheck for a lumper, repair or other approved expense, then snap the receipt.
• Chat with dispatch about a load, or in the company channel.
• Set your duty status: On Duty, Off Duty or On Break.
• Send an SOS or breakdown alert to dispatch.
• Get notifications for new loads, messages and safety alerts.
• View your pay statements when your carrier makes them available.

WHO IT IS FOR
Company drivers and owner-operators who drive for a carrier using TD Pro. You need an invitation from your carrier to sign in; there is no public sign-up.

LOCATION
TD Pro Driver uses your location to share GPS updates with your dispatch team while you are on an active load, including when the app is in the background or the screen is locked. Location is not collected when you have no active load.

PRIVACY
We do not sell personal data. Privacy policy: https://app.tdpro.cloud/privacy

Support: support@tdpro.cloud

name: TDS Connect: Digital Card
description:
TDS Connect, by Tech Direct Support, puts your digital business card in your pocket.

Create your card in minutes, then hand over your details in seconds: show your QR code, send your link, or tap a phone against an NFC tag you've written your card to. The other person doesn't need an app. Their phone opens your card, and they can save your contact details straight away.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Add your photo, job title, company, phone, email, location, a short bio and links to your website, LinkedIn and more.
• Choose your card's web address, and publish it when it's ready.
• Edit any time: everyone who opens your card from then on sees the change. There's nothing to reprint.

SHARE IT YOUR WAY
• QR code: show it full screen, at full brightness, for scanning across a table or in a dim room.
• Link: send it by message, email or AirDrop, or copy it to paste anywhere.
• NFC tag: write your card's link to an NFC sticker or card. Anyone who taps the tag with their phone opens your card.

FOR TEAMS
• If your company uses TDS Connect teams, invite colleagues by email and share each other's cards.
• Switch between your own cards and your team's cards.

MADE FOR THE MOMENT
• Your QR code is made on your iPhone, so it still works with no signal once your cards have loaded.
• Ask Siri or use Spotlight: "Show my TDS Connect QR code".
• Works in Dark Mode and with larger text sizes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking and no analytics in the app. Your sign-in stays on your iPhone, and you can delete your account in the app at any time.

Create your free account in the app, or sign in with your TDS Connect website account. A free account includes one card; teams and extra cards depend on your TDS Connect account.

name: TeacherBoard: Classroom Tools
description:
Your classroom, organized in seconds.

TeacherBoard brings the classroom tools teachers use every day into one simple, powerful app. Set a timer, pick a student, create groups, display directions, or share a QR code—all without juggling multiple apps or websites.

Designed for real classrooms, TeacherBoard makes everyday teaching routines faster, easier, and more organized.

EVERYDAY CLASSROOM TOOLS

• Timers & Time Bank: Keep lessons moving with easy-to-use timers, stopwatches, and time-tracking tools.

• Student Picker: Randomly select students for participation, discussions, or activities using your saved class rosters.

• Group Maker: Quickly create student groups and partners for collaborative learning.

• Team Scoreboard: Track team points, encourage participation, and celebrate classroom achievements.

• Student Points: Recognize effort, participation, teamwork, and positive classroom behaviors.

• Daily Agenda: Create reusable daily schedules, display upcoming activities, and set optional reminders.

• Directions Board: Display clear, step-by-step instructions so students know exactly what to do.

• Noise Meter: Help students monitor classroom sound levels with simple, visual feedback.

• Classroom Signals: Display voice levels, traffic lights, and attention signals.

• QR Codes & Quick Links: Generate QR codes and quickly share classroom resources with students.

• Random Tools: Roll dice, flip coins, generate numbers, and make random selections for classroom activities.

BUILT FOR TEACHERS

TeacherBoard is designed to be practical, flexible, and easy to use.

• Quick access to your favorite classroom tools.
• Clean, intuitive interfaces with minimal setup.
• Customizable tools to fit your teaching style.
• Full-screen presentation views for classroom displays.
• Optimized for iPhone and iPad.
• Save classroom rosters, settings, and frequently used resources.
• Core classroom tools work offline.
• No account required to get started.

LESS SETUP. MORE TEACHING.

Whether you're managing classroom transitions, organizing student groups, encouraging participation, or displaying instructions, TeacherBoard puts helpful tools right at your fingertips.

From the first bell to the end of the school day, TeacherBoard helps you stay organized and keep students engaged.

One app. More possibilities for your classroom.

name: Team Jesus
description:
You scroll every day. Team Jesus gives you something better to scroll: a short daily feed that feeds your spirit, then sends you to the Word and to prayer.

A FEED THAT ENDS
• Did you know: a fact a day about the Bible and the faith
• Fire starters: words from people who burned for God
• Tip of the day: one small thing to do today
• Quick questions and quizzes
• Be still: a few quiet minutes with Jesus
When you reach the end it says so: stop scrolling, read the Bible, pray and give thanks.

THE BIBLE, AND KEEPING IT
• Read the whole Bible (Berean Standard Bible)
• Reading plans, a chapter a day
• Study with your own notes, highlights and voice notes
• Save memory verses and learn them by heart, a word at a time
• Turn any verse into a picture to share

KEEP YOUR LAMP BURNING
Jesus told of ten bridesmaids waiting through the night. Five had oil. Your lamp shows whether you have oil: it burns brighter as you spend time in the Word and in prayer, and the app counts that time for you. Set kingdom goals and take them one stepping stone at a time.

PRAYER
• Your prayer list, with a scripture to pray for each request
• A prayer timer, and prayer times
• Answered prayers are kept, so you can look back at what God has done
• Your secret place: choose a time each day and get a reminder

WHEN IT IS HEAVY
• Give it to Jesus: a step-by-step way to hand over worry and fear and wait for his peace
• Your living room: bring your thoughts back to him
• Your garden: look for weeds and pull them out

TEAM (ADULTS, 18+)
• Connect only with friends you know, by invite link
• Share prayer requests, praise and testimonies
• Follow your church or ministry for events, polls and news
• Small groups with a shared prayer list and reading plan

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• 100% free. No adverts.
• No email, no phone number, no password
• Your prayers, notes and reading stay on your phone
• Team keeps only your first name and what you choose to share, and you can delete it all at any time

name: TempestTides
description:
TempestTides è un gioco di guerra navale con visuale dall'alto. Comanda la tua nave da guerra con un solo dito e i cannoni si agganceranno automaticamente alle navi nemiche. Sopravvivi ad attacchi sempre più feroci, scegli potenti potenziamenti durante le pause tra i combattimenti, scatena devastanti attacchi a 360 gradi e sfida Leviathan nella missione finale.

Il gioco include tre navi da guerra uniche, cinque livelli di missione e tre livelli di difficoltà. I ​​tuoi progressi di gioco, i punteggi, le impostazioni e il completamento delle missioni vengono salvati e visualizzati. Il gioco supporta la modalità offline e include effetti sonori sintetizzati e feedback aptico.

name: Tempo3: Interval Walking
description:
Tempo3 turns the Shinshu University interval-walking protocol into a hands-free coach: 3 minutes brisk, 3 minutes easy, five gentle rounds. Thirty minutes that fit a lunch break, backed by longevity research on alternating walking intensity.

WALK YOUR WAY
- Outdoors: pocket-friendly voice cues, live step cadence and a halfway turnaround alert. Your GPS route is saved to Apple Health.
- Walking Pad: a landscape companion with big glanceable timers and 10-second speed-shift warnings, so you never miss a change.

PODCAST-SAFE AUDIO
Natural coach voice and soft singing-bowl chimes briefly lower your podcast or music, then return it smoothly. Never pauses your show. Lock-screen fallback alerts keep you on track with the screen off.

PROGRESS WITHOUT GUILT
A weekly 50-minute brisk tank fills at your pace. Four walks a week completes it; rest days are welcome. No streaks, no shame.
- Every walk becomes a shareable two-tone route card (4:5 or 9:16).
- A 12-week Shinshu longevity ladder shows what each phase builds.
- Talk-test tuning adapts your target cadence after each walk.

STARTS AT YOUR PACE
Answer one question and Tempo3 calibrates week 1 so it energizes, never punishes. Knee-friendly and easing-in options included.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Sessions stay on your device; HealthKit sync is optional.

TEMPO3 PRO
Outdoor interval walking is free forever. Pro unlocks the Walking Pad companion, adaptive & custom plans, the halfway turnaround cue and studio card themes.
- Monthly $0.99, yearly $8.99 (7-day free trial), or lifetime $11.99.
- Payment charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel in Apple ID settings. Any unused trial portion is forfeited on purchase.

Terms: https://www.sun-apps.com/tempo3/terms.html
Privacy: https://www.sun-apps.com/tempo3/privacy.html

name: TennisDennis: Ping Pong Score
description:
TennisDennis is a table tennis scoreboard that listens to you. No need to put down your paddle and reach for the phone: say "nine — seven" and the scoreboard shows the score, who serves and how many serves are left.

VOICE SCORING
• Say the score in your language — the app understands numbers, names and commands ("repeat the score", "new game").
• Serves are tracked automatically: who serves and how many are left, deuce after 10:10.
• The score is read aloud — you hear it even with the phone in your pocket or in Bluetooth headphones.
• Play with the screen off: the phone in your pocket keeps listening.
• Big digits are readable from the other end of the table; tapping a card adds a point too.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Rooms for your group or club: members, photos, a place on the map.
• Team game: the scoreboard on several phones at once, the score updates live.
• One-on-one match: find a player by login or with the nearby radar and invite them to play.
• Scheduled games with place and time — every member gets a reminder.

TOURNAMENTS
• Knockout bracket or round robin for three players.
• Matches start on free tables automatically; the table and podium appear right after the final.

LIVE BROADCASTS
• Broadcast a game with camera and sound — friends watch live with the score over the video.
• "Live for everyone" games are visible to all.

GAME HISTORY
• Every point is recorded: who served, the score after it, a photo of the moment.
• A replay animation behind the history: table, paddles and ball following the real score.

OFFLINE
• Scoring works without a network. Nearby phones play a match over Bluetooth; once the internet is back, everything syncs.

NO SIGN-UP NEEDED
• Start right away as a guest; sign in with Apple or Google to keep your games and play in rooms — guest data moves to your account.

19 languages: Ukrainian, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Dutch, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Romanian, Greek, Turkish, Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish.

TennisDennis is free. It shows ads; the Premium subscription removes ads and adds a badge next to your nickname.

Premium is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account; it renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

name: Tents & Trees, CampGrid
description:
Make a little space to think. Place one tent next to each tree, match the row and column numbers, and keep tents apart — even at the corners.

CampGrid includes 180 original trail puzzles across six board sizes, plus a daily selection from a 365-puzzle pool. Every board has one verified tent layout. No timer, no lives, no forced ads.

• First 30 trail puzzles and the daily puzzle are free.
• Unlimited undo, checking and one-cell hints.
• Tap to place a tent; tap again to remove it. Optional empty-square marks.
• Short interactive practice on first launch, with Skip and voluntary replay.
• Your campsite gains trees as you complete the trail.
• Automatic progress saving on your device.
• Offline play, English and Turkish.

Camp Pass is an optional one-time purchase unlocking 150 additional trail puzzles. No subscription. The App Store shows your local price before purchase. Restore purchases with the Apple Account that purchased Camp Pass. The daily pool repeats after 365 selections. No multiplayer, cloud synchronization or online leaderboard is included.

name: Terank
description:
Terank is the match log for tennis and padel players. Record your match, your opponent confirms the score, and your ranking updates right away.

YOUR LEVEL, MATCH AFTER MATCH
Every player has a level per discipline: tennis and padel, singles and doubles. It goes up or down after each confirmed match, based on the score and the level gap with your opponents. Follow your progress, your best rating and your head-to-heads.

YOUR CLUB
Join your club by scanning the QR code displayed at the clubhouse. Find the members’ ranking, announcements, events, live matches and derbies against other clubs.

YOUR GROUP OF FRIENDS
No club? Create your group, invite your partners with a link, and get your own ranking, feed and chat. A group can stay private or open to the whole community.

FIND A MATCH
Post a call to your club to find a partner, a fourth player or an opponent at your level. Available players answer, you pick, the session is created.

THE TERANK COMMUNITY
The Terank ranking brings all players together, per discipline, from five confirmed matches against at least three different opponents. The Terank feed shows matches their players made public.

MESSAGES AND NOTIFICATIONS
Message players from your club or groups. Get notified when a score awaits your confirmation, when someone writes to you or when a session is waiting. Choose what makes your phone ring, and mute notifications at night.

SAFETY
Block or report a player at any time. A player declared as a minor cannot message an adult privately.

FOR CLUBS
Club managers handle their members, post announcements, organize events and display the club ranking from the pro space, on terank.fr.

name: Tercihlerin: YKS KPSS Tercih
description:
Tercihlerin, YKS ve KPSS tercih döneminde doğru kararı vermeniz için puanınızı gerçek verilerle karşılaştırır. Her program ve kadro için yerleşme şansınızı önceden görür, tercih listenizi bilinçli şekilde oluşturursunuz.

RİSK ANALİZİ
Puanınızı ve başarı sıranızı girin; her programın sizin için risk seviyesini görün: Garanti, Güvenli, İdeal / Rekabetçi, Sürpriz / Plase ve Hayal / Yüksek Risk. YKS'de risk, son yılların taban başarı sıraları ve kontenjan değişimleriyle hesaplanır; KPSS'de puanınız kadronun taban puanıyla karşılaştırılır. Her sonucun nedeni açıkça yazılır.

KEŞFET
• Güncel kılavuzdaki program ve kadroları arayın; bölüm, branş, şehir ve puan türüne göre süzün.
• Arşivde geçmiş yılların taban puanlarını, başarı sıralarını ve kontenjanlarını inceleyin.
• Haritada kontenjan, rekabet ve doluluk oranlarını illere göre karşılaştırın.

KPSS'YE ÖZEL
• Branşınızı seçin; yalnız size uygun kadroları görün.
• Her kadronun nitelik, özel koşul ve alan/dal kodlarını açıklamalarıyla birlikte inceleyin.
• Lisans, Önlisans ve Ortaöğretim puan türleri desteklenir.

YERLEŞENLER
Uygulama kullanıcılarının tercihleriyle yapılan anlık simülasyonda bir programa ya da kadroya kimlerin hangi puanla yerleştiğini görün.

TERCİH LİSTESİ VE FAVORİLER
• 30 tercihe kadar listenizi sürükleyerek sıralayın.
• Her değişiklikte simülasyon yeniden hesaplanır; nereye yerleştiğinizi Ana Sayfa'da hemen görün.

PUANLARIM
YKS (Sayısal, Sözel, Eşit Ağırlık, Dil, TYT) ve KPSS puanlarınızı yıl yıl kaydedin. Hesaplamalarda her tür için en güncel puanınız kullanılır.

KULLANIMI KOLAY

VERİ KAYNAĞI
Veriler ÖSYM'nin kamuya açık tercih kılavuzları ve yerleştirme sonuçlarından derlenir. Tercihlerin; ÖSYM, YÖK veya herhangi bir devlet kurumuyla bağlantılı değildir. Simülasyon yalnız uygulama kullanıcılarının tercihlerine dayanır ve resmi yerleştirme sonucu değildir; kesin sonuçlar için ÖSYM'yi takip edin.

name: Tern Mastermind
description:
Tern Mastermind is the classic code-breaking game in a calm, ad-free app. The computer hides a secret code of colored pegs – your job is to crack it in as few guesses as possible.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap the colors to place pegs in the row – tap a hole to change it.
• Tap Guess and read the clues next to the row.
• Black pin: right color in the right position.
• White pin: right color, but in the wrong position.
• Use logic and the clues from every guess to narrow down the code.

THREE DIFFICULTY LEVELS
• 4 pegs – 4 colors, 10 guesses
• 5 pegs – 5 colors, 12 guesses
• 6 pegs – 6 colors, 14 guesses
Choose whether a color may repeat in the code for an extra challenge.

THE WHOLE BOARD ON ONE SCREEN
The board fills from the bottom like the real game, and every row is visible at once – even with 6 pegs and 14 guesses. Made for both iPhone and iPad.

YOUR STATISTICS
• Played, solved and solve rate for each difficulty
• Fewest guesses and average number of guesses
• Fastest and average time – the clock starts at your first peg
• Current and best streak
• Distribution of how many guesses you need
• New records are celebrated – and statistics can be reset at any time

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases. Plays fully offline, and everything stays on your device.

Part of the Tern family alongside Tern Daily, Tern Yatzy and Tern Cards.

Happy code-breaking!

name: Terraloom
description:
Small actions. Visible impact. A living planet.

Terraloom turns everyday eco-friendly choices into the restoration of your own virtual planet. Save water, switch off the lights, recycle, walk instead of driving, buy less - then watch dry land turn green, polluted water run clear and wildlife return.

YOUR PLANET, ALIVE
Your world starts dry, hazy and quiet. Every action you record heals a different part of it:

Water brings back lakes, rivers and waterfalls

Energy grows trees and vegetation

Recycling heals cracked ground and restores grass

Transport clears the haze from the sky

Conscious consumption brings flowers and wildlife
Drag to look around, zoom in, and tap trees, water, animals and sky to see how your choices made a difference.

RECORD IN SECONDS
Pick a category, tap an action, confirm. No long forms. Choose from 28 everyday actions across Water, Energy, Recycling, Transport and Consumption, and add an optional quantity when it matters, such as minutes saved or kilometres travelled.

SIX BIOMES TO RESTORE
Verdant Forest, Crystal Waters, Golden Grasslands, Blooming Wetlands, Ancient Highlands and Coral Haven. Each has its own landscape, plants, animals and five stages of recovery, from Dormant Land to Restored Environment.

DISCOVER WILDLIFE
As a biome heals, animals return: foxes, owls, otters, herons, seahorses, sea turtles and more. Build a collection with a description, habitat, a nature fact and a rarity for every species, and plant new trees and flowers with the Eco Points you earn.

CHALLENGES, LEVELS AND ACHIEVEMENTS
Take on daily and weekly challenges, climb ten levels from Newcomer to Master Restorer, and unlock achievements. Missing a challenge never takes away your progress.

INSIGHTS
See your activity by day, week, month or all time, with estimated water saved, electricity saved, distance travelled sustainably and CO2 avoided. Every estimate is clearly labelled, and the reference values used are listed in the app.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account. No login. No ads. No analytics. Everything stays on your device and works without an internet connection. A daily reminder is optional, and you can erase all of your data at any time in Settings.

Terraloom is a motivational tool. Your actions are recorded by you and are not verified, and environmental figures are rough estimates, not scientific measurements.

Restore your planet, one small action at a time.

name: Tetherfin: Reef Routes
description:
A little otter. A glowing tether. A reef waiting to wake up.

Join Pip in a tiny cork skiff and draw your way through a sea of buoys, glowseeds, and curious little fish. Every route has two jobs: gather light now, then become a current that helps the fins find home on the next turn.

Think one tide ahead. A clever shortcut might collect the glow you need, but will it leave the right way home?

ONE ROUTE, TWO LITTLE JOBS

Connect anchored buoys, collect glowseeds, and leave a luminous water trail. Fish follow the current from the previous turn, so a thoughtful plan matters more than quick reactions.

100 PUZZLES ACROSS TEN SEAS

Explore Pebble Bay, Kelp Switchyard, Bubble Rise, and seven more cozy ocean regions. Discover alternating coral gates, one-way bubble passages, playful crab crossings, prism filters, driftwood latches, and two-current relays.

A LITTLE MORE TO DISCOVER

Find each level's optional keepsake and aim for three stars. Restore ten reef landmarks, revisit favorite puzzles, and improve your own local records. Every leaderboard entry comes from play on your current device.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE

Plan without a countdown. Draw with a finger or build routes by tapping. Undo a turn whenever you need, ask for an optional hint, and choose reduced motion for a calmer journey. Guided and Standard records stay separate.

GIFTS WITH THE TIDE

Return for daily shell stamps and unlock little decorations. Miss a day? Your stamps stay with you. Decorations are just for looks and never change the puzzles.

YOUR OWN QUIET OCEAN

All 100 levels are included and work offline. No accounts, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Progress and records are stored locally on your device.

Draw a route. Gather the glow. Guide little fins home.

name: Text Shop
description:
Text Shop lets you edit the words in any picture as easily as editing a note.

Tap any text in a photo or screenshot, type something new, and Text Shop redraws it in a matching font, size, weight, color and spacing, even on tilted signs. Old letters disappear and the background is filled back in, so the change blends right in.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Change text: fix a typo, update a price on a menu, or rewrite a sign
• Erase text: remove words, or brush away anything you don't want
• Move text: drag words anywhere in the picture
• Copy text: grab every word in an image, or just one line
• Compare: hold to see the original, or drag the before/after slider
• Share a before/after image, export a searchable PDF, or save to Photos

SMART BY DESIGN
• Automatic font matching: picks the closest font, weight, size and letter spacing
• Matches the photo: copies blur and grain so new text doesn't look pasted on
• Keeps spacing: wide gaps, like the one before a price, stay wide
• Centered lines stay centered when the text gets longer or shorter
• Optional AI fill redraws brick, wood, fabric or sky behind removed text
• Made for iPhone Duo: photo on one half, tools on the other

PRIVATE
Everything happens on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded.

TEXT SHOP PRO
Text Shop is free to use. Free exports include a light Text Shop watermark. Pro removes the watermark from everything you save and share.
• Weekly, monthly or yearly plans, each starting with a 3-day free trial
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase (after the free trial, if one applies)
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://alexg1722.github.io/textshop/privacy.html

Please only edit pictures you own or have permission to change. Text Shop is for creative and everyday edits, not for altering official documents.

name: THE ARK News
description:
THE ARK brings together strategic news from official institutions, universities and independent think tanks.

• Headlines from the European Council, ECB, UN, Chatham House, MIT and more
• Regional feeds for the US, Canada, Europe, China, Asia, Africa and South America
• Local-language sources for every language
• 7 languages: Türkçe, English, Deutsch, Français, 简体中文, 日本語, Русский
• Save and share stories; light and dark mode

Headlines may be machine-translated; every story links to its original source.

name: The Benedictine Way
description:
Set aside a little time each day with the Rule of Saint Benedict. Open Today for the day’s reading and a short reflection, or search the full Rule and read a chapter at your own pace.

In the evening, look back over the day with the Examen and close it with Compline, the Church’s night prayer. In the Guild tab, you’ll find the Confraternity’s commitment, nightly prayers, and Rite of Enrollment, along with a link to the weekly Prayer Letter.

The readings and prayers work offline. You can change the text size or choose light or dark appearance in Settings. No account is needed to read or pray.

name: The Last Lightkeeper
description:
Guide a trail of light through 100 handcrafted puzzles. Connect the relics, open stone gates, and route your light through portals as you explore the ruins.

Learn each mechanic at your own pace, then return to improve your times and earn stars. Play offline, replenish energy over time or with an optional rewarded ad, or use a one-time purchase for unlimited play.

name: The Posting AI
description:
theposting.ai writes your social media posts for you, and publishes them only when you say so.

Pick a photo or a video, write one sentence about it, and theposting.ai drafts a post for every network you use: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Threads, Pinterest and more, each in the format and length that network expects, in your brand's voice.

You stay in control. Read every draft, edit it, approve it, then publish now or schedule it for the best time.

On your phone:
• Camera and gallery: take a photo, record a video or pick from your gallery right in the app.
• Connect your social networks with their own sign-in, then come straight back to the app.

Also in theposting.ai:
• Several businesses or brands, each with its own accounts and brand profile
• A calendar of everything scheduled
• Results per post and per account
• Romanian, English and Italian

You need a theposting.ai account to use the app.

name: The Sacred Prayer
description:
The Sacred Prayer is a quiet place to pray every day. This is the members' area: sign in with the email you used to get The Sacred Prayer.

Inside you will find The Lost Prayer of Solomon, built on Solomon's own words in the Bible and read aloud for you, and a gentle 7-day journey that walks with you one day at a time. Most days take 5 to 7 minutes: listen, follow a few simple steps and mark the day as done.

WHAT IS INSIDE
- The Lost Prayer of Solomon, with audio
- The 7-Day Journey, one short guided session for each day
- Prayers in Times of Illness: seven prayers for comfort and strength, to pray alongside the care of your doctor
- Prayers for Work and Provision: for guidance, patience and wisdom with money
- Prayers for the Family: for marriages, children and reconciliation
- Prayers for Protection: courage, discernment and peace when fear rises
- The Manuscript of Solomon: eleven short teachings from the Bible, with commentary
- The Song of God: a calm seven-minute sacred chant
- Divine Vitality: a guide to foods and simple recipes from the lands of the Bible

MADE TO BE EASY
- Clear text and a calm design
- Every prayer can be read or listened to
- Your progress is saved, so you can come back whenever you need

FOR EXISTING MEMBERS
Sign in with the email you used to get The Sacred Prayer. The first time you sign in, the app asks for your first name, date of birth and a password, and you are in.

Need help? Write to support@thesacredprayer.app and we will reply by email.

The prayers in this app are for comfort and faith. They do not replace medical, financial or professional advice.

name: Theophony Resound
description:
Theophony Resound is the app of Theophony, a Christian radio and podcast ministry. Listen live to Theophony English Radio and Theophony Tamil Radio, catch up on podcasts and video teaching, and keep good news with you through the day.

LISTEN LIVE
• Two live stations, English and Tamil, one tap from the home screen
• See the programme that is on air now, and browse recently played songs
• Keeps playing with the screen off, with controls on your Lock Screen and in Control Center
• Programme schedule shown in your own time zone, with what is on next

PODCASTS AND VIDEOS
• Browse podcasts and videos from Theophony; filter by language, speaker and category
• Play episodes in the background and skip forward or back

WAKE UP TO THE RADIO
• Set an alarm for your favourite station; at the time you choose, a notification opens the app and starts the radio

YOUR APP, YOUR WAY
• Save favourites, receive notifications from Theophony, share a station with friends
• Choose from five colour themes and your own language
• Sign in only if you want your favourites, theme and alarms saved to your account
• Free, with no ads

Theophony Ministries exists to spread faith, hope and love to the global Christian community, to serve the church and to promote the gospel to all nations. We broadcast in English and Tamil to encourage believers and to be an instrument of worship and ministry.

Questions or feedback? Use Contact us in the app, or write to theophonyfm@gmail.com.

name: Thermal Rounds: Sauna & Plunge
description:
Make room for every part of your routine: heat, rest and cold.

Thermal brings clear session controls to iPhone and Apple Watch Ultra, with local history and optional Apple Health observations. Build a routine, move through each stage at your own pace, and keep a record you can return to.

YOUR ROUTINE, YOUR PACE
Customize heat, cold and contrast routines with target durations, rest stages, rounds and manually entered environment temperatures. Pause, resume or finish when you choose. Reaching a target is a reminder; it does not advance the stage automatically.

AT YOUR WRIST
Start and control a session on Ultra. Choose optional goal alerts and, with your permission, live heart-rate recording through a Mind & Body workout. Missing or stale readings are labeled clearly. Completed Watch sessions wait locally for delivery to the paired iPhone.

A HISTORY THAT STAYS WITH YOU
Record sessions offline, add past sessions manually, and keep notes alongside actual stage durations. Send routine edits from iPhone to Watch and review completed sessions on your phone.

OVERNIGHT OBSERVATIONS
Choose whether to connect Apple Health for sleep, heart-rate variability, resting heart rate and sleeping wrist temperature. Thermal shows an absolute nightly wrist measurement with its date and source. Its separately labeled temperature change uses Thermal's own baseline from prior measured nights, not Apple's baseline.

Sleeping wrist temperature is an overnight measurement. It is not live wrist or core temperature, and Thermal does not measure sauna air or plunge water automatically. Sauna and plunge temperatures are manual entries. Sleep comparisons are observations of associations, not evidence that a session caused a change.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No Thermal account, advertising SDK or app-operated server. Session history is stored on your devices and transfers between your paired Watch and iPhone. Thermal excludes its local recordings from device backups. Apple Health is managed separately through your system settings.

DEVICE LIMITS MATTER
The Watch workflow is designed for Apple Watch Ultra. Follow Apple's device guidance: avoid all steam rooms and Ultra sauna use above 55°C / 130°F; specified underwater water temperatures are 0–40°C / 32–104°F. Entered values cannot verify the real environment or determine a personally safe exposure time. Keep your iPhone outside the sauna.

Requires iOS 17 or later. The Watch companion requires watchOS 10 or later. Apple Health access and Watch heart-rate recording are optional.

name: TheSoryn
description:
Don't just read. Explore. Understand. Remember. Discover.

THESORYN turns learning into exploration. Instead of endless lists of articles, you move through a living map of knowledge: ten glowing regions, from Science and History to Psychology, Philosophy and Space, each filled with topics you can open, read, connect and remember.

EXPLORE A UNIVERSE OF IDEAS
• Pan and zoom an interactive knowledge map with ten regions and forty topics
• Tap a region to dive in, tap a topic to see what it is about
• Watch topics change as you go: unexplored, available, opened, in progress, completed, and needing review
• Prefer a list? Switch to the catalog at any time

READ WITHOUT DISTRACTION
• A calm reading mode with adjustable text size, line spacing and light, dark or sepia themes
• Highlight passages, add bookmarks, write notes and copy text
• Definitions, timelines, comparisons and step-by-step diagrams make ideas easy to follow
• Your place is saved, so you can pick up where you left off

CONNECT WHAT YOU LEARN
• Every topic links to related topics, with a short explanation of how they are connected
• See the links as a small network, and follow them from one idea to the next

REMEMBER MORE
• Flip knowledge cards for definitions, facts, events, comparisons and more
• Review with simple spaced repetition: rate each card Again, Hard, Good or Easy and the app schedules the next review
• Create your own cards
• Test yourself with short challenges: multiple choice, true or false, matching, ordering, fill in the blank, find the mistake and short answer

DISCOVER SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• A fact of the day, featured topics and curated highlights from science, history and technology
• Tap SURPRISE ME for an unexpected question and the topic behind it
• Follow guided learning paths such as Understand the Universe or How Artificial Intelligence Works

A GENTLE PROGRESSION SYSTEM
• Earn XP, level up, unlock achievements and complete small daily missions
• Choose a daily goal from 5 minutes to no limit
• Missed days are never punished

YOUR LIBRARY
• Save articles, favorite topics, cards, quotes, bookmarks and notes
• Organise topics into your own collections
• Search across topics, concepts, cards and paths

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Everything works offline, and your progress stays on your device

name: Threadjury
description:
A closet full of clothes can still leave you wondering what to wear. Threadjury helps you see what you own, put pieces together in new ways, and remember the outfits you want to wear again.

Build a closet from your own clothes. Take a photo or choose one already on your device, then sort your pieces into tops, bottoms, and footwear. Add occasion tags so you can find what fits the day.

Give your wardrobe a spin. Threadjury picks a top, a bottom, and a pair of shoes from your closet. Lock any piece you want to keep and spin again to change the rest. Save a combination you like or mark it as worn today.

Try different looks in Studio. Dress an illustrated mannequin, change garment colours and patterns, and save the combinations you want to revisit. You can experiment with the built-in garments as soon as you open Studio.

Make getting dressed easier tomorrow. Assign a saved outfit to a date, group favourite looks into collections, and use your wear history to see which pieces get the most use.

Threadjury works offline. Your clothing photos, saved looks, outfit plans, and wear history stay on your device. No account, ads, or subscription required.

name: Threadless: Gmail Triage
description:
Threadless turns your Gmail inbox into a prioritized feed. See what needs a reply, what can wait, and what’s already handled without sorting through every message yourself.

- Read short summaries, or open the original email when you need the details.
- Mark messages as read, move them to Trash, or reply without leaving the app.
- Ask a question about an email and get an answer from its contents.
- Try the sample inbox without connecting a Gmail account.

Threadless asks for permission before sharing email content with OpenAI for sorting, summaries, and answers. It only sends mail when you write it and tap Send. You can delete your Threadless account in Settings.

name: ThreadPitch
description:
ThreadPitch helps makers and workshop users convert between metric thread pitch and threads per inch. Enter a value to see the equivalent spacing, browse common pitch references, and save conversions for later.

Pitch alone does not identify a thread; check diameter and thread form separately. Saved conversions are stored on your device.

name: THXO Sales
description:
THXO Sales คือแอปสำหรับพนักงานขายของบริษัทที่ใช้ระบบ THXO รับลีดจากฟอร์มบนเว็บ งานอีเวนต์ หรือที่คีย์เอง แล้วตามต่อได้จากมือถือ

• ลีดเรียงตามคะแนน ร้อน อุ่น เย็น และเวลาที่ต้องติดต่อให้ทัน
• หัวหน้าทีมดูลีดของทั้งทีมได้

• กดโทรหรือส่งอีเมลจากหน้าลีด แล้วบันทึกผลการติดต่อทันที
• ตั้งวันติดตามครั้งต่อไป ระบบเตือนเมื่อถึงเวลา

ต้องมีระบบ THXO ของบริษัท (th-xo.com)

name: Thyryn
description:
Thyryn is a small, offline ledger for a household vinyl shelf: what is on it, how it is holding up, when it last turned on the platter, and what you noticed while it did. No catalogue, no shop, no rating, no account, no cloud. Every working feature works offline.

The home tab opens with the honest number: five records, two of them waiting. A summary card says how many need a spin and why; a queue tile leads to the two lists that matter. Each record row carries its genre, artist and year, condition and rotation state, plus a single "Log a spin" button so a listen takes one tap and never leaves the shelf. Adding a record takes a title, an artist, a year, a genre, a pressing note such as "2021 reissue · 180 g", a condition from Mint to Fair, and any observation worth keeping.

name: TideMath
description:
TideMath - Tide Charts & Solunar Fishing Times

TideMath turns the NOAA tide tables into one clean screen. Open it, pick your station, and you get today's tide curve, the next high and low, the sun and moon, and the feeding windows anglers actually plan around - all computed on the device, with no connection needed.

Built for boats, docks, kayaks, rock fishing, clam digging, beach walks and anyone who has to know when the water turns.

WHAT YOU GET

Tide chart
- A smooth, scrolling curve of the whole day, with the exact high and low marks plotted on it
- Read the height at any moment, plus whether the water is rising or falling right now
- Countdown to the next high or low tide, in minutes
- Today's full table of highs and lows with times and heights
- The next seven days, one tap per day, for planning the weekend

3,496 NOAA stations - every US tide prediction station that publishes harmonic constants
- Search by name or state, favourite the ones you actually use
- Subordinate stations are resolved through their reference station, with NOAA's own time and height offsets applied

Solunar fishing windows
- Moon overhead, moon underfoot, moonrise and moonset windows for the day, marked major or minor
- A daily rating that reflects how strong the tide and moon combination is
- Sun and moon rise/set, moon phase and illumination, so you can see at a glance whether it is a spring or neap tide

Yours, not rented
- One purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account, no sign-in, no tracking
- The entire station list ships inside the app: predictions are computed on your phone, not fetched from a server
- Feet or metres, MLLW or MSL datum, 12 or 24 hour clock
- Works in airplane mode, at the ramp, in the boat, past the last bar of signal

HOW IT IS CALCULATED
TideMath implements the same harmonic method NOAA uses: each station's published constituent amplitudes, phases and speeds are summed against the astronomical arguments, then reduced to your datum. The result is checked against NOAA's own tide predictions - typical agreement is within a few centimetres and a few minutes at reference stations. Subordinate stations inherit their reference station's model with NOAA's tabulated offsets.

TideMath is a planning and reference tool. It is not a navigation instrument and must not be used for piloting, chart plotting, or any decision where an official tide table is required. Tides vary locally with wind, pressure and river flow; always check your official source before you leave the dock.

Data: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS), public domain.

name: Tidy Pack Master
description:
Your little packing studio just opened its doors, and the first letter is already pinned to the cork board. A graduate leaving her dorm, a grandmother moving after fifty-one years, newlyweds with two of everything, a florist with dripping buckets, a musician heading on tour: every client has a home full of things, and none of it is in order.

【Dig through the mess】
Each room is a heap of belongings piled on the table and spilling onto the floor. Anything with nothing lying on top of it can be picked up, and every tap uncovers what was hiding underneath.

【Three boxes, three of a kind】
Three open boxes wait on your counter, each asking for three of one thing. Tap a match and it flies straight in. Fill a box and it gets taped, stamped and rolled away, and the next one slides in.

【Mind the tray】
Nothing wants that item yet? It waits on the tray and hops into its box the moment that box arrives. Let the tray overflow and the room has to be packed again, so think a few taps ahead.

【A new surprise with every client】
Bundles wrapped in newspaper hide what's inside, taped cartons pop open, vines need clearing, and big gear takes two tray spaces. Fifty hand-checked rooms grow from gentle warm-ups to proper brain-teasers.

Earn coins and stars, decorate your studio, collect each client's memories, and see why every box tells a story.

name: Tigadv
description:
Thanks for being with us! We are constantly iterating and improving—please feel free to leave your suggestions at any time.


Tigadv is a hiking journal printed on topographic map paper. Every hike you log becomes a waypoint on a dashed trail that winds down your screen — a calm, personal record of everywhere you've walked.

Tigadv is a journal you fill in by hand: you type in the distance, time and elevation of each hike. It does not use GPS or track your location.

LOG EVERY HIKE
• Date, trail, distance, time, elevation gain and loss, difficulty, weather, companions and a 1–5 summit rating
• Add up to four photos from your library or camera, plus your own trail notes
• Pace and average speed are worked out from the numbers you enter
• Search, filter by difficulty or favourite trails, and sort by date, distance, climb or rating
• Share a hike as a short text summary

A LIBRARY OF TRAILS
• Save routes with location, length, type (loop, out & back, point to point), difficulty, elevation gain and notes
• Mark favourites and see your history and best pace on each trail
• Log a hike or plan a trip straight from a trail

GEAR & PACKING LISTS
• Keep an inventory of your kit with weights, categories and condition — see your total kit weight and what needs replacing
• Build reusable packing lists and copy them for each planned trip
• Tick items off as you pack and get an optional reminder the evening before you head out

FIELD NOTES
• Jot down wildlife sightings, route changes, safety notes and ideas, then search and filter them

PERSONAL STATS
• Hikes, distance, climb and time on trail per year or all time
• Animated monthly distance and climb charts — tap a month to inspect it
• Personal records: longest hike, biggest climb, fastest pace, average pace and most-hiked trail
• Export a PDF report, CSV spreadsheets or your complete journal as JSON

OFFLINE-FIRST, SYNCED TO YOUR ACCOUNT
• Create a free account with your email address and a password
• Everything is saved on your iPhone first and works without signal
• Your journal syncs privately to your account when you're online, so it's there when you sign in again
• Metric or imperial units, light and dark appearance

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• No GPS or location access — every entry is typed in by you
• Delete your account and all of its data at any time from Settings › Account

Tigadv is a journal, not a navigation or safety tool. Always check conditions and carry proper equipment.

name: Tiger Wok
description:
Take charge of a tiger chef’s counter in four illustrated night markets. Cook at different heat levels and fill customer orders before time runs out. This single-player arcade game has 16 campaign shifts with fixed order queues and 16 recipes made from eight ingredients.

Drag or tap to add ingredients to a wok. Flip dumplings and tofu to cook both sides, and transfer food between woks as needed. Browning, steam, and smoke help you judge doneness. When a ticket has arrows, ingredients must land on the plate in the order shown. Each wasted ingredient breaks your serving streak and takes three seconds off the clock during timed shifts.

Hit the serving goal to unlock the next shift. Replay unlocked shifts and earn patches by meeting their streak and waste requirements. The Recipe tin records dishes served in finished campaign attempts, even if you miss the goal. Flip a recipe card to check the cooking and plating details, then practice the dish on a single ticket with no timer.

Clear all 16 campaign shifts to unlock a 110-second Free shift with three woks and orders drawn from your learned recipes.

name: Tilda: Room & Object Scanner
description:
Tilda turns the LiDAR scanner in your iPhone Pro into a fast, private 3D scanner. Scan a room, a whole floor or an object, then export in a few taps. Free, with no accounts, no ads and no tracking.

ROOM SCANS
- Scan one room, or switch to whole-floor mode and merge several rooms into one model.
- Get a clean 3D model with walls, doors, windows and furniture, plus a floor plan.
- Room summary with square footage, ceiling height, and door and window counts. Share it as a PDF.
- Photo tour: swipe through photos pinned to spots on the floor plan.
- Walk-through: move through your scanned space in 3D.

OBJECT SCANS
- Photoreal: a textured 3D model built on your iPhone with Apple's Object Capture.
- LiDAR quick: an instant shape that works well for shiny or plain objects.

MESH SCANS
- Mesh: solid surfaces colored from the camera.
- Point cloud: millions of colored LiDAR points.
- Surfaces: walls, floor, furniture and more in separate colors.

EXPORT ANYWHERE
- USDZ, OBJ, STL and PLY for Blender, CAD, 3D printing and AR.
- Photos with camera poses for photogrammetry and Gaussian splat tools.
- Photos for Mac, to rebuild an object at full detail with Object Capture.
- Share by AirDrop, Files, Mail or any app. Scans also show up in the Files app.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE (OPTIONAL)
- On supported iPhones, Tilda names and summarizes your scans, and suggests tags.
- Ask a scan questions such as "How much paint for the walls?" or "Will a 2 m sofa fit?"
- It all runs on your iPhone with Apple's on-device model. Nothing is sent to a cloud.

SIRI, SHORTCUTS AND SPOTLIGHT
- Say "Start a room scan in Tilda" or "Open my latest scan in Tilda".
- Find your scans in Spotlight search.

FREE AND PRIVATE
- No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics.
- Scans stay on your iPhone. Tilda makes no network connections of its own.
- Data leaves your phone only when you choose to export or share a file.

REQUIREMENTS
- An iPhone with a LiDAR scanner (Pro models, iPhone 12 Pro and later) running iOS 26 or later. Without LiDAR, Tilda explains that scanning is not available.
- Apple Intelligence features need a supported iPhone with Apple Intelligence turned on.

Tips: walk slowly, keep walls, floor and corners in view, and use the flash in dark rooms.

Questions or ideas? Visit the support page or send feedback from Settings.

name: Tilt Arena: Party Brawl
description:
One disc. Four players. Only one stays on.

Tilt Arena is a fast 4-player battle on a floating disc that tilts, spins and shakes under your feet. Push your rivals over the edge, time your parry to send their push right back, and be the last one standing!

• PUSH AND PARRY – shove anyone in reach, or block at the perfect moment and knock the attacker back.
• THE DISC FIGHTS BACK – it tilts, spins, rocks like a seesaw and quakes. Every few seconds the ground changes.
• SECOND CHANCE – fall once and a flying saucer may catch you and drop you back in the fight.
• RANKED ONLINE – real players, short rounds. Climb from Bronze to Legend.
• PLAY WITH FRIENDS – add friends by ID, form a party and jump into a match together.
• UNIQUE CHARACTERS – unlock a whole cast of heroes and try any of them out.
• THREE ARENAS – the open Sky, a Volcano over boiling lava, and the frozen Ice world.

Short rounds, big falls, loud laughs. Can you keep your feet?

name: Time Block Planner - Ritim
seller_name: MAKS YAZILIM VE TEKNOLOJI SANAYI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Ritim is a personal planner that keeps your calendar, tasks, goals and focus time in one place. Plan your day hour by hour, sort your work by priority and see how close you are to your goals. Works on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.

CALENDAR AND TIME BLOCKING
• Month, week and day views
• An hour-by-hour day timeline: give each task a time block and see where the day goes
• Two-way sync with the calendars on your device: Ritim reads your existing events and writes new ones back
• Tasks and events on the same timeline

TASKS
• Inbox: capture a thought now, sort it later
• Priorities, subtasks and due dates
• Overdue tasks never disappear; they are listed separately, with a nudge to move them to tomorrow

GOALS
• Weekly, monthly and quarterly goals
• Progress indicators and counters
• Focus-hour goals: set a target such as "10 hours of deep work this week" and let your focus sessions count toward it

FOCUS TIMER
• Pomodoro-style deep work sessions
• Link a session to a task so the time you spend is recorded
• Focus Shield: silences notifications during a session, shows only the task you are working on, and logs it as an interruption if you leave the app

WEEKLY ANALYTICS
• Total focus time and completion rate
• Task breakdown by category
• Weekly insights: your most productive day and where you slipped, in a sentence

WIDGETS AND APPLE WATCH
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: today's plan at a glance
• Apple Watch app with complications: check your day, your goals and your focus session from your wrist

SYNC AND BACKUP
• iCloud sync keeps your records up to date on devices signed in to the same Apple Account
• Backup file: gather all your records in one file and restore it on any device

WHO IT IS FOR
• Students planning a study timetable or an exam week
• People who want work, meetings and personal goals in one agenda
• Anyone who wants to plan the day in time blocks and work without distraction

Ritim is available in English and Turkish.

RITIM PRO
Ritim is free to download. Some features require a Ritim Pro subscription.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Ritim Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://ritim.arctools.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://ritim.arctools.dev/privacy

name: Times Table Tricks
description:
Understand it first, then know it by heart: the whole multiplication table, not just 1 to 9.

Five levels take you from 1×1–9×9 to the teens (11–19), the twenties (21–29), the fifties (51–59) and the hundreds (101–109), each with one short trick.

SEE WHY IT WORKS
Why does "add the other number's last digit, then multiply the last digits" work? An animated block picture shows it: turn the strip on the right and move it underneath, and the rectangle becomes neat rows of ten plus one small corner. You'll also see why the twenties trick doubles and the fifties trick halves.

GET IT RIGHT EVERY TIME
Short tricks usually skip three cases. This app never does:
• Two-digit back? Carry it: 17 × 18 = 306
• The back needs two digits: 101 × 102 = 10302
• Odd number to halve? The extra 50 goes to the back: 53 × 54 = 2862
Every problem has a step-by-step explanation that shows how the front and back join into the answer.

LEARN IT BY HEART
• Flash cards: see it, think it, flip it
• Step by step: fill in each step of the trick
• Speed round: type the answer and earn stars
The app remembers how well you know each fact. Smart review picks the ones you know least, and the table is color-coded so you can see what's mastered.

LISTEN AND LEARN
Every fact and explanation is read aloud in a natural voice, and you can listen to a whole table from start to finish.

For children learning their times tables, kids practicing mental math, and the parents helping them.

• English and Chinese interface, following your system language
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up
• Works offline; progress stays on your device
• For iPhone and iPad

name: Tincture Brew
description:
TINCTURE is a run-based strategy builder about an apothecary. You go from the village of Nettlecombe to the Capital. On the road, guilds give you commissions. Each commission has a target value of potency.

How to make a tincture:
1. Select one to five reagents on the table.
2. Tap BREW to make a recipe.
3. Tap DISCARD to replace reagents.
4. Reach the target before you use all your brews.

Each recipe has a Body value and a Mult value. The potency of a tincture is Body multiplied by Mult. TINCTURE has ten recipes, from the Pair to the Quintet. A Mortar charm increases the level of one recipe. Some reagents have a distillation or a seal. These reagents add Body, add Mult or pour two times.

When you reach the target, the guild stamps your ledger and gives you marks. Use the marks at the cart of Pell, the peddler. When you keep marks, you receive interest. If you do not reach the target, the run stops. Your unlocks stay.

Familiars are animals that help you. TINCTURE has 50 familiars. The ability of each familiar comes from a fact about that animal. Because an octopus has three hearts, it adds Mult to the first three reagents. The familiars operate from left to right on the shelf. Change their order to change the result. Feed a familiar to make it stronger.

The road has six waystations. Each waystation has a Small, a Large and a Guildmaster commission. Each Guildmaster adds a special rule. At the end, the Royal Assayer asks for one million potency. After that, the endless road starts.

Other functions:
- Daily Ledger: one seed each day, one attempt.
- Seed codes: play the same run again.
- Satchel Workshop: make a satchel of 40 to 60 reagents.
- Challenge Scrolls: write your own rules.
- Bestiary: read each animal fact and its source.
- Ledger: see your runs, 34 achievements and rank stamps.

name: TinyGods: History Simulator
description:
You are a tiny god. You can't control your people, but you can shape their world.

TinyGods is a simulation game about keeping a civilization alive for hundreds of years. Your people farm, build, get sick, go to war and raise children who learn from the adults around them. Your job is to make the big choices, like what every child learns in school, so that hard-won skills like farming, medicine and reading are never forgotten.

STORY MODE
Play 10 missions, each with its own world and goals. Survive plagues, famines, droughts and wars. Watch out for "known mistakes": choices real societies made that look helpful but cause trouble decades later. Earn a rank from S to F, then unlock bonus missions for an extra challenge.

HISTORY MODE
Take charge of the real Earth and make the big decisions of history yourself. Can you reach electricity sooner, avoid the world wars or keep the planet healthy? At the end, compare your world to what really happened.

SANDBOX
Build your own levels. Pick the world, the hardships, the starting rules and the goals, then see if your people can make it.

MADE FOR NEW PLAYERS TOO
- A practice run explains every word and number before you play
- Tap any bar or number to see what it means
- Read-aloud narration for every page
- Save your run and pick it up later

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Earn tinys by playing to unlock extra time, bonus missions and the Sandbox
- History goals and your best runs give you a reason to replay
- Works on iPhone and iPad

NO ADS. NO PURCHASES. NO TRACKING.
TinyGods works completely offline and collects no personal data. Your progress is saved only on your device.

name: TKDR
description:
TKDR is the companion app to the tournament registration platform tkdr.eu – for taekwondo coaches, clubs, athletes and parents.

On tournament day you see at a glance what matters for your team:

• Now: which fight is running on which court and which of your athletes are up next
• Weigh-in: who passed, who is still open and when the weigh-in closes
• Fights: every athlete's fight numbers with corner colour
• Standings: medal table and team ranking
• Athletes: ID card to show at the venue, also offline, plus results, certificate, stickers and trophies after the tournament

Notifications tell you when a fight is coming up or the weigh-in is about to close. If you like, the lock screen shows the next fight.

You need an account on tkdr.eu to sign in. Entries, payments and documents stay on tkdr.eu – the app opens the right pages for you.

name: Tlustplan
description: Tlustplan pomaga przygotować się do Tłustego Czwartku. Odliczaj dni do święta, oszacuj liczbę pączków według liczby osób i apetytu, zapisuj zamówienia oraz ustawiaj przypomnienia o odbiorze. Dodaj alergeny domowników, aby zobaczyć konflikty z domyślnymi składnikami wybranych rodzajów pączków. Zapisuj rzeczywisty czas oczekiwania i porównuj szacunki dla różnych pór dnia. W kuchni przelicz składniki klasycznych pączków z różą, odhaczaj zakupy i etapy przygotowania oraz korzystaj z timera. Po święcie zapisz zakupy i resztki, aby lepiej zaplanować kolejny sezon. Dane pozostają na urządzeniu, bez rejestracji. Aplikacja nie wysyła zamówień do cukierni ani nie obsługuje płatności.

name: Today's Blooms
description:
What are we arranging today?

Today's Blooms is a little flower book for your phone: sixteen arrangements, every one of them shoppable at a grocery store. Draw a card, take the list to the store, and arrange it yourself — no florist required.

SIXTEEN RECIPE CARDS, FOUR PACKS
• Everyday Table — easy jars and medleys for ordinary days (about $11-$23)
• Thanksgiving & Holiday — gratitude runners and festive centerpieces
• Christmas — amaryllis, holly and pine for the December table
• Cheer-Up Gift — small bouquets that say it for you

Each card tells you exactly what to buy: every flower with its stem count and an honest grocery-shelf price guess, plus a swap for anything the bucket is out of.

A SHOPPING LIST THAT WRITES ITSELF
Pick your cards and the booklet adds everything up into one list — every stem counted, ready to tick off at the store.

STEP BY STEP, WITH PICTURES
Follow the steps and watch the vase fill up as you work. Every step has its own picture, and you can tick steps off as you go.

MUSIC FOR ARRANGING
Each pack has its own gentle background music (by Kevin MacLeod, CC BY 4.0) that starts when you open a card. Tap the music button any time to hush it.

WHY TODAY'S BLOOMS?
• 100% free — every card, no paywall
• Works fully offline — cards, pictures, and music are all inside the app
• Private by design — no account, no ads, no data collected, ever
• Made for real grocery runs — real prices, real swaps, nothing precious

From the team behind todaysblooms.com.

Note: Prices in the app are honest estimates from the grocery shelf, not florist quotes — your store's bucket may differ a little.

name: Token Board & Reward Chart
description:
A token board for parents, teachers and therapists: a clear picture of what a child is working for, and how far there is to go.

I AM WORKING FOR…
Choose the reward and its picture, what the tokens are given for, and how many fill the board: three, five or ten. Then give a token with one tap each time it is earned. The token pops into its place with a bell that climbs a note every time. When the board is full: confetti, a fanfare, and "You did it!".

MADE TO BE HANDED OVER
Lock the board before you give the iPhone to the child: then only tokens can be given, and nothing can be changed or closed until you hold the lock. A token given by mistake can be taken back.

CALM CELEBRATIONS
For children who find confetti and fanfares too much: one switch replaces them with a quiet tick and a still "All done".

PICTURES THAT ARE CLEAR
Seventy-eight pictures for rewards, for home, for school and for going out, each on its own colour: video game, the park, brush teeth, get dressed, homework, the dentist. Twenty-four kinds of token: stars, hearts, smiles, paws, coins.

TOKEN BOARD PRO: AS MANY BOARDS AS YOU NEED
A board for homework, one for the table, one for the car, each in its own colour. For every child in the family or the class, each with their own boards.

TOKEN BOARD PRO: YOUR OWN PHOTOS
The real toy, the real playground, the child's own face as a token. Photos are chosen with the system's photo picker, made small and kept on the iPhone. Boards of any size, from 1 to 20 tokens.

TOKEN BOARD PRO: FIRST, THEN
"First homework, then the park": two big pictures. Tap the first when it is done, and the second lights up.

TOKEN BOARD PRO: SCHEDULES
The steps of a routine in pictures, to tick off one by one, with the next step marked. Start from Morning, Bedtime, After school, Washing hands or Going out, and change the steps to fit.

TOKEN BOARD PRO: THE RECORD
For each child: tokens today and this week, tokens per day for two weeks, and every reward, first-then board and schedule that was finished.

FREE
One child and one token board of three, five or ten tokens, with all the pictures and tokens of the app, the lock and the celebrations.

A TOOL, NOT A TREATMENT
Token boards, first-then boards and visual schedules are widely used at home, in classrooms and in behaviour support. The app is a tool for the adult who uses them; it gives no advice and makes no medical claims.

PRIVATE
No account. The names, the boards, the photos you choose and the record stay on your iPhone; the app sends nothing to us.

Token Board Pro is optional. It is offered as a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account's subscriptions. A free trial is shown in the app only when the App Store offers one to you, and it turns into the paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

Privacy Policy: https://www.appgeolist.com/app/token-board/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: TOMOLAN
description:
TOMOLAN is the Japanese learning app of www.vnjpclub.com. Start with Hiragana and Katakana and work your way up to JLPT N1 – lesson by lesson, level by level, a little every day.

TEXTBOOKS
• Minna no Nihongo, plus a library of textbooks by level (N5–N1): Mimikara Oboeru, Speed Master, Shin Kanzen Master, Marugoto, Dokkai 55+, Temabetsu, Kanji Look and Learn and more.
• Elementary, intermediate, kanji and general courses.

JLPT PRACTICE N5–N1
• Vocabulary, grammar, reading and listening practice for every level.
• "Review" gathers the questions you got wrong so you can practise exactly where you are weak.

DICTIONARY
• Look up Japanese vocabulary, kanji and grammar with English meanings.
• Type an exact word and the entry opens straight away, with reading and meaning.
• Safari extension included: tap Japanese words on web pages in Safari to see their Vietnamese meanings (iOS 16.4 or later).

STUDY EVERY DAY
• Sign in to save your progress and sync it between the app and the website.
• Daily study reminder at the time you choose.
• Furigana on/off, light and dark themes, several colour tones.
• Sign in with a TOMOLAN account (the same as on vnjpclub.com), Google or Apple – or try the app without an account.

VIP
Most lessons are free. VIP unlocks extra content and advanced study tools, and removes ads. VIP is an auto-renewable subscription of 1, 3, 6 or 12 months, paid with your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. One VIP account works in both the app and the website.

Privacy policy: https://www.vnjpclub.com/en/privacy-policy/
Terms of service: https://www.vnjpclub.com/en/terms-of-service/
Support: admin@vnjpclub.com

name: Tonight's Pour
description:
Tonight, which drink?

Tonight's Pour is a little home bar book for your phone: 45 cocktail recipes on cards. Draw a card, check your shelf, make something lovely — no bartending course required.

45 RECIPE CARDS
• 36 classics, mixed the IBA way — Old Fashioned, Negroni, Margarita, Daiquiri and friends
• A 9-card Holiday Collection — Classic Eggnog, Mulled Wine, Coquito, a zero-proof Spiced Apple Cider, and more
• Zero-proof drinks included and clearly marked 0% ABV

Every card gives exact amounts in ml, honest notes, and step-by-step mixing with a little glass picture that fills as you work. Making it for friends? Scale any recipe to 1/2, 1, 2 or 4 servings with one tap.

MY BAR — START WITH WHAT YOU OWN
Tick the bottles already on your shelf and every recipe updates itself: what you can pour tonight, and exactly what each other drink is still missing. No more buying a bottle for one drink and forgetting why.

A MOOD FOR EVERY GLASS
Each recipe carries its own background mood music (by Kevin MacLeod, CC BY 4.0) — smoky jazz for the stirred ones, bossa for the bright ones. Tap the music button any time to hush it.

WHY TONIGHT'S POUR?
• 100% free — every card, no paywall
• Works fully offline — recipes, pictures, and music are all inside the app
• Private by design — no account, no ads, no data collected, ever
• Real proportions — classic recipes, measured properly, nothing watered down

From the team behind tonightspour.com.

21+. Please drink responsibly. Zero-proof recipes are marked 0% ABV.

name: Touchdown Town: Fun Football
description:
Touchdown Town is a sunny, sticker-bright arcade football game you can finish in about ten minutes. Pick a city, call one of eight plays, then dodge, dive and sprint your way down the field. Eleven players a side, big chunky buttons, and a cheerful zebra referee named Stripes keeping everything fair.

EIGHT PLAYS, ONE BIG GUESS
Four runs and four passes: Smash up the middle, Zoom around the edge, Zip a quick throw, loft a Rainbow deep, and more. On defense, guess what the other team will try. Read them right and your tacklers get a head start.

RUN, THROW, TACKLE
Steer your runner with one thumb and tap a receiver to throw. On defense, chase the ball carrier and dive at the right moment. Time the kick meter to send field goals sailing through the uprights, and take kickoffs back on a return. Call timeouts late in a half to stop the clock.

32 HOMETOWN TEAMS
Every city has its own team, colors, mascot and personality: Boston's stubborn Beans, Buffalo's Snowballs that roll downhill, and thirty more. Each one has its own run, pass, defense and speed ratings.

ROOKIE HELP
Turned on, it slows the kick meter, widens the sweet spot and keeps the ball safe from fumbles, so even a first-time player can score. Switch it off and pick All-Star when you want a real challenge.

COACH MODE
Call every play and let your team run it on the field. Smart calls win games.

PLAY A FRIEND
Go head to head with someone nearby, or through Game Center.

WATCH MODE
Pick two towns and let the computer play. Speed it up, jump to the next score, or skip straight to the final whistle.

CALM AND KIND
Catchy jingles, soft crowd cheers and never a harsh buzzer. Missed kicks get a gentle shrug, not a scolding.

NO STRINGS
Every team and every mode is free. No ads, no accounts, and no internet needed to play the computer. Your game history stays on your device. If you enjoy it, you can leave an optional tip in Settings. Tips unlock nothing.

Touchdown Town is an independent game with original teams and art. It is not affiliated with any professional league.

name: TowerGridBuild
description: TowerGridBuild is a mobile building-puzzle game where players assemble a growing tower from different building pieces. Each placement affects the available space and can trigger score bonuses based on the current layout. Timed sessions, active skills, customization, and progression systems add variety to the core loop.

name: TPLUS-HR
description:
TPLUS-HR is the HR self-service app for employees of TPLUS Digital Co., Ltd. Manage your attendance, leave, overtime, and payslips from your phone.

CLOCK IN AND OUT
- Clock in and out when you are inside your assigned work zone
- Review your attendance log with clock-in, clock-out, and total hours
- See late entries and early leaves at a glance

LEAVE REQUESTS
- Submit leave requests with dates, leave type, morning or afternoon period, and reason
- Attach a supporting document, such as a medical certificate
- Track the status of your requests and see your leave history

OVERTIME (OT)
- Request overtime and turn on OT mode
- Follow your active OT session and review your OT request history

PAYSLIPS
- View your salary slips by month
- See earnings, allowances, deductions, and net pay in each payslip

APPROVALS
- Managers and approvers can review, approve, or reject leave and OT requests
- Get notifications when your requests are updated

SECURE SIGN-IN
- Sign in with your employee ID and password
- Set a 6-digit PIN for faster sign-in
- Use fingerprint or face unlock on supported devices

PROFILE AND SETTINGS
- View your personal information, department, and position
- Adjust the text size and switch between English and Lao

ACCESS
TPLUS-HR accounts are created by TPLUS HR for employees. If you do not have an account, please contact your HR department.

LOCATION
Location is used only to check your work zone when you sign in, clock in or out, and request overtime.

name: TRACKINGSV GPS
description:
TRACKING SV es la app oficial de TRACKING SV para monitorear tus vehículos y equipos GPS desde el celular, estés donde estés.

Con TRACKING SV puedes:
• Ver tus vehículos en tiempo real en el mapa, con su estado en colores: en movimiento, ralentí, estacionado o desconectado.
• Revisar el historial de recorridos y reproducir rutas.
• Recibir notificaciones al instante: encendido y apagado, exceso de velocidad, entrada y salida de geocercas y más.
• Generar reportes en PDF o Excel y compartirlos.
• Bloquear y desbloquear tu vehículo y activar el parqueo seguro (si tu plan lo incluye).
• Compartir la ubicación en tiempo real con un enlace.
• Ver el video en vivo de tus cámaras (si tu plan lo incluye).

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta del servicio de rastreo de TRACKING SV. Si todavía no la tienes, contáctanos:
+50375973860 · infogpstracksv@gmail.com · https://gps.trackingsv.net

name: Trado
description:
TRADO – Cold Chain, Delivered Right.

Create shipments, track packages in real time, and manage your deliveries in one simple app.

• Create shipments in seconds
• Real-time package tracking
• COD tracking and payment requests
• Clear, exportable reports
• Instant status notifications
• Arabic and English support

Download TRADO and ship with confidence.

name: Traffic Fines Tajikistan
description:
Traffic Fines Tajikistan is an independent reference to transport offences in Tajikistan. Find an article, read the applicable penalties and calculate fine amounts in somoni, even without an internet connection.

FIND THE RELEVANT ARTICLE
Search by article and part number, words or familiar terms, including red lights, speeding, parking, seat belts and phone use while driving.

EXPLORE THE CATALOGUE
Browse 151 active offences across 23 categories. Details retain article numbers, parts and legal wording. Fine ranges for individuals, officials and legal entities are shown separately. Read additional and alternative penalties, repeat-offence conditions and related parts of each article.

CALCULATE IN SOMONI
Convert calculation units to somoni, including fractional units. One calculation unit for 2026 is 78 TJS. The calculator provides reference amounts, not a decision on a penalty in a particular case.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY REFERENCE
• Use the catalogue, search, calculator and favourites offline.
• Save articles, copy their text and share them.
• Choose Russian, Tajik or English.
• Select a light, dark or system theme.
• No registration or purchases are required. The app contains ads.

ABOUT THE DATA
The bundled database uses the legislative edition dated 16 February 2026. No complete legal verification as of a later date is claimed. Tajik and English translations of legal text are provided for information and are not presented as official translations. The Russian source text remains available in the app.

SOURCES FOR VERIFICATION
Code of Administrative Offences of the Republic of Tajikistan, published on WIPO Lex:
https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/en/legislation/details/23714

Calculation unit for 2026, Ministry of Transport of the Republic of Tajikistan:
https://www.mintrans.tj/news-page/details/965

INDEPENDENT REFERENCE
This app does not represent a government body and is not affiliated with the Ministry of Internal Affairs or the traffic police. It does not check personal outstanding fines or accept fine payments. Information is for reference; the legislation in force in the Republic of Tajikistan is the legally authoritative source.

Support: alisher.mukaramov@icloud.com

name: Transcribe: Offline Notes
description:
Transcribe records, transcribes, and separates speakers entirely on your phone.

After you download a speech model once, nothing about your recordings leaves the device: no account, no upload, no cloud processing, no analytics. It works in airplane mode.

RECORD
- Start with one tap, then pause, resume, and stop from the app or the notification
- Bookmark a moment while you record, without interrupting capture
- A free-space warning stops and saves the recording before storage runs out
- A crash or a killed app brings the pending recording back at the next launch

TRANSCRIBE
- On-device transcription with speaker separation, so you can see who said what
- Unknown speakers and overlapping speech are shown as they are, never guessed at
- Pick the language you record in; each speech model covers one language
- Import an existing audio file instead of recording

READ AND CORRECT
- Every segment carries a timestamp; tap one to hear that moment
- Edit any line, with the original model output always kept, and switch between raw and edited
- Playback with speed control, skip, replay, and follow-along through the transcript
- Bookmarks with notes, reachable from the timeline or the transcript

FIND IT LATER
- Search titles, tags, transcripts, speaker names, and bookmarks
- Open a result at the exact moment in the recording
- Tags, filters, and bulk actions for libraries that grow

name: Transport Phenomena: Gradivane
description:
Transport Phenomena: Gradivane is a course app for engineering undergraduates that teaches how momentum, heat and mass move, and what the three have in common.

Learn it two ways and switch at any time. Classical follows the usual syllabus order across 24 units: fluxes and the three laws, shell balances for Couette and tube flow, power-law fluids, boundary layers, conduction and fins, transient conduction, laminar convection, diffusion, diffusion with reaction, and convective mass transfer with the Chilton-Colburn analogy. Real-world starts from something you want to make, and the theory appears at the moment you need it: design a heat-sink pin fin, plan a drug-delivery patch, size a catalyst pellet, pump a shear-thinning polymer. Finished designs are saved on your Made-it shelf.

Seven interactive labs, each tied to a cited relation and checked against a second numerical method: a boundary-layer studio with Blasius profiles and thermal layers, a space-time map of a cooling slab, a fin bench, tube-flow rheology for Newtonian and power-law fluids, a catalyst pellet with the Thiele modulus, an analogy explorer for Prandtl and Schmidt numbers, and an erfc penetration front.

Adaptive practice: 844 original questions across four levels from Beginner to Research. Numeric answers are accepted within a tolerance and every numeric answer is cross-checked by a separate numerical solver. Your mastery is tracked on the device for each concept, fades gently when you are away, and decides what is suggested next. After every quiz you get encouraging, specific feedback with links to the lesson, the lab and a free drill for what to look at next. Choose 5, 10, 20, 40 or a custom number of questions, or take a timed, ad-free mock exam.

Sources are cited and open in a full-width sheet with Back and Close. Text size goes from 50 to 300 percent on every screen. The app works offline and keeps your progress on the device.

Free with ads. Watch a short video to unlock premium features for 24 hours, or remove ads and unlock everything with a monthly subscription. Lessons, worked solutions and your progress always stay free. Payment is charged to your store account, the subscription renews monthly until cancelled in your store account settings, and the price is shown by the store before you subscribe. Restore purchases is in More.

Education only: examples use idealised models and are not a design standard for real equipment. Not affiliated with any university or textbook publisher named in the sources.
