Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-transport-phenomena-gradivane.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Trapdoor: Creature Swap
description:
Four friends are stuck in a world of traps, and nobody gets out alone.

Creature Swap is a puzzle platformer where you switch between four creatures. Each one can do something nobody else can:
- The Hero is the only one who can carry keys.
- The BbuJjhy jumps high and presses the paw switches nobody else can reach.
- The Lujy carries a light, and some floors only exist while it shines on them.
- The Cujy builds tubes that carry friends across gaps.

Park one friend on a switch, swap to another, and work out who goes where. Everyone has to reach the door.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 72 hand-built rooms across 6 worlds
- Friends locked in cages, waiting to be rescued
- Ryrunts: sneaky critters that steal your key. Stomp one to get it back.
- Dark rooms where only the Lujy's light shows the way
- Two players on one screen: each of you plays a different creature, and you solve it together
- Build a Trap: make your own rooms, beat them yourself, then dare someone else
- English and Spanish

HOW IT PLAYS
Move with the arrows, jump, and tap a friend's face to become them. In two-player, each player has their own buttons and their own row of faces at their end of the screen.

MADE FOR KIDS, TRICKY FOR EVERYONE
Built by a dad in Malaga for his five kids, with creatures dreamed up by one of them. No ads, no purchases, no accounts, no data collected, and it works offline.

Every room has been verified beatable, in one-player and two-player.

name: Tripsya: Travel Planner
description:
Tripsya turns a destination into a simple, day-by-day plan.

Pick a place, choose how many days you have, and Tripsya lays out what to see each day, in a sensible order, with honest tips on timing and pace.

WHAT YOU GET
• Day-by-day plans for well-known destinations, from the Kerala backwaters and the Taj Mahal to Petra, Kyoto, Santorini, Machu Picchu and more
• Travel guides with the best months to go and how long to stay
• Recent flight fares seen by other travellers, so you know roughly what a route costs
• Quick links to book flights, airport transfers, car hire, tours and travel eSIMs with well-known partners
• English, Malayalam, Hindi and Arabic, with full right-to-left support

HOW BOOKING WORKS
Tripsya is a planner, not a travel agency. When you tap a booking link, you book directly with that partner on their own site. Prices and availability come from the partner. Some links are affiliate links, which means we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. Details: tripsya.com/affiliate-disclosure

PRIVACY
No account needed. Error reports are only sent if you agree.

Questions or feedback: social@tripsya.com

name: TrovePress
description:
Trove Press is a clipping book for the digitised Australian press. Type a name, a street or an event, and the app reads the newspaper columns the National Library of Australia has scanned since 1803, marking the words you searched for and showing which years kept returning to the same subject. A family that appears once in 1854 and eleven times in 1889 is telling you something, and the coverage ribbon makes that rhythm visible before you read a single line.

Cut the passage that matters into a clipping, write the note you will still understand in five years, and keep it beside its citation. Arrivals, weddings, obituaries and land sales can be gathered into a family timeline that follows a household from the wharf to the third generation. Because the text was read by machine from old paper, the app also searches the spellings that typesetters and scanners produced, and it always points back to the original page so the image can settle the question.

name: Tsubuyaki Kifu: Go Records
description:
Create, keep and share Go (baduk / weiqi) game records.
Tsubuyaki Kifu lets you record and edit Go games on your phone and share them right away.

- Create and edit
  * Boards from 19×19 down to 4×4 (Renju supported too)
  * Triangle, square, circle and X marks, letter and number labels, dimmed areas
  * Comments on every move and game info (players, ranks, komi, result and more)
  * Variations are created automatically when you play a different move
  * Zoom input: long-press to zoom in and place stones precisely, even on 19×19
  * Rotate, mirror and swap colors

- My Kifu (auto-save)
  * Records you create or open are saved on your device automatically; the app resumes where you left off
  * Search by players, title or memo; filter by board size, handicap, date and the app that made the record
  * Position search: place an opening or joseki on the board to find games where the same shape appears (rotations, mirror images and swapped colors included)
  * Memos for each record and folders
  * Export / import everything at once (for a new phone or a backup)

- Share
  * Share links on LINE or X, copy the URL, or copy an image + link for blogs
  * Save or share SGF files, copy SGF text
  * Copy a text diagram of the board for places where images can't be posted
  * Export animated GIFs or MP4 videos for social media

- View and edit
  * Shared records open in a read-only viewer, so nothing changes by accident
  * Tap Edit to start editing from the move you are viewing

- Open files
  * SGF, GIB (Tygem), NGF, UGF (Pandanet) and IG1
  * Open them from Files, mail or chat attachments with Tsubuyaki Kifu

- Also
  * Japanese, English, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese (follows your device language)
  * Built-in help
  * Shows notices about related services of the developer at the bottom of the screen (Japanese only)

Links to records shared from the web version (https://igo-kids.com/pk/) open in the app too.

name: Tsypa Clap
description:
You got a budgie last spring. Now you're not entirely sure when you last weighed it, the cage schedule lives in a voice memo somewhere, and you're pretty sure the nail check is weeks overdue. This is exactly the gap Tsypa Clap was built to fill.

Tsypa Clap is a companion app for people who keep birds — a single canary on the windowsill or a whole flock of parrots that run the household. It brings care routines, health records and bird knowledge into one clean place, requires no account and stores everything on your device.

 Keep track of what actually matters

Add each bird with their species, hatch date, sex and a photo. Build a care plan around daily food changes, weekly cage cleans, monthly health checks — whatever your flock needs. Set a reminder and the app handles the nudging. Every task you tick off earns feathers, the in-app currency that unlocks something surprisingly satisfying down the line.

Learn while you care

The Academy takes you through bird biology without being dry about it: illustrated lessons on feathers, beaks, feet, flight, songs and nests, each one ending in a short quiz. There are thirty vocabulary cards to flip through and an interactive anatomy diagram you can tap apart piece by piece — useful when you finally want to know what a syrinx is or why a parrot's knee looks like it bends the wrong way.

Games worth coming back to

The Tsypa Clap holds five mini-games — Owl Memory, Stymphalian Rhythm, Bolt Dodge, Swan Pairs and Phoenix Merge — each tied to a guardian from Greek myth. Win feathers, then spend them restoring ruined shrines from rubble all the way to full Olympian radiance. It sounds like a small side feature but it keeps pulling you back.

 What's under the hood

 Weight logs with species reference ranges. Health notes with dates. Task intervals from one day to a year. Local notifications. No subscription, no cloud, nothing sold.

 Just your birds — a little more organised than yesterday.

name: Tucola: Sticker Maker
description:
Turn your own photos into WhatsApp stickers. Tucola removes the background on your iPhone, lets you add an outline, meme text and emoji, and organizes everything into packs ready to send.

MAKE STICKERS IN SECONDS
- Pick a photo and the background comes off right on your device
- White or colored outline, in any thickness
- Meme text with ready-made Brazilian Portuguese phrases or your own
- Emoji tags so WhatsApp suggests the right sticker in chat
- A brush to erase or restore any part of the cutout

AI STYLE
- Turn a photo into anime, caricature, cartoon, 3D figure or comic style
- Each style uses 1 credit per photo. You get 3 credits to try it and can buy more credit packs
- If a conversion fails, the credit comes back
- The photo is sent to OpenAI only to generate the style, it is not used to train models and may be kept up to 30 days for abuse monitoring

ANIMATED STICKERS (PRO)
- Create animated stickers from videos and Live Photos, with text, outline and emoji

YOUR PACK ALBUM
- Organize stickers into packs of up to 30, like pages of an album
- The app checks everything before sending: at least 3 stickers, the right size and an emoji on each
- Works with WhatsApp: tap Add to WhatsApp and allow paste when WhatsApp asks
- Copy or share each sticker to other apps too

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
- Cutting, editing and building packs work offline
- No account, no sign-up and no ads
- Your photos stay on your iPhone

TUCOLA PRO
- Unlimited packs and animated stickers with a single purchase, no subscription

Tucola is an independent app and is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by WhatsApp.

name: Tuke
description:
Tuke is a project manager for DIY and home improvement work. Instead of plans in one notes app, receipts in a drawer, and progress in your head, each project gets a single home for its plan, budget, and record.

Create a project with a cover photo, a category such as Woodwork, Painting, or Gardening, and a status from Planning to Completed. Build a materials list with quantities and unit prices; Tuke totals the budget while you mark each item Pending, On Hand, or Partial. Break the work into steps with estimated hours and watch the progress ring fill as you complete them. Keep a tool list marked Owned or Need, and file photos in Phase, Compare, and Done albums with captions and a full-screen zoom viewer.

Collect ideas on an inspiration board with images, links, and project associations. The profile tab shows total, active, and completed project counts, budget-versus-spent statistics for every project, and exports all data as a shareable JSON file.

Five sample projects are preloaded so you can explore before starting your own.

name: Turkish Cases: Step by Step
description:
Turkish cases, one small step at a time.

Turkish has no genders and no declension types: one suffix fits every word, and the last vowel decides its form. Pady teaches this system in 47 short steps, from "evde" to "Ali'nin arabası".

HOW IT WORKS
• Every step starts with one small table, then 10 sentences to practise.
• Pick the right form and see the answer at once.
• Every mistake is explained: the right form, a short hint and the step's table in one tap.
• Build long words from suffix tiles: ev + imiz + de = evimizde.
• Vowel harmony in colour: e, i, ö, ü → -de; a, ı, o, u → -da.
• "My mistakes" brings back the sentences you missed.

WHAT YOU LEARN
• Where? Where to? Where from? -de, -e, -den, and the apostrophe in names
• The object: -ı / -i / -u / -ü, consonant changes (kitap → kitabı)
• "With": ile and -le
• Personal and question pronouns: bana, sana, kimi, nereye
• Possession: evim, evin, Ali'nin arabası, okul kapısı
• Which verbs want which case: -e bakmak, -den korkmak, -i beklemek

The interface is in English, Russian or Turkish.

FREE AND FULL ACCESS
The first two steps and 10 practice questions a day are free. A subscription opens all 7 chapters and unlimited practice.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel them in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/turkishcases

name: TurnGo: Chess Clock & Timer
description:
TurnGo is a chess clock and turn timer for every game on the table: blitz and tournament chess, Go and shogi, word games, strategy games, and any game where someone takes too long. No adverts, no account, no internet needed.

A PROPER CHESS CLOCK
• Fischer increment, Bronstein and simple (US) delay.
• Tournament controls with up to five stages, each with its own increment: FIDE 90/40 + 30, "120/40, then +30 s from move 41", and your own.
• Time odds for a stronger player, and Armageddon.
• Hourglass, time per move, byo-yomi and Canadian overtime.
• Your tap counts the moment your finger touches the screen, and time is measured precisely, never by counting ticks.

BOARD GAMES FOR 2 TO 8 PLAYERS
• Names and colours for everyone. Tap to pass the turn, or tap a name to hand it to someone else.
• Pass for the round, reverse the order, or roll to see who starts.
• Time per turn, a bank of time each, or count up to see who takes longest.
• When time runs out, the game ends, that player is out and the rest carry on, or the clock keeps counting in red.
• An optional nudge when a turn goes on too long.

FIX MISTAKES IN A SECOND
• Undo a wrong tap, and the time goes back exactly.
• Adjust any clock: add or take away time, give a two-minute penalty, set an exact time or correct the move count.

HARD TO MISS
• Amber when time runs low, then red with a beep every second at the end.
• A long, loud time's-up alarm with vibration.
• Big digits that fill any screen and face the player opposite, in portrait or landscape. Light and dark themes.

EVERY GAME REMEMBERED
• Results for each finished game: each player's total, average and longest turn, and a turn-by-turn timeline.
• A game in progress is saved, and comes back paused if the app is closed.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
TurnGo needs no account and doesn't use the internet. Your timers and game history stay on your device and are included in your phone's own backup, and you can save a backup file wherever you like.

name: Turnholm: Chores & Cooking
description:
Turnholm keeps track of who's doing what around the house, starting with the kitchen.

Tap who shopped, prepped, cooked and cleaned up for breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks. Add the other chores your household does. Turnholm adds up the points and shows each person's share next to the split you agreed on.

Your household. Your definition of fair.

AGREE ON THE EFFORT
Rate each meal job and chore Light, Medium or Heavy. Pick chores from a starter list or add your own. Any single job can be marked Quick, Normal or Big, with a short note.

RECORD IT AS THE DAY GOES
One tap says who did a job. More than one person can share a job, Prep and Cooking can be split into named parts, and a job that wasn't needed can be marked that way. Log shopping trips, say who ate, and mark a meal as reheated.

SEE WHERE YOU STAND
Totals shows a week or a month: points for each person, their share against their target, and ideas for evening it up. Choose the split that's fair for you: 50/50, 60/40 or anything else.

WORK IT OUT TOGETHER
When two or more people in a household have their own login:
Check this asks about an entry you're not sure of.
Thanks says thank you for one.
A change to how heavy something is, or to target shares, is a suggestion the others accept before it counts.
A weigh-in lets everyone rate every job and chore privately, then shows the answers together.
Each week, everyone says Looks right before the week locks.

FOR ANY HOUSEHOLD
Couples, families and housemates, up to 12 people. Children, and anyone who doesn't need a login, can be added as a name. Owners invite the others to log in with their own email address.

GOOD TO KNOW
Turnholm needs an internet connection.
The same account and records work on turnholm.com.
No ads and no tracking.
Light and dark, following your phone.
A login is for people 18 and over.
Delete my account is at the bottom of Settings.

THE PLAN
Turnholm needs a plan. One plan covers your whole household, however many people log in. Choose monthly or yearly; the price is shown before you pay. The plan renews by itself until it's cancelled, and you can cancel any time in your Apple account.

Privacy: https://turnholm.com/privacy
Terms: https://turnholm.com/terms
Questions: support@turnholm.com

name: Turret Defence: Tower Defense
description:
Bug swarms are rushing your wall. Place your turrets, merge them, power them up and survive to the last wave!

A new choice every level
Level up as you defeat enemies and pick one of three cards: a new turret, an upgrade, twin barrels for your main cannon, or risky but powerful cards. Every run ends with a different build.

20 weapons
Gatling, Tesla, Cryo, Mortar, Railgun, Drone Hive and more. Find the right pairs and unlock hidden combos.

10 giant bosses
Scorpion, Crab, Centipede, Wasp Nest, Magma Worm… each with its own attacks. Beat the boss and choose a rare reward.

Waves full of surprises
Fog, Bounty, Frenzy, Meteor Shower. When the wave changes, so does your strategy.

You choose the target
Tap an enemy and every turret locks on.

Modes
• 100-level campaign plus elite levels
• Endless mode: how long can you last?
• Boss Rush: bosses back to back
• Daily challenge: same level and same condition for everyone

name: TV Media Monitor
description:
TV Media Monitor is a professional media-intelligence app for campaign teams, political parties, agencies and communication teams. It brings live television and YouTube news monitoring, alarms and analytics from the Media Pulse platform to your iPhone, so your team can see what is being said on air and online without sitting in front of a desktop.

Access is by invitation only. You need a username and password issued by GROK MEDIA PRIVATE LIMITED or by your organisation's administrator. The app does not offer public sign-up.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Live Wall
Watch a wall of monitored news channels and YouTube sources, filter by TV, YouTube or Punjab channels, and open any channel in a full-screen player.

Alarms
See when a negative or viral story airs on several channels. Review each alarm, acknowledge it, and open the related stories. The Alarm Log keeps a history of past alarms, and an airings map shows where and when a story ran.

War Room
See airtime and narrative trends in one view: share of voice by party, spreading stories, a daily airtime-by-party chart and an airtime map across channels.

Reports and analytics
Browse candidate coverage, Vox Pop public-opinion segments, perception scores, issue tracking, rebuttal points and daily reports. Export data to share with your team.

Spokesperson and debate tracking
Review spokesperson clips and debate shows, with an in-app video and audio player, and look up each speaker and their appearances.

Response Tracker and Narrative Predictor
Track attacks and responses, see which ones are still unanswered and how long responses take, and review narrative predictions.

Party Tracker, Campaign Intel and Election Desk
Follow stories by party, review campaign intelligence such as attack lines, voices and political ads, and use the Election Desk for seats, polls, leaders and the election calendar.

Channels and keywords
Add or manage monitored channels and keywords, and view monitoring status, depending on your role. Viewer accounts are read-only.

Notes and support
Keep alerts and notes, change sign-in preferences, and message the administrator from inside the app.

DESIGNED FOR PROFESSIONAL USE
- Dark, high-contrast interface built for quick reading.
- Role-based access: administrators, members and view-only users.
- Some actions use AI-assisted analysis. These actions ask for confirmation before they run.
- Encrypted connection (HTTPS) to the Media Pulse servers.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION
- TV Media Monitor analyses publicly broadcast and publicly published content to produce monitoring reports. Summaries and AI-assisted outputs should be reviewed by a person before they are relied on or published.
- The app is not affiliated with any government body or broadcaster, and it is not a news publisher.
- Privacy policy: https://www.grokmedia.in/privacy

Need an account or a demo? Contact salman@grokmedia.in or visit https://www.grokmedia.in/

name: TVHand: Smart TV Remote
description:
Your phone is the remote.

Lost the remote? Tired of typing letter by letter with arrow keys? TVHand turns your iPhone into a fast remote for your smart TV over your home Wi‑Fi. No ads, no account.

WHY TVHAND
• Show photos and videos on the TV: pick them on your iPhone and they play on TVs that support it. Nothing is copied to the TV.
• Nothing to install on the TV: TVHand uses the remote service your TV already has.
• Type from your iPhone: use your iPhone keyboard for searches and passwords on the TV.
• Search YouTube by voice or text on Google TV: say what you want to watch and the results open on your TV.
• Remote without opening the app: a Home Screen widget, a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Control Center controls (iOS 18) for volume, OK, power and arrows.
• A mouse pointer on LG TVs: for apps that ignore the arrow keys.
• Popular apps, one tap: open YouTube, Netflix, Shahid and more from your phone (the list depends on your TV).
• Switch the TV input (HDMI) to your receiver or game console.
• Finds your TV by itself in seconds and remembers it next time.
• Try it without a TV: demo mode shows you everything before any setup.

WORKS WITH
Google TV and Android TVs with Google's remote service, Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS) and Roku.

TRY 3 DAYS, THEN SUBSCRIBE
Try every feature for 3 days when you start a monthly or yearly plan (new subscribers only). Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends and nothing is charged.
Then keep TVHand Pro with a monthly or yearly subscription. After the trial, every feature, including Power, needs a subscription.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
TVHand Pro is an auto‑renewable subscription (1 month or 1 year). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

SETUP
Samsung and LG: press Allow on the TV the first time. Google TV and Android TV: type the code shown on the TV the first time.
Nothing is ever installed on the TV.
Some features depend on your TV: the mouse works on LG TVs, YouTube search on Google TV.

YOUR PRIVACY
Commands go straight from your phone to your TV inside your home network. No account, and we don't collect your data.

TVHand is an independent app and is not affiliated with Samsung, LG, Google, Roku or any streaming service. YouTube, Netflix and other names belong to their owners and are used only to show compatibility.

Terms of Use: https://devahmedfares.github.io/tvhand/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://devahmedfares.github.io/tvhand/privacy.html

name: twiceword
description:
twiceword is a personal dictionary for the words you encounter while reading. Look up words and passages in English, Chinese, Japanese, and French, then keep them in your own library.

UNDERSTAND A WORD IN CONTEXT
Read meanings, parts of speech, examples, and common expressions together. Chinese entries include pinyin with tone marks.

READ THE WHOLE PASSAGE
Enter a sentence or short passage to see a translation. Add the words and expressions you want to remember to your vocabulary.

NOTICE WHAT YOU LOOK UP AGAIN
Your lookups stay in history. Looking up the same word again increases its count instead of creating another entry. Filter by language, search your library, and add personal notes to words.

TAKE YOUR DICTIONARY WITH YOU
Start as a guest. Sign in with an email verification code to use the same dictionary on another device or on the web. Switch the interface between Japanese and English.

Lookups require an internet connection. New AI generations have usage limits, and AI explanations can contain errors. The app shows the AI recipient and asks for permission before sending your input. Optional usage sharing for product improvement is off by default.

name: Twinge: Recovery Tracker
description:
Twinge is a quick, private way to track the niggles that come with training and everyday life, and to see how they change over time.

LOG IN SECONDS
• One tap when you feel fine.
• Tap the body map, slide the intensity, add a few words when something's off.
• An optional evening check-in, with a one-tap answer right from the notification.

SEE THE PATTERNS
• A Today screen with your 7-day level, streaks, sleep and steps.
• Trends that adapt from 7 to 90 days, with your workouts alongside.
• See how sleep, workouts and your routine compared on harder days.

ANALYSIS ON YOUR IPHONE
• See what changed, where it shows up, and what your own notes keep mentioning.
• Written on your iPhone by Apple Intelligence on supported devices; clear plain-language summaries on others.

SHARE IT YOUR WAY
• Share progress and milestones as clean cards for Stories or posts.
• Make a one-page summary to share with anyone you choose.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account. No ads. No tracking.
• Everything is stored on your iPhone. Apple Health data is read only and never leaves your device.
• Export a backup whenever you like.

Works with Apple Health, so workouts and sleep from Apple Watch and watches that sync to Health (like Garmin, COROS and Polar) can appear next to your entries.

Twinge is a personal log. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition. Talk to a clinician before making medical decisions.

name: Twinkle Moss Meadow
description:
Twinkle Moss Meadow is three merge puzzle games in one app. Slide stardust into a Black Hole in Cosmo Merge, chain falling gems in Gem Cascade, and match three to grow a garden in Bloom Garden. It works fully offline, with no ads and no account.
Features:
	•	Three games: Cosmo Merge, Gem Cascade and Bloom Garden.
	•	90 levels: 30 per game. Earn up to 3 stars on each.
	•	Five modes: Classic, Blitz, Daily, Zen and Levels.
	•	Daily Quests: a new challenge every day, with coin rewards.
	•	Progress to chase: Quest Level, streaks, badges and the Codex.
	•	Theme Shop: tile skins, boards and power-ups, bought with coins you earn.
	•	Leaderboards and stats: your top scores and full game history.
	•	Glossy 3D tiles: smooth animations, plus Dark Mode and VoiceOver support.

How to play:
	•	Cosmo Merge: swipe to slide the tiles. Two of the same merge into the next item.
	•	Gem Cascade: tap a column to drop a gem. Matching gems merge and can chain into combos.
	•	Bloom Garden: place pieces so three or more of the same kind touch, and they grow.
	•	Levels: reach the goal before you run out of moves.

Benefits:
	•	Three puzzle games in one app.
	•	Play anywhere: fully offline.
	•	Quick or relaxing sessions.
	•	Daily rewards and goals to chase.
	•	No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases.

name: Twistway
description:
Your ball rides a road that never stops twisting. Tap to switch lanes. Dodge the blocks. Grab gems and power-ups.

It starts easy. Then it gets fast. Hit max speed and the screen goes red.

Power-ups
Shield takes a hit for you.
Magnet pulls in every gem nearby.
Slow-Mo gives you a second to breathe.
Boost doubles your points, but you still have to dodge.

Make it yours
16 themes with moving backgrounds. Galaxy, Lava, Storm, Sakura, even a golf course.
16 balls, each with its own trail. Fireball, Black Hole, Saturn, a peppermint and more.
Classic, Dot and Cube are free. Mono unlocks when you score 120.

Game Center leaderboard so you can see who's actually good.

No ads.

name: TWM V2
description:
TWM v2 is here: a completely redesigned app, built to keep you in control of everything you track.

TWM changes the way you use your tracking devices. Share your tracker's live location with anyone, anytime, from anywhere, and follow it in real time. Version 2 brings a fresh new interface, faster navigation and powerful new tools, all in one app.

WHAT'S NEW IN v2
• All-new design: a clean, modern interface with simple bottom navigation: Home, Map, Menu and Alerts are always one tap away.
• Home at a glance: see your vehicle's status and last location the moment you open the app.
• Ask: tap the Ask button for quick help with your trackers, right inside the app.
• Your language: use TWM in English, Hindi, Gujarati, French, German or Spanish.
• Sign in your way: log in or sign up with your email or phone number.

LIVE TRACKING
• Follow every tracker live on the map, with connection status, battery level and address.
• Search and switch between all your vehicles from one list.
• Share live location with family, friends or your team.

SMART GEOFENCING
• Create multiple geofences and customise the shape and size of each one.
• Link geofences to your trackers and get an alert the moment a boundary is crossed.

INSTANT ALERTS
• Get notified about geofence entry and exit, low battery and other important events.
• Filter alerts by type or by vehicle, and choose which notifications you receive.

TRIPS AND REPORTS
• Review past trips, stops and route history.
• Trip, stop and summary reports help you understand how your vehicles are used.

DEVICE CONTROLS
• My Devices: manage your tracker hardware in one place.
• Add new devices quickly by scanning their barcode.
• Immobilise or mobilise a vehicle remotely (on supported devices).
• Live dash cam streaming (on supported devices).
• TWM StiQR: scan a vehicle's QR sticker to contact its driver.
• Parking records for your vehicles.

SHOP
• Buy TWM trackers, dash cams and accessories directly in the app

Whether you're managing personal safety, keeping an eye on loved ones or overseeing valuable assets, TWM v2 gives you a seamless, intuitive experience. Take charge like a pro and enjoy peace of mind with TWM, your ultimate tracking companion.

name: TYCC
description:
TYCC, Türkiye'nin Yorkshire kanarya derneğinin resmî uygulamasıdır.

• 2002'den bu yana yapılan yarışmaların sonuçlarını, dereceleri ve BEST sıralamalarını görün.
• Üyeler: yarışma kayıtlarınızı, kuşlarınızı ve bileziklerinizi takip edin, kafes etiketindeki QR kodu okutup kuşun bilgilerine ulaşın.
• Bileziği tek yerden talep edin.
• Yarışma sonuçları ve duyurular için bildirim alın.
• Irk standartları, yarışma tüzüğü, kategoriler ve yönetim kurulu bilgileri elinizin altında.

Uygulamadaki bilgiler tycc.org.tr ile aynıdır.

name: typelink: Links Keyboard
description:
Stop hunting for links. typelink is a keyboard that knows your links.

Save the links you share all the time, like your Instagram, booking page, portfolio, media kit or store, with the phrases you'd naturally type. Then just write. When you type "my instagram" or "book a time", typelink shows the right link above the keys. One tap puts it in your message.

YOUR LINKS, EVERYWHERE YOU TYPE
• Works in Messages, WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, Mail, Slack and any app that uses the keyboard.
• Add links right on your iPhone, or sync them from the typelink Chrome extension.
• Use the same links in Claude and ChatGPT through the typelink connector.

A KEYBOARD THAT FEELS FAMILIAR
• Key sizes and positions match the iOS keyboard.
• Gentle autocorrect that leaves names, handles and slang alone.
• Smart tap targets that help when you type fast.

FIND ANY LINK
• Live search finds brand pages, videos, news and places without leaving your conversation.
• Nothing is sent until you tap search, and only the words you searched for.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Nothing you type is ever stored or sent.
• Matching happens on your iPhone.
• Your saved links work even with Allow Full Access off; only live search needs it.

TYPELINK PRO
Free covers one iPhone and 10 web searches a day. Pro adds up to 10 phones and 500 searches a day. Pro is bought on typelink's website.

name: TZTIP
description: It offers a convenient way to browse summaries, organize tracked content, review history, analyze categorized information, and monitor subsequent developments. Within a clean, structured workspace, you can fluidly switch between an overview of overall progress and the details of individual items, while also comparing changes in their respective statuses.

name: UE ERP
description:
UE ERP is a unified school and campus management application designed to bridge students, parents, teachers, and school administration seamlessly.

Key Features:
• Student & Parent Portal: Real-time academic tracking, attendance records, exam schedules, and report cards.
• Dual Verification Leave Requests: Safe leave application system with student submission and parent consent verification.
• Fee Management & Receipts: Easy fee overview, payment breakdown, and instant digital receipts.
• Class & Homework Updates: Daily assignments, study material, and school circulars.
• Staff & Teacher Tools: Quick attendance marking, student reviews, and leave sanctions.
• Instant Alerts: Important institutional announcements and emergency notifications delivered via push notifications.

Empowering schools with smart, secure, and modern digital governance.

name: UHAI · Explore Komori
description:
UHAI · Explore Komori vous fait découvrir la nature des Comores : Ngazidja, Mwali et Ndzuani.

Les Trésors des Comores : 172 plantes et animaux qui ne vivent nulle part ailleurs, avec photos, noms en shikomori et en français, et statut de menace.
La carte des observations : plus de 17 000 observations sur les îles, à explorer espèce par espèce.
Le calendrier de la nature : baleines à bosse, ponte des tortues, floraison de l'ylang-ylang… Recevez un rappel quand une saison commence.
Sur le terrain : enregistrez la carte et les photos pour les consulter sans connexion.
Observer : notez ce que vous voyez, avec photo et position. Les publications des élèves et des chercheurs sont validées par leur enseignant.
Une appli pour les écoles, les familles, les guides et tous les curieux. Conçue avec des chercheurs de l'Université des Comores. Gratuite, sans publicité. Conçue par MMBT.

name: Umeetz: Meet People Nearby
description:
Umeetz shows you who is nearby without ever showing where anyone is.

Instead of dropping pins on a map, Umeetz divides the world into small squares. You see how many people are in each square around you. Tap a square to see who is there, and start a conversation.

THREE WAYS TO MEET
• Dating: meet someone new close to you.
• Business: find professionals and opportunities around you.
• Friendship: find people to hang out with nearby.
Each mode has its own profile and photos, so you decide what to show in each one.

PRIVACY FIRST
• Your exact location is never shared. Other people only see the square you are in.
• You choose when you are visible. Turn visibility off any time.
• Block and report anyone, right from their profile or the chat.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create your profile and pick the modes you want.
2. Open the map and see how many people are in the squares near you.
3. Tap a square, browse the people there, and show interest.
4. Chat in real time when the interest is mutual.

Umeetz is for adults (18+).

Questions or feedback: https://umeetz.com

name: UMOSONE GW
description:
모바일 그룹웨어 앱입니다.
PC에서 사용하는 기능 그대로 모바일 그룹웨어를 사용할 수 있습니다.
결재메뉴의 기안작성 / 결재처리 / 첨부 / 진행현황을 확인 할 수 있습니다.
메일 / 게시판 / 웹폴더 / 일정 / 직원검색 / 자원예약 메뉴를 사용 할 수 있습니다.
웹과 완벽하게 통합된 하이브리드 앱 방식입니다.

name: Underground Aquarium
description:
Underground Aquarium is the app for people who keep fish. Test your water, find what's wrong and fix it fast, then buy, sell and trade fish with keepers near you.

WATER CHECK
Enter the numbers from your test strip or liquid kit: temperature, pH, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, GH and KH. Water Check tells you right away what's off, why it matters and exactly what to do about it. Cycling a new tank with no fish yet? Flip on Fishless Cycle and it coaches you through it.

TANK BUILDER
Pick your tank size and the fish you want. Tank Builder shows the temperature and pH each fish likes, where they overlap, and sizes your heater and filter before you buy a single fish.

FREE LOCAL CLASSIFIEDS
Buy, sell and trade live fish, shrimp, snails, plants, coral and gear with hobbyists near you. Free to post and free to browse. Set alerts so you hear first when something you want is listed nearby.

FIND LOCAL FISH STORES
Find aquarium and fish stores near you with directions, reviews and photos. Top Stores ranks the best shops every quarter, so you know where the good ones are.

SPECIES DATABASE
More than 500 freshwater species with real care data: adult size, minimum tank, temperature, pH and difficulty.

BREEDING GUIDES
Over 200 step-by-step guides for fish, shrimp, snails and plants, from easy beginner breeders to expert projects.

FEED, FORUMS AND EVENTS
Share your tanks, ask questions and get answers from real keepers. Find fish swaps, frag swaps, auctions, club meetings and shows near you.

Underground Aquarium is free to use. Built by a fishkeeper for fishkeepers.

name: Unit Orbit: Unit Converter
description:
Unit Orbit is a fast, offline unit converter. Type a value once and see it in every unit of the category at the same time.

TYPE ONCE, SEE EVERY UNIT
• 170 units in 16 categories: length, area, volume, mass, temperature, speed, time, data, pressure, energy, power, angle, fuel economy, cooking, frequency and number bases
• A calculator keypad: type 12×3+4 or 15% and the result converts as you type
• Tap any result to copy it; touch and hold to convert from that unit
• Swap units in one tap
• Exact definitions (international yard and pound, US and UK gallons), with the precision you choose

FAVOURITES AND HISTORY
• Star the unit pairs you use most and find them on Home
• Every conversion is kept in History, searchable, ready to reuse

YOUR OWN FORMULAS
• Build small calculators with named inputs, such as fuel cost or tip per person
• Type the formula on the keypad with +, −, ×, ÷, powers, percent, square root and π

USEFUL EVERYWHERE
• Kitchen measures (cups, tablespoons, sticks of butter), tola and decimal land units, L/100 km ↔ mpg, binary and hexadecimal
• Search across all units
• Light and dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver
• English, Arabic, Bengali, Turkish, Indonesian, Malay, French and Spanish

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• No account and no sign-in. Your data stays on your device.
• Works without internet. Currency is not included because it needs live rates.

UNIT ORBIT PRO (optional)
• No ads
• Home Screen widgets for favourites and formulas
• 6 extra colour themes
• Unlimited formulas and a history of 1,000 conversions with CSV export
Pro is available monthly or yearly. You can also remove ads with a one-time purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.
Privacy Policy: https://bendroid.app/apps/unit-orbit/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: UntilNest
description:
Look forward to a trip, birthday or personal goal with UntilNest. Add a title, date and time, then see the calendar days remaining. Past events stay available as days since.

• Organize multiple events and search titles or notes.
• Personalize each event with a color, icon and photo background.
• Pin one event for all widgets, or let them show the nearest future event.
• Add small or medium Home Screen widgets and Lock Screen widgets.
• Share a countdown from its detail screen.
• Follow the device language or choose one of ten languages in the app.

On supported devices, open Apple’s Image Playground to create and accept a background yourself. Save a prompt and up to ten prompt candidates for each event. Random selection picks a prompt; it does not generate an image automatically. Image Playground availability depends on the device, OS, language, region and system settings. Apple’s service may require a network connection and Private Cloud Compute.

No account, ads or analytics. Events and imported background copies are stored on your device. Photos are shown only where widget backgrounds are supported; other styles keep text readable. Calendar days use your device’s current time zone. iOS controls widget refresh timing; exact refresh times are not guaranteed.

name: Unum – Bible Together
description:
The complete Bible, free forever, with no ads and no sign-up. Unum adapts to your faith: Catholic (73 books) or Evangelical (66 books).

READ TOGETHER
Create a group for your family, small group or Sunday school. Everyone follows the same reading plan, sees who has read today's passage, encourages each other and shares prayer requests. All it takes is an invite code, no account.

THE BIBLE, YOUR WAY
• Complete Bible offline, large text and read-aloud
• Verse of the day, highlights, favorites and sharing
• Reading plans: the Gospels in 30 days, Lent, Advent and more
• Verses for every moment: anxiety, fear, grief, gratitude

PRAY EVERY DAY
• Guided rosary with the mysteries of the day (Catholics)
• Guided prayer time: praise, thanksgiving, confession, requests and the Lord's Prayer
• "Listen" mode: the app prays with you out loud

YOUR COMMUNITY
• Calendar of the liturgical year's feasts and saint of the day
• Churches near you, with directions

UNUM PREMIUM (optional)
Create your group and unlock every reading plan (the Bible in a year, the New Testament…), the prayer journal with answered prayers, bilingual reading, sepia and night themes and unlimited reminders. One Premium for the whole family (Family Sharing).
Monthly or yearly subscription (7 days free on the yearly plan) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your Apple account settings.

The Bible, the verse of the day, the rosary, prayer time and groups stay free forever.

Terms of use: https://unum-biblia.netlify.app/termos.html#en
Privacy: https://unum-biblia.netlify.app/privacidade.html#en
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

"That they all may be one." — John 17:21

name: Uotan WearBox
description: Uotan WearBox is a management tool for Wear OS smartwatches. Simply connect your iPhone and watch to the same Wi-Fi network and enable wireless debugging on your watch to get started.

name: UploadReady: File Checklist
description:
A portal asks for a PDF with a specific name, a JPEG under its own size limit, and a maximum size for the whole set. UploadReady gives you one place to check each requirement before you submit the files.

Choose your PDF, JPEG, or PNG files from Files. Check their format, exact filename where required, and size against the rules you entered. See which files still need attention and how close the collection is to the total limit.

Use the included document checklist to try the workflow. Review the contents of the documents and submit them through the destination portal yourself.

Save one project with up to 12 entries for free. Lifetime is a one-time purchase that lets you save more projects, add more entries, and share reports. You can use the app offline without creating an account. To keep a backup, choose iCloud Drive or another location in Files.

name: Upside: Good News Nearby
description:
Upside finds the good news where you live. It reads the public feeds of local TV stations, newspapers, public radio and nonprofit newsrooms, keeps only the uplifting stories, and sums each one up for you. Every story is real and links to the newsroom that published it. Upside never writes stories of its own.

GOOD NEWS NEARBY
• 80+ cities across the US, Canada, the UK, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand
• Follow any town, and choose how far around it to look, from your closest city to 1,500 miles
• Follow several places: home, family's town, or a trip, and switch between them in a tap
• Good news from everywhere, from outlets that only cover good news

SUMMARIES ON YOUR IPHONE
• On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, each story is checked and summarized on your device
• Other iPhones get key sentences from the story, using Upside's built-in checks
• Nothing about you is ever sent to a server

3 GOOD THINGS
• A morning note with the day's three best local stories
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Topics: Kindness, Community, Health & Science, Animals, Environment, Education, Arts & Culture, Sports & Wins

LISTEN
• Hear the day's good news read aloud, even with your screen locked
• Works with your headphones' and Lock Screen controls

YOUR UPSIDE SCORE
• How much of your area's news is good news today
• A 30-day chart, and a Sunday recap of your week's best stories

MY GOOD THINGS
• A little journal for good moments from your own day
• Keep a streak, and add stories you loved

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
• "Get good news from Upside", "Listen to Upside", "Add a good thing to Upside", "What's my Upside score"

MAKE IT YOURS
• Mute words and newsrooms you'd rather not see
• Save and share any story

Pay once. No ads, no subscriptions, no account, no tracking.

name: URPAQ-VIP
UsedDeal
description:
A used phone with a lower asking price can cost more once you factor in a battery replacement. UsedDeal helps you compare offers while the details are still fresh.

Enter each asking price and the repair estimates you have. Record what you checked on the screen and touch controls, battery, cameras, and audio. Keep ownership and activation checks marked as unconfirmed until you have checked them yourself.

Try the example with two used phones to see how a repair estimate can change which one costs less.

Save one project with up to 12 entries for free. Lifetime is a one-time purchase that lets you save more projects, add more entries, and share reports. You can use the app offline without creating an account. To keep a backup, choose iCloud Drive or another location in Files.

name: Vadual Moon
description:
Follow the phases of the Moon and find out when it rises and sets in a location you choose. Vadual Moon shows the changing light on the lunar disk, complete with detailed surface texture.

• Browse the monthly calendar and check the estimated times of the four principal phases.
• See the illuminated fraction, lunar age, and distance from Earth.
• Explore the visibility timeline and the Moon’s altitude chart.
• Search for a city, use GPS, or compare local moonrise and moonset times for your favorite places.

Astronomical calculations run on your device. Times and positions are estimates. The chart shows when the Moon is above the calculated horizon.

A VADUAL app for iPhone and iPad.

name: VainilCure
description:
VainilCure es la herramienta práctica para procesadores de Vainilla de Papantla en Veracruz. Planifica el curado tradicional de vainas verdes: desde la clasificación hasta el rendimiento final.

CLASIFICACIÓN DE VAINAS
Registra madurez, longitud, peso y apariencia para formar lotes claros y evitar mezclas.

PLAN DE CURADO
Gestiona cada etapa del proceso tradicional: calentamiento, soleado, sudoración, secado y almacenamiento. Avanza o revisa la etapa actual con un toque.

CÁLCULO DE FECHAS
Elige un plan de proceso y obtén fechas estimadas de inicio y fin por etapa, según el ciclo que uses.

ESPACIO DE CURADO
Calcula cuántos estantes, cajas de sudoración y metros de almacén necesitas según el peso fresco y la capacidad de tu equipo.

RENDIMIENTO Y PÉRDIDA
Registra el peso curado y las vainas por grado (Gourmet, Extra, Primera, Segunda). Consulta la tasa de salida y la pérdida de cada lote.

Diseñada para pequeños y medianos procesadores que necesitan ordenar ciclos largos, aprovechar mejor sus instalaciones y conocer el resultado real de cada cosecha.

Oficio: curado tradicional de Vainilla de Papantla.

name: Vaires Care
description:
Vaires Care 

ТРЕВОГА SOS
Удерживайте кнопку SOS 3 секунды — оператор Vaires Care и ваши доверенные контакты получат сигнал, ваше сообщение и координаты. Пока тревога активна, местоположение обновляется.

ДОВЕРЕННЫЕ КОНТАКТЫ
Добавьте близких, которые получат сигнал при тревоге, — вручную или из телефонной книги.

SOS-СООБЩЕНИЕ
Заранее подготовьте текст, который уйдёт вместе с вашими координатами.

ИСТОРИЯ ОБРАЩЕНИЙ
Дата, время и место каждого обращения.

СПРАВОЧНАЯ ИНФОРМАЦИЯ
Кризисные центры, психологическая помощь, инструкции на случай опасности и экстренные номера — доступны даже без входа.

ВХОД
Персональную ссылку или QR-код выдаёт специалист Vaires Care. Для входа также нужен PIN-код.

Приложение доступно на русском и кыргызском языках.

Vaires Care не заменяет экстренные службы. При непосредственной угрозе жизни звоните 112 или 102.

Пользовательское соглашение: https://care.wires.kg/user_agreement.html
Политика конфиденциальности: https://care.wires.kg/privacy_policy.html

name: Valoche : Liste de valise
description:
Ta valise prête en 30 secondes, sans rien oublier.

Dis à Valoche où tu pars, quand et avec quel bagage : l'app prépare une liste sur mesure, adaptée à la météo, à la durée de ton séjour et au pays. Tu n'as plus qu'à cocher.

POURQUOI VALOCHE ?
• Une liste vraiment personnalisée : plage, city trip, ski, rando, camping, road trip, festival ou voyage pro.
• La météo de ta destination : prévisions jour par jour quand ton départ approche, estimation selon la saison sinon.
• Les bonnes quantités : t-shirts, chaussettes, sous-vêtements… calculés selon la durée. Petit sac cabine ? Valoche prévoit une lessive à mi-séjour.
• Les papiers selon le pays : carte d'identité ou passeport, ESTA, ETA pour le Royaume-Uni, carte européenne d'assurance maladie, adaptateur de prise…
• Les règles de l'avion : liquides en 100 ml, batterie externe en cabine.
• En famille : des listes adaptées aux enfants et aux bébés.

TA CHECK-LIST, TOUT SIMPLEMENT
• Coche au fur et à mesure et suis ta progression.
• Ajoute tes propres objets et change les quantités.
• Partage ta liste avec ceux qui partent avec toi.
• « Avant de partir » : vider le frigo, fermer les volets, faire l'enregistrement en ligne…

TON PASSEPORT DE VOYAGE
• Un globe avec une épingle pour chaque voyage.
• Tes stats : pays visités, jours de voyage, part du monde explorée.
• Partage ton passeport en story.

TES DONNÉES RESTENT CHEZ TOI
Pas de compte à créer : tes voyages sont enregistrés sur ton iPhone.

VALOCHE PRO
Valoche Pro donne accès à toutes les fonctionnalités de l'app, pour tous tes voyages. Abonnement mensuel ou annuel, avec 3 jours d'essai gratuit sur l'annuel.
Le paiement est débité sur ton compte Apple à la confirmation de l'achat. L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf s'il est annulé au moins 24 h avant la fin de la période en cours. Tu peux le gérer ou l'annuler dans les réglages de ton compte Apple.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Politique de confidentialité : https://faceria.fr/Valoche/confidentialite

Bon voyage !

name: Vánoční koledy a advent
description:
Koledy na Štědrý večer vždycky po ruce. Přes 170 českých koled, známých i zapomenutých. Otevřete je i bez internetu.

ADVENTNÍ KALENDÁŘ
Každý den od 1. do 24. prosince otevřete jedno okénko s koledou. Ráno vám appka připomene, že je nové okénko připravené.

REŽIM ZPÍVÁNÍ
Velký text přes celou obrazovku, displej nezhasíná a text se sám posouvá. Telefon opřete o stromeček a zpívá celá rodina.

MELODIE
U známých koled si můžete pustit melodii a hned se chytit.

SDÍLEJTE KOLEDU
Vyberte sloku a pošlete ji jako vánoční přání na WhatsApp, Instagram nebo Facebook.

KOLEDY V DALŠÍCH JAZYCÍCH
Kromě českých koled i slovenské, polské a německé. Jazyky si zapnete v nastavení.

A DÁL
• hledání v názvech i textech
• oblíbené koledy
• světlý a tmavý motiv, čtyři velikosti písma
• bez reklam, bez registrace, funguje offline

Všechny koledy jsou lidové nebo volné dílo a u každé je uvedený zdroj.

Veselé Vánoce!

name: VaultCard 人脈名片
description:
一張名片，就是一則筆記。

VaultCard 是給喜歡做筆記的人的社交名片。交換名片後，每個認識的人都會變成一則 Markdown 筆記：記下在哪裡認識、聊了什麼，用 [[雙向連結]] 和 #標籤 把人串起來，最後在關係圖譜裡看見你的人脈網路。

【30 秒做好你的名片】
填上名字、職稱、公司、自我介紹和標籤，加上電話、Email、網站、LINE、Instagram、Threads、LinkedIn、GitHub，挑一個主題色。名片會即時預覽，並自動產生你的 QR Code 和分享連結。

【掃一下就交換】
對方用手機相機掃你的 QR Code，或打開你傳的連結，就能看到你的名片，一鍵存成人脈筆記，再把他的名片回傳給你。對方不用安裝 App 也能看。

【每個人都是一則筆記】
記下在哪裡認識、哪一天認識，寫下聊了什麼、之後想一起做什麼。支援 Markdown、[[雙向連結]]、#標籤和 Callout 提示框。
・反向連結：看到誰的筆記提到了這個人
・同場認識：同一場活動認識的人自動列在一起
・點一個還沒存的 [[名字]]，就能直接新增這個人
・改名時，其他筆記裡的連結會自動更新

【人脈圖譜】
以你為中心，人脈、活動、標籤連成一張可以拖曳、縮放的網路圖。誰介紹誰、哪場活動認識最多人，一眼就看得出來。

【匯出成筆記資料夾】
一鍵把所有人脈匯出成 .zip：每個人一則 .md 筆記（含屬性）、每個活動一則、一份人脈總覽。解壓縮後可以直接用你喜歡的 Markdown 筆記軟體開啟。也能下載單一名片的 vCard，存進手機通訊錄。

【適合誰？】
・常參加活動、研討會、聚會，名片一多就記不住誰是誰的人
・自由工作者、創業者、業務，想好好經營人脈
・已經在用 Markdown 做筆記，想把人脈也放進第二大腦的人

【隱私】
・不需要註冊帳號，沒有後端伺服器
・名片資料直接放在分享連結裡，不經過任何伺服器
・人脈筆記只儲存在你的裝置上，不蒐集、不上傳任何資料
・沒有廣告
・可隨時備份、還原或清除所有資料

VaultCard 為獨立開發的 App，與 Obsidian（Dynalist Inc.）無隸屬關係。

name: VectorP72
description:
Make sense of incomplete badminton doubles records. Trace service order, examine possible scoring histories and explore changes across rallies with interactive charts.

VectorP72 helps teachers, club recorders and referee trainees review the evidence behind a match record.

EXPLORE RALLIES WITH CHARTS
Compare 5- and 9-rally momentum trends, inspect score differences where both scores are determined, and tap or drag across a chart to examine individual rallies. View viable court states in a bar chart and exact rally-winner candidate counts in a ring chart.

A clearly labeled 50-rally demonstration shows a longer match with repeated changes in momentum and score margin. Switch to Current case to inspect your own evidence. Demonstration data stays separate from your saved records.

RECONSTRUCT THE RECORD
Set the scoring rules, starting conditions and rally range. Add the observations you know while leaving unknown fields open. Count complete legal scoring histories within the configured range, compare representative flows and inspect where they disagree.

REVIEW YOUR EVIDENCE
Keep sources and notes with observations. Preview how a new observation changes the candidate set, examine conflicting fields, and compare revisions while preserving the original record.

KEEP YOUR WORK
Save cases, working drafts, review plans and version history on your device. Export PDF review cards and transfer editable case backups through system sharing.

Current-case charts describe the possibilities allowed by the current rules and evidence. Candidate distributions and momentum indices are descriptive, not predictions of match outcomes. Missing data remains unavailable.

The app interface is in English. User-entered names and notes retain their original text.

description:

name: Velmora Gentle Remind
description:
Open Velmora Gentle Remind to pick how each reminder should repeat — a rolling interval you set, specific weekdays at a chosen time, or a prompt anchored to when you wake up or go to sleep. Add one from a quick-add preset or build it from scratch, then swipe right on the home list to mark it done, left to snooze, archive, or delete. Mark reminders done to keep your streak going.

Water has its own tab. Set a daily goal in millilitres or ounces, save the containers you actually drink from, and tap one to log a sip. A pace card shows how far ahead or behind you are, the next-sip time respects quiet hours, and the water reminders pause once you've hit the goal for the day.

For a small break between reminders, the Play tab serves a daily Sudoku in a classic 9×9 or a mini 6×6 grid with its own streak, plus a practice mode with easy, medium, and hard puzzles. Insights pulls it together across the last 7, 30, or 90 days — a completion heatmap, per-habit success rate, water trends, and the weekdays you're most consistent on. Sort reminders by next due time, name, streak, or drag them into any order you like.

name: Velunacre: Palace Puzzles
description:
Walk into a palace where a familiar deck leads to unexpected puzzles.

Velunacre brings eight distinct ways to think with playing cards into a bright moonlit setting. Work through 192 levels across four difficulty tiers: Gentle, Poised, Intricate and Regal.

Eight wings, eight kinds of discovery

Moonthread: Trace a neighboring path that alternates colors and changes rank by one.
Silver Mirrors: Exchange neighboring cards until mirrored pairs share a suit and total 14.
Suit Canals: Guide cards through suit gates in ascending order, using limited reserves.
Equinox Scales: Fill trays to match both rank totals and suit counts.
Orrery Ranks: Rotate rings and exchange bridge cards to restore a target arrangement.
Echo Gallery: Study an arrangement, then rebuild it from memory.
Thirteen Chambers: Clear alternating-color paths that total 13 as the cards settle downward.
Lantern Passage: Read each card's color and rank to gather keys and reach the exit.

A gentler rhythm

Choose a palace wing and preview its puzzle before you enter. Return to your most recent game with Continue. Challenges use step limits, giving you time to consider each move.

Small tools, new possibilities

Use Undo to revisit a move, Shuffle to try another arrangement, or Revive to recover a safe checkpoint after a failed attempt. Begin with one of each tool; each completed attempt adds one tool to the shared supply.

A Chronicle of your progress

Keep a saved puzzle in each mode and revisit completed levels to improve your personal bests. Reach restoration milestones at 6, 12, 18 and 24 newly completed levels in each wing. Chronicle brings together your completions, best results and tool totals.

Comfort in the details

Choose larger cards, extra suit labels and gentle haptics. All puzzles support tap-based play.

Find a path. Make a little space for the next idea.

name: VentGrid
description:
Το VentGrid είναι τετράδιο εργασίας για τη γραμμή σκλήρυνσης γυαλιού. Κάθε παραγωγή είναι μία παρτίδα: πρώτα πίεση αέρα, μετά εσχάρα, μετά δοκιμή θρυμματισμού, στο τέλος αρχείο. Ανοίγεις και δουλεύεις — χωρίς λογαριασμό.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς

Πίεση: γράφεις όνομα παρτίδας, πάχος, πλάτος, ζώνη κλιβάνου (άνω / κάτω / ίση), κατηγορία τάσης και θερμοκρασία χώρου. Παίρνεις αμέσως πρόταση πίεσης, λόγο άνω/κάτω και διάστημα ασφαλείας. Με την αποθήκευση η πρόταση περνά στην εσχάρα.
Εσχάρα: ορίζεις αριθμό ζωνών, στόχο Pa και άνοιγμα βαλβίδας σε κάθε ζώνη. Μπορείς να γεμίσεις τα πεδία από την πρόταση με ένα πάτημα.
Δοκιμή: ζυγίζεις το δείγμα, μετράς τα θραύσματα πάνω από το κόσκινο, διαλέγεις διάμετρο κόσκινου και αν έγινε θερμή εμβάπτιση. Η εφαρμογή δίνει θραύσματα ανά κιλό και κρίση: εντός, επανέλεγχος ή εκτός.
Αρχείο: βλέπεις μετρήσεις, ζώνες και χρονολόγιο της ίδιας παρτίδας. Αντιγράφεις ως νέα παρτίδα για την επόμενη ρύθμιση ή φιλτράρεις κατά αποτέλεσμα.
Η αρχική δείχνει τις σημερινές παρτίδες και το επόμενο βήμα. Οι σημειώσεις πεδίου καλύπτουν ισορροπία εσχάρας, ολίσθηση πίεσης και δειγματοληψία.

Οι αριθμοί είναι για ρύθμιση στο δάπεδο, όχι εργαστηριακή πιστοποίηση. Τα αρχεία μένουν στη συσκευή, χωρίς σύννεφο.

name: Veqalith Solitaire
description:
Four columns stand between you and a perfect number.
Every card you place changes the possibilities ahead. Some combinations are waiting to happen, while others require patience, careful positioning, and a little confidence in your next decision.
Veqalith Solitaire brings number merging and card-based strategy together in a puzzle where the goal is to build increasingly valuable cards without running out of space.
The playing field contains four separate columns. New numbered cards appear from the deck at the bottom of the screen, and you decide where each one belongs.
Drag a card into your chosen column and begin shaping the stacks.
The rules are easy to understand, but the order of your moves makes all the difference.
Matching cards combine to form a higher value, opening room for additional cards and bringing you closer to the ultimate target: 2048.
A small number can be the beginning of something much bigger. Two matching cards become one stronger card, and that result can eventually join another matching value to continue the progression.
The challenge lies in preparing those opportunities before the columns become too crowded.
Each column has limited capacity, so placing a card in the wrong position can create an awkward stack. Unlike traditional solitaire, cards cannot be moved directly between columns after they have been placed.
That means every placement deserves a little thought.
You might reserve one column for smaller values while building a promising sequence in another. You may choose to complete an immediate match or keep a particular card available for a more valuable combination later.
There isn't always one obvious answer.
Sometimes the best move creates a match right away. Sometimes it simply keeps your options open.
Reaching 2048 in a column creates a particularly satisfying moment. The completed column clears, freeing valuable space and giving you a fresh opportunity to continue building new combinations.
The discard area also resets when you reach this milestone.
This creates a natural rhythm of building, combining, clearing, and beginning again, with each successful sequence giving you another chance to extend your run.
Veqalith Solitaire doesn't rely on a fixed series of traditional levels. The game continues as long as you can manage the available spaces and keep creating combinations.
When the board becomes too crowded and no valid combinations remain, the run comes to an end.
To help you manage difficult situations, a discard area allows you to set aside cards you don't want to place in the main columns. Its initial capacity is limited, so choosing which cards to discard becomes another part of the strategy.
As you progress, you can expand that capacity using the virtual coins earned through successful matches.
A special Star Card offers another useful option. When activated, it can copy the value of the card beneath it, creating an opportunity to complete a combination that might otherwise be difficult to arrange.
The Star Card is an optional booster rather than a regular card in the starting deck.
Every successful merge contributes to your in-game coin balance, rewarding you for building stronger numbers and keeping your columns organized.
The more confidently you understand the card progression, the easier it becomes to recognize useful combinations and avoid unnecessary clutter.
Veqalith Solitaire is about finding order in a constantly changing set of choices.
There are no complicated controls to memorize. Just drag, place, combine, and decide what deserves a space on the board.
A single card can rescue a crowded column. A carefully prepared match can open the way toward a much larger number. And reaching 2048 is only part of the challenge when your run can continue beyond it.
Build your stacks with purpose, keep your options alive, and discover how far your number-merging strategy can take you.

The app is available in Slovak, English, Czech, German, Hungarian and Polish and follows the language of the phone.

Suunnittele asuja viikolle ja avaa päivä valmiiksi sommiteltuna. Käytön kirjaaminen vie yhden napautuksen ja päivittää vaatekaapin oivallukset huomaamatta.

**TIEDÄ, MITÄ TODELLA KÄYTÄT**
Näe käyttökustannus, käyttökierto, vaatekaapin arvo, kategorioiden tasapaino, väritarina ja eniten käyttämäsi vaatteet. Vestora ei kannusta ostamaan lisää. Se auttaa saamaan enemmän siitä, mikä on jo olemassa.

**INHIMILLISEN TUNTUINEN**
Lämpimät paperisävyt, toimituksellinen typografia, käsin piirretyt vaatemuodot ja tarkoituksella rauhallinen käyttöliittymä tekevät pukeutumisesta pienen päivittäisen rituaalin.

**YKSITYINEN LÄHTÖKOHTAISESTI**
Ei tiliä. Ei pilveä. Ei mainosohjelmistoja. Ei sovellusten välistä seurantaa. Vaatekaappisi, kuvasi, muistiinpanosi, asusi ja suunnitelmasi pysyvät laitteellasi.

Vestorassa on valmis mallivaatekaappi, jonka avulla voit tutustua kaikkiin ominaisuuksiin heti. Muokkaa sitä, lisää omat vaatteesi tai tyhjennä se, kun olet valmis. Käyttöliittymä tukee englantia ja suomea.

name: Via DevTools - iOS Debug Kit
description:
ViaDevTools is a toolbox for iOS developers and QA testers. Check device values, test hardware and notifications, and decode common formats on a real iPhone.

DEVICE INFO
• Model identifier, model name, iOS version, physical memory, Low Power Mode, thermal state
• Screen size in points and pixels, scale, and safe area insets
• IDFA, IDFV, and App Tracking Transparency status, with a button to request permission
• Network connection, IPv4/IPv6 addresses, expensive and Low Data Mode status
• Appearance, Dynamic Type, Bold Text, Increase Contrast, Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency, VoiceOver
• Preferred languages, region, locale, time zone, calendar, time format, measurement system
• Long-press any value to copy it

HARDWARE
• NFC: read a tag's UID and NDEF records, and write text, URL, or MIME records
• Bluetooth LE: scan nearby peripherals with RSSI and advertisement data
• Haptics: try impact, notification, and other feedback styles

INSPECTORS
• Clipboard: list type identifiers without reading the contents, then read values on demand
• Universal Links: check a domain's apple-app-site-association file on both your server and Apple's CDN, and open a URL as a Universal Link only
• Share sheet: share anything to ViaDevTools from another app to see its items and types

NOTIFICATION PLAYGROUND
• Build local notifications with title, subtitle, body, badge, sound, interruption level, thread ID, image attachment, and action buttons
• Set a delay to see them on the Lock Screen
• View and share the matching APNs payload
• See notifications as they arrive or are opened

TOOLBOX
• JWT: decode the header and payload, with exp and iat shown as dates (the signature is not verified)
• JSON: format and minify
• Base64: encode and decode, including URL-safe without padding
• UUID: generate version 4 UUIDs in bulk
• Timestamp: convert between Unix timestamps and dates, with seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, and nanoseconds detected automatically

No accounts, ads, or analytics. The IDFA is only shown on screen and is never sent anywhere.

Mỗi trang xem có nút Báo cáo và Chặn kênh. Chúng tôi xem mọi báo cáo trong 24 giờ, gỡ nội dung vi phạm và khoá tài khoản vi phạm.

TÀI KHOẢN
Đăng nhập bằng email ngay trong ứng dụng. Xoá tài khoản trong mục Tài khoản.

Lưu ý: mỗi nền tảng có điều kiện riêng để nhận luồng phát (ví dụ TikTok chỉ cấp khoá luồng cho một số tài khoản). Bạn tự chịu trách nhiệm về nội dung phát và phải tuân thủ quy định của từng nền tảng.

name: Viewer for Penpot
description:
Viewer for Penpot brings your Penpot design files to your iPhone. Browse your teams and projects, look at every board in full detail, and take part in design reviews wherever you are.

Penpot is the open-source design and prototyping platform. The app works with design.penpot.app and with self-hosted Penpot servers.

SEE YOUR DESIGNS
• Boards are drawn on your iPhone as vector graphics, so text and shapes stay sharp at any zoom.
• Open a whole page on a zoomable canvas, with every board in its place.
• Play prototypes full screen and tap through their flows.
• Files you opened before load instantly, even large design systems.

REVIEW AND COMMENT
• See comment pins right on the board and on the page.
• Reply, resolve, and start a new thread by tapping where it belongs.
• Mention teammates with @ and filter threads.
• An inbox collects unread comments from all your teams.

WORK WITH YOUR TEAM
• Invite members and manage their roles.
• Create and revoke share links.
• Browse the version history and restore earlier versions.
• Manage files, projects, shared libraries and fonts, and bring back deleted files.
• Export boards as PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG or PDF, and download or import .penpot files.

FEELS LIKE PENPOT
• The same icons, typeface and colors as Penpot, in light and dark.
• All 34 languages Penpot speaks, right-to-left included.
• No ads and no tracking. The source code is on GitHub.

The app is for viewing, reviewing and commenting. To draw or edit designs, use Penpot on your computer. You need a Penpot account to sign in.

Viewer for Penpot is an independent app. It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by Kaleidos, the company behind Penpot. "Penpot" is a trademark of Kaleidos.

name: Villelongue Padel
description:
Une application très complète, qui va vous permettre de :
- Réserver dans votre club,
- Accéder aux informations principales,
- Remplir votre Wallet avec les cartes prépayées,
- Obtenir l'information en direct,
- Suivre vos compétitions.

Et plein d'autres fonctionnalités !

name: Vinyl Wave: LP Player
description:
Play the music stored on your phone like records on a turntable.

Vinyl Wave is not a streaming app. Import the music files on your device and every album becomes a record — put it on the platter and drop the needle, just like a real turntable.

■ A real turntable feel
• Drag the tonearm to drop the needle on any song
• START·STOP, 33⅓ / 45 RPM buttons and ±8% fine pitch
• Spin-up and spin-down as the platter starts and stops
• The tick-tick of the run-out groove when a record ends

■ A library that plays like records
• Albums are records; playlists become mixtape records
• Pack songs into crates and drag to reorder them
• Play next, queue, repeat, shuffle and sleep timer
• Albums without artwork get a record label of their own

■ Warm analog sound
• The crackle and surface noise of a dusty record
• Pure mode when you want the source untouched

■ Vinyl Wave Pro
• 3 premium turntable themes: Walnut Heritage, Midnight Noir, Clear Acrylic
• Slipmat and record colour customization
• Crackle presets, wow & flutter, warmth, vintage mono, custom equalizer
• Ambient mode while charging
• Monthly, yearly (7-day free trial) or lifetime

■ Good to know
• Plays music files on your device: MP3, AAC, FLAC, ALAC, WAV and more
• DRM-protected songs from streaming services can’t be played
• No sign-up; your music library stays on your device
• Available in 14 languages

Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Privacy policy: https://hnh-labs.com/vinylwave/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://hnh-labs.com/vinylwave/tac.html

name: VIPER Experience Staff
description:
VIPER Experience Staff is the secure operations hub for approved VIPER employees and contractors. Manage your profile, review event details, upload required documents and photos, submit time and expenses, and stay connected to your assignments.

Features include secure staff access, event details and scheduling, profile and document uploads, time and expense submissions, and native camera, file-sharing, and document support.

This app requires an existing VIPER staff account.

name: Vistream
description:
Vistream is a media player for the playlists you already have. Add an M3U link or an Xtream login from your own provider, and watch your live channels, films and series on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with one account that keeps everything in step.

Vistream is a player only. It includes no channels, films or series and sells no subscriptions. You bring your own playlist, and you are responsible for having the right to watch what is in it.

WHAT IT DOES
• Live TV with what is on now and next, a programme guide and replay of past programmes, where your provider offers them
• Films and series with posters, stories, cast and trailers
• One search across channels, films and series
• My list, watched marks and resume points that follow your account to every device
• Profiles for the household, with children's profiles and a parental PIN
• Subtitles and audio tracks, with subtitles found online in several languages
• Categories gathered by country and by language; hide the ones you never open
• Radio stations from your playlist, on a screen of their own
• A layout of its own on an iPad held sideways and on a Mac, with keyboard shortcuts

THE PLAYER
• Plays the formats providers really send, MPEG-TS and MKV included
• Picks up where you stopped and starts the next episode by itself
• Fit, fill or stretch the picture, and a sleep timer
• Reconnects by itself when a stream drops

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Create your account in the app and add your playlists there
• Change or remove a playlist whenever you like
• Delete your account and everything kept for it at any time, in Settings
• No adverts and no advertising trackers

Vistream is available in English, French, Spanish and Arabic.

Film and series details are provided by TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Terms of use: https://vistream.net/terms
Privacy policy: https://vistream.net/privacy

name: VIVI Crochet
description:
VIVI Crochet is your all-in-one home for crochet: learn new stitches, shop quality materials and explore live classes with a tutor who guides you one stitch at a time.

LEARN CROCHET STEP BY STEP
• Video lessons for Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced levels
• Free preview lessons so you can try before you commit
• Watch at your own pace and pick up where you left off
• Track your learning progress as you go
• Available in English, Hindi and Tamil

SHOP CROCHET MATERIALS
• Yarn in a wide range of colours and shades
• Hooks, bag rings, lobster hooks and other tools and findings
• Search, filter by category and save favourites to your wishlist
• Delivery estimates before you check out
• Track every order from your account

LIVE CLASSES WITH YOUR TUTOR
• Beginner-friendly live crochet classes, taught in real time
• See what each course covers and the projects you will make
• Get in touch with the team to ask about batches and seats

MORE TO ENJOY
• Trending tutorials and viral makes to inspire your next project
• Special offers on courses and materials
• Notifications for your orders and class updates (optional)
• Secure phone OTP sign-in
• Delete your account any time from Settings

Whether you are holding a hook for the first time or planning your next big make, VIVI Crochet keeps your learning, your materials and your community in one place.

Handmade with love.

name: VocabInFrame
description:
Turn photos of the places you use every day into vocabulary flashcards. Take a picture or choose one from your library, review the suggested objects, and make a study pack in English, Spanish, Portuguese, or French.

Flip cards to see the word, translation, and a short example. Listen to pronunciation using your device’s voice. Try a sample kitchen or start with your own photo.

Preview up to three cards in each pack for free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the rest of that pack on the device.

name: Voisample
description:
Record your voice. Search by word. Play it on the pads.
Your voice never leaves your iPhone.

Your recording turns into text automatically.
Search for a word, or slide your finger over the text, and cut out just that part.
Put the sound on a pad and play it.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Record or import
Record on the spot, or import an audio or video file. Japanese and English are supported.
Send audio from other apps, such as Voice Memos, with the Share menu.

Search by word
Type a word and see every place it appears. You can also pick one from "Frequent words".

Select with your finger
Slide over the text to choose the part you want. Move the start and the end with the arrows.

Good clips
The app finds short, clear words for you. Put one on a pad with one tap.

9 pads
Put the sounds on pads and tap them. Choose one-shot or repeat for each pad. Reverse and volume can change per pad too. Name and color are yours as well.
You can also copy a pad to another pad.

FX
Pitch, vocoder, lo-fi and reverb. Move the sliders or type a number. Choose which pads get the effects. Push them as far as you like: a limiter at the end helps keep the sound from clipping.

Loop recording
Loop 1, 2 or 4 bars and tap the pads to layer rhythms. Your taps snap to the nearest 16th note.

Record your performance
After a count-in, your pad performance is recorded as you play it. The metronome click is not recorded.

Save as WAV
When you finish playing, name the take and save it to the Library.
You can also throw it away, record it again, or share it (Pro).
Saved performances can be played any time.
Save or share them as a WAV file, as recorded or with the volume evened out (Pro).

Undo
Take back a wrong pad or an edit at any time.

PRIVACY

Your voice never leaves your iPhone.
Turning speech into text happens only on your iPhone. Your recordings and text are not sent to MarbLabo (the developer), to Apple, or to anyone else.
MarbLabo has no server, no account system and no analytics, so we cannot receive or see your recordings.
No ads.

FREE AND PRO

Bank A (9 pads) is free.
Pro is a one-time purchase that adds 7 more banks, B to H (63 pads), recordings and imports up to 30 minutes (Free: 3 minutes), and performance recordings up to 30 minutes (Free: 3 minutes). Loop recording (1/2/4 bars) is free. Saving WAV files is also a Pro feature (Free can still listen to recorded performances in the app). Effects are free.
No subscription and no ads.

TIPS

- Record in a quiet place, close to your mouth, for better text.
- Choose the language (Japanese, English or Auto) at the top of an opened recording.
- The text may not be accurate for some audio. Singing, loud background music, several voices or a low voice can cause mistakes or gaps.
- The first time, the app may download Apple's speech data.
- Check a clip by ear before you use it.
- Press and hold a pad to edit, rename or clear it.
- Use only sounds you recorded yourself or have permission to use.

Contact: marblabo@gmail.com

name: Voiswitch Connect
description:
Voiswitch Connect puts your company's Voiswitch phone system on your phone. Calls to your extension and your business numbers ring here too, at the office, at home or on the road, and the people you call see your business number, not your cell.

CALLS
• Make and take calls on Wi-Fi or mobile data, with your business caller ID
• Calls ring even when the app is closed or the phone is locked
• Hold, mute, speaker, transfer (straight away or after asking first), merge into a conference, park, and move a call to your desk phone or your cell without hanging up
• Your recent calls, missed calls, and call back in one tap

VOICEMAIL, TEXTS AND FAXES
• Listen to voicemail, read its transcript, call back or delete it
• Text from your business number, with pictures
• Read the faxes sent to you

YOUR TEAM
• See who's available, busy or on a call
• Team chat, one-to-one and in groups, with files and pictures
• Your favourites, your colleagues, your shared contacts and your phone's own contacts in one place

MEETINGS
• Start a video meeting in one tap, or join one with its ID
• Schedule meetings and invite people by email, colleagues and guests alike

AND
• Do not disturb, forwarding and your status in one place
• Light or dark, or as your phone is set

Voiswitch Connect is for businesses that use Voiswitch. Your company's administrator creates your account; sign in with your email and password, or scan the code in Voiswitch Connect on your computer.

name: Vortiq
description:
Το Vortiq είναι ένα σημειωματάριο τσέπης για εργαστήρια διεργασιών. Γράψτε την ταχύτητα αναταραχής (RPM) και τη μετατροπή για κάθε παρτίδα, στη συνέχεια δείτε πώς κινούνται μαζί και ποια ζώνη RPM να δοκιμάσετε επόμενο.
Πώς να το χρησιμοποιήσετε
