Στούντιο. Ανοίξτε την εφαρμογή και είστε ήδη στον πάγκο: δείκτη ανάμιξης, τελευταία μετατροπή, συσχέτιση Pearson και το συνιστώμενο παράθυρο ταχύτητας. Πρόσφατες παρτίδες κάθονται σαν μικρές κάρτες κάτω.
Μπατς. Επιλέξτε κλίμακα αντιδραστήρα και τροχοφόρο. Εισάγετε RPM και μετατροπή, στη συνέχεια θερμοκρασία, ιξώδες, πυκνότητα, διάμετρο τροχού, χρόνο διαμονής, και μια σημείωση. Αποθηκεύστε. Το παρτί πάει στο αρχείο.
Ανάλυση. Από δύο παρτίδες και μετά παίρνετε μια διάσπαρση μετατροπής έναντι RPM, Pearson και Spearman, γραμμικές και τετραγωνικές προσαρμογές, καθεστώς ανάμιξης Reynolds, ισχύς άξονα, χρόνο ανάμιξης και αριθμό Damkohler. Αν η καμπύλη κορυφωθεί, αυτό το RPM γίνεται το παράθυρο. Πατήστε για να γεμίσετε την επόμενη παρτίδα με αυτό.
Δέκα παραδείγματα παρτίδων είναι ήδη στη συσκευή, έτσι μπορείτε να πατήσετε αμέσως. Όλα τα δεδομένα παραμένουν σε αυτό το iPhone. Χωρίς λογαριασμό, χωρίς παρακολούθηση, χωρίς δίκτυο.

name: VoteTrellis
description:
Keep the original preferences, follow each transfer, and save a result you can explain.

VoteTrellis is a notebook for manually recorded complete rankings. Create a poll with 2–12 options, arrange every option in preference order, and enter the number of matching ballots. Count votes to inspect each round, the majority threshold, the uniquely lowest option and the next continuing preferences. A tied lowest tally stops as Unresolved tie; no hidden tie-break winner is selected.

REVIEW THE INPUT
Check each ranking and its quantity before counting. Edit saved rankings, copy an option list into a new empty poll, search your library, and reopen saved work later.

FOLLOW THE COUNT
Inspect round tallies and trace how each ranking pattern contributes. Complete rankings are required: every option appears exactly once, with no equal preferences.

KEEP THE EVIDENCE
Freeze an independent report containing the input, counting-rule version and complete result. Later source edits do not change that snapshot. Generate actual CSV and PDF files, preview saved outputs, and choose a system share destination. Delete individual records or clear the notebook with confirmation.

LIMITS
Up to 100 polls, 500 ranking records per poll, 1–10,000 votes per record, 1,000,000 votes per poll and 300 reports. VoteTrellis records the data you supply. It does not collect online votes, authenticate voters, guarantee ballot privacy, certify elections or implement statutory election tie-break rules.

name: VRFitRowing
description:
VRFit Rowing센서를 통해 가상 로잉앱을 즐길수 있는 앱입니다.

아름다운 조경을 보며 로잉을 즐겨보세요.

* 해당앱은 VRFit Rowing 센서를 필요로 합니다.

name: Vyran
description: Vyran is a quiet, offline breathing studio. Fifteen guided rhythms, five intentions — calm, focus, sleep, energy and reset — and a ring that grows and settles with every phase. Nothing to sign into, nothing to stream, nothing to measure. Just a count and a few minutes.

name: Vyxel HR
description:
Vyxel HR is your all-in-one mobile workforce and Human Resource Management System (HRMS) designed to simplify everyday workplace operations. Whether you are clocking in, managing leaves, tracking performance, or accessing company resources, Vyxel HR puts everything at your fingertips.

KEY FEATURES:

• Smart Attendance & Geofenced Clock-In:
Effortlessly log daily clock-in and clock-out with GPS-verified geolocation and secure biometric verification. View monthly attendance history, shifts, and working hours in real-time.

• Leave & Absence Management:
Check leave balances, apply for paid time off, sick leave, or remote work, and track approval status directly from your phone.

• Payroll & Compensation:
View and download detailed monthly salary slips, breakdown of earnings, deductions, and tax summaries securely.

• Shifts, Schedules & Timesheets:
Stay updated on your upcoming rosters, shift schedules, and log project timesheets with seamless team coverage.

• Employee Self-Service (ESS):
Access personal documents, company policies, tax forms, and update emergency contacts without contacting HR directly.

• Directory & Organization Chart:
Find and connect with colleagues across departments and branches with a comprehensive corporate directory.

• Performance, Goals & Reviews:
Keep track of key performance indicators (KPIs), participate in appraisal campaigns, and receive continuous feedback.

• Approvals & Manager Hub:
Managers can review, approve, or reject leave requests, timesheets, and expense claims instantly on the move.

• Announcements & Helpdesk:
Receive important broadcast announcements, participate in employee pulse surveys, and raise internal HR helpdesk tickets.

---

PLEASE NOTE:
Vyxel HR is an enterprise application. Your company or organization must have an active Vyxel HR subscription and provide you with authorized login credentials. For assistance or setup inquiries, please contact your organization’s HR administrator.

name: Waelen
description:
Waelen is a quiet, offline notebook for the two things cyclists actually keep track of: the rides they did, and the state of the bike underneath them. It works without an account, without a connection, and without asking for your location.
Pick the bike, enter the distance, the moving time and the climb, choose the surface (Road, Gravel, Commute, Mountain, City or Indoor) and how hard it felt, add a line about the weather or the route, and save. That is the whole flow. Waelen turns those entries into a weekly total, a day streak, an average speed and a running odometer per bike.

name: Walnut Block Lab
description:
Meet Walnut Block Lab, the wooden block puzzle that's completely free and completely ad-free.

No banners. No pop-ups. No waiting for a timer. Just you, a beautiful wooden board, and one more move.

Drag the pieces onto the board and fill rows, columns, and 3x3 squares to make them vanish. Chain clears for combo points, clear the whole board for a 500-point bonus, and watch the pieces get trickier as your score climbs.

Free to play, with no ads and no purchases
Classic mode for the full board, Easy mode for a quick, smaller game
Worldwide leaderboards: see who's best this week, this month, this year, or of all time
Submit your name and score and see where you rank against players around the globe
Smooth drag-and-drop with a lifted piece, so you always see where it lands
Warm wood textures and a calm look that's easy on the eyes
Easy to learn. Hard to put down. How high can you climb?

name: WarrantyVault - Receipt Vault
description:
Never lose a receipt or miss a warranty deadline again.

WarrantyVault keeps all your electronics, appliances, serial numbers, and purchase receipts organized in one private, offline vault on your iPhone. Get alerted weeks before coverage expires so you can claim repairs in time.

KEY FEATURES
- Visual Warranty Countdown: Instantly see which devices are covered, expiring soon, or out of warranty.
- Receipt and Serial Number Storage: Attach crisp receipt photos, store invoice details, and log model numbers locally.
- Proactive Expiry Alerts: Schedule reminders 30, 14, or 7 days before your manufacturer warranty ends.
- Home Screen Widgets and Insights: Track total protected asset value and upcoming expirations at a glance.
- Private and Local-First: Optional Face ID lock, zero developer servers, zero accounts, and full offline access.

HONEST PRICING
Store up to 5 items free forever. Unlock unlimited items, custom titanium themes, and full insights with a single $5.99 lifetime purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/warrantyvault/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: https://hesaassdfs.github.io/app-legal-pages/warrantyvault/support.html

name: Wash Mark
description:
Wash Mark is for the moment a shirt's care label is still unread. Name the shirt, then tap the basin, the triangle, the square, the iron, and the circle until each symbol matches the tag in your hand. The phone writes one sentence: the wash, the bleach, the drying, the iron, and the dry-clean mark. Keep the tag. Open Shirts later and the sentence is still there, with the time you kept it.

It does not run a washer, look up a clothing maker, or make a file. There is no account. Everything stays on this iPhone.

name: Water Breathing for iPad
description:
Water Breathing is a simple guide to breathing slowly. No scores, no streaks to protect. Just breathe along as much as feels right today.

The circle in the middle grows as you breathe in and shrinks as you breathe out. A singing bowl marks the start of each inhale and exhale, so you can close your eyes and follow the sound.

■ Breathe
• Default rhythm: inhale 5s · exhale 5s (about 6 breaths a minute)
• Other rhythms: inhale 3s · exhale 3s, 5s · 10s, 10s · 10s, or set your own from 1 to 30 seconds
• Session length: 1, 3, 5, 10 or 15 minutes, your own length from 1 to 60 minutes, or free breathing until you finish
• Tap Start Breathing and your first inhale begins after 3, 2, 1
• Tap the screen to pause or finish anytime
• Choose the singing bowl pitch you find comfortable: 174, 285, 396, 417, 432 or 528 Hz
• Keep the screen on while you breathe, or get a quiet completion notice when the screen is off
• Prefer water? Choose a rising wave instead of the circle

■ On iPad
• Move between Today, History and About in the sidebar
• A large circle and large inhale and exhale cues fill the screen, in landscape or portrait
• Split View, Slide Over and Stage Manager: breathe in a small window while you read or work
• Keyboard: Return to start, Space to pause, Esc to finish
• Connect a monitor or TV to show just the breathing circle, large (for classes or breathing together)
• On wide screens, sessions by day sit beside weekly and monthly charts

■ Records
• Finished sessions are shown by date, week and month
• Add a short note to any session
• Swipe to delete, then undo right away or restore from Recently Deleted for 30 days
• Optionally save your breathing time to Mindful Minutes in Apple Health (write only; Health data is never read)

■ Your records are yours
• Every feature works without signing in, and records are stored on this iPad
• Optionally sign in with Apple to keep records in the cloud and in step across your devices. We don't ask for your name or email
• Export anytime as a password-protected backup, CSV or JSON
• No ads, no tracking

■ For everyone
• Supports VoiceOver, larger text, Reduce Motion and Increase Contrast
• Korean, English, Japanese, Spanish, German, French, Traditional Chinese and Portuguese

■ One-time purchase
No subscription. Buy once and keep every feature, cloud sync included. The iPhone app (with its Apple Watch app) is sold separately.

If you feel dizzy or short of breath, stop anytime and return to your normal breathing. Water Breathing is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat or prevent any condition.

name: WaveInkVoyage
description:
Chart a woodblock sea where every round starts with a clear look at the board.

Tiles appear in a tidy grid. Study the seals, then the chart flips. Tap only the marked ones before your lives run out.

Easy, Medium, and Hard change grid size, study time, and how many seals you must recover. Score clean picks, chase perfect rounds, unlock achievements, and check voyage stats between short sessions of indigo waves and vermilion ink.

name: Waypoint: Reward Stay Finder
description:
See which nights you can book with Wyndham Rewards points. Waypoint lets you check a hotel’s reward calendar before you decide where or when to stay.

Explore more than 8,000 hotels in the directory. Search for a city, country or hotel, choose a nightly points level, or turn on U.S. national parks to plan a trip around one. Tap a hotel to see its reward calendar.

If your dates are flexible, check a month of possible arrivals. For a specific trip, select a date, one or two nights, and one to four adults sharing one room. Open a checked date to see the room types, total points for the stay and time of the last check.

Save your favorite hotels in My list. Track an exact check-in or a range of arrival dates. Waypoint checks when iOS grants background time or when you next open the app. Turn on notifications to hear when a check finds an available points-only stay.

On devices with the on-device Apple Intelligence model available, use AI Chat to ask about a destination, dates and points budget. Open a result on the map or jump to its calendar.

The directory, saved hotels and previous checks are available offline. New availability checks need an internet connection. Continue to Wyndham to confirm the current rate, any property fees and booking terms. Waypoint is an independent travel planner.

name: WBTEL CLIENTES
description:
No app da Central do Assinante da WBTEL CLIENTES você pode:

Obter segunda via de fatura.
Ver todo o histórico financeiro.
Solicitar Suporte.
Fazer promessa de pagamento.
Receber notificações.

name: Web Toolkit
description:
Understand your network, find connection problems, and keep useful results on your iPhone or iPad.

Start with free device discovery, Bluetooth scanning, port checks, and core diagnostics. See useful results before the optional Pro upgrade. No scan countdown. No account required.

FIND DEVICES AND SERVICES
Discover responding devices on your connected local network, browse Bonjour services, and check open TCP ports. Scan nearby advertising Bluetooth Low Energy devices and use changing signal tones to help you locate them.

DIAGNOSE CONNECTION PROBLEMS
Check speed, latency, packet loss, DNS, and internet reachability. Go deeper with bufferbloat tests, resolver comparisons, traceroute, IPv4 and IPv6 tools, subnet calculations, registration lookups, and website and TLS inspection.

WORK WITH SERVERS
Save HTTP, HTTPS, or TCP health checks and see availability, response times, and outage history while Web Toolkit is open. Connect to SSH terminals and browse FTP or SFTP servers using saved profiles and optional Keychain credential storage.

BUILD AND DEBUG
Compose HTTP requests, inspect responses, test WebSocket and MQTT connections, and send TCP or UDP messages. Reuse targets across tools instead of entering the same address again.

SURVEY AND SHARE
Organize site surveys with imported floor plans or LiDAR room capture on supported devices. Map measured network performance and share individual results as PDF, CSV, JSON, or text.

START FREE. KEEP PRO FOR LIFE.
Free scanning and core tools remain available without a time limit. The optional one-time Pro purchase adds advanced diagnostics, technician tools, expanded history, site surveys, and heatmaps. There is no subscription.

CLEAR MEASUREMENTS
Web Toolkit labels measured, reported, inferred, and unavailable information so you can judge each result. Saved network history stays on your device, and you choose what to share.

WI-FI SCANNER ACCESSORY
Nearby Wi-Fi access-point discovery, channel analysis, and RSSI heatmaps require the optional NetScope Scanner accessory. Without it, site surveys can measure latency, packet loss, DNS, and throughput. Bluetooth discovery works with advertising Bluetooth Low Energy devices. Server monitoring runs while the app is open and pauses in the background.

Meet Pip, your little bat companion for a clearer view of your network.

name: Wedge Clock
description:
Wedge Clock keeps optical wedges and clocking jobs on this iPhone.

Drag the round face. Edge thickness at each hour is the center thickness plus half the wedge height times the cosine of that hour. The thin edge sits opposite the thick edge. Offset is the shorter hour gap between that thin edge and the fixture mark. The wedge is clocked when the gap is inside the tolerance you set.

Keep a reading, then compare two saved faces. Attach a fixture photo from the photo library while you edit a wedge. Share the report when you want a copy.

Wedges, jobs, and photos stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: WeexLab Management
description:
weexlabmnagement is a private desk for two everyday money questions: what a holding is worth in the built-in research book, and what cash the coming bills still need.

The book keeps a hand-built fair value for each sample company. You see the book price beside that value, how many cents you pay per dollar of fair value, the growth the price assumes, and how many blocks of the portfolio sit above the model. A green path can still mean the desk needs attention. Figures are illustrative and stay on this iPhone. They are not live quotes and not advice to buy or sell.

Bills sit on the same desk. Overdue, the next seven days, and later dates stay in one list. Set-aside turns the list into a weekly number and a two-paycheck number. Pay order suggests what to handle first. A six-month forecast steps repeating bills forward. Coverage compares cash you enter with what is due, and keeps the stock book out of the rent jar.

No account. No network. No ads. Names, amounts, and the sample desk are saved on this phone only. You can replace the sample holdings and bills, switch the ink or paper look, and read a short glossary when a word is new.

name: Weft Turn
description: Weft Turn keeps one tablet-woven band on this iPhone. A pick lands only after the weft is passed through the shed and beaten, and the cards then turn a quarter. Turn before the weft is in and beaten, and the warp twists. The pick count stays. Turn the cards back and the warp lies flat again. At four picks the band is woven: passing, beating, and turning no longer change it. Name a band, open it from the list, and share the sentence. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Welldone Connect
description:
Welldone Connect brings clients and freelancers closer together, making it easier to communicate, follow project progress and stay organized wherever work takes you. Built as the mobile companion to Welldone, it keeps your conversations, project updates and important schedules within reach. Welldone Connect is part of the Welldone freelance platform, connecting talented freelancers and clients. 

For discovering services, placing orders and managing your complete freelance workflow, visit www.welldone.asia.

name: WetterBlickKamera
description:
WetterBlick labels your photos with the weather – simple, easy to read and without uploading your pictures anywhere.

CHOOSE OR TAKE A PHOTO
Take a photo with the camera or pick one from your library. WetterBlick overlays temperature, conditions, humidity, wind, gusts and rain.

WEATHER FROM THE DAY IT WAS TAKEN
When you pick a photo, WetterBlick automatically shows the weather at that exact moment – at the place it was taken, using the photo's metadata, even for pictures from years ago. The time is shown in local time at the capture location; one tap switches to the current weather.

"RUHIG" PLUS THREE FAVOURITES
• Ruhig (calm): large temperature, conditions and icons on a soft gradient
• Three favourites you design yourself: which values to show, where (seven positions), how large and on which background – with a live preview
Plus °C or °F, km/h or m/s and the WetterBlick logo in four sizes.

STRAIGHT FROM THE PHOTOS APP
Use "Share → WetterBlick" to label a photo without opening the app and share it right away.

YOUR OWN WEATHER STATION
If you run a weather station in Home Assistant, connect it directly with an access token. The token stays in your iPhone's keychain. Alternatively, WetterBlick reads a data.json file or fetches values from Open-Meteo.

PRIVACY
• No tracking, no ads, no account
• Photos stay on your device; the exported image contains no EXIF or GPS data
• For the weather of a photo, its capture location is rounded to two decimal places and sent to Open-Meteo – can be switched off in Settings
• Your current location is only requested after you tap and is also sent rounded

The app interface is currently in German.

Weather data: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0).

name: Wfmcpt
description:
Thank you for choosing our app. We are steadily refining the details and welcome your valuable ideas.



Wfmcpt turns your iPhone into a stop-motion workstation. Shoot an animation one picture at a time, see the last frame as an onion skin while you line up the next move, fine-tune the timing frame by frame and export a looping GIF or an MP4 video to share.

Every animation is a reel, kept in the vault as a film canister with a tape slate label. Open a reel and the dark editor loads: a viewfinder with a frame counter and timecode, transport controls, a sprocketed filmstrip and a shooting deck. It is built for clay figures, paper cut-outs, brick builds, toys, drawings and anything else you can move a little at a time.

There is no account and no sign-in. Wfmcpt opens straight into the vault, works fully offline and quietly keeps a private backup of your reels.

SHOOT FRAME BY FRAME
• CAPTURE opens the camera with Wfmcpt's own console: a big red shutter, the onion skin of your previous shot, an opacity fader and canvas guides.
• The camera stays open between shots, so you can expose a whole sequence without stopping. Each new shot becomes the next onion skin.
• IMPORT adds pictures from your photo library (several at once on iOS 14 and later). New frames are placed right after the selected frame.

ONION SKIN
• See the previous frame faintly over the current one, in the editor and in the camera.
• Set how strong the ghost image is with the onion fader.

ARRANGE AND TIME
• Step through frames, move a frame left or right, duplicate it or delete it.
• The Arrange sheet lets you drag frames into a new order or reverse the whole reel.
• Choose a frame rate from 1 to 30 fps per reel, with quick picks for 6, 8, 10, 12, 15 and 24.
• Hold any frame for ×1 to ×12 frame durations to pause on a pose. Timecode and running time include every hold.

PLAY IT BACK
• Play, pause and step in the editor; playback loops so you can judge the motion.
• The Screening Room previews the reel with a scrubber, loop or play-once and ½×, 1× or 2× speed.

EXPORT AND SHARE
• Export an animated GIF (loop forever or play once) or an MP4 (H.264) video.
• Light (640 px) or Standard (960 px) size, in your reel's canvas: Upright 3:4, Square 1:1 or Wide 4:3.
• Files are rendered on your iPhone and only leave it when you share them through the share sheet.

YOUR VAULT
• Slate each reel with a production title, scene and take.
• Edit the slate, duplicate a reel (every frame picture is copied) or scrap it.
• Studio Notes holds new-reel defaults (frame rate and canvas), a studio log of reels, shots, imports and exports, and your data controls.
• New here? Studio Notes > Load sample data adds three fictional sample reels drawn by the app (Bouncing Clay Ball, Paper Rocket and Snail Sprint) so you can press play right away. Remove sample data takes them away again and leaves your own reels alone.

PRIVATE BACKUP, NO SIGN-IN
• Everything is saved on your iPhone first, so Wfmcpt works without a connection.
• Your reels, frame order, holds and settings are backed up to a private cloud space that belongs only to your install of the app. There is no account, email or password.
• Frame pictures stay on your iPhone and are backed up to cloud storage when it is available; Studio Notes always shows the current backup state.
• Changes made offline are sent automatically when you are back online.
• Studio Notes > Delete all my data erases every reel, frame and setting from your iPhone and from the cloud backup.

PRIVACY
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Camera access is requested only when you tap CAPTURE. Library pictures are the ones you choose.

Wfmcpt is a creative tool for making your own animations. The sample reels are original drawings made for the app.

name: Whalewake Powder Pact
description:
A whale leaps between two pirate skiffs and crashes into the sea. The impact sends a swell under your bow. Hold to raise the cannon, then release while the deck is still climbing. Rivals can take three to five regular hits. Watch their hulls crack and start to smoke with each strike.

In Whalewake Powder Pact, the sea sets your shooting angle. The barrel has a limited range of motion, and even a fully aimed shot falls short on flat water. A cannonball that lands with a splash sends a new ripple back across the field. With a limited number of rounds, every release changes the next shot.

Cargo drops from above and drifts toward your skiff. Pick up a Powder Crate for extra rounds, fan out three shots with Triple Pearls, or use a Skip Buoy to bounce a round off the water. Five more cargo types let you shape the swell, hold your trim, break armor, trace a flight path or stop a drifting rival.

- Sail through 100 voyages across ten regions.
- Read shifting waves, crosswinds and moving corsairs in a fixed portrait playfield.
- Earn up to three stars per voyage and rank your best results on your iPhone.
- Claim daily Harbor Seals to ring the bell and send a fresh swell.
- Play offline with one-touch controls and independent sound and haptic settings.

name: Wheel Test: Roll Out
description:
Wheel Test Roll Out turns a dusty roadside garage into the most unusual testing ground you have ever seen. Two friends, Ravi and Gurpreet, have a crazy idea: what if a tire could fly across the desert, through the forest, and over a frozen lake? Now it is your turn to find out.

Launch tires with style. Pick a launching machine, a tire, and a testing ground, set your wrench stake, choose the power and the angle, and send your tire rolling. While it flies, tap the golden wrenches that drift past to add them to your balance, avoid the cones that cut the distance, and catch the double bonus when it appears. Every launch ends with a clear summary of your distance, your earnings, and the XP you gained.

Solve the factory line. The Tire Factory is a sliding puzzle built on a 6 by 6 grid with one empty slot. Slide the parts next to the gap until three matching parts line up in a row or a column before the 60 second timer runs out. Complete tasks to earn wrenches, pause whenever you need a breather, and shuffle the board when you want a fresh start. Hearts keep you in the game, and they refill over time.

Upgrade your garage. Spend your wrenches in the Garage Shop on tires with different bounce, grip, and weight, on stronger launching machines, and on new testing grounds from autumn valleys to sunken kingdoms. Every item has its own character, and you can equip your favorites with a single tap.

Climb the leaderboard. Earn XP with every launch, every completed task, and every chapter you read. Compare your best distances and your levels on the leaderboard, and watch your place rise as your machines get better.

Follow the story. Garage Stories follows the adventures of Ravi and Gurpreet, from the first crooked sign above the door to the mysteries of Project Horizon. A new chapter unlocks every two launches, so keep experimenting to see what comes next.

Come back every day. The daily reward gives you wrenches and hearts, and a seven day streak ends with a chest full of rewards. Helpful tips appear the first time you visit each part of the game, so you can jump right in and learn as you play.

Everything is saved on your device, so your garage is always ready when you are. Wheel Test Roll Out is made for quick sessions and long experiments alike.

name: WheelOfRelics
description:
Every turn uncovers a story.

Explore forgotten courts, jade waterways and storm-worn archives in Wheel of Relics, a strategy puzzle adventure about choosing your path and piecing together the past.

PLAN THE RETURN JOURNEY
Recover three fragments and bring them safely home across 18 expeditions. Choose your direction and stride, inspect each landing, and decide when to replenish lamps, use ropes or seek shelter. Three equipment kits support different routes. Currents and sandstorms introduce new decisions as you travel.

RESTORE WHAT YOU DISCOVER
Unlock 18 restoration seals and explore an always-available practice puzzle. Turn overlapping groups of four tiles to rebuild nine-piece artifact mosaics. A correct corner may need to move again before the whole picture falls into place.

BUILD YOUR FIELD JOURNAL
Reveal six illustrated artifacts and their fictional curator stories. Improve your expedition medals, compare attempt reports, and revisit completed routes with a different approach.

LEARN, EXPERIMENT AND REFINE
Illustrated lessons introduce both puzzle modes. Precise landing previews help you plan expeditions, while undo, restoration targets and contextual hints give you room to test ideas and improve your strategy.

name: Where They Fell
description:
Where They Fell is an atlas of where lives ended, and who they were.

Find the exact ground where notable people drew their last breath, where battles were fought and where tragedies happened, across more than 40,000 places worldwide. Then go there. Stand there. Remember them.

• MEMORIALS: Each place tells its story, with photographs of the setting across the years and seasons.
• NEARBY: See what happened around you, with distance and direction to each place.
• PAY RESPECTS IN PERSON: Stand at the site to mark your visit in your journal. Or light a candle from anywhere and see how many others have remembered them.
• TRAILS: Follow themed journeys like the Civil War battlefields and Pearl Harbor & the Pacific War, in the order they happened.
• YOUR JOURNAL: Keep the places you've stood and the people you've remembered, and save it to your email to bring it to a new phone.
• CORRECT THE RECORD: Help fix locations and details. Families can ask for a record to be removed.

Where They Fell is made to be respectful. There are no ads on memorial pages, and we never describe suicide as a manner of death. Many places are private homes, hospitals or graves. Please stay on public ground and honor the people who live and grieve nearby.

name: Whilepin: Location Reminders
description:
Remind me while I'm here. Whilepin ties a task to a place, so the reminder shows up when you walk into the store, get home or leave work.
Missed it? Whilepin asks again on your next visit, and the one after that, until it's done.

PIN IT TO A PLACE
Home, work, a friend's house, the pharmacy on your way home. Search for the place and pin your task to it. Pick when you want to hear about it: when you arrive, or when you leave, like "take the gym bag" on your way out.

LISTS THAT OPEN WHEN YOU WALK IN
Pin your grocery list to the market. When you get there, the notification shows what's still on it. Whilepin suggests items for the kind of place, so you can tap instead of typing, and it learns what you usually buy. Check things off as you shop, then keep the list for next week. Lists are free for everyone.

ANSWER FROM THE LOCK SCREEN
Done, Later or Mute today, right from the notification. No need to open the app.

SHARE WITH YOUR FAMILY
With Whilepin Family you start a family list for up to 6 people, you included. Joining is free, with their own Apple Account.
• Tap "I'll get it" and the others won't be reminded for a few hours
• Done by one means done for everyone
• Tag who a pin is for, and only they get reminded
• Add and check items together, and see who checked what
Nobody's live location is ever shared. The family list only shares the saved places your family pins use. Each iPhone and iPad only checks its own location to remind the person it belongs to.

ON YOUR iPHONE AND iPAD
Your pins, places and lists sync with iCloud. Add widgets to your Home Screen and Lock Screen, start a new pin from Control Center, or ask Siri to add something to a list.

FREE
• 5 active pins, up to 3 places each
• Arrive and leave reminders, on every visit until done
• Lists with item suggestions

PRO
• Unlimited pins and places
• Quiet hours: a reminder that would land at night waits until morning, if you're still there
• Grouping: one notification per place
• Repeat spacing: choose how soon a pin can remind you again
• Quick Add: type "pick up dry cleaning when I leave work" and Whilepin fills in the pin, or turns a sentence into a list
Quiet hours and repeat spacing need Location access set to Always. Grouping works with While Using the App too.

YOUR PLACES STAY YOURS
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your personal pins and places live on your devices and in your own private iCloud account. Your location is never sent to our servers. Whilepin uses the region monitoring built into iOS, so it doesn't follow you around all day. Quick Add runs on your device when it can. If it needs our cloud AI, it asks you first, and your location is never included.

SUBSCRIPTIONS AND PURCHASES
Whilepin is free to download. Optional purchases:
• Whilepin Pro, monthly or yearly: auto renewing subscriptions
• Whilepin Family: an auto renewing yearly subscription with everything in Pro, shared with your Apple Family Sharing group (up to 6 people)
• Whilepin Pro Lifetime: a one time purchase that never renews
Eligible accounts can try Pro Yearly free for 1 week. The trial turns into a paid yearly subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before that period ends. You can manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. Prices are shown in the App Store in your local currency.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://whilepin.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://whilepin.com/privacy

name: Whim: Shower Thoughts
description:
I kept losing my shower thoughts. So I made this.

Press the Action Button or ask Siri, and just talk. Then lock your phone. That's it. Nothing to type, nothing to file. You can also open Whim and tap the circle.

It writes down what you said, right on the phone. It notes the time, and if you let it, the weather and where you were.

Give it a few weeks and the same things keep turning up. Whim shows them as a cloud of words that turns slowly. The big words are the ones you keep coming back to. Tap a word and you get every time you said it.

A few more things:
• Ask it a question and it answers from what you've said.
• Bring in screenshots of lines you saved.
• Compare with a friend you invite. You see where you overlap and what they've chosen to share. Nothing else.
• Turn one thought into a postcard picture and send it.

There's no account, no ads and no tracking. The audio stays on your phone and in your iCloud. Nothing goes to an AI until you say it can. When you do, Claude, an AI made by Anthropic, reads your words, the time and your city. That's how the cloud gets made.

Recording and keeping your whims is free. The reading is the part that costs money. The first readings are free. After that, Whim+ is $2.99 a month and keeps the reading going, up to a monthly limit. It's charged to your Apple account and renews each month until you cancel in your Apple account settings.

For adults 18 and over, in the US. iPhone only.

Privacy: https://whim.day/privacy
Terms: https://whim.day/terms

name: Whisker Escape
description:
Slide every mouse into the hole that matches its scarf.

A mouse keeps sliding until something stops it. Cheese, cans, and books stay put. Crates budge one square. Yarn rolls until it hits something. Other mice block the way too, so the order matters. Free every mouse to clear the level.

Play the same twelve levels three ways. Classic has no timer and no move cap, and fewer moves earn more stars. Time Attack gives each level a countdown, and more time left means more stars. Move Limit gives each level a move budget, and undo does not give a move back.

In Classic and Time Attack, a dead end nudges the player to undo and the puzzle keeps going. In Move Limit, a dead end ends the run. Stars and progress are saved separately for each mode.

Undo, restart, and hints are built in. A hint shows the shortest solution. Music, sound, and vibration can be turned off. No ads, no account, and no connection required.

name: Whisperpond
description:
Guide wandering moths into the moon lantern with carefully placed ripples. Plan each tap around rocks, wind and pond currents.

Explore 100 chapters with varied pond layouts, moving lanterns and limited ripple budgets. Use echo leaves and one Still Water skill per attempt to shape your route. Earn up to three stars in each chapter and revisit unlocked chapters to improve your best result.

Progress stays on your device. Play offline with no account, advertisements or in-app purchases. When connected, optional pond photographs and background music load in the background; bundled artwork and sound remain available offline.

name: Wile: Word Tile Puzzle
description:
Meet Tilly, a cheerful hedgehog who loves words!

Every Wile puzzle is a word square. Swap any two letter tiles to put them in place, and make every row and every column spell a word. Tiles turn green when a word is right, and real words that are not the answer light up as bonus words.

WORD PUZZLES YOUR WAY
- Over 1,100 built-in puzzles in English and over 1,100 in French
- Grid sizes from a quick 3x3 up to a tough 7x7
- Easy, Medium and Hard puzzles
- Optional time limit, or play with no pressure
- Reshuffle-if-stuck option for extra excitement
- Optional download of new puzzles from our server

HINTS AND REWARDS
- Hints swap a tile into its right place, paid for with the points you earn
- Bonus words, stars, scores and achievements
- Statistics to track your progress

SIGHTS AND SOUNDS
- Bright hand-drawn cartoon art and a hedgehog mascot who reacts to your play
- Optional weather in the scenery: rain, snow or sunshine to match your day
- 5 soundtracks: Classic Funk, Cosy Lo-fi, Jazzy Paws, Retro Arcade and Island Breeze
- Confetti and celebrations for every solved puzzle

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Works fully offline
- No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking, no in-app purchases
- Settings and statistics are stored only on your device

Available in English and French. Suitable for all ages.

Wile is published by AppsSolutely Apps, a division of 4MEC Limited (UK).
Privacy Policy: https://4mec.co.uk/wile/privacy.html
Support: https://4mec.co.uk/wile/support.html

name: Willow Rand
description:
Willow Rand keeps one round of six stakes on this iPhone.

The first stroke covers the first stake only from the front. The next stake is covered only when the face changes. The same face slips, and that stake stays bare. Six covered stakes close the round. Press the border only after the round is closed. After the border is pressed, another stroke does not change the round.

You can name the basket. You can delete it only before the border is pressed. Share sends the name and whether the border is pressed. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Winco Connect
description:
WINCO Connect – World Infra Networking Community
"Build Connections. Create Opportunities. Grow Together."

WINCO Connect is the premier, exclusive mobile platform built for infrastructure leaders, civil contractors, structural engineering consultants, architects, equipment fleet owners, precast manufacturers, and renewable energy EPC leaders.

Designed to bridge the gap in the infrastructure and construction industry, WINCO Connect empowers verified members to exchange high-value business referrals, form strategic joint ventures for mega government and private tenders, and collaborate seamlessly across regional chapters.

KEY APPLICATION FEATURES:

1. EXECUTIVE DASHBOARD & LIVE METRICS
• Real-time visibility into overall network statistics, active chapter members, and total closed business generated across chapters.
• Instant access to your personal networking performance and business slips.

2. VERIFIED MEMBER DIRECTORY
• Search and connect directly with vetted infrastructure professionals across diverse business categories.
• Detailed company profiles, capabilities, past projects, leadership credentials, and one-tap contact options.

3. BUSINESS REFERRAL EXCHANGE
• Seamlessly pass and receive business referral slips with estimated contract values and project specifications.
• Complete lifecycle tracking from "Given/Received" to "In Discussion", "Proposal Submitted", and "Closed Business (TYFCB)".

4. MEGA PROJECTS & JOINT VENTURE HUB
• Explore major infrastructure opportunities across highways, bridges, railways, urban mass transit, industrial parks, and clean energy.
• Form consortiums and joint ventures to jointly qualify and bid for high-ticket tenders.

5. REGIONAL CHAPTERS & FORTNIGHTLY CONCLAVES
• Access event agendas, meeting venues, and schedules for your local chapter conclaves.
• Confirm attendance with instant RSVP tracking and review regional chapter leadership.

6. PRIME CLUB SYNDICATE
• Exclusive engagement tier for senior contractors and enterprise builders executing multi-crore EPC packages.

7. SECURE & RELIABLE ARCHITECTURE
• Enterprise-grade data encryption protecting member contact details and proprietary commercial slips.

Experience a trusted, high-velocity networking ecosystem designed specifically for the infrastructure industry. Download WINCO Connect today to expand your professional horizons.

name: Wink Rally: Date Night Games
description:
Make a little time for each other. Wink Rally brings games for couples to one screen. Pass the phone, make something together, or see how well you can read your partner's clues. Choose Bonding, Intimacy, or Just for Fun and start when you're ready.

DRAW, LISTEN, AND MOVE
• Sketch Swap: Start a drawing, then pass it to your partner to add a surprise twist. Compare the first sketch with the result.
• Echo: Make a four-note pattern and challenge your partner to play it back. Take turns on one phone or exchange a short code to play on two.
• Same Beat: Wait for the cue and tap together.
• Mirror Move and Palm Post: Copy a small movement or guess the shape your partner traces.

TALK AND PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Use Secret Signal to guess a hidden choice from your partner's clue, take turns improvising a story in Plot Twist, or draw a card from Night Deck. For a closer conversation, choose Chemistry and discuss the topics you both picked. Skip anything you would rather pass on.

Wink Rally is designed for adults. Play offline without an account. Game choices stay on your device. Echo codes go to another player only when you share them yourself. The interface and game content are available in English, Spanish, and Japanese.

name: Winterwood Fuel
description:
Keep your Winterwood Fuel account close at hand.

The Winterwood Fuel app gives customers a convenient way to manage account details and access everyday delivery tools from one place.

FUEL DELIVERY
• Order fuel directly from your tank screen
• Review scheduled delivery information
• See previous orders, delivery amounts and order status

TANK INFORMATION
• Add and manage tanks associated with your account
• Check tank capacity, location and product information
• Update tank names and settings

ACCOUNT TOOLS
• Access bill pay
• Manage account settings
• Contact the Winterwood Fuel team when you need assistance

Designed for Winterwood Fuel customers, the app makes it easier to stay informed and take care of routine fuel-account tasks wherever you are.

name: Wiper Span
description:
Dear friend,

Wiper blades squeak or streak and you still cannot remember which car got new blades last — or whether that was the front pair or the rear. Wiper Span is a small garage notebook for people who keep more than one car and want a calm place to log blade sizes and replacement timing on this phone.

1. Register each car and its blade set
Give the car a short name, then note front and rear blade sizes in plain text (for example 26 in / 16 in or 650 mm / 400 mm). Set a replacement interval in months between 1 and 36, and the last replacement date. That is enough for the app to reckon the next due day.

2. See what is due at a glance
The Due board groups blade sets into overdue, due soon, and on schedule so you can open the garage and know which car to touch first. Tap Mark replaced to log today’s change and roll the next due date forward by the interval you chose.

3. Keep cars and sizes searchable
Cars lists every vehicle with search. Open a car to edit sizes, interval, or last date, or to review that car’s replacement log. Sizes gathers the size notes you have used so you can jump back to matching cars without retyping.

4. Quiet landscape layout, local-only data
The screens stay readable in landscape: a soft garage wash, clear cards, and actions that sit where your thumbs expect them. Everything lives on this device. There is no account, no ads, and nothing to buy. About covers getting started, Privacy, Support mail to chamkaursingh1971@icloud.com, and Erase all local data after two confirmations.

Warmly,
Wiper Span

name: Wisdom from the East
description:
One verse. One breath.

Wisdom from the East turns an idle scroll into a quiet reading of the Buddhist, Confucian and Taoist classics. Each screen holds a single verse, hung like a scroll painting: the ink painting above, the classical Chinese written in columns at its side, and a clear English rendering below.

108 VERSES, 16 CLASSICS
The Analects, Mencius, The Great Learning, The Doctrine of the Mean, the Tao Te Ching, Zhuangzi, the Dhammapada, the Heart, Diamond and Platform Sutras, and more.

FOUR STUDY TOOLS FOR EVERY VERSE
• Explain It Easier: a plain modern paraphrase
• Original & Characters: the key characters, with readings and meanings
• Historical Context: who said it, and why
• Apply It Today: one small thing to try

FIND THE WORDS YOU NEED
Browse by theme (inner peace, relationships, anxiety, focus), by book, or along six curated paths. Search instantly across every verse, meaning and character.

KEEP AND SHARE
Save verses, mark the ones you want to carry with you on a ring of 108 beads, and make a card for your story in paper, night or landscape style.

WIDGETS
A new verse each morning on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

THREE LIGHTS
Bright paper, soft moonlight or deep ink. Choose the one you like to read by.

English, 한국어, 日本語 and 繁體中文.

Free and complete. No account, no ads, no tracking. It works offline, and everything you save stays on your iPhone.

The translations and study notes were written for this app with the help of AI.

name: WishDay – Birthday Reminders
description:
Never forget a birthday, anniversary or festival again

WishDay remembers the special days of everyone you love, reminds you on the day, and turns their photo into a beautiful story-style wish you can post to WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook or Snapchat in one tap.

REMINDERS THAT ACTUALLY HELP
• A notification on the day, and the day before
• Tap it and your post is ready: photo, caption and stickers
• Birthdays, anniversaries, work anniversaries, remembrance days and any custom occasion
• Import birthdays from your contacts in seconds

DESIGN LIKE A STORY
• Add text, cakes, balloons, hearts, diyas and more
• Pinch, drag and rotate stickers, crop with your fingers
• Frames, festive backgrounds, story (9:16), post (4:5) and square sizes
• Your original photo is never changed

THE PERFECT CAPTION
• 60+ captions in English, Hindi and Hinglish
• Warm, funny, emotional, short or formal
• Name and age filled in for you: "Happy 30th birthday, Priya!"
• Save your favourite captions forever

POST IN ONE TAP
• WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat or any app
• The image is ready and the caption is copied, just paste
• Mark it posted and WishDay remembers

STORIES, TIMELINE & HISTORY
• Today's occasions as stories
• Month-by-month timeline of every special day
• See who you wished, who you missed, and your wishing streak

FESTIVALS FOR EVERYONE
Diwali, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, Eid, Christmas, Thanksgiving, Karwa Chauth, Ganesh Chaturthi, Navratri, Lunar New Year, Bonfire Night and 40+ more for India, the US, the UK and worldwide.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no servers. Your people, photos and dates stay on your phone.
Note: because data is stored only on your device, deleting the app deletes it. Cloud backup is coming soon.

FREE, SEATS OR PRO
• Free: up to 6 people, with ads
• Seats: add one more person at a time
• Pro: unlimited people, no ads, every sticker, frame and caption, week-before reminders, no watermark, backup & restore

Be the friend who never forgets. Download WishDay today!

name: With My Clique
description:
Clique is the easy way to say "I'm going to this, come along" without a group chat.

Post an open invite: what, when, where, maybe a photo and a ticket link. Everyone who follows you sees it on a shared calendar and can join with one tap, and you see who's coming and when they plan to arrive. No planning threads, no pressure, no one left wondering if they're invited.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Post open invites to all your friends, to a group you've made, or to a hand-picked few
• See your friends' plans on one calendar, or as a list, and join the ones you like
• Say when you'll arrive, so people know who's there early and who's coming later
• Add a photo, an address with directions, a ticket link and a price
• Add to your calendar: Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or any .ics app
• Follow friends with a link, by name, or by the email or phone number you already have
• Groups and custom lists keep smaller plans private
• Block anyone, any time, and they simply stop seeing you

FIND SOMETHING TO DO
Nothing on? Search shows and events near you by date, time of day and vibe, from big venues to bookshops, cafés and run clubs, then turn one into an invite for your friends.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your invites are visible only to the audience you choose, and that is enforced in the database, not just in the app. We don't sell your data and there are no ads. Delete your account any time from inside the app.

Sign in with Apple, Google or email. Clique is also at withmyclique.com.

name: Witness Dip
description:
Witness Dip keeps a coating run on this iPhone.

Drag the dip on the monitor curve. The open layer is the shutter count plus one. Gap is the dip minus the design wavelength. Shutter moves on only when the gap sits inside the tolerance. Remain is the size of that gap against the open layer, and it does not decide the shutter.

Keep a run, then compare two saved curves. Tap a layer swatch to change its index. Share the report when you want a copy.

Layers and runs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: WOGO İstanbul
description:
WOGO İstanbul makes getting around Istanbul simple. Book private airport transfers, hourly chauffeur hire and city tours in a few taps, with fixed prices and no hidden fees.

WHY WOGO
• Istanbul Airport (IST) and Sabiha Gökçen (SAW) transfers to hotels, hospitals and any address
• Premium vehicles: Mercedes Vito, Sprinter and VIP options for families and groups
• Fixed prices in TRY, EUR, USD and GBP
• Meet & greet at the airport and free flight tracking
• Licensed travel agency (TÜRSAB)

IN THE APP
• Booking: search your route, pick a date and time, choose your vehicle and reserve
• Explore: popular routes with live prices from wogoistanbul.com
• Packages: VIP transfer packages and Istanbul tours
• Guide: Istanbul travel tips, neighbourhoods and airport guides, readable offline
• Quick quote: send your trip details via WhatsApp or e-mail
• Contact: reach the WOGO team 24/7 on WhatsApp or by phone
• Turkish and English language support

Whether you are landing in Istanbul for business, medical travel or a holiday, WOGO İstanbul gets you there comfortably and on time.

name: Wolfoshadow
description:
Your wolves are spirits of the night. They can run only through shadow, and moonlight makes them fade. You are the moon.

Drag the moon across the sky and watch every cactus, rock and mesa cast a new shadow on the canyon floor. A low moon throws long shadows. A high moon shrinks them. Find the sky position that opens a dark path, then send your wolves along it to Howl Rock.

HOW A NIGHT PLAYS
• Drag the moon to one of 15 positions in the sky. While you hold it, the board previews the new shadows, marks wolves in danger and shows which gold will wake.
• Release to commit the move. Each move brings dawn one step closer.
• Tap a wolf, then tap a dark cell. The wolf runs there for free.
• Light up moon gold to wake it, then cover it in shadow and collect it.
• Bring the pack to Howl Rock before sunrise.

FIVE WOLVES, FIVE GIFTS
• Ash sniffs out the gold around her.
• Vega leaps over a lit cell.
• Burrow digs a safe hole in open ground.
• Echo howls to scare rattlesnakes off the trail.
• Pale shields a packmate from the light.

A CANYON THAT FIGHTS BACK
Campfires and lanterns burn through shadow. Crystals throw beams of light. Pools reflect the moon. Clouds drift with the wind, and lantern keepers walk their routes. Under the Blood Moon the rules turn inside out.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• The Trail: 60 nights across five regions, each ending with a Blood Moon night. Earn up to three Paw Marks per night and find 30 hidden relics.
• Endless Night: a run of generated nights. Pick a blessing after each one and see how deep you can go.
• Daily Howl: one new puzzle a day, the same for every player. Keep your streak alive.

BETWEEN NIGHTS
Spend moon gold in the Den on upgrades and charms like Eclipse, Rewind and Shadow Seed. Fill your Journal with relics, a field guide of the canyon and a star chart of achievements.

Undo any move. Ask the owl for a hint when you are stuck. The game generates every Endless and Daily night with a solver check, so each one has a solution.

name: Word and Wheat
description:
Spend time in Scripture, one passage at a time.

Word and Wheat brings you the Verse of the Day with its surrounding context and the full chapter, using the New American Standard Bible — NASB 1995.

• Read the daily verse, explore its context, and continue in the Bible reader.
• Mark chapters as read and follow your progress through Scripture.
• Bookmark a verse, a verse with context, or a whole chapter.
• Use your private sync key to pick up your progress and bookmarks in the app or on the website.
• Restore your saved sync key through iCloud when available.
• Revisit recently opened readings offline.
• Choose a light, sepia, or dark reading theme.

Reading is free, with no advertising. You can read without signing in. Tracking and bookmarks are optional.

Scripture quotations from the New American Standard Bible – NASB 1995 Copyright © 1960, 1971, 1977, 1995 by The Lockman Foundation. All rights reserved. Used by permission. https://www.Lockman.org

name: Wordglow: Word Search Puzzle
description:
Find the hidden words and watch them glow.

Wordglow is a calm word search for quiet moments. Swipe across the letters to light up a word, or tap its first and last letter. Every word gets its own colour, and leaves and fireflies drift from your fingertips as you play.

WHAT YOU GET
• 12 themes: Animals, Food, Colours, Sports, Nature, Travel, Home, Space, Music, Weather, Jobs and Garden
• Grids that grow as you go, from 6 by 6 up to 10 by 10
• Words across, down and diagonal, and backwards on later levels
• Hint shows where the next word starts
• Find a word lights one up for you
• Soft sounds and gentle music, with one switch to turn them off
• Confetti and falling leaves when you finish a level
• Your level is saved, so you can pick up where you left off

FREE TO PLAY
Wordglow is free and shows ads. Hints are unlocked by watching a short video, only when you choose to. A one-time Remove Ads purchase takes away the banner and the ads between levels and makes hints free. No subscription.

Made by Lumina Dev Apps.

name: Wortstaffel: Story Relay
description:
One story, many hands. Wortstaffel turns writing into a relay race: someone starts with the opening and passes on the baton. Whoever holds it writes the next stage – and, depending on the setting, sees only the end of the last one. At the finish, everything is revealed, and everyone gets the whole story as a book to page through and as a PDF.

HOW A RELAY WORKS
• Start a relay: choose length, deadline and visibility, then write the opening.
• Pass on the baton – directly to friends, by link, into the open relay, or around the table on one iPhone.
• Whoever’s turn it is writes the next stage, with a fixed limit of words or characters.
• At the finish, the manuscript is ready for everyone. If you like, your book goes into the Bookshop, free to read.

THE EVENING GAME
You sit together and pass one iPhone around. Whoever’s turn it is sees only the last sentence and writes one of their own. At the end, the whole story is revealed and read aloud. For 2 to 12 people, with no account and no network.

GROUPS
Start a group for family, friends or a writing circle. Your finished relays sit on the shared group shelf.

YOUR OWN WORDS
Wortstaffel is made for your imagination: writing tools that generate text for you are switched off in the writing field, and long texts from elsewhere can’t be pasted in. What you read here, you wrote yourselves.

THE BOOKSHOP
Finished stories from all over the world, free to read – in your language first.

FAIR INSTEAD OF A SUBSCRIPTION
Reading and co-writing never cost anything. Every profile starts with two relays and one evening free. After that, another evening or a new relay costs a small one-time purchase by size – from booklet to big book. No subscription, no ads. The small price keeps spam away.

NO SIGN-UP
No password and no e-mail address: Wortstaffel uses your iCloud account. No tracking, no analytics.

WRITING TOGETHER SAFELY
A content filter checks as you write, reporting and blocking take one tap, and moderators can ban books. Wortstaffel is for people aged 16 and over.

name: Wortwelle
description:
German vocabulary from A1 to C2, sorted by topic, with English translations.

This app goes with the vocabulary booklets by German with Kevin & Vanessa. Learn word by word, review at the right time and watch your vocabulary grow.

• 6 levels: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2 with about 2,890 words and expressions in total (German → English)
• Flip tiles: tap a word to see the translation and hear the German pronunciation
• Nouns with colour-coded articles (der, die, das) to help you remember them
• Spaced repetition: words you know come back later, uncertain ones soon
• “Words for today”: your daily round of due and new words (5 to 20 new words per day, adjustable)
• Statistics: see how many words you are learning and have mastered
• Quizzes on articles, plurals, perfect tense and prepositions (depending on the level)
• “Useful phrases” for every topic
• Search across all words
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no sign-up

Free and Premium: levels A1 and A2 are free forever. Wortwelle Premium unlocks B1, B2, C1 and C2 – as a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscription info: the subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple Account settings. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Pronunciation: the app uses the German voice of your device. If none is installed, the app shows you how to add one in your settings.

Privacy: your learning progress stays on your device.

---

name: WSSA Safe Hunting Beacon
description:
WSSA Safe Hunting Beacon is a simple safety tool for members and guests of the West Shore Sportsmen's Association.

Sign in once with the email address or cell phone number the club has for you. When you head out, turn tracking ON. While it is on, the app records where your phone is about once a minute, even with the app closed, so club staff can find you if something happens. Turn it OFF when you are done.

- One big ON / OFF button. Your name and member number are shown so you know you are signed in as yourself.
- SOS button: tells club staff where you are, and they can call you.
- Nobody but club staff can see your location. Other members cannot.
- Works with weak signal: points are kept on your phone and sent when you have signal.
- The club can switch your tracking off, but can never switch it on. You are always in control.

This app is a safety aid, not an emergency service. In an emergency, call 911. For club members and guests only.

name: Xavis Booth
description:
Xavis Booth turns an iPad into a complete photobooth for weddings, birthdays, corporate events and pop-up booths.

Guests tap Start, pick a layout and pose to a big on-screen countdown. Then they choose a frame, add stickers, text or drawings, and get their photos printed in seconds, plus a QR code to download them on their phone.

FOR GUESTS
- Layouts for every event: polaroid, strips and grids
- A big countdown, retakes and photo looks
- Your event's own frames, with every photo fitted in place
- Stickers, text and drawing on the finished photo
- Instant prints on a receipt printer or a photo printer
- Scan a QR code to download the photo, GIF and boomerang
- Leave a video message for the hosts

FOR BOOTH OPERATORS
- Set up packages, prices, frames and branding from the Xavis Snaps dashboard
- Cash, voucher and QR payments, or free mode for private events
- Bluetooth receipt printers and AirPrint photo printers
- Use the iPad camera or a USB camera (webcam, DSLR in webcam mode)
- Keeps working offline: photos and messages upload when the internet is back
- Device logs and printer status in the dashboard

Xavis Booth needs a Xavis Snaps booth licence. Sign up at xavissnaps.com.

name: xMagic Games
description:
xMagic Games is a growing collection of quick, friendly games in one app. Open it, pick a game and play in seconds. No long setup, no clutter.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Puzzle, arcade and casual games, each with a short description and screenshots.
• Browse by category and sort by newest, most played or top rated.
• Play as a guest right away, or create an account to keep your progress, scores and favorites.
• Pause and pick up where you left off.

COMPETE AND COLLECT
• Leaderboards for the games that keep a score. See where you rank.
• Daily challenges: one ranked attempt per game each day, the same challenge for everyone.
• Achievements and points that unlock as you play.
• Rate games and read what other players think. You can report or block a player or a review at any time.

MADE TO FIT
• Light and dark themes.
• Available in English and Vietnamese.
• Delete your account and its data whenever you like, from Settings or at https://cookmagic.net/delete-account.

ADS AND PURCHASES
The app contains ads: a small banner below a game, and full-screen ads only after a finished run or when you choose to watch one for a hint. An optional one-time purchase, Remove Ads, switches them off for good and can be restored on any device with your Apple ID.

New games are added over time.

Privacy policy: https://cookmagic.net/legal/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://cookmagic.net/legal/terms.html

name: Xorvella Playmagic Pro
description:
Xorvella Playmagic Pro is a fairy-tale card arcade bundle built around the four classic suits. Two original mini-games live inside one quiet, polished package: Suit Tower and Suit Dungeon.

In Suit Tower, hold anywhere on the screen to smash your ball straight down through a spinning tower of suit-shaped blocks. Match your ball's color to shatter whole rings, dodge obsidian traps, and ride a growing blaze meter that lets you burst through everything for a few glorious seconds. A pink heart ward can save you from a single smash, and a green clover charm slows the tower when the stack gets wild.

In Suit Dungeon, you explore handcrafted rooms room by room. Kick suit blocks into wandering spirits, outsmart ghosts, bats, wisps and spiders, gather shards along the way, and open the magic door to the next floor. Level two onward adds pickups and a portal that rewards careful routing.

Progress, best scores, settings, and the round history with saved screenshots all stay on your device, and you can clear them anytime from Settings. Every shape, sound and melody is drawn and composed in code, so the game stays light, quick to launch, and friendly on battery.

Good for a short break, a long train ride, or winding down at the end of the day.

name: Yaelen
description: Yaelen is a small, offline field journal for naked-eye night-sky observation. It holds a fixed atlas of twenty-four bright and familiar objects, a private record of every night session, and five short notes on waiting for dark. There is no account, no feed, no map, no sync and no advertising. Everything you need for the next clear night is already inside the app.

name: Yarn Dress Club
description: Yarn Dress Club is a casual color-sorting puzzle game built around 3D knitted outfits. Choose a design, from a prince’s royal coat to a princess gown, then tap or drag to unravel it one strand at a time. Fill each box with three strands of the same color. Strands without a matching box go into temporary slots, so plan your moves to keep those slots from filling up. If you get stuck, undo your last move or use a booster to add a slot, open another sorting box, or move waiting yarn into reserve. Each completed design earns 50 coins to spend on boosters. The game works offline without an account and saves completed designs, coins, boosters, and sound preferences on your device.

name: Yellow Boot Pizza
description:
**The art of pizza at home.**

Exceptional ingredients. Unforgettable moments.

Great pizza starts with the right ingredients, the right proportions, and a little knowledge.

Yellow Boot Pizza brings together practical tools, pizza-making science, and inspiration to help you create exceptional pizza in your own kitchen.

**MAKE YOUR DOUGH**

Calculate your pizza dough with precision. Adjust hydration, flour, yeast, salt, fermentation time, and temperature to create a recipe that fits your needs.

**EXPLORE PIZZA ENGINEERING**

Go beyond basic recipes with advanced fermentation tools:

• Classic Dough Calculator
• Scientific Fermentation Mode
• Fermentation Tracker
• Fermentation Prediction

Understand how time, temperature, and ingredients influence your dough.

**PLAN YOUR PIZZA NIGHT**

Let Pizza Planner help you organize your next pizza night, calculate ingredient quantities, and prepare for your guests.

**DISCOVER PIZZA SECRETS**

Explore 10 practical lessons covering the ingredients, techniques, and details behind great pizza.

**NUTRITION & INGREDIENTS**

Explore estimated nutritional information and better understand your pizza dough ingredients.

**EXPLORE OVENS & FIND STORES**

Discover pizza-making equipment and find stores offering ingredients and supplies.

**MADE FOR HOME PIZZA MAKERS**

Whether you're preparing your first homemade pizza or refining your fermentation technique, Yellow Boot Pizza gives you the tools to improve with every bake.

One purchase. All features included.

No subscriptions. No advertisements. No in-app purchases.

**Yellow Boot Pizza**
*Noble ingredients, great moments.*

name: YIYE
description:
Stop paying for subscriptions just to make a photo collage. 

Meet YIYE — the ultimate private photo layout app. Turn your photos into stunning, printable memory pages in seconds.

100% On-Device. No servers. No accounts. We technically can't see your photos.
8 Curated Templates. From vintage Polaroid to modern Magazine. No design skills needed.
One-Time Purchase. Buy once ($9.99), yours forever. No hidden fees.
Family Sharing. One purchase covers up to 6 family members.
Print Ready. Export in ultra-high resolution.

Your memories deserve better than a cloud server. Download YIYE today.

name: YıldızTalk
description:
YıldızTalk, Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi (YTÜ) öğrencileri için yapılmış bir kampüs sosyal ağıdır. Üniversite e-postanla kayıt olursun; böylece burada sadece YTÜ'lüler var.

Neler yapabilirsin?

• Akış: Kampüste neler konuşulduğunu gör. Yazı, fotoğraf, GIF ve anket paylaş; beğen, yorum yap, yeniden paylaş.
• Mesajlar: Arkadaşlarınla birebir mesajlaş.
• Kulüpler ve topluluklar: Kulüpleri takip et, duyurularını ve etkinliklerini kaçırma.
• Etkinlikler: Kampüsteki etkinlikleri tek yerde gör.
• Sınavlar ve çıkmış sorular: Sınav takvimine ve geçmiş yılların sorularına ulaş.
• Ders notları: Ders notu paylaş ve bul.
• Ring ve kampüs haritası: Ring saatlerine ve kampüs haritasına hızlıca bak.
• Akademisyenler: Hocalar hakkında öğrenci yorumlarını oku.
• İtiraf ve ilanlar: Anonim itiraflar, ev arkadaşı, eşya, kayıp-buluntu ilanları.
• Oyunlar: Arkadaşlarınla mini oyunlar oyna, başarımlar kazan.
• Anlık bildirimler: Mesaj, yorum ve etkileşimlerden anında haberdar ol.

Güvenli bir topluluk için: Rahatsız edici gönderileri şikayet edebilir, kullanıcıları engelleyebilirsin. Şikayetler yöneticiler tarafından incelenir. Hesabını istediğin zaman uygulama içinden kalıcı olarak silebilirsin.

YıldızTalk öğrenciler tarafından geliştirilen bağımsız bir projedir; Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi'nin resmî uygulaması değildir.

name: Yoraba: GPS Speedometer
description:
GPS Speedometer turns your phone into a clear, mechanical-style speed readout using GPS—no extra sensors.

SPEED
• Large analog-style dial with live GPS speed (mph or km/h; default follows your region)
• Day and night dial that follows Dark Mode
• Speed alert: the dial turns red and your iPhone taps when you go over your limit
• GPS status and accuracy at a glance
• Trip tray: average speed, top speed, distance, and elapsed time while you drive
• Start and stop trip recording from the Speed tab
• HUD mode mirrors speed for windshield reflection (light, dark, or match system)

TRIPS
• Completed trips saved on your device with date, distance, duration, and speed stats
• Open any trip to see its route on a map with start and finish
• Export a trip as GPX or CSV and share it to other apps
• Swipe to delete
• No cloud sync and no account

STATISTICS
• Totals for trip count, distance, driving time, and best top speed
• Filter by week, month, year, or all time
• Distance chart for the last 7 days

SETTINGS
• Units: miles per hour or kilometres per hour
• Vehicle profile for the dial icon (car, motorcycle, bicycle, scooter)
• Optional speed alert threshold
• HUD appearance
• Remove ads (one-time purchase) and Restore Purchases

FREE WITH OPTIONAL REMOVE ADS
All features are free. A small banner sits at the bottom of the Trips and Statistics tabs only—never on the live Speed screen or HUD while driving. Pay once for Remove Ads to hide banners permanently. No subscription.

PRIVACY
• No account or sign-in
• No analytics or tracking SDKs beyond ad SDK requirements
• Trip history and settings stay on your device
• Location is used only while the app is in use to calculate speed and record trips
• Google AdMob may show ads on Trips and Statistics

Use GPS Speedometer responsibly. Obey local laws about phone use while driving. Speed from GPS can lag or vary with signal quality.

Support: https://yoraba.com/apps/gps-speedometer/support/
Privacy: https://yoraba.com/apps/gps-speedometer/privacy/

name: YoSuite
description:
YoSuite puts your company's HR workspace in your pocket. Check in for the day, request time off, follow company news and get answers from HR without opening a laptop.

YoSuite is for employees of organizations that use YoSuite. Your HR team creates your account. Sign in with the email and password they send you.

ATTENDANCE
• Punch in and out in one tap
• See today's working time and your punch sessions
• Browse your attendance history
• Request a time adjustment when you forget to punch

TIME OFF
• Check your leave balances
• Request time off and track its approval
• See company holidays and your organization's calendar

REQUESTS
• Raise asset, maintenance, benefit, compensation, loan, job-information and other HR requests
• Follow every request's status and approval history in one place

STAY CONNECTED
• Company news feed with announcements and comments
• Events and holidays at a glance
• In-app notification inbox for approvals and updates

AI ASSISTANT
• Ask HR questions in plain language and get instant answers about your attendance, leave and company policies
• The assistant only starts after you agree to its data-use terms

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Location is used only for attendance, only if you allow it, and is sent only when you punch in or out. No background tracking
• Data is encrypted in transit, and your employer's workspace is private to your organization

Available in English and Bengali.

name: You've Got Brains! Calm Quest
description:
When big mad or stressed feelings show up, the Brain Buddies are here to help. Children explore Brain Village and learn a simple path for big feelings: notice it, name it, calm the body, then choose.

- Alarm Tower: Amy Alarm helps kids find their body clues
- Spark Station: a feelings thermometer and "What lit my spark?"
- Vee's Calm Lagoon: balloon breaths, starfish hand breathing, and flower and candle breaths
- Wiggle Woods: shake it out, wall push, squeeze the lemons, stomp march and butterfly hug
- Choice Bridge: real-life stories with safe choices and a kind "redo"
- Hippo's Library: My Calm Plan, with body clues, sparks, favorite tools and safe grown-ups

Also inside:
- Calm Zones check-in: Too High, Just Right and Too Low
- Amy's alarm meter, which gets quieter with every calm tool
- A Calm Toolbox with every tool in one place
- A Grown-Up Guide: connect before you correct, calm before you reason, and when to reach out for extra support
- A grown-up corner in every place: what your child is learning there, how to help, and a moment for yourself
- A full grown-up Calm Quest through the same six places, for parents' own stress and anger, with a private grown-up journal
- "Add my own" body clues, calm tools, kind words and grown-up choices, in their own words
- Every line and story read aloud in a warm, gentle voice by Maxine Golden, so children who can't read yet can play too
- Magical sparkles and gentle chimes, with an option to turn sounds off

Children learn that anger is a normal feeling and that their alarm system is trying to protect them. There are no scores, penalties or countdowns.

From the creators of You've Got Brains! Created by Maxine Golden, Pre-Licensed MFT, Center for Parent Coaching, Brainspotting & Therapy.

Privacy: the app collects no data. Everything a child or grown-up chooses or writes stays only on their device. Links out of the app are protected by a grown-ups-only check.

This app is educational play for children and families. It does not replace individualized clinical care.

name: Yum Yum Garden
description:
Welcome to Yum Yum Garden! A storm left Nana's beautiful garden in ruins, and she needs your help to bring it back to life.

MERGE AND GROW
• Tap generators to grow seedlings, berries, veggies, bread and honey
• Drag two matching items together to make something better: seedlings become tulips, tulips become bouquets
• Merge next to the hedges to clear them and uncover hidden treasure

HELP YOUR NEIGHBORS
• Rosa, Leo, Nana and friends need flowers, fruit and treats
• Deliver their orders to earn coins and gems, and chase the gold orders for bigger rewards

RESTORE THE GARDEN
• Bring 12 gardens back to life, from the front yard and Candy Hill to Seashell Beach and Snowy Peak
• Finish the valley and blast off to two bonus stages: the Moon and Mars!
• Follow a heartwarming story as the whole valley returns
• Choose a style for every project you build: Classic, Pastel, Moonlight or Golden

COLLECT MYTHIC FRIENDS
• 100 adorable creature cards, from the cozy Mousibloom to the one-of-a-kind Mythic Donkicorn
• Every card has its own serial number; your first of each is a gold 1st Edition
• About one card in sixty is a rare Golden Harvest print, basking in a sunny garden
• Fill a page of ten friends and it turns gold, with a reward and a new phone wallpaper
• Trade with friends sitting next to you, just like real trading cards
• Move your favorite friends into your garden, dress them in costumes, and send friends gifts and garden visits

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
• Seasonal festivals with exclusive prizes, and a cozy holiday tune in December
• A weekly Sticker Book or Busy Bees event, and the Golden Seed mystery with a new chapter every week
• Daily quests, free gifts and a login streak
• A "Friend of the day" widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Game Center achievements, if you'd like them
• The garden changes with the real seasons and time of day

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• No ads. No tracking. Data Not Collected
• Card packs are earned by playing, never sold
• Optional in-app purchases ask a grown-up first
• In English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Italian and Chinese

Relaxing, no timers you have to beat, and playable in short breaks. Designed by Pauram.

name: Yutnori ABORRO
description:
Every throw brings a new possibility.
ABORRO Yutnori brings the classic board game to your iPhone with AI opponents, online multiplayer, and a board designed for thoughtful play.

Throw the sticks, move your pieces, and race to bring all four pieces home. Choose which piece to move, stack your pieces to advance together, capture opponents, and take shortcuts when the opportunity arises.

CHALLENGE AI
Choose from three difficulty levels. Learn the basics, explore different strategies, and challenge yourself as your confidence grows.

PLAY ONLINE
Create a room or join another player's room. Once everyone is ready, start the match. Piece positions, turns, throw results, and match results stay synchronized between players.

MAKE EVERY MOVE COUNT
Stack friendly pieces and move them together. Capture an opponent's pieces to send them back to the start. Plan around extra throws, branching paths, and the result that moves a piece one space backward.

REVIEW YOUR MATCHES
Step through the game record to revisit earlier moves. Look back at captures, route choices, and turning points before starting your next match.

A DISTINCTIVE BOARD
Enjoy a warm gold board, deep green backgrounds, and clearly marked pieces. Open the rules from the home screen whenever you want to review how to play.

FIVE LANGUAGE OPTIONS
Choose from five interface languages in the app's settings.

GETTING STARTED
Guest mode is available for AI matches and online rooms.
An internet connection is required for both AI gameplay and online multiplayer.

Your next match starts with a throw. Play ABORRO Yutnori.

name: ZDS Academy
description:
Mit ZDS Academy haben Sie das Programm, Ihr Ticket und die freigegebenen Unterlagen Ihrer ZDS-Veranstaltung auf dem Smartphone oder Tablet.

Richten Sie Ihren Zugang per QR-Code, QR-Code aus einem Foto oder Ticketlink aus Ihrer E-Mail ein. Nach der Bestätigung sehen Sie die Inhalte, die für Ihr Ticket freigeschaltet sind.

Je nach Veranstaltung können Sie:
• Ihr Ticket und Ihre gebuchten Veranstaltungstage aufrufen
• Das Programm mit Beitragsbeschreibungen und Referentenprofilen ansehen und zwischen parallelen Bühnen wechseln
• Fragen zu Vorträgen stellen, für Fragen abstimmen und an Umfragen teilnehmen
• Eine bereitgestellte Live-Übersetzung mit Text und Audio verfolgen
• Veranstaltungsmitteilungen lesen und auf Wunsch Push-Benachrichtigungen aktivieren
• Ihre digitale Visitenkarte ansehen und bearbeiten
• Handouts durchsuchen, PDFs ansehen und einzelne Dateien teilen oder speichern
• Alle freigegebenen Unterlagen als ZIP laden oder sich den persönlichen Download-Link an die eigene Ticket-E-Mail senden lassen
